name: lookup_start_env_var_ret
statement: !b1 b2 w. bir_env_lookup (start_env b1 b2 w) var_ret = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w))

name: lookup_start_env_var_cond1
statement: !b1 b2 w. bir_env_lookup (start_env b1 b2 w) var_cond1 = SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b b1))

name: lookup_start_env_var_cond2
statement: !b1 b2 w. bir_env_lookup (start_env b1 b2 w) var_cond2 = SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b b2))

name: and_not_exp_correct
statement:
!b1 b2 w. bir_compute_exp and_not_exp (start_env b1 b2 w) = 
    SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 (if b1 /\ b2 then w else ~w)))

name: var_cond1_def
statement: var_cond1 = BVar "r1"

name: var_cond2_def
statement: var_cond2 = BVar "r2"

name: var_ret_def
statement: var_ret = BVar "r3"

name: start_env_def
statement:
start_env b1 b2 w = 
  bir_env_update (bir_env_update 
      (bir_env_update bir_empty_env var_ret (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w))) 
    var_cond1 (BVal_Imm (bool2b b1))) var_cond2 (BVal_Imm (bool2b b2))

name: and_not_exp_def
statement:
and_not_exp = 
      BExp_IfThenElse (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And (BExp_Den var_cond1) (BExp_Den var_cond2)) 
        (BExp_Den var_ret) (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not (BExp_Den var_ret))

name: increment_exp_correct
statement: !w. bir_compute_exp increment_exp (start_env w) = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 (w + 1w)))

name: reg_var_def
statement: reg_var = BVar "r1"

name: start_env_def
statement: start_env w = bir_env_update bir_empty_env reg_var (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w))

name: increment_exp_def
statement:
increment_exp = 
    BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus
      (BExp_Den reg_var)
      (BExp_Const (Imm64 1w))

name: mem_var_def
statement: mem_var = BVar "MEM8"

name: mem_addr_def
statement: mem_addr w = BExp_Const (Imm64 w)

name: start_mem_def
statement: start_mem n1 n2 = BVal_Mem Bit64 Bit8 (FEMPTY |+ (n1, n2))

name: start_env_def
statement: start_env n1 n2 = bir_env_update bir_empty_env mem_var (start_mem n1 n2)

name: mem_incr_exp_def
statement:
mem_incr_exp w = 
  BExp_Store (BExp_Den mem_var) (mem_addr w) BEnd_BigEndian
    (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus (BExp_Const (Imm8 1w)) 
      (BExp_Load (BExp_Den mem_var) (mem_addr w) BEnd_BigEndian Bit8))

name: cv_sum_one_def
statement:
cv_sum_one = BCVExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus (BCVExp_Den (BVar "r0"))
    (BCVExp_Load (BCVExp_Den (BVar "MEM64")) (BCVExp_Den (BVar "r1")) BEnd_BigEndian Bit64)

name: cv_stmt_sum_one_def
statement: cv_stmt_sum_one = BCVStmt_Assign (BVar "r0") cv_sum_one

name: cv_incr_r1_def
statement:
cv_incr_r1 = BCVExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus 
      (BCVExp_Den (BVar "r1")) (BCVExp_Const (Imm64 1w))

name: cv_stmt_incr_r1_def
statement: cv_stmt_incr_r1 = BCVStmt_Assign (BVar "r1") cv_incr_r1

name: cv_condition_def
statement: cv_condition = BCVExp_BinPred BIExp_LessThan (BCVExp_Den (BVar "r1")) (BCVExp_Den (BVar "n"))

name: cv_block_cond_def
statement:
cv_block_cond = BCVBlock (BL_Label "cond") [] 
  (BCVStmt_CJmp cv_condition (BCVLE_Label (BL_Label "loop")) (BCVLE_Label (BL_Label "out")))

name: cv_block_loop_def
statement:
cv_block_loop = BCVBlock (BL_Label "loop") [cv_stmt_sum_one; cv_stmt_incr_r1]
    (BCVStmt_Jmp (BCVLE_Label (BL_Label "cond")))

name: cv_sum_list_program_def
statement: cv_sum_list_program = BirCVProgram [cv_block_cond; cv_block_loop]

name: cv_start_mem_aux_def
statement:
(cv_start_mem_aux alist 0 addr k = alist) /\
  (cv_start_mem_aux alist (SUC n) addr k = cv_start_mem_aux ((addr, k)::alist) n (addr+1) (k+1))

name: cv_start_mem_def
statement: cv_start_mem n = BCVVal_Mem Bit64 Bit64 (cv_start_mem_aux [] n 0 1)

name: cv_start_pc_def
statement: cv_start_pc = BCVProgramCounter (BL_Label "cond") 0

name: cv_start_env_def
statement:
cv_start_env n = 
  bir_cv_env_update
    (bir_cv_env_update
      (bir_cv_env_update 
        (bir_cv_env_update bir_cv_empty_env (BVar "MEM64") (cv_start_mem n)) 
        (BVar "r0") (BCVVal_Imm (Imm64 0w)))
      (BVar "r1") (BCVVal_Imm (Imm64 0w)))
    (BVar "n") (BCVVal_Imm (Imm64 (n2w n)))

name: cv_start_state_def
statement: cv_start_state n = BCVState cv_start_pc (cv_start_env n) BST_Running

name: sum_one_def
statement:
sum_one = BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus (BExp_Den (BVar "r0"))
    (BExp_Load (BExp_Den (BVar "MEM64")) (BExp_Den (BVar "r1")) BEnd_BigEndian Bit64)

name: stmt_sum_one_def
statement: stmt_sum_one = BStmt_Assign (BVar "r0") sum_one

name: incr_r1_def
statement:
incr_r1 = BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus 
      (BExp_Den (BVar "r1")) (BExp_Const (Imm64 1w))

name: stmt_incr_r1_def
statement: stmt_incr_r1 = BStmt_Assign (BVar "r1") incr_r1

name: condition_def
statement: condition = BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessThan (BExp_Den (BVar "r1")) (BExp_Den (BVar "n"))

name: block_cond_def
statement:
block_cond = <| bb_label := BL_Label "cond"; bb_statements := [];
    bb_last_statement := BStmt_CJmp condition (BLE_Label (BL_Label "loop")) (BLE_Label (BL_Label "out")) |>

name: block_loop_def
statement:
block_loop = <| bb_label := BL_Label "loop"; bb_statements := [stmt_sum_one; stmt_incr_r1];
    bb_last_statement := BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Label (BL_Label "cond")) |>

name: sum_list_program_def
statement: sum_list_program = BirProgram [block_cond; block_loop]

name: start_mem_aux_def
statement:
(start_mem_aux fmap 0 addr k = fmap) /\
  (start_mem_aux fmap (SUC n) addr k = start_mem_aux (fmap |+ (addr, k)) n (addr+1) (k+1))

name: start_mem_def
statement: start_mem n = BVal_Mem Bit64 Bit64 (start_mem_aux FEMPTY n 0 1)

name: start_pc_def
statement: start_pc = <| bpc_label := BL_Label "cond"; bpc_index := 0 |>

name: start_env_def
statement:
start_env n = 
  bir_env_update
    (bir_env_update
      (bir_env_update 
        (bir_env_update bir_empty_env (BVar "MEM64") (start_mem n)) 
        (BVar "r0") (BVal_Imm (Imm64 0w)))
      (BVar "r1") (BVal_Imm (Imm64 0w)))
    (BVar "n") (BVal_Imm (Imm64 (n2w n)))

name: start_state_def
statement:
start_state n = <| bst_pc := start_pc; bst_environ := (start_env n);
    bst_status := BST_Running |>

name: bool2b_T_eq_bir_cvT

name: from_to_cv_val
statement: !v. from_cv_val (to_cv_val v) = v

statement: !v. from_cv_val_option (to_cv_val_option v) = v

name: bir_cv_dest_bool_val_eq_dest_bool_val
statement:

name: bir_cvT_def
statement: bir_cvT = BCVVal_Imm (Imm1 1w)

name: bir_cvF_def
statement: bir_cvF = BCVVal_Imm (Imm1 0w)

name: bir_cv_dest_bool_val_def
statement:
(bir_cv_dest_bool_val (BCVVal_Imm (Imm1 w)) = SOME (w = 1w)) /\
  (bir_cv_dest_bool_val _ = NONE)

name: cv_val_from_imm_option_def
statement:
(cv_val_from_imm_option NONE = NONE) /\
  (cv_val_from_imm_option (SOME imm) = SOME (BCVVal_Imm imm))

name: from_cv_val_def
statement:
(from_cv_val (BCVVal_Imm imm) = BVal_Imm imm) /\
  (from_cv_val (BCVVal_Mem aty rty mmap_alist) = 
    (BVal_Mem aty rty (alist_to_fmap mmap_alist)))

name: to_cv_val_def
statement:
(to_cv_val (BVal_Imm imm) = BCVVal_Imm imm) /\
  (to_cv_val (BVal_Mem aty rty mmap) = 
    (BCVVal_Mem aty rty (fmap_to_alist mmap)))

name: from_cv_val_option_def
statement:
(from_cv_val_option NONE = NONE) /\
  (from_cv_val_option (SOME cv_val) = SOME (from_cv_val cv_val))

name: to_cv_val_option_def
statement:
(to_cv_val_option NONE = NONE) /\
  (to_cv_val_option (SOME v) = SOME (to_cv_val v))

name: from_cv_exp_def
statement:
(from_cv_exp (BCVExp_Const c) = BExp_Const c) /\
  (from_cv_exp (BCVExp_MemConst aty vty mmap_alist) = 
    (BExp_MemConst aty vty (alist_to_fmap mmap_alist))) /\
  (from_cv_exp (BCVExp_Den var) = BExp_Den var) /\
  (from_cv_exp (BCVExp_BinExp binexp e1 e2) = 
    (BExp_BinExp binexp (from_cv_exp e1) (from_cv_exp e2))) /\
  (from_cv_exp (BCVExp_UnaryExp unaryexp e) = 
    (BExp_UnaryExp unaryexp (from_cv_exp e))) /\
  (from_cv_exp (BCVExp_BinPred binpred e1 e2) = 
    (BExp_BinPred binpred (from_cv_exp e1) (from_cv_exp e2))) /\
  (from_cv_exp (BCVExp_IfThenElse e1 e2 e3) = 
    (BExp_IfThenElse (from_cv_exp e1) (from_cv_exp e2) (from_cv_exp e3))) /\
  (from_cv_exp (BCVExp_Load e1 e2 en rty) = 
    (BExp_Load (from_cv_exp e1) (from_cv_exp e2) en rty)) /\
  (from_cv_exp (BCVExp_Store e1 e2 en e3) = 
    (BExp_Store (from_cv_exp e1) (from_cv_exp e2) en (from_cv_exp e3)))

name: to_cv_exp_def
statement:
(to_cv_exp (BExp_Const c) = BCVExp_Const c) /\
  (to_cv_exp (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) = 
    (BCVExp_MemConst aty vty (fmap_to_alist mmap))) /\
  (to_cv_exp (BExp_Den var) = BCVExp_Den var) /\
  (to_cv_exp (BExp_BinExp binexp e1 e2) = 
    (BCVExp_BinExp binexp (to_cv_exp e1) (to_cv_exp e2))) /\
  (to_cv_exp (BExp_UnaryExp unaryexp e) = 
    (BCVExp_UnaryExp unaryexp (to_cv_exp e))) /\
  (to_cv_exp (BExp_BinPred binpred e1 e2) = 
    (BCVExp_BinPred binpred (to_cv_exp e1) (to_cv_exp e2))) /\
  (to_cv_exp (BExp_IfThenElse e1 e2 e3) = 
    (BCVExp_IfThenElse (to_cv_exp e1) (to_cv_exp e2) (to_cv_exp e3))) /\
  (to_cv_exp (BExp_Load e1 e2 en rty) = 
    (BCVExp_Load (to_cv_exp e1) (to_cv_exp e2) en rty)) /\
  (to_cv_exp (BExp_Store e1 e2 en e3) = 
    (BCVExp_Store (to_cv_exp e1) (to_cv_exp e2) en (to_cv_exp e3)))

name: bir_cv_compute_binexp_eq_compute_binexp
statement:
!binexp v1 v2.

     (bir_compute_binexp binexp (from_cv_val_option v1) (from_cv_val_option v2))

name: bir_cv_compute_binexp_def
statement:
(bir_cv_compute_binexp binexp (SOME (BCVVal_Imm imm1)) (SOME (BCVVal_Imm imm2)) =
    (cv_val_from_imm_option (bir_compute_binexp_imm binexp imm1 imm2))) /\
  (bir_cv_compute_binexp _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_cv_compute_binpred_eq_compute_binpred
statement:
!binpred v1 v2. 
  from_cv_val_option (bir_cv_compute_binpred binpred v1 v2) = 
    (bir_compute_binpred binpred (from_cv_val_option v1) (from_cv_val_option v2))

name: bir_cv_compute_binpred_def
statement:
(bir_cv_compute_binpred binpred (SOME (BCVVal_Imm imm1)) (SOME (BCVVal_Imm imm2)) =
    (SOME (BCVVal_Imm (bool2b (bir_compute_binpred_imm binpred imm1 imm2))))) /\
  (bir_cv_compute_binpred _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_compute_exp_eq_cv_compute_exp
statement:
!cv_env cv_e. bir_compute_exp (from_cv_exp cv_e) (from_cv_env cv_env) = 
    from_cv_val_option (bir_cv_compute_exp cv_e cv_env)

name: bir_cv_compute_exp_def
statement:
(bir_cv_compute_exp (BCVExp_Const n) env = SOME (BCVVal_Imm n)) /\

  (bir_cv_compute_exp (BCVExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) env = SOME (BCVVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) /\

  (bir_cv_compute_exp (BCVExp_Den v) env = bir_cv_env_lookup env v) /\

  
  

  (bir_cv_compute_exp (BCVExp_UnaryExp et e) env = (
     bir_cv_compute_unaryexp et (bir_cv_compute_exp e env))) /\

  (bir_cv_compute_exp (BCVExp_BinExp et e1 e2) env = (
     bir_cv_compute_binexp et (bir_cv_compute_exp e1 env) (bir_cv_compute_exp e2 env))) /\

  (bir_cv_compute_exp (BCVExp_BinPred pt e1 e2) env = (
     bir_cv_compute_binpred pt (bir_cv_compute_exp e1 env) (bir_cv_compute_exp e2 env))) /\
  
  
  
  
  
  (bir_cv_compute_exp (BCVExp_IfThenElse c et ef) env =
     bir_cv_compute_ifthenelse (bir_cv_compute_exp c env) (bir_cv_compute_exp et env) (bir_cv_compute_exp ef env)
  ) /\

  (bir_cv_compute_exp (BCVExp_Load mem_e a_e en ty) env =
     bir_cv_compute_load (bir_cv_compute_exp mem_e env) (bir_cv_compute_exp a_e env) en ty) /\

  (bir_cv_compute_exp (BCVExp_Store mem_e a_e en v_e) env =
     bir_cv_compute_store (bir_cv_compute_exp mem_e env) (bir_cv_compute_exp a_e env) en (bir_cv_compute_exp v_e env))

statement: !cvenv. env_eq (from_cv_env cvenv) cvenv

name: bir_cv_env_update_def
statement: bir_cv_env_update (BCVEnv env) (BVar id) v = BCVEnv ((id, v)::env)

name: from_cv_env_def
statement:
from_cv_env (BCVEnv []) = bir_empty_env /\
  from_cv_env (BCVEnv (t::q)) = 
    bir_env_update (from_cv_env (BCVEnv q)) (BVar (FST t)) (from_cv_val (SND t))

name: env_eq_def

env_eq env cv_env = 
    !var. bir_env_lookup env var = from_cv_val_option (bir_cv_env_lookup cv_env var)

name: bir_cv_compute_ifthenelse_eq_compute_ifthenelse
statement:
!b v1 v2.
    from_cv_val_option (bir_cv_compute_ifthenelse b v1 v2) =
      (bir_compute_ifthenelse (from_cv_val_option b) (from_cv_val_option v1) (from_cv_val_option v2))

name: bir_cv_compute_ifthenelse_def
statement:
bir_cv_compute_ifthenelse b v1 v2 = 
    if b = SOME bir_cvT then v1 
    else if b = SOME bir_cvF then v2
    else NONE

name: cv_n2l_eq_n2l_2
statement: !n. cv_n2l n = n2l 2 n

statement:
!aty vty mmap_alist addr n.
    bir_cv_load_splits_from_mmap aty vty mmap_alist addr n = 
    bir_load_splits_from_mmap aty vty (alist_to_fmap mmap_alist) addr n

statement:
!vty rty aty mmap_alist en addr.
    bir_cv_compute_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap_alist en addr =
      bir_compute_load_from_mem vty rty aty (alist_to_fmap mmap_alist) en addr

name: bir_cv_compute_load_eq_compute_load
statement:
!v_mem v_addr en rty.
  from_cv_val_option (bir_cv_compute_load v_mem v_addr en rty) =
    (bir_compute_load (from_cv_val_option v_mem) (from_cv_val_option v_addr) en rty)

name: bir_cv_update_mmap_eq_update_mmap
statement:
!aty mmap_alist a l.
    alist_to_fmap (bir_cv_update_mmap aty mmap_alist a l) =
      bir_update_mmap aty (alist_to_fmap mmap_alist) a l

name: bir_cv_compute_store_eq_compute_store
statement:
!v_mem v_addr en result.
    from_cv_val_option (bir_cv_compute_store v_mem v_addr en result) =
    (bir_compute_store (from_cv_val_option v_mem) (from_cv_val_option v_addr) en (from_cv_val_option result))

name: bir_cv_load_mmap_def
statement:
bir_cv_load_mmap (mmap_alist : (num # num) list) a =
      case ALOOKUP mmap_alist a of
        | NONE => 0
        | SOME v => v

name: cv_n2l_def
statement: cv_n2l n = if n < 2 then [n MOD 2] else (n MOD 2) :: cv_n2l (n DIV 2)

name: cv_n2v_def
statement: cv_n2v n = boolify [] (cv_n2l n)

name: bir_cv_load_bitstring_from_mmap_def
statement:
bir_cv_load_bitstring_from_mmap vty mmap (a:num) =
    fixwidth (size_of_bir_immtype vty) (cv_n2v (bir_cv_load_mmap mmap a))

name: bir_cv_load_splits_from_mmap_def
statement:
bir_cv_load_splits_from_mmap aty vty mmap addr n =
    (MAP (\k. bir_cv_load_bitstring_from_mmap vty mmap (bir_mem_addr aty (addr + k))) (COUNT_LIST n))

name: bir_cv_compute_load_from_mem_def
statement:
bir_cv_compute_load_from_mem
  (vty : bir_immtype_t) (rty : bir_immtype_t) (aty : bir_immtype_t) (mmap_alist : (num # num) list) (en: bir_endian_t) (addr:num) =

   case (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty) of
    | NONE => NONE
    | SOME (n:num) => (
        let vs = bir_cv_load_splits_from_mmap aty vty mmap_alist addr n in
        let vs' = (case en of BEnd_LittleEndian => SOME (REVERSE vs)
                          |  BEnd_BigEndian => SOME vs
                          |  BEnd_NoEndian => if (n = 1) then SOME vs else NONE) in
        case vs' of NONE => NONE
                 |  SOME vs'' => SOME (bir_mem_concat vs'' rty)
   )

name: bir_cv_compute_load_def
statement:
(bir_cv_compute_load (SOME (BCVVal_Mem aty vty mmap_alist)) (SOME (BCVVal_Imm addr)) en rty = 
    cv_val_from_imm_option (bir_cv_compute_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap_alist en (b2n addr))) /\
  (bir_cv_compute_load _ _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_cv_update_mmap_def
statement:
(bir_cv_update_mmap aty mmap_alist a [] = mmap_alist) /\
  (bir_cv_update_mmap aty mmap_alist a (v::vs) =
    bir_cv_update_mmap aty (((bir_mem_addr aty a), v2n v)::mmap_alist) (SUC a) vs)

name: bir_cv_compute_store_in_mem_def
statement:
bir_cv_compute_store_in_mem
  (vty : bir_immtype_t) (aty : bir_immtype_t) (result : bir_imm_t) (mmap_alist : (num # num) list) (en: bir_endian_t) (addr:num) =

   let rty = type_of_bir_imm result in
   case (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty) of
    | NONE => NONE
    | SOME (n:num) => (
      case  (bitstring_split (size_of_bir_immtype vty) (b2v result)) of
        | NONE => NONE
        | SOME vs =>
        let vs' = (case en of BEnd_LittleEndian => SOME (REVERSE vs)
                          |  BEnd_BigEndian => SOME vs
                          |  BEnd_NoEndian => if (n = 1) then SOME vs else NONE) in

        case vs' of NONE => NONE
                 |  SOME vs'' => SOME (BCVVal_Mem aty vty (bir_cv_update_mmap aty mmap_alist addr vs''))
   )

name: bir_cv_compute_store_def
statement:
(bir_cv_compute_store (SOME (BCVVal_Mem aty vty mmap_alist)) (SOME (BCVVal_Imm addr)) en (SOME (BCVVal_Imm result)) = 
    bir_cv_compute_store_in_mem vty aty result mmap_alist en (b2n addr)) /\
  (bir_cv_compute_store _ _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_cv_state_is_terminated_eq_state_is_terminated
statement:
!cv_st. (bir_cv_state_is_terminated cv_st) = 
    bir_state_is_terminated (from_cv_state cv_st)

name: INDEX_FIND_from_cv_block
statement:
!n P l. INDEX_FIND n P (MAP from_cv_block l) = 
    from_num_cv_block_option (INDEX_FIND n (\x. P (from_cv_block x)) l)

name: bir_cv_get_current_statement_eq_get_current_statement
statement:
!cv_prog pc. from_cv_stmt_option (bir_cv_get_current_statement cv_prog pc) =
    bir_get_current_statement (from_cv_program cv_prog) (from_cv_programcounter pc)

name: bir_cv_compute_label_exp_eq_compute_label_exp
statement:
!cv_le cv_env.
    bir_cv_compute_label_exp cv_le cv_env = 
      bir_compute_label_exp (from_cv_label_exp cv_le) (from_cv_env cv_env)

name: bir_is_label_in_program_eq_MEM
statement:
!l cv_prog.
    is_label_in_program l cv_prog = 
      MEM l (bir_labels_of_program (from_cv_program cv_prog))

name: bir_cv_block_pc_eq_block_pc
statement: !l. from_cv_programcounter (bir_cv_block_pc l) = bir_block_pc l

name: bir_cv_jmp_to_label_eq_jmp_to_label
statement:
!cv_prog l cv_st. 
  from_cv_state (bir_cv_jmp_to_label cv_prog l cv_st) =
    bir_jmp_to_label (from_cv_program cv_prog) l (from_cv_state cv_st)

name: bir_cv_compute_stmt_jmp_eq_compute_stmt_jmp
statement:
!cv_prog cv_le cv_st.
    from_cv_state (bir_cv_compute_stmt_jmp cv_prog cv_le cv_st) =
      bir_compute_stmt_jmp (from_cv_program cv_prog) (from_cv_label_exp cv_le) (from_cv_state cv_st)

name: bir_cv_compute_stmt_cjmp_eq_compute_stmt_cjmp
statement:
!cv_prog cv_cexp cv_le1 cv_le2 cv_st.
    from_cv_state (bir_cv_compute_stmt_cjmp cv_prog cv_cexp cv_le1 cv_le2 cv_st) = 
    bir_compute_stmt_cjmp (from_cv_program cv_prog) (from_cv_exp cv_cexp)
        (from_cv_label_exp cv_le1) (from_cv_label_exp cv_le2)(from_cv_state cv_st)

name: bir_cv_compute_stmtE_eq_compute_stmtE
statement:
!cv_prog cv_stmt cv_st. from_cv_state (bir_cv_compute_stmtE cv_prog cv_stmt cv_st) =
    bir_compute_stmtE (from_cv_program cv_prog) (from_cv_stmt_end cv_stmt) (from_cv_state cv_st)

name: bir_cv_compute_stmt_assign_eq_compute_stmt_assign
statement:
!var cv_exp cv_st . from_cv_state (bir_cv_compute_stmt_assign var cv_exp cv_st) = 
    bir_compute_stmt_assign var (from_cv_exp cv_exp) (from_cv_state cv_st)

name: bir_cv_compute_stmtB_eq_compute_stmtB
statement:
!cv_stmt cv_st. from_cv_state (bir_cv_compute_stmtB cv_stmt cv_st) =
    bir_compute_stmtB (from_cv_stmt_basic cv_stmt) (from_cv_state cv_st)

name: bir_cv_pc_next_eq_pc_next
statement: !b. from_cv_programcounter (bir_cv_pc_next b) = bir_pc_next (from_cv_programcounter b)

name: bir_cv_state_next_eq_state_next
statement: !cv_st. from_cv_state (bir_cv_state_next cv_st) = bir_state_next (from_cv_state cv_st)

name: bir_cv_compute_stmt_eq_compute_stmt
statement:
!cv_prog cv_st cv_stmt. from_cv_state (bir_cv_compute_stmt cv_prog cv_stmt cv_st) = 
    bir_compute_stmt (from_cv_program cv_prog) (from_cv_stmt cv_stmt) (from_cv_state cv_st)

name: bir_cv_compute_step_eq_compute_exp
statement:
!cv_p cv_st. from_cv_state (bir_cv_compute_step cv_p cv_st) =
   bir_compute_step (from_cv_program cv_p) (from_cv_state cv_st)

name: bir_cv_block_get_label_def
statement: bir_cv_block_get_label (BCVBlock label _ _) = label

name: bir_cv_block_get_stmts_def
statement: bir_cv_block_get_stmts (BCVBlock _ stmts _) = stmts

name: bir_cv_block_get_end_def
statement: bir_cv_block_get_end (BCVBlock _ _ end_stmt) = end_stmt

name: bir_cv_programcounter_get_label_def
statement: bir_cv_programcounter_get_label (BCVProgramCounter label _) = label

name: bir_cv_programcounter_get_index_def
statement: bir_cv_programcounter_get_index (BCVProgramCounter _ index) = index

name: bir_cv_state_get_pc_def
statement: bir_cv_state_get_pc (BCVState pc _ _) = pc

name: bir_cv_state_get_environ_def
statement: bir_cv_state_get_environ (BCVState _ env _) = env

name: bir_cv_state_get_status_def
statement: bir_cv_state_get_status (BCVState _ _ status) = status

name: bir_cv_get_program_block_info_by_label_def
statement:
bir_cv_get_program_block_info_by_label
  (BirCVProgram p) l = INDEX_FIND 0 (\(x:bir_cv_block_t). (bir_cv_block_get_label x) = l) p

name: bir_cv_state_is_terminated_def
statement:
bir_cv_state_is_terminated (BCVState _ _ status) =
  (status <> BST_Running)

name: bir_cv_state_set_failed_def
statement:
bir_cv_state_set_failed (BCVState pc env status) =
    BCVState pc env BST_Failed

name: bir_cv_state_set_typeerror_def
statement:
bir_cv_state_set_typeerror (BCVState pc env status) =
    BCVState pc env BST_TypeError

name: bir_cv_get_current_statement_def
statement:
bir_cv_get_current_statement p pc = 
    case (bir_cv_get_program_block_info_by_label p (bir_cv_programcounter_get_label pc)) of 
      | NONE => NONE
      | SOME (_, bl) => if ((bir_cv_programcounter_get_index pc) < LENGTH (bir_cv_block_get_stmts bl)) 
                        then SOME (BCVStmtB (EL (bir_cv_programcounter_get_index pc) (bir_cv_block_get_stmts bl))) 
                        else (if (bir_cv_programcounter_get_index pc) = LENGTH (bir_cv_block_get_stmts bl) 
                              then SOME (BCVStmtE (bir_cv_block_get_end bl)) 
                              else NONE)

name: bir_cv_labels_of_program_def
statement:
bir_cv_labels_of_program (BirCVProgram p) =
  MAP bir_cv_block_get_label p

name: is_label_in_program_aux_def
is_label_in_program_def
statement: is_label_in_program label (BirCVProgram p) = is_label_in_program_aux label p

name: bir_cv_block_pc_def
statement: bir_cv_block_pc label = BCVProgramCounter label 0

name: bir_cv_pc_next_def
statement: bir_cv_pc_next (BCVProgramCounter label index) = (BCVProgramCounter label (SUC index))

name: bir_cv_state_next_def
statement:
bir_cv_state_next (BCVState pc env status) =
     if (bir_cv_state_is_terminated (BCVState pc env status)) then (BCVState pc env status) else
       (BCVState (bir_cv_pc_next pc) env status)

name: bir_cv_jmp_to_label_def
statement:
bir_cv_jmp_to_label prog
   (l : bir_label_t) (BCVState pc env status) =
    if is_label_in_program l prog then
      (BCVState (bir_cv_block_pc l) env status)
    else (BCVState pc env (BST_JumpOutside l))

name: bir_cv_compute_label_exp_def
statement:
(bir_cv_compute_label_exp (BCVLE_Label l) env = SOME l) /\
   (bir_cv_compute_label_exp (BCVLE_Exp e) env = case bir_cv_compute_exp e env of
      | SOME (BCVVal_Imm i) => SOME (BL_Address i)
      | _ => NONE
   )

name: bir_cv_compute_stmt_assign_def
statement:
bir_cv_compute_stmt_assign v ex (BCVState pc env status) =
   case bir_cv_compute_exp ex env of
     | SOME va => BCVState pc (bir_cv_env_update env v va) status
     | NONE => bir_cv_state_set_typeerror (BCVState pc env status)

name: bir_cv_compute_stmtB_def
statement: (bir_cv_compute_stmtB (BCVStmt_Assign v ex) st = (bir_cv_compute_stmt_assign v ex st))

name: bir_cv_compute_stmt_jmp_def
statement:
bir_cv_compute_stmt_jmp p le (st : bir_cv_state_t) =
    case bir_cv_compute_label_exp le (bir_cv_state_get_environ st) of
      | NONE => bir_cv_state_set_typeerror st
      | SOME l => bir_cv_jmp_to_label p l st

name: bir_cv_compute_stmt_cjmp_def
statement:
bir_cv_compute_stmt_cjmp p ec l1 l2 (st : bir_cv_state_t) =
    case bir_cv_compute_exp ec (bir_cv_state_get_environ st) of 
      | NONE => bir_cv_state_set_typeerror st
      | SOME v => case bir_cv_dest_bool_val v of
        | SOME T => bir_cv_compute_stmt_jmp p l1 st
        | SOME F => bir_cv_compute_stmt_jmp p l2 st 
        | NONE => bir_cv_state_set_typeerror st

name: bir_cv_compute_stmtE_def
statement:
(bir_cv_compute_stmtE p (BCVStmt_Jmp l) st = bir_cv_compute_stmt_jmp p l st) /\
  (bir_cv_compute_stmtE p (BCVStmt_CJmp e l1 l2) st = bir_cv_compute_stmt_cjmp p e l1 l2 st)

name: bir_cv_compute_stmt_def
statement:
(bir_cv_compute_stmt (p:bir_cv_program_t) (BCVStmtB (bst:bir_cv_stmt_basic_t)) st =
     let st' = bir_cv_compute_stmtB bst st in bir_cv_state_next st') /\
  (bir_cv_compute_stmt p (BCVStmtE bst) st = bir_cv_compute_stmtE p bst st)

name: bir_cv_compute_step_def
statement:
bir_cv_compute_step p state =
  if (bir_cv_state_is_terminated state) then state else
  case (bir_cv_get_current_statement p (bir_cv_state_get_pc state)) of
    | NONE => bir_cv_state_set_failed state
    | SOME stm => (bir_cv_compute_stmt p stm state)

name: from_cv_stmt_basic_def
statement: (from_cv_stmt_basic (BCVStmt_Assign var cv_exp) = (BStmt_Assign var (from_cv_exp cv_exp)))

name: from_cv_label_exp_def
statement:
(from_cv_label_exp (BCVLE_Label label) = BLE_Label label) /\
  (from_cv_label_exp (BCVLE_Exp cv_exp) = BLE_Exp (from_cv_exp cv_exp))

name: from_cv_stmt_end_def
statement:
(from_cv_stmt_end (BCVStmt_Jmp cv_le) = BStmt_Jmp (from_cv_label_exp cv_le)) /\
    (from_cv_stmt_end (BCVStmt_CJmp cv_cexp cv_le1 cv_le2) = 
      BStmt_CJmp (from_cv_exp cv_cexp) (from_cv_label_exp cv_le1) (from_cv_label_exp cv_le2))

name: from_cv_stmt_def
statement:
(from_cv_stmt (BCVStmtB cv_stmt) = BStmtB (from_cv_stmt_basic cv_stmt)) /\
  (from_cv_stmt (BCVStmtE cv_stmt) = BStmtE (from_cv_stmt_end cv_stmt))

name: from_cv_stmt_option_def
statement:
(from_cv_stmt_option (SOME v) = SOME (from_cv_stmt v)) /\
  (from_cv_stmt_option NONE = NONE)

name: from_cv_block_def
from_cv_program_def
statement: from_cv_program (BirCVProgram blist) = BirProgram (MAP from_cv_block blist)

name: from_cv_programcounter_def
statement:
from_cv_programcounter (BCVProgramCounter label index) = 
    <| bpc_label := label; bpc_index := index |>

name: from_cv_state_def
from_num_cv_block_option_def
statement:
(from_num_cv_block_option NONE = NONE) /\
  (from_num_cv_block_option (SOME (n:num,cv_b)) = SOME (n, from_cv_block cv_b))

name: bir_cv_compute_unaryexp_eq_compute_unaryexp
statement:
!unaryexp v. 
  from_cv_val_option (bir_cv_compute_unaryexp unaryexp v) = 
    (bir_compute_unaryexp unaryexp (from_cv_val_option v))

name: bir_cv_compute_unaryexp_def
statement:
(bir_cv_compute_unaryexp unaryexp (SOME (BCVVal_Imm imm1)) = 
    (cv_val_from_imm_option (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm unaryexp imm1))) /\
  (bir_cv_compute_unaryexp _ _ = NONE)

name: bool2w_def
statement: bool2w b = (if b then 1w else 0w):word1

name: bool2b_def
statement: bool2b b = Imm1 (bool2w b)

name: birT_def
statement: birT = BVal_Imm (Imm1 1w)

name: birF_def
statement: birF = BVal_Imm (Imm1 0w)

name: bir_dest_bool_val_def
statement:
(bir_dest_bool_val (BVal_Imm (Imm1 w)) = SOME (w = 1w)) /\
  (bir_dest_bool_val _ = NONE)

name: val_from_imm_option_def
statement:
(val_from_imm_option NONE = NONE) /\
  (val_from_imm_option (SOME imm) = SOME (BVal_Imm imm))

name: bir_env_lookup_def
statement: bir_env_lookup (BEnv env) (BVar id) = env id

name: bir_env_lookup_rel_def
statement: bir_env_lookup_rel (BEnv env) (BVar id) a = (env id = (SOME a))

name: bir_empty_env_def
statement: bir_empty_env = BEnv (\x. NONE)

name: bir_env_update_def
statement: bir_env_update ((BEnv env):bir_var_environment_t) (BVar id) v = BEnv ((id =+ SOME v) env)

name: size_of_bir_immtype_def
statement:
(size_of_bir_immtype Bit1 = 1) /\
  (size_of_bir_immtype Bit8 = 8) /\
  (size_of_bir_immtype Bit16 = 16) /\
  (size_of_bir_immtype Bit32 = 32) /\
  (size_of_bir_immtype Bit64 = 64) /\
  (size_of_bir_immtype Bit128 = 128)

name: type_of_bir_imm_def
statement:
(type_of_bir_imm (Imm1 w) = Bit1) /\
  (type_of_bir_imm (Imm8 w) = Bit8) /\
  (type_of_bir_imm (Imm16 w) = Bit16) /\
  (type_of_bir_imm (Imm32 w) = Bit32) /\
  (type_of_bir_imm (Imm64 w) = Bit64) /\
  (type_of_bir_imm (Imm128 w) = Bit128)

name: type_of_bir_val_def
statement:
(type_of_bir_val (BVal_Imm imm) = (BType_Imm (type_of_bir_imm imm))) /\
  (type_of_bir_val (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap) = (BType_Mem aty vty) )

name: bir_binexp_get_oper_def
statement:
(bir_binexp_get_oper BIExp_And = word_and) /\
  (bir_binexp_get_oper BIExp_Plus = word_add)

name: bir_unaryexp_get_oper_def
statement:
(bir_unaryexp_get_oper BIExp_Not = word_1comp) /\
  (bir_unaryexp_get_oper BIExp_ChangeSign = word_2comp)

name: bir_binpred_get_oper_def
statement:
(bir_binpred_get_oper BIExp_Equal = $=) /\
  (bir_binpred_get_oper BIExp_LessThan = word_lo)

name: n2bs_def
statement:
(n2bs n Bit1   = Imm1   (n2w n)) /\
  (n2bs n Bit8   = Imm8   (n2w n)) /\
  (n2bs n Bit16  = Imm16  (n2w n)) /\
  (n2bs n Bit32  = Imm32  (n2w n)) /\
  (n2bs n Bit64  = Imm64  (n2w n)) /\
  (n2bs n Bit128 = Imm128 (n2w n))

name: v2bs_def
statement: v2bs v s = n2bs (v2n v) s

name: b2n_def
statement:
(b2n ( Imm1   w ) = w2n w) /\
  (b2n ( Imm8   w ) = w2n w) /\
  (b2n ( Imm16  w ) = w2n w) /\
  (b2n ( Imm32  w ) = w2n w) /\
  (b2n ( Imm64  w ) = w2n w) /\
  (b2n ( Imm128 w ) = w2n w)

name: b2v_def
statement:
(b2v ( Imm1   w ) = w2v w) /\
  (b2v ( Imm8   w ) = w2v w) /\
  (b2v ( Imm16  w ) = w2v w) /\
  (b2v ( Imm32  w ) = w2v w) /\
  (b2v ( Imm64  w ) = w2v w) /\
  (b2v ( Imm128 w ) = w2v w)

name: bitstring_split_aux_def
statement:
(bitstring_split_aux 0 acc bs = NONE) /\
  (bitstring_split_aux n acc [] = SOME $ REVERSE acc) /\
  (bitstring_split_aux n acc bs =
    bitstring_split_aux n ((TAKE n bs)::acc) (DROP n bs))

name: bitstring_split_def
statement: bitstring_split n bs = bitstring_split_aux n [] bs

name: is_exp_well_typed_def
statement: is_exp_well_typed env exp = ?ty. type_of_bir_exp env exp ty

name: bir_load_mmap_def
statement:
bir_load_mmap (mmap: num |-> num) a =
      case FLOOKUP mmap a of
        | NONE => 0
        | SOME v => v

name: bir_mem_concat_def
statement: bir_mem_concat vl rty = v2bs (FLAT vl) rty

name: bir_mem_addr_def
statement: bir_mem_addr aty a = MOD_2EXP (size_of_bir_immtype aty) a

name: bir_number_of_mem_splits_def
statement:
bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty =
    if ((size_of_bir_immtype rty) MOD (size_of_bir_immtype vty) = 0) then
      if ((size_of_bir_immtype rty) DIV (size_of_bir_immtype vty) <= 
        2 **(size_of_bir_immtype aty)) then
          SOME ((size_of_bir_immtype rty) DIV (size_of_bir_immtype vty))
      else NONE
    else NONE

name: bir_load_bitstring_from_mmap_def
statement:
bir_load_bitstring_from_mmap vty mmap (a:num) =
    fixwidth (size_of_bir_immtype vty) (n2v (bir_load_mmap mmap a))

name: bir_load_splits_from_mmap_def
statement:
bir_load_splits_from_mmap aty vty mmap addr n =
    (MAP (\k. bir_load_bitstring_from_mmap vty mmap (bir_mem_addr aty (addr + k))) (COUNT_LIST n))

name: bir_eval_load_def
statement:
(bir_eval_load (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap) (BVal_Imm addr) en rty v = 
    bir_eval_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap en (b2n addr) v) /\
  (bir_eval_load _ _ _ _ _ = F)

name: bir_update_mmap_def
statement:
(bir_update_mmap aty mmap a [] = mmap) /\
  (bir_update_mmap aty mmap a (v::vs) =
    bir_update_mmap aty (FUPDATE mmap ((bir_mem_addr aty a), v2n v)) (SUC a) vs)

name: bir_eval_store_def
statement:
(bir_eval_store (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap) (BVal_Imm addr) en (BVal_Imm result) v = 
    bir_eval_store_in_mem vty aty result mmap en (b2n addr) v) /\
  (bir_eval_store _ _ _ _ _ = F)

name: bir_pc_next_def
statement: bir_pc_next pc = pc with bpc_index updated_by SUC

name: bir_get_program_block_info_by_label_def
statement:
bir_get_program_block_info_by_label
  (BirProgram p) l = INDEX_FIND 0 (\(x:bir_block_t). x.bb_label = l) p

name: bir_state_is_terminated_def
statement:
bir_state_is_terminated st =
  (st.bst_status <> BST_Running)

name: bir_state_set_failed_def
statement:
bir_state_set_failed st =
  (st with bst_status := BST_Failed)

name: bir_state_set_typeerror_def
statement:
bir_state_set_typeerror st =
  (st with bst_status := BST_TypeError)

name: bir_get_current_statement_def
statement:
bir_get_current_statement p pc = 
    case (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p pc.bpc_label) of 
      | NONE => NONE
      | SOME (_, bl) => if (pc.bpc_index < LENGTH bl.bb_statements) 
                        then SOME (BStmtB (EL (pc.bpc_index) bl.bb_statements)) 
                        else (if pc.bpc_index = LENGTH bl.bb_statements 
                              then SOME (BStmtE bl.bb_last_statement) 
                              else NONE)

name: bir_labels_of_program_def
statement:
bir_labels_of_program (BirProgram p) =
  MAP (\bl. bl.bb_label) p

name: bir_stmts_of_block_def
statement:
bir_stmts_of_block b = 
    (BStmtE b.bb_last_statement) :: MAP (\bst. (BStmtB bst)) b.bb_statements

name: bir_stmts_of_program_def
statement:
bir_stmts_of_program (BirProgram blist) = 
  FLAT (MAP (\bl. bir_stmts_of_block bl) blist)

name: bir_block_pc_def
statement: bir_block_pc l = <| bpc_label := l; bpc_index := 0 |>

name: bir_state_next_def
statement:
bir_state_next st =
     if (bir_state_is_terminated st) then st else st with bst_pc updated_by bir_pc_next

name: bir_jmp_to_label_def
statement:
bir_jmp_to_label p
   (l : bir_label_t) (st : bir_state_t) =
    if (MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p)) then
      st with bst_pc := bir_block_pc l
    else (st with bst_status := (BST_JumpOutside l))

name: bir_eval_label_exp_def
statement:
(bir_eval_label_exp (BLE_Label l) env l' = (l = l')) /\
  (bir_eval_label_exp (BLE_Exp e) env (BL_Address i) = bir_eval_exp env e (BVal_Imm i)) /\
  (bir_eval_label_exp _ _ _ = F)

name: bir_eval_stmtB_def
statement:
(bir_eval_stmtB (BStmt_Assign v ex) st st' = 
    (?va. (bir_eval_exp st.bst_environ ex va) 
    /\ (st' = (st with bst_environ := (bir_env_update st.bst_environ v va)))))

name: bir_eval_stmt_jmp_def
statement:
bir_eval_stmt_jmp p le (st : bir_state_t) st' =
    (?l. bir_eval_label_exp le st.bst_environ l 
    /\ bir_jmp_to_label p l st = st')

name: bir_eval_stmt_cjmp_def
statement:
bir_eval_stmt_cjmp p ec l1 l2 (st : bir_state_t) st' =
    (if bir_eval_exp st.bst_environ ec birT then 
      bir_eval_stmt_jmp p l1 st st'
    else if bir_eval_exp st.bst_environ ec birF then
      bir_eval_stmt_jmp p l2 st st'
    else F)

name: bir_eval_stmtE_def
statement:
(bir_eval_stmtE p (BStmt_Jmp le) st st' = bir_eval_stmt_jmp p le st st') /\
  (bir_eval_stmtE p (BStmt_CJmp e l1 l2) st st' = bir_eval_stmt_cjmp p e l1 l2 st st')

name: type_of_bir_exp_def
statement:
[Type_BExp_Const:] (! (env:bir_var_environment_t) (bir_imm:bir_imm_t) .
(clause_name "Type_BExp_Const")
 ==> 
( ( type_of_bir_exp env (BExp_Const bir_imm) (BType_Imm  (type_of_bir_imm  bir_imm ) ) )))

[Type_BExp_MemConst:] (! (env:bir_var_environment_t) (bir_immtype1:bir_immtype_t) (bir_immtype2:bir_immtype_t) (mmap:mmap) .
(clause_name "Type_BExp_MemConst")
 ==> 
( ( type_of_bir_exp env (BExp_MemConst bir_immtype1 bir_immtype2 mmap) (BType_Mem bir_immtype1 bir_immtype2) )))

[Type_BExp_Den:] (! (env:bir_var_environment_t) (bir_var:bir_var_t) (bir_val:bir_val_t) .
(clause_name "Type_BExp_Den") /\
(( (bir_env_lookup_rel  env   bir_var   bir_val ) ))
 ==> 
( ( type_of_bir_exp env (BExp_Den bir_var)  (type_of_bir_val  bir_val )  )))

[~BEnd_BigEndian:]

    (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty = SOME n)
    ==>

      (BVal_Imm (bir_mem_concat (bir_load_splits_from_mmap aty vty mmap addr n) rty)))

  (!aty vty mmap addr rty n.
    (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty = SOME n)
    ==>

      (BVal_Imm (bir_mem_concat (REVERSE (bir_load_splits_from_mmap aty vty mmap addr n)) rty)))

  (!aty vty mmap addr rty.
    (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty = SOME 1)
    ==>
    bir_eval_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap BEnd_NoEndian addr
      (BVal_Imm (bir_mem_concat (bir_load_splits_from_mmap aty vty mmap addr 1) rty)))

[Eval_BExp_BinPred:] (! (env:bir_var_environment_t) (bir_binpred:bir_binpred_t) (bir_exp1:bir_exp_t) (bir_exp2:bir_exp_t) (bir_val:bir_val_t) (bir_val1:bir_val_t) (bir_val2:bir_val_t) .

!binexp v1 v2 v. bir_eval_binexp binexp v1 v2 v <=> 
    bir_compute_binexp binexp (SOME v1) (SOME v2) = SOME v

name: bir_eval_store_eq_compute_store

    (bir_compute_store (SOME v_mem) (SOME v_addr) en (SOME result) = SOME v)

name: bir_compute_binexp_imm_def
statement:
(bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_And (Imm1 w1) (Imm1 w2) = SOME (Imm1 (word_and w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_And (Imm8 w1) (Imm8 w2) = SOME (Imm8 (word_and w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_And (Imm16 w1) (Imm16 w2) = SOME (Imm16 (word_and w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_And (Imm32 w1) (Imm32 w2) = SOME (Imm32 (word_and w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_And (Imm64 w1) (Imm64 w2) = SOME (Imm64 (word_and w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_And (Imm128 w1) (Imm128 w2) = SOME (Imm128 (word_and w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_Plus (Imm1 w1) (Imm1 w2) = SOME (Imm1 (word_add w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_Plus (Imm8 w1) (Imm8 w2) = SOME (Imm8 (word_add w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_Plus (Imm16 w1) (Imm16 w2) = SOME (Imm16 (word_add w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_Plus (Imm32 w1) (Imm32 w2) = SOME (Imm32 (word_add w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_Plus (Imm64 w1) (Imm64 w2) = SOME (Imm64 (word_add w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm BIExp_Plus (Imm128 w1) (Imm128 w2) = SOME (Imm128 (word_add w1 w2))) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp_imm binexp _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_compute_binexp_def
statement:
(bir_compute_binexp binexp (SOME (BVal_Imm imm1)) (SOME (BVal_Imm imm2)) =
    val_from_imm_option (bir_compute_binexp_imm binexp imm1 imm2)) /\
  (bir_compute_binexp _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_compute_unaryexp_imm_def
statement:
(bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_Not (Imm1 w1) = SOME (Imm1 (word_1comp w1))) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_Not (Imm8 w1) = SOME (Imm8 (word_1comp w1))) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_Not (Imm16 w1) = SOME (Imm16 (word_1comp w1))) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_Not (Imm32 w1) = SOME (Imm32 (word_1comp w1))) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_Not (Imm64 w1) = SOME (Imm64 (word_1comp w1))) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_Not (Imm128 w1) = SOME (Imm128 (word_1comp w1))) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_ChangeSign (Imm1 w1) = SOME (Imm1 (word_2comp w1))) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_ChangeSign (Imm8 w1) = SOME (Imm8 (word_2comp w1))) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_ChangeSign (Imm16 w1) = SOME (Imm16 (word_2comp w1))) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_ChangeSign (Imm32 w1) = SOME (Imm32 (word_2comp w1))) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_ChangeSign (Imm64 w1) = SOME (Imm64 (word_2comp w1))) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm BIExp_ChangeSign (Imm128 w1) = SOME (Imm128 (word_2comp w1)))

name: bir_compute_unaryexp_def
statement:
(bir_compute_unaryexp unaryexp (SOME (BVal_Imm imm1)) = 
    val_from_imm_option (bir_compute_unaryexp_imm unaryexp imm1)) /\
  (bir_compute_unaryexp _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_compute_binpred_imm_def
statement:
(bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_Equal (Imm1 w1) (Imm1 w2) = $= w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_Equal (Imm8 w1) (Imm8 w2) = $= w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_Equal (Imm16 w1) (Imm16 w2) = $= w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_Equal (Imm32 w1) (Imm32 w2) = $= w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_Equal (Imm64 w1) (Imm64 w2) = $= w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_Equal (Imm128 w1) (Imm128 w2) = $= w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_LessThan (Imm1 w1) (Imm1 w2) = word_lo w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_LessThan (Imm8 w1) (Imm8 w2) = word_lo w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_LessThan (Imm16 w1) (Imm16 w2) = word_lo w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_LessThan (Imm32 w1) (Imm32 w2) = word_lo w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_LessThan (Imm64 w1) (Imm64 w2) = word_lo w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm BIExp_LessThan (Imm128 w1) (Imm128 w2) = word_lo w1 w2) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred_imm binpred _ _ = F)

name: bir_compute_binpred_def
statement:
(bir_compute_binpred binpred (SOME (BVal_Imm imm1)) (SOME (BVal_Imm imm2)) =
    SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (bir_compute_binpred_imm binpred imm1 imm2)))) /\
  (bir_compute_binpred _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_compute_ifthenelse_def
statement:
bir_compute_ifthenelse b v1 v2 = 
    if b = SOME birT then v1 
    else if b = SOME birF then v2
    else NONE

name: bir_compute_load_from_mem_def
statement:
bir_compute_load_from_mem
  (vty : bir_immtype_t) (rty : bir_immtype_t) (aty : bir_immtype_t) (mmap : num |-> num) (en: bir_endian_t) (addr:num) =

   case (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty) of
    | NONE => NONE
    | SOME (n:num) => (
        let vs = bir_load_splits_from_mmap aty vty mmap addr n in
        let vs' = (case en of BEnd_LittleEndian => SOME (REVERSE vs)
                          |  BEnd_BigEndian => SOME vs
                          |  BEnd_NoEndian => if (n = 1) then SOME vs else NONE) in
        case vs' of NONE => NONE
                 |  SOME vs'' => SOME (bir_mem_concat vs'' rty)
   )

name: bir_compute_load_def
statement:
(bir_compute_load (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm addr)) en rty = 
    val_from_imm_option (bir_compute_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap en (b2n addr))) /\
  (bir_compute_load _ _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_compute_store_in_mem_def
statement:
bir_compute_store_in_mem
  (vty : bir_immtype_t) (aty : bir_immtype_t) (result : bir_imm_t) (mmap : num |-> num) (en: bir_endian_t) (addr:num) =

   let rty = type_of_bir_imm result in
   case (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty) of
    | NONE => NONE
    | SOME (n:num) => (
      case  (bitstring_split (size_of_bir_immtype vty) (b2v result)) of
        | NONE => NONE
        | SOME vs =>
        let vs' = (case en of BEnd_LittleEndian => SOME (REVERSE vs)
                          |  BEnd_BigEndian => SOME vs
                          |  BEnd_NoEndian => if (n = 1) then SOME vs else NONE) in

        case vs' of NONE => NONE
                 |  SOME vs'' => SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty (bir_update_mmap aty mmap addr vs''))
   )

name: bir_compute_store_def
statement:
(bir_compute_store (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm addr)) en (SOME (BVal_Imm result)) = 
    bir_compute_store_in_mem vty aty result mmap en (b2n addr)) /\
  (bir_compute_store _ _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_compute_exp_def
statement:
(bir_compute_exp (BExp_Const n) env = SOME (BVal_Imm n)) /\

  (bir_compute_exp (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) env = SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) /\

  (bir_compute_exp (BExp_Den v) env = bir_env_lookup env v) /\

  
  

  (bir_compute_exp (BExp_UnaryExp et e) env = (
     bir_compute_unaryexp et (bir_compute_exp e env))) /\

  (bir_compute_exp (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) env = (
     bir_compute_binexp et (bir_compute_exp e1 env) (bir_compute_exp e2 env))) /\

  (bir_compute_exp (BExp_BinPred pt e1 e2) env = (
     bir_compute_binpred pt (bir_compute_exp e1 env) (bir_compute_exp e2 env))) /\
  
  
  
  
  
  (bir_compute_exp (BExp_IfThenElse c et ef) env =
     bir_compute_ifthenelse (bir_compute_exp c env) (bir_compute_exp et env) (bir_compute_exp ef env)
  ) /\

  (bir_compute_exp (BExp_Load mem_e a_e en ty) env =
     bir_compute_load (bir_compute_exp mem_e env) (bir_compute_exp a_e env) en ty) /\

  (bir_compute_exp (BExp_Store mem_e a_e en v_e) env =
     bir_compute_store (bir_compute_exp mem_e env) (bir_compute_exp a_e env) en (bir_compute_exp v_e env))

statement: BVal_Imm (Imm1 (bool2w F)) = birF

name: size_of_bir_immtype_leq_1
statement: !b. 1 <= 2 ** (size_of_bir_immtype b)

name: bir_eval_binpred_correct_type

    (type_of_bir_val v = (BType_Imm Bit1) <=> type_of_bir_val v3 = ty)

name: type_of_bir_val_imp_bir_eval_load_bigendian
statement:
!aty vty v_mem v_addr rty.
  ((type_of_bir_val v_mem = (BType_Mem aty vty)) /\ 
    (type_of_bir_val v_addr = BType_Imm aty) /\
     ((size_of_bir_immtype rty) MOD (size_of_bir_immtype vty) = 0) /\
     ((size_of_bir_immtype rty) DIV (size_of_bir_immtype vty) <= 
        2 **(size_of_bir_immtype aty)))
  ==>
  ?v. bir_eval_load v_mem v_addr BEnd_BigEndian rty v

  ==>
  ?v. bir_eval_load v_mem v_addr BEnd_NoEndian rty v

name: type_of_bir_val_imp_bir_eval_store_noendian

!aty vty v_mem v_addr v_result rty.

name: well_typed_bir_eval_label_exp_value
statement:
!le env prog.
    is_label_exp_typed_in_env env prog le ==>
    ?l. bir_eval_label_exp le env l

name: bir_eval_stmt_jmp_eq_compute_stmt_jmp
statement:
!p le st st'.
    is_label_exp_typed_in_env (st.bst_environ) p le ==>
    (bir_eval_stmt_jmp p le st st' <=> (bir_compute_stmt_jmp p le st = st'))

name: bir_eval_stmtE_eq_compute_stmtE
statement:
!p bst st st'.
    is_stmt_end_typed_in_env (st.bst_environ) p bst ==>
    (bir_eval_stmtE p bst st st' <=> (bir_compute_stmtE p bst st = st'))

name: bir_eval_stmtB_eq_compute_stmtB
statement:
!p bst st st'.
    is_stmt_basic_typed_in_env st.bst_environ bst ==>
    (bir_eval_stmtB bst st st' <=> (bir_compute_stmtB bst st = st'))

name: bir_eval_step_eq_compute_step
statement:
!p st st'.
    (~bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
    (is_prog_typed_in_env st.bst_environ p) ==>
    (bir_eval_step p st st' <=> (bir_compute_step p st = st'))

name: MEM_INDEX_FIND_SOME
statement:
!n l P i e.
    INDEX_FIND n P l = SOME (i,e) ==>
    MEM e l

name: MEM_bir_get_program_block_info_by_label
statement:
!blist l i b. 
    bir_get_program_block_info_by_label (BirProgram blist) l = SOME (i,b) ==>
    MEM b blist

name: MEM_bir_get_current_statement_stmts_of_program
statement:
!p pc bst.
    bir_get_current_statement p pc = SOME bst ==>
      MEM bst (bir_stmts_of_program p)

name: bir_compute_label_exp_def
statement:
(bir_compute_label_exp (BLE_Label l) env = SOME l) /\
   (bir_compute_label_exp (BLE_Exp e) env = case bir_compute_exp e env of
      | SOME (BVal_Imm i) => SOME (BL_Address i)
      | _ => NONE
   )

name: bir_compute_stmt_assign_def
statement:
bir_compute_stmt_assign v ex (st : bir_state_t) =
   case bir_compute_exp ex st.bst_environ of
     | SOME va => (st with bst_environ := (bir_env_update st.bst_environ v va))
     | NONE => bir_state_set_typeerror st

name: bir_compute_stmtB_def
statement: (bir_compute_stmtB (BStmt_Assign v ex) st = (bir_compute_stmt_assign v ex st))

name: bir_compute_stmt_jmp_def
statement:
bir_compute_stmt_jmp p le (st : bir_state_t) =
    case bir_compute_label_exp le st.bst_environ of
      | NONE => bir_state_set_typeerror st
      | SOME l => bir_jmp_to_label p l st

name: bir_compute_stmt_cjmp_def
statement:
bir_compute_stmt_cjmp p ec l1 l2 (st : bir_state_t) =
  let
    vobc = option_CASE (bir_compute_exp ec st.bst_environ) NONE bir_dest_bool_val
  in
  case vobc of
    | SOME T => bir_compute_stmt_jmp p l1 st
    | SOME F => bir_compute_stmt_jmp p l2 st
    | NONE => bir_state_set_typeerror st

name: bir_compute_stmtE_def
statement:
(bir_compute_stmtE p (BStmt_Jmp l) st = bir_compute_stmt_jmp p l st) /\
  (bir_compute_stmtE p (BStmt_CJmp e l1 l2) st = bir_compute_stmt_cjmp p e l1 l2 st)

name: bir_compute_stmt_def
statement:
(bir_compute_stmt (p:bir_program_t) (BStmtB (bst:bir_stmt_basic_t)) st =
     let st' = bir_compute_stmtB bst st in bir_state_next st') /\
  (bir_compute_stmt p (BStmtE bst) st = bir_compute_stmtE p bst st)

name: bir_compute_step_def
statement:
bir_compute_step p state =
  if (bir_state_is_terminated state) then state else
  case (bir_get_current_statement p state.bst_pc) of
    | NONE => bir_state_set_failed state
    | SOME stm => (bir_compute_stmt p stm state)

name: bir_eval_step_def
statement:
[~BStmtB:]
!p state bst.
  ((~bir_state_is_terminated state) /\
  (bir_get_current_statement p state.bst_pc = SOME (BStmtB bst)) /\
  (bir_eval_stmtB bst state state'))
  ==>
  bir_eval_step p state (bir_state_next state')

[~BStmtE:]
!p state bst.
  ((~bir_state_is_terminated state) /\
  (bir_get_current_statement p state.bst_pc = SOME (BStmtE bst)) /\
  (bir_eval_stmtE p bst state state'))
  ==>
  (bir_eval_step p state state')

[~NoStatemnt:]
!p state.
  ((~bir_state_is_terminated state) /\
  (bir_get_current_statement p state.bst_pc = NONE))
  ==>
  (bir_eval_step p state (bir_state_set_failed state))

name: is_prog_typed_bir_stmts_of_program
statement:
!p env bst.
    is_prog_typed_in_env env p ==>
    MEM bst (bir_stmts_of_program p) ==>
    is_stmt_typed_in_env env p bst

name: is_prog_typed_get_current_statement
statement:
!p st bst.
    (is_prog_typed_in_env st.bst_environ p) ==>
    (bir_get_current_statement p st.bst_pc = SOME bst) ==>
    (is_stmt_typed_in_env (st.bst_environ) p bst)

name: is_stmt_basic_typed_in_env_def
statement: (is_stmt_basic_typed_in_env env (BStmt_Assign var exp) = is_exp_well_typed env exp)

name: is_label_exp_typed_in_env_def
statement:
(is_label_exp_typed_in_env env prog (BLE_Label l) = (MEM l (bir_labels_of_program prog))) /\
  (is_label_exp_typed_in_env env prog (BLE_Exp exp) = 
    (?ity. type_of_bir_exp env exp (BType_Imm ity)))

name: is_stmt_end_typed_in_env_def
statement:
(is_stmt_end_typed_in_env env prog (BStmt_Jmp lexp) = is_label_exp_typed_in_env env prog lexp) /\
  (is_stmt_end_typed_in_env env prog (BStmt_CJmp cexp lexp1 lexp2) =
    ((type_of_bir_exp env cexp (BType_Imm Bit1)) /\ 
    (is_label_exp_typed_in_env env prog lexp1) /\ (is_label_exp_typed_in_env env prog lexp2)))

name: is_stmt_typed_in_env_def
statement:
(is_stmt_typed_in_env env prog (BStmtB bst) = is_stmt_basic_typed_in_env env bst) /\
  (is_stmt_typed_in_env env prog (BStmtE bst) = is_stmt_end_typed_in_env env prog bst)

name: is_block_typed_in_env_def
statement:
is_block_typed_in_env env prog block = 
    ( (EVERY (\stmt. is_stmt_basic_typed_in_env env stmt) block.bb_statements) 
    /\ (is_stmt_end_typed_in_env env prog block.bb_last_statement))

name: is_prog_typed_in_env_def
statement:
is_prog_typed_in_env env (BirProgram blist) = 
    EVERY (\b. is_block_typed_in_env env (BirProgram blist) b) blist

name: list_minus_thm
statement: !l x. MEM x (list_minus l l') <=> (MEM x l /\ ~MEM x l')

name: list_minus_append
statement: !l1 l2 l3. list_minus (l1++l2) l3 = list_minus l1 l3 ++ list_minus l2 l3

name: list_assoc_mem
statement: !l x y. list_assoc x l = SOME y ==> MEM (x,y) l

name: list_assoc_not_mem
statement: !l x y. list_assoc x l = NONE ==> ~MEM (x,y) l

name: list_assoc_split
statement:
!l x y. list_assoc x l = SOME y <=>
  ?l1 l2. (l = l1++(x,y)::l2) /\ ~MEM x (MAP FST l1)

name: list_assoc_append
statement:
!l1 l2 x. list_assoc x (l1++l2) =
   case list_assoc x l1 of
   | SOME y => SOME y
   | NONE => list_assoc x l2

name: mem_list_assoc
statement: !l x. MEM x (MAP FST l) ==> ?y. list_assoc x l = SOME y

name: not_mem_list_assoc
statement: !l x. ~MEM x (MAP FST l) ==> list_assoc x l = NONE

name: list_assoc_distinct_reverse
statement:
!l. ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST l) ==>
  !x. list_assoc x (REVERSE l) = list_assoc x l

name: list_assoc_map
statement:
!l x f. list_assoc x (MAP (\z. (FST z, f (SND z))) l) =
  OPTION_MAP f (list_assoc x l)

name: mono_every_id_thm
statement: (!x. P x ==> Q x) ==> EVERY (\x. x) (MAP P l) ==> EVERY (\x. x) (MAP Q l)

name: filter_size
statement: !l f size. list_size size (FILTER f l) <= list_size size l

name: list_minus_def
statement:
(list_minus [] ys = [])
 /\
 (list_minus (x::xs) ys =
   if ~MEM x ys then x::(list_minus xs ys) else list_minus xs ys)

name: list_assoc_def
statement:
(list_assoc x [] = NONE)
 /\
 (list_assoc x ((x',y')::xys) = if x=x' then SOME y' else list_assoc x xys)

name: clause_name_def
statement: clause_name (x:string) = T

name: simulated_termination_REFL
statement: ∀p. simulated_termination p p

name: simulated_simulated_termination
statement: ∀p p'. simulated p p' ⇒ simulated_termination p p'

name: simulated_fail_simulated_termination
statement: ∀p p'. simulated_fail p p' ⇒ simulated_termination p p'

name: simulated_termination_simulated_termination_n
statement: ∀p p'. simulated_termination p p' ⇒ simulated_termination_n p p'

name: bir_exec_to_labels_expand_labels
statement:
∀ls ls' p s s' os c1 c2.
    ~bir_state_is_terminated s' ⇒
    ls SUBSET ls' ⇒
    bir_exec_to_labels ls p s = BER_Ended os c1 c2 s' ⇒
    (∃n c2'.
       n > 0 ∧
       bir_exec_to_labels_n ls' p s n = BER_Ended os c1 c2' s' ∧
       (∀n'. 0 < n' ∧ n' < n ⇒
             ∃s'' os' c1' c2''.
               bir_exec_to_labels_n ls' p s n' = BER_Ended os' c1' c2'' s'' ∧
               ~(s''.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls)))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_restrict_labels
statement:
∀ls ls' p s s' os c1 c2.
    ls SUBSET ls' ⇒
    bir_exec_to_labels ls' p s = BER_Ended os c1 c2 s' ⇒
    s'.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls ⇒
    ~bir_state_is_terminated s' ⇒
    (∃os' c1' c2'. bir_exec_to_labels ls p s = BER_Ended os' c1' c2' s')

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_restrict_labels
statement:
∀ls ls' n p s s' os c1 c2.
    ls SUBSET ls' ⇒
    n > 0 ⇒
    bir_exec_to_labels_n ls' p s n = BER_Ended os c1 c2 s' ⇒
    s'.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls ⇒
    ~bir_state_is_terminated s' ⇒
    (∀n'. 0 < n' ∧ n' < n ⇒
          ∃s'' os' c1' c2''.
            bir_exec_to_labels_n ls' p s n' = BER_Ended os' c1' c2'' s'' ∧
            ~(s''.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls)) ⇒
    (∃os' c1' c2'. bir_exec_to_labels ls p s = BER_Ended os' c1' c2' s')

name: simulated_termination_transitive
statement:
∀p1 p2 p3.
    set (bir_labels_of_program p1) SUBSET set (bir_labels_of_program p2) ⇒
    simulated_termination p1 p2 ∧
    simulated_termination p2 p3 ⇒
    simulated_termination p1 p3

name: simulated_termination_simulated_contract
statement: ∀p p'. simulated_termination p p' ⇒ simulated_contract p p'

name: bir_exec_to_labels_triple_transfer
statement:
∀ p p' l ls pre post.
    simulated_termination p p' ⇒
    (bir_vars_of_program p') SUBSET (bir_vars_of_program p) ⇒

    MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ⇒
    ls SUBSET (set (bir_labels_of_program p)) ⇒

    bir_exec_to_labels_triple p' l ls pre post ⇒
    bir_exec_to_labels_triple p l ls pre post

name: contract_transfer
statement:
∀ p p' i l ls ls' pre post.
    simulated_termination p p' ⇒
    (bir_vars_of_program p') SUBSET (bir_vars_of_program p) ⇒

    MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ⇒
    ls SUBSET (set (bir_labels_of_program p)) ⇒
    ls' SUBSET (set (bir_labels_of_program p)) ⇒

    bir_simp_jgmt p' i l ls ls' pre post ⇒
    bir_simp_jgmt p i l ls ls' pre post

name: simulated_termination_def
statement:
simulated_termination (p: 'a bir_program_t) (p': 'a bir_program_t) =
  ∀s l s' o2 m2 n2.
    s.bst_pc = bir_block_pc l ⇒
    MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ⇒

    exec_to_prog p' s p = BER_Ended o2 m2 n2 s' ⇒
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated s') ⇒
    (∃o1 m1 n1.
      exec_to_prog p s p = BER_Ended o1 m1 n1 s')

name: exec_to_prog_n_def
statement:
exec_to_prog_n p s pls n =
  bir_exec_to_labels_n (set (bir_labels_of_program pls)) p s n

name: simulated_termination_n_def
statement:
simulated_termination_n p p' =
  ∀n s l s' os2 m2 n2.
    s.bst_pc = bir_block_pc l ⇒
    MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ⇒

    exec_to_prog_n p' s p n = BER_Ended os2 m2 n2 s' ⇒
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated s') ⇒
    (∃os1 m1 n1.
      exec_to_prog_n p s p n = BER_Ended os1 m1 n1 s')

name: simulated_contract_def
statement:
simulated_contract p p' =
  ∀s l ls s' os2 m2 n2.
    s.bst_pc = bir_block_pc l ⇒
    MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ⇒
    ls SUBSET (set (bir_labels_of_program p)) ⇒

    bir_exec_to_labels ls p' s = BER_Ended os2 m2 n2 s' ⇒
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated s') ⇒
    (∃os1 m1 n1.
      bir_exec_to_labels ls p s = BER_Ended os1 m1 n1 s')

name: resolved_block_labels
statement:
∀l v sl bl1 bl2 bl3.
    resolved_block l v sl bl1 bl2 bl3 ⇒
    bl1.bb_label = l ∧ bl2.bb_label = l ∧ bl3.bb_label = BL_Label sl

name: resolved_block_vars
statement:
∀l1 v sl bl1 bl2 bl3.
    resolved_block l1 v sl bl1 bl2 bl3 ⇒
    (bir_vars_of_block bl2 UNION bir_vars_of_block bl3)
    SUBSET bir_vars_of_block bl1

name: resolved_fail_block_labels
statement:
∀l bl1 bl2.
    resolved_fail_block l bl1 bl2 ⇒
    bl1.bb_label = l ∧ bl2.bb_label = l

name: resolved_fail_block_vars
statement:
∀l bl1 bl2.
    bir_vars_of_stmtE bl2.bb_last_statement = {} ⇒
    resolved_fail_block l bl1 bl2 ⇒
    bir_vars_of_block bl2 SUBSET bir_vars_of_block bl1

name: cjmp_stmtE_def
statement:
cjmp_stmtE e v sl =
   BStmt_CJmp (BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal e (BExp_Const v))
              (BLE_Label (BL_Address v))
              (BLE_Label (BL_Label sl))

name: cjmp_block_def
jmp_block_def
direct_jump_target_block_def
statement:
direct_jump_target_block l bl =
  ∀es.
    es = bl.bb_last_statement ⇒
    (es = BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Label l) ∨
     ∃c l2. es = BStmt_CJmp c (BLE_Label l) l2 ∨
     ∃c l1. es = BStmt_CJmp c l1 (BLE_Label l))

name: direct_jump_target_def
statement:
direct_jump_target l p =
  ∃l' bl.
    bir_get_current_block p (bir_block_pc l') = SOME bl ∧
    direct_jump_target_block l bl

name: fresh_label_def
statement:
fresh_label l p =
  (~(MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p)) ∧
   ~(direct_jump_target l p))

name: assert_block_def
resolved_block_def
statement:
∀l1 v sl bl1 bl2 bl3 bss e.
    type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm (type_of_bir_imm v)) ∧

    bl1 = bir_block_t l1 bss (BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Exp e)) ∧
    bl2 = cjmp_block l1 bss e v sl ∧
    bl3 = jmp_block sl e ⇒
    resolved_block l1 v sl bl1 bl2 bl3

name: resolved_def
statement:
∀l1 v sl p p' bl1 bl2 bl3.
    fresh_label (BL_Label sl) p ∧
    (∀l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔
           MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ∨ l = BL_Label sl) ∧

    bir_get_current_block p (bir_block_pc l1) = SOME bl1 ∧
    bir_get_current_block p' (bir_block_pc l1) = SOME bl2 ∧
    bir_get_current_block p' (bir_block_pc (BL_Label sl)) = SOME bl3 ∧
    resolved_block l1 v sl bl1 bl2 bl3 ∧

    (∀l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ∧ l ≠ l1 ⇒
         ∃bl. bir_get_current_block p (bir_block_pc l) = SOME bl ∧
              bir_get_current_block p' (bir_block_pc l) = SOME bl) ⇒

    resolved l1 v sl p p'

name: resolved_fail_block_def
statement:
∀l bl1 bl2 e.
    bl1 = bir_block_t l bss (BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Exp e)) ∧
    bl2 = assert_block l bss es ⇒
    resolved_fail_block l bl1 bl2

name: resolved_fail_def
statement:
∀l1 p p' bl1 bl2.
    (∀l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔ MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p)) ∧

    bir_get_current_block p (bir_block_pc l1) = SOME bl1 ∧
    bir_get_current_block p' (bir_block_pc l1) = SOME bl2 ∧
    resolved_fail_block l1 bl1 bl2 ∧

    (∀l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ∧ l ≠ l1 ⇒
         ∃bl. bir_get_current_block p (bir_block_pc l) = SOME bl ∧
              bir_get_current_block p' (bir_block_pc l) = SOME bl) ⇒

    resolved_fail l1 p p'

name: fresh_label_compute_sound
statement: ∀l p. fresh_label_compute l p ⇒ fresh_label l p

name: resolve_fully_simulated_termination
statement:
∀p l xs p'.
    resolve_fully p l xs = SOME p' ⇒
    simulated_termination p p'

name: resolve_fully_vars
statement:
∀p l xs p'.
    resolve_fully p l xs = SOME p' ⇒
    bir_vars_of_program p' SUBSET bir_vars_of_program p

name: resolve_fully_labels
statement:
∀p l xs p'.
    resolve_fully p l xs = SOME p' ⇒
    set (bir_labels_of_program p) SUBSET set (bir_labels_of_program p')

name: resolve_fully_n_simulated_termination
statement:
∀p ys p'.
    resolve_fully_n p ys = SOME p' ⇒
    simulated_termination p p'

name: resolve_fully_n_vars
statement:
∀p ys p'.
    resolve_fully_n p ys = SOME p' ⇒
    bir_vars_of_program p' SUBSET bir_vars_of_program p

name: resolve_fully_n_bir_exec_to_labels_triple_transfer
statement:
∀p ys p' l ls pre post.
    resolve_fully_n p ys = SOME p' ⇒

    MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ⇒
    ls SUBSET (set (bir_labels_of_program p)) ⇒

    bir_exec_to_labels_triple p' l ls pre post ⇒
    bir_exec_to_labels_triple p l ls pre post

name: resolve_fully_n_contract_transfer
statement:
∀p ys p' i l ls ls' pre post.
    resolve_fully_n p ys = SOME p' ⇒

    MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ⇒
    ls SUBSET (set (bir_labels_of_program p)) ⇒
    ls' SUBSET (set (bir_labels_of_program p)) ⇒

    bir_simp_jgmt p' i l ls ls' pre post ⇒
    bir_simp_jgmt p i l ls ls' pre post

name: direct_jump_targets_block_compute_def
statement:
direct_jump_targets_block_compute bl =
  case bl.bb_last_statement of
    BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Label l) => [l]
  | BStmt_CJmp e (BLE_Label l1) (BLE_Label l2) => [l1; l2]
  | BStmt_CJmp e (BLE_Label l1) _ => [l1]
  | BStmt_CJmp e  _ (BLE_Label l2) => [l2]
  | _ => []

name: fresh_label_compute_def
statement:
(fresh_label_compute l (BirProgram []) = T) ∧
  (fresh_label_compute l (BirProgram (bl::bls)) =
    (~(bl.bb_label = l) ∧
     ~(MEM l (direct_jump_targets_block_compute bl)) ∧
     fresh_label_compute l (BirProgram bls)))

name: resolve_fully_def
statement:
(resolve_fully p l [] = resolve_fail p l) ∧
  (resolve_fully p l ((v, sl) :: xs) =
     if fresh_label_compute (BL_Label sl) p then
       OPTION_BIND (resolve p l v sl) (\p'. resolve_fully p' (BL_Label sl) xs)
     else NONE)

name: resolve_fully_n_def
statement:
(resolve_fully_n p [] = SOME p) ∧
  (resolve_fully_n p ((l, xs) :: ys) =
     OPTION_BIND (resolve_fully p l xs) (\p'. resolve_fully_n p' ys))

name: INDEX_FIND_append_stop
statement:
∀P xs n ys.
    EXISTS P xs ⇒
    INDEX_FIND n P (xs ++ ys) =
    INDEX_FIND n P xs

name: INDEX_FIND_append_skip
statement:
∀P xs n ys n' x.
    EVERY ($~ o P) xs ⇒
    INDEX_FIND n P (xs ++ ys) = SOME (n', x) ⇒
    ∃n''. INDEX_FIND n P ys = SOME (n'', x)

name: INDEX_FIND_cons_stop
statement:
∀P x n xs.
    P x ⇒
    INDEX_FIND n P (x::xs) = SOME (n, x)

name: bir_get_program_block_info_by_label_append_stop
statement:
∀bls1 bls2 l.
    EXISTS (\bl. bl.bb_label = l) bls1 ⇒
    bir_get_program_block_info_by_label (BirProgram (bls1 ++ bls2)) l =
    bir_get_program_block_info_by_label (BirProgram bls1) l

name: bir_get_program_block_info_by_label_append_skip
statement:
∀l bls1 bls2 i bl.
    EVERY (\bl. bl.bb_label ≠ l) bls1 ⇒
    bir_get_program_block_info_by_label (BirProgram (bls1 ++ bls2)) l = SOME (i, bl) ⇒
    ∃j. bir_get_program_block_info_by_label (BirProgram bls2) l = SOME (j, bl)

name: bir_get_program_block_info_by_label_cons_stop
statement:
∀bl bls l.
    bl.bb_label = l ⇒
    ∃n. bir_get_program_block_info_by_label (BirProgram (bl::bls)) l =
        SOME (n, bl)

name: bir_get_current_block_append_stop
statement:
∀bls1 bls2 l.
    EXISTS (\bl. bl.bb_label = l) bls1 ⇒
    bir_get_current_block (BirProgram (bls1 ++ bls2)) (bir_block_pc l) =
    bir_get_current_block (BirProgram bls1) (bir_block_pc l)

name: bir_get_current_block_append_skip
statement:
∀bls1 bls2 l.
    EVERY (\bl. bl.bb_label ≠ l) bls1 ⇒
    bir_get_current_block (BirProgram (bls1 ++ bls2)) (bir_block_pc l) =
    bir_get_current_block (BirProgram bls2) (bir_block_pc l)

name: bir_get_current_block_cons_stop
statement:
∀bl bls l.
    bl.bb_label = l ⇒
    bir_get_current_block (BirProgram (bl::bls)) (bir_block_pc l) =

name: bir_get_current_block_cons_skip
statement:
∀bl bls l.
    bl.bb_label ≠ l ⇒
    bir_get_current_block (BirProgram (bl::bls)) (bir_block_pc l) =

name: replace_SOME
statement:
∀f P xs xs'.
    replace f P xs = SOME xs' ⇒
    (∃xs1 y xs2 ys.
       P y ∧ EVERY (\x. ~P x) xs1 ∧
       f y = SOME ys ∧
       xs = xs1 ++ y::xs2 ∧
       xs' = xs1 ++ ys ++ xs2)

name: replace_block_SOME
statement:
∀p l f p'.
    replace_block (BirProgram p) l f = SOME (BirProgram p') ⇒
    (∃bls1 bl bls2 bls.
       bl.bb_label = l ∧ EVERY (\bl. bl.bb_label ≠ l) bls1 ∧
       f bl = SOME bls ∧
       p = bls1 ++ bl::bls2 ∧
       p' = bls1 ++ bls ++ bls2)

name: replace_block_SOME_vars
statement:
∀p l f p'.
    refines_vars f ⇒
    replace_block p l f = SOME p' ⇒
    bir_vars_of_program p' SUBSET bir_vars_of_program p

name: resolve_fail_block_sound
statement:
∀bl1 r.

    (∃bl2. r = [bl2] ∧
           resolved_fail_block (bl1.bb_label) bl1 bl2)

name: resolve_fail_block_refines_vars

name: resolve_block_sound
statement:
∀bl1 v sl r.
    resolve_block bl1 v sl = SOME r ⇒
    (∃bl2 bl3.
       r = [bl2; bl3] ∧
       resolved_block (bl1.bb_label) v sl bl1 bl2 bl3)

name: resolve_block_refines_vars
statement: ∀v sl. refines_vars (\bl. resolve_block bl v sl)

name: resolve_sound
statement:
∀p l v sl p'.

    resolve p l v sl = SOME p' ⇒
    resolved l v sl p p'

name: resolve_labels

name: replace_def
replace_block_def
statement:
replace_block (BirProgram p) l f =
  OPTION_MAP BirProgram (replace f (\b. b.bb_label = l) p)

name: refines_vars_def
statement:
refines_vars f =
  ∀bl bls.
    f bl = SOME bls ⇒
    BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_block (set bls)) SUBSET bir_vars_of_block bl

name: resolve_fail_block_def
statement:
(resolve_fail_block bl =
     case bl.bb_last_statement of
       BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Exp e) =>
         SOME [assert_block bl.bb_label bl.bb_statements (BStmt_Halt (BExp_Const (Imm1 0w)))]
     | _ => NONE)

name: resolve_fail_def
statement: resolve_fail p l = replace_block p l resolve_fail_block

name: resolve_block_def
statement:
(resolve_block bl v sl =
     case bl.bb_last_statement of
       BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Exp e) =>
         if type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm (type_of_bir_imm v))
         then SOME [cjmp_block bl.bb_label bl.bb_statements e v sl;
                    jmp_block sl e]
         else NONE
     | _ => NONE)

name: resolve_def
statement: resolve p l v sl = replace_block p l (\bl. resolve_block bl v sl)

name: bir_exec_stmsB_assert_cjmp
statement:
∀bss os c s os2 m2 s2 os1 m1 s1.
    bir_exec_stmtsB (bss ++ [BStmt_Assert (BExp_Const (Imm1 0w))]) (os, c, s) = (os2, m2, s2) ⇒
    bir_exec_stmtsB bss (os, c, s) = (os1, m1, s1) ⇒
    (s1 = s2 ∧ os1 = os2 ∧ m1 = m2 ∧ bir_state_is_terminated s2) ∨
    (s2.bst_status = BST_AssertionViolated)

name: bir_exec_block_assert_jmp
statement:
∀p' p l1 bss es e s s2 s1 os2 m2 os1 m1 bl1 bl2.
    bl1 = bir_block_t l1 bss (BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Exp e)) ⇒
    bl2 = assert_block l1 bss es ⇒

    bir_exec_block p' bl2 s = (os2, m2, s2) ⇒
    bir_exec_block p bl1 s = (os1, m1, s1) ⇒
    ((s1 = s2 ∧ os1 = os2 ∧ m1 = m2 ∧ bir_state_is_terminated s2) ∨
    (s2.bst_status = BST_AssertionViolated))

    simulated_fail p p'

name: simulated_fail_def
statement:
simulated_fail (p: 'a bir_program_t) (p': 'a bir_program_t) =
  ∀s l s' o2 m2 n2.
    s.bst_pc = bir_block_pc l ⇒
    MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ⇒

    exec_to_prog p' s p = BER_Ended o2 m2 n2 s' ⇒
    ~(s'.bst_status = BST_AssertionViolated) ⇒
    (∃o1 m1 n1.
      exec_to_prog p s p = BER_Ended o1 m1 n1 s')

name: bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label_same
statement:
∀l p' p s s'.
    (MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔ MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p)) ⇒
    bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p' l s = s' ⇒
    bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p l s = s'

name: bir_eval_label_exp_lem
statement:
∀p' p sls le s l.
    (∀l'. MEM l' (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔
            MEM l' (bir_labels_of_program p) ∨
            (∃sl. l' = BL_Label sl ∧ sl IN sls)) ⇒
    ~(∃sl. sl IN sls ∧ le = BLE_Label (BL_Label sl)) ⇒
    bir_eval_label_exp le s.bst_environ = SOME l ⇒
    (MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔ MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p))

name: bir_exec_stmt_jmp_same
statement:
∀p' p sls le s s'.
    (∀l'. MEM l' (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔
            MEM l' (bir_labels_of_program p) ∨
            (∃sl. l' = BL_Label sl ∧ sl IN sls)) ⇒
    ~(∃sl. sl IN sls ∧ le = BLE_Label (BL_Label sl)) ⇒
    bir_exec_stmt_jmp p' le s = s' ⇒
    bir_exec_stmt_jmp p le s = s'

name: bir_exec_stmt_cjmp_same
statement:
∀p' p sls le1 le2 c s s' .
    (∀l'. MEM l' (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔
            MEM l' (bir_labels_of_program p) ∨
            (∃sl. l' = BL_Label sl ∧ sl IN sls)) ⇒
    ~(∃sl. sl IN sls ∧ le1 = BLE_Label (BL_Label sl)) ⇒
    ~(∃sl. sl IN sls ∧ le2 = BLE_Label (BL_Label sl)) ⇒
    bir_exec_stmt_cjmp p' c le1 le2 s = s' ⇒
    bir_exec_stmt_cjmp p c le1 le2 s = s'

name: bir_exec_block_same
statement:
∀p' p sls bl s s' os m.
    (∀l'. MEM l' (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔
            MEM l' (bir_labels_of_program p) ∨
            (∃sl. l' = BL_Label sl ∧ sl IN sls)) ⇒
    (∀sl. sl IN sls ⇒ ~direct_jump_target_block (BL_Label sl) bl) ⇒
    bir_exec_block p' bl s = (os, m, s') ⇒
    bir_exec_block p bl s = (os, m, s')

name: jump_fresh_terminated
statement:
∀e s s2 sl s1 p.
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated s) ⇒
    jump_fresh e s s2 sl s1 p ⇒
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated s2)

name: bir_exec_stmtE_cjmp_jmp
statement:
∀p' p sl es1 e c v es2 s s2 s1.
    (∀l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔
           MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ∨ l = (BL_Label sl)) ⇒
    type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm (type_of_bir_imm v)) ⇒

    es1 = BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Exp e) ⇒
    es2 = cjmp_stmtE e v sl ⇒

    s.bst_status = BST_Running ⇒
    bir_exec_stmtE p' es2 s = s2 ⇒
    bir_exec_stmtE p es1 s = s1 ⇒
    (s1 = s2 ∨ jump_fresh e s s2 sl s1 p)

name: bir_exec_block_cjmp_jmp
statement:
∀p' p sl  bl1 l1 bss e c v bl2 s s2 os2 m2 s1 os1 m1.
    (∀l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔
           MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ∨ l = (BL_Label sl)) ⇒
    ~(direct_jump_target_block (BL_Label sl) bl1) ⇒
    type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm (type_of_bir_imm v)) ⇒

    bl1 = bir_block_t l1 bss (BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Exp e)) ⇒
    bl2 = cjmp_block l1 bss e v sl ⇒

    bir_exec_block p' bl2 s = (os2, m2, s2) ⇒
    bir_exec_block p bl1 s = (os1, m1, s1) ⇒
    (s1 = s2 ∧ os1 = os2 ∧ m1 = m2) ∨
    (jump_fresh e (exec_stmtsB bss s) s2 sl s1 p)

name: bir_exec_block_jmp
statement:
∀p' p sl s e v bl.
    (∀l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔
           MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ∨ l = (BL_Label sl)) ⇒
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated s) ⇒
    bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm v) ⇒
    bl = jmp_block sl e ⇒
    (∃s'. bir_exec_block p' bl s = ([], 1, s') ∧
          if MEM (BL_Address v) (bir_labels_of_program p) then
            s' = s with bst_pc := bir_block_pc (BL_Address v)
          else s'.bst_status = BST_JumpOutside (BL_Address v))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_jmp
statement:
∀(p' : 'a bir_program_t) (p : 'a bir_program_t) sl e s v bl ls.
    (∀l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p') ⇔
           MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ∨ l = (BL_Label sl)) ⇒
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated s) ⇒
    bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm v) ⇒

    bl = jmp_block sl e ⇒
    bir_get_current_block p' (s.bst_pc) = SOME bl ⇒
    ls = bir_labels_of_program p ⇒
    (∃s' n. bir_exec_to_labels (set ls) p' s = BER_Ended [] 1 n s' ∧
            if MEM (BL_Address v) (bir_labels_of_program p) then
              s' = s with bst_pc := bir_block_pc (BL_Address v)
            else s'.bst_status = BST_JumpOutside (BL_Address v))

name: resolved_simulated_lem
statement:
∀p s bl os m s' pc_cond ls.
    bir_get_current_block p s.bst_pc = SOME bl ⇒
    bir_exec_block p bl s = (os, m, s') ⇒
    s'.bst_status = BST_Running ⇒
    ls = bir_labels_of_program p ⇒
    pc_cond = (F, (λpc. pc.bpc_index = 0 ∧ MEM pc.bpc_label ls)) ⇒
    0 < m ∧ bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond s'

name: resolved_simulated

name: exec_to_prog_def

name: simulated_def
statement:
simulated (p: 'a bir_program_t) (p': 'a bir_program_t) =
  ∀s l s' o2 m2 n2.
    s.bst_pc = bir_block_pc l ⇒
    MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ⇒

    exec_to_prog p' s p = BER_Ended o2 m2 n2 s' ⇒
    ~(∃l'. s'.bst_status = BST_JumpOutside l') ⇒
    (∃o1 m1 n1.
      exec_to_prog p s p = BER_Ended o1 m1 n1 s')

name: jump_fresh_def
statement:
jump_fresh e s s2 sl s1 p =
  ∃v.
  (bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm v) ∧
   s.bst_status = BST_Running ∧
   s2 = s with bst_pc := bir_block_pc (BL_Label sl) ∧
   (MEM (BL_Address v) (bir_labels_of_program p) ⇒
    s1 = s with bst_pc := bir_block_pc (BL_Address v)))

name: exec_stmtsB_def

     (BExp_BinExp BIExp_LeftShift 
      (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Xor pre_a_exp pre_d_exp)
     (BExp_Const (Imm32 s)))
     (BExp_BinExp BIExp_RightShift
      (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Xor pre_a_exp pre_d_exp)

name: chacha_quarter_round_bir_exprs_def
statement:
chacha_quarter_round_bir_exprs pre_a_exp pre_b_exp pre_c_exp pre_d_exp
  : bir_exp_t # bir_exp_t # bir_exp_t # bir_exp_t =
  let a = pre_a_exp in
  let b = pre_b_exp in
  let c = pre_c_exp in
  let d = pre_d_exp in

  let a = chacha_line_bir_exp_fst a b in
  let d = chacha_line_bir_exp_snd a d 16w in

  let c = chacha_line_bir_exp_fst c d in

  if 0 < r then
     if n = 0 then 0
     else (let x = 2 * root_compute r (n DIV (exp_compute 2 r)) in
           if n < exp_compute (SUC x) r then x else (SUC x))
  else ROOT 0 n

name: CCS_distinct

(var X <> prefix u E :'a CCS) /\
    (var X <> E1 + E2 :'a CCS) /\
    (var X <> E1 || E2 :'a CCS) /\
    (var X <> restr L E :'a CCS) /\
    (var X <> relab E rf :'a CCS) /\
    (var X <> rec Y E :'a CCS) /\
    (prefix u E <> E1 + E2 :'a CCS) /\
    (prefix u E <> E1 || E2 :'a CCS) /\
    (prefix u E <> restr L E' :'a CCS) /\
    (prefix u E <> relab E' rf :'a CCS) /\
    (prefix u E <> rec X E' :'a CCS) /\
    (E1 + E2 <> E3 || E4 :'a CCS) /\
    (E1 + E2 <> restr L E :'a CCS) /\
    (E1 + E2 <> relab E rf :'a CCS) /\
    (E1 + E2 <> rec X E :'a CCS) /\
    (E1 || E2 <> (restr L) E :'a CCS) /\
    (E1 || E2 <> relab E rf :'a CCS) /\
    (E1 || E2 <> rec X E :'a CCS) /\
    (restr L E <> relab E' rf :'a CCS) /\
    (restr L E <> rec X E' :'a CCS) /\
     relab E rf <> rec X E' :'a CCS

    (!u E u' E' :'a CCS. prefix u E = prefix u' E' <=> u = u' /\ E = E') /\
    (!E1 E2 E1' E2' :'a CCS. E1 + E2 = E1' + E2' <=> E1 = E1' /\ E2 = E2') /\
    (!E1 E2 E1' E2' :'a CCS. E1 || E2 = E1' || E2' <=> E1 = E1' /\ E2 = E2') /\
    (!L E L' E' :'a CCS. restr L E = restr L' E' <=> L = L' /\ E = E') /\
    (!(E :'a CCS) rf E' rf'. relab E rf = relab E' rf' <=> E = E' /\ rf = rf')

name: CCS_Subst_def

   (CCS_Subst (prefix u E) E' X = prefix u (CCS_Subst E E' X)) /\
   (CCS_Subst (sum E1 E2)  E' X = sum (CCS_Subst E1 E' X)
                                      (CCS_Subst E2 E' X)) /\
   (CCS_Subst (par E1 E2)  E' X = par (CCS_Subst E1 E' X)
                                      (CCS_Subst E2 E' X)) /\
   (CCS_Subst (restr L E)  E' X = restr L (CCS_Subst E E' X)) /\
   (CCS_Subst (relab E rf) E' X = relab   (CCS_Subst E E' X) rf) /\
   (CCS_Subst (var Y)      E' X = if (Y = X) then E' else (var Y)) /\
   (Y <> X /\ Y # E' ==>
    CCS_Subst (rec Y E)    E' X = rec Y (CCS_Subst E E' X))

name: TRANS_def
statement:
(!E u.                           TRANS (prefix u E) u E) /\         
    (!E u E1 E'.    TRANS E u E1 ==> TRANS (sum E E') u E1) /\          
    (!E u E1 E'.    TRANS E u E1 ==> TRANS (sum E' E) u E1) /\          
    (!E u E1 E'.    TRANS E u E1 ==> TRANS (par E E') u (par E1 E')) /\ 
    (!E u E1 E'.    TRANS E u E1 ==> TRANS (par E' E) u (par E' E1)) /\ 
    (!E l E1 E' E2. TRANS E (label l) E1 /\ TRANS E' (label (COMPL l)) E2
                ==> TRANS (par E E') tau (par E1 E2)) /\                
    (!E u E' l L.   TRANS E u E' /\ ((u = tau) \/
                                     ((u = label l) /\ l NOTIN L /\ (COMPL l) NOTIN L))
                ==> TRANS (restr L E) u (restr L E')) /\                
    (!E u E' rf.    TRANS E u E'
                ==> TRANS (relab E rf) (relabel rf u) (relab E' rf)) /\ 
    (!E u X E1.     TRANS (CCS_Subst E (rec X E) X) u E1
                ==> TRANS (rec X E) u E1)

name: TRANSn_def
statement:
(!E u.            TRANSn 0 (prefix u E) u E) /\
    (!n E u E1 E'.    TRANSn n E u E1 ==> TRANSn (SUC n) (sum E E') u E1) /\
    (!n E u E1 E'.    TRANSn n E u E1 ==> TRANSn (SUC n) (sum E' E) u E1) /\
    (!n E u E1 E'.    TRANSn n E u E1 ==> TRANSn (SUC n) (par E E') u (par E1 E')) /\
    (!n E u E1 E'.    TRANSn n E u E1 ==> TRANSn (SUC n) (par E' E) u (par E' E1)) /\
    (!n E l E1 E' E2. TRANSn n E (label l) E1 /\ TRANSn n' E' (label (COMPL l)) E2
                  ==> TRANSn (SUC (MAX n n')) (par E E') tau (par E1 E2)) /\
    (!n E u E' l L.   TRANSn n E u E' /\ ((u = tau) \/
                                          ((u = label l) /\ l NOTIN L /\ (COMPL l) NOTIN L))
                  ==> TRANSn (SUC n) (restr L E) u (restr L E')) /\
    (!n E u E' rf.    TRANSn n E u E'
                  ==> TRANSn (SUC n) (relab E rf) (relabel rf u) (relab E' rf)) /\
    (!n E u X E1.     TRANSn n (CCS_Subst E (rec X E) X) u E1
                  ==> TRANSn (SUC n) (rec X E) u E1)

statement: !a. WG (\t. prefix a t)
