statement: ~WG (\t. t)

name: WG_CONST
statement: !e. IS_CONST e ==> WG e

name: NO_WG8
statement: !e X. ~IS_CONST e ==> ~WG (\t. rec X (e t))

name: WG8_IMP_CONST
statement: !e X. WG (\t. rec X (e t)) ==> IS_CONST e

name: WG3_backward
statement: !e u. WG (\t. prefix u (e t)) ==> CONTEXT e

name: WG4_backward
statement: !e e'. WG (\t. sum (e t) (e' t)) ==> WG e /\ WG e'

name: WG5_backward
statement: !e e'. WG (\t. par (e t) (e' t)) ==> WG e /\ WG e'

name: WG6_backward
statement: !e L. WG (\t. restr L (e t)) ==> WG e

name: WG7_backward
statement: !e rf. WG (\t. relab (e t) rf) ==> WG e

name: WG8_backward
statement: !e X. WG (\t. rec X (e t)) ==> WG e

name: WG_IMP_CONTEXT
statement: !e. WG e ==> CONTEXT e

name: CONTEXT_WG_combin
statement: !c e. CONTEXT c /\ WG e ==> WG (c o e)

name: SG_CONST
statement: !e. IS_CONST e ==> SG e

name: SG3_backward
statement: !e. SG (\t. prefix tau (e t)) ==> SG e

name: SG4_backward
statement: !e e'. SG (\t. sum (e t) (e' t)) ==> SG e /\ SG e'

name: SG10
statement: !e e'. SG (\t. sum (prefix tau (e t)) (prefix tau (e' t))) ==> SG e /\ SG e'

name: SG11
statement: !e e' L. SG (\t. sum (prefix tau (e t)) (prefix (label L) (e' t))) ==> SG e

name: SG11'
statement: !e e' L. SG (\t. sum (prefix (label L) (e t)) (prefix tau (e' t))) ==> SG e'

name: SEQ_IMP_CONTEXT
statement: !e. SEQ e ==> CONTEXT e

name: GSEQ_CONST
statement: !e. IS_CONST e ==> GSEQ e

name: GSEQ_IMP_CONTEXT
statement: !e. GSEQ e ==> CONTEXT e

name: SG_SEQ_strong_induction
statement:
!R. (!p. R (\t. p)) /\
        (!(l :'a Label) e. SEQ e ==> R (\t. prefix (label l) (e t))) /\
        (!(a :'a Action) e. SG e /\ SEQ e /\ R e ==> R (\t. prefix a (e t))) /\
        (!e1 e2. SG e1 /\ SEQ e1 /\ R e1 /\
                 SG e2 /\ SEQ e2 /\ R e2 ==> R (\t. sum (e1 t) (e2 t)))
        ==> (!e. SG e /\ SEQ e ==> R e)

name: SG_GSEQ_strong_induction
statement:
!R. (!p. R (\t. p)) /\
        (!(l :'a Label) e. GSEQ e ==> R (\t. prefix (label l) (e t))) /\
        (!(a :'a Action) e. SG e /\ GSEQ e /\ R e ==> R (\t. prefix a (e t))) /\
        (!e1 e2.       SG e1 /\ GSEQ e1 /\ R e1 /\ SG e2 /\ GSEQ e2 /\ R e2
                   ==> R (\t. sum (prefix tau (e1 t)) (prefix tau (e2 t)))) /\
        (!l2 e1 e2.    SG e1 /\ GSEQ e1 /\ R e1 /\ GSEQ e2
                   ==> R (\t. sum (prefix tau (e1 t)) (prefix (label l2) (e2 t)))) /\
        (!l1 e1 e2.    GSEQ e1 /\ SG e2 /\ GSEQ e2 /\ R e2
                   ==> R (\t. sum (prefix (label l1) (e1 t)) (prefix tau (e2 t)))) /\
        (!l1 l2 e1 e2. GSEQ e1 /\ GSEQ e2
                   ==> R (\t. sum (prefix (label l1) (e1 t)) (prefix (label l2) (e2 t))))
        ==> (!e. SG e /\ GSEQ e ==> R e)

name: SG_SEQ_combin
statement: !E. SG E /\ SEQ E ==> !H. SEQ H ==> (SG (H o E) /\ SEQ (H o E))

name: SG_GSEQ_combin
statement: !E. SG E /\ GSEQ E ==> !H. GSEQ H ==> (SG (H o E) /\ GSEQ (H o E))

name: WGS_CONST
statement: !e. IS_CONST e ==> WGS e

name: GCONTEXT_WGS_combin
statement: !c e. GCONTEXT c /\ WGS e ==> WGS (c o e)

name: IS_CONST_def
statement: IS_CONST (e :'a context) <=> !t1 t2. e t1 = e t2

name: closed_const
statement: closed_const (e :'a context) <=> IS_CONST e /\ !t. closed (e t)

name: precongruence
statement:
precongruence R <=> PreOrder R /\
        !x y ctx. CONTEXT ctx ==> R x y ==> R (ctx x) (ctx y)

name: precongruence'
statement:
precongruence' R <=> PreOrder R /\
        !x y ctx. GCONTEXT ctx ==> R x y ==> R (ctx x) (ctx y)

name: congruence
statement:
congruence R <=> equivalence R /\
        !x y ctx. CONTEXT ctx ==> R x y ==> R (ctx x) (ctx y)

name: congruence'
statement:
congruence' R <=> equivalence R /\
        !x y ctx. GCONTEXT ctx ==> R x y ==> R (ctx x) (ctx y)

name: OH_CONTEXT_def
statement:
(                        OH_CONTEXT (\t. t)) /\              
    (!a c.  OH_CONTEXT c ==> OH_CONTEXT (\t. prefix a (c t))) /\ 
    (!x c.  OH_CONTEXT c ==> OH_CONTEXT (\t. sum (c t) x)) /\    
    (!x c.  OH_CONTEXT c ==> OH_CONTEXT (\t. sum x (c t))) /\    
    (!x c.  OH_CONTEXT c ==> OH_CONTEXT (\t. par (c t) x)) /\    
    (!x c.  OH_CONTEXT c ==> OH_CONTEXT (\t. par x (c t))) /\    
    (!L c.  OH_CONTEXT c ==> OH_CONTEXT (\t. restr L (c t))) /\  
    (!rf c. OH_CONTEXT c ==> OH_CONTEXT (\t. relab (c t) rf))

name: CONTEXT_def
statement:
(                      CONTEXT (\t. t)) /\                 
    (!p.                   CONTEXT (\t. p)) /\                 
    (!a e.   CONTEXT e ==> CONTEXT (\t. prefix a (e t))) /\    
    (!e1 e2. CONTEXT e1 /\ CONTEXT e2
                       ==> CONTEXT (\t. sum (e1 t) (e2 t))) /\ 
    (!e1 e2. CONTEXT e1 /\ CONTEXT e2
                       ==> CONTEXT (\t. par (e1 t) (e2 t))) /\ 
    (!L e.   CONTEXT e ==> CONTEXT (\t. restr L (e t))) /\     
    (!e rf.  CONTEXT e ==> CONTEXT (\t. relab (e t) rf))

name: GCONTEXT_def
statement:
(                       GCONTEXT (\t. t)) /\                 
    (!p.                    GCONTEXT (\t. p)) /\                 
    (!a e.   GCONTEXT e ==> GCONTEXT (\t. prefix a (e t))) /\    
    (!a1 a2 e1 e2.
             GCONTEXT e1 /\ GCONTEXT e2
                        ==> GCONTEXT (\t. sum (prefix a1 (e1 t)) 
                                              (prefix a2 (e2 t)))) /\
    (!e1 e2. GCONTEXT e1 /\ GCONTEXT e2
                        ==> GCONTEXT (\t. par (e1 t) (e2 t))) /\ 
    (!L e.   GCONTEXT e ==> GCONTEXT (\t. restr L (e t))) /\     
    (!e rf.  GCONTEXT e ==> GCONTEXT (\t. relab (e t) rf))

name: WG_def
statement:
(!p.                        WG (\t. p)) /\                 
    (!a e.   CONTEXT e      ==> WG (\t. prefix a (e t))) /\    
    (!e1 e2. WG e1 /\ WG e2 ==> WG (\t. sum (e1 t) (e2 t))) /\ 
    (!e1 e2. WG e1 /\ WG e2 ==> WG (\t. par (e1 t) (e2 t))) /\ 
    (!L e.   WG e           ==> WG (\t. restr L (e t))) /\     
    (!rf e.  WG e           ==> WG (\t. relab (e t) rf))

name: SG_def
statement:
(!p.                        SG (\t. p)) /\                      
    (!l e.   CONTEXT e      ==> SG (\t. prefix (label l) (e t))) /\ 
    (!a e.   SG e           ==> SG (\t. prefix a (e t))) /\         
    (!e1 e2. SG e1 /\ SG e2 ==> SG (\t. sum (e1 t) (e2 t))) /\      
    (!e1 e2. SG e1 /\ SG e2 ==> SG (\t. par (e1 t) (e2 t))) /\      
    (!L e.   SG e           ==> SG (\t. restr L (e t))) /\          
    (!rf e.  SG e           ==> SG (\t. relab (e t) rf))

name: SEQ_def
statement:
(                             SEQ (\t. t)) /\              
    (!p.                          SEQ (\t. p)) /\              
    (!a e.   SEQ e            ==> SEQ (\t. prefix a (e t))) /\ 
    (!e1 e2. SEQ e1 /\ SEQ e2 ==> SEQ (\t. sum (e1 t) (e2 t)))

name: GSEQ_def
statement:
(                         GSEQ (\t. t)) /\                 
    (!p.                      GSEQ (\t. p)) /\                 
    (!a e.        GSEQ e  ==> GSEQ (\t. prefix a (e t))) /\    
    (!a1 a2 e1 e2.
       GSEQ e1 /\ GSEQ e2 ==> GSEQ (\t. sum (prefix a1 (e1 t)) 
                                            (prefix a2 (e2 t))))

name: C_contracts_IMP_SUM_contracts
statement: !p q. C_contracts p q ==> SUM_contracts p q

name: SUM_contracts_IMP_OBS_contracts
statement:
!p q. free_action p /\ free_action q ==>
          (SUM_contracts p q ==> OBS_contracts p q)

name: COARSEST_PRECONGR_LEMMA
statement:
!p q. (?k. STABLE k /\ closed k /\
               (!p' u. WEAK_TRANS p u p' ==> ~(WEAK_EQUIV p' k)) /\
               (!q' u. WEAK_TRANS q u q' ==> ~(WEAK_EQUIV q' k))) ==>
          (!r. closed r ==> (sum p r) contracts (sum q r)) ==> OBS_contracts p q

name: SUM_contracts
statement: SUM_contracts = (\p q. !r. closed r ==> (sum p r) contracts (sum q r))

name: contracts_def
statement:
!(E :'a CCS) (E' :'a CCS).
       (!l.
         (!E1. TRANS E  (label l) E1 ==>
               ?E2. TRANS E' (label l) E2 /\ $contracts E1 E2) /\
         (!E2. TRANS E' (label l) E2 ==>
               ?E1. WEAK_TRANS E (label l) E1 /\ WEAK_EQUIV E1 E2)) /\
       (!E1. TRANS E  tau E1 ==> $contracts E1 E' \/ ?E2. TRANS E' tau E2 /\ $contracts E1 E2) /\
       (!E2. TRANS E' tau E2 ==> ?E1. EPS E E1 /\ WEAK_EQUIV E1 E2)
      ==> $contracts E E'

name: WG_example1
statement: WG (\t. prefix a t + prefix b t + prefix c (var Y))

name: WG_example2
statement: WG (\t. prefix a (var X) + prefix b (var X) + prefix c t)

name: expands_def
statement:
!(E :'a CCS) (E' :'a CCS).
       (!l.
         (!E1. TRANS E  (label l) E1 ==>
               ?E2. TRANS E' (label l) E2 /\ $expands E1 E2) /\
         (!E2. TRANS E' (label l) E2 ==>
               ?E1. WEAK_TRANS E (label l) E1 /\ $expands E1 E2)) /\
       (!E1. TRANS E  tau E1 ==> $expands E1 E' \/ ?E2. TRANS E' tau E2 /\ $expands E1 E2) /\
       (!E2. TRANS E' tau E2 ==> ?E1. WEAK_TRANS E tau E1 /\ $expands E1 E2)
      ==> $expands E E'

name: CCS_SUBST_sing
statement: !X E E'. CCS_SUBST (fromList [X] [E']) E = CCS_Subst E E' X

name: fromList_EMPTY
statement: fromList [] [] = FEMPTY

name: fromList_HD
statement:
!X Xs P Ps. ~MEM X Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) ==>
                (fromList (X::Xs) (P::Ps) = (fromList Xs Ps) |+ (X,P))

name: FDOM_fromList
statement: !Xs Ps. (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) ==> (FDOM (fromList Xs Ps) = set Xs)

name: fromList_DOMSUB_NOT_IN_DOM
statement:
!X Xs Ps. ~MEM X Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) ==>
              (fromList Xs Ps) \\ X = fromList Xs Ps

name: fromList_FAPPLY_HD
statement:
!X Xs P Ps n. ~MEM X Xs /\ ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) ==>
                  ((fromList (X::Xs) (P::Ps)) ' X = P)

name: fromList_FAPPLY_EL
statement:
!Xs Ps n. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) /\ n < LENGTH Xs ==>
              ((fromList Xs Ps) ' (EL n Xs) = EL n Ps)

name: fromList_FAPPLY_EL'
statement:
!X P Xs Ps n. ~MEM X Xs /\ ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) /\
                  n < LENGTH Xs ==>
                  ((fromList (X::Xs) (P::Ps)) ' (EL n Xs) = EL n Ps)

name: CCS_SUBST_elim
statement:
!Xs Ps E. DISJOINT (FV E) (set Xs) /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) ==>
             (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E = E)

name: lemma0
statement:
!X P E fm. X NOTIN (FDOM fm) /\ DISJOINT (FDOM fm) (FV P) /\
               FEVERY (\(k,v). X NOTIN (FV v)) fm ==>
              (CCS_SUBST (fm |+ (X,P)) E = CCS_Subst (CCS_SUBST fm E) P X)

name: CCS_SUBST_reduce
statement:
!X Xs P Ps. ~MEM X Xs /\ ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) /\
                EVERY (\e. X NOTIN (FV e)) Ps /\
                DISJOINT (set Xs) (FV P) ==>
         !E. CCS_SUBST (fromList (X::Xs) (P::Ps)) E =
             CCS_Subst (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E) P X

name: lemma1
statement:
!E E' map.
      map <> [] /\
      ~MEM (FST (HD map)) (MAP FST (TL map)) /\
      ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST (TL map)) /\
      DISJOINT (set (MAP FST (TL map))) (FV (SND (HD map))) /\
      EVERY (\e. (FST (HD map)) NOTIN (FV e)) (MAP SND (TL map)) /\
      CCS_SUBST (FEMPTY |++ (TL map)) E = E'
   ==>
      CCS_SUBST (FEMPTY |++ map) E = CCS_Subst E' (SND (HD map)) (FST (HD map))

name: lemma2
statement:
!E map. ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST map) /\
            EVERY (\(x,p). DISJOINT (set (MAP FST map)) (FV p)) map ==>
           (CCS_SUBST (FEMPTY |++ map) E =
            FOLDR (\l e. CCS_Subst e (SND l) (FST l)) E map)

name: CCS_SUBST_FOLDR
statement:
!Xs Ps E. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs /\
              EVERY (\p. DISJOINT (set Xs) (FV p)) Ps ==>
             (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E =
              FOLDR (\(x,y) e. CCS_Subst e y x) E (ZIP (Xs,Ps)))

name: CCS_SUBST_FOLDR'
statement:
!Xs Ps E. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs /\
              EVERY (\p. DISJOINT (set Xs) (FV p)) Ps ==>
             (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E =
              FOLDR (\(x,y) e. CCS_Subst e y x) E (ZIP (Xs,Ps)))

name: CCS_SUBST_self
statement: !E Xs. ALL_DISTINCT Xs ==> (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs (MAP var Xs)) E = E)

name: CCS_SUBST_nested
statement:
!Xs Ps Es E.
        ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) /\ (LENGTH Es = LENGTH Xs) ==>
       (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Es) E) =
        CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs (MAP (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps)) Es)) E)

name: FV_SUBSET_BIGUNION
statement:
!Xs Ps E. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) ==>
              FV (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E) SUBSET
                 (FV E) UNION BIGUNION (IMAGE FV (set Ps))

name: FV_SUBSET_BIGUNION'
statement:
!Xs Ps E. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) ==>
              FV (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E) SUBSET
                 ((FV E) DIFF (set Xs)) UNION BIGUNION (IMAGE FV (set Ps))

name: CCS_SUBST_IS_PROC
statement:
!Xs Ps E. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) /\
              ALL_PROC Ps /\ FV E SUBSET (set Xs) ==>
              IS_PROC (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E)

name: CCS_SUBST_elim_closed
statement:
!Xs Ps P. LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs /\ IS_PROC P ==>
              CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) P = P

name: context_nil
statement: !Xs. context Xs nil

name: context_prefix
statement: !Xs u E. context Xs (prefix u E) ==> context Xs E

name: context_prefix_rule
statement: !Xs u E. context Xs E ==> context Xs (prefix u E)

name: context_prefix_rewrite
statement: !Xs u E. context Xs (prefix u E) <=> context Xs E

name: context_sum
statement: !Xs E1 E2. context Xs (sum E1 E2) ==> context Xs E1 /\ context Xs E2

name: context_sum_rule
statement: !Xs E1 E2. context Xs E1 /\ context Xs E2 ==> context Xs (sum E1 E2)

name: context_sum_rewrite
statement:
!Xs E1 E2. context Xs (sum E1 E2) <=>
               context Xs E1 /\ context Xs E2

name: context_par
statement: !Xs E1 E2. context Xs (par E1 E2) ==> context Xs E1 /\ context Xs E2

name: context_par_rule
statement: !Xs E1 E2. context Xs E1 /\ context Xs E2 ==> context Xs (par E1 E2)

name: context_par_rewrite
statement:
!Xs E1 E2. context Xs (par E1 E2) <=>
               context Xs E1 /\ context Xs E2

name: context_restr
statement: !Xs L E. context Xs (restr L E) ==> context Xs E

name: context_restr_rule
statement: !Xs L E. context Xs E ==> context Xs (restr L E)

name: context_restr_rewrite
statement: !Xs L E. context Xs (restr L E) <=> context Xs E

name: context_relab
statement: !Xs E rf. context Xs (relab E rf) ==> context Xs E

name: context_relab_rule
statement: !Xs E rf. context Xs E ==> context Xs (relab E rf)

name: context_relab_rewrite
statement: !Xs E rf. context Xs (relab E rf) <=> context Xs E

name: context_var
statement: !Xs Y. context Xs (var Y)

name: context_rec
statement: !Xs Y E. context Xs (rec Y E) ==> DISJOINT (FV E DELETE Y) (set Xs)

name: STRONG_EQUIV_subst_context
statement:
!Xs Ps Qs. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) /\
               LIST_REL STRONG_EQUIV Ps Qs ==>
        !E. context Xs E ==>
            STRONG_EQUIV (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E)
                         (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) E)

name: OBS_CONGR_subst_context
statement:
!Xs Ps Qs. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) /\
               LIST_REL OBS_CONGR Ps Qs ==>
        !E. context Xs E ==>
            OBS_CONGR (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E)
                      (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) E)

name: OBS_contracts_subst_context
statement:
!Xs Ps Qs. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) /\
               LIST_REL OBS_contracts Ps Qs ==>
        !E. context Xs E ==>
            OBS_contracts (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E)
                          (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) E)

name: context_combin
statement:
!Xs Es C. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ context Xs C /\
              EVERY (context Xs) Es /\ (LENGTH Es = LENGTH Xs) ==>
              context Xs (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Es) C)

name: weakly_guarded_imp_context
statement: !Xs E. weakly_guarded Xs E ==> context Xs E

name: EVERY_weakly_guarded
statement:
!Xs Es. EVERY (weakly_guarded Xs) Es ==>
            !E X. MEM E Es /\ MEM X Xs ==> WG (\t. CCS_Subst E t X)

name: weakly_guarded_nil
statement: !Xs. weakly_guarded Xs nil

name: weakly_guarded_prefix
statement: !Xs u E. weakly_guarded Xs (prefix u E) ==> context Xs E

name: weakly_guarded_prefix_rule
statement: !Xs u E. context Xs E ==> weakly_guarded Xs (prefix u E)

name: weakly_guarded_sum
statement:
!Xs E1 E2. weakly_guarded Xs (sum E1 E2) ==>
               weakly_guarded Xs E1 /\ weakly_guarded Xs E2

name: weakly_guarded_sum_rule
statement:
!Xs E1 E2. weakly_guarded Xs E1 /\ weakly_guarded Xs E2 ==>
               weakly_guarded Xs (sum E1 E2)

name: weakly_guarded_sum_rewrite
statement:
!Xs E1 E2. weakly_guarded Xs (sum E1 E2) <=>
               weakly_guarded Xs E1 /\ weakly_guarded Xs E2

name: weakly_guarded_par
statement:
!Xs E1 E2. weakly_guarded Xs (par E1 E2) ==>
               weakly_guarded Xs E1 /\ weakly_guarded Xs E2

name: weakly_guarded_par_rule
statement:
!Xs E1 E2. weakly_guarded Xs E1 /\ weakly_guarded Xs E2 ==>
               weakly_guarded Xs (par E1 E2)

name: weakly_guarded_par_rewrite
statement:
!Xs E1 E2. weakly_guarded Xs (par E1 E2) <=>
               weakly_guarded Xs E1 /\ weakly_guarded Xs E2

name: weakly_guarded_restr
statement: !Xs L E. weakly_guarded Xs (restr L E) ==> weakly_guarded Xs E

name: weakly_guarded_restr_rule
statement: !Xs L E. weakly_guarded Xs E ==> weakly_guarded Xs (restr L E)

name: weakly_guarded_restr_rewrite
statement: !Xs L E. weakly_guarded Xs (restr L E) <=> weakly_guarded Xs E

name: weakly_guarded_relab
statement: !Xs E rf. weakly_guarded Xs (relab E rf) ==> weakly_guarded Xs E

name: weakly_guarded_relab_rule
statement: !Xs E rf. weakly_guarded Xs E ==> weakly_guarded Xs (relab E rf)

name: weakly_guarded_relab_rewrite
statement: !Xs E rf. weakly_guarded Xs (relab E rf) <=> weakly_guarded Xs E

name: weakly_guarded_var
statement: !Xs Y. weakly_guarded Xs (var Y) ==> ~MEM Y Xs

name: weakly_guarded_var_rule
statement: !Xs Y. ~MEM Y Xs ==> weakly_guarded Xs (var Y)

name: weakly_guarded_rec
statement: !Xs Y E. weakly_guarded Xs (rec Y E) ==> DISJOINT (FV E DELETE Y) (set Xs)

name: disjoint_imp_weakly_guarded
statement: !Xs E. DISJOINT (FV E) (set Xs) ==> weakly_guarded Xs E

name: disjoint_imp_context
statement: !Xs E. DISJOINT (FV E) (set Xs) ==> context Xs E

name: weakly_guarded_combin
statement:
!Xs Es C. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ context Xs C /\
              EVERY (weakly_guarded Xs) Es /\ (LENGTH Es = LENGTH Xs) ==>
              weakly_guarded Xs (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Es) C)

name: CCS_solution_length
statement:
!Xs Es R Ps. CCS_equation Xs Es /\ CCS_solution R Xs Es Ps ==>
                 (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs)

name: strong_unique_solution_lemma
statement:
!Xs E. weakly_guarded Xs E /\ FV E SUBSET (set Xs) ==>
           !Ps. (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) ==>
                !u P'. TRANS (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E) u P' ==>
                       ?E'. context Xs E' /\
                            FV E' SUBSET (set Xs) /\
                           (P' = CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E') /\
                            !Qs. (LENGTH Qs = LENGTH Xs) ==>
                                 TRANS (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) E) u
                                       (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) E')

name: strong_unique_solution_thm
statement:
!Xs Es Ps Qs.
        CCS_equation Xs Es /\ EVERY (weakly_guarded Xs) Es /\
        Ps IN (CCS_solution STRONG_EQUIV Xs Es) /\
        Qs IN (CCS_solution STRONG_EQUIV Xs Es) ==> STRONG_EQUIV Ps Qs

name: OBS_contracts_transitive
statement:
!(Ps :'a CCS list) Qs Rs.
          LIST_REL OBS_contracts Ps Qs /\ LIST_REL OBS_contracts Qs Rs
      ==> LIST_REL OBS_contracts Ps Rs

name: OBS_contracts_reflexive
statement: !(Ps :'a CCS list). LIST_REL OBS_contracts Ps Ps

name: USC_unfolding_lemma1
statement:
!Xs Es E C0 Ps.
           CCS_equation Xs Es /\ EVERY (context Xs) Es /\
           CCS_solution OBS_contracts Xs Es Ps /\ context Xs C /\
           (E = \Ys. MAP (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ys)) Es) /\
           (C0 = \Ys. (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ys)) C)
       ==> !n. OBS_contracts (C0 Ps) ((C0 o (FUNPOW E n)) Ps)

name: USC_unfolding_lemma2
statement:
!Xs. ALL_DISTINCT Xs ==>
       !E. weakly_guarded Xs E ==>
           !Ps u P'. (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) /\ ALL_PROC Ps /\
                     TRANS (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) E) u P' ==>
                ?C'. context Xs C' /\
                    (P' = CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) C') /\
                    !Qs. (LENGTH Qs = LENGTH Xs) ==>
                         TRANS (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) E) u
                               (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) C')

name: USC_unfolding_lemma3
statement:
!Xs Es C E. ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ context Xs C /\
               (LENGTH Es = LENGTH Xs) /\
                EVERY (weakly_guarded Xs) Es /\
               (E = \Ys. MAP (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ys)) Es) ==>
       !Ps x P'. (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) /\ ALL_PROC Ps /\
                 TRANS (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs (E Ps)) C) x P' ==>
          ?C'. context Xs C' /\
              (P' = CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) C') /\
              !Qs. (LENGTH Qs = LENGTH Xs) ==>
                    TRANS (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs (E Qs)) C) x
                          (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) C')

name: USC_unfolding_lemma4
statement:
!Xs Es C E C0.
           CCS_equation Xs Es /\ EVERY (weakly_guarded Xs) Es /\
           context Xs C /\
          (E = \Ys. MAP (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ys)) Es) /\
          (C0 = \Ys. (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ys)) C) ==>
       !n xs Ps P'.
          (LENGTH Ps = LENGTH Xs) /\ ALL_PROC Ps /\
           TRACE ((C0 o FUNPOW E n) Ps) xs P' /\ LENGTH xs <= n ==>
           ?C''. context Xs C'' /\
                (P' = CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) C'') /\
                !Qs. (LENGTH Qs = LENGTH Xs) ==>
                      TRACE ((C0 o FUNPOW E n) Qs) xs
                            (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) C'')

name: unique_solution_of_rooted_contractions_lemma
statement:
!Xs Es Ps Qs. CCS_equation Xs Es /\ EVERY (weakly_guarded Xs) Es /\
                  CCS_solution OBS_contracts Xs Es Ps /\
                  CCS_solution OBS_contracts Xs Es Qs ==>
        !C. context Xs C ==>
            (!l R. WEAK_TRANS (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) C) (label l) R ==>
                   ?C'. context Xs C' /\
                        R contracts (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) C') /\
                        (WEAK_EQUIV O (\x y. WEAK_TRANS x (label l) y))
                          (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) C)
                          (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) C')) /\
            (!R. WEAK_TRANS (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) C) tau R ==>
                 ?C'. context Xs C' /\
                      R contracts (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) C') /\
                      (WEAK_EQUIV O EPS) (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) C)
                                         (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) C'))

name: shared_lemma
statement:
CCS_equation Xs Es /\
   EVERY (weakly_guarded Xs) Es /\
   CCS_solution OBS_contracts Xs Es Ps /\
   CCS_solution OBS_contracts Xs Es Qs
  ==>
   WEAK_BISIM (\R S. ?C. context Xs C /\
                         WEAK_EQUIV R (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps) C) /\
                         WEAK_EQUIV S (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Qs) C))

name: fromList_def

name: context_def

name: weakly_guarded_def

name: CCS_equation_def

        ALL_DISTINCT Xs /\ LENGTH Es = LENGTH Xs /\
        EVERY (\e. (FV e) SUBSET (set Xs)) Es

name: CCS_solution_def

        ALL_PROC Ps /\
        LIST_REL R Ps (MAP (CCS_SUBST (fromList Xs Ps)) Es)

         (!E2. TRANS E' (label l) E2 ==>
               ?E1. WEAK_TRANS E  (label l) E1 /\ WEAK_EQUIV E1 E2)) /\
       (!E1. TRANS E  tau E1 ==> (?E2. EPS E' E2 /\ WEAK_EQUIV E1 E2)) /\

rho a =

    if x = 0 ∧ y = 0 then f (x, y, z)
    else
      let t = LEAST t. rho_xy t = (x, y) in
      let tt = ((t + 1) * (t + 2)) DIV 2 in
      let ww = ((24 * 25) DIV 2) * a.w in
      f (x, y, (z + ww - tt) MOD a.w))

name: rc_step_def
statement:
rc_step r =
  let ra = F :: r in
  let re =
    GENLIST (λi.
      if i ∈ {0; 4; 5; 6} then
        EL i ra ≠ EL 8 ra
      else
        EL i ra)
      9
  in
    TAKE 8 re

name: rc_def
statement:
rc t =
  if t MOD 255 = 0 then T else
  HD (FUNPOW rc_step (t MOD 255) (T :: REPLICATE 7 F))

name: iota_def
statement:
iota a i =
  a with A updated_by (λf. restrict a.w $ λ(x, y, z).
    if x = 0 ∧ y = 0 then
      let l = w2l a.w in
      let RCz = case some j. j ≤ l ∧ z = 2 ** j - 1
                of NONE => F
                 | SOME j => rc (j + 7 * i)
      in
        f (x, y, z) ≠ RCz
    else f (x, y, z))

  let a1 = FST (FUNPOW (λ(a,i). (Rnd a i, SUC i)) (SUC i1 - i0) (a, i0)) in
  state_array_to_string a1

name: sponge_def
statement:
sponge f b pad r N d =
  let P = N ++ pad r (LENGTH N) in
  let c = b - r in
  let Pis = chunks r P in
  let S0 = REPLICATE b F in
  let S = FOLDL (λSi Pi. f (MAP2 $<> Si (Pi ++ REPLICATE c F))) S0 Pis in
  let Z = FST $ WHILE
    (λ(Z, S). LENGTH Z < d)
    (λ(Z, S). (Z ++ (TAKE r S), f S))
    ([], S) in
  TAKE d Z

name: theta_spt_def
statement:
theta_spt t =
  let w = b2w $ size t in
  let c = fromList (
    GENLIST (λi.
      (THE (lookup i t) ≠
        (THE (lookup (i + 5 * w) t) ≠
          (THE (lookup (i + 10 * w) t) ≠
            (THE (lookup (i + 15 * w) t) ≠
              (THE (lookup (i + 20 * w) t)))))))
      (5 * w)) in
  let d = fromList (
    GENLIST (λi.
      (THE (lookup (((i DIV w + 4) MOD 5) * w + i MOD w) c) ≠
       THE (lookup (((i DIV w + 1) MOD 5) * w + (i MOD w + PRE w) MOD w) c)))
      (5 * w)) in
  mapi (λi b. b ≠ THE (lookup (((i DIV w) MOD 5) * w + i MOD w) d)) t

name: spt_to_state_array_def

  let w = b2w $ size t in
  <| w := w
   ; A := restrict w $

              of SOME b => b | NONE => F
   |>

statement:

    x < 5 ∧ y < 5 ∧ z < w ∧

    of NONE => F | SOME b => b

name: rho_spt_def
statement:
rho_spt a =
    let w = b2w $ size a in
    let ww = 300 * w in
    let (x,y,t,a') =
    WHILE (λ(x,y,t,a'). t ≤ 23)
      (λ(x,y,t,a'). (y, (2 * x + 3 * y) MOD 5, t + 1,
        let tt = (t + 1) * (t + 2) DIV 2 in
        SND $
        WHILE (λ(z,a'). z < w) (λ(z,a'). (z+1,
          insert (triple_to_index w (x,y,z))
            (THE $ lookup (triple_to_index w (x,y,(z + ww - tt) MOD w)) a)
          a'))
          (0, a')))
      (1,0,0,a)
    in a'

name: pi_spt_def
statement:
pi_spt a =
  let w = b2w (size a) in
  fromList (GENLIST (λi.
    let (x, y, z) = index_to_triple w i in
      THE (lookup (triple_to_index w ((x + 3 * y) MOD 5, x, z)) a)
  ) (size a))

name: chi_spt_def
statement:
chi_spt a =
    let w = b2w (size a) in
    mapi (λk v.
      let (x,y,z) = index_to_triple w k in
      let v1 = THE (lookup (triple_to_index w ((x + 1) MOD 5, y, z)) a) in
      let v2 = THE (lookup (triple_to_index w ((x + 2) MOD 5, y, z)) a) in
      v ≠ (¬v1 ∧ v2)) a

name: iota_spt_def
statement:
iota_spt a i =
  let w = b2w (size a) in
  mapi (λk v.
    let (x,y,z) = index_to_triple w k in
    if x = 0 ∧ y = 0 then
      let l = w2l w in
      let RCz = ((z = 2 ** LOG2 (SUC z) - 1 ∧ LOG2 (SUC z) ≤ l) ∧
                 rc (LOG2 (SUC z) + 7 * i)) in
        THE (lookup (triple_to_index w (0,0,z)) a) ≠ RCz
    else v) a

name: Rnd_spt_def

name: Keccak_p_spt_def

  let t = FST (FUNPOW (λ(t, i). (Rnd_spt t i, SUC i)) (SUC i1 - i0)
               (fromList s, i0)) in
    spt_to_string t

name: Pohjola_def
statement:
(∀p q P D.
    Pohjola P p D ⇒
    Pohjola P (Seq p q) D)
  ∧
  (∀p q P M D.
    Hoare P p M ∧ Pohjola M q D ⇒
    Pohjola P (Seq p q) D)
  ∧
  (∀x p q P D.
    Pohjola (λs. P s ∧  guard x s) p D ∧
    Pohjola (λs. P s ∧ ~guard x s) q D ⇒
    Pohjola P (If x p q) D)
  ∧
  
  (∀P x p (D: value llist -> bool).
    (∀s. P s ⇒
         ∃H ev.
           guard x s ∧ H 0 s ∧ ignores_output H ∧
           D (FLAT (output_of s ::: fromSeq ev)) ∧
           ∀i. Hoare (λs. H i s ∧ output_of s = []) p
                     (λs. H (i+1) s ∧ output_of s = ev i ∧ guard x s)) ⇒
    Pohjola P (While x p) D)
  ∧
  

  (∀P x p R b.
    (∀s. P s ⇒ guard x s) ∧ WF R ∧
    (∀s0. Hoare (λs. P s ∧ b s ∧ s = s0) p (λs. P s ∧ R s s0)) ∧
    Pohjola (λs. P s ∧ ~b s) p D ⇒
    Pohjola P (While x p) D)
  ∧
  

  (∀p D.
    Pohjola (λs. F) p D)
  ∧
  (∀P p D b.
    Pohjola (λs. P s ∧ b s) p D ∧
    Pohjola (λs. P s ∧ ~b s) p D ⇒
    Pohjola P p D)
  ∧
  (∀P p D P' D'.
    (∀s. P s ⇒ P' s) ∧ Pohjola P' p D' ∧ (∀s. D' s ⇒ D s) ⇒
    Pohjola P p D)

name: Hoare_def
statement:
(∀P.
    Hoare P Skip P)
  ∧
  (∀Q n x.
    Hoare (Q o subst n x) (Assign n x) Q)
  ∧
  (∀Q x.
    Hoare (Q o print x) (Print x) Q)
  ∧
  (∀p q P M Q.
    Hoare P p M ∧ Hoare M q Q ⇒
    Hoare P (Seq p q) Q)
  ∧
  (∀x p q P Q.
    Hoare (λs. P s ∧  guard x s) p Q ∧
    Hoare (λs. P s ∧ ~guard x s) q Q ⇒
    Hoare P (If x p q) Q)
  ∧
  (∀P x p R.
    (∀s0. Hoare (λs. P s ∧ guard x s ∧ s = s0) p (λs. P s ∧ R s s0)) ∧ WF R ⇒
    Hoare P (While x p) (λs. P s ∧ ~guard x s))
  ∧
  (∀P p Q P' Q'.
    (∀s. P s ⇒ P' s) ∧ Hoare P' p Q' ∧ (∀s. Q' s ⇒ Q s) ⇒
    Hoare P p Q)

name: Hoare_strengthen
statement: ∀P P' p Q. (∀s. P s ⇒ P' s) ∧ Hoare P' p Q ⇒ Hoare P p Q

name: Hoare_While
statement:
(∀s. P s ⇒ Inv s) ∧ (∀s. Inv s ∧ ¬guard x s ⇒ Q s) ∧
  (∀s0. Hoare (λs. Inv s ∧ guard x s ∧ s = s0) p (λs. Inv s ∧ m s < ((m s0):num))) ⇒
  Hoare P (While x p) Q

name: Hoare_terminates
statement: Hoare (λs. ∃t. terminates s c t ∧ Q t) c Q

name: Hoare_completeness
statement: ∀P c Q. HoareSem P c Q ⇒ Hoare P c Q

name: Hoare_soundness
statement: ∀P c Q. Hoare P c Q ⇒ HoareSem P c Q

name: output_of_def

name: subst_def

name: guard_def
statement: guard x ((s,out):state) = (x s ≠ 0)

name: step_def
statement:
(∀s:state.
    step (Skip,s) (Skip,s))
  ∧
  (∀s n x.
     step (Assign n x,s) (Skip, subst n x s))
  ∧
  (∀s x.
     step (Print x,s) (Skip, print x s))
  ∧
  (∀s q.
     step (Seq Skip q,s) (q,s))
  ∧
  (∀p0 p1 q s0 s1.
     step (p0,s0) (p1,s1) ∧ p0 ≠ Skip ⇒
     step (Seq p0 q,s0) (Seq p1 q,s1))
  ∧
  (∀x p q s.
     step (If x p q, s) ((if guard x s then p else q), s))
  ∧
  (∀x p s.
     step (While x p, s) (If x (Seq p (While x p)) Skip, s))

name: terminates_def
statement: ∀s p t. RTC step (p,s) (Skip,t) ⇒ terminates s p t

name: diverges_def
statement:
∀s p output.
    (∀t. ~(terminates s p t)) ∧
    output = LUB { fromList out | ∃q t. RTC step (p,s) (q,t,out) }
    ⇒
    diverges s p output

name: step_exists
statement: ∀s. ∃t. step s t

name: terminates_or_diverges
statement:
∀s p.
    (∃t. terminates s p t) ∨ (∃output. diverges s p output)

name: step_deterministic
statement: ∀s t1 t2. step s t1 ∧ step s t2 ⇒ t1 = t2

name: NRC_step_deterministic
statement: ∀n x y z. NRC step n x y ∧ NRC step n x z ⇒ y = z

name: terminates_deterministic
statement: ∀s p t1 t2. terminates s p t1 ∧ terminates s p t2 ⇒ t1 = t2

name: diverges_deterministic
statement: ∀s p t1 t2. diverges s p t1 ∧ diverges s p t2 ⇒ t1 = t2

name: NRC_step
statement: ∀n s t. NRC step n (Skip,s) (Skip,t) ⇒ s = t

name: terminates_Skip
statement:
terminates s Skip t
  ⇔
  s = t

name: terminates_Assign
statement:
terminates s (Assign n x) t
  ⇔
  t = subst n x s

name: terminates_Print
statement:
terminates s (Print x) t
  ⇔
  t = print x s

name: terminates_If
statement:
terminates s (If x p q) t
  ⇔
  terminates s (if guard x s then p else q) t

name: terminates_While
statement:
terminates s (While f c) t
  ⇔
  terminates s (If f (Seq c (While f c)) Skip) t

name: terminates
statement:
terminates s p t ⇔
    RTC real_step (p,s) (Skip,t)

name: NRC_real_step_Skip
statement: NRC real_step n (Skip,s) (Skip,t) ⇔ n = 0 ∧ s = t

name: NRC_real_step_not_Skip
statement:
p ≠ Skip ⇒
  (NRC real_step n (p,s) (Skip,t) ⇔
   ∃k m. real_step (p,s) m ∧ NRC real_step k m (Skip,t) ∧ n = k + 1)

name: real_steps_Seq
statement:
∀n p q s t.
    NRC real_step n (Seq p q,s) (Skip,t) ⇔
    ∃n1 n2 m.
      NRC real_step n1 (p,s) (Skip,m) ∧
      NRC real_step n2 (q,m) (Skip,t) ∧ n = n1 + n2 + 1

name: terminates_eq_exec
statement: terminates s p t ⇔ exec s p t

name: terminates_Seq
statement:
terminates s (Seq p q) t
  ⇔
  ∃m. terminates s p m ∧ terminates m q t

name: terminates_While_NRC
statement:
∀m f c t. terminates m (While f c) t ⇒
            ∃n. NRC (λs t. guard f s ∧ terminates s c t) n m t ∧ ¬guard f t

  ~diverges s (Print x) l

name: RTC_Seq

name: NRC_step_output_mono
statement: ∀k c s c' s'. NRC step k (c,s) (c',s') ⇒ output_of s ≼ output_of s'

name: lprefix_chain_RTC_step
statement: lprefix_chain {fromList out | (∃q t. RTC step x (q,t,out))}

name: diverges_Seq
statement:
diverges s (Seq c c') l ⇔
  diverges s c l ∨ ∃t. terminates s c t ∧ diverges t c' l

name: diverges_If
statement: diverges s (If f p q) l = diverges s (if guard f s then p else q) l

name: diverges_While

name: NRC_terminates

name: terminates_history
statement:

name: exec_FST
statement:
exec s c s1 ⇒

name: real_step_def
statement: real_step (p,s) (q,t) ⇔ p ≠ Skip ∧ step (p,s) (q,t)

name: exec_def
statement:
(∀s:state.
     exec s Skip s)
  ∧
  (∀s n x.
     exec s (Assign n x) (subst n x s))
  ∧
  (∀s x.
     exec s (Print x) (print x s))
  ∧
  (∀p q s0 s1 s2.
     exec s0 p s1 ∧ exec s1 q s2 ⇒
     exec s0 (Seq p q) s2)
  ∧
  (∀x p q s.
     exec s (if guard x s then p else q) s1 ⇒
     exec s (If x p q) s1)
  ∧
  (∀x p s.
     ~guard x s ⇒
     exec s (While x p) s)
  ∧
  (∀x p s s1 s2.
     guard x s ∧
     exec s p s1 ∧
     exec s1 (While x p) s2 ⇒
     exec s (While x p) s2)

name: patV_def

(patV wild_pat           = {}) /\
 (patV (var_pat v)        = {v})

name: Vars_def
statement:
(atexpV (var_exp v)      = {v}) /\
    (atexpV (let_exp d e)    = (decV d) UNION (expV e))
     /\
    (expV (aexp a)           = atexpV a) /\
    (expV (app_exp e a)      = (expV e) UNION (atexpV a)) /\
    (expV (fn_exp m)         = matchV m)
     /\
    (matchV (match r)        = ruleV r) /\
    (matchV (matchl r mrst)  = (ruleV r) UNION (matchV mrst))
     /\
    (ruleV (rule p e)        = (patV p) UNION (expV e))
     /\
    (decV (val_dec b)        = valbindV b) /\
    (decV (local_dec d1 d2)  = (decV d1) UNION (decV d2)) /\
    (decV (seq_dec d1 d2)    = (decV d1) UNION (decV d2))
     /\
    (valbindV (bind p e)     = (patV p) UNION (expV e)) /\
    (valbindV (bindl p e vb) = (patV p) UNION (expV e) UNION (valbindV vb)) /\
    (valbindV (rec_bind vb)  = (valbindV vb))

!f g1:'a group g2 h1 h2.

    SURJ f g1.carrier g2.carrier /\ kernel f g1 g2 SUBSET h1.carrier ==>

       kernel_group f (preimage_group f g1 g2 h.carrier) g2).carrier

name: subgroup_cross_card_eqn
statement:
!(g h1 h2):'a group. h1 <= g /\ h2 <= g /\ FINITE G ==>
   let (s1 = h1.carrier) in let (s2 = h2.carrier) in
    (CARD (h1 o h2).carrier * CARD (s1 INTER s2) = (CARD s1) * (CARD s2))

name: action_closure
statement: !f g X. (g act X) f ==> !a x. a IN G /\ x IN X ==> f a x IN X

name: action_compose
statement: !f g X. (g act X) f ==> !a b x. a IN G /\ b IN G /\ x IN X ==> f a (f b x) = f (a * b) x

name: action_id
statement: !f g X. (g act X) f ==> !x. x IN X ==> f #e x = x

name: action_reverse
statement:
!f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f ==>
          !a x y. a IN G /\ x IN X /\ y IN X /\ f a x = y ==> f ( |/ a) y = x

name: action_trans
statement:
!f g X. (g act X) f ==> !a b x y z. a IN G /\ b IN G /\
          x IN X /\ y IN X /\ z IN X /\ f a x = y /\ f b y = z ==> f (b * a) x = z

name: reach_refl
statement: !f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==> (x ~~ x) f g

name: reach_sym
statement: !f g X x y. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X /\ y IN X /\ (x ~~ y) f g ==> (y ~~ x) f g

name: reach_trans
statement:
!f g X x y z. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X /\ y IN X /\ z IN X /\
                (x ~~ y) f g /\ (y ~~ z) f g ==> (x ~~ z) f g

name: reach_equiv
statement: !f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f ==> (reach f g) equiv_on X

name: orbit_alt
statement: !f g x. orbit f g x = {f a x | a IN G}

name: orbit_element
statement: !f g x y. y IN orbit f g x <=> (x ~~ y) f g

name: orbit_has_action_element
statement: !f g x a. a IN G ==> f a x IN (orbit f g x)

name: orbit_has_self
statement: !f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==> x IN orbit f g x

name: orbit_subset_target
statement: !f g X x. (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==> (orbit f g x) SUBSET X

name: orbit_element_in_target
statement: !f g X x y. (g act X) f /\ x IN X /\ y IN (orbit f g x) ==> y IN X

name: orbit_finite
statement: !f (g:'a group) x. FINITE G ==> FINITE (orbit f g x)

name: orbit_finite_by_target
statement: !f g X x. (g act X) f /\ x IN X /\ FINITE X ==> FINITE (orbit f g x)

name: orbit_eq_equiv_class
statement: !f g X x. (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==> orbit f g x = equiv_class (reach f g) X x

name: orbit_eq_orbit
statement:
!f g X x y. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X /\ y IN X ==>
              (orbit f g x = orbit f g y <=> (x ~~ y) f g)

name: orbits_alt
statement: !f g X. orbits f g X = {orbit f g x | x | x IN X}

name: orbits_element
statement: !f g X e. e IN orbits f g X <=> ?x. x IN X /\ e = orbit f g x

name: orbits_eq_partition
statement: !f g X. (g act X) f ==> orbits f g X = partition (reach f g) X

name: orbits_finite
statement: !f g X. FINITE X ==> FINITE (orbits f g X)

name: orbits_element_finite
statement: !f g X. (g act X) f /\ FINITE X ==> EVERY_FINITE (orbits f g X)

name: orbits_element_nonempty
statement: !f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f ==> !e. e IN orbits f g X ==> e <> EMPTY

name: orbits_element_subset
statement: !f g X e. (g act X) f /\ e IN orbits f g X ==> e SUBSET X

name: orbits_element_element
statement: !f g X e x. (g act X) f /\ e IN orbits f g X /\ x IN e ==> x IN X

name: orbit_is_orbits_element
statement: !f g X x. x IN X ==> (orbit f g x) IN (orbits f g X)

name: orbits_element_is_orbit
statement:
!f g X e x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ e IN orbits f g X /\
              x IN e ==> e = orbit f g x

name: action_to_orbit_surj
statement: !f g X x. (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==> SURJ (\a. f a x) G (orbit f g x)

name: orbit_finite_inj_card_eq
statement:
!f g X x. (g act X) f /\ x IN X /\ FINITE X /\
            INJ (\a. f a x) G (orbit f g x) ==> CARD (orbit f g x) = CARD G

name: target_card_by_partition
statement:
!f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ FINITE X ==>
          CARD X = SIGMA CARD (orbits f g X)

name: orbits_equal_size_partition_equal_size
statement:
!f g X n. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ FINITE X /\
            (!x. x IN X ==> CARD (orbit f g x) = n) ==>
            (!e. e IN orbits f g X ==> CARD e = n)

name: orbits_equal_size_property
statement:
!f g X n. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ FINITE X /\
            (!x. x IN X ==> (CARD (orbit f g x) = n)) ==> n divides (CARD X)

name: orbits_size_factor_partition_factor
statement:
!f g X n. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ FINITE X /\
            (!x. x IN X ==> n divides (CARD (orbit f g x))) ==>
            (!e. e IN orbits f g X ==> n divides (CARD e))

name: orbits_size_factor_property
statement:
!f g X n. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ FINITE X /\
            (!x. x IN X ==> n divides (CARD (orbit f g x))) ==> n divides (CARD X)

name: stabilizer_element
statement: !f g x a. a IN stabilizer f g x <=> a IN G /\ f a x = x

name: stabilizer_subset
statement: !f g x. (stabilizer f g x) SUBSET G

name: stabilizer_has_id
statement: !f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==> #e IN stabilizer f g x

name: stabilizer_nonempty
statement: !f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==> stabilizer f g x <> EMPTY

name: stabilizer_as_image
statement:
!f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==>
            stabilizer f g x = IMAGE (\a. if f a x = x then a else #e) G

name: stabilizer_group_property
statement:
!f g x. (StabilizerGroup f g x).carrier = stabilizer f g x /\
          (StabilizerGroup f g x).op = g.op /\
          (StabilizerGroup f g x).id = #e

name: stabilizer_group_carrier
statement: !f g x. (StabilizerGroup f g x).carrier = stabilizer f g x

name: stabilizer_group_id
statement: !f g x. (StabilizerGroup f g x).id = g.id

name: stabilizer_group_group
statement: !f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==> Group (StabilizerGroup f g x)

name: stabilizer_group_subgroup
statement: !f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==> (StabilizerGroup f g x) <= g

name: stabilizer_group_finite_group
statement:
!f g X x. FiniteGroup g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==>
            FiniteGroup (StabilizerGroup f g x)

name: stabilizer_group_card_divides
statement:
!f (g:'a group) X x. FiniteGroup g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==>
                       CARD (stabilizer f g x) divides (CARD G)

name: orbit_stabilizer_map_good
statement:
!f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==>
            !a b. a IN G /\ b IN G /\ f a x = f b x ==>
                  a * (stabilizer f g x) = b * (stabilizer f g x)

name: orbit_stabilizer_map_inj
statement:
!f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==>
            !a b. a IN G /\ b IN G /\
                  a * (stabilizer f g x) = b * (stabilizer f g x) ==>
                  f a x = f b x

name: action_match_condition
statement:
!f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==>
            !a b. a IN G /\ b IN G ==>
                  (f a x = f b x <=> ( |/ a * b) IN (stabilizer f g x))

name: action_match_condition_alt
statement:
!f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==>
            !a b::G. f a x = f b x <=> ( |/ a * b) IN (stabilizer f g x)

name: stabilizer_conjugate
statement:
!f g X x a. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X /\ a IN G ==>
              conjugate g a (stabilizer f g x) = stabilizer f g (f a x)

name: action_reachable_coset
statement:
!f g X x y. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X /\ y IN orbit f g x ==>
              (act_by f g x y) * (stabilizer f g x) = {a | a IN G /\ f a x = y}

name: action_reachable_coset_alt
orbit_stabilizer_cosets_bij
statement:
!f g X x. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==>
            BIJ (\y. (act_by f g x y) * (stabilizer f g x))
                (orbit f g x)
                {a * (stabilizer f g x) | a IN G}

name: orbit_stabilizer_cosets_bij_alt
statement:
!f g X x.
     Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X ==>
     BIJ (\y. (act_by f g x y) * (stabilizer f g x))
         (orbit f g x)
         (CosetPartition g (StabilizerGroup f g x))

name: orbit_stabilizer_thm
statement:
!f (g:'a group) X x. FiniteGroup g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X /\ FINITE X ==>
                       CARD G = CARD (orbit f g x) * CARD (stabilizer f g x)

name: orbit_card_divides_target_card
statement:
!f (g:'a group) X x. FiniteGroup g /\ (g act X) f /\ x IN X /\ FINITE X ==>
                       CARD (orbit f g x) divides CARD G

name: fixed_points_element
statement: !f g X x. x IN (fixed_points f g X) <=> x IN X /\ !a. a IN G ==> f a x = x

name: fixed_points_subset
statement: !f g X. (fixed_points f g X) SUBSET X

name: fixed_points_finite
statement: !f g X. FINITE X ==> FINITE (fixed_points f g X)

name: fixed_points_element_element
statement: !f g X x. x IN fixed_points f g X ==> x IN X

name: fixed_points_orbit_sing
orbit_sing_fixed_points
statement:
!f g X. (g act X) f ==>
          !x. x IN X /\ orbit f g x = {x} ==> x IN fixed_points f g X

name: fixed_points_orbit_iff_sing
statement:
!f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f ==>
          !x. x IN X ==> (x IN fixed_points f g X <=> SING (orbit f g x))

name: non_fixed_points_orbit_not_sing
statement:
!f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f ==>
          !x. x IN (X DIFF fixed_points f g X) <=>
              x IN X /\ ~ SING (orbit f g x)

name: non_fixed_points_card
statement:
!f g X. FINITE X ==>
          CARD (X DIFF fixed_points f g X) =
          CARD X - CARD (fixed_points f g X)

name: sing_orbits_element
statement: !f g X e. e IN sing_orbits f g X <=> e IN (orbits f g X) /\ SING e

name: sing_orbits_subset
statement: !f g X. (sing_orbits f g X) SUBSET (orbits f g X)

name: sing_orbits_finite
statement: !f g X. FINITE X ==> FINITE (sing_orbits f g X)

name: sing_orbits_element_subset
statement: !f g X e. (g act X) f /\ e IN (sing_orbits f g X) ==> e SUBSET X

name: sing_orbits_element_finite
statement: !f g X e. e IN (sing_orbits f g X) ==> FINITE e

name: sing_orbits_element_card
statement: !f g X e. e IN (sing_orbits f g X) ==> CARD e = 1

name: sing_orbits_element_choice
statement:
!f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f ==>
          !e. e IN (sing_orbits f g X) ==> CHOICE e IN fixed_points f g X

name: multi_orbits_element
statement: !f g X e. e IN multi_orbits f g X <=> e IN (orbits f g X) /\ ~SING e

name: multi_orbits_subset
statement: !f g X. (multi_orbits f g X) SUBSET (orbits f g X)

name: multi_orbits_finite
statement: !f g X. FINITE X ==> FINITE (multi_orbits f g X)

name: multi_orbits_element_subset
statement: !f g X e. (g act X) f /\ e IN (multi_orbits f g X) ==> e SUBSET X

name: multi_orbits_element_finite
statement: !f g X e. (g act X) f /\ FINITE X /\ e IN (multi_orbits f g X) ==> FINITE e

name: target_orbits_disjoint
statement: !f g X. DISJOINT (sing_orbits f g X) (multi_orbits f g X)

name: target_orbits_union
statement: !f g X. orbits f g X = (sing_orbits f g X) UNION (multi_orbits f g X)

name: target_card_by_orbit_types
statement:
!f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ FINITE X ==>
          CARD X = CARD (sing_orbits f g X) + SIGMA CARD (multi_orbits f g X)

name: sing_orbits_to_fixed_points_inj
statement:
!f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f ==>
          INJ (\e. CHOICE e) (sing_orbits f g X) (fixed_points f g X)

name: sing_orbits_to_fixed_points_surj
statement:
!f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f ==>
          SURJ (\e. CHOICE e) (sing_orbits f g X) (fixed_points f g X)

name: sing_orbits_to_fixed_points_bij
statement:
!f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f ==>
          BIJ (\e. CHOICE e) (sing_orbits f g X) (fixed_points f g X)

name: sing_orbits_card_eqn
statement:
!f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ FINITE X ==>
          CARD (sing_orbits f g X) = CARD (fixed_points f g X)

name: target_card_by_fixed_points
statement:
!f g X. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ FINITE X ==>
          CARD X = CARD (fixed_points f g X) + SIGMA CARD (multi_orbits f g X)

name: target_card_and_fixed_points_congruence
statement:
!f g X n. Group g /\ (g act X) f /\ FINITE X /\ 0 < n /\
            (!e. e IN multi_orbits f g X ==> (CARD e = n)) ==>
            CARD X MOD n = CARD (fixed_points f g X) MOD n

name: action_def
statement:
action f (g:'a group) (X:'b -> bool) =
       !x. x IN X ==> (!a. a IN G ==> f a x IN X) /\
                      f #e x = x /\
                      (!a b. a IN G /\ b IN G ==> f a (f b x) = f (a * b) x)

name: orbit_def
statement: orbit (f:'a -> 'b -> 'b) (g:'a group) (x:'b) = IMAGE (\a. f a x) G

name: orbits_def
statement: orbits f (g:'a group) X = IMAGE (orbit f g) X

name: StabilizerGroup_def
orders_is_feq_class_order
statement: !g:'a group. orders g = feq_class ord G

name: cyclic_image_ord_is_divisors
statement: !g:'a group. cyclic g /\ FINITE G ==> (IMAGE ord G = divisors (CARD G))

name: cyclic_orders_partition
statement:
!g:'a group. cyclic g /\ FINITE G ==>
       (partition (eq_order g) G = IMAGE (orders g) (divisors (CARD G)))

name: finite_cyclic_group_uniqueness
statement:
!g1:'a group g2:'b group.
    cyclic g1 /\ cyclic g2 /\ FINITE g1.carrier /\ FINITE g2.carrier /\
    (CARD g1.carrier = CARD g2.carrier) ==>
    ?f. GroupIso f g1 g2

name: Zadd_carrier
statement: !n. (Z n).carrier = count n

name: Zadd_carrier_alt
statement: !n. (Z n).carrier = {i | i < n}

name: Zadd_id
statement: !n. (Z n).id = 0

name: Zstar_carrier
statement: !p. (Z* p).carrier = residue p

name: Zstar_carrier_alt
statement: !p. (Z* p).carrier = {i | 0 < i /\ i < p}

name: Estar_carrier
statement: !n. (Estar n).carrier = Euler n

name: Estar_carrier_alt
statement: !n. (Estar n).carrier = {i | 0 < i /\ i < n /\ coprime n i }

name: Estar_id
statement: !n. (Estar n).id = 1

name: trivial_group_carrier
statement: !e. (trivial_group e).carrier = {e}

name: trivial_group_id
statement: !e. (trivial_group e).id = e

name: fn_cyclic_group_carrier
statement: !e f. (fn_cyclic_group e f).carrier = { x | ?n. FUNPOW f n e = x }

name: fn_cyclic_group_id
statement: !e f. (fn_cyclic_group e f).id = e

name: add_mod_carrier
statement: !n. (add_mod n).carrier = { i | i < n }

name: add_mod_carrier_alt
statement: !n. (add_mod n).carrier = count n

name: add_mod_id
statement: !n. (add_mod n).id = 0

name: mult_mod_carrier
statement: !p. (mult_mod p).carrier = { i | i <> 0 /\ i < p }

name: mult_mod_carrier_alt
statement: !p. (mult_mod p).carrier = residue p

name: mult_mod_id
statement: !p. (mult_mod p).id = 1

name: group_homo_sym_any
statement:
Group g /\ GroupHomo f g h /\
  (!x. x IN h.carrier ==> i x IN g.carrier /\ f (i x) = x) /\
  (!x. x IN g.carrier ==> i (f x) = x)
  ==>
  GroupHomo i h g

name: group_homo_monoid_homo
statement: !f g h. (GroupHomo f g h /\ f #e = h.id) <=> MonoidHomo f g h

name: group_iso_monoid_iso
statement: !f g h. (GroupIso f g h /\ f #e = h.id) <=> MonoidIso f g h

name: group_inj_image_group
statement: !(g:'a group) (f:'a -> 'b). Group g /\ INJ f G univ(:'b) ==> Group (monoid_inj_image g f)

name: group_inj_image_abelian_group
statement:
!(g:'a group) (f:'a -> 'b). AbelianGroup g /\ INJ f G univ(:'b) ==>
       AbelianGroup (monoid_inj_image g f)

name: group_inj_image_excluding_group
statement:
!(g:'a group) (f:'a -> 'b) e.
      Group (g excluding e) /\ INJ f G univ(:'b) /\ e IN G ==>
      Group (monoid_inj_image g f excluding f e)

name: group_inj_image_excluding_abelian_group
statement:
!(g:'a group) (f:'a -> 'b) e.
      AbelianGroup (g excluding e) /\ INJ f G univ(:'b) /\ e IN G ==>
      AbelianGroup (monoid_inj_image g f excluding f e)

name: group_inj_image_group_homo
statement: !(g:'a group) f. INJ f G univ(:'b) ==> GroupHomo f g (monoid_inj_image g f)

name: group_uroots_group
statement: !g:'a group. AbelianGroup g ==> !n. Group (uroots n)

name: group_uroots_group
statement: !g:'a group. AbelianGroup g ==> !n. Group (uroots n)

name: Generated_subset_subset
statement: !(g:'a group) s. Group g /\ s SUBSET G ==> (gen_set s).carrier SUBSET G

name: real_add_group
statement: AbelianGroup real_add_monoid

name: real_mul_group
statement: AbelianGroup (real_mul_monoid excluding 0)

name: group_inv_element
statement: !g:'a group. Group g ==> !x. x IN G ==> |/x IN G

name: group_alt
statement:
!(g:'a group). Group g <=>
          (!x y::G. x * y IN G) /\ 
          (!x y z::G. x * y * z = x * (y * z)) /\ 
          #e IN G /\ (!x::G. #e * x = x) /\ 
          !x::G. |/ x IN G /\ |/ x * x = #e

name: group_including_excluding_eqn
coset_id_eq_subgroup
statement: !(g:'a group) h. h <= g ==> (#e * H = H)

name: IMAGE_ID_lemma
statement: (!x. x IN s ==> (f x = x)) ==> (IMAGE f s = s)

name: coset_id_eq_subgroup
statement: !(g:'a group) h. h <= g ==> (#e * H = H)

name: coset_id_eq_subgroup
statement: !(g:'a group) h. h <= g ==> (#e * H = H)

name: residue_0
statement: residue 0 = {}

name: residue_1
statement: residue 1 = {}

name: residue_no_zero
statement: !n. 0 NOTIN residue n

name: residue_no_self
statement: !n. n NOTIN residue n

name: prod_set_residue
statement: !n. PROD_SET (residue n) = FACT (n - 1)

name: upto_delete
statement: !n. (upto n) DELETE n = count n

name: mod_mod_prod_eq
statement:
!m n a b. 0 < m /\ 0 < n /\ a MOD (m * n) = b MOD (m * n) ==>
            a MOD m = b MOD m /\ a MOD n = b MOD n

name: coprime_mod_mod_prod_eq
statement:
!m n a b. 0 < m /\ 0 < n /\ coprime m n /\
            a MOD m = b MOD m /\ a MOD n = b MOD n ==>
            a MOD (m * n) = b MOD (m * n)

name: coprime_mod_mod_prod_eq_iff
statement:
!m n. 0 < m /\ 0 < n /\ coprime m n ==>
        !a b. a MOD (m * n) = b MOD (m * n) <=> a MOD m = b MOD m /\ a MOD n = b MOD n

name: coprime_mod_mod_solve
statement:
!m n a b. 0 < m /\ 0 < n /\ coprime m n ==>
            ?!x. x < m * n /\ x MOD m = a MOD m /\ x MOD n = b MOD n

name: PROD_SET_IMAGE_EXP_NONZERO
statement:
!n m. PROD_SET (IMAGE (\j. n ** j) (count m)) =
        PROD_SET (IMAGE (\j. n ** j) (residue m))

name: gcd_matches_alt
statement: !n d. gcd_matches n d = (natural n) INTER {j | gcd j n = d}

name: divisors_element
statement: !n d. d IN divisors n <=> 0 < d /\ d <= n /\ d divides n

name: divisors_element_alt
statement: !n. 0 < n ==> !d. d IN divisors n <=> d divides n

name: divisors_has_element
statement: !n d. d IN divisors n ==> 0 < n

name: divisors_has_1
statement: !n. 0 < n ==> 1 IN (divisors n)

name: divisors_has_last
statement: !n. 0 < n ==> n IN (divisors n)

name: divisors_not_empty
statement: !n. 0 < n ==> divisors n <> {}

name: divisors_0
statement: divisors 0 = {}

name: divisors_1
statement: divisors 1 = {1}

name: divisors_eq_empty
statement: !n. divisors n = {} <=> n = 0

name: divisors_eqn
statement: !n. divisors n = IMAGE (\j. if (j + 1) divides n then j + 1 else 1) (count n)

name: divisors_has_factor
statement: !n p q. 0 < n /\ n = p * q ==> p IN divisors n /\ q IN divisors n

name: divisors_has_cofactor
statement: !n d. d IN divisors n ==> (n DIV d) IN divisors n

name: divisors_delete_last
statement: !n. (divisors n) DELETE n = {m | 0 < m /\ m < n /\ m divides n}

name: divisors_nonzero
statement: !n d. d IN (divisors n) ==> 0 < d

name: divisors_subset_natural
statement: !n. (divisors n) SUBSET (natural n)

name: divisors_finite
statement: !n. FINITE (divisors n)

name: divisors_divisors_bij
statement: !n. (\d. n DIV d) PERMUTES divisors n

name: divisor_le_cofactor_ge
statement: !n p. 0 < p /\ p divides n /\ p <= SQRT n ==> SQRT n <= (n DIV p)

name: divisor_gt_cofactor_le
statement: !n p. 0 < p /\ p divides n /\ SQRT n < p ==> (n DIV p) <= SQRT n

name: divisors_cofactor_inj
statement: !n. INJ (\j. n DIV j) (divisors n) univ(:num)

name: divisors_card_upper
statement: !n. CARD (divisors n) <= 2 * SQRT n

name: divisors_eq_gcd_image
statement: !n. divisors n = IMAGE (gcd n) (natural n)

name: gcd_eq_partition_by_divisors
statement: !n. partition (feq (gcd n)) (natural n) = IMAGE (gcd_matches n) (divisors n)

name: sum_over_natural_by_divisors
statement: !f n. SIGMA f (natural n) = SIGMA (SIGMA f) (IMAGE (gcd_matches n) (divisors n))

name: gcd_matches_from_divisors_inj
statement: !n. INJ (gcd_matches n) (divisors n) univ(:num -> bool)

name: coprimes_by_with_card

name: HALF_SUC_SUC
statement: !n. 0 < n ==> HALF (SUC (SUC n)) <= n

name: HALF_SUC_LE
statement: !n m. n < HALF (SUC m) ==> 2 * n + 1 <= m

name: HALF_EVEN_LE

name: HALF_ODD_LT

name: EXP_THM
EXP_MOD_EQN
statement:
!b n m. 1 < m ==>
      ((b ** n) MOD m =
       if (n = 0) then 1
       else let result = (b * b) ** (HALF n) MOD m
             in if EVEN n then result else (b * result) MOD m)

name: DIV_POS
statement: !m n. 0 < m /\ m <= n ==> 0 < n DIV m

name: DIV_EQ
statement: !x y z. 0 < z ==> (x DIV z = y DIV z <=> x - x MOD z = y - y MOD z)

name: ADD_DIV_EQ
statement: !n a b. a MOD n + b < n ==> (a + b) DIV n = a DIV n

name: divides_iff_equal
statement: !m n. 0 < n /\ n < 2 * m ==> (m divides n <=> n = m)

name: divides_eq_thm
statement: !a b. a divides b /\ 0 < b /\ b < 2 * a ==> (b = a)

name: factor_eq_cofactor
statement: !m n. 0 < m /\ m divides n ==> (m = n DIV m <=> n = m ** 2)

name: MOD_MOD_EQN
statement: !n a b. 0 < n /\ b <= a ==> (a MOD n = b MOD n <=> ?c. a = b + c * n)

name: MOD_PLUS2
statement: !n x y. 0 < n ==> (x + y) MOD n = (x + y MOD n) MOD n

name: mod_add_eq_sub
statement:
!n a b c d. b < n /\ c < n ==>
              ((a + b) MOD n = (c + d) MOD n <=>
               (a + (n - c)) MOD n = (d + (n - b)) MOD n)

name: mod_add_eq_sub_eq
statement:
!n a b c d. 0 < n ==>
              ((a + b) MOD n = (c + d) MOD n <=>
               (a + (n - c MOD n)) MOD n = (d + (n - b MOD n)) MOD n)

name: mod_divides
statement: !n a b. 0 < n /\ b divides n /\ b divides (a MOD n) ==> b divides a

name: mod_divides_iff
statement: !n a b. 0 < n /\ b divides n ==> (b divides (a MOD n) <=> b divides a)

name: mod_divides_divides
statement: !n a b c. 0 < n /\ a MOD n = b /\ c divides n /\ c divides a ==> c divides b

name: mod_divides_divides_iff
statement: !n a b c. 0 < n /\ a MOD n = b /\ c divides n ==> (c divides a <=> c divides b)

name: mod_eq_divides
statement: !n a b c. 0 < n /\ a MOD n = b MOD n /\ c divides n /\ c divides a ==> c divides b

name: mod_eq_divides_iff
statement: !n a b c. 0 < n /\ a MOD n = b MOD n /\ c divides n ==> (c divides a <=> c divides b)

name: mod_mult_eq_mult
statement:
!m n a b. coprime m n /\ 0 < a /\ a < 2 * n /\ 0 < b /\ b < 2 * m /\
            (m * a) MOD (m * n) = (n * b) MOD (m * n) ==> (a = n /\ b = m)

name: MOD_MULT_LCANCEL
statement: !p x y z. prime p /\ (x * y) MOD p = (x * z) MOD p /\ x MOD p <> 0 ==> y MOD p = z MOD p

name: MOD_MULT_RCANCEL
statement:
!p x y z. prime p /\ (y * x) MOD p = (z * x) MOD p /\ x MOD p <> 0 ==>
            y MOD p = z MOD p

name: difference_of_squares_alt
statement: !a b. a * a - b * b = (a - b) * (a + b)

name: EVEN_PRIME

name: NOT_PRIME_4

name: INSERT_DELETE_NON_ELEMENT

name: SUBSET_DIFF_CARD

name: SUBSET_CARD_EQ

name: SURJ_CARD_IMAGE

name: BIJ_IS_INJ

name: BIJ_IS_SURJ
statement: !f s t. BIJ f s t ==> !x. x IN t ==> ?y. y IN s /\ f y = x

name: BIJ_FINITE_IFF
statement: !f s t. BIJ f s t ==> (FINITE s <=> FINITE t)

name: INJ_EQ_11
statement: !f s x y. INJ f s s /\ x IN s /\ y IN s ==> ((f x = f y) <=> (x = y))

name: INJ_IMP_11

name: IMAGE_DIFF

name: CARD_UNION_3_EQN
statement:
!a b c. FINITE a /\ FINITE b /\ FINITE c ==>
          (CARD (a UNION b UNION c) =
           CARD a + CARD b + CARD c + CARD (a INTER b INTER c) -
           CARD (a INTER b) - CARD (b INTER c) - CARD (a INTER c))

name: CARD_UNION_3_DISJOINT
statement:
!a b c. FINITE a /\ FINITE b /\ FINITE c /\
           DISJOINT a b /\ DISJOINT b c /\ DISJOINT a c ==>
           (CARD (a UNION b UNION c) = CARD a + CARD b + CARD c)

name: MAX_SET_TEST_IFF
statement:
!s. FINITE s /\ s <> {} ==>
      !x. x IN s ==> ((MAX_SET s = x) <=> (!y. y IN s ==> y <= x))

name: MIN_SET_TEST_IFF
statement: !s. s <> {} ==> !x. x IN s ==> ((MIN_SET s = x) <=> (!y. y IN s ==> x <= y))

name: MAX_SET_IMAGE_SUC_COUNT
statement: !n. MAX_SET (IMAGE SUC (count n)) = n

name: FINITE_INJ_IS_SURJ
statement:
!f s t. FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ CARD s = CARD t /\

name: FINITE_INJ_IS_BIJ
statement: !f s t. FINITE s /\ FINITE t /\ CARD s = CARD t /\ INJ f s t ==> BIJ f s t

name: FINITE_CARD_IMAGE
statement:
!s f. (!x y. (f x = f y) <=> (x = y)) /\ FINITE s ==>

name: FINITE_BIJ_COUNT_CARD
statement: !s. FINITE s ==> ?f. BIJ f (count (CARD s)) s

name: finite_partition_by_predicate
SPLIT_SUBSETS
statement: !s u v. s =|= u # v ==> u SUBSET s /\ v SUBSET s

name: SPLIT_FINITE
statement: !s u v. FINITE s /\ s =|= u # v ==> FINITE u /\ FINITE v

name: SPLIT_CARD
statement: !s u v. FINITE s /\ s =|= u # v ==> (CARD s = CARD u + CARD v)

name: LINV_SUBSET

name: SUM_IMAGE_DOUBLET

name: SUM_IMAGE_TRIPLET
statement: !f x y z. x <> y /\ y <> z /\ z <> x ==> SIGMA f {x; y; z} = f x + f y + f z

name: SIGMA_CARD_CONSTANT
statement: !n s. FINITE s /\ (!e. e IN s ==> CARD e = n) ==> SIGMA CARD s = n * CARD s

name: SIGMA_CARD_FACTOR
statement: !n s. FINITE s /\ (!e. e IN s ==> n divides (CARD e)) ==> n divides (SIGMA CARD s)

name: card_le_sigma_card
statement: !s. FINITE s /\ (!e. e IN s ==> CARD e <> 0) ==> CARD s <= SIGMA CARD s

name: card_eq_sigma_card

!s. FINITE s /\ (!e. e IN s ==> CARD e <> 0) /\

name: partition_element

name: partition_element_not_empty

name: equiv_class_not_empty

name: partition_element_exists

name: equal_partition_factor

!R s n. FINITE s /\ R equiv_on s /\ (!e. e IN partition R s ==> (CARD e = n)) ==>
          n divides (CARD s)

statement: !s t. t SUBSET s /\ PAIR_DISJOINT s ==> PAIR_DISJOINT t

name: preimage_subset

self_to_log_index_member

name: lcm_special_for_coprime_factors

!n a b. n = a * b /\ coprime a b ==>

name: prime_divisors_0

name: gcd_park_decomposition
statement:
!m n. 0 < m /\ 0 < n ==> let a = park m n in let b = gcd m n DIV a in
        b = PROD_SET (IMAGE (\p. p ** ppidx n) (park_off m n)) /\
        gcd m n = a * b /\ coprime a b

name: lcm_park_decomposition
statement:
!m n.
    0 < m /\ 0 < n ==>
    let a = park m n ; b = gcd m n DIV a ;
        p = m DIV a  ; q = (a * n) DIV (gcd m n)
    in
        b = PROD_SET (IMAGE (\p. p ** ppidx n) (park_off m n)) /\
        p = PROD_SET (IMAGE (\p. p ** ppidx m)
                      ((prime_divisors m) DIFF (park_on m n))) /\
        q = PROD_SET (IMAGE (\p. p ** ppidx n)
                      ((prime_divisors n) DIFF (park_off m n))) /\
        lcm m n = p * q /\ coprime p q /\ gcd m n = a * b /\ m = a * p /\
        n = b * q

name: lcm_fun_2

name: lcm_fun_suc_some

name: factor_seek_def
statement:
factor_seek n c q =
    if c <= q then n
    else if 1 < q /\ (n MOD q = 0) then q
    else factor_seek n c (q + 1)

name: sublist_MONO_DEC

name: FILTER_element_order

!P ls j h. let fs = FILTER P ls in ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ j < h /\ h < LENGTH fs ==>

name: FILTER_MONO_DEC

name: lcm_run_lower_odd

name: BAG_OF_SET_IMAGE_INJ
statement:
!f s.
  (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x = f y ==> x = y) ==>
  BAG_OF_SET (IMAGE f s) = BAG_IMAGE f (BAG_OF_SET s)

name: GITBAG_EMPTY
statement: !g a. GITBAG g {||} a = a

name: GITBAG_INSERT
statement:
!b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
    !g x a. GITBAG g (BAG_INSERT x b) a =
              GITBAG g (BAG_REST (BAG_INSERT x b))
                (g.op (BAG_CHOICE (BAG_INSERT x b)) a)

name: SUBSET_COMMUTING_ITBAG_INSERT
statement:
!f b t.
    SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET t /\ closure_comm_assoc_fun f t /\ FINITE_BAG b ==>
          !x a::t. ITBAG f (BAG_INSERT x b) a = ITBAG f b (f x a)

name: COMMUTING_GITBAG_INSERT
statement:
!g b. AbelianMonoid g /\ FINITE_BAG b /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET G ==>
  !x a::(G). GITBAG g (BAG_INSERT x b) a = GITBAG g b (g.op x a)

name: GITBAG_UNION
statement:
!g. AbelianMonoid g ==>
  !b1. FINITE_BAG b1 ==> !b2. FINITE_BAG b2 /\ SET_OF_BAG b1 SUBSET G
                                            /\ SET_OF_BAG b2 SUBSET G ==>
  !a. a IN G ==> GITBAG g (BAG_UNION b1 b2) a = GITBAG g b2 (GITBAG g b1 a)

name: GITBAG_in_carrier
statement:
!g. AbelianMonoid g ==>
  !b. FINITE_BAG b ==> !a. SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET G /\ a IN G ==> GITBAG g b a IN G

name: GBAG_in_carrier
statement: !g b. AbelianMonoid g /\ FINITE_BAG b /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET G ==> GBAG g b IN G

name: GITBAG_GBAG
statement:
!g. AbelianMonoid g ==>
  !b. FINITE_BAG b ==> !a. a IN g.carrier /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET g.carrier ==>
      GITBAG g b a = g.op a (GITBAG g b g.id)

name: GBAG_UNION
statement:
AbelianMonoid g /\ FINITE_BAG b1 /\ FINITE_BAG b2 /\
  SET_OF_BAG b1 SUBSET g.carrier /\ SET_OF_BAG b2 SUBSET g.carrier ==>
  GBAG g (BAG_UNION b1 b2) = g.op (GBAG g b1) (GBAG g b2)

name: GITBAG_BAG_IMAGE_op
statement:
!g. AbelianMonoid g ==>
  !b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
  !p q a. IMAGE p (SET_OF_BAG b) SUBSET g.carrier /\
          IMAGE q (SET_OF_BAG b) SUBSET g.carrier /\ a IN g.carrier ==>
  GITBAG g (BAG_IMAGE (\x. g.op (p x) (q x)) b) a =
  g.op (GITBAG g (BAG_IMAGE p b) a) (GBAG g (BAG_IMAGE q b))

name: IMP_GBAG_EQ_ID
statement:
AbelianMonoid g ==>
  !b. BAG_EVERY ((=) g.id) b ==> GBAG g b = g.id

name: GITBAG_CONG
statement:
!g. AbelianMonoid g ==>
  !b. FINITE_BAG b ==> !b' a a'. FINITE_BAG b' /\
        a IN g.carrier /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET g.carrier /\ SET_OF_BAG b' SUBSET g.carrier
        /\ (!x. BAG_IN x (BAG_UNION b b') /\ x <> g.id ==> b x = b' x)
  ==>
  GITBAG g b a = GITBAG g b' a

name: GITBAG_same_op
statement:
g1.op = g2.op ==>
  !b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
  !a. GITBAG g1 b a = GITBAG g2 b a

name: GBAG_IMAGE_PARTITION
statement:
AbelianMonoid g /\ FINITE s ==>
  !b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
    IMAGE f (SET_OF_BAG b) SUBSET G /\
    (!x. BAG_IN x b ==> ?P. P IN s /\ P x) /\
    (!x P1 P2. BAG_IN x b /\ P1 IN s /\ P2 IN s /\ P1 x /\ P2 x ==> P1 = P2)
  ==>
    GBAG g (BAG_IMAGE (λP. GBAG g (BAG_IMAGE f (BAG_FILTER P b))) (BAG_OF_SET s)) =
    GBAG g (BAG_IMAGE f b)

name: GBAG_PARTITION
statement:
AbelianMonoid g /\ FINITE s /\ FINITE_BAG b /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET G /\
    (!x. BAG_IN x b ==> ?P. P IN s /\ P x) /\
    (!x P1 P2. BAG_IN x b /\ P1 IN s /\ P2 IN s /\ P1 x /\ P2 x ==> P1 = P2)
  ==>
    GBAG g (BAG_IMAGE (λP. GBAG g (BAG_FILTER P b)) (BAG_OF_SET s)) = GBAG g b

name: GBAG_IMAGE_FILTER
statement:
AbelianMonoid g ==>
  !b. FINITE_BAG b ==> IMAGE f (SET_OF_BAG b ∩ P) SUBSET g.carrier ==>
  GBAG g (BAG_IMAGE f (BAG_FILTER P b)) =
  GBAG g (BAG_IMAGE (\x. if P x then f x else g.id) b)

name: GBAG_INSERT
statement:
AbelianMonoid g /\ FINITE_BAG b /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET g.carrier /\ x IN g.carrier ==>
  GBAG g (BAG_INSERT x b) = g.op x (GBAG g b)

name: MonoidHomo_GBAG
statement:
AbelianMonoid g /\ AbelianMonoid h /\
  MonoidHomo f g h /\ FINITE_BAG b /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET g.carrier ==>
  f (GBAG g b) = GBAG h (BAG_IMAGE f b)

name: IMP_GBAG_EQ_EXP
statement:
AbelianMonoid g /\ x IN g.carrier /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET {x} ==>
  GBAG g b = g.exp x (b x)

name: monoid_homo_sym_any

order_minimal
