name: real_mul_monoid
statement: AbelianMonoid real_mul_monoid

name: real_add_monoid_def
statement:
real_add_monoid : real monoid =
  <| carrier := UNIV; id := 0; op := (real_add) |>

name: real_mul_monoid_def
statement:
real_mul_monoid : real monoid =
  <| carrier := UNIV; id := 1; op := (real_mul) |>

name: extend_is_monoid
statement: ∀m. Monoid m ⇒ Monoid (extend m)

name: extend_carrier
statement: (extend m).carrier = UNIV

name: extend_id
statement: (extend m).id = m.id

name: extend_op
statement: x ∈ m.carrier ∧ y ∈ m.carrier ⇒ (extend m).op x y = m.op x y

name: extend_def
statement:
extend m = <| carrier := UNIV; id := m.id;
                op := λx y. if x ∈ m.carrier then
                              if y ∈ m.carrier then m.op x y else y
                            else x |>

name: GBAG_IMAGE_GBAG_BAG_OF_SET
statement:
AbelianMonoid g ==>
  !s. FINITE s ==>
  (!x. x IN s ==> FINITE (b x) /\ !y. y IN b x ==> f x y IN g.carrier) ==>
  GBAG g
    (BAG_IMAGE
      (\x. GBAG g (BAG_IMAGE (f x) (BAG_OF_SET (b x))))
    (BAG_OF_SET s)) =
  GBAG g
    (BAG_IMAGE (UNCURRY f)
      (BAG_OF_SET (BIGUNION (IMAGE (\x. IMAGE (\y. (x, y)) (b x)) s))))

name: SET_OF_BAG_UPDATE
statement:
SET_OF_BAG ((x =+ n) b) =
  if 0 < n then
    if BAG_IN x b then SET_OF_BAG b
    else x INSERT SET_OF_BAG b
  else
    if BAG_IN x b then SET_OF_BAG b DELETE x
    else SET_OF_BAG b

name: ring_mult_lsum
statement:
Ring r /\ c IN r.carrier ==>
  !b. FINITE_BAG b ==> SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET r.carrier ==>
      r.prod.op (GBAG r.sum b) c =
      GBAG r.sum (BAG_IMAGE (\x. r.prod.op x c) b)

name: ring_mult_rsum
statement:
Ring r /\ c IN r.carrier ==>
  !b. FINITE_BAG b ==> SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET r.carrier ==>
      r.prod.op c (GBAG r.sum b) =
      GBAG r.sum (BAG_IMAGE (\x. r.prod.op c x) b)

name: ring_mult_sum_image
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE s1 /\ FINITE s2 /\ IMAGE f1 s1 SUBSET r.carrier /\ IMAGE f2 s2 SUBSET r.carrier ==>
  r.prod.op (GBAG r.sum (BAG_IMAGE f1 (BAG_OF_SET s1)))
            (GBAG r.sum (BAG_IMAGE f2 (BAG_OF_SET s2))) =
  GBAG r.sum (BAG_IMAGE (\(x1,x2). r.prod.op (f1 x1) (f2 x2)) (BAG_OF_SET (s1 CROSS s2)))

name: poly_eval_GBAG
statement:
Ring r ==>
  !p. weak p /\ x IN r.carrier ==>
     poly_eval r p x = GBAG r.sum (BAG_IMAGE (\n. r.prod.op (EL n p) (r.prod.exp x n))
                                              (BAG_OF_SET (count (LENGTH p))))

name: rrestrict_in_carrier
statement: Ring r ==> rrestrict r (p m) ∈ r.carrier

name: rrestrict_rrestrict
statement: rrestrict r (rrestrict r v) = rrestrict r v

name: rrestrict_zero
statement: Ring r ==> rrestrict r r.sum.id = r.sum.id

name: mpoly_eval_support
statement:
(!x. x IN support r p ==> f1 x = f2 x) ==>
  mpoly_eval r p f1 = mpoly_eval r p f2

name: empty_monomials
statement: monomials r p = {} <=> (!x. p x IN r.carrier ==> p x = r.sum.id)

name: empty_support
statement: support r p = {} <=> monomials r p SUBSET {{||}}

name: support_SING_monomial_form
statement:
support r p = {v} /\ m IN monomials r p ==>
  m = \x. if x = v then m v else 0

name: weak_poly_of_mpoly
statement: Ring r ==> weak (poly_of_mpoly r p)

name: poly_poly_of_mpoly
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE (monomials r p) /\ support r p SUBSET {v} ==>
  poly (poly_of_mpoly r p)

name: mpoly_of_poly_empty
statement: mpoly_of_poly r v [] = K r.sum.id

name: monomials_mpoly_of_poly
statement:
Ring r /\ poly p ==>
  monomials r (mpoly_of_poly r v p) =
  IMAGE (λn x. if x = v then n else 0)
  (count (LENGTH p) INTER { n | EL n p <> r.sum.id })

name: support_mpoly_of_poly
statement:
Ring r /\ poly p ==>
  support r (mpoly_of_poly r v p) = if LENGTH p <= 1 then {} else {v}

name: poly_of_mpoly_of_poly
statement:
Ring r ⇒
  ∀p. poly p ⇒ poly_of_mpoly r (mpoly_of_poly r v p) = p

name: FINITE_support_finite_mpoly
statement: mpoly r p ==> (FINITE (support r p) <=> finite_mpoly r p)

name: mpoly_of_poly_of_mpoly
statement:
Ring r ∧ mpoly r p ∧ support r p ⊆ {v} ⇒
  mpoly_of_poly r v (poly_of_mpoly r p) = p

name: BIJ_poly_of_mpoly
BIJ_mpoly_of_poly
statement:
Ring r ==>
  BIJ (mpoly_of_poly r v) {p | poly p} {p | mpoly r p /\ support r p SUBSET {v}}

name: eval_mpoly_of_poly
statement:
Ring r /\ poly p /\ f v IN r.carrier ==>
  mpoly_eval r (mpoly_of_poly r v p) f = poly_eval r p (f v)

name: eval_poly_of_mpoly
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p ∧ f v ∈ r.carrier ∧ support r p SUBSET {v} ==>
  poly_eval r (poly_of_mpoly r p) (f v) = mpoly_eval r p f

name: rrestrict_mpoly_add
statement:
Ring r ⇒
  rrestrict r (mpoly_add r p1 p2 t) = r.sum.op (rrestrict r (p1 t)) (rrestrict r (p2 t))

name: monomials_mpoly_add
statement:
Ring r ==>
  monomials r (mpoly_add r p1 p2) =
    (monomials r p1 ∪ monomials r p2) DIFF
      { m | r.sum.op (rrestrict r (p1 m)) (rrestrict r (p2 m)) = r.sum.id }

name: support_mpoly_add_SUBSET
statement: Ring r ==> support r (mpoly_add r p q) SUBSET support r p UNION support r q

name: mpoly_mpoly_add
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE (monomials r p) /\ FINITE (monomials r q) ==>
  mpoly r (mpoly_add r p q)

name: mpoly_eval_mpoly_add
statement:
Ring r ∧ finite_mpoly r p1 ∧ finite_mpoly r p2 ∧
  (∀x::(support r p1 ∪ support r p2). f x ∈ R) ⇒
  mpoly_eval r (mpoly_add r p1 p2) f = mpoly_eval r p1 f + mpoly_eval r p2 f

name: mpoly_add_assoc
statement:
Ring r ==>
  mpoly_add r (mpoly_add r x y) z =
  mpoly_add r x (mpoly_add r y z)

name: monomials_zero
statement: monomials r (K r.sum.id) = {}

name: support_zero
statement: support r (K r.sum.id) = {}

name: mpoly_zero
statement: Ring r ==> mpoly r (K r.sum.id)

name: mpoly_eval_zero
statement:
Ring r ==>
  mpoly_eval r (K r.sum.id) = K r.sum.id

name: mpoly_add_zero
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==>
  mpoly_add r (K r.sum.id) p = p

name: monomials_mpoly_neg
statement: Ring r ==> monomials r (mpoly_neg r p) = monomials r p

name: support_mpoly_neg
statement: Ring r ==> support r (mpoly_neg r p) = support r p

name: mpoly_mpoly_neg
statement: Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==> mpoly r (mpoly_neg r p)

name: mpoly_add_neg
statement:
Ring r ==>
  mpoly_add r (mpoly_neg r p) p = K r.sum.id

name: mpoly_add_comm
statement: Ring r ==> mpoly_add r p q = mpoly_add r q p

name: mpoly_of_poly_add
statement:
Ring r /\ poly p /\ poly q ==>
  mpoly_of_poly r v (p + q) =
  mpoly_add r (mpoly_of_poly r v p) (mpoly_of_poly r v q)

name: monomials_mpoly_mul_SUBSET
statement:
Ring r ==>
  monomials r (mpoly_mul r p1 p2) ⊆
  IMAGE (UNCURRY BAG_UNION) (monomials r p1 × monomials r p2)

name: support_mpoly_mul_SUBSET
statement:
Ring r ==>
  support r (mpoly_mul r p q) SUBSET support r p UNION support r q

name: mpoly_mul_in_carrier
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE (monomials r p1) /\ FINITE (monomials r p2)
  ==> mpoly_mul r p1 p2 m ∈ r.carrier

name: mpoly_mul_BAG_FILTER_cross
statement:
mpoly_mul r p1 p2 m =
  GBAG r.sum (BAG_IMAGE (λ(m1,m2). r.prod.op (rrestrict r (p1 m1)) (rrestrict r (p2 m2)))
                (BAG_FILTER (((=) m) o UNCURRY BAG_UNION)
                  (BAG_OF_SET (monomials r p1 × monomials r p2))))

name: mpoly_eval_mpoly_mul
statement:
Ring r /\ finite_mpoly r p1 /\ finite_mpoly r p2 /\
  (!x::support r p1 ∪ support r p2. f x IN r.carrier) ==>
  mpoly_eval r (mpoly_mul r p1 p2) f =
  r.prod.op (mpoly_eval r p1 f) (mpoly_eval r p2 f)

name: mpoly_mpoly_mul
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE (monomials r p) /\ FINITE (monomials r q) ==>
  mpoly r (mpoly_mul r p q)

name: rrestrict_mpoly_mul
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE (monomials r p) /\ FINITE (monomials r q) ==>
  rrestrict r ((mpoly_mul r p q) m) = mpoly_mul r p q m

name: mpoly_mul_comm
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE (monomials r p) /\ FINITE (monomials r q) ==>
  mpoly_mul r p q = mpoly_mul r q p

name: mpoly_mul_assoc
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE (monomials r x) /\ FINITE (monomials r y) /\ FINITE (monomials r z) ==>
  mpoly_mul r (mpoly_mul r x y) z =
  mpoly_mul r x (mpoly_mul r y z)

name: imp_mpoly_mul_zero
statement: monomials r p = {} \/ monomials r q = {} ==> mpoly_mul r p q = K #0

name: monomials_mpoly_one
statement: Ring r ==> monomials r (mpoly_one r) = if r.sum.id = r.prod.id then {} else {{||}}

name: support_mpoly_one
statement: Ring r ==> support r (mpoly_one r) = {}

name: mpoly_mpoly_one
statement: Ring r ==> mpoly r (mpoly_one r)

name: mpoly_of_poly_const
statement:
Ring r /\ c IN r.carrier ==>
  mpoly_of_poly r v [c] = r.prod.op c o (mpoly_one r)

name: mpoly_mul_one
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==>
  mpoly_mul r (mpoly_one r) p = p /\
  mpoly_mul r p (mpoly_one r) = p

name: mpoly_of_poly_mul
statement:
Ring r /\ poly p /\ poly q ==>
  mpoly_of_poly r v (p * q) =
  mpoly_mul r (mpoly_of_poly r v p) (mpoly_of_poly r v q)

name: monomials_cmul
statement:
IntegralDomain r /\ mpoly r p /\ c IN r.carrier /\ c <> r.sum.id ==>
  monomials r (r.prod.op c o p) = monomials r p

name: support_cmul
statement:
IntegralDomain r /\ mpoly r p /\ c IN r.carrier /\ c <> r.sum.id ==>
  support r (r.prod.op c o p) = support r p

name: mpoly_cmul
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ c IN r.carrier ==>
  mpoly r (r.prod.op c o p)

name: mpoly_mul_cmul
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ mpoly r q /\ c IN r.carrier ==>
  mpoly_mul r (r.prod.op c o p) q =
  r.prod.op c o mpoly_mul r p q

name: cmul_zero
statement: Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==> r.prod.op r.sum.id o p = K r.sum.id

name: cmul_one
statement: Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==> r.prod.op r.prod.id o p = p

name: mpoly_mul_add
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE (monomials r x) /\ FINITE (monomials r y) /\ FINITE (monomials r z) ==>
  mpoly_mul r x (mpoly_add r y z) =
  mpoly_add r (mpoly_mul r x y) (mpoly_mul r x z)

name: mpoly_ring_carrier
statement: (mpoly_ring r s).carrier = { p | mpoly r p /\ support r p SUBSET s }

name: mpoly_add_group
statement: Ring r ==> Group (mpoly_ring r s).sum

name: mpoly_add_abelian_group
statement: Ring r ==> AbelianGroup (mpoly_ring r s).sum

name: mpoly_mul_monoid
statement: Ring r ==> Monoid (mpoly_ring r s).prod

name: mpoly_mul_abelian_monoid
statement: Ring r ==> AbelianMonoid (mpoly_ring r s).prod

name: mpoly_ring
statement: Ring r ==> Ring (mpoly_ring r s)

name: mpoly_eval_in_carrier
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ finite_mpoly r p /\
  IMAGE f (support r p) SUBSET r.carrier
  ==>
  mpoly_eval r p f IN r.carrier

name: monomials_mpoly_ring_more_support
statement:
s SUBSET s' /\ mpoly (mpoly_ring r s) p ==>
  monomials (mpoly_ring r s) p =
  monomials (mpoly_ring r s') p

name: support_mpoly_ring_more_support
statement:
s SUBSET s' /\ mpoly (mpoly_ring r s) p ==>
  support (mpoly_ring r s) p = support (mpoly_ring r s') p

name: mpoly_mpoly_ring_more_support
statement:
mpoly (mpoly_ring r s) p /\ s SUBSET s' ==>
  mpoly (mpoly_ring r s') p

name: mpoly_ring_sum_applied
statement:
!b. FINITE_BAG b ==> Ring r /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET (mpoly_ring r s).carrier
  ==> !x.
  GBAG (mpoly_ring r s).sum b x =
  GBAG r.sum (BAG_IMAGE (\f. f x) b)

name: mpoly_sum_monomials
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ support r p SUBSET s ==>
  GBAG (mpoly_ring r s).sum
    (BAG_IMAGE (\m t. if t = m then p m else r.sum.id)
      (BAG_OF_SET (monomials r p))) = p

name: mpoly_ring_neg
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ support r p SUBSET s ==>
  (mpoly_ring r s).sum.inv p = mpoly_neg r p

name: mpoly_eval_neg
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ support r p SUBSET s /\
  FINITE (support r p) /\ IMAGE f (support r p) SUBSET r.carrier ==>
  mpoly_eval r ((mpoly_ring r s).sum.inv p) f =
  r.sum.inv (mpoly_eval r p f)

name: mpoly_eval_sub
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ mpoly r q /\ support r p ⊆ s /\ support r q ⊆ s ∧
  FINITE (support r p) /\ FINITE (support r q) ∧
  IMAGE f s SUBSET r.carrier ==>
  mpoly_eval r (ring_sub (mpoly_ring r s) p q) f =
  ring_sub r (mpoly_eval r p f) (mpoly_eval r q f)

name: monomials_sum_SUBSET
statement:
Ring r ==>
  !b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
  SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET (mpoly_ring r s).carrier ==>
  monomials r (GBAG (mpoly_ring r s).sum b) SUBSET
  BIGUNION (IMAGE (monomials r) (SET_OF_BAG b))

name: support_sum_SUBSET
statement:
!b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
  Ring r /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET (mpoly_ring r s).carrier ==>
  support r (GBAG (mpoly_ring r s).sum b) ⊆
  BIGUNION (IMAGE (support r) (SET_OF_BAG b))

name: mpoly_eval_sum
statement:
!b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
  Ring r /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET (mpoly_ring r s).carrier /\
  IMAGE f (BIGUNION (IMAGE (support r) (SET_OF_BAG b))) SUBSET r.carrier /\
  BAG_EVERY (finite_mpoly r) b
  ==>
  mpoly_eval r (GBAG (mpoly_ring r s).sum b) f =
  GBAG r.sum (BAG_IMAGE (flip (mpoly_eval r) f) b)

name: support_mul_SUBSET
statement:
!b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
  Ring r /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET (mpoly_ring r s).carrier ==>
  support r (GBAG (mpoly_ring r s).prod b) ⊆
  BIGUNION (IMAGE (support r) (SET_OF_BAG b))

name: mpoly_eval_one
statement:
Ring r ==>
  mpoly_eval r (mpoly_one r) = K r.prod.id

name: mpoly_eval_prod
statement:
!b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
  Ring r /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET (mpoly_ring r s).carrier /\
  IMAGE f (BIGUNION (IMAGE (support r) (SET_OF_BAG b))) SUBSET r.carrier /\
  BAG_EVERY (finite_mpoly r) b
  ==>
  mpoly_eval r (GBAG (mpoly_ring r s).prod b) f =
  GBAG r.prod (BAG_IMAGE (flip (mpoly_eval r) f) b)

name: mpoly_eval_cmul
statement:
IntegralDomain r /\ mpoly r p /\ c IN r.carrier /\ c <> r.sum.id /\
  IMAGE f (support r p) SUBSET r.carrier /\
  (!m. m IN monomials r p ==> FINITE_BAG m)
  ==>
  mpoly_eval r (r.prod.op c o p) f = r.prod.op c (mpoly_eval r p f)

name: DISJOINT_support_mpoly_mul
statement:
IntegralDomain r /\ mpoly r p /\ mpoly r q /\
  DISJOINT (support r p) (support r q) ==>
  monomials r (mpoly_mul r p q) =
  IMAGE (UNCURRY BAG_UNION) (monomials r p × monomials r q) /\
  !m1 m2. m1 IN monomials r p /\ m2 IN monomials r q ==>
    mpoly_mul r p q (BAG_UNION m1 m2) = r.prod.op(p m1)(q m2)

name: degree_of_mpoly_add_le
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE (monomials r p) ∧ FINITE (monomials r q) ⇒
  degree_of r (mpoly_add r p q) v ≤ MAX (degree_of r p v) (degree_of r q v)

name: degree_of_mpoly_add_less
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE (monomials r p) /\ FINITE (monomials r q) /\
  degree_of r p v < degree_of r q v
  ==>
  degree_of r (mpoly_add r p q) v = degree_of r q v

name: degree_of_mpoly_add_less_sym
statement:
Ring r /\ FINITE (monomials r p) /\ FINITE (monomials r q) /\
  degree_of r q v < degree_of r p v
  ==>
  degree_of r (mpoly_add r p q) v = degree_of r p v

name: degree_of_zero
statement: degree_of r (K #0) v = 0

name: support_degree_of
statement:
FINITE (monomials r p) ==>
  (v IN support r p <=> 1 <= degree_of r p v)

name: degree_of_mpoly_of_poly
statement:
Ring r /\ poly p ==>
  degree_of r (mpoly_of_poly r v p) v = deg p

name: degree_of_sum_le
statement:
!b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
  Ring r /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET (mpoly_ring r s).carrier ==>
  degree_of r (GBAG (mpoly_ring r s).sum b) v <=
  MAX_SET (IMAGE (flip (degree_of r) v) (SET_OF_BAG b))

name: RingIso_mpoly_of_poly
statement:
Ring r ==>
  RingIso (mpoly_of_poly r v) (poly_ring r) (mpoly_ring r {v})

name: RingIso_poly_of_mpoly
statement:
Ring r ==>
  RingIso (poly_of_mpoly r) (mpoly_ring r {v}) (poly_ring r)

name: poly_of_mpoly_add
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ mpoly r q /\ support r p SUBSET {v} /\ support r q SUBSET {v} ==>
  poly_of_mpoly r (mpoly_add r p q) =
  poly_of_mpoly r p + poly_of_mpoly r q

name: mpoly_ring_empty_support_iso
statement:
Ring r ==>
  RingIso (\p. p {||}) (mpoly_ring r {}) r

name: monomials_remove_var_mono_SUBSET
statement: !r p x m. monomials r (remove_var_mono r x p m) ⊆  IMAGE (x =+ 0) (monomials r p)

name: mpoly_remove_var_mono
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ m IN monomials r p ==>
  mpoly r (remove_var_mono r x p m)

name: support_remove_var_mono
statement:
m IN monomials (r:'a ring) p ==>
  support r (remove_var_mono r x p m) SUBSET support r p DELETE x

name: remove_var_mono_nonzero
statement:
Ring r /\ m IN monomials r p ==>
  remove_var_mono r x p m <> K #0

name: remove_var_mono_inj
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ mpoly r q /\
  remove_var_mono r x p =
  remove_var_mono r x q
  ==>
  p = q

name: degree_of_remove_var_mono_le
statement:
FINITE (monomials r p) /\ x <> y ==>
  degree_of r (remove_var_mono r x p m) y <= degree_of r p y

name: monomials_isolate_var_mono
mpoly_isolate_var_mono
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ m IN monomials r p ==>
  mpoly (mpoly_ring r (support r p DELETE x))
    (isolate_var_mono r x p m)

name: support_isolate_var_mono
isolate_var_mono_inj
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ mpoly r q ==>
  isolate_var_mono r x p = isolate_var_mono r x q
  ==> p = q

name: isolate_var_ring_ring
statement: Ring r ==> Ring (isolate_var_ring r x p)

name: isolate_var_mono_in_carrier
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ m IN monomials r p ==>
  isolate_var_mono r x p m IN (isolate_var_ring r x p).carrier

name: isolate_var_in_carrier
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==>
  isolate_var r x p ∈ (isolate_var_ring r x p).carrier

name: isolate_var_coeff
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==>
  isolate_var r x p (λy. if y = x then n else 0) =
  GBAG (mpoly_ring r (support r p DELETE x)).sum
    (BAG_OF_SET (IMAGE (remove_var_mono r x p)
                       (monomials r p INTER { m | m x = n })))

name: isolate_var_coeff_zero
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\
  ((?y. x <> y /\ BAG_IN y b) ∨ !m. m IN monomials r p ==> m x <> b x) ==>
  isolate_var r x p b = K #0

name: degree_of_isolate_var_le
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==>
  degree_of r (isolate_var r v p m) x <= degree_of r p x

name: monomials_one_mono
mpoly_one_mono
statement:
Ring r /\ n IN r.carrier ==>
  mpoly r (one_mono r v n)

name: support_one_mono
statement:
Ring r ==>
  support r (one_mono r x n) =
  if n = r.sum.id \/ n NOTIN r.carrier then {} else SET_OF_BAG x

name: sum_distinct_one_monomials_nonzero
statement:
Ring r /\ (∀m. m IN ms /\ m <> K r.sum.id ==>
                 ?v n. SET_OF_BAG v SUBSET s /\
                       n IN r.carrier /\
                       m = one_mono r v n /\
                       (!m'. m' IN ms /\ m' v <> #0 ==> m' = m))
  /\ FINITE ms
  ==>
  (GBAG (mpoly_ring r s).sum (BAG_OF_SET ms) = K #0 <=> ms SUBSET {K #0})

name: monomials_isolate_var
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==>
  monomials (mpoly_ring r (support r p DELETE x))
    (isolate_var r x p) =
    IMAGE (λm y. if y = x then m x else 0) (monomials r p)

name: mpoly_isolate_var
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==>
  mpoly (mpoly_ring r (support r p DELETE x)) (isolate_var r x p)

name: support_isolate_var
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==>
  support (mpoly_ring r (support r p DELETE x)) (isolate_var r x p) =
  {x} INTER support r p

name: degree_of_isolate_var
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ support r p SUBSET s ==>
  degree_of (mpoly_ring r (s DELETE v)) (isolate_var r v p) v =
  degree_of r p v

name: restore_isolate_var
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p ==>
  restore_var r x (isolate_var r x p) = p

name: monomials_restore_var
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly (mpoly_ring r s) p /\ support (mpoly_ring r s) p SUBSET {x} /\
  x NOTIN s ==>
  monomials r (restore_var r x p) =
  BIGUNION (IMAGE (\m. IMAGE (x =+ m x) (monomials r (p m)))
                  (monomials (mpoly_ring r s) p))

name: mpoly_restore_var
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly (mpoly_ring r s) p /\ support (mpoly_ring r s) p SUBSET {x} /\
  x NOTIN s ==>
  mpoly r (restore_var r x p)

name: support_restore_var
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly (mpoly_ring r s) p /\ support (mpoly_ring r s) p SUBSET {x} /\
  x NOTIN s ==>
  support r (restore_var r x p) =
  BIGUNION (IMAGE (BIGUNION o IMAGE SET_OF_BAG o monomials r o p)
                  (monomials (mpoly_ring r s) p))
  ∪ if monomials (mpoly_ring r s) p ⊆ {{||}} then {} else {x}

name: isolate_restore_var
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly (mpoly_ring r s) p /\ support (mpoly_ring r s) p SUBSET {x} /\
  x NOTIN s ==>
  isolate_var r x (restore_var r x p) = p

name: isolate_var_inj
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ mpoly r q /\
  isolate_var r x p = isolate_var r x q ==>
  p = q

name: RingIso_restore_var
statement:
Ring r /\ x IN s ==>
  RingIso (restore_var r x)
    (mpoly_ring (mpoly_ring r (s DELETE x)) {x})
    (mpoly_ring r s)

name: RingIso_isolate_var
statement:
Ring r /\ x IN s ==>
    RingIso (isolate_var r x)
      (mpoly_ring r s)
      (mpoly_ring (mpoly_ring r (s DELETE x)) {x})

name: RingIso_mpoly_ring_poly_ring
statement:
Ring r /\ x IN s ==>
  RingIso (poly_of_mpoly (mpoly_ring r (s DELETE x)) o isolate_var r x)
    (mpoly_ring r s) (PolyRing (mpoly_ring r (s DELETE x)))

name: degree_of_mpoly_mul_deg
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ mpoly r q /\
  support r p ⊆ s /\ support r q ⊆ s /\ v IN s ==>
  degree_of r (mpoly_mul r p q) v =
  Deg (mpoly_ring r (s DELETE v))
    (poly_mult (mpoly_ring r (s DELETE v))
         (poly_of_mpoly (mpoly_ring r (s DELETE v)) (isolate_var r v p))
         (poly_of_mpoly (mpoly_ring r (s DELETE v)) (isolate_var r v q)))

name: mpoly_integral_domain
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==>
      !r. IntegralDomain r ==> IntegralDomain (mpoly_ring r s)

name: degree_of_mpoly_mul
statement:
IntegralDomain r /\ mpoly r p /\ mpoly r q /\
  support r p SUBSET s /\ support r q SUBSET s /\ v IN s /\ FINITE s /\
  p <> K r.sum.id /\ q <> K r.sum.id
  ==>
  degree_of r (mpoly_mul r p q) v = degree_of r p v + degree_of r q v

name: support_mpoly_mul
statement:
IntegralDomain r /\
  mpoly r p /\ mpoly r q /\ p <> K r.sum.id /\ q <> K r.sum.id /\
  FINITE (support r p) /\ FINITE (support r q)
  ==>
  support r (mpoly_mul r p q) = support r p ∪ support r q

name: mpoly_roots_of_poly
statement:
IntegralDomain r /\ poly p ==>
  mpoly_roots r (mpoly_of_poly r v p) =
  BIGUNION (IMAGE (λx. {f | 0 < Deg r p ==> f v = x})
                  (poly_roots r p))

name: poly_roots_of_mpoly
statement:
IntegralDomain r /\ mpoly r p /\ support r p SUBSET {v} ==>
  poly_roots r (poly_of_mpoly r p) =
  IMAGE (\f. f v) (mpoly_roots r p) INTER r.carrier

name: monomials_mpoly_eval_o_isolate_var
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p
  ==>
  monomials r (flip (mpoly_eval r) f o isolate_var r e p) SUBSET
    IMAGE (λm v. if v = e then m e else 0) (monomials r p)

name: update_zero_BAG_DIFF
statement: (x =+ 0)b = b - (\y. if x = y then b x else 0)

name: mpoly_eval_mpoly_eval_o_isolate_var
statement:
Ring r /\ mpoly r p /\ IMAGE f (support r p DELETE x) SUBSET r.carrier /\
  g x IN r.carrier /\ FINITE (support r p) ==>
  mpoly_eval r (flip (mpoly_eval r) f o isolate_var r x p) g =
  mpoly_eval r p ((x =+ g x) f)

name: zero_degree_of_is_zero
statement:
IntegralDomain r /\ mpoly r p /\ FINITE (support r p) /\
  BIGUNION (IMAGE s (support r p)) SUBSET r.carrier /\
  (!x. x IN support r p /\ FINITE (s x) ==> degree_of r p x < CARD (s x)) ∧
  (∀f. (∀x. x IN support r p ==> f x IN s x)
       ==> mpoly_eval r p f = r.sum.id)
  ==>
  p = K r.sum.id

name: rrestrict_def
statement: rrestrict r v = if v IN r.carrier then v else r.sum.id

name: monomials_def
statement: monomials r p = { t | rrestrict r (p t) <> r.sum.id }

name: finite_mpoly_def
statement:
finite_mpoly r p <=>
    FINITE (monomials r p) ∧ (∀m. m ∈ monomials r p ⇒ FINITE_BAG m)

name: support_def
statement: support r p = BIGUNION (IMAGE SET_OF_BAG (monomials r p))

name: mpoly_eval_def
statement:
mpoly_eval r p f = GBAG r.sum
    (BAG_IMAGE (λt. r.prod.op (rrestrict r (p t)) (GBAG r.prod (BAG_IMAGE f t)))
      (BAG_OF_SET (monomials r p)))

name: poly_of_mpoly_def
statement:
poly_of_mpoly r p =
    if support r p = {} then
    if rrestrict r (p {||}) = r.sum.id then [] else [rrestrict r (p {||})] else
    let v = @v. v IN support r p in
    GENLIST (\n. rrestrict r (p (\w. if w = v then n else 0)))
    (SUC (MAX_SET (IMAGE (\m. m v) (monomials r p))))

name: mpoly_of_poly_def
statement:
mpoly_of_poly r v p m =
  if SET_OF_BAG m = {v} ∧ m v < LENGTH p
  then rrestrict r (EL (m v) p)
  else if m = {||} /\ 0 < LENGTH p then rrestrict r (EL 0 p)
  else r.sum.id

name: mpoly_def
statement: mpoly r p <=> IMAGE p UNIV ⊆ r.carrier ∧ FINITE (monomials r p)

name: mpoly_add_def
statement: mpoly_add r p1 p2 t = r.sum.op (rrestrict r (p1 t)) (rrestrict r (p2 t))

name: mpoly_neg_def
statement: mpoly_neg r p m = r.sum.inv (rrestrict r (p m))

name: mpoly_mul_def
statement:
mpoly_mul r p1 p2 m =
    GBAG r.sum (BAG_IMAGE (λ(m1,m2). r.prod.op (rrestrict r (p1 m1)) (rrestrict r (p2 m2)))
                   (BAG_OF_SET { (m1,m2) | BAG_UNION m1 m2 = m ∧
                                           m1 ∈ monomials r p1 ∧
                                           m2 ∈ monomials r p2 }))

name: mpoly_one_def
statement: mpoly_one r m = if m = {||} then r.prod.id else r.sum.id

name: mpoly_ring_def
degree_of_def
statement:
degree_of r (p:('c,'v) mpoly) v =
    MAX_SET (IMAGE (λt. t v) (monomials r p))

name: remove_var_mono_def
statement:
remove_var_mono r x p m t =
    if t = (x =+ 0n) m then rrestrict r (p m) else r.sum.id

name: isolate_var_mono_def
statement:
isolate_var_mono r x p m t =
    if t = (λy. if y = x then m x else 0n)
    then remove_var_mono r x p m
    else K r.sum.id

name: isolate_var_ring_def
statement:
isolate_var_ring r x p =
    mpoly_ring (mpoly_ring r (support r p DELETE x)) {x}

name: isolate_var_def
statement:
isolate_var r x p =
    GBAG (isolate_var_ring r x p).sum
      (BAG_IMAGE (isolate_var_mono r x p)
        (BAG_OF_SET (monomials r p)))

name: one_mono_def
statement: one_mono r x n y = if y = x then n else r.sum.id

name: restore_var_def
statement:
restore_var r x p m =
    p (λt. if t = x then m x else 0n) ((x =+ 0) m)

name: mpoly_root_def
statement: mpoly_root r p f = (mpoly_eval r p f = r.sum.id)

name: mpoly_roots_def
statement:
mpoly_roots r p =
    { f | IMAGE f (support r p) SUBSET r.carrier /\ mpoly_root r p f }

name: poly_coeff_sum_genlist
statement:
!r:'a ring.

name: poly_mod_sub
statement:
!r:'a ring. Ring r ==>

!r:'a field. Field r ==> !n. n < char r ==>

name: poly_field_mod_sum_group_homo_quotient_ring
statement:
!r:'a field.
    Field r ==> !z. poly z /\ z <> |0| ==>
    GroupHomo
      (\x. coset (PolyRing r).sum x (principal_ideal (PolyRing r) z).carrier)
      (PolyModRing r z).sum
      (PolyRing r / principal_ideal (PolyRing r) z).sum

name: poly_field_mod_prod_monoid_homo_quotient_ring
statement:
!r:'a field.
    Field r ==>
    !z. poly z /\ z <> |0| ==>
        MonoidHomo
         (\x. coset (PolyRing r).sum x (principal_ideal (PolyRing r) z).carrier)
         (PolyModRing r z).prod
         (PolyRing r / principal_ideal (PolyRing r) z).prod

name: poly_field_mod_ring_homo_quotient_ring
statement:
!r:'a field.
    Field r ==>
    !z. poly z /\ z <> |0| ==>
        RingHomo
         (\x. coset (PolyRing r).sum x (principal_ideal (PolyRing r) z).carrier)
         (PolyModRing r z)
         (quotient_ring (PolyRing r) (principal_ideal (PolyRing r) z))

name: poly_field_mod_ring_iso_quotient_ring
statement:
!r:'a field.
    Field r ==>
    !z. poly z /\ z <> |0| ==>
        RingIso
         (\x. coset (PolyRing r).sum x (principal_ideal (PolyRing r) z).carrier)
         (PolyModRing r z)
         (quotient_ring (PolyRing r) (principal_ideal (PolyRing r) z))

name: HD_poly_mult

Ring r /\ poly p /\ poly q /\ p * q <> |0| ==>

name: HD_weak_add_shift

name: EL_weak_add
statement:
k < LENGTH (p || q) ==>
  EL k (p || q) = if k < LENGTH p then
                    if k < LENGTH q then EL k p + EL k q
                    else EL k p
                  else EL k q

!r p q. LENGTH (weak_mult r p q) =

name: EL_poly_shift
statement:
!r p n k. k < LENGTH (p >> n) ==>
  EL k (p >> n) = if ~(k < n) /\ k < n + LENGTH p then
                     EL (k - n) p else r.sum.id

name: EL_weak_mult
statement:
!p q k. Ring r /\ k < LENGTH (weak_mult r p q) /\ weak p /\ weak q ==>
          EL k (weak_mult r p q) =
      GBAG r.sum (BAG_IMAGE (λ(n,m). r.prod.op (EL n p) (EL m q))
                   (BAG_FILTER (λ(n,m). n + m = k)
                     (BAG_OF_SET ((count (LENGTH p) × count (LENGTH q))))))

name: HD_chop
statement: !p. chop p <> [] ==> HD (chop p) = HD p

name: EL_chop

!p n. n < LENGTH (chop p) ==>

name: EL_chop_0

name: poly_deg_weak_neg

name: weak_add_def

(weak_add (r:'a ring) [] q = q) /\

  (weak_add (r:'a ring) (ph:'a :: pt:'a poly) (qh:'a :: qt:'a poly) =

name: weak_cmult_def
statement:
(weak_cmult (r:'a ring) (c:'a) [] = []) /\

name: weak_neg_def

(weak_neg (r:'a ring) [] = []) /\

name: poly_shift_def

(poly_shift (r:'a ring) [] n = []) /\
  (poly_shift (r:'a ring) (p:'a poly) 0 = p) /\

name: weak_mult_def
statement:
(weak_mult (r:'a ring) [] (q:'a poly) = []) /\

name: prime_is_irreducible
statement:
!r p. IntegralDomain r /\ p IN r.carrier /\ ring_prime r p
        /\ p <> r.sum.id /\ ~Unit r p
        ==> irreducible r p

name: integral_domain_divides_prime
statement:
!r p x. IntegralDomain r /\ x IN r.carrier /\ p IN r.carrier /\
          p <> r.sum.id /\ ring_prime r p /\ ~Unit r p /\ ~Unit r x /\
          ring_divides r x p
          ==>
          ring_associates r x p

name: integral_domain_prime_factors_unique
statement:
IntegralDomain r ==>
  !l1 l2.
  (!m. MEM m l1 ==>
       m IN r.carrier /\ ring_prime r m /\ m <> r.sum.id /\ ~Unit r m) /\
  (!m. MEM m l2 ==>
       m IN r.carrier /\ ring_prime r m /\ m <> r.sum.id /\ ~Unit r m) /\
  ring_associates r
    (GBAG r.prod (LIST_TO_BAG l1))
    (GBAG r.prod (LIST_TO_BAG l2)) ==>
  ?l3. PERM l2 l3 /\ LIST_REL (ring_associates r) l1 l3

name: ring_prime_divides_product
statement:
!r. Ring r ==>
  !p. p IN r.carrier ==>
    (ring_prime r p /\ ~Unit r p <=>
     (!b. FINITE_BAG b /\ SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET r.carrier /\
          ring_divides r p (GBAG r.prod b) ==>
          ?x. BAG_IN x b /\ ring_divides r p x))

name: ring_product_factors_divide
statement:
!r. Ring r ==>
  !b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
      SET_OF_BAG b SUBSET r.carrier /\
      ring_divides r (GBAG r.prod b) x ==>
      !y. BAG_IN y b ==> ring_divides r y x

name: ring_associates_sym

name: ring_associates_trans
statement:
!r x y z.

name: ring_associates_refl

name: ring_associates_mult

!r p q x.

name: ring_associates_divides

name: ring_divides_associates

name: LIST_REL_ring_associates_product

Ring r ==>

name: ring_divides_iso
statement:
!r r_ f. Ring r /\ Ring r_ /\ RingIso f r r_ ==>
    !p q. p IN r.carrier /\ ring_divides r p q ==>
      ring_divides r_ (f p) (f q)

name: ring_prime_iso
statement:
!r r_ f. Ring r /\ Ring r_ /\ RingIso f r r_ ==>
    !p. p IN r.carrier /\ ring_prime r p ==> ring_prime r_ (f p)

name: ring_homo_sym_any
statement:
Ring r /\ Ring s /\ RingHomo f r s /\
  (!x. x IN s.carrier ==> i x IN r.carrier /\ f (i x) = x) /\

              ==> (EL i pat = EL (k+i) search))
      /\ (EL j pat <> EL (k+j) search)
      /\ (a < LENGTH all_chars)
      /\ (EL (k+j) search = EL a all_chars)
    ==>

name: bmRecur_def
statement:
(bmRecur [] _ _ _ = 0) /\
    (bmRecur _ _ _ [] = 0) /\
    (bmRecur pat patTab all_chars search =
        if
            ~(LENGTH pat <= LENGTH search)
        then
            (LENGTH search)
        else
            let
                (j = checkPrefixRL pat search)
            in
                if
                    ~(j < LENGTH patTab)
                then
                    0
                else
                    let
                        (a = findElem all_chars (EL j search))
                    in
                        if
                            ~(a < LENGTH (EL j patTab))
                        then
                            (LENGTH search + 1)
                        else
                            let
                                (d = EL a (EL j patTab))
                            in
                                if
                                    ~(0 < d)
                                then
                                    (LENGTH search + 1)
                                else
                                    (d + (bmRecur pat patTab
                                            all_chars (DROP d search)))
    )

num_set_tree_union_def
statement:
(num_set_tree_union LN t2 = t2 : num_set num_map) /\
  (num_set_tree_union (LS a) t =
   case t of
     | LN => LS a
     | LS b => LS (union a b)
     | BN t1 t2 => BS t1 a t2
     | BS t1 b t2 => BS t1 (union a b) t2) /\
  (num_set_tree_union (BN t1 t2) t =
     case t of
       | LN => BN t1 t2
       | LS a => BS t1 a t2
       | BN t1' t2' =>
            BN (num_set_tree_union t1 t1') (num_set_tree_union t2 t2')
       | BS t1' a t2' =>
        BS (num_set_tree_union t1 t1') a (num_set_tree_union t2 t2')) /\
  (num_set_tree_union (BS t1 a t2) t =
     case t of
       | LN => BS t1 a t2
       | LS b => BS t1 (union a b) t2
       | BN t1' t2' =>
            BS (num_set_tree_union t1 t1') a (num_set_tree_union t2 t2')
       | BS t1' b t2' =>
            BS (num_set_tree_union t1 t1') (union a b)
                (num_set_tree_union t2 t2'))

    let nodes = spt_fold union LN sets in
    if subspt nodes reachable then reachable
    else closure_spt (union reachable nodes) tree

      let names = MAP FST lets in
      let to_num = MAPi (\i n. (n,i)) names in
      let from_num = fromAList (MAPi (\i n. (i,n)) names) in
      let nesting = top_sort (MAPi (\i (n,ns). (i,to_nums to_num ns)) lets) in
        MAP
          (MAP (\n. case lookup n from_num of SOME m => m | _ => HD (names)))
          nesting

name: left_unique_TmC
statement: left_unique AC ⇒ left_unique (TmC AC)

name: right_unique_TmC
statement: right_unique AC ⇒ right_unique (TmC AC)

name: RRANGE_TmC
statement: RRANGE (TmC AC) = is_cvterm (RRANGE AC)

name: t2c_def
statement:
t2c cf (term$Var n) = cp (cn 0) (cn n) ∧
  t2c cf (term$Pair t1 t2) = cp (cn 1) (cp (t2c cf t1) (t2c cf t2)) ∧
  t2c cf (term$Const c) = cp (cn 2) (cf c)

name: TmC_def
statement:
(TmC AC (term$Var n) c ⇔ c = cp (cn 0) (cn n)) ∧
  (TmC AC (term$Pair t1 t2) c ⇔ ∃c1 c2. c = cp (cn 1) (cp c1 c2) ∧
                                        TmC AC t1 c1 ∧ TmC AC t2 c2) ∧
  (TmC AC (term$Const ct) c ⇔ ∃c0. c = cp (cn 2) c0 ∧ AC ct c0)

name: is_cvterm_def
statement:
[~var:]
  is_cvterm Cs (cp (cn 0) (cn n))
[~pair:]
  is_cvterm Cs c1 ∧ is_cvterm Cs c2 ⇒
  is_cvterm Cs (cp (cn 1) (cp c1 c2))
[~const:]
  c ∈ Cs ⇒ is_cvterm Cs (cp (cn 2) c)

name: FUNREL_flipR
statement: (AB |==> CD |==> EF) f (flip g) ⇔ (CD |==> AB |==> EF) (flip f) g

name: TERMREL_EQ
statement: TERMREL (=) = (=)

name: term_CASE_CONG
statement:
(TERMREL AB |==> ((=) |==> CD) |==> (TERMREL AB |==> TERMREL AB |==> CD) |==>
   (AB |==> CD) |==> CD) term_CASE term_CASE

name: FMSP_wfs
statement: (FMSP (=) (=) |==> (=)) wfs swfs

name: FMSP_vwalk
statement: (FMSP (=) (=) |==> (=) |==> (=)) vwalk svwalk

name: FMSP_unify
statement: (FMSP (=) (=) |==> (=) |==> (=) |==> OPTREL (FMSP (=) (=))) unify sunify

name: TERMREL_def
statement:
(TERMREL AB (Var n) t ⇔ t = Var n) ∧
  (TERMREL AB (Pair t11 t12) t ⇔ ∃t21 t22. t = Pair t21 t22 ∧
                                           TERMREL AB t11 t21 ∧
                                           TERMREL AB t12 t22) ∧
  (TERMREL AB (Const c1) t ⇔ ∃c2. AB c1 c2 ∧ t = Const c2)

name: svR_def
statement: svR sp u v = vR (sp2fm sp) u v

name: swfs_def
statement: swfs sp = wfs (sp2fm sp)

name: svwalk_def
statement: svwalk sp t = vwalk (sp2fm sp) t

name: swalk_def
statement: swalk sp t = walk (sp2fm sp) t

name: soc_def
statement: soc sp t v = oc (sp2fm sp) t v

name: sunify_def
statement: sunify sp t1 t2 = OPTION_MAP fm2sp (unify (sp2fm sp) t1 t2)

name: contify_optbind
statement:
contify k (OPTION_BIND opt f) =
  contify (λov. case ov of
                  NONE => k NONE
                | SOME x => contify k (f x))
          opt

name: contify_term_case
statement:
contify k (term_CASE t v p c) =
  contify (λt. case t of Var n => contify k (v n)
                      | Pair t1 t2 => contify k (p t1 t2)
                      | Const cn => contify k (c cn))
          t

name: sum_CASE_pair_CASE
statement:
sum_CASE (pair_CASE p f) lf rf =
  pair_CASE p (λa b. sum_CASE (f a b) lf rf)

name: sum_CASE_term_CASE
statement:
sum_CASE (term_CASE t vf pf cf) lf rf =
  term_CASE t
            (λv. sum_CASE (vf v) lf rf)
            (λt1 t2. sum_CASE (pf t1 t2) lf rf)
            (λcn. sum_CASE (cf cn) lf rf)

name: sum_CASE_COND
statement:
sum_CASE (if p then t else e) lf rf =
  if p then sum_CASE t lf rf else sum_CASE e lf rf

name: sum_CASE_option_CASE
statement:
sum_CASE (option_CASE ov n sf) lf rf =
  option_CASE ov (sum_CASE n lf rf) (λv. sum_CASE (sf v) lf rf)

name: sum_CASE_list_CASE
statement:
sum_CASE (list_CASE k i tkf) lf rf =
  list_CASE k (sum_CASE i lf rf)
              (λt k. sum_CASE (tkf t k) lf rf)

name: svwalk_tcallish
statement:
!x.

    (λ(s,nm). svwalk s nm) x =
    tcall ^svwalk_code (λ(s,nm). svwalk s nm) x

name: svwalk_cleaned
statement:
!x. (λ(s,nm). swfs s ∧ wf s) x ==>

name: apply_ockontT
statement: apply_ockont s v k T = T

name: dfkoc_removed
statement: dfkoc s t v k = apply_ockont s v (t :: k) F

name: ocwl0_varcheck

!x.
    (λ(s,sm). swfs s ∧ wf s) x ==>
    (λ(s,k). kocwl s v k) x =

statement: FINITE_BAG (BAG_OF_LIST l)

statement: FINITE_BAG b ==> mlt1 R b (BAG_INSERT e b)

name: ocwl_cleaned0
statement: !x. (λ(s,sm). swfs s ∧ wf s) x ==> (λ(s,k). kocwl s v k) x = trec ^oc_code x

name: tocwl_correct
statement: swfs s ∧ wf s ==> (soc s t v ⇔ tocwl s v [t])

name: disj_oc
statement: swfs s ∧ wf s ==> (soc s t1 v \/ soc s t2 v <=> tocwl s v [t1; t2])

name: apply_unifkont_NONE
statement: apply_unifkont k NONE = NONE

(λov. case ov of NONE => NONE | SOME s => dfkunify s t1 t2 k) =
  apply_unifkont ((t1, t2)::k)

name: kunifywl_tcallish
statement:
!x.
    (λ(s,k). swfs s ∧ wf s) x ==>
    (λ(s,k). kunifywl s k) x =
    tcall ucode (λ(s,k). kunifywl s k) x

statement: FINITE (plist_vars tps)

name: WF_kuR
statement: WF kuR

name: vwalk_rangevars
statement:
wfs s ∧ vwalk s v = t ⇒
  t = Var v ∧ v ∉ FDOM s ∨ vars t ⊆ rangevars s

name: walk_rangevars
statement:
wfs s ∧ walk s t = u ⇒
  vars u ⊆ rangevars s ∪ vars t

name: ucode_reduces_at_callsite
statement: ∀s k y. swfs s ∧ wf s ∧ ucode (s,k) = INL y ⇒ kuR y (s,k)

name: ucode_preserves_guard
statement: wf σ ∧ swfs σ ∧ ucode (σ,k) = INL (σ',k') ⇒ wf σ' ∧ swfs σ'

name: kunify_cleaned
statement:
∀x. (λ(s,k). swfs s ∧ wf s) x ⇒
      (λ(s,k). kunifywl s k) x = trec ucode x

name: option_CASE_MAP
statement:
option_CASE (OPTION_MAP f x) n sf =
  option_CASE x n (sf o f)

name: option_CASE_term_CASE
statement:
option_CASE (term_CASE t vf pf cf) n sf =
  term_CASE t (λv. option_CASE (vf v) n sf)
            (λt1 t2. option_CASE (pf t1 t2) n sf)
            (λc. option_CASE (cf c) n sf)

name: option_CASE_COND
statement:
option_CASE (COND g t e) n sf =
  COND g (option_CASE t n sf) (option_CASE e n sf)

name: tunifywl_NIL
statement: tunifywl σ [] = SOME σ

name: twalk_to_var
statement: swfs s ∧ wf s ∧ twalk s t = Var v ⇒ v ∉ domain s ∧ ∃u. t = Var u

name: substvars_FUPDATE
statement: substvars (fm |+ (v,t)) = substvars (fm \\ v) ∪ {v} ∪ vars t

name: ucode_EQ_INR
statement:
ucode (σ, k) = INR y ⇒
  k = [] ∧ y = SOME σ ∨
  ∃t1 t2 s. k = (t1,t2)::s ∧ y = NONE ∧
            ∀s'. ucode(σ,(t1,t2)::s') = INR NONE

name: ucode_EQ_INL
statement:
ucode (σ,k) = INL x ⇒
  ∃t1 t2 rest σ' p'.
    k = (t1,t2) :: rest ∧
    x = (σ',p' ++ rest) ∧
    ∀rest'. ucode (σ, (t1,t2) :: rest') =
            INL (σ', p' ++ rest')

name: tunifywl_APPEND
statement:
∀sts σ pfx sfx.
    wf σ ∧ swfs σ ∧ sts = (σ,pfx ++ sfx) ⇒
    tunifywl σ (pfx ++ sfx) =
    OPTION_BIND (tunifywl σ pfx) (λσ'. tunifywl σ' sfx)

name: ispair_def
statement:
ispair (Pair t1 t2) = T ∧
  ispair (Var v) = F ∧
  ispair (Const c) = F

name: isconst_def
statement:
isconst (Const c) = T ∧
  isconst (Var v) = F ∧
  isconst (Pair c1 c2) = F

name: destpair_def
statement: destpair (term$Pair c1 c2) = (c1,c2)

name: destvar_def
statement: destvar (Var v) = v

name: tvwalk_def
statement: tvwalk s nm = trec ^svwalk_code (s,nm)

name: twalk_def
statement:
twalk s t =
  case t of
    Var v => tvwalk s v
  | Pair t1 t2 => Pair t1 t2
  | Const c => Const c

name: koc_def
statement: koc (s:α term num_map) t v k = cwc (soc s t v) k

name: apply_ockont_def
statement:
apply_ockont s v [] b = b /\
  apply_ockont s v (t::ts) b =
  if b then T
  else koc s t v (λb. apply_ockont s v ts b)

name: dfkoc_def
statement: dfkoc s t v k = koc s t v (apply_ockont s v k)

name: kocwl_def
statement: kocwl s v k = ocwl0 s v k F

name: BAG_OF_SUM
statement:
BAG_OF_SUM (INL (t,k)) = BAG_OF_LIST (t :: k) /\
  BAG_OF_SUM (INR (k,b)) = BAG_OF_LIST k

name: ocR_def
statement:
ocR (s:α term num_map) =
  inv_image (pair$RPROD (=) (mlt1 (walkstarR (sp2fm s))))
            (λ(s:α term num_map,k:α term list). (s, BAG_OF_LIST k))

name: tocwl_def
statement: tocwl s v k = trec ^oc_code (s, k)

name: kunify_def
statement: kunify (s:α term num_map) t1 t2 k = cwc (sunify s t1 t2) k

name: apply_unifkont_def
statement:
apply_unifkont [] x = x /\
  apply_unifkont ((t1,t2)::k) NONE = NONE /\
  apply_unifkont ((t1,t2)::k) (SOME s) = kunify s t1 t2 (apply_unifkont k)

name: dfkunify_def
statement: dfkunify (s:α term num_map) t1 t2 k = kunify s t1 t2 (apply_unifkont k)

name: kunifywl_def
statement: kunifywl s k = unifywl0 k (SOME s)

name: ucode_def
statement: ucode = ^unify_code

name: plist_vars_def
statement:
plist_vars [] = {} ∧
  plist_vars ((t1,t2) :: tps) = vars t1 ∪ vars t2 ∪ plist_vars tps

name: kuR_def
statement:
kuR (s : α term num_map, wl : (α term # α term) list) (s0,wl0) ⇔
    wf s ∧ swfs s ∧ wf s0 ∧ swfs s0 ∧ sp2fm s0 ⊑ sp2fm s ∧
    (substvars $ sp2fm s) ∪ plist_vars wl ⊆
    (substvars $ sp2fm s0) ∪ plist_vars wl0 ∧
    mlt1 (measure
          (λ(t1,t2).
             pair_count (walk* (sp2fm s) t1) +
             pair_count (walk* (sp2fm s) t2)))
         (BAG_OF_LIST wl)
         (BAG_OF_LIST wl0)

name: tunifywl_def
statement: tunifywl s wl = trec ucode (s,wl)

name: istep_def
statement:
istep (sl,bl) (sr,br) <=>
  (∃t. br + {|(t, t)|} = bl ∧ sr = sl) ∨
  (∃t1a t1d t2a t2d.
    (br + {|(Pair t1a t1d, Pair t2a t2d)|} = {|(t1a,t2a); (t1d,t2d)|} + bl) ∧
    (sr = sl)) ∨
  (∃v t bi.
    ((bi + {|(Var v, t)|} = bl) ∨
     (bi + {|(t, Var v)|} = bl)) ∧
    v ∉ vars t ∧
    br = BAG_IMAGE (λ(t1,t2). ((FEMPTY|+(v,t)) ❜ t1, (FEMPTY|+(v,t)) ❜ t2)) bi ∧
    sr = sl |+ (v,t))

name: IN_vars_APPLY
statement: ∀t v. v IN vars (s ❜ t) ⇔ v ∉ FDOM s ∧ v ∈ vars t ∨ ∃x. vR s v x ∧ x ∈ vars t

name: TC_vR_selfapp
statement:
(vR (selfapp s))^+ v u ⇔
    (∃n. NRC (vR s) (2 * (SUC n)) v u) ∨
    (∃n u'. NRC (vR s) (2 * n) u' u ∧ vR1 s v u')

name: vR_FUNPOW_selfapp_bound
statement:
∀n v u. vR (FUNPOW selfapp n s) v u ⇒
          ∃m. 1 ≤ m ∧ NRC (vR s) m v u ∧ (v IN FDOM s ⇒ n ≤ m)

name: pair_count_def
statement:
(pair_count (Var v) = 0) /\
  (pair_count (Const c) = 0) /\
  (pair_count (Pair t1 t2) = 1 + pair_count t1 + pair_count t2)

name: vars_def
statement:
(vars (Var x) = {x}) /\
  (vars (Pair t1 t2) = vars t1 UNION vars t2) /\
  (vars (Const _) = {})

name: varb_def
statement:
(varb (Var s) = {| s |}) /\
  (varb (Pair t1 t2) = BAG_UNION (varb t1) (varb t2)) /\
  (varb (Const c) = {||})

name: vR_update
statement: v NOTIN FDOM s /\ x <> v ==> (vR (s |+ (v,t)) y x <=> vR s y x)

name: TC_vR_update
statement:
!y x. (vR (s |+ (v,t)))^+ y x ==> v NOTIN FDOM s ==>
        (vR s)^+ y x \/ ?u. (vR s)^* v x /\ u IN vars t /\ (vR s)^* y u

name: uR_RSUBSET_uR_lex
statement: uR RSUBSET uR_lex

name: WF_FINITE_PSUBSET
statement: WF (λs1 s2. s1 PSUBSET s2 ∧ FINITE s2)

name: uR_def
statement:
uR (sx,c1,c2) (s,t1,t2) <=>
  wfs sx ∧ s SUBMAP sx ∧ allvars sx c1 c2 SUBSET allvars s t1 t2 ∧
  measure (pair_count o (walkstar sx)) c1 t1

name: uR_lex_def
statement:
uR_lex =
    inv_image ((λs1 s2. s2 SUBMAP s1 ∧ s2 ≠ s1) LEX
               (λs1 s2. s1 ⊂ s2 ∧ FINITE s2) LEX (measure pair_count))
              (λ(s,t1,t2). (s,allvars s t1 t2,walk* s t1))

name: ext_s_check_def
statement: ext_s_check s v t = if oc s t v then NONE else SOME (s |+ (v,t))

name: walkstar_extend
statement:
wfs s1 /\ wfs (s|+(vx,tx)) /\ vx NOTIN FDOM s /\
  walkstar s1 (Var vx) = walkstar s1 (walkstar s tx) ==>
     !t. walkstar s1 (walkstar (s|+(vx,tx)) t) = walkstar s1 (walkstar s t)

name: unify_same
statement: ∀s. wfs s ⇒ ∀t. unify s t t = SOME s

name: wex
statement:
wfs s1 ∧ wfs (s|+(vx,tx)) ∧
  walkstar s1 (walk* s (Var vx)) = walkstar s1 (walkstar s tx) ∧ vx ∉ FDOM s
 ==>
  !t. walkstar s1 (walkstar (s|+(vx,tx)) t) = walkstar s1 (walkstar s t)

name: example2
statement: y ≠ x ⇒ vwalk_rhs [(y,Var x);(x,Const c)] [(y,Var x);(x,Const c)] x = Var x

name: TC_vR_vars_walkstar
statement:
wfs s /\ u IN vars t /\ (vR s)^+ v u /\ v NOTIN FDOM s ==>
  v IN vars (walk* s t)

name: vars_walkstar
statement:
wfs s ⇒
  ∀t. vars (walkstar s t) ⊆ vars t ∪ BIGUNION (FRANGE (vars o_f s))

name: walkstarR_def
statement:
walkstarR s =
   inv_image ((LEX) (mlt1 (vR s)^+)^+ (measure pair_count)) (\t. (varb t, t))

name: pnomsl_def
statement:
(pnomsl [] = []) ∧
  (pnomsl ((a1,a2)::t) = a1::a2::pnomsl t)

name: DISTINCT_def
statement:
(DISTINCT [] = []) ∧
  (DISTINCT (h::t) = if MEM h t then DISTINCT t else (h::DISTINCT t))

name: Ctermeq_refl
statement: ∀t. Ctermeq t t

name: FINITE_nvars
statement: FINITE (nvars t)

name: FINITE_nvarb
statement: ∀t. FINITE_BAG (nvarb t)

name: IN_nvarb_nvars
statement: ∀t. BAG_IN e (nvarb t) <=> e IN nvars t

name: Ctermeq_def
statement:
(Ctermeq (CNom a1) (CNom a2) = (a1 = a2)) ∧
  (Ctermeq (CSus p1 v1) (CSus p2 v2) <=> (p1 == p2) ∧ (v1 = v2)) ∧
  (Ctermeq (CTie a1 t1) (CTie a2 t2) <=> (a1 = a2) ∧ Ctermeq t1 t2) ∧
  (Ctermeq (CnPair t1a t1d) (CnPair t2a t2d) <=>
     Ctermeq t1a t2a ∧ Ctermeq t1d t2d) ∧
  (Ctermeq (CnConst c1) (CnConst c2) = (c1 = c2)) ∧
  (Ctermeq t1 t2 = F)

name: nvars_def
statement:
(nvars (Sus p v) = {v}) ∧
  (nvars (Tie a t) = nvars t) ∧
  (nvars (nPair t1 t2) = nvars t1 ∪ nvars t2) ∧
  (nvars _ = {})

name: nvarb_def
statement:
(nvarb (Sus p v) = {|v|}) ∧
  (nvarb (Tie a t) = nvarb t) ∧
  (nvarb (nPair t1 t2) = nvarb t1 + nvarb t2) ∧
  (nvarb _ = {||})

name: nwfs_extend
statement:
nwfs s /\ v NOTIN FDOM s /\ v NOTIN nvars (nwalkstar s t) ==>
  nwfs (s |+ (v, t))

name: term_fcs_monadic_thm
FINITE_sysvars

sysvars s (t1:'a nterm) (t2:'a nterm) =

name: uR_def

uR = λ((sx,fex:fe),c,c2) ((s,fe:fe),t,t2).
              nwfs sx
           /\ s SUBMAP sx
           /\ sysvars sx c c2 SUBSET sysvars s t t2

statement:
!desc size value.
    preserve_relation_mmu (write_mem <|proc:=0|> (desc,size) value)
                          (assert_mode 16w) (assert_mode 16w)
                          priv_mode_constraints priv_mode_similar

name: IT_advance_constlem
statement:
((s.psrs(0,CPSR)).IT = 0w) ==>
  (((IT_advance <|proc :=0|>) s) = (ValueState () s))

name: TC_ONE_STEP_THM
statement:
!f. TCON f <=>
        IS_IMAP f /\ (!a. f 0 (f 0 a) = f 0 a) /\ (!a. f 0 (f 1 a) = f 1 a)

name: ONE_STEP_THM
statement:
!spec impl imm abs.
       UNIFORM imm impl /\
       TCON spec /\
       TCON_IMMERSION impl imm /\
       DATA_ABSTRACTION abs (impl 0) (spec 0) ==>
      (CORRECT spec impl imm abs <=>
        (!a. spec 0 (abs a) = abs (impl (imm a 0) a)) /\
         !a. spec 1 (abs a) = abs (impl (imm a 1) a))

name: ONE_STEP_SUP_THM
statement:
!spec impl imm1 imm2 abs.
      (ADJUNCT imm1 imm2 impl /\
       TCON spec /\
       TCON_IMMERSION impl imm2) ==>
      (CORRECT_SUP spec impl imm1 imm2 abs <=>
        DATA_ABSTRACTION abs (impl 0) (spec 0) /\
        (!a. spec (imm1 a 0) (abs a) = abs (impl (imm2 a 0) a)) /\
         !a. spec (imm1 a 1) (abs a) = abs (impl (imm2 a 1) a))

name: po_loc
statement: po_loc G = po G RINTER same_loc G

name: intervening_write
statement: intervening_write G r = r ⨾ diag (W G) ⨾ r

name: im0

  (E G RCROSS E G) RINTER
  ((is_init RCROSS (W G DIFF is_init)) RINTER same_loc G)

name: ca
statement: ca G <=> fr G RUNION G.co

name: lrs
statement:
lrs G <=>
  diag (W G) ⨾ (po_loc G RMINUS intervening_write G (po_loc G)) ⨾ diag (R G)

name: lws
statement: lws G <=> diag (RW G) ⨾ po_loc G ⨾ diag (W G)

name: obs
statement: obs G <=> rfe G RUNION fre G RUNION coe G

name: dob
statement:
dob G <=>
         G.addr
  RUNION G.data
  RUNION G.ctrl ⨾ diag (W G)
  RUNION ((G.ctrl RUNION (G.addr ⨾ po G)) ⨾ diag (F_isb G) ⨾ po G ⨾ diag (R G))
  RUNION G.addr ⨾ po G ⨾ diag (W G)
  RUNION (G.addr RUNION G.data) ⨾ lrs G

name: aob
statement: aob G <=> rmw G RUNION diag (RRANGE (rmw G)) ⨾ lrs G ⨾ diag (A G UNION Q G)

name: bob
statement:
bob G <=>
         po G ⨾ diag (F_dmbsy G) ⨾ po G
  RUNION po G ⨾ (diag (A G) ⨾ G.amo ⨾ diag (L G)) ⨾ po G
  RUNION diag (L G) ⨾ po G ⨾ diag (A G)
  RUNION diag (R G) ⨾ po G ⨾ diag (F_dmbld G) ⨾ po G
  RUNION diag (A G UNION Q G) ⨾ po G
  RUNION diag (W G) ⨾ po G ⨾ diag (F_dmbst G) ⨾ po G ⨾ diag (W G)
  RUNION po G ⨾ diag (L G)

name: lob
statement:
lob G <=>
  TC (lws G ⨾ si G
      RUNION dob G
      RUNION aob G
      RUNION bob G)

name: ER
statement: ER G = RRANGE (rfe G)

name: IR
statement: IR G = RRANGE (rfi G)

name: rfisw
statement: rfisw G <=> inv (rfi G) ⨾ si G ⨾ rfi G

name: erln
statement:
erln G <=>
         si G RINTER (W G RCROSS W G)
  RUNION si G RINTER (ER G RCROSS ER G)
  RUNION si G RINTER (R G RCROSS R G) RINTER rfisw G
  RUNION diag (E G)

name: MC
statement: MC G = classes (erln G)

name: scaob
statement: scaob G <=> si G RINTER (ER G RCROSS IR G)

name: linearization_of
statement:
linearization_of G r cb <=>
  r RSUBSET cb /\
  strict_total_order (MC G) cb /\
  cb RSUBSET (MC G) RCROSS (MC G)

name: internal
statement: internal G = acyclic (po_loc G RUNION ca G RUNION G.rf)

name: atomic
statement: atomic G <=> rmw G RINTER (fre G ⨾ coe G) RSUBSET REMPTY

name: arm_common
statement: arm_common G <=> WellFormed G /\ complete G /\ internal G /\ atomic G

name: preorder_cb
statement: preorder_cb G <=> im0 G RUNION lob G RUNION scaob G

name: preorder_cb_lift
statement: preorder_cb_lift G <=> lift (erln G) (preorder_cb G)

name: dcbl
statement: dcbl G cb = delift (erln G) cb RINTER same_loc G

name: rf_fwd
statement:
rf_fwd G cb <=>
  ((W G RCROSS R G) RINTER po_loc G RINTER inv (dcbl G cb))
  RMINUS intervening_write G (po_loc G)

name: rf_nfwd
statement:
rf_nfwd G cb <=>
  ((W G RCROSS R G) RINTER dcbl G cb)
  RMINUS intervening_write G (dcbl G cb RUNION po_loc G)

name: rf_cb
statement: rf_cb G cb <=> rf_fwd G cb RUNION rf_nfwd G cb

name: co_cb
statement: co_cb G cb <=> dcbl G cb RINTER (W G RCROSS W G)

name: external_completion
statement:
external_completion G =
  ?cb. linearization_of G (preorder_cb_lift G) cb /\
       (G.rf = rf_cb G cb) /\
       (G.co = co_cb G cb)

name: arm_ec
statement: arm_ec G <=> arm_common G /\ external_completion G

name: gc_req
statement:
gc_req G <=>
         (W G RCROSS UNIV)
  RUNION ((R G RCROSS UNIV) RINTER (RRANGE (rfe G) RCROSS UNIV))
  RUNION (inv (rfi G) ⨾ lob G)

name: preorder_gcb
statement: preorder_gcb G <=> im0 G RUNION lob G RINTER gc_req G RUNION scaob G

name: preorder_gcb_lift
statement: preorder_gcb_lift G <=> lift (erln G) (preorder_gcb G)

name: dgcbl
statement: dgcbl G gcb = delift (erln G) gcb RINTER same_loc G

name: rf_gcb
statement:
rf_gcb G gcb <=>
  ((W G RCROSS R G) RINTER dgcbl G gcb) RMINUS intervening_write G (dgcbl G gcb)

name: co_gcb
statement: co_gcb G gcb <=> (W G RCROSS W G) RINTER dgcbl G gcb

name: external_global
statement:
external_global G =
  ?gcb. linearization_of G (preorder_gcb_lift G) gcb /\
        (G.rf = rf_gcb G gcb) /\
        (G.co = co_gcb G gcb)

name: arm_egc
statement: arm_egc G <=> arm_common G /\ external_global G

name: erln_trans
statement: WellFormed G ==> transitive (erln G)

name: erln_sym
statement: symmetric (erln G)

name: erln_in_si
statement: erln G RSUBSET si G

name: wf_lrsE
statement: lrs G = diag (E G) ⨾ lrs G ⨾ diag (E G)

name: wf_lwsE
statement: lws G = diag (E G) ⨾ lws G ⨾ diag (E G)

name: wf_obsE
statement: WellFormed G ==> obs G = diag (E G) ⨾ obs G ⨾ diag (E G)

name: wf_dobE
statement: WellFormed G ==> dob G = diag (E G) ⨾ dob G ⨾ diag (E G)

name: wf_aobE
statement: WellFormed G ==> aob G = diag (E G) ⨾ aob G ⨾ diag (E G)

name: wf_bobE
statement: WellFormed G ==> bob G = diag (E G) ⨾ bob G ⨾ diag (E G)

name: wf_lobE
statement: WellFormed G ==> lob G = diag (E G) ⨾ lob G ⨾ diag (E G)

name: wf_lrsD
statement: lrs G = diag (W G) ⨾ lrs G ⨾ diag (R G)

name: wf_lwsD
statement: lws G = diag (RW G) ⨾ lws G ⨾ diag (W G)

name: wf_obsD
statement: WellFormed G ==> obs G = diag (RW G) ⨾ obs G ⨾ diag (RW G)

name: wf_dobD
statement: WellFormed G ==> dob G = dob G ⨾ diag (RW G)

name: wf_aobD
statement: WellFormed G ==> aob G = aob G ⨾ diag (RW G)

name: lws_in_po
statement: lws G RSUBSET po G

name: lrs_in_po
statement: lrs G RSUBSET po G

name: dob_in_po
statement: WellFormed G ==> dob G RSUBSET po G

name: aob_in_po
statement: WellFormed G ==> aob G RSUBSET po G

name: bob_in_po
statement: WellFormed G ==> bob G RSUBSET po G

name: lob_in_po
statement: WellFormed G ==> lob G RSUBSET po G

name: wf_ecol
statement: WellFormed G ==> eco G RSUBSET same_loc G

name: InternalConsistent_sc_per_loc
statement: WellFormed G /\ internal G ==> sc_per_loc G

name: obs_in_eco
statement: obs G RSUBSET eco G

name: in_po_obs_po
statement: eco G RSUBSET RC (po G) ⨾ RC (obs G) ⨾ RC (obs G) ⨾ RC (po G)

name: coi_lws
statement: WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==> coi G = diag (W G) ⨾ lws G

name: fri_lws
statement: WellFormed G /\ complete G /\ sc_per_loc G ==> fri G = diag (R G) ⨾ lws G

name: lws_expand
statement:
WellFormed G /\ complete G /\ sc_per_loc G ==>
  diag (RW G) ⨾ lws G = coi G RUNION fri G

name: bob_fri
statement: WellFormed G ==> bob G ⨾ fri G RSUBSET bob G ⨾ RC (bob G)

name: co_in_ob
statement: WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==> G.co RSUBSET obs G RUNION lob G

name: fr_in_ob
statement: WellFormed G /\ complete G /\ sc_per_loc G ==> fr G RSUBSET obs G RUNION lob G

name: po_loc_ww
statement:
WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G /\ po G x y /\ W G x /\ W G y /\
  same_loc G x y ==> G.co x y

name: im0_in_co
statement: WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==> im0 G RSUBSET G.co

name: no_obs_to_init
statement: WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==> obs G RSUBSET (K T) RCROSS (COMPL is_init)

name: no_lob_to_init
statement: WellFormed G ==> lob G RSUBSET (K T) RCROSS (COMPL is_init)

name: si_init
statement:
si G RSUBSET
  is_init RCROSS is_init RUNION ((COMPL is_init) RCROSS (COMPL is_init))

name: L_si
statement: WellFormed G ==> diag (L G) ⨾ si G = si G ⨾ diag (L G)

name: A_si
statement: WellFormed G ==> diag (A G) ⨾ si G = si G ⨾ diag (A G)

name: Q_si
statement: WellFormed G ==> diag (Q G) ⨾ si G = si G ⨾ diag (Q G)

name: bob_si
statement: WellFormed G ==> bob G ⨾ si G = bob G

name: scaob_scaob
statement: WellFormed G ==> scaob G ⨾ scaob G = REMPTY

name: erln_refl
statement: E G x ==> erln G x x

name: erln_scaob
statement: WellFormed G ==> erln G ⨾ scaob G = scaob G

name: scaob_erln
statement: WellFormed G ==> scaob G ⨾ erln G RSUBSET scaob G

name: lrs_erln
statement:
WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==>
  lrs G ⨾ erln G RSUBSET
  si G ⨾ lrs G RUNION TC (obs G ⨾ si G) RUNION is_init RCROSS COMPL is_init

name: dob_erln
statement:
WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==>
  dob G ⨾ erln G RSUBSET dob G RUNION dob G ⨾ TC (obs G ⨾ si G)

name: rmw_in_lws
statement: WellFormed G ==> rmw G RSUBSET lws G

name: aob_erln
statement:
WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==>
  aob G ⨾ erln G RSUBSET
  TC (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G) RUNION
  diag (W_ex G) ⨾ si G ⨾ aob G RUNION
  is_init RCROSS COMPL is_init

name: lrs_si_aob
statement: WellFormed G ==> lrs G ⨾ si G ⨾ aob G RSUBSET lob G

name: dob_si_aob
statement: WellFormed G ==> dob G ⨾ si G ⨾ aob G RSUBSET lob G

name: aob_si_aob
statement: WellFormed G ==> aob G ⨾ si G ⨾ aob G RSUBSET lob G RUNION si G ⨾ TC (aob G)

name: aob_Wex
statement: WellFormed G ==> aob G ⨾ diag (W_ex G) RSUBSET lws G

name: lob_si_aob
statement:
WellFormed G ==>
  lob G ⨾ diag (W_ex G) ⨾ si G ⨾ aob G RSUBSET TC (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G)

name: ob_si_aob
statement:
WellFormed G ==>
  TC (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G) ⨾ diag (W_ex G) ⨾ si G ⨾ aob G RSUBSET
  TC (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G)

name: lob_erln
statement:
WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==>
  lob G ⨾ erln G RSUBSET
  TC (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G) RUNION diag (W_ex G) ⨾ si G ⨾ aob G RUNION
  is_init RCROSS COMPL is_init

name: lrs_scaob
statement:
WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==>
  lrs G ⨾ scaob G RSUBSET TC (obs G ⨾ si G) RUNION is_init RCROSS COMPL is_init

name: dob_scaob
statement:
WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==>
  dob G ⨾ scaob G RSUBSET dob G RUNION dob G ⨾ TC (obs G ⨾ si G)

name: aob_scaob
statement:
WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==>
  aob G ⨾ scaob G RSUBSET diag (W_ex G) ⨾ TC (obs G ⨾ si G)

name: lob_scaob
statement:
WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==>
  lob G ⨾ scaob G RSUBSET TC (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G)

name: erln_refl1
statement:
WellFormed G /\
  ((im0 G RUNION obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G RUNION scaob G) x y \/
   (im0 G RUNION obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G RUNION scaob G) y x) ==> erln G x x

name: erln_refl2
statement: WellFormed G ==> (erln G x x <=> E G x)

name: acyclic_pre_ec
statement:
WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G /\ acyclic (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G) ==>
  acyclic
    (lift (erln G) (im0 G RUNION obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G RUNION scaob G))

name: partial_order_pre_ec
statement:
WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G /\ acyclic (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G) ==>
  StrongOrder
    (TC (lift (erln G) (im0 G RUNION obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G RUNION scaob G)))

name: co_in_ob2
statement: WellFormed G /\ sc_per_loc G ==> G.co RSUBSET obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G

name: fr_in_ob2
statement:
WellFormed G /\ complete G /\ sc_per_loc G ==>
  fr G RSUBSET obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G

name: obs_si_scaob
statement:
WellFormed G /\ complete G ==>
  obs G ⨾ si G = obs G ⨾ erln G RUNION rfe G ⨾ scaob G

name: erln_rewrite
statement: WellFormed G /\ erln G x y ==> erln G x = erln G y

name: ArmConsistentExtComp_equiv
statement: arm_ev = arm_ec

name: acyclic_pre_gcb1
statement:
WellFormed G /\ complete G /\ sc_per_loc G /\
  acyclic (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G) ==>
  acyclic ((rfi G RUNION
            is_init RCROSS COMPL is_init RUNION
            scaob G RUNION
            erln G ⨾ obs G ⨾ si G RUNION
            erln G ⨾ (lob G RINTER gc_req G)) ⨾ erln G)

name: erln_refl3
statement:
WellFormed G /\
  ((im0 G RUNION G.rf RUNION G.co RUNION fr G RUNION obs G ⨾ si G RUNION
    lob G RINTER gc_req G RUNION scaob G) x y \/
   (im0 G RUNION G.rf RUNION G.co RUNION fr G RUNION obs G ⨾ si G RUNION
    lob G RINTER gc_req G RUNION scaob G) y x) ==>
  erln G x x

name: acyclic_pre_egc
statement:
WellFormed G /\ complete G /\ sc_per_loc G /\
  acyclic (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G) ==>
  acyclic (lift (erln G)
             (im0 G RUNION
              G.rf RUNION
              G.co RUNION
              fr G RUNION
              obs G ⨾ si G RUNION
              lob G RINTER gc_req G
              RUNION scaob G))

name: partial_order_pre_egc
statement:
WellFormed G /\ complete G /\ sc_per_loc G /\
  acyclic (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G) ==>
  StrongOrder
    (TC (lift (erln G)
           (im0 G RUNION G.rf RUNION G.co RUNION fr G RUNION obs G ⨾ si G RUNION
            lob G RINTER gc_req G RUNION scaob G)))

name: scaob_aob
statement: WellFormed G ==> scaob G ⨾ aob G RSUBSET lob G RINTER gc_req G

name: si_dob
statement: WellFormed G ==> si G ⨾ dob G RSUBSET dob G

name: si_bob
statement: WellFormed G ==> si G ⨾ bob G RSUBSET bob G

name: scaob_lob
statement: WellFormed G ==> scaob G ⨾ lob G RSUBSET RC (scaob G) ⨾ lob G RINTER gc_req G

name: ArmConsistentGlobExtComp_equiv
statement: arm_ev = arm_egc

name: external
statement: external G = acyclic (obs G ⨾ si G RUNION lob G)

name: arm_ev
statement: arm_ev G <=> arm_common G /\ external G

name: tid
statement:
tid a =
  case a of
    InitEvent _ => tid_init
  | ThreadEvent e => e.thread

name: is_tid
statement: is_tid i a = (tid a = i)

name: index
statement:
index a =
  case a of
    InitEvent _ => 0
  | ThreadEvent e => e.index

name: is_init
statement:
is_init a =
  case a of
    InitEvent _ => T
  | ThreadEvent _ => F

name: same_tid
statement: same_tid a b = (tid a = tid b)

name: loc
statement:
loc lab a =
  case lab a of
  | Aload l => SOME l.location
  | Astore s => SOME s.location
  | _ => NONE

name: value
statement:
value lab a =
  case lab a of
  | Aload l => SOME l.value
  | Astore s => SOME s.value
  | _ => NONE

name: is_r
statement:
is_r lab a =
  case lab a of
  | Aload l => T
  | _ => F

name: is_w
statement:
is_w lab a =
  case lab a of
  | Astore s => T
  | _ => F

name: is_f
statement:
is_f lab a =
  case lab a of
  | Afence _ => T
  | _ => F

name: is_br
statement:
is_br lab a =
  case lab a of
  | Abranch => T
  | _ => F

name: is_w_rel
statement:
is_w_rel lab a =
  case lab a of
  | Astore s => s.order = Orel
  | _ => F

name: is_r_acqSC
statement:
is_r_acqSC lab a =
  case lab a of
  | Aload l => l.order = OacqSC
  | _ => F

name: is_r_acqPC
statement:
is_r_acqPC lab a =
  case lab a of
  | Aload l => l.order = OacqPC
  | _ => F

name: is_dmbst
statement: is_dmbst lab a <=> lab a = Afence Odmbst

name: is_dmbld
statement: is_dmbld lab a <=> lab a = Afence Odmbld

name: is_dmbsy
statement: is_dmbsy lab a <=> lab a = Afence Odmbsy

name: is_isb
statement: is_isb lab a <=> lab a = Afence Oisb

name: R_ex
statement:
R_ex lab a =
  case lab a of
  | Aload r => r.exclusive
  | _ => F

name: same_loc
statement: same_loc lab a b = (loc lab a = loc lab b)

name: ext_sb
statement:
ext_sb a b =
  case a, b of
  | _, InitEvent _ => F
  | InitEvent _, _ => T
  | ThreadEvent e, ThreadEvent e' => e.thread = e'.thread /\ e.index < e'.index

name: si_matching_label
statement:
si_matching_label label1 label2 =
  case label1, label2 of
  | Aload l1, Aload l2 => l1.exclusive = l2.exclusive /\
                          l1.order = l2.order
  | Astore s1, Astore s2 => s1.exclusive = s2.exclusive /\
                            s1.order = s2.order
  | Afence o1, Afence o2 => o1 = o2
  | Abranch, Abranch => T
  | _ => F

name: ext_si
statement:
ext_si a b =
  case a, b of
  | InitEvent l, InitEvent l' => l = l'
  | ThreadEvent e, ThreadEvent e' => e.thread = e'.thread /\ e.index = e'.index
  | _ => F

name: acts_set
statement: acts_set G x = MEM x G.acts

name: po
statement: po G = diag (E G) ⨾ ext_sb ⨾ diag (E G)

name: si
statement: si G = diag (E G) ⨾ ext_si ⨾ diag (E G)

name: rmw
statement: rmw G = G.lxsx RUNION G.amo

name: fr
statement: fr G = inv G.rf ⨾ G.co

name: rfe
statement: rfe G = G.rf RMINUS po G

name: coe
statement: coe G = G.co RMINUS po G

name: fre
statement: fre G = fr G RMINUS po G

name: rfi
statement: rfi G = G.rf RINTER po G

name: coi
statement: coi G = G.co RINTER po G

name: fri
statement: fri G = fr G RINTER po G

name: deps
statement: deps G = G.data RUNION G.addr RUNION G.ctrl

name: W_ex
statement: W_ex G = RRANGE (rmw G)

name: eco
statement: eco G <=> G.rf RUNION G.co ⨾ RC G.rf RUNION fr G ⨾ RC G.rf

name: sc_per_loc
statement: sc_per_loc G = irreflexive (po G ⨾ eco G)

name: WellFormed
complete
statement: complete G <=> E G INTER R G SUBSET RRANGE G.rf

name: label_distinct
statement:
~(R G x /\ W G x) /\
  ~(R G x /\ Fence G x) /\
  ~(R G x /\ Br G x) /\
  ~(W G x /\ Fence G x) /\
  ~(W G x /\ Br G x) /\
  ~(Fence G x /\ Br G x)

name: loceq_same_tid
statement: funeq tid r <=> r RSUBSET r RINTER same_tid

name: lab_rwf
statement: is_r lab a \/ is_w lab a \/ is_f lab a \/ is_br lab a

name: R_ex_in_R
statement: R_ex lab SUBSET is_r lab

name: loceq_same_loc
statement: funeq (loc G) r <=> r RSUBSET r RINTER (same_loc G)

name: same_loc_trans
statement: transitive (same_loc lab)

name: same_loc_sym
statement: symmetric (same_loc lab)

name: is_w_val
statement: is_w lab x ==> ?v. value lab x = SOME v

name: is_w_loc
statement: is_w lab x ==> ?v. loc lab x = SOME v

name: is_r_val
statement: is_r lab x ==> ?v. value lab x = SOME v

name: is_r_loc
statement: is_r lab x ==> ?v. loc lab x = SOME v

name: ext_sb_trans
statement: transitive ext_sb

name: ext_sb_irr
statement: irreflexive ext_sb

name: ext_sb_to_non_init
statement: ext_sb RSUBSET (ext_sb ⨾ diag (\x. ~is_init x))

name: ext_sb_semi_total_l
statement:
~is_init x /\ index y <> index z /\ ext_sb x y /\ ext_sb x z ==>
  ext_sb y z \/ ext_sb z y

name: ext_sb_semi_total_r
statement: index y <> index z /\ ext_sb y x /\ ext_sb z x ==> ext_sb y z \/ ext_sb z y

name: ext_sb_tid_init
statement: ext_sb x y ==> tid x = tid y \/ is_init x

name: ext_sb_tid_init'
statement: ext_sb RSUBSET (ext_sb RINTER same_tid RUNION (diag is_init ⨾ ext_sb))

name: ext_si_refl
statement: reflexive ext_si

name: ext_si_sym
statement: symmetric ext_si

name: ext_si_trans
statement: transitive ext_si

name: is_init_tid
statement: is_init SUBSET (\x. tid x = tid_init)

name: initninit_in_ext_sb
statement: (is_init RCROSS COMPL is_init) RSUBSET ext_sb

name: po_trans
statement: transitive (po G)

name: po_po
statement: po G ⨾ po G RSUBSET po G

name: po_same_loc_trans
statement: transitive (po G RINTER same_loc G)

name: po_same_loc_W_trans
statement: transitive ((po G RINTER same_loc G) ⨾ diag (W G))

name: po_neq_loc_in_po
statement: po G RMINUS same_loc G RSUBSET po G

name: fr_co
statement: WellFormed G ==> ((fr G ⨾ G.co) RSUBSET (fr G))

name: rmw_in_po
statement: WellFormed G ==> (rmw G RSUBSET (po G))

name: deps_in_po
statement: WellFormed G ==> (deps G RSUBSET (po G))

name: amo_in_po
statement: WellFormed G ==> (G.amo RSUBSET (po G))

name: lxsx_in_po
statement: WellFormed G ==> (G.lxsx RSUBSET (po G))

statement: WellFormed G ==> funeq (loc G) G.rf

name: loceq_co
statement: WellFormed G ==> funeq (loc G) G.co

statement: WellFormed G ==> funeq (loc G) (rmw G)

name: loceq_fr
statement: WellFormed G ==> funeq (loc G) (fr G)

statement: WellFormed G ==> fr G RSUBSET same_loc G

name: wf_poE
statement: po G = diag (E G) ⨾ po G ⨾ diag (E G)

name: wf_dataE
statement: WellFormed G ==> (G.data = diag (E G) ⨾ G.data ⨾ diag (E G))

name: wf_addrE
statement: WellFormed G ==> (G.addr = diag (E G) ⨾ G.addr ⨾ diag (E G))

statement: WellFormed G ==> (G.ctrl = diag (E G) ⨾ G.ctrl ⨾ diag (E G))

    (ARM_UNALIGNED_SUPPORT state) /\ (ARM_READ_EVENT_REGISTER state) /\
    ~(ARM_READ_INTERRUPT_WAIT state) /\ ~(ARM_READ_SCTLR sctlrV state) /\
    (ARM_READ_SCTLR sctlrA state) /\ ~(ARM_READ_SCTLR sctlrU state) /\
    (ARM_READ_IT state = 0w) /\ ~(ARM_READ_STATUS psrJ state) /\
    ~(ARM_READ_STATUS psrT state) /\ ~(ARM_READ_STATUS psrE state) /\
    (ARM_MODE state = 16w)

name: uart0_ok_def
statement:
uart0_ok current_time (uart0:uart0_state) <=>
    
    (uart0.U0LCR ' 7 = F) /\
    
    (uart0.U0LSR ' 0 <=> (uart0.input_time <= current_time) /\ ~(uart0.input_list = [])) /\
    (uart0.U0LSR ' 5 <=> (uart0.output_time <= current_time)) /\
    
    (?w. uart0.U0RBR = if uart0.U0LSR ' 0 then HD (uart0.input_list) else w) /\
    (?w. uart0.U0THR = if uart0.U0LSR ' 5 then w else HD (uart0.output_list))

name: UART0_NEXT_def
statement:
UART0_NEXT
    current_time
    (accesses:memory_access list)
    (s1:uart0_state)
    (s2:uart0_state)
  <=>

    


    uart0_ok current_time s1 /\ uart0_ok (current_time+1) s2 /\

    
    (if MEM (MEM_READ 0xE000C000w) accesses then
       (s1.U0LSR ' 0 = T) /\ 
       (s2.input_list = TL s1.input_list) 
       
     else
       
       (s2.input_time = s1.input_time) /\
       (s2.input_list = s1.input_list)) /\

    
    (if ?w. MEM (MEM_WRITE 0xE000C000w w) accesses then
       (s1.U0LSR ' 5 = T) /\ 
       (s2.output_list = w2w (BYTE_WRITTEN_TO_MEM 0xE000C000w accesses) :: s1.output_list) 
       
     else
       
       (s2.output_time = s1.output_time) /\
       (s2.output_list = s1.output_list)) /\

    
    REG32_RW_NEXT 0xE000C00Cw (s1.U0LCR) accesses (s2.U0LCR) /\
    REG32_RO_NEXT 0xE000C014w accesses

name: unionWithKey_thm
statement:
∀cmp f t1 t2.
    good_cmp cmp ∧
    invariant cmp t1 ∧
    invariant cmp t2 ∧
    (∀k1 k2 x y. cmp k1 k2 = Equal ⇒ f k1 x y = f k2 x y)
  ⇒ invariant cmp (unionWithKey cmp f t1 t2) ∧
    to_fmap cmp (unionWithKey cmp f t1 t2) =
      FMERGE_WITH_KEY (λks x y. f (CHOICE ks) x y)
                      (to_fmap cmp t1)
                      (to_fmap cmp t2)

    to_fmap cmp (unionWith cmp f t1 t2) =
      FMERGE_WITH_KEY (λks x y. f x y) (to_fmap cmp t1) (to_fmap cmp t2)

name: lookup_unionWithKey
statement:
good_cmp cmp ∧ invariant cmp t1 ∧ invariant cmp t2 ∧
  (∀k1 k2 x y. cmp k1 k2 = Equal ⇒ f k1 x y = f k2 x y) ⇒
  lookup cmp k (unionWithKey cmp f t1 t2) =
    case lookup cmp k t1 of
    | NONE => lookup cmp k t2
    | SOME v1 =>
      case lookup cmp k t2 of
      | NONE => SOME v1
      | SOME v2 => SOME $ f k v1 v2

name: lookup_unionWith

    | SOME v1 =>
      case lookup cmp k t2 of
      | NONE => SOME v1
      | SOME v2 => SOME $ f v1 v2

name: mapWithKey_thm

    ⇒
    invariant cmp (mapWithKey f t) ∧

    (∀k1 k2 x. cmp k1 k2 = Equal ⇒ f k1 x = f k2 x) ⇒
      invariant cmp (filterWithKey f t) ∧
      to_fmap cmp (filterWithKey f t) =
      FDIFF (to_fmap cmp t)
            {k |k,v| FLOOKUP (to_fmap cmp t) k = SOME v ∧ ¬f (CHOICE k) v}

name: balanceL'_def
statement:
balanceL' k x l r =
  case r of
     | Tip =>
         (case l of
            | Tip => Bin 1 k x Tip Tip
            | (Bin _ _ _ Tip Tip) => Bin 2 k x l Tip
            | (Bin _ lk lx Tip (Bin _ lrk lrx _ _)) =>
                 Bin 3 lrk lrx (Bin 1 lk lx Tip Tip) (Bin 1 k x Tip Tip)
            | (Bin _ lk lx (Bin s' k' v' l' r') Tip) =>
                 Bin 3 lk lx (Bin s' k' v' l' r') (Bin 1 k x Tip Tip)
            | (Bin ls lk lx (Bin lls k' v' l' r') (Bin lrs lrk lrx lrl lrr)) =>
                if lrs < ratio*lls then
                  Bin (1+ls) lk lx
                      (Bin lls k' v' l' r')
                      (Bin (1+lrs) k x (Bin lrs lrk lrx lrl lrr) Tip)
                else
                  Bin (1+ls) lrk lrx
                      (Bin (1+lls+size lrl) lk lx (Bin lls k' v' l' r') lrl)
                      (Bin (1+size lrr) k x lrr Tip))
     | (Bin rs _ _ _ _) =>
         case l of
            | Tip => Bin (1+rs) k x Tip r
            | (Bin ls lk lx ll lr) =>
                if ls > delta*rs  then
                  case (ll, lr) of
                    | (Bin lls _ _ _ _, Bin lrs lrk lrx lrl lrr) =>
                         if lrs < ratio*lls then
                           Bin (1+ls+rs) lk lx ll (Bin (1+rs+lrs) k x lr r)
                         else
                           Bin (1+ls+rs) lrk lrx
                               (Bin (1+lls+size lrl) lk lx ll lrl)
                               (Bin (1+rs+size lrr) k x lrr r)
                     | (_, _) => Tip 
                else Bin (1+ls+rs) k x l r

name: link2_def
statement:
(link2 l Tip = l) ∧
  (link2 Tip r = r) ∧
  (link2 (Bin sizeL kx x lx rx) (Bin sizeR ky y ly ry) =
    if delta*sizeL < sizeR then
      balanceL ky y (link2 (Bin sizeL kx x lx rx) ly) ry
    else if delta*sizeR < sizeL then
      balanceR kx x lx (link2 rx (Bin sizeR ky y ly ry))
    else
       glue (Bin sizeL kx x lx rx) (Bin sizeR ky y ly ry))

name: hedgeUnionWithKey_def
statement:
(hedgeUnionWithKey _ _ _ _ t1 Tip = t1) ∧
  (hedgeUnionWithKey cmp _ blo bhi Tip (Bin _ kx x l r) =
    link kx x (filterGt cmp blo l) (filterLt cmp bhi r)) ∧
  (hedgeUnionWithKey cmp f blo bhi (Bin _ kx x l r) t2 =
    let newx = (case lookup cmp kx t2 of NONE => x | SOME y => f kx x y) in
    link kx newx
      (hedgeUnionWithKey cmp f blo (SOME kx) l (trim cmp blo (SOME kx) t2))
      (hedgeUnionWithKey cmp f (SOME kx) bhi r (trim cmp (SOME kx) bhi t2)))

name: unionWithKey_def

  (unionWithKey _ _ t1 Tip = t1) ∧
  (unionWithKey cmp f t1 t2 =

name: filterWithKey_def

filterWithKey f Tip = Tip ∧
  filterWithKey f (Bin s kx x l r) =
    let l' = filterWithKey f l in
    let r' = filterWithKey f r in
      if f kx x then link kx x l' r' else link2 l' r'

name: filter_def

name: mapWithKey_def
