  (∀f g. recfn1 f ∧ recfn1 g ⇒ recfn1 (recpair f g)) ∧
  (∀f g. recfn1 f ∧ recfn1 g ⇒ recfn1 (recCn1 f g)) ∧
  (∀b s. recfn1 b ∧ recfn1 s ⇒ recfn1 (recPr1 b s)) ∧
  (∀f. recfn1 f ⇒ recfn1 (recMin1 f))

name: countchars_PERM
statement: ∀s1 s2. PERM s1 s2 ⇒ ∀fm. countchars fm s1 = countchars fm s2

name: aux_correctness
statement: ∀i fm s. i ≤ LENGTH s ⇒ countchars_aux fm s i = countchars fm (TAKE i s)

name: countchars_EQN
statement: countchars fm s = countchars_aux fm s (LENGTH s)

name: correctness
statement:
∀fm0 s fm.
     countchars fm0 s =
       FUN_FMAP (λc. LENGTH (FILTER ((=) c) s) +
                     (case FLOOKUP fm0 c of NONE => 0 | SOME i => i))
                (FDOM fm0 ∪ set s)

name: countchars_def
statement:
countchars fm [] = fm ∧
  countchars fm (c::cs) =
    let fm' =
      case FLOOKUP fm c of
        NONE => fm |+ (c,1)
      | SOME n => fm |+ (c, n + 1)
    in
      countchars fm' cs

name: countchars_aux_def
statement:
countchars_aux fm s i =
    if i = 0 then fm
    else
      let c = EL (i - 1) s in
      let fm' =
        case FLOOKUP fm c of
          NONE => fm |+ (c,1)
        | SOME n => fm |+ (c, n + 1)
      in
        countchars_aux fm' s (i - 1)

name: to_bool_SmartIf
statement: to_bool e (SmartIf v x y) = to_bool e (If v x y)

name: to_bool_def
statement:
to_bool e True = T ∧
  to_bool e False = F ∧
  to_bool e (Var v) = e v ∧
  to_bool e (Not x) = ~ (to_bool e x) ∧
  to_bool e (Or x y) = (to_bool e x ∨ to_bool e y) ∧
  to_bool e (And x y) = (to_bool e x ∧ to_bool e y) ∧
  to_bool e (If v x y) = if e v then to_bool e x else to_bool e y

name: SmartIf_def
statement:
SmartIf v x y =
    if x = True ∧ y = False then Var v else
    if x = False ∧ y = True then Not (Var v) else
    if x = y then x else
    if x = True then Or (Var v) y else
    if y = False then And (Var v) x else
    if x = False then And (Not (Var v)) y else
    if y = True then Or (Not (Var v)) x else If v x y

name: all_vars_def
statement:
all_vars True acc = acc ∧
  all_vars False acc = acc ∧
  all_vars (Var v) acc = (if MEM v acc then acc else v::acc) ∧
  all_vars (Not x) acc = all_vars x acc ∧
  all_vars (Or x y) acc = all_vars x (all_vars y acc) ∧
  all_vars (And x y) acc = all_vars x (all_vars y acc) ∧
  all_vars (If v x y) acc = all_vars x (all_vars y (if MEM v acc then acc else v::acc))

name: vars_of_def
statement: vars_of xs = FOLDR all_vars [] xs

name: b2n_def
statement: b2n T = 1n ∧ b2n F = 0

name: gol_def
statement:
gol x1 x2 x3
      y1 y2 y3
      z1 z2 z3
  ⇔
    let n = SUM (MAP b2n [x1;x2;x3;y1;y3;z1;z2;z3]) in
      n = 3 ∨ (y2 ∧ n = 2)

name: eval_bool_exp_def
statement:
eval_bool_exp True true_vars = T ∧
  eval_bool_exp False true_vars = F ∧
  eval_bool_exp (Var v) true_vars = MEM v true_vars ∧
  eval_bool_exp (Not x) true_vars = ~ eval_bool_exp x true_vars ∧
  eval_bool_exp (Or x y) true_vars =
    (eval_bool_exp x true_vars ∨ eval_bool_exp y true_vars) ∧
  eval_bool_exp (And x y) true_vars =
    (eval_bool_exp x true_vars ∧ eval_bool_exp y true_vars) ∧
  eval_bool_exp (If v x y) true_vars =
    if MEM v true_vars then eval_bool_exp x true_vars else eval_bool_exp y true_vars

name: sum_bool_exps_def
statement:
sum_bool_exps [] true_vars = 0:num ∧
  sum_bool_exps (e::es) true_vars =
    if eval_bool_exp e true_vars then 1 + sum_bool_exps es true_vars
    else sum_bool_exps es true_vars

name: decide_gol_def
statement:
(decide_gol (v::vs) y2 rest true_vars =
    SmartIf v (decide_gol vs y2 rest (v::true_vars))
              (decide_gol vs y2 rest true_vars)) ∧
  (decide_gol [] y2 rest true_vars =
    let n = sum_bool_exps rest true_vars in
      if n = 3 then True else
        if eval_bool_exp y2 true_vars ∧ n = 2 then True else False)

name: is_eq_def
statement:
(is_eq (v::vs) e1 e2 true_vars =
     (is_eq vs e1 e2 (v::true_vars) ∧ is_eq vs e1 e2 true_vars)) ∧
  (is_eq [] e1 e2 true_vars =
     (eval_bool_exp e1 true_vars = eval_bool_exp e2 true_vars))

name: is_eq_bool_exp_def
statement:
is_eq_bool_exp e1 e2 =
    let vs = all_vars e1 (all_vars e2 []) in
      is_eq vs e1 e2 []

name: bool_exp_gol_def
statement:
bool_exp_gol x1 x2 x3
               y1 y2 y3
               z1 z2 z3
  =
  let vs = vars_of [x1;x2;x3;y1;y2;y3;z1;z2;z3] in
    decide_gol vs y2 [x1;x2;x3;y1;y3;z1;z2;z3] []

name: next_row_def
statement:
(next_row (x1::x2::x3::xs) (y1::y2::y3::ys) (z1::z2::z3::zs) ⇔
     bool_exp_gol x1 x2 x3 y1 y2 y3 z1 z2 z3 ::
     next_row (x2::x3::xs) (y2::y3::ys) (z2::z3::zs)) ∧
  (next_row (x1::x2::[]) (y1::y2::[]) (z1::z2::[]) ⇔
     bool_exp_gol x1 x2 False y1 y2 False z1 z2 False :: []) ∧
  (next_row _ _ _ ⇔ [])

name: next_frame_def
statement:
(next_frame (x::y::z::xs) ⇔
     next_row (False :: x) (False :: y) (False :: z) ::
     next_frame (y::z::xs)) ∧
  (next_frame (x::y::[]) ⇔
     next_row (False :: x) (False :: y) (False :: MAP (K False) y) :: []) ∧
  (next_frame _ ⇔ [])

name: next_sim_def
statement:
next_sim [] = [] ∧
  next_sim (x::xs) = next_frame (MAP (K False) x :: x :: xs)

name: factc_is_fact
statement: !n. factc (Num n) = Num (FACT n)

name: isprime_is_prime
statement: !n. isprime n <=> prime n

name: primes_uptoc_is_primes_upto
statement: !n. primes_uptoc (Num n) = ns2c (primes_upto n)

name: factc_def
statement:
factc n =
    cv_if (cv_lt n (Num 1))
          (Num 1)
          (cv_mul n (factc (cv_sub n (Num 1))))

name: isprimec_aux_def
statement:
isprimec_aux dvs n =
    cv_if (cv_lt dvs n)
          (cv_if (cv_mod n dvs)
                 (isprimec_aux (cv_add dvs (Num 2)) n)
                 (Num 0))
          (Num 1)

name: isprimec_def
statement:
isprimec n =
    cv_if (cv_lt n (Num 2))
          (Num 0)
          (cv_if (cv_eq n (Num 2))
                 (Num 1)
                 (cv_if (cv_mod n (Num 2))
                        (isprimec_aux (Num 3) n)
                        (Num 0)))

name: primes_uptoc_def
statement:
primes_uptoc upto =
    cv_if (cv_ispair upto)
          (Num 0)
          (cv_if (cv_lt (Num 1) upto)
                 (cv_if (isprimec upto)
                        (Pair upto (primes_uptoc (cv_sub upto (Num 1))))
                        (primes_uptoc (cv_sub upto (Num 1))))
                 (Num 0))

name: isprime_aux_def
statement:
isprime_aux dvs n =
    if dvs < n then
      if n MOD dvs <> 0 then
        isprime_aux (dvs + 2) n
      else F
    else T

name: isprime_def
statement:
isprime n =
    if n < 2 then F else
    if n = 2 then T else
    if n MOD 2 = 0 then F
    else isprime_aux 3 n

name: primes_upto_def
statement:
primes_upto upto =
    if 1 < upto then
      if isprime upto then
        upto :: primes_upto (upto - 1)
      else
        primes_upto (upto - 1)
    else
      []

name: ns2c_def
statement:
ns2c [] = Num 0 ∧
  ns2c (h::t) = Pair (Num h) (ns2c t)

name: c2ns_def
statement:
c2ns (Num 0) = [] ∧
  c2ns (Pair (Num n) c) = n :: c2ns c

  ALL_DISTINCT (MAP (\e. DS_EXPRESSION_EVAL_VALUE s e) c) /\

           (~(IS_DSV_NIL (DS_EXPRESSION_EVAL s e1)) /\

  ALL_DISTINCT (MAP (λ(e1,e2). DS_EXPRESSION_EVAL_VALUE s e1)
                (FILTER (λ(e1,e2). ~(DS_EXPRESSION_EQUAL s e1 e2)) d)) /\

             (!z. MEM z M ==> 0 < FST z /\ 0 < SND z) /\
             (LENGTH L = LENGTH M) /\
             (!t'.
               ~NULL (union_unavail_event_list p L &t') /\
                (!z. MEM z (union_unavail_event_list p L ( (&t'))) ==> z IN events p) /\
                mutual_indep p (union_unavail_event_list p L ( (&t')))) /\
             inst_unavail_exp_list p L M ==>
              (lim (\t.  prob p (AND_unavail_FT_gate p L &t)) =
               list_prod (steady_state_unavail_list M))

statement:
!p L M. prob_space p /\
            (!z. MEM z M ==> (0 < FST z /\ 0 < SND z)) /\
            (LENGTH L = LENGTH M) /\
            (!t'.
              (!z. MEM z ((union_unavail_event_list p L (&t'))) ==> z IN events p)) /\
            (inst_avail_exp_list2 p L M) ==>
              (\t.
                list_prod
                  (list_prob p

name: NAND_steady_state_avail
statement:
!p L1 L2 M1 M2.
          prob_space p /\
          (!z. MEM z (M1++M2) ==> 0 < FST z /\ 0 < SND z) /\
          ((LENGTH (L1) = LENGTH (M1)) /\ (LENGTH L2 = LENGTH M2)) /\
          (!t'.
            1 ≤ LENGTH  (union_unavail_event_list p L1 (&t') ++
                         union_unavail_event_list p L2 (&t')) /\
            (!z. MEM z ((union_unavail_event_list p L1 (&t')) ++
                        (union_unavail_event_list p L2 (&t'))) ==> z IN events p) /\
            mutual_indep p ((union_unavail_event_list p L1 (&t')) ++
                         (union_unavail_event_list p L2 (&t')))) /\
         inst_avail_exp_list2 p L1 M1 /\ inst_unavail_exp_list p L2 M2 ==>
          (lim
            (\t.
             prob p (NAND_unavail_FT_gate p L1 L2 &t)) =
          list_prod ((steady_state_avail_list M1)) *
          list_prod ((steady_state_unavail_list M2)))

name: inst_XOR_tends_steady
statement:
!p X1 m1.
       inst_unavail_exp p X1 m1 /\
       (0 < FST m1 /\ 0 < SND m1) ==>
        ((\t. prob p (union_unavail_events p X1 (&t))) --> steady_state_unavail m1)

name: XOR_steady_unavail
statement:
!p X1 X2 m1 m2 t.
     prob_space p  /\
     (!t'.
       union_unavail_events p X1 (&t') IN events p /\
       union_unavail_events p X2 (&t') IN events p /\
       indep p (union_unavail_events p X1 (&t'))
       (union_unavail_events p X2 (&t'))) /\
     ((0 < FST m1) /\ (0 < SND m1)) /\
     ((0 < FST m2) /\ 0 < SND m2) /\
     (inst_unavail_exp p X1 m1) /\
     (inst_unavail_exp p X2 m2) ==>
       (lim (\t.
            prob p
             (XOR_FT_gate p (atomic (union_unavail_events p X1 &t))
                            (atomic (union_unavail_events p X2 &t)))) =
       steady_state_unavail m1 * (1 - steady_state_unavail m2) +
       steady_state_unavail m2 * (1 - steady_state_unavail m1))

name: avail_event_def
statement:
avail_event (L:(('a->extreal) # ('a->extreal)) list) n t =
{x |
(EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE (\a. (FST (EL a L)) x + (SND (EL a L)) x) (count n)  <= t) /\
(t <
 EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE (\a. (FST (EL a L)) x + (SND (EL a L)) x) (count n) +
 (FST (EL (n) L)) x)}

name: union_avail_events_def
statement:
union_avail_events L n t =
(BIGUNION (IMAGE (\a. avail_event L a (Normal t)) (count n)))

name: union_avail_events1_def
statement:
union_avail_events1 L t =
(BIGUNION (IMAGE (\a. avail_event L a (Normal t)) (count (LENGTH L))))

name: union_avail_event_list_def
statement:
union_avail_event_list L n t =
 MAP (\a. union_avail_events a n t) L

name: union_avail_event_list1_def
statement:
union_avail_event_list1 L t =
 MAP (\a. union_avail_events1 a t) L

name: list_union_avail_event_list_def
statement:
list_union_avail_event_list L t =
 MAP (\a. union_avail_event_list1 a t) L

name: avail_event_list_def
statement:
avail_event_list L n t =
 MAP (\a. avail_event a n t) L

name: expec_avail_def
statement:
expec_avail p (L:(('a->extreal) # ('a->extreal)) list) n t =
 sum (0,n) (\a. prob p (avail_event L a t))

name: expec_avail1_def
statement:
expec_avail1 p (L:(('a->extreal) # ('a->extreal)) list) n t =
 sum (0,n) (prob p o (\a. avail_event L a t))

name: cdf_def
statement: cdf p X t = distribution p X {y| y <= t}

name: reliability_def
statement: reliability p X t = 1 - cdf p X t

name: rel_event_def
statement: rel_event1 p X t = PREIMAGE X {y | t < y} INTER p_space p

name: expec_def
statement: expec n f = sum (0,n) f

name: inst_avail_exp_def
statement:
inst_avail_exp p L n m =
 !(t:real). (expec n (\a. prob p (avail_event L a (Normal t))) =
            (SND (m) / (SND m + FST m)) + (FST m /(SND m + FST m)) *
            exp (-((SND m + FST m))*t))

name: inst_avail_exp1_def
statement:
inst_avail_exp1 p L n m =
 !t. (prob p ( union_avail_events L n &t) =
     (SND m / (SND m + FST m)) +
     (FST m / (SND m + FST m)) * exp (-((SND m + FST m)) * &t))

name: inst_avail_exp2_def
statement:
inst_avail_exp2 p L m =
 !t. (prob p ( union_avail_events1 L &t)  =
     (SND (m) / (SND m + FST m)) +
     (FST m /(SND m + FST m)) * exp (-((SND m + FST m)) * &t))

name: inst_avail_exp3_def
statement:
inst_avail_exp3 p L m =
 !t. (prob p ( union_avail_events1 L &t INTER p_space p)  =
     (SND (m) / (SND m + FST m)) +
     (FST m /(SND m + FST m)) * exp (-((SND m + FST m))* &t))

name: inst_avail_exp_list_def
statement:
(inst_avail_exp_list p [] n M = T) /\
 (inst_avail_exp_list p (h::t) n M = (inst_avail_exp p h n (HD M) /\
  inst_avail_exp_list p t n (TL M) ))

name: inst_avail_exp_list1_def
statement:
(inst_avail_exp_list1 p [] M = T) /\
 (inst_avail_exp_list1 p (h::t) M = (inst_avail_exp2 p h (HD M) /\
  inst_avail_exp_list1 p t (TL M) ))

name: inst_avail_exp_list2_def
statement:
(inst_avail_exp_list2 p [] M = T) /\
 (inst_avail_exp_list2 p (h::t) M = (inst_avail_exp3 p h (HD M) /\
  inst_avail_exp_list2 p t (TL M) ))

name: two_dim_inst_avail_exp_def
statement:
(two_dim_inst_avail_exp p [] M = T) /\
 (two_dim_inst_avail_exp p (h::t) M = (inst_avail_exp_list1 p h (HD M) /\
  two_dim_inst_avail_exp p t (TL M) ))

name: steady_state_avail_def
statement: steady_state_avail m = (SND (m:real#real) / (SND m + FST m))

name: steady_state_avail_list_def
statement:
(steady_state_avail_list [] = []) /\
 (steady_state_avail_list (h::t) =  steady_state_avail h :: steady_state_avail_list t)

name: two_dim_steady_state_avail_list_def
statement:
(two_dim_steady_state_avail_list [] = []) /\
 (two_dim_steady_state_avail_list (h::t) =
  steady_state_avail_list h :: two_dim_steady_state_avail_list t)

name: steady_state_avail_prod_def
statement:
(steady_state_avail_prod [] = (1:real)) /\
 (steady_state_avail_prod (h::t) =
  steady_state_avail h * steady_state_avail_prod t)

name: two_dim_steady_state_avail_prod_def
statement:
(two_dim_steady_state_avail_prod [] = (1:real)) /\
 (two_dim_steady_state_avail_prod (h::t) =
  steady_state_avail_prod h * two_dim_steady_state_avail_prod t)

name: compl_steady_state_avail_def
statement:
(compl_steady_state_avail [] = 1) /\
 (compl_steady_state_avail (h::t) =
 (1 - steady_state_avail h) * compl_steady_state_avail (t))

name: unavail_event_def
statement:
unavail_event p L n t  =
p_space p DIFF (avail_event L n t INTER p_space p)

name: union_unavail_events_def
statement:
union_unavail_events p L t  =
p_space p DIFF (union_avail_events1 L t INTER p_space p)

name: union_unavail_event_list_def
statement:
union_unavail_event_list p L t  =
MAP (\a. union_unavail_events p a t) L

name: steady_state_unavail_def
statement: ( steady_state_unavail (m:real#real) = FST m / (SND m + FST m))

name: steady_state_unavail_list_def
statement: ( steady_state_unavail_list M = MAP (\a. steady_state_unavail a) M)

name: inst_unavail_exp_def
statement:
inst_unavail_exp p L m =
 !(t). (prob p ( union_unavail_events p L &t)  =
       (FST (m) / (SND m + FST m)) -
       (FST m /(SND m + FST m)) * exp (-((SND m + FST m))* &t))

name: inst_unavail_exp_list_def
statement:
(inst_unavail_exp_list p [] M = T) /\
(inst_unavail_exp_list p (h::t) M =
(inst_unavail_exp p h (HD M) /\ inst_unavail_exp_list p t (TL M) ))

name: two_dim_inst_unavail_exp_def
statement:
(two_dim_inst_unavail_exp p [] M = T) /\
 (two_dim_inst_unavail_exp p (h::t) M =
  (inst_unavail_exp_list p h (HD M) /\ two_dim_inst_unavail_exp p t (TL M) ))

name: AND_unavail_FT_gate_def
statement:
AND_unavail_FT_gate p L t =
       FTree p (AND (gate_list (union_unavail_event_list p L t)))

name: OR_unavail_FT_gate_def
statement:
OR_unavail_FT_gate p L t =
       FTree p (OR (gate_list (union_unavail_event_list p L t)))

name: NOR_unavail_FT_gate_def
statement:
NOR_unavail_FT_gate p L t  =
       p_space p DIFF FTree p (OR (gate_list (union_unavail_event_list p L t)))

name: NAND_unavail_FT_gate_def
statement:
NAND_unavail_FT_gate p L1 L2 t  =
             FTree p
               (AND (gate_list (compl_list p (union_unavail_event_list p L1 t) ++
                                             (union_unavail_event_list p L2 t))))

name: XOR_unavail_FT_gate_def
statement:
XOR_unavail_FT_gate p X Y t  =
           (XOR_FT_gate p (atomic (union_unavail_events p X t))
                          (atomic (union_unavail_events p Y t)))

        P {} /\
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> P(s INTER t) /\ P(s UNION t) /\ P(s DIFF t)) /\
        FINITE A /\ (!a. a IN A ==> P(a))
        ==> (f(BIGUNION A) =
            sum_set {B | B SUBSET A /\ ~(B = {})}
                (\B. (- &1) pow (CARD B + 1) * f(BIGINTER B)))

name: FTree_def

    (FTree p (AND []) = p_space p) /\
    (FTree p (AND (x::xs)) =
                FTree p (x:'a gate) INTER FTree p (AND (xs))) /\
     (FTree p (OR []) = {} ) /\
     (FTree p (OR (x::xs)) =

            (x' IN events p)) /\
         (mutual_indep p (FLAT (two_dim_rel_event_list p ([[PIED]]++list_ESW_list++[[CIED]]) t))) /\
         (LENGTH C_list_ESW_list = LENGTH list_ESW_list) /\

              (LENGTH (EL n list_ESW_list) = LENGTH (EL n C_list_ESW_list))) /\
         two_dim_exp_dist_list p ([[PIED]]++list_ESW_list++[[CIED]])
                                 ([[C_PIED]]++C_list_ESW_list++[[C_CIED]]) ==>
           (prob p (redund_star_ring_RBD p PIED list_ESW_list CIED t) =
           (list_prod of

                {{(Normal (&x))}| k <= x /\ x < SUC n}))))

name: k_out_n_RBD_v2

!p n k X pr.
       prob_space p /\ (k < (SUC n)) /\
       (\x. PREIMAGE X {Normal(&x)}) IN
       ((count (SUC n)) -> events p) /\
       (!x. (distribution p X {Normal (&x)} =
       ((& binomial n x)* (pr pow x) * ((1- pr) pow (n - x))))) ==>
         (prob p (K_out_N_struct p X k n) =
            sum (k, (SUC n)-k)
                (\x. (& binomial n x) * (pr pow x) * ((1 - pr) pow (n - x) )))

name: series_rbd_indep_k_out_n_rbd
statement:
!p L n k X pr.
       prob_space p /\
       ~NULL L /\
       (!x'. MEM x' L ==> x' IN events p) /\
       mutual_indep p (L++ [PREIMAGE X (BIGUNION {{Normal (&x)} | k <= x /\ x < SUC n})]) /\
       (k < (SUC n)) /\
       (\x. PREIMAGE X {Normal(&x)}) IN ((count (SUC n)) -> events p) /\
       (!x. (distribution p X {Normal (&x)} =
       ((& binomial n x)* (pr pow x) * ((1 - pr) pow (n - x)))))
 ==>
       (prob p (rbd_struct p (series (rbd_list L)) INTER
               K_out_N_struct p X k n) =
        list_prod (list_prob p L) *
        sum (k, (SUC n)-k)
            (\x. (& binomial n x) * (pr pow x) * ((1 - pr) pow (n - x) )))

name: parallel_rbd_indep_k_out_n_rbd

       in_events p (FLAT L) /\
       (!k. (k < SUC n) ==> in_events p (binomial_event_list L1 k)) /\
       not_null L /\ ~NULL ((K_out_N_struct_list p L1 k n))
  ==>
        (prob p
        (rbd_struct p (parallel (rbd_list (K_out_N_struct_list p L1 k n))) INTER
         rbd_struct p (series (MAP (\a. parallel (rbd_list a)) L))) =
     (1 - list_prod (one_minus_list (list_prob p (K_out_N_struct_list p L1 k n)))) *
      (list_prod of
       (\a. 1 - list_prod (one_minus_list (list_prob p a)))) L)

statement:

       0 <= t /\

       mutual_indep p
         ((FLAT
             (K_out_N_struct_list p [ESWs;ESWs] 3 4::
                (two_dim_rel_event_list p
                   [[PIED];[ESW1;ESW2];[ESW3;ESW4];[CIED]] t)))) /\
       in_events p
          (FLAT
            (two_dim_rel_event_list p
               [[PIED];[ESW1;ESW2];[ESW3;ESW4];[CIED]] t)) /\
       (!x.
          (x < SUC 4) ==>
          in_events p (binomial_event_list [ESWs;ESWs] x)) /\
       (!x.
          (distribution p ESWs {Normal (&x)} =
          ((& binomial 4 x)* (pr pow x) * ((1 - pr) pow (4 - x))))) /\
       (two_dim_exp_dist_list p
        [[PIED]; [ESW1; ESW2]; [ESW3; ESW4]; [CIED]]
        [[C_PIED]; [C_ESW1; C_ESW2]; [C_ESW3; C_ESW4]; [C_CIED]]) ==>
       (prob p
          (rbd_struct p
            (parallel
               (rbd_list (K_out_N_struct_list p [ESWs;ESWs] 3 4))) INTER
           rbd_struct p
            (series
               (MAP (\a. parallel (rbd_list a))
                  (two_dim_rel_event_list p
                     [[PIED];[ESW1;ESW2];[ESW3;ESW4];[CIED]] t)))) =
        (1 -
         (1 -
          sum (3,SUC 4 - 3)
            (\x.
                &binomial 4 x * pr pow x * (1 - pr) pow (4 - x))) *
         (1 - sum (3,SUC 4 - 3)
            (\x. &binomial 4 x * pr pow x * (1 - pr) pow (4 - x))))  *
      (list_prod of
       (\a. 1 - list_prod (one_minus_list (exp_func_list a t))))
            [[C_PIED];[C_ESW1;C_ESW2];[C_ESW3;C_ESW4];[C_CIED]])

        (mutual_information b p (IMAGE X (p_space p), POW (IMAGE X (p_space p)))
                                (IMAGE Y (p_space p) CROSS IMAGE Z (p_space p),
                                 POW (IMAGE Y (p_space p) CROSS IMAGE Z (p_space p))) X (\x. (Y x,Z x)) =
         SIGMA (\(x,(y,z)). (joint_distribution p X (\x. (Y x,Z x)) {(x,(y,z))}) *
                         logr b ((joint_distribution p X (\x. (Y x,Z x)) {(x,(y,z))})/
                                 ((distribution p X {x})*(distribution p (\x. (Y x,Z x)) {(y,z)}))))
               ((IMAGE X (p_space p)) CROSS (IMAGE Y (p_space p) CROSS IMAGE Z (p_space p))))

name: finite_conditional_mutual_information_reduce
statement:
!b p X Y Z. prob_space p /\ (POW (p_space p) = events p) /\
               random_variable X p (IMAGE X (p_space p), POW (IMAGE X (p_space p))) /\
               random_variable Y p (IMAGE Y (p_space p), POW (IMAGE Y (p_space p))) /\
               random_variable Z p (IMAGE Z (p_space p), POW (IMAGE Z (p_space p))) /\
               FINITE (p_space p) ==>
        (conditional_mutual_information b p (IMAGE X (p_space p), POW (IMAGE X (p_space p)))
                                            (IMAGE Y (p_space p), POW (IMAGE Y (p_space p)))
                                            (IMAGE Z (p_space p), POW (IMAGE Z (p_space p)))
                                             X Y Z =
        ~ SIGMA (\(x,z). joint_distribution p X Z {(x,z)} *
                         logr b (joint_distribution p X Z {(x,z)} / distribution p Z {z}))
                (IMAGE X (p_space p) CROSS IMAGE Z (p_space p))
        -
        ~ SIGMA (\(x,(y,z)). joint_distribution p X (\x. (Y x, Z x)) {(x,(y,z))} *
                           logr b (joint_distribution p X (\x. (Y x, Z x)) {(x,(y,z))}/
                                   distribution p (\x. (Y x, Z x)) {(y,z)}))
                ((IMAGE X (p_space p)) CROSS (IMAGE (\x. (Y x, Z x)) (p_space p))))

name: unif_prog_space_leakage_reduce

!high low random f. FINITE high /\ FINITE low /\ FINITE random /\
           ~((high CROSS low) CROSS random={}) ==>
           (leakage (unif_prog_space high low random) f =
            SIGMA (\x. (\(x,y,z).
                  joint_distribution (unif_prog_space high low random) f (\x. (H x,L x)) {(x,y,z)} *
                  lg (joint_distribution (unif_prog_space high low random) f (\x. (H x,L x)) {(x,y,z)} *
                      & (CARD high * CARD low))) x)
                  (IMAGE (\s. (f s,FST s)) (high CROSS low CROSS random)) -
            SIGMA (\x. (\(x,z).
                  joint_distribution (unif_prog_space high low random) f L {(x,z)} *
                  lg (joint_distribution (unif_prog_space high low random) f L {(x,z)} *
                      & (CARD low))) x)
                  (IMAGE (\s. (f s,SND (FST s))) (high CROSS low CROSS random)))

name: unif_prog_space_visible_leakage_reduce

           ~((high CROSS low) CROSS random={}) ==>

            SIGMA
  (\x.
     (\(x,y,z).
        joint_distribution (unif_prog_space high low random) f
          (\s. (H s,L s,R s)) {(x,y,z)} *
        lg
          (joint_distribution (unif_prog_space high low random) f
             (\s. (H s,L s,R s)) {(x,y,z)} *
           & (CARD high * CARD low * CARD random))) x)
  (IMAGE (\s. (f s,FST (FST s),SND (FST s),SND s))
     (high CROSS low CROSS random)) -
SIGMA
  (\x.
     (\(x,z).
        joint_distribution (unif_prog_space high low random) f (\s. (L s,R s))
          {(x,z)} *
        lg
          (joint_distribution (unif_prog_space high low random) f (\s. (L s,R s))
             {(x,z)} * & (CARD low * CARD random))) x)
  (IMAGE (\s. (f s,SND (FST s),SND s)) (high CROSS low CROSS random)))

name: unif_prog_space_leakage_LIST_TO_SET_computation_reduce
statement:
!high low random f.
    ALL_DISTINCT high /\ ALL_DISTINCT low /\
    ALL_DISTINCT random /\ ~(high = []) /\ ~(low = []) /\ ~(random = []) ==>
    (leakage (unif_prog_space (set high) (set low) (set random)) f =
     (1/(&(LENGTH high * LENGTH low * LENGTH random)))*
     ((REAL_SUM (MAP (λx.
                       (λ(out,h,l). (\s. s * lg ((1/(&(LENGTH random)))*s))
                                    (REAL_SUM (MAP (\r. if (f((h,l),r)=out) then 1
                                                        else 0) random))) x)
                 (nub
                  (MAP (\s. (f s,FST s))
                   (LIST_COMBS (LIST_COMBS high low) random))))) -
      (REAL_SUM (MAP (\x. (λ(out,l).
                            (\s. s * lg ((1/(&(LENGTH high * LENGTH random)))*s))
                            (REAL_SUM (MAP (λ(h,r). if (f((h,l),r)=out) then 1
                                                    else 0)
                                       (LIST_COMBS high random)))) x)
                 (nub
                  (MAP (\s. (f s,SND (FST s)))
                   (LIST_COMBS (LIST_COMBS high low) random)))))))

name: unif_prog_space_visible_leakage_LIST_TO_SET_computation_reduce
statement:
!high low random f.
    ALL_DISTINCT high /\ ALL_DISTINCT low /\ ALL_DISTINCT random /\
    high ≠ [] /\ low ≠ [] /\ random ≠ [] ==>
    (visible_leakage (unif_prog_space (set high) (set low) (set random)) f =
     -(1/(&(LENGTH high * LENGTH low * LENGTH random)))*
     ((REAL_SUM (MAP (\x. (λ(out,l,r).
                            (\s. s * lg ((1/(&(LENGTH high)))*s))
                            (REAL_SUM (MAP (\h. if (f((h,l),r)=out) then 1 else 0)
                                       high))) x)
                 (nub
                  (MAP (\s. (f s,SND (FST s),SND s))
                   (LIST_COMBS (LIST_COMBS high low) random)))))))

name: unif_prog_space_leakage_computation_reduce_COMPUTE
statement:
!high low random f.
    FINITE high /\ FINITE low /\ FINITE random /\
    ((high CROSS low) CROSS random <> {}) ==>
    (leakage (unif_prog_space high low random) f =
     (1/(&(CARD high * CARD low * CARD random)))*
     (SIGMA (λ(out,h,l). (\x. x * lg (((1/(&(CARD random)))* x)))
                         (SIGMA (\r. if (f((h,l),r)=out) then 1 else 0) random))
      (IMAGE (\s. (f s,FST s)) (high CROSS low CROSS random)) -
      SIGMA (λ(out,l). (\x. x * lg (((1/(&(CARD high * CARD random)))* x)))
                       (SIGMA (λ(h,r). if (f((h,l),r)=out) then 1 else 0)
                        (high CROSS random)))
      (IMAGE (\s. (f s,SND (FST s))) (high CROSS low CROSS random))))

name: necklace_def
statement: necklace n a = {ls | LENGTH ls = n /\ (set ls) SUBSET (count a) }

name: monocoloured_def
statement:
monocoloured n a =
       {ls | ls IN necklace n a /\ (ls <> [] ==> SING (set ls)) }

name: multicoloured_def
statement: multicoloured n a = (necklace n a) DIFF (monocoloured n a)

name: cycle_order_minimal

name: cycle_order_property
statement: !ls. ls <> [] ==> 0 < order ls /\ cycle (order ls) ls = ls

name: cycle_order_eqn
statement:
!n ls. ls <> [] ==> (n = order ls <=>

name: cycle_order_multiple
statement: !n ls. cycle (n * (order ls)) ls = ls

name: cycle_mod_order
statement: !n ls. cycle n ls = cycle (n MOD (order ls)) ls

name: cycle_order_divides_length
statement: !ls. ls <> [] ==> LENGTH ls MOD (order ls) = 0

name: cycle_order_similar

name: associate_eq_order_image

!ls. ls <> [] ==>
       associate ls = IMAGE (\n. cycle n ls) (count (order ls))

name: associate_order_map_surj

!ls. ls <> [] ==>

name: associate_order_map_inj_imp
statement:
!m n ls. ls <> [] /\ m < order ls /\ n < order ls /\

name: associate_order_map_inj
statement: !ls. ls <> [] ==> INJ (\n. cycle n ls) (count (order ls)) (associate ls)

name: associate_order_map_bij

!ls. ls <> [] ==>
       BIJ (\n. cycle n ls) (count (order ls)) (associate ls)

name: associate_card_eq_order

name: associate_card_divides_length
statement: !ls. ls <> [] ==> (LENGTH ls) MOD (CARD (associate ls)) = 0

name: cycle_1_eq_order_1

name: associate_card_prime_length

name: corners_finite

name: corners_empty

name: corners_conjugate_fixes

name: transpose_involute_corners

name: transpose_fix
statement:
!a x b y. transpose (a,x,b,y) = (a,x,b,y) <=>
             if x < y then x = a /\ y = b else if y < x then x = b /\ y = a else T

name: corners_less_fix_element

name: corners_more_fix_subset
statement: !n. corners_more_fix n SUBSET corners n

name: prime_corners_eq_fix
statement: !p. prime p ==> corners_eq_fix p = {(a,1,b,1) | p = a + b /\ 0 < a /\ a < b}

name: prime_corners_eq_fix_eqn
statement: !p. prime p ==> corners_eq_fix p = IMAGE (\a. (a,1,p - a, 1)) (natural (HALF (p - 1)))

name: prime_corners_eq_fix_card
statement: !p. prime p ==> CARD (corners_eq_fix p) = HALF (p - 1)

name: prime_corners_conjugate_fixes
statement:
!p. prime p ==> fixes conjugate (corners p) =
                    if p = 2 then {} else {(1, HALF (p - 1), HALF (p + 1),1)}

name: prime_corners_more_fix

name: tik_prime_corners_less_fix

name: prime_non_quad

name: prime_mod_eq_0

name: mod_4_even

name: squares_sum_prime_coprime

name: squares_sum_prime_thm

!p a b c d. prime p /\
              p = a ** 2 + b ** 2 /\ p = c ** 2 + d ** 2 /\

name: doublet_eq

name: doublet_finite

name: doublet_card

name: partition_three_special_card
statement:
!s a b c. FINITE s /\ s = a UNION b UNION c /\
            a INTER b = {} /\ b INTER c = {} /\ a INTER c = {} /\
            CARD a = CARD c ==> CARD s = 2 * CARD a + CARD b

name: set_partition_bij_card
statement:
!f s a b. FINITE s /\ s = a UNION b /\ a INTER b = {} /\ BIJ f a b ==>
            CARD s = 2 * CARD a

name: set_partition_bij_card_even
statement:
!f s a b. FINITE s /\ s = a UNION b /\ a INTER b = {} /\ BIJ f a b ==>
            EVEN (CARD s)

name: set_partition_bij_give_bij
statement:
!f s t a b c d.
       s = a UNION b /\ a INTER b = {} /\
       t = c UNION d /\ c INTER d = {} /\
       BIJ f a d /\ BIJ f b c ==> BIJ f s t

name: WHILE_RULE_PRE_POST
statement:
(!x. Invariant x /\ Guard x ==> Measure (Command x) < Measure x) /\
  (!x. Precond x ==> Invariant x) /\
  (!x. Invariant x /\ ~Guard x ==> Postcond x) /\
  HOARE_SPEC (\x. Invariant x /\ Guard x) Command Invariant ==>
  HOARE_SPEC Precond (WHILE Guard Command) Postcond

name: zagier_flip_iterate_period_ne_2

statement: !t. is_pong t ==> ~is_pung t

name: is_pong_alt
statement: !x y z. is_pong (x,y,z) <=> 0 < 2 * z - x /\ 2 * z - x <= SQRT (windmill (x,y,z))

name: is_pung_alt
statement: !x y z. is_pung (x,y,z) <=> 2 * z - x = 0

name: is_ping_x_x_z
statement: !x z. 2 * x < z ==> is_ping (x,x,z)

name: is_pong_1_k_1
statement: !k. is_pong (1,k,1)

name: not_ping_x_y_y
statement: !x y. ~is_ping (x,y,y)

name: is_pong_x_y_x
statement: !x y. 0 < x ==> is_pong (x,y,x)

name: is_ping_by_ping
statement: !t. let (x,y,z) = ping t in is_ping t <=> 0 < z

name: is_pong_by_pong
statement: !t. let (x,y,z) = pong t in 0 < x /\ 0 < z ==> is_pong t

name: is_pung_by_pung
statement: !t. let (x,y,z) = pung t in 0 < x ==> is_pung t

name: zagier_flip_thm
statement:
!t. (zagier o flip) t = if is_ping t then ping t
                          else if is_pong t then pong t else pung t

name: zagier_flip_ping
statement: !t. is_ping t ==> (zagier o flip) t = ping t

name: zagier_flip_pong
statement: !t. is_pong t ==> (zagier o flip) t = pong t

name: zagier_flip_pung
statement: !t. is_pung t ==> (zagier o flip) t = pung t

name: zagier_flip_ping_funpow
statement: !m t. (!j. j < m ==> is_ping (FUNPOW ping j t)) ==> FUNPOW (zagier o flip) m t = FUNPOW ping m t

name: zagier_flip_pung_funpow
statement: !m t. (!j. j < m ==> is_pung (FUNPOW pung j t)) ==> FUNPOW (zagier o flip) m t = FUNPOW pung m t

name: pung_next_non_ping
statement: !x y z. 2 * z <= x ==> ~is_ping (pung (x,y,z))

name: pung_next_not_ping
statement: !t. is_pung t ==> ~is_ping (pung t)

name: ping_before_not_pung
statement: !t. is_ping ((zagier o flip) t) ==> ~is_pung t

name: mind_of_ping
statement: !x y z. mind (ping (x,y,z)) = x + 2 * y

name: mind_rise_by_ping
statement: !t. mind t <= mind (ping t)

name: mind_inc_by_ping
statement: !x y z. 0 < x /\ 0 < y ==> mind (x,y,z) < mind (ping (x,y,z))

name: mind_of_pung
statement: !x y z. 2 * z <= x ==> mind (pung (x,y,z)) = x

name: mind_fall_for_pung
statement: !x y z. 2 * z <= x ==> mind (pung (x,y,z)) <= mind (x,y,z)

name: mind_fall_by_pung
statement: !t. is_pung t ==> mind (pung t) <= mind t

name: path_alt
statement:
(!n. path n 0 = [(1,n DIV 4,1)]) /\
   !n k. path n (SUC k) = (path n k) ++ [(zagier o flip) (LAST (path n k))]

name: path_1
