name: path_not_nil
statement: !n k. path n k <> []

name: path_length
statement: !n k. LENGTH (path n k) = k + 1

name: path_head
statement: !n k. HD (path n k) = (1,n DIV 4,1)

name: path_last
statement: !n k. LAST (path n k) = FUNPOW (zagier o flip) k (1,n DIV 4,1)

name: path_head_alt
statement: !n k. HD (path n k) = EL 0 (path n k)

name: path_last_alt
statement: !n k. LAST (path n k) = EL k (path n k)

name: path_tail_alt
statement: !n m. TL (path n (1 + m)) = iterate_trace (1,1,n DIV 4) (zagier o flip) m

name: path_tail_all_distinct
statement:
!n k. tik n /\ ~square n /\ k = 1 + HALF (iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,n DIV 4)) ==>
        ALL_DISTINCT (TL (path n k))

name: path_eq_sing
statement: !n k. path n k = [(1,n DIV 4,1)] <=> k = 0

name: path_head_flip_fix
statement: !n k. let ls = path n k in tik n ==> (flip (HD ls) = HD ls <=> n = 5)

name: path_front_length
statement: !n k. LENGTH (FRONT (path n k)) = k

name: path_front_head
statement: !n k. 0 < k ==> HD (FRONT (path n k)) = (1,n DIV 4,1)

name: path_element_eqn
statement: !n k j. j <= k ==> EL j (path n k) = FUNPOW (zagier o flip) j (1,n DIV 4,1)

name: path_element_suc
statement: !n k j. j < k ==> EL (SUC j) (path n k) = (zagier o flip) (EL j (path n k))

name: path_element_thm
statement: !n k j h. j + h <= k ==> EL (j + h) (path n k) = FUNPOW (zagier o flip) h (EL j (path n k))

name: path_element_in_mills
statement: !n k j. tik n /\ j <= k ==> EL j (path n k) IN mills n

name: path_element_windmill
statement: !n k j. tik n /\ j <= k ==> n = windmill (EL j (path n k))

name: path_head_is_pong
statement: !n k. is_pong (EL 0 (path n k))

name: path_element_0
statement: !n k. EL 0 (path n k) = (1,n DIV 4,1)

name: path_element_1
statement: !n k. 0 < k ==> EL 1 (path n k) = (1,1,n DIV 4)

name: path_tail_element
statement: !n k j. j < k ==> EL j (TL (path n k)) = FUNPOW (zagier o flip) j (1,1,n DIV 4)

name: path_head_next_property
statement:
!n k. 0 < k ==> let t = EL 1 (path n k) in
        if n < 4 then is_pung t else if n < 12 then is_pong t else is_ping t

name: path_last_not_ping
statement: !n k. let ls = path n k in flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls ==> ~is_ping (LAST ls)

name: path_last_at_half_period
statement:
!n k. let ls = path n k; u = (1,1,n DIV 4); p = iterate_period (zagier o flip) u in
        k = 1 + HALF p ==> LAST ls = FUNPOW (zagier o flip) (HALF p) u

name: path_element_ping_funpow
statement:
!n k u m. let ls = path n k in m + u <= k /\
            (!j. j < m ==> is_ping (EL (u + j) ls)) ==>
             !j. j <= m ==> EL (u + j) ls = FUNPOW ping j (EL u ls)

name: path_element_pung_funpow
statement:
!n k u m. let ls = path n k in m + u <= k /\
            (!j. j < m ==> is_pung (EL (u + j) ls)) ==>
             !j. j <= m ==> EL (u + j) ls = FUNPOW pung j (EL u ls)

name: pung_to_ping_has_pong
statement:
!n k j h. let ls = path n k in j < h /\ h <= k /\
            is_pung (EL j ls) /\ is_ping (EL h ls) ==>
            ?p. j < p /\ p < h /\ is_pong (EL p ls)

name: pong_interval_ping_start
statement:
!n k j h. let ls = path n k in j < h /\ h <= k /\
            is_pong (EL j ls) /\ is_pong (EL h ls) /\ (!p. j < p /\ p < h ==> ~is_pong (EL p ls)) ==>
            !e. j < e /\ e < h /\ is_ping (EL e ls) ==> !p. j < p /\ p <= e ==> is_ping (EL p ls)

name: pong_interval_ping_start_alt
statement:
!n k j h. let ls = path n k in j < h /\ h <= k /\
            is_pong (EL j ls) /\ is_pong (EL h ls) /\ EVERY (\p. ~is_pong (EL p ls)) [j+1 ..< h] ==>
            !e. j < e /\ e < h /\ is_ping (EL e ls) ==> EVERY (\p. is_ping (EL p ls)) [j+1 .. e]

name: pong_interval_pung_stop
statement:
!n k j h. let ls = path n k in j < h /\ h <= k /\
            is_pong (EL j ls) /\ is_pong (EL h ls) /\ (!p. j < p /\ p < h ==> ~is_pong (EL p ls)) ==>
            !e. j < e /\ e < h /\ is_pung (EL e ls) ==> !p. e <= p /\ p < h ==> is_pung (EL p ls)

name: pong_interval_pung_stop_alt
statement:
!n k j h. let ls = path n k in j < h /\ h <= k /\
            is_pong (EL j ls) /\ is_pong (EL h ls) /\ EVERY (\p. ~is_pong (EL p ls)) [j+1 ..< h] ==>
            !e. j < e /\ e < h /\ is_pung (EL e ls) ==> EVERY (\p. is_pung (EL p ls)) [e ..< h]

name: pong_interval_cut_exists
statement:
!n k j h. let ls = path n k in j < h /\ h <= k /\
            is_pong (EL j ls) /\ is_pong (EL h ls) /\ (!p. j < p /\ p < h ==> ~is_pong (EL p ls)) ==>
            ?c. j < c /\ c <= h /\ ~is_ping (EL c ls) /\
            (!p. j < p /\ p < c ==> is_ping (EL p ls)) /\ (!p. c <= p /\ p < h ==> is_pung (EL p ls))

name: pong_interval_cut_exists_alt
statement:
!n k j h. let ls = path n k in j < h /\ h <= k /\
            is_pong (EL j ls) /\ is_pong (EL h ls) /\ EVERY (\p. ~is_pong (EL p ls)) [j+1 ..< h] ==>
            ?c. j < c /\ c <= h /\ ~is_ping (EL c ls) /\
            EVERY (\p. is_ping (EL p ls)) [j+1 ..< c] /\ EVERY (\p. is_pung (EL p ls)) [c ..< h]

name: pong_seed_pung_before
statement:
!n k e. let ls = path n k in ~is_pung (HD ls) /\ e < k /\ is_pong (EL e ls) ==>
          ?j. j <= e /\ (!p. j <= p /\ p < e ==> is_pung (EL p ls)) /\ ~is_pung (EL (PRE j) ls)

name: pong_seed_ping_after
statement:
!n k e. let ls = path n k in ~is_ping (LAST ls) /\ e < k /\ is_pong (EL e ls) ==>
          ?h. e <= h /\ h < k /\ (!p. e < p /\ p <= h ==> is_ping (EL p ls)) /\ ~is_ping (EL (SUC h) ls)

name: pong_seed_pung_ping
statement:
!n k e. let ls = path n k in ~is_pung (HD ls) /\ ~is_ping (LAST ls) /\ e < k /\ is_pong (EL e ls) ==>
           ?j h. j <= e /\ e <= h /\ h < k /\
                 (!p. j <= p /\ p < e ==> is_pung (EL p ls)) /\ ~is_pung (EL (PRE j) ls) /\
                 (!p. e < p /\ p <= h ==> is_ping (EL p ls)) /\ ~is_ping (EL (SUC h) ls)

name: pung_next_not_flip_fix
statement:
!x y z. 0 < y /\ is_pung (x,y,z) ==>
          let t = pung (x,y,z) in flip t <> t

name: path_last_flip_fix_not_by_pung
statement:
!n k e. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ ~square n /\
          flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls ==> ~is_pung (EL (k-1) ls)

name: path_last_pong_to_flip_fix
statement:
!n k j h. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ ~square n /\ j < h /\ h <= k /\ is_pong (EL j ls) /\ flip (EL h ls) = EL h ls /\
            (!p. j < p /\ p < h ==> ~is_pong (EL p ls)) ==> !p. j < p /\ p < h ==> is_ping (EL p ls)

name: hop_alt
statement:
!m x y z. 0 < z ==>
            hop m (x,y,z) = if x DIV (2 * z) < m
                            then (2 * m * z - x, z, y + m * x - m ** 2 * z)
                            else (x - 2 * m * z, y + m * x - m ** 2 * z, z)

name: hop_0
statement: !t. hop 0 t = t

name: hop_1
statement: !t. ~is_ping t ==> hop 1 t = (zagier o flip) t

name: hop_arm
statement:
!m n x y z. ~square n /\ n = windmill (x,y,z) ==>
              (m <= (x + SQRT n) DIV (2 * z) <=> 0 < y + m * x - m ** 2 * z)

name: hop_triple_first
statement: !n m t. tik n /\ n = windmill t ==> 0 < FST (hop m t)

name: hop_windmill
statement:
!m n x y z. ~square n /\ n = windmill (x,y,z) /\ m <= (x + SQRT n) DIV (2 * z) ==>
              n = windmill (hop m (x,y,z))

name: hop_range
statement:
!m n x y z. n = windmill (x,y,z) /\
              0 < 2 * m * z - x /\ 0 < y + m * x - m ** 2 * z ==>
              x DIV (2 * z) < m /\ m <= (x + SQRT n) DIV (2 * z)

name: hop_range_iff
statement:
!m n x y z. ~square n /\ n = windmill (x,y,z) ==>
              (0 < 2 * m * z - x /\ 0 < y + m * x - m ** 2 * z <=>
              0 < z /\ x DIV (2 * z) < m /\ m <= (x + SQRT n) DIV (2 * z))

name: ping_funpow
statement: !m x y z. FUNPOW ping m (x,y,z) = (x + 2 * m * y, y, z - m * x - m ** 2 * y)

name: ping_windmill
statement: !t. is_ping t ==> windmill t = windmill (ping t)

name: pong_windmill
statement: !t. is_pong t ==> windmill t = windmill (pong t)

name: pung_windmill
statement: !t. is_pung t ==> windmill t = windmill (pung t)

name: ping_funpow_windmill
statement: !m t. (!j. j < m ==> is_ping (FUNPOW ping j t)) ==> windmill t = windmill (FUNPOW ping m t)

name: pung_funpow_windmill
statement: !m t. (!j. j < m ==> is_pung (FUNPOW pung j t)) ==> windmill t = windmill (FUNPOW pung m t)

name: pung_funpow
statement:
!n x y z m. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill (x,y,z) /\
              (!j. j < m ==> is_pung (FUNPOW pung j (x,y,z))) ==>
              FUNPOW pung m (x,y,z) = (x - 2 * m * z, y + m * x - m ** 2 * z, z)

name: pung_funpow_by_hop
statement:
!n m t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\
          (!j. j < m ==> is_pung (FUNPOW pung j t)) ==> FUNPOW pung m t = hop m t

name: pung_to_ping_by_hop
statement:
!n t p q. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ is_pong (FUNPOW pung q t) /\
            (!j. j < q ==> is_pung (FUNPOW pung j t)) ==>
            (FUNPOW ping p o pong o FUNPOW pung q) t = hop (p + q + 1) t

name: hop_over_pung
statement: !m x y z. 0 < z /\ m < x DIV (2 * z) ==> is_pung (hop m (x,y,z))

name: hop_beyond_pung
statement: !m x y z. 0 < z /\ m = x DIV (2 * z) ==> ~is_pung (hop m (x,y,z))

name: step_0
statement: !x y z. step 0 (x,y,z) = x DIV (2 * z)

name: step_sqrt
statement: !n x y z. step (SQRT n) (x,y,z) = (x + SQRT n) DIV (2 * z)

name: hop_step_0_over_pung
statement: !m x y z. 0 < z /\ m < step 0 (x,y,z) ==> is_pung (hop m (x,y,z))

name: hop_step_0_beyond_pung
statement: !m x y z. 0 < z /\ m = step 0 (x,y,z) ==> ~is_pung (hop m (x,y,z))

name: step_0_eq_0
statement: !x y z. 0 < z ==> (step 0 (x,y,z) = 0 <=> ~is_pung (x,y,z))

name: step_0_of_ping
statement: !x y z. 0 < z /\ is_ping (x,y,z) ==> step 0 (x,y,z) = 0

name: step_0_of_pong
statement: !x y z. 0 < z /\ is_pong (x,y,z) ==> step 0 (x,y,z) = 0

name: step_0_of_pung
statement: !x y z. 0 < z /\ is_pung (x,y,z) ==> 0 < step 0 (x,y,z)

name: hop_identity_1
statement: !m x z. let xx = x - 2 * m * z in xx - 2 * z = x - 2 * (m + 1) * z

name: hop_identity_2
statement: !m x z. let xx = x - 2 * m * z in 0 < xx ==> 2 * z - xx = 2 * (m + 1) * z - x

name: hop_identity_3
statement:
!m x y z. let xx = x - 2 * m * z; yy = y + m * x - m ** 2 * z in 0 < xx /\ 0 < yy ==>
            xx + yy - z = y + (m + 1) * x - (m + 1) ** 2 * z

name: hop_identity_4
statement:
!m x y z. let xx = 2 * m * z - x; yy = y + m * x - m ** 2 * z in 0 < xx /\ 0 < yy ==>
            yy - z - xx = y + (m + 1) * x - (m + 1) ** 2 * z

name: hop_step_0_before_pong
statement: !n m t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ m <= step 0 t ==> hop m t = FUNPOW pung m t

name: hop_step_0_at_pong
statement: !n m t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ m = step 0 t ==> hop (m + 1) t = pong (hop m t)

name: hop_step_0_beyond_pong
statement:
!n m j t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ m = step 0 t /\ m + j < step (SQRT n) t ==>
            hop (m + 1 + j) t = FUNPOW ping j (hop (m + 1) t)

name: hop_step_0_around_pong
statement:
!n m j t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ m = step 0 t /\ m + j < step (SQRT n) t ==>
            hop (m + 1 + j) t = (FUNPOW ping j o pong o FUNPOW pung m) t

name: hop_step_0_before_pong_is_pung
statement: !n m t. ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ m < step 0 t ==> is_pung (hop m t)

name: hop_step_0_at_pong_is_pong
statement: !n m t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ m = step 0 t /\ ~is_ping t ==> is_pong (hop m t)

name: step_sqrt_eq_0
statement: !x y z. 0 < z ==> (step (SQRT (windmill (x,y,z))) (x,y,z) = 0 <=> is_ping (x,y,z))

name: step_sqrt_of_ping
statement: !x y z. 0 < z /\ is_ping (x,y,z) ==> step (SQRT (windmill (x,y,z))) (x,y,z) = 0

name: step_sqrt_of_pong
statement: !x y z. 0 < z /\ is_pong (x,y,z) ==> 0 < step (SQRT (windmill (x,y,z))) (x,y,z)

name: step_sqrt_of_pung
statement: !x y z. 0 < z /\ is_pung (x,y,z) ==> 0 < step (SQRT (windmill (x,y,z))) (x,y,z)

name: step_0_le_step_sqrt
statement: !x y z. 0 < z ==> step 0 (x,y,z) <= step (SQRT (windmill (x,y,z))) (x,y,z)

name: step_0_lt_step_sqrt
statement: !n t. ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ ~is_ping t ==> step 0 t < step (SQRT n) t

name: hop_step_0_beyond_pong_is_ping
statement:
!n m j t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\
            m = step 0 t /\ m + 1 + j < step (SQRT n) t ==> is_ping (hop (m + 1 + j) t)

name: hop_step_sqrt_not_ping
statement: !n t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ ~is_ping t ==> ~is_ping (hop (step (SQRT n) t) t)

name: hop_step_type
hopping_focus_thm
statement:
!n t m. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ ~is_ping t /\
          m < step (SQRT n) t ==> focus (hop m t) = focus t

name: skip_ping_thm
statement:
!t k. ~is_ping (FUNPOW ping k t) /\ (!j. j < k ==> is_ping (FUNPOW ping j t)) ==>
        skip_ping t = FUNPOW ping k t

name: skip_ping_none
statement: !t. ~is_ping t ==> skip_ping t = t

name: skip_pung_thm
statement:
!t k. ~is_pung (FUNPOW pung k t) /\ (!j. j < k ==> is_pung (FUNPOW pung j t)) ==>
        skip_pung t = FUNPOW pung k t

name: skip_pung_none
statement: !t. ~is_pung t ==> skip_pung t = t

name: hopping_0
statement: !n t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t ==> hopping 0 t = skip_pung t

name: hopping_sqrt
statement:
!n t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ ~is_ping t ==>
        hopping (SQRT n) t = skip_ping (pong (hopping 0 t))

name: hopping_sqrt_eqn
statement:
!n t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ ~is_ping t ==>
        hopping (SQRT n) t = (skip_ping o pong o skip_pung) t

name: pong_nodes_nil
statement: pong_nodes [] = []

name: pong_nodes_length
statement: !ls. LENGTH (pong_nodes ls) <= LENGTH ls

name: pong_nodes_element
statement: !ls j. let ps = pong_nodes ls in j < LENGTH ps ==> is_pong (EL j ps) /\ MEM (EL j ps) ls

name: pong_nodes_all_distinct
statement: !ls. ls <> [] /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls ==> ALL_DISTINCT (pong_nodes (FRONT ls))

name: pong_nodes_path_element
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ps = pong_nodes (FRONT ls) in j < LENGTH ps ==>
           ?h. h < k /\ EL j ps = EL h ls /\ is_pong (EL h ls)

name: pong_nodes_path_head
statement: !n k. 0 < k ==> HD (pong_nodes (FRONT (path n k))) = (1, n DIV 4, 1)

name: pong_nodes_path_head_alt
statement: !n k. let ls = path n k in 0 < k ==> HD (pong_nodes (FRONT ls)) = HD ls

name: pong_nodes_path_eq_nil
statement: !n k. pong_nodes (FRONT (path n k)) = [] <=> k = 0

name: path_all_distinct
statement:
!n k. tik n /\ ~square n /\ k = 1 + HALF (iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,n DIV 4)) ==>
        (ALL_DISTINCT (path n k) <=> n <> 5)

name: path_skip_ping_thm
statement:
!n k p q. let ls = path n k in p <= q /\ q <= k /\ ~is_ping (EL q ls) /\
            (!j. p <= j /\ j < q ==> is_ping (EL j ls)) ==> EL q ls = skip_ping (EL p ls)

name: path_skip_pung_thm
statement:
!n k p q. let ls = path n k in p <= q /\ q <= k /\ ~is_pung (EL q ls) /\
            (!j. p <= j /\ j < q ==> is_pung (EL j ls)) ==> EL q ls = skip_pung (EL p ls)

name: path_skip_ping_member
statement: !n k t. let ls = path n k in ~is_ping (LAST ls) /\ MEM t ls ==> MEM (skip_ping t) ls

name: path_skip_pung_member
statement: !n k t. let ls = path n k in ~is_pung (LAST ls) /\ MEM t ls ==> MEM (skip_pung t) ls

name: pong_interval_next_pong
statement:
!n k p q. let ls = path n k in p < q /\ q <= k /\ is_pong (EL p ls) /\ is_pong (EL q ls) /\
            (!j. p < j /\ j < q ==> ~is_pong (EL j ls)) ==> EL q ls = (skip_pung o skip_ping o pong) (EL p ls)

name: pong_nodes_pair_in_path
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ps = pong_nodes (FRONT ls) in ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ j + 1 < LENGTH ps ==>
          ?p q. p < q /\ q < k /\ EL p ls = EL j ps /\ EL q ls = EL (j + 1) ps /\
          is_pong (EL p ls) /\ is_pong (EL q ls) /\ !h. p < h /\ h < q ==> ~is_pong (EL h ls)

name: pong_nodes_path_element_suc
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ps = pong_nodes (FRONT ls) in ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ j + 1 < LENGTH ps ==>
          EL (j + 1) ps = (skip_pung o skip_ping o pong) (EL j ps)

name: pong_nodes_path_element_eqn
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ps = pong_nodes (FRONT ls) in ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ j < LENGTH ps ==>
          EL j ps = FUNPOW (skip_pung o skip_ping o pong) j (HD ps)

name: beyond_pong_eqn
statement: !n t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ is_pong t ==> beyond_pong t = hopping (SQRT n) t

name: beyond_pong_path_member
statement:
!n k t. let ls = path n k in ~is_ping (LAST ls) /\
          is_pong t /\ MEM t (FRONT ls) ==> MEM (beyond_pong t) ls

name: pong_interval_beyond_pong
statement:
!n k p q. let ls = path n k in p < q /\ q <= k /\ is_pong (EL p ls) /\ is_pong (EL q ls) /\
            (!j. p < j /\ j < q ==> ~is_pong (EL j ls)) ==>
            beyond_pong (EL q ls) = (skip_ping o pong o skip_pung) (beyond_pong (EL p ls))

name: hop_nodes_alt
statement: !ls. hop_nodes ls = MAP (skip_ping o pong) (pong_nodes (FRONT ls))

name: hop_nodes_length
statement: !ls. LENGTH (hop_nodes ls) = LENGTH (pong_nodes (FRONT ls))

name: hop_nodes_element
statement:
!ls j. j < LENGTH (hop_nodes ls) ==>
         EL j (hop_nodes ls) = beyond_pong (EL j (pong_nodes (FRONT ls)))

name: hop_nodes_path_eq_nil
statement: !n k. hop_nodes (path n k) = [] <=> k = 0

name: hop_nodes_path_head
statement:
!n k. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ ~square n /\ 0 < k ==>
        HD (hop_nodes ls) = hopping (SQRT n) (HD ls)

name: hop_nodes_path_member
statement: !n k t. let ls = path n k in ~is_ping (LAST ls) /\ MEM t (hop_nodes ls) ==> MEM t ls

name: hop_nodes_path_element_less
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls; t = EL j ns in tik n /\
          ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ j + 1 < LENGTH ns ==> n = windmill t /\ ~is_ping t /\ MEM t ls /\ t <> LAST ls

name: hop_nodes_path_element_last
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls; t = EL j ns in tik n /\ ~square n /\
          ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ j + 1 = LENGTH ns /\ flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls ==>
          n = windmill t /\ ~is_ping t /\ MEM t ls /\ t = LAST ls

name: hop_nodes_path_element_thm
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls; t = EL j ns in tik n /\ ~square n /\
          ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ j < LENGTH ns /\ flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls ==>
          n = windmill t /\ ~is_ping t /\ MEM t ls /\ (t = LAST ls <=> j + 1 = LENGTH ns)

name: hop_nodes_path_element_eqn
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls in
          tik n /\ ~square n /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls /\ j < LENGTH ns ==>
          EL j ns = FUNPOW (hopping (SQRT n)) (j + 1) (HD ls)

name: hop_nodes_path_last
statement:
!n k. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls in
        tik n /\ ~square n /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls /\ 0 < k ==>
        LAST ns = LAST ls /\ LAST ls = FUNPOW (hopping (SQRT n)) (LENGTH ns) (HD ls)

name: hop_nodes_path_element_findi_range
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls; ps = pong_nodes (FRONT ls) in
          ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ j + 1 < LENGTH ns ==>
          findi (EL j ps) ls < findi (EL j ns) ls /\ findi (EL j ns) ls <= findi (EL (j+1) ps) ls

name: hop_nodes_path_element_findi_thm
statement:
!n k j h. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls; ps = pong_nodes (FRONT ls) in
            ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ j + 1 + h < LENGTH ns ==>
            findi (EL j ps) ls < findi (EL j ns) ls /\ findi (EL j ns) ls <= findi (EL (j+1+h) ps) ls

name: hop_nodes_path_element_findi_last
statement:
!n k. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls; ps = pong_nodes (FRONT ls) in tik n /\ ~square n /\
        ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls /\ 0 < k ==>
        findi (LAST ns) ls = k /\ findi (LAST ps) ls < k

name: hop_nodes_path_all_distinct
statement:
!n k. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ ~square n /\
        ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls ==> ALL_DISTINCT (hop_nodes ls)

name: tik_prime_property
statement:
!n. let s = mills n; u = (1,1,n DIV 4) in tik n /\ prime n ==>
      ~square n /\ FINITE s /\ zagier involute s /\ flip involute s /\
      fixes zagier s = {u} /\ ODD (iterate_period (zagier o flip) u)

name: tik_prime_iterate_period_odd
statement: !n. tik n /\ prime n ==> ODD (iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,n DIV 4))

name: tik_prime_path_last_not_ping
statement:
!n p. prime n /\ tik n /\ p = iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,n DIV 4) ==>
        ~is_ping (LAST (path n (1 + HALF p)))

name: tik_prime_path_last_flip_fix
statement:
!n k. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ prime n /\
        k = 1 + HALF (iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,n DIV 4)) ==> flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls

name: tik_prime_path_not_flip_fix
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ prime n /\
          k = 1 + HALF (iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,n DIV 4)) /\
          0 < j /\ j < k ==> flip (EL j ls) <> EL j ls

name: tik_prime_path_flip_fix_iff
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ prime n /\
          k = 1 + HALF (iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,n DIV 4)) /\
          0 < j /\ j <= k ==> (flip (EL j ls) = EL j ls <=> j = k)

name: tik_prime_path_flip_fix_iff_alt
statement:
!n k t. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ prime n /\
          k = 1 + HALF (iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,n DIV 4)) /\
          MEM t ls /\ flip (HD ls) <> HD ls ==> (flip t = t <=> t = LAST ls)

name: tik_prime_hop_nodes_member_flip_fix
statement:
!n k t. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls in tik n /\ prime n /\
          k = 1 + HALF (iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,n DIV 4)) /\
          MEM t ns /\ flip (HD ls) <> HD ls ==> (flip t = t <=> t = LAST ns)

name: tik_prime_path_hopping_while_thm
statement:
!n k. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ prime n /\
        k = 1 + HALF (iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,n DIV 4)) ==>
        WHILE (\t. flip t <> t) (hopping (SQRT n)) (HD ls) = LAST ls

name: two_sq_hop_thm
statement: !n. tik n /\ prime n ==> two_sq_hop n IN fixes flip (mills n)

name: two_sq_hop_thm
statement: !n. tik n /\ prime n ==> two_sq_hop n IN fixes flip (mills n)

name: two_squares_hop_thm
statement: !n. tik n /\ prime n ==> let (u,v) = two_squares_hop n in (n = u ** 2 + v ** 2)

name: popping_sqrt_eq_hopping_sqrt
statement: !n t. ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ ~is_ping t ==> popping (SQRT n) t = hopping (SQRT n) t

name: popping_sqrt_eqn
statement:
!n t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ ~is_ping t ==>
        popping (SQRT n) t = (skip_ping o pong o skip_pung) t

name: beyond_pong_eqn_by_pop
statement: !n t. tik n /\ ~square n /\ n = windmill t /\ is_pong t ==> beyond_pong t = popping (SQRT n) t

name: hop_nodes_path_head_by_pop
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls in tik n /\ ~square n /\ 0 < k ==>
          HD ns = popping (SQRT n) (HD ls)

name: hop_nodes_path_element_eqn_by_pop
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls in
          tik n /\ ~square n /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls /\ j < LENGTH ns ==>
          EL j ns = FUNPOW (popping (SQRT n)) (j + 1) (HD ls)

name: hop_nodes_path_last_by_pop
statement:
!n k. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls in
        tik n /\ ~square n /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls /\ flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls /\ 0 < k ==>
        LAST ns = LAST ls /\ LAST ls = FUNPOW (popping (SQRT n)) (LENGTH ns) (HD ls)

name: tik_prime_path_popping_while_thm
statement:
!n k. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ prime n /\
        k = 1 + HALF (iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,n DIV 4)) ==>
        WHILE (\t. flip t <> t) (popping (SQRT n)) (HD ls) = LAST ls

name: two_sq_pop_eqn
statement: !n. tik n /\ prime n ==> two_sq_pop n = two_sq_hop n

name: two_sq_pop_thm
statement: !n. tik n /\ prime n ==> two_sq_pop n IN fixes flip (mills n)

name: two_squares_pop_thm
statement: !n. tik n /\ prime n ==> let (u,v) = two_squares_pop n in n = u ** 2 + v ** 2

name: node_1
statement: !n. node n 1 = popping (SQRT n) (1,n DIV 4,1)

name: node_thm
statement: !n j. node n j = FUNPOW (popping (SQRT n)) j (1,n DIV 4,1)

name: node_path_eqn
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls in tik n /\ ~square n /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls /\
          flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls /\ j < LENGTH ns ==> node n (j + 1) = EL j ns

name: node_path_last
statement:
!n k. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls in tik n /\ ~square n /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls /\
        flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls /\ 0 < k ==> node n (LENGTH ns) = LAST ls

name: node_path_last_iff
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ns = hop_nodes ls in tik n /\ ~square n /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls /\
          flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls /\ j < LENGTH ns ==>
          node n (j + 1) = EL j ns /\ (node n (j + 1) = LAST ls <=> j + 1 = LENGTH ns)

name: ping_funpow_1_1_k
statement: !m k. FUNPOW ping m (1,1,k) = (1 + 2 * m, 1, k - m - m ** 2)

name: ping_funpow_1_1_k_range
statement: !n m. tik n /\ ~square n ==> let (x,y,z) = FUNPOW ping m (1,1,n DIV 4) in 0 < z <=> m < HALF (1 + SQRT n)

name: path_start_over_ping
statement:
!n k. let h = HALF (1 + SQRT n) in tik n /\ ~square n /\ h <= k ==>
        !j. 0 < j /\ j < h ==> is_ping (EL j (path n k))

name: path_start_beyond_ping
statement:
!n k. let h = HALF (1 + SQRT n) in tik n /\ ~square n /\ h <= k ==>
        ~is_ping (EL h (path n k))

name: path_start_skip_ping
statement:
!n k. let ls = path n k; h = HALF (1 + SQRT n) in tik n /\ ~square n /\ h <= k ==>
        skip_ping (EL 1 ls) = EL (step (SQRT n) (1,n DIV 4,1)) ls

name: hop_step_0_path_element_before_pong
statement:
!n k u m. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ ~square n /\ u <= k /\ m <= step 0 (EL u ls) ==>
            hop m (EL u ls) = FUNPOW pung m (EL u ls)

name: hop_step_0_path_element_at_pong
statement:
!n k u m. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ ~square n /\ u <= k /\ m = step 0 (EL u ls) ==>
            hop (m + 1) (EL u ls) = pong (hop m (EL u ls))

name: hop_step_0_path_element_beyond_pong
statement:
!n k u m j. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ ~square n /\ u <= k /\
              m = step 0 (EL u ls) /\ m + j < step (SQRT n) (EL u ls) ==>
              hop (m + 1 + j) (EL u ls) = FUNPOW ping j (hop (m + 1) (EL u ls))

name: hop_step_0_path_element_around_pong
statement:
!n k u m j. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ ~square n /\ u <= k /\
              m = step 0 (EL u ls) /\ m + j < step (SQRT n) (EL u ls) ==>
              hop (m + 1 + j) (EL u ls) = (FUNPOW ping j o pong o FUNPOW pung m) (EL u ls)

name: hop_step_0_path_element
statement:
!n k u m. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ ~square n /\ flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls /\
            u < k /\ m <= step 0 (EL u ls) ==> u + m < k /\ hop m (EL u ls) = EL (u + m) ls

name: hop_step_0_suc
statement:
!n k u j. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ ~square n /\ flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls /\
            u < k /\ j < step 0 (EL u ls) ==>
            hop (SUC j) (EL u ls) = (zagier o flip) (hop j (EL u ls))

name: hopping_path_step_0
statement:
!n k u. let ls = path n k in tik n /\ ~square n /\ flip (LAST ls) = LAST ls /\ u < k ==>
          hopping 0 (EL u ls) = skip_pung (EL u ls)

name: pong_nodes_path_element_suc_by_hop
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ps = pong_nodes (FRONT ls) in tik n /\ ~square n /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls /\
          j + 1 < LENGTH ps ==> EL (j + 1) ps = ((hopping 0) o beyond_pong) (EL j ps)

name: pong_nodes_path_element_eqn_by_hop
statement:
!n k j. let ls = path n k; ps = pong_nodes (FRONT ls) in tik n /\ ~square n /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls /\
          j < LENGTH ps ==> EL j ps = FUNPOW ((hopping 0) o beyond_pong) j (HD ps)

name: ping_def
statement: ping (x,y,z) = (x + 2 * y, y, z - y - x)

name: pong_def
statement: pong (x,y,z) = (2 * z - x, z, x + y - z)

name: pung_def
statement: pung (x,y,z) = (x - 2 * z, x + y - z, z)

name: is_ping_def
statement: is_ping (x, y, z) <=> x < z - y

name: is_pong_def
statement: is_pong (x, y, z) <=> ~(x < z - y) /\ x < 2 * z

name: is_pung_def
statement: is_pung (x, y, z) <=> ~(x < z - y) /\ ~(x < 2 * z)

name: path_def
statement:
path n 0 = [(1,n DIV 4,1)] /\ 
   path n (SUC k) = SNOC ((zagier o flip) (LAST (path n k))) (path n k)

name: hop_def
step_def
statement: step c (x,y,z) = (x + c) DIV (2 * z)

name: hopping_def
statement: hopping c t = hop (step c t) t

name: two_sq_hop_def
statement: two_sq_hop n =  WHILE ($~ o found) (hopping (SQRT n)) (1,n DIV 4,1)

name: focus_def
statement: focus (x,y,z) = if is_ping (x,y,z) then y else z

name: skip_ping_def
statement: skip_ping t = WHILE (is_ping) ping t

name: skip_pung_def
statement: skip_pung t = WHILE (is_pung) pung t

name: pong_nodes_def
statement: pong_nodes ls = FILTER is_pong ls

name: beyond_pong_def
statement: beyond_pong t = (skip_ping o pong) t

name: hop_nodes_def
statement: hop_nodes ls = MAP beyond_pong (pong_nodes (FRONT ls))

name: two_squares_hop_def
statement: two_squares_hop n = let (x,y,z) = two_sq_hop n in (x, y + z)

name: pop_def
statement: pop m (x,y,z) = (2 * m * z - x,z,y + m * x - m ** 2 * z)

name: popping_def
statement: popping c t = pop (step c t) t

name: two_sq_pop_def
statement: two_sq_pop n =  WHILE ($~ o found) (popping (SQRT n)) (1,n DIV 4,1)

name: two_squares_pop_def
statement: two_squares_pop n = let (x,y,z) = two_sq_pop n in (x, y + z)

name: node_def
statement:
node n 0 = (1,n DIV 4, 1) /\
   node n (SUC j) = popping (SQRT n) (node n j)

name: funpow_action
statement: !f X. f involute X ==> (Z2 act X) (FUNPOW f)

name: funpow_equiv
statement: !f X. f involute X ==> reach (FUNPOW f) Z2 equiv_on X

name: funpow_orbit_finite
statement: !f x. FINITE (orbit (FUNPOW f) Z2 x)

name: involute_orbit_element
statement:
!f X x y. f involute X /\ x IN X /\
            y IN (orbit (FUNPOW f) Z2 x) ==> y = x \/ y = f x

name: involute_orbit_has_self
statement: !f X x. f involute X /\ x IN X ==> x IN orbit (FUNPOW f) Z2 x

name: involute_orbit_has_funpow
statement:
!f X x n. f involute X /\ x IN X ==>
            FUNPOW f n x IN orbit (FUNPOW f) Z2 x

name: involute_orbit_has_image
statement: !f X x. f involute X /\ x IN X ==> f x IN orbit (FUNPOW f) Z2 x

name: involute_orbit_nonempty
statement: !f X e. f involute X /\ e IN orbits (FUNPOW f) Z2 X ==> e <> EMPTY

name: involute_orbits_element_is_orbit
statement:
!f X e x. f involute X /\ e IN orbits (FUNPOW f) Z2 X /\ x IN e ==>
            e = orbit (FUNPOW f) Z2 x

name: involute_orbits_element_element
statement: !f X e x. f involute X /\ e IN orbits (FUNPOW f) Z2 X /\ x IN e ==> x IN X

name: involute_fixed_points
statement: !f X x. f involute X /\ x IN fixed_points (FUNPOW f) Z2 X ==> f x = x

name: involute_fixed_points_iff
statement:
!f X x. f involute X /\ x IN X ==>
          (x IN fixed_points (FUNPOW f) Z2 X <=> f x = x)

name: involute_target_card_by_types
statement:
!f X. FINITE X /\ f involute X ==>
        CARD X = CARD (sing_orbits (FUNPOW f) Z2 X) +
                 SIGMA CARD (multi_orbits (FUNPOW f) Z2 X)

name: involute_target_card_eqn
statement:
!f X. FINITE X /\ f involute X ==>
        CARD X = CARD (fixed_points (FUNPOW f) Z2 X) +
                 SIGMA CARD (multi_orbits (FUNPOW f) Z2 X)

name: involute_orbit_fixed
statement:
!f X x. f involute X /\ x IN X /\ f x = x ==>
          orbit (FUNPOW f) Z2 x = {x}

name: involute_orbit_not_fixed
statement:
!f X x. f involute X /\ x IN X /\ f x <> x ==>
          orbit (FUNPOW f) Z2 x = {x; f x}

name: involute_multi_orbits_element_card
statement:
!f X e. f involute X /\
          e IN (multi_orbits (FUNPOW f) Z2 X) ==> CARD e = 2

name: involute_target_card_thm
statement:
!f X. FINITE X /\ f involute X ==>
        CARD X = 2 * CARD (multi_orbits (FUNPOW f) Z2 X) +
                 CARD (fixed_points (FUNPOW f) Z2 X)

name: involute_fixed_points_both_even
statement:
!f X. FINITE X /\ f involute X ==>
        (EVEN (CARD X) <=> EVEN (CARD (fixed_points (FUNPOW f) Z2 X)))

name: involute_fixed_points_both_odd
statement:
!f X. FINITE X /\ f involute X ==>
        (ODD (CARD X) <=> ODD (CARD (fixed_points (FUNPOW f) Z2 X)))

name: involute_two_fixed_points_both_even
statement:
!f g X. FINITE X /\ f involute X /\ g involute X ==>
          (EVEN (CARD (fixed_points (FUNPOW f) Z2 X)) <=>
           EVEN (CARD (fixed_points (FUNPOW g) Z2 X)))

name: involute_two_fixed_points_both_odd
statement:
!f g X. FINITE X /\ f involute X /\ g involute X ==>
          (ODD (CARD (fixed_points (FUNPOW f) Z2 X)) <=>
           ODD (CARD (fixed_points (FUNPOW g) Z2 X)))

name: fpair_refl
statement: !f x. (x fpair x) f

name: fpair_sym
statement: !f s x y. f involute s /\ x IN s /\ (x fpair y) f ==> (y fpair x) f

name: fpair_trans
statement:
!f s x y z. f involute s /\ x IN s /\
               (x fpair y) f /\ (y fpair z) f ==> (x fpair z) f

name: fpair_equiv
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> (pair_by f) equiv_on s

name: fixes_element
statement: !f s x. x IN fixes f s <=> x IN s /\ f x = x

name: pairs_element
statement: !f s x. x IN pairs f s <=> x IN s /\ f x <> x

name: fixes_empty
statement: !f. fixes f {} = {}

name: pairs_empty
statement: !f. pairs f {} = {}

name: fixes_subset
statement: !f s. fixes f s SUBSET s

name: pairs_subset
statement: !f s. pairs f s SUBSET s

name: fixes_finite
statement: !f s. FINITE s ==> FINITE (fixes f s)

name: pairs_finite
statement: !f s. FINITE s ==> FINITE (pairs f s)

name: equiv_class_fixes_iff
statement:
!f s x. f endo s ==>
          (x IN fixes f s <=> equiv_class (pair_by f) s x = {x})

name: equiv_class_fixes
statement: !f s x. x IN fixes f s ==> equiv_class (pair_by f) s x = {x}

name: equiv_class_pairs_iff
statement:
!f s x. f endo s ==>
          (x IN pairs f s <=> equiv_class (pair_by f) s x = {x; f x} /\ f x <> x)

name: equiv_class_pairs
statement:
!f s x. x IN pairs f s /\ f x IN s ==>
          equiv_class (pair_by f) s x = {x; f x}

name: involute_pairs_element_pair
statement: !f s x. f involute s /\ x IN pairs f s ==> f x IN pairs f s

name: equiv_class_pairs_pairs
statement:
!f s x. f involute s /\ x IN pairs f s ==>
            equiv_class (pair_by f) s (f x) = equiv_class (pair_by f) s x

name: fixes_pairs_split
statement: !f s. s =|= (fixes f s) # (pairs f s)

name: equiv_fixes_element
statement:
!f s x. x IN equiv_fixes f s <=>
          ?y. y IN (fixes f s) /\ x = equiv_class (pair_by f) s y

name: equiv_pairs_element
statement:
!f s x. x IN equiv_pairs f s <=>
          ?y. y IN (pairs f s) /\ x = equiv_class (pair_by f) s y

name: equiv_fixes_pairs_disjoint
statement: !f s. DISJOINT (equiv_fixes f s) (equiv_pairs f s)

name: equiv_fixes_pairs_union
statement: !f s. partition (pair_by f) s = (equiv_fixes f s) UNION (equiv_pairs f s)

name: equiv_fixes_pairs_split
statement: !f s. partition (pair_by f) s =|= (equiv_fixes f s) # (equiv_pairs f s)

name: equiv_fixes_subset
statement: !f s. equiv_fixes f s SUBSET partition (pair_by f) s

name: equiv_pairs_subset
statement: !f s. equiv_pairs f s SUBSET partition (pair_by f) s

name: equiv_fixes_element_sing_iff
statement:
!f s t. f endo s ==>
          (t IN equiv_fixes f s <=> ?x. x IN fixes f s /\ t = {x})

name: equiv_fixes_element_sing
statement: !f s t. t IN equiv_fixes f s ==> ?x. x IN fixes f s /\ t = {x}

name: equiv_fixes_element_card
statement: !f s t. t IN equiv_fixes f s ==> CARD t = 1

name: equiv_pairs_element_doublet_iff
statement:
!f s t. f endo s ==>
          (t IN equiv_pairs f s <=> ?x. x IN pairs f s /\ t = {x; f x})

name: equiv_pairs_element_doublet
statement: !f s t. f endo s /\ t IN equiv_pairs f s ==> ?x. x IN pairs f s /\ t = {x; f x}

name: equiv_pairs_element_card
statement: !f s t. f endo s /\ t IN equiv_pairs f s ==> CARD t = 2

name: equiv_fixes_fixes_bij
statement: !f s. f endo s ==> BIJ CHOICE (equiv_fixes f s) (fixes f s)

name: equiv_fixes_card
statement: !f s. FINITE s /\ f endo s ==> CARD (equiv_fixes f s) = CARD (fixes f s)

name: equiv_fixes_finite
statement: !f s. FINITE s ==> FINITE (equiv_fixes f s)

name: equiv_pairs_finite
statement: !f s. FINITE s ==> FINITE (equiv_pairs f s)

name: equiv_fixes_pair_disjoint
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> PAIR_DISJOINT (equiv_fixes f s)

name: equiv_pairs_pair_disjoint
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> PAIR_DISJOINT (equiv_pairs f s)

name: equiv_pairs_bigunion_card_even
statement: !f s. FINITE s /\ f involute s ==> EVEN (CARD (BIGUNION (equiv_pairs f s)))

name: equiv_fixes_by_image
statement: !f s. f endo s ==> equiv_fixes f s = IMAGE (\x. {x}) (fixes f s)

name: equiv_pairs_by_image
statement: !f s. f endo s ==> equiv_pairs f s = IMAGE (\x. {x; f x}) (pairs f s)

name: equiv_fixes_bigunion
statement: !f s. f endo s ==> BIGUNION (equiv_fixes f s) = fixes f s

name: equiv_fixes_pairs_bigunion_disjoint
statement:
!f s. f involute s ==>
        DISJOINT (BIGUNION (equiv_fixes f s)) (BIGUNION (equiv_pairs f s))

name: equiv_fixes_pairs_bigunion_union
statement:
!f s. f involute s ==>
        s = BIGUNION (equiv_fixes f s) UNION BIGUNION (equiv_pairs f s)

name: equiv_fixes_pairs_bigunion_split
statement:
!f s. f involute s ==>
        s =|= (BIGUNION (equiv_fixes f s)) # (BIGUNION (equiv_pairs f s))

name: equiv_pairs_bigunion
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> BIGUNION (equiv_pairs f s) = pairs f s

name: equiv_pairs_bigunion
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> BIGUNION (equiv_pairs f s) = pairs f s

name: pairs_card_even
statement: !f s. FINITE s /\ f involute s ==> EVEN (CARD (pairs f s))

name: involute_set_fixes_both_even
statement: !f s. FINITE s /\ f involute s ==> (EVEN (CARD s) <=> EVEN (CARD (fixes f s)))

name: involute_set_fixes_both_odd
statement: !f s. FINITE s /\ f involute s ==> (ODD (CARD s) <=> ODD (CARD (fixes f s)))

name: mates_element
statement: !f s x. x IN mates f s <=> x IN s /\ f x <> x

name: mates_subset
statement: !f s. mates f s SUBSET s

name: mates_finite
statement: !f s. FINITE s ==> FINITE (mates f s)

name: mates_fixes_union
statement: !f s. s = (mates f s) UNION (fixes f s)

name: mates_fixes_disjoint
statement: !f s. DISJOINT (mates f s) (fixes f s)

name: mates_fixes_card
statement: !f s. FINITE s ==> CARD s = CARD (mates f s) + CARD (fixes f s)

name: involute_mates
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> f involute (mates f s)

name: involute_mates_partner
statement: !f s x. f involute s /\ x IN mates f s ==> f x IN mates f s

name: fpair_equiv_on_mates
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> (pair_by f) equiv_on (mates f s)

name: mates_partition_element_doublet
statement:
!f s t. f involute s ==>
          (t IN partition (pair_by f) (mates f s) <=>
           ?x. x IN (mates f s) /\ t = {x; f x})

name: mates_partition_element_card
statement:
!f s t. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\
          t IN partition (pair_by f) (mates f s) ==> CARD t = 2

name: mates_card_even
statement: !f s. FINITE s /\ f involute s ==> EVEN (CARD (mates f s))

name: involute_set_fixes_both_even
statement: !f s. FINITE s /\ f involute s ==> (EVEN (CARD s) <=> EVEN (CARD (fixes f s)))

name: involute_two_fixes_both_even
statement:
!f g s. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s ==>
          (EVEN (CARD (fixes f s)) <=> EVEN (CARD (fixes g s)))

name: involute_two_fixes_both_odd
statement:
!f g s. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s ==>
          (ODD (CARD (fixes f s)) <=> ODD (CARD (fixes g s)))

name: fpair_def
statement: fpair x y f <=> y = x \/ y = f x

name: fixes_def
statement: fixes f s = {x | x IN s /\ f x = x}

name: pairs_def
statement: pairs f s = {x | x IN s /\ f x <> x}

name: equiv_fixes_def
statement: equiv_fixes f s = IMAGE (equiv_class (pair_by f) s) (fixes f s)

name: equiv_pairs_def
statement: equiv_pairs f s = IMAGE (equiv_class (pair_by f) s) (pairs f s)

name: mates_def
statement: mates f s = s DIFF (fixes f s)

name: involute_endo
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> f endo s

name: involute_empty
statement: !f. f involute {}

name: involute_inj
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> INJ f s s

name: involute_surj
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> SURJ f s s

name: involute_bij
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> f PERMUTES s

name: involute_LINV
statement: !f s. f involute s ==> (LINV f s) involute s

name: involute_FUNPOW
statement:
!f s x n. f involute s /\ x IN s ==>
            FUNPOW f n x = if EVEN n then x else f x

name: involute_FUNPOW_LINV
statement:
!f s x n. f involute s /\ x IN s ==>
            FUNPOW (LINV f s) n x = FUNPOW f n x

name: involute_alt
statement: !f s. f involute s <=> f endo s /\ !x. x IN s ==> FUNPOW f 2 x = x

name: involute_involute_permutes
statement: !f g s. f involute s /\ g involute s ==> (f o g) PERMUTES s

name: involute_involute_involute
statement: !f g s. f involute s /\ g involute s /\ f o g = g o f ==> (f o g) involute s

name: involute_compose_inv
statement:
!f g s x. f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN s ==>
              (LINV (f o g) s) x = (g o f) x

name: involute_funpow_inv
statement:
!f g s x n. f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN s ==>
              FUNPOW (f o g) n (FUNPOW (g o f) n x) = x

name: iterate_involute_compose_inv
statement:
!f g s x n. f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN s ==>
              (LINV (FUNPOW (f o g) n) s) x = FUNPOW (g o f) n x

name: iterate_involute_compose_eqn
statement:
!f g s x n. f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN s ==>
              FUNPOW (g o f) n x = (g o (FUNPOW (f o g) n) o g) x

name: iterate_involute_compose_shift
statement:
!f g s x n. f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN s ==>
              f (FUNPOW (g o f) n x) = FUNPOW (f o g) n (f x)

name: iterate_involute_mod_period
statement:
!f g s x p i j. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\
                  x IN s /\ p = iterate_period (f o g) x ==>
                 (FUNPOW (f o g) i x = FUNPOW (g o f) j x <=> (i + j) MOD p = 0)

name: involute_involute_period_inv
statement:
!f g s x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN s ==>
            iterate_period (g o f) x = iterate_period (f o g) x

name: involute_involute_fixes_both
statement:
!f g s p x. f involute s /\ g involute s /\
              x IN fixes f s /\ p = iterate_period (f o g) x ==>
              (p = 1 <=> x IN fixes g s)

name: involute_involute_fix_orbit_1
statement:
!f g s x p i j. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\
                  x IN fixes f s /\ p = iterate_period (f o g) x ==>
                 (FUNPOW (f o g) i x = f (FUNPOW (f o g) j x) <=>
                  (i + j) MOD p = 0)

name: involute_involute_fix_orbit_2
statement:
!f g s x p i j. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\
                  x IN fixes f s /\ p = iterate_period (f o g) x ==>
                 (FUNPOW (f o g) i x = g (FUNPOW (f o g) j x) <=>
                  (i + j + 1) MOD p = 0)

name: involute_involute_fix_orbit_fix_even
statement:
!f g s p x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN fixes f s /\
              p = iterate_period (f o g) x /\ EVEN p ==>
              (FUNPOW (f o g) (p DIV 2) x) IN fixes f s

name: involute_involute_fix_orbit_fix_odd
statement:
!f g s p x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN fixes f s /\
              p = iterate_period (f o g) x /\ ODD p ==>
              (FUNPOW (f o g) (p DIV 2) x) IN fixes g s

name: involute_involute_fix_orbit_fix_even_inv
statement:
!f g s p x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN fixes f s /\
              p = iterate_period (g o f) x /\ EVEN p ==> FUNPOW (g o f) (HALF p) x IN fixes f s

name: involute_involute_fix_orbit_fix_odd_inv
statement:
!f g s p x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN fixes f s /\
               p = iterate_period (g o f) x /\ ODD p ==> FUNPOW (g o f) (1 + HALF p) x IN fixes g s

name: involute_involute_fix_orbit_fix_even_distinct
statement:
!f g s p x y. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN fixes f s /\
                p = iterate_period (f o g) x /\
                (y = FUNPOW (f o g) (p DIV 2) x) /\
                EVEN p ==> (y IN fixes f s /\ y <> x)

name: involute_involute_fix_orbit_fix_even_distinct_iff
statement:
!f g s p x y. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN fixes f s /\
                p = iterate_period (f o g) x /\
                (y = FUNPOW (f o g) (p DIV 2) x) /\
                 EVEN p ==> y IN fixes f s /\ (y = x <=> p = 0)

name: involute_involute_fix_orbit_fix_odd_distinct
statement:
!f g s p x y. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN fixes f s /\
                p = iterate_period (f o g) x /\
                (y = FUNPOW (f o g) (p DIV 2) x) /\
                 ODD p ==> y IN fixes g s /\ (1 < p ==> y <> x)

name: involute_involute_fix_orbit_fix_odd_distinct_iff
statement:
!f g s p x y. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN fixes f s /\
                p = iterate_period (f o g) x /\
                (y = FUNPOW (f o g) (p DIV 2) x) /\
                 ODD p ==> y IN fixes g s /\ (y = x <=> p = 1)

name: involute_involute_fix_sing_period_odd
statement:
!f g s p x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\
              fixes f s = {x} /\ p = iterate_period (f o g) x ==> ODD p

name: involute_involute_fix_iterates_1
statement:
!f g s p x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\
              x IN fixes f s /\ p = iterate_period (f o g) x ==>
              !j. j <= p ==> f (FUNPOW (f o g) j x) = FUNPOW (f o g) (p - j) x

name: involute_involute_fix_iterates_2
statement:
!f g s p x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\
              x IN fixes f s /\ p = iterate_period (f o g) x ==>
              !j. j < p ==> g (FUNPOW (f o g) j x) = FUNPOW (f o g) (p - 1 - j) x

name: involute_involute_fix_even_period_fix
statement:
!f g s p x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\
              x IN fixes f s /\ p = iterate_period (f o g) x /\ EVEN p ==>
              !j. 0 < j /\ j < p ==>
                  (FUNPOW (f o g) j x IN fixes f s <=> j = p DIV 2)

name: involute_involute_fix_odd_period_fix
statement:
!f g s p x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\
              x IN fixes f s /\ p = iterate_period (f o g) x /\ ODD p ==>
              !j. j < p ==> (FUNPOW (f o g) j x IN fixes g s <=> j = p DIV 2)

name: iterate_mate_element
statement:
!f g s x. f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN s ==>
            iterate_mate f g x IN s

name: iterate_mate_reverse
statement:
!f g s x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN s ==>
            iterate_mate g f x = iterate_mate f g x

name: iterate_mate_fixes_mate
statement:
!f g s x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN fixes f s ==>
            iterate_mate f g (iterate_mate f g x) = x

name: iterate_mate_mate
statement:
!f g s x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\ x IN s ==>
            iterate_mate f g (iterate_mate f g x) = x

name: iterate_mate_fixes_mate_fixes
statement:
!f g s x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\
            x IN (fixes f s UNION fixes g s) ==>
            iterate_mate f g x IN (fixes f s UNION fixes g s)

name: iterate_mate_involute_fixes
statement:
!f g s. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s ==>
          (iterate_mate f g) involute ((fixes f s) UNION (fixes g s))

name: involute_involute_fix_odd_period_fix_while
statement:
!f g s p x. FINITE s /\ f involute s /\ g involute s /\
              x IN fixes f s /\ p = iterate_period (f o g) x /\ ODD p ==>
              WHILE (\y. g y <> y) (f o g) x IN fixes g s

name: iterate_mate_def
statement:
iterate_mate f g x =
      let h = (iterate_period (f o g) x) DIV 2 
       in if f x = x then FUNPOW (f o g) h x 
          else if g x = x then FUNPOW (g o f) h x 
          else x

name: iterate_search_over
statement: !f g x c b j. c <= j ==> iterate_search f g x c b j = b

name: iterate_search_exit
statement: !f g x c b j. j < c /\ g x ==> iterate_search f g x c b j = x

name: iterate_search_next
statement:
!f g x c b j. j < c /\ ~g x ==>
                iterate_search f g x c b j = iterate_search f g (f x) c b (j + 1)

name: iterate_search_run
statement:
!f g x c b j k. 0 < k /\ j + k <= c /\
                  (!i. i < k ==> ~g (FUNPOW f i x)) ==>
                  iterate_search f g x c b j =
                  iterate_search f g (FUNPOW f k x) c b (j + k)

name: iterate_search_done
statement:
!f g x c b j n. 0 < n /\ j + n < c /\
                  (!i. i < n ==> ~g (FUNPOW f i x)) /\ g (FUNPOW f n x) ==>
                  iterate_search f g x c b j = FUNPOW f n x

name: iterate_search_thm
statement:
!f g x c b n. n < c /\ (!i. i < n ==> ~g (FUNPOW f i x)) /\
                g (FUNPOW f n x) ==>
                iterate_search f g x c b 0 = FUNPOW f n x

name: iterate_trace_length
statement: !a b c. LENGTH (iterate_trace a b c) = 1 + c

name: iterate_trace_non_nil
statement: !a b c. iterate_trace a b c <> []

name: iterate_trace_sing
statement: !a b. iterate_trace a b 0 = [a]

name: iterate_trace_0
statement: !a b. iterate_trace a b 0 = [a]

name: iterate_trace_suc
statement: !a b c. iterate_trace a b (SUC c) = SNOC (iterate a b (SUC c)) (iterate_trace a b c)

name: iterate_trace_head
statement: !a b c. HD (iterate_trace a b c) = a

name: iterate_trace_last
statement: !a b c. LAST (iterate_trace a b c) = iterate a b c

name: iterate_trace_element
statement: !a b c j. j <= c ==> EL j (iterate_trace a b c) = iterate a b j

name: iterate_trace_element_idx
statement:
!a b c ls j. ls = iterate_trace a b c /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls /\
               j <= c ==> findi (iterate a b j) ls = j

name: iterate_trace_member
statement:
!a b c ls x. ls = iterate_trace a b c /\ x <> iterate a b c /\
               MEM x ls ==> MEM (b x) ls

name: iterate_trace_member_iff
statement:
!a b c ls x. ls = iterate_trace a b c ==>
               (MEM x ls <=> ?j. j <= c /\ (x = iterate a b j))

name: iterate_trace_index
statement:
!a b c ls x. ls = iterate_trace a b c /\ x <> iterate a b c /\
               MEM x ls /\ ALL_DISTINCT ls ==> (findi (b x) ls = 1 + findi x ls)

name: iterate_trace_all_distinct
statement:
!s a b c p. FINITE s /\ b PERMUTES s /\ a IN s /\
              p = iterate_period b a /\ c < p ==>
              ALL_DISTINCT (iterate_trace a b c)

name: iterate_while_hoare
statement:
!s a b c p g n. FINITE s /\ b PERMUTES s /\ a IN s /\
                  p = iterate_period b a /\ n < c /\ c < p /\
                  
                  ~g (iterate a b n) /\ (!j. j < n ==> g (iterate a b j)) ==>
                  HOARE_SPEC {a} (WHILE g b) {iterate a b n}

name: iterate_while_thm_1
statement:
!s a b c p g n. FINITE s /\ b PERMUTES s /\ a IN s /\
                  p = iterate_period b a /\ n < c /\ c < p /\
                  ~g (iterate a b n) /\ (!j. j < n ==> g (iterate a b j)) ==>
                  WHILE g b a = iterate a b n

name: iterate_while_hoare_0
statement: !a b g. ~g a ==> HOARE_SPEC {a} (WHILE g b) {a}

name: iterate_while_thm_0
statement: !a b g. ~g a ==> WHILE g b a = a

name: iterate_while_eqn
statement:
!g b x k. (!j. j < k ==> g (FUNPOW b j x)) ==>
            WHILE g b x =
               if g (FUNPOW b k x) then WHILE g b (FUNPOW b (k + 1) x)
               else FUNPOW b k x

name: iterate_while_thm
statement:
!g b x k. (!j. j < k ==> g (FUNPOW b j x)) /\ ~g (FUNPOW b k x) ==>
            WHILE g b x = FUNPOW b k x

name: iterate_while_none
statement: !g b x. ~g x ==> WHILE g b x = x

name: skip_idx_while_thm
statement:
!ls f h k. h <= k /\ (!j. h <= j /\ j < k ==> f (EL j ls)) /\ ~f (EL k ls) ==>
             WHILE (\j. f (EL j ls)) SUC h = k

name: skip_list_while_thm
statement:
!ls g b h k. h <= k /\ (!j. h <= j /\ j < k ==> g (EL j ls)) /\ ~g (EL k ls) /\
               (!j. h + j <= k ==> EL (h + j) ls = FUNPOW b j (EL h ls)) ==>
               EL k ls = WHILE g b (EL h ls)

name: iterate_trace_def
statement: iterate_trace (a:'a) (b:'a -> 'a) (c:num) = MAP (iterate a b) [0 .. c]

name: iterate_period_property
statement: !f x. FUNPOW f (iterate_period f x) x = x

name: iterate_period_minimal
statement: !f x n. 0 < n /\ n < iterate_period f x ==> FUNPOW f n x <> x

name: iterate_period_thm
statement:
!f x n. 0 < n ==>
          (iterate_period f x = n <=>
           FUNPOW f n x = x /\ !m. 0 < m /\ m < n ==> FUNPOW f m x <> x)

name: iterate_fix_0
statement: !f x n. n < iterate_period f x /\ FUNPOW f n x = x ==> n = 0

name: iterate_not_distinct
statement:
!f s x. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s ==>
           ?h k. FUNPOW f h x = FUNPOW f k x /\ (h <> k)

name: iterate_period_exists
statement:
!f s x. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s ==>
          ?n. 0 < n /\ n = iterate_period f x

name: iterate_period_pos
statement: !f s x. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s ==> 0 < iterate_period f x

name: iterate_mod_period
statement:
!f s x n. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s ==>
            FUNPOW f n x = FUNPOW f (n MOD iterate_period f x) x

name: iterate_reduce
statement:
!f s x n. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s ==>
            ?m. FUNPOW f n x = FUNPOW f m x /\ m < iterate_period f x

name: iterate_period_eq_0
statement: !f x. iterate_period f x = 0 <=> !n. 0 < n ==> FUNPOW f n x <> x

name: iterate_period_eq_1
statement: !f x. iterate_period f x = 1 <=> f x = x

name: iterate_period_eq_2
statement: !f x. iterate_period f x = 2 <=> (f x <> x /\ f (f x) = x)

name: iterate_period_multiple
statement: !f x n. FUNPOW f n x = x <=> ?k. n = k * (iterate_period f x)

name: iterate_period_mod
statement:
!f x n p. 0 < p /\ p = iterate_period f x ==>
            (FUNPOW f n x = x <=> n MOD p = 0)

name: iterate_period_mod_eq
statement:
!f s p x i j. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s /\
                p = iterate_period f x ==>
                (FUNPOW f i x = FUNPOW f j x <=> i MOD p = j MOD p)

name: iterate_period_mod_eq
statement:
!f s p x i j. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s /\
                p = iterate_period f x ==>
                (FUNPOW f i x = FUNPOW f j x <=> i MOD p = j MOD p)

name: iterate_period_funpow_inj
statement:
!f s p x. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s /\
            p = iterate_period f x ==>
            INJ (\j. FUNPOW f j x) (count p) s

name: iterate_period_upper
statement:
!f s p x. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s /\
            p = iterate_period f x ==> p <= CARD s

name: iterate_period_inv
statement:
!f s x. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s ==>
          iterate_period (LINV f s) x = iterate_period f x

name: iterate_period_inv_alt
statement:
!f s p x. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s /\ p = iterate_period f x ==>
            iterate_period (LINV f s) x = p

name: iterate_period_iterate
statement:
!f s x y j. FINITE s /\ f PERMUTES s /\ x IN s /\ y = FUNPOW f j x ==>
              iterate_period f y = iterate_period f x

name: iterate_period_def
statement:
iterate_period (f:'a -> 'a) (x:'a) =
      case OLEAST k. 0 < k /\ FUNPOW f k x = x of
           NONE => 0
         | SOME k => k

name: quarity_cases
statement: !n. zig n \/ zag n \/ tik n \/ tok n

name: zig_exists
statement: !n. zig n ==> ?k. n = 4 * k

name: zag_exists
statement: !n. zag n ==> ?k. n = 4 * k + 2

name: tik_exists
statement: !n. tik n ==> ?k. n = 4 * k + 1

name: tok_exists
statement: !n. tok n ==> ?k. n = 4 * k + 3

name: tok_not_square
statement: !n. tok n ==> ~square n

name: zag_not_square
statement: !n. zag n ==> ~square n

name: tik_non_square
statement: !n. tik n /\ ~square n ==> n = 5 \/ 12 < n

name: odd_tik_tok
statement: !n. ODD n <=> (tik n \/ tok n)

name: even_zig_zag
statement: !n. EVEN n <=> (zig n \/ zag n)

name: odd_eq_two_sq_sum
statement: !m n. ODD (m ** 2 + n ** 2) <=> (ODD m <=> EVEN n)

name: even_eq_two_sq_sum
statement: !m n. EVEN (m ** 2 + n ** 2) <=> (EVEN m <=> EVEN n)

name: tik_div_4
statement: !n. tik n ==> (n - 1) DIV 4 = n DIV 4

name: tik_sub_odd_sq_mod_4
statement: !n m. tik n /\ ODD m ==> (n - m ** 2) MOD 4 = 0

name: tik_sub_odd_sq_div_4
statement: !n m. tik n /\ ~square n /\ ODD m /\ m <= SQRT n ==> 0 < (n - m ** 2) DIV 4

name: zig_sub_even_sq_mod_4
statement: !n m. zig n /\ EVEN m ==> (n - m ** 2) MOD 4 = 0

name: zig_sub_even_sq_div_4
statement: !n m. zig n /\ ~square n /\ EVEN m /\ m <= SQRT n ==> 0 < (n - m ** 2) DIV 4

name: mills_tok_empty
statement: !n. tok n ==> mills n = {}

name: mills_zag_empty
statement: !n. zag n ==> mills n = {}

name: windmill_mind_odd
statement: !n x y z. tik n /\ n = windmill (x, y, z) ==> ODD x /\ x <= SQRT n

name: windmill_mind_even
statement: !n x y z. zig n /\ n = windmill (x, y, z) ==> EVEN x /\ x <= SQRT n

name: odds_to_element
statement: !n x. x IN odds_to n <=> ODD x /\ x <= n

name: odds_to_eqn
statement: !n. odds_to n = IMAGE (\j. if ODD j then j else 1) (natural n)

name: odds_to_thm
statement: !n. odds_to n = IMAGE (\j. 2 * j + 1) (count (HALF (n + 1)))

name: odds_to_subset_count
statement: !n. odds_to n SUBSET count (n + 1)

name: odds_to_finite
statement: !n. FINITE (odds_to n)

name: odds_to_card
statement: !n. CARD (odds_to n) = HALF (n + 1)

name: evens_to_element
statement: !n x. x IN evens_to n <=> EVEN x /\ x <= n

name: evens_to_eqn
statement: !n. evens_to n = IMAGE (\j. if EVEN j then j else 0) (count (n+1))

name: evens_to_thm
statement: !n. evens_to n = IMAGE (\j. 2 * j) (count (HALF (n + 2)))

name: evens_to_subset_count
statement: !n. (evens_to n) SUBSET (count (n + 1))

name: evens_to_finite
statement: !n. FINITE (evens_to n)

name: evens_to_card
statement: !n. CARD (evens_to n) = HALF (n + 2)

name: factor_pair_0
statement: factor_pair 0 = {}

name: factor_pair_empty
statement: !n. factor_pair n = {} <=> n = 0

name: factor_pair_nonzero_element
statement: !n p q. 0 < n ==> ((p, q) IN factor_pair n <=> n = p * q)

name: mills_tik_eqn
statement: !n. tik n /\ ~square n ==> mills n = mills_tik n

name: mills_odd_eqn
mills_tok_card
statement: !n. tok n ==> CARD (mills n) = 0

name: mills_tik_card
statement:
!n. tik n /\ ~square n ==>
        CARD (mills n) = SIGMA (\x. CARD (divisors ((n - x ** 2) DIV 4))) (odds_to (SQRT n))

name: mills_tik_card_upper_thm
statement:
!n. tik n /\ ~square n ==>
        CARD (mills n) <= SIGMA (\x. 2 * SQRT ((n - x ** 2) DIV 4)) (odds_to (SQRT n))

name: mills_tik_card_upper_tight
statement:
!n. tik n /\ ~square n ==>
        CARD (mills n) <= 2 * SQRT (n DIV 4) * HALF (1 + SQRT n)

name: mills_tik_card_upper
statement: !n. tik n /\ ~square n ==> CARD (mills n) <= n

name: mills_zig_eqn
statement: !n. zig n /\ ~square n ==> mills n = mills_zig n

name: mills_even_eqn
mills_zag_card
statement: !n. zag n ==> CARD (mills n) = 0

name: mills_zig_card
statement:
!n. zig n /\ ~square n ==>
        CARD (mills n) = SIGMA (\x. CARD (divisors ((n - x ** 2) DIV 4))) (evens_to (SQRT n))

name: mills_zig_card_upper_thm
statement:
!n. zig n /\ ~square n ==>
        CARD (mills n) <= SIGMA (\x. 2 * SQRT ((n - x ** 2) DIV 4)) (evens_to (SQRT n))

name: mills_zig_card_upper_tight
statement:
!n. zig n /\ ~square n ==>
        CARD (mills n) <= 2 * SQRT (n DIV 4) * HALF (2 + SQRT n)

name: mills_zig_card_upper
statement: !n. zig n /\ ~square n ==> CARD (mills n) <= n

name: mills_square_element
statement: !n x y z. (x, y, z) IN mills_square n <=> n = windmill (x, y, z) /\ (y = 0 \/ z = 0)

name: mills_tik_square_eqn
statement: !n. tik n /\ square n ==> mills n = (mills_tik n) UNION (mills_square n)

name: mills_zig_square_eqn
statement: !n. zig n /\ square n ==> mills n = (mills_zig n) UNION (mills_square n)

name: mills_tik_not_mills_square
statement: !n. (mills_tik n) INTER (mills_square n) = {}

name: mills_zig_not_mills_square
statement: !n. (mills_zig n) INTER (mills_square n) = {}

name: mills_eqn
statement:
!n. mills n = if (square n) then mills n
                 else if zig n then mills_zig n
                 else if tik n then mills_tik n
                 else {}

name: mills_card_upper
statement: !n. ~square n ==> CARD (mills n) <= n

name: two_sq_sum_element
statement: !n x y. (x,y) IN two_sq_sum n <=> n = x ** 2 + y ** 2

name: two_sq_sum_subset
statement: !n. two_sq_sum n SUBSET (count (1 + SQRT n)) CROSS (count (1 + SQRT n))

name: two_sq_sum_finite
statement: !n. FINITE (two_sq_sum n)

name: two_sq_sum_eqn
statement:
!n. two_sq_sum n =
        BIGUNION (IMAGE
           (\x. let m = n - x * x; y = SQRT m in if y * y = m then {(x, y)} else {})
           (upto (SQRT n)))

name: two_sq_sum_tok
statement: !n. tok n ==> two_sq_sum n = {}

name: odds_to_def
statement: odds_to n = {x | ODD x /\ x <= n}

name: evens_to_def
statement: evens_to n = {x | EVEN x /\ x <= n}

name: factor_pair_def
statement: factor_pair n = IMAGE (\j. (j, n DIV j)) (divisors n)

name: mills_tik_def
statement: mills_tik n = BIGUNION (IMAGE (\x. IMAGE (\p. (x,p)) (factor_pair ((n - x * x) DIV 4))) (odds_to (SQRT n)))

name: mills_zig_def
statement: mills_zig n = BIGUNION (IMAGE (\x. IMAGE (\p. (x,p)) (factor_pair ((n - x * x) DIV 4))) (evens_to (SQRT n)))

name: mills_square_def
statement: mills_square n = {(x,y,z) | n = windmill (x, y, z) /\ y * z = 0}

name: two_sq_sum_def
statement: two_sq_sum n = {(x, y) | n = x ** 2 + y ** 2}

name: zagier_fixes_prime
statement: !p. prime p /\ (p MOD 4 = 1) ==> (fixes zagier (mills p) = {(1,1,p DIV 4)})

name: fermat_two_squares_unique_odd_even
statement:
!p a b c d. prime p /\ ODD a /\ EVEN b /\ (p = a ** 2 + b ** 2) /\
               ODD c /\ EVEN d /\ (p = c ** 2 + d ** 2) ==> ((a = c) /\ (b = d))

name: flip_fixes_prime_card_upper
statement: !p. prime p /\ (p MOD 4 = 1) ==> CARD (fixes flip (mills p)) <= 1

name: fermat_two_squares_exists_windmill
statement: !p. prime p /\ (p MOD 4 = 1) ==> ?x y. p = windmill (x, y, y)

name: fermat_two_squares_exists_odd_even
statement:
!p. prime p /\ (p MOD 4 = 1) ==>
   ?(u,v). ODD u /\ EVEN v /\ (p = u ** 2 + v ** 2)

name: flip_fixes_prime_sing
statement: !p. prime p /\ (p MOD 4 = 1) ==> SING (fixes flip (mills p))

name: flip_fixes_prime
flip_fixes_prime_alt
statement:
!p u n. prime p /\ (p MOD 4 = 1) /\ (u = (1, 1, p DIV 4)) /\
           (n = iterate_period (zagier o flip) u) ==>
           (fixes flip (mills p) = {FUNPOW (zagier o flip) (n DIV 2) u})

name: fermat_two_squares_thm
statement:
!p. prime p /\ (p MOD 4 = 1) ==>
   ?!(u,v). ODD u /\ EVEN v /\ (p = u ** 2 + v ** 2)

name: fermat_two_squares_iff
statement:
!p. prime p ==>
  ((p MOD 4 = 1) <=> ?!(u,v). ODD u /\ EVEN v /\ (p = u ** 2 + v ** 2))

name: zagier_flip_1_1_z_period
statement: !z. (iterate_period (zagier o flip) (1,1,z) = 1) <=> (z = 1)

name: flip_fixes_iterates_prime
statement:
!p u n g. prime p /\ (p MOD 4 = 1) /\ (u = (1, 1, p DIV 4)) /\
             (n = iterate_period (zagier o flip) u) /\ (g = \(x,y,z). y <> z) ==>
             (~g (FUNPOW (zagier o flip) (n DIV 2) u) /\
              (!j. j < n DIV 2 ==> g (FUNPOW (zagier o flip) j u)))

!n x y. n = windmill (x, y, y) ==>

statement: !n x y z. n = windmill (x, y, z) ==> y * z = (n - x ** 2) DIV 4

name: windmill_yz_eq_0
statement: !n x y z. n = windmill (x, y, z) ==> ((n - x ** 2) DIV 4 = 0 <=> y = 0 \/ z = 0)

statement: !n x y z. n = windmill (x,y,z) ==> x <= SQRT n

name: windmill_yz_upper
statement: !n x y z. n = windmill (x,y,z) ==> y * z <= n DIV 4

statement: !n x y z. n = windmill (x,y,z) /\ 0 < z ==> y <= n DIV 4

statement: !n x y z. (x, y, z) IN mills n ==> (x, z, y) IN mills n

name: mills_1_infinite
statement: INFINITE (mills 1)

statement: !n x y z. ~square n /\ (x, y, z) IN mills n ==> x < n /\ y < n /\ z < n

statement: !n. ~square n ==> mills n SUBSET (count n) CROSS (count n CROSS (count n))

statement: !n. ~square n ==> CARD (mills n) < n ** 3

statement: !n. ~square n ==> FINITE (mills n)

statement: !n. FINITE (mills n) <=> ~square n

name: mills_with_no_mind

name: mills_with_mind

statement: !x y z. x * z <> 0 ==> zagier (zagier (x, y, z)) = (x, y, z)

             else x

statement: !L. (L dot L) SUBSET L ==> (L dot KSTAR L) SUBSET L

statement: Finite_State L <=> FINITE (Intrinsic_States L)

name: derives_TOK

statement: tk ∈ firstSet G sf ⇒ tk ∈ firstSetML G {} sf

name: firstSetML_eqn
statement: firstSet G sf = firstSetML G {} sf

name: nullable_def

name: nullableML_def
statement:
nullableML seen [] = T ∧
  nullableML seen (TOK t :: _) = F ∧
  nullableML seen (NT n :: rest) =
      if n ∈ FDOM G.rules ∧ n ∉ seen then
        if G.rules ' n ∩ { r | nullableML (n INSERT seen) r } = ∅ then F
        else nullableML seen rest
      else F

name: ptree_NTs_def
statement:
(ptree_NTs (Lf (l,_)) = case l of NT N => {N} | _ => ∅) ∧
  (ptree_NTs (Nd (n,_) subs) = n INSERT BIGUNION (IMAGE ptree_NTs (set subs)))

name: ptree_rptfree_def
statement:
ptree_rptfree (Lf _) = T ∧
  ptree_rptfree (Nd (N,_) subs) =
    ∀s. MEM s subs ⇒ ptree_rptfree s ∧ N ∉ ptree_NTs s

name: firstSet_def
statement: firstSet G sf = { t | ∃rest. derives G sf (TOK t :: rest) }

name: firstSetML_def
statement:
firstSetML seen [] = {} ∧
  firstSetML seen (TOK t :: _) = {t} ∧
  firstSetML seen (NT n :: rest) =
    if n ∈ FDOM G.rules then
      (if n ∉ seen then
        BIGUNION (IMAGE (firstSetML (n INSERT seen))
                        (G.rules ' n))
       else {}) ∪
      (if nullable G [NT n] then firstSetML seen rest
       else {})
    else {}

name: nts_derive_def
statement:
(nts_derive G [] tok ⇔ F) ∧
  (nts_derive G [N] tok ⇔
    N ∈ FDOM G.rules ∧
    ∃p s. p ++ [TOK tok] ++ s ∈ G.rules ' N ∧
          nullable G p) ∧
  (nts_derive G (N1::N2::NS) tok ⇔
    N1 ∈ FDOM G.rules ∧
    ∃p s. p ++ [NT N2] ++ s ∈ G.rules ' N1 ∧
          nullable G p ∧
          nts_derive G (N2::NS) tok)

name: MAP_TKI_11
statement: (MAP (TOK ## I) l1 = MAP (TOK ## I) l2) ⇔ (l1 = l2)

name: valid_lptree_thm
statement:
(valid_lptree G (Lf p) ⇔ T) ∧
  (valid_lptree G (Nd (n, l) children) ⇔
      l = merge_list_locs (MAP ptree_loc children) ∧
      n ∈ FDOM G.rules ∧ MAP ptree_head children ∈ G.rules ' n ∧
      ∀pt. MEM pt children ⇒ valid_lptree G pt)

name: derive_paste_horizontally
statement: derive G sf11 sf12 ∧ derive G sf21 sf22 ⇒ derives G (sf11 ++ sf21) (sf12 ++ sf22)

name: derive_1NT
statement: derive G [NT s] l ⇔ s ∈ FDOM G.rules ∧ l ∈ G.rules ' s

name: derives_common_prefix
statement: ∀sf1 sf2 p. derives G sf1 sf2 ⇒ derives G (p ++ sf1) (p ++ sf2)

name: derives_common_suffix
statement: ∀sf1 sf2 s. derives G sf1 sf2 ⇒ derives G (sf1 ++ s) (sf2 ++ s)

name: derives_paste_horizontally
statement: derives G sf11 sf12 ∧ derives G sf21 sf22 ⇒ derives G (sf11 ++ sf21) (sf12 ++ sf22)

name: valid_ptree_derive
statement: ∀pt. valid_ptree G pt ⇒ derives G [ptree_head pt] (ptree_fringe pt)

name: FLAT_EQ_APPEND
statement:
FLAT l = x ++ y ⇔
    (∃p s. l = p ++ s ∧ x = FLAT p ∧ y = FLAT s) ∨
    (∃p s ip is.
       l = p ++ [ip ++ is] ++ s ∧ ip ≠ [] ∧ is ≠ [] ∧
       x = FLAT p ++ ip ∧
       y = is ++ FLAT s)

name: FLAT_EQ_NIL
statement: FLAT l = [] ⇔ ∀e. MEM e l ⇒ e = []

name: FLAT_EQ_SING
statement:
FLAT l = [x] ⇔
    ∃p s. l = p ++ [[x]] ++ s ∧ FLAT p = [] ∧ FLAT s = []

name: isTOK_def

name: destTOK_def

(destTOK (TOK tk, _) = SOME tk) ∧

name: ptree_loc_def
statement:
ptree_loc (Lf(_,l)) = l ∧
  ptree_loc (Nd(_,l) _) = l

name: ptree_list_loc_def
statement: ptree_list_loc l = merge_list_locs (MAP ptree_loc l)

name: ptree_head_def
statement:
(ptree_head (Lf (tok,l)) = tok) ∧
  (ptree_head (Nd (nt,l) children) = NT nt)

name: valid_ptree_def
statement:
(valid_ptree G (Lf _) ⇔ T) ∧
  (valid_ptree G (Nd (nt,l) children) ⇔
    nt ∈ FDOM G.rules ∧ MAP ptree_head children ∈ G.rules ' nt ∧
    ∀pt. pt ∈ set children ⇒ valid_ptree G pt)

name: ptree_fringe_def
statement:
(ptree_fringe (Lf (t,_)) = [t]) ∧
  (ptree_fringe (Nd _ children) = FLAT (MAP ptree_fringe children))

name: complete_ptree_def
statement:
complete_ptree G pt ⇔
    valid_ptree G pt ∧ ptree_head pt = NT G.start ∧
    ∀t. t ∈ set (ptree_fringe pt) ⇒ isTOK t

name: real_fringe_def
statement:
(real_fringe (Lf t) = [t]) ∧
  (real_fringe (Nd n ptl) = FLAT (MAP real_fringe ptl))

name: valid_locs_def
statement:
(valid_locs (Lf _) ⇔ T) ∧
  (valid_locs (Nd (_, l) children) ⇔
     l = merge_list_locs (MAP ptree_loc children) ∧
     ∀pt. MEM pt children ⇒ valid_locs pt)

name: valid_lptree_def
statement: valid_lptree G pt ⇔ valid_locs pt ∧ valid_ptree G pt

name: language_def
derive_def

name: locncol_def

name: locnle_def
statement:
locnle l1 l2 <=>
    l1 = l2 ∨ 
    l1 = unknown_locn ∨ 
    l2 = end_locn ∨ 
    
    l2 ≠ unknown_locn ∧ l1 ≠ end_locn ∧

name: locsle_def

name: merge_locs_def

name: lift_number_def

name: leftassoc_def

leftassoc f (XList []) b = b ∧

name: samplePEG_def
resultmap_EQ_Success
statement: resultmap f r = Success a x eo ⇔ ∃x0. r = Success a x0 eo ∧ x = f x0

       sr = Success s r eo ⇒ IS_SUFFIX s0 s) ∧

peg_eval G (s0,e) (Success s c eo) ⇒

name: FORALL_result

name: lemma4_1a0
statement:
(∀s0 e r.
     peg_eval G (s0, e) r ⇒
     (∀c eo. r = Success s0 c eo ⇒ peg0 G e) ∧
     (isFailure r ⇒ pegfail G e) ∧
     (∀s c eo. r = Success s c eo ∧ LENGTH s < LENGTH s0 ⇒ peggt0 G e)) ∧
  (∀s0 e s rl err.
     peg_eval_list G (s0,e) (s,rl,err) ⇒
     (s0 = s ⇒ pegfail G e) ∧
     (LENGTH s < LENGTH s0 ⇒ peggt0 G e))

name: subexprs_included

name: start_IN_Gexprs

name: IN_subexprs_TRANS
statement: ∀a b c. a ∈ subexprs b ∧ b ∈ subexprs c ⇒ a ∈ subexprs c

name: Gexprs_subexprs
statement: e ∈ Gexprs G ⇒ subexprs e ⊆ Gexprs G

(not e c ∈ Gexprs G ⇒ e ∈ Gexprs G) ∧
  (seq e1 e2 f ∈ Gexprs G ⇒ e1 ∈ Gexprs G ∧ e2 ∈ Gexprs G) ∧
  (choice e1 e2 f2 ∈ Gexprs G ⇒ e1 ∈ Gexprs G ∧ e2 ∈ Gexprs G) ∧

name: reducing_peg_eval_makes_list
statement:
(∀s. LENGTH s < n ⇒ ∃r. peg_eval G (s, e) r) ∧ ¬peg0 G e ∧ LENGTH s0 < n ⇒
  ∃s' rl err. peg_eval_list G (s0,e) (s',rl,err)

name: peg_eval_total
statement: wfG G ⇒ ∀s e. e ∈ Gexprs G ⇒ ∃r. peg_eval G (s,e) r

name: peg_eval_seq_SOME
statement:
peg_eval G (i0, seq s1 s2 f) (Success i r eo) ⇔
    ∃i1 r1 r2 eo1.
      peg_eval G (i0, s1) (Success i1 r1 eo1) ∧
      peg_eval G (i1, s2) (Success i r2 eo) ∧ r = f r1 r2

name: peg_eval_seq_NONE
statement:
peg_eval G (i0, seq s1 s2 f) (Failure fl fe) ⇔
  peg_eval G (i0, s1) (Failure fl fe) ∨
  ∃i r eo. peg_eval G (i0,s1) (Success i r eo) ∧
           peg_eval G (i,s2) (Failure fl fe)

name: peg_eval_tok_SOME
statement:
peg_eval G (i0, tok P f) (Success i r eo) ⇔
  ∃h l. P h ∧ i0 = (h,l)::i ∧ r = f (h,l) ∧ eo = NONE

name: peg_eval_empty
statement: peg_eval G (i, empty r) x ⇔ x = Success i r NONE

name: peg_eval_NT_SOME
statement:
peg_eval G (i0,nt N f) (Success i r eo) ⇔
  ∃r0. r = f r0 ∧ N ∈ FDOM G.rules ∧
       peg_eval G (i0,G.rules ' N) (Success i r0 eo)

name: peg_eval_choice
statement:
∀x.
     peg_eval G (i0, choice s1 s2 f) x ⇔
      (∃sr. peg_eval G (i0, s1) sr ∧ isSuccess sr ∧
            x = resultmap (f o INL) sr) ∨
      (∃i r eo fl fe.
         peg_eval G (i0, s1) (Failure fl fe) ∧
         peg_eval G (i0, s2) (Success i r eo) ∧
         x = Success i (f $ INR r) (optmax MAXerr (SOME (fl,fe)) eo)) ∨
      ∃fl1 fe1 fl2 fe2.
        peg_eval G (i0, s1) (Failure fl1 fe1) ∧
        peg_eval G (i0, s2) (Failure fl2 fe2) ∧
        x = UNCURRY Failure (MAXerr (fl1,fe1) (fl2,fe2))

name: peg_eval_choicel_NIL
statement: peg_eval G (i0, choicel []) x = (x = Failure (sloc i0) G.notFAIL)

name: peg_eval_choicel_CONS
statement:
∀x. peg_eval G (i0, choicel (h::t)) x ⇔
        ∃y.
          peg_eval G (i0, h) y ∧
          case y of
            Success i r eo => x = Success i r eo
          | Failure fl1 fe1 =>
              ∃z. peg_eval G (i0, choicel t) z ∧
                  case z of
                    Success i r eo =>
                      x = Success i r (optmax MAXerr (SOME(fl1,fe1)) eo)
                  | Failure fl2 fe2 =>
                      x = UNCURRY Failure (MAXerr (fl1,fe1) (fl2,fe2))

name: peg_eval_rpt
statement:
peg_eval G (i0, rpt s f) x ⇔
    ∃i l err. peg_eval_list G (i0,s) (i,l,err) ∧ x = Success i (f l) (SOME err)

name: pegfail_empty
statement: pegfail G (empty r) = F

name: peg0_empty
statement: peg0 G (empty r) = T

name: peg0_not
statement: peg0 G (not s r) ⇔ pegfail G s

name: peg0_choice
statement: peg0 G (choice s1 s2 f) ⇔ peg0 G s1 ∨ pegfail G s1 ∧ peg0 G s2

name: peg0_choicel
statement:
(peg0 G (choicel []) = F) ∧
  (peg0 G (choicel (h::t)) ⇔ peg0 G h ∨ pegfail G h ∧ peg0 G (choicel t))

name: peg0_seq
statement: peg0 G (seq s1 s2 f) ⇔ peg0 G s1 ∧ peg0 G s2

name: peg0_tok
statement: peg0 G (tok P f) = F

name: peg0_pegf
statement: peg0 G (pegf s f) = peg0 G s

name: isSuccess_def
statement:
isSuccess (Success _ _ _) = T ∧
  isSuccess (Failure _ _) = F

name: isFailure_def
statement:
isFailure (Success _ _ _) = F ∧
  isFailure (Failure _ _) = T

name: resultmap_def
statement:
resultmap f (Success a c eo) = Success a (f c) eo ∧
  resultmap f (Failure fl fe) = Failure fl fe

name: MAXerr_def
statement:
MAXerr (fl1, fe1) (fl2, fe2) =
  if locsle fl1 fl2 then (fl2, fe2) else (fl1,fe1)

name: optmax_def
statement:
optmax f NONE NONE = NONE ∧
  optmax f NONE (SOME x) = SOME x ∧
  optmax f (SOME x) NONE = SOME x ∧
  optmax f (SOME x) (SOME y) = SOME (f x y)

name: sloc_def
statement:
sloc [] = EOF ∧
  sloc (h::t) = SND h

name: subexprs_def
statement:
(subexprs (any f1) = { any f1 }) ∧
  (subexprs (empty c) = { empty c }) ∧
  (subexprs (tok t f2) = { tok t f2 }) ∧
  (subexprs (error e) = { error e }) ∧
  (subexprs (nt s f) = { nt s f }) ∧
  (subexprs (not e c) = not e c INSERT subexprs e) ∧
  (subexprs (seq e1 e2 f3) = seq e1 e2 f3 INSERT subexprs e1 ∪ subexprs e2) ∧
  (subexprs (choice e1 e2 f4) =
    choice e1 e2 f4 INSERT subexprs e1 ∪ subexprs e2) ∧
  (subexprs (rpt e f5) = rpt e f5 INSERT subexprs e)

name: Gexprs_def
statement: Gexprs G = BIGUNION (IMAGE subexprs (G.start INSERT FRANGE G.rules))

name: pegf_def
statement: pegf sym f = seq sym (empty ARB) (λl1 l2. f l1)

name: peg_eval_def
statement:
[~empty:]
  (∀s c. peg_eval G (s, empty c) (Success s c NONE))
[~nt:]
  (∀n s f res.
       n ∈ FDOM G.rules ∧ peg_eval G (s, G.rules ' n) res ⇒
       peg_eval G (s, nt n f) (resultmap f res))
[~any_success:]
  (∀h t f. peg_eval G (h::t, any f) (Success t (f h) NONE))
[~any_failure:]
  (∀f. peg_eval G ([], any f) (Failure EOF G.anyEOF))
[~tok_success:]
  (∀e t P f.
     P (FST e) ⇒ peg_eval G (e::t, tok P f) (Success t (f e) NONE))
[~tok_failureF:]
  (∀h t P f.
     ¬P (FST h) ⇒
     peg_eval G (h::t, tok P f) (Failure (SND h) G.tokFALSE))
[~tok_failureEOF:]
  (∀P f. peg_eval G ([], tok P f) (Failure EOF G.tokEOF))
[~not_success:]
  (∀e s c fr.
     peg_eval G (s, e) fr ∧ isFailure fr ⇒
     peg_eval G (s, not e c) (Success s c NONE))
[~not_failure:]
  (∀e s r c.
     peg_eval G (s, e) r ∧ isSuccess r ⇒
     peg_eval G (s, not e c) (Failure (sloc s) G.notFAIL))
[~seq_fail1:]
  (∀e1 e2 s f fl fe.
     peg_eval G (s, e1) (Failure fl fe) ⇒
     peg_eval G (s, seq e1 e2 f) (Failure fl fe))
[~seq_fail2:]
  (∀e1 e2 f s0 eo s1 c1 fl fe.
     peg_eval G (s0, e1) (Success s1 c1 eo) ∧
     peg_eval G (s1, e2) (Failure fl fe) ⇒
     peg_eval G (s0, seq e1 e2 f) (Failure fl fe))
[~seq_success:]
  (∀e1 e2 s0 s1 s2 c1 c2 f eo1 eo2.
     peg_eval G (s0, e1) (Success s1 c1 eo1) ∧
     peg_eval G (s1, e2) (Success s2 c2 eo2) ⇒
     peg_eval G (s0, seq e1 e2 f) (Success s2 (f c1 c2) eo2))
[~choice_fail:]
  (∀e1 e2 s f fl1 fe1 fl2 fe2.
     peg_eval G (s, e1) (Failure fl1 fe1) ∧
     peg_eval G (s, e2) (Failure fl2 fe2) ⇒
     peg_eval G (s, choice e1 e2 f)
              (UNCURRY Failure (MAXerr (fl1,fe1) (fl2,fe2))))
[~choice_success1:]
  (∀e1 e2 s0 f s r eo.
     peg_eval G (s0, e1) (Success s r eo) ⇒
     peg_eval G (s0, choice e1 e2 f) (Success s (f (INL r)) eo))
[~choice_success2:]
  (∀e1 e2 s0 s r eo f fl fe.
     peg_eval G (s0, e1) (Failure fl fe) ∧
     peg_eval G (s0, e2) (Success s r eo) ⇒
     peg_eval G (s0, choice e1 e2 f)
              (Success s (f (INR r)) (optmax MAXerr (SOME (fl,fe)) eo)))
[~error:]
  (∀e s. peg_eval G (s, error e) (Failure (sloc s) e))
[~rpt:]
  (∀e f s s1 list err.
     peg_eval_list G (s, e) (s1,list,err) ⇒
     peg_eval G (s, rpt e f) (Success s1 (f list) (SOME err)))
[~list_nil:]
  (∀e s fl fe. peg_eval G (s, e) (Failure fl fe) ⇒
               peg_eval_list G (s, e) (s,[],(fl,fe)))
[~list_cons:]
  (∀e eo0 eo s0 s1 s2 c cs.
     peg_eval G (s0, e) (Success s1 c eo0) ∧
     peg_eval_list G (s1, e) (s2,cs,eo) ⇒
     peg_eval_list G (s0, e) (s2,c::cs,eo))

name: peg0_def
statement:
(∀c. peg0 G (empty c)) ∧

  
  (∀f. peggt0 G (any f)) ∧
  (∀f. pegfail G (any f)) ∧

  
  (∀t f. peggt0 G (tok t f)) ∧
  (∀t f. pegfail G (tok t f)) ∧

  
  (∀e f. pegfail G e ⇒ peg0 G (rpt e f)) ∧
  (∀e f. peggt0 G e ⇒ peggt0 G (rpt e f)) ∧

  
  (∀n f. n ∈ FDOM G.rules ∧ peg0 G (G.rules ' n) ⇒
         peg0 G (nt n f)) ∧
  (∀n f. n ∈ FDOM G.rules ∧ peggt0 G (G.rules ' n) ⇒
         peggt0 G (nt n f)) ∧
  (∀n f. n ∈ FDOM G.rules ∧ pegfail G (G.rules ' n) ⇒
         pegfail G (nt n f)) ∧

  
  (∀e1 e2 f. pegfail G e1 ∨ (peg0 G e1 ∧ pegfail G e2) ∨
             (peggt0 G e1 ∧ pegfail G e2) ⇒
             pegfail G (seq e1 e2 f)) ∧
  (∀e1 e2 f. peggt0 G e1 ∧ (peg0 G e2 ∨ peggt0 G e2) ∨
             (peg0 G e1 ∨ peggt0 G e1) ∧ peggt0 G e2 ⇒
             peggt0 G (seq e1 e2 f)) ∧
  (∀e1 e2 f. peg0 G e1 ∧ peg0 G e2 ⇒ peg0 G (seq e1 e2 f)) ∧

  
  (∀e1 e2 f. peg0 G e1 ∨ (pegfail G e1 ∧ peg0 G e2) ⇒
             peg0 G (choice e1 e2 f)) ∧
  (∀e1 e2 f. pegfail G e1 ∧ pegfail G e2 ⇒ pegfail G (choice e1 e2 f)) ∧
  (∀e1 e2 f. peggt0 G e1 ∨ (pegfail G e1 ∧ peggt0 G e2) ⇒
             peggt0 G (choice e1 e2 f)) ∧

  
  (∀e c. pegfail G e ⇒ peg0 G (not e c)) ∧
  (∀e c. peg0 G e ∨ peggt0 G e ⇒ pegfail G (not e c)) ∧

  
  (∀e. pegfail G (error e))
