name: coreloop_def
statement:
coreloop G =
   OWHILE (λs. case s of Result _ => F
                       | _ => T)
          (λs. case s of
                   EV (empty v) i r eo errs k fk => AP k i (SOME v::r) eo errs
                 | EV (any tf) i r eo errs k fk =>
                   (case i of
                        [] => let err = (EOF, G.anyEOF)
                              in
                                AP fk i r (OME eo (SOME err)) (err::errs)
                      | h::t => AP k t (SOME (tf h) :: r) eo errs)
                 | EV (tok P tf2) i r eo errs k fk =>
                   (case i of
                        [] => let err = (EOF, G.tokEOF)
                              in
                                AP fk i r (OME eo (SOME err)) (err::errs)
                      | h::t => if P (FST h) then
                                  AP k t (SOME (tf2 h)::r) eo errs
                                else let err = (sloc i, G.tokFALSE)
                                     in AP fk i r (OME eo (SOME err))
                                           (err::errs))
                 | EV (nt n tf3) i r eo errs k fk =>
                   if n ∈ FDOM G.rules then
                     EV (G.rules ' n) i r eo errs (appf1 tf3 k) fk
                   else
                     Looped
                 | EV (seq e1 e2 f) i r eo errs k fk =>
                     EV e1 i r eo errs
                        (restoreEO eo
                         (ksym e2
                          (appf2 f k)
                          (cmpEO eo $ returnTo i r fk)))
                        fk
                 | EV (choice e1 e2 cf) i r eo errs k fk =>
                     EV e1 i r eo errs
                        (appf1 (cf o INL) k)
                        (returnTo i r
                         (ksym e2
                          (dropErr (appf1 (cf o INR) k))
                          (cmpErrs fk)))
                 | EV (rpt e lf) i r eo errs k fk =>
                     EV e i (NONE::r) eo errs
                        (restoreEO eo $ listsym e lf k)
                        (poplist lf k)
                 | EV (not e v) i r eo errs k fk =>
                     EV e i r eo errs
                        (restoreEO eo $
                           returnTo i r (addErr (sloc i) G.notFAIL fk))
                        (restoreEO eo $ returnTo i (SOME v::r) (dropErr k))
                 | EV (error err) i r eo errs k fk =>
                     let err = (sloc i, err)
                     in
                       AP fk i r (OME eo (SOME err)) (err :: errs)
                 | AP done i [] _ _ => Looped
                 | AP done i (NONE :: t) _ _ => Looped
                 | AP done i (SOME rv :: _) eo _ => Result (Success i rv eo)
                 | AP failed i r _ [] => Looped
                 | AP failed i r _ ((l,e)::_) => Result (Failure l e)
                 | AP (dropErr _) i r _ [] => Looped
                 | AP (dropErr k) i r eo (_ :: t) => AP k i r eo t
                 | AP (addErr l e k) i r eo errs =>
                     AP k i r (OME eo (SOME (l,e))) ((l,e)::errs)
                 | AP (cmpErrs k) i r _ [] => Looped
                 | AP (cmpErrs k) i r _ [_] => Looped
                 | AP (cmpErrs k) i r eo ((l2,er2)::(l1,er1)::rest) =>
                     AP k i r eo
                        ((if locsle l1 l2 then (l2,er2) else (l1,er1)) :: rest)
                 | AP (cmpEO eo1 k) i r eo2 [] => Looped
                 | AP (cmpEO eo1 k) i r eo2 ((l,err)::rest) =>
                     AP k i r (OME eo1 (SOME (l,err))) ((l,err)::rest)
                 | AP (ksym e k fk) i r eo errs => EV e i r eo errs k fk
                 | AP (appf1 f1 k) i (SOME v :: r) eo errs =>
                     AP k i (SOME (f1 v) :: r) eo errs
                 | AP (appf1 _ _) _ _ _ _ => Looped
                 | AP (appf2 f2 k) i (SOME v1 :: SOME v2 :: r) eo errs =>
                     AP k i (SOME (f2 v2 v1) :: r) eo errs
                 | AP (appf2 _ _) _ _ _ _ => Looped
                 | AP (returnTo i r k) i' r' eo errs => AP k i r eo errs
                 | AP (restoreEO eo k) i r eo' errs => AP k i r eo errs
                 | AP (listsym e f k) i r eo errs =>
                     EV e i r eo errs (restoreEO eo $ listsym e f k) (poplist f k)
                 | AP (poplist f k) i r eo [] => Looped
                 | AP (poplist f k) i r eo (e :: errs) =>
                     AP k i (poplistval f r) eo errs
                 | Result r => Result r
                 | Looped => Looped)

name: peg_exec_def
statement:
peg_exec (G:('atok,'bnt,'cvalue,'err)peg) e i r eo errs k fk =
    case coreloop G (EV e i r eo errs k fk) of
        SOME r => r
      | NONE => Looped

name: applykont_def
statement:
applykont G k i r eo errs =
  case coreloop G (AP k i r eo errs) of
    SOME r => r
  | NONE => Looped

        Success s v eo => SOME (s,v,eo)
      | _ => NONE
    else NONE

  decode (SUM f g) (SX_NUM n) = NONE ∧
  decode (SUM f g) (SX_STR s) = NONE ∧
  decode (SUM f g) (SX_SYM s) = NONE ∧
  decode (SUM f g) (SX_CONS s1 s2) =
  if s1 = SX_SYM "inl" then OPTION_MAP INL (decode f s2)
  else if s1 = SX_SYM "inr" then OPTION_MAP INR (decode g s2)

  decode (OPTION sc) (SX_SYM s) = (if s = "none" then SOME NONE else NONE) ∧
  decode (OPTION sc) (SX_CONS s1 s2) =
  if s1 = SX_SYM "some" then OPTION_MAP SOME (decode sc s2)

name: SUM0_def
statement:
SUM0 f g =
  ((λs. case s of
          SX_CONS s1 s2 =>
            if s1 = SX_SYM "inl" then OPTION_MAP INL $ decode f s2
            else if s1 = SX_SYM "inr" then OPTION_MAP INR $ decode g s2
            else NONE
        | _ => NONE),
   λsum. case sum of
         | INL x => SX_CONS (SX_SYM "inl") (encode f x)
         | INR y => SX_CONS (SX_SYM "inr") (encode g y))

                                          OPTION_MAP SOME (decode sc s2)
                                        else NONE
                     | _ => NONE),
                λaopt. case aopt of NONE => SX_SYM "none"
                                 | SOME a => SX_CONS (SX_SYM "some")
                                                     (encode sc a))

        case r2 of

name: peg_eval_seq_ASSOC
statement:
peg_eval G (toks, seq (seq s1 s2 (λa b. b)) s3 f) =
  peg_eval G (toks, seq s1 (seq s2 s3 f) (λa b. b))

name: gen_peg_eval_seqtok
statement:
peg_eval G ((c,l) :: toks, seq (tok P f) sym g) res =
  if P c then
    (∃fl fe. res = Failure fl fe ∧ peg_eval G (toks,sym) res) ∨
    ∃s2 c2 eo. res = Success s2 (g (f (c,l)) c2) eo ∧
               peg_eval G (toks,sym) (Success s2 c2 eo)
  else
    res = Failure l G.tokFALSE

name: gen_peg_eval_tok
statement:
peg_eval G ((c,l) :: toks, tok P f) res <=>
  if P c then res = Success toks (f (c,l)) NONE
  else res = Failure l G.tokFALSE

name: peg_eval_not
statement:
peg_eval G (i0, not s c) r ⇔
    ∃r0. peg_eval G (i0, s) r0 ∧
         ((∃v eo i. r0 = Success i v eo ∧
                    r = Failure (sloc i0) G.notFAIL) ∨
          (∃fl fe. r0 = Failure fl fe ∧ r = Success i0 c NONE))

name: peg_eval_any
statement:
peg_eval G (i0, any f) r ⇔
    i0 = [] ∧ r = Failure (Locs EOFpt EOFpt) G.anyEOF ∨
    ∃h t. i0 = h::t ∧ r = Success t (f h) NONE

name: peg_eval_valid_symbol
statement:
∀s. valid_symbol (MAP FST s) ⇒
      ∃eo.
        peg_eval sexpPEG (s,sexpPEG.start) (Success [] (SX_SYM (MAP FST s)) eo)

name: peg_eval_list_digits
statement:
∀s.
    EVERY isDigit (MAP FST s) ∧ (rst ≠ [] ⇒ ¬ isDigit (FST (HD rst))) ⇒
    ∃fl fe.
    peg_eval_list sexpPEG
                  (s ++ rst, nt(mkNT sxnt_digit) I)
                  (rst,MAP (SX_NUM o combin$C $- 48 o ORD) (MAP FST s),
                   fl, fe)

name: peg_eval_list_chars
statement:
∀loc l1 l2.
    EVERY isPrint l1 ⇒ escape_string l1 = MAP FST l2  ⇒
    ∃fe.
    peg_eval_list sexpPEG (l2 ++[(#"\"",loc)], nt (mkNT sxnt_strchar) I)
                  ([(#"\"",loc)],MAP (λc. SX_SYM [c]) l1,loc,fe)

name: sexpnum_requires_digits
statement:
¬isDigit c ⇒
  (peg_eval sexpPEG ((c,l)::rest, pnt sxnt_sexpnum) r ⇔
     r = Failure l sexpPEG.tokFALSE)

name: sexpsym_no_rparen
statement:
peg_eval sexpPEG ((#")", l) :: toks, pnt sxnt_sexpsym) r ⇔
  r = Failure l sexpPEG.tokFALSE

name: sexpsym_no_dot
statement:
peg_eval sexpPEG ((#".", l) :: toks, pnt sxnt_sexpsym) r ⇔
  r = Failure l sexpPEG.tokFALSE

name: peg_eval_sexp0_NONE
statement:
c = #")" ∨ c = #"." ⇒
  (peg_eval sexpPEG ((c,l)::rst,nt (mkNT sxnt_sexp0) I) res ⇔
     res = Failure l sexpPEG.notFAIL)

name: peg_eval_tokNIL
statement: peg_eval G ([], tok P f) r ⇔ r = Failure EOF G.tokEOF

name: peg_eval_seqtokNIL
statement: peg_eval G ([], seq (tok P f) sym g) r ⇔ r = Failure EOF G.tokEOF

name: seqgrabWS
statement:
inp ≠ [] ∧ ¬isSpace (FST (HD inp)) ⇒
  (peg_eval G (inp, seq (grabWS sym1) sym2 f) res ⇔
     peg_eval G (inp, seq sym1 sym2 f) res) ∧
  (peg_eval G (inp, pegf (grabWS sym) g) res ⇔
     peg_eval G (inp, pegf sym g) res) ∧
  (peg_eval G (inp, grabWS sym) res ⇔ peg_eval G (inp, sym) res)

name: grabWS_grabs
statement:
(peg_eval G ((#" ", l)::rest, grabWS sym) res ⇔
     peg_eval G (rest, grabWS sym) res) ∧
  (peg_eval G ((#" ", l)::rest, seq (grabWS sym1) sym2 f) res ⇔
     peg_eval G (rest, seq (grabWS sym1) sym2 f) res)

name: sxnt_normstrcharNIL
statement:
peg_eval sexpPEG ([], pnt sxnt_normstrchar) r ⇔
  r = Failure EOF sexpPEG.tokEOF

name: strip_dot_EQ_NILNONE
statement: strip_dot s = ([], NONE) ⇔ s = ⟪ ⟫

name: strip_dot_EQ_E
statement:
strip_dot s = (sexps, rest) ⇒
    s = FOLDR SX_CONS (case rest of
                         NONE => ⟪ ⟫
                       | SOME s0 => s0) sexps

name: option_sequence_EQ_NIL
statement: option_sequence l = SOME [] ⇔ l = []

name: peg_eval_rpt_never_fails
statement: ¬peg_eval G (inp, rpt sym f) (Failure fl fe)

name: print_nt_sym_consequences
statement:
print_nt sxnt_sexpsym (SX_SYM str) = SOME s ⇒
  ∃c s0. s = c::s0 ∧ isGraph c ∧ c ≠ #"'" ∧ c ≠ #"(" ∧ c ≠ #")" ∧ c ≠ #"." ∧
         c ≠ #"\"" ∧ ¬isDigit c ∧ str = s

name: peg_eval_print_nt
statement:
∀nt s strl rst str.
    print_nt nt s = SOME str ∧ (rst ≠ [] ⇒ FST(HD rst) ∈ stoppers nt) ⇒
    MAP FST strl = str ⇒
    ∃eo.
      peg_eval sexpPEG (strl ++ rst, pnt nt) (Success rst s eo)

name: print_nt_print_sexp
statement: ∀s. valid_sexp s ⇒ (print_nt sxnt_sexp s = SOME (print_sexp s))

name: peg_eval_print_sexp
statement:
∀s sl. valid_sexp s ⇒
         print_sexp s = MAP FST sl ⇒
         ∃eo.
           peg_eval sexpPEG (sl,sexpPEG.start) (Success [] s eo)

name: parse_print
statement: valid_sexp s ⇒ print_sexp s = MAP FST sl ⇒ parse_sexp sl = SOME s

name: parse_sexp_def
statement:
parse_sexp s =
    OPTION_BIND (pegparse sexpPEG s)
      (λ(rest,sx). OPTION_IGNORE_BIND (OPTION_GUARD (rest=[])) (SOME (FST sx)))

name: escape_string_def
statement:
escape_string s =
    case s of
    | "" => ""
    | #"\\"::s => "\\\\" ++ escape_string s
    | #"\""::s => "\\\"" ++ escape_string s
    | c::s => c::(escape_string s)

name: print_space_separated_def
statement:
(print_space_separated [] = "") ∧
  (print_space_separated [x] = x) ∧
  (print_space_separated (x::xs) = x ++ " " ++ print_space_separated xs)

name: strip_dot_def
statement:
strip_dot (SX_NUM n) = ([], SOME $ SX_NUM n) ∧
  strip_dot (SX_STR s) = ([], SOME $ SX_STR s) ∧
  strip_dot (SX_SYM s) =
    (if s = "nil" then ([], NONE) else ([], SOME $ SX_SYM s)) ∧
  strip_dot (SX_CONS a d) = let (ls,n) = strip_dot d in (a::ls,n)

name: print_sexp_def
statement:
(print_sexp (SX_SYM s) = s) ∧
  (print_sexp (SX_NUM n) = toString n) ∧
  (print_sexp (SX_STR s) = "\"" ++ escape_string s ++ "\"") ∧
  (print_sexp s =
   let (ls,n) = strip_dot s in
   case n of
   | NONE =>
     if LENGTH ls = 2 ∧ HD ls = SX_SYM "quote" then "'" ++ print_sexp (EL 1 ls)
     else "(" ++ print_space_separated (MAP print_sexp ls) ++ ")"
   | SOME last =>
       "(" ++ print_space_separated (MAP print_sexp ls) ++ " . " ++
       print_sexp last ++ ")")

name: nt_rank_def
statement:
(nt_rank sxnt_normstrchar = 0n) ∧
  (nt_rank sxnt_escapedstrchar = 0) ∧
  (nt_rank sxnt_strchar = 0) ∧
  (nt_rank sxnt_strcontents = 1) ∧
  (nt_rank sxnt_sexpseq = 2) ∧
  (nt_rank sxnt_sexp0 = 3) ∧
  (nt_rank sxnt_sexp = 4) ∧
  (nt_rank _ = 0)

name: dest_quote_def
statement:
(dest_quote (SX_CONS q (SX_CONS a n)) =
     if q = SX_SYM "quote" ∧ n = nil then
       SOME a
     else NONE) ∧
  dest_quote _ = NONE

name: print_nt_def
statement:
(print_nt sxnt_normstrchar (SX_SYM [c]) =
     if isPrint c ∧ c ≠ #"\"" ∧ c ≠ #"\\" then SOME [c] else NONE) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_normstrchar _ = NONE) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_escapedstrchar (SX_SYM [c]) =
    if c = #"\\" ∨ c = #"\"" then SOME [c] else NONE) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_strchar (SX_SYM [c]) =
    if c = #"\\" ∨ c = #"\"" then SOME (#"\\"::[c]) else
    if isPrint c then SOME [c] else NONE) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_strcontents (SX_STR str) =
    FOLDR (λc a. OPTION_MAP2 (++) (print_nt sxnt_strchar (SX_SYM [c])) a)
          (SOME "") str) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_sexpsym (SX_SYM str) =
   if ¬NULL str ∧ valid_first_symchar (HD str) ∧ EVERY valid_symchar (TL str)
   then SOME str
   else NONE) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_sexpsym _ = NONE) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_sexpseq sx =
   let (ls,n) = strip_dot sx in
   OPTION_BIND (option_sequence (MAP (print_nt sxnt_sexp0) ls))
   (λl1. OPTION_MAP (λl2. print_space_separated l1 ++ l2 ++ ")")
     (case n of NONE => SOME ""
      | SOME d =>
        if NULL ls then NONE else
          OPTION_MAP (APPEND " . ") (print_nt sxnt_sexp0 d)))) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_sexp0 (SX_STR str) =
    OPTION_MAP (λs. "\"" ++ s ++ "\"")
      (print_nt sxnt_strcontents (SX_STR str))) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_sexpnum (SX_NUM n) = SOME (toString n)) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_sexpnum _ = NONE) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_sexp0 (SX_SYM str) = print_nt sxnt_sexpsym (SX_SYM str)) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_sexp0 (SX_NUM n) = print_nt sxnt_sexpnum (SX_NUM n)) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_sexp0 sx =
   case dest_quote sx of SOME a => OPTION_MAP (APPEND "'") (print_nt sxnt_sexp0 a)
      | NONE => OPTION_MAP (APPEND "(") (print_nt sxnt_sexpseq sx)) ∧
  (print_nt sxnt_sexp sx = print_nt sxnt_sexp0 sx) ∧
  (print_nt _ _ = NONE)

name: stoppers_def
statement:
(stoppers sxnt_sexpnum = UNIV DIFF isDigit) ∧
  (stoppers sxnt_normstrchar = UNIV) ∧
  (stoppers sxnt_escapedstrchar = UNIV) ∧
  (stoppers sxnt_strchar = UNIV) ∧
  (stoppers sxnt_strcontents = {#"\""}) ∧
  (stoppers sxnt_sexpsym = UNIV DIFF valid_symchar) ∧
  (stoppers sxnt_sexp0 = UNIV DIFF valid_symchar DIFF isDigit) ∧
  (stoppers sxnt_sexpseq = UNIV) ∧
  (stoppers sxnt_sexp = ∅)

name: strip_sxcons_thm
statement:
strip_sxcons (SX_NUM n) = NONE ∧
  strip_sxcons (SX_SYM s) = (if s = "nil" then SOME [] else NONE) ∧
  strip_sxcons (SX_STR s) = NONE ∧
  strip_sxcons (SX_CONS h t) = OPTION_MAP (CONS h) (strip_sxcons t)

name: sxMEM_sizelt
statement: ∀s1 s2. sxMEM s1 s2 ⇒ sexp_size s1 < sexp_size s2

name: valid_first_symchar_def
statement:
valid_first_symchar c ⇔
    isGraph c ∧ c ∉ {#"'"; #"("; #")"; #"."; #"\""} ∧ ¬isDigit c

name: valid_symchar_def
statement: valid_symchar c ⇔ isGraph c ∧ c ∉ {#"'"; #"("; #")"}

name: valid_symbol_def
statement:
(valid_symbol "" ⇔ F) ∧
   (valid_symbol (c::cs) ⇔ valid_first_symchar c ∧ EVERY valid_symchar cs)

name: valid_sexp_def
statement:
(valid_sexp (SX_SYM s) ⇔ valid_symbol s) ∧
  (valid_sexp (SX_CONS s1 s2) ⇔ valid_sexp s1 ∧ valid_sexp s2) ∧
  (valid_sexp (SX_STR s) ⇔ EVERY isPrint s) ∧
  (valid_sexp s ⇔ T)

name: arb_sexp_def
statement: arb_sexp = SX_NUM 0

name: destSXNUM_def
statement:
destSXNUM (SX_NUM n) = n ∧
  destSXNUM _ = 0

name: destSXSYM_def
statement:
destSXSYM (SX_SYM s) = s ∧
  destSXSYM _ = ""

name: destSXCONS_def
statement:
destSXCONS (SX_CONS a d) = (a,d) ∧
  destSXCONS _ = (arb_sexp, arb_sexp)

name: strip_sxcons_def
statement:
strip_sxcons s =
    case s of
        SX_CONS h t => OPTION_MAP (CONS h) (strip_sxcons t)
      | SX_SYM s => if s = "nil" then SOME []
                    else NONE
      | _ => NONE

name: csize_lem
statement: !plist p. MEM p plist ==> csize (SND p) < list_size (\(a,c). csize c) plist

name: lvprefixes_refl
statement: !lval. lval IN lvprefixes lval

name: lvprefixes_Recd_downclosed
statement: !x lval fld. RecdProj lval fld IN lvprefixes x ==> lval IN lvprefixes x

name: lvsize_lvprefixes
statement: !lval lv. lv IN lvprefixes lval ==> lvsize lv < lvsize lval \/ lv = lval

name: IN_Contig_Lang
statement:
!s.
     (s IN Contig_Lang theta (Basic a) <=> LENGTH s = atomWidth a) /\
     (s IN Contig_Lang theta Void <=> F) /\
     (s IN Contig_Lang theta (Assert b) <=> (s = "" /\ evalBexp theta b = SOME T)) /\
     (s IN Contig_Lang theta (Recd fields) <=>
        ?slist. s = CONCAT slist /\
                LIST_REL (\s contig. s IN Contig_Lang theta contig) slist (MAP SND fields)) /\
     (s IN Contig_Lang theta (Array c e) <=>
        ?slist.
            evalExp theta e = SOME (LENGTH slist) /\
            s = CONCAT slist /\
            EVERY (Contig_Lang theta c) slist) /\
     (s IN Contig_Lang theta (List c) <=>
       ?slist.
            s = STRCAT (CONCAT slist) [NilTag] /\
            EVERY (\plist. ?elt. plist = ConsTag::elt /\ elt IN Contig_Lang theta c) slist) /\
     (s IN Contig_Lang theta (Alt bexp c1 c2) <=>
         ?b. evalBexp theta bexp = SOME b /\
              if b then s IN Contig_Lang theta c1
                   else s IN Contig_Lang theta c2)

name: Assert_Eliminable
statement: Contig_Lang theta (Assert b) = Contig_Lang theta (Alt b (Recd []) Void)

name: atomWidth_pos
statement: !b. 0 < atomWidth b

name: evalExp_submap
statement:
!e theta1 theta2 v.
   theta1 SUBMAP theta2 /\
   evalExp theta1 e = SOME v
   ==>
   evalExp theta2 e = SOME v

name: evalBexp_submap
statement:
!bexp theta1 theta2 v.
   theta1 SUBMAP theta2 /\
   evalBexp theta1 bexp = SOME v
   ==>
   evalBexp theta2 bexp = SOME v

name: matchFn_submap
statement:
!wklist s theta s2 theta'.
    matchFn (wklist,s,theta) = SOME (s2, theta')
    ==>
   finite_map$SUBMAP theta theta'

name: matchFn_substWk_lem
statement:
!wklist (s:string) theta s2 theta'.
   matchFn (wklist,s,theta) = SOME (s2, theta')
   ==>
   ?s1. substWk theta' wklist = SOME s1 /\ s1 ++ s2 = s

name: matchFn_substWk_thm
statement:
!wklist (s:string) theta s2 theta'.
    matchFn (wklist,s,theta) = SOME (s2, theta')
    ==>
    THE (substWk theta' wklist) ++ s2 = s

name: every_list_rel_replicate
statement:
!list a R.
    EVERY (R a) list <=> LIST_REL (\x y. R y x)  list (REPLICATE (LENGTH list) a)

name: Singleton_Recd
statement:
!s theta contig fName.
     s IN Contig_Lang theta (Recd [(fName,contig)])
      <=>
     s IN Contig_Lang theta contig

name: field_names_ignored
statement:
!plist1 plist2 theta.
     (MAP SND plist1 = MAP SND plist2)
    ==>
    Contig_Lang theta (Recd plist1) = Contig_Lang theta (Recd plist2)

name: Recd_flat
statement:
!s plist1 plist2 theta fName.
   s IN Contig_Lang theta (Recd ((fName,Recd plist1)::plist2)) <=>
   s IN Contig_Lang theta (Recd (plist1 ++ plist2))

name: Array_flat
statement:
!s e n c clist theta.
  evalExp theta e = SOME n
   ==>
   (s IN Contig_Lang theta (arb_labels(Array c e::clist))
    <=>
    s IN Contig_Lang theta (arb_labels(REPLICATE n c ⧺ clist)))

name: Alt_flatA
statement:
!s b c1 c2 clist theta.
  evalBexp theta b = SOME T
   ==>
   (s IN Contig_Lang theta (arb_labels(Alt b c1 c2::clist))
    <=>
    s IN Contig_Lang theta (arb_labels(c1::clist)))

name: Alt_flatB
statement:
!s b c1 c2 clist theta.
  evalBexp theta b = SOME F
   ==>
   (s IN Contig_Lang theta (arb_labels(Alt b c1 c2::clist))
    <=>
    s IN Contig_Lang theta (arb_labels(c2::clist)))

name: matchFn_wklist_sound
statement:
!wklist s fmap suffix theta.
   matchFn (wklist,s,fmap) = SOME (suffix, theta)
    ==>
   ?prefix. (s = prefix ++ suffix) /\
            prefix IN Contig_Lang theta (arb_labels(MAP SND wklist))

name: matchFn_sound
statement:
!contig s theta lval.
   matchFn ([(lval,contig)],s,FEMPTY) = SOME ("", theta)
    ==>
   s IN Contig_Lang theta contig

name: layout_def
statement: layout b n width = PAD_RIGHT 0n width (n2l b n)

name: repFn_def
statement: repFn w n = MAP CHR (layout 256 n w)

name: valFn_def
statement: valFn s = if s = "" then NONE else SOME (l2n 256 (MAP ORD s))

name: evalExp_def
statement:
evalExp theta (Loc lval) =
   (case FLOOKUP theta lval
     of SOME (a,s) => valFn s
      | NONE => NONE) /\
 evalExp theta (numLit n)  = SOME n /\
 evalExp theta (Add e1 e2) =
   (case evalExp theta e1
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME n1 =>
    case evalExp theta e2
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME n2 => SOME (n1+n2))

name: evalBexp_def
statement:
(evalBexp theta (boolLit b) = SOME b) /\
 (evalBexp theta (BLoc lval) =
    case FLOOKUP theta lval
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME (a,s) =>
     case valFn s
      of NONE => NONE
      | SOME n => SOME (~(n = 0n))) /\
 (evalBexp theta (Bnot b) =
   case evalBexp theta b
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME bval => SOME (~bval)) /\
 (evalBexp theta (Bor b1 b2) =
   case evalBexp theta b1
     of NONE => NONE
     |  SOME bv1 =>
    case evalBexp theta b2
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME bv2 => SOME (bv1 \/ bv2)) /\
 (evalBexp theta (Band b1 b2) =
   case evalBexp theta b1
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME bv1 =>
    case evalBexp theta b2
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME bv2 => SOME (bv1 /\ bv2)) /\
 (evalBexp theta (Beq e1 e2) =
   case evalExp theta e1
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME n1 =>
    case evalExp theta e2
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME n2 => SOME (n1 = n2)) /\
 (evalBexp theta (Blt e1 e2) =
   case evalExp theta e1
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME n1 =>
    case evalExp theta e2
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME n2 => SOME (n1 < n2))

name: atomWidth_def
statement:
atomWidth Bool = 1 /\
 atomWidth Char = 1 /\
 atomWidth U8   = 1 /\
 atomWidth U16  = 2 /\
 atomWidth U32  = 4

name: csize_def
statement:
(csize (Basic a)     = 0) /\
  (csize Void          = 0) /\
  (csize (Assert b)    = 0) /\
  (csize (Recd fields) = 1 + list_size (\(a,c). csize c) fields) /\
  (csize (Array c dim) = 1 + csize c) /\
  (csize (List c)      = 1 + csize c) /\
  (csize (Alt b c1 c2) = 1 + csize c1 + csize c2)

name: lvsize_def
statement:
lvsize (VarName s) = 1 /\
  lvsize (RecdProj lv s) = 1 + lvsize lv /\
  lvsize (ArraySub lv e) = 1 + lvsize lv

name: lvprefixes_def
statement:
lvprefixes (VarName s) = {VarName s} /\
  lvprefixes (RecdProj lv s) = (RecdProj lv s INSERT lvprefixes lv) /\
  lvprefixes (ArraySub lv e) = (ArraySub lv e INSERT lvprefixes lv)

name: lvdescendants_def
statement: lvdescendants theta lval = {path | path IN FDOM theta /\ lval IN lvprefixes path}

name: NilTag_def
statement: NilTag = CHR 0

name: ConsTag_def
statement: ConsTag = CHR 1

name: Contig_Lang_def
statement:
Contig_Lang theta (Basic a) = {s | LENGTH s = atomWidth a} /\
  Contig_Lang theta Void = {} /\
  Contig_Lang theta (Assert b) =
    (case evalBexp theta b
      of NONE => {}
       | SOME T => {""}
       | SOME F => {}) /\
  Contig_Lang theta (Recd fields) =
    {CONCAT slist
      | LIST_REL (\s contig. s IN Contig_Lang theta contig) slist (MAP SND fields)} /\
  Contig_Lang theta (Array c e) =
    (case evalExp theta e
      of NONE => {}
       | SOME n =>
     {CONCAT slist
       | (LENGTH slist = n) /\ EVERY (Contig_Lang theta c) slist}) /\
  Contig_Lang theta (List c) =
      (KSTAR ({[ConsTag]} dot (Contig_Lang theta c)) dot {[NilTag]}) /\
  Contig_Lang theta (Alt bexp c1 c2) =
    (case evalBexp theta bexp
      of NONE => {}
       | SOME T => Contig_Lang theta c1
       | SOME F => Contig_Lang theta c2)

name: choiceFn_def
statement:
choiceFn theta bexp =
    case evalBexp theta bexp
     of NONE => F
      | SOME bval => bval

name: indexFn_def
statement: indexFn lval c n = (ArraySub lval (numLit n),c)

name: fieldFn_def
statement: fieldFn lval (fName,c) = (RecdProj lval fName,c)

name: ListRecd_def
statement:
ListRecd lval c =
    (lval,
     Alt (Beq (Loc (RecdProj lval "tag")) (numLit 0)) (Recd [])
     (Alt (Beq (Loc (RecdProj lval "tag"))  (numLit 1))
          (Recd [("hd",c); ("tl", List c)])
          Void))

name: predFn_def
statement:
predFn (worklist,s,theta) =
  case worklist
   of [] => T
    | (lval,Basic a)::t =>
        (case take_drop (atomWidth a) s
          of NONE => F
           | SOME (segment,rst) => predFn (t,rst,theta |+ (lval,(a,segment))))
   | (lval,Void)::t => F
   | (lval,Assert b)::t =>
       (case evalBexp theta b
         of NONE   => F
          | SOME F => F
          | SOME T => predFn (t,s,theta))
   | (lval,Recd fields)::t =>
       predFn (MAP (fieldFn lval) fields ++ t,s,theta)
   | (lval,Array c exp)::t =>
       (case evalExp theta exp
         of NONE => F
          | SOME dim =>
            predFn (MAP (indexFn lval c) (COUNT_LIST dim) ++ t,s,theta))
   | (lval, List c)::t =>
      (case take_drop (atomWidth U8) s
        of NONE => F
         | SOME (segment,rst) =>
              predFn (ListRecd lval c::t, rst,
                      theta |+ (RecdProj lval "tag",(U8,segment))))
   | (lval,Alt bexp c1 c2)::t =>
       case evalBexp theta bexp
        of NONE => F
         | SOME T => predFn ((lval,c1)::t,s,theta)
         | SOME F => predFn ((lval,c2)::t,s,theta)

name: matchFn_def
statement:
matchFn (worklist,s,theta) =
 case worklist
  of [] => SOME (s,theta)
   | (lval,Basic a)::t =>
       (case take_drop (atomWidth a) s
         of NONE => NONE
          | SOME (segment,rst) =>
        if lval IN FDOM theta then
            NONE
        else matchFn (t, rst, theta |+ (lval,(a,segment))))
   | (lval,Void)::t => NONE
   | (lval,Assert b)::t =>
       (case evalBexp theta b
         of NONE   => NONE
          | SOME F => NONE
          | SOME T => matchFn (t,s,theta))
   | (lval,Recd fields)::t =>
        matchFn (MAP (fieldFn lval) fields ++ t,s,theta)
   | (lval,Array c exp)::t =>
       (case evalExp theta exp
         of NONE => NONE
          | SOME dim =>
             matchFn (MAP (indexFn lval c) (COUNT_LIST dim) ++ t,s,theta))
   | (lval, List c)::t =>
      (case take_drop (atomWidth U8) s
           of NONE => NONE
            | SOME (segment,rst) =>
              if RecdProj lval "tag" IN FDOM theta then
                 NONE
              else
              matchFn (ListRecd lval c::t, rst,
                       theta |+ (RecdProj lval "tag",(U8,segment))))
   | (lval,Alt bexp c1 c2)::t =>
       case evalBexp theta bexp
        of NONE => NONE
         | SOME T => matchFn ((lval,c1)::t,s,theta)
         | SOME F => matchFn ((lval,c2)::t,s,theta)

name: remaining_lvals_def
statement: remaining_lvals(theta,lval) = CARD(lvdescendants theta lval)

name: substFn_def
statement:
substFn theta (lval,contig) =
  case contig
   of Basic _ =>
        (case FLOOKUP theta lval
          of NONE => NONE
           | SOME(a,segment) => SOME segment)
    | Void  => NONE
    | Assert b =>
       (case evalBexp theta b
         of NONE   => NONE
          | SOME F => NONE
          | SOME T => SOME "")
    | Recd fields =>
       concatPartial
         (MAP (\(fName,c). substFn theta (RecdProj lval fName,c)) fields)
    | Array c exp =>
       (case evalExp theta exp
         of NONE => NONE
          | SOME dim =>
            concatPartial
               (MAP (\i. substFn theta (ArraySub lval (numLit i), c))
                    (COUNT_LIST dim)))
    | List c =>
       (case FLOOKUP theta (RecdProj lval "tag")
         of NONE => NONE
          | SOME (a,segment) =>
            if a = U8 /\ segment = [NilTag] then
               SOME segment
            else
            if a = U8 /\ segment = [ConsTag] then
             concatPartial
                 [SOME segment;
                  substFn theta (RecdProj lval "hd",c);
                  substFn theta (RecdProj lval "tl",List c)]
            else NONE
       )
    | Alt bexp c1 c2 =>
       (case evalBexp theta bexp
         of NONE => NONE
          | SOME T => substFn theta (lval,c1)
          | SOME F => substFn theta (lval,c2))

name: substWk_def
statement: substWk theta wklist = concatPartial (MAP (substFn theta) wklist)

name: arb_labels_def
statement: arb_labels clist = Recd (MAP (\c. (ARB, c)) clist)

name: SKOLEM_SUBSET
statement:
!P Q.
    (!x. P x ==> ?y. Q x y) <=> ?f. !x. P x ==> Q x (f x)

name: IS_SOME_NEG
statement: IS_SOME = \x. ~(x=NONE)

name: strlen_eq
statement:
!(s:string) m. (STRLEN L = m)
       <=>
       (m = 0 /\ L = []) \/
       (0 < m /\ ?n t. L = CHR n::t /\ n < 256 /\ STRLEN t = m - 1)

name: strlen_eq_1
statement: !L. (STRLEN L = 1) <=> ?n. n < 256 /\ L = [CHR n]

name: tdrop_thm
statement:
!n list acc acc'.
     tdrop n list acc = SOME (acc',suf)
     <=>
     (acc' ++ suf = REVERSE acc ++ list) /\
     (LENGTH acc' = n + LENGTH acc)

name: take_drop_thm
statement:
!n list.
      take_drop n list = SOME (pref,suf) <=> pref ++ suf = list /\ (n = LENGTH pref)

name: upto_interval_thm
statement: !lo hi. set(upto lo hi) = {n | lo <= n /\ n <= hi}

name: length_upto
statement: !lo hi. lo <= hi ==> LENGTH(upto lo hi) = (hi-lo) + 1

name: concatPartial_acc_NONE
statement:
!optlist acc list.
  (concatPartial_acc optlist acc = NONE)
   <=>
  EXISTS (\x. x=NONE) optlist

name: concatPartial_acc_SOME
statement:
!optlist acc list.
  (concatPartial_acc optlist acc = SOME list)
   <=>
  EVERY IS_SOME optlist /\
  (list = REVERSE (MAP THE optlist) ++ acc)

name: concatPartial_NONE
statement:
!optlist.
  (concatPartial optlist = NONE)
   =
  EXISTS (\x. x=NONE) optlist

name: concatPartial_SOME
statement:
!optlist list.
  (concatPartial optlist = SOME list)
  <=>
  EVERY IS_SOME optlist /\
  (list = FLAT (MAP THE optlist))

name: concatPartial_thm
statement:
concatPartial optlist =
    if EXISTS (\x. x=NONE) optlist
       then NONE
    else SOME (FLAT (MAP THE optlist))

name: concatPartial_nil
statement: concatPartial [] = SOME []

name: tdrop_def
statement:
tdrop 0 list acc = SOME (REVERSE acc, list) /\
  tdrop n [] acc = NONE /\
  tdrop (SUC n) (h::t) acc = tdrop n t (h::acc)

name: take_drop_def
statement: take_drop n list = tdrop n list []

name: upto_def
statement: upto lo hi = if lo > hi then [] else lo::upto (lo+1) hi

name: concatPartial_acc_def
statement:
concatPartial_acc [] acc = SOME acc /\
  concatPartial_acc (NONE::t) acc = NONE /\
  concatPartial_acc (SOME x::t) acc = concatPartial_acc t (x::acc)

name: concatPartial_def
statement:
concatPartial optlist =
    case concatPartial_acc optlist []
     of NONE => NONE
      | SOME list => SOME (FLAT (REVERSE list))

name: mem_alphabet
statement: !c. MEM c ALPHABET ==> c < alphabet_size

name: alphabet_mem
statement: !c. c < alphabet_size ==> MEM c ALPHABET

name: mem_alphabet_iff
statement: !c. MEM c ALPHABET <=> c < alphabet_size

name: ORD_CHR_lem
statement: !c. c < alphabet_size ==> (ORD(CHR c) = c)

name: charset_mem_empty
statement:
!c.
   ~charset_mem c charset_empty

name: charset_mem_union
statement:
!c cs1 cs2.
    charset_mem c (charset_union cs1 cs2) <=> charset_mem c cs1 \/ charset_mem c cs2

name: num_cmp_eq
statement:
!k1 k2.
   (num_cmp k1 k2 = Equal) <=> (k1 = k2)

name: charset_cmp_eq
statement:
!cs1 cs2.
   (charset_cmp cs1 cs2 = Equal) <=> (cs1 = cs2)

name: charset_cmp_less
statement:
!u1 u2 u3 u4 v1 v2 v3 v4.
    (charset_cmp (Charset u1 u2 u3 u4) (Charset v1 v2 v3 v4) = Less)
   <=>
    w2n u1 < w2n v1
    \/ (w2n u1 = w2n v1) /\ w2n u2 < w2n v2
    \/ (w2n u1 = w2n v1) /\ (w2n u2 = w2n v2) /\ w2n u3 < w2n v3
    \/ (w2n u1 = w2n v1) /\ (w2n u2 = w2n v2) /\ (w2n u3 = w2n v3) /\ w2n u4 < w2n v4

name: charset_cmp_strict
statement:
!cs1 cs2.
   (charset_cmp cs1 cs2 = Less) <=> (charset_cmp cs2 cs1 = Greater)

name: charset_cmp_trans
statement:
!cs1 cs2 cs3.
      (charset_cmp cs1 cs2 = Less) /\
      (charset_cmp cs2 cs3 = Less)
      ==>
      (charset_cmp cs1 cs3 = Less)

name: alphabet_size_def
statement: alphabet_size = ^(numSyntax.term_of_int Regexp_Type.alphabet_size)

name: ALPHABET_def
statement: ALPHABET = ^(rhs (concl (EVAL ``GENLIST I alphabet_size``)))

name: charset_empty_def
statement: charset_empty = Charset 0w 0w 0w 0w

name: charset_full_def
statement: charset_full = Charset (~0w) (~0w) (~0w) (~0w)

name: words4_bit_def
statement:
words4_bit c (Charset w1 w2 w3 w4) =
     if c < 128 then
       (if c < 64 then word_bit c w1 else word_bit (c-64) w2)
     else
       (if c < 192 then word_bit (c-128) w3 else word_bit (c-192) w4)

name: charset_mem_def
statement: charset_mem c (cs:charset) <=> c < alphabet_size /\ words4_bit c cs

name: charset_union_def
statement:
charset_union (cs1:charset) (cs2:charset) =
    if cs1 = cs2 then cs1 else
    if cs1 = charset_empty then cs2 else
    if cs2 = charset_empty then cs1
    else
    case (cs1,cs2)
     of (Charset u1 u2 u3 u4, Charset v1 v2 v3 v4)
        => Charset (word_or u1 v1)
                   (word_or u2 v2)
                   (word_or u3 v3)
                   (word_or u4 v4)

name: charset_sing_def
statement:
charset_sing c =
     let n = ORD c
     in if n < 64  then Charset (1w << n) 0w 0w 0w else
        if n < 128 then Charset 0w (1w << (n-64)) 0w 0w else
        if n < 192 then Charset 0w 0w (1w << (n-128)) 0w
        else Charset 0w 0w 0w (1w << (n-192))

name: charset_insert_def
statement: charset_insert c cset = charset_union (charset_sing c) cset

name: charset_cmp_def
statement:
charset_cmp (Charset u1 u2 u3 u4) (Charset v1 v2 v3 v4) =
    case num_cmp (w2n u1) (w2n v1)
      of Less => Less
       | Greater => Greater
       | Equal =>
    case num_cmp (w2n u2) (w2n v2)
      of Less => Less
       | Greater => Greater
       | Equal =>
    case num_cmp (w2n u3) (w2n v3)
      of Less => Less
       | Greater => Greater
       | Equal =>
    num_cmp (w2n u4) (w2n v4)

name: charset_string_def
statement:
charset_string s =
      FOLDL (\a c. charset_union a (charset_sing c))
            charset_empty
            s

name: MEM_ZIP_IMP
statement:
!l1 l2 a b.
     MEM (a,b) (ZIP (l1,l2)) ==> MEM a l1 /\ MEM b l2

name: zip_append
statement:
!l1 l2 l3 l4.
   (LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2) /\
   (LENGTH l3 = LENGTH l4)
   ==>
    (ZIP (l1 ++ l3, l2 ++ l4) = ZIP (l1,l2) ++ ZIP (l3,l4))

name: regexp_induction
statement:
!P Q.
     (!cs. P (Chset cs)) /\
     (!r r0. P r /\ P r0 ==> P (Cat r r0)) /\
     (!r. P r ==> P (Star r)) /\ (!l. Q l ==> P (Or l)) /\
     (!r. P r ==> P (Neg r)) /\ Q [] /\ (!r l. P r /\ Q l ==> Q (r::l)) ==>
     (!r. P r) /\ !l. Q l

name: rsize_or_lem
statement: !l a. MEM a l ==> rsize a < rsize (Or l)

name: rsizel_append
statement: !l1 l2. rsizel (l1 ++ l2) = rsizel (l1) + rsizel (l2)

name: regexp_lang_thm
statement:
(regexp_lang (Chset ns) w = ?c. charset_mem c ns /\ (w = [CHR c])) /\
   (regexp_lang (Cat r s) w  = ?w1 w2. regexp_lang r w1 /\
                                       regexp_lang s w2 /\ (w = w1++w2)) /\
   (regexp_lang (Star r) w   = ?ws. EVERY (regexp_lang r) ws /\ (w = FLAT ws)) /\
   (regexp_lang (Neg r) w    = ~regexp_lang r w) /\
   (regexp_lang (Or rlist) w = EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r w) rlist)

name: regexp_lang_epsilon
statement: regexp_lang Epsilon = {""}

name: regexp_lang_empty
statement: regexp_lang Empty = EMPTY

name: regexp_lang_epsilon_thm
statement: !s. regexp_lang Epsilon s <=> (s = "")

name: regexp_lang_empty_thm
statement: !s. regexp_lang Empty s <=> F

name: regexp_lang_dot
statement: regexp_lang DOT = \w. ?c. w = [c]

name: regexp_lang_dot_star
statement: regexp_lang (Star DOT) = \w. T

name: union_compl
statement: !s. s UNION COMPL s = UNIV

name: regexp_lang_invol
statement: !r. regexp_lang (Or [r ; Neg r]) = \w. T

name: regexp_lang_invol_dot_star
statement: !r. regexp_lang (Or [r ; Neg r]) = regexp_lang (Star DOT)

name: regexp_lang_dot_star_negempty
statement: regexp_lang (Star DOT) = regexp_lang (Neg Empty)

name: len_cmp_sym
statement: !l1 l2. (len_cmp l1 l2 = Equal) <=> (len_cmp l2 l1 = Equal)

name: len_cmp_thm
statement:
!l1 l2. len_cmp l1 l2 =
           if (LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2) then Equal else
           if (LENGTH l1 < LENGTH l2) then Less else Greater

name: len_cmp_neq
statement: !l1 l2. (len_cmp l1 l2 <> Equal) ==> (l1 <> l2)

name: len_cmp_length
statement:
!l1 l2.
    ((len_cmp l1 l2 = Equal) ==> (LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2)) /\
    ((len_cmp l1 l2 = Less) ==> (LENGTH l1 < LENGTH l2)) /\
    ((len_cmp l1 l2 = Greater) ==> (LENGTH l2 < LENGTH l1))

name: len_cmp_strict
statement: !l1 l2. (len_cmp l1 l2 = Less) <=> (len_cmp l2 l1 = Greater)

name: len_cmp_good_lem0
statement: !l1 l2. (len_cmp l1 l2 = Equal) <=> (len_cmp l2 l1 = Equal)

name: len_cmp_good_lem1
statement: !l1 l2. (l1 = l2) ==> (len_cmp l1 l2 = Equal)

name: len_cmp_good_lem2
statement: !l1 l2. (len_cmp l1 l2 = Greater) <=> (len_cmp l2 l1 = Less)

name: len_cmp_good_lem3
statement: !l1 l2 l3. (len_cmp l1 l2 = Less) /\ (len_cmp l2 l3 = Equal) ==> (len_cmp l1 l3 = Less)

name: len_cmp_good_lem4
statement: !l1 l2 l3. (len_cmp l1 l2 = Less) /\ (len_cmp l2 l3 = Less) ==> (len_cmp l1 l3 = Less)

name: len_cmp_good
statement: good_cmp len_cmp

name: len_cmp_zip
statement:
!l1 l2 l3 l4. (len_cmp l1 l2 = Equal) ==>
    (ZIP (l1,l2) ++ ZIP (l3,l4) = ZIP (l1++l3,l2++l4))

name: regexp_compareW_thm
statement:
(regexp_compareW [] = Equal) /\
  (regexp_compareW ((Chset cs1, Chset cs2)::t) =
     (case charset_cmp cs1 cs2
       of Equal => regexp_compareW t
        | result => result)) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Chset cs1,Cat v15 v16)::t) = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Chset cs1,Star v17)::t) = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Chset cs1,Or v18)::t) = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Chset cs1,Neg v19)::t) = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Cat r1 r2,Chset v26)::t) = Greater) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Cat r1 r2,Cat r3 r4)::t) = regexp_compareW ((r1,r3)::(r2,r4)::t)) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Cat r1 r2,Star v29)::t) = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Cat r1 r2,Or v30)::t) = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Cat r1 r2,Neg v31)::t) = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Star r,Chset v38)::t) = Greater) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Star r,Cat v39 v40)::t) = Greater) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Star r,Star s)::t) = regexp_compareW ((r,s)::t)) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Star r,Or v42)::t) = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Star r,Neg v43)::t) = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Or rs1,Chset v50)::t) = Greater) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Or rs1,Cat v51 v52)::t) = Greater) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Or rs1,Star v53)::t) = Greater) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Or rs1,Or rs2)::t) =
         (case len_cmp rs1 rs2 of
            Less => Less
          | Equal => regexp_compareW (ZIP (rs1,rs2) ++ t)
          | Greater => Greater)) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Or rs1,Neg v55)::t) = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Neg r',Chset v62)::t) = Greater) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Neg r',Cat v63 v64)::t) = Greater) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Neg r',Star v65)::t) = Greater) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Neg r',Or v66)::t) = Greater) /\
   (regexp_compareW ((Neg r',Neg s')::t) = regexp_compareW ((r',s')::t))

name: regexp_compareW_prefix_eq
statement:
!plist L1 L2.
     (plist = L1 ++ L2) /\ EVERY (\p. FST p = SND p) L1
     ==>
     regexp_compareW plist = regexp_compareW L2

name: regexp_compareW_compute
statement:
!plist.
   regexp_compareW plist =
    case plist of
     | [] => Equal
     | pair::t =>
        if FST pair = SND pair then regexp_compareW t
        else
        case pair of
        | (Chset cs1, Chset cs2) => charset_cmp cs1 cs2
        | (Chset cs, r)          => Less
        | (Cat r s, Chset cs)    => Greater
        | (Cat r1 r2, Cat r3 r4) => regexp_compareW ((r1,r3)::(r2,r4)::t)
        | (Cat r s, r1)          => Less
        | (Star r, Chset cs)     => Greater
        | (Star r, Cat r1 s)     => Greater
        | (Star r, Star s)       => regexp_compareW ((r,s)::t)
        | (Star r, s)            => Less
        | (Or rs, Chset cs)      => Greater
        | (Or rs, Cat r s)       => Greater
        | (Or rs, Star r)        => Greater
        | (Or rs1, Or rs2) =>
            (case len_cmp rs1 rs2 of
              | Equal => regexp_compareW (ZIP (rs1,rs2) ++ t)
              | verdict => verdict)
        | (Or rs, r)     => Less
        | (Neg r, Neg s) => regexp_compareW ((r,s)::t)
        | (Neg r, r1)    => Greater

name: regexp_compareW_eq
statement:
!plist l1 l2.
    (LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2) /\ (ZIP (l1,l2) = plist)
    ==>
    ((regexp_compareW plist = Equal) <=> (l1 = l2))

name: regexp_compareW_Equal
statement: !plist. regexp_compareW plist = Equal <=> EVERY (UNCURRY $=) plist

name: regexp_compare_eq
statement: !r s. (regexp_compare r s = Equal) <=> (r = s)

name: regexp_compareW_antisym
statement:
!plist l1 l2.
    (LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2) /\ (ZIP (l1,l2) = plist)
     ==>
     ((regexp_compareW plist = Greater) <=> (regexp_compareW (ZIP (l2,l1)) = Less))

name: regexp_compare_antisym
statement: !r s. (regexp_compare r s = Greater) <=> (regexp_compare s r = Less)

name: regexp_compareW_trans
statement:
!plist l1 l2 l3.
   (LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2) /\ (LENGTH l2 = LENGTH l3) /\
   (plist = ZIP (l1,l2)) /\
   (regexp_compareW plist = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW (ZIP (l2,l3)) = Less)
    ==>
   (regexp_compareW (ZIP (l1,l3)) = Less)

name: regexp_compare_trans
statement:
!r s u. (regexp_compare r s = Less) /\ (regexp_compare s u = Less)
         ==>
         (regexp_compare r u = Less)

name: regexp_compareW_trans_eq
statement:
!plist l1 l2 l3.
   (LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2) /\ (LENGTH l2 = LENGTH l3) /\
   (plist = ZIP (l1,l2)) /\
   (regexp_compareW plist = Less) /\
   (regexp_compareW (ZIP (l2,l3)) = Equal)
    ==>
   (regexp_compareW (ZIP (l1,l3)) = Less)

name: regexp_compare_trans_eq
statement:
!r s u. (regexp_compare r s = Less) /\ (regexp_compare s u = Equal)
         ==>
         (regexp_compare r u = Less)

name: regexp_compare_good
statement: good_cmp regexp_compare

name: regexp_leq_total
statement: total regexp_leq

name: regexp_leq_transitive
statement: transitive regexp_leq

name: regexp_leq_antisym
statement: antisymmetric regexp_leq

name: regexp_compare_id
statement: !r. regexp_compare r r = Equal

name: regexp_empty_thm
statement: !r.  is_regexp_empty r ==> !w. ~regexp_lang r w

name: nullableW_thm
statement: !rlist. nullableW rlist <=> EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r "") rlist

name: nullable_thm
statement: !r. nullable r <=> regexp_lang r ""

name: split_concat
statement:
!ss c s.
   (c::s = CONCAT ss)
   ==>
   ?ss1 s2 ss3. EVERY (\s. s = "") ss1 /\ (ss = ss1++[c::s2]++ss3)

name: concat_empties
statement: !ss1. EVERY (\s. s = []) ss1 ==> (CONCAT ss1 = [])

name: deriv_thm
statement:
(!r c s. regexp_lang r (c::s) = regexp_lang (deriv (ORD c) r) s) /\
 (!rs c s. regexp_lang (Or rs) (c::s) = regexp_lang (deriv (ORD c) (Or rs)) s)

name: regexp_lang_deriv
statement: !r s. regexp_lang r s = deriv_matches r s

name: regexp_lang_eqns
statement:
(!s. regexp_lang (Chset charset_empty) s = F) /\
 (!r1 r2 r3 s.
    regexp_lang (Cat (Cat r1 r2) r3) s = regexp_lang (Cat r1 (Cat r2 r3)) s) /\
 (!s. regexp_lang (Or []) s = F) /\
 (!s r. regexp_lang (Or [r]) s = regexp_lang r s) /\
 (!r. (!s. regexp_lang r s = F) ==>
      (!r' s. regexp_lang (Cat r' r) s = F) /\
      (!r' s. regexp_lang (Cat r r') s = F) /\
      (!s. regexp_lang (Star r) s = (s = ""))) /\
 (!r. (!s. regexp_lang r s = (s = "")) ==>
      (!r' s. regexp_lang (Cat r' r) s = regexp_lang r' s) /\
      (!r' s. regexp_lang (Cat r r') s = regexp_lang r' s) /\
      (!s. regexp_lang (Star r) s = (s = "")))

name: regexp_lang_ctxt_eqns
statement:
!r1 r2.
  (!s. regexp_lang r1 s = regexp_lang r2 s)
  ==>
  (!r s. regexp_lang (Cat r1 r) s = regexp_lang (Cat r2 r) s) /\
  (!r s. regexp_lang (Cat r r1) s = regexp_lang (Cat r r2) s) /\
  (!s. regexp_lang (Star r1) s = regexp_lang (Star r2) s) /\
  (!s rs1 rs2. regexp_lang (Or (rs1++r1::rs2)) s =
               regexp_lang (Or (rs1++r2::rs2)) s) /\
  (!s. regexp_lang (Neg r1) s = regexp_lang (Neg r2) s)

name: assoc_cat_correct
statement: !r1 r2 s. regexp_lang (assoc_cat r1 r2) s = regexp_lang (Cat r1 r2) s

name: Cat_Empty
statement:
(!r. regexp_lang (Cat r Empty) = regexp_lang Empty) /\
  (!r. regexp_lang (Cat Empty r) = regexp_lang Empty)

name: EVERY_EMPTY
statement: !wlist. EVERY EMPTY wlist ==> (CONCAT wlist = [])

name: regexp_lang_epsilon
statement: regexp_lang Epsilon w = (w = "")

name: Cat_Epsilon
statement:
(!r. regexp_lang (Cat r Epsilon) = regexp_lang r) /\
  (!r. regexp_lang (Cat Epsilon r) = regexp_lang r)

name: build_cat_correct
statement: !r1 r2 s. regexp_lang (build_cat r1 r2) s = regexp_lang (Cat r1 r2) s

name: flatten_or_correct
statement:
!rs s.
   EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r s) (flatten_or rs) =
   EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r s) rs

name: sort_regexps_correct
statement:
!rs s.
  EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r s) (mergesort regexp_leq rs) =
  EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r s) rs

name: merge_charsets_correct
statement:
!rs s.
  EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r s) (merge_charsets rs) =
  EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r s) rs

name: remove_dups_correct
statement:
!rs s.
  EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r s) (remove_dups rs) =

name: build_or_init_correct
statement:
!rs s.
  EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r s) rs

  EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r s)
         (remove_dups (merge_charsets (mergesort regexp_leq (flatten_or rs))))

name: build_or_correct
statement: !rs s. regexp_lang (build_or rs) s = regexp_lang (Or rs) s

name: build_star_correct
statement: !r s. regexp_lang (build_star r) s = regexp_lang (Star r) s

name: build_neg_correct
statement: !r s. regexp_lang (build_neg r) s = regexp_lang (Neg r) s

name: smart_constructors_correct
statement:
(!r c s. regexp_lang (smart_deriv c r) s <=> regexp_lang (deriv c r) s) /\
  (!rs c s. EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang (smart_deriv c r) s) rs <=>
            EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang (deriv c r) s) rs)

name: lem
statement: smart_deriv c (Cat (Chset cs) r) = if charset_mem c cs then r else Empty

name: smart_deriv_thm
statement:
(smart_deriv c (Chset cs) = if charset_mem c cs then Epsilon else Empty) /\
  (smart_deriv c (Cat (Chset cs) r) = if charset_mem c cs then r else Empty) /\
  (smart_deriv c (Cat r1 r2) =
    let d1 = build_cat (smart_deriv c r1) r2
    in if nullable r1
         then build_or [d1; smart_deriv c r2]
         else d1) /\
  (smart_deriv c (Star r) = build_cat (smart_deriv c r) (build_star r)) /\
  (smart_deriv c (Or rs) = build_or (MAP (smart_deriv c) rs)) /\
  (smart_deriv c (Neg r) = build_neg (smart_deriv c r))

name: regexp_lang_smart_deriv
statement: !r s. smart_deriv_matches r s <=> regexp_lang r s

name: regexp_lang_normalize_help
statement:
(!r s. regexp_lang r s = regexp_lang (normalize r) s) /\
 (!rs s. EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang r s) rs =
         EXISTS (\r. regexp_lang (normalize r) s) rs)

name: regexp_lang_normalize
statement: !r s. regexp_lang r s = regexp_lang (normalize r) s

name: regexp_lang_normalize_eta
statement: !r. regexp_lang r = regexp_lang (normalize r)

name: is_normalized_eqns
statement:
(!cs. is_normalized (Chset cs) <=> T) /\
  (!r. is_normalized (Star r) <=> is_normalized r /\ (!s. r <> Star s)) /\
  (!r. is_normalized (Neg r) <=> is_normalized r /\ (!s. r <> Neg s)) /\
  (!r1 r2.
       is_normalized (Cat r1 r2) <=>
         r1 <> Chset charset_empty /\ r2 <> Chset charset_empty /\
         r1 <> Star (Chset charset_empty) /\ r2 <> Star (Chset charset_empty) /\
         (!x y. r1 <> Cat x y) /\
         is_normalized r1 /\ is_normalized r2) /\
  (!rs. is_normalized (Or rs) <=>
        LENGTH rs > 1 /\ LENGTH (FILTER is_charset rs) <= 1 /\
        ALL_DISTINCT rs /\ SORTED regexp_leq rs /\ no_sub_or rs /\
        EVERY is_normalized rs /\
        Neg (Chset charset_empty) NOTIN set rs /\
        Chset charset_empty NOTIN set rs)

name: norm_char_set
statement: !cs. is_normalized (build_char_set cs)

name: norm_is_regexp_empty
statement: !r. is_normalized r ==> (is_regexp_empty r = (r = Chset charset_empty))

name: assoc_cat_cat
statement: !r1 r2. ?r1' r2'. assoc_cat r1 r2 = Cat r1' r2'

name: normalized_assoc_cat
statement:
!r1 r2.
  (r1 <> Chset charset_empty) /\
  (r2 <> Chset charset_empty) /\
  (r1 <> Star (Chset charset_empty)) /\
  (r2 <> Star (Chset charset_empty)) /\
  is_normalized r1 /\
  is_normalized r2
  ==>
  is_normalized (assoc_cat r1 r2)

name: norm_cat
statement: !r1 r2. is_normalized r1 /\ is_normalized r2 ==> is_normalized (build_cat r1 r2)

name: norm_star
statement: !r. is_normalized r ==> is_normalized (build_star r)

name: norm_neg
statement: !r. is_normalized r ==> is_normalized (build_neg r)

name: flatten_or_norm_pres
statement: !rs. EVERY is_normalized rs ==> EVERY is_normalized (flatten_or rs)

name: mergesort_norm_pres
statement: !rs. EVERY is_normalized rs ==> EVERY is_normalized (mergesort regexp_leq rs)

name: merge_charsets_norm_pres
statement: !rs. EVERY is_normalized rs ==> EVERY is_normalized (merge_charsets rs)

name: remove_dups_norm_pres
statement: !rs. EVERY is_normalized rs ==> EVERY is_normalized (remove_dups rs)

name: flatten_or_no_or
statement: !rs. EVERY is_normalized rs ==> no_sub_or (flatten_or rs)

name: mergesort_no_or_pres
statement: !rs. no_sub_or rs ==> no_sub_or (mergesort regexp_leq rs)

name: merge_charsets_no_or_pres
statement: !rs. no_sub_or rs ==> no_sub_or (merge_charsets rs)

name: remove_dups_no_or_pres
statement: !rs. no_sub_or rs ==> no_sub_or (remove_dups rs)

name: charset_smallest
statement: !r s. is_charset s /\ regexp_leq r s ==> is_charset r

name: SORTED_starts_charsets
statement:
!rs. SORTED regexp_leq rs ==>
  ?rs1 rs2. (rs = rs1 ++ rs2) /\ EVERY is_charset rs1 /\ ~EXISTS is_charset rs2

name: merge_charsets_no_charsets
statement: !rs. ~EXISTS is_charset rs ==> (merge_charsets rs = rs)

name: merge_charsets_append
statement:
!rs1 rs2.
  rs1 <> [] /\
  EVERY is_charset rs1 /\
  ~EXISTS is_charset rs2
  ==>
  ?c.
    is_charset c /\
    (merge_charsets rs1 = [c]) /\
    (merge_charsets (rs1 ++ rs2) = c :: rs2)

name: merge_charsets_sorted_pres
statement: !rs. SORTED regexp_leq rs ==> SORTED regexp_leq (merge_charsets rs)

name: remove_dups_mem
statement: !rs r. MEM r (remove_dups rs) = MEM r rs

name: remove_dups_sorted_pres
statement: !rs. SORTED regexp_leq rs ==> SORTED regexp_leq (remove_dups rs)

name: merge_charsets_only1
statement: !rs. SORTED regexp_leq rs ==> LENGTH (FILTER is_charset (merge_charsets rs)) <= 1

name: remove_dups_charset_only1_pres
statement:
!rs.
 LENGTH (FILTER is_charset rs) <= 1 ==>
 (LENGTH (FILTER is_charset (remove_dups rs)) = LENGTH (FILTER is_charset rs))

name: remove_dups_no_dups
statement: !rs. SORTED regexp_leq rs ==> ALL_DISTINCT (remove_dups rs)

name: norm_or
statement: !rs. EVERY is_normalized rs ==> is_normalized (build_or rs)

name: normalize_thm
statement: !r. is_normalized (normalize r)

name: map_id_lem
statement: !L f. (!x. MEM x L ==> (f x = x)) ==> (MAP f L = L)

name: flatten_or_id
statement: !L. no_sub_or L ==> (flatten_or L = L)

name: PERM_SORTED_LIST_EQ
statement:
!L1 L2.
     PERM L1 L2 /\ antisymmetric R /\ total R /\ transitive R /\
     SORTED R L1 /\ SORTED R L2 ==> (L1 = L2)

name: sorted_sort_id
statement: !L. SORTED regexp_leq L ==> (mergesort regexp_leq L = L)

name: merge_charsets_id
statement: !L. LENGTH (FILTER is_charset L) <= 1 ==> (merge_charsets L = L)

name: remove_dups_id
statement: !L. ALL_DISTINCT L ==> (remove_dups L = L)

name: normalize_id
statement: !r. is_normalized r ==> (normalize r = r)

name: normalize_idempotent
statement: !r. normalize (normalize r) = normalize r

name: smart_deriv_normalized
statement: !c r. is_normalized r ==> is_normalized (smart_deriv c r)

name: smart_deriv_normalize_deriv
statement: !r c. is_normalized r ==> (smart_deriv c r = normalize (deriv c r))

name: regexp_lang_algorithm
statement:
(!cs r. regexp_lang (Cat (Chset cs) r) [] = F) /\
  (!cs r c s.
   regexp_lang (Cat (Chset cs) r) (c::s) =
     (charset_mem (ORD c) cs /\ regexp_lang r s)) /\
  (!r1 r2 r3 s.
   regexp_lang (Cat (Cat r1 r2) r3) s =
     regexp_lang (Cat r1 (Cat r2 r3)) s) /\
  (!r1 r2 s.
   regexp_lang (Cat (Star r1) r2) s =
     (regexp_lang r2 s \/
     regexp_lang (Cat r1 (Cat (Star r1) r2)) s)) /\
  (!rs r s.
   regexp_lang (Cat (Or rs) r) s =
     EXISTS (\r'. regexp_lang (Cat r' r) s) rs)

name: LIST_UNION_def
statement:
(LIST_UNION [] = {}) /\
  (LIST_UNION (h::t) = h UNION LIST_UNION t)

name: And_def
statement: And r s = Neg(Or[Neg r; Neg s])

name: Empty_def
statement: Empty = Chset charset_empty

name: DOT_def
statement: DOT = Chset charset_full

name: Epsilon_def
statement: Epsilon = Star (Chset charset_empty)

name: catstring_def
statement:
(catstring [] = Epsilon) /\
    (catstring (c::t) = Cat(Chset(charset_sing c)) (catstring t))

name: rsize_def
statement:
(rsize (Chset a) = 1n) /\
    (rsize (Cat r s) = 1 + (rsize r + rsize s)) /\
    (rsize (Star a)  = 1 + rsize a) /\
    (rsize (Or a)    = 1 + rsizel a) /\
    (rsize (Neg a)   = 1 + rsize a)
    /\
    (rsizel []       = 0n) /\
    (rsizel (r::t)   = 1 + (rsize r + rsizel t))

name: regexp_list_size_def
statement:
(regexp_list_size [] (acc:num)     = acc) /\
    (regexp_list_size (Chset _::t) acc = regexp_list_size t (acc+1)) /\
    (regexp_list_size (Star r::t) acc  = regexp_list_size (r::t) (acc+1)) /\
    (regexp_list_size (Neg r::t) acc   = regexp_list_size (r::t) (acc+1)) /\
    (regexp_list_size (Cat r s::t) acc = regexp_list_size (r::s::t) (acc+1)) /\
    (regexp_list_size (Or rl::t) acc = regexp_list_size (rl ++ t) (acc + LENGTH rl + 1))

name: regexp_lang_def
statement:
(regexp_lang (Chset ns) = {w:string | ?c. charset_mem c ns /\ (w = [CHR c])}) /\
  (regexp_lang (Cat r s)  = (regexp_lang r dot regexp_lang s)) /\
  (regexp_lang (Star r)   = KSTAR (regexp_lang r)) /\
  (regexp_lang (Neg r)    = COMPL (regexp_lang r)) /\
  (regexp_lang (Or rlist) = LIST_UNION (MAP regexp_lang rlist))

name: len_cmp_def
statement:
(len_cmp [] [] = Equal) /\
   (len_cmp [] (_::_) = Less) /\
   (len_cmp (_::_) [] = Greater) /\
   (len_cmp (_::t1) (_::t2) = len_cmp t1 t2)

name: regexp_compareW_def
statement:
(regexp_compareW [] = Equal) /\
  (regexp_compareW (pair::t) =
     case pair of
      | (Chset cs1, Chset cs2) =>
            (case charset_cmp cs1 cs2
              of Equal => regexp_compareW t
               | result => result)
      | (Chset _, __) => Less
      | (Cat _ _, Chset _) => Greater
      | (Cat r1 r2, Cat r3 r4) => regexp_compareW ((r1,r3)::(r2,r4)::t)
      | (Cat _ _, __) => Less
      | (Star _, Chset _) => Greater
      | (Star _, Cat _ _) => Greater
      | (Star r, Star s) => regexp_compareW ((r,s)::t)
      | (Star _, __) => Less
      | (Or _, Chset _) => Greater
      | (Or _, Cat _ _) => Greater
      | (Or _, Star _) => Greater
      | (Or rs1, Or rs2) =>
          (case len_cmp rs1 rs2
            of Equal => regexp_compareW (ZIP (rs1,rs2) ++ t)
             | verdict => verdict)
      | (Or _, __) => Less
      | (Neg r, Neg s) => regexp_compareW ((r,s)::t)
      | (Neg _, __) => Greater)

name: regexp_compare_def
statement: regexp_compare r s = regexp_compareW [(r,s)]

name: regexp_leq_def
statement:
regexp_leq r1 r2 <=>
   case regexp_compare r1 r2 of
    | Less => T
    | Equal => T
    | Greater => F

name: is_regexp_empty_def
statement:
(is_regexp_empty (Chset cs) = (cs = charset_empty)) /\
   (is_regexp_empty (Cat r1 r2) = (is_regexp_empty r1 \/ is_regexp_empty r2)) /\
   (is_regexp_empty (Star _) = F) /\
   (is_regexp_empty (Or rs) = EVERY is_regexp_empty rs) /\
   (is_regexp_empty (Neg r) = F)

name: nullableW_def
statement:
(nullableW [] = F) /\
  (nullableW (Chset _ :: t) = nullableW t) /\
  (nullableW (Cat r s :: t) = ((nullableW [r] /\ nullableW [s]) \/ nullableW t)) /\
  (nullableW (Star _ :: t)  = T) /\
  (nullableW (Neg r :: t)   = (~nullableW [r] \/ nullableW t)) /\
  (nullableW (Or rs :: t)   = nullableW (rs ++ t))

name: nullable_def
statement: nullable r = nullableW [r]

name: deriv_def
statement:
(deriv c (Chset cs) = if charset_mem c cs then Epsilon else Empty) /\
  (deriv c (Neg r)    = Neg (deriv c r)) /\
  (deriv c (Star r)   = Cat (deriv c r) (Star r)) /\
  (deriv c (Cat r s) =
    let cat = Cat (deriv c r) s
    in if nullable r
          then Or [cat; deriv c s]
          else cat) /\
  (deriv c (Or rs) = Or (MAP (deriv c) rs))

name: deriv_matches_def
statement:
(deriv_matches r "" = nullable r) /\
   (deriv_matches r (c::s) = deriv_matches (deriv (ORD c) r) s)

name: is_charset_def
statement:
(is_charset (Chset cs) = T) /\
   (is_charset _ = F)

name: build_char_set_def
statement: build_char_set cs = Chset cs

name: merge_charsets_def
statement:
(merge_charsets (Chset cs1::Chset cs2::rs) =
       merge_charsets (Chset (charset_union cs1 cs2)::rs)) /\
   (merge_charsets rs = rs)

name: assoc_cat_def
statement:
(assoc_cat (Cat r1 r2) r3 = Cat r1 (assoc_cat r2 r3)) /\
   (assoc_cat r1 r2 = Cat r1 r2)

name: build_cat_def
statement:
build_cat r1 r2 =
     if (r1 = Empty) \/ (r2 = Empty) then Empty
     else if r1 = Epsilon then r2
     else if r2 = Epsilon then r1
     else
       assoc_cat r1 r2

name: build_neg_def
statement:
(build_neg (Neg r) = r) /\
  (build_neg r = Neg r)

name: build_star_def
statement:
(build_star (Star r) = Star r) /\
  (build_star r = Star r)

name: flatten_or_def
statement:
(flatten_or [] = []) /\
  (flatten_or (Or rs::rs') = rs ++ flatten_or rs') /\
  (flatten_or (r::rs) = r :: flatten_or rs)

name: remove_dups_def
statement:
(remove_dups [] = []) /\
  (remove_dups [r] = [r]) /\
  (remove_dups (r1::r2::rs) =
    if regexp_compare r1 r2 = Equal then
      remove_dups (r2::rs)
    else
      r1::remove_dups (r2::rs))

name: build_or_def
statement:
build_or rs =
    let rs = remove_dups (merge_charsets (mergesort regexp_leq (flatten_or rs)))
    in
      if MEM (Neg Empty) rs then Neg Empty
      else
      case rs of
        | [] => Empty
        | [r] => r
        | [Chset cs; r] =>
            if cs = charset_empty then
              r
            else
              Or [Chset cs; r]
        | Chset cs :: rs =>
             if cs = charset_empty then
              Or rs
            else
              Or (Chset cs::rs)
        | ___ => Or rs

name: smart_deriv_def
statement:
(smart_deriv c (Chset cs) = if charset_mem c cs then Epsilon else Empty) /\
   (smart_deriv c (Cat r1 r2) =
     let d1 = build_cat (smart_deriv c r1) r2
     in if nullable r1
          then build_or [d1; smart_deriv c r2]
          else d1) /\
   (smart_deriv c (Star r) = build_cat (smart_deriv c r) (build_star r)) /\
   (smart_deriv c (Or rs) = build_or (MAP (smart_deriv c) rs)) /\
   (smart_deriv c (Neg r) = build_neg (smart_deriv c r))

name: smart_deriv_matches_def
statement:
(smart_deriv_matches r "" = nullable r) /\
   (smart_deriv_matches r (c::s) = smart_deriv_matches (smart_deriv (ORD c) r) s)

name: normalize_def
statement:
(normalize (Chset cs) = build_char_set cs) /\
   (normalize (Cat r1 r2) = build_cat (normalize r1) (normalize r2)) /\
   (normalize (Star r) = build_star (normalize r)) /\
   (normalize (Or rs) = build_or (MAP normalize rs)) /\
   (normalize (Neg r) = build_neg (normalize r))

name: no_sub_or_def
statement: no_sub_or rs = EVERY (\r. case r of | Or _ => F | _ => T) rs

name: is_normalized_def
statement:
(is_normalized (Chset cs) <=> T) /\
  (is_normalized (Cat r1 r2) <=>
     (r1 <> Chset charset_empty) /\
     (r2 <> Chset charset_empty) /\
     (r1 <> Star (Chset charset_empty)) /\
     (r2 <> Star (Chset charset_empty)) /\
     (case r1 of | Cat _ _ => F | _ => T) /\
     (is_normalized r1) /\
     (is_normalized r2)) /\
  (is_normalized (Star r) <=> is_normalized r /\ (case r of | Star _ => F | _ => T)) /\
  (is_normalized (Or rs) <=>
     LENGTH rs > 1 /\
     LENGTH (FILTER is_charset rs) <= 1 /\
     ALL_DISTINCT rs /\
     SORTED regexp_leq rs /\
     no_sub_or rs /\
     EVERY is_normalized rs /\
     ~MEM (Neg (Chset charset_empty)) rs /\
     ~MEM (Chset charset_empty) rs) /\
  (is_normalized (Neg r) <=> is_normalized r /\ (case r of | Neg _ => F | _ => T))

name: MAX_LE_THM
statement: !m n. m <= MAX m n /\ n <= MAX m n

name: IS_SOME_EXISTS
statement: !x. IS_SOME x = ?y. x = SOME y

name: string_to_numlist
statement:
!s. (!c. c IN set s ==> ORD c IN set ALPHABET)
     ==>
      ?nl. (s = MAP CHR nl) /\
           (!n. n IN set nl ==> n IN set ALPHABET)

name: all_ord_string
statement:
EVERY (\c. MEM (ORD c) ALPHABET) s
   <=>
  EVERY (\c. ORD c < alphabet_size) s

name: Empty_arcs_thm
statement: MAP (\c. (c,smart_deriv c Empty)) ALPHABET = Empty_arcs

name: transitions_thm
statement:
transitions r = if r = Empty then Empty_arcs
                  else MAP (\c. (c,smart_deriv c r)) ALPHABET

name: WOP_ALT
statement: !P. (?n. P n) ==> ?min. P min /\ !k. P k ==> min <= k

name: IS_SOME_Brz
statement:
!d seen work acc.
    IS_SOME (Brz seen work acc d) ==> d <> 0

name: Brz_SOME
statement:
!d seen work acc res.
   (Brz seen work acc d = SOME res) ==> d <> 0

name: Brz_dlem
statement:
!d seen work acc.
   IS_SOME (Brz seen work acc d)
   ==>
   (Brz seen work acc d = Brz seen work acc (SUC d))

name: Brz_monotone
statement:
!d1 d2 seen work acc.
      IS_SOME(Brz seen work acc d1) /\ d1 <= d2
       ==> (Brz seen work acc d1 = Brz seen work acc d2)

name: Brz_norm
statement:
!d seen work acc.
   IS_SOME(Brz seen work acc d)
    ==>
   (Brz seen work acc d = Brz seen work acc (rdepth seen work acc))

name: Brz_determ
statement:
!d1 d2 seen work acc.
    IS_SOME(Brz seen work acc d1) /\ IS_SOME(Brz seen work acc d2)
       ==> (Brz seen work acc d1 = Brz seen work acc d2)

name: lem
statement:
!seen work acc.
   null work ==> IS_SOME (Brz seen work acc 1)

name: dom_base_case
statement:
!seen work acc.
   null work ==> dom_Brz seen work acc

name: step2_lem1a
statement:
!seen work acc r x t.
   ~null work /\
   (deleteFindMin work = ((r,x),t)) /\
   mem_regexp r seen /\ dom_Brz seen work acc
    ==> dom_Brz seen t acc

name: step2_lem1b
statement:
!seen work acc r x t arcs.
   ~null work /\
   (deleteFindMin work = ((r,x),t)) /\
   ~mem_regexp r seen /\
   (arcs = transitions r) /\
   dom_Brz seen work acc
    ==> dom_Brz (insert_regexp r seen)
                (FOLDL (\work a. insert_regexp (SND a) work) t arcs)
                (build_table arcs r acc)

name: step2_lem2a
statement:
!seen work acc r x t.
   ~null work /\
   (deleteFindMin work = ((r,x),t)) /\
   mem_regexp r seen /\ dom_Brz seen t acc
   ==> dom_Brz seen work acc

name: step2_lem2b
statement:
!seen work acc r x t arcs.
   ~null work /\
   (deleteFindMin work = ((r,x),t)) /\
   (arcs = transitions r) /\
  ~mem_regexp r seen /\
  dom_Brz (insert_regexp r seen)
          (FOLDL (\work a. insert_regexp (SND a) work) t arcs)
          (build_table arcs r acc)
   ==> dom_Brz seen work acc

name: dom_Brz_eqns
statement:
dom_Brz seen work acc =
    if null work then
      T
    else let (m,t) = deleteFindMin work ;
             r = FST m;
         in
           if mem_regexp r seen then
               dom_Brz seen t acc
           else let arcs = transitions r
                in dom_Brz (insert_regexp r seen)
                           (FOLDL (\work a. insert_regexp (SND a) work) t arcs)
                           (build_table arcs r acc)

name: acc_irrelevant
statement:
!n seen work acc acc1.

name: dom_Brz_alt_equal

name: dom_Brz_alt_eqns
statement:
dom_Brz_alt seen work =
    if null work then
      T
    else let (m,t) = deleteFindMin work ;
             r = FST m;
         in
           if mem_regexp r seen then
               dom_Brz_alt seen t
           else let arcs = transitions r
                in dom_Brz_alt (insert_regexp r seen)
                           (FOLDL (\work a. insert_regexp (SND a) work) t arcs)

name: Brzozo_base
statement:
!seen work acc.
    dom_Brz seen work acc /\ null work
    ==>
   (Brzozo seen work acc = (seen,acc))

name: Brzozo_rec1
statement:
!seen work accr r x t.
     ~null work /\
     (deleteFindMin work = ((r,x),t)) /\
      dom_Brz seen work acc /\
      mem_regexp r seen
     ==>
      (Brzozo seen work acc = Brzozo seen t acc)

name: Brzozo_rec2
statement:
!seen work accr r x t.
    ~null work /\
    (deleteFindMin work = ((r,x),t)) /\
    dom_Brz seen work acc /\
    ~mem_regexp r seen
    ==>
    (Brzozo seen work acc =
       let arcs = transitions r
       in Brzozo (insert_regexp r seen)
                 (FOLDL (\work a. insert_regexp (SND a) work) t arcs)
                 (build_table arcs r acc))

name: Brzozo_eqns
statement:
!seen work acc.

    ==>
     Brzozo seen work acc =
       if null work then
          (seen,acc)
       else
         let (rp,t) = deleteFindMin work;

         in

name: step3a_lt
statement:
!seen work acc r x t.
   ~null work /\
   (deleteFindMin work = ((r,x),t)) /\
   mem_regexp r seen /\
    dom_Brz seen work acc
    ==> rdepth seen t acc  < rdepth seen work acc

name: step3b_lt
statement:
!seen work acc r x t arcs.
    ~null work /\
    (deleteFindMin work = ((r,x),t)) /\
    ~mem_regexp r seen /\
    (arcs = transitions r) /\ dom_Brz seen work acc
    ==> rdepth (insert_regexp r seen)
               (FOLDL (\work a. insert_regexp (SND a) work) t arcs)
               (build_table arcs r acc)
         <
        rdepth seen work acc

name: ind_lemB
statement:
!P. (!seen work acc.
         (!a b c. rdepth a b c < rdepth seen work acc
                  ==> dom_Brz a b c
                  ==> P a b c)
         ==> dom_Brz seen work acc ==> P seen work acc)
  ==>
  !seen work acc. dom_Brz seen work acc ==> P seen work acc

name: Brzozowski_ind
statement:
!P.
   (!seen work acc.
       dom_Brz seen work acc /\
       (!r x t. ~null work /\
                (deleteFindMin work = ((r,x),t)) /\
                mem_regexp r seen ==> P seen t acc) /\
       (!r x t arcs.
           ~null work /\ (deleteFindMin work = ((r,x),t)) /\
           (arcs = transitions r) /\ ~mem_regexp r seen
           ==> P (insert_regexp r seen)
                 (FOLDL (\work a. insert_regexp (SND a) work) t arcs)
                 (build_table arcs r acc))
         ==> P seen work acc)
  ==> !seen work acc. dom_Brz seen work acc ==> P seen work acc

name: exec_dfa_thm
statement:
(exec_dfa finals table n [] = sub finals n) /\
  (exec_dfa finals table n (c::t) =
    case sub (sub table n) (ORD c) of
     | NONE => F
     | SOME k => exec_dfa finals table k t)

name: sorted_get_accepts
statement:
!fmap.
     SORTED $<= (get_accepts fmap)

name: mem_get_acceptsA
statement:
!fmap P x acc.
    balanced_map$invariant regexp_compare fmap /\
    MEM x (foldrWithKey
               (\r n nlist. if P r then n::nlist else nlist)
               acc fmap)
     ==>
    MEM x acc \/ ?r. P r /\ (lookup regexp_compare r fmap = SOME x)

name: mem_foldrWithKey_mono
statement:
!P fmap x acc.

               (\r n nlist. if P r then n::nlist else nlist)

name: mem_get_acceptsB

name: mem_get_accepts

!bmap x.

    ==>

      ?r. nullable r /\

name: extend_states_inv
statement:
!next_state state_map table states next_state' state_map' table'.
     (extend_states next_state state_map table states
         = (next_state',state_map',table')) /\
     extend_states_inv next_state state_map table
    ==>
    extend_states_inv next_state' state_map' table'

name: extend_states_thm
statement:
!next_state state_map table states next_state' state_map' table'.
    (extend_states next_state state_map table states
       = (next_state',state_map',table')) /\
    invariant regexp_compare state_map
   ==>
  (fdom regexp_compare state_map' =
      (fdom regexp_compare state_map UNION set (MAP SND states))) /\
  submap regexp_compare state_map state_map' /\
  next_state <= next_state' /\
  (table' = REVERSE
             (MAP (\(c,r). (c, fapply regexp_compare state_map' r)) states)
            ++ table) /\
  invariant regexp_compare state_map'

name: dom_union
statement:
!a b.
    invariant regexp_compare a /\ invariant regexp_compare b
    ==>
   (dom (union a b) = (dom a) UNION (dom b))

name: triv_lem
statement: !s1 s2. (s1 = s2) ==> ((s1 UNION s) = (s2 UNION s))

name: Brz_inv_pres
statement:
!todo1 x todos work seen next_state state_map table.
    ~null work /\
    (deleteFindMin work = ((todo1,x),todos)) /\
    Brz_invariant seen work (next_state,state_map,table) /\
    ~mem_regexp todo1 seen
   ==>
   Brz_invariant (insert_regexp todo1 seen)
                 (FOLDL (\work a. insert_regexp (SND a) work) todos (transitions todo1))
                 (build_table (transitions todo1)
                              todo1 (next_state,state_map,table))

name: Brz_inv_thm
statement:
!seen work acc.
   dom_Brz seen work acc
   ==>
    !seen' acc'.
      Brz_invariant seen work acc /\
      (Brzozowski seen work acc = (seen',acc'))
      ==>
       Brz_invariant seen' balanced_map$empty acc'

name: Brz_mono
statement:
!seen work acc.
   dom_Brz seen work acc
   ==>
   !seen' acc'.
     Brz_invariant seen work acc /\
     (Brzozowski seen work acc = (seen',acc'))
     ==>
     submap regexp_compare (FST (SND acc)) (FST(SND acc'))

name: Brz_invariant_final
statement:
!seen next_state state_map table.
   Brz_invariant seen empty (next_state,state_map,table)
    ==>
    (next_state = LENGTH table) /\
    PERM (MAP FST table) (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH table)) /\
    (!x. MEM x (get_accepts state_map) ==> x < LENGTH table) /\
    (!n l c. (ALOOKUP table n = SOME l) /\ (?x. ALOOKUP l c = SOME x) ==> MEM c ALPHABET)

name: table_lang_correct
statement:
!finals table state_map.
   fmap_inj regexp_compare state_map /\
   good_table state_map table /\
   (set (MAP FST table) = frange regexp_compare state_map) /\
   (!n r. (lookup regexp_compare r state_map = SOME n) ==> (MEM n finals <=> nullable r))
   ==>
   !n r s.
     (!c. MEM c s ==> MEM c ALPHABET) /\
     (lookup regexp_compare r state_map = SOME n)
     ==>
     (table_lang finals table n s <=> smart_deriv_matches r (MAP CHR s))

name: vec_lang_lem1
statement:
!(n:num).

name: vec_lang_lem4
statement: !l x. ALOOKUP (MAP (\(c,n). (c,SOME n)) l) x = OPTION_MAP SOME (ALOOKUP l x)

name: table_to_vec_thm
statement:
!table final_states max_char max_state table' final_states'.
    (max_char = alphabet_size) /\
    SORTED $<= final_states /\
    (!x. MEM x final_states ==> x < max_state) /\
    (!n l c. (ALOOKUP table n = SOME l) /\
             (?x. ALOOKUP l c = SOME x) ==> c < max_char) /\
    PERM (MAP FST table) (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH table)) /\
    (table_to_vectors table = table') /\
    (accepts_to_vector final_states max_state = final_states')
  ==>
   (LENGTH table' = LENGTH table) /\
   (LENGTH final_states' = max_state) /\
   (!n. MEM n final_states <=> n < LENGTH final_states' /\ EL n final_states') /\
   (!n. (?l. ALOOKUP table n = SOME l) <=> n < LENGTH table') /\
   (!n l. n < LENGTH table' ==> (LENGTH (EL n table') = max_char)) /\
   (!n c x.
     (?l. (ALOOKUP table n = SOME l) /\ (ALOOKUP l c = SOME x)) <=>
     n < LENGTH table' /\
     c < LENGTH (EL n table') /\ (EL c (EL n table') = SOME x))

name: Brz_inv_to_good_vec
statement:
!seen next_state state_map table.
   Brz_invariant seen empty (next_state,state_map,table) /\
    (table_to_vectors table = vec) /\
    (accepts_to_vector (get_accepts state_map) next_state = final_states)
    ==>
    (next_state = LENGTH table) /\
    good_vec vec final_states /\
    (!r n. (lookup regexp_compare r state_map = SOME n) ==> n < LENGTH vec)

name: compile_regexp_good_vec
statement:
!r state_map table final_states.
    dom_Brz empty (singleton (normalize r) ())
                 (1,singleton (normalize r) 0,[]) /\
    (compile_regexp r = (state_map, table, final_states))
    ==>
    good_vec table final_states /\
    (!r n. (lookup regexp_compare r state_map = SOME n) ==> n < LENGTH table) /\
    normalize r IN fdom regexp_compare state_map

name: vec_lang_correct
statement:
!table final_states max_char vec final_states'.
   (max_char = alphabet_size) /\
   SORTED $<= final_states /\
   (!x. MEM x final_states ==> x < LENGTH table) /\
   (!n l c. (ALOOKUP table n = SOME l) /\ (?x. ALOOKUP l c = SOME x) ==> c < max_char) /\
   (PERM (MAP FST table) (COUNT_LIST (LENGTH table))) /\
   (!n'. n' IN BIGUNION (IMAGE alist_range (alist_range table)) ==> n' < LENGTH table) /\
   (table_to_vectors table = vec) /\
   (accepts_to_vector final_states (LENGTH table) = final_states')
   ==>
   !n s. (!c. MEM c s ==> c < max_char) /\ n < LENGTH table
         ==>
        (table_lang final_states table n s
           <=>
         exec_dfa (fromList final_states')
                  (fromList (MAP fromList vec))
                  n
                  (MAP CHR s))

name: Brzozowski_correct
statement:
!r s.
   dom_Brz empty (singleton (normalize r) ())
           (1,singleton (normalize r) 0,[]) /\
   (!c. MEM c s ==> MEM (ORD c) ALPHABET)
   ==>
   (Brz_lang r s = regexp_lang (normalize r) s)

name: Brzozowski_correct_alt
statement:
!r s.
    dom_Brz empty (singleton (normalize r) ())
            (1,singleton (normalize r) 0,[]) /\
    (!c. MEM c s ==> MEM (ORD c) ALPHABET)
   ==>
