statement: ∀s t k. timeBS k s t ⇔ NRC step k s t ∧ lambda t

name: closed_spaceBS
statement:
∀k s t.
    closed s ⇒
    spaceBS k s t ⇒
    closed t

name: spaceBS_ge
statement:
∀s t m.
    spaceBS m s t ⇒ size s ≤ m ∧ size t ≤ m

name: step_evaluatesSpace
statement:
∀s s' t m.
    step s s' ⇒
    spaceBS m s' t ⇒
    spaceBS (MAX (size s) m) s t

name: spaceBS_correctL
statement:
∀s t m.
    spaceBS m s t ⇒
      redWithMaxSizeL m s t ∧ lambda t

name: spaceBS_correctR
statement:
∀s t m.
    redWithMaxSizeL m s t ∧ lambda t ⇒
      spaceBS m s t

name: spaceBS_correct
statement:
∀s t m.
    spaceBS m s t ⇔
      redWithMaxSizeL m s t ∧ lambda t

name: size
statement:
size s =
                case s of
                        | dV x => 1 + x
                        | dABS s => 1 + (size s)
                        | dAPP s t => 1 + size s + size t

name: closed
statement: closed s = bound 0 s

name: lambda
statement: lambda s = ∃t. s = dABS t

name: redWithMaxSizeL
statement: redWithMaxSizeL = redWithMaxSize size step

name: bound_def
statement:
(∀k n. n < k ⇒ bound k (dV n)) ∧
        (∀k s t. bound k s ∧ bound k t ⇒ bound k (dAPP s t)) ∧
        (∀k s. bound (SUC k) s ⇒ bound k (dABS s))

name: step_def
statement:
[~App:]
        (∀s t. step (dAPP (dABS s) (dABS t)) (subst s 0 (dABS t)))
[~AppR:]
        (∀s t t'. step t t' ⇒ step (dAPP (dABS s) t) (dAPP (dABS s) t'))
[~AppL:]
        (∀s s' t. step s s' ⇒ step (dAPP s t) (dAPP s' t))

name: timeBS_def
statement:
[~Val:]
  (∀s. timeBS (0:num) (dABS s) (dABS s))
[~Beta:]
  (∀s s' t t' u i j k l.
    timeBS i s (dABS s') ∧
    timeBS j t (dABS t') ∧
    timeBS k (subst s' 0 (dABS t')) u ∧
    l = i+j+1+k ⇒
    timeBS l (dAPP s t) u)

name: spaceBS_def
statement:
[~Val:]
  (∀s. spaceBS (size (dABS s)) (dABS s) (dABS s))
[~Beta:]
  (∀s s' t t' u m1 m2 m3 m.
    spaceBS m1 s (dABS s') ∧
    spaceBS m2 t (dABS t')  ∧
    spaceBS m3 (subst s' 0 (dABS t')) u ∧
    m = MAX (m1 + 1 + size t)
            (MAX (size (dABS s') + 1 + m2) m3) ⇒
    spaceBS m (dAPP s t) u)

name: finite_subset_instance
statement:
∀t'. FINITE t' ∧ t' ⊆ { formsubst v p | P v ∧ p ∈ s} ⇒
        ∃t. FINITE t ∧ t ⊆ s ∧ t' ⊆ {formsubst v p | P v ∧ p ∈ t}

name: finite_subset_SKOLEM
statement:
∀s u. FINITE u ∧ u ⊆ { SKOLEM p | p ∈ s} ⇒
        ∃t. FINITE t ∧ t ⊆ s ∧ u = {SKOLEM p | p ∈ t}

name: valuation_exists
statement: ∀M. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒ ∃v:num -> α. valuation M v

name: holds_FOLDR_exists
statement:
∀M xs v.
    holds M v (FOLDR Exists p xs) ⇔
    ∃as. LENGTH as = LENGTH xs ∧ EVERY M.Dom as ∧
         holds M (FOLDL (combin$C (UNCURRY UPDATE)) v (MAP2 $, xs as)) p

name: pholds_prop_of_model
statement: ∀p. qfree p ⇒ (pholds (prop_of_model M v) p ⇔ holds M v p)

name: prop_of_canon_of_prop
statement: ∀p l. prop_of_model (canon_of_prop L v) V (Pred p l) = v (Pred p l)

name: holds_canon_of_prop
statement: qfree p ⇒ (holds (canon_of_prop L v) V p ⇔ pholds v p)

name: holds_canon_of_prop_general
statement: qfree p ⇒ (holds (canon_of_prop L v1) v2 p ⇔ pholds v1 (formsubst v2 p))

name: canonical_canon_of_prop
statement: canonical L (canon_of_prop L d)

name: interpretation_canon_of_prop
statement: ∀L d. interpretation L (canon_of_prop L d)

name: prop_valid_imp_fol_valid
statement: ∀p. qfree p ∧ (∀d. pholds d p) ⇒ ∀M v. holds M v p

name: fol_valid_imp_prop_valid
statement:
!p. qfree p ∧
      (∀C (v:num->term). canonical(language {p}) C ⇒ holds C v p)
       ==> !d. pholds d p

name: satisfies_psatisfies
statement:
(∀p. p ∈ s ⇒ qfree p) ∧ M satisfies s ∧ valuation M v ⇒
  prop_of_model M v psatisfies s

name: psatisfies_instances
statement:
(∀p. p ∈ s ⇒ qfree p) ∧
  d psatisfies {formsubst v p | (∀x. v x ∈ terms (FST L)) ∧ p ∈ s} ⇒
  canon_of_prop L d satisfies s

name: satisfies_instances
statement:
interpretation (language t) M ⇒
  (M satisfies {formsubst i p | p ∈ s ∧ ∀x. i x ∈ terms (FST (language t))} ⇔
   M satisfies s)

name: COMPACT_CANON_QFREE
statement:
(∀p. p ∈ s ⇒ qfree p) ∧
  (∀t. FINITE t ∧ t ⊆ s ⇒
       ∃M. interpretation (language ss) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ M satisfies t) ⇒
  ∃C. interpretation (language ss) C ∧ canonical (language ss) C ∧
      C satisfies s

name: interpretation_restrictlanguage
statement: ∀M s t. t ⊆ s ∧ interpretation (language s) M ⇒ interpretation (language t) M

name: interpretation_extendlanguage
statement:
∀M s t. interpretation (language t) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ M satisfies t ⇒
          ∃M'. M'.Dom = M.Dom ∧ M'.Pred = M.Pred ∧
               interpretation (language s) M' ∧ M' satisfies t

name: COMPACT_LS
statement:
(∀t. FINITE t ∧ t ⊆ s ⇒
       ∃M. interpretation (language s) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ M satisfies t)
 ⇒
  ∃C:term model. C.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ interpretation (language s) C ∧ C satisfies s

name: CANON
statement:
∀M:α model s.
    interpretation (language s) M ∧
    M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ (∀p. p IN s ⇒ qfree p) /\ M satisfies s
  ⇒
    ∃C:term model.
        C.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ interpretation (language s) C ∧ C satisfies s

name: DOM_LOWMOD_EMPTY
statement: (LOWMOD M).Dom = ∅ ⇔ M.Dom = ∅

name: LOWMOD_termval
statement:
valuation (LOWMOD M) v ⇒
  ∀t. termval (LOWMOD M) v t = num_of_term (termval M (term_of_num o v) t)

name: term_of_num_composition
statement: term_of_num o v⦇ n ↦ num_of_term t ⦈ = (term_of_num o v)⦇ n ↦ t ⦈

name: holds_LOWMOD
statement:
∀p v. valuation (LOWMOD M) v ⇒
        (holds (LOWMOD M) v p ⇔ holds M (term_of_num o v) p)

name: interpretation_LOWMOD
statement: ∀L M. interpretation L (LOWMOD M) ⇔ interpretation L M

name: LS
statement:
∀M : α model s.
     interpretation (language s) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ (∀p. p ∈ s ⇒ qfree p) ∧
     M satisfies s
    ⇒
     ∃N: num model.
       interpretation (language s) N ∧ N.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ N satisfies s

name: COMPACT_LS_ALPHA
statement:
INFINITE 𝕌(:α) ∧
  (∀t. FINITE t ∧ t ⊆ s ⇒
       ∃M:α model.
          interpretation (language s) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ M satisfies t) ⇒
  ∃M:α model.
     interpretation (language s) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ M satisfies s

name: COMPACTNESS_satisfiable
statement: INFINITE 𝕌(:α) ∧ ffinsat (:α) s ⇒ satisfiable (:α) s

name: tm_constify_varify
statement:
tm_constify keeps t =
    termsubst (varify_map keeps (λn. Fn (1 ⊗ n) [])) (bumpterm t)

name: FVT_tm_constify
statement: ∀t. FVT (tm_constify kvs t) = kvs ∩ FVT t

name: FV_fm_constify
statement: ∀p kvs. FV(fm_constify kvs p) = kvs ∩ FV p

name: constifymod_rwts
statement: (constifymod v M).Dom = M.Dom ∧ (constifymod v M).Pred = M.Pred

name: termval_constify
statement:
termval (constifymod v M) w (tm_constify kvs t) =
  termval M (λvnm. if vnm ∈ kvs then w vnm else v vnm) t

name: holds_constify
statement:
∀ϕ kvs v w M.
    holds (constifymod v M) w (fm_constify kvs ϕ) ⇔
    holds M (λvnm. if vnm ∈ kvs then w vnm else v vnm) ϕ

name: holds_constify_thm
statement: holds (constifymod v M) w (fm_constify ∅ ϕ) ⇔ holds M v ϕ

name: FMC_Not
statement: FMC (Not ϕ) = Not (FMC ϕ)

name: language_NOT_INSERT
statement: language (Not ϕ INSERT s) = language (ϕ INSERT s)

name: term_functions_tm_constify
form_functions_fm_constify
form_predicates_fm_constify
statement: ∀p kvs. form_predicates (fm_constify kvs p) = form_predicates p

name: functions_fmc
predicates_fmc
statement: predicates {FMC p | p ∈ s } = predicates s

name: valuation_constifymod
statement: valuation (constifymod v M) w ⇔ valuation M w

name: constifymod_interpretation
statement:
valuation M v ⇒
    (interpretation (language {FMC p | p ∈ s}) (constifymod v M) ⇔
     interpretation (language s) M)

name: uncm_mod_rwts
statement:
(uncm_mod M).Dom = M.Dom ∧
  (uncm_mod M).Fun n l = M.Fun (0 ⊗ n) l ∧
  (uncm_mod M).Pred = M.Pred

name: termval_uncm
statement:
∀t. (FVT t DIFF kvs) ⊆ fs ⇒
      termval M v (tm_constify kvs t) =
      termval (uncm_mod M)
              (λvnm. if vnm ∈ kvs then v vnm else uncm_map M fs vnm)
              t

name: UNION_DIFF_lemma
statement: (s ∪ t) DIFF r = (s DIFF r) ∪ (t DIFF r)

name: holds_uncm
statement:
∀ϕ v kvs fs.
     FV ϕ DIFF kvs ⊆ fs ⇒
     (holds (uncm_mod M)
            (λvnm. if vnm ∈ kvs then v vnm else uncm_map M fs vnm)
            ϕ ⇔ holds M v (fm_constify kvs ϕ))

name: interpretation_uncm
statement:
interpretation (language {FMC p | p ∈ s}) M ⇒
  interpretation (language s) (uncm_mod M)

name: interpretation_uncm_valuation
statement:
interpretation (language {FMC p | p ∈ s}) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒
  valuation (uncm_mod M) (uncm_map M (BIGUNION (IMAGE FV s)))

name: entails_constify
statement: entails (:α) {FMC p | p ∈ H} (FMC ϕ) ⇔ entails (:α) H ϕ

name: satisfiable_constify
statement: satisfiable (:α) s ⇒ satisfiable (:α) { FMC p | p ∈ s }

name: holds_FMC_ARB
statement: holds M v (FMC p) ⇔ holds M ARB (FMC p)

name: not_entails
statement: ¬entails (:α) H ϕ ⇔ satisfiable (:α) { FMC p | p ∈ Not ϕ INSERT H }

name: entails_mono
statement: entails (:α) Γ₁ ϕ ∧ Γ₁ ⊆ Γ₂ ⇒ entails (:α) Γ₂ ϕ

name: satisfiable_antimono
statement: satisfiable (:α) s₁ ∧ s₂ ⊆ s₁ ⇒ satisfiable (:α) s₂

name: tm_constify_11
statement: ∀t1 t2. tm_constify ks t1 = tm_constify ks t2 ⇔ t1 = t2

name: fm_constify_11
statement: ∀f1 f2 ks. fm_constify ks f1 = fm_constify ks f2 ⇔ f1 = f2

name: finite_entailment
statement:
INFINITE 𝕌(:α) ⇒
    (entails (:α) Γ ϕ ⇔ ∃Γ₀. FINITE Γ₀ ∧ Γ₀ ⊆ Γ ∧ entails (:α) Γ₀ ϕ)

name: canonical_def
statement: canonical L M ⇔ M.Dom = terms (FST L) ∧ ∀f. M.Fun f = Fn f

name: prop_of_model_def
statement: prop_of_model M v (Pred p l) ⇔ holds M v (Pred p l)

name: canon_of_prop_def
statement:
canon_of_prop L v = <| Dom := terms (FST L); Fun := Fn;
                         Pred := λp zs. v (Pred p zs) |>

name: LOWMOD_def
tm_constify_def
statement:
(tm_constify kvs (V x) = if x ∈ kvs then V x else Fn (1 ⊗ x) []) ∧
  (tm_constify kvs (Fn f zs) = Fn (0 ⊗ f) (MAP (tm_constify kvs) zs))

name: varify_map_def
statement: varify_map kvs m k = if k ∈ kvs then V k else m k

name: fm_constify_def
statement:
fm_constify kvs False = False ∧
  fm_constify kvs (Pred n zs) = Pred n (MAP (tm_constify kvs) zs) ∧
  fm_constify kvs (IMP p1 p2) = IMP (fm_constify kvs p1) (fm_constify kvs p2) ∧
  fm_constify kvs (FALL x p) = FALL x (fm_constify (x INSERT kvs) p)

name: constifymod_def
uncm_mod_def
uncm_map_def
statement:
uncm_map M fvs vnm = if vnm ∈ fvs then M.Fun (1 ⊗ vnm) []
                      else @a. a ∈ M.Dom

name: terms_def
statement:
(∀x. terms fns (V x)) ∧
  (∀f l. (f,LENGTH l) ∈ fns ∧ (∀t. MEM t l ⇒ terms fns t) ⇒
         terms fns (Fn f l))

name: IN_LIST_UNION
statement: x ∈ LIST_UNION l ⇔ ∃s. MEM s l ∧ x ∈ s

name: FINITE_LIST_UNION
statement: FINITE (LIST_UNION sets) ⇔ ∀s. MEM s sets ⇒ FINITE s

name: term_size_lemma
statement: ∀x l a. MEM a l ⇒ term_size a < 1 + (x + term1_size l)

name: term_induct
statement:
∀P. (∀v. P (V v)) ∧ (∀n ts. (∀t. MEM t ts ⇒ P t) ⇒ P (Fn n ts)) ⇒
      ∀t. P t

name: FVT_FINITE
statement: ∀t. FINITE (FVT t)

name: tswap_inv
statement: ∀t. tswap x y (tswap x y t) = t

name: tswap_id
statement: ∀t. tswap x x t = t

name: tswap_supp_id
statement: ∀t. x ∉ FVT t ∧ y ∉ FVT t ⇒ (tswap x y t = t)

name: termsubst_termsubst
statement: ∀t i j. termsubst j (termsubst i t) = termsubst (termsubst j o i) t

name: termsubst_triv
statement: ∀t. termsubst V t = t

name: termsubst_valuation
statement: ∀t v1 v2. (∀x. x ∈ FVT t ⇒ (v1 x = v2 x)) ⇒ (termsubst v1 t = termsubst v2 t)

name: termsubst_fvt
statement: ∀t i. FVT (termsubst i t) = { x | ∃y. y ∈ FVT t ∧ x ∈ FVT (i y) }

name: freshsubst_tswap
statement: ∀t. y ∉ FVT t ⇒ (termsubst V⦇ x ↦ V y ⦈ t = tswap x y t)

name: form_functions_Exists
statement: form_functions (Exists x p) = form_functions p

name: form_predicates_Exists
statement: form_predicates (Exists x p) = form_predicates p

name: functions_SING
statement: functions {f} = form_functions f

name: language_SING
statement: language {p} = (form_functions p, form_predicates p)

name: FV_extras
statement:
(FV True = ∅) ∧
  (FV (Not p) = FV p) ∧
  (FV (And p q) = FV p ∪ FV q) ∧
  (FV (Or p q) = FV p ∪ FV q) ∧
  (FV (Iff p q) = FV p ∪ FV q) ∧
  (FV (Exists x p) = FV p DELETE x)

name: language_FALL
statement: language {FALL x p} = language {p}

name: language_Exists
statement: language {Exists x p} = language {p}

name: FV_FINITE
statement: ∀f. FINITE (FV f)

name: BV_FINITE
statement: ∀f. FINITE (BV f)

name: VARIANT_FINITE
statement: ∀s. FINITE s ⇒ VARIANT s ∉ s

name: VARIANT_THM
statement: VARIANT (FV t) ∉ FV t

name: formsubst_triv
statement: formsubst V p = p

name: formsubst_valuation
statement: ∀v1 v2. (∀x. x ∈ FV p ⇒ (v1 x = v2 x)) ⇒ (formsubst v1 p = formsubst v2 p)

name: formsubst_FV
statement: ∀i. FV (formsubst i p) = { x | ∃y. y ∈ FV p ∧ x ∈ FVT (i y) }

name: VARIANT_NOTIN_SUBSET
statement: FINITE s ∧ t ⊆ s ⇒ VARIANT s ∉ t

name: formsubst_rename
statement: FV (formsubst V⦇ x ↦ V y⦈ p) DELETE y = (FV p DELETE x) DELETE y

name: term_functions_termsubst
statement:
∀t i. term_functions (termsubst i t) =
        term_functions t ∪ { x | ∃y. y ∈ FVT t ∧ x ∈ term_functions (i y) }

name: form_functions_formsubst
statement:
∀i. form_functions (formsubst i p) =
      form_functions p ∪ { x | ∃y. y ∈ FV p ∧ x ∈ term_functions (i y) }

name: form_functions_formsubst1
statement:
x ∈ FV p ⇒
  (form_functions (formsubst V⦇ x ↦ t ⦈ p) =
   form_functions p ∪ term_functions t)

name: form_predicates_formsubst
statement: ∀i. form_predicates (formsubst i p) = form_predicates p

name: formsubst_14b
statement: x ∉ FV p ⇒ (formsubst V⦇ x ↦ t ⦈ p = p)

name: formsubst_language_rename
statement: language {formsubst V⦇ x ↦ V y ⦈ p} = language {p}

name: num_of_term_11
statement: ∀t1 t2. num_of_term t1 = num_of_term t2 ⇔ t1 = t2

name: TERM_OF_NUM
statement: term_of_num(num_of_term t) = t

name: countable_terms
statement: countable 𝕌(:term)

name: INFINITE_terms
statement: INFINITE 𝕌(:term)

name: num_of_form_11
statement: ∀p1 p2. num_of_form p1 = num_of_form p2 ⇔ p1 = p2

name: countable_forms
statement: countable 𝕌(:form)

name: INFINITE_forms
statement: INFINITE 𝕌(:form)

name: FORM_OF_NUM
statement: form_of_num (num_of_form p) = p

name: LIST_UNION_def
statement:
(LIST_UNION [] = ∅) ∧
  (LIST_UNION (h::t) = h ∪ LIST_UNION t)

name: tswap_def
statement:
(tswap x y (V v) = if v = x then V y else if v = y then V x else V v) ∧
  (tswap x y (Fn f ts) = Fn f (MAP (tswap x y) ts))

name: FVT_def
statement:
(FVT (V v) = {v}) ∧
  (FVT (Fn s ts) = LIST_UNION (MAP FVT ts))

name: termsubst_def
statement:
(termsubst v (V x) = v x) ∧
  (termsubst v (Fn f l) = Fn f (MAP (termsubst v) l))

name: Not_def
statement: Not f = IMP f False

name: True_def
statement: True = Not False

name: Or_def
statement: Or p q = IMP (IMP p q) q

name: And_def
statement: And p q = Not (Or (Not p) (Not q))

name: Iff_def
statement: Iff p q = And (IMP p q) (IMP q p)

name: Exists_def
statement: Exists x p = Not (FALL x (Not p))

name: term_functions_def
statement:
(term_functions (V v) = ∅) ∧
  (term_functions (Fn f args) =
     (f, LENGTH args) INSERT LIST_UNION (MAP term_functions args))

name: form_functions_def
statement:
(form_functions False = ∅) ∧
  (form_functions (Pred n ts) = LIST_UNION (MAP term_functions ts)) ∧
  (form_functions (IMP f1 f2) = form_functions f1 ∪ form_functions f2) ∧
  (form_functions (FALL x f) = form_functions f)

name: form_predicates
statement:
(form_predicates False = ∅) ∧
  (form_predicates (Pred n ts) = {(n,LENGTH ts)}) ∧
  (form_predicates (IMP f1 f2) = form_predicates f1 ∪ form_predicates f2) ∧
  (form_predicates (FALL x f) = form_predicates f)

name: functions_def
statement: functions fms = BIGUNION{form_functions f | f ∈ fms}

name: predicates_def
statement: predicates fms = BIGUNION {form_predicates f | f ∈ fms}

name: language_def
statement: language fms = (functions fms, predicates fms)

name: FV_def
statement:
(FV False = ∅) ∧
  (FV (Pred _ ts) = LIST_UNION (MAP FVT ts)) ∧
  (FV (IMP f1 f2) = FV f1 ∪ FV f2) ∧
  (FV (FALL x f) = FV f DELETE x)

name: BV_def
statement:
(BV False = ∅) ∧
  (BV (Pred _ _) = ∅) ∧
  (BV (IMP f1 f2) = BV f1 ∪ BV f2) ∧
  (BV (FALL x f) = x INSERT BV f)

name: VARIANT_def
statement: VARIANT s = MAX_SET s + 1

name: formsubst_def
statement:
(formsubst v False = False) ∧
  (formsubst v (Pred p l) = Pred p (MAP (termsubst v) l)) ∧
  (formsubst v (IMP f1 f2) = IMP (formsubst v f1) (formsubst v f2)) ∧
  (formsubst v (FALL u f) =
     let v' = v⦇ u ↦ V u ⦈ ;
         z  = if ∃y. y ∈ FV (FALL u f) ∧ u ∈ FVT (v' y) then
                VARIANT (FV (formsubst v' f))
              else u
     in
       FALL z (formsubst v⦇ u ↦ V z ⦈ f))

name: num_of_term_def
statement:
num_of_term (V x) = 0 ⊗ x ∧
  num_of_term (Fn f l) = 1 ⊗ (f ⊗ nlist_of (MAP num_of_term l))

name: term_of_num_def
statement: term_of_num n = @t. n = num_of_term t

name: num_of_form_def
statement:
num_of_form False = 0 ⊗ 0 ∧
  num_of_form (Pred p l) = 1 ⊗ (p ⊗ nlist_of (MAP num_of_term l)) ∧
  num_of_form (IMP p1 p2) = 2 ⊗ (num_of_form p1 ⊗ num_of_form p2) ∧
  num_of_form (FALL x p) = 3 ⊗ (x ⊗ num_of_form p)

name: form_of_num_def
statement: form_of_num n = @f. num_of_form f = n

name: upd_valuation
statement: valuation M v ∧ a ∈ M.Dom ⇒ valuation M v⦇x ↦ a⦈

name: satisfies_SING
statement: M satisfies {p} ⇔ ∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v p

name: HOLDS
statement:
(holds M v False ⇔ F) ∧
  (holds M v True ⇔ T) ∧
  (holds M v (Pred a l) ⇔ M.Pred a (MAP (termval M v) l)) ∧
  (holds M v (Not p) ⇔ ~holds M v p) ∧
  (holds M v (Or p q) ⇔ holds M v p ∨ holds M v q) ∧
  (holds M v (And p q) ⇔ holds M v p ∧ holds M v q) ∧
  (holds M v (Iff p q) ⇔ (holds M v p ⇔ holds M v q)) ∧
  (holds M v (IMP p q) ⇔ (holds M v p ⇒ holds M v q)) ∧
  (holds M v (FALL x p) ⇔ ∀a. a ∈ M.Dom ⇒ holds M v⦇x ↦ a⦈ p) ∧
  (holds M v (Exists x p) ⇔ ∃a. a ∈ M.Dom ∧ holds M v⦇x ↦ a⦈ p)

name: termval_valuation
statement:
∀t M v1 v2.
     (∀x. x ∈ FVT t ⇒ (v1 x = v2 x)) ⇒
     (termval M v1 t = termval M v2 t)

name: holds_valuation
statement:
∀M p v1 v2.
     (∀x. x ∈ FV p ⇒ (v1 x = v2 x)) ⇒
     (holds M v1 p ⇔ holds M v2 p)

name: interpretation_termval
statement:
∀t M v (preds:(num # num)set).
     interpretation (term_functions t,preds) M ∧ valuation M v ⇒
     termval M v t ∈ M.Dom

name: interpretation_sublang
statement: fns2 ⊆ fns1 ∧ interpretation (fns1,preds1) M ⇒ interpretation (fns2,preds2) M

name: termsubst_termval
statement: (M.Fun = Fn) ⇒ ∀t v. termsubst v t = termval M v t

name: termval_triv
statement: (M.Fun = Fn) ⇒ ∀t. termval M V t = t

name: termval_termsubst
statement: ∀t v i. termval M v (termsubst i t) = termval M (termval M v o i) t

name: holds_formsubst
statement: ∀v i. holds M v (formsubst i p) ⇔ holds M (termval M v o i) p

name: holds_formsubst1
statement: holds M σ (formsubst V⦇ x ↦ t ⦈ p) ⇔ holds M σ⦇ x ↦ termval M σ t⦈ p

name: holds_rename
statement: holds M σ (formsubst V⦇ x ↦ V y ⦈ p) ⇔ holds M σ⦇ x ↦ σ y ⦈ p

name: holds_alpha_forall
statement:
y ∉ FV (FALL x p) ⇒
  (holds M v (FALL y (formsubst V⦇ x ↦ V y⦈ p)) ⇔
   holds M v (FALL x p))

name: holds_alpha_exists
statement:
y ∉ FV (Exists x p) ⇒
  (holds M v (Exists y (formsubst V⦇ x ↦ V y⦈ p)) ⇔
   holds M v (Exists x p))

name: termval_functions
statement:
∀t. (∀f zs. (f,LENGTH zs) ∈ term_functions t ⇒ (M.Fun f zs = M'.Fun f zs)) ⇒
      ∀v. termval M v t = termval M' v t

name: holds_functions
statement:
(M2.Dom = M1.Dom) ∧ (∀P zs. M2.Pred P zs ⇔ M1.Pred P zs) ∧
  (∀f zs. (f,LENGTH zs) ∈ form_functions p ⇒ (M2.Fun f zs = M1.Fun f zs))
 ⇒
  ∀v. holds M2 v p ⇔ holds M1 v p

name: holds_predicates
statement:
(M2.Dom = M1.Dom) ∧ (∀f zs. M2.Fun f zs = M1.Fun f zs) ∧
  (∀P zs. (P,LENGTH zs) ∈ form_predicates p ⇒ (M2.Pred P zs ⇔ M1.Pred P zs))
⇒
  ∀v. holds M2 v p ⇔ holds M1 v p

name: holds_uclose
statement:
(∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v (FALL x p)) ⇔
  (M.Dom = ∅) ∨ ∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v p

name: copy_models
statement:
INJ f 𝕌(:α) 𝕌(:β) ⇒
  (∃Ms : α model.
     Ms.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ interpretation (language s) Ms ∧ Ms satisfies s) ⇒
  (∃Mt : β model.
     Mt.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ interpretation (language s) Mt ∧ Mt satisfies s)

name: valuation_def
statement: valuation M v ⇔ ∀n. v n ∈ M.Dom

name: termval_def
statement:
(termval M v (V x) = v x) ∧
  (termval M v (Fn f l) = M.Fun f (MAP (termval M v) l))

name: holds_def
statement:
(holds M v False ⇔ F) ∧
  (holds M v (Pred a l) ⇔ M.Pred a (MAP (termval M v) l)) ∧
  (holds M v (IMP f1 f2) ⇔ (holds M v f1 ⇒ holds M v f2)) ∧
  (holds M v (FALL x f) ⇔ ∀a. a ∈ M.Dom ⇒ holds M v⦇x ↦ a⦈ f)

name: hold_def
statement: hold M v fms ⇔ ∀p. p ∈ fms ⇒ holds M v p

name: satisfies_def
statement: (satisfies) M fms ⇔ ∀v p. valuation M v ∧ p ∈ fms ⇒ holds M v p

name: interpretation_def
statement:
interpretation (fns,preds : (num # num) set) M ⇔
    ∀f l. (f, LENGTH l) ∈ fns ∧ (∀x. MEM x l ⇒ x ∈ M.Dom) ⇒
          M.Fun f l ∈ M.Dom

name: satisfiable_def
statement:
satisfiable (:α) fms ⇔
    ∃M:α model. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ interpretation (language fms) M ∧ M satisfies fms

name: ffinsat_def
statement: ffinsat (:α) s ⇔ ∀t. FINITE t ∧ t ⊆ s ⇒ satisfiable (:α) t

name: valid_def
statement:
valid (:α) fms ⇔
     ∀M:α model. interpretation (language fms) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒ M satisfies fms

name: entails_def
statement:
entails (:α) Γ p ⇔
    ∀M:α model v.
       valuation M v ∧
       interpretation (language (p INSERT Γ)) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ hold M v Γ ⇒
       holds M v p

name: equivalent_def
statement:
equivalent (:α) p q ⇔
    ∀M:α model v. holds M v p ⇔ holds M v q

name: QFREE
statement:
(qfree False ⇔ T) ∧
  (qfree True ⇔ T) ∧
  (qfree (Pred n ts) ⇔ T) ∧
  (qfree (Not p) ⇔ qfree p) ∧
  (qfree (Or p q) ⇔ qfree p ∧ qfree q) ∧
  (qfree (And p q) ⇔ qfree p ∧ qfree q) ∧
  (qfree (Iff p q) ⇔ qfree p ∧ qfree q) ∧
  (qfree (IMP p q) ⇔ qfree p ∧ qfree q) ∧
  (qfree (FALL n p) ⇔ F) ∧
  (qfree (Exists n p) ⇔ F)

name: qfree_formsubst
statement: qfree (formsubst i p) ⇔ qfree p

name: qfree_bv_empty
statement: qfree p ⇔ (BV p = ∅)

name: prenex_INDUCT_NOT
statement:
∀P. (∀p. qfree p ⇒ P p) ∧
      (∀x p. P p ⇒ P (FALL x p)) ∧
      (∀p. P p ⇒ P (Not p))
    ⇒
      ∀p. prenex p ⇒ P p

name: universal_prenex
statement: ∀p. universal p ⇒ prenex p

name: Exists_eqns
statement:
Exists x p ≠ Or q r ∧
  Exists x p ≠ Iff q r ∧
  Exists x p ≠ And q r ∧
  Exists x p ≠ FALL y q ∧
  Exists x p ≠ Pred n ts ∧
  ((Exists x p = IMP q r) ⇔ (q = FALL x (IMP p False)) ∧ (r = False)) ∧
  ((Exists x p = Exists y q) ⇔ (x = y) ∧ (p = q))

name: PRENEX
statement:
(prenex False ⇔ T) ∧
  (prenex True ⇔ T) ∧
  (prenex (Pred n ts) ⇔ T) ∧
  (prenex (Not p) ⇔ qfree p ∨ ∃x q. (Not p = Exists x q) ∧ prenex q) ∧
  (prenex (Or p q) ⇔ qfree p ∧ qfree q) ∧
  (prenex (And p q) ⇔ qfree p ∧ qfree q) ∧
  (prenex (IMP p q) ⇔ qfree p ∧ qfree q ∨
                      ∃x r. (IMP p q = Exists x r) ∧ prenex r) ∧
  (prenex (Iff p q) ⇔ qfree p ∧ qfree q) ∧
  (prenex (FALL x p) ⇔ prenex p) ∧
  (prenex (Exists x p) ⇔ prenex p)

name: formsubst_EQ
statement:
(∀i p. (formsubst i p = False) ⇔ (p = False)) ∧
  (∀i p. (False = formsubst i p) ⇔ (p = False)) ∧
  (∀i p n ts. (formsubst i p = Pred n ts) ⇔ ∃ts0. (p = Pred n ts0) ∧
                                       (ts = MAP (termsubst i) ts0)) ∧
  (∀i p q r. (formsubst i p = IMP q r) ⇔
             ∃q0 r0. (p = IMP q0 r0) ∧ (q = formsubst i q0) ∧
                     (r = formsubst i r0)) ∧
  (∀i p q. (formsubst i p = Not q) ⇔ ∃q0. (p = Not q0) ∧ (q = formsubst i q0))

name: formsubst_Not
statement: formsubst i (Not p) = Not (formsubst i p)

name: Not_11
statement: (Not p = Not q) ⇔ (p = q)

name: formsubst_EQ_FALL
statement: (∃x q. formsubst i p = FALL x q) ⇔ (∃x q. p = FALL x q)

name: formsubst_EQ_Exists
statement: (∃x q. formsubst i p = Exists x q) ⇔ (∃x q. p = Exists x q)

name: prenex_formsubst
statement: prenex (formsubst i p) ⇔ prenex p

name: SIZE
statement:
(size False = 1) ∧
  (size True = 3) ∧
  (size (Pred n ts) = 1) ∧
  (size (Not p) = 2 + size p) ∧
  (size (Or p q) = size p + 2 * size q + 2) ∧
  (size (And p q) = size p + 2 * size q + 10) ∧
  (size (Iff p q) = 3 * size p + 3 * size q + 13) ∧
  (size (IMP p q) = size p + size q + 1) ∧
  (size (FALL x p) = 1 + size p) ∧
  (size (Exists x p) = 5 + size p)

name: size_formsubst
statement: ∀i. size (formsubst i p) = size p

name: PPAT
statement:
(PPAT A B C (FALL x p) = A x p) ∧
  (PPAT A B C (Exists x p) = B x p) ∧
  ((!x q. p ≠ FALL x q) ∧ (∀x q. p ≠ Exists x q) ⇒ (PPAT A B C p = C p))

name: PPAT_CONG
statement:
∀A1 A2 B1 B2 C1 C2 q q'.
    (∀x p. size p < size q ⇒ (A1 x p = A2 x p)) ∧
    (∀x p. size p < size q ⇒ (B1 x p = B2 x p)) ∧ (∀p. C1 p = C2 p) ∧
    (q = q') ⇒
    (PPAT A1 B1 C1 q = PPAT A2 B2 C2 q')

name: prenexR_thm
statement:
(prenexR p (FALL x q) = let y = VARIANT (FV p ∪ FV (FALL x q))
                          in
                            FALL y (prenexR p (formsubst V⦇x ↦ V y⦈ q))) ∧
  (prenexR p (Exists x q) = let y = VARIANT (FV p ∪ FV(Exists x q))
                            in
                              Exists y (prenexR p (formsubst V⦇x ↦ V y⦈ q))) ∧
  (qfree q ⇒ (prenexR p q = IMP p q))

name: prenexL_thm
statement:
(prenexL (FALL x p) q = let y = VARIANT (FV (FALL x p) ∪ FV q)
                          in
                            Exists y (prenexL (formsubst V⦇x ↦ V y⦈ p) q)) ∧
  (prenexL (Exists x p) q = let y = VARIANT (FV (Exists x p) ∪ FV q)
                            in
                              FALL y (prenexL (formsubst V⦇x ↦ V y⦈ p) q)) ∧
  (qfree p ⇒ (prenexL p q = prenexR p q))

name: prenexR_language
statement: ∀p. language {prenexR p q} = language {IMP p q}

name: prenexL_language
statement: ∀q. language {prenexL p q} = language {IMP p q}

name: prenex_lemma_forall
statement:
P ∧ (FV f1 = FV f2) ∧ (language {f1} = language {f2}) ∧
  (∀M:α model v. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒ (holds M v f1 ⇔ holds M v f2)) ⇒
  P ∧ (FV (FALL z f1) = FV (FALL z f2)) ∧
  (language {FALL z f1} = language {FALL z f2}) ∧
  ∀M:α model v. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒ (holds M v (FALL z f1) ⇔ holds M v (FALL z f2))

name: prenex_lemma_exists
statement:
P ∧ (FV f1 = FV f2) ∧ (language {f1} = language {f2}) ∧
  (∀M:α model v. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒ (holds M v f1 ⇔ holds M v f2)) ⇒
  P ∧ (FV (Exists z f1) = FV (Exists z f2)) ∧
  (language {Exists z f1} = language {Exists z f2}) ∧
  ∀M:α model v. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒ (holds M v (Exists z f1) ⇔ holds M v (Exists z f2))

name: prenex_rename1
statement: ∀f x y. prenex (formsubst V⦇x ↦ V y⦈ f) ⇔ prenex f

name: tfresh_rename_inverts
statement: ∀t x y. y ∉ FVT t ⇒ (termsubst V⦇y ↦ V x⦈ (termsubst V⦇x ↦ V y⦈ t) = t)

name: holds_nonFV
statement: v ∉ FV f ⇒ (holds M i⦇ v ↦ t ⦈ f ⇔ holds M i f)

name: prenexR_FV
statement: FV (prenexR p q) = FV p ∪ FV q

name: prenexR_prenex
statement: qfree p ∧ prenex q ⇒ prenex (prenexR p q)

name: prenexR_holds
statement: ∀M v. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒ (holds M v (prenexR p q) ⇔ holds M v (IMP p q))

name: prenexL_FV
statement: FV (prenexL p q) = FV p ∪ FV q

name: prenexL_prenex
statement: prenex p ∧ prenex q ⇒ prenex (prenexL p q)

name: prenexL_holds
statement: ∀M vln. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒ (holds M vln (prenexL p q) ⇔ holds M vln (IMP p q))

name: prenex_Prenex
statement: prenex (Prenex f)

name: FV_Prenex
statement: FV (Prenex f) = FV f

name: holds_Prenex
statement: ∀vln. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒ (holds M vln (Prenex f) ⇔ holds M vln f)

name: language_Prenex
statement: language {Prenex f} = language {f}

name: form_functions_prenexR
statement: ∀f1 f2. form_functions (prenexR f1 f2) = form_functions f1 ∪ form_functions f2

name: form_functions_prenexL
statement: ∀f1 f2. form_functions (prenexL f1 f2) = form_functions f1 ∪ form_functions f2

name: form_functions_Prenex
statement: form_functions (Prenex f) = form_functions f

name: form_predicates_prenexR
statement:
∀f1 f2.
    form_predicates (prenexR f1 f2) = form_predicates f1 ∪ form_predicates f2

name: form_predicates_prenexL
statement:
∀f1 f2.
    form_predicates (prenexL f1 f2) = form_predicates f1 ∪ form_predicates f2

name: form_predicates_Prenex
statement: form_predicates (Prenex p) = form_predicates p

name: qfree_def
statement:
(qfree False ⇔ T) ∧
  (qfree (Pred _ _) ⇔ T) ∧
  (qfree (IMP f1 f2) ⇔ qfree f1 ∧ qfree f2) ∧
  (qfree (FALL _ _) ⇔ F)

name: size_def
statement:
(size False = 1) ∧
  (size (Pred _ _) = 1) ∧
  (size (IMP q r) = 1 + size q + size r) ∧
  (size (FALL _ q) = 1 + size q)

name: PPAT_def
statement:
PPAT A B C p =
    case some (x,q). p = Exists x q of
        SOME (x,q) => B x q
      | NONE =>
        case p of
            FALL x q => A x q
          | _ => C p

name: prenexR_def
statement:
prenexR p q =
    PPAT
      (λx q0. let y = VARIANT (FV p ∪ FV(FALL x q0))
              in
                FALL y (prenexR p (formsubst V⦇x ↦ V y⦈ q0)))
      (λx q0. let y = VARIANT (FV p ∪ FV(Exists x q0))
              in
                Exists y (prenexR p (formsubst V⦇x ↦ V y⦈ q0)))
      (λq. IMP p q)
      q

name: prenexL_def
statement:
prenexL p q =
    PPAT (λx p0. let y = VARIANT (FV (FALL x p0) ∪ FV q)
                 in
                   Exists y (prenexL (formsubst V⦇x ↦ V y⦈ p0) q))
         (λx p0. let y = VARIANT (FV (Exists x p0) ∪ FV q)
                 in
                   FALL y (prenexL (formsubst V⦇x ↦ V y⦈ p0) q))
         (λp. prenexR p q) p

name: Prenex_def
statement:
(Prenex False = False) ∧
  (Prenex (Pred n ts) = Pred n ts) ∧
  (Prenex (IMP f1 f2) = prenexL (Prenex f1) (Prenex f2)) ∧
  (Prenex (FALL x f) = FALL x (Prenex f))

name: PHOLDS
statement:
(pholds v False ⇔ F) ∧
  (pholds v True ⇔ T) ∧
  (pholds v (Pred pnm l) ⇔ v (Pred pnm l)) ∧
  (pholds v (Not q) ⇔ ¬pholds v q) ∧
  (pholds v (Or p q) ⇔ pholds v p ∨ pholds v q) ∧
  (pholds v (And p q) ⇔ pholds v p ∧ pholds v q) ∧
  (pholds v (Iff p q) ⇔ (pholds v p ⇔ pholds v q)) ∧
  (pholds v (IMP p q) ⇔ (pholds v p ⇒ pholds v q)) ∧
  (pholds v (Exists x p) ⇔ ¬v (FALL x (Not p))) ∧
  (pholds v (FALL x p) ⇔ v (FALL x p))

name: psatisfiable_mono
statement: psatisfiable a ∧ b ⊆ a ⇒ psatisfiable b

name: finsat_mono
statement: finsat a ∧ b ⊆ a ⇒ finsat b

name: satisfiable_finsat
statement: psatisfiable s ⇒ finsat s

name: IN_UNCURRY
statement: x IN UNCURRY f ⇔ UNCURRY f x

name: FINSAT_MAX
statement: finsat a ⇒ ∃b. a ⊆ b ∧ finsat b ∧ ∀c. b ⊆ c ∧ finsat c ⇒ c = b

name: finsat_extend
statement: finsat b ⇒ ∀p. finsat (p INSERT b) ∨ finsat (Not p INSERT b)

name: finsat_max_complete
statement: finsat b ∧ (∀c. b ⊆ c ∧ finsat c ⇒ c = b) ⇒ ∀p. p ∈ b ∨ Not p ∈ b

name: finsat_max_complete_strong
statement: finsat b ∧ (∀c. b ⊆ c ∧ finsat c ⇒ c = b) ⇒ ∀p. Not p ∈ b ⇔ p ∉ b

name: finsat_deduction
statement:
finsat b ∧ (∀c. b ⊆ c ∧ finsat c ⇒ c = b) ⇒
  ∀p. p ∈ b ⇔ ∃a. FINITE a ∧ a ⊆ b ∧ ∀v. (∀q. q ∈ a ⇒ pholds v q) ⇒ pholds v p

name: finsat_consistent
statement: finsat b ⇒ False ∉ b

name: finsat_max_homo
statement:
finsat b ∧ (∀c. b ⊆ c ∧ finsat c ⇒ c = b) ⇒
  ∀p q. IMP p q ∈ b ⇔ p ∈ b ⇒ q ∈ b

name: COMPACT_PROP
statement:
(∀b. FINITE b ∧ b ⊆ a ⇒ ∃v. ∀r. r ∈ b ⇒ pholds v r) ⇒
  ∃v. ∀r. r ∈ a ⇒ pholds v r

name: compact_finsat
statement: psatisfiable a ⇔ finsat a

name: COMPACT_PROP_ALT
statement:
∀a. (∀v. ∃p. p ∈ a ∧ pholds v p) ⇒
      ∃b. FINITE b ∧ b ⊆ a ∧ ∀v. ∃p. p ∈ b ∧ pholds v p

name: FINITE_DISJ_lemma
statement:
∀a. FINITE a ⇒
      ∃ps. EVERY (λp. p ∈ a) ps ∧
           ∀v. pholds v (FOLDR Or False ps) ⇔
               ∃p. p ∈ a ∧ pholds v p

name: COMPACT_DISJ
statement:
∀a. (∀v. ∃p. p ∈ a ∧ pholds v p) ⇒
      ∃ps. EVERY (λp. p ∈ a) ps ∧ ∀v. pholds v (FOLDR Or False ps)

name: pholds_def
statement:
(pholds v False ⇔ F) ∧
  (pholds v (Pred p l) ⇔ v (Pred p l)) ∧
  (pholds v (IMP p q) ⇔ (pholds v p ⇒ pholds v q)) ∧
  (pholds v (FALL x p) ⇔ v (FALL x p))

name: psatisfies_def
statement: v psatisfies s ⇔ ∀p. p ∈ s ⇒ pholds v p

name: psatisfiable_def
statement: psatisfiable s ⇔ ∃v. v psatisfies s

name: finsat_def
statement: finsat a ⇔ ∀b. b ⊆ a ∧ FINITE b ⇒ psatisfiable b

name: holds_exists_lemma
statement:
∀p t x M v (preds : (num # num) set).
     interpretation (term_functions t, preds) M ∧
     valuation M v ∧
     holds M v (formsubst V⦇x ↦ t⦈ p)
    ⇒
     holds M v (Exists x p)

name: FV_Skolem1
statement: FV (Skolem1 f x p) = FV (Exists x p)

name: size_Skolem1
statement: size (Skolem1 f x p) = size p

name: prenex_Skolem1
statement: prenex (Skolem1 f x p) ⇔ prenex p

name: form_predicates_Skolem1
statement: form_predicates (Skolem1 f x p) = form_predicates p

name: LIST_UNION_MAP_KEMPTY
statement:
LIST_UNION (MAP (λa. ∅) l) = ∅ ∧
  LIST_UNION (MAP (K ∅) l) = ∅

name: form_functions_Skolem1
statement:
form_functions (Skolem1 f x p) ⊆
    (f, CARD (FV (Exists x p))) INSERT form_functions p ∧
  form_functions p ⊆ form_functions (Skolem1 f x p)

name: Skolem1_ID
statement: x ∉ FV p ⇒ Skolem1 f x p = p

name: termval_o_V
statement: termval M v o V = v

name: holds_Skolem1_I
statement:
(f,CARD (FV (Exists x p))) ∉ form_functions (Exists x p)
 ⇒
  ∀M. interpretation (language {p}) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧
      (∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v (Exists x p))
   ⇒
      ∃M'. M'.Dom = M.Dom ∧ M'.Pred = M.Pred ∧
           (∀g zs. g ≠ f ∨ LENGTH zs ≠ CARD (FV (Exists x p)) ⇒
                   M'.Fun g zs = M.Fun g zs) ∧
           interpretation (language {Skolem1 f x p}) M' ∧
           ∀v. valuation M' v ⇒ holds M' v (Skolem1 f x p)

name: holds_Skolem1_E
statement:
(f,CARD (FV (Exists x p))) ∉ form_functions (Exists x p) ⇒
  ∀N. interpretation (language {Skolem1 f x p}) N ∧ N.Dom ≠ ∅
     ⇒
      ∀v. valuation N v ∧ holds N v (Skolem1 f x p) ⇒ holds N v (Exists x p)

name: prenex_Skolems_universal
statement: ∀J p k. prenex p ⇒ universal (Skolems J p k)

name: FV_Skolems
statement: ∀J p k. FV (Skolems J p k) = FV p

name: form_predicates_Skolems
statement: ∀J p k. form_predicates (Skolems J p k) = form_predicates p

name: form_functions_Skolems_up
statement:
∀J p k.
    form_functions (Skolems J p k) ⊆
      {(J ⊗ l, m) | l, m | k ≤ l} ∪ form_functions p

name: form_functions_Skolems_down
statement:
∀J p k.
    form_functions p ⊆ form_functions (Skolems J p k)

name: holds_Skolems_I
statement:
∀J p k M.
     interpretation (language{p}) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧
     (∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v p) ∧
     (∀l m. (J ⊗ l,m) ∈ form_functions p ⇒ l < k)
    ⇒
     ∃M'. M'.Dom = M.Dom ∧ M'.Pred = M.Pred ∧
          (∀g zs. M'.Fun g zs ≠ M.Fun g zs ⇒ ∃l. k ≤ l ∧ g = J ⊗ l) ∧
          interpretation (language {Skolems J p k}) M' ∧
          ∀v. valuation M' v ⇒ holds M' v (Skolems J p k)

name: interpretation_Skolem1_E
statement:
∀N f x p. interpretation (language {Skolem1 f x p}) N ⇒
            interpretation (language {p}) N

name: interpretation_Skolems_E
statement:
∀J p k N. interpretation (language {Skolems J p k}) N ⇒
            interpretation (language {p}) N

name: holds_Skolems_E
statement:
∀J p k.
    (∀l m. (J ⊗ l, m) ∈ form_functions p ⇒ l < k) ⇒
    ∀N. interpretation (language {Skolems J p k}) N ∧ N.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒
        ∀v. valuation N v ∧ holds N v (Skolems J p k) ⇒
            holds N v p

name: FV_Skopre

name: universal_Skopre

name: form_predicates_Skopre

name: form_functions_Skopre_I

name: form_functions_Skopre_E
statement: form_functions (Skopre j p) ⊆ {(j ⊗ l, m) | l,m | T } ∪ form_functions p

name: holds_Skopre_I
statement:
∀p j M.
     (∀l m. (j ⊗ l, m) ∉ form_functions p) ∧
     interpretation (language {p}) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧
     (∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v p)
   ⇒
     ∃M'. M'.Dom = M.Dom ∧ M'.Pred = M.Pred ∧
          (∀g zs. M'.Fun g zs ≠ M.Fun g zs ⇒ ∃l. g = j ⊗ l) ∧
          interpretation (language {Skopre j p}) M' ∧
          ∀v. valuation M' v ⇒ holds M' v (Skopre j p)

name: holds_Skopre_E
statement:
∀p j N. (∀l m. (j ⊗ l, m) ∉ form_functions p) ∧
          interpretation (language{Skopre j p}) N ∧ N.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒
          ∀v. valuation N v ∧ holds N v (Skopre j p) ⇒ holds N v p

name: interpretation_Skopre_E
statement:
∀p j N. interpretation (language {Skopre j p}) N ⇒
          interpretation (language {p}) N

name: bumpmod_rwts

(bumpmod M).Pred = M.Pred ∧ (bumpmod M).Dom = M.Dom ∧

name: valuation_bumpmod

name: FV_bumpform

name: holds_bump
statement: ∀M v p. holds (bumpmod M) v (bumpform p) ⇔ holds M v p

name: term_functions_bumpterm
statement: term_functions (bumpterm t) = { (0 ⊗ k, m) | (k,m) ∈ term_functions t }

name: form_predicates_bumpform
statement: form_predicates (bumpform p) = form_predicates p

name: interpretation_bumpform

interpretation (language {bumpform p}) (bumpmod M) ⇔

name: bumpterm_inv
statement: unbumpterm (bumpterm t) = t

name: bumpform_inv
statement: unbumpform (bumpform p) = p

name: unbumpmod_rwts
statement:
(unbumpmod M).Dom = M.Dom ∧
  (unbumpmod M).Pred = M.Pred ∧
  (∀v. valuation (unbumpmod M) v ⇔ valuation M v)

name: termval_unbumpmod
statement: termval (unbumpmod M) v t = termval M v (bumpterm t)

name: holds_unbumpmod
statement: ∀M v p. holds (unbumpmod M) v p ⇔ holds M v (bumpform p)

name: SKOLEMIZE_props
statement:
universal (SKOLEMIZE p) ∧
  prenex (SKOLEMIZE p) ∧
  form_predicates (SKOLEMIZE p) = form_predicates p ∧
  FV (SKOLEMIZE p) = FV p

name: form_functions_SKOLEMIZE_E
statement:
form_functions (SKOLEMIZE p) ⊆
    {(k ⊗ l, m) | k,l,m | k = num_of_form (bumpform p) +1} ∪
    form_functions (bumpform p)

name: holds_SKOLEMIZE_I
statement:
∀M p. interpretation (language {bumpform p}) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧
        (∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v (bumpform p))
     ⇒
        ∃M'. M'.Dom = M.Dom ∧
             M'.Pred = M.Pred ∧
             (∀g zs. M'.Fun g zs ≠ M.Fun g zs ⇒
                     ∃l. g = (num_of_form (bumpform p) + 1) ⊗ l) ∧
             interpretation (language {SKOLEMIZE p}) M' ∧
             ∀v. valuation M' v ⇒ holds M' v (SKOLEMIZE p)

name: holds_SKOLEMIZE_E
statement:
∀N. interpretation (language {SKOLEMIZE p}) N ∧ N.Dom ≠ ∅
        ⇒
      ∀v. valuation N v ∧ holds N v (SKOLEMIZE p) ⇒
          holds N v (bumpform p)

name: interpretation_SKOLEMIZE_E
statement:
interpretation (language {SKOLEMIZE p}) N ⇒
  interpretation (language {bumpform p}) N

name: SKOMOD1_rwts
statement:
interpretation (language{p}) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒
  (SKOMOD1 p M).Dom = M.Dom ∧
  (SKOMOD1 p M).Pred = M.Pred ∧
  interpretation (language {SKOLEMIZE p}) (SKOMOD1 p M)

name: holds_SKOMOD1_I
statement:
interpretation (language{p}) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒
  (∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v p)
    ⇒
  (∀g zs. (SKOMOD1 p M).Fun g zs ≠ (bumpmod M).Fun g zs ⇒
          ∃l. g = (num_of_form (bumpform p) + 1) ⊗ l) ∧
  ∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds (SKOMOD1 p M) v (SKOLEMIZE p)

name: SKOMOD_rwts
statement:
(SKOMOD M).Dom = M.Dom ∧
  (SKOMOD M).Pred = M.Pred ∧
  (∀v. valuation (SKOMOD M) v = valuation M v)

name: SKOMOD_INTERPRETATION
statement:
interpretation (language {p}) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅
    ⇒
  interpretation (language {SKOLEMIZE p}) (SKOMOD M)

name: SKOMOD_WORKS
statement:
interpretation (language {p}) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒
  ((∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds (SKOMOD M) v (SKOLEMIZE p)) ⇔
   (∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v p))

name: SKOMOD_INTERPRETATION_SET
statement:
interpretation (language s) M ∧ M.Dom ≠ ∅
    ⇒
  interpretation (language {SKOLEMIZE p | p ∈ s}) (SKOMOD M)

name: interpretation_language_member
statement:
interpretation (language s) M ∧ p ∈ s ⇒
  interpretation (language {p}) M

name: SKOLEMIZE_SATISFIABLE
statement:
(∃M : α model. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ interpretation (language s) M ∧ M satisfies s) ⇔
  (∃M : α model.
       M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ interpretation (language {SKOLEMIZE p | p ∈ s}) M ∧
       M satisfies {SKOLEMIZE p | p ∈ s})

name: holds_specialize
statement:
∀M p. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒
        ((∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v (specialize p)) ⇔
         (∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v p))

name: specialize_satisfies
statement: M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒ (M satisfies {specialize p | p ∈ s} ⇔ M satisfies s)

name: specialize_satisfies_IMAGE
statement: M.Dom ≠ ∅ ⇒ (M satisfies (IMAGE specialize s) ⇔ M satisfies s)

name: specialize_qfree
statement: ∀p. universal p ⇒ qfree(specialize p)

name: form_functions_specialize
statement: form_functions (specialize p) = form_functions p

name: form_predicates_specialize
statement: form_predicates (specialize p) = form_predicates p

name: language_specialize
statement: language {specialize p | p ∈ s} = language s

name: language_specialize_IMAGE
statement: language (IMAGE specialize s) = language s

name: qfree_SKOLEM
statement: qfree (SKOLEM p)

name: SKOLEM_SATISFIABLE
statement:
(∃M:α model. M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ interpretation (language s) M ∧ M satisfies s) ⇔
  (∃M:α model.
     M.Dom ≠ ∅ ∧ interpretation (language {SKOLEM p | p ∈ s}) M ∧
     M satisfies {SKOLEM p | p ∈ s})

name: satisfiable_SKOLEM
statement: satisfiable (:α) { SKOLEM p | p ∈ s } ⇔ satisfiable (:α) s

name: Skolem1_def
statement:
Skolem1 f x p =
    formsubst V⦇ x ↦ Fn f (MAP V (SET_TO_LIST (FV (Exists x p))))⦈ p

name: Skolems_def
statement:
Skolems J r k =
    PPAT (λx q. FALL x (Skolems J q k))
         (λx q. Skolems J (Skolem1 (J *, k) x q) (k + 1))
         (λp. p) r

name: Skopre_def
statement: Skopre J p = Skolems J (Prenex p) 0

name: bumpmod_def
statement: bumpmod M = M with Fun := λk zs. M.Fun (nsnd k) zs

name: bumpterm_def
statement:
bumpterm (V x) = V x ∧
  bumpterm (Fn k l) = Fn (0 ⊗ k) (MAP bumpterm l)

name: bumpform_def
statement:
bumpform False = False ∧
  bumpform (Pred p l) = Pred p (MAP bumpterm l) ∧
  bumpform (IMP p q) = IMP (bumpform p) (bumpform q) ∧
  bumpform (FALL x p) = FALL x (bumpform p)

name: unbumpterm_def
statement:
unbumpterm (V x) = V x ∧
  unbumpterm (Fn k l) = Fn (nsnd k) (MAP unbumpterm l)

name: unbumpform_def
statement:
unbumpform False = False ∧
  unbumpform (Pred p l) = Pred p (MAP unbumpterm l) ∧
  unbumpform (IMP f1 f2) = IMP (unbumpform f1) (unbumpform f2) ∧
  unbumpform (FALL x f) = FALL x (unbumpform f)

name: unbumpmod_def
statement: unbumpmod M = M with Fun := λk zs. M.Fun (0 ⊗ k) zs

name: SKOLEMIZE_def
statement: SKOLEMIZE p = Skopre (num_of_form (bumpform p) + 1) (bumpform p)

name: SKOMOD1_def
statement:
SKOMOD1 p M =
    if (∀v. valuation M v ⇒ holds M v p) then
      @M'. M'.Dom = (bumpmod M).Dom ∧
           M'.Pred = (bumpmod M).Pred ∧
           (∀g zs. M'.Fun g zs ≠ (bumpmod M).Fun g zs ⇒
                   ∃l. g = (num_of_form (bumpform p) + 1) ⊗ l) ∧
           interpretation (language {SKOLEMIZE p}) M' ∧
           ∀v. valuation M' v ⇒ holds M' v (SKOLEMIZE p)
    else M with Fun := λg zs. @a. a ∈ M.Dom

name: SKOMOD_def
statement:
SKOMOD M =
    M with
      Fun := λg zs.
       if nfst g = 0 then M.Fun (nsnd g) zs
       else (SKOMOD1 (unbumpform (form_of_num (nfst g - 1))) M).Fun g zs

name: specialize_def
statement:
specialize False = False ∧
  specialize (Pred p l) = Pred p l ∧
  specialize (IMP p1 p2) = IMP p1 p2 ∧
  specialize (FALL x p) = specialize p

name: SKOLEM_def

statement: ∀rf1 rf2 π. faeq (rawfpm π rf1) (rawfpm π rf2) ⇔ faeq rf1 rf2

name: faeq_rawALLL_invert
statement:
faeq (rawALL bv1 rf1) rf ⇔
   ∃bv2 rf2 z. (rf = rawALL bv2 rf2) ∧ z ≠ bv1 ∧ z ≠ bv2 ∧
               z ∉ raw_atoms rf1 ∧ z ∉ raw_atoms rf2 ∧
               faeq (rawfpm [(bv1,z)] rf1) (rawfpm [(bv2,z)] rf2)

name: rawfpm_sing_to_front

name: faeq_trans

name: faeq_equiv
statement: ∀rf1 rf2. faeq rf1 rf2 ⇔ (faeq rf1 = faeq rf2)

name: faeq_rawfv

name: faeq_imp0
statement: faeq (imp0 rf1 rf2) (imp0 rfa rfb) ⇔ faeq rf1 rfa ∧ faeq rf2 rfb

statement: faeq (rawP n1 ts1) (rawP n2 ts2) ⇔ (n1 = n2) ∧ (ts1 = ts2)

name: faeq_ALL_respects

name: raw_tpm_def
statement:
(raw_tpm π (V s) = V (lswapstr π s)) ∧
  (raw_tpm π (TFn f ts) = TFn f (MAP (raw_tpm π) ts))

name: LIST_UNION_def
statement:
(LIST_UNION [] = ∅) ∧
  (LIST_UNION (s::rest) = s ∪ LIST_UNION rest)

name: tfv_def

(tfv (V s) = {s}) ∧
  (tfv (TFn f ts) = LIST_UNION (MAP tfv ts))

name: rawfpm_def
statement:
(rawfpm pi (imp0 rf1 rf2) = imp0 (rawfpm pi rf1) (rawfpm pi rf2)) ∧
  (rawfpm pi raw_falsity = raw_falsity) ∧
  (rawfpm pi (rawP p ts) = rawP p (tlpm pi ts)) ∧
  (rawfpm pi (rawALL bv f) = rawALL (lswapstr pi bv) (rawfpm pi f))

name: raw_atoms_def
statement:
(raw_atoms raw_falsity = {}) ∧
  (raw_atoms (imp0 rf1 rf2) = raw_atoms rf1 ∪ raw_atoms rf2) ∧
  (raw_atoms (rawP p ts) = LIST_UNION (MAP tfv ts)) ∧
  (raw_atoms (rawALL bv f) = bv INSERT raw_atoms f)

name: rawfv_def
statement:
(rawfv raw_falsity = ∅) ∧
  (rawfv (imp0 rf1 rf2) = rawfv rf1 ∪ rawfv rf2) ∧
  (rawfv (rawP _ ts) = LIST_UNION (MAP tfv ts)) ∧
  (rawfv (rawALL bv rf) = rawfv rf DELETE bv)

name: ADDEDGE_COUNTER_LEMM
statement:
∀g e f g2.
       addEdgeToGraph f e g = SOME g2 ∧ flws_sorted g ∧ wfg g ==>
       flws_sorted g2

name: ADDEDGE_LEMM
statement:
!g f e aP. wfg g ∧ MEM f (graphStates g)
            ∧ unique_node_formula g
            ∧ (!x. MEM x e.sucs ==> MEM x (graphStates g))
            ∧ (flws_sorted g)
        ==> (?g2. (addEdgeToGraph f e g = SOME g2) ∧ wfg g2
          ∧ (set (graphStatesWithId g) = set (graphStatesWithId g2))
          ∧ (unique_node_formula g2)
          ∧ (!h.
                 if h = f
                 then ?i. extractTrans g2 h
                        = extractTrans g h ∪ { (i, e.pos,e.neg,set e.sucs) }
                 else extractTrans g2 h = extractTrans g h))

name: EXP_GRAPH_AP
statement:
!aP g fs g2.
        (wfg g)
      ∧ (!f. MEM f fs ==> (props f ⊆ set aP))
      ∧ (expandGraph g fs = SOME g2)
      ∧ (∀id fls.
         (id ∈ domain g.nodeInfo ∧ lookup id g.followers = SOME fls)
         ==> (∀e. MEM e (MAP FST fls)
               ⇒ MEM_SUBSET e.pos_lab aP ∧ MEM_SUBSET e.neg_lab aP)
        )
      ∧ (!id nL.
         (lookup id g.nodeInfo = SOME nL)
         ==> (!e. MEM e nL.true_labels
                   ==> MEM_SUBSET e.pos_lab aP ∧ MEM_SUBSET e.neg_lab aP
             )
        )
      ==>
      (∀id fls.
        (id ∈ domain g2.nodeInfo ∧ lookup id g2.followers = SOME fls)
        ==> (∀e. MEM e (MAP FST fls)
              ⇒ MEM_SUBSET e.pos_lab aP ∧ MEM_SUBSET e.neg_lab aP)
      )
      ∧ (!id nL.
             (lookup id g2.nodeInfo = SOME nL)
             ==> (!e. MEM e nL.true_labels
                       ==> MEM_SUBSET e.pos_lab aP ∧ MEM_SUBSET e.neg_lab aP
                 )
        )

name: expandGraph_def
statement:
(expandGraph g [] = SOME g)
 ∧ (expandGraph g1 (f::fs)  =
     let trans = trans_concr f
     in let allSucs = nub (FOLDR (\e pr. e.sucs ++ pr) [] trans)
     in let g2 = FOLDR (\p g. addFrmlToGraph g p) g1 allSucs
     in let g3 =
            FOLDR
                (\e g_opt. monad_bind g_opt (addEdgeToGraph f e))
                (SOME g2) trans
     in let restNodes =
              FILTER (\s. ~(MEM s (graphStates g1))
                       ∧ ~(s = f)
                       ∧ ~(MEM s fs)) allSucs
     in case g3 of
         | NONE => NONE
         | SOME g => expandGraph g (restNodes++fs))

name: expandGBA_def
statement:
(expandGBA g_AA acc [] G = SOME G)
 ∧ (expandGBA g_AA acc (id::ids) G =
    case lookup id G.nodeInfo of
      | NONE => NONE
      | SOME current_node =>
       let aa_frml_ids =
            CAT_OPTIONS
              (MAP (λf. OPTION_MAP FST
                          (findNode (λ(i,l). l.frml = f) g_AA)
                   )
                  current_node.frmls)
       in let concr_edges =
               CAT_OPTIONS
                 (MAP (concr_extrTrans g_AA) aa_frml_ids)
       in let trans_unopt = gba_trans_concr concr_edges
       in let flws_with_acc_sets =
                MAP (λcE. (cE,get_acc_set acc cE)) trans_unopt
       in let trans =
              ONLY_MINIMAL
                  concr_min_rel
                  flws_with_acc_sets
       in let new_sucs =
                FILTER (λqs. ~inGBA G qs)
                   (MAP (λ(cE,fs). cE.sucs) trans)
       in let (new_ids, G1) =
              FOLDR (λn (ids,g).
                        if inGBA g n
                        then (ids,g)
                        else ((g.next::ids),addNodeToGBA g n))
                      ([],G) new_sucs
       in do G2 <-
              FOLDR
                (λ(eL,suc) g_opt. do g <- g_opt ;
                                     addEdgeToGBA g id eL suc
                                  od)
                (SOME G1)
                (MAP (λ(cE,f). (edgeLabelGBA cE.pos cE.neg f,cE.sucs)) trans) ;
             expandGBA g_AA acc (nub (ids ++ new_ids)) G2
          od
   )

name: ident_EQ_SOME

ident s = SOME v ⇔
     ∃px sx. s = px ++ sx ∧ px ≠ [] ∧ EVERY (λc. isAlpha c ∧ isLower c) px ∧
             (∀c t. sx = c::t ⇒ ¬isAlpha c ∨ ¬isLower c) ∧ v = (px, sx)

TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL_def
statement:
TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL (LTL_PROP p) w = (\t. P_SEM (w t) p) /\

  TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL (LTL_AND (l1, l2)) w =
     (\a b t. a t /\ b t) (TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL l1 w)
                              (TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL l2 w) /\

  TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL (LTL_NOT l) w =
     (\a t. ~(a t)) (TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL l w) /\
  TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL (LTL_NEXT l) w =
     NEXT (TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL l w) /\
  TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL (LTL_SUNTIL (l1, l2)) w =
    (TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL l1 w SUNTIL TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL l2 w) /\
  TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL (LTL_PSNEXT l) w =
    PSNEXT (TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL l w) /\
  TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL (LTL_PSUNTIL (l1, l2)) w =
    (TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL l1 w PSUNTIL TEMPORAL_DEEP_TO_TEMPORAL l2 w)

name: bisim_def

            (!v. v IN M.frame.world /\ M.frame.rel w v ==>
                 ?v'. v' IN M'.frame.world /\ Z v v' /\ M'.frame.rel w' v') /\
            (!v'. v' IN M'.frame.world /\ M'.frame.rel w' v' ==>
                  ?v. v IN M.frame.world /\ Z v v' /\ M.frame.rel w v)

name: nbisim_def
statement:
nbisim M M' f n w w' ⇔
    w ∈ M.frame.world /\ w' ∈ M'.frame.world /\

    (!m a b. a IN M.frame.world /\ b IN M'.frame.world ==>
             m + 1 <= n ==> f (m + 1) a b ==> f m a b) /\
    f n w w' /\

    (!v v'. v IN M.frame.world /\ v' IN M'.frame.world ==>
            f 0 v v' ==> !p. satis M v (VAR p) <=> satis M' v' (VAR p)) /\

    (!v v' u i.
       i + 1 <= n /\ v IN M.frame.world /\ v' IN M'.frame.world /\
       u IN M.frame.world /\ M.frame.rel v u /\ f (i + 1) v v' ==>
       ?u'. u' IN M'.frame.world /\ M'.frame.rel v' u' /\ f i u u') /\

    (!v v' u' i.
       i + 1 <= n /\ v IN M.frame.world /\ v' IN M'.frame.world /\
       u' IN M'.frame.world /\ M'.frame.rel v' u' /\ f (i + 1) v v' ==>
       ?u. u IN M.frame.world /\ M.frame.rel v u /\ f i u u')

name: mm2folm_def
statement:
mm2folm M = <|
    Dom := M.frame.world ;
    Fun := \n args. CHOICE (M.frame.world);
    Pred := \p zs.
              case zs of
              | [w] => w IN M.frame.world /\ M.valt p w
              | [w1;w2] => p = 0 ∧ M.frame.rel w1 w2 ∧
                           w1 IN M.frame.world /\ w2 IN M.frame.world
              |  _ => F
  |>

name: ST_def
statement:
(ST x (VAR p) = fP p (fV x)) /\
  (ST x (FALSE) = fFALSE) /\
  (ST x (NOT phi) = fNOT (ST x phi)) /\
  (ST x (DISJ phi psi) = fDISJ (ST x phi) (ST x psi)) /\
  (ST x (DIAM phi) =
     fEXISTS (x + 1) (fAND (fR (fV x) (fV (x + 1))) (ST (x + 1) phi)))

name: fsatis_def
statement: fsatis M σ fform <=> valuation M σ ∧ feval M σ fform

name: ST_alt_def
statement:
(ST_alt x (VAR p) = fP p (fV x)) /\
  (ST_alt x (FALSE) = fFALSE) /\
  (ST_alt x (NOT phi) = fNOT (ST_alt x phi)) /\
  (ST_alt x (DISJ phi psi) = fDISJ (ST_alt x phi) (ST_alt x psi)) /\
  (ST_alt x (DIAM phi) =
     fEXISTS (1 - x) (fAND (fR (fV x) (fV (1 - x))) (ST_alt (1 - x) phi)))

    (∀n. M.Pred n [] ⇔ F) /\
    (∀a b n. M.Pred n [a; b] ⇒ n = 0) /\
    (∀a b c d n. (M.Pred n (a::b::c::d) ⇔ F)) /\
    IMAGE σ (univ(:num)) ⊆ M.Dom) ==>
    (feval M σ a <=>
     feval (mm2folm (ultraproduct_model U I (λi. folm2mm M)))
       (λx. {fw | Uequiv U I (models2worlds (λi. folm2mm M)) (λi. σ x) fw}) a)

      (∀a b n. M.Pred n [a; b] ⇒ n = 0) ==>
      (∀a b c d n. (M.Pred n (a::b::c::d) ⇔ F)) ==>
           (feval (mm2folm (folm2mm M)) σ f ⇔ feval M σ f)

name: ultraproduct_mm2folm_folm2mm_comm_feval

    (∀ff ll. M.Fun ff ll ∈ M.Dom) /\
    IMAGE σ (univ(:num)) ⊆ M.Dom) ==>
    (feval M σ a <=>
     feval (mm2folm (ultraproduct_model U I (λi. folm2mm M)))
       (λx. {fw | Uequiv U I (models2worlds (λi. folm2mm M)) (λi. σ x) fw}) a)

name: mm2folm_folm2mm_Pred0

name: FCT_def
statement:
(FCT (V v) = {}) /\
  (FCT (Fn s ts) = if ts = [] then {s} else (LIST_UNION (MAP FCT ts)))

name: FC_def
statement:
(FC False = {}) /\
  (FC (Pred n ts) = LIST_UNION (MAP FCT ts)) /\
  (FC (IMP f1 f2) = FC f1 ∪ FC f2) /\
  (FC (FALL x f) = FC f)

name: shift_term_def
statement:
shift_term n (V m) = V (m+n) /\
  shift_term n (Fn m l) = if l = [] then (V m) else (Fn m (MAP (shift_term n) l))

name: shift_form_def
statement:
shift_form n False = False /\
  shift_form n (Pred m l) = Pred m (MAP (shift_term n) l) /\
  shift_form n (IMP f1 f2) = IMP (shift_form n f1) (shift_form n f2) /\
  shift_form n (FALL x f) = FALL (x + n) (shift_form n f)

name: shift_valuation_def
statement: shift_valuation n σ f = \m. if m < n then (f m) else (σ (m-n))

name: equiv_on_same_partition

name: IBC_INJ_propform_equiv0

   (!phi. IBC phi fs ==>
      ?phi0.

           prop_letters phi0 ⊆ count (CARD fs)) ==>
     INJ
        (\phis.
            {f |f ⊆ count (CARD fs) /\
                peval f
                    (CHOICE
                          {phi0 | subst σ phi0 = CHOICE phis /\
                                  propform phi0 /\
                                  prop_letters phi0 ⊆ count (CARD fs)})})
        (partition (equiv0 (:β)) {phi | IBC phi fs})
        (POW (POW ((count (CARD fs)))))

name: IBC_FINITE_equiv0
statement: !fs. FINITE fs ==> FINITE (partition (equiv0 (:β)) {phi | IBC phi fs})

name: FINITE_propform_equiv0
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==>
    FINITE (partition (equiv0 (:β))
                      {phi | propform phi /\ prop_letters phi ⊆ s})

name: equiv0_TRANS
statement: !f1 f2 f3. equiv0 (:β) f1 f2 /\ (equiv0 (:β)) f2 f3 ==> equiv0 (:β) f1 f3

name: FINITE_FINITE_IBC
statement:
!fs. FINITE (partition (equiv0 (:β)) fs) ==>
       FINITE (partition (equiv0 (:β)) {phi | IBC phi fs})

name: EQ_equiv0_def
statement:
!f g. equiv0 (:β) f g <=>
      !M w:'b. w IN M.frame.world ==> (satis M w f <=> satis M w g)

name: equiv0_DIAM_lemma
statement:
!f g. INFINITE univ(:β) ==>
      ¬(equiv0 (:β) f g) ==> ¬(equiv0 (:β) (DIAM f) (DIAM g))

name: equiv0_DIAM
statement:
!f g. INFINITE univ(:'b) ==>
      (equiv0 (:β) (DIAM f) (DIAM g) <=> equiv0 (:β) f g)

name: prop_2_29_prop_letters
statement:
!s. FINITE s /\ INFINITE univ(:'b) ==>
      !n. FINITE
             (partition (equiv0 (:β))
                        { f| DEG f <= n /\ prop_letters f ⊆ s})

name: FIP_PSUBSET_proper_filter
statement:
!W S. W <> {} /\ FIP S W ==>
        ?V. proper_filter V W /\ S SUBSET V

name: UNION_proper_proper
statement:
∀W U.
     W ≠ ∅ ∧ U ≠ ∅ ∧ (∀A. A ∈ U ⇒ proper_filter A W) ∧
     (∀A B. A ∈ U ∧ B ∈ U ⇒ A ⊆ B ∨ B ⊆ A) ⇒
     proper_filter (BIGUNION U) W

name: ultrafilter_theorem
statement: !f w. proper_filter f w ==> ?U. ultrafilter U w /\ f SUBSET U

name: example_2_72
statement: (ultrafilter U (univ (:num)) /\ !n. {n} NOTIN U) ==> countably_incomplete U (univ (:num))

name: exercise_2_5_4_a
statement: FIP ({(univ(:num)) DIFF X | FINITE X}) (univ (:num))

name: exercise_2_5_4_b
statement: ?U. ultrafilter U (univ(:num)) /\ !s. FINITE s ==> s NOTIN U

name: ultrafilter_complement
statement: !U I. ultrafilter U I ==> !P. {i| i IN I /\ P i} IN U <=> {i | i IN I /\ ¬(P i)} NOTIN U

name: ultrafilter_SUBSET'
statement: !U I. ultrafilter U I ==> !s1 s2. s1 IN U /\ s1 ⊆ s2 /\ s2 ⊆ I ==> s2 IN U

name: ultrafilter_INTER
statement: !U I. ultrafilter U I ==> !s1 s2. s1 IN U /\ s2 IN U ==> (s1 ∩ s2) IN U

name: ultrafilter_INTER_INTER_SUBSET
statement:
!U I. ultrafilter U I ==>
       !s1 s2 s3. s1 IN U /\ s2 IN U /\ s3 IN U ==>
          !s4. s4 ⊆ I ==> s1 ∩ s2 ∩ s3 ⊆ s4 ==> s4 IN U

name: ultrafilter_INTER_EMPTY
statement: !U I. ultrafilter U I ==> !IFS. IFS ⊆ U /\ IFS <> {} /\ (BIGINTER IFS) NOTIN U ==> INFINITE IFS

name: countably_incomplete_chain_lemma
statement:
!U I. countably_incomplete  U I ==>
       ?In. (!n:num. In n IN U /\ In (n + 1) SUBSET In n) /\ BIGINTER {In n | n IN univ(:num)} = {}

name: countably_incomplete_chain
statement:
!U I. countably_incomplete U I ==>
       ?In. In 0 = I /\ (!n:num. In n IN U /\ In (n + 1) SUBSET In n) /\ BIGINTER {In n | n IN univ(:num)} = {}

name: chain_TRANS
statement:
!In. (!n:num. In (n + 1) SUBSET In n) ==>
  !a b. a <= b ==> In b ⊆ In a

name: chain_Ni_lemma
statement:
!In. ((!n:num. In (n + 1) SUBSET In n) /\ BIGINTER {In n | n IN univ(:num)} = {}) ==>
      (!i. i IN (In 0) ==> ?n. i IN (In n) /\
                          (!a. a > n ==> i NOTIN In a))

name: chain_Ni_EXISTS
statement:
!In. ((!n:num. In (n + 1) SUBSET In n) /\ BIGINTER {In n | n IN univ(:num)} = {}) ==>
      ?Ni.
        (!i. i IN (In 0) ==> i IN (In (Ni i)) /\
                        !a. a > (Ni i) ==> i NOTIN In a)

name: two_chains_INTER
statement:
!In. ((!n:num. In (n + 1) SUBSET In n) /\ BIGINTER {In n | n IN univ(:num)} = {}) ==>
  !Jn. (!n:num. Jn (n + 1) SUBSET Jn n) ==>
     !n. (In (n+1)) ∩ (Jn (n+1)) ⊆ (In n) ∩ (Jn n) /\
         BIGINTER {(In n) ∩ (Jn n) | n IN univ(:num)} = {}

name: generated_filter_elements
generated_filter_minimal
statement:
!E W. E ⊆ POW W /\ W <> {} ==>
      !F0. (filter F0 W /\ E ⊆ F0) ==> generated_filter E W ⊆ F0

name: prop_A_16
statement: !U I A. ultrafilter U I ==> (Uequiv U I A) equiv_on Cart_prod I A

name: ultraproduct_same_eqclass
statement:
!U I A. ultrafilter U I ==>
      !fc. fc IN (ultraproduct U I A) ==>
         !x y. x IN fc /\ y IN fc ==>
              {i | i IN I /\ x i = y i} IN U

name: ultraproduct_go_to_same_eq_class
statement:
!U I A. ultrafilter U I ==>
     !x y. (!i. i IN I ==> (x i) IN (A i)) /\
           (!i. i IN I ==> (y i) IN (A i)) /\
           ({i | i IN I /\ x i = y i} IN U) ==>
       !fc. fc IN (ultraproduct U I A) ==> (y IN fc <=> x IN fc)

name: ultraproduct_eqclass_non_empty
statement:
!U I A. ultrafilter U I ==>
      !fc. fc IN (ultraproduct U I A) ==> fc <> {}

name: eqc_CHOICE
ultraproduct_world_NOT_EMPTY
ultraproduct_world
statement:
!U J MS.
    ultrafilter U J ==>
    !v.
      v ∈ (ultraproduct_model U J MS).frame.world <=>
      (!i. i IN J ==> (MS i).frame.world <> {}) /\
      ∃x.
         (∀i. i ∈ J ⇒ x i ∈ (MS i).frame.world) /\
         v = {y | (∀i. i ∈ J ⇒ y i ∈ (MS i).frame.world) /\
                  {i | i ∈ J ∧ x i = y i} ∈ U}

name: Los_modal_thm
statement:
∀U J Ms phi fc.
            (ultrafilter U J /\
                fc ∈ (ultraproduct_model U J Ms).frame.world) ⇒
                (satis (ultraproduct_model U J Ms) fc phi ⇔
                 ∃f. f ∈ fc ∧ {i | i ∈ J ∧ satis (Ms i) (f i) phi} ∈ U)

name: thm_A_19_i_V_l3
statement:
!U I A m eqc.
    ultrafilter U I ==> m IN eqc /\ eqc IN ultraproduct U I A ==>
    !i. i IN I ==> (m i) IN (A i)

name: thm_A_19_i_V_l2
statement:
!U I A m eqc. ultrafilter U I ==>
                (m IN eqc /\ eqc IN (ultraproduct U I A)) ==> m ∈ Cart_prod I A

name: thm_A_19_i_V_l1
statement:
!U I A m eqc. ultrafilter U I ==>
                (m IN eqc /\ eqc IN (ultraproduct U I A)) ==> Uequiv U I A m m

name: thm_A_19_i_V_l4
statement: !U I A. ultrafilter U I ==> !eqc. eqc IN (ultraproduct U I A) ==> (CHOICE eqc) IN eqc

name: Uequiv_SYM
statement: !U I A x y. ultrafilter U I ==> (Uequiv U I A x y <=> Uequiv U I A y x)

name: thm_A_19_i_V_l5
statement:
!U I A. ultrafilter U I ==> !eqc. eqc IN (ultraproduct U I A) ==>
          {f | Uequiv U I A f (CHOICE eqc)} ∈ ultraproduct U I A

name: thm_A_19_i_Fn_l1
statement: !σ U I A. IMAGE σ 𝕌(:num) ⊆ ultraproduct U I A ==> (!i. i IN I ==> A i <> {})

name: termval_IN_Dom
statement:
!FM. (!n l. (FM.Fun n l) IN FM.Dom) ==>
       !σ. IMAGE σ (univ(:num)) ⊆ FM.Dom ==>
           !t. (termval FM σ t) IN FM.Dom

name: thm_A_19_i
statement:
!t U I.
    ultrafilter U I ==>
    !σ FMS. IMAGE σ (univ(:num)) ⊆ ultraproduct U I (folmodels2Doms FMS) ==>
            (!i ff ll. i IN I ==> (FMS i).Fun ff ll IN (FMS i).Dom) ==>
            termval (ultraproduct_folmodel U I FMS) σ t =
            {f | Uequiv U I (folmodels2Doms FMS) f
                        (\i. termval (FMS i) (\n. CHOICE (σ n) i) t)}

name: IMAGE_UPDATE
statement: !σ a. IMAGE σ A ⊆ B ==> !b. b IN B ==> IMAGE σ(|a |-> b|) A ⊆ B

name: thm_A_19_ii
statement:
!U I phi σ FMS. (ultrafilter U I /\
                 (valuation (ultraproduct_folmodel U I FMS) σ) /\
                 (!i. i IN I ==> wffm (FMS i))) ==>
                  (feval (ultraproduct_folmodel U I FMS) σ phi <=>
                  {i | i IN I /\ feval (FMS i) (\x. (CHOICE (σ x)) i) phi} IN U)

name: ultraproduct_rep_independence_lemma
statement:
!U I FMS σ.
  ultrafilter U I ==>
  IMAGE σ (univ(:num)) ⊆ ultraproduct U I (folmodels2Doms FMS) ==>
  !phi rv.
     (!v. v IN (FV phi) ==> (rv v) IN (σ v)) ==>
  ({i | i ∈ I ∧ feval (FMS i) (λx. CHOICE (σ x) i) phi} ∈ U <=>
   {i | i ∈ I ∧ feval (FMS i) (λv. (rv v) i) phi} ∈ U)

name: corollary_A_21
statement:
!U I FMS FM.
   ultrafilter U I ==> (!i. i IN I ==> FMS i = FM) ==>
   (∀i ff ll. i ∈ I ⇒ FM.Fun ff ll ∈ FM.Dom) ==>
   !σ.
      IMAGE σ (univ(:num)) ⊆ FM.Dom ==>
     !phi.
           (feval FM σ phi <=>
            feval (ultraproduct_folmodel U I FMS)
            (\x. {g | Uequiv U I (folmodels2Doms FMS) g (\i. σ x)}) phi)

name: rep_give_wf_valuation
statement:
!U I FMS.
  ultrafilter U I ==>
   !rv. (!v i. i IN I ==> (rv v i) IN (FMS i).Dom) ==>
     IMAGE (λv. {g | Uequiv U I (folmodels2Doms FMS) g (rv v)}) 𝕌(:num) ⊆
        (ultraproduct U I (folmodels2Doms FMS))

name: Uequiv_REFL
statement:
!U I A f.
  ultrafilter U I ==>
   (!i. i IN I ==> (f i) IN (A i)) ==>
    Uequiv U I A f f

name: ultraproduct_suffices_rep
statement:
!U I FMS rv.
    ultrafilter U I ==>
    (∀i ff ll. i ∈ I ⇒ (FMS i).Fun ff ll ∈ (FMS i).Dom) ==>
    !rv. (!v i. i IN I ==> (rv v i) IN (FMS i).Dom) ==>
         !phi.
           {i | i IN I /\ feval (FMS i) (\v. rv v i) phi} IN U ==>
           feval (ultraproduct_folmodel U I FMS)
                 (\v. {g | Uequiv U I (folmodels2Doms FMS) g (rv v)}) phi

name: Cart_prod_def
statement: Cart_prod I A = {f | !i. i IN I ==> f i IN A i}

name: Uequiv_def
statement:
Uequiv U I A f g <=> ultrafilter U I /\
                     (!i. i IN I ==> A i <> {}) /\
                     f IN Cart_prod I A /\ g IN Cart_prod I A /\
                     {i | i IN I /\ f i = g i} IN U

name: ultraproduct_def
statement: ultraproduct U I A = partition (Uequiv U I A) (Cart_prod I A)

name: models2worlds_def
statement: models2worlds MS = \i. (MS i).frame.world

name: ultraproduct_model_def
statement:
ultraproduct_model U I MS = <|
    frame := <|
      world := ultraproduct U I (models2worlds MS);
      rel := \fu gu. (?f g. f IN fu /\ g IN gu /\
                            {i | i IN I /\ (MS i).frame.rel (f i) (g i)} IN U)
    |>;
    valt := \p fu. (?f. f IN fu /\ {i | i IN I /\ (f i) IN (MS i).valt p} IN U)
  |>

name: folmodels2Doms_def
statement: folmodels2Doms FMS = \i. (FMS i).Dom

name: ultraproduct_folmodel_def
statement:
ultraproduct_folmodel U I FMS = <|
    Dom := ultraproduct U I (folmodels2Doms FMS) ;
    Fun := \n fs.
             {y | (!i. i IN I ==> (y i) IN (FMS i).Dom) /\
                  {i | i IN I /\
                       y i = (FMS i).Fun n (MAP (\fc. (CHOICE fc) i)fs)} IN U};
    Pred := \p zs.
              {i | i IN I /\ (FMS i).Pred p (MAP (\fc. (CHOICE fc) i) zs)} IN U
  |>

name: wffm_def
statement: wffm M <=> (∀n0 l0. M.Fun n0 l0 ∈ M.Dom)

name: satis_only_in_worlds
statement: ∀w. satis M w f ⇒ w ∈ M.frame.world

name: forces_only_in_worlds
statement: ∀w. forces M w nfm ⇒ w ∈ M.frame.world

name: to_nnf_correct
statement:
(forces M w (to_nnf p f) ⇔ if p then satis M w f
                             else ¬satis M w f ∧ w ∈ M.frame.world)

name: NNF_correct
statement: forces M w (NNF f) ⇔ satis M w f

name: to_full_correct
statement: ∀w. satis M w (to_full f) ⇔ forces M w f

name: NNF_RID
statement: to_nnf T (to_full f) = f

name: satis_def
statement:
(satis M w (VAR p) <=> w ∈ M.frame.world /\ w ∈ M.valt p) /\
  (satis M w FALSE <=> F) /\
  (satis M w (NOT form) <=> w IN M.frame.world /\ ¬ satis M w form) ∧
  (satis M w (DISJ form1 form2) <=> satis M w form1 \/ satis M w form2) ∧
  (satis M w (DIAM form) <=>
   w IN M.frame.world /\
   ∃v. M.frame.rel w v /\ v IN M.frame.world /\ satis M v form)

name: forces_def
statement:
(forces M w (Var n)      ⇔ w ∈ M.frame.world ∧ w ∈ M.valt n) ∧
  (forces M w (NVar n)     ⇔ w ∈ M.frame.world ∧ w ∉ M.valt n) ∧
  (forces M w (Conj f1 f2) ⇔ forces M w f1 ∧ forces M w f2) ∧
  (forces M w (Disj f1 f2) ⇔ forces M w f1 ∨ forces M w f2) ∧
  (forces M w (Box f)      ⇔
     w ∈ M.frame.world ∧
     ∀v. v ∈ M.frame.world ∧ M.frame.rel w v ⇒ forces M v f) ∧
  (forces M w (Dia f)      ⇔
     w ∈ M.frame.world ∧
     ∃v. v ∈ M.frame.world ∧ M.frame.rel w v ∧ forces M v f)

name: to_nnf_def
statement:
to_nnf p (VAR n) = (if p then Var n else NVar n) ∧
  to_nnf p FALSE = (if p then Conj else Disj) (Var 0) (NVar 0) ∧
  to_nnf p (NOT f) = to_nnf (¬p) f ∧
  to_nnf p (DISJ f1 f2) =
    (if p then Disj else Conj) (to_nnf p f1) (to_nnf p f2) ∧
  to_nnf p (DIAM f) = (if p then Dia else Box) (to_nnf p f)

name: to_full_def
statement:
to_full (Var n) = VAR n ∧
  to_full (NVar n) = NOT (VAR n) ∧
  to_full (Conj f1 f2) = NOT (DISJ (NOT (to_full f1)) (NOT (to_full f2))) ∧
  to_full (Disj f1 f2) = DISJ (to_full f1) (to_full f2) ∧
  to_full (Box f) = NOT (DIAM (NOT (to_full f))) ∧
  to_full (Dia f) = DIAM (to_full f)

name: reflexive_M
statement: reflexive_M m ⇔ ∀w. w ∈ m.frame.world ⇒ m.frame.rel w w

name: transitive_M
statement:
transitive_M m ⇔
    ∀u v w. u ∈ m.frame.world ∧ v ∈ m.frame.world ∧ w ∈ m.frame.world ∧
            m.frame.rel u v ∧ m.frame.rel v w ⇒
            m.frame.rel u w

name: contradiction_EQ_NONE
statement: ∀Γ. contradiction Γ = NONE ⇔ ∀n. MEM (Var n) Γ ⇒ ¬MEM (NVar n) Γ

name: contradiction_EQ_SOME
statement: (contradiction Γ = SOME i) ⇒ MEM (Var i) Γ ∧ MEM (NVar i) Γ

name: conjsplit_EQ_NONE
statement: ∀Γ. conjsplit Γ = NONE ⇔ ∀f1 f2. ¬(MEM (Conj f1 f2) Γ)

name: MEM_conjsplit
statement:
∀Γ₀ Γ ϕ. conjsplit Γ₀ = SOME Γ ∧ MEM ϕ Γ₀ ⇒
            (∃ϕ₁ ϕ₂. ϕ = Conj ϕ₁ ϕ₂ ∧ MEM ϕ₁ Γ ∧ MEM ϕ₂ Γ) ∨
            MEM ϕ Γ

name: conjsplit_MEM2
statement:
∀Γ₀ Γ ϕ. conjsplit Γ₀ = SOME Γ ∧ MEM ϕ Γ ⇒
           MEM ϕ Γ₀ ∨ (∃ϕ'. MEM (Conj ϕ ϕ') Γ₀) ∨
           (∃ϕ'. MEM (Conj ϕ' ϕ) Γ₀)

name: conjsplit_size
statement: ∀Γ fs. conjsplit Γ = SOME fs ⇒ gsize fs < gsize Γ

name: disjsplit_size
statement:
∀Γ fs1 fs2. disjsplit Γ = SOME (fs1, fs2) ⇒
                  SUM (MAP form_size fs1) < SUM (MAP form_size Γ) ∧
                  SUM (MAP form_size fs2) < SUM (MAP form_size Γ)

name: disjsplit_EQ_NONE
statement: ∀Γ. disjsplit Γ = NONE ⇔ ∀f1 f2. ¬(MEM (Disj f1 f2) Γ)

name: MEM_disjsplit
statement:
∀Γ Γ1 Γ2 ϕ.
    disjsplit Γ = SOME (Γ1, Γ2) ∧ MEM ϕ Γ ⇒
      (∃ϕ₁ ϕ₂. ϕ = Disj ϕ₁ ϕ₂ ∧ MEM ϕ₁ Γ1 ∧ MEM ϕ₂ Γ2) ∨
      MEM ϕ Γ1 ∧ MEM ϕ Γ2

name: disjsplit_MEM2
statement:
∀Γ Γ1 Γ2 f1 f2.
     MEM f1 Γ1 ∧ MEM f2 Γ2 ∧ disjsplit Γ = SOME (Γ1,Γ2) ⇒
     MEM f1 Γ ∨ MEM f2 Γ ∨ MEM (Disj f1 f2) Γ

name: MEM_unbox
statement: MEM ϕ (unbox Γ) ⇔ MEM (Box ϕ) Γ

name: unbox_APPEND
statement: unbox (Γ ++ Δ) = unbox Γ ++ unbox Δ

name: MEM_undia
statement: MEM ϕ (undia Γ) ⇔ MEM (Dia ϕ) Γ

name: MEM_unvar
statement: MEM n (unvar Γ) ⇔ MEM (Var n) Γ

name: MEM_tmodel_size
statement: MEM t ts ⇒ tmodel_size t < tmodel1_size ts

name: tmodel_ind
statement:
∀P. (∀vs ts. (∀t. MEM t ts ⇒ P t) ⇒ P (Nd vs ts)) ⇒
      (∀t. P t)

name: tree_rel_size_bounds
statement: tree_rel t1 t2 ⇒ tmodel_size t2 ≤ tmodel_size t1

name: forces_grows_backward
statement:
∀w. forces M1 w f ∧ M2.valt = M1.valt ∧ M2.frame.rel = M1.frame.rel ∧
      M1.frame.world ⊆ M2.frame.world ∧ w ∈ M1.frame.world ∧
      (∀w1 w2. M1.frame.rel w1 w2 ∧ w1 ∈ M1.frame.world ⇒ w2 ∈ M1.frame.world) ⇒
      forces M2 w f

name: scmap_MEM
statement: ∀l0 l e f. scmap f l0 = SOME l ∧ MEM e l ⇒ ∃e0. MEM e0 l0 ∧ f e0 = SOME e

name: scmap_MEM2
statement: ∀l0 l e0 f. scmap f l0 = SOME l ∧ MEM e0 l0 ⇒ ∃e. MEM e l ∧ f e0 = SOME e

name: scmap_EQ_NONE
statement: ∀l f. scmap f l = NONE ⇔ ∃e. MEM e l ∧ f e = NONE

name: is_literal_def
statement: (is_literal (Var _) ⇔ T) ∧ (is_literal (NVar _) ⇔ T) ∧ (is_literal _ ⇔ F)

name: is_conj_def
statement:
is_conj (Conj _ _ ) = T ∧
  is_conj _ = F

name: is_disj_def
statement:
is_disj (Disj f1 f2) = T ∧
  is_disj _ = F

name: is_dia_def
statement:
is_dia (Dia _) = T ∧
  is_dia _ = F

name: dest_dia_def
statement: dest_dia (Dia f) = f

name: is_box_def
statement:
is_box (Box _) = T ∧
  is_box _ = F

name: contradiction_def
statement:
(contradiction [] ⇔ NONE) ∧
  (contradiction (Var n :: rest) ⇔
     if MEM (NVar n) rest then SOME n
     else contradiction rest) ∧
  (contradiction (NVar n :: rest) ⇔
     if MEM (Var n) rest then SOME n else  contradiction rest) ∧
  (contradiction (_ :: rest) ⇔ contradiction rest)

name: conjsplit_def
statement:
(conjsplit (Conj f1 f2 :: rest) = SOME (f1 :: f2 :: rest)) ∧
  (conjsplit (f :: rest) = OPTION_MAP (CONS f) (conjsplit rest)) ∧
  (conjsplit [] = NONE)

name: disjsplit_def
statement:
disjsplit (Disj f1 f2 :: rest) = SOME (f1::rest, f2::rest) ∧
  disjsplit (f :: rest) = OPTION_MAP (CONS f ## CONS f) (disjsplit rest) ∧
  disjsplit [] = NONE

name: unbox_def
statement:
unbox (Box f :: rest) = f :: unbox rest ∧
  unbox (f :: rest) = unbox rest ∧
  unbox [] = []

name: undia_def
statement:
undia (Dia f :: rest) = f :: undia rest ∧
  undia (f :: rest) = undia rest ∧
  undia [] = []

name: unvar_def
statement:
unvar (Var n :: rest) = n :: unvar rest ∧
  unvar (f :: rest) = unvar rest ∧
  unvar [] = []

name: tree_rel_def
statement: tree_rel t1 t2 ⇔ ∃vs ts. t1 = Nd vs ts ∧ MEM t2 ts

name: subtree_def
statement: subtree t1 t2 ⇔ tree_rel^* t2 t1

name: reljump_size_lemma
statement:
∀a Γ l. MEM a (MAP (λd. d :: l) (undia Γ)) ⇒
          gsize a ≤ gsize l + gsize (undia Γ)

name: undiabox_size
statement: Γ ≠ [] ⇒ gsize (undia Γ) + gsize (unbox Γ) < gsize Γ

name: reljump_size
statement: MEM a (MAP (λd. d :: unbox Γ) (undia Γ)) ⇒ gsize a < gsize Γ

name: tree_model_thm
statement:
((tree_model t).valt = λv u. case u of Nd vs _ => MEM v vs) ∧
  (tree_model t).frame.rel = tree_rel ∧
  m ∈ (tree_model m).frame.world

name: FINITE_tree_model_worlds
statement: ∀t. FINITE (tree_model t).frame.world

name: tableau_sound
statement: ∀Γ t. tableau Γ = SOME t ⇒ ∀f. MEM f Γ ⇒ forces (tree_model t) t f

name: tableau_complete
statement: ∀Γ. tableau Γ = NONE ⇒ ∀M w. w ∈ M.frame.world ⇒ ∃f. MEM f Γ ∧ ¬forces M w f

name: tableau_unsat
statement: ∀Γ. tableau Γ = NONE ⇒ ¬sat (:α) (set Γ)

name: PERM_leading_contradiction
statement: PERM Γ₁ Γ₂ ⇒ (contradiction Γ₁ = NONE ⇔ contradiction Γ₂ = NONE)

name: tableau_def
statement:
tableau Γ =
    case contradiction Γ of
      SOME i => NONE
    | NONE =>
        case conjsplit Γ of
          SOME Γ' => tableau Γ'
        | NONE => case disjsplit Γ of
                    SOME (Γ1, Γ2) =>
                        (case tableau Γ1 of
                            SOME m => SOME m
                          | NONE =>
                            case tableau Γ2 of SOME m => SOME m | NONE => NONE)
                  | NONE => if EVERY is_literal Γ then SOME (Nd (unvar Γ) [])
                            else
                              let
                                boxes = unbox Γ ;
                                children =
                                      scmap tableau (MAP (λd. d :: boxes)
                                                         (undia Γ))
                              in
                                case children of
                                    SOME ms => SOME (Nd (unvar Γ) ms)
                                  | NONE => NONE

name: tree_model_def
tableauR_def
statement:
[~conj:]
  (∀p s f1 f2.
      tableauR (p ++ [f1;f2] ++ s) r ⇒
      tableauR (p ++ [Conj f1 f2] ++ s) r)
[~disj1:]
  (∀p s f1 f2.
      tableauR (p ++ [f1] ++ s) r ⇒ tableauR (p ++ [Disj f1 f2] ++ s) r)
[~disj2:]
  (∀p s f1 f2.
      tableauR (p ++ [f2] ++ s) r ⇒ tableauR (p ++ [Disj f1 f2] ++ s) r)
[~diam:]
  (∀G.
      (∀f. MEM f G ⇒ ¬is_conj f ∧ ¬is_disj f) ∧ (∃f. MEM f G ∧ is_dia f) ∧
      contradiction G = NONE ∧
      LIST_REL (λf r. tableauR (dest_dia f :: unbox G) r)
               (FILTER is_dia G)
               rs
     ⇒
      tableauR G (Nd (unvar G) rs))
[~open:]
  (∀G. (∀f. MEM f G ⇒ is_literal f ∨ is_box f) ∧ contradiction G = NONE ⇒
       tableauR G (Nd (unvar G) []))

name: trule_def
statement:
trule Σ (Box f :: rest) = (Box f::Σ, f::rest) ∧
  trule Σ (f :: rest) = ((\x. x) ## CONS f) (trule Σ rest) ∧
  trule Σ [] = (Σ, [])

name: scmap2_def

  scmap2 f Σ (h :: t) =
    case f Σ h of
       NONE => NONE
     | SOME fsh => OPTION_MAP (CONS fsh) (scmap2 f Σ t)

name: modal_size_def

modal_size (Var a) = 0 ∧
  modal_size (Box a) = 1 + modal_size a ∧
  modal_size (Dia a) = 1 + modal_size a ∧
  modal_size (NVar a) = 0 ∧
  modal_size (Conj a0 a1) = modal_size a0 + modal_size a1 ∧
  modal_size (Disj a0 a1) = modal_size a0 + modal_size a1

name: max_list_def

name: degree_def

  degree (s::Σ, Γ) = MAX (modal_size s) (degree (Σ, Γ)) ∧
  degree (Σ, g::Γ) = MAX (modal_size g) (degree (Σ, Γ))

name: unbox_single_def

name: tableau_KT_def
statement:
tableau_KT Σ Γ =
    case contradiction Γ of
      SOME i => NONE
    | NONE =>
        case conjsplit Γ of
          SOME Γ' => tableau_KT Σ Γ'
        | NONE => case disjsplit Γ of
                    SOME (Γ1, Γ2) =>
                      (case tableau_KT Σ Γ1 of
                         SOME m => SOME m
                       | NONE =>
                           case tableau_KT Σ Γ2 of
                           | SOME m => SOME m
                           | NONE => NONE)
                  | NONE => if EXISTS is_box Γ then
                              tableau_KT (FST (trule Σ Γ)) (SND (trule Σ Γ))
                            else  if EXISTS is_dia Γ then
                              let
                                children = scmap2 tableau_KT []
                                                  (MAP (λd. d :: (unbox Σ))
                                                   (undia Γ))
                              in
                                case children of
                                  SOME ms => SOME (Nd (unvar Γ) ms)
                                | NONE => NONE
                            else SOME (Nd (unvar Γ) [])

name: reflexive_sequent_def

    ∀𝜑 v l. MEM (Box 𝜑) Σ ⇒
            (∀f. MEM f Γ ⇒
                 forces (T_tree_model (Nd v l)) (Nd v l) f) ∧
            (∀s. MEM s l ⇒
                 (∀𝜓. MEM (Box 𝜓) Σ ⇒ forces (T_tree_model s) s 𝜓))
            ⇒
            forces (T_tree_model (Nd v l)) (Nd v l) 𝜑

name: MEM_disjsplit1
statement:
∀Γ Γ1 Γ2 f1.
     MEM f1 Γ1 ∧ disjsplit_s4 Γ = SOME (f, (Γ1,Γ2)) ⇒
     MEM f1 Γ ∨ (∃f2. MEM f2 Γ2 ∧ MEM (Disj f1 f2) Γ)

name: MEM_disjsplit2
statement:
∀Γ Γ1 Γ2 f2.
     MEM f2 Γ2 ∧ disjsplit_s4 Γ = SOME (f, (Γ1,Γ2)) ⇒
     MEM f2 Γ ∨ (∃f1. MEM f1 Γ1 ∧ MEM (Disj f1 f2) Γ)

name: wfm_S4_Disj
statement:
∀s Γ0 Γ1 Γ2.   wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 s ∧ disjsplit_s4 s.Gm = SOME (f, (Γ1,Γ2))
               ⇒
               wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 (s with <|Ss := NONE; Gm := Γ1|>) ∧
               wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 (s with <|Ss := NONE; Gm := Γ2|>)

name: conjsplit_s4_MEM2
statement:
∀Γ₀ Γ ϕ. conjsplit_s4 Γ₀ = SOME (f, Γ) ∧ MEM ϕ Γ ⇒
           MEM ϕ Γ₀ ∨ (∃ϕ'. MEM (Conj ϕ ϕ') Γ₀) ∨
           (∃ϕ'. MEM (Conj ϕ' ϕ) Γ₀)

name: wfm_S4_Conj
statement:
∀s Γ0 Γ'.  wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 s ∧ conjsplit_s4 s.Gm = SOME (f, Γ')
           ⇒
           wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 (s with <|Ss := NONE; Gm := Γ'|>)

name: wfm_S4_Transitive
statement:
∀Γ0 s m w. tableau_S4 Γ0 s = SOME m ∧
             wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 s ∧

             wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 w.id

name: pluck_eq_none

name: disjsplit_s4_MEM2

name: tableau_S4_complete
statement:
∀Γ0 s. wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 s ⇒
         tableau_S4 Γ0 s = CLOSED ⇒
         ∀M w.
             w ∈ M.frame.world ∧ reflexive_M M ∧ transitive_M M ⇒
             ∃f. MEM f (s.Gm++s.Sg) ∧ ¬forces M w f

name: final_tableau_S4_complete
statement:
∀f.  final_tableau_S4 f = CLOSED ⇒
       ∀M w.
         w ∈ M.frame.world ∧ reflexive_M M ∧ transitive_M M ⇒
         ¬forces M w f

name: pre_hintikka_box_cons

name: disjsplit_s4_EQ_NONE

name: pre_hintikka_s4
statement:
∀G.
  contradiction G = NONE ∧
  conjsplit_s4 G = NONE ∧
  disjsplit_s4 G = NONE ∧

  pre_hintikka G

name: pre_hintikka_disj_left_cons

name: disj_s4_pf_eq_some

      set s ⊆ pf INSERT set s1 ∧ set s ⊆ pf INSERT set s2

name: disj_s4_g2_in_g0

name: pre_hintikka_disj_right_cons
statement: ∀f2 h. pre_hintikka h ∧ MEM f2 h ⇒ ∀f1. pre_hintikka ((Disj f1 f2)::h)

name: pre_hintikka_conj_cons

∀f1 f2 h.
    pre_hintikka h ∧ MEM f1 h ∧ MEM f2 h ⇒ pre_hintikka ((Conj f1 f2)::h)

name: conj_s4_pf_eq_some

∀s pf s1 s2 g. conjsplit_s4 s = SOME (pf, g) ⇒
    ∃f1 f2. pf = (Conj f1 f2) ∧ MEM f1 g ∧ MEM f2 g ∧ set s ⊆ pf INSERT set g

name: reach_step_preserve_box

∀w v.
    reach_step m w v ⇒
    MEM (Box p) w.htk ⇒
    thm_3_19_prop w ⇒
    thm_3_17_prop v ⇒
    wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 v.id ⇒
    MEM (Box p) v.htk

    RTC (reach_step m) w v ∧

    MEM (Box p) w.htk ∧
    thm_3_19_prop m ∧
    thm_3_17_prop m ∧
    (∀s. RTC pt_rel m s ⇒ wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 s.id) ⇒
    MEM (Box p) v.htk

name: tableau_S4_sound

∀f m. final_tableau_S4 f = OPEN m ⇒
          ∀w. w ∈ (s4_tree_model m).frame.world ⇒
               ∀p. MEM p w.htk ⇒
                   forces (s4_tree_model m) w p
