name: closure_list_conc_def
statement:
closure_list_conc [] = [] ∧
  closure_list_conc (Conj f1 f2::rest) =
    Conj f1 f2::closure_list_conc [f1] ⧺ closure_list_conc [f2] ⧺
    closure_list_conc rest ∧
  closure_list_conc (Disj f1 f2::rest) =
    Disj f1 f2::closure_list_conc [f1] ⧺ closure_list_conc [f2] ⧺
    closure_list_conc rest ∧
  closure_list_conc (Box f::rest) =
    Box f :: closure_list_conc [f] ++ (closure_list_conc rest) ∧
  closure_list_conc (Dia f::rest) =
    Dia f :: closure_list_conc [f] ++ (closure_list_conc rest) ∧
  closure_list_conc (f::rest) = f :: (closure_list_conc rest)

name: wfm_S4_sequent
statement:
wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 s ⇔
    ALL_DISTINCT s.Sg ∧ ALL_DISTINCT s.Hs ∧
    set s.Sg PSUBSET set (closure_list_conc [Γ0]) ∧
    set s.Hs SUBSET set (closure_list_conc [Γ0]) ∧
    set s.Gm SUBSET set (closure_list_conc [Γ0]) ∧
    EVERY is_box s.Sg ∧
    (∀x. MEM x s.Hs ⇒ MEM (Dia x) (closure_list_conc [Γ0])) ∧
    (∀p. MEM p s.Hs ⇒ MEM (p, s.Sg) s.As) ∧
    (∀q r. s.Ss = SOME (q, r) ⇒ MEM q s.Gm ∧ set r ⊆ set s.Gm)

name: pluck_def
statement:
pluck P []     = NONE ∧
  pluck P (h::t) = if P h then SOME (h, t)
                   else (case pluck P t of NONE => NONE
                                          |SOME (a, b) => SOME (a, h::b))

name: dest_box_def
statement:
dest_box (Box f) = SOME f ∧
  dest_box f = NONE

name: trule_s4_def
statement:
trule_s4 s =
  case pluck is_box s.Gm of
    NONE        => NONE
  | SOME(b, rest) =>
      if MEM b s.Sg then
        SOME (b, s with <| Ss := NONE ; Gm := THE (dest_box b)::rest |>)
      else
        SOME (b, s with <| Ss := NONE;
                           Hs := [];
                           Sg := b::s.Sg;
                           Gm := THE (dest_box b)::rest;  |>)

name: add_rule
statement: add_rule rule (Nd (s, r) lst) = Nd (s, rule) [Nd (s, r) lst]

name: conjsplit_s4_def
statement:
(conjsplit_s4 (Conj f1 f2 :: rest) = SOME (Conj f1 f2, f1 :: f2 :: rest)) ∧
  (conjsplit_s4 (f :: rest) = OPTION_MAP (I ## CONS f) (conjsplit_s4 rest)) ∧
  (conjsplit_s4 [] = NONE)

name: disjsplit_s4_def
statement:
disjsplit_s4 (Disj f1 f2 :: rest) = SOME (Disj f1 f2, (f1::rest, f2::rest)) ∧
  disjsplit_s4 (f :: rest) =
    OPTION_MAP (I ## (CONS f ## CONS f)) (disjsplit_s4 rest) ∧
  disjsplit_s4 [] = NONE

name: s4_request_local
statement:
s4_request_local [] _ = [] ∧
  s4_request_local (s::xs) sg = (s, sg)::(s4_request_local xs sg)

name: tableau_S4_def
statement:
tableau_S4 Γ0 s = if  ¬ wfm_S4_sequent Γ0 s then CLOSED else
    case contradiction s.Gm of
      SOME i => CLOSED
    | NONE =>
        case conjsplit_s4 s.Gm of
          SOME (pf, Γ') =>
            (case tableau_S4 Γ0 (s with <| Ss:=NONE; Gm:=Γ'; |>) of
               NONE => NONE
             |  SOME (Nd (id, h, r) cs) => SOME (Nd (s, pf::h, r) cs))
        | NONE =>
            case disjsplit_s4 s.Gm of
              SOME (pf, (Γ1, Γ2)) =>
                (case tableau_S4 Γ0 (s with <| Ss:=NONE; Gm:=Γ1; |>) of
                   SOME (Nd (id, h, r) cs) => SOME (Nd (s, pf::h, r) cs)
                 | NONE =>
                     case tableau_S4 Γ0 (s with <| Ss:=NONE; Gm:=Γ2; |>) of
                       SOME (Nd (id, h, r) cs) => SOME (Nd (s, pf::h, r) cs)
                     | NONE => NONE)
            | NONE =>
                if EXISTS is_box s.Gm then
                  case trule_s4 s of
                    SOME (pf, s') =>
                      (case tableau_S4 Γ0 s' of
                         NONE => NONE
                       | SOME (Nd (id, h, r) cs) =>
                           SOME (Nd (s, pf::h, r) cs))
                  | NONE => NONE
                else if EXISTS is_dia s.Gm then
                  let
                    children =
                    scmap
                    (λdf. tableau_S4 Γ0 (s with <| As := (df, s.Sg)::s.As;
                                                   Ss := SOME (df, s.Sg);
                                                   Hs := df::s.Hs;
                                                   Gm := df::s.Sg |>))
                    (FILTER (λf. ¬ MEM f s.Hs) (undia s.Gm))
                  in
                    case children of
                      SOME ms =>
                        SOME (Nd (s, s.Gm, s4_request_local s.Hs s.Sg) ms)
                    | NONE => CLOSED
                else SOME (Nd (s, s.Gm, s4_request_local s.Hs s.Sg) [])

name: final_tableau_S4_def
pre_hintikka_def
statement:
pre_hintikka l =
    (
      contradiction l = NONE ∧
      (∀f1 f2. MEM (Conj f1 f2) l ⇒ MEM f1 l ∧ MEM f2 l) ∧
      (∀f1 f2. MEM (Disj f1 f2) l ⇒ MEM f1 l ∨ MEM f2 l) ∧
      (∀f. MEM (Box f) l ⇒ MEM f l)
    )

name: thm_3_17_prop
statement:
thm_3_17_prop (Nd (id, h, r) cs) ⇔ pre_hintikka h ∧
                                     set id.Gm ⊆ set h ∧
                                     ∀s. MEM s cs ⇒ thm_3_17_prop s

name: thm_3_19_prop
statement:
thm_3_19_prop (Nd (id, h, r) l) ⇔
            (∀s p. MEM s l ∧ MEM p id.Sg ⇒ MEM p (get_htk s)) ∧
            (∀s p. MEM s l ∧ MEM (Box p) h ⇒ MEM (Box p) (get_htk s)) ∧
            (∀p.
                 MEM (Dia p) h ⇒
                 (∃d. MEM (p,d) r) ∨ ∃s. MEM s l ∧ MEM p (get_htk s)) ∧
            (∀g d p. MEM (g,d) r ∧ MEM (Box p) (h ⧺ id.Sg) ⇒ MEM (Box p) d) ∧
            set r ⊆ set id.As ∧
            (∀s. MEM s l ⇒ thm_3_19_prop s)

name: thm_3_19_prop'
statement:
thm_3_19_prop' m ⇔
    (∀s p. MEM s m.l ∧ MEM p m.id.Sg ⇒ MEM p (get_htk s)) ∧
    (∀s p. MEM s m.l ∧ MEM (Box p) m.htk ⇒ MEM (Box p) (get_htk s)) ∧
    (∀p.
       MEM (Dia p) m.htk ⇒
       (∃d. MEM (p,d) m.request) ∨ ∃s. MEM s m.l ∧ MEM p (get_htk s)) ∧
    (∀g d p. MEM (g,d) m.request ∧ MEM (Box p) (m.htk ⧺ m.id.Sg) ⇒
             MEM (Box p) d) ∧
    set m.request ⊆ set m.id.As ∧
    (∀s. MEM s m.l ⇒ thm_3_19_prop' s)

name: thm_3_20_prop
statement:
thm_3_20_prop m ⇔
      (∀s r. RTC pt_rel m s ∧ MEM r s.request ⇒
        MEM r m.id.As ∨ ∃d. RTC pt_rel m d ∧ SOME r = d.id.Ss) ∧
      (∀s. pt_rel m s ⇒ thm_3_20_prop s)

name: reach_step
statement:
reach_step m s t ⇔
    MEM t s.l ∨ ∃sig. RTC pt_rel m t ∧ t.id.Ss = SOME sig ∧ MEM sig s.request

name: s4_tree_model
tableau_S4_Ss_eq_Gm_prop
statement:
tableau_S4_Ss_eq_Gm_prop m ⇔
  (m.id.Ss = NONE ∨ ∃p sg. m.id.Ss = SOME (p, sg) ∧ set (p::sg) ⊆ set m.id.Gm) ∧
  (∀s. pt_rel m s ⇒ tableau_S4_Ss_eq_Gm_prop s)

name: tsubst_def

(tsubst v t1 (Var u) = if u = v then t1 else Var u) ∧
  tsubst v t1 (Fn fnm ts) = Fn fnm (MAP (tsubst v t1) ts)

name: tFV_def
statement:
tFV (Var v) = {v} ∧
  tFV (Fn _ ts) = { v | ∃t. if MEM t ts then v IN tFV t else F }

name: fsubst_def
statement:
fsubst v t (IMP f1 f2) = IMP (fsubst v t f1) (fsubst v t f2) ∧
  fsubst v t (NEG f) = NEG (fsubst v t f) ∧
  fsubst v t (REL rnm ts) = REL rnm (MAP (tsubst v t) ts) ∧
  fsubst v t (ALL u f) = if u = v then ALL u f else ALL u (fsubst v t f)

name: fFV_def
statement:
fFV (IMP f1 f2) = fFV f1 ∪ fFV f2 ∧
  fFV (NEG f) = fFV f ∧
  fFV (REL _ ts) = tFV (Fn "" ts) ∧
  fFV (ALL v f) = fFV f DELETE v

name: acceptable_def
statement:
(acceptable v t (IMP f1 f2) ⇔ acceptable v t f1 ∧ acceptable v t f2) ∧
  (acceptable v t (NEG f) ⇔ acceptable v t f) ∧
  (acceptable v t (REL _ _) ⇔ T) ∧
  (acceptable v t (ALL u f) ⇔ u = v ∨ v ∉ fFV f ∨
                              acceptable v t f ∧ u ∉ tFV t)

name: conmap_def
statement:
conmap (REL _ _) = T ∧
  conmap (IMP f1 f2) = (conmap f1 ⇒ conmap f2) ∧
  conmap (NEG f) = ¬conmap f ∧
  conmap (ALL _ f) = conmap f

name: ded_def
statement:
[PL1:] (∀A B. ded R Hs (A ⥰ B ⥰ A))
[PL2:] (∀A B C. ded R Hs ((A ⥰ B ⥰ C) ⥰ (A ⥰ B) ⥰ (A ⥰ C)))
[PL3:] (∀A B. ded R Hs ((⌁A ⥰ ⌁B) ⥰ (⌁A ⥰ B) ⥰ A))
[PL4:] (∀v t f. acceptable v t f ⇒ ded R Hs ((ALL v f) ⥰ fsubst v t f))
[PL5:] (∀v A B. v ∉ fFV A ⇒ ded R Hs (ALL v (A ⥰ B) ⥰ A ⥰ (ALL v B)))
[~MP:] (∀A B. ded R Hs (A ⥰ B) ∧ ded R Hs A ⇒ ded R Hs B)
[UG:] (∀v A. (∀h. h ∈ Hs ⇒ v ∉ fFV h) ∧ ded R Hs A ⇒ ded R Hs (ALL v A))
[~hyp:] (∀h. h ∈ Hs ⇒ ded R Hs h)
[~R:] (∀B s. (∀A hs. (hs,A) ∈ s ⇒ ded R hs A) ∧ R s Hs B ⇒ ded R Hs B)

name: dpll_def
statement:
dpll cset =
    if cset = [] then SOME FEMPTY
    else if MEM [] cset then NONE
    else
      case find_uprop cset of
        NONE => (let splitv = choose cset
                 in
                   case dpll (rewrite splitv T cset) of
                     NONE => (case dpll (rewrite splitv F cset) of
                                NONE => NONE
                              | SOME fm => SOME (fm |+ (splitv,F)))
                   | SOME fm => SOME (fm |+ (splitv,T)))
      | SOME (v,b) =>
          case dpll (rewrite v b cset) of
            NONE => NONE
          | SOME fm => SOME (fm |+ (v,b))

statement: ∀A B. CAN_FUSION (Theory A) (Theory B) = Theory (A ∘ᵣ B)

name: CAN_ORTH_alt
statement: ∀A B. CAN_ORTH (Theory A) (Theory B) ⇔ A |-^ (~B)

name: Canonical_System_is_RCS
statement: Is_Relevant_Cover_System Canonical_System

name: lemma6_5_3_1
statement: ∀A. Up (to_CS Canonical_System) {Theory A} = EQUIV_W A

name: lemma6_5_3_2
statement: ∀A B. EQUIV_W A ∩ EQUIV_W B = EQUIV_W (A & B)

name: lemma6_5_3_3
statement: ∀A. Perp (EQUIV_W A) = EQUIV_W (~A)

name: lemma6_5_3_4
statement: ∀A B. (EQUIV_W A ⟹ₘ EQUIV_W B) = EQUIV_W (A --> B)

name: lemma6_5_3_5
statement: ∀A B. Orthojoin (EQUIV_W A) (EQUIV_W B) = EQUIV_W (A V B)

name: Canonical_System_is_R_Model_system
statement: R_MODEL_SYSTEM Canonical_System Canonical_System_Ps

name: Model_System_Characterisation_1_2
statement: ∀p. |- p ⇒ (∀RCS Ps M. R_MODEL_SYSTEM RCS Ps ∧ Model_Function RCS Ps M ⇒ C_Holds RCS Ps M RCS.E p)

name: Model_System_Characterisation_2_3
statement:
∀p. (∀RCS Ps M. R_MODEL_SYSTEM RCS Ps ∧ Model_Function RCS Ps M ⇒ C_Holds RCS Ps M RCS.E p) ⇒
      ∀M. Model_Function Canonical_System Canonical_System_Ps M ⇒
          C_Holds Canonical_System Canonical_System_Ps M Canonical_System.E p

name: Model_System_Characterisation_3_1
statement:
∀p. (∀M. Model_Function Canonical_System Canonical_System_Ps M ⇒
            C_Holds Canonical_System Canonical_System_Ps M Canonical_System.E p)
      ⇒ |- p

name: completeness
statement:
(∀RCS Ps M. R_MODEL_SYSTEM RCS Ps ∧ Model_Function RCS Ps M ⇒ C_Holds RCS Ps M RCS.E p) ⇒
  |- p

name: Upset_def
statement: Upset CS X ⇔ X ⊆ CS.W ∧ ∀d e. d ∈ X ∧ e ∈ CS.W ∧ CS.REF d e ⇒ e ∈ X

name: Up_def
statement: Up CS x = {u | u ∈ CS.W ∧ ∃w. w ∈ x ∧ CS.REF w u}

name: PREORDER_def
statement:
PREORDER R X ⇔
    (∀x. x ∈ X ⇒ R x x) ∧
    (∀x y z. x ∈ X ∧ y ∈ X ∧ z ∈ X ∧ R x y ∧ R y z ⇒
             R x z)

name: Is_Cover_System_def
statement:
Is_Cover_System CS ⇔ PREORDER CS.REF CS.W ∧
                       (∀x y. CS.REF x y ⇒ x ∈ CS.W ∧ y ∈ CS.W) ∧
                       (∀x. x ∈ CS.W ⇒ ∃Z. CS.COVER Z x) ∧
                       (∀x Z. x ∈ CS.W ∧ CS.COVER Z x ⇒ Z ⊆ Up CS {x})

name: j_def
statement: j CS X = {w | w ∈ CS.W ∧ ∃Z. CS.COVER Z w ∧ Z ⊆ X}

name: Localized_def
statement: Localized CS X ⇔ j CS X ⊆ X

name: rel_Lift_1
statement: rel_Lift_1 R X y ⇔ ∀x. x ∈ X ⇒ R x y

name: rel_Lift_2
statement: rel_Lift_2 R x Y ⇔ ∀y. y ∈ Y ⇒ R x y

name: op_Lift_1
statement: op_Lift_1 R X y = {R x y | x ∈ X}

name: op_Lift_2
statement: op_Lift_2 R x Y = {R x y | y ∈ Y}

name: to_CS_def
statement: (to_CS: α R_COVER_SYSTEM -> α COVER_SYSTEM) RCS = <|W := RCS.W; REF := RCS.REF; COVER := RCS.COVER |>

name: Is_Relevant_Cover_System_def
statement:
Is_Relevant_Cover_System RCS ⇔
    RCS.E ∈ RCS.W ∧
    (∀x y. x ≼ₐ y ⇒ x ∈ RCS.W ∧ y ∈ RCS.W) ∧
    (∀x Z. Z ▹ₐ x ⇒ x ∈ RCS.W ∧ Z ⊆ RCS.W) ∧
    (∀x y. x ∈ RCS.W ∧ y ∈ RCS.W ⇒ x ⬝ₐ y ∈ RCS.W) ∧
    (∀x y. x ⊥ₐ y ⇒ x ∈ RCS.W ∧ y ∈ RCS.W) ∧
    Is_Cover_System (to_CS RCS) ∧

    
    (∀x. x ∈ RCS.W ⇒ (x ⬝ₐ RCS.E) = x) ∧
    (∀x. x ∈ RCS.W ⇒ (RCS.E ⬝ₐ x) = x) ∧
    (∀x y. x ∈ RCS.W ∧ y ∈ RCS.W ⇒ (x ⬝ₐ y) = (y ⬝ₐ x)) ∧
    (∀x y z. x ∈ RCS.W ∧ y ∈ RCS.W ∧ z ∈ RCS.W ⇒ (x ⬝ₐ (y ⬝ₐ z)) = ((x ⬝ₐ y) ⬝ₐ z)) ∧
    (∀x x' y y'. x ≼ₐ x' ∧ y ≼ₐ y' ⇒ (x ⬝ₐ y) ≼ₐ (x' ⬝ₐ y')) ∧
    (∀x. x ∈ RCS.W ⇒ (x ⬝ₐ x) ≼ₐ x) ∧

    
    (∀x y Z. Z ▹ₐ x ∧ y ∈ RCS.W ⇒ (Z ⬝ₐ y) ▹ₐ (x ⬝ₐ y)) ∧
    (∀x x' y y'. x ≼ₐ x' ∧ y ≼ₐ y' ∧ x ⊥ₐ y ⇒ x' ⊥ₐ y') ∧
    (∀x Z. Z ▹ₐ x ∧ Z ⊥ₐ RCS.E ⇒ x ⊥ₐ RCS.E) ∧
    (∀x y z. x ∈ RCS.W ∧ y ∈ RCS.W ∧ z ∈ RCS.W ∧ (x ⬝ₐ y) ⊥ₐ z ⇒ (x ⬝ₐ z) ⊥ₐ y)

name: Perp_def
statement: Perp RCS (X: α set) = {y | y ∈ RCS.W ∧ ∀x. x ∈ X ⇒ y ⊥ₐ x}

name: Is_Prop_def
statement: Is_Prop RCS X ⇔ (Localized (to_CS RCS) X ∧ Upset (to_CS RCS) X)

name: IMP_def
statement: IMP RCS X Y = {w | w ∈ RCS.W ∧ {w ⬝ₐ x | x ∈ X} ⊆ Y}

name: Orthojoin_def
statement: Orthojoin RCS X Y = Perp RCS (Perp RCS (X ∪ Y))

name: R_MODEL_SYSTEM_def
statement:
R_MODEL_SYSTEM RCS Ps ⇔ Is_Relevant_Cover_System RCS ∧
                          ((Up (to_CS RCS) {RCS.E}) ∈ Ps) ∧
                          (∀X. X ∈ Ps ⇒ Upset X) ∧
                          (∀X. X ∈ Ps ⇒ X = Perp (Perp X)) ∧
                          (∀X. X ∈ Ps ⇒ Perp X ∈ Ps) ∧
                          (∀X Y. X ∈ Ps ∧ Y ∈ Ps ⇒ X ∩ Y ∈ Ps) ∧
                          (∀X Y. X ∈ Ps ∧ Y ∈ Ps ⇒ X ⟹ₐ Y ∈ Ps) ∧
                          (∀X Y. X ∈ Ps ∧ Y ∈ Ps ⇒ Orthojoin X Y = j (X ∪ Y))

name: Model_Function_def
statement:
Model_Function (RCS: (g_prop set) R_COVER_SYSTEM) Ps M ⇔
    (∀a A. M (g_VAR a) = A ⇒ A ∈ Ps) ∧
    (M τ = Up (to_CS RCS) {RCS.E}) ∧
    (∀A B. M (A & B) = M A ∩ M B) ∧
    (∀A B. M (A --> B) = (M A ⟹ M B)) ∧
    (∀A. M (~A) = Perp (M A))

name: C_Holds_def
statement: C_Holds RCS Ps M w A ⇔ w ∈ M A ∧ Model_Function RCS Ps M ∧ R_MODEL_SYSTEM RCS Ps

name: ENTAILS_def
statement:
ENTAILS A B ⇔
    |- (A --> B)

name: Theory_def
statement: Theory A = {B | A |-^ B}

name: gens_def
statement: gens X = {A | Theory A = X}

name: EQUIV_def
statement: EQUIV A = {B | B |-^ A ∧ A |-^ B}

name: is_EQUIV_def
statement: is_EQUIV X ⇔ ∃A. X = EQUIV A ∨ X = ∅

name: Theory_union_def
statement: Theory_union X = BIGUNION {Theory A | A ∈ X}

name: CAN_FUSION_def
statement: CAN_FUSION X Y = Theory_union {x ∘ᵣ y | x ∈ gens X ∧ y ∈ gens Y}

name: CAN_ORTH_def
statement: CAN_ORTH X Y = ∃A B. A ∈ gens X ∧ B ∈ gens Y ∧ A |-^ (~B)

name: Canonical_System_def
EQUIV_W_def
statement: EQUIV_W A = {w | A ∈ w ∧ w ∈ Canonical_System.W}

name: Canonical_System_Ps_def
statement: Canonical_System_Ps = {EQUIV_W A | A ∈ 𝕌(:g_prop)}

name: g_permutation
statement: ∀A B C. goldblatt_provable ((A -->ₐ (B -->ₐ C)) -->ₐ (B -->ₐ (A -->ₐ C)))

name: g_double_neg
statement: ∀A. goldblatt_provable (A -->ₐ ~ₐ (~ₐ A))

name: g_double_negative_equiv
statement: ∀A. goldblatt_provable (A <->ₐ ~ₐ (~ₐ A))

name: g_double_negative_implication_equiv
statement: ∀A B. goldblatt_provable((A -->ₐ B) <->ₐ (A -->ₐ ~ₐ (~ₐ B)))

name: g_conj_intro_rule
statement:
∀A B C. goldblatt_provable (A -->ₐ B) ∧
          goldblatt_provable (A -->ₐ C) ⇒
          goldblatt_provable (A -->ₐ (B &ₐ C))

name: g_equiv_replacement
statement:
∀A B C. goldblatt_provable (A <->ₐ B) ⇒
          (goldblatt_provable ((A -->ₐ C) <->ₐ (B -->ₐ C))) ∧
          (goldblatt_provable ((C -->ₐ A) <->ₐ (C -->ₐ B))) ∧
          (goldblatt_provable ((A &ₐ C) <->ₐ (B &ₐ C))) ∧
          (goldblatt_provable ((C &ₐ A) <->ₐ (C &ₐ B))) ∧
          (goldblatt_provable ((~ₐ A) <->ₐ ~ₐ B)) ∧
          (goldblatt_provable ((A <->ₐ C) <->ₐ (B <->ₐ C))) ∧
          (goldblatt_provable ((C <->ₐ A) <->ₐ (C <->ₐ B))) ∧
          (goldblatt_provable A ⇔ goldblatt_provable B)

name: g_contrapositive_alt
statement: ∀ A B. goldblatt_provable ((A -->ₐ B) <->ₐ (~ₐ B -->ₐ ~ₐ A))

name: g_io_rule
statement: ∀A B C. goldblatt_provable ((A ioₐ B) -->ₐ C) ⇔ goldblatt_provable (A -->ₐ (B -->ₐ C))

name: g_OR_def
statement: g_OR A B = ~ₐ(~ₐA &ₐ ~ₐB)

name: g_DIMP_def
statement: g_DIMP A B = (A -->ₐ B) &ₐ (B -->ₐ A)

name: g_ICONJ_def
statement: g_ICONJ A B = ~ₐ(A -->ₐ ~ₐB)

name: goldblatt_provable_def
statement:
[g_identity:] (∀A. goldblatt_provable (A -->ₐ A))
[g_suffixing:]
  (∀ A B C. goldblatt_provable ((A -->ₐ B) -->ₐ ((B -->ₐ C) -->ₐ (A -->ₐ C))))
[g_assertion:]
  (∀A B. goldblatt_provable (A -->ₐ ((A -->ₐ B) -->ₐ B)))
[g_contraction:]
  (∀A B. goldblatt_provable ((A -->ₐ (A -->ₐ B)) -->ₐ (A -->ₐ B)))
[g_conjunction_l:] (∀A B. goldblatt_provable((A &ₐ B) -->ₐ A))
[g_conjunction_r:] (∀A B. goldblatt_provable ((A &ₐ B) -->ₐ B))
[g_conj_introduction:]
  ∀A B C.
    goldblatt_provable (((A -->ₐ B) &ₐ (A -->ₐ C)) -->ₐ (A -->ₐ (B &ₐ C)))
[g_disjunction_l:] (∀A B. goldblatt_provable (A -->ₐ (A Vₐ B)))
[g_disjunction_r:] (∀A B. goldblatt_provable (B -->ₐ (A Vₐ B)))
[g_disjunction_elim:]
  ∀A B C.
    goldblatt_provable (((A -->ₐ C) &ₐ (B -->ₐ C)) -->ₐ ((A Vₐ B) -->ₐ C))
[g_distribution:]
  (∀A B C. goldblatt_provable ((A &ₐ (B Vₐ C)) -->ₐ ((A &ₐ B) Vₐ (A &ₐ C))))
[g_contrapositive:]
  ∀A B. goldblatt_provable ((A -->ₐ (~ₐB)) -->ₐ (B -->ₐ (~ₐA)))
[g_double_negation:] (∀A. goldblatt_provable ((~ₐ(~ₐA)) -->ₐ A ))
[g_adjunction_rule:]
  ∀A B. goldblatt_provable A ∧ goldblatt_provable B ⇒
        goldblatt_provable (A &ₐ B)
[g_modus_ponens:]
  ∀A B. goldblatt_provable A ∧ goldblatt_provable (A -->ₐ B) ⇒
        goldblatt_provable B
[g_tt_rl:] (∀A. goldblatt_provable A ⇒ goldblatt_provable (τₐ -->ₐ A))
[g_tt_lr:] (∀A. goldblatt_provable (τₐ -->ₐ A) ⇒ goldblatt_provable A)

name: gs_sg_equiv
statement: ∀A. slaney_provable (A <->ₛ (gs $ sg A))

name: sg_gs_EQ
statement: ∀A. sg $ gs A = A

name: g_trans_invarient
statement: ∀A. goldblatt_provable $ sg $ gs A ⇔ goldblatt_provable A

name: s_trans_invarient
statement: ∀A. slaney_provable $ gs $ sg A ⇔ slaney_provable A

name: goldblatt_implies_slaney
statement: ∀A. goldblatt_provable A ⇒ slaney_provable $ gs A

name: slaney_implies_goldblatt
statement: ∀A. slaney_provable A ⇒ goldblatt_provable $ sg A

name: goldblatt_slaney_equiv
statement:
∃ s g. ∀A B. (goldblatt_provable A ⇒ slaney_provable $ s A) ∧
               (slaney_provable B ⇒ goldblatt_provable $ g B) ∧
               (goldblatt_provable $ g $ s A ⇔ goldblatt_provable A) ∧
               (slaney_provable $ s $ g B ⇔ slaney_provable B)

name: sg_translation_def
statement:
(sg_translation (s_VAR A) = g_VAR A) ∧
  (sg_translation (A -->ₛ B) = sg_translation A -->ₐ sg_translation B) ∧
  (sg_translation (A &ₛ B) = sg_translation A &ₐ sg_translation B) ∧
  (sg_translation (A Vₛ B) = sg_translation A Vₐ sg_translation B) ∧
  (sg_translation (A ioₛ B) = sg_translation A ioₐ sg_translation B) ∧
  (sg_translation (~ₛ A) = ~ₐ (sg_translation A)) ∧
  (sg_translation τₛ = τₐ)

name: gs_translation_def
statement:
(gs_translation (g_VAR A) = s_VAR A) ∧
  (gs_translation (A -->ₐ B) = gs_translation A -->ₛ gs_translation B) ∧
  (gs_translation (A &ₐ B) = gs_translation A &ₛ gs_translation B) ∧
  (gs_translation (~ₐ A) = ~ₛ (gs_translation A)) ∧
  (gs_translation τₐ = τₛ)

name: SEMICOLON_associative_rl
statement: ∀Γ X Y Z A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (X； (Y； Z))) A ⇒ R_sequent (REPLACE Γ ((X； Y)； Z)) A

name: AND_Elimination_l_alt
statement: ∀A B. R_sequent (PROP (A & B)) A

name: AND_Elimination_r_alt
statement: ∀A B. R_sequent (PROP (A & B)) B

name: OR_Introduction_l_alt
statement: ∀A B. R_sequent (PROP A) (A V B)

name: OR_Introduction_r_alt
statement: ∀A B. R_sequent (PROP B) (A V B)

name: NOT_NOT_Introduction_alt
statement: ∀A. R_sequent (PROP A) (~~A)

name: NOT_NOT_Elimination_alt
statement: ∀A. R_sequent (PROP (~~A)) (A)

name: hilbert_to_natural_deduction
statement:
∀A. |- A
      ⇒ (PROP  τ) ||- A

name: OR_Bunch_rule
statement: |- (bg (REPLACE Γ (PROP (A V B))) --> (bg (REPLACE Γ (PROP A)) V bg (REPLACE Γ (PROP B))))

name: CONTEXT_IMP
statement: ∀X Y. |- (bg(X) --> bg(Y)) ⇒ ∀Γ. |- (bg(REPLACE Γ X) --> bg(REPLACE Γ (Y)))

name: X_derive_bg_X
statement: ∀X. X ||- bg(X)

name: REPLACE_def
statement:
(REPLACE HOLE X = X) ∧
  (REPLACE (LCOMMA Γ b) X = COMMA (REPLACE Γ X) b) ∧
  (REPLACE (RCOMMA b Γ) X = COMMA b (REPLACE Γ X)) ∧
  (REPLACE (LSEMI Γ b) X  = SEMICOLON (REPLACE Γ X) b) ∧
  (REPLACE (RSEMI b Γ) X  = SEMICOLON b (REPLACE Γ X))

name: bg_translation_def
statement:
(bg_translation (PROP A) = A) ∧
  (bg_translation (X ， Y) = (bg_translation X) & (bg_translation Y)) ∧
  (bg_translation (X； Y) = (bg_translation X) ∘ᵣ (bg_translation Y))

name: R_sequent_def
statement:
[Assumption:] (∀A. R_sequent (PROP A) A)
[AND_Elimination_l:] (∀X A B. R_sequent X (A & B) ⇒ R_sequent X A)
[AND_Elimination_r:] (∀X A B. R_sequent X (A & B) ⇒ R_sequent X B)
[OR_Introduction_l:] (∀X A B. R_sequent X A ⇒ R_sequent X (A V B))
[OR_Introduction_r:] (∀X A B. R_sequent X B ⇒ R_sequent X (A V B))
[NOT_NOT_Introduction:] (∀X A. R_sequent X A ⇒ R_sequent X (~~A))
[NOT_NOT_Elimination:] (∀X A. R_sequent X (~~A) ⇒ R_sequent X A)


[AND_Introduction:]
  ∀X Y A B. (R_sequent X A ∧ R_sequent Y B ⇒ R_sequent (X， Y) (A & B))
[IMP_Introduction:]
  ∀X A B. R_sequent (X ； (PROP A)) B ⇒ R_sequent X (A --> B)
[IMP_Elimination:]
  ∀X Y A B. R_sequent X (A --> B) ∧ R_sequent Y A ⇒ R_sequent (X ； Y) B
[RAA:]
  ∀X Y A B. R_sequent (X ； (PROP A)) B ∧ R_sequent Y (~B) ⇒
            R_sequent (X ； Y) (~A)
[OR_Elimination:]
  ∀Γ X A B C. R_sequent X (A V B) ∧ R_sequent(REPLACE Γ (PROP  A)) C ∧
              R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (PROP  B)) C
              ⇒
              R_sequent (REPLACE Γ X) C

[COMMA_commutative:]
  (∀Γ X Y A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (X ， Y)) A ⇒ R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (Y ， X)) A)
[COMMA_associative_lr:]
  (∀Γ X Y Z A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ ((X ， Y) ， Z)) A ⇒
               R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (X ， (Y ， Z))) A)
[COMMA_associative_rl:]
  (∀Γ X Y Z A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (X ， (Y ， Z))) A ⇒ R_sequent (REPLACE Γ ((X ， Y) ， Z)) A) 
[COMMA_idempotent_lr:]
  (∀Γ X A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (X ， X)) A ⇒ R_sequent (REPLACE Γ X) A)
[COMMA_idempotent_rl:]
  (∀Γ X A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ X) A ⇒ R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (X ， X)) A)
[weakening:]
  (∀Γ X Y A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ X) A ⇒ R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (X ， Y)) A)
[identity_lr:]
  (∀Γ X A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ ((PROP τ) ； X) ) A ⇒ R_sequent (REPLACE Γ X) A)
[identity_rl:]
  (∀Γ X A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ X) A ⇒ R_sequent (REPLACE Γ ((PROP τ) ； X) ) A)

[SEMICOLON_commutative:]
  (∀Γ X Y A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (X ； Y)) A ⇒ R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (Y；X)) A)
[SEMICOLON_associative_lr:]
  (∀Γ X Y Z A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ ((X ； Y) ； Z)) A ⇒
               R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (X ； (Y ； Z))) A)
[SEMICOLON_idempotent_lr:]
  (∀Γ X A. R_sequent (REPLACE Γ (X ； X)) A ⇒ R_sequent (REPLACE Γ X) A)

name: g_AND_commutative
statement: ∀A B. goldblatt_provable ((A &ₐ B) <->ₐ B &ₐ A)

name: g_io_distribution_equiv
statement: ∀A B C. |- ((A ∘ᵣ (B V C)) <-> ((A ∘ᵣ B) V (A ∘ᵣ C)))

name: g_io_distribution_lr
statement: ∀A B C. |- ((A ∘ᵣ (B V C)) --> ((A ∘ᵣ B) V (A ∘ᵣ C)))

name: NOT_MEM_FILTER_LEMMA
statement: ∀ a γ. ¬ MEM a (FILTER (λx. x ≠ a) γ)

name: MEM_FILTER_LEMMA
statement: ∀ a x γ. MEM x (FILTER (λx. x ≠ a) γ) ⇒ MEM x γ

name: EMPTY_FILTER_LEMMA
statement: ∀a γ. FILTER (λx. x ≠ a) γ = [] ⇔ set γ ⊆ {a}

name: FILTER_NON_MEM_EQUAL
statement: ∀ γ A. ¬MEM A γ ⇒ FILTER (λx. x ≠ A) γ = γ

name: FINITE_EXISTS_LIST
statement: ∀x. FINITE x ⇒ ∃l. set l = x

name: OR_Holds
statement: ∀ RM w A B. R_Model RM ∧ w ∈ RM.RF.W ⇒ (Holds RM w (A V B) ⇔ Holds RM w A ∨ Holds RM w B)

name: Hereditary_Lemma
statement:
∀ RM x y p.
    R_Model RM ∧ x ∈ RM.RF.W ∧ y ∈ RM.RF.W ∧ Holds RM x p ∧ RM.RF.R RM.RF.Z x y ⇒
    Holds RM y p

name: R_INTER_WORLD_CONVERSE
statement:
∀RF. R_Frame RF ⇒
     ∀w x y z b. RF.R x y b ∧ RF.R w b z ∧ x ∈ RF.W ∧ y ∈ RF.W ∧ z ∈ RF.W ∧ w ∈ RF.W ∧ b ∈ RF.W
                 ⇒ ∃a. RF.R w x a ∧ RF.R a y z ∧ a ∈ RF.W

name: Contraction_Lemma
statement: R_Frame RF ∧ RF.R w x y ∧ w ∈ RF.W ∧ x ∈ RF.W ∧ y ∈ RF.W ⇒ ∃x'. x' ∈ RF.W ∧ RF.R w x x' ∧ RF.R x' x y

name: Soundness
statement: ∀p RM. |- p ∧ R_Model RM ⇒ Holds RM RM.RF.Z p

name: LIST_SUBSET_ADJUNCTION
statement: ∀γ. set γ ⊆ {p | |- p} ⇒ |- (CONJl γ)

name: g_A_CONJl_A
statement:
∀A γ. set γ ⊆ {A} ∧ γ ≠ []  ⇒
        |- (A --> CONJl γ)

name: CONJl_weaken_r
statement: γ ≠ [] ⇒ |- (CONJl (δ ++ γ) --> CONJl γ)

name: CONJl_weaken_l
statement: ∀δ. δ ≠ [] ⇒ |- (CONJl (δ ++ γ) --> CONJl δ)

name: CONJl_split
statement:
∀ α β. α ≠ [] ∧ β ≠ [] ⇒
         |- (CONJl α & CONJl β --> CONJl (α ++ β)) ∧
         |- (CONJl (α ++ β) --> CONJl α & CONJl β)

name: CONJl_MEM_IMP
statement: MEM p γ ⇒ |- (CONJl γ --> p)

name: FILTER_AND_FILTERED_IMP_CONJl
statement:
∀A γ.γ ≠ [] ∧ MEM A γ ∧ FILTER (λx. x ≠ A) γ ≠ [] ⇒
          |- ((CONJl (FILTER (λx. x ≠ A) γ) & A) --> CONJl γ)

name: CONJl_IN_R_Theory_IMP
statement: ∀ A γ. R_Theory A ∧ γ ≠ []  ⇒ (CONJl γ ∈ A ⇔ set γ ⊆ A)

name: IMP_CONJl_R_THEORY
statement:
∀ A γ θ. γ ≠ [] ∧ R_Theory θ ∧ (∀ B. B ∈ set γ ⇒ A --> B ∈ θ) ⇒
           A --> CONJl γ ∈ θ

name: CONJl_NOTIN_PRIME
statement:
∀A γ. Prime A ∧ ~CONJl γ ∈ A ∧ γ ≠ [] ⇒
        ∃x. MEM x γ ∧ ~x ∈ A

name: R_gn_INJ
statement: ∀A B. R_gn A = R_gn B ⇔ A = B

name: countable_g_props
statement: countable 𝕌(:g_prop)

name: Theta_i_grows
statement: e ∈ Theta_i n A ∧ n ≤ m ⇒ e ∈ Theta_i m A

name: FINITE_SUBSET_THETA
statement: ∀s. FINITE s ⇒ (s ⊆ Theta A ⇔ ∃n. s ⊆ Theta_i n A)

name: Theta_Maximal_Rejection
statement:
∀A. ¬ |- A ⇒
      ¬((Theta A) |-^ A) ∧ ∀q. q ∉ (Theta A) ⇒ (Theta A ∪ {q}) |-^ A

name: R_SUBSET_THETA
statement: {p | |- p} ⊆ Theta A

name: Theta_R_Theory
statement: ∀A. ¬ |- A ⇒ R_Theory (Theta A)

name: Exists_Theta_prop
statement:
∀A a. ¬( |- A ) ∧ a ∉ Theta A ⇒
         ∃ c. |- ((c & a) --> A) ∧ c ∈ Theta A

name: Theta_Prime
statement: ∀A. ¬ |- A ⇒ Prime (Theta A)

name: Theta_Ordinary
statement: ∀A. ¬ |- A ⇒ Ordinary (Theta A)

name: Theta_S_theory_cor
statement: ¬ |- p ⇒ ((S_Theory (Theta p) Γ) ⇔ ∀q. (sENTAILS (Theta p) Γ q ⇒ q ∈ Γ))

name: Theta_Theta_theory
statement: ∀A. ¬ |- A ⇒  S_Theory (Theta A) (Theta A)

name: Canonical_Frame_STAR_STAR
statement:
∀ A x.
      x ∈ (Canonical_Frame A).W ⇒
      (Canonical_Frame A).STAR ((Canonical_Frame A).STAR x) = x

name: Prime_STAR_R_Theory
statement: ∀x. Prime x ⇒ R_Theory {A | ~A ∉ x}

name: STAR_IN_CANONICAL_FRAME
statement:
∀A x.
      x ∈ (Canonical_Frame A).W ∧ ¬ |- A ⇒
      (Canonical_Frame A).STAR x ∈ (Canonical_Frame A).W

name: B_WORLD_i_grows
statement:
∀ e n m Θ A R. e ∈ B_WORLD_i n Θ A R ∧ n ≤ m ⇒
                 e ∈ B_WORLD_i m Θ A R

name: FINITE_SUBSET_B_WORLD
statement: ∀ s Θ A R. FINITE s ⇒ (s ⊆ B_WORLD Θ A R ⇔ ∃n. s ⊆ B_WORLD_i n Θ A R)

name: S_Theory_imp_R_Theory
statement: ∀ θ x. S_Theory θ x ⇒ R_Theory x

name: CONJl_IN_APPLIED
statement:
∀ θ w x γ. S_Theory θ w ∧
             set γ ⊆ APPLYING w x ∧ γ ≠ [] ⇒
             CONJl γ ∈ APPLYING w x

name: S_Theory_B_WORLD
statement:
∀A w x y z. ¬ |- A ∧
            S_Theory (Theta A) w ∧
            APPLYING w (B_WORLD (Theta A) (APPLYING x y) {p | (∃q. p --> q ∈ w ∧ q ∉ z)}) ⊆ z
            ⇒
            S_Theory (Theta A) (B_WORLD (Theta A) (APPLYING x y) {p | (∃q. p --> q ∈ w ∧ q ∉ z)})

name: B_WORLD_prop_exists
statement:
∀ p x w z C. ¬ |- p ∧ Prime z ∧ S_Theory (Theta p) w ∧
              S_Theory (Theta p) (B_WORLD (Theta p) x {p | ∃q. p --> q ∈ w ∧ q ∉ z}) ∧
              C ∉ B_WORLD (Theta p) x {p | ∃q. p --> q ∈ w ∧ q ∉ z} ∧ B_WORLD (Theta p) x {p | ∃q. p --> q ∈ w ∧ q ∉ z} ≠ ∅ ⇒
              ∃D d. D ∉ z ∧ d ∈ B_WORLD (Theta p) x {p | ∃q. p --> q ∈ w ∧ q ∉ z} ∧
                    d & C --> D ∈ w

name: Prime_B_WORLD
statement:
∀A w x y z.¬ |- A ∧
           Prime z ∧ S_Theory (Theta A) w ∧
           APPLYING w (B_WORLD (Theta A) (APPLYING x y) {p | (∃q. p --> q ∈ w ∧ q ∉ z)}) ⊆ z
           ⇒
           Prime (B_WORLD (Theta A) (APPLYING x y) {p | (∃q. p --> q ∈ w ∧ q ∉ z)})

name: Canonical_Frame_is_R_Frame
statement: ∀A. ¬|- A ⇒ R_Frame (Canonical_Frame A)

name: Canonical_Model_is_R_Model
statement: ∀A. ¬|-A ⇒ R_Model (Canonical_Model A)

name: X_WORLD_i_grows
statement:
∀ e n m Θ A R w. e ∈ X_WORLD_i n Θ A R w ∧ n ≤ m ⇒
                   e ∈ X_WORLD_i m Θ A R w

name: FINITE_SUBSET_X_WORLD
statement: ∀s Θ A R w. FINITE s ⇒ (s ⊆ X_WORLD Θ A R w ⇔ ∃n. s ⊆ X_WORLD_i n Θ A R w)

name: X_WORLD_condition
statement:
∀p w A B. ¬|- p ∧ B ∈ APPLYING w (X_WORLD (Theta p) {A} {B} w) ⇒
  ∃γ. CONJl γ --> B ∈ w ∧ set γ ⊆ {A} ∧ γ ≠ []

name: APPLIED_X_WORLD_i_GROWS
statement:
∀ x n m. n ≤ m ∧ x ∈ APPLYING w (X_WORLD_i n (Theta p) {A} {B} w) ⇒
       x ∈ APPLYING w (X_WORLD_i m (Theta p) {A} {B} w)

name: FINITE_APPLIED_SUBSET
FINITE_X_WORLD_i
statement: ∀n θ a b w. FINITE (X_WORLD_i n θ {a} {b} w)

name: NOT_EMPTY_X_WORLD_i
statement: ∀n θ a b w. X_WORLD_i n θ {a} {b} w ≠ ∅

name: APPLYING_TO_FINITE
statement:
∀ w θ x γ p. FINITE x ∧ set γ = x ∧ S_Theory θ w ∧ p ∈ APPLYING w x ⇒
             CONJl γ --> p ∈ w

name: APPLIED_S_THEORY_alt
statement:
∀θ w x. S_Theory θ w ⇒
  S_Theory θ (APPLYING w x)

name: APPLIED_S_THEORY
statement:
∀p w x. ¬ |- p ∧ S_Theory (Theta p) w ⇒
  S_Theory (Theta p) (APPLYING w x)

name: Y_WORLD_i_grows
statement:
∀ e n m Θ A R. e ∈ Y_WORLD_i n Θ A R ∧ n ≤ m ⇒
                   e ∈ Y_WORLD_i m Θ A R

name: FINITE_SUBSET_Y_WORLD
statement: ∀s Θ A R. FINITE s ⇒ (s ⊆ Y_WORLD Θ A R ⇔ ∃n. s ⊆ Y_WORLD_i n Θ A R)

name: X_WORLD_THETA_THEORY
statement:
¬ |- p ∧ S_Theory (Theta p) w ∧ A --> B ∉ w ⇒
  S_Theory (Theta p) (X_WORLD (Theta p) {A} {B} w)

name: X_WORLD_prop_exists
statement:
∀w p A B a. ¬ |- p ∧ S_Theory (Theta p) w ∧ Prime w ∧
              A --> B ∉ w ∧ a ∉ X_WORLD (Theta p) {A} {B} w ⇒
              ∃c γ. c ∈ X_WORLD (Theta p) {A} {B} w ∧
                    c & a --> CONJl γ ∈ w ∧ CONJl γ --> B ∈ (Theta p)

name: X_WORLD_Prime
statement:
∀p θ w A B.
    ¬ |- p ∧ S_Theory (Theta p) w ∧ Prime w ∧ A --> B ∉ w ⇒
    Prime (X_WORLD (Theta p) {A} {B} w)

name: Y_WORLD_THETA_THEORY
statement:
∀p B x.  ¬ |- p ∧ B ∉ x ∧ S_Theory (Theta p) x ⇒
  S_Theory (Theta p) (Y_WORLD (Theta p) x {B})

name: Y_WORLD_prop_exists
statement:
∀x p B a. ¬ |- p ∧  B ∉ x ∧ S_Theory (Theta p) x ∧ a ∉ Y_WORLD (Theta p) x {B} ∧ Y_WORLD (Theta p) x {B} ≠ ∅ ⇒
            ∃c. c ∈ Y_WORLD (Theta p) x {B} ∧ c & a --> B ∈ (Theta p)

name: Y_WORLD_Prime
statement:
∀p θ x A B.
    ¬ |- p ∧ S_Theory (Theta p) x ∧ B ∉ x ⇒
    Prime (Y_WORLD (Theta p) x {B})

name: Truth_Lemma
statement:
∀p. ¬ |- p ⇒  (∀A w. w ∈ (Canonical_Model p).RF.W ⇒
      (Holds (Canonical_Model p) w A ⇔ A ∈ w))

name: Completeness
statement: (∀ (RM : (g_prop set) MODEL) . R_Model RM ⇒ Holds RM RM.RF.Z p) ⇒ |- p

name: R_Frame_def
statement:
R_Frame RF  ⇔
    (RF.Z ∈ RF.W) ∧

    (∀x. x ∈ RF.W ⇒ (RF.STAR x) ∈ RF.W) ∧

    (∀x. x ∈ RF.W ⇒ RF.R RF.Z x x) ∧
    (∀x x' y y' z z'.
        x ∈ RF.W ∧ y ∈ RF.W ∧  z ∈ RF.W ∧
        x' ∈ RF.W ∧ y' ∈ RF.W ∧  z' ∈ RF.W ∧
        RF.R RF.Z x' x ∧ RF.R RF.Z y' y ∧ RF.R RF.Z z z' ∧
        RF.R x y z ⇒ RF.R x' y' z')  ∧

    (∀x. x ∈ RF.W ⇒ RF.STAR (RF.STAR x) = x) ∧
    (∀ w x y. RF.R w x y ∧ x ∈ RF.W ∧ y ∈ RF.W ∧ w ∈ RF.W ⇒ RF.R w (RF.STAR y) (RF.STAR x)) ∧
    
    (∀x. x ∈ RF.W ⇒ RF.R x x x) ∧
    (∀x y z.
        x ∈ RF.W ∧ y ∈ RF.W ∧  z ∈ RF.W ∧
        RF.R x y z ⇒ RF.R y x z) ∧
    (∀w x y z a.
       x ∈ RF.W ∧ y ∈ RF.W ∧  z ∈ RF.W ∧ w ∈ RF.W ∧  a ∈ RF.W ∧
        RF.R w x a ∧ RF.R a y z ⇒
       (∃ b. RF.R x y b ∧ RF.R w b z ∧ b ∈ RF.W))

name: Hereditary_def
statement:
Hereditary RM ⇔
    ∀x y s. RM.RF.R RM.RF.Z x y ∧ x ∈ RM.VF s ⇒ y ∈ RM.VF s

name: R_Model_def
statement: R_Model RM ⇔ R_Frame RM.RF ∧ Hereditary RM

name: Holds_def
statement:
(Holds RM w (g_VAR s) ⇔ w ∈ RM.RF.W ∧ w ∈ RM.VF s) ∧
  (Holds RM w (a & b) ⇔  w ∈ RM.RF.W ∧ Holds RM w a ∧ Holds RM w b) ∧
  (Holds RM w (~a) ⇔  w ∈ RM.RF.W ∧ ¬ Holds RM (RM.RF.STAR w) a) ∧
  (Holds RM w (a --> b) ⇔  w ∈ RM.RF.W ∧ ∀x y. x ∈ RM.RF.W ∧ y ∈ RM.RF.W ∧ RM.RF.R w x y ∧ Holds RM x a ⇒ Holds RM y b) ∧
  (Holds RM w τ ⇔  w ∈ RM.RF.W ∧ RM.RF.R RM.RF.Z RM.RF.Z w)

name: CONJl_def
statement:
(CONJl [] = τ) ∧
  (CONJl [p] = p) ∧
  (CONJl (p::(q::lp)) = p & CONJl (q::lp))

name: pENTAIL_def
statement:
pENTAIL Γ p ⇔
    ∃ γ. γ ≠ [] ∧ (set γ) ⊆ Γ ∧ |- ((CONJl γ) --> p)

name: R_Theory_def
statement:
R_Theory θ ⇔
    (∀p. θ |-^ p ⇒ p ∈ θ)

name: Regular_def
statement:
Regular θ ⇔
    R_Theory θ ∧ (∀p. |- p ⇒ p ∈ θ)

name: Prime_def
statement:
Prime θ ⇔
    R_Theory θ ∧ (∀A B. (A V B) ∈ θ ⇒ (A ∈ θ ∨ B ∈ θ))

name: Ordinary_def
statement: Ordinary θ ⇔ Prime θ ∧ Regular θ

name: R_gn
statement:
R_gn (g_VAR s) = 4*(s2n s + 1) ∧
  R_gn (A --> B) = 4*(R_gn A ⊗ R_gn B) + 1 ∧
  R_gn (A & B) = 4*(R_gn A ⊗ R_gn B) + 2 ∧
  R_gn (~A) = 4*(R_gn A) + 3 ∧
  R_gn τ = 0

name: Theta_i_def
statement:
Theta_i 0 A = {p | |- p} ∧
  Theta_i (SUC n) A =
  if Theta_i n A ∪ {LINV R_gn UNIV n} |-^ A
     then Theta_i n A
     else Theta_i n A ∪ {LINV R_gn UNIV n}

name: Theta_def
statement: Theta A = BIGUNION {Theta_i n A | n ∈ UNIV}

name: sENTAILS_def
statement:
sENTAILS S Γ p ⇔
    ∃ γ. γ ≠ [] ∧ (set γ) ⊆ Γ ∧ (CONJl γ) --> p ∈ S

name: S_Theory_def
statement:
S_Theory S Θ ⇔
    Ordinary S ∧ ∀p. (sENTAILS S Θ p ⇒ p ∈ Θ)

name: APPLYING_def
statement: APPLYING X Y = {p | ∃γ. γ ≠ [] ∧ (CONJl γ --> p) ∈ X ∧ set γ ⊆ Y}

name: Canonical_Frame_def
B_WORLD_i_def
B_WORLD_def
statement: B_WORLD Θ S R = BIGUNION {B_WORLD_i n Θ S R | n ∈ UNIV}

name: Canonical_Model_def
X_WORLD_i_def
X_WORLD_def
statement: X_WORLD Θ S R w = BIGUNION {X_WORLD_i n Θ S R w | n ∈ UNIV}

name: Y_WORLD_i_def
Y_WORLD_def
statement: Y_WORLD Θ S R = BIGUNION {Y_WORLD_i n Θ S R | n ∈ UNIV}

name: s_assertion
statement: ∀A B. slaney_provable (A -->ₛ ((A -->ₛ B) -->ₛ B))

name: s_prefixing
statement: ∀A B C. slaney_provable ((A -->ₛ B) -->ₛ ((C -->ₛ A) -->ₛ (C -->ₛ B)))

name: s_equiv_identity
statement: ∀A. slaney_provable (A <->ₛ A)

name: s_equiv_symmetry
statement: ∀A B. slaney_provable (A <->ₛ B) ⇔ slaney_provable (B <->ₛ A)

name: s_equiv_transitivity
statement:
∀ A B C. slaney_provable (A <->ₛ B) ∧ slaney_provable (B <->ₛ C) ⇒
           slaney_provable (A <->ₛ C)

name: s_conj_intro_rule
statement:
∀A B C. slaney_provable (A -->ₛ B) ∧
          slaney_provable (A -->ₛ C) ⇒
          slaney_provable (A -->ₛ (B &ₛ C))

name: s_equiv_replacement
statement:
∀A B C. slaney_provable (A <->ₛ B) ⇒
          (slaney_provable ((A -->ₛ C) <->ₛ (B -->ₛ C))) ∧
          (slaney_provable ((C -->ₛ A) <->ₛ (C -->ₛ B))) ∧
          slaney_provable (~ₛ A <->ₛ ~ₛ B) ∧
          (slaney_provable ((A &ₛ C) <->ₛ (B &ₛ C))) ∧
          (slaney_provable ((C &ₛ A) <->ₛ (C &ₛ A))) ∧
          (slaney_provable ((A Vₛ C) <->ₛ (B Vₛ C))) ∧
          (slaney_provable ((C Vₛ A) <->ₛ (C Vₛ A))) ∧
          (slaney_provable ((A ioₛ C) <->ₛ (B ioₛ C))) ∧
          (slaney_provable ((C ioₛ A) <->ₛ (C ioₛ A))) ∧
          (slaney_provable ((A <->ₛ C) <->ₛ (B <->ₛ C))) ∧
          (slaney_provable ((C <->ₛ A) <->ₛ (C <->ₛ A))) ∧
          (slaney_provable (A) ⇔ slaney_provable (B))

name: s_double_negative_equiv
statement: ∀A. slaney_provable (A <->ₛ ~ₛ (~ₛ A))

name: s_double_negative_implication_equiv
statement: ∀A B. slaney_provable((A -->ₛ B) <->ₛ (A -->ₛ ~ₛ (~ₛ B)))

name: s_contrapositive_2
statement: ∀A B. slaney_provable ((A -->ₛ B) <->ₛ (~ₛ B -->ₛ ~ₛ A))

name: s_double_dimp_equiv
statement:
∀A B C D. slaney_provable (A <->ₛ B) ∧ slaney_provable (C <->ₛ D) ⇒
          slaney_provable ((A -->ₛ C) <->ₛ (B -->ₛ D)) ∧
          slaney_provable ((A &ₛ C) <->ₛ (B &ₛ D)) ∧
          slaney_provable ((A Vₛ C) <->ₛ (B Vₛ D)) ∧
          slaney_provable ((A ioₛ C) <->ₛ (B ioₛ D))

name: s_OR_definable
statement: ∀A B. slaney_provable ((A Vₛ B) <->ₛ (~ₛ (~ₛ A &ₛ ~ₛ B)))

name: s_IO_definable
statement: ∀A B. slaney_provable ((A ioₛ B) <->ₛ (~ₛ (A -->ₛ ~ₛ B)))

name: s_disjunction_OR_def
statement:
∀A B C. slaney_provable (( A &ₛ ~ₛ (~ₛ B &ₛ ~ₛ C)) -->ₛ
                           ~ₛ(~ₛ ( A &ₛ B) &ₛ ~ₛ ( A &ₛ C)))

name: s_DIMP_def
statement: s_DIMP A B = (A -->ₛ B) &ₛ (B -->ₛ A)

name: slaney_provable_def
statement:
[s_identity:]
  ∀A. slaney_provable (A -->ₛ A)
[s_permutation:]
  ∀A B C. slaney_provable ((A -->ₛ (B -->ₛ C)) -->ₛ (B -->ₛ (A -->ₛ C)))
[s_transitivity:]
  ∀A B C. slaney_provable ((A -->ₛ B) -->ₛ ((B -->ₛ C) -->ₛ (A -->ₛ C)))
[s_contraction:] (∀A B. slaney_provable ((A -->ₛ (A -->ₛ B)) -->ₛ (A -->ₛ B)))
[s_conjunction_l:] (∀A B. slaney_provable ((A &ₛ B) -->ₛ A))
[s_conjunction_r:] (∀A B. slaney_provable ((A &ₛ B) -->ₛ B))
[s_conj_introduction:]
  ∀A B C. slaney_provable (((A -->ₛ B) &ₛ (A -->ₛ C)) -->ₛ (A -->ₛ (B &ₛ C)))
[s_disjunction_l:] (∀A B. slaney_provable (A -->ₛ (A Vₛ B)))
[s_disjunction_r:] (∀A B. slaney_provable (B -->ₛ (A Vₛ B)))
[s_disjunction_elim:]
  ∀A B C. slaney_provable (((A -->ₛ C) &ₛ (B -->ₛ C)) -->ₛ ((A Vₛ B) -->ₛ C))
[s_distribution:]
  ∀A B C. slaney_provable ((A &ₛ (B Vₛ C)) -->ₛ ((A &ₛ B) Vₛ (A &ₛ C)))
[s_contrapositive:] ∀A B. slaney_provable ((A -->ₛ (~ₛB)) -->ₛ (B -->ₛ (~ₛA)))
[s_double_negation:] (∀A. slaney_provable ((~ₛ(~ₛA)) -->ₛ A ))
[s_adjunction_rule:]
  (∀A B. slaney_provable A ∧ slaney_provable B ⇒ slaney_provable (A &ₛ B))
[s_modus_ponens:]
  (∀A B. slaney_provable A ∧ slaney_provable (A -->ₛ B) ⇒ slaney_provable B)
[s_intensional_conj_lr:]
  (∀A B C. slaney_provable ((A ioₛ B) -->ₛ C) ⇒ slaney_provable (A -->ₛ (B -->ₛ C)))
[s_intensional_conj_rl:]
  ∀A B C. slaney_provable (A -->ₛ (B -->ₛ C)) ⇒
          slaney_provable ((A ioₛ B) -->ₛ C)
[s_tt_rl:] (∀A. slaney_provable A ⇒ slaney_provable (τₛ -->ₛ A))
[s_tt_lr:] (∀A. slaney_provable (τₛ -->ₛ A) ⇒ slaney_provable A)

name: DET_OMEGA_EXISTS_FORALL_THEOREM
statement:
(?q:num->'state.
     (q t0 = InitVal) /\
     (!t. q(t+(t0+1)) = TransRel((i(t+t0):'input),q(t+t0))) /\
     Accept(i,(\t.q(t+t0))))
  =
  (!q:num->'state.
     (q t0 = InitVal) /\
     (!t. q(t+(t0+1)) = TransRel((i(t+t0):'input),q(t+t0)))
     ==>     Accept(i,(\t.q(t+t0))))

name: REPETITION_BOOL_LEMMA
statement:
(!s:num->'state.?x0 l. (0<l) /\ (s(x0)=s(x0+l))) ==>
  !(s:num->'state) (q:num->bool).
    ?x0 l. 0<l /\ (s x0 =s(x0+l)) /\ (q x0 = q(x0+l))

name: SUNTIL_SIGNAL
statement:
(a SUNTIL b) t0 =
          ?delta. (!t. t<delta ==> a(t+t0) /\~b(t+t0)) /\ b(delta+t0)

name: BEFORE_AS_WHEN
statement: a BEFORE b = (\t. ~b t) WHEN (\t.a t \/ b t)

name: NO_EMPTY_SET_IN_RUN___PATH_THROUGH_RUN_AND_REACHABLE_STATE_EXISTS
statement:
!r s n. IS_REACHABLE_BY_RUN (s, n) r /\ NO_EMPTY_SET_IN_RUN r ==>
          ?w. IS_PATH_THROUGH_RUN w r /\ w n = s

name: ALT_SEM_S0_AND_SPLIT___INITIAL
statement:
!A f i p1 p2.
    IS_VALID_ALTERNATING_AUTOMATON A /\ (A.A.S0 = P_AND(p1, p2)) /\
    (A.AC = INITIAL f) ==>
    (ALT_SEM A i =
     (ALT_SEM (alternating_automaton (alternating_semi_automaton A.A.S A.A.I
                                      p1 A.A.R) A.AC) i /\
      ALT_SEM (alternating_automaton (alternating_semi_automaton A.A.S A.A.I
                                      p2 A.A.R) A.AC) i))

name: A_USED_VARS___DIRECT_DEF
statement:
!A f p a b.
   (A_USED_VARS (ACCEPT_COND p) = ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS p) /\
   (A_USED_VARS A_TRUE = EMPTY) /\
   (A_USED_VARS (A_NDET(A, f)) = (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_VARS A UNION (A_USED_VARS f))) /\
   (A_USED_VARS (A_NOT a) = (A_USED_VARS a)) /\
   (A_USED_VARS (A_AND(a, b)) = (A_USED_VARS a) UNION (A_USED_VARS b))

name: A_SEM_THM
statement:
!A f v p a b.
      (A_SEM v (ACCEPT_COND p) = ACCEPT_COND_SEM v p) /\
      (A_SEM v (A_UNIV(A, f)) =
        !w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A v w ==> A_SEM (INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION A v w) f) /\
      (A_SEM v (A_NDET(A, f)) =
        ?w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A v w /\ A_SEM (INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION A v w) f) /\
      (A_SEM v A_TRUE) /\
     ~(A_SEM v A_FALSE) /\
      (A_SEM v (A_NOT a) = ~(A_SEM v a)) /\
      (A_SEM v (A_AND(a, b)) = (A_SEM v a /\ A_SEM v b)) /\
      (A_SEM v (A_OR(a, b)) = (A_SEM v a \/ A_SEM v b)) /\
      (A_SEM v (A_IMPL(a, b)) = (A_SEM v a ==> A_SEM v b)) /\
      (A_SEM v (A_EQUIV(a, b)) = (A_SEM v a <=> A_SEM v b))

name: VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA___A_USED_STATE_VARS_COMPATIBLE
statement:
!a1 a2. VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA (A_AND(a1, a2)) ==>
            A_USED_STATE_VARS_COMPATIBLE a1 a2

name: AUTOMATON_EQUIV_THM
statement:
(!A f. AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_NDET(A, f)) (A_NOT (A_UNIV(A, A_NOT f)))) /\
      (!A f. AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_UNIV(A, f)) (A_NOT (A_NDET(A, A_NOT f)))) /\
      (!a1 a2. AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_NOT a1) (A_NOT a2) <=> AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a2) /\
      (!a1 a2. AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_AND (a1,a2)) (A_AND (a2,a1))) /\
      (!a1 a2 b. AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a2 ==> AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_AND (a1,b)) (A_AND (a2,b))) /\
      (!a1 a2. (!v. A_SEM v (A_EQUIV(a1, a2))) <=> AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a2) /\
      (!a1 a2. AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_OR (a1,a2)) (A_OR (a2,a1))) /\
      (!a1 a2 b. AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a2 ==> AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_OR (a1,b)) (A_OR (a2,b))) /\
      (!a1 a2 b. AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a2 ==> AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_IMPL (a1,b)) (A_IMPL (a2,b))) /\
      (!a1 a2 b. AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a2 ==> AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_IMPL (b,a1)) (A_IMPL (b,a2))) /\
      (!A a1 a2. AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a2 ==> AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_NDET(A, a1)) (A_NDET(A, a2))) /\
      (!A a1 a2. AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a2 ==> AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_UNIV(A, a1)) (A_UNIV(A, a2))) /\
      (!a1 a2. AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a2 <=> AUTOMATON_EQUIV a2 a1) /\
      (!a1. AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a1) /\
      (!a1 a2 a3. AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a2 /\ AUTOMATON_EQUIV a2 a3 ==> AUTOMATON_EQUIV a1 a3)

name: A_BIGAND___A_USED_INPUT_VARS
statement:
!C1 C2. A_USED_INPUT_VARS (A_BIGAND (APPEND C1 C2)) =
            A_USED_INPUT_VARS (A_AND (A_BIGAND C1, A_BIGAND C2))

name: A_BIGAND___A_USED_STATE_VARS
statement:
!C1 C2. A_USED_STATE_VARS (A_BIGAND (APPEND C1 C2)) =
            A_USED_STATE_VARS (A_AND (A_BIGAND C1, A_BIGAND C2))

name: A_BIGAND___A_SEM
statement:
!C1 C2 v. A_SEM v (A_BIGAND (APPEND C1 C2)) <=>
              A_SEM v (A_BIGAND C1) /\ A_SEM v (A_BIGAND C2)

name: A_BIGAND_SEM
statement: !w C. A_SEM w (A_BIGAND C) <=> !e. MEM e C ==> A_SEM w e

name: ACCEPT_BIGAND_SEM
statement:
!t w C. ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME t w (ACCEPT_BIGAND C) <=>
            !e. MEM e C ==> ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME t w e

name: ACCEPT_BIGAND___VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!f C. ACCEPT_VAR_RENAMING f (ACCEPT_BIGAND C) =
          ACCEPT_BIGAND (MAP (ACCEPT_VAR_RENAMING f) C)

name: A_BIGAND___AUTOMATON_EQUIV
statement:
!C1 C2. AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_BIGAND (APPEND C1 C2))
                            (A_AND(A_BIGAND C1, A_BIGAND C2))

name: A_BIGAND___STATE_VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA
statement:
!C1 C2. STATE_VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA (A_BIGAND (APPEND C1 C2)) =
            STATE_VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA (A_AND (A_BIGAND C1,  A_BIGAND C2))

name: A_BIGAND___VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA
statement:
!C1 C2. VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA (A_BIGAND (APPEND C1 C2)) =
            VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA (A_AND (A_BIGAND C1, A_BIGAND C2))

name: A_BIGAND_EMPTY
statement: !C. (A_BIGAND C = A_TRUE) <=> (C = [])

name: A_BIGAND_11
statement: !C D. (A_BIGAND C = A_BIGAND D) <=> (C = D)

name: UNIQUE_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES___IMPLIES_EXISTENCE
statement: !A C. UNIQUE_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A C ==> EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A C

name: A_NDET_CONSTRAINED_11
statement:
!A B C D p q.
      (A_NDET_CONSTRAINED(A, C, p) = A_NDET_CONSTRAINED(B, D, q)) <=>
      (A = B) /\ (C = D) /\ (p = q)

name: ACCEPT_COND_PROP_11
statement: !p1 p2. (ACCEPT_COND_PROP p1 = ACCEPT_COND_PROP p2) <=> (p1 = p2)

name: A_TAUTOLOGY_CONTRADICTION_DUAL
statement:
(!A. A_IS_CONTRADICTION (A_NOT A) = A_IS_TAUTOLOGY A) /\
    (!A. A_IS_TAUTOLOGY (A_NOT A) = A_IS_CONTRADICTION A)

name: A_TAUTOLOGY_CONTRADICTION___TO___EQUIVALENT
statement:
(!A. A_IS_CONTRADICTION A = AUTOMATON_EQUIV A A_FALSE) /\
    (!A. A_IS_TAUTOLOGY A = AUTOMATON_EQUIV A A_TRUE)

name: FINITE___ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS
statement: !a. FINITE (ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS a)

name: ACCEPT_VAR_RENAMING___USED_VARS
statement:
!a f. ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS (ACCEPT_VAR_RENAMING f a) =
          IMAGE f (ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS a)

name: FINITE___A_USED_INPUT_VARS
statement: !a. FINITE (A_USED_INPUT_VARS a)

name: A_VAR_RENAMING___USED_STATE_VARS
statement: !a f. A_USED_STATE_VARS (A_VAR_RENAMING f a) = IMAGE f (A_USED_STATE_VARS a)

name: A_VAR_RENAMING___USED_INPUT_VARS
statement:
!a f. INJ f (A_USED_VARS a) UNIV ==>
         (A_USED_INPUT_VARS (A_VAR_RENAMING f a) = IMAGE f (A_USED_INPUT_VARS a))

name: A_VAR_RENAMING___USED_VARS
statement:
!a f. INJ f (A_USED_VARS a) UNIV ==>
         (A_USED_VARS (A_VAR_RENAMING f a) = IMAGE f (A_USED_VARS a))

name: A_VAR_RENAMING___A_BIGAND
statement: !f C. A_VAR_RENAMING f (A_BIGAND C) = A_BIGAND (MAP (A_VAR_RENAMING f) C)

name: ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS_INTER_SUBSET_THM
statement:
!a S t v. (ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS a) SUBSET S ==>
              (ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME t v a = ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME t (PATH_RESTRICT v S) a)

name: ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS_INTER_THM
statement:
!a t v. ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME t v a =
            ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME t (PATH_RESTRICT v (ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS a)) a

name: A_USED_INPUT_VARS_INTER_SUBSET_THM
statement:
!a S. (A_USED_INPUT_VARS a) SUBSET S ==>
          !i. A_SEM i a = A_SEM (PATH_RESTRICT i S) a

name: A_USED_INPUT_VARS_INTER_THM
statement: !a i. A_SEM i a = A_SEM (PATH_RESTRICT i (A_USED_INPUT_VARS a)) a

name: A_USED_INPUT_VARS_DIFF_DISJOINT_THM
statement: !a S. DISJOINT (A_USED_INPUT_VARS a) S ==> !i. A_SEM i a = A_SEM (PATH_DIFF i S) a

name: A_AND___A_NDET
statement:
!A1 f1 A2 f2. A_USED_STATE_VARS_COMPATIBLE (A_NDET(A1, f1)) (A_NDET(A2, f2)) ==>
                  AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_AND(A_NDET(A1, f1), A_NDET(A2, f2)))
                                  (A_NDET((PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A1 A2), A_AND(f1,f2)))

name: PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON___EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES
statement:
!A1 C1 A2 C2.
        A_USED_STATE_VARS_COMPATIBLE (A_NDET(A1, A_BIGAND C1)) (A_NDET(A2, A_BIGAND C2)) ==>
        EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A1 C1 /\ EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A2 C2 ==>
        EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES (PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A1 A2) (C1++C2)

name: PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON___UNIQUE_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES
statement:
!A1 C1 A2 C2.
        A_USED_STATE_VARS_COMPATIBLE (A_NDET(A1, A_BIGAND C1)) (A_NDET(A2, A_BIGAND C2)) ==>
        UNIQUE_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A1 C1 /\ UNIQUE_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A2 C2 ==>
        UNIQUE_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES (PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A1 A2) (C1++C2)

name: A_NDET___FLATTENING
statement:
!A1 A2 f. A_USED_STATE_VARS_COMPATIBLE (A_NDET(A1, A_TRUE)) (A_NDET(A2, f)) ==>
              AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_NDET(A1, A_NDET(A2, f)))
                              (A_NDET(PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A1 A2, f))

name: TOTAL_DET_AUTOMATON_EX_ALL_EQUIV
statement:
!A. IS_TOTAL_DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A ==>
        !f. AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_NDET(A,f)) (A_UNIV(A,f))

name: UNIQUE_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES___CONSTRAINED_AUTOMATON_EX_ALL_EQUIV
statement:
!A C. UNIQUE_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A C ==>
          !f. AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_NDET_CONSTRAINED (A,C,f)) (A_UNIV_CONSTRAINED (A,C,f))

name: NEG_ACCEPTANCE_CONDITION
statement: !A f. AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_NOT(A_NDET(A,f))) (A_UNIV(A, A_NOT f))

name: NEG_ACCEPTANCE_CONDITION_DET
statement:
!A f. IS_TOTAL_DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A ==>
          AUTOMATON_EQUIV (A_NOT(A_NDET(A,f))) (A_NDET(A, A_NOT f))

name: ACCEPT_COND___VAR_RENAMING___NOT_INJ
statement:
!ac t i f.
       ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME t i (ACCEPT_VAR_RENAMING f ac) =
       ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME t (\n x. f x IN i n) ac

name: ACCEPT_COND___VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!a t i f. INJ f (PATH_USED_VARS i UNION ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS a) UNIV ==>
                    (ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME t i a =
                     ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME t (PATH_VAR_RENAMING f i) (ACCEPT_VAR_RENAMING f a))

name: AUTOMATON_FORMULA___VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!a i (f:'a->'b). INJ f (PATH_USED_VARS i UNION A_USED_VARS a) UNIV ==>
                    (A_SEM i a = A_SEM (PATH_VAR_RENAMING f i) (A_VAR_RENAMING f a))

name: AUTOMATON_FORMULA___STATE_VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!a i f. INJ f (PATH_USED_VARS i UNION A_USED_VARS a) UNIV /\
           (!x. x IN (A_USED_INPUT_VARS a) ==> (f x = x)) ==>
           (A_SEM i a = A_SEM i (A_VAR_RENAMING f a))

name: A_SEM_AUTOMATON_RUN___STATE_VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!A a f. INJ f UNIV UNIV /\
            (!x. x IN (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A UNION
                       (A_USED_INPUT_VARS a DIFF A.S)) ==> (f x = x)) ==>
      !i w. (A_SEM (INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION A i w) a =
             A_SEM (INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION (SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING f A) i (PATH_VAR_RENAMING f w))
                   (A_VAR_RENAMING f a))

name: STATE_VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA___VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!a f. INJ f (A_USED_STATE_VARS a) UNIV ==>
         (STATE_VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA (A_VAR_RENAMING f a) =
          STATE_VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA a)

name: VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA___VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!a f. INJ f (A_USED_VARS a) UNIV ==>
         (VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA (A_VAR_RENAMING f a) = VARDISJOINT_AUTOMATON_FORMULA a)

name: EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES___A_SEM_REWRITE
statement: !A C. EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A C = !i. A_SEM i (A_NDET (A, A_BIGAND C))

name: EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES___STATE_VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!A C f. INJ f UNIV UNIV /\
           (!x. x IN (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A
                      UNION ((A_USED_INPUT_VARS (A_BIGAND C)) DIFF A.S)) ==> (f x = x)) ==>
      (EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES (SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING f A) (MAP (A_VAR_RENAMING f) C) =
       EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A C)

name: UNIQUE_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES___STATE_VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!A C f. INJ f UNIV UNIV /\
           (!x. x IN (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A
                      UNION ((A_USED_INPUT_VARS (A_BIGAND C)) DIFF A.S)) ==> (f x = x)) ==>
      (UNIQUE_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES (SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING f A) (MAP (A_VAR_RENAMING f) C) =
       UNIQUE_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A C)

name: EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES___PROPERTIES_SPLIT
statement:
(!A C1 C2. EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A (C1++C2) ==>
               EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A C1 /\ EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A C2) /\
    (!A c C. EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A (c::C) ==>
             EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A [c] /\ EXISTS_RUN_WITH_PROPERTIES A C)

name: A_NDET___INITIAL_ACCEPTANCE_SYM
statement:
!S S0 R p C. AUTOMATON_EQUIV
                  (A_NDET (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0 R,A_AND (ACCEPT_COND_PROP p,A_BIGAND C)))
                  (A_NDET (symbolic_semi_automaton S (P_AND(p, S0)) R,A_BIGAND C))

name: A_UNIV___INITIAL_ACCEPTANCE_SYM
statement:
!S S0 R p C. AUTOMATON_EQUIV
                  (A_UNIV (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0 R,A_IMPL (ACCEPT_COND_PROP p,A_BIGAND C)))
                  (A_UNIV (symbolic_semi_automaton S (P_AND(p, S0)) R,A_BIGAND C))

name: ACCEPT_COND_RESTN_SEM
statement:
!f v t1 t2. (ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME (t1+t2) v f =
                 ACCEPT_COND_SEM_TIME t1 (PATH_RESTN v t2) f)

name: ID_AUTOMATON_SEM
statement: !a. AUTOMATON_EQUIV a (A_NDET(ID_SEMI_AUTOMATON, a))

name: A_NDET___SIMPLIFIED_SEMI_AUTOMATON_THM
statement:
!A A' f ac.
       IS_SIMPLIFIED_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A' A f /\
       DISJOINT (IMAGE f (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A)) (ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS ac) ==>
       !i. A_SEM i (A_NDET (A, ACCEPT_COND ac)) =
           A_SEM i (A_NDET (A', ACCEPT_COND
                                 (ACCEPT_VAR_RENAMING
                                   (\x. (if x IN SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A then f x else x)) ac)))

name: A_UNIV___SIMPLIFIED_SEMI_AUTOMATON_THM
statement:
!A A' f ac.
       IS_SIMPLIFIED_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A' A f /\
       DISJOINT (IMAGE f (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A)) (ACCEPT_COND_USED_VARS ac) ==>
       !i. A_SEM i (A_UNIV (A, ACCEPT_COND ac)) =
           A_SEM i (A_UNIV (A', ACCEPT_COND
                                 (ACCEPT_VAR_RENAMING
                                   (\x. (if x IN SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A then f x else x)) ac)))

name: IS_LTL_RELATIONS
statement:
!f. (IS_LTL_F f = IS_LTL_G (LTL_NOT f)) /\
        (IS_LTL_G f = IS_LTL_F (LTL_NOT f)) /\
        (IS_LTL_FG f = IS_LTL_GF (LTL_NOT f)) /\
        (IS_LTL_GF f = IS_LTL_FG (LTL_NOT f)) /\
        (IS_LTL_F f ==> IS_LTL_FG f) /\
        (IS_LTL_G f ==> IS_LTL_GF f) /\
        (IS_LTL_G f ==> IS_LTL_FG f) /\
        (IS_LTL_F f ==> IS_LTL_GF f) /\
        (IS_LTL_PREFIX f ==> IS_LTL_FG f /\ IS_LTL_GF f)

name: LTL_USED_VARS_INTER_SUBSET_THM
statement:
!f t v S. (LTL_USED_VARS f) SUBSET S ==>
              (LTL_SEM_TIME t v f = LTL_SEM_TIME t (PATH_RESTRICT v S) f)

name: LTL_USED_VARS_INTER_THM
statement: !f t v. (LTL_SEM_TIME t v f = LTL_SEM_TIME t (PATH_RESTRICT v (LTL_USED_VARS f)) f)

name: FINITE___LTL_USED_VARS
statement: !l. FINITE (LTL_USED_VARS l)

name: LTL_USED_VARS_EVAL
statement:
!p r r1 r2.
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_PROP p) = P_USED_VARS p) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_NOT r) = LTL_USED_VARS r) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_AND (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_NEXT r) = LTL_USED_VARS r) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_SUNTIL(r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_PSNEXT r) = LTL_USED_VARS r) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_PSUNTIL(r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_OR (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_IMPL (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_EQUIV (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_ALWAYS r) = LTL_USED_VARS r) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_EVENTUAL r) = LTL_USED_VARS r) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_PNEXT r) = LTL_USED_VARS r) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS LTL_TRUE  = EMPTY) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS LTL_FALSE = EMPTY) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS LTL_INIT = EMPTY) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_PALWAYS r) = LTL_USED_VARS r) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_PEVENTUAL r) = LTL_USED_VARS r) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_WHILE (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_BEFORE (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_SWHILE (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_SBEFORE (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_PWHILE (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_PBEFORE (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_PSWHILE (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2) /\
    (LTL_USED_VARS (LTL_PSBEFORE (r1,r2)) = LTL_USED_VARS r1 UNION LTL_USED_VARS r2)

name: LTL_SEM_TIME___VAR_RENAMING___NOT_INJ
statement:
!f' t v f. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f f') =
               LTL_SEM_TIME t (\n x. f x IN v n) f'

name: LTL_SEM_TIME___VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!f' t v f. INJ f (PATH_USED_VARS v UNION LTL_USED_VARS f') UNIV ==>
              (LTL_SEM_TIME t v f' =
               LTL_SEM_TIME t (PATH_VAR_RENAMING f v) (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f f'))

name: LTL_SEM_TIME___VAR_RENAMING___PATH_RESTRICT
statement:
!f' t v f. INJ f (LTL_USED_VARS f') UNIV ==>
              (LTL_SEM_TIME t v f' =
               LTL_SEM_TIME t (PATH_VAR_RENAMING f (PATH_RESTRICT v (LTL_USED_VARS f')))
                              (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f f'))

name: FUTURE_LTL_CONSIDERS_ONLY_FUTURE
statement: !f t v. IS_FUTURE_LTL f ==> (LTL_SEM_TIME t v f <=> LTL_SEM (\t'. v (t'+t)) f)

name: FUTURE_LTL_EQUIVALENT_INIT_IS_EQUIVALENT
statement:
!l1 l2. IS_FUTURE_LTL l1 /\ IS_FUTURE_LTL l2 ==>
           (LTL_EQUIVALENT_INITIAL l1 l2 <=> LTL_EQUIVALENT l1 l2)

name: LTL_OR_SEM
statement:
!v f1 f2 t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_OR(f1,f2)) <=>
                LTL_SEM_TIME t v f1 \/ LTL_SEM_TIME t v f2

name: LTL_IMPL_SEM
statement:
!v f1 f2 t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_IMPL(f1,f2)) <=>
               (LTL_SEM_TIME t v f1 ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v f2)

name: LTL_EQUIV_SEM
statement:
!v f1 f2 t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_EQUIV(f1,f2)) <=>
               (LTL_SEM_TIME t v f1 <=> LTL_SEM_TIME t v f2)

name: LTL_SBEFORE_SEM
statement:
!v f1 f2 t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_SBEFORE(f1,f2)) <=>
       ?k. k >= t /\ (LTL_SEM_TIME k v f1) /\
           !j. t <= j /\ j <= k ==> ~(LTL_SEM_TIME j v f2)

name: LTL_PSBEFORE_SEM
statement:
!v f1 f2 t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PSBEFORE(f1,f2)) <=>
                ?k. k <= t /\ LTL_SEM_TIME k v f1 /\
                    !j. k <= j /\ j <= t ==> ~(LTL_SEM_TIME j v f2)

name: LTL_EVENTUAL_SEM
statement: !v f t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_EVENTUAL f) = ?k. k >= t /\ LTL_SEM_TIME k v f

name: LTL_ALWAYS_SEM
statement: !v f t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_ALWAYS f) = !k. k >= t ==> LTL_SEM_TIME k v f

name: LTL_PEVENTUAL_SEM
statement:
!v f t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PEVENTUAL f) =
            ?k:num. (0 <= k /\ k <= t) /\ LTL_SEM_TIME k v f

name: LTL_PALWAYS_SEM
statement: !v f t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PALWAYS f) = !k. k <= t ==> LTL_SEM_TIME k v f

name: LTL_PNEXT_SEM
statement: !v f t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PNEXT f) = ((t = 0) \/ LTL_SEM_TIME (PRE t) v f)

name: LTL_TRUE_SEM
statement: !v t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v LTL_TRUE

name: LTL_FALSE_SEM
statement: !v t. ~(LTL_SEM_TIME t v LTL_FALSE)

name: LTL_INIT_SEM
statement: !t v. (LTL_SEM_TIME t v LTL_INIT) = (t = 0)

name: LTL_VAR_RENAMING_EVAL
statement:
(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_PROP p) = LTL_PROP (P_VAR_RENAMING f p)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_NOT r) = LTL_NOT (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_AND (r1,r2)) = LTL_AND(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_NEXT r) = LTL_NEXT (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_SUNTIL(r1,r2)) = LTL_SUNTIL(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_PSNEXT r) = LTL_PSNEXT (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_PSUNTIL(r1,r2)) = LTL_PSUNTIL(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_OR (r1,r2)) = LTL_OR(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_IMPL (r1,r2)) = LTL_IMPL(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_EQUIV (r1,r2)) = LTL_EQUIV(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_ALWAYS r) = LTL_ALWAYS (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_EVENTUAL r) = LTL_EVENTUAL (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_PNEXT r) = LTL_PNEXT (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f LTL_TRUE  = LTL_TRUE) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f LTL_FALSE = LTL_FALSE) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f LTL_INIT = LTL_INIT) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_PALWAYS r) = LTL_PALWAYS (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_PEVENTUAL r) = LTL_PEVENTUAL (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_WHILE (r1,r2)) = LTL_WHILE(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_BEFORE (r1,r2)) = LTL_BEFORE(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_SWHILE (r1,r2)) = LTL_SWHILE(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_SBEFORE (r1,r2)) = LTL_SBEFORE(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_PWHILE (r1,r2)) = LTL_PWHILE(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_PBEFORE (r1,r2)) = LTL_PBEFORE(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_PSWHILE (r1,r2)) = LTL_PSWHILE(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2)) /\
    (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f (LTL_PSBEFORE (r1,r2)) = LTL_PSBEFORE(LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r1, LTL_VAR_RENAMING f r2))

name: LTL_ALWAYS_PALWAYS_ALTERNATIVE_DEFS
statement:
(!l. LTL_ALWAYS l = LTL_NOT (LTL_SUNTIL (LTL_TRUE, LTL_NOT l))) /\
    (!l. LTL_PALWAYS l = LTL_NOT (LTL_PSUNTIL (LTL_TRUE, LTL_NOT l)))

name: LTL_TAUTOLOGY_CONTRADICTION_DUAL
statement:
(!l. LTL_IS_CONTRADICTION (LTL_NOT l) <=> LTL_IS_TAUTOLOGY l) /\
    (!l. LTL_IS_TAUTOLOGY (LTL_NOT l) <=> LTL_IS_CONTRADICTION l)

name: LTL_TAUTOLOGY_CONTRADICTION___TO___EQUIVALENT_INITIAL
statement:
(!l. LTL_IS_CONTRADICTION l <=> LTL_EQUIVALENT_INITIAL l LTL_FALSE) /\
    (!l. LTL_IS_TAUTOLOGY l <=> LTL_EQUIVALENT_INITIAL l LTL_TRUE)

name: LTL_EQUIVALENT_INITIAL___TO___TAUTOLOGY
statement: !l1 l2. LTL_EQUIVALENT_INITIAL l1 l2 <=> LTL_IS_TAUTOLOGY (LTL_EQUIV(l1, l2))

name: LTL_EQUIVALENT_INITIAL___TO___CONTRADICTION
statement:
!l1 l2. LTL_EQUIVALENT_INITIAL l1 l2 <=>
            LTL_IS_CONTRADICTION (LTL_NOT (LTL_EQUIV(l1, l2)))

name: LTL_EQUIVALENT___TO___CONTRADICTION
statement:
!l1 l2. LTL_EQUIVALENT l1 l2 <=>
            LTL_IS_CONTRADICTION (LTL_EVENTUAL (LTL_NOT (LTL_EQUIV (l1,l2))))

name: LTL_CONTRADICTION___VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!f' f. INJ f (LTL_USED_VARS f') UNIV ==>
          (LTL_IS_CONTRADICTION f' <=> LTL_IS_CONTRADICTION (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f f'))

name: LTL_KS_SEM___VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!f' M f. INJ f (LTL_USED_VARS f' UNION (SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE_USED_VARS M)) UNIV ==>
            (LTL_KS_SEM M f' <=> LTL_KS_SEM (SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE_VAR_RENAMING f M)
                                            (LTL_VAR_RENAMING f f'))

name: LTL_RECURSION_LAWS___LTL_ALWAYS
statement:
!f. LTL_EQUIVALENT (LTL_ALWAYS f)
                       (LTL_AND(f, LTL_NEXT(LTL_ALWAYS f)))

name: LTL_RECURSION_LAWS___LTL_EVENTUAL
statement:
!f. LTL_EQUIVALENT (LTL_EVENTUAL f)
                       (LTL_OR(f, LTL_NEXT(LTL_EVENTUAL f)))

name: LTL_RECURSION_LAWS___LTL_SUNTIL
statement:
!l1 l2. LTL_EQUIVALENT (LTL_SUNTIL (l1, l2))
                           (LTL_OR(l2, LTL_AND(l1, LTL_NEXT(LTL_SUNTIL (l1, l2)))))

name: LTL_RECURSION_LAWS___LTL_PSUNTIL
statement:
!l1 l2. LTL_EQUIVALENT (LTL_PSUNTIL (l1, l2))
                           (LTL_OR(l2, LTL_AND(l1, LTL_PSNEXT(LTL_PSUNTIL (l1, l2)))))

name: LTL_EVENTUAL___PALWAYS
statement:
!k w p. LTL_SEM_TIME k w (LTL_EVENTUAL p) ==>
            !l. l <= k ==> LTL_SEM_TIME l w (LTL_EVENTUAL p)

name: LTL_WEAK_UNTIL___ALTERNATIVE_DEF
statement:
!f1 f2. LTL_EQUIVALENT (LTL_UNTIL(f1,f2))
                           (LTL_NOT (LTL_SUNTIL(LTL_NOT f2, LTL_AND(LTL_NOT f1, LTL_NOT f2))))

name: LTL_PAST_WEAK_UNTIL___ALTERNATIVE_DEF
statement:
!f1 f2. LTL_EQUIVALENT (LTL_PUNTIL(f1,f2))
                           (LTL_NOT (LTL_PSUNTIL(LTL_NOT f2, LTL_AND(LTL_NOT f1, LTL_NOT f2))))

name: LTL_STRONG___WEAK__IMPL___UNTIL
statement:
!k w p1 p2. LTL_SEM_TIME k w (LTL_SUNTIL(p1, p2)) ==>
                LTL_SEM_TIME k w (LTL_UNTIL(p1, p2))

name: LTL_COND___OR
statement:
!k w c p1 p2. LTL_SEM_TIME k w (LTL_COND (c, p1, p2)) ==>
                  LTL_SEM_TIME k w (LTL_OR (p1, p2))

name: LTL_MONOTICITY_LAWS
statement:
!As Aw Bs Bw v. (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v Aw ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v As) /\
                    (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v Bw ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v Bs) ==>
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_NOT As) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_NOT Aw)) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_NEXT Aw) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_NEXT As)) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_AND(Aw, Bw)) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_AND(As, Bs))) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_OR(Aw, Bw)) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_OR(As, Bs))) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_ALWAYS Aw) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_ALWAYS As)) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_EVENTUAL Aw) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_EVENTUAL As)) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_UNTIL(Aw, Bw)) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_UNTIL(As, Bs))) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_SUNTIL(Aw, Bw)) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_SUNTIL(As, Bs))) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_BEFORE(Aw, Bs)) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_BEFORE(As, Bw))) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_SBEFORE(Aw, Bs)) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_SBEFORE(As, Bw))) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PNEXT Aw) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PNEXT As)) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PSNEXT Aw) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PSNEXT As)) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PALWAYS Aw) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PALWAYS As)) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PEVENTUAL Aw) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PEVENTUAL As)) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PUNTIL(Aw, Bw)) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PUNTIL(As, Bs))) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PSUNTIL(Aw, Bw)) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PSUNTIL(As, Bs))) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PBEFORE(Aw, Bs)) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PBEFORE(As, Bw))) /\
         (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PSBEFORE(Aw, Bs)) ==> LTL_SEM_TIME t v (LTL_PSBEFORE(As, Bw)))

name: DET_TOTAL_KRIPKE_STRUCTURES_THM
statement:
INFINITE (UNIV:'b set) ==>
  (!S i. ((IS_ULTIMATIVELY_PERIODIC_PATH i /\ FINITE S /\ PATH_SUBSET i S)=
          (?M:('a, 'b) kripke_structure.
             IS_WELL_FORMED_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE M /\
             (M.P = S) /\
             IS_TRACE_OF_INITIAL_PATH_THROUGH_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE M i /\
             (!j. IS_TRACE_OF_INITIAL_PATH_THROUGH_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE M j ==>
                  (j = i)))))

name: PRODUCT_KRIPKE_STRUCTURES___PATH_IS_PRODUCT_OF_ORIGINAL_PATHS
statement:
!K1 K2 p.
    IS_PATH_THROUGH_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE (PRODUCT_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K1 K2) p =
    (IS_PATH_THROUGH_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K1 (\n. FST (p n)) /\
     IS_PATH_THROUGH_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K2 (\n. SND (p n)) /\
     (!n. (K1.L (FST (p n)) INTER K1.P INTER K2.P =
           K2.L (SND (p n)) INTER K1.P INTER K2.P)))

name: IS_BISIMULATION_RELATION___DIRECT_DEF
statement:
!K1 K2 P.
        (IS_WELL_FORMED_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K1 /\
         IS_WELL_FORMED_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K2) ==>

        (IS_BISIMULATION_RELATION K1 K2 P =
          ((K1.P = K2.P) /\
          (!s1 s2. P s1 s2 ==> (s1 IN K1.S /\ s2 IN K2.S)) /\
          (!s1 s2. P s1 s2 ==> (K1.L s1 = K2.L s2)) /\
          (!s1 s1' s2. (P s1 s2 /\ (s1, s1') IN K1.R) ==>
                  ?s2'. (P s1' s2' /\ (s2, s2') IN K2.R)) /\
          (!s2 s2' s1. (P s1 s2 /\ (s2, s2') IN K2.R) ==>
                  ?s1'. (P s1' s2'/\ (s1, s1') IN K1.R)) /\
          (!s1. s1 IN K1.S0 ==> ?s2. s2 IN K2.S0 /\ P s1 s2) /\
          (!s2. s2 IN K2.S0 ==> ?s1. s1 IN K1.S0 /\ P s1 s2)))

name: P_NEGATE_VARS_SEM
statement: !p s. (P_SEM s (P_NEGATE_VARS p)) = (P_SEM (UNIV DIFF s) p)

name: P_SEM_THM
statement:
!s b1 b2 c b p.
    (P_SEM s (P_TRUE)) /\ ~(P_SEM s (P_FALSE)) /\
    (P_SEM s (P_PROP p) = p IN s) /\
    (P_SEM s (P_NOT b) = ~(P_SEM s b)) /\
    (P_SEM s (P_AND(b1,b2)) = (P_SEM s b1 /\ P_SEM s b2)) /\
    (P_SEM s (P_OR(b1,b2)) = (P_SEM s b1 \/ P_SEM s b2)) /\
    (P_SEM s (P_IMPL(b1,b2)) = (P_SEM s b1 ==> P_SEM s b2)) /\
    (P_SEM s (P_COND(c, b1,b2)) =
     (P_SEM s c /\ P_SEM s b1) \/ (~P_SEM s c /\ P_SEM s b2)) /\
    (P_SEM s (P_EQUIV(b1,b2)) = (P_SEM s b1 = P_SEM s b2))

name: P_USED_VARS_INTER_SUBSET_THM
statement: !s p S. (P_USED_VARS p) SUBSET S ==> (P_SEM s p = P_SEM (s INTER S) p)

name: P_VAR_RENAMING_EVAL
statement:
!p f b b1 b2.
    (P_VAR_RENAMING f (P_TRUE) = P_TRUE) /\
    (P_VAR_RENAMING f (P_FALSE) = P_FALSE) /\
    (P_VAR_RENAMING f (P_PROP p) = (P_PROP (f p))) /\
    (P_VAR_RENAMING f (P_NOT b) = P_NOT(P_VAR_RENAMING f b)) /\
    (P_VAR_RENAMING f (P_AND(b1, b2)) =
     P_AND(P_VAR_RENAMING f b1, P_VAR_RENAMING f b2)) /\
    (P_VAR_RENAMING f (P_OR(b1, b2)) =
     P_OR(P_VAR_RENAMING f b1, P_VAR_RENAMING f b2)) /\
    (P_VAR_RENAMING f (P_IMPL(b1, b2)) =
     P_IMPL(P_VAR_RENAMING f b1, P_VAR_RENAMING f b2)) /\
    (P_VAR_RENAMING f (P_EQUIV(b1, b2)) =
     P_EQUIV(P_VAR_RENAMING f b1, P_VAR_RENAMING f  b2))

name: IS_POSITIVE_NEGATIVE_PROP_FORMULA_SUBSET_SEM
statement:
!p V V' S.
    (IS_POSITIVE_PROP_FORMULA_SUBSET V p /\ P_SEM S p /\ V' SUBSET V ==>
     P_SEM (S UNION V') p) /\
    (IS_NEGATIVE_PROP_FORMULA_SUBSET V p /\ P_SEM (S UNION V') p /\
     V' SUBSET V ==>
     P_SEM S p)

name: P_PROP_DISJUNCTION_MIN_SEM
statement: !S1:'a set S2. P_SEM_MIN S1 (P_PROP_DISJUNCTION S2) = EXISTS (\s. S1 = {s}) S2

name: P_SEM_MIN_MODEL_EXISTS_FINITE
statement:
!n p S. FINITE S /\ CARD S < n ==> P_SEM S p ==>
          ?S'. S' SUBSET S /\ P_SEM_MIN S' p

name: VAR_RENAMING_HASHTABLE_LIST___P_USED_VARS
statement:
!l S f. P_USED_VARS (VAR_RENAMING_HASHTABLE_LIST l S f) =
          LIST_TO_SET l UNION IMAGE (\x. f (x UNION S)) (POW (LIST_TO_SET l))

name: P_EXISTS_def
statement:
(P_EXISTS [] p = p) /\
  (P_EXISTS (v::l) p =
   P_EXISTS l (P_OR(P_ASSIGN_TRUE {v} p, P_ASSIGN_FALSE {v} p)))

name: VAR_RENAMING_HASHTABLE_def
statement:
VAR_RENAMING_HASHTABLE S f =
  P_BIGOR (SET_TO_LIST
           (IMAGE (\s. P_AND(P_PROP_SET_MODEL s S, P_PROP(f s))) (POW S)))

name: P_VAR_RENAMING_def
statement:
(P_VAR_RENAMING (f:'a->'b) (P_TRUE) = P_TRUE) /\
  (P_VAR_RENAMING f (P_PROP p) = P_PROP (f p)) /\
  (P_VAR_RENAMING f (P_NOT b) = P_NOT (P_VAR_RENAMING f b)) /\
  (P_VAR_RENAMING f (P_AND(b1,b2)) =
   P_AND(P_VAR_RENAMING f b1, P_VAR_RENAMING f b2))

name: IS_FAIR_PATH_THROUGH_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE___ALTERNATIVE_DEF
statement:
!K FC p.
       IS_FAIR_PATH_THROUGH_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K FC p =
        (IS_PATH_THROUGH_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K p /\
         !b. MEM b FC ==> !t0. ?t. P_SEM (p (t0 + t + 1)) b)

name: IS_FAIR_PATH_THROUGH_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE___EMPTY_FAIRNESS
statement:
!K p. (IS_FAIR_PATH_THROUGH_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K [] p =
           IS_PATH_THROUGH_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K p) /\
          (IS_FAIR_INITIAL_PATH_THROUGH_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K [] p =
           IS_INITIAL_PATH_THROUGH_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K p)

name: IS_EMPTY_FAIR_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE___IDENTIFY_VARIABLES
statement:
!f K fc.
       IS_EMPTY_FAIR_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K fc ==>
       IS_EMPTY_FAIR_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE
        (SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE_VAR_RENAMING f K) (MAP (P_VAR_RENAMING f) fc)

name: IS_EMPTY_FAIR_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE___VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!f K fc. INJ f
      (SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE_USED_VARS K UNION
       LIST_BIGUNION (MAP P_USED_VARS fc)) UNIV ==>
      (IS_EMPTY_FAIR_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE K fc =
       IS_EMPTY_FAIR_SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE
         (SYMBOLIC_KRIPKE_STRUCTURE_VAR_RENAMING f K) (MAP (P_VAR_RENAMING f) fc))

name: SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_VARS___DIRECT_DEF
statement: !A. SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_VARS A = P_USED_VARS A.S0 UNION XP_USED_VARS A.R UNION A.S

name: SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING_REWRITES
statement:
!A f. ((SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING f A).S = IMAGE f A.S) /\
          ((SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING f A).S0 = P_VAR_RENAMING f A.S0) /\
          ((SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING f A).R = XP_VAR_RENAMING f A.R)

name: IS_TOTAL_DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON_THM
statement:
!A. IS_TOTAL_DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A =
       (!i. ?!s. ((s SUBSET A.S) /\ (P_SEM (INPUT_RUN_STATE_UNION A i s) A.S0))) /\
       (!s1 i1 i2. ?!s2. ((s2 SUBSET A.S) /\ IS_TRANSITION A s1 i1 s2 i2))

name: IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SIMPLE_SEMI_AUTOMATON_THM
statement:
!A. IS_SIMPLE_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A ==>
        !i w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A i w =
              IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SIMPLE_SEMI_AUTOMATON A i w

name: PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON_THM
statement:
!A B C. (PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A B = C) <=> (C.S  = (A.S UNION B.S)) /\
                                                 (C.S0 = (P_AND(A.S0, B.S0))) /\
                                                 (C.R  = (XP_AND(A.R, B.R)))

name: PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON_REWRITES
statement:
!A B. ((PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A B).S  = (A.S UNION B.S)) /\
          ((PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A B).S0 = (P_AND(A.S0,B.S0))) /\
          ((PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A B).R  = (XP_AND(A.R, B.R)))

name: ID_SEMI_AUTOMATON_RUN
statement: !i w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON ID_SEMI_AUTOMATON i w <=> (w = EMPTY_PATH)

name: ID_SEMI_AUTOMATON_REWRITES
statement:
(ID_SEMI_AUTOMATON.S  = EMPTY) /\
    (ID_SEMI_AUTOMATON.S0 = P_TRUE) /\
    (ID_SEMI_AUTOMATON.R  = XP_TRUE)

name: SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON___REWRITE
statement: !A. symbolic_semi_automaton A.S A.S0 A.R = A

name: FINITE___SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS
statement: !A. FINITE (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A)

name: SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING___USED_VARS
statement:
!A f. SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_VARS (SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING f A) =
          IMAGE f (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_VARS A)

name: SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING___USED_INPUT_VARS
statement:
!A f. INJ f (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_VARS A) UNIV ==>
         (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS (SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING f A) =
         (IMAGE f (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A)))

name: TOTAL_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON_TRANS_FUNC
statement:
!A. IS_TOTAL_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A ==>
        ?R_FUNC. !s1 s2 i1 i2. (R_FUNC s1 i1 i2 = s2) ==>
                               s2 SUBSET A.S /\ IS_TRANSITION A s1 i1 s2 i2

name: DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON_TRANS_FUNC
statement:
!A. IS_DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A ==>
        ?R_FUNC. !s1 s2 i1 i2. s2 SUBSET A.S /\ IS_TRANSITION A s1 i1 s2 i2 ==>
                               (R_FUNC s1 i1 i2 = s2)

name: TOTAL_DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON_TRANS_FUNC
statement:
!A. IS_TOTAL_DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A ==>
        ?R_FUNC. !s1 s2 i1 i2. s2 SUBSET A.S /\ IS_TRANSITION A s1 i1 s2 i2 <=>
                               (R_FUNC s1 i1 i2 = s2)

name: DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON_EXISTS_AT_MOST_ONE_RUN
statement:
!A i. IS_DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A ==>
          EXISTS_AT_MOST_ONE w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A i w

name: TOTAL_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON_EXISTS_RUN
statement:
!A i. IS_TOTAL_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A ==>
          ?w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A i w

name: TOTAL_DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON_UNIQUE_RUN
statement:
!A i. IS_TOTAL_DET_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A ==>
          ?!w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A i w

name: PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON_COMM_RUN
statement:
!A B v w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A B) v w =
              IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON B A) v w

name: PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON_RUN
statement:
!A1 A2. DISJOINT A1.S A2.S /\
            DISJOINT A1.S (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A2) /\
            DISJOINT A2.S (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A1) ==>
           !i w1 w2. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A1 i w1 /\
                     IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A2 i w2 ==>
                     IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON
                       (PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A1 A2) i (PATH_UNION w1 w2)

name: PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON_RUN2___FIRST
statement:
!A1 A2. DISJOINT A1.S A2.S /\
            DISJOINT A2.S (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A1) ==>
           !i w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A1 A2) i w ==>
                 IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A1 i (PATH_RESTRICT w A1.S)

name: PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON_RUN2___SECOND
statement:
!A1 A2. DISJOINT A1.S A2.S /\
            DISJOINT A1.S (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A2) ==>
           !i w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (PRODUCT_SEMI_AUTOMATON A1 A2) i w ==>
                 IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A2 i (PATH_RESTRICT w A2.S)

name: SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS_INTER_SUBSET_THM
statement:
!A S. (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A) SUBSET S ==>
          !i w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A i w =
                IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A (PATH_RESTRICT i S) w

name: SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS_INTER_THM
statement:
!A i w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A i w =
            IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A
              (PATH_RESTRICT i (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A)) w

name: IS_SIMPLIFIED_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON___RUN_INPUT_VARS
statement:
!A A' f w i. IS_SIMPLIFIED_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A A' f /\
                 IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A i w ==>
       !i'. i' IN SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A' ==> !n. i' IN i n <=> f i' IN w n

name: IS_SIMPLIFIED_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON___RUNS
statement:
!A A' f. IS_SIMPLIFIED_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A A' f ==>
             IS_SIMPLE_SYMBOLIC_SEMI_AUTOMATON A /\
             !w i. PATH_SUBSET w A'.S ==>
                  (IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A i
                    (\n. w n UNION
                         IMAGE f (i n INTER SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A')) =
                   IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A' i w)

name: INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION___SPLIT
statement: !A p. INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION A p (PATH_RESTRICT p A.S) = p

name: INPUT_RUN_STATE_UNION___SPLIT
statement: !A s. INPUT_RUN_STATE_UNION A s (s INTER A.S) = s

name: IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON___SPLIT
statement:
!S S0 R i w.
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0 R) i w <=>
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0 XP_TRUE) i w /\
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S P_TRUE R) i w

name: IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON___R_AND_SPLIT
statement:
!S S0 R1 R2 i w.
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0 (XP_AND(R1, R2))) i w <=>
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0 R1) i w /\
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0 R2) i w

name: IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON___R_AND_SPLIT_MINIMAL
statement:
!S S0 R1 R2 i w.
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0 (XP_AND(R1, R2))) i w <=>
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0 XP_TRUE) i w /\
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S P_TRUE R1) i w /\
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S P_TRUE R2) i w

name: IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON___S0_AND_SPLIT
statement:
!S S0_1 S0_2 R i w.
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S (P_AND(S0_1, S0_2)) R) i w
       <=>
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0_1 R) i w /\
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0_2 R) i w

name: IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON___S0_AND_SPLIT_MINIMAL
statement:
!S S0_1 S0_2 R i w.
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S (P_AND(S0_1, S0_2)) R) i w
       <=>
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S P_TRUE R) i w /\
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0_1 XP_TRUE) i w /\
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S S0_2 XP_TRUE) i w

name: IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON___S_EXTENSION
statement:
!S1 S2 S' S0 R i w.
       (S2 = S1 UNION S') /\ DISJOINT S' (P_USED_VARS S0 UNION XP_USED_VARS R) /\
        PATH_SUBSET w S2 ==>
       (IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S2 S0 R) i w <=>
        IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (symbolic_semi_automaton S1 S0 R) i
          (PATH_RESTRICT w S1))

name: SEMI_AUTOMATON___VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!A v f w. INJ f ((PATH_USED_VARS v) UNION (PATH_USED_VARS w) UNION (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_VARS A))
                    UNIV ==>
      (IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A v w =
       IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON
         (SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING f A) (PATH_VAR_RENAMING f v) (PATH_VAR_RENAMING f w))

name: SEMI_AUTOMATON___STATE_VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!A f. (INJ f UNIV UNIV) /\ (!x. x IN (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A) ==> (f x = x)) ==>
          !i w. IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON A i w =
                IS_SYMBOLIC_RUN_THROUGH_SEMI_AUTOMATON (SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING f A)
                  i (PATH_VAR_RENAMING f w)

name: P_SEM_AUTOMATON_RUN___STATE_VAR_RENAMING
statement:
!A p f. INJ f UNIV UNIV /\
            (!x. x IN (SEMI_AUTOMATON_USED_INPUT_VARS A UNION (P_USED_VARS p DIFF A.S)) ==> (f x = x)) ==>
      !i w t. (P_SEM (INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION A i w t) p =
               P_SEM (INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION (SEMI_AUTOMATON_VAR_RENAMING f A) i
                                           (PATH_VAR_RENAMING f w) t)
                     (P_VAR_RENAMING f p))

name: TRANSITION_CURRENT_STATE_CLEANING
statement:
!A s1 i1 s2 i2. IS_TRANSITION A s1 i1 s2 i2 =
                    IS_TRANSITION A (s1 INTER A.S) (i1 UNION s1) s2 i2

name: TRANSITION_NEXT_STATE_CLEANING
statement:
!A s1 i1 s2 i2. IS_TRANSITION A s1 i1 s2 i2 =
                    IS_TRANSITION A s1 i1 (s2 INTER A.S) (i2 UNION s2)

name: TRANSITION_STATE_CLEANING
statement:
!A s1 i1 s2 i2. IS_TRANSITION A s1 i1 s2 i2 =
                    IS_TRANSITION A (s1 INTER A.S) (i1 UNION s1) (s2 INTER A.S) (i2 UNION s2)

name: PROP_LOGIC_EQUIVALENT_REFL
statement: !x. PROP_LOGIC_EQUIVALENT x x
