name: PROP_LOGIC_EQUIVALENT_TRANS
statement:
!x y z. PROP_LOGIC_EQUIVALENT x y /\ PROP_LOGIC_EQUIVALENT y z ==>
            PROP_LOGIC_EQUIVALENT x z

name: THE_LTL3
statement: (THE LTL3_T = T) /\ (THE LTL3_F = F)

name: LTL3_nchotomy
statement: !a. (a = LTL3_T) \/ (a = LTL3_F) \/ (a = LTL3_U)

name: LTL3_distinct
statement: LTL3_T <> LTL3_F /\ LTL3_T <> LTL3_U /\ LTL3_F <> LTL3_U

name: LTL3_NOT_U
statement: !x. x <> LTL3_U <=> (x = LTL3_T) \/ (x = LTL3_F)

name: concat_assoc
statement: !(u :'a list) (v :'a list) (w :num -> 'a). (u ++ v) ++ w = u ++ (v ++ w)

name: concat_finite
statement: !i u w. i < LENGTH u ==> (u ++ w) i = EL i u

name: LTL3_SEM_TIME_T
statement: !t u f. (LTL3_SEM_TIME t u f = LTL3_T) <=> !v. LTL_SEM_TIME t (u ++ v) f

name: LTL3_SEM_TIME_F
statement: !t u f. (LTL3_SEM_TIME t u f = LTL3_F) <=> !v. ~LTL_SEM_TIME t (u ++ v) f

name: LTL3_SEM_DEF
statement:
!u f. LTL3_SEM u f = if (!v.  LTL_SEM (u ++ v) f) then LTL3_T
                    else if (!v. ~LTL_SEM (u ++ v) f) then LTL3_F
                    else LTL3_U

name: LTL3_SEM_TIME_MONO_T
statement:
!t u f. (LTL3_SEM_TIME t u f = LTL3_T) ==>
            !v. (LTL3_SEM_TIME t (u ++ v) f = LTL3_T)

name: LTL3_SEM_TIME_MONO_F
statement:
!t u f. (LTL3_SEM_TIME t u f = LTL3_F) ==>
            !v. (LTL3_SEM_TIME t (u ++ v) f = LTL3_F)

name: LTL3_SEM_TIME_MONO
statement:
!t u f. (LTL3_SEM_TIME t u f <> LTL3_U) ==>
        !v. (LTL3_SEM_TIME t (u ++ v) f = LTL3_SEM_TIME t u f)

name: PTLTL_SEM_THM
statement:
!u w w' i. i < LENGTH u ==>
           !f. IS_PAST_LTL f ==>
              (LTL_SEM_TIME i (u ++ w) f = LTL_SEM_TIME i (u ++ w') f)

name: PTLTL_SEM_LTL3_CONCL
statement: !f u i. i < LENGTH u /\ IS_PAST_LTL f ==> IS_CONCL (LTL3_SEM_TIME i u f)

name: PTLTL_SEM_LTL3_AND
statement:
!i u f1 f2. i < LENGTH u /\ IS_PAST_LTL f1 /\ IS_PAST_LTL f2 ==>
               (THE (LTL3_SEM_TIME i u (LTL_AND (f1,f2))) <=>
                THE (LTL3_SEM_TIME i u f1) /\ THE (LTL3_SEM_TIME i u f2))

name: PTLTL_SEM_ALT_LTL3
statement:
!f u. IS_PAST_LTL f /\ 0 < LENGTH u ==>
         (PTLTL_SEM_ALT u f = THE (LTL3_SEM_TIME (LENGTH u - 1) u f))

name: concat_def
statement:
concat (u :'a list) (v :num -> 'a) =
     \i. if i < LENGTH u then EL i u else (v (i - LENGTH u))

name: LTL3_SEM_TIME_def
statement:
LTL3_SEM_TIME t (u :'a set list) f =
             if (!w.  LTL_SEM_TIME t (concat u w) f) then LTL3_T
        else if (!w. ~LTL_SEM_TIME t (concat u w) f) then LTL3_F
        else LTL3_U

name: LTL3_SEM_def
statement: LTL3_SEM u f = LTL3_SEM_TIME 0 u f

name: PTLTL_SEM_def
statement:
(PTLTL_SEM u (LTL_PROP p)        = (P_SEM (LAST u) p)) /\
   (PTLTL_SEM u (LTL_NOT f)         = ~PTLTL_SEM u f) /\
   (PTLTL_SEM u (LTL_AND (f1,f2))   = (PTLTL_SEM u f1 /\ PTLTL_SEM u f2)) /\
   (PTLTL_SEM u (LTL_PREV f)        =
     if (1 < LENGTH u) then PTLTL_SEM (BUTLASTN 1 u) f
                       else PTLTL_SEM u f) /\
   (PTLTL_SEM u (LTL_SINCE (f1,f2)) =
     ?k. k < LENGTH u /\ PTLTL_SEM (BUTLASTN k u) f2 /\
         !j. j < k ==> PTLTL_SEM (BUTLASTN j u) f1)

name: PTLTL_SEM_ALT_def
statement:
(PTLTL_SEM_ALT u (LTL_PROP p)        = (P_SEM (LAST u) p)) /\
   (PTLTL_SEM_ALT u (LTL_NOT f)         = ~PTLTL_SEM_ALT u f) /\
   (PTLTL_SEM_ALT u (LTL_AND (f1,f2))   = (PTLTL_SEM_ALT u f1 /\
                                           PTLTL_SEM_ALT u f2)) /\
   (PTLTL_SEM_ALT u (LTL_PREV f)        =
     (1 < LENGTH u /\ PTLTL_SEM_ALT (BUTLASTN 1 u) f)) /\
   (PTLTL_SEM_ALT u (LTL_SINCE (f1,f2)) =
     ?k. k < LENGTH u /\ PTLTL_SEM_ALT (BUTLASTN k u) f2 /\
         (!j. j < k  ==>  PTLTL_SEM_ALT (BUTLASTN j u) f1))

name: IS_CONCL_def
statement: IS_CONCL x = ((x = LTL3_T) \/ (x = LTL3_F))

name: LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___IN_USED_STATE_VARS
statement:
!DS s sv. s IN LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___USED_STATE_VARS DS sv <=>
              ?n. n < DS.SN /\ (s = sv n)

name: LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___USED_STATE_VARS___COUNT
statement:
!DS sv. LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___USED_STATE_VARS DS sv =
            IMAGE sv (count DS.SN)

name: LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___USED_STATE_VARS___FINITE
statement: !DS sv. FINITE (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___USED_STATE_VARS DS sv)

name: LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___FAIR_RUN___PATH_SUBSET
statement:
!DS sv i w. LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___FAIR_RUN DS i w sv ==>
                PATH_SUBSET w (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___USED_STATE_VARS DS sv)

name: LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___MAX_FAIR_RUN_alt
statement:
!DS i w p sv.
    LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___MAX_FAIR_RUN DS i w p sv =
      !w'. LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___FAIR_RUN DS i w' sv ==>
           !t. P_SEM ((INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEMI_AUTOMATON DS sv) i w') t) p ==>
               P_SEM ((INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEMI_AUTOMATON DS sv) i w) t) p

name: LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___BINDING_RUN___REWRITE
statement:
!DS sv i w l pf b1 b2.
        LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___BINDING_RUN DS w (l, b1, b2, pf) i sv <=>
       !wi. (wi = INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEMI_AUTOMATON DS sv) i w) ==>
            (!t. LTL_SEM_TIME t i l = P_SEM (wi t) (pf sv)) /\
             !w' wi'. LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___FAIR_RUN DS i w' sv /\
                     (wi' = INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEMI_AUTOMATON DS sv) i w')
                 ==> (!t. b1 /\ P_SEM (wi' t) (pf sv) ==> P_SEM (wi  t) (pf sv)) /\
                     (!t. b2 /\ P_SEM (wi  t) (pf sv) ==> P_SEM (wi' t) (pf sv))

name: LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEM___MAX
statement:
!DS l pf sv a.
       (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___IS_ELEMENT_ITERATOR DS sv /\
        LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEM DS /\ (l, T, a, pf) IN DS.B) ==>
       !i. LTL_SEM i l = A_SEM i (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___A_NDET DS pf sv)

name: LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEM___MIN
statement:
!DS l pf sv a.
    (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___IS_ELEMENT_ITERATOR DS sv /\
     LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEM DS /\ (l, a, T, pf) IN DS.B) ==>
       !i. LTL_SEM i l = A_SEM i (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___A_UNIV DS pf sv)

name: LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___KS_SEM___MIN
statement:
!DS l pf sv a.
    (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___IS_ELEMENT_ITERATOR DS sv /\
     LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEM DS /\ (l, a, T, pf) IN DS.B) ==>
       !M. LTL_KS_SEM M l = A_KS_SEM M (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___A_UNIV DS pf sv)

name: LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___KS_SEM___MAX
statement:
!DS l pf sv a.
    (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___IS_ELEMENT_ITERATOR DS sv /\
     LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEM DS /\ (l, T, a, pf) IN DS.B) ==>
       !M. LTL_KS_SEM M l = A_KS_SEM M (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___A_NDET DS pf sv)

name: EXTEND_LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___FAIR_RUN
statement:
!DS sv w i DS' w' n' S0' IV' R' FC' B'.

(LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEM DS /\
 LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___IS_ELEMENT_ITERATOR DS' sv /\
(!n b. (MEM (n, b) S0' ==> (n < n' + DS.SN))) /\
(DS' = EXTEND_LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS DS n' S0' IV' R' FC' B') /\
(w' = INPUT_RUN_PATH_UNION (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEMI_AUTOMATON DS' sv) i w)) ==>

(LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___FAIR_RUN DS' i w sv =

PATH_SUBSET w (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___USED_STATE_VARS DS' sv) /\
P_SEM (w 0) (P_BIGAND (MAP (\(n, b). if b then P_PROP (sv n) else P_NOT(P_PROP (sv n))) S0')) /\
(!n xp. MEM xp R' ==> XP_SEM (xp sv) (w' n, w' (SUC n))) /\
(!p. MEM p FC' ==> A_SEM w' (ACCEPT_COND_GF (p sv))) /\
LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___FAIR_RUN DS i (PATH_RESTRICT w
  (LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___USED_STATE_VARS DS sv)) sv)

name: CONSTRUCTION_LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___CASE_SUNTIL
statement:
!b11 b12 b21 b22 a DS DS' l1 l2 pf1 pf2.
        (DS' = EXTEND_LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS DS 1 [] {}
               [\sv. XP_EQUIV(XP_PROP (sv DS.SN), XP_OR(XP_CURRENT (pf2 sv),
                                                        XP_AND(
                                                          XP_CURRENT (pf1 sv),
                                                          XP_NEXT_PROP (sv DS.SN))))]
               (if (b11 /\ b21 /\ a) then [\sv. P_IMPL(P_PROP(sv DS.SN), pf2 sv)] else [])
               {(LTL_SUNTIL(l1, l2), b11 /\ b21 /\ a, b12 /\ b22, \sv. P_PROP(sv DS.SN))}) ==>

        ((LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEM DS /\ (l1, b11, b12, pf1) IN DS.B /\ (l2, b21, b22, pf2) IN DS.B) ==>
        LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEM DS')

name: CONSTRUCTION_LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___CASE_PSUNTIL
statement:
!b11 b12 b21 b22 DS DS' l1 l2 pf1 pf2.
        (DS' = EXTEND_LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS DS 1 [(DS.SN, F)] {}
               [\sv. XP_EQUIV(XP_NEXT_PROP (sv DS.SN), XP_OR(XP_CURRENT (pf2 sv),
                                                        XP_AND(
                                                          XP_CURRENT (pf1 sv),
                                                          XP_PROP (sv DS.SN))))]
               []
               {(LTL_PSUNTIL(l1, l2), b11 /\ b21, b12 /\ b22, \sv. (P_OR(pf2 sv, P_AND(pf1 sv, P_PROP(sv DS.SN)))))}) ==>
        ((LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEM DS /\ (l1, b11, b12, pf1) IN DS.B /\ (l2, b21, b22, pf2) IN DS.B) ==>
        LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI_DS___SEM DS')

name: LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI___EXTEND___THM
statement:
!l b1 b2 DS DS' pf.
       ((pf, DS') = LTL_TO_GEN_BUECHI___EXTEND l b1 b2 DS) ==>

    ((aU1 q * p) (arm2set' (rs,ms,st,cp,ud) s) ⇔
      (q = ARM_READ_UNDEF s) /\ ud /\ p (arm2set' (rs,ms,st,cp,F) s)) /\
    ((cond g * p) (arm2set' (rs,ms,st,cp,ud) s) ⇔
      g /\ p (arm2set' (rs,ms,st,cp,ud) s))

name: ARM_OK_def
statement:
ARM_OK state <=>
    (ARM_ARCH state = ARMv6) /\ (ARM_EXTENSIONS state = {}) /\
    (ARM_UNALIGNED_SUPPORT state) /\ (ARM_READ_EVENT_REGISTER state) /\
    ~(ARM_READ_INTERRUPT_WAIT state) /\ ~(ARM_READ_SCTLR sctlrV state) /\
    (ARM_READ_SCTLR sctlrA state) /\ ~(ARM_READ_SCTLR sctlrU state) /\
    (ARM_READ_IT state = 0w) /\ ~(ARM_READ_STATUS psrJ state) /\
    ~(ARM_READ_STATUS psrT state) /\ ~(ARM_READ_STATUS psrE state) /\
    (ARM_MODE state = 16w)

name: set_add_def
statement: set_add a x (b,s) <=> (b - (a:'a word), s) IN x

name: mc_full_cmp_eq
statement:
((mc_header (s,xs) = 0x0w) <=> (xs = [])) /\ mw_ok xs /\
    ((mc_header (t,ys) = 0x0w) <=> (ys = [])) /\ mw_ok ys /\
    LENGTH (xs:'a word list) < dimword (:'a) DIV 2 /\
    LENGTH ys < dimword (:'a) DIV 2 /\
    LENGTH xs + LENGTH ys < LENGTH zs /\ LENGTH zs < dimword (:'a) DIV 2 /\
    LENGTH xs + 1 <= l ==>
    ?zs1 l2.
      mc_full_cmp_pre (l,3w,mc_header (s,xs),mc_header (t,ys),xs,ys,zs) /\
      (mc_full_cmp (l,3w,mc_header (s,xs),mc_header (t,ys),xs,ys,zs) =
       (l2,mc_header (mwi_op Eq (s,xs) (t,ys)),xs,ys,
        SND (mwi_op Eq (s,xs) (t,ys)) ++ zs1)) /\
      (LENGTH (SND (mwi_op Eq (s,xs) (t,ys)) ++ zs1) = LENGTH zs) /\
      l <= l2 + LENGTH xs + 1

name: d_lemma4
statement:
!(v1:'a word) (d:'a word).
    ?n. w2n (calc_d (FST(v1,d),1w)) = 2 ** n

name: mw_div_range2
statement:
! (u1:'a word) u2 us (v1:'a word) vs.
    (LENGTH us = LENGTH vs) /\
    mw2n (REVERSE (u1::u2::us)) DIV mw2n (REVERSE (v1::vs))
    < dimword(:'a) /\
    dimword(:'a) DIV 2 <= w2n v1 ==>
    MIN ((w2n u1 * dimword(:'a) + w2n u2) DIV w2n v1) (dimword(:'a)-1)
    <= mw2n (REVERSE (u1::u2::us)) DIV mw2n (REVERSE (v1::vs)) + 2
Proof[exclude_simps = DIV_0 MOD_0]

    REPEAT GEN_TAC >>
    Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`V = mw2n (REVERSE (v1::vs))` >>
    Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`U = mw2n (REVERSE (u1::u2::us))`>>
    Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`q = U DIV V` >>
    Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`q' = MIN ((w2n u1 * dimword(:'a) + w2n u2) DIV w2n v1) (dimword(:'a) - 1)` >>
    Cases_on `V <= U`
    THEN1( (MATCH_MP_TAC o (fn (x,y) => y)) (EQ_IMP_RULE MONO_NOT_EQ) >>
           strip_tac >>
           qpat_x_assum `~x` (ASSUME_TAC o (fn x => (MP ((fn (x,y)=>x) (EQ_IMP_RULE (Q.SPECL [`q'`,`q+2`] NOT_LESS_EQUAL)))  x))) >>
           Cases_on `LENGTH us = LENGTH vs`
           THEN1( Cases_on `q < dimword(:'a)`
                  THEN1( srw_tac[][] >> REWRITE_TAC [NOT_LESS_EQUAL] >>
                         `3 <= q' - q` by METIS_TAC[SUB_LEFT_LESS,ADD_COMM,LESS_EQ,DECIDE ``3 = SUC 2``] >>
                         Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`b = dimword(:'a)` >> REWRITE_TAC[HD] >>
                         Cases_on `0 < w2n v1`
                         THEN1( Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`a = w2n v1` >>
                                `0 < b ** LENGTH vs` by METIS_TAC[Abbr`b`,ZERO_LT_dimword,ZERO_LT_EXP] >>
                                `0 < V` by (lrw[Abbr`V`,Abbr`a`,mw2n_msf,dimwords_dimword] >> METIS_TAC[ADD_COMM,MULT_COMM,LESS_EQ_ADD,LE_MULT_CANCEL_LBARE,LESS_EQ_TRANS,LESS_LESS_EQ_TRANS]) >>
                                `b ** (LENGTH vs ) <= V` by (lrw[Abbr`V`,mw2n_msf,LENGTH_REVERSE,dimwords_dimword] >> METIS_TAC[LE_MULT_CANCEL_LBARE,LESS_EQ_ADD,ADD_COMM,LESS_EQ_TRANS]) >>
                                Cases_on `V = b ** (LENGTH vs)`
                                THEN1( `V = mw2n ((REVERSE vs)++[v1])` by full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[] >>
                                       qpat_x_assum `V = mw2n xxx` (fn x => (ASSUME_TAC (RW[mw2n_msf,LENGTH_REVERSE,dimwords_dimword] x))) >>
                                       `b ** LENGTH vs * w2n v1 <= V` by METIS_TAC[ADD_COMM,LESS_EQ_ADD] >>
                                       `0 < b ** LENGTH vs` by METIS_TAC[ZERO_LT_EXP,Abbr`b`,ZERO_LT_dimword] >>
                                       `a <= 1` by METIS_TAC[Abbr`a`,LE_MULT_CANCEL_RBARE,NOT_ZERO_LT_ZERO] >>
                                       `a = 1` by DECIDE_TAC  >>
                                       `U = mw2n (REVERSE us) + V*(w2n u2) + V*b*(w2n u1)` by full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[MULT_COMM,Abbr`b`,Abbr`U`,LENGTH_REVERSE,mw2n_msf,dimwords_dimword,GSYM ADD1,EXP,ENC] >>
                                       qpat_x_assum `U = xxx` (fn x => ASSUME_TAC(RW[GSYM MULT_ASSOC,GSYM ADD_ASSOC,GSYM LEFT_ADD_DISTRIB] x)) >>
                                       `mw2n (REVERSE us) < V` by METIS_TAC[mw2n_lt,dimwords_dimword,Abbr`b`,LENGTH_REVERSE] >>
                                       `q = w2n u1 * b + w2n u2` by METIS_TAC[RIGHT_ADD_DISTRIB,DIV_MULT,ADD_COMM,MULT_COMM] >>
                                       `q' = MIN (b-1) q` by full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[MIN_COMM,ENC] >>
                                       `~(b - 1 < q)` by DECIDE_TAC >>
                                       `q' = q` by full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[MIN_DEF] >>
                                       RW_TAC arith_ss [] ) >>
                                `b ** (LENGTH vs) < V` by DECIDE_TAC >>
                                qpat_x_assum `xxx <> yyy` (fn x => ALL_TAC) >>
                                `2 * V * (V - b ** (LENGTH vs)) <= U * b ** (LENGTH vs)` by( Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`l = b ** LENGTH vs` >>
                                       `l < V` by METIS_TAC[LE_MULT_CANCEL_LBARE,LESS_EQ_LESS_TRANS] >>
                                       Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`X= V - l` >> `0 < X` by METIS_TAC[SUB_LESS_0] >>
                                       `0 < l` by METIS_TAC[ZERO_LT_dimword,ZERO_LT_EXP] >>
                                       `0 < q*V` by METIS_TAC[DIV_GT0,ZERO_LESS_MULT] >>
                                       `U - V < q * V + V - V` by METIS_TAC[DIV_thm4,DIV_thm3,LESS_MONO_ADD,SUB_ADD,ADD_COMM,LT_SUB_RCANCEL,ADD_0] >>
                                       qpat_x_assum `U - V < xxx` (fn x => `U-V < q*V` by METIS_TAC[x,ADD_SUB]) >>
                                       `q' <= (w2n u1 * b + w2n u2) DIV a` by lrw[Abbr`a`,Abbr`q'`] >>
                                       `q' * (a * l) <= (w2n u1 * b + w2n u2) * l` by METIS_TAC[MULT_ASSOC,Abbr`a`,DIV_thm3,LESS_EQ_TRANS,LESS_MONO_MULT,Abbr`q'`] >>
                                       `U = (w2n u1 * b + w2n u2) * l + mw2n (REVERSE us)` by lrw[Abbr`U`,Abbr`b`,Abbr`l`,mw2n_msf,dimwords_dimword,EXP,GSYM ADD1] >>
                                       `q' * (a * l) <= U` by METIS_TAC[Abbr`a`,LESS_EQ_ADD,LESS_EQ_TRANS,Abbr`q'`] >>
                                       Cases_on `U = 0` THEN1 gvs[ENC] >>
                                       `q' * X < U` by( Cases_on `0 < q'`
                                              THEN1( `V = a * l + mw2n(REVERSE vs)` by lrw[Abbr`V`,Abbr`l`,Abbr`a`,mw2n_msf,dimwords_dimword] >>
                                                     `V < a * l + l` by (full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[Abbr`l`,Abbr`b`,Abbr`a`] >> METIS_TAC[mw2n_lt,LENGTH_REVERSE,dimwords_dimword]) >>
                                                     `0 < a * l` by METIS_TAC[ZERO_LT_EXP,ZERO_LT_dimword, Abbr`a`,ZERO_LESS_MULT] >>
                                                     `X < a * l` by full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[Abbr`X`,ADD_SUB,LT_SUB_RCANCEL,LT_ADDL,ADD_COMM] >>
                                                     METIS_TAC[LT_MULT_RCANCEL,MULT_COMM,LESS_LESS_EQ_TRANS]) >>
                                              DECIDE_TAC) >>
                                       qpat_x_assum `q' <= xxx` (fn x => ALL_TAC)>>
                                       REPEAT (qpat_x_assum `q' * (a * l) <= xxx` (fn x => ALL_TAC)) >>
                                       `3 * (X * V) <= q' * (X * V) - q * (X * V) /\
                                       (q' * (X * V) < U * V) /\
                                       ((U - V) * X < q * (V * X))`
                                       by METIS_TAC[LESS_MONO_MULT,RIGHT_SUB_DISTRIB,LT_MULT_RCANCEL,MULT_ASSOC] >>
                                       `3 * (X * V) <= U * V - (U-V)*X` by DECIDE_TAC >>
                                       markerLib.UNABBREV_TAC "X" >>
                                       `3 * ((V-l)*V) <= U*V - ((U-V)*V - (U-V)*l)` by METIS_TAC[LEFT_SUB_DISTRIB] >>
                                       `(U-V)*l <= (U-V)*V` by METIS_TAC[LESS_IMP_LESS_OR_EQ,LE_MULT_LCANCEL] >>
                                       `3 * ((V-l)*V) <= U*V + (U-V)*l - (U-V)*V` by METIS_TAC[SUB_SUB] >>
                                       `3 * ((V-l)*V) <= U*V + (U*l - V*l) - (U*V - V*V)` by METIS_TAC[RIGHT_SUB_DISTRIB]>>
                                       `3 * ((V-l)*V) <= U*V + (U*l - V*l) + V*V - U*V`by METIS_TAC[LE_MULT_RCANCEL,SUB_SUB] >>
                                       `3 * ((V-l)*V) <= U*l - V*l + V*V` by METIS_TAC[ADD_ASSOC,PROVE [ADD_COMM,ADD_ASSOC,ADD_SUB] ``a+b-a=b``]>>
                                       `V*l <= U*l` by METIS_TAC[LESS_MONO_MULT] >>
                                       `3*((V-l)*V) <= (V*V + U*l) - V*l` by METIS_TAC[ADD_COMM,LESS_MONO_MULT,LESS_EQ_ADD_SUB] >>
                                       `3*((V-l)*V) <= U*l + V*(V-l)` by METIS_TAC[ADD_COMM,LEFT_SUB_DISTRIB,LESS_EQ_ADD_SUB,SUB_LESS_0,LESS_IMP_LESS_OR_EQ,LE_MULT_LCANCEL] >>
                                       qpat_x_assum `xxx <= yyy + V*(V-l)` (fn x =>
                                                   ASSUME_TAC (RW[DECIDE ``3 = 2 + 1``,RIGHT_ADD_DISTRIB,MULT_LEFT_1] x)) >>
                                       `(V-l)*V <= V*V` by METIS_TAC[SUB_LESS_EQ,LESS_MONO_MULT] >>
                                       REPEAT (qpat_x_assum `3*xxx <= yyy` (fn x => ALL_TAC)) >>
                                       METIS_TAC[MULT_COMM,MULT_ASSOC,LESS_EQ_MONO_ADD_EQ]) >>
                               `V = (a-1+1) * b ** LENGTH vs + mw2n(REVERSE vs)` by lrw[Abbr`V`,Abbr`a`,mw2n_msf,dimwords_dimword] >>
                               qpat_x_assum `V = xxx` (fn x => (ASSUME_TAC (RW[RIGHT_ADD_DISTRIB,MULT_LEFT_1,Once (DECIDE ``a + b + c = a + c + b``)] x))) >>
                               `(a - 1) * b ** (LENGTH vs) <= V - b ** (LENGTH vs)`  by METIS_TAC[ADD_SUB,LESS_EQ_ADD] >>
                               `2 * V * ((a-1) * b ** LENGTH vs) <= 2 * V * (V - b ** LENGTH vs)` by full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[] >>
                               `2 * V * ((a-1) * b ** LENGTH vs) <= U * b ** LENGTH vs` by METIS_TAC[LESS_EQ_TRANS] >>
                               qpat_x_assum `xxx <= U * b ** LENGTH vs` (fn x => ASSUME_TAC (RW[MULT_ASSOC] x)) >>
                               `b ** LENGTH vs <> 0` by METIS_TAC[ZERO_LT_EXP,Abbr`b`,ZERO_LT_dimword,NOT_ZERO_LT_ZERO] >>
                               `2 * V * (a-1) <= U` by METIS_TAC[LE_MULT_RCANCEL] >>
                               qpat_x_assum `2 * V * xxx <= U` (fn x => (ASSUME_TAC (RW[Once (DECIDE ``a * b * c = a * c * b``)] x))) >>
                               `2 * (a-1) <= q` by METIS_TAC[Abbr`q`,DIV_LE_MONOTONE,MULT_DIV] >>
                               `q + 3 <= q'` by METIS_TAC [LESS_EQ, EVAL ``SUC 2``,ADD,ADD_COMM] >>
                               `q <= (q' - 3)` by METIS_TAC[LE_SUB_RCANCEL,ADD_SUB,ADD_COMM,LESS_EQ_ADD] >>
                               qpat_x_assum ` q + 3 <= q'` (fn x => ALL_TAC) >>
                               `!xx yy.MIN xx yy <= yy` by srw_tac[][] >>
                               `q' <= b - 1` by METIS_TAC[] >> qpat_x_assum `!xx yy. zzz` (fn x => ALL_TAC) >>
                               `2 <= b - 2` by METIS_TAC[SUB_LESS_EQ,LESS_EQ_TRANS,LE_SUB_RCANCEL,DECIDE ``(3-1 = 2)/\(b - 1 - 1 = b - 2)``]  >>
                               `2 <= 2 * a` by METIS_TAC[LE_MULT_CANCEL_LBARE,Abbr`a`] >>
                               `q' - 3 <= b - 4` by  METIS_TAC[LE_SUB_RCANCEL,SUB_LESS_EQ,LESS_EQ_TRANS,DECIDE ``x - 1 - 3 = x - 4``] >>
                               `2 * a <= b - 2` by RW_TAC arith_ss [] >>
                               qpat_x_assum `2*a <= xxx` (fn x => `a <= (b - 2) DIV 2` by METIS_TAC [DIV_LE_MONOTONE, DECIDE ``0<2``, MULT_COMM,MULT_DIV,x]) >>
                               `2 <= b` by METIS_TAC[SUB_LESS_EQ, LESS_EQ_TRANS] >>
                               `a <= (b DIV 2 - 1)` by METIS_TAC[DECIDE ``0<2``,MULT_RIGHT_1,DIV_SUB] >>
                               RW_TAC arith_ss [Abbr`b`,ZERO_LT_dimword] ) >>
                       `w2n v1 = 0` by DECIDE_TAC >>
                       METIS_TAC[DIV_GT0,DECIDE ``0<2``,ONE_LT_dimword,Abbr`b`,LESS_EQ,TWO]) >>
               DECIDE_TAC)>>
       DECIDE_TAC)>>
  strip_tac >>
  qpat_x_assum `~x` (fn x => ASSUME_TAC(MP ((fn (x,y) => x)(EQ_IMP_RULE (Q.SPECL [`V`,`U`] NOT_LESS_EQUAL))) x)) >>
  `LENGTH ((REVERSE us) ++ [u2]) = SUC(LENGTH us)` by lrw[] >>
  `U = mw2n (REVERSE us) + dimword(:'a) ** LENGTH us * w2n u2 + dimword(:'a) ** (LENGTH(REVERSE us ++ [u2])) * w2n u1` by full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[Abbr`U`,LENGTH_REVERSE,GSYM ADD1,mw2n_msf,dimwords_dimword] >>
  `U = mw2n (REVERSE us) + dimword(:'a) ** LENGTH us * w2n u2 + dimword(:'a) ** (LENGTH us) * dimword(:'a) * w2n u1` by full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[EXP,MULT_COMM] >>
  qpat_x_assum `U = xxx` (fn x => ASSUME_TAC(RW[GSYM MULT_ASSOC,GSYM ADD_ASSOC,GSYM LEFT_ADD_DISTRIB] x)) >>
  `V = mw2n (REVERSE vs) + dimword(:'a) ** LENGTH vs * w2n v1` by full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[mw2n_msf,dimwords_dimword] >>
  `V < dimword(:'a) ** LENGTH vs * SUC (w2n v1)` by METIS_TAC[mw2n_lt,LENGTH_REVERSE,LESS_MONO_ADD,MULT,ADD_COMM,MULT_COMM,dimwords_dimword] >>
  `U < dimword(:'a) ** SUC(LENGTH us)` by METIS_TAC[mw2n_lt,LESS_TRANS,LENGTH_REVERSE,LENGTH,dimwords_dimword]>>
  `w2n u2 + dimword(:'a) * w2n u1 <= w2n v1` by METIS_TAC[ADD_COMM,LESS_EQ_ADD,LESS_EQ_LESS_TRANS,LESS_TRANS,LT_MULT_LCANCEL,DECIDE ``a < SUC b ==> (a <= b)``] >>
  `MIN a b <= a` by lrw[] >>
  `q' <= (w2n u2 +  dimword(:'a)*w2n u1) DIV w2n v1` by full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[ADD_COMM,MULT_COMM,Abbr`q'`]>>
  `0 < w2n v1` by METIS_TAC[DIV_GT0,DECIDE ``0<2``,ONE_LT_dimword,LESS_EQ,TWO,ONE,LESS_EQ_TRANS]  >>
  `(w2n u2 +  dimword(:'a)*w2n u1) DIV w2n v1 <= 1` by (Cases_on `w2n u2 + dimword(:'a)*w2n u1 = w2n v1` THEN1 (RW_TAC arith_ss[]) >>
  `(w2n u2 + dimword(:'a) * w2n u1) < w2n v1` by RW_TAC arith_ss[] >> METIS_TAC[LESS_DIV_EQ_ZERO, DECIDE ``0<=1``]) >>
  lrw[]
QED

val mw_div_test_lemma1 = store_thm( "mw_div_test_lemma1",
``!q u1 u2 u3 v1 v2. w2n (mw_div_test q u1 u2 u3 v1 v2) <= w2n q``,
    HO_MATCH_MP_TAC mw_div_test_ind >> REPEAT strip_tac >>
    srw_tac[][Once mw_div_test_def] >>
    `w2n q2 <= w2n q` by
    METIS_TAC[Abbr`q2`,w2n_n2w,ZERO_LT_dimword,MOD_LESS_EQ,LESS_EQ_TRANS,DECIDE ``x - 1 <=x``] >>
    Cases_on `mw_cmp [u2; u1] (FST (mw_add [FST s; SND s] [0w; 1w] F)) = SOME T`
           >> full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[] >> METIS_TAC[LESS_EQ_TRANS])

val mw_div_test_lemma2 = store_thm( "mw_div_test_lemma2",
``!(us:'a word list) (vs:'a word list).
  !q u1 u2 u3 v1 v2.
   (0 < w2n v1) /\ (LENGTH us = LENGTH vs) /\
   (mw2n (REVERSE (u1::u2::u3::us)) DIV mw2n (REVERSE (v1::v2::vs)) < dimword(:'a)) /\
   (mw2n (REVERSE (u1::u2::u3::us)) DIV mw2n (REVERSE (v1::v2::vs)) <= w2n q) ==>
   (mw2n (REVERSE (u1::u2::u3::us)) DIV mw2n (REVERSE (v1::v2::vs))
    <= w2n (mw_div_test q u1 u2 u3 v1 v2))``,

    GEN_TAC >> GEN_TAC >>
    HO_MATCH_MP_TAC mw_div_test_ind >>
    REPEAT strip_tac >>
    Cases_on `(mw_cmp [u3; u2; u1] (mw_mul_by_single q [v2; v1]) = SOME T)`
    THEN1( Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC `u = u1::u2::u3::us` >>
           Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC` v = v1::v2::vs` >>
           srw_tac[][Once mw_div_test_def] >>
           qsuff_tac `mw2n (REVERSE (u:'a word list)) DIV mw2n (REVERSE (v:'a word list)) <= w2n (n2w (w2n (q:'a word) - 1):'a word)`
           THEN1( strip_tac >>
                  Cases_on `mw_cmp [u2; u1] (FST (mw_add [FST s; SND s] [0w; 1w] F)) = SOME T` >>
                  METIS_TAC[Abbr`q2`]) >>
           qpat_x_assum `!q'. xxx` (K ALL_TAC) >>
           qsuff_tac `w2n u1 * dimword (:'a) * dimword (:'a) + w2n u2 * dimword (:'a) + w2n u3 < w2n q * (w2n v1 * dimword (:'a) + w2n v2)`
           THEN1( strip_tac >>
                  Cases_on `mw2n (REVERSE u) DIV mw2n (REVERSE v) = 0` THEN1 DECIDE_TAC >>
                  `0 < w2n q` by DECIDE_TAC >>
                  `w2n (n2w (w2n (q:'a word) - 1):'a word) = w2n q - 1` by METIS_TAC[w2n_n2w,LESS_MOD,DECIDE ``x - 1 <= x``,LESS_EQ_LESS_TRANS,w2n_lt] >>
                  POP_ASSUM (fn x => REWRITE_TAC[x]) >>
                  markerLib.UNABBREV_TAC "v" >>
                  srw_tac[][mw2n_msf,EXP, GSYM ADD1,dimwords_dimword] >>
                  `0 < w2n v1 * dimword(:'a) + w2n v2`
                   by METIS_TAC[ZERO_LT_dimword,LE_MULT_CANCEL_LBARE,LESS_EQ_ADD,LESS_EQ_TRANS,LESS_LESS_EQ_TRANS] >>
                   `0 < dimword(:'a) ** (LENGTH vs)` by  METIS_TAC[ZERO_LT_dimword,ZERO_LT_EXP]  >>
                   Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC `U = mw2n (REVERSE u)` >>
                   qsuff_tac `U DIV ((w2n v1 * dimword(:'a) + w2n v2) * dimword(:'a)**(LENGTH vs)) <= w2n q - 1`
                   THEN1( Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`X = (w2n v1 * dimword(:'a) + w2n v2) * dimword(:'a) ** (LENGTH vs)` >>
                          Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`V = mw2n (REVERSE vs) + dimword (:'a) ** LENGTH vs * w2n v2 + dimword (:'a) * dimword (:'a) ** LENGTH vs * w2n v1` >>
                          strip_tac >>
                          `0 < X` by METIS_TAC[Abbr `X`,ZERO_LESS_MULT]>>
                          `X <= V` by METIS_TAC[LESS_EQ_ADD,LESS_EQ_TRANS,DECIDE ``vs + l*v2 + b*l*v1 = (v1*b + v2)*l + vs``] >>
                          METIS_TAC[DIV_thm1,LESS_EQ_TRANS]) >>
                   Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`X1 = w2n v1 * dimword(:'a) + w2n v2` >>
                   Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`X2 = dimword(:'a) ** LENGTH vs` >>
                   `U DIV (X1 * X2) = U DIV X2 DIV X1` by METIS_TAC[MULT_COMM,DIV_DIV_DIV_MULT] >>
                   qpat_x_assum `U DIV xxx = yyy` (fn x => REWRITE_TAC[x]) >>
                   srw_tac[][Abbr`U`,Abbr`u`,mw2n_msf,dimwords_dimword,EXP, GSYM ADD1] >>
                   REWRITE_TAC[DECIDE ``u + x2 * u3 + b * x2 * u2 + b * (b * x2) * u1 = (u3 + u2*b + u1*b*b)*x2 + u``] >>
                   Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`A = (w2n u3 + w2n u2 * dimword (:'a) + w2n u1 * dimword (:'a) * dimword (:'a))` >>
                   Q.PAT_ABBREV_TAC`B = mw2n (REVERSE us)` >>
                   `(A * X2 + B) DIV X2 = A` by METIS_TAC[DIV_MULT,Abbr`X2`,Abbr`B`,mw2n_lt,dimwords_dimword,LENGTH_REVERSE] >>
                   qpat_x_assum `xx DIV X2 = A` (fn x => REWRITE_TAC[x]) >>
                   `A < w2n q * X1` by METIS_TAC[ADD_COMM,ADD_ASSOC] >>
                   `A DIV X1 < w2n q` by METIS_TAC[DIV_thm2] >>
                   Cases_on `w2n q` THEN1 full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[] >>
                   METIS_TAC[SUC_SUB1,LESS_EQ,LESS_EQ_MONO]) >>
            REWRITE_TAC[DECIDE ``a1 * d * d + a2 * d + a3 = a3 + d * (a2 + ( d * a1))``,
                        DECIDE ``w * (b1 * d + b2) = w *( b2 + d * b1)``] >>
            `(w2n u1 = mw2n [u1]) /\ (w2n v1 = mw2n [v1])` by lrw[mw2n_def] >>
            POP_ASSUM (fn x => REWRITE_TAC[x]) >> POP_ASSUM (fn x => REWRITE_TAC[x]) >>
            REWRITE_TAC[SPEC_ALL (GSYM (CONJUNCT2 mw2n_def)),GSYM (CONJUNCT1 (SPEC_ALL mw_mul_by_single_lemma))] >>
            `LENGTH [u3;u2;u1] = LENGTH (mw_mul_by_single q [v2;v1])` by lrw[mw_mul_by_single_lemma] >>
            FULL_SIMP_TAC std_ss [mw_cmp_thm]) >>
full_simp_tac (srw_ss())[Once mw_div_test_def] )

val q_thm = store_thm( "q_thm",
``!(u1:'a word) u2 us (v1:'a word) vs.
  (LENGTH us = LENGTH vs) /\ (0 < w2n v1) /\

Theorem mw_div_test_thm:
  !(u1:'a word) u2 u3 us (v1:'a word) v2 vs.
    (LENGTH us = LENGTH vs) /\ (dimword(:'a) DIV 2 <= w2n v1) /\
    (mw2n (REVERSE (u1::u2::u3::us)) DIV (mw2n (REVERSE (v1::v2::vs))) < dimword(:'a))  ==>
    let q = if w2n u1 < w2n v1 then FST (single_div u1 u2 v1) else (n2w (dimword(:'a) - 1):'a word)
    in
      w2n (mw_div_test q u1 u2 u3 v1 v2) < dimword(:'a) /\ (
      (w2n (mw_div_test q u1 u2 u3 v1 v2) =
       mw2n (REVERSE (u1::u2::u3::us)) DIV mw2n (REVERSE (v1::v2::vs))) \/
      (w2n (mw_div_test q u1 u2 u3 v1 v2) =
       SUC (mw2n (REVERSE (u1::u2::u3::us)) DIV mw2n (REVERSE (v1::v2::vs)))))

name: single_div_loop_thm
statement:
!k ns m is t qs.
    (single_div_loop (n2w k,ns,m,is) = (t,qs:'a word list)) /\
    k < dimword (:'a) /\
    k <= dimindex (:'a) /\ (w2n m < 2 ** (dimindex (:'a) - k)) /\
    (LENGTH ns = 2) /\ (LENGTH is = 2) ==>
    (num_div_loop (k,mw2n ns,w2n m,mw2n is) = (w2n t, mw2n qs)) /\
    (LENGTH qs = 2)

name: single_div_full_thm
statement:
mw2n [x2;x1] < mw2n [0w;y] ==>
    (single_div_full x1 x2 y = single_div x1 x2 y)

name: xor_F
statement: !x. x xor F <=> x

name: F_xor
statement: !x. F xor x <=> x

name: SUM_CONST
statement: !l c. (!x. MEM x l ==> (x = c)) ==> (SUM l = LENGTH l * c)

name: MEM_LIST_COMBS
statement: !l l' x. MEM x (LIST_COMBS l l') <=> (MEM (FST x) l /\ MEM (SND x) l')

name: LENGTH_LIST_COMBS
statement: !x y. LENGTH (LIST_COMBS x y) = LENGTH x * LENGTH y

name: ALL_DISTINCT_APPEND
statement:
!l l'. ALL_DISTINCT l /\ ALL_DISTINCT l' /\ (!x. ~(MEM x l /\ MEM x l')) ==>
           ALL_DISTINCT (l ++ l')

name: ALL_DISTINCT_MAP
statement:
!l f. ALL_DISTINCT l /\ (!x y. (f x = f y) = (x = y)) ==>
          ALL_DISTINCT (MAP f l)

name: ALL_DISTINCT_MAP2
statement:
!l f. ALL_DISTINCT l /\ (!x y. MEM x l /\ MEM y l /\ (f x = f y) ==> (x = y)) ==>
          ALL_DISTINCT (MAP f l)

name: ALL_DISTINCT_LIST_COMBS
statement: !l l'. ALL_DISTINCT l /\ ALL_DISTINCT l' ==> ALL_DISTINCT (LIST_COMBS l l')

name: DIV_TWO_UNIQUE
statement:
!n q r. n = 2 * q + r /\ (r = 0 \/ r = 1) ==>
          q = n DIV 2 /\ r = n MOD 2

name: DIV_TWO_CANCEL
statement: !n. (2 * n DIV 2 = n) /\ (SUC (2 * n) DIV 2 = n)

name: EXP_SUBTYPE
statement:
$EXP IN ((gtnum 0 -> UNIV -> gtnum 0) INTER
           (gtnum 1 -> gtnum 0 -> gtnum 1))

name: EXP_MONO
statement: !p a b. 1 < p ==> (p EXP a < p EXP b <=> a < b)

name: EXP2_MONO_LE
statement: !a b n. 0 < n /\ a <= b ==> a EXP n <= b EXP n

name: DISJOINTL_KILL_DUPS
statement:
!(l:('a->bool) list).
    DISJOINTL (nub l) = (!x y. MEM x l /\ MEM y l ==> (x = y) \/ DISJOINT x y)

name: inf_alt
statement: !p. inf p = ~(sup (IMAGE $~ p))

name: DIVIDES_MOD
statement: !n a. 0 < n ==> ((a MOD n = 0) = divides n a)

name: PRIME_EXPONENT
statement:
!n p.
     0 < n /\ prime p ==>
     divides (p EXP exponent p n) n /\
     ~divides (p EXP (SUC (exponent p n))) n

name: exponent_def
statement: exponent m n = LEAST k. ~divides (m EXP SUC k) n

name: GORD
statement:
!G :: finite_group. !g :: gset G.
       (0 < gord G g /\ (gpow G g (gord G g) = gid G)) /\
       !n. 0 < n /\ n < gord G g ==> ~(gpow G g n = gid G)

name: gord_def
statement: gord G g = LEAST n. 0 < n /\ (gpow G g n = gid G)

name: lcoset_list_def
statement: lcoset_list G H = nub (MAP (\g. lcoset G g H) (SET_TO_LIST (gset G)))

name: FACTORIZES_1_UNIQUE
statement: !l. factorizes 1 l = (l = [])

name: factorizes_def
statement: factorizes n l = EVERY prime l /\ sorted $<= l /\ (prod l = n)

name: CARD_WITNESS
INDEP_FN_NONEXAMPLE
statement: (\s. (shd s = shd (stl s), stl s)) NOTIN indep_fn

name: INDEP_FN_BIND
statement: !f g. f IN indep_fn /\ (!x. g x IN indep_fn) ==> BIND f g IN indep_fn

name: INDEP_FN_PROB_FST_INSERT
statement:
!f x xs.
       f IN indep_fn /\ ~(x IN xs) ==>
       (prob bern {s | FST (f s) IN (x INSERT xs)} =
        prob bern {s | FST (f s) = x} + prob bern {s | FST (f s) IN xs})

name: PREFIX_COVER_LEVELS_DISJOINT
statement:
!c b ca a m n.
    (!a. prefix_cover (ca a)) /\ ~(m = n) ==>
    DISJOINT (prefix_cover_level c b ca a m)
             (prefix_cover_level c b ca a n)

name: MINIMAL_EQ
statement: !P m. P m /\ (m = $LEAST P) <=> P m /\ (!n. n < m ⇒ ~P n)

name: PROB_WHILE_TERMINATES_PREFIX_COVER_STAR
statement:
!c b bc ca a.
       (!a. b a IN indep_fn) /\
       (!a. prefix_cover (ca a)) /\
       (!a l s.
          l IN ca a /\ s IN prefix_set l ==>
          (b a s = (FST (b a (prefix_seq l)),sdrop (LENGTH l) s))) /\
       (bc = (\a l. FST (b a (prefix_seq l)))) /\
       prob_while_terminates c b ==>
       prefix_cover (prefix_cover_star c bc ca a)

name: PROB_WHILE_WITNESS_BIND
statement:
!c b a.
    prob_while_witness c b a =
    if c a then BIND (b a) (prob_while_witness c b) else UNIT a

name: PREFIX_COVER_STAR_FIXES_FN
statement:
!c b bc ca a s l n.
    (!a. prefix_cover (ca a)) /\
    (!a l s.
       l IN ca a /\ s IN prefix_set l ==>
       (b a s = (FST (b a (prefix_seq l)), sdrop (LENGTH l) s))) /\
    (bc = (\a l. FST (b a (prefix_seq l)))) /\
    s IN prefix_set l /\
    l IN prefix_cover_level c bc ca a n ==>
    (prob_while_witness c b a s =
     (FST (prob_while_witness c b a (prefix_seq l)),
      sdrop (LENGTH l) s))

name: PROB_WHILE_WITNESS_COUNTABLE_RANGE
statement:
!c b (a : 'a).
    (!a. b a IN indep_fn) ==>
    countable (range (FST o prob_while_witness c b a))

name: PROB_WHILE_WITNESS_MEASURABLE_FST
statement:
!c b (a : 'a).
    (!a. b a IN indep_fn) ==>
    FST o prob_while_witness c b a IN
        measurable (p_space bern, events bern) (UNIV, UNIV)

name: PROB_WHILE_WITNESS_MEASURABLE_SND
statement:
!c b (a : 'a).
    (!a. b a IN indep_fn) ==>
    SND o prob_while_witness c b a IN
        measurable (p_space bern, events bern) (p_space bern, events bern)

name: PROB_BERN_NONEVENT_SEQ
statement:
!n.
    nonevent IN events bern ==>
    (prob bern (nonevent_seq n) = 2 pow n * prob bern nonevent)

name: PROB_BERN_BIND_COUNTABLE
statement:
!p f g c.
       f IN indep_fn /\ (!a. g a IN indep_fn) /\
       (!x. x IN range (FST o f) ==> ?n. (c n = x)) ==>
       (\n.
         if (!m. m < n ==> ~(c m = c n)) then
           prob bern ($= (c n) o FST o f) *
           prob bern (p o FST o g (c n))
         else 0) sums
       prob bern (p o FST o BIND f g)

name: prob_while_witness_def
statement:
prob_while_witness c b a s = case OWHILE (c o FST) (UNCURRY b) (a,s) of
                                 NONE => ARB
                               | SOME x => x

name: MEASURABLE_IMP_PREMEASURABLE
statement:
!f a b. sigma_algebra a /\ sigma_algebra b /\ f IN measurable a b ==>
            f IN premeasurable a b

name: PREMEASURABLE_SIGMA
statement:
!f a b sp.
       sigma_algebra a /\ subset_class sp b /\ f IN (space a -> sp) /\
       (!s. s IN b ==> (PREIMAGE f s) INTER (space a) IN subsets a) ==>
       f IN premeasurable a (sigma sp b)

name: PROB_TWIN_NIL
statement: !l. ~prob_twin l [] /\ ~prob_twin [] l

name: PROB_TWINFREE_STEP2
statement:
!l1 l2. (~MEM [] l1 \/ ~MEM [] l2) /\
          prob_twinfree l1 /\ prob_twinfree l2
          ==> prob_twinfree (APPEND (MAP (CONS T) l1) (MAP (CONS F) l2))

name: RANDOM_LURCHES_MULTIPLICATIVE
statement:
!a.
    prob bern
         {s |
          ?n. FST (prob_while_cut ($< 0) random_lurch n a s) = 0} =
    (prob bern
     {s |
      ?n. FST (prob_while_cut ($< 0) random_lurch n 1 s) = 0}) pow a

name: PROB_TERMINATES_RANDOM_WALK
statement: prob_while_terminates ($< 0) random_lurch

name: fibmod
statement: ∀n. EVEN (fib n) ⇔ n MOD 3 = 2

name: fib_def
statement: fib n = if n = 0n then 1n else if n = 1 then 1 else fib (n-1) + fib (n - 2)

name: NU_thm
NU_P_ONE
statement: ∀p. nu p 1 = 0

name: NU_P_P
statement: ∀p. 1

name: NU_TRIV
statement: ∀p n. p≤1 ⇒ ν p n = 0

name: NU_NON_TRIVIAL
statement: ∀p n. 1

name: NU_NOT_DIV
statement: ∀p n. ~(p divides n) ⇒ nu p n = 0

name: NU_SUC
statement: ∀p n v. ν p n = SUC v ⇒ p divides n ∧ ν p (n DIV p) = v

name: NU_POS
statement: ∀p n. 1

name: NU_DIVIDES
statement: ∀p n k. 1 < p ∧ n ≠ 0 ⇒ (k ≤ ν p n ⇔ (p ** k) divides n)

name: NU_MULT
statement: ∀p a b. a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ prime p ⇒ ν p (a * b) = ν p a + ν p b

name: NU_SUM
statement: ∀p a b. a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ prime p ⇒ MIN (ν p a) (ν p b) ≤ ν p (a+b)

name: NU_SUM_NEQ
statement:
∀p a b. a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ prime p ∧ ν p a ≠ ν p b ⇒
          MIN (ν p a) (ν p b) = ν p (a+b)

name: NU_ABS_DIFF
statement: ∀p a b. prime p ∧ a≠0 ∧ b≠0 ∧ a≠b ⇒ MIN (ν p a) (ν p b) ≤ ν p (ABS_DIFF a b)

name: NU_ABS_DIFF_NEQ
statement:
∀p a b. prime p ∧ a≠0 ∧ b≠0 ∧ ν p a ≠ ν p b ⇒
          MIN (ν p a) (ν p b) = ν p (ABS_DIFF a b)

name: NU_def
statement:
(nu 0 n = 0) ∧
  (nu 1 n = 0) ∧
  (nu p 0 = 0) ∧
  (nu p n = if p divides n then 1 + nu p (n DIV p) else 0)

name: NUM_MULT
statement: !a b. Num (a*b) = Num a * Num b

name: NUM_EQ_0
statement: Num x = 0 <=> x = 0

name: NU_FRAC_WELL_DEF
statement: !p f1 f2. prime p ==> rat_equiv f1 f2 ==> ν p f1 = ν p f2

name: NU_FRAC_MUL
statement: prime p /\ frac_nmr f1 <> 0 /\ frac_nmr f2 <> 0 ==> ν p (frac_mul f1 f2) = ν p f1 + ν p f2

name: NU_RAT_MUL
statement: prime p /\ q1 <> 0 /\ q2 <> 0 ==> nu_rat p (q1 * q2) = nu_rat p q1 + nu_rat p q2

name: NU_RAT_0
statement: ν p 0 = 0

name: NU_RAT_1
statement: ν p 1 = 0

name: NU_RAT_NEG1
statement: prime p ==> ν p (-1) = 0

name: RAT_NEG
statement: -r:rat = -1 * r

name: NU_RAT_NEG
statement: prime p ⇒ ν p (-n) = ν p n

name: NU_RAT_OF_NUM
statement: prime p ⇒ ν p (rat_of_num n) = &ν p n

name: RAT_EQUIV_RATND
statement: rat_equiv (rep_rat r) (abs_frac (RATN r, &RATD r))

name: NU_RAT_DIV
statement: prime p ∧ a≠0 ∧ b≠0 ⇒ ν p (a/b) = ν p a - ν p b

name: NU_RAT_MINV
statement: prime p ∧ r ≠ 0 ⇒ ν p (rat_minv r) = - ν p r

name: NU_RAT_OF_INT
statement: prime p ⇒ ν p (rat_of_int i) = &ν p (Num i)

name: NU_RAT_RATND
statement: prime p ⇒ ν p (r:rat) = &(ν p (Num (RATN r))) - &(ν p (RATD r))

name: NUM_SUM
statement: Num (a+b) = if SGN a = SGN b then Num a + Num b else ABS_DIFF (Num a) (Num b)

name: PULL_RAT_OF_INT

rat_of_int i * &n = rat_of_int (i * &n) ∧ &n * rat_of_int i = rat_of_int (&n*i) ∧ rat_of_int i * rat_of_int j = rat_of_int (i*j) ∧
  rat_of_int i + &n = rat_of_int (i + &n) ∧ &n + rat_of_int i = rat_of_int (&n+i) ∧ rat_of_int i + rat_of_int j = rat_of_int (i+j)

name: SGN_OPP
statement: ∀a b. a≠0 ∧ b≠0 ∧ SGN a ≠ SGN b ⇒ SGN a = - SGN b

name: NU_RAT_SUM
statement: prime p ∧ a≠0 ∧ b≠0 ∧ a+b≠0 ⇒ int_min (ν p a) (ν p b) ≤ ν p (a+b)

name: NU_RAT_DIFF
statement: prime p ∧ a≠0 ∧ b≠0 ∧ a≠b ⇒ int_min (ν p a) (ν p b) ≤ ν p (a-b)

name: NU_RAT_EXP
statement: prime p ⇒ ν p (exp (&p) i) = i

name: NU_RAT_P_DIV
statement: prime p ∧ r≠0 ⇒ ∃q. ν p q = 0 ∧ r = q * (exp (&p) (ν p r))

name: NU_RAT_SUM_NEQ
statement: prime p ∧ a≠0 ∧ b≠0 ∧ ν p a ≠ ν p b ⇒ int_min (ν p a) (ν p b) = ν p (a+b)

name: RATND_COPRIME

name: NU_RAT_EQ_0

prime p ∧ ν p r = 0 ∧ r≠0 ⇒

name: NU_RAT_CASES

  (ν p r ≤ 0 ⇒ -&ν p (RATD r) = ν p r ∧ ν p (Num (RATN r)) = 0)

name: NU_FRAC_def

nufrac p f:int = if frac_nmr f = 0 then 0
                   else &(ν p (Num $ frac_nmr f)) - &(ν p (Num $ frac_dnm f))

name: PRIMEITS_PRIME

name: PRIMEITS_POS

statement: ∀x. pair_of_rat (-1) * x = -x

statement: - pair_of_rat 0 = pair_of_rat 0

statement: ∀x y z. x*(y+z) = x*y + x*z ∧ (x+y)*z = x*z + y*z

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_THM
statement:
padic_seq_equiv (f,(:α)) (g,(:α)) ⇔
    pcauchy (f,(:α)) ∧ pcauchy (g,(:α)) ∧
    if FINITE univ (:α) ∧ prime (CARD (univ (:α))) then
      pseqv (CARD (univ (:α))) f g
    else pseqv 2 f g

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_THM2
statement:
padic_seq_equiv x y ⇔
    pcauchy x ∧ pcauchy y ∧ pseqv (primeits (SND x)) (FST x) (FST y)

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_REL
statement: padic_seq_equiv equiv_on pcauchy

name: PCAUCHY_ADD
statement: ∀x y. pcauchy x ∧ pcauchy y ⇒ pcauchy (x+y)

name: PCAUCHY_IMP_BOUNDED
statement: pcauchy (f,(:α)) ⇒ ∃M. ∀n. abs (primeits (:α)) (f n) ≤ M

name: REAL_DIVMUL_CANCEL2
statement: c≠0:real ⇒ a/(b*c) * c = a/b

name: PCAUCHY_MUL
statement: ∀x y. pcauchy x ∧ pcauchy y ⇒ pcauchy (x*y)

name: PCAUCHY_PAIR_OF_RAT
statement: ∀r. pcauchy (pair_of_rat r)

name: PCAUCHY_AINV
statement: ∀x. pcauchy x ⇒ pcauchy (-x)

name: PCAUCHY_SUB
statement: ∀x y. pcauchy x ∧ pcauchy y ⇒ pcauchy (x-y)

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_MUL_RSP
statement:
padic_seq_equiv x1 x2 ∧ padic_seq_equiv y1 y2 ⇒
  padic_seq_equiv (x1*y1) (x2*y2)

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_ADD_RSP
statement:
padic_seq_equiv x1 x2 ∧ padic_seq_equiv y1 y2 ⇒
  padic_seq_equiv (x1+y1) (x2+y2)

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_CAUCHY
statement: pcauchy (f1,(:α)) ∧ pseqv (primeits (:α)) f1 f2 ⇒ pcauchy (f2,(:α))

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_SYM
statement: ∀x y. padic_seq_equiv x y ⇔ padic_seq_equiv y x

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_REFL
statement: ∀x. pcauchy x ⇒ padic_seq_equiv x x

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_TRANS
statement: ∀x y z. padic_seq_equiv x y ∧ padic_seq_equiv y z ⇒ padic_seq_equiv x z

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_SCALING
statement:
∀x y s. padic_seq_equiv x y ⇒
          padic_seq_equiv (pair_of_rat s * x) (pair_of_rat s * y)

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_AINV_RSP
statement: ∀x y. padic_seq_equiv x1 x2 ⇒ padic_seq_equiv (-x1) (-x2)

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_SUB_RSP
statement:
padic_seq_equiv x1 x2 ∧ padic_seq_equiv y1 y2 ⇒
  padic_seq_equiv (x1-y1) (x2-y2)

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_CLASSES
statement:
padic_seq_equiv x y ⇔
    padic_seq_equiv x x ∧ padic_seq_equiv y y ∧
    padic_seq_equiv x = padic_seq_equiv y

name: Q_THM
statement:
(∃x. padic_seq_equiv x x) ∧
  (∀x y. padic_seq_equiv x y ⇔
           padic_seq_equiv x x ∧ padic_seq_equiv y y ∧
           (padic_seq_equiv x = padic_seq_equiv y))

name: PAIR_OF_RAT_PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_REFL
statement: padic_seq_equiv (pair_of_rat q) (pair_of_rat q)

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQUIV_PAIR_OF_RAT
statement: padic_seq_equiv (pair_of_rat p) (pair_of_rat q) ⇔ p = q

name: primeits_def
statement:
primeits (:α) = let c = (CARD (univ (:α))) in
                    if FINITE (univ (:α)) ∧ prime c then c else 2

name: pmet_def
statement: pmet (:α) = padic_met (primeits (:α))

name: padic_pair_add_def
statement: pair_add (f,(:α)) (g,(:α)) = (rat_fn_add f g,(:α))

name: padic_pair_mul_def
statement: pair_mul (f,(:α)) (g,(:α)) = (rat_fn_mul f g,(:α))

name: padic_pair_ainv_def
statement: pair_ainv (f,(:α)) = (-f,(:α))

name: padic_pair_sub_def
statement: pair_sub (f,(:α)) (g,(:α)) = (f-g,(:α))

name: pair_of_rat_def
statement: pair_of_rat r = (const r:num->rat,(:α))

name: pcauchy_def
statement: pcauchy (f,(:α)) = cauchy f (pmet (:α))

name: padic_seq_equiv_def
statement:
padic_seq_equiv (f,(:α)) (g,(:α)) ⇔
    pcauchy (f,(:α)) ∧ pcauchy (g,(:α)) ∧ pseqv (primeits (:α)) f g

name: PADIC_ABS_EQ_0
statement: ∀p r. p≠0 ⇒ (abs p r = 0 ⇔ r = 0)

name: PADIC_ABS_POS
statement: ∀p r. 0

name: PADIC_ABS_MUL
statement: ∀p r q. prime p ⇒ abs p (r*q) = abs p r * abs p q

name: PADIC_ABS_NEG
statement: ∀p r. prime p ⇒ abs p (-r) = abs p r

name: RAT_MAX_REF
statement: ∀r. rat_max r r = r

name: RAT_MAX_SYM
statement: ∀r1 r2. rat_max r1 r2 = rat_max r2 r1

name: RAT_MAX_ADD
statement: ∀r1 r2 r3. rat_max (r1 + r3) (r2+r3) = rat_max r1 r2 + r3

name: RAT_MIN_REF
statement: ∀r. rat_min r r = r

name: RAT_MIN_SYM
statement: ∀r1 r2. rat_min r1 r2 = rat_min r2 r1

name: RAT_MAX_NEG
statement: ∀r1 r2. rat_max (-r1) (-r2) = -(rat_min r1 r2)

name: RAT_MAX_LEQ
statement: ∀r1 r2. r1 ≤ rat_max r1 r2 ∧ r2 ≤ rat_max r1 r2

name: PADIC_ABS_ULTRAMETRIC
statement: ∀p r q. prime p ⇒ abs p (r+q) ≤ max (abs p r) (abs p q)

name: PADIC_ABS_TRIANGLE
statement: ∀p r q. prime p ⇒ abs p (r+q) ≤ abs p r + abs p q

name: PADIC_ABS_ULTRAMETRIC_NEQ
statement:
∀p r q. prime p ∧ abs p r ≠ abs p q ⇒
          abs p (r+q) = max (abs p r) (abs p q)

name: PADIC_DIST_ISMET
statement: prime p ⇒ ismet (padic_dist p)

name: PADIC_DIST_POS
statement: ∀p r q. prime p ⇒ 0 ≤ padic_dist p (r,q)

name: PADIC_DIST_SYM
statement: ∀p r q. prime p ⇒ padic_dist p (r,q) = padic_dist p (q,r)

name: PADIC_MET_DIST
statement: prime p ⇒ dist (padic_met p) = padic_dist p

name: PADIC_DIST_FROM_0
statement: prime p ⇒ dist (padic_met p) (x,0) = abs p x

name: PADIC_DIST_ULTRAMETRIC
statement: prime p ⇒ padic_dist p (r,q) ≤ max (padic_dist p (r,s)) (padic_dist p (s,q))

name: CONVERGES_IMP_CAUCHY
statement: ∀f m. (∃L. converges_to f L m) ⇒ cauchy f m

name: CONVERGES_CONSTANT
statement: ∀k m. converges_to (λn. k) k m

name: CONSTANT_CAUCHY
statement: ∀m k. cauchy (λn. k) m

name: CAUCHY_ALT
statement: cauchy f m = ∀ε. 0<ε ⇒ ∃n:num. ∀n1 n2. n≤n1 ∧ n≤n2 ⇒ dist m (f n1, f n2) < ε

name: FINITE_IMP_BOUNDED_ABOVE
statement: ∀A. FINITE A ⇒ ∃M. ∀a. A a ⇒ a≤M

name: FINITE_BOUNDED_ITERATE
statement: ∀n:num. FINITE {f n0 | n0 < n}

name: CAUCHY_IMP_BOUNDED
statement: ∀f m. cauchy f m ⇒ ∃M. ∀n. (dist m)(f n, f 0) ≤ M

name: RAT_FN_ADD_ASSOC
statement: ∀(f:'a->rat) g h. f + (g + h) = f + g + h

name: RAT_FN_ADD_COMM
statement: ∀(f:'a->rat) g. f + g = g + f

name: CONST_THM
statement: const x a = x ∧ const_rat_of_num n a = &n

name: RAT_FN_MUL_ASSOC
statement: ∀f g h. f*(g*h)=f*g*h

name: RAT_FN_MUL_COMM
statement: ∀f g. f*g=g*f

name: CONST_INJ
statement: const m = const n ⇔ m=n

name: CONST_AINV
statement: -const c = const (-c)

name: CONST_RAT_OF_NUM
statement: const (&n) = &n

name: RAT_FN_SUB_ADDAINV
statement: ∀f g. f-g = f + -g

name: RAT_FN_AINV_SUB
statement: ∀f g. -(f-g) = g-f

name: RAT_FN_DISTRIB
statement: ∀f g h. f*(g+h) = f*g + f*h ∧ (g+h)*f = g*f + h*f

name: RAT_FN_AINV_ADD
statement: ∀f g. -(f+g)=-f-g

name: RAT_FN_SUB_DISTRIB
statement: ∀f g h. f * (g - h) = f * g - f * h ∧ (g - h) * f = g * f - h * f

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQV_REFL
statement: pseqv p f f

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQV_SYM
statement: prime p ⇒ (pseqv p f g ⇔ pseqv p g f)

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQV_TRANS
statement: ∀p f g h. prime p ∧ pseqv p f g ∧ pseqv p g h ⇒ pseqv p f h

name: PADIC_SEQ_EQV_REL
statement: prime p ⇒ (pseqv p) equiv_on (λx. T)

name: PADIC_SEQ_CONVERGES_TO_ZERO_ADD
statement: ∀p f g. prime p ∧ converges_to f 0 (padic_met p) ∧ converges_to g 0 (padic_met p) ⇒ converges_to (f+g) 0 (padic_met p)

name: CAUCHY_IMP_BOUNDED_PADIC
statement: prime p ∧ cauchy f (padic_met p) ⇒ ∃M. ∀n. abs p (f n) ≤ M

name: PADIC_SEQ_CONVERGES_TO_ZERO_MUL
statement: ∀p f g. prime p ∧ converges_to f 0 (padic_met p) ∧ cauchy g (padic_met p) ⇒ converges_to (f*g) 0 (padic_met p)

name: padic_abs_def
statement: padic_abs p (r:rat) = if p=0 ∨ r=0 then 0 else real_of_rat ((&p) ** (- ν p r))

name: padic_dist
statement: padic_dist p (r,q) = padic_abs p (r-q)

name: padic_met_def
statement: padic_met p = metric (padic_dist p)

name: cauchy_def
statement: cauchy (f :num->'a) m = ∀ε. 0<ε ⇒ ∃n:num. ∀n'. n≤n' ⇒ (dist m)(f n,f n')<ε

name: converges_to_def
statement: converges_to (f :num->'a) (L:'a) m = ∀ε. 0<ε ⇒ ∃n. ∀n'. n≤n' ⇒ (dist m)(f n',L)<ε

name: rat_fn_add_def
statement: rat_fn_add f g = (λx. rat_add (f x) (g x))

name: rat_fn_mul_def
statement: rat_fn_mul f g = (λx. rat_mul (f x) (g x))

name: rat_fn_sub_def
statement: rat_fn_sub f g = (λx. rat_sub (f x) (g x))

name: rat_fn_ainv_def
statement: rat_fn_ainv f = (λx. rat_ainv (f x))

name: const_fn_def
statement: const (x:rat) = (λa. x)

name: const_rat_of_num_fn_def
statement: const_rat_of_num = const o rat_of_num

name: pseqv_def
statement: pseqv p f g = converges_to (f-g) 0 (padic_met p)

name: preal_le_eq0
statement: !x y. 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y ==> (preal x <= preal y <=> x <= y)

name: preal_add_eq
statement:
!x y.
    preal x + preal y =
    if 0 <= x then if 0 <= y then preal (x + y) else preal x else preal y

name: posreal_of_num_sub
statement: !m n : num. & m - & n = & (m - n)

name: mul_eq_infty
statement:
!x y.
    (x * y = infty) <=> (x = infty) /\ ~(y = 0) \/ ~(x = 0) /\ (y = infty)

name: inv_antimono
statement: !x y. inv x <= inv y <=> y <= x

name: rat_cancel
statement: !a b c. (& a * & b) / (& a * & c) = if a = 0 then 0 else & b / & c

name: real_random_variable_LLN_general
statement:
!p X Z b. prob_space p /\
             (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\ (!n. integrable p (X n)) /\
             (!n x. x IN p_space p ==> Z n x = SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count n)) /\
             (!n :num. 0 < b n)
          ==> !n. real_random_variable
                    (\x. (Z (b n) x - expectation p (Z (b n))) / &(b n)) p

name: real_random_variable_LLN
statement:
!p X Z. prob_space p /\
           (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
           (!n. integrable p (X n)) /\
           (!n x. x IN p_space p ==> Z n x = SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count1 n)) ==>
           (!n. real_random_variable
                  (\x. (Z n x - expectation p (Z n)) / &SUC n) p)

name: real_random_variable_LLN_general'
statement:
!p X b. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\ (!n :num. 0 < b n)
        ==> !n. real_random_variable (\x. SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count (b n)) / &(b n)) p

name: real_random_variable_LLN'
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\
         (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) ==>
         (!n. real_random_variable (\x. SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count1 n) / &SUC n) p)

name: WLLN_uncorrelated_L2
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
         (!i j. i <> j ==> uncorrelated p (X i) (X j)) /\
         (?c. c <> PosInf /\ !n. variance p (X n) <= c) ==>
          LLN p X (in_lebesgue 2)

name: WLLN_uncorrelated
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
         (!i j. i <> j ==> uncorrelated p (X i) (X j)) /\
         (?c. c <> PosInf /\ !n. variance p (X n) <= c) ==>
          LLN p X in_probability

name: SLLN_uncorrelated_wlog
statement:
!p X S M c. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
       (!i j. i <> j ==> uncorrelated p (X i) (X j)) /\
       c <> PosInf /\ (!n. variance p (X n) <= c) /\
       (!n x. S n x = SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count1 n)) /\
       (!n. M n = expectation p (S n)) ==>
       ?(Y :num -> 'a -> extreal) W.
           (!n x. x IN p_space p ==> W n x = SIGMA (\i. Y i x) (count1 n)) /\
           (!n x. x IN p_space p ==> S n x - M n = W n x) /\
           (!n. expectation p (Y n) = 0) /\
           (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
           (!n. finite_second_moments p (Y n)) /\
           (!n. variance p (Y n) <= c) /\
           (!n. integrable p (Y n)) /\
           (!i j. i <> j ==> orthogonal p (Y i) (Y j))

name: SLLN_uncorrelated
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
         (!i j. i <> j ==> uncorrelated p (X i) (X j)) /\
         (?c. c <> PosInf /\ !n. variance p (X n) <= c) ==>
          LLN p X almost_everywhere

name: equivalent_comm
statement: !X Y. equivalent p (X :num -> 'a -> extreal) Y <=> equivalent p Y X

name: equivalent_events
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\
            (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) ==>
            !n. {x | x IN p_space p /\ X n x <> Y n x} IN events p

name: equivalent_lemma
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ equivalent p X Y /\
            (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) ==>
       ?N f. N IN null_set p /\
            !x. x IN p_space p DIFF N ==> !n. f x <= n ==> (X n x - Y n x = 0)

name: equivalent_thm1
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ equivalent p X Y /\
           (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
           (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) ==>
        ?Z. real_random_variable Z p /\
           ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. X i x - Y i x) (count1 n)) --> Z) (almost_everywhere p)

name: equivalent_thm2'
statement:
!b a p X Y. prob_space p /\ equivalent p X Y /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
                mono_increasing a /\ (sup (IMAGE a UNIV) = PosInf) /\
               (!m n. m <= n ==> b m <= b n) /\ (!n. ?i. n <= b i) ==>
          ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. X i x - Y i x) (count (b n)) / a n) --> (\x. 0))
            (almost_everywhere p)

name: equivalent_thm2
statement:
!a p X Y. prob_space p /\ equivalent p X Y /\
             (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
             (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
              mono_increasing a /\ (sup (IMAGE a UNIV) = PosInf) ==>
       ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. X i x - Y i x) (count1 n) / (a n)) --> (\x. 0))
          (almost_everywhere p)

name: equivalent_thm3
statement:
!a p X Y Z. prob_space p /\ equivalent p X Y /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
                real_random_variable Z p /\
               (!n. 0 < a n /\ a n < PosInf) /\
                mono_increasing a /\ sup (IMAGE a UNIV) = PosInf /\
       ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count1 n) / a n) --> Z) (in_probability p) ==>
       ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. Y i x) (count1 n) / a n) --> Z) (in_probability p)

name: equivalent_thm3'
statement:
!p X Y Z. prob_space p /\ equivalent p X Y /\
             (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
             (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
              real_random_variable Z p /\
       ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count1 n) / &SUC n) --> Z) (in_probability p) ==>
       ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. Y i x) (count1 n) / &SUC n) --> Z) (in_probability p)

name: equivalent_thm4
statement:
!p X Y Z a b. prob_space p /\ equivalent p X Y /\
                 (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
                 (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
                  real_random_variable Z p /\
                 (!n. 0 < a n /\ a n < PosInf) /\
                 mono_increasing a /\ sup (IMAGE a UNIV) = PosInf /\
                 (!m n. m <= n ==> b m <= b n) /\ (!n. ?i. n <= b i) /\
       ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count (b n)) / a n) --> Z) (almost_everywhere p) ==>
       ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. Y i x) (count (b n)) / a n) --> Z) (almost_everywhere p)

name: LLN_alt_converge_PR_IID
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV /\ integrable p (X 0) ==>
         (LLN p X in_probability <=>
          ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count1 n) / &SUC n) --> (\x. expectation p (X 0)))
           (in_probability p))

name: LLN_alt_converge_AE_IID
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV /\ integrable p (X 0) ==>
         (LLN p X almost_everywhere <=>
          ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count1 n) / &SUC n) --> (\x. expectation p (X 0)))
           (almost_everywhere p))

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_truncated
statement: !c. (\x. if c <= abs x then 0 else x) IN measurable Borel Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_truncated'
statement: !c. (\x. if c <= abs x then x else 0) IN measurable Borel Borel

name: truncated_alt
statement:
!p X n x. prob_space p /\ random_variable (X n) p Borel /\ x IN p_space p ==>
             (truncated X n x =
              X n x * indicator_fn {x | x IN p_space p /\ abs (X n x) < &SUC n} x)

name: truncated_le_abs
statement: !X n x. abs (truncated X n x) <= abs (X n x)

name: random_variable_truncated
statement:
!p X n. prob_space p /\ random_variable (X n) p Borel ==>
            random_variable (truncated X n) p Borel

name: real_random_variable_truncated
statement:
!p X n. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable (X n) p ==>
            real_random_variable (truncated X n) p

name: integrable_truncated
statement:
!p X n. prob_space p /\ random_variable (X n) p Borel /\ integrable p (X n) ==>
            integrable p (truncated X n)

name: truncated_vars_expectation
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV /\ integrable p (X 0) ==>
         ((\n. real (expectation p (truncated X n))) -->
               real (expectation p (X 0))) sequentially

name: truncated_vars_expectation'
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV /\ integrable p (X 0) ==>
         ((\n. real (expectation p
                      (\x. SIGMA (\i. truncated X i x) (count1 n)) / &SUC n)) -->
               real (expectation p (X 0))) sequentially

name: WLLN_IID
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
          pairwise_indep_vars p X (\n. Borel) UNIV /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV /\ integrable p (X 0)
      ==> LLN p X in_probability

name: pow_seq_pos_lt
statement: !a n. 1 < a ==> 0 < pow_seq a n

name: pow_seq_lower_bound
statement: !a n. 1 < a ==> a pow n / 2 < &pow_seq a n

name: pow_seq_unbounded
statement: !a (x :real). 1 < a ==> ?n. x < &pow_seq a (SUC n)

name: pow_seq_monotone
statement: !a i j. 1 < a /\ i <= j ==> pow_seq a i <= pow_seq a j

name: pow_seq_complete
statement: !a k. 1 < a /\ 0 < k ==> ?n. pow_seq a n <= k /\ k <= pow_seq a (SUC n)

name: pow_seq_limit
statement: !a. 1 < a ==> ((\n. &pow_seq a (SUC n) / &pow_seq a n) --> a) sequentially

name: pow_seq_limit'
statement: !a. 1 < a ==> ((\n. &pow_seq a n / &pow_seq a (SUC n)) --> inv a) sequentially

name: SLLN_IID_lemma
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
          pairwise_indep_vars p X (\n. Borel) UNIV /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV /\ integrable p (X 0) ==>
          !a. 1 < a ==>
             ((\n x. SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count (pow_seq a (SUC n))) /
                     &pow_seq a (SUC n)) --> (\x. expectation p (X 0))) (almost_everywhere p)

name: SLLN_IID_zero
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
          pairwise_indep_vars p X (\n. Borel) UNIV /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV /\
          integrable p (X 0) /\ expectation p (X 0) = 0 /\
         (!n x. x IN p_space p ==> 0 <= X n x)
      ==> LLN p X almost_everywhere

name: SLLN_IID_wlog
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
          pairwise_indep_vars p X (\n. Borel) UNIV /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV /\
          integrable p (X 0) /\
          (!n x. x IN p_space p ==> 0 <= X n x)
      ==> LLN p X almost_everywhere

name: SLLN_IID
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
          pairwise_indep_vars p X (\n. Borel) UNIV /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV /\ integrable p (X 0)
      ==> LLN p X almost_everywhere

name: SLLN_IID_diverge
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
          pairwise_indep_vars p X (\n. Borel) UNIV /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV /\
          expectation p (abs o X 0) = PosInf
      ==> AE x::p. limsup (\n. abs (SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count1 n)) / &SUC n) = PosInf

name: LLN_def
statement:
LLN p X convergence_mode =
    let Z n x = SIGMA (\i. X i x) (count1 n) in
      ((\n x. (Z n x - expectation p (Z n)) / &SUC n) --> (\x. 0))
       (convergence_mode p)

name: equivalent_def
statement:
equivalent p (X :num -> 'a -> extreal) Y =
      (suminf (\n. prob p {x | x IN p_space p /\ X n x <> Y n x}) < PosInf)

name: truncated_def
statement:
truncated (X :num -> 'a -> extreal) =
      \n x. if &SUC n <= abs (X n x) then 0 else X n x

name: pow_seq_def
statement: pow_seq a n = flr (a pow n)

name: absolutely_integrable_on_indicator
statement:
!A X. indicator A absolutely_integrable_on X <=>
          indicator A integrable_on X

name: has_integral_indicator_UNIV
statement:
!s A x. (indicator (s INTER A) has_integral x) UNIV =
            (indicator s has_integral x) A

name: integral_one
statement: !A. integral A (\x. 1) = integral univ(:real) (indicator A)

name: has_integral_interval_cube
statement:
!a b n. (indicator (interval [a,b]) has_integral
               content (interval [a,b] INTER (line n))) (line n)

name: space_lebesgue
statement: m_space lebesgue = univ(:real)

name: in_sets_lebesgue
statement: !A. (!n. indicator A integrable_on line n) ==> A IN measurable_sets lebesgue

name: limseq_indicator_BIGUNION
statement:
!A x. ((\k. indicator (BIGUNION {(A:num->real->bool) i | i < k}) x) -->
           (indicator (BIGUNION {A i | i IN UNIV}) x)) sequentially

name: sigma_algebra_lebesgue
statement: sigma_algebra (UNIV, {A | !n. (indicator A) integrable_on (line n)})

name: sets_lebesgue
statement: measurable_sets lebesgue = {A | !n. (indicator A) integrable_on (line n)}

name: in_sets_lebesgue_imp
statement: !A n. A IN measurable_sets lebesgue ==> indicator A integrable_on line n

name: measure_lebesgue
statement:
measure lebesgue =
      (\A. sup {Normal (integral (line n) (indicator A)) | n IN UNIV})

name: positive_lebesgue
statement: positive lebesgue

name: countably_additive_lebesgue
statement: countably_additive lebesgue

name: measure_space_lebesgue
statement: measure_space lebesgue

name: borel_imp_lebesgue_sets
statement: !s. s IN subsets borel ==> s IN measurable_sets lebesgue

name: lborel_subset_lebesgue
statement: (measurable_sets lborel) SUBSET (measurable_sets lebesgue)

name: borel_imp_lebesgue_measurable
statement:
!f. f IN borel_measurable (space borel, subsets borel) ==>
        f IN borel_measurable (m_space lebesgue, measurable_sets lebesgue)

name: negligible_in_lebesgue
statement: !s. negligible s ==> s IN measurable_sets lebesgue

name: lebesgue_of_negligible
statement: !s. negligible s ==> (measure lebesgue s = 0)

name: lebesgue_measure_iff_LIMSEQ
statement:
!A m. A IN measurable_sets lebesgue /\ 0 <= m ==>
         ((measure lebesgue A = Normal m) <=>
          ((\n. integral (line n) (indicator A)) --> m) sequentially)

name: lebesgue_closed_interval
statement: !a b. a <= b ==> (measure lebesgue (interval [a,b]) = Normal (b - a))

name: lebesgue_empty
statement: measure lebesgue {} = 0

name: lebesgue_closed_interval_content
statement: !a b. measure lebesgue (interval [a,b]) = Normal (content (interval [a,b]))

name: lambda_eq_lebesgue
statement: !s. s IN subsets borel ==> lambda s = measure lebesgue s

name: lebesgue_open_interval
statement: !a b. a <= b ==> measure lebesgue (interval (a,b)) = Normal (b - a)

name: lebesgue_def
statement:
lebesgue = (univ(:real),
              {A | !n. (indicator A) integrable_on (line n)},
              (\A. sup {Normal (integral (line n) (indicator A)) | n IN UNIV}))

name: finite_space_integral_reduce
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\
          f IN borel_measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) /\
          FINITE (m_space m) ==> (integral m f = finite_space_integral m f)

name: finite_POW_RN_deriv_reduce
statement:
!m v. measure_space m /\
          FINITE (m_space m) /\
          measure_space (m_space m, measurable_sets m, v) /\
         (POW (m_space m) = measurable_sets m) /\
         (!x. (measure m {x} = 0) ==> (v {x} = 0)) ==>
         (!x. x IN m_space m /\ measure m {x} <> 0 ==>
             (RN_deriv m v x = v {x} / (measure m {x})))

name: countable_space_integral_reduce
statement:
!m f p n. measure_space m /\ positive m /\
              f IN borel_measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) /\
              countable (IMAGE f (m_space m)) /\
             ~(FINITE (IMAGE (fn_plus f) (m_space m))) /\
             ~(FINITE (IMAGE (fn_minus f) (m_space m))) /\
             (\r. r *
                  measure m (PREIMAGE (fn_minus f) {r} INTER m_space m)) o
                enumerate ((IMAGE (fn_minus f) (m_space m))) sums n /\
             (\r. r *
                  measure m (PREIMAGE (fn_plus f) {r} INTER m_space m)) o
                enumerate ((IMAGE (fn_plus f) (m_space m))) sums p ==>
             (integral m f = p - n)

name: finite_prod_measure_space_POW
statement:
!s1 s2 u v. FINITE s1 /\ FINITE s2  ==>
          (prod_measure_space (s1, POW s1, u) (s2, POW s2, v) =
          (s1 CROSS s2, POW (s1 CROSS s2), prod_measure (s1, POW s1, u) (s2, POW s2, v)))

name: finite_POW_prod_measure_reduce3
statement:
!m0 m1 m2. measure_space m0 /\ measure_space m1 /\ measure_space m2 /\
               FINITE (m_space m0) /\ FINITE (m_space m1) /\ FINITE (m_space m2) /\
              (POW (m_space m0) = measurable_sets m0) /\
              (POW (m_space m1) = measurable_sets m1) /\
              (POW (m_space m2) = measurable_sets m2) ==>
             (!a0 a1 a2. a0 IN measurable_sets m0 /\
                         a1 IN measurable_sets m1 /\
                         a2 IN measurable_sets m2
             ==> ((prod_measure3 m0 m1 m2) (a0 CROSS (a1 CROSS a2)) =
                  measure m0 a0 * measure m1 a1 * measure m2 a2))

name: measure_space_finite_prod_measure_POW3
statement:
!m0 m1 m2. measure_space m0 /\ measure_space m1 /\ measure_space m2 /\
               FINITE (m_space m0) /\ FINITE (m_space m1) /\ FINITE (m_space m2) /\
              (POW (m_space m0) = measurable_sets m0) /\
              (POW (m_space m1) = measurable_sets m1) /\
              (POW (m_space m2) = measurable_sets m2) ==>
        measure_space (m_space m0 CROSS (m_space m1 CROSS m_space m2),
                       POW (m_space m0 CROSS (m_space m1 CROSS m_space m2)),
                       prod_measure3 m0 m1 m2)

name: finite_prod_measure_space_POW3
statement:
!s1 s2 s3 u v w.
         FINITE s1 /\ FINITE s2 /\ FINITE s3 ==>
         (prod_measure_space3 (s1,POW s1,u) (s2,POW s2,v) (s3,POW s3,w) =
          (s1 CROSS (s2 CROSS s3),POW (s1 CROSS (s2 CROSS s3)),
           prod_measure3 (s1,POW s1,u) (s2,POW s2,v) (s3,POW s3,w)))

name: REAL_SUP_SEQ
statement:
!P. (?x. P x) /\ (?z. !x. P x ==> x <= z) ==>
        ?x. (!n. x n IN P) /\ (!n. x n <= x (SUC n)) /\ (sup (IMAGE x UNIV) = sup P)

name: REAL_SUP_FUN_SEQ_IMAGE
statement:
!(P:real->bool) (P':('a->real)->bool) f.
         (?x. P x) /\ (?z. !x. P x ==> x <= z) /\ (P = IMAGE f P')
      ==> ?g. (!n:num. g n IN P') /\
              (sup (IMAGE (\n. f (g n)) UNIV) = sup P)

name: max_fn_seq_mono
statement: !g n x. max_fn_seq g n x <= max_fn_seq g (SUC n) x

name: REAL_SUP_FUN_SEQ_MONO_IMAGE
statement:
!(P:real->bool) (P':('a->real)->bool) f.
       (?x. P x) /\ (?z. !x. P x ==> x <= z) /\ (P = IMAGE f P') /\
       (!g1 g2. (g1 IN P' /\ g2 IN P' /\ (!x. g1 x <= g2 x))  ==> f g1 <= f g2) /\
       (!g1 g2. g1 IN P' /\ g2 IN P' ==> (\x. max (g1 x) (g2 x)) IN P')
    ==> ?g. (!n. g n IN P') /\
                (!x n. g n x <= g (SUC n) x) /\
                (sup (IMAGE (\n. f (g n)) UNIV) = sup P)

name: pos_simple_fn_def
statement:
pos_simple_fn m f (s :num set) (a :num -> 'a set) (x :num -> real) =
       ((!t. 0 <= f t) /\
        (!t. t IN m_space m ==> (f t = SIGMA (\i. (x i) * (indicator_fn (a i) t)) s)) /\
        (!i. i IN s ==> a i IN measurable_sets m) /\
        (!i. 0 <= x i) /\
        FINITE s /\
        (!i j. i IN s /\ j IN s /\ i <> j ==> DISJOINT (a i) (a j)) /\
        (BIGUNION (IMAGE a s) = m_space m))

name: pos_simple_fn_integral_def
statement:
pos_simple_fn_integral (m :'a m_space)
                           (s :num set) (a :num -> 'a set) (x :num -> real) =
        SIGMA (\i. (x i) * (measure m (a i))) s

name: psfs_def
statement: psfs m f = {(s,a,x) | pos_simple_fn m f s a x}

name: seq_sup_def
statement:
(seq_sup P 0       = @r. r IN P /\ sup P < r + 1) /\
   (seq_sup P (SUC n) = @r. r IN P /\ sup P < r + (1 / 2) pow (SUC n) /\
                                      seq_sup P n < r /\ r < sup P)

name: max_fn_seq_def
statement:
(max_fn_seq g       0 x = g 0 x) /\
   (max_fn_seq g (SUC n) x = max (max_fn_seq g n x) (g (SUC n) x))

name: MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE
statement:
!m s f.
       measure_space m /\ f IN (UNIV -> measurable_sets m) /\
       (!n. f n SUBSET f (SUC n)) /\
       (s = BIGUNION (IMAGE f UNIV)) ==>
       measure m o f --> measure m s

name: borel_measurable_le_iff
statement:
!m. measure_space m ==>
        !f. f IN borel_measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) <=>
            !a. {w | w IN m_space m /\ f w <= a} IN measurable_sets m

name: borel_measurable_gr_iff
statement:
!m. measure_space m ==>
        !f. f IN borel_measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) <=>
            !a. {w | w IN m_space m /\ a < f w} IN measurable_sets m

name: borel_measurable_less_iff
statement:
!m. measure_space m ==>
        !f. f IN borel_measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) <=>
            !a. {w | w IN m_space m /\ f w < a} IN measurable_sets m

name: borel_measurable_ge_iff
statement:
!m. measure_space m ==>
        !f. f IN borel_measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) <=>
            !a. {w | w IN m_space m /\ a <= f w} IN measurable_sets m

name: joint_distribution_sums_1
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ FINITE (p_space p) /\
           (events p = POW (p_space p)) ==>
           (SIGMA (λ(x,y). joint_distribution p X Y {(x,y)})
                  ((IMAGE X (p_space p)) CROSS (IMAGE Y (p_space p))) = 1)

name: joint_distribution_sum_mul1
statement:
!p X Y f. prob_space p /\ FINITE (p_space p) /\
             (events p = POW (p_space p))
         ==> (SIGMA (λ(x,y). joint_distribution p X Y {(x,y)} * (f x))
                    (IMAGE X (p_space p) CROSS IMAGE Y (p_space p)) =
              SIGMA (\x. distribution p X {x} * (f x)) (IMAGE X (p_space p)))

name: COND_PROB_POS_IMP_PROB_NZ
statement:
!A B p. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\
          (0 < cond_prob p A B) ==> (prob p (A INTER B) <> 0)

name: PROB_FINITE_ADDITIVE
statement:
!p s f t. prob_space p /\ FINITE s /\ (!x. x IN s ==> f x IN events p) /\
       (!a b. (a:'b) IN s /\ b IN s /\ ~(a = b) ==> DISJOINT (f a) (f b)) /\
       (t = BIGUNION (IMAGE f s)) ==> (prob p t = SIGMA (prob p o f) s)

name: COND_PROB_FINITE_ADDITIVE
statement:
!p A B n s. prob_space p /\ B IN events p /\ A IN ((count n) -> events p) /\
        (s = BIGUNION (IMAGE A (count n))) /\
        (!a b. a <> b ==> DISJOINT (A a) (A b)) ==>
        (cond_prob p s B = SIGMA (\i. cond_prob p (A i) B) (count n))

name: PDF_LE_POS
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ random_variable X p borel /\
          distribution p X << lborel ==> !x. 0 <= PDF p X x

name: EXPECTATION_PDF_1
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ random_variable X p borel /\
          distribution p X << lborel ==>
          expectation lborel (PDF p X) = 1

name: PDF_def
statement: PDF p X = RN_deriv (distribution p X) lborel

name: RECTANGLE_UNIV
statement: rectangle (\n. univ(:'a)) (:'N) = univ(:'a['N])

name: IN_RECTANGLE
statement:
!x (h :num -> 'a set). x IN rectangle h (:'N) <=>
       !i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> x ' i IN h i

name: PREIMAGE_RECTANGLE
statement:
!(f :'a -> 'b['N]) (h :num -> 'b set).
        PREIMAGE f (rectangle h (:'N)) =
        BIGINTER (IMAGE (\n. PREIMAGE (\x. f x ' n) (h n)) (count (dimindex(:'N))))

name: sigma_algebra_of_dimension
statement: !(B :'a algebra). sigma_algebra (B of_dimension (:'N))

name: space_sigma_of_dimension
statement: !(B :'a algebra). space (B of_dimension (:'N)) = rectangle (\n. space B) (:'N)

name: sigma_of_dimension_alt
statement:
!(B :'a algebra).
      subset_class (space B) (subsets B) /\ space B IN subsets B ==>
      B of_dimension (:'N) =
      sigma (rectangle (\n. space B) (:'N))
            {rectangle h (:'N) | !i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> h i IN subsets B}

name: sigma_of_dimension_alt_sigma_algebra
statement:
!(B :'a algebra). sigma_algebra B ==>
      B of_dimension (:'N) =
      sigma (rectangle (\n. space B) (:'N))
            {rectangle h (:'N) | !i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> h i IN subsets B}

name: rectangle_in_sigma_of_dimension
statement:
!B h. sigma_algebra B /\ (!i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> h i IN subsets B) ==>
          rectangle h (:'N) IN subsets (B of_dimension (:'N))

name: RECTANGLE_INTER_STABLE
statement:
!(B :'a algebra) C.
     (C = {rectangle h (:'N) | !i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> h i IN subsets B}) /\
     (!s t. s IN subsets B /\ t IN subsets B ==> s INTER t IN subsets B) ==>
      !s t. s IN C /\ t IN C ==> s INTER t IN C

name: borel_space_alt_sigma_functions
statement:
borel_space (:'N) =
    sigma_functions univ(:real['N]) (\n. borel) (\n v. v ' n)
                   (count (dimindex(:'N)))

name: Borel_space_alt_sigma_functions
statement:
Borel_space (:'N) =
    sigma_functions univ(:extreal['N]) (\n. Borel) (\n v. v ' n)
                   (count (dimindex(:'N)))

name: borel_space_alt_sigma
Borel_space_alt_sigma
rectangle_in_borel_space
statement:
!h. (!i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> h i IN subsets borel) ==>
        rectangle h (:'N) IN subsets (borel_space(:'N))

name: RECTANGLE_IN_BOREL_SPACE
statement:
!h. (!i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> h i IN subsets Borel) ==>
        rectangle h (:'N) IN subsets (Borel_space(:'N))

name: sigma_of_dimension_decomposition
statement:
!(B :'a algebra).
      subset_class (space B) (subsets B) /\ space B IN subsets B /\
      FINITE univ(:'M) /\ FINITE univ(:'N) ==>
      B of_dimension (:'M + 'N) = fcp_sigma (B of_dimension (:'M)) (B of_dimension (:'N))

name: borel_space_decomposition
statement:
FINITE univ(:'M) /\ FINITE univ(:'N) ==>
    borel_space (:'M + 'N) = fcp_sigma (borel_space (:'M)) (borel_space (:'N))

name: Borel_space_decomposition
statement:
FINITE univ(:'M) /\ FINITE univ(:'N) ==>
    Borel_space (:'M + 'N) = fcp_sigma (Borel_space (:'M)) (Borel_space (:'N))

name: general_filtration_def
statement:
general_filtration A a J =
     (poset J /\ (!n. n IN (carrier J) ==> sub_sigma_algebra (a n) A) /\
      (!i j. i IN (carrier J) /\ j IN (carrier J) /\ (relation J) i j ==>
             subsets (a i) SUBSET subsets (a j)))

name: general_filtered_measure_space_def
statement:
general_filtered_measure_space m a J =
      (measure_space m /\ general_filtration (m_space m,measurable_sets m) a J)

name: general_sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space_def
statement:
general_sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a J =
      (general_filtered_measure_space m a J /\
       !n. n IN (carrier J) ==> sigma_finite (m_space m,subsets (a n),measure m))

name: general_martingale_def
statement:
general_martingale m a u J =
     (general_sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a J /\
      (!n. n IN (carrier J) ==> integrable m (u n)) /\
      !i j s. i IN (carrier J) /\ j IN (carrier J) /\ (relation J) i j /\
              s IN (subsets (a i)) ==>
             (integral m (\x. u i x * indicator_fn s x) =
              integral m (\x. u j x * indicator_fn s x)))

name: upwards_filtering_def
statement:
upwards_filtering (J :'index poset) =
      !i j. i IN (carrier J) /\ j IN (carrier J) ==>
            ?k. k IN (carrier J) /\ (relation J) i k /\ (relation J) j k

name: fcp_rectangle_def
statement:
fcp_rectangle (h :num -> 'a set) (:'N) =
      {(v :'a['N]) | !i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> v ' i IN h i}

name: sigma_of_dimension_def
statement:
sigma_of_dimension (B :'a algebra) (:'N) =
    sigma_functions (rectangle (\n. space B) (:'N))
                    (\n. B) (\n v. v ' n)
                    (count (dimindex(:'N)))

name: borel_space_def
statement: borel_space (:'N) = borel of_dimension (:'N)

name: Borel_space_def
statement: Borel_space (:'N) = Borel of_dimension (:'N)

name: FIRST_OCCURENCE_EQ_REWRITES
statement:
(!n P L. (FIRST_OCCURENCE n P L = NONE) = (EVERY ($~ o P) L)) /\
  (!n m x P L. (FIRST_OCCURENCE n P L = (SOME (m,x))) =
               (EXISTS P L /\ (n <= m) /\ (EL (m-n) L = x) /\ P x /\
                !m'. m' < (m - n) ==> ~(P (EL m' L))))

name: FIRST_OCCURENCE_def
LIST_ZIP_def
statement:
LIST_ZIP L = if NULL (HD L) \/ NULL L then []
               else (MAP HD L)::LIST_ZIP (MAP TL L)

name: ASL_TRACE_ZIP_def
statement:
(ASL_TRACE_ZIP [] t = {t}) /\
   (ASL_TRACE_ZIP t [] = {t}) /\
   (ASL_TRACE_ZIP (aa1::t1) (aa2::t2) =
      (let z1 = IMAGE (\x. aa1::x) (ASL_TRACE_ZIP t1 (aa2::t2)) in
       let z2 = IMAGE (\x. aa2::x) (ASL_TRACE_ZIP (aa1::t1) t2) in
       let z3 = z1 UNION z2 in
       if (ASL_IS_PRIM_COMMAND_ATOMIC_ACTION aa1 /\
           ASL_IS_PRIM_COMMAND_ATOMIC_ACTION aa2) then
      IMAGE (\x. (asl_aa_check (ASL_GET_PRIM_COMMAND_ATOMIC_ACTION aa1) (ASL_GET_PRIM_COMMAND_ATOMIC_ACTION aa2))::x) z3 else
      z3))

name: ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC_def
statement:
(ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv (asl_pt_prim_command pc) = {[asl_aa_pc pc]}) /\
   (ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv (asl_pt_seq p1 p2) =
      {t1 ++ t2 | t1 IN ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv p1 /\ t2 IN ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv p2}) /\

   (ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv (asl_pt_parallel p1 p2) =
      BIGUNION {ASL_TRACE_ZIP t1 t2 | t1 IN (ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv p1) /\ t2 IN (ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv p2)}) /\

   (ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv (asl_pt_lock_declaration l p) =
      IMAGE (\t. ASL_TRACE_REMOVE_LOCKS {l} ([asl_aa_verhoog l]++t++[asl_aa_prolaag l])) ((ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv p) INTER (ASL_TRACE_IS_LOCK_SYNCHRONISED l))) /\

   (ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv (asl_pt_critical_section l p) =
      IMAGE (\t. [asl_aa_prolaag l]++t++[asl_aa_verhoog l]) (ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv p)) /\

   (ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC 0 penv (asl_pt_procedure_call name arg) =
      if ~(name IN (FDOM penv)) then {[asl_aa_fail]} else {}) /\

   (ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC (SUC n) penv (asl_pt_procedure_call name arg) =
    if ~(name IN (FDOM penv)) then {[asl_aa_fail]} else (
    BIGUNION (IMAGE (ASL_PROTO_TRACES_EVAL_PROC n penv) ((penv ' name) arg))))

name: TREE_FOLD_def
statement:
(TREE_FOLD (base, f) leaf = base) /\
   (TREE_FOLD (base, f) (node v tL) =
      f v (MAP (TREE_FOLD (base, f)) tL))

name: to_bits_n_m
statement: !m n. to_bits n m = GENLIST (\j. (n DIV 2 ** j) MOD 2) m

name: pop_property
statement: !b n. 1 < b /\ 0 < n ==> !j. b ** j <= n <=> j < pop b n

name: bop_def
statement:
bop b m x =
  if (b = 0) \/ (m <= x) then 0 else SUC (bop b m (x + b))

name: increase_by_def
statement:
increase_by b m x =
  if (b = 0) \/ (m <= x) then [] else x::increase_by b m (x + b)

name: diminishing_def
statement:
diminishing ls =
  if ls = [] then [] else ls::diminishing (TL ls)

name: mop_def
statement:
mop b m x =
  if (b <= 1) \/ (x = 0) \/ (m <= x) then 0 else SUC (mop b m (b * x))

name: multiply_by_def
statement:
multiply_by b m x =
  if (b <= 1) \/ (x = 0) \/ (m <= x) then [] else x::multiply_by b m (b * x)

name: full_heap_def
statement:
(!b m. full_heap b b m) /\
  (!b e m n xs d.
     (m b = H_BLOCK (xs,n,d)) /\ EMP_RANGE (b+1,b+n+1) m /\
     full_heap (b+n+1) e m ==> full_heap b e m)

name: part_heap_def
statement:
(!b m. part_heap b b m 0) /\
  (!b e m k.
     ~(isBLOCK (m b)) /\ part_heap (b+1) e m k ==> part_heap b e m k) /\
  (!b e m n xs d k.
     (m b = H_BLOCK (xs,n,d)) /\ EMP_RANGE (b+1,b+n+1) m /\
     part_heap (b+n+1) e m k ==> part_heap b e m (k+n+1))

name: EL_SPLIT_LIST
statement:
!xs n.
      n < LENGTH xs ==>
      (EL n xs = if EVEN n then EL (n DIV 2) (FST (SPLIT_LIST xs))
                           else EL (n DIV 2) (SND (SPLIT_LIST xs)))

name: SPLIT_LIST_def
statement:
(SPLIT_LIST [] = ([],[])) /\
  (SPLIT_LIST [x] = ([x],[])) /\
  (SPLIT_LIST (x1::x2::xs) =
     (x1::FST (SPLIT_LIST xs),x2::SND (SPLIT_LIST xs)))

name: zLISP_raw
statement: zLISP = zLISP_ALT (\wsp wi we ds tw2. T)

name: R_ev_T_cases
statement:
(R_ev (x,env,k,io,ok) (r,k',io',T) ⇔
