name: SIGN_NZ
statement: !p. ~(sign p = &0)

name: SIGN_I
statement: sign I = &1

name: SIGN_INVERSE
statement: !p. permutation p ==> (sign (inverse p) = sign p)

name: SIGN_COMPOSE
statement: !p q. permutation p /\ permutation q ==> (sign (p o q) = sign (p) * sign (q))

name: SIGN_SWAP
statement: !a b. sign (swap(a,b)) = if a = b then &1 else - &1

name: SIGN_IDEMPOTENT
statement: !p. sign (p) * sign (p) = &1

name: REAL_ABS_SIGN
statement: !p. abs(sign p) = &1

name: IN_DIMINDEX_SWAP
statement:
!m n j. m < dimindex(:'N) /\ n < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < dimindex(:'N)
           ==> SWAP(m,n) j < dimindex(:'N)

name: FCP_BETA_PERM
statement:
!g p i. p PERMUTES count(dimindex (:'N)) /\ i < dimindex(:'N)
         ==> (((FCP) g : 'a ** 'N) ' (p i) = g(p i))

name: DET_TRANSP
statement: !A:real['N]['N]. DET (TRANSP A) = DET A

name: DET_LOWERTRIANGULAR
statement:
!A:real['N]['N].
       (!i j. i < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) /\ i < j ==> (A ' i ' j = &0))
        ==> (DET(A) = PRODUCT (count (dimindex(:'N))) (\i. A ' i ' i))

name: DET_UPPERTRIANGULAR
statement:
!A:real['N]['N].
       (!i j. i < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < i ==> (A ' i ' j = &0))
        ==> (DET(A) = PRODUCT (count (dimindex(:'N))) (\i. A ' i ' i))

name: DET_DIAGONAL
statement:
!A:real['N]['N].
    (!i j. i < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) /\ ~(i = j) ==> (A ' i ' j = &0))
        ==> (DET(A) = PRODUCT (count (dimindex(:'N))) (\i. A ' i ' i))

name: DET_I
statement: DET(MAT 1 :real['N]['N]) = &1

name: DET_0
statement: DET(MAT 0 :real['N]['N]) = &0

name: DET_PERMUTE_ROWS
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] p.
        p PERMUTES (count (dimindex(:'N)))
        ==> (DET(FCP i. A ' (p i)) = SIGN(p) * DET(A))

name: DET_PERMUTE_COLUMNS
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] p.
        p PERMUTES (count (dimindex(:'N)))
        ==> (DET((FCP i j. A ' i ' (p j)):real['N]['N]) = SIGN(p) * DET(A))

name: DET_IDENTICAL_ROWS
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] i j.
    i < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) /\ ~(i = j) /\ (ROW i A = ROW j A)
                    ==> (DET A = &0)

name: DET_IDENTICAL_COLUMNS
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] i j.
    i < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) /\ ~(i = j) /\ (COLUMN i A = COLUMN j A)
                    ==> (DET A = &0)

name: DET_ZERO_ROW
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] i.
       i < dimindex(:'N) /\ (ROW i A = VECTOR_0)  ==> (DET A = &0)

name: DET_ZERO_COLUMN
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] i.
      i < dimindex(:'N) /\ (COLUMN i A = VECTOR_0)  ==> (DET A = &0)

name: DET_ROW_ADD
statement:
!a b c k.
          k < dimindex(:'N)
        ==> (DET ((FCP i. if i = k then a + b else c i):real['N]['N]) =
             DET ((FCP i. if i = k then a else c i):real['N]['N]) +
             DET ((FCP i. if i = k then b else c i):real['N]['N]))

name: DET_ROW_MUL
statement:
!a b c k.
        k < dimindex(:'N)
        ==> (DET((FCP i. if i = k then c * a else b i):real['N]['N]) =
             c * DET((FCP i. if i = k then a else b i):real['N]['N]))

name: DET_ROW_OPERATION
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] c i j.
        i < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) /\ ~(i = j)
        ==> (DET(FCP k. if k = i then ROW i A + c * ROW j A else ROW k A) =
             DET A)

name: DET_ROW_SPAN
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] i x.
        i < dimindex(:'N) /\
        x IN span {ROW j A |j < dimindex(:'N) /\ ~(j = i)}
        ==> (DET(FCP k. if k = i then ROW i A + x else ROW k A) = DET A)

name: DET_DEPENDENT_ROWS
statement: !A:real['N]['N]. dependent(ROWS A) ==> (DET A = &0)

name: DET_DEPENDENT_COLUMNS
statement: !A:real['N]['N]. dependent(COLUMNS A) ==> (DET A = &0)

name: DET_LINEAR_ROW_VSUM
statement:
!a c s k.
         FINITE s /\ k < dimindex(:'N)
         ==> (DET((FCP i. if i = k then VSUM s a else c i):real['N]['N]) =
             SUM s
               (\j. DET((FCP i. if i = k then a(j) else c i):real['N]['N])))

name: BOUNDED_FUNCTIONS_BIJECTIONS_1
statement:
!p. p IN {(y,g) | y IN s /\
                     g IN {f | (!i. i < k ==> f i IN s) /\
                               (!i. ~(i < k) ==> (f i = i))}}
       ==> (\(y,g) i. if i = k then y else g(i)) p IN
             {f | (!i. i < SUC k ==> f i IN s) /\
                  (!i. ~(i < SUC k) ==> (f i = i))} /\
           ((\h. h(k),(\i. if i = k then i else h(i)))
            ((\(y,g) i. if i = k then y else g(i)) p) = p)

name: BOUNDED_FUNCTIONS_BIJECTIONS_2
statement:
!h. h IN {f | (!i. i < SUC k ==> f i IN s) /\
                 (!i. ~(i < SUC k) ==> (f i = i))}
       ==> (\h. h(k),(\i. if i = k then i else h(i))) h IN
           {(y,g) | y IN s /\
                     g IN {f | (!i. i < k ==> f i IN s) /\
                               (!i. ~(i < k) ==> (f i = i))}} /\
           ((\(y,g) i. if i = k then y else g(i))
              ((\h. h(k),(\i. if i = k then i else h(i))) h) = h)

name: FINITE_BOUNDED_FUNCTIONS
DET_LINEAR_ROWS_VSUM_LEMMA
statement:
!s k a c.
         FINITE s /\ k <= dimindex(:'N)
         ==> (DET((FCP i. if i < k then VSUM s (a i) else c i):real['N]['N]) =
              SUM {f | (!i. i < k ==> f(i) IN s) /\
                       !i. ~(i < k) ==> (f(i) = i)}
                  (\f. DET((FCP i. if i < k then a i (f i) else c i)
                          :real['N]['N])))

name: DET_LINEAR_ROWS_VSUM
statement:
!s k a.
         FINITE s
         ==> (DET((FCP i. VSUM s (a i)):real['N]['N]) =
              SUM {f | (!i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> f(i) IN s) /\
                      !i. ~(i < dimindex(:'N)) ==> (f(i) = i)}
                 (\f. DET((FCP i. a i (f i)):real['N]['N])))

name: MATRIX_MUL_VSUM_ALT
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] B:real['N]['N]. A ** B =
                  FCP i. VSUM (count(dimindex(:'N))) (\k. A ' i ' k * B ' k)

name: DET_ROWS_MUL
statement:
!a c. DET((FCP i. c i * a i):real['N]['N]) =
         PRODUCT(count(dimindex(:'N))) (\i. c(i)) *
         DET((FCP i. a(i)):real['N]['N])

name: DET_MUL
statement: !A B:real['N]['N]. DET(A ** B) = DET(A) * DET(B)

name: INVERTIBLE_DET_NZ
statement: !A:real['N]['N]. invertible(A) <=> ~(DET A = &0)

name: DET_EQ_0
statement: !A:real['N]['N]. (DET(A) = &0) <=> ~invertible(A)

name: DET_MATRIX_EQ_0
statement:
!f:real['N]->real['N].
        linear f
        ==> ((DET(matrix f) = &0) <=>
             ~(?g. linear g /\ (f o g = I) /\ (g o f = I)))

name: DET_MATRIX_EQ_0_LEFT
statement:
!f:real['N]->real['N].
        linear f
        ==> ((DET(matrix f) = &0) <=>
             ~(?g. linear g /\ (g o f = I)))

name: DET_MATRIX_EQ_0_RIGHT
statement:
!f:real['N]->real['N].
        linear f
        ==> ((DET(matrix f) = &0) <=>
             ~(?g. linear g /\ (f o g = I)))

name: CRAMER_LEMMA_TRANSP
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] x:real['N] k.
         k < dimindex(:'N)
        ==> (DET((FCP i. if i = k
                           then VSUM (count (dimindex(:'N))) (\i. (x ' i) * ROW i A)
                           else ROW i A): real['N]['N]) =
            (x ' k) * DET A)

name: CRAMER_LEMMA
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] x:real['N] k.
        k < dimindex(:'N)
        ==> (DET((FCP i j. if j = k then (A**x) ' i else A ' i ' j):real['N]['N]) =
             x ' k * DET(A))

name: CRAMER
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] x b.
        ~(DET(A) = &0)
        ==> ((A ** x = b) <=>
             (x = FCP k.
                   DET((FCP i j. if j = k then b ' i else A ' i ' j):real['N]['N]) /
                   DET(A)))

name: LAPLACE_ROW
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] i.
      i < dimindex (:'N) ==>
          (DET(A) = SUM (count(dimindex (:'N))) (\j. (A ' i ' j ) * (ALG_COMP A i j)))

name: LAPLACE_COLUMN
statement:
!A:real['N]['N] j.
      j < dimindex (:'N) ==>
          (DET(A) = SUM (count(dimindex (:'N))) (\i. (A ' i ' j ) * (ALG_COMP A i j)))

name: LAPLACE_ROW_COROLLARY
statement:
!A:real['N]['N].
    !i j. i < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) /\ ~(i = j) ==>
        (SUM (count (dimindex(:'N))) (\k. A ' i ' k * ALG_COMP A j k) = &0)

name: LAPLACE_COLUMN_COROLLARY
statement:
!A:real['N]['N].
    !i j. i < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) /\ ~(i = j) ==>
        (SUM (count (dimindex(:'N))) (\k. A ' k ' i * ALG_COMP A k j) = &0)

name: LAPLACE_COROLLARY_LMUL
statement: !A:real['N]['N]. A ** ADJOINT_MATRIX A = DET A * MAT 1

name: LAPLACE_COROLLARY_RMUL
statement: !A:real['N]['N]. ADJOINT_MATRIX A ** A = DET A * MAT 1

name: MATRIX_INV_EXPLICIT
statement:
!A:real['N]['N].
    invertible A ==> (MATRIX_INV A = inv(DET A) * ADJOINT_MATRIX A)

name: sign_def
statement: (sign p):real = if evenperm p then &1 else - &1

name: det_def
alg_comp_def
statement:
(alg_comp:real['N]['N]-> num -> num -> real) A i j =
                DET ((FCP k l. if k = i then (if l = j then &1 else &0) else
                                (if l = j then &0 else A ' k ' l)):real['N]['N])

name: adjoint_matrix_def
statement:
(adjoint_matrix:real['N]['N]-> real['N]['N]) A =
                TRANSP(FCP i j. ALG_COMP A i j)

name: ROW_FCP
statement:
!f k. k < dimindex(:'M) ==>
        (row k ((FCP i j. f i j):real['N]['M]) = FCP j. f k j)

name: COLUMN_FCP
statement:
!f k. k < dimindex (:'N) ==>
        (column k ((FCP i j. f i j):real['N]['M]) = FCP i. f i k)

name: MATRIX_CMUL_COMPONENT
statement:
!c A:real['N]['M] i j. i < dimindex(:'M) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) ==>
                         ((c * A) ' i ' j = c * A ' i ' j)

name: MATRIX_ADD_COMPONENT
statement:
!A B:real['N]['M] i j. i < dimindex(:'M) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) ==>
                         ((A + B) ' i ' j = A ' i ' j + B ' i ' j)

name: MATRIX_SUB_COMPONENT
statement:
!A B:real['N]['M] i j. i < dimindex(:'M) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) ==>
                         ((A - B) ' i ' j = A ' i ' j - B ' i ' j)

name: MATRIX_NEG_COMPONENT
statement:
!A:real['N]['M] i j. i < dimindex(:'M) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) ==>
                       ((~A) ' i ' j = -A ' i ' j)

name: MAT_COMPONENT
statement:
!n i j. i < dimindex(:'M) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) ==>
          ((mat n:real['N]['M]) ' i ' j = if i = j then &n else &0)

name: MATRIX_CMUL_ASSOC
statement: !a b X:real['N]['M]. a * (b * X) = (a * b) * X

name: MATRIX_CMUL_LID
statement: !X:real['N]['M]. &1 * X = X

name: MATRIX_ADD_SYM
statement: !A:real['N]['M] B. A + B = B + A

name: MATRIX_ADD_ASSOC
statement: !A:real['N]['M] B C. A + (B + C) = (A + B) + C

name: MATRIX_ADD_LID
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. mat 0 + A = A

name: MATRIX_ADD_RID
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. A + mat 0 = A

name: MATRIX_ADD_LNEG
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. ~A + A = mat 0

name: MATRIX_ADD_RNEG
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. A + ~A = mat 0

name: MATRIX_SUB
statement: !A:real['N]['M] B. A - B = A + ~B

name: MATRIX_SUB_REFL
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. A - A = mat 0

name: MATRIX_ADD_LDISTRIB
statement: !A:real['P]['M] B:real['N]['P] C. A ** (B + C) = A ** B + A ** C

name: VECTOR_DOT_FCP2
statement:
!f u v. (($FCP f :real['N]) dot v) =
           sum (count (dimindex(:'N))) (\i. f i * (v ' i)) /\
          (u dot ($FCP f :real['N])) =
           sum (count (dimindex(:'N))) (\i. (u ' i) * f i)

name: MATRIX_MUL_EQ
statement:
!A:real['P]['M] B:real['N]['P] k:real.
        (FCP i j. sum (count(dimindex(:'P))) (\k. A ' i ' k * B ' k ' j)) =
        (FCP i j. (row i A) dot (column j B)): real['N]['M]

name: MATRIX_MUL_LMUL
statement: !A:real['N]['M] B:real['P]['N] c. (c * A) ** B = c * (A ** B)

name: MATRIX_MUL_RMUL
statement: !A:real['N]['M] B:real['P]['N] c. A ** (c * B) = c * (A ** B)

name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_ASSOC
statement: !A:real['N]['M] B:real['P]['N] x:real['P]. A ** B ** x = (A ** B) ** x

name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_LID
statement: !x:real['N]. (mat 1 :real['N]['N]) ** x = x

name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_LZERO
statement: !x:real['N]. (mat 0 :real['N]['M]) ** x = vec 0

name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_RZERO
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. A ** (vec 0) = (vec 0)

name: MATRIX_TRANSP_MUL
statement: !A:real['N]['M] B. transp(A ** B) = transp(B) ** transp(A)

name: MATRIX_EQ
statement: !A:real['N]['M] B. (A = B) <=> !x:real['N]. A ** x = B ** x

name: TRANSP_MAT
statement: !n. transp(mat n) = mat n :real['M]['N]

name: TRANSP_TRANSP
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. transp(transp A) = A

name: TRANSP_EQ
statement: !A B:real['N]['M]. (transp A = transp B) <=> (A = B)

name: ROW_TRANSP
statement:
!A:real['N]['M] i.
        i < dimindex(:'N) ==> (row i (transp A) = column i A)

name: COLUMN_TRANSP
statement:
!A:real['N]['M] i.
        i < dimindex(:'M) ==> (column i (transp A) = row i A)

name: ROWS_TRANSP
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. rows(transp A) = columns A

name: COLUMNS_TRANSP
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. columns(transp A) = rows A

name: VECTOR_MATRIX_MUL_TRANSP
statement: !A:real['N]['M] x:real['M]. x ** A = transp A ** x

name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_TRANSP
statement: !A:real['N]['M] x:real['N]. A ** x = x ** transp A

name: MATRIX_MUL_LID
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. mat 1 ** A = A

name: MATRIX_MUL_RID
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. A ** mat 1 = A

name: MATRIX_MUL_DOT
statement: !A:real['N]['M] x. A ** x = FCP i. A ' i dot x

name: MATRIX_MUL_VSUM
statement: !A:real['N]['M] x. A ** x = vsum(count(dimindex(:'N))) (\i. x ' i * column i A)

name: VECTOR_COMPONENTWISE
statement:
!x:real['N].
    x = FCP j. SUM(count(dimindex(:'N)))
                     (\i. x ' i * (basis i :real['N]) ' j)

name: LINEAR_COMPONENTWISE
statement:
!f:real['M]->real['N].
      linear(f)
      ==> !x j. j < dimindex(:'N)
                ==> (f x ' j =
                     SUM(count(dimindex(:'M))) (\i. x ' i * f(basis i) ' j))

name: MATRIX_INV
statement:
!A:real['N]['M].
    invertible A ==> (A ** MATRIX_INV A = mat 1) /\ (MATRIX_INV A ** A = mat 1)

name: INVERTIBLE_MATRIX_INV
statement: !A:real['N]['N]. invertible A ==> invertible(MATRIX_INV A)

name: MATRIX_RMUL_EQ
statement: !A:real['N]['M] (X Y):real['M]['P]. invertible A ==> ((X = Y) = (X ** A = Y ** A))

name: MATRIX_LMUL_EQ
statement: !A:real['N]['M] (X Y):real['P]['N]. invertible A ==> ((X = Y) = (A ** X = A ** Y))

name: MATRIX_RMUL_INV_EQ
statement:
!A:real['N]['M] (X Y):real['N]['P]. invertible A ==>
      ((X = Y) <=> (X ** MATRIX_INV A = Y ** MATRIX_INV A))

name: MATRIX_LMUL_INV_EQ
statement:
!A:real['N]['M] (X Y):real['P]['M]. invertible A ==>
       ((X = Y) <=> (MATRIX_INV A ** X = MATRIX_INV A ** Y))

name: MATRIX_EQ_RMUL
statement: !(A B C):real['N]['N]. invertible C /\ (A ** C = B ** C) ==> (A = B)

name: MATRIX_EQ_LMUL
statement: !(A B C):real['N]['N]. invertible C /\ (C ** A  = C ** B)==> (A = B)

name: MATRIX_INV_INV
statement: !(A B):real['N]['N]. invertible A ==>(MATRIX_INV(MATRIX_INV A) = A)

name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL_LINEAR
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. linear(\x. A ** x)

name: MATRIX_WORKS
statement: !f:real['M]->real['N]. linear f ==> !x. matrix f ** x = f(x)

name: MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL
statement: !f:real['M]->real['N]. linear f ==> (f = \x. matrix f ** x)

name: MATRIX_OF_MATRIX_VECTOR_MUL
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. matrix(\x. A ** x) = A

name: MATRIX_COMPOSE
statement: !f g. linear f /\ linear g ==> (matrix(g o f) = matrix g ** matrix f)

name: MATRIX_VECTOR_COLUMN
statement:
!A:real['N]['M] x.
        A ** x = vsum(count(dimindex(:'N))) (\i. x ' i * (transp A) ' i)

name: MATRIX_MUL_COMPONENT
statement:
!(A:real['N]['N]) (B:real['N]['N]) i. i < dimindex(:'N)
       ==> ((A ** B) ' i = transp B ** A ' i)

name: ADJOINT_MATRIX
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. ADJOINT(\x. A ** x) = (\x. transp A ** x)

name: MATRIX_ADJOINT
statement: !f. linear f ==> (matrix(adjoint f) = transp(matrix f))

name: MATRIX_ID
statement: matrix(\x. x) = mat 1

name: MATRIX_I
statement: matrix I = mat 1

name: LINEAR_EQ_MATRIX
statement: !f g. linear f /\ linear g /\ (matrix f = matrix g) ==> (f = g)

name: MATRIX_SELF_ADJOINT
statement: !f. linear f ==> ((adjoint f = f) <=> (transp(matrix f) = matrix f))

name: LEFT_INVERTIBLE_TRANSP
statement:
!A:real['N]['M].
    (?B:real['N]['M]. B ** transp A = mat 1) <=> (?B:real['M]['N]. A ** B = mat 1)

name: RIGHT_INVERTIBLE_TRANSP
statement:
!A:real['N]['M].
    (?B:real['N]['M]. transp A ** B = mat 1) <=> (?B:real['M]['N]. B ** A = mat 1)

name: MATRIX_LEFT_INVERTIBLE_INJECTIVE
statement:
!A:real['N]['M].
        (?B:real['M]['N]. B ** A = mat 1) <=>
        !x y:real['N]. (A ** x = A ** y) ==> (x = y)

name: MATRIX_RIGHT_INVERTIBLE_SURJECTIVE
statement:
!A:real['N]['M].
        (?B:real['M]['N]. A ** B = mat 1) <=> !y. ?x. A ** x = y

name: MATRIX_LEFT_INVERTIBLE_INDEPENDENT_COLUMNS
statement:
!A:real['N]['M]. (?B:real['M]['N]. B ** A = mat 1) <=>
                !c. (vsum(count(dimindex(:'N))) (\i. c(i) * column i A) = (vec 0)) ==>
                    !i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> (c(i) = &0)

name: MATRIX_RIGHT_INVERTIBLE_INDEPENDENT_ROWS
statement:
!A:real['N]['M]. (?B:real['M]['N]. A ** B = mat 1) <=>
                !c. (vsum(count(dimindex(:'M))) (\i. c(i) * row i A) = (vec 0)) ==>
                    !i. i < dimindex(:'M) ==> (c(i) = &0)

name: MATRIX_RIGHT_INVERTIBLE_SPAN_COLUMNS
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. (?B:real['M]['N]. A ** B = mat 1) <=> (span(columns A) = (UNIV:real['M]->bool))

name: MATRIX_LEFT_INVERTIBLE_SPAN_ROWS
statement: !A:real['N]['M]. (?B:real['M]['N]. B ** A = mat 1) <=> (span(rows A) = (UNIV:real['N]->bool))

name: MATRIX_LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE
statement: !A:real['N]['N] A':real['N]['N]. (A ** A' = mat 1) <=> (A' ** A = mat 1)

name: MATRIX_LEFT_INVERTIBLE
statement:
!f:real['M]->real['N].
    linear f ==> ((?B:real['N]['M]. B ** matrix f = mat 1) <=>
                  (?g. linear g /\ (g o f = I)))

name: MATRIX_RIGHT_INVERTIBLE
statement:
!f:real['M]->real['N].
    linear f ==> ((?B:real['N]['M]. matrix f ** B = mat 1) <=>
                  (?g. linear g /\ (f o g = I)))

name: MATRIX_INVERTIBLE
statement:
!f:real['N]->real['N].
        linear f
        ==> (invertible(matrix f) <=>
             ?g. linear g /\ (f o g = I) /\ (g o f = I))

name: MATRIX_LINV_UNIQ
statement: !A B:real['N]['N]. (A ** B = mat 1) ==> (A = MATRIX_INV B)

name: MATRIX_RINV_UNIQ
statement: !(A B):real['N]['N]. (A ** B = mat 1) ==> (B = MATRIX_INV A)

name: matrix_cmul_def
statement: matrix_cmul:real->real['N]['M]->real['N]['M] c A = FCP i j. c * A ' i ' j

name: matrix_neg_def
statement: matrix_neg:real['N]['M]->real['N]['M] A = FCP i j. -(A ' i ' j)

name: matrix_add_def
statement:
matrix_add:real['N]['M]->real['N]['M]->real['N]['M] A B =
     FCP i j. A ' i ' j + B ' i ' j

name: matrix_sub_def
statement:
matrix_sub:real['N]['M]->real['N]['M]->real['N]['M] A B =
     FCP i j. A ' i ' j - B ' i ' j

name: matrix_mul_def
statement:
matrix_mul:real['P]['M]->real['N]['P]->real['N]['M] A B =
     FCP i j. sum (count(dimindex(:'P))) (\k. A ' i ' k * B ' k ' j)

name: matrix_vector_mul_def
statement:
matrix_vector_mul:real['N]['M]->real['N]->real['M] A x =
     FCP i. sum (count(dimindex(:'N))) (\j. A ' i ' j * x ' j)

name: vector_matrix_mul_def
statement:
vector_matrix_mul:real['M]->real['N]['M]->real['N] x A =
     FCP j. sum (count(dimindex(:'M))) (\i. A ' i ' j * x ' i)

name: row_def
statement: (row:num->real['N]['M]->real['N]) i A = (FCP j. A ' i ' j ):real['N]

name: column_def
statement: (column:num->real['N]['M]->real['M]) j A = (FCP i. A ' i ' j):real['M]

name: transp_def
statement: (transp:real['N]['M]->real['M]['N]) A = (FCP i j. (A ' j ' i)):real['M]['N]

name: mat_def
statement: (mat:num->real['N]['M]) k = FCP i j. if i = j then &k else &0

name: rows_def
statement: rows (A:real['N]['M]) = {row i A | i < dimindex(:'M)}

name: columns_def
statement: columns (A:real['N]['M]) = {column i A | i < dimindex(:'N)}

name: invertible_def
statement:
invertible(A:real['N]['M]) =
        ?A':real['M]['N]. (A ** A' = mat 1) /\ (A' ** A = mat 1)

name: MATRIX_INV_DEF
statement:
MATRIX_INV(A:real['N]['M]) =
        @A':real['M]['N]. (A ** A' = mat 1) /\ (A' ** A = mat 1)

name: matrix_def
statement: (matrix:(real['M]->real['N])->real['M]['N]) f = FCP i j. f(basis j) ' i

name: FCP_MAP2_def
statement: !f x y. FCP_MAP2 f (x :'a['N]) (y :'b['N]) = (FCP i. f (x ' i) (y ' i))

name: vector_add_alt
statement: !x y. (vector_add :real['N]->real['N]->real['N]) x y = FCP_MAP2 (+) x y

name: vector_sub_alt
statement: !x y. (vector_sub :real['N]->real['N]->real['N]) x y = FCP_MAP2 (-) x y

name: vector_neg_alt
statement: !x. (vector_neg :real['N]->real['N]) x = FCP_MAP (~) x

name: vector_mul_alt
statement: !c x. (vector_mul :real -> real['N] -> real['N]) c x = FCP_MAP ($* c) x

name: dot_alt
statement:
!x y. ((x:real['N]) dot (y:real['N])) =
          SIGMA (\i. (x ' i) * (y ' i)) (count (dimindex(:'N)))

name: VEC_COMPONENT
statement: !k i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> (((vec k):real['N]) ' i = &k)

name: VECTOR_ADD_COMPONENT
statement: !x:real['N] y i. i < dimindex (:'N) ==> ((x + y) ' i = (x ' i) + (y ' i))

name: VECTOR_NEG_COMPONENT
statement: !x:real['N] i. i < dimindex (:'N) ==> ((~x) ' i = -(x ' i))

name: VECTOR_SUB_COMPONENT
statement: !x:real['N] y i. i < dimindex (:'N) ==> ((x - y) ' i = (x ' i) - (y ' i))

name: VECTOR_MUL_COMPONENT
statement: !x:real['N] c i. i < dimindex (:'N) ==> ((c * x) ' i = c * (x ' i))

name: COND_COMPONENT
statement: (if b then x else y) ' i = if b then x ' i else y ' i

name: VEC_EQ
statement: !m n. (vec m = (vec n):real['N]) <=> (m = n)

name: NEUTRAL_VECTOR_ADD
statement: neutral(+) = (vec 0):real['N]

name: MONOIDAL_VECTOR_ADD
statement: monoidal ((+):real['N]->real['N]->real['N])

name: vsum_alt
statement:
!s f. FINITE s ==>
         (vsum:('a->bool)->('a->real['N])->real['N]) s f =
          FCP i. SIGMA (\x. f(x) ' i) s

name: VSUM_CLAUSES
statement:
(!(f:'a->real['N]). vsum {} f = (vec 0)) /\
   (!x (f:'a->real['N]) s. FINITE s
            ==> vsum (x INSERT s) f =
                if x IN s then vsum s f else f(x) + vsum s f)

name: VSUM
statement: !(f:'a->real['N]) s. FINITE s ==> vsum s f = iterate (+) s f

name: VSUM_EQ_0
statement: !(f:'a->real['N]) s. (!x:'a. x IN s ==> (f(x) = (vec 0))) ==> (vsum s f = (vec 0))

name: VSUM_0
statement: (vsum:('a->bool)->('a->real['N])->real['N]) s (\x. (vec 0)) = (vec 0)

name: VSUM_LMUL
statement: !(f:'a->real['N]) c s.  vsum s (\x. c * f(x)) = c * vsum s f

name: VSUM_RMUL
statement: !(c :'a->real) s (v :real['N]). vsum s (\x. c x * v) = (sum s c) * v

name: VSUM_ADD
statement: !(f:'a->real['N]) g s. FINITE s ==> (vsum s (\x. f x + g x) = vsum s f + vsum s g)

name: VSUM_SUB
statement: !(f:'a->real['N]) g s. FINITE s ==> (vsum s (\x. f x - g x) = vsum s f - vsum s g)

name: VSUM_COMPONENT
statement: !s f i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> (vsum s (f:'a->real['N])) ' i = sum s (\x. f(x) ' i)

name: VSUM_IMAGE
statement:
!(f :'a->'b) (g :'b->real['N]) s.
        FINITE s /\ (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ (f x = f y) ==> (x = y))
           ==> (vsum (IMAGE f s) g = vsum s (g o f))

name: VSUM_DELETE
statement:
!(f:'a->real['N]) s a. FINITE s /\ a IN s
           ==> (vsum (s DELETE a) f = vsum s f - f a)

name: VSUM_NEG
statement: !(f:'a->real['N]) s. vsum s (\x. ~f x) = ~vsum s f

name: VSUM_EQ
statement: !(f:'a->real['N]) g s. (!x. x IN s ==> (f x = g x)) ==> (vsum s f = vsum s g)

name: VSUM_DELETE_CASES
statement:
!x (f:'a->real['N]) s.
        FINITE(s:'a->bool)
        ==> (vsum (s DELETE x) f = if x IN s then vsum s f - f x else vsum s f)

name: VSUM_RESTRICT_SET
statement:
!P s (f:'a->real['N]).
           vsum {x | x IN s /\ P x} f =
           vsum s (\x. if P x then f x else (vec 0))

name: BASIS_INJ
statement:
!i j. i < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) /\ (basis i :real['N] = basis j)
     ==> i = j

name: BASIS_NE
statement:
!i j. i < dimindex(:'N) /\ j < dimindex(:'N) /\ ~(i = j)
     ==> ~(basis i :real['N] = basis j)

name: BASIS_COMPONENT
statement:
!k i. i < dimindex(:'N)
         ==> ((basis k :real['N]) ' i = if i = k then &1 else &0)

name: BASIS_EXPANSION
statement: !(x:real['N]). vsum (count(dimindex(:'N))) (\i. x ' i * basis i) = x

name: BASIS_EXPANSION_UNIQUE
statement:
!u (x:real['N]).
        (vsum (count(dimindex(:'N))) (\i. f(i) * basis i) = x) <=>
        (!i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> (f(i) = x ' i))

name: DOT_BASIS
statement:
!x:real['N] i. i < dimindex(:'N) ==> (((basis i) dot x) = x ' i) /\
                                        ((x dot (basis i)) = x ' i)

name: VECTOR_EQ_LDOT
statement: !y z:real['N]. (!x. (x dot y) = (x dot z)) <=> (y = z)

name: VECTOR_EQ_RDOT
statement: !x y:real['N]. (!z. (x dot z) = (y dot z)) <=> (x = y)

name: LINEAR_COMPOSE_CMUL
statement: !(f:real['M]->real['N]) c. linear f ==> linear (\x. c * f(x))

name: LINEAR_COMPOSE_NEG
statement: !(f:real['M]->real['N]). linear f ==> linear (\x. ~(f(x)))

name: LINEAR_COMPOSE_ADD
statement: !(f:real['M]->real['N]) g. linear f /\ linear g ==> linear (\x. f(x) + g(x))

name: LINEAR_COMPOSE_SUB
statement: !(f:real['M]->real['N]) g. linear f /\ linear g ==> linear (\x. f(x) - g(x))

name: LINEAR_COMPOSE
statement: !(f:real['M]->real['N]) g. linear f /\ linear g ==> linear (g o f)

name: LINEAR_ID
statement: linear (\x. x:real['N])

name: LINEAR_I
statement: linear (I :real['N]->real['N])

name: LINEAR_ZERO
statement: linear ((\x. (vec 0)):real['M]->real['N])

name: LINEAR_NEGATION
statement: linear ((~) :real['N]->real['N])

name: LINEAR_COMPOSE_VSUM
statement:
!(f :'a->real['M]->real['N]) s.
         FINITE s /\ (!a. a IN s ==> linear(f a))
         ==> linear(\x. vsum s (\a. f a x))

name: LINEAR_VMUL_COMPONENT
statement:
!(f:real['M]->real['N]) v k.
     linear f /\ k < dimindex(:'N)
     ==> linear (\x. f(x) ' k * v)

name: LINEAR_0
statement: !(f:real['M]->real['N]). linear f ==> (f((vec 0)) = (vec 0))

name: LINEAR_CMUL
statement: !(f:real['M]->real['N]) c x. linear f ==> (f(c * x) = c * f(x))

name: LINEAR_NEG
statement: !(f:real['M]->real['N]) x. linear f ==> (f(~x) = ~(f x))

name: LINEAR_ADD
statement: !(f:real['M]->real['N]) x y. linear f ==> (f(x + y) = f(x) + f(y))

name: LINEAR_SUB
statement: !(f:real['M]->real['N]) x y. linear f ==> (f(x - y) = f(x) - f(y))

name: LINEAR_VSUM
statement: !(f:real['M]->real['N]) g s. linear f /\ FINITE s ==> (f(vsum s g) = vsum s (f o g))

name: LINEAR_VSUM_MUL
statement:
!(f:real['M]->real['N]) s c v.
        linear f /\ FINITE s
        ==> (f(vsum s (\i. c i * v i)) = vsum s (\i. c(i) * f(v i)))

name: SYMMETRIC_LINEAR_IMAGE
statement:
!(f:real['M]->real['N]) s. (!x. x IN s ==> ~x IN s) /\ linear f
          ==> !x. x IN (IMAGE f s) ==> ~x IN (IMAGE f s)

name: BILINEAR_SWAP
statement:
!(h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]).
        bilinear(\x y. h y x) <=> bilinear h

name: BILINEAR_LADD
statement:
!(h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]) x y z.
      bilinear h ==> h (x + y) z = (h x z) + (h y z)

name: BILINEAR_RADD
statement:
!(h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]) x y z.
      bilinear h ==> h x (y + z) = (h x y) + (h x z)

name: BILINEAR_LMUL
statement:
!(h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]) c x y.
      bilinear h ==> h (c * x) y = c * (h x y)

name: BILINEAR_RMUL
statement:
!(h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]) c x y.
      bilinear h ==> h x (c * y) = c * (h x y)

name: BILINEAR_LNEG
statement: !(h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]) x y. bilinear h ==> h (~x) y = ~(h x y)

name: BILINEAR_RNEG
statement: !(h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]) x y. bilinear h ==> h x (~y) = ~(h x y)

name: BILINEAR_LZERO
statement: !(h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]) x. bilinear h ==> h (vec 0) x = vec 0

name: BILINEAR_RZERO
statement: !(h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]) x. bilinear h ==> h x (vec 0) = vec 0

name: BILINEAR_LSUB
statement:
!(h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]) x y z.
      bilinear h ==> h (x - y) z = (h x z) - (h y z)

name: BILINEAR_RSUB
statement:
!(h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]) x y z.
      bilinear h ==> h x (y - z) = (h x y) - (h x z)

name: ADJOINT_WORKS
statement: !f:real['M]->real['N]. linear f ==> !x y. (f(x) dot y) = (x dot (adjoint f)(y))

name: ADJOINT_LINEAR
statement: !f:real['M]->real['N]. linear f ==> linear(adjoint f)

name: ADJOINT_CLAUSES
statement:
!f:real['M]->real['N].
     linear f ==> (!x y. (x dot (adjoint f)(y)) = (f(x) dot y)) /\
                  (!x y. ((adjoint f)(y) dot x) = (y dot f(x)))

name: ADJOINT_ADJOINT
statement: !f:real['M]->real['N]. linear f ==> (adjoint(adjoint f) = f)

name: ADJOINT_UNIQUE
statement:
!(f:real['M]->real['N]) f'. linear f /\ (!x y. (f'(x) dot y) = (x dot f(y)))
          ==> (f' = adjoint f)

name: SUBSPACE_UNIV
statement: subspace(UNIV:real['N]->bool)

name: SUBSPACE_IMP_NONEMPTY
statement: !(s :real['N]->bool). subspace s ==> ~(s = {})

name: SUBSPACE_0
statement: !(s :real['N]->bool). subspace s ==> (vec 0) IN s

name: SUBSPACE_ADD
statement: !x y (s :real['N]->bool). subspace s /\ x IN s /\ y IN s ==> (x + y) IN s

name: SUBSPACE_MUL
statement: !x c (s :real['N]->bool). subspace s /\ x IN s ==> (c * x) IN s

name: SUBSPACE_NEG
statement: !x (s :real['N]->bool). subspace s /\ x IN s ==> (~x) IN s

name: SUBSPACE_SUB
statement: !x y (s :real['N]->bool). subspace s /\ x IN s /\ y IN s ==> (x - y) IN s

name: SUBSPACE_VSUM
statement:
!(s :real['N]->bool) f t. subspace s /\ FINITE t /\ (!x. x IN t ==> f(x) IN s)
           ==> (vsum t f) IN s

name: SUBSPACE_LINEAR_IMAGE
statement: !f (s :real['N]->bool). linear f /\ subspace s ==> subspace(IMAGE f s)

name: SUBSPACE_LINEAR_PREIMAGE
statement: !f (s :real['N]->bool). linear f /\ subspace s ==> subspace {x | f(x) IN s}

name: SPAN_SPAN
statement: !(s :real['N]->bool). span(span s) = span s

name: SPAN_MONO
statement: !(s :real['N]->bool) t. s SUBSET t ==> span s SUBSET span t

name: SUBSPACE_SPAN
statement: !(s :real['N]->bool). subspace(span s)

name: SPAN_CLAUSES
statement:
(!a s. a IN (s :real['N]->bool) ==> a IN span s) /\
   ((vec 0) IN span (s :real['N]->bool)) /\
   (!x y s. x IN span (s :real['N]->bool) /\ y IN span s ==> (x + y) IN span s) /\
   (!x c s. x IN span (s :real['N]->bool) ==> (c * x) IN span s)

name: SPAN_INDUCT
statement:
!(s :real['N]->bool) h.
       (!x. x IN s ==> x IN h) /\ subspace h ==> !x. x IN span(s) ==> h(x)

name: SPAN_EMPTY
statement: span ({} :real['N]->bool) = {(vec 0)}

name: INDEPENDENT_EMPTY
statement: independent ({} :real['N]->bool)

name: INDEPENDENT_NONZERO
statement: !s. independent (s :real['N]->bool) ==> ~((vec 0) IN s)

name: INDEPENDENT_MONO
statement: !s t:real['N]->bool. independent t /\ s SUBSET t ==> independent s

name: DEPENDENT_MONO
statement: !s t:real['N]->bool. dependent s /\ s SUBSET t ==> dependent t

name: SPAN_SUBSPACE
statement: !b s:real['N]->bool. b SUBSET s /\ s SUBSET (span b) /\ subspace s ==> (span b = s)

name: SPAN_INDUCT_ALT
statement:
!(s :real['N]->bool) h. h((vec 0)) /\
         (!c x y. x IN s /\ h(y) ==> h(c * x + y))
          ==> !x:real['N]. x IN span(s) ==> h(x)

name: SPAN_SUPERSET
statement: !x. x IN (s :real['N]->bool) ==> x IN span s

name: SPAN_INC
statement: !s. s SUBSET span (s :real['N]->bool)

name: SPAN_UNION_SUBSET
statement: !(s :real['N]->bool) t. span s UNION span t SUBSET span(s UNION t)

name: SPAN_UNIV
statement: span(UNIV:real['N]->bool) = (UNIV:real['N]->bool)

name: SPAN_0
statement: (vec 0) IN span (s :real['N]->bool)

name: SPAN_ADD
statement: !x y (s :real['N]->bool). x IN span s /\ y IN span s ==> (x + y) IN span s

name: SPAN_MUL
statement: !x c s. x IN span s ==> (c * x) IN span (s :real['N]->bool)

name: SPAN_MUL_EQ
statement: !x:real['N] c s. ~(c = &0) ==> ((c * x) IN span s <=> x IN span s)

name: SPAN_NEG
statement: !x s. x IN span s ==> (~x) IN span (s :real['N]->bool)

name: SPAN_NEG_EQ
statement: !x s. ~x IN span s <=> x IN span (s :real['N]->bool)

name: SPAN_SUB
statement: !x y s. x IN span s /\ y IN span s ==> (x - y) IN span (s :real['N]->bool)

name: SPAN_VSUM
statement:
!s f t. FINITE t /\ (!x. x IN t ==> f(x) IN span(s))
           ==> (vsum t f) IN span (s :real['N]->bool)

name: SPAN_ADD_EQ
statement: !(s :real['N]->bool) x y. x IN span s ==> ((x + y) IN span s <=> y IN span s)

name: SPAN_EQ_SELF
statement: !s. (span s = s) <=> subspace (s :real['N]->bool)

name: SPAN_SUBSET_SUBSPACE
statement: !s t:real['N]->bool. s SUBSET t /\ subspace t ==> span s SUBSET t

name: SUBSPACE_TRANSLATION_SELF
statement: !(s :real['N]->bool) a. subspace s /\ a IN s ==> (IMAGE (\x. a + x) s = s)

name: SUBSPACE_TRANSLATION_SELF_EQ
statement: !s a:real['N]. subspace s ==> ((IMAGE (\x. a + x) s = s) <=> a IN s)

name: SUBSPACE_SUMS
statement:
!s t. subspace s /\ subspace t
         ==> subspace {x + y | x IN s /\ y IN t}

name: SPAN_UNION
statement: !s t. span(s UNION t) = {x + y:real['N] | x IN span s /\ y IN span t}

name: SPAN_LINEAR_IMAGE
statement: !f:real['M]->real['N] s. linear f ==> (span(IMAGE f s) = IMAGE f (span s))

name: SPAN_BREAKDOWN
statement:
!b s a:real['N].
      b IN s /\ a IN span s ==> ?k. (a - k * b) IN span(s DELETE b)

name: SPAN_BREAKDOWN_EQ
statement: !a:real['N] s. (x IN span(a INSERT s) <=> (?k. (x - k * a) IN span s))

name: SPAN_INSERT_0
statement: !s. span((vec 0) INSERT s) = span (s :real['N]->bool)

name: SPAN_SING
statement: !(a :real['N]). span {a} = {u * a | u IN (UNIV:real set)}

name: IN_SPAN_INSERT
statement:
!a b:real['N] s.
        a IN span(b INSERT s) /\ ~(a IN span s) ==> b IN span(a INSERT s)

name: IN_SPAN_DELETE
statement:
!a b (s :real['N]->bool).
         a IN span s /\ ~(a IN span (s DELETE b))
         ==> b IN span (a INSERT (s DELETE b))

name: EQ_SPAN_INSERT_EQ
statement: !s x y:real['N]. (x - y) IN span s ==> (span(x INSERT s) = span(y INSERT s))

name: SPAN_TRANS
statement: !x y:real['N] s. x IN span(s) /\ y IN span(x INSERT s) ==> y IN span(s)

name: SPAN_EXPLICIT
statement:
!(p:real['N] -> bool).
        span p =
         {y | ?s u. FINITE s /\ s SUBSET p /\
                    (vsum s (\v. u v * v) = y)}

name: DEPENDENT_EXPLICIT
statement:
!p. dependent (p:real['N]-> bool) <=>
                ?s u. FINITE s /\ s SUBSET p /\
                      (?v. v IN s /\ ~(u v = &0)) /\
                      (vsum s (\v. u v * v) = (vec 0))

name: DEPENDENT_FINITE
statement:
!s:real['N]->bool.
        FINITE s
        ==> (dependent s <=> ?u. (?v. v IN s /\ ~(u v = &0)) /\
                                 (vsum s (\v. u(v) * v) = (vec 0)))

name: SPAN_FINITE
statement:
!s:real['N]->bool.
        FINITE s ==> (span s = {y | ?u. vsum s (\v. u v * v) = y})

name: SPAN_STDBASIS
statement: span {basis i :real['N] | i < dimindex(:'N)} = UNIV

name: HAS_SIZE_STDBASIS
statement: {basis i :real['N] | i < dimindex(:'N)} HAS_SIZE dimindex(:'N)

name: FINITE_STDBASIS
statement: FINITE {basis i :real['N] |i < dimindex(:'N)}

name: CARD_STDBASIS
statement: CARD {basis i :real['N] |i < dimindex(:'N)} = dimindex(:'N)

name: IN_SPAN_IMAGE_BASIS
statement:
!x:real['N] s.
        x IN span(IMAGE basis s) <=>
          !i. i < dimindex(:'N) /\ ~(i IN s) ==>(x ' i = &0)

name: INDEPENDENT_STDBASIS
statement: independent {basis i :real['N] | i < dimindex(:'N)}

name: INDEPENDENT_INSERT
SPANNING_SUBSET_INDEPENDENT
statement:
!s t:real['N]->bool.
        t SUBSET s /\ independent s /\ s SUBSET span(t) ==> (s = t)

name: EXCHANGE_LEMMA
statement:
!s t:real['N]->bool.
        FINITE t /\ independent s /\ s SUBSET span t
        ==> ?t'. (t' HAS_SIZE (CARD t)) /\
                 s SUBSET t' /\ t' SUBSET (s UNION t) /\ s SUBSET (span t')

name: INDEPENDENT_SPAN_BOUND
statement:
!(s :real['N]->bool) t. FINITE t /\ independent s /\ s SUBSET span(t)
         ==> FINITE s /\ CARD(s) <= CARD(t)

name: INDEPENDENT_BOUND
statement:
!s:real['N]->bool.
        independent s ==> FINITE s /\ CARD(s) <= dimindex(:'N)

name: DEPENDENT_BIGGERSET
statement: !s:real['N]->bool. (FINITE s ==> CARD(s) > dimindex(:'N)) ==> dependent s

name: INDEPENDENT_IMP_FINITE
statement: !s:real['N]->bool. independent s ==> FINITE s

name: INDEPENDENT_EXPLICIT
statement:
!b:real['N]->bool.
        independent b <=>
            FINITE b /\
            !c. (vsum b (\v. c(v) * v) = (vec 0)) ==> !v. v IN b ==> (c(v) = &0)

name: MAXIMAL_INDEPENDENT_SUBSET_EXTEND
statement:
!s v:real['N]->bool.
        s SUBSET v /\ independent s
        ==> ?b. s SUBSET b /\ b SUBSET v /\ independent b /\
                v SUBSET (span b)

name: MAXIMAL_INDEPENDENT_SUBSET
statement: !v:real['N]->bool. ?b. b SUBSET v /\ independent b /\ v SUBSET (span b)

name: BASIS_EXISTS
statement:
!v. ?b. b SUBSET v /\ independent b /\ v SUBSET (span b) /\
           (b HAS_SIZE (dim v))

name: BASIS_EXISTS_FINITE
statement:
!v. ?b. FINITE b /\
           b SUBSET v /\
           independent b /\
           v SUBSET (span b) /\
           (b HAS_SIZE (dim v))

name: BASIS_SUBSPACE_EXISTS
statement:
!s:real['N]->bool.
        subspace s
        ==> ?b. FINITE b /\
                b SUBSET s /\
                independent b /\
                (span b = s) /\
                (b HAS_SIZE dim s)

name: INDEPENDENT_CARD_LE_DIM
statement:
!v b:real['N]->bool.
        b SUBSET v /\ independent b ==> FINITE b /\ CARD(b) <= dim v

name: SPAN_CARD_GE_DIM
statement:
!v b:real['N]->bool.
        v SUBSET (span b) /\ FINITE b ==> dim(v) <= CARD(b)

name: CARD_GE_DIM_INDEPENDENT
statement:
!v b:real['N]->bool.
        b SUBSET v /\ independent b /\ dim v <= CARD(b)
        ==> v SUBSET (span b)

name: CARD_LE_DIM_SPANNING
statement:
!v b:real['N]->bool.
        v SUBSET (span b) /\ FINITE b /\ CARD(b) <= dim v
        ==> independent b

name: SPANS_IMAGE
statement:
!f b v. linear f /\ v SUBSET (span b)
           ==> (IMAGE f v) SUBSET span(IMAGE f b)

name: SPANNING_SURJECTIVE_IMAGE
statement:
!f:real['M]->real['N] s.
        UNIV SUBSET (span s) /\ linear f /\ (!y. ?x. f(x) = y)
        ==> UNIV SUBSET span(IMAGE f s)

name: INDEPENDENT_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_GEN
statement:
!f:real['M]->real['N] s.
        independent s /\ linear f /\
        (!x y. x IN span s /\ y IN span s /\ (f(x) = f(y)) ==> (x = y))
        ==> independent (IMAGE f s)

name: INDEPENDENT_INJECTIVE_IMAGE
statement:
!f:real['M]->real['N] s.
        independent s /\ linear f /\ (!x y. (f(x) = f(y)) ==> (x = y))
        ==> independent (IMAGE f s)

name: LINEAR_INDEP_IMAGE_LEMMA
statement:
!f b. linear(f:real['M]->real['N]) /\
         FINITE b /\
         independent (IMAGE f b) /\
         (!x y. x IN b /\ y IN b /\ (f x = f y) ==> (x = y))
         ==> !x. x IN span b ==> (f(x) = (vec 0)) ==> (x = (vec 0))

name: LINEAR_INDEPENDENT_EXTEND_LEMMA
statement:
!f b. FINITE b
         ==> independent b
             ==> ?g:real['M]->real['N].
                        (!x y. x IN span b /\ y IN span b
                                ==> (g(x + y) = g(x) + g(y))) /\
                        (!x c. x IN span b ==> (g(c * x) = c * g(x))) /\
                        (!x. x IN b ==> (g x = f x))

name: LINEAR_INDEPENDENT_EXTEND
statement:
!f b. independent b
         ==> ?g:real['M]->real['N]. linear g /\ (!x. x IN b ==> (g x = f x))

name: SUBSPACE_KERNEL
statement: !f. linear f ==> subspace {x | f(x) = (vec 0)}

name: LINEAR_EQ_0_SPAN
statement:
!f:real['M]->real['N] b.
        linear f /\ (!x. x IN b ==> (f(x) = (vec 0)))
        ==> !x. x IN span(b) ==> (f(x) = (vec 0))

name: LINEAR_EQ_0
statement:
!f b (s :real['N]->bool).
           linear f /\ s SUBSET (span b) /\ (!x. x IN b ==> (f(x) = (vec 0)))
           ==> !x. x IN s ==> (f(x) = (vec 0))

name: LINEAR_EQ
statement:
!f g b (s :real['N]->bool). linear f /\ linear g /\ s SUBSET (span b) /\
             (!x. x IN b ==> (f(x) = g(x)))
              ==> !x. x IN s ==> (f(x) = g(x))

name: LINEAR_EQ_STDBASIS
statement:
!f:real['M]->real['N] g.
        linear f /\ linear g /\
        (!i. i < dimindex(:'M)
             ==> (f(basis i) = g(basis i)))
        ==> (f = g)

name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_IMP_SURJECTIVE
statement:
!f:real['N]->real['N].
        linear f /\ (!x y. (f(x) = f(y)) ==> (x = y))
        ==> !y. ?x. f(x) = y

name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_IMP_INJECTIVE
statement:
!f:real['N]->real['N].
        linear f /\ (!y. ?x. f(x) = y)
        ==> !x y. (f(x) = f(y)) ==> (x = y)

name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_IFF_INJECTIVE
statement:
!f:real['N]->real['N].
      linear f ==> ((!y. ?x. f x = y) <=> (!x y. (f x = f y) ==> (x = y)))

name: LEFT_RIGHT_INVERSE_EQ
statement: !f:'a->'a g h. (f o g = I) /\ (g o h = I) ==> (f = h)

name: ISOMORPHISM_EXPAND
statement: !f g. (f o g = I) /\ (g o f = I) <=> (!x. f(g x) = x) /\ (!x. g(f x) = x)

name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_LEFT_INVERSE
statement:
!f:real['M]->real['N].
        linear f /\ (!x y. (f x = f y) ==> (x = y))
        ==> ?g. linear g /\ (g o f = I)

name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_RIGHT_INVERSE
statement:
!f:real['M]->real['N].
        linear f /\ (!y. ?x. f x = y) ==> ?g. linear g /\ (f o g = I)

name: LINEAR_INJECTIVE_ISOMORPHISM
statement:
!f:real['N]->real['N].
        linear f /\ (!x y. (f x = f y) ==> (x = y))
        ==> ?f'. linear f' /\ (!x. f'(f x) = x) /\ (!x. f(f' x) = x)

name: LINEAR_SURJECTIVE_ISOMORPHISM
statement:
!f:real['N]->real['N].
        linear f /\ (!y. ?x. f x = y)
        ==> ?f'. linear f' /\ (!x. f'(f x) = x) /\ (!x. f(f' x) = x)

name: LINEAR_INVERSE_LEFT
statement:
!f:real['N]->real['N] f'.
        linear f /\ linear f' ==> ((f o f' = I) <=> (f' o f = I))

name: vector_add_def
statement: (vector_add :real['N]->real['N]->real['N]) x y = FCP i. x ' i + y ' i

name: vector_sub_def
statement: (vector_sub :real['N]->real['N]->real['N]) x y = FCP i. x ' i - y ' i

name: vector_neg_def
statement: (vector_neg :real['N]->real['N]) x = FCP i. ~(x ' i)

name: FCP_MAP2
statement: FCP_MAP2 f (x :'a['N]) (y :'b['N]) = FCP_MAP (UNCURRY f) (FCP_ZIP x y)

name: vector_mul_def
statement: (vector_mul :real -> real['N] -> real['N]) c x = FCP i. c * x ' i

name: vec_def
statement: (vec :num -> real['N]) n = FCP i. &n

name: dot_def
statement:
((x:real['N]) dot (y:real['N])) =
     SUM (count(dimindex(:'N))) (\i. (x ' i) * (y ' i))

name: vsum_def
statement: (vsum:('a->bool)->('a->real['N])->real['N]) s f = FCP i. sum s (\x. f(x) ' i)

name: basis_def
statement: basis k = ((FCP i. if i = k then &1 else &0):real['N])

name: linear_def
statement:
vec_linear (f:real['M]->real['N]) =
       ((!x y. f(x + y) = f(x) + f(y)) /\
        (!c x. f(c * x) = c * f(x)))

name: bilinear_def
statement:
vec_bilinear (h:real['M]->real['N]->real['P]) =
     ((!x. linear(\y. h x y)) /\ (!y. linear (\x. h x y)))

name: adjoint_def
statement: adjoint(f:real['M]->real['N]) = @f'. !x y. (f(x) dot y) = (x dot f'(y))

name: subspace_def
statement:
vector_subspace s =
       ((vec 0) IN s /\
        (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s ==> (x + y) IN s) /\
        (!c x. x IN s ==> (c * x) IN s))

name: span_def
statement: vector_span s = (vector_subspace hull s)

name: dependent_def
statement: vector_dependent s = (?a. a IN s /\ a IN vector_span(s DELETE a))

name: independent_def
statement: vector_independent s = ~(vector_dependent s)

name: dim_def
index_invariant
statement: index z < size z

name: size_nonzero
statement: 0 < size z

name: LENGTH_toList
statement: LENGTH (toList z) = size z

name: moveLeft_invariant
statement: toList (moveLeft z) = toList z ∧ size (moveLeft z) = size z

name: size_zmap
statement: size (zmap f z) = size z

name: index_zmap
statement: index (zmap f z) = index z

name: zmap_zmap_o
statement: zmap f (zmap g z) = zmap (f o g) z

name: zmap_ID
statement: zmap (λx. x) z = z

name: focus_def
statement: focus (Z p a s) = a

name: toList_def
statement: toList (Z p a s) = REVERSE p ++ [a] ++ s

name: size_def
statement: size (Z p a s) = LENGTH p + LENGTH s + 1

name: index_def
statement: index (Z p a s) = LENGTH p

name: moveLeft_def
statement:
(moveLeft (Z [] a s) = Z [] a s) ∧
  (moveLeft (Z (h::t) a s) = Z t h (a::s))

name: moveRight_def
statement:
(moveRight (Z p a []) = Z p a []) ∧
  (moveRight (Z p a (h::t)) = Z (a::p) h t)

name: zmap_def
statement: zmap f (Z p a s) = Z (MAP f p) (f a) (MAP f s)

name: enc2dec_some
statement:
!p e l x t.
       wf_encoder p e ==>
       ((enc2dec p e l = SOME (x, t)) <=> p x /\ (l = APPEND (e x) t))

name: dec2enc_some
statement:
!p d x l.
       wf_decoder p d ==>
       ((dec2enc d x = l) /\ p x <=> (d l = SOME (x, [])))

name: dec_bnum_lt
statement: !m l n t. (dec_bnum m l = SOME (n, t)) ==> n < 2 ** m

name: decode_bnum
statement:
wf_pred_bnum m p ==>
     (decode_bnum m p l =
      case dec_bnum m l of NONE => NONE
      | SOME (n, t) => if p n then SOME (n, t) else NONE)

name: biprefix_cons
statement: !a b c d. biprefix (a :: b) (c :: d) <=> (a = c) /\ biprefix b d

name: encode_list_cong
statement:
!l1 l2 f1 f2.
      (l1=l2) /\ (!x. MEM x l2 ==> (f1 x = f2 x))
              ==>
      (encode_list f1 l1 = encode_list f2 l2)

name: lift_blist_suc
statement: !n p h t. lift_blist (SUC n) p (h :: t) <=> p h /\ lift_blist n p t

name: encode_bnum_inj
statement:
!m x y.
    x < 2 ** m /\ y < 2 ** m /\ encode_bnum m x = encode_bnum m y ==>
    x = y

name: BAG_MERGE_SUB_BAG_UNION
statement: !s t. (SUB_BAG (BAG_MERGE s t) (s + t))

name: BAG_MERGE_EMPTY
statement: !b. ((BAG_MERGE {||} b) = b) /\ ((BAG_MERGE b {||}) = b)

name: BAG_MERGE_ELBAG_SUB_BAG_INSERT
statement: !A b. SUB_BAG (BAG_MERGE {|A|} b) (BAG_INSERT A b)

name: BAG_INSERT_EQ_MERGE_DIFF
statement:
!a b c e. (BAG_INSERT e a = BAG_MERGE b c)
        ==> ((BAG_MERGE b c = BAG_INSERT e (BAG_MERGE (b - {|e|}) (c - {|e|}))))

name: BAG_MERGE_BAG_INSERT
statement:
!e a b.
    ((a e <= b e)
      ==> ((BAG_MERGE a (BAG_INSERT e b)) = (BAG_INSERT e (BAG_MERGE a b)))) /\
    ((b e < a e) ==> ((BAG_MERGE a (BAG_INSERT e b)) = (BAG_MERGE a b))) /\
    ((a e < b e) ==> ((BAG_MERGE (BAG_INSERT e a) b) = ((BAG_MERGE a b)))) /\
    ((b e <= a e)
      ==> ((BAG_MERGE (BAG_INSERT e a) b) = (BAG_INSERT e (BAG_MERGE a b)))) /\
    ((a e = b e)
      ==> ((BAG_MERGE (BAG_INSERT e a) (BAG_INSERT e b))
            = (BAG_INSERT e (BAG_MERGE a b))))

name: BAG_IN_BAG_INSERT
statement:
!b e1 e2:'a.
        BAG_IN e1 (BAG_INSERT e2 b) <=> (e1 = e2) \/ BAG_IN e1 b

name: BAG_INN_BAG_INSERT
statement:
!b e1 e2:'a. BAG_INN e1 n (BAG_INSERT e2 b) <=>
                   BAG_INN e1 (n - 1) b /\ (e1 = e2) \/
                   BAG_INN e1 n b

name: BAG_INN_BAG_INSERT_STRONG
statement:
!b n e1 e2.
        BAG_INN e1 n (BAG_INSERT e2 b) <=>
          BAG_INN e1 (n - 1) b /\ (e1 = e2) \/
          BAG_INN e1 n b /\ e1 <> e2

name: BAG_IN_BAG_UNION
statement: !b1 b2 e. BAG_IN e (BAG_UNION b1 b2) <=> BAG_IN e b1 \/ BAG_IN e b2

name: BAG_IN_BAG_MERGE
statement: !e b1 b2. BAG_IN e (BAG_MERGE b1 b2) <=> BAG_IN e b1 \/ BAG_IN e b2

name: BAG_DELETE_concrete
statement:
!b0 b e. BAG_DELETE b0 e b <=>
               b0 e > 0 /\ (b = \x. if (x = e) then b0 e - 1 else b0 x)

name: BAG_MEMBER_NOT_EMPTY
statement: !b. (?x. BAG_IN x b) <=> b <> EMPTY_BAG

name: BAG_OF_SET_UNION
statement: !b b'. BAG_OF_SET (b UNION b') = (BAG_MERGE (BAG_OF_SET b) (BAG_OF_SET b'))

name: BAG_OF_SET_DISJOINT_UNION
statement:
!s1 s2. DISJOINT s1 s2 ==>
  BAG_OF_SET (s1 UNION s2) = BAG_UNION (BAG_OF_SET s1) (BAG_OF_SET s2)

name: BAG_OF_SET_INSERT
statement: !e s. BAG_OF_SET (e INSERT s) = BAG_MERGE {|e|} (BAG_OF_SET s)

name: BAG_OF_SET_INSERT_NON_ELEMENT
statement:
!e s. e NOTIN s ==>
        BAG_OF_SET (e INSERT s) = BAG_INSERT e (BAG_OF_SET s)

name: BAG_OF_SET_BAG_DIFF_DIFF
statement: !b s. (BAG_OF_SET s) - b = (BAG_OF_SET (s DIFF (SET_OF_BAG b)))

name: SET_OF_SINGLETON_BAG
statement: !e. SET_OF_BAG {|e|} = {e}

name: BAG_IN_BAG_OF_SET
statement: !P p. BAG_IN p (BAG_OF_SET P) <=> p IN P

name: SET_OF_EL_BAG
statement: !e. SET_OF_BAG (EL_BAG e) = {e}

name: IN_SET_OF_BAG
statement: !x b. x IN SET_OF_BAG b <=> BAG_IN x b

name: SET_OF_BAG_SING
statement: !b e. SET_OF_BAG b = {e} <=> ?n. 0 < n /\ b = \x. if x = e then n else 0

name: BAG_OF_SET_EQ_INSERT
statement: !e b s. (BAG_INSERT e b = BAG_OF_SET s) ==> (?s'. s = (e INSERT s'))

name: FINITE_BAG_UNION
statement:
!b1 b2. FINITE_BAG (BAG_UNION b1 b2) <=>
            FINITE_BAG b1 /\ FINITE_BAG b2

name: FINITE_BAG_MERGE
statement: !a b. FINITE_BAG (BAG_MERGE a b) <=> FINITE_BAG a /\ FINITE_BAG b

name: FINITE_EL_BAG
statement: FINITE_BAG (EL_BAG e)

name: BAG_MERGE_CARD
statement:
!a b. FINITE_BAG a /\ FINITE_BAG b ==>
        BAG_CARD (BAG_MERGE a b) <= (BAG_CARD a + BAG_CARD b)

name: BAG_FILTER_BAG_UNION
statement:
BAG_FILTER P (BAG_UNION b1 b2) =
  BAG_UNION (BAG_FILTER P b1) (BAG_FILTER P b2)

name: BAG_OF_SET_DIFF
statement: !b b'. BAG_OF_SET (b DIFF b') = BAG_FILTER (COMPL b') (BAG_OF_SET b)

name: BAG_FILTER_BAG_OF_SET
statement: !P s. BAG_FILTER P (BAG_OF_SET s) = BAG_OF_SET (s INTER { x | P x })

name: BAG_FILTER_SPLIT
statement: !s b. BAG_UNION (BAG_FILTER s b) (BAG_FILTER (COMPL s) b) = b

name: FINITE_BAG_OF_SET
statement: !s. FINITE_BAG (BAG_OF_SET s) <=> FINITE s

name: BAG_CARD_BAG_OF_SET
statement: !s. FINITE s ==> BAG_CARD (BAG_OF_SET s) = CARD s

name: SET_OF_BAG_SING_CARD
statement: !b e. SET_OF_BAG b = {e} ==> BAG_CARD b = b e

name: BAG_OF_SET_INJ
statement: !s1 s2. BAG_OF_SET s1 = BAG_OF_SET s2 <=> s1 = s2

name: BAG_IMAGE_CONG
statement:
!f1 b1 f2 b2.
  b1 = b2 /\ (!x. BAG_IN x b1 ==> f1 x = f2 x)
  ==>
  BAG_IMAGE f1 b1 = BAG_IMAGE f2 b2

name: BAG_IN_FINITE_BAG_IMAGE
statement:
FINITE_BAG b ==>
    (BAG_IN x (BAG_IMAGE f b) = ?y. (f y = x) /\ BAG_IN y b)

name: BAG_IN_BAG_IMAGE_IMP
statement: !x f b. BAG_IN x (BAG_IMAGE f b) ==> ?y. BAG_IN y b /\ f y = x

name: ITSET_BAG_INSERT_BAG_UNION_BAG_IMAGE_BAG_OF_SET
statement:
!f s. FINITE s ==> !a.
    ITSET (\x b. BAG_INSERT (f x) b) s a =
    BAG_UNION a (BAG_IMAGE f (BAG_OF_SET s))

name: BAG_IMAGE_BAG_OF_SET_ITSET_BAG_INSERT
statement:
!f s. FINITE s ==>
    BAG_IMAGE f (BAG_OF_SET s) = ITSET (\x b. BAG_INSERT (f x) b) s {||}

name: FINITE_SUB_BAGS
statement: !b. FINITE_BAG b ==> FINITE { s | s <= b }

name: ITBAG_SING
statement: ITBAG f {|x|} a = f x a

name: SET_OF_BAG_IMAGE
statement: SET_OF_BAG (BAG_IMAGE f b) = IMAGE f (SET_OF_BAG b)

name: BAG_ALL_DISTINCT_SUB_BAG
statement: !s t.  s <= t /\ BAG_ALL_DISTINCT t ==> BAG_ALL_DISTINCT s

name: BAG_DISJOINT_SUB_BAG
statement: !b1 b2 b3. b1 <= b2 /\ BAG_DISJOINT b2 b3 ==> BAG_DISJOINT b1 b3

name: BAG_DISJOINT_SYM
statement: !b1 b2. BAG_DISJOINT b1 b2 <=> BAG_DISJOINT b2 b1

name: MONOID_BAG_UNION_EMPTY_BAG
statement: MONOID $+ {||}

name: BAG_DISJOINT_FOLDR_BAG_UNION
statement:
!ls b0 b1.
    BAG_DISJOINT b1 (FOLDR BAG_UNION b0 ls) <=> EVERY (BAG_DISJOINT b1) (b0::ls)

name: BAG_GEN_PROD_EQ_0
statement:
!b. FINITE_BAG b ==>
    !e. BAG_GEN_PROD b e = 0 <=> BAG_IN 0 b \/ e = 0

name: BIG_BAG_UNION_EQ_ELEMENT
statement:
FINITE sob /\ b IN sob ==>
  (BIG_BAG_UNION sob = b <=> !b'. b' IN sob ==> b' = b \/ b' = {||})

name: unibag_INSERT
statement: !a b. (unibag (BAG_INSERT a b)) = BAG_MERGE {|a|} (unibag b)

name: unibag_UNION
statement: !a b. unibag (a + b) = BAG_MERGE (unibag a) (unibag b)

name: unibag_EQ_BAG_INSERT
statement: !e b b'. (unibag b = BAG_INSERT e b') ==> ?c. (b' = unibag c)

name: unibag_FINITE
statement: !b. FINITE_BAG (unibag b) = FINITE_BAG b

name: unibag_ALL_DISTINCT
statement: !b. BAG_ALL_DISTINCT (unibag b)

name: BAG_IN_unibag
statement: !e b. BAG_IN e (unibag b) <=> BAG_IN e b

name: unibag_EL_MERGE_cases
statement:
!e b. ((BAG_IN e b) ==> (BAG_MERGE {|e|} (unibag b) = (unibag b))) /\
        (~(BAG_IN e b) ==> (BAG_MERGE {|e|} (unibag b) = BAG_INSERT e (unibag b)))

name: unibag_DECOMPOSE
statement: unibag g <> g ==> ?A g0. g = {|A;A|} + g0

name: unibag_SUB_BAG
statement: !b. unibag b <= b

name: LESS_EQ_BAG_CARD_PRIME_FACTORS_PROD
statement:
!b n.
  FINITE_BAG b /\ BAG_GEN_PROD b 1 = n /\ (!x. BAG_IN x b ==> 2 <= x) ==>

name: BIJ_homs_iso

name: lemma5_3

name: bisim_RUNION

name: bquot_correct

name: bquot_coequalizer

name: subsystem_system

name: subsystem_INTER

name: thm7_1
statement:
hom f (A,af) (B,bf) ==>
  hom f (A,af) (IMAGE f A,restr bf (IMAGE f A)) /\
  (!g h C cf. hom g (IMAGE f A,restr bf (IMAGE f A)) (C,cf) /\
              hom h (IMAGE f A,restr bf (IMAGE f A)) (C,cf) /\
              restr (h o f) A = restr (g o f) A ==> h = g) /\
  hom (eps (kernel A f) A) (A,af) (bquot (A,af) (kernel A f)) /\
  hom (restr (\x.x) (IMAGE f A))
      (IMAGE f A, restr bf (IMAGE f A))
      (B,bf) /\
  iso (IMAGE f A, restr bf (IMAGE f A))
      (bquot (A,af) (kernel A f)) /\
  ?mu. hom mu (bquot (A,af) (kernel A f)) (B,bf) /\
       INJ mu (FST (bquot (A,af) (kernel A f))) B

name: thm7_2
statement:
hom f (A,af) (B,bf) /\ bisim R (A,af) (A,af) /\ R RSUBSET kernel A f /\
  R equiv_on A ==>
  ?!fbar.
    hom fbar (bquot (A,af) R) (B,bf) /\ f = restr (fbar o eps R A) A

name: thm7_3
statement:
system (A,af) /\ subsystem B (A,af) /\ bisim R (A,af) (A,af) /\
  R equiv_on A /\
  Abbrev(TR = { a | a IN A /\ ?b. b IN B /\ R a b })
  ==>
  subsystem TR (A,af) /\
  let Q = CURRY (UNCURRY R INTER (B CROSS B))
  in
    bisim Q (B,restr af B) (B,restr af B) /\ Q equiv_on B /\
    iso (bquot (B,restr af B) Q) (bquot (TR,restr af TR) R)

name: gbisim_equivalence
statement: system (A,af) ==> gbisim (A,af) equiv_on A

name: bisim_gbisim
statement: system (A,af) ==> bisim (gbisim (A,af)) (A,af) (A,af)

simple (As:'a system) ==>

name: simple_eq3
statement: simple As <=> !R. bisim R As As /\ R equiv_on (FST As) ==> R = Delta (FST As)

name: relF_def
statement: relF R x y <=> ?z. setF z SUBSET UNCURRY R /\ mapF FST z = x /\ mapF SND z = y

name: Fset_def
statement: Fset (A : 'a set) = { af | setF af SUBSET A }

name: system_def
statement:
system ((A,af) : 'a system) <=>
  (!a. a IN A ==> af a IN Fset A) /\ !a. a NOTIN A ==> af a = ARB

name: hom_def
statement:
hom h (A,af) (B,bf) <=>
  system (A,af) /\ system (B,bf) /\
  (!a. a IN A ==> h a IN B /\ bf (h a) = mapF h (af a)) /\
  (!a. a NOTIN A ==> h a = ARB)

name: epi_def
statement:
epi f ((A,af):'a system) ((B,bf):'b system) (:'c) <=>
  hom f (A,af) (B,bf) /\
  !C cf g h. hom g (B,bf) ((C,cf):'c system) /\ hom h (B,bf) (C,cf) /\
             restr (g o f) A = restr (h o f) A ==> g = h

name: iso_def
statement:
iso (A,af) (B,bf) <=>
     ?f g. hom f (A,af) (B,bf) /\ hom g (B,bf) (A,af) /\
           (!a. a IN A ==> g (f a) = a) /\
           (!b. b IN B ==> f (g b) = b)

name: Fpushout_def
statement:
Fpushout ((A,af):'a system) ((B,bf):'b system) ((C,cf):'c system) f g
           ((P,pf):'p system,i1,i2) (:'d)
  <=>
  hom f (A,af) (B,bf) /\ hom g (A,af) (C,cf) /\ hom i1 (B,bf) (P,pf) /\
  hom i2 (C,cf) (P,pf) /\ restr (i1 o f) A = restr (i2 o g) A  /\
  !Q qf j1 j2.
    hom j1 (B,bf) ((Q,qf):'d system) /\ hom j2 (C,cf) (Q,qf) /\
    restr (j1 o f) A = restr (j2 o g) A ==>
    ?!u. hom u (P,pf) (Q,qf) /\
         restr (u o i1) B = j1 /\
         restr (u o i2) C = j2

name: bisim_def
statement:
bisim R (A,af) (B,bf) <=>
  system (A,af) /\ system (B,bf) /\
  !a b. R a b ==> a IN A /\ b IN B /\ relF R (af a) (bf b)

name: bisimilar_def
statement: bisimilar As Bs <=> ?R. bisim R As Bs

name: bquot_def
statement:
bquot ((A,af):'a system) R : 'a set system =
     (partition R A,
      restr (\ap. mapF (eps R A) (af (CHOICE ap))) (partition R A))

name: coequalizer_def
statement:
coequalizer ((A,af):'a system) ((B,bf):'b system) f1 f2 ((C,cf), g) (:'d) <=>
  hom f1 (A,af) (B,bf) /\ hom f2 (A,af) (B,bf) /\
  hom g (B,bf) ((C,cf):'c system) /\ restr (g o f1) A = restr (g o f2) A /\
  !h D df.
    hom h (B,bf) ((D,df):'d system) /\ restr (h o f1) A = restr (h o f2) A ==>
    ?!u. hom u (C,cf) (D,df) /\ h = restr (u o g) B

name: subsystem_def
statement:
subsystem V (A,af) <=>
  system (A,af) /\ V SUBSET A /\ ?vf. hom (restr (\x.x) V) (V,vf) (A,af)

name: genS_def
statement: genS As X = BIGINTER { V | subsystem V As /\ X SUBSET V }

name: bounded_def
statement:
bounded (:'a) (:'b) =
   !a A af. system ((A,af):'a system) /\ a IN A ==>
            ?f V:'b set. INJ f (genS (A,af) {a}) V

name: gbisim_def
statement: gbisim (A,af) x y <=> ?R. bisim R (A,af) (A,af) /\ R x y

name: simple_def
statement:
simple (A : 'a system) <=>
  !R. bisim R A A ==> !x y. R x y ==> x = y

name: type_inhabited
statement: ?f. itree_rep_ok ^f

name: itree_rep_ok_itree_rep
statement: !t. itree_rep_ok (itree_rep t)

name: itree_abs_11
statement:
itree_rep_ok r1 /\ itree_rep_ok r2 ==>
  (itree_abs r1 = itree_abs r2 <=> r1 = r2)

name: itree_rep_11
statement: (itree_rep t1 = itree_rep t2) = (t1 = t2)

name: itree_rep_ok_Ret
statement: !x. itree_rep_ok (Ret_rep x : ('a,'b,'c) itree_rep)

name: itree_rep_ok_Div
statement: itree_rep_ok (Div_rep : ('a,'b,'c) itree_rep)

name: itree_rep_ok_Vis
statement:
!a g. (!a. itree_rep_ok (g a)) ==>
        itree_rep_ok (Vis_rep e g  : ('a,'b,'c) itree_rep)

name: Ret_rep_11
statement: !x y. Ret_rep x = Ret_rep y <=> x = y

name: Ret_11
statement: !x y. Ret x = Ret y <=> x = y

name: Vis_rep_11
statement: !x y g g'. Vis_rep x g = Vis_rep y g' <=> x = y /\ g = g'

name: Vis_11
statement: !x f y g. Vis x f = Vis y g <=> x = y /\ f = g

name: itree_all_distinct
statement: !x e g. ALL_DISTINCT [Ret x; Div; Vis e g :('a,'b,'c) itree]

name: rep_exists
statement:
itree_rep_ok f ==>
    (?x. f = Ret_rep x) \/
    (f = Div_rep) \/
    ?a g. f = Vis_rep a g /\ !v. itree_rep_ok (g v)

name: itree_cases
statement: !t. (?x. t = Ret x) \/ (t = Div) \/ (?a g. t = Vis a g)

name: itree_CASE
statement:
itree_CASE (Ret r)   ret div vis = ret r /\
  itree_CASE Div       ret div vis = div /\
  itree_CASE (Vis a g) ret div vis = vis a g

name: itree_CASE_eq
statement:
itree_CASE t ret div vis = v <=>
    (?r. t = Ret r /\ ret r = v) \/
    (t = Div /\ div = v) \/
    (?a g. t = Vis a g /\ vis a g = v)

name: itree_CASE_elim
statement:
!f.
  f(itree_CASE t ret div vis) <=>
    (?r. t = Ret r /\ f(ret r)) \/
    (t = Div /\ f(div)) \/
    (?a g. t = Vis a g /\ f(vis a g))

name: itree_rep_abs_itree_unfold_path
statement: itree_rep (itree_abs (itree_unfold_path f s)) = itree_unfold_path f s

name: itree_unfold
statement:
itree_unfold f seed =
    case f seed of
    | Ret' r   => Ret r
    | Div'     => Div
    | Vis' e g => Vis e (itree_unfold f o g)

name: itree_rep_abs_itree_unfold_err_path
statement:
itree_rep (itree_abs (itree_unfold_err_path f err s)) =
  itree_unfold_err_path f err s

name: itree_unfold_err
statement:
itree_unfold_err f (rel, err_f, err) seed =
    case f seed of
    | Ret' r   => Ret r
    | Div'     => Div
    | Vis' e g =>
        Vis e
          (λa. case a of
                  INL x => Ret $ err_f e x
                | INR y =>
                    if rel e y then itree_unfold_err f (rel, err_f, err) (g y)
                    else Ret $ err e)

name: itree_el_def
statement:
itree_el (Ret r) []   = Return r /\
  itree_el Div []       = Stuck /\
  itree_el (Vis e g) [] = Event e /\
  itree_el (Ret r) (a::ns)   = Return ARB /\
  itree_el Div (a::ns)       = Return ARB /\
  itree_el (Vis e g) (a::ns) = itree_el (g a) ns

name: itree_el_eqv
statement: !t1 t2. t1 = t2 <=> !path. itree_el t1 path = itree_el t2 path

name: itree_bisimulation
statement:
!t1 t2.
    t1 = t2 <=>
    ?R. R t1 t2 /\
        (!x t. R (Ret x) t ==> t = Ret x) /\
        (!t. R Div t ==> t = Div) /\
        (!a f t. R (Vis a f) t ==> ?b g. t = Vis a g /\ !s. R (f s) (g s))

name: itree_CASE_cong
statement:
!M M' ret div vis ret' div' vis'.
    M = M' /\
    (!x. M' = Ret x ==> ret x = ret' x) /\
    (M' = Div ==> div = div') /\
    (!a g. M' = Vis a g ==> vis a g = vis' a g) ==>
    itree_CASE M ret div vis = itree_CASE M' ret' div' vis'

name: datatype_itree
statement:
DATATYPE ((itree
    (Ret : 'r -> ('a, 'e, 'r) itree)
    (Div : ('a, 'e, 'r) itree)
    (Vis : 'e -> ('a -> ('a, 'e, 'r) itree) -> ('a, 'e, 'r) itree)):bool)

name: iflat_div
statement: iflat Div = Div

name: iflat_ret
statement: iflat (Ret r) = r

name: iflat_vis
statement: iflat (Vis ov f) = Vis ov (iflat o f)

name: iflat_eq_ret
statement: (iflat itr = Ret rv <=> itr = Ret (Ret rv)) /\ (Ret rv = iflat itr <=> itr = Ret (Ret rv))

name: iflat_eq_vis
statement:
iflat itr = Vis ov f <=> (? g. itr = Vis ov g /\ iflat o g = f) \/
                         itr = Ret (Vis ov f)

name: iflat_eq_div
statement: iflat itr = Div <=> itr = Div \/ itr = Ret Div

name: imap_ret
statement: imap g (Ret rv) = Ret (g rv)

name: imap_div
statement: imap g Div = Div

name: imap_vis
statement: imap f (Vis ov g) = Vis ov ((imap f) o g)

name: imap_eq_ret
statement: Ret r = imap g itr <=> ?x. itr = Ret x /\ g x = r

name: imap_eq_vis
statement: Vis rv f = imap g itr <=> ?h. itr = Vis rv h /\ imap g o h = f

name: imap_eq_div
statement: (imap g itr = Div <=> itr = Div) /\ (Div = imap g itr <=> itr = Div)

name: imap_id
statement: imap (λx. x) itr = itr

name: imap_composition
statement: imap (f o g) itr = imap f (imap g itr)

name: ibind_left_id
statement: ibind (ireturn itr) f = f itr

name: ibind_right_id
statement: ibind itr ireturn = itr

name: ibind_eq_ret
statement: ibind itr f = Ret v <=> ?v'. itr = Ret v' /\ f v' = Ret v

name: ibind_eq_div
statement: ibind itr f = Div <=> itr = Div \/ (?x. itr = Ret x /\ f x = Div)

name: ibind_eq_vis
statement:
ibind itr f = Vis rv g <=> (?h. itr = Vis rv h /\ iflat o imap f o h = g) \/
                           (?x. itr = ireturn x /\ f x = Vis rv g)

name: ibind_assoc
statement: ibind itr (λx. ibind (f x) g) = ibind (ibind itr f) g

name: iset_thm
statement:
(iset (Ret e) e' <=> e = e') /\
  (iset Div e = F) /\
  (iset (Vis ov f) e <=> ?i. iset (f i) e)

name: itruncate_ret
statement: !n. itruncate n itr = Ret r <=> (itr = Ret r /\ n <> 0)

name: itruncate_implies_ifinite
statement: !itr. itruncate n itr = itr ==> ifinite itr

name: iset_truncate
statement: iset itr elem ==> ? n. iset (itruncate n itr) elem

name: iset_flat_1
statement: ! itr e. iset (iflat itr) e ==> ?t0. iset itr t0 /\ iset t0 e

name: iset_flat_2
statement: ! itr t0 e. iset itr t0 /\ iset t0 e ==> iset (iflat itr) e

name: iset_flat
statement: ! itr e. iset (iflat itr) e <=> ?t0. iset itr t0 /\ iset t0 e

name: iset_map_1
statement: ! itr x. iset (imap f itr) x ==> ?y. x = f y /\ iset itr y

name: iset_map_2
statement: ! itr. iset itr y ==> iset (imap f itr) (f y)

name: iset_map
statement: iset (imap f itr) = IMAGE f (iset itr)

name: at_path_thm
statement:
(at_path Div p e = F) /\
  (at_path (Ret e) p a <=> (p = [] /\ a = e)) /\
  (at_path (Vis ov f) p e <=> ?i l. (p = (ov,i)::l /\ at_path (f i) l e))

name: at_path_implies_iset
statement: at_path itree p e ==> iset itree e

name: iset_iff_exists_path
statement: iset itree e <=> ?p. at_path itree p e

name: ievery_thm
statement:
(ievery P Div = T) /\
  (ievery P (Ret e) <=> P e) /\
  (ievery P (Vis ov f) <=> ! iv. ievery P (f iv))

name: iexists_thm
statement:
(iexists P Div = F) /\
  (iexists P (Ret e) <=> P e) /\
  (iexists P (Vis ov f) <=> ? iv. iexists P (f iv))

name: not_ievery_exists
statement: ~ ievery P itr <=> iexists (λx. ~ P x) itr

name: ievery_set
statement: ! itr. ievery P itr <=> ! rv. (iset itr rv ==> P rv)

name: path_ok_def
statement:
path_ok path ^f <=>
  !xs y ys.
    path = xs ++ y::ys ==>
    f xs <> Stuck /\
    !z. f xs <> Return z

name: itree_rep_ok_def
statement:
itree_rep_ok ^f <=>
    
    !path. ~path_ok path f ==> f path = Return ARB

name: Ret_rep_def
statement:
Ret_rep (x:'r) =
    \path. if path = [] then Return x else Return ARB

name: Div_rep_def
statement:
Div_rep =
    \path. if path = [] then Stuck else Return ARB

name: Vis_rep_def
statement:
Vis_rep e g =
    \path. case path of
           | [] => Event e
           | (a::rest) => g a rest

name: Ret_def
statement: Ret x = itree_abs (Ret_rep x)

name: Div_def
statement: Div = itree_abs Div_rep

name: Vis_def
statement: Vis e g = itree_abs (Vis_rep e (itree_rep o g))

name: itree_CASE
statement:
itree_CASE (t:('a,'e,'r) itree) ret div vis =
    case itree_rep t [] of
    | Return r => ret r
    | Stuck    => div
    | Event e  => vis e (\a. (itree_abs (\path. itree_rep t (a::path))))

name: itree_unfold_path_def
statement:
(itree_unfold_path f seed [] =
     case f seed of
     | Ret' r   => Return r
     | Div'     => Stuck
     | Vis' e g => Event e) /\
  (itree_unfold_path f seed (n::rest) =
     case f seed of
     | Ret' r   => Return ARB
     | Div'     => Return ARB
     | Vis' e g => itree_unfold_path f (g n) rest)

name: itree_unfold
statement: itree_unfold f seed = itree_abs (itree_unfold_path f seed)

name: itree_unfold_err_path_def
statement:
(itree_unfold_err_path f (rel, err_f, err) seed [] =
     case f seed of
     | Ret' r   => Return r
     | Div'     => Stuck
     | Vis' e g => Event e) /\
  (itree_unfold_err_path f (rel, err_f, err) seed (n::rest) =
     case f seed of
     | Ret' r   => Return ARB
     | Div'     => Return ARB
     | Vis' e g =>
        case n of
        | INL x => if rest = [] then Return (err_f e x) else Return ARB
        | INR y =>
            if rel e y then itree_unfold_err_path f (rel, err_f, err) (g y) rest
            else if rest = [] then Return $ err e else Return ARB)

name: itree_unfold_err
statement:
itree_unfold_err f err seed =
    itree_abs (itree_unfold_err_path f err seed)

name: itree_el_def
statement:
itree_el t [] =
    itree_CASE t (\r. Return r) Stuck (\e g. Event e) /\
  itree_el t (a::ns) =
    itree_CASE t (\r. Return ARB) (Return ARB) (\e g. itree_el (g a) ns)

name: iflat_def
statement:
iflat itr = itree_unfold (λx. case x of
                                INL(Ret r) =>
                                  (case r of
                                     Ret r0 => Ret' r0
                                   | Div => Div'
                                   | Vis e f => Vis' e (λi. INR (f i)))
                              | INL(Div) => Div'
                              | INL(Vis e f) => Vis' e (λi. INL (f i))
                              | INR(Ret r) => Ret' r
                              | INR(Div) => Div'
                              | INR(Vis e f) => Vis' e (λi. INR (f i))
                         ) (INL itr)

name: imap_def
statement:
imap g itr = itree_unfold (λx. case x of
                                Ret r => Ret' (g r)
                              | Div => Div'
                              | Vis e f => Vis' e f
                         ) itr

name: ibind_def
statement: ibind itr f = iflat (imap f itr)

name: itruncate_def
statement:
itruncate 0 itr = Div /\
  itruncate n Div = Div /\
  itruncate n (Ret rv) = Ret rv /\
  itruncate n (Vis ov f) = Vis ov (λx. itruncate (n-1) (f x))

name: iset_def
statement:
[~ret:]
  !e. iset (Ret e) e
[~vis:]
  iset (f i) e  ==> iset (Vis ov f) e

name: ifinite_def
statement:
[~ret:]
  ifinite (Ret e)
[~div:]
  ifinite Div
[~vis:]
  (! iv. ifinite (f iv)) ==> ifinite (Vis ov f)

name: at_path_def
statement:
[~ret:]
  at_path (Ret e) [] e
[~vis:]
  (at_path (f i) p e ==> at_path (Vis ov f) ((ov,i)::p) e)

name: ievery_def
statement:
[~div:]
  (ievery P Div)
[~ret:]
  (P e ==> ievery P (Ret e))
[~vis:]
  ((! iv. ievery P (f iv)) ==> ievery P (Vis ov f))

name: iexists_def
statement:
[~ret:]
  (P e ==> iexists P (Ret e))
[~vis:]
  (? iv. iexists P (f iv)) ==> iexists P (Vis ov f)

name: type_inhabited
statement: ?f. itree_rep_ok ^f

name: itree_rep_ok_itree_rep
statement: !t. itree_rep_ok (itree_rep t)

name: itree_abs_11
statement:
itree_rep_ok r1 /\ itree_rep_ok r2 ==>
  (itree_abs r1 = itree_abs r2 <=> r1 = r2)

name: itree_rep_11
statement: (itree_rep t1 = itree_rep t2) = (t1 = t2)

name: itree_rep_ok_Ret
statement: !x. itree_rep_ok (Ret_rep x : ('a,'e,'r) itree_rep)

name: itree_rep_ok_Tau
statement: !f. itree_rep_ok f ==> itree_rep_ok (Tau_rep ^f)

name: itree_rep_ok_Vis
statement: !a g. (!a. itree_rep_ok (g a)) ==> itree_rep_ok (Vis_rep e g)

name: Ret_rep_11
statement: !x y. Ret_rep x = Ret_rep y <=> x = y

name: Ret_11
statement: !x y. Ret x = Ret y <=> x = y

name: Tau_rep_11
statement: !x y. Tau_rep x = Tau_rep y <=> x = y

name: Tau_11
statement: !x y. Tau x = Tau y <=> x = y

name: Vis_rep_11
statement: !x y g g'. Vis_rep x g = Vis_rep y g' <=> x = y /\ g = g'

name: Vis_11
statement: !x f y g. Vis x f = Vis y g <=> x = y /\ f = g

name: itree_distinct_lemma
statement: ALL_DISTINCT [Ret x; Tau t; Vis e g]

name: rep_exists
statement:
itree_rep_ok f ==>
    (?x. f = Ret_rep x) \/
    (?u. f = Tau_rep u /\ itree_rep_ok u) \/
    ?a g. f = Vis_rep a g /\ !v. itree_rep_ok (g v)

name: itree_cases
statement: !t. (?x. t = Ret x) \/ (?u. t = Tau u) \/ (?a g. t = Vis a g)

name: itree_CASE
statement:
itree_CASE (Ret r) ret tau vis = ret r /\
  itree_CASE (Tau t) ret tau vis = tau t /\
  itree_CASE (Vis a g) ret tau vis = vis a g

name: itree_CASE_eq
statement:
itree_CASE t ret tau vis = v <=>
    (?r. t = Ret r /\ ret r = v) \/
    (?u. t = Tau u /\ tau u = v) \/
    (?a g. t = Vis a g /\ vis a g = v)

name: itree_CASE_elim
statement:
!f.
  f(itree_CASE t ret tau vis) <=>
    (?r. t = Ret r /\ f(ret r)) \/
    (?u. t = Tau u /\ f(tau u)) \/
    (?a g. t = Vis a g /\ f(vis a g))

name: itree_rep_abs_itree_unfold_path
statement: itree_rep (itree_abs (itree_unfold_path f s)) = itree_unfold_path f s

name: itree_unfold
statement:
itree_unfold f seed =
    case f seed of
    | Ret' r   => Ret r
    | Tau' s   => Tau (itree_unfold f s)
    | Vis' e g => Vis e (itree_unfold f o g)

name: itree_el_thm
statement:
itree_el (Ret r) [] = Return r /\
  itree_el (Tau t) [] = Silence /\
  itree_el (Vis e g) [] = Event e /\
  itree_el (Ret r) (NONE::ns) = Silence /\
  itree_el (Tau t) (NONE::ns) = itree_el t ns /\
  itree_el (Vis e g) (NONE::ns) = Silence /\
  itree_el (Ret r) (SOME a::ns) = Silence /\
  itree_el (Tau t) (SOME a::ns) = Silence /\
  itree_el (Vis e g) (SOME a::ns) = itree_el (g a) ns

name: itree_el_eqv
statement: !t1 t2. t1 = t2 <=> !path. itree_el t1 path = itree_el t2 path

name: itree_bisimulation
statement:
!t1 t2.
    t1 = t2 <=>
    ?R. R t1 t2 /\
        (!x t. R (Ret x) t ==> t = Ret x) /\
        (!u t. R (Tau u) t ==> ?v. t = Tau v /\ R u v) /\
        (!a f t. R (Vis a f) t ==> ?g. t = Vis a g /\ !s. R (f s) (g s))

name: itree_strong_bisimulation
statement:
!t1 t2.
    t1 = t2 <=>
    ?R. R t1 t2 /\
        (!x t. R (Ret x) t ==> t = Ret x) /\
        (!u t. R (Tau u) t ==> ?v. t = Tau v /\ (R u v \/ u = v)) /\
        (!a f t. R (Vis a f) t ==> ?g. t = Vis a g /\
                                       !s. R (f s) (g s) \/ f s = g s)

name: itree_CASE_cong
statement:
!M M' ret tau vis ret' tau' vis'.
    M = M' /\
    (!x. M' = Ret x ==> ret x = ret' x) /\
    (!t. M' = Tau t ==> tau t = tau' t) /\
    (!a g. M' = Vis a g ==> vis a g = vis' a g) ==>
    itree_CASE M ret tau vis = itree_CASE M' ret' tau' vis'

name: datatype_itree
statement:
DATATYPE ((itree
    (Ret : 'r -> ('a, 'e, 'r) itree)
    (Tau : ('a, 'e, 'r) itree -> ('a, 'e, 'r) itree)
    (Vis : 'e -> ('a -> ('a, 'e, 'r) itree) -> ('a, 'e, 'r) itree)):bool)

name: itree_bind_thm
statement:
itree_bind (Ret r) k = k r /\
  itree_bind (Tau t) k = Tau (itree_bind t k) /\
  itree_bind (Vis e k') k = Vis e (λx. itree_bind (k' x) k)

name: itree_bind_right_identity
statement: itree_bind t Ret = t

name: itree_bind_assoc
statement:
itree_bind (itree_bind t k) k' =
  itree_bind t (λx. itree_bind (k x) k')

name: itree_iter_thm
statement:
itree_iter body seed =
    itree_bind (body seed)
               (λx. case x of INL a => Tau(itree_iter body a)
                           |  INR b => Ret b)

name: strip_tau_simps
statement:
(strip_tau t' (Tau t) = F) /\
  (strip_tau (Ret v) (Vis e k) = F) /\
  (strip_tau (Vis e k) (Ret v)  = F) /\
  (strip_tau (Tau t) t' = strip_tau t t')

name: strip_tau_simps2
statement: strip_tau (Ret v) (Ret v') = (v = v')

name: strip_tau_simps3
statement: strip_tau (Vis e k) (Vis e' k') = (e = e' /\ k = k')

name: strip_tau_inj
statement: !t t' t''. strip_tau t t' /\ strip_tau t t'' ==> t' = t''

name: itree_wbisim_refl
statement: itree_wbisim t (t:('a,'b,'c) itree)

name: itree_wbisim_sym
statement: !t t'. itree_wbisim t t' ==> itree_wbisim t' t

name: itree_wbisim_tau_eq
statement: itree_wbisim (Tau t) t

name: itree_wbisim_strong_coind
statement:
!R.
    (!t t'.
       R t t' ==>
       (?t2 t3. t = Tau t2 /\ t' = Tau t3 /\ (R t2 t3 \/ itree_wbisim t2 t3)) \/
       (?e k k'.
          strip_tau t (Vis e k) /\ strip_tau t' (Vis e k') /\
          !r. R (k r) (k' r) \/ itree_wbisim (k r) (k' r)) \/
       ?r. strip_tau t (Ret r) /\ strip_tau t' (Ret r)) ==>
    !t t'. R t t' ==> itree_wbisim t t'

name: itree_wbisim_coind_upto
statement:
!R.
    (!t t'.
       R t t' ==>
       (?t2 t3. t = Tau t2 /\ t' = Tau t3 /\ (R t2 t3 \/ itree_wbisim t2 t3)) \/
       (?e k k'.
          strip_tau t (Vis e k) /\ strip_tau t' (Vis e k') /\
          !r. R (k r) (k' r) \/ itree_wbisim (k r) (k' r)) \/
       (?r. strip_tau t (Ret r) /\ strip_tau t' (Ret r))
       \/ itree_wbisim t t')
    ==> !t t'. R t t' ==> itree_wbisim t t'

name: itree_wbisim_tau
statement: !t t'. itree_wbisim (Tau t) t' ==> itree_wbisim t t'

name: itree_wbisim_tau_eqn0
statement: !t t'. (?t0. t = Tau t0 /\ itree_wbisim t0 t') ==> itree_wbisim t t'

name: itree_wbisim_tau_eqn
statement:
(itree_wbisim (Tau t1) t2 <=> itree_wbisim t1 t2) /\
  (itree_wbisim t1 (Tau t2) <=> itree_wbisim t1 t2)

name: itree_wbisim_strip_tau
statement: !t t' t''. itree_wbisim t t' /\ strip_tau t t'' ==> itree_wbisim t'' t'

name: itree_wbisim_strip_tau_sym
statement: !t t' t''. itree_wbisim t t' /\ strip_tau t' t'' ==> itree_wbisim t t''

name: itree_wbisim_strip_tau_Ret
statement: !t t' v. itree_wbisim t t' /\ strip_tau t (Ret v) ==> strip_tau t' (Ret v)

name: itree_wbisim_strip_tau_Vis
statement:
!t t' e k. itree_wbisim t t' /\ strip_tau t (Vis e k)
           ==> ?k'. strip_tau t' (Vis e k') /\ !r. itree_wbisim (k r) (k' r)

name: itree_wbisim_trans
statement: !t t' t''. itree_wbisim t t' /\ itree_wbisim t' t'' ==> itree_wbisim t t''

name: itree_bind_strip_tau_wbisim
statement: !u u' k. strip_tau u u' ==> itree_wbisim (itree_bind u k) (itree_bind u' k)

name: itree_bind_vis_strip_tau
statement:
!u k k' e. strip_tau u (Vis e k') ==>
             strip_tau (itree_bind u k) (Vis e (λx. itree_bind (k' x) k))

name: itree_bind_resp_t_wbisim
statement: !a b k. itree_wbisim a b ==> itree_wbisim (itree_bind a k) (itree_bind b k)

name: itree_bind_resp_k_wbisim
statement:
!t k1 k2. (!r. itree_wbisim (k1 r) (k2 r)) ==>
            itree_wbisim (itree_bind t k1) (itree_bind t k2)

name: itree_bind_resp_wbisim
statement:
!a b k1 k2. itree_wbisim a b /\ (!r. itree_wbisim (k1 r) (k2 r)) ==>
              itree_wbisim (itree_bind a k1) (itree_bind b k2)

name: itree_iter_ret_tau_wbisim
statement:
itcb1 = (λx. case x of INL a => Tau (itree_iter k1 a) | INR b => Ret b) /\
  itcb2 = (λx. case x of INL a => Tau (itree_iter k2 a) | INR b => Ret b) /\
  itree_wbisim (Ret x) (Tau u) /\ (!r. itree_wbisim (k1 r) (k2 r))
  ==>
  (?t2 t3.
     itree_bind (Ret x) itcb1 = Tau t2 /\ itree_bind (Tau u) itcb2 = Tau t3 /\
     ((?sa sb. itree_wbisim sa sb /\
               t2 = itree_bind sa itcb1 /\ t3 = itree_bind sb itcb2)
      \/ itree_wbisim t2 t3)) \/
  (?e k k'.
     strip_tau (itree_bind (Ret x) itcb1) (Vis e k) /\
     strip_tau (itree_bind (Tau u) itcb2) (Vis e k') /\
     !r. (?sa sb. itree_wbisim sa sb /\
                  k r = itree_bind sa itcb1 /\ k' r = itree_bind sb itcb2)
         \/ itree_wbisim (k r) (k' r)) \/
  ?r. strip_tau (itree_bind (Ret x) itcb1) (Ret r) /\
      strip_tau (itree_bind (Tau u) itcb2) (Ret r)

name: itree_iter_resp_wbisim
statement:
!t k1 k2. (!r. itree_wbisim (k1 r) (k2 r)) ==>
            itree_wbisim (itree_iter k1 t) (itree_iter k2 t)

name: spin
statement: spin = Tau spin

name: strip_tau_spin
statement: (!t'. ~strip_tau t t') ==> t = spin

name: spin_strip_tau
statement: !t. strip_tau spin t ==> F

name: untau_spin
statement: untau spin = Div

name: untau_IMP_wbisim
statement: !t t'. untau t = untau t' ==> itree_wbisim t t'

name: wbisim_IMP_untau
statement: !t t'. itree_wbisim t t' ==> untau t = untau t'

name: path_ok_def
statement:
path_ok path ^f <=>
    !xs y ys.
      path = xs ++ y::ys ==>
      case f xs of
      | Return _ => F         
      | Silence  => y = NONE  
      | Event e  => IS_SOME y

name: itree_rep_ok_def
statement:
itree_rep_ok ^f <=>
    
    !path. ~path_ok path f ==> f path = Silence

name: Ret_rep_def
statement:
Ret_rep (x:'r) =
    \path. if path = [] then Return x else Silence

name: Tau_rep_def
statement:
Tau_rep ^f =
    \path. case path of
           | (NONE::rest) => f rest
           | _ => Silence

name: Vis_rep_def
statement:
Vis_rep e g =
    \path. case path of
           | [] => Event e
           | (NONE::rest) => Silence
           | (SOME a::rest) => g a rest

name: Ret_def
statement: Ret x = itree_abs (Ret_rep x)

name: Tau_def
statement: Tau t = itree_abs (Tau_rep (itree_rep t))

name: Vis_def
statement: Vis e g = itree_abs (Vis_rep e (itree_rep o g))

name: itree_CASE
statement:
itree_CASE (t:('a,'e,'r) itree) ret tau vis =
    case itree_rep t [] of
    | Return r => ret r
    | Silence => tau (itree_abs (\path. itree_rep t (NONE::path)))
    | Event e => vis e (\a. (itree_abs (\path. itree_rep t (SOME a::path))))

name: itree_unfold_path_def
statement:
(itree_unfold_path f seed [] =
     case f seed of
     | Ret' r => Return r
     | Tau' s => Silence
     | Vis' e g => Event e) /\
  (itree_unfold_path f seed (NONE::rest) =
     case f seed of
     | Ret' r => Silence
     | Tau' s => itree_unfold_path f s rest
     | Vis' e g => Silence) /\
  (itree_unfold_path f seed (SOME n::rest) =
     case f seed of
     | Ret' r => Silence
     | Tau' s => Silence
     | Vis' e g => itree_unfold_path f (g n) rest)

name: itree_unfold
statement: itree_unfold f seed = itree_abs (itree_unfold_path f seed)

name: itree_el_def
statement:
itree_el t [] =
    itree_CASE t (\r. Return r) (\t. Silence) (\e g. Event e) /\
  itree_el t (NONE::ns) =
    itree_CASE t (\r. Silence) (\t. itree_el t ns) (\e g. Silence) /\
  itree_el t (SOME a::ns) =
    itree_CASE t (\r. Silence) (\t. Silence) (\e g. itree_el (g a) ns)

name: itree_bind_def
statement:
itree_bind t k =
  itree_unfold
        (λx.
           case x of
             INL(Ret r) =>
               (case k r of
                  Ret s =>
                    Ret' s
                | Tau t =>
                    Tau' (INR t)
                | Vis e g =>
                     Vis' e (INR o g))
           | INL(Vis e g) => Vis' e (INL o g)
           | INL(Tau t) => Tau' (INL t)
           | INR(Ret r) => Ret' r
           | INR(Vis e g) => Vis' e (INR o g)
           | INR(Tau t) => Tau' (INR t)
        )
        (INL t)

name: itree_iter_def
statement:
itree_iter body seed =
    itree_unfold
        (λx.
           case x of
             Ret(INL seed') => Tau'(body seed')
           | Ret(INR v) => Ret' v
           | Tau u => Tau' u
           | Vis e g => Vis' e g)
     (body seed)

name: itree_loop_def
statement:
itree_loop body seed =
  itree_iter (λx.
          itree_bind (body x)
                     (λcb. case cb of INL c => Ret (INL(INL c))
                                   |  INR b => Ret (INR b)))
                     (INR seed)

name: untau_def

               | SOME(Vis e k) => Vis' e k)

name: strip_tau_def

  (strip_tau (Vis e k) (Vis e k)) /\
  (strip_tau (Ret v) (Ret v))

name: itree_wbisim_def

  (strip_tau t (Vis e k) /\ strip_tau t' (Vis e k') /\
   (!r. itree_wbisim (k r) (k' r)) ==>
   itree_wbisim t t') /\
  (strip_tau t (Ret r) /\ strip_tau t' (Ret r) ==> itree_wbisim t t')
