statement: LSUFFIX xs zs <=> ?ys. xs = LAPPEND (fromList ys) zs \/ zs = LNIL

name: lbind_def
statement: lbind ll f = LFLATTEN (LMAP f ll)

name: lrep_ok_def
statement:
(lrep_ok (λn. NONE))
/\ (lrep_ok t ==> lrep_ok (λn. if n = 0 then SOME h else t(n - 1)))

name: exists_def
statement:
(!h t. P h ==> exists P (h ::: t)) /\
  (!h t. exists P t ==> exists P (h ::: t))

name: llist_upto_def
statement:
(llist_upto R x x) /\
  (R x y ==> llist_upto R x y) /\
  (llist_upto R x y /\ llist_upto R y z ==> llist_upto R x z) /\
  (llist_upto R x y ==> llist_upto R (LAPPEND z x) (LAPPEND z y))

name: type_inhabited
statement: ?f. ltree_rep_ok f

name: ltree_rep_ok_ltree_rep
statement: ltree_rep_ok (ltree_rep f)

name: ltree_abs_11
statement:
ltree_rep_ok r1 /\ ltree_rep_ok r2 ==>
  (ltree_abs r1 = ltree_abs r2 <=> r1 = r2)

name: ltree_rep_11
statement: (ltree_rep t1 = ltree_rep t2) = (t1 = t2)

name: every_ltree_rep_ok
statement: !ts. every ltree_rep_ok (LMAP ltree_rep ts)

name: LMAP_ltree_rep_11
statement: LMAP ltree_rep ts1 = LMAP ltree_rep ts2 <=> ts1 = ts2

name: LMAP_ltree_rep_ltree_abs
statement:
every ltree_rep_ok ts ==>
  LMAP ltree_rep (LMAP ltree_abs ts) = ts

name: ltree_rep_ok_Branch_rep_every
statement: ltree_rep_ok (Branch_rep a ts) = every ltree_rep_ok ts

name: ltree_rep_ok_Branch_rep
statement: every ltree_rep_ok ts ==> ltree_rep_ok (Branch_rep a ts)

name: ltree_rep_ok_Branch_rep_IMP
statement: ltree_rep_ok (Branch_rep a ts) ==> every ltree_rep_ok ts

name: Branch_rep_11
statement: !a1 a2 ts1 ts2. Branch_rep a1 ts1 = Branch_rep a2 ts2 <=> a1 = a2 /\ ts1 = ts2

name: Branch_11
statement: !a1 a2 ts1 ts2. Branch a1 ts1 = Branch a2 ts2 <=> a1 = a2 /\ ts1 = ts2

name: Branch_rep_exists
statement: ltree_rep_ok f ==> ?a ts. f = Branch_rep a ts

name: ltree_cases
statement: !t. ?a ts. t = Branch a ts

name: dest_Branch_rep_Branch_rep
statement: dest_Branch_rep (Branch_rep x xs) = (x,xs)

name: ltree_CASE
statement: ltree_CASE (Branch a ts) f = f a ts

name: ltree_CASE_eq
statement: ltree_CASE t f = v <=> ?a ts. t = Branch a ts /\ f a ts = v

name: ltree_CASE_elim
statement: !f'. f'(ltree_CASE t f) <=> ?a ts. t = Branch a ts /\ f'(f a ts)

name: ltree_rep_ok_make_ltree_rep
statement: !f. ltree_rep_ok (make_ltree_rep f)

name: gen_ltree
statement:
gen_ltree f =
    let (a,len) = f [] in
      Branch a (LGENLIST (\n. gen_ltree (\path. f (n::path))) len)

name: gen_ltree_LNIL
statement: gen_ltree f = Branch a LNIL <=> f [] = (a, SOME 0)

name: ltree_unfold
statement:
ltree_unfold f seed =
    let (a,seeds) = f seed in
      Branch a (LMAP (ltree_unfold f) seeds)

name: ltree_el_def
statement:
ltree_el (Branch a ts) [] = SOME (a, LLENGTH ts) /\
  ltree_el (Branch a ts) (n::ns) =
    case LNTH n ts of
    | NONE => NONE
    | SOME t => ltree_el t ns

name: ltree_el_eqv
statement: !t1 t2. t1 = t2 <=> !path. ltree_el t1 path = ltree_el t2 path

name: ltree_rel
statement:
ltree_rel R (Branch a ts) (Branch b us) <=>
  R a b /\ llist_rel (ltree_rel R) ts us

name: ltree_rel_eq
statement: ltree_rel (=) x y <=> x = y

name: ltree_bisimulation
statement:
!t1 t2.
    t1 = t2 <=>
    ?R. R t1 t2 /\
        !a ts a' ts'.
          R (Branch a ts) (Branch a' ts') ==>
          a = a' /\ llist_rel R ts ts'

name: ltree_lookup_def
statement:
ltree_lookup t [] = SOME t /\
  ltree_lookup (Branch a ts) (n::ns) =
    case LNTH n ts of
    | NONE => NONE
    | SOME t => ltree_lookup t ns

name: subtrees
statement:
subtrees (Branch a ts) =
    Branch a ts INSERT BIGUNION (IMAGE subtrees (LSET ts))

name: ltree_set
statement:
ltree_set (Branch a ts) =
    a INSERT BIGUNION (IMAGE ltree_set (LSET ts))

name: ltree_map
statement: ltree_map f (Branch a xs) = Branch (f a) (LMAP (ltree_map f) xs)

name: ltree_map_id
statement: ltree_map I t = t

name: ltree_map_map
statement: ltree_map f (ltree_map g t) = ltree_map (f o g) t

name: ltree_set_map
statement: ltree_set (ltree_map f t) = IMAGE f (ltree_set t)

name: ltree_rel_O
statement: ltree_rel R1 O ltree_rel R2 RSUBSET ltree_rel (R1 O R2)

name: ltree_CASE_cong
statement:
!M M' f f'.
    M = M' /\
    (!a ts. M' = Branch a ts ==> f a ts = f' a ts) ==>
    ltree_CASE M f = ltree_CASE M' f'

name: datatype_ltree
statement: DATATYPE ((ltree Branch):bool)

name: ltree_finite
statement:
ltree_finite (Branch a ts) <=>
  LFINITE ts /\ !t. t IN LSET ts ==> ltree_finite t

name: ltree_every_rewrite
statement: ltree_every P (Branch a ts) <=> P a ts /\ every (ltree_every P) ts

name: finite_branching_rules
statement:
!a ts. EVERY finite_branching ts ==>
           finite_branching (Branch a (fromList ts))

name: finite_branching_rules'
statement:
!a ts. LFINITE ts /\ every finite_branching ts ==>
           finite_branching (Branch a ts)

name: ltree_finite_imp_finite_branching
statement: !t. ltree_finite t ==> finite_branching t

name: finite_branching_cases
statement:
!t. finite_branching t <=>
        ?a ts. t = Branch a (fromList ts) /\ EVERY finite_branching ts

name: finite_branching_cases'
statement:
!t. finite_branching t <=>
        ?a ts. t = Branch a ts /\ LFINITE ts /\ every finite_branching ts

name: finite_branching_coind
statement:
!P. (!t. P t ==> ?a ts. t = Branch a (fromList ts) /\ EVERY P ts) ==>
         !t. P t ==> finite_branching t

name: finite_branching_coind'
statement:
!P. (!t. P t ==> ?a ts. t = Branch a ts /\ LFINITE ts /\ every P ts) ==>
         !t. P t ==> finite_branching t

name: finite_branching_rewrite
statement: finite_branching (Branch a ts) <=> LFINITE ts /\ every finite_branching ts

name: ltree_node_children_reduce
statement: Branch (ltree_node t) (ltree_children t) = t

name: IN_ltree_lookup
statement: !p t. p IN ltree_paths t <=> ltree_lookup t p <> NONE

name: NIL_IN_ltree_paths
statement: [] IN ltree_paths t

name: ltree_paths_inclusive
statement: !l1 l2 t. l1 <<= l2 /\ l2 IN ltree_paths t ==> l1 IN ltree_paths t

name: ltree_el
statement:
ltree_el t [] = SOME (ltree_node t,LLENGTH (ltree_children t)) /\
    ltree_el t (n::ns) =
      case LNTH n (ltree_children t) of
        NONE => NONE
      | SOME a => ltree_el a ns

name: ltree_lookup
statement:
ltree_lookup t [] = SOME t /\
    ltree_lookup t (n::ns) =
      case LNTH n (ltree_children t) of
        NONE => NONE
      | SOME a => ltree_lookup a ns

name: ltree_lookup_iff_ltree_el
statement: !p t. ltree_lookup t p <> NONE <=> ltree_el t p <> NONE

name: ltree_paths_alt
statement: !t. ltree_paths A = {p | ltree_el A p <> NONE}

name: ltree_el_valid
statement: !p t. p IN ltree_paths t <=> ltree_el t p <> NONE

name: ltree_el_valid_inclusive
statement: !p t. p IN ltree_paths t <=> !p'. p' <<= p ==> ltree_el t p' <> NONE

name: ltree_lookup_valid
statement: !p t. p IN ltree_paths t <=> ltree_lookup t p <> NONE

name: ltree_lookup_valid_inclusive
statement: !p t. p IN ltree_paths t <=> !p'. p' <<= p ==> ltree_lookup t p' <> NONE

name: ltree_finite_from_rose
statement: ltree_finite t <=> ?r. from_rose r = t

name: ltree_rep_ok_def
statement:
ltree_rep_ok f <=>
    !path x n.
      f path = (x, SOME n) ==>
      !pos rest. f (path ++ pos::rest) <> NOTHING ==> pos < n

name: Branch_rep_def
statement:
Branch_rep (x:'a) (xs:('a ltree_rep) llist) =
    \path. case path of
           | [] => (x, LLENGTH xs)
           | (n::rest) => case LNTH n xs of SOME t => t rest | NONE => NOTHING

name: Branch
statement: Branch a ts = ltree_abs (Branch_rep a (LMAP ltree_rep ts))

name: dest_Branch_rep_def
statement:
dest_Branch_rep (l:'a ltree_rep) =
    let (x,len) = l [] in
      (x, LGENLIST (\n path. l (n::path)) len)

name: ltree_CASE
statement:
ltree_CASE t f =
    let (a,ts) = dest_Branch_rep (ltree_rep t) in
      f a (LMAP ltree_abs ts)

name: path_ok_def
statement:
path_ok path f <=>
    !xs n ys k a.
      path = xs ++ n::ys /\ f xs = (a,SOME k) ==> n < k

name: make_ltree_rep_def
statement:
make_ltree_rep f =
    \path. if path_ok path f then f path else NOTHING

name: gen_ltree_def
statement: gen_ltree f = ltree_abs (make_ltree_rep f)

name: make_unfold_def
statement:
make_unfold f seed [] =
    (let (a,seeds) = f seed in (a,LLENGTH seeds)) /\
  make_unfold f seed (n::path) =
    let (a,seeds) = f seed in
       make_unfold f (THE (LNTH n seeds)) path

name: ltree_unfold
statement:
ltree_unfold f seed =
    gen_ltree (make_unfold f seed)

name: ltree_el_def
statement:
ltree_el t [] =
    ltree_CASE t (\a ts. SOME (a, LLENGTH ts)) /\
  ltree_el t (n::ns) =
    ltree_CASE t (\a ts.
       case LNTH n ts of
       | NONE => NONE
       | SOME t => ltree_el t ns)

name: ltree_rel_def
statement:
ltree_rel R x y <=>
    !path.
      OPTREL (\x y. R (FST x) (FST y) /\ SND x = SND y)
        (ltree_el x path) (ltree_el y path)

name: ltree_lookup_def
statement:
ltree_lookup t [] = SOME t /\
  ltree_lookup t (n::ns) =
    ltree_CASE t (\a ts.
       case LNTH n ts of
       | NONE => NONE
       | SOME t => ltree_lookup t ns)

name: subtrees_def
statement: subtrees t = { u | ?path. ltree_lookup t path = SOME u }

name: ltree_set_def
statement: ltree_set t = { a | ?ts. Branch a ts IN subtrees t }

name: ltree_map_def
statement: ltree_map f = ltree_unfold (\t. ltree_CASE t (\a ts. (f a,ts)))

name: finite_branching_def
statement: finite_branching = ltree_every (\a ts. LFINITE ts)

name: ltree_node_def
statement: ltree_node (Branch a ts) = a

name: ltree_children_def
statement: ltree_children (Branch a ts) = ts

name: ltree_paths_def
statement: ltree_paths t = {p | ltree_lookup t p <> NONE}

name: from_rose_def
statement: from_rose (Rose a ts) = Branch a (fromList (MAP from_rose ts))

name: ltree_finite_def
statement: EVERY ltree_finite ts ==> ltree_finite (Branch a (fromList ts))

name: ltree_every_def
statement: P a ts /\ every (ltree_every P) ts ==> (ltree_every P (Branch a ts))

name: stopped_at_11
statement: !x y. (stopped_at x = stopped_at y : ('a,'b) path) = (x = y)

name: pcons_11
statement:
!x r p y s q.
       (pcons x r p = pcons y s q) <=> (x = y) /\ (r = s) /\ (p = q)

name: stopped_at_not_pcons
statement: !x y r p. ~(stopped_at x = pcons y r p) /\ ~(pcons y r p = stopped_at x)

name: FORALL_path
statement: !P. (!p. P p) <=> (!x. P (stopped_at x)) /\ (!x r p. P (pcons x r p))

name: EXISTS_path
statement: !P. (?p. P p) <=> (?x. P (stopped_at x)) \/ (?x r p. P (pcons x r p))

name: length_cases
statement:
!p. (finite p <=> (?n. length p = SOME (SUC n))) /\
        (~finite p <=> (length p = NONE))

name: pconcat_eq_pcons
statement:
!x r p p1 lab p2.
      ((pconcat p1 lab p2 = pcons x r p) <=>
       (lab = r) /\ (p1 = stopped_at x) /\ (p = p2) \/
       (?p1'. (p1 = pcons x r p1') /\ (p = pconcat p1' lab p2))) /\
      ((pcons x r p = pconcat p1 lab p2) <=>
       (lab = r) /\ (p1 = stopped_at x) /\ (p = p2) \/
       (?p1'. (p1 = pcons x r p1') /\ (p = pconcat p1' lab p2)))

name: finite_pconcat
statement: !p1 lab p2. finite (pconcat p1 lab p2) <=> finite p1 /\ finite p2

name: exists_thm
statement:
!P. (!x. exists P (stopped_at x) = P x) /\
      (!x r p. exists P (pcons x r p) <=> P x \/ exists P p)

name: every_thm
statement:
!P. (!x. every P (stopped_at x) = P x) /\
      (!x r p. every P (pcons x r p) <=> P x /\ every P p)

name: mem_thm
statement:
(!x s. mem s (stopped_at x) = (s = x)) /\
  (!x r p s. mem s (pcons x r p) <=> (s = x) \/ mem s p)

name: IN_PL_drop
statement: !i j p. i IN PL p ==> (j IN PL (drop i p) <=> i + j IN PL p)

name: drop_tail_commute
statement: !i p. SUC i IN PL p ==> (drop i (tail p) = tail (drop i p))

name: drop_not_stopped
statement: !i p. SUC i IN PL p ==> ?v r q. drop i p = pcons v r q

name: pgenerate_11
statement:
!f1 g1 f2 g2. (pgenerate f1 g1 = pgenerate f2 g2) <=>
                (f1 = f2) /\ (g1 = g2)

name: okpath_thm
statement:
!R. (!x. okpath R (stopped_at x)) /\
      (!x r p. okpath R (pcons x r p) <=> R x r (first p) /\ okpath R p)

name: finite_plink
statement: !p1 p2. finite (plink p1 p2) <=> finite p1 /\ finite p2

name: okpath_plink
statement:
!R p1 p2. finite p1 /\ (last p1 = first p2) ==>
            (okpath R (plink p1 p2) <=> okpath R p1 /\ okpath R p2)

name: LTAKE_labels
statement:
!n p l.
    (LTAKE n (labels p) = SOME l)
    <=>
    n IN PL p /\ (toList (labels (take n p)) = SOME l)

name: okpath_parallel_comp
statement:
!p m1 m2.
     okpath (parallel_comp m1 m2) p
     <=>
     okpath m1 (pmap FST (\x.x) p) /\ okpath m2 (pmap SND (\x.x) p)

name: infinite_path_cases
statement: !p. infinite p ==> ?x r q. (p = pcons x r q) /\ infinite q

name: finite_take_all
statement: !p. finite p ==> (take (PRE (THE (length p))) p = p)

name: finite_last_el
statement: !p. finite p ==> (last p = el (PRE (THE (length p))) p)

name: K_PARTIAL
statement: !x. K x = \z. x

name: I_EQ_IDABS
statement: I = \x. x

name: IN_EXTENSIONAL
statement: !s (f :'a->'b). f IN EXTENSIONAL s <=> (!x. ~(x IN s) ==> f x = ARB)

name: IN_EXTENSIONAL_UNDEFINED
statement: !s (f :'a->'b) x. f IN EXTENSIONAL s /\ ~(x IN s) ==> f x = ARB

name: RESTRICTION_THM
statement: !s (f :'a->'b). RESTRICTION s f = \x. if x IN s then f x else ARB

name: RESTRICTION_DEFINED
statement: !s (f :'a->'b) x. x IN s ==> RESTRICTION s f x = f x

name: RESTRICTION_UNDEFINED
statement: !s (f :'a->'b) x. ~(x IN s) ==> RESTRICTION s f x = ARB

name: RESTRICTION_EQ
statement: !s (f :'a->'b) x y. x IN s /\ f x = y ==> RESTRICTION s f x = y

name: EXTENSIONAL_RESTRICTION
statement: !s (f :'a->'b). EXTENSIONAL s (RESTRICTION s (f :'a -> 'b))

name: FORALL_ONE_FN
statement: (!uf : one -> 'a. P uf) = !a. P (\u. a)

name: FORALL_OPTION
statement: (!opt. P opt) <=> P NONE /\ !x. P (SOME x)

name: EXISTS_OPTION
statement: (?opt. P opt) <=> P NONE \/ ?x. P (SOME x)

name: IS_NONE_EQ_NONE
statement: !x. IS_NONE x = (x = NONE)

name: NOT_IS_SOME_EQ_NONE
statement: !x. ~(IS_SOME x) = (x = NONE)

name: option_case_ID
statement: !x:'a option. option_CASE x NONE SOME = x

name: option_case_SOME_ID
statement: !x:'a option. (option_CASE x x SOME = x)

name: OPTION_MAP_CONG
statement:
!opt1 opt2 f1 f2.
      (opt1 = opt2) /\ (!x. (opt2 = SOME x) ==> (f1 x = f2 x)) ==>
      (OPTION_MAP f1 opt1 = OPTION_MAP f2 opt2)

name: OPTION_MAP_id
statement: OPTION_MAP I (x:'a option) = x /\ OPTION_MAP (\x. x) x = x

name: OPTION_MAP2_cong
statement:
!x1 x2 y1 y2 f1 f2.
       (x1 = x2) /\ (y1 = y2) /\
       (!x y. (x2 = SOME x) /\ (y2 = SOME y) ==> (f1 x y = f2 x y)) ==>
       (OPTION_MAP2 f1 x1 y1 = OPTION_MAP2 f2 x2 y2)

name: OPTION_BIND_cong
statement:
!o1 o2 f1 f2.
     (o1:'a option = o2) /\ (!x. (o2 = SOME x) ==> (f1 x = f2 x)) ==>
     (OPTION_BIND o1 f1 = OPTION_BIND o2 f2)

name: OPTION_BIND_EQUALS_OPTION
statement:
(OPTION_BIND (p:'a option) f = NONE <=>
   p = NONE \/ ?x. p = SOME x /\ f x = NONE) /\
  (OPTION_BIND p f = SOME y <=> ?x. p = SOME x /\ f x = SOME y)

name: OPTION_BIND_SOME
statement: !opt:'a option. OPTION_BIND opt SOME = opt

name: OPTION_IGNORE_BIND_cong
statement:
(o1 = o2: 'a option) /\ (!v. o2 = SOME v ==> p1 = p2:'b option) ==>
  OPTION_IGNORE_BIND o1 p1 = OPTION_IGNORE_BIND o2 p2

name: OPTREL_eq
statement: OPTREL (=) = (=)

name: OPTREL_SOME
statement:
(!R x y. OPTREL R (SOME x) y <=> ?z. (y = SOME z) /\ R x z) /\
  (!R x y. OPTREL R x (SOME y) <=> ?z. (x = SOME z) /\ R z y)

name: OPTREL_NONE
statement:
(OPTREL R NONE y <=> y = NONE) /\
  (OPTREL R x NONE <=> x = NONE)

name: OPTREL_O
statement: !R1 R2. OPTREL (R1 O R2) = OPTREL R1 O OPTREL R2

name: OPTREL_THM
statement:
(OPTREL R (SOME x) NONE = F) /\
  (OPTREL R NONE (SOME y) = F) /\
  (OPTREL R NONE NONE     = T) /\
  (OPTREL R (SOME x) (SOME y) = R x y)

name: OPTREL_CONG
statement:
!(opt1:'a option) (opt2:'b option) opt1' opt2' R R'.
    opt1 = opt1' /\ opt2 = opt2' /\
    (!x y. opt1' = SOME x /\ opt2' = SOME y ==> R x y = R' x y) ==>
    (OPTREL R opt1 opt2 <=> OPTREL R' opt1' opt2')

name: option_case_eq'
statement:
(option_CASE (x:'a option) v f = v') <=>
   ((x = NONE) /\ (v = v') \/ ?a. (x = SOME a) /\ (f a = v'))

name: SWAP_SWAP
statement: !x. SWAP (SWAP x) = x

name: UNCURRY_DEF
statement: !f x y. UNCURRY f (x,y) :'c = f x y

name: IN_UNCURRY_R
statement: (x,y) IN UNCURRY R <=> R x y

name: PAIR_MAP_THM
statement: !f g x y. (f##g) (x,y) = (f x, g y)

name: FST_PAIR_MAP
statement: !p f g. FST ((f ## g) p) = f (FST p)

name: SND_PAIR_MAP
statement: !p f g. SND ((f ## g) p) = g (SND p)

name: PAIR_REL_SYM
statement:
(!x y:'a. R1 x y <=> R1 y x) /\ (!a b:'b. R2 a b <=> R2 b a) ==>
  !xy ab. (R1 ### R2) xy ab <=> (R1 ### R2) ab xy

name: PAIR_REL_TRANS
statement:
(!x y z:'a. R1 x y /\ R1 y z ==> R1 x z) /\
  (!a b c:'b. R2 a b /\ R2 b c ==> R2 a c) ==>
  !xy ab uv. (R1 ### R2) xy ab /\ (R1 ### R2) ab uv ==>
             (R1 ### R2) xy uv

name: PAIR_EQUIV
statement:
!(R1:'a -> 'a -> bool) (R2 : 'b -> 'b -> bool).
    EQUIV R1 ==> EQUIV R2 ==> EQUIV (R1 ### R2)

name: IN_PAIR_SET
statement: c IN PAIR_SET f g (a,b) <=> c IN f a \/ c IN g b

name: IN_setFSTSND
statement:
(a IN setFST ab <=> FST ab = a) /\
  (b IN setSND ab <=> SND ab = b)

name: PAIR_MAP_CONG
statement:
(!a:'a. a IN setFST ab ==> f1 a = f2 a :'c) /\
  (!b:'b. b IN setSND ab ==> g1 b = g2 b :'d) ==>
  (f1 ## g1) ab = (f2 ## g2) ab

name: PAIR_MAP_SET
statement:
(c IN setFST ((f ## g) ab) <=> ?a:'a. c:'c = f a /\ a IN setFST ab) /\
  (d IN setSND ((f ## g) ab) <=> ?b:'b. d:'d = g b /\ b IN setSND ab)

name: PAIR_QUOTIENT
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1.
    QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
    !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2.
      QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
      QUOTIENT (R1 ### R2) (abs1 ## abs2) (rep1 ## rep2)

name: FST_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1.
    QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
    !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2.
      QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
      !p. FST p = abs1 (FST ((rep1 ## rep2) p))

name: FST_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1.
    QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
    !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2.
      QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
      !p1 p2. (R1 ### R2) p1 p2 ==> R1 (FST p1) (FST p2)

name: SND_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1.
    QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
    !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2.
      QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
      !p. SND p = abs2 (SND ((rep1 ## rep2) p))

name: SND_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1.
    QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
    !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
                              !p1 p2.
                                (R1 ### R2) p1 p2 ==> R2 (SND p1) (SND p2)

name: COMMA_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
         !a b. (a,b) = (abs1 ## abs2) (rep1 a, rep2 b)

name: COMMA_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
         !a1 a2 b1 b2.
          R1 a1 b1 /\ R2 a2 b2 ==>
          (R1 ### R2) (a1,a2) (b1,b2)

name: CURRY_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'd) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'e) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
        !R3 (abs3:'c -> 'f) rep3. QUOTIENT R3 abs3 rep3 ==>
         !f a b. CURRY f a b =
                 abs3 (CURRY (((abs1 ## abs2) --> rep3) f)
                             (rep1 a) (rep2 b))

name: CURRY_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'd) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'e) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
        !R3 (abs3:'c -> 'f) rep3. QUOTIENT R3 abs3 rep3 ==>
         !f1 f2.
          ((R1 ### R2) ===> R3) f1 f2 ==>
          (R1 ===> R2 ===> R3) (CURRY f1) (CURRY f2)

name: UNCURRY_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'd) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'e) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
        !R3 (abs3:'c -> 'f) rep3. QUOTIENT R3 abs3 rep3 ==>
         !f p. UNCURRY f p =
               abs3 (UNCURRY ((abs1 --> abs2 --> rep3) f)
                             ((rep1 ## rep2) p))

name: UNCURRY_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'd) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'e) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
        !R3 (abs3:'c -> 'f) rep3. QUOTIENT R3 abs3 rep3 ==>
         !f1 f2.
          (R1 ===> R2 ===> R3) f1 f2 ==>
          ((R1 ### R2) ===> R3) (UNCURRY f1) (UNCURRY f2)

name: PAIR_MAP_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'e) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'f) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
        !R3 (abs3:'c -> 'g) rep3. QUOTIENT R3 abs3 rep3 ==>
        !R4 (abs4:'d -> 'h) rep4. QUOTIENT R4 abs4 rep4 ==>
         !f g. (f ## g) =
               ((rep1 ## rep3) --> (abs2 ## abs4))
                   (((abs1 --> rep2) f) ## ((abs3 --> rep4) g))

name: PAIR_MAP_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'e) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'f) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
        !R3 (abs3:'c -> 'g) rep3. QUOTIENT R3 abs3 rep3 ==>
        !R4 (abs4:'d -> 'h) rep4. QUOTIENT R4 abs4 rep4 ==>
         !f1 f2 g1 g2.
          (R1 ===> R2) f1 f2 /\ (R3 ===> R4) g1 g2 ==>
          ((R1 ### R3) ===> (R2 ### R4)) (f1 ## g1) (f2 ## g2)

name: sum_Axiom
statement:
!(f:'a -> 'c) (g:'b -> 'c).
          ?h. (!x. h (INL x) = f x) /\ (!y. h (INR y) = g y)

name: FORALL_SUM
statement: (!s. P s) <=> (!x. P (INL x)) /\ (!y. P (INR y))

name: SUM_MAP_o
statement: (f ++ g) o (h ++ k) = (f o h) ++ (g o k)

name: IN_SUM_FIN_THM
statement:
(INL a IN SUM_FIN A B <=> a IN A) /\
  (INR b IN SUM_FIN A B <=> b IN B)

name: SUM_REL_THM
statement:
(SUM_REL R1 R2 (INL x :'a + 'b) (INL a) <=> R1 x a) /\
  (SUM_REL R1 R2 (INL x) (INR b) <=> F) /\
  (SUM_REL R1 R2 (INR y) (INL a) <=> F) /\
  (SUM_REL R1 R2 (INR y) (INR b) <=> R2 y b)

name: SUM_REL_EQ
statement: SUM_REL $= $= = ($= : 'a + 'b -> 'a + 'b -> bool)

name: SUM_REL_REFL
statement:
(!x:'a. R1 x x) /\ (!a:'b. R2 a a) ==>
  !xy. SUM_REL R1 R2 xy xy

name: SUM_REL_SYM
statement:
(!x y:'a. R1 x y <=> R1 y x) /\ (!a b:'b. R2 a b <=> R2 b a) ==>
  !xy ab. SUM_REL R1 R2 xy ab <=> SUM_REL R1 R2 ab xy

name: SUM_REL_TRANS
statement:
(!x y z:'a. R1 x y /\ R1 y z ==> R1 x z) /\
  (!a b c:'b. R2 a b /\ R2 b c ==> R2 a c) ==>
  !xy ab uv. SUM_REL R1 R2 xy ab /\ SUM_REL R1 R2 ab uv ==>
             SUM_REL R1 R2 xy uv

name: SUM_SETLR_THM
statement:
(a1 IN setL (INL a2 : 'a + 'b) <=> a1 = a2) /\
  (a IN setL  (INR b  : 'a + 'b) <=> F) /\
  (b IN setR  (INL a  : 'a + 'b) <=> F) /\
  (b1 IN setR (INR b2 : 'a + 'b) <=> b1 = b2)

name: SUM_MAP_CONG
statement:
(!a:'a. a IN setL ab ==> f1 a = f2 a :'c) /\
  (!b:'b. b IN setR ab ==> g1 b = g2 b :'d) ==>
  SUM_MAP f1 g1 ab = SUM_MAP f2 g2 ab

name: SUM_ALL_SET
statement: SUM_ALL P Q ab <=> (!a. a IN setL ab ==> P a) /\ (!b. b IN setR ab ==> Q b)

name: SUM_MAP_SET
statement:
(c IN setL (SUM_MAP f g ab) <=> ?a:'a. c:'c = f a /\ a IN setL ab) /\
  (d IN setR (SUM_MAP f g ab) <=> ?b:'b. d:'d = g b /\ b IN setR ab)

name: SUM_EQUIV
statement:
!(R1:'a -> 'a -> bool) (R2:'b -> 'b -> bool).
    EQUIV R1 ==> EQUIV R2 ==> EQUIV (R1 +++ R2)

name: SUM_QUOTIENT
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
         QUOTIENT (R1 +++ R2) (abs1 ++ abs2) (rep1 ++ rep2)

name: INL_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
         !a. INL a = (abs1 ++ abs2) (INL (rep1 a))

name: INL_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
         !a1 a2.
          R1 a1 a2 ==>
          (R1 +++ R2) (INL a1) (INL a2)

name: INR_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
         !b. INR b = (abs1 ++ abs2) (INR (rep2 b))

name: INR_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
         !b1 b2.
          R2 b1 b2 ==>
          (R1 +++ R2) (INR b1) (INR b2)

name: ISL_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
         !a. ISL a = ISL ((rep1 ++ rep2) a)

name: ISL_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
         !a1 a2.
          (R1 +++ R2) a1 a2 ==>
          (ISL a1 = ISL a2)

name: ISR_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
         !a. ISR a = ISR ((rep1 ++ rep2) a)

name: ISR_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
         !a1 a2.
          (R1 +++ R2) a1 a2 ==>
          (ISR a1 = ISR a2)

name: SUM_MAP_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'e) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'f) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
        !R3 (abs3:'c -> 'g) rep3. QUOTIENT R3 abs3 rep3 ==>
        !R4 (abs4:'d -> 'h) rep4. QUOTIENT R4 abs4 rep4 ==>
         !f g. (f ++ g) =
               ((rep1 ++ rep3) --> (abs2 ++ abs4))
                   (((abs1 --> rep2) f) ++ ((abs3 --> rep4) g))

name: SUM_MAP_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'e) rep1. QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
        !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'f) rep2. QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
        !R3 (abs3:'c -> 'g) rep3. QUOTIENT R3 abs3 rep3 ==>
        !R4 (abs4:'d -> 'h) rep4. QUOTIENT R4 abs4 rep4 ==>
         !f1 f2 g1 g2.
          (R1 ===> R2) f1 f2 /\ (R3 ===> R4) g1 g2 ==>
          ((R1 +++ R3) ===> (R2 +++ R4)) (f1 ++ g1) (f2 ++ g2)

name: NUMSUM_INJ
statement: !b1 x1 b2 x2. (NUMSUM b1 x1 = NUMSUM b2 x2) <=> (b1 = b2) /\ (x1 = x2)

name: INJP_INJ
statement:
!(f1:num->'a->bool) f1' f2 f2'.
        (INJP f1 f2 = INJP f1' f2') <=> (f1 = f1') /\ (f2 = f2')

name: CONSTR_INJ
statement:
!c1 i1 r1 c2 i2 r2. (CONSTR c1 i1 r1 :'a recspace = CONSTR c2 i2 r2) <=>
                      (c1 = c2) /\ (i1 = i2) /\ (r1 = r2)

name: inftree_11
statement:
((iLf a1 = iLf a2 : ('a,'b,'c) inftree) <=> (a1 = a2)) /\
    ((iNd b1 f1 = iNd b2 f2 : ('a,'b,'c)inftree) <=> (b1 = b2) /\ (f1 = f2))

statement: <| size := 3|>.size = 3

name: BAG_IN_EQNS
statement:
(!x. BAG_IN x {||} <=> F) /\
  !x y. BAG_IN x (BAG_INSERT y b) <=> x = y \/ BAG_IN x b

name: SET_OF_BAG_EQNS
statement:
(SET_OF_BAG ({||}:'a bag) = ({}:'a set)) /\
  (!(x:'a) b. SET_OF_BAG (BAG_INSERT x b) = x INSERT (SET_OF_BAG b))

name: BAG_OF_SET_EQNS
statement:
(BAG_OF_SET ({}:'a set) = ({||}:'a bag)) /\
  (!(x:'a) (s:'a set).
     BAG_OF_SET (x INSERT s) = if x IN s then BAG_OF_SET s
                               else BAG_INSERT x (BAG_OF_SET s))

name: LTAKE_thm
statement:
!ll. LTAKE n ll =
       if n = 0 then SOME []
       else case LHD ll of
              NONE => NONE
            | SOME h => OPTION_MAP (\t. h::t)
                                   (LTAKE (n - 1) (THE (LTL ll)))

name: ALOOKUP_MAP_2
statement:
!f al x.
    ALOOKUP (MAP (\ (x,y). (x,f x y)) al) x =
    OPTION_MAP (f x) (ALOOKUP al x)

name: fmap_to_alist_inj
statement: !f1 f2. (fmap_to_alist f1 = fmap_to_alist f2) ==> (f1 = f2)

name: FEVERY_alist_to_fmap
statement: EVERY P ls ==> FEVERY P (alist_to_fmap ls)

name: ALL_DISTINCT_FEVERY_alist_to_fmap
statement:
ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST ls) ==>
   (FEVERY P (alist_to_fmap ls) <=> EVERY P ls)

name: AFUPDKEY_ALOOKUP
statement:
ALOOKUP (AFUPDKEY k2 f al) k1 =
    case ALOOKUP al k1 of
        NONE => NONE
      | SOME v => if k1 = k2 then SOME (f v) else SOME v

name: MAP_FST_AFUPDKEY
statement: MAP FST (AFUPDKEY f k alist) = MAP FST alist

name: AFUPDKEY_unchanged
statement:
!k f alist.
   (!v. (ALOOKUP alist k = SOME v) ==> (f v = v))
   ==> (AFUPDKEY k f alist = alist)

name: AFUPDKEY_o
statement: AFUPDKEY k f1 (AFUPDKEY k f2 al) = AFUPDKEY k (f1 o f2) al

name: AFUPDKEY_eq
statement:
!k f1 l f2.
   (!v. (ALOOKUP l k = SOME v) ==> (f1 v = f2 v))
   ==> (AFUPDKEY k f1 l = AFUPDKEY k f2 l)

name: AFUPDKEY_I
statement: AFUPDKEY n I = I

name: LENGTH_AFUPDKEY
statement: !ls. LENGTH (AFUPDKEY k f ls) = LENGTH ls

name: AFUPDKEY_comm
statement:
!k1 k2 f1 f2 l. k1 <> k2 ==>
  (AFUPDKEY k2 f2 (AFUPDKEY k1 f1 l) =
   AFUPDKEY k1 f1 (AFUPDKEY k2 f2 l))

name: MEM_ADELKEY
statement: !al. MEM (k1,v) (ADELKEY k2 al) <=> k1 <> k2 /\ MEM (k1,v) al

name: ALOOKUP_ADELKEY
statement:
!al. ALOOKUP (ADELKEY k1 al) k2
       = if k1 = k2 then NONE else ALOOKUP al k2

name: ADELKEY_AFUPDKEY_same
statement: !fd f ls. ADELKEY fd (AFUPDKEY fd f ls) = ADELKEY fd ls

name: ADELKEY_unchanged
statement: !x ls. ((ADELKEY x ls = ls) <=> ~MEM x (MAP FST ls))

name: ADELKEY_AFUPDKEY
statement:
!ls f x y. x <> y ==>
    (ADELKEY x (AFUPDKEY y f ls) = (AFUPDKEY y f (ADELKEY x ls)))

name: FLOOKUP_FUPDATE_LIST
statement:
!xs k m. FLOOKUP (m |++ xs) k =
           case ALOOKUP (REVERSE xs) k of
           | NONE => FLOOKUP m k
           | SOME x => SOME x

name: HD_APPEND
statement: HD (xs ++ ys) = (if xs = [] then HD ys else HD xs)

name: LAST_APPEND
statement: LAST (xs ++ ys) = (if ys = [] then LAST xs else LAST ys)

name: HD_MAP
statement: xs <> [] ==> (HD (MAP f xs) = f (HD xs))

name: HD_MEM
statement: xs <> []  ==> MEM (HD xs) xs

name: is_insert_l
statement:
!n. is_insert fl T R k x l l' ==>
    is_insert fl T R k x (count_append n l r) (count_append ARB l' r)

name: insert_fl_R
statement:
is_insert fl fr R k x al al' ==> fl ==> SORTED R (MAP FST al)
    ==> irreflexive R /\ transitive R
    ==> (k = FST (HD al)) \/ R (HD (MAP FST al)) k

name: insert_fl_R_append
statement:
is_insert T fr R k x r r'
    ==> SORTED R (MAP FST (l ++ r))
    ==> irreflexive R /\ transitive R
    ==> ~ MEM k (MAP FST l)

name: is_insert_r
statement:
!n. is_insert T fr R k x r r' ==>
    is_insert T fr R k x (count_append n l r) (count_append ARB l r')

name: is_insert_to_empty
statement: !R k x. is_insert F F R k x [] [(k, x)]

name: is_insert_overwrite
statement: !R k x v. (FST v = k) ==> is_insert T T R k x [v] [(k, x)]

name: sorted_fst_insert_centre
statement:
!k. SORTED R (MAP FST l ++ MAP FST r) ==>
    (~ (l = []) ==> R (FST (LAST l)) k) ==>
    (~ (r = []) ==> R k (FST (HD r))) ==>
    SORTED R (MAP FST l ++ (k :: MAP FST r))

name: is_insert_centre_rule
statement:
(fl ==> ~ (l = [])) ==> (~ (l = []) ==> R (FST (LAST l)) k) ==>
    (fr ==> ~ (r = [])) ==> (~ (r = []) ==> R k (FST (HD r))) ==>
    is_insert fl fr R k x (count_append n l r)
        (count_append ARB l (count_append ARB [(k, x)] r))

name: is_insert_far_left
statement:
!R k x xs. ~ (xs = []) ==> R k (FST (HD xs)) ==>
    is_insert F T R k x xs (count_append ARB [(k, x)] xs)

name: is_insert_far_right
statement:
!R k x xs. ~ (xs = []) ==> R (FST (LAST xs)) k ==>
    is_insert T F R k x xs (count_append ARB xs [(k, x)])

name: count_append_HD_LAST
statement:
(HD (count_append i (count_append j xs ys) zs)
    = HD (count_append 0 xs (count_append 0 ys zs))) /\
  (HD (count_append i (x :: xs) ys) = x) /\
  (HD (count_append i [] ys) = HD ys) /\
  (LAST (count_append i xs (count_append j ys zs))
      = LAST (count_append 0 (count_append 0 xs ys) zs)) /\
  (LAST (count_append i xs (y :: ys)) = LAST (y :: ys)) /\
  (LAST (count_append i xs []) = LAST xs) /\
  (HD (x :: xs) = x) /\
  (LAST (x :: y :: zs) = LAST (y :: zs)) /\
  (LAST [x] = x) /\
  ((count_append i (count_append j xs ys) zs = []) =
      (count_append 0 xs (count_append 0 ys zs) = [])) /\
  ((count_append i [] ys = []) = (ys = [])) /\
  ((count_append i (x :: xs) ys = []) = F) /\
  ((x :: xs = []) = F)

name: balance_r
statement:
count_append i (count_append j xs ys) zs
     = count_append ARB xs (count_append ARB ys zs)

name: balance_l
statement:
count_append i xs (count_append j ys zs)
     = count_append ARB (count_append ARB xs ys) zs

name: set_count
statement: !j. count_append i xs ys = count_append j xs ys

name: alookup_append_option_choice_f
statement: ALOOKUP (xs ++ ys) = option_choice_f (ALOOKUP xs) (ALOOKUP ys)

name: alookup_empty_option_choice_f
statement:
(option_choice_f (ALOOKUP []) f = f)
    /\ (option_choice_f f (ALOOKUP []) = f)

name: option_choice_f_assoc
statement:
option_choice_f (option_choice_f f g) h
    = option_choice_f f (option_choice_f g h)

name: empty_is_ALOOKUP
statement: (\x. NONE) = ALOOKUP []

name: repr_insert
statement:
sorted_alist_repr R al f /\ is_insert fl fr R k x al al' ==>
    sorted_alist_repr R al' (option_choice_f (ALOOKUP [(k, x)]) f)

name: alookup_to_option_choice
statement:
(ALOOKUP (x :: y :: zs) = option_choice_f (ALOOKUP [x]) (ALOOKUP (y :: zs)))
    /\ (option_choice_f (ALOOKUP []) g = g)

name: alist_repr_choice_trans_left
statement:
sorted_alist_repr R al f /\
    sorted_alist_repr R al' (option_choice_f (ALOOKUP al) g) ==>
    sorted_alist_repr R al' (option_choice_f f g)

name: alist_repr_refl
statement:
!al. irreflexive R /\ transitive R ==> SORTED R (MAP FST al) ==>
    sorted_alist_repr R al (ALOOKUP al)

name: lookup_repr
statement: sorted_alist_repr R al f /\ is_lookup fl fr R al x r ==> (f x = r)

name: is_lookup_l
statement:
!n. is_lookup fl T R l x res
    ==> is_lookup fl T R (count_append n l r) x res

name: is_lookup_r
statement:
!n. is_lookup T fr R r x res
    ==> is_lookup T fr R (count_append n l r) x res

name: is_lookup_far_left
statement: !R k k' v. R k k' ==> is_lookup F T R [(k', v)] k NONE

name: is_lookup_far_right
statement: !R k k' v. R k' k ==> is_lookup T F R [(k', v)] k NONE

name: is_lookup_hit
statement: !R k k' v. (k' = k) ==> is_lookup T T R [(k', v)] k (SOME v)

name: is_lookup_centre
statement:
!R n l r k.
     l <> [] ==> R (FST (LAST l)) k ==> r <> [] ==> R k (FST (HD r)) ==>
     is_lookup T T R (count_append n l r) k NONE

name: is_lookup_empty
statement: !R k al. (al = []) ==> is_lookup F F R al k NONE

name: list_cmp_cong
statement:
!cmp l1 l2 cmp' l1' l2'.
    l1 = l1' /\ l2 = l2' /\
    (!x x'. MEM x l1' /\ MEM x' l2' ==> cmp x x' = cmp' x x')
    ==>
    list_cmp cmp l1 l2 = list_cmp cmp' l1' l2'

name: option_cmp_cong
statement:
!cmp v1 v2 cmp' v1' v2'.
    v1 = v1' /\ v2 = v2' /\
    (!x x'. v1' = SOME x /\ v2' = SOME x' ==> cmp x x' = cmp' x x') ==>
    option_cmp cmp v1 v2 = option_cmp cmp' v1' v2'

name: option_cmp2_cong
statement:
!cmp v1 v2 cmp' v1' v2'.
    v1 = v1' /\ v2 = v2' /\
    (!x x'. v1' = SOME x /\ v2' = SOME x' ==> cmp x x' = cmp' x x')
    ==>
    option_cmp2 cmp v1 v2 = option_cmp2 cmp' v1' v2'

name: pair_cmp_cong
statement:
!cmp1 cmp2 v1 v2 cmp1' cmp2' v1' v2'.
    v1 = v1' /\
    v2 = v2' /\
    (!a b c d. v1' = (a,b) /\ v2' = (c,d) ==> cmp1 a c = cmp1' a c) /\
    (!a b c d. v1' = (a,b) /\ v2' = (c,d) ==> cmp2 b d = cmp2' b d)
  ==>
    pair_cmp cmp1 cmp2 v1 v2 = pair_cmp cmp1' cmp2' v1' v2'

name: LIST_TO_BAG_SUB_BAG_FLAT_suff
statement:

name: FLOOKUP_FMERGE
statement:
FLOOKUP (FMERGE f m1 m2) k =
    case (FLOOKUP m1 k, FLOOKUP m2 k) of
    | (SOME v1, SOME v2) => SOME $ f v1 v2
    | (f1, f2) => OPTION_CHOICE f1 f2

name: FMERGE_WITH_KEY_EXISTS
statement:
!f m1 m2. ?u.
    FDOM u = FDOM m1 UNION FDOM m2 /\
    !x. u ' x =
      if x IN FDOM m1 /\ x IN FDOM m2 then f x (m1 ' x) (m2 ' x)
      else if x IN FDOM m1 then m1 ' x else m2 ' x

name: FLOOKUP_FMERGE_WITH_KEY
statement:
FLOOKUP (FMERGE_WITH_KEY f m1 m2) k =
    case (FLOOKUP m1 k, FLOOKUP m2 k) of
    | (SOME v1, SOME v2) => SOME $ f k v1 v2
    | (f1, f2) => OPTION_CHOICE f1 f2

name: FMERGE_WITH_KEY_FEMPTY
statement:
FMERGE_WITH_KEY f FEMPTY m2 = m2 /\
  FMERGE_WITH_KEY f m1 FEMPTY = m1

name: FLOOKUP_FMERGE_WITH_KEY_COMM

name: FLOOKUP_FMERGE_WITH_KEY_ASSOC
statement: ASSOC (FMERGE_WITH_KEY f) = !k. ASSOC (f k)

name: FMERGE_WITH_KEY_FUPDATE

name: FMERGE_WITH_KEY_FUNION

    (FMERGE_WITH_KEY f m1 (DRESTRICT m3 (FDOM m1)))
    (FMERGE_WITH_KEY f m2 m3)

    !x. x IN FDOM m2 ==> x IN FDOM m1 /\ (f x (m1 ' x) (m2 ' x) = m1 ' x)) /\
  (FMERGE_WITH_KEY f m1 m2 = m2 <=>
    !x. x IN FDOM m1 ==> x IN FDOM m2 /\ (f x (m1 ' x) (m2 ' x) = m2 ' x))

name: FMERGE_WITH_KEY_DRESTRICT

name: ITFMAPR_unique

  !fm A0 A1 A2. ITFMAPR f fm A0 A1 /\ ITFMAPR f fm A0 A2 ==> A1 = A2

name: ITFMAP_thm
statement:
(ITFMAP f FEMPTY A = A) /\
  ((!k1 k2 v1 v2 A. k1 <> k2 ==> f k1 v1 (f k2 v2 A) = f k2 v2 (f k1 v1 A))
     ==>
   ITFMAP f (fm |+ (k,v)) A = f k v (ITFMAP f (fm\\k) A))

name: ITFMAP_FEMPTY
statement: ITFMAP f FEMPTY A = A

name: fp_soluble_FOLDR1
statement:
fp_soluble R P fm0 f /\
  fm0 = FOLDR (flip $|+) fm kvl /\
  DISJOINT (set (MAP FST kvl)) (FDOM fm) /\
  ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST kvl) ==>
  (!s A. IS_SUFFIX kvl s /\ RC R A P ==>
         RC R A (FOLDR (UNCURRY f) A s) /\
         RC R (FOLDR (UNCURRY f) A s) P) /\
  !s A k v. IS_SUFFIX kvl s /\ RC R A P /\ MEM (k,v) s /\
            f k v A <> A ==>
            FOLDR (UNCURRY f) A s <> A

name: FOLDR_FUPDATE_DOMSUB'

ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST kvl) /\ DISJOINT (set (MAP FST kvl)) (FDOM fm) /\
  ~MEM k (MAP FST kvl) ==>
  FOLDR (flip $|+) (fm \\ k) kvl |+ (k,v) =
  FOLDR (flip $|+) (fm |+ (k,v)) kvl

name: fmlfpR_total_lemma
statement:
fp_soluble R P fm0 f
 ==>
  RC R A0 A1 /\ RC R A1 P /\ (fm : 'b |-> 'c) SUBMAP fm0 /\
  A1 = FOLDR (UNCURRY f) A0 kvl /\
  DISJOINT (set (MAP FST kvl)) (FDOM fm) /\
  ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST kvl) /\
  fm0 = FOLDR (flip $|+) fm kvl
==>
  (fmlfpR f fm0 A0 fm A1 A2 <=> A2 = P)

name: TO_FLOOKUP
statement:
(x IN FDOM m <=> FLOOKUP (m:'a |-> 'b) x <> NONE) /\
  (y IN FRANGE m <=> ?k. FLOOKUP m k = SOME y) /\
  (FLOOKUP m x <> NONE ==> m ' x = THE (FLOOKUP m x)) /\
  (m = m' <=> FLOOKUP m = FLOOKUP m') /\
  (m SUBMAP m' <=> !k v. FLOOKUP m k = SOME v ==> FLOOKUP m' k = SOME v) /\
  (FEVERY P m <=> !k v. FLOOKUP m k = SOME v ==> P (k, v))

  transitive R /\ WF (lbound P (inv R)) /\
  (!k v A. FLOOKUP fm k = SOME v /\ RC R A P ==>
           RC R A (f k v A) /\ RC R (f k v A) P) /\
  
  !A. R A P ==> ?k v. FLOOKUP fm k = SOME v /\ f k v A <> A

(!A0 A1.
    A0 = A1 ==> fmlfpR f fm0 A0 FEMPTY A1 A0) /\
  (!A0 A1 A2.
    fmlfpR f fm0 A1 fm0 A1 A2 /\ A0 <> A1 ==>
    fmlfpR f fm0 A0 FEMPTY A1 A2) /\
  (!A0 A1 A2 fm k v.
    fmlfpR f fm0 A0 (fm \\ k) (f k v A1) A2 ==>
    fmlfpR f fm0 A0 (fm |+ (k,v)) A1 A2)

name: IN_domain
statement:
!n x t1 t2.
      (n IN domain LN <=> F) /\
      (n IN domain (LS x) <=> (n = 0)) /\
      (n IN domain (BN t1 t2) <=>
         n <> 0 /\ (if EVEN n then ((n-1) DIV 2) IN domain t1
                    else ((n-1) DIV 2) IN domain t2)) /\
      (n IN domain (BS t1 x t2) <=>
         (n = 0) \/ (if EVEN n then ((n-1) DIV 2) IN domain t1
                     else ((n-1) DIV 2) IN domain t2))

name: insert_swap

name: lookup_def
statement:
(lookup k LN = NONE) /\
  (lookup k (LS a) = if k = 0 then SOME a else NONE) /\
  (lookup k (BN t1 t2) =
     if k = 0 then NONE
     else lookup ((k - 1) DIV 2) (if EVEN k then t1 else t2)) /\
  (lookup k (BS t1 a t2) =
     if k = 0 then SOME a
     else lookup ((k - 1) DIV 2) (if EVEN k then t1 else t2))

name: insert_def
statement:
(insert k a LN = if k = 0 then LS a
                     else if EVEN k then BN (insert ((k-1) DIV 2) a LN) LN
                     else BN LN (insert ((k-1) DIV 2) a LN)) /\
  (insert k a (LS a') =
     if k = 0 then LS a
     else if EVEN k then BS (insert ((k-1) DIV 2) a LN) a' LN
     else BS LN a' (insert ((k-1) DIV 2) a LN)) /\
  (insert k a (BN t1 t2) =
     if k = 0 then BS t1 a t2
     else if EVEN k then BN (insert ((k - 1) DIV 2) a t1) t2
     else BN t1 (insert ((k - 1) DIV 2) a t2)) /\
  (insert k a (BS t1 a' t2) =
     if k = 0 then BS t1 a t2
     else if EVEN k then BS (insert ((k - 1) DIV 2) a t1) a' t2
     else BS t1 a' (insert ((k - 1) DIV 2) a t2))

name: size_def
statement:
(size LN = 0) /\
  (size (LS a) = 1) /\
  (size (BN t1 t2) = size t1 + size t2) /\
  (size (BS t1 a t2) = size t1 + size t2 + 1)

name: lrnext_def
statement: lrnext n = if n = 0 then 1 else 2 * lrnext ((n - 1) DIV 2)

name: domain_def
statement:
domain LN = {} /\
  domain (LS _) = {0} /\
  domain (BN t1 t2) =
     IMAGE (\n. 2 * n + 2) (domain t1) UNION
     IMAGE (\n. 2 * n + 1) (domain t2) /\
  domain (BS t1 _ t2) =
     {0} UNION IMAGE (\n. 2 * n + 2) (domain t1) UNION
     IMAGE (\n. 2 * n + 1) (domain t2)

name: spt_acc_def
statement:
(spt_acc i 0 = i) /\
  (spt_acc i (SUC k) =
     spt_acc (i + if EVEN (SUC k) then 2 * lrnext i else lrnext i) (k DIV 2))

name: mapi0_def
statement:
(mapi0 f i LN = LN) /\
  (mapi0 f i (LS a) = LS (f i a)) /\
  (mapi0 f i (BN t1 t2) =
   let inc = lrnext i in
     mk_BN (mapi0 f (i + 2 * inc) t1) (mapi0 f (i + inc) t2)) /\
  (mapi0 f i (BS t1 a t2) =
   let inc = lrnext i in
     mk_BS (mapi0 f (i + 2 * inc) t1) (f i a) (mapi0 f (i + inc) t2))

name: mapi_def
statement: mapi f pt = mapi0 f 0 pt

name: fromAList_def

name: map_def
statement:
(map f LN = LN) /\
  (map f (LS a) = (LS (f a))) /\
  (map f (BN t1 t2) = BN (map f t1) (map f t2)) /\
  (map f (BS t1 a t2) = BS (map f t1) (f a) (map f t2))

name: subspt_eq

  (subspt (BS t1 x t2) t <=>
     (spt_center t = SOME x) /\
     subspt t1 (spt_left t) /\ subspt t2 (spt_right t))

name: spt_centers_def
statement:
(spt_centers i [] = (i, [])) /\
  (spt_centers i ((j, x) :: xs) = case spt_center x of
    | NONE => spt_centers (i + j) xs
    | SOME y => apsnd_cons (i, y) (spt_centers (i + j) xs))

name: spts_to_alist_def
statement:
spts_to_alist i xs =
    let ys = combine_rle isEmpty xs in
    if EVERY (isEmpty o SND) ys then [] else
    let (j, centers) = spt_centers i ys in
    let rights = MAP (\(i, t). (i, spt_right t)) ys in
    let lefts = MAP (\(i, t). (i, spt_left t)) ys in
    centers ++ spts_to_alist j (rights ++ lefts)

name: float_cases

name: float_is_distinct

!x. ~(float_is_nan x /\ float_is_infinite x) /\
      ~(float_is_nan x /\ float_is_normal x) /\
      ~(float_is_nan x /\ float_is_subnormal x) /\
      ~(float_is_nan x /\ float_is_zero x) /\
      ~(float_is_infinite x /\ float_is_normal x) /\
      ~(float_is_infinite x /\ float_is_subnormal x) /\
      ~(float_is_infinite x /\ float_is_zero x) /\
      ~(float_is_normal x /\ float_is_subnormal x) /\
      ~(float_is_normal x /\ float_is_zero x) /\

name: float_infinities

name: float_infinities_distinct

name: diff_exponent_boundary

name: diff_exponent_ULP
statement:
!x: ('t, 'w) float y: ('t, 'w) float.
    (x.Sign = y.Sign) /\ x.Exponent <> y.Exponent /\
    ~exponent_boundary y x ==>
    ULP (x.Exponent, (:'t)) <= abs (float_to_real x - float_to_real y)

name: diff_exponent_ULP_gt
statement:
!x: ('t, 'w) float y: ('t, 'w) float.
    (x.Sign = y.Sign) /\ x.Exponent <> y.Exponent /\
    x.Significand NOTIN {0w; -1w} ==>
    ULP (x.Exponent, (:'t)) < abs (float_to_real x - float_to_real y)

name: diff_exponent_ULP_gt0
statement:
!x: ('t, 'w) float y: ('t, 'w) float.
    (x.Sign = y.Sign) /\ x.Exponent <+ y.Exponent /\
    (x.Significand = 0w) /\ ~float_is_zero x ==>
    ULP (x.Exponent, (:'t)) < abs (float_to_real x - float_to_real y)

name: diff_exponent_ULP_gt01
statement:
!x: ('t, 'w) float y: ('t, 'w) float.
    (x.Sign = y.Sign) /\ x.Exponent <> y.Exponent /\
    y.Significand <> -1w  /\ (x.Significand = 0w) /\ (x.Exponent = 1w) ==>
    ULP (x.Exponent, (:'t)) < abs (float_to_real x - float_to_real y)

name: float_to_real_lt_exponent_mono
statement:
!x: ('t, 'w) float y: ('t, 'w) float.
    (x.Sign = y.Sign) /\ abs (float_to_real x) <= abs (float_to_real y) ==>
    x.Exponent <=+ y.Exponent

name: diff_significand_ULP_mul
statement:
!x: ('t, 'w) float y: ('t, 'w) float.
        (x.Sign = y.Sign) /\ (x.Exponent = y.Exponent) ==>
        (abs (float_to_real x - float_to_real y) =
         abs (&w2n x.Significand - &w2n y.Significand) *
         ULP (x.Exponent, (:'t)))

name: diff_significand_ULP
statement:
!x: ('t, 'w) float y: ('t, 'w) float.
        (x.Sign = y.Sign) /\ (x.Exponent = y.Exponent) /\
        x.Significand <> y.Significand ==>
        ULP (x.Exponent, (:'t)) <= abs (float_to_real x - float_to_real y)

name: float_to_real_eq
statement:
!x: ('t, 'w) float y: ('t, 'w) float.
       (float_to_real x = float_to_real y) <=>
       (x = y) \/ (float_is_zero x /\ float_is_zero y)

name: diff_ulp_next_float
statement:
!x y: ('t, 'w) float.
       ~float_is_zero x /\ y.Significand NOTIN {0w; -1w} ==>
       ((abs (float_to_real y - float_to_real x) = ULP (y.Exponent,(:'t))) <=>
        (x = y with Significand := y.Significand - 1w) \/
        (x = y with Significand := y.Significand + 1w))

name: diff_ulp_next_float0
statement:
!x y: ('t, 'w) float.
    ~float_is_zero x /\ ~float_is_zero y /\ (y.Significand = 0w) /\
    abs (float_to_real y) <= abs (float_to_real x) ==>
    ((abs (float_to_real y - float_to_real x) = ULP (y.Exponent,(:'t))) =
     (x = y with Significand := y.Significand + 1w))

name: diff_ulp_next_float01
statement:
!x y: ('t, 'w) float.
    ~float_is_zero x /\ ~float_is_zero y /\
    x.Significand <> -1w /\ (y.Significand = 0w) /\ (y.Exponent = 1w) ==>
    ((abs (float_to_real y - float_to_real x) = ULP (y.Exponent,(:'t))) =
     (x = y with Significand := y.Significand + 1w))

!x r: ('t, 'w) float.
    (2 * abs x = ulp (:'t # 'w)) /\
    (!b: ('t, 'w) float.
       float_is_finite b ==>
       abs (float_to_real r - x) <= abs (float_to_real b - x)) ==>

    r IN {float_plus_min (:'t # 'w);
          float_negate (float_plus_min (:'t # 'w))}

name: largest_lt_threshold
statement: largest (:'t # 'w) < threshold (:'t # 'w)

name: float_tests
statement:
(!s e f.
       float_is_nan <| Sign := s; Exponent := e; Significand := f |> <=>
       (e = -1w) /\ (f <> 0w)) /\
    (!s e f.
       float_is_signalling <| Sign := s; Exponent := e; Significand := f |> <=>
       (e = -1w) /\ ~word_msb f /\ (f <> 0w)) /\
    (!s e f.
       float_is_infinite <| Sign := s; Exponent := e; Significand := f |> <=>
       (e = -1w) /\ (f = 0w)) /\
    (!s e f.
       float_is_normal <| Sign := s; Exponent := e; Significand := f |> <=>
       (e <> 0w) /\ (e <> -1w)) /\
    (!s e f.
       float_is_subnormal <| Sign := s; Exponent := e; Significand := f |> <=>
       (e = 0w) /\ (f <> 0w)) /\
    (!s e f.
       float_is_zero <| Sign := s; Exponent := e; Significand := f |> <=>
       (e = 0w) /\ (f = 0w)) /\
    (!s e f.
       float_is_finite <| Sign := s; Exponent := e; Significand := f |> <=>
       (e <> -1w))

name: float_is_nan_impl
statement: !x. float_is_nan x <=> ~float_equal x x

name: float_is_zero_impl
statement: !x. float_is_zero x <=> float_equal (float_plus_zero (:'w # 't)) x

name: is_closest_def
statement:
is_closest s x a <=>
      a IN s /\
      !b. b IN s ==> abs (float_to_real a - x) <= abs (float_to_real b - x)

name: float_sqrt_def
statement:
float_sqrt mode (x: ('t, 'w) float) =
      if x.Sign = 0w then
         case float_value x of
            NaN => (check_for_signalling [x], float_some_qnan (FP_Sqrt mode x))
          | Infinity => (clear_flags, float_plus_infinity (:'t # 'w))
          | Float r => (float_round_with_flags mode F (sqrt r))
      else if x = float_minus_zero (:'t # 'w) then
        (clear_flags, float_minus_zero (:'t # 'w))
      else
        (invalidop_flags, float_some_qnan (FP_Sqrt mode x))

name: closest_is_everything
statement:
!p s x. s <> EMPTY ==>
           is_closest s x (closest_such p s x) /\
           ((?b. is_closest s x b /\ p b) ==> p (closest_such p s x))

name: float_finite

name: float_to_real_finite

!x : ('t, 'w) float.

name: error_bound_lemma1
statement:
!fracw x.
       0r <= x /\ x < 1 /\ 0 < fracw ==>
       ?n. n < 2n EXP fracw /\ &n / 2 pow fracw <= x /\
           x < &(SUC n) / 2 pow fracw

name: error_bound_big1
statement:
!x k. 2 pow k <= abs x /\ abs x < 2 pow SUC k /\
         abs x < threshold (:'t # 'w) /\ 1 < dimindex (:'w) ==>
         ?a : ('t, 'w) float.
             float_is_finite a /\
             abs (float_to_real a - x) <= 2 pow k / 2 pow (dimindex (:'t) + 1)

name: absolute_error_denormal
statement:
!x. abs x < threshold (:'t # 'w) /\ abs x < 2 * 1 / 2 pow (bias (:'w) - 1) /\
      1 < bias (:'w) ==>
      ?e. abs (float_to_real(round roundTiesToEven x:('t,'w) float) - x) <= e /\
          e <= 1 / 2 pow (bias (:'w) + dimindex (:'t))

name: float_sqrt
statement:
!a : ('t, 'w) float.
    float_is_finite a /\ sqrtable a /\
    abs (sqrt (float_to_real a)) < threshold (:'t # 'w) ==>
    float_is_finite (SND (float_sqrt roundTiesToEven a)) /\
    (float_to_real (SND (float_sqrt roundTiesToEven a)) =
     sqrt (float_to_real a) + error (:'t # 'w) (sqrt (float_to_real a)))

name: sqrtable_def

!p q. (ABS p < q <=> p < q /\ ~q < p) /\

        (~ABS p < q <=> ~q < p \/ p < q) /\

name: signed_saturate_add
statement:
!a b:'a word.
     signed_saturate_add a b =
       let sum = a + b and msba = word_msb a in
         if (msba = word_msb b) /\ (msba <> word_msb sum) then
           if msba then INT_MINw else INT_MAXw
         else
           sum

name: MAPi_compute

name: MAPi_EQ_MAP

name: MAPi_def
statement:
(MAPi f [] = []) /\
  (MAPi f (h::t) = f 0 h :: MAPi (f o SUC) t)

name: MAPi_ACC_def
statement:
(MAPi_ACC f i a [] = REVERSE a) /\
  (MAPi_ACC f i a (h::t) = MAPi_ACC f (i + 1) (f i h :: a) t)

name: FOLDRi_def

name: LIST_TO_SET

name: MAP2_APPEND

name: INDEX_FIND_add

!ls n.
    INDEX_FIND n P ls = OPTION_MAP (\(i, x). (i + n, x)) (INDEX_FIND 0 P ls)

name: FIND_thm

(FIND P [] = NONE) /\
  (FIND P (h::t) = if P h then SOME h else FIND P t)

name: INDEX_OF_eq_NONE

name: INDEX_OF_eq_SOME

name: CONS

name: MEM_APPEND

!l:'a list n1 n2.

name: LENGTH_EQ_NUM

(!l:'a list. LENGTH l = 0 <=> l = []) /\
  (!l:'a list n.
     LENGTH l = SUC n <=> ?h l'. LENGTH l' = n /\ l = h::l') /\
  (!l:'a list n1 n2.
     LENGTH l = n1+n2 <=>
     ?l1 l2. LENGTH l1 = n1 /\ LENGTH l2 = n2 /\ l = l1++l2)

!l1 l1'. (LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l1') ==>

name: FILTER_EQ_CONS
statement:
!P l h lr.
    FILTER P l = h::lr <=>
    ?l1 l2. l = l1++[h]++l2 /\ FILTER P l1 = [] /\ FILTER P l2 = lr /\ P h

name: FILTER_F
statement: !xs. FILTER (\x. F) xs = []

name: FILTER_T
statement: !xs. FILTER (\x. T) xs = xs

name: MEM
statement: (!x:'a. MEM x [] <=> F) /\ (!x:'a h t. MEM x (h::t) <=> x = h \/ MEM x t)

name: LIST_REL_equivalence
statement: !R. equivalence R ==> equivalence (LIST_REL R)

name: list_size_cong
statement:
!M N f f'.
    M=N /\ (!x. MEM x N ==> (f x = f' x))
          ==>
    list_size f M = list_size f' N

name: list_size_append
statement: !f xs ys. list_size f (xs ++ ys) = list_size f xs + list_size f ys

name: FOLDR_CONG
statement:
!l l' b b' (f:'a->'b->'b) f'.
    l=l' /\ b=b' /\ (!x a. MEM x l' ==> (f x a = f' x a))
          ==>
    FOLDR f b l = FOLDR f' b' l'

name: FOLDL_CONG
statement:
!l l' b b' (f:'b->'a->'b) f'.
    l=l' /\ b=b' /\ (!x a. MEM x l' ==> (f a x = f' a x))
          ==>
    FOLDL f b l = FOLDL f' b' l'

name: MAP_CONG
statement:
!l1 l2 f f'.
    l1=l2 /\ (!x. MEM x l2 ==> (f x = f' x)) ==>
    MAP f l1 = MAP f' l2

name: MAP2_CONG
statement:
!l1 l1' l2 l2' f f'.
    l1=l1' /\ l2=l2' /\
    (!x y. MEM x l1' /\ MEM y l2' ==> (f x y = f' x y))
    ==>
    (MAP2 f l1 l2 = MAP2 f' l1' l2')

name: EXISTS_CONG
statement:
!l1 l2 P P'.
    (l1=l2) /\ (!x. MEM x l2 ==> (P x = P' x))
          ==>
    (EXISTS P l1 = EXISTS P' l2)

name: EVERY_CONG
statement:
!l1 l2 P P'.
    l1=l2 /\ (!x. MEM x l2 ==> (P x <=> P' x))
    ==>
    (EVERY P l1 <=> EVERY P' l2)

name: LENGTH_ZIP_MIN
statement: !xs ys. LENGTH (ZIP (xs,ys)) = MIN (LENGTH xs) (LENGTH ys)

name: LIST_REL_EVERY_ZIP
statement:
!R l1 l2.
    LIST_REL R l1 l2 <=>
    LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2 /\ EVERY (UNCURRY R) (ZIP (l1,l2))

name: NOT_EVERY_EXISTS_FIRST
statement: !P l. ~EVERY P l <=> ?i. i < LENGTH l /\ ~P (EL i l) /\ !j. j < i ==> P (EL j l)

name: EXISTS_FIRST
statement: !P l. EXISTS P l <=> ?i. i < LENGTH l /\ P (EL i l) /\ !j. j < i ==> ~P (EL j l)

name: LAST_MAP
statement: !l f. l <> [] ==> (LAST (MAP f l) = f (LAST l))

name: TAKE_LENGTH_TOO_LONG
statement: !l n. LENGTH l <= n ==> (TAKE n l = l)

name: LENGTH_TAKE_EQ
statement: LENGTH (TAKE n xs) = if n <= LENGTH xs then n else LENGTH xs

name: EL_TAKE
statement: !n x l. x < n ==> (EL x (TAKE n l) = EL x l)

name: DROP_0
statement: DROP 0 l = l

name: DROP_LENGTH_NIL
statement: !l. DROP (LENGTH l) l = []

name: DROP_APPEND1
statement: !n l1. n <= LENGTH l1 ==> !l2. DROP n (l1 ++ l2) = DROP n l1 ++ l2

name: DROP_APPEND2
statement: !l1 n. LENGTH l1 <= n ==> !l2. DROP n (l1 ++ l2) = DROP (n - LENGTH l1) l2

name: DROP_APPEND
statement: !n l1 l2. DROP n (l1 ++ l2) = DROP n l1 ++ DROP (n - LENGTH l1) l2

name: TAKE1_DROP
statement: !n l. n < LENGTH l ==> (TAKE 1 (DROP n l) = [EL n l])

name: TAKE_TAKE_MIN
statement: !m n. TAKE n (TAKE m l) = TAKE (MIN n m) l

name: FRONT_TAKE
statement: !l n. 0 < n /\ n <= LENGTH l ==> (FRONT (TAKE n l) = TAKE (n - 1) l)

name: DROP_LENGTH_TOO_LONG
statement: !l n. LENGTH l <= n ==> (DROP n l = [])

name: MEM_DROP
statement:
!x ls n. MEM x (DROP n ls) <=>
           ?m. m + n < LENGTH ls /\ x = EL (m + n) ls

name: DROP_EQ_NIL
statement: !ls n. DROP n ls = [] <=> LENGTH ls <= n

name: HD_DROP
statement: !n l. n < LENGTH l ==> (HD (DROP n l) = EL n l)

name: EL_DROP
statement: !m n l. m + n < LENGTH l ==> (EL m (DROP n l) = EL (m + n) l)

name: MAP_DROP
statement: !l i. MAP f (DROP i l) = DROP i (MAP f l)

name: MAP_FRONT
statement: !ls. ls <> [] ==> (MAP f (FRONT ls) = FRONT (MAP f ls))

name: FOLDL2_cong
statement:
!l1 l1' l2 l2' a a' f f'.
    l1 = l1' /\ l2 = l2' /\ a = a' /\
    (!z b c. MEM b l1' /\ MEM c l2' ==> (f z b c = f' z b c)) ==>
    FOLDL2 f a l1 l2 = FOLDL2 f' a' l1' l2'

name: FOLDL2_FOLDL
statement:
!l1 l2. LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2 ==>
          !f a. FOLDL2 f a l1 l2 = FOLDL (\a. UNCURRY (f a)) a (ZIP (l1,l2))

name: EVERY2_cong
statement:
!l1 l1' l2 l2' P P'.
    l1 = l1' /\ l2 = l2' /\
    (!x y. MEM x l1' /\ MEM y l2' ==> (P x y = P' x y)) ==>
    (EVERY2 P l1 l2 <=> EVERY2 P' l1' l2')

name: MAP_EQ_EVERY2
statement:
!f1 f2 l1 l2. (MAP f1 l1 = MAP f2 l2) <=>
                  (LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2) /\
                  LIST_REL (\x y. f1 x = f2 y) l1 l2

name: EVERY2_EVERY
statement:
!l1 l2 f. EVERY2 f l1 l2 <=>
            LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2 /\ EVERY (UNCURRY f) (ZIP (l1,l2))

name: ALL_DISTINCT_ZIP
statement:
!l1 l2. ALL_DISTINCT l1 /\ (LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2) ==>
            ALL_DISTINCT (ZIP (l1,l2))

name: ALL_DISTINCT_INDEX_OF_EL
statement:
!l n.
    (ALL_DISTINCT l /\ n < LENGTH l) ==>
    INDEX_OF (EL n l) l = SOME n

name: LRC_MEM_right
statement: LRC R (h::t) x y /\ MEM e t ==> ?z p. R z e /\ LRC R p x z

name: INJ_MAP_EQ
statement:
!f l1 l2. INJ f (set l1 UNION set l2) UNIV /\ MAP f l1 = MAP f l2 ==>
            l1 = l2

name: SET_TO_LIST_EMPTY_IFF
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==>
  (SET_TO_LIST s = [] <=> s = {})

name: SET_TO_LIST_IN_MEM
statement: !s. FINITE s ==> !x. x IN s <=> MEM x (SET_TO_LIST s)

name: MEM_SET_TO_LIST
statement: !s. FINITE s ==> !x. MEM x (SET_TO_LIST s) <=> x IN s

name: LIST_TO_SET_TAKE
statement: !i l. set (TAKE i l) SUBSET set l

name: LIST_TO_SET_DROP
statement: !i l. set (DROP i l) SUBSET set l

name: LIST_TO_SET_SING
statement: !vs x. ALL_DISTINCT vs /\ set vs = {x} <=> vs = [x]

name: bounded_length_FINITE
statement:
FINITE (UNIV:'a set) ==>
  !m (s:'a list set). (!x. x IN s ==> LENGTH x <= m) ==> FINITE s

name: EVERY_SNOC
statement: !P (x:'a) l. EVERY P (SNOC x l) <=> EVERY P l /\ P x

name: EXISTS_SNOC
statement: !P (x:'a) l. EXISTS P (SNOC x l) <=> P x \/ (EXISTS P l)

name: MEM_SNOC
statement: !(y:'a) x l. MEM y (SNOC x l) <=> (y = x) \/ MEM y l

name: isPREFIX_SNOC
statement: l <<= SNOC x l

name: LENGTH_GENLIST
statement: !(f:num->'a) n. LENGTH(GENLIST f n) = n

name: GENLIST_ID
statement: !x. GENLIST (\i. EL i x) (LENGTH x) = x

name: ALL_DISTINCT_SNOC
statement: !x l. ALL_DISTINCT (SNOC x l) <=> ~MEM x l /\ ALL_DISTINCT l

name: ALL_DISTINCT_GENLIST
statement:
ALL_DISTINCT (GENLIST f n) <=>
   (!m1 m2. m1 < n /\ m2 < n /\ (f m1 = f m2) ==> (m1 = m2))

name: TAKE_GENLIST
statement: TAKE n (GENLIST f m) = GENLIST f (MIN n m)

name: DROP_GENLIST
statement: DROP n (GENLIST f m) = GENLIST (f o (+) n) (m-n)

name: GENLIST_CONG
statement:
!n1 n2 f1 f2.
    n1 = n2 /\ (!m. m < n2 ==> f1 m = f2 m) ==> GENLIST f1 n1 = GENLIST f2 n2

name: LIST_REL_O
statement: !R1 R2. LIST_REL (R1 O R2) = LIST_REL R1 O LIST_REL R2

name: FOLDL_UNION_BIGUNION_paired
statement:
!f ls s. FOLDL (\s (x,y). s UNION f x y) s ls =
           s UNION BIGUNION (IMAGE (UNCURRY f) (set ls))

name: LUPDATE_def
statement:
(!e n. LUPDATE e n [] = [] : 'a list) /\
  (!e x l. LUPDATE e 0 (x::l) = e::l) /\
  (!e n x l. LUPDATE e (SUC n) (x::l) = x :: LUPDATE e n l)

name: LUPDATE_GENLIST
statement: !m n e f. LUPDATE e n (GENLIST f m) = GENLIST ((n =+ e) f) m

name: splitAtPki_RAND
statement: f (splitAtPki P k l) = splitAtPki P ($o ($o f) k) l

name: splitAtPki_MAP
statement:
splitAtPki P k (MAP f l) =
  splitAtPki (combin$C ($o $o P) f) (combin$C ($o o k o MAP f) (MAP f)) l

name: splitAtPki_change_predicate
statement:
(!i. i < LENGTH l ==> (P1 i (EL i l) <=> P2 i (EL i l))) ==>
  (splitAtPki P1 k l = splitAtPki P2 k l)

name: FLAT_MAP_K_NIL
statement: !ls. FLAT (MAP (K []) ls) = []

name: nub_set
statement: !l. set (nub l) = set l

name: all_distinct_nub
statement: !l. ALL_DISTINCT (nub l)

name: all_distinct_nub_id
statement: !l. ALL_DISTINCT l ==> nub l = l

name: CARD_LIST_TO_SET_EQN
statement: CARD (LIST_TO_SET l) = LENGTH (nub l)

name: MEM_nub
statement: MEM x (nub l) = MEM x l

name: nub_MAP_INJ
statement:
INJ f (set ls) UNIV ==>
  nub (MAP f ls) = MAP f (nub ls)

name: ALL_DISTINCT_TAKE
statement: !ls n. ALL_DISTINCT ls ==> ALL_DISTINCT (TAKE n ls)

name: FINITE_BOUNDED_LISTS
statement: !s n. FINITE s ==> FINITE { l | set l SUBSET s /\ LENGTH l <= n}

name: FINITE_ALL_DISTINCT_LISTS
statement: !s. FINITE s ==> FINITE { l | set l SUBSET s /\ ALL_DISTINCT l}

name: TAKE_LENGTH_ID_rwt
statement: !l m. (m = LENGTH l) ==> (TAKE m l = l)

name: TAKE_LENGTH_ID_rwt2
statement: !l m. TAKE m l = l <=> LENGTH l <= m

name: LIST_REL_eq
statement: LIST_REL (=) = (=)

name: LIST_REL_MEM_IMP
statement: !xs ys P x. LIST_REL P xs ys /\ MEM x xs ==> ?y. MEM y ys /\ P x y

name: LIST_REL_MEM_IMP_R
statement: !xs ys P y. LIST_REL P xs ys /\ MEM y ys ==> ?x. MEM x xs /\ P x y

name: LIST_REL_SNOC
statement:
(LIST_REL R (SNOC x xs) yys <=>
      ?y ys. (yys = SNOC y ys) /\ LIST_REL R xs ys /\ R x y) /\
  (LIST_REL R xxs (SNOC y ys) <=>
      ?x xs. (xxs = SNOC x xs) /\ LIST_REL R xs ys /\ R x y)

name: LIST_REL_APPEND_IMP
statement:
!xs ys xs1 ys1.
      LIST_REL P (xs ++ xs1) (ys ++ ys1) /\ (LENGTH xs = LENGTH ys) ==>
      LIST_REL P xs ys /\ LIST_REL P xs1 ys1

name: LIST_REL_APPEND
statement:
EVERY2 R l1 l2 /\ EVERY2 R l3 l4 <=>
     EVERY2 R (l1 ++ l3) (l2 ++ l4) /\
     (LENGTH l1 = LENGTH l2) /\ (LENGTH l3 = LENGTH l4)

name: LIST_REL_APPEND_suff
statement: EVERY2 R l1 l2 /\ EVERY2 R l3 l4 ==> EVERY2 R (l1 ++ l3) (l2 ++ l4)

name: LIST_REL_APPEND_EQ
statement:
(LENGTH x1 = LENGTH x2) ==>
  (LIST_REL R (x1 ++ y1) (x2 ++ y2) <=> LIST_REL R x1 x2 /\ LIST_REL R y1 y2)

name: LIST_REL_MAP_inv_image
statement: LIST_REL R (MAP f l1) (MAP f l2) = LIST_REL (inv_image R f) l1 l2

name: OPT_MMAP_cong
statement:
!f1 f2 x1 x2.
    x1 = x2 /\ (!a. MEM a x2 ==> f1 a = f2 a) ==>
    OPT_MMAP f1 x1 = OPT_MMAP f2 x2

name: DROP_TAKE
statement: !xs n k. DROP n (TAKE k xs) = TAKE (k - n) (DROP n xs)

name: TAKE_DROP_SWAP
statement: !xs k n. TAKE k (DROP n xs) = DROP n (TAKE (k + n) xs)

name: adjacent_thm
statement:
adjacent [] a b = F /\
  adjacent [e] a b = F /\
  adjacent (a::b::t) a b = T

name: adjacent_iff
statement: adjacent (h1::h2::t) a b <=> h1 = a /\ h2 = b \/ adjacent (h2::t) a b

name: adjacent_EL
statement: adjacent L a b <=> ?i. i + 1 < LENGTH L /\ a = EL i L /\ b = EL (i + 1) L

name: LIST_EQUIV
statement: !R:'a -> 'a -> bool. EQUIV R ==> EQUIV (LIST_REL R)

name: LIST_QUOTIENT
statement:
!R (abs:'a -> 'b) rep.
    QUOTIENT R abs rep ==>
    QUOTIENT (LIST_REL R) (MAP abs) (MAP rep)

name: NIL_RSP
statement: !R (abs:'a -> 'b) rep. QUOTIENT R abs rep ==> LIST_REL R [] []

name: NIL_PRS
statement: !R (abs:'a -> 'b) rep. QUOTIENT R abs rep ==> [] = (MAP abs) []

name: CONS_PRS
statement:
!R (abs:'a -> 'b) rep.
    QUOTIENT R abs rep ==>
    !t h. CONS h t = (MAP abs) (CONS (rep h) (MAP rep t))

name: CONS_RSP
statement:
!R (abs:'a -> 'b) rep.
    QUOTIENT R abs rep ==>
    !t1 t2 h1 h2.
      R h1 h2 /\ (LIST_REL R) t1 t2 ==> (LIST_REL R) (CONS h1 t1) (CONS h2 t2)

name: EVERY_PRS
statement:
!R (abs:'a -> 'b) rep.
    QUOTIENT R abs rep ==>
    !l P. EVERY P l = EVERY ((abs --> I) P) (MAP rep l)

name: LIST_TO_SET_PRS
statement:
!R (abs : 'a -> 'b) rep.
    QUOTIENT R abs rep ==>
    !l. LIST_TO_SET l = IMAGE abs (LIST_TO_SET (MAP rep l))

name: SET_REL_EQ
statement: SET_REL (=) = (=)

name: SET_REL_THM
statement:
SET_REL R s1 s2 <=>
  (!x. x IN s1 ==> ?y. y IN s2 /\ R x y) /\
  (!y. y IN s2 ==> ?x. x IN s1 /\ R x y)

name: SET_QUOTIENT
statement:
!R abs rep.
    QUOTIENT R (abs : 'a -> 'b) rep ==>
    QUOTIENT (SET_REL R) (IMAGE abs) (IMAGE rep)

name: LIST_TO_SET_RSP
statement:
!R (abs:'a -> 'b) rep.
    QUOTIENT R abs rep ==>
    !l1 l2. LIST_REL R l1 l2 ==>
            SET_REL R (LIST_TO_SET l1) (LIST_TO_SET l2)

name: EVERY_RSP
statement:
!R (abs:'a -> 'b) rep.
    QUOTIENT R abs rep ==>
    !l1 l2 P1 P2.
      (R ===> $=) P1 P2 /\ (LIST_REL R) l1 l2 ==>
      (EVERY P1 l1 <=> EVERY P2 l2)

name: MAP_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1.
    QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
    !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2.
      QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
      !l1 l2 f1 f2.
        (R1 ===> R2) f1 f2 /\ (LIST_REL R1) l1 l2 ==>
        (LIST_REL R2) (MAP f1 l1) (MAP f2 l2)

name: MAP_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1.
    QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
    !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2.
      QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
      !l f. MAP f l = (MAP abs2) (MAP ((abs1 --> rep2) f) (MAP rep1 l))

name: MAP2_DEF
statement:
(MAP2 f (h1::t1) (h2::t2) = f h1 h2::MAP2 f t1 t2) /\
  (MAP2 f x y = [])

name: INDEX_FIND_def
FIND_def
statement: FIND P = OPTION_MAP SND o INDEX_FIND 0 P

name: INDEX_OF_def
statement: INDEX_OF x = OPTION_MAP FST o INDEX_FIND 0 ($= x)

name: TAKE_def
statement:
(TAKE n [] = []) /\
  (TAKE n (x::xs) = if n = 0 then [] else x :: TAKE (n - 1) xs)

name: DROP_def
statement:
(DROP n [] = []) /\
  (DROP n (x::xs) = if n = 0 then x::xs else DROP (n - 1) xs)

name: FOLDL2_def
statement:
(FOLDL2 f a (b::bs) (c::cs) = FOLDL2 f (f a b c) bs cs) /\
  (FOLDL2 f a bs cs = a)

name: LRC_def
statement:
(LRC R [] x y <=> (x = y)) /\
  (LRC R (h::t) x y <=>
     x = h /\ ?z. R x z /\ LRC R t z y)

name: isPREFIX
statement:
(isPREFIX [] l = T) /\
  (isPREFIX (h::t) l = case l of [] => F
                               | h'::t' => (h = h') /\ isPREFIX t t')

name: GENLIST
statement:
GENLIST (f:num->'a) 0 = [] /\
  GENLIST f (SUC n) = SNOC (f n) (GENLIST f n)

name: GENLIST_AUX
statement:
(GENLIST_AUX f 0 l = l) /\
  (GENLIST_AUX f (SUC n) l = GENLIST_AUX f n ((f n)::l))

name: PAD_LEFT
statement: PAD_LEFT c n s = (GENLIST (K c) (n - LENGTH s)) ++ s

name: PAD_RIGHT
statement: PAD_RIGHT c n s = s ++ (GENLIST (K c) (n - LENGTH s))

name: LEN_DEF
statement:
LEN [] n = n /\
  LEN (h::t) n = LEN t (n+1)

name: REV_DEF
statement:
(REV [] acc = acc) /\
  (REV (h::t) acc = REV t (h::acc))

name: LUPDATE_DEF
statement:
LUPDATE e n [] = [] /\
  LUPDATE e n (x::l) = if n = 0 then e :: l else x :: LUPDATE e (PRE n) l

name: EVERYi_def
statement:
(EVERYi P [] <=> T) /\
  (EVERYi P (h::t) <=> P 0 h /\ EVERYi (P o SUC) t)

name: splitAtPki_def
nub_def
statement:
(nub [] = []) /\
   (nub (x::l) = if MEM x l then nub l else x :: nub l)

name: OPT_MMAP_def
statement:
(OPT_MMAP f [] = SOME []) /\
  (OPT_MMAP f (h0::t0) =
     OPTION_BIND (f h0) (\h. OPTION_BIND (OPT_MMAP f t0) (\t. SOME (h::t))))

name: SET_REL_def
statement:
SET_REL R s1 s2 <=>
  ?ps. IMAGE FST ps = s1 /\ IMAGE SND ps = s2 /\
       !p. p IN ps ==> R (FST p) (SND p)

name: adjacent_def
statement:
(!a b t. adjacent (a::b::t) a b) /\
  (!a b h t. adjacent t a b ==> adjacent (h::t) a b)

name: ncons_11
statement: ncons x y = ncons h t <=> x = h /\ y = t

name: ncons_not_nnil
statement: ncons x y <> nnil

name: lt_ncons1
statement: h < ncons h t

name: lt_ncons2
statement: t < ncons h t

name: nlistrec_thm
statement:
nlistrec n f nnil = n /\
  nlistrec n f (ncons h t) = f h t (nlistrec n f t)

name: nlist_ind
statement: !P. P 0 /\ (!h t. P t ==> P (ncons h t)) ==> !n. P n

name: nlist_cases
statement: !n. (n = nnil) \/ ?h t. n = ncons h t

name: nlist_of_EQ0
statement:
(nlist_of l = 0 <=> l = []) /\
  (0 = nlist_of l <=> l = [])

name: listOfN_zero
statement: listOfN 0 = []

name: listOfN_ncons
statement: listOfN (ncons h t) = h :: listOfN t

name: listOfN_EQ_NIL
statement: (listOfN l = [] <=> l = 0) /\ ([] = listOfN l <=> l = 0)

name: listOfN_EQ_CONS
statement: listOfN n = h :: t <=> ?tn. n = ncons h tn /\ listOfN tn = t

name: nlist_listOfN
statement: !l. nlist_of (listOfN l) = l

name: listOfN_nlist
statement: !l. listOfN (nlist_of l) = l

name: listOfN_SURJ
statement: !l. ?n. listOfN n = l

name: listOfN_INJ
statement: !l1 l2. listOfN l1 = listOfN l2 <=> l1 = l2

name: nlist_of_INJ
statement: !n1 n2. nlist_of n1 = nlist_of n2 <=> n1 = n2

name: nlist_of_SURJ
statement: !l. ?n. nlist_of n = l

name: nhd0
statement: nhd 0 = 0

name: nhd_thm
statement: nhd (ncons h t) = h

name: ntl_zero
statement: ntl 0 = 0

name: ntl_thm
statement: ntl (ncons h t) = t

name: ntl_LT
statement: 0 < n ==> ntl n < n

name: ncons_nhd_ntl
statement: !l. l <> 0 ==> ncons (nhd l) (ntl l) = l

name: ntl_zero_empty_OR_ncons
statement: ntl l = 0 <=> l = 0 \/ ?x. l = ncons x 0

name: ndrop_SUC
statement: !l n. ndrop (SUC n) l = ntl (ndrop n l)

name: ntl_ndrop
statement: !l. ntl (ndrop n l) = ndrop n (ntl l)

name: nel_nnil
statement: nel x 0 = 0

name: nel0_ncons
statement: nel 0 (ncons h t) = h

name: nel_nhd
statement: nel 0 l = nhd l

name: nel_SUC_CONS
statement: !n h t. nel (SUC n) (ncons h t) = nel n t

name: nlast_nnil
statement: nlast 0 = 0

name: nlast_ncons
statement: nlast (ncons h tn) = if tn = 0 then h else nlast tn

name: nlast_nel
statement: !l. nlast l = nel (nlen l - 1) l

name: nfront_nnil
statement: nfront 0 = 0

name: nfront_nsingl
statement: nfront (ncons x 0) = 0

name: nfront_thm
statement:
nfront 0 = 0 /\
  nfront (ncons h t) = if t = 0 then 0 else ncons h (nfront t)

name: nhd_nfront
statement: !l. l <> 0 /\ ntl l <> 0 ==> nhd (nfront l) = nhd l

name: LENGTH_nfront

name: set_byte_32
statement:
set_byte a b (w:word32) be =
    let i = byte_index a be in
      if i = 0  then w2w b       || (w && 0xFFFFFF00w) else
      if i = 8  then w2w b << 8  || (w && 0xFFFF00FFw) else
      if i = 16 then w2w b << 16 || (w && 0xFF00FFFFw) else
                     w2w b << 24 || (w && 0x00FFFFFFw)

name: set_byte_64
statement:
set_byte a b (w:word64) be =
    let i = byte_index a be in
      if i = 0  then w2w b       || (w && 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFF00w) else
      if i = 8  then w2w b << 8  || (w && 0xFFFFFFFFFFFF00FFw) else
      if i = 16 then w2w b << 16 || (w && 0xFFFFFFFFFF00FFFFw) else
