(!m:num. P m m) /\ (!m n. P m n <=> P n m) /\ (!m n. m < n ==> P m n)
   ==> !m y. P m y

name: WLOG_LE
statement:
(!m n:num. P m n <=> P n m) /\ (!m n:num. m <= n ==> P m n) ==>
    !m n:num. P m n

name: num_case_NUMERAL_compute
statement:
num_CASE (NUMERAL (BIT1 n)) (z:'a) s = s (NUMERAL(BIT1 n) - 1) /\
  num_CASE (NUMERAL (BIT2 n)) z s = s (NUMERAL(BIT1 n))

name: transitive_LE
statement: transitive $<=

name: WOP_measure
statement: !P m. (?a:'a. P a) ==> ?b. P b /\ !c. P c ==> m b <= m c

name: INV_PRE_LESS
statement: !m. 0 < m  ==> !n. PRE m < PRE n <=> m < n

name: SUB_LESS_0
statement: !n m. m < n <=> 0 < n - m

name: LESS_MULT_MONO
statement: !m i n. SUC n * m < SUC n * i <=> m < i

name: ADD_SUB2
statement: !m n. (m + n) - m = n

name: GREATER_EQ
statement: !n m. n >= m <=> m <= n

name: LESS_EQ_EXISTS
statement: !m n. m <= n <=> ?p. n = m + p

name: EVEN_MULT
statement: !m n. EVEN(m * n) <=> EVEN m \/ EVEN n

name: ODD_ADD
statement: !m n. ODD(m + n) <=> ODD m <> ODD n

name: ODD_MULT
statement: !m n. ODD(m * n) <=> ODD(m) /\ ODD(n)

name: ODD_POS
statement: !n. ODD n ==> 0 < n

name: ADD_MONO_LESS_EQ
statement: !m n p. m + n <= m + p <=> n <= p

name: NOT_LEQ
statement: !m n. ~(m <= n) <=> SUC n <= m

name: NOT_NUM_EQ
statement: !m n. m <> n <=> SUC m <= n \/ SUC n <= m

name: NOT_GREATER_EQ
statement: !m n. ~(m >= n) <=> SUC m <= n

name: MULT_LESS_EQ_SUC
statement: !m n p. m <= n <=> SUC p * m <= SUC p * n

name: LE_MULT_RCANCEL
statement: !m n p. m * n <= p * n <=> n = 0 \/ m <= p

name: LT_MULT_LCANCEL
statement: !m n p. m * n < m * p <=> 0 < m /\ n < p

name: LT_MULT_RCANCEL
statement: !m n p. m * n < p * n <=> 0 < n /\ m < p

name: DIVISION
statement: !n. 0 < n ==> !k. k = k DIV n * n + k MOD n /\ k MOD n < n

name: DIVMOD_UNIQ
statement: !m n q r. (m = q * n + r) /\ r < n ==> (m DIV n = q) /\ (m MOD n = r)

name: DIV_0
statement: k DIV 0 = 0 /\ 0 DIV n = 0

name: MOD_0
statement: k MOD 0 = k /\ 0 MOD n = 0

name: X_MOD_Y_EQ_X
statement: !x y. 0 < y ==> ((x MOD y = x) <=> x < y)

name: X_LE_DIV
statement: !x y z. 0 < z ==> (x <= y DIV z <=> x * z <= y)

name: DIV_LT_X
statement: !x y z. 0 < z ==> (y DIV z < x <=> y < x * z)

name: DIV_EQ_X
statement: !x y z. 0 < z ==> ((y DIV z = x) <=> x * z <= y /\ y < SUC x * z)

name: EQ_ADD_LCANCEL'
statement: x + y = y + z <=> x = z

name: DIV_NUMERAL_THM
statement:
(NUMERAL (BIT1 n) * x) DIV NUMERAL (BIT1 n) = x /\
  (NUMERAL (BIT2 n) * x) DIV NUMERAL (BIT2 n) = x /\
  (NUMERAL (BIT1 n) * x + y) DIV NUMERAL (BIT1 n) = x + y DIV NUMERAL (BIT1 n)/\
  (NUMERAL (BIT2 n) * x + y) DIV NUMERAL (BIT2 n) = x + y DIV NUMERAL (BIT2 n)/\
  (y + NUMERAL (BIT1 n) * x) DIV NUMERAL (BIT1 n) = x + y DIV NUMERAL (BIT1 n)/\
  (y + NUMERAL (BIT2 n) * x) DIV NUMERAL (BIT2 n) = x + y DIV NUMERAL (BIT2 n)

name: NUMERAL_MULT_EQ_DIV
statement:
((NUMERAL (BIT1 x) * y = NUMERAL z) <=>
       (y = NUMERAL z DIV NUMERAL (BIT1 x)) /\
       (NUMERAL z MOD NUMERAL(BIT1 x) = 0)) /\
    ((NUMERAL (BIT2 x) * y = NUMERAL z) <=>
       (y = NUMERAL z DIV NUMERAL (BIT2 x)) /\
       (NUMERAL z MOD NUMERAL(BIT2 x) = 0))

name: DIV_0_IMP_LT
statement: !b n. 1 < b /\ (n DIV b = 0) ==> n < b

name: DIVMOD_ELIM_THM
statement:
!P m n. 0 < n ==>
           (P (m DIV n) (m MOD n) <=> !q r. m = q * n + r /\ r < n ==> P q r)

name: DIVMOD_ELIM_THM'
statement:
!P m n. 0 < n ==>
           (P (m DIV n) (m MOD n) <=> ?q r. m = q * n + r /\ r < n /\ P q r)

name: MULT_DIV_2
statement: !n. (2 * n) DIV 2 = n

name: EVEN_DIV_2
statement: !n. ~(EVEN n) ==> ((SUC n) DIV 2 = SUC((n - 1) DIV 2))

name: PRE_ELIM_THM'
statement: P (PRE n) <=> !m. n = SUC m \/ m = 0 /\ n = 0 ==> P m

name: PRE_ELIM_THM_EXISTS
statement: P (PRE n) <=> (?m. (n = SUC m \/ m = 0 /\ n = 0) /\ P m)

name: EXP_1
statement: !n. (1 EXP n = 1) /\ (n EXP 1 = n)

name: EXP_EXP_LT_MONO
statement: !a b. a EXP n < b EXP n <=> a < b /\ 0 < n

name: EXP_EXP_LE_MONO
statement: !a b. a EXP n <= b EXP n <=> a <= b \/ (n = 0)

name: EXP_EXP_INJECTIVE
statement: !b1 b2 x. (b1 EXP x = b2 EXP x) <=> (x = 0) \/ (b1 = b2)

name: MIN_LT
statement:
!n m p. (MIN m n < p <=> m < p \/ n < p) /\
          (p < MIN m n <=> p < m /\ p < n)

name: MAX_LT
statement:
!n m p. (p < MAX m n <=> p < m \/ p < n) /\
          (MAX m n < p <=> m < p /\ n < p)

name: MIN_LE
statement:
!n m p. (MIN m n <= p <=> m <= p \/ n <= p) /\
          (p <= MIN m n <=> p <= m /\ p <= n)

name: MAX_LE
statement:
!n m p. (p <= MAX m n <=> p <= m \/ p <= n) /\
          (MAX m n <= p <=> m <= p /\ n <= p)

name: FUNPOW_CONG
statement:
!n x f g.
  (!m. m < n ==> f (FUNPOW f m x) = g (FUNPOW f m x))
  ==>
  FUNPOW f n x = FUNPOW g n x

name: FUNPOW_invariant
statement:
!m x.
  P x /\ (!x. P x ==> P (f x)) ==>
  P (FUNPOW f m x)

name: EXP2_LT
statement: !m n. n DIV 2 < 2 ** m <=> n < 2 ** SUC m

name: EVEN_SUB
statement: !m n. m <= n ==> (EVEN (n - m) <=> (EVEN n <=> EVEN m))

name: ODD_SUB
statement: !m n. m <= n ==> (ODD (n - m) <=> (ODD n <=/=> ODD m))

name: CEILING_DIV_LE_X
statement: !k m n. 0 < k ==> (CEILING_DIV n k <= m <=> n <= m * k)

name: CEILING_DIV
statement: !k. 0 < k ==> !n. CEILING_DIV n k = n DIV k + MIN (n MOD k) 1

name: CEILING_DIV_MOD
statement:
!k.
    0 < k ==>
    !n. (n = k * CEILING_DIV n k - CEILING_MOD n k) /\ CEILING_MOD n k < k

name: LE_MULT_CEILING_DIV
statement: !k. 0 < k ==> !n. n <= k * CEILING_DIV n k

name: N0_11
statement: N0 m = N0 n <=> m = n

name: ODD12
statement: ODD 1 /\ ~ODD 2

name: ONE_DIV2
statement: 1 DIV 2 = 0

name: P0_11
statement: P0 c d = P0 e f <=> c = e /\ d = f

name: Pair_11
statement: Pair c d = Pair e f <=> c = e /\ d = f

name: Num_11
statement: Num m = Num n <=> m = n

name: cv_distinct
statement: Num n <> Pair c d

name: cvrel_exists
statement: !f g c. ?r. cvrel f g c r

name: cvrel_unique
statement:
!c r1. cvrel f g c r1 ==>
         !r2. cvrel f g c r2 ==> r1 = r2

name: cvrelf_Pair
statement: cvrelf f g (Pair c d) = g c d (cvrelf f g c) (cvrelf f g d)

name: cv_Axiom
statement:
!f g. ?h. (!n. h (Num n) = f n) /\
            (!c d. h (Pair c d) = g c d (h c) (h d))

name: cv_if_def
statement:
cv_if (Num (SUC m)) (p:cv) (q:cv) = p /\
  cv_if (Num 0) p q = q /\
  cv_if (Pair r s) p q = q

name: c2b_thm
statement:
(c2b (Num (SUC n)) = T) /\
  (c2b (Num 1) = T) /\
  (c2b (Num 0) = F) /\
  (c2b (Num (NUMERAL ZERO)) = F) /\
  (c2b (Pair x y) = F)

name: b2c
statement:
((b2c x = Num 1) = x) /\
  (b2c x = Num (SUC 0)) = x

name: b2c_if
statement: b2c g = if g then Num (SUC 0) else Num 0

name: cv_lt_def
statement:
cv_lt (Num m) (Num n) = Num (if m < n then SUC 0 else 0) /\
  cv_lt (Num m) (Pair p q) = Num 0 /\
  cv_lt (Pair p q) (Num n) = Num 0 /\
  cv_lt (Pair p q) (Pair r s) = Num 0

name: cv_add_def
statement:
cv_add (Num m) (Num n) = Num (m + n) /\
  cv_add (Num m) (Pair p q) = Num m /\
  cv_add (Pair p q) (Num n) = Num n /\
  cv_add (Pair p q) (Pair r s) = Num 0

name: cv_sub_def
statement:
cv_sub (Num m) (Num n) = Num (m - n) /\
  cv_sub (Num m) (Pair p q) = Num m /\
  cv_sub (Pair p q) (Num n) = Num 0 /\
  cv_sub (Pair p q) (Pair r s) = Num 0

name: cv_mul_def
statement:
cv_mul (Num m) (Num n) = Num (m * n) /\
  cv_mul (Num m) (Pair p q) = Num 0 /\
  cv_mul (Pair p q) (Num n) = Num 0 /\
  cv_mul (Pair p q) (Pair r s) = Num 0

name: cv_div_def
statement:
cv_div (Num m) (Num n) = Num (m DIV n) /\
  cv_div (Num m) (Pair p q) = Num 0 /\
  cv_div (Pair p q) (Num n) = Num 0 /\
  cv_div (Pair p q) (Pair r s) = Num 0

name: cv_mod_def
statement:
cv_mod (Num m) (Num n) = Num (m MOD n) /\
  cv_mod (Num m) (Pair p q) = Num m /\
  cv_mod (Pair p q) (Num n) = Num 0 /\
  cv_mod (Pair p q) (Pair r s) = Num 0

name: cv_eq_def
statement: cv_eq p q = Num (if p = q then SUC 0 else 0)

name: cv_eq
statement:
(cv_eq (Pair x y) (Pair x' y') = b2c (x = x' /\ y = y')) /\
  (cv_eq (Num m) (Num n) = b2c (m = n)) /\
  (cv_eq (Pair x y) (Num n) = b2c F) /\
  (cv_eq (Num n) (Pair x y) = b2c F)

name: lemma
statement: n:num <= m ==> (m - n = k <=> m = n + k)

name: DIV_RECURSIVE
statement:
m DIV n =
    if n = 0 then 0 else
    if m < n then 0 else
      SUC ((m - n) DIV n)

name: MOD_RECURSIVE
statement: m MOD n = if n = 0 then m else if m < n then m else (m - n) MOD n

name: CV_EQ
statement:
((Pair p q = Pair r s) = (if p = r then q = s else F)) /\
  ((Pair p q = Num n) = F) /\
  ((Num m = Num n) = (m = n))

name: LT_RECURSIVE
statement:
((m < 0) = F) /\
  ((m < SUC n) = (if m = n then T else m < n))

name: SUC_EQ
statement:
((SUC m = 0) = F) /\
  ((SUC m = SUC n) = (m = n))

name: cv_if_cong
statement:
(c2b P = c2b Q) /\
  (c2b Q ==> x = x') /\
  (~c2b Q ==> y = y') ==>
    cv_if P x y = cv_if Q x' y'

name: cv_if
statement: cv_if x y z = if c2b x then y else z

name: cv_extras
statement:
(cv_lt v (Pair x y) = Num 0) /\
  (cv_lt (Pair x y) v = Num 0) /\
  (cv_add (Pair x y) v = case v of Pair a b => Num 0 | _ => v) /\
  (cv_add v (Pair x y) = case v of Pair a b => Num 0 | _ => v) /\
  (cv_sub (Pair x y) v = Num 0) /\
  (cv_sub v (Pair x y) = case v of Pair a b => Num 0 | _ => v) /\
  (cv_mul (Pair x y) v = Num 0) /\
  (cv_mul v (Pair x y) = Num 0) /\
  (cv_div (Pair x y) v = Num 0) /\
  (cv_div v (Pair x y) = case v of Pair a b => Num 0 | _ => Num 0) /\
  (cv_mod (Pair x y) v = Num 0) /\
  (cv_mod v (Pair x y) = case v of Pair a b => Num 0 | _ => v)

name: neq_to_cv
statement: !m n. m = n <=> c2b (cv_eq (Num m) (Num n))

name: lt_to_cv
statement: m < n <=> c2b (cv_lt (Num m) (Num n))

name: gt_to_cv
statement: m > n <=> c2b (cv_lt (Num n) (Num m))

name: le_to_cv
statement: m <= n <=> ~c2b (cv_lt (Num n) (Num m))

name: ge_to_cv
statement: n >= m <=> ~c2b (cv_lt (Num n) (Num m))

name: ODD_to_cv
statement: ODD n <=> c2b (cv_mod (Num n) (Num 2))

name: EVEN_to_cv
statement: EVEN n <=> ~c2b (cv_mod (Num n) (Num 2))

name: add_to_cv
statement: m + n = c2n (cv_add (Num m) (Num n))

name: suc_to_cv
statement: SUC m = c2n (cv_add (Num m) (Num 1))

name: sub_to_cv
statement: m - n = c2n (cv_sub (Num m) (Num n))

name: pre_to_cv
statement: PRE m = c2n (cv_sub (Num m) (Num 1))

name: mul_to_cv
statement: m * n = c2n (cv_mul (Num m) (Num n))

name: div_to_cv
statement: m DIV n = c2n (cv_div (Num m) (Num n))

name: mod_to_cv
statement: m MOD n = c2n (cv_mod (Num m) (Num n))

name: cv_exp_eq
statement:
cv_exp b e =
    cv_if e                                        
          (cv_if (cv_mod e (Num 2))                
                 (cv_mul b (cv_exp b (cv_sub e (Num 1))))
                 (let x = cv_exp b (cv_div e (Num 2))
                  in cv_mul x x))
          (Num 1)

name: exp_to_cv
statement: m ** n = c2n (cv_exp (Num m) (Num n))

name: iscv_def
statement:
[~num:] (!m. iscv (N0 m))
[~pair:] (!c d. iscv c /\ iscv d ==> iscv (P0 c d))

name: cvrel_def
statement:
[~num:]
  (!n. cvrel f g (Num n) (f n))
[~pair:]
  (!c d rc rd. cvrel f g c rc /\ cvrel f g d rd ==>
               cvrel f g (Pair c d) (g c d rc rd))

name: isnseq_def
statement:
[~nil:] isnseq (Num 0)
[~cons:] (!n c. isnseq c ==> isnseq (Pair n c))

name: cv_rep_T
statement: b2c T = Num 1

name: cv_rep_F
statement: b2c F = Num 0

name: cv_rep_not
statement: b2c (~b1) = cv_sub (Num 1) (b2c b1)

name: cv_rep_and
statement: b2c (b1 /\ b2) = cv_if (b2c b1) (b2c b2) (Num 0)

name: cv_rep_or
statement: b2c (b1 \/ b2) = cv_if (b2c b1) (Num 1) (b2c b2)

name: cv_inline_imp
statement: b2c (a ==> b) = cv_if (b2c a) (b2c b) (Num 1)

name: cv_rep_suc
statement: Num (SUC n) = cv_add (Num n) (Num 1)

name: cv_rep_sub1
statement: Num (PRE n) = cv_sub (Num n) (Num 1)

name: cv_rep_add
statement: Num (n + m) = cv_add (Num n) (Num m)

name: cv_rep_sub
statement: Num (n - m) = cv_sub (Num n) (Num m)

name: cv_rep_mul
statement: Num (n * m) = cv_mul (Num n) (Num m)

name: cv_rep_div
statement: Num (n DIV m) = cv_div (Num n) (Num m)

name: cv_rep_mod
statement: Num (n MOD m) = cv_mod (Num n) (Num m)

name: cv_rep_exp
statement: Num (n ** m) = cv_exp (Num n) (Num m)

name: cv_rep_odd
statement: b2c (ODD n) = cv_mod (Num n) (Num 2)

name: cv_rep_even
statement: b2c (EVEN n) = cv_sub (Num 1) (cv_mod (Num n) (Num 2))

name: cv_rep_lt
statement: b2c (n < m) = cv_lt (Num n) (Num m)

name: cv_rep_le
statement: b2c (n <= m) = cv_sub (Num 1) (cv_lt (Num m) (Num n))

name: cv_rep_num_case
statement:
cv_rep p1 c1 Num x /\
  cv_rep p2 c2 (a:'a->cv) y /\
  (!v:num. cv_rep (p3 v) (c3 (Num v)) (a:'a->cv) (z v)) ==>
  cv_rep (p1 /\ (x = 0 ==> p2) /\ !n. x = SUC n ==> p3 n)
         (cv_if (cv_lt (Num 0) c1) (let y = cv_sub c1 (Num 1) in c3 y) c2)
         a (num_CASE x y z)

name: cv_min_thm
statement: Num (MIN m n) = cv_min (Num m) (Num n)

name: cv_max_thm
statement: Num (MAX m n) = cv_max (Num m) (Num n)

name: cv_gcd_thm
statement: Num (gcd a b) = cv_gcd (Num a) (Num b)

name: cv_rep_LOG2
statement: n <> 0 ==> Num (LOG2 n) = cv_log2 (Num 0) (Num n)

name: cv_int_of_num
statement: from_int (&n) = Num n

name: cv_Num
statement: Num (integer$Num i) = cv_abs (from_int i)

name: cv_neg_int
statement: from_int (- x) = cv_int_neg (from_int x)

name: cv_int_lt
statement: b2c (int_lt i j) = cv_int_lt (from_int i) (from_int j)

name: cv_int_le
statement:
b2c (int_le i j) = cv_if (cv_int_lt (from_int j) (from_int i))
                      (Num 0) (Num 1)

name: cv_int_gt
statement: b2c (int_gt i j) = cv_int_lt (from_int j) (from_int i)

name: cv_int_ge
statement:
b2c (int_ge i j) = cv_if (cv_int_lt (from_int i) (from_int j))
                      (Num 0) (Num 1)

name: cv_int_add
statement: from_int (i + j) = cv_int_add (from_int i) (from_int j)

name: cv_int_sub
statement: from_int (i - j) = cv_int_add (from_int i) (cv_int_neg (from_int j))

name: total_int_div
statement:
total_int_div i j =
    if j = 0 then 0
    else if j < 0 then
            if i < 0 then &(Num i DIV Num j)
            else -&(Num i DIV Num j) + if Num i MOD Num j = 0 then 0 else -1
    else if i < 0 then -&(Num i DIV Num j) + if Num i MOD Num j = 0 then 0 else -1
         else &(Num i DIV Num j)

name: cv_int_div
statement: from_int (total_int_div i j) = cv_int_div (from_int i) (from_int j)

name: cv_int_mul
statement: from_int (i * j) = cv_int_mul (from_int i) (from_int j)

name: cv_rat_of_int
statement: from_rat (rat_of_int i) = Pair (from_int i) (Num 1)

name: cv_rat_neg
statement: from_rat (-r) = cv_rat_neg (from_rat r)

name: cv_rat_reciprocal
statement: r <> 0 ==> from_rat (rat_minv r) = cv_rat_reciprocal (from_rat r)

name: cv_rat_norm_div_gcd
statement:
(λ(x,y). Pair (from_int x) (Num y)) (div_gcd a b) =
  cv_rat_norm (Pair (from_int a) (Num b))

name: from_rat_eq_cv_rat_norm_suff
statement:
r = rat_of_int n / &d /\ d <> 0 /\
  from_int n = x /\
  Num d = y
  ==> from_rat r = cv_rat_norm (Pair x y)

name: cv_rat_add
statement: from_rat (r1 + r2) = cv_rat_add (from_rat r1) (from_rat r2)

name: cv_rat_sub
statement: from_rat (r1 - r2) = cv_rat_add (from_rat r1) (cv_rat_neg (from_rat r2))

name: cv_rat_mul
statement: from_rat (r1 * r2) = cv_rat_mul (from_rat r1) (from_rat r2)

name: cv_rat_div
statement:
r2 <> 0 ==> from_rat (r1 / r2) =
            cv_rat_mul (from_rat r1) (cv_rat_reciprocal (from_rat r2))

name: cv_rat_lt
statement: b2c (r1 < r2) = cv_rat_lt (from_rat r1) (from_rat r2)

name: cv_rat_le
statement:
b2c (r1 <= r2) = cv_if (cv_rat_lt (from_rat r2) (from_rat r1))
                        (Num 0) (Num 1)

name: cv_rat_gt
statement: b2c (r1 > r2) = cv_rat_lt (from_rat r2) (from_rat r1)

name: cv_rat_ge
statement:
b2c (r1 >= r2) = cv_if (cv_rat_lt (from_rat r1) (from_rat r2))
                        (Num 0) (Num 1)

name: cv_chr_thm
statement: n < 256 ==> from_char (CHR n) = Num n

name: cv_ord_thm
statement: Num (ORD c) = from_char c

name: cv_rep_if
statement:
cv_rep p1 c1 b2c b /\
  cv_rep p2 c2 f t /\
  cv_rep p3 c3 f e ==>
  cv_rep (p1 /\ (b ==> p2) /\ (~b ==> p3))
         (cv_if c1 c2 c3) f (if b then t else e)

name: cv_rep_let
statement:
cv_rep p1 c1 (a:'a->cv) x /\
  (!v. cv_rep (p2 v) (c2 (a v)) (b:'b->cv) (y v)) ==>
  cv_rep (p1 /\ !v. v = x ==> p2 v) (LET c2 c1) b (LET y x)

name: cv_rep_arb
statement: F ==> f ARB = Num 0

name: cv_rep_eq
statement:
cv_rep p1 c1 f x /\
  cv_rep p2 c2 f y /\
  from_to f t ==>
  cv_rep (p1 /\ p2) (cv_eq c1 c2) b2c (x = y)

name: cv_rep_word_w2n
statement: Num (w2n w) = from_word (w :'a word)

name: cv_rep_word_n2w
statement: from_word (n2w n : 'a word) = (cv_mod (Num n) (Num (2 ** dimindex (:'a))))

name: cv_rep_word_w2w
statement:
from_word ((w2w (w:'a word)) : 'b word)
  =
  if dimindex (:'a) <= dimindex (:'b) then from_word w else
    cv_mod (from_word w) (Num (2 ** dimindex (:'b)))

name: cv_inline_word_sw2sw
statement:
sw2sw (w : 'a word) =
  let v = w in (if word_msb v then -1w << dimindex (:'a) else 0w) + w2w v : 'b word

name: cv_rep_dimindex
statement: Num (dimindex (:'a)) =  Num (dimindex (:'a))

name: cv_inline_w2i
statement: w2i w = let v = w in if word_msb v then -&w2n (-v) else &w2n v

name: v2n_custom_thm
statement: v2n_custom 0 = v2n

name: cv_inline_w2v
statement:
w2v (w:'a word) = let d = dimindex (:'a) in
                      GENLIST (λi. word_bit (d - 1 - i) w) d

name: cv_rep_word_add
statement:
from_word (w1 + w2)
  =
  cv_mod (cv_add (from_word (w1 :'a word)) (from_word w2)) (Num (dimword (:'a)))

name: cv_rep_word_sub
statement:
from_word (w1 - w2 :'a word)
  =
  cv_word_sub (from_word w1) (from_word w2) (Num (dimword (:'a)))

name: cv_rep_word_neg
statement:
from_word (- w1 :'a word)
  =
  cv_word_sub (Num 0) (from_word w1) (Num (dimword (:'a)))

name: cv_rep_word_mul
statement:
from_word (w1 * w2 :'a word)
  =
  cv_mod (cv_mul (from_word w1) (from_word w2)) (Num (dimword (:'a)))

name: cv_rep_word_div
statement:
from_word (word_div w1 w2)
  =
  cv_div (from_word w1) (from_word w2)

name: cv_rep_word_mod
statement:
from_word (word_mod w1 w2)
  =
  cv_mod (from_word w1) (from_word w2)

name: cv_rep_word_msb
statement:
b2c (word_msb w)
  =
  cv_div (from_word (w :'a word)) (Num (2 ** (dimindex (:'a) - 1)))

name: cv_rep_word_uint_max
statement:
from_word (UINT_MAXw:'a word)
  =
  Num (2 ** dimindex (:'a) - 1)

name: cv_rep_word_lsl
statement:
from_word (word_lsl (w:'a word) n)
  =
  cv_mod (cv_mul (from_word w) (cv_exp (Num 2) (Num n)))
         (Num (2 ** dimindex (:'a)))

name: cv_rep_word_lsr
statement:
from_word (word_lsr (w:'a word) n)
  =
  cv_div (from_word w) (cv_exp (Num 2) (Num n))

name: word_asr_add
statement:
w >> n =
  let x = w in
  if word_msb (x :'a word) then
    (dimindex (:'a) - 1 '' dimindex (:'a) - n) UINT_MAXw + (x >>> n)
  else x >>> n

name: cv_inline_word_ror
cv_word_lo_thm
statement: b2c (word_lo w1 w2) = cv_lt (from_word w1) (from_word w2)

name: cv_word_hi_thm
statement: b2c (word_hi w2 w1) = cv_lt (from_word w1) (from_word w2)

name: cv_word_hs_thm
statement: b2c (word_hs w1 w2) = cv_sub (Num 1) (cv_lt (from_word w1) (from_word w2))

name: cv_word_ls_thm
statement: b2c (word_ls w1 w2) = cv_sub (Num 1) (cv_lt (from_word w2) (from_word w1))

name: cv_word_lt_thm
statement:
b2c (word_lt w1 w2)
  =
  cv_word_lt (from_word w1) (from_word (w2:'a word))
             (cv_div (from_word w1) (Num (2 ** (dimindex (:'a) - 1))))
             (cv_div (from_word w2) (Num (2 ** (dimindex (:'a) - 1))))

name: cv_word_gt_thm
statement:
b2c (word_gt w2 w1)
  =
  cv_word_lt (from_word w1) (from_word (w2:'a word))
             (cv_div (from_word w1) (Num (2 ** (dimindex (:'a) - 1))))
             (cv_div (from_word w2) (Num (2 ** (dimindex (:'a) - 1))))

name: cv_word_le_thm
statement:
b2c (word_le w2 w1)
  =
  cv_sub (Num 1)
         (cv_word_lt (from_word w1) (from_word (w2:'a word))
                     (cv_div (from_word w1) (Num (2 ** (dimindex (:'a) - 1))))
                     (cv_div (from_word w2) (Num (2 ** (dimindex (:'a) - 1)))))

name: cv_word_ge_thm
statement:
b2c (word_ge w1 w2)
  =
  cv_sub (Num 1)
         (cv_word_lt (from_word w1) (from_word (w2:'a word))
                     (cv_div (from_word w1) (Num (2 ** (dimindex (:'a) - 1))))
                     (cv_div (from_word w2) (Num (2 ** (dimindex (:'a) - 1)))))

name: cv_word_bit_thm
statement:
b2c (word_bit b w) =
    cv_mod (cv_div (from_word w) (cv_exp (Num 2) (Num b))) (Num 2)

name: cv_word_bits_thm
statement:
from_word (word_bits h l (w:'a word))
  =
  cv_div (cv_mod (from_word w)
                 (cv_exp (Num 2) (cv_min (cv_add (Num h) (Num 1)) (Num (dimindex (:'a))))))
         (cv_exp (Num 2) (Num l))

name: cv_word_slice_thm
statement:
from_word (word_slice h l (w:'a word))
  =
  cv_mod (cv_mul
    (cv_div (cv_mod (from_word w)
                   (cv_exp (Num 2) (cv_min (cv_add (Num h) (Num 1)) (Num (dimindex (:'a))))))
            (cv_exp (Num 2) (Num l)))
    (cv_exp (Num 2) (Num l))) (Num (dimword (:'a)))

name: cv_word_join_thm
statement:
FINITE univ(:'a) /\ FINITE univ(:'b) ==>
  from_word (word_join (w1:'a word) (w2:'b word))
  =
  cv_add (cv_mul (from_word w1) (cv_exp (Num 2) (Num (dimindex (:'b)))))
         (from_word w2)

name: BITWISE_ADD
statement:
!l k m n b.
    BITWISE (l + k) b m n =
    BITWISE l b m n +
    BITWISE k b (m DIV 2 ** l) (n DIV 2 ** l) * 2 ** l

name: BITWISE
statement:
BITWISE 0 b m n = 0 /\
  BITWISE (SUC k) b m n =
  (if b (ODD m) (ODD n) then 1 else 0) + 2 * BITWISE k b (m DIV 2) (n DIV 2)

name: cv_word_and_loop_thm
statement:
!m n.
    m <= n /\ n < dimword (:'a) ==>
    cv_word_and_loop (Num m) (Num n) = Num (w2n (n2w m && n2w n :'a word))

name: cv_word_or_loop_thm
statement:
!m n.
    m <= n /\ n < dimword (:'a) ==>
    cv_word_or_loop (Num m) (Num n) = Num (w2n (n2w m || n2w n :'a word))

name: cv_word_xor_loop_thm
statement:
!m n.
    m <= n /\ n < dimword (:'a) ==>
    cv_word_xor_loop (Num m) (Num n) = Num (w2n (word_xor (n2w m) (n2w n) :'a word))

name: cv_rep_word_and
statement:
from_word (w1 && w2)
  =
  cv_word_and (from_word w1) (from_word w2)

name: cv_rep_word_or
statement:
from_word (w1 || w2)
  =
  cv_word_or (from_word w1) (from_word w2)

name: cv_rep_word_xor
statement:
from_word (word_xor w1 w2)
  =
  cv_word_xor (from_word w1) (from_word w2)

name: cv_rep_word_not
statement:
from_word (~ w :'a word)
  =
  cv_word_xor (from_word w) (Num (2 ** dimindex (:'a) - 1))

name: cv_min_def
statement: cv_min x y = cv_if (cv_lt x y) x y

name: cv_max_def
statement: cv_max x y = cv_if (cv_lt x y) y x

name: cv_gcd_def
statement: cv_gcd a b = cv_if a (cv_gcd (cv_mod b a) a) b

name: cv_log2_def
statement:
cv_log2 acc n =
    cv_if (cv_lt (Num 1) n)
      (cv_log2 (cv_add acc (Num 1)) (cv_div n (Num 2)))
      acc

name: cv_abs_def
statement: cv_abs i = cv_if (cv_ispair i) (cv_fst i) i

name: cv_int_neg_def
statement:
cv_int_neg x =
    cv_if (cv_eq x (Num 0)) x $
          cv_if (cv_ispair x) (cv_fst x) (Pair x (Num 0))

name: cv_int_lt_def
statement:
cv_int_lt i j =
    cv_if (cv_ispair i) 
      (cv_if (cv_ispair j) 
        (cv_lt (cv_abs j) (cv_abs i))
        (Num 1))
      (cv_if (cv_ispair j) 
        (Num 0)
        (cv_lt i j))

name: cv_int_add_def
statement:
cv_int_add i j =
    cv_if (cv_ispair i) 
      (cv_if (cv_ispair j) 
        (Pair (cv_add (cv_fst i) (cv_fst j)) (Num 0))
        (cv_if (cv_int_lt j (cv_fst i)) 
          (Pair (cv_sub (cv_fst i) j) (Num 0))
          (cv_sub j (cv_fst i))))
      (cv_if (cv_ispair j) 
        (cv_if (cv_int_lt i (cv_fst j)) 
          (Pair (cv_sub (cv_fst j) i) (Num 0))
          (cv_sub i (cv_fst j)))
        (cv_add i j))

name: total_int_div_def
statement: total_int_div i j = if j = 0 then 0 else int_div i j

name: cv_int_div_def
statement:
cv_int_div i j =
    cv_if (cv_eq j (Num 0)) (Num 0) $
      cv_if (cv_ispair j) 
        (cv_if (cv_ispair i) 
          (cv_div (cv_fst i) (cv_fst j))
          (cv_int_add
            (Pair (cv_div i (cv_fst j)) (Num 0))
            (cv_if (cv_mod i (cv_fst j))
              (Pair (Num 1) (Num 0)) (Num 0))))
        (cv_if (cv_ispair i) 
          (cv_int_add
            (Pair (cv_div (cv_fst i) j) (Num 0))
            (cv_if (cv_mod (cv_fst i) j)
              (Pair (Num 1) (Num 0)) (Num 0)))
          (cv_div i j))

name: cv_int_mul_def
statement:
cv_int_mul i j =
    cv_if (cv_eq i (Num 0)) (Num 0) $
    cv_if (cv_eq j (Num 0)) (Num 0) $
    cv_if (cv_ispair i)
      (cv_if (cv_ispair j)
        (cv_mul (cv_fst i) (cv_fst j))
        (Pair (cv_mul (cv_fst i) j) (Num 0)))
      (cv_if (cv_ispair j)
        (Pair (cv_mul i (cv_fst j)) (Num 0))
        (cv_mul i j))

name: cv_rat_neg_def
statement: cv_rat_neg r = Pair (cv_int_neg (cv_fst r)) (cv_snd r)

name: cv_rat_reciprocal_def
statement:
cv_rat_reciprocal r =
    cv_if (cv_int_lt (cv_fst r) (Num 0))
      (Pair (Pair (cv_snd r) (Num 0)) (cv_fst (cv_fst r)))
      (Pair (cv_snd r) (cv_fst r))

name: cv_rat_norm_def
statement:
cv_rat_norm r =
    let d = cv_gcd (cv_abs (cv_fst r)) (cv_snd r) in
    cv_if (cv_lt d (Num 2))
      r
      (Pair (cv_int_div (cv_fst r) d) (cv_div (cv_snd r) d))

name: cv_rat_add_def
statement:
cv_rat_add r1 r2 =
    cv_rat_norm $ Pair
      (cv_int_add (cv_int_mul (cv_fst r1) (cv_snd r2)) (cv_int_mul (cv_fst r2) (cv_snd r1)))
      (cv_mul (cv_snd r1) (cv_snd r2))

name: cv_rat_mul_def
statement:
cv_rat_mul r1 r2 =
    cv_rat_norm $ Pair
      (cv_int_mul (cv_fst r1) (cv_fst r2))
      (cv_mul (cv_snd r1) (cv_snd r2))

name: cv_rat_lt_def
statement:
cv_rat_lt r1 r2 =
    cv_int_lt (cv_int_mul (cv_fst r1) (cv_snd r2))
              (cv_int_mul (cv_fst r2) (cv_snd r1))

name: v2n_custom_def
statement:
v2n_custom acc [] = acc /\
  v2n_custom acc (T::rest) = v2n_custom (2 * acc + 1n) rest /\
  v2n_custom acc (F::rest) = v2n_custom (2 * acc) rest

name: cv_word_sub_def
statement:
cv_word_sub x y d =
    cv_if (cv_lt x y)
      (cv_sub (cv_add x d) y)
      (cv_sub x y)

name: cv_word_lt_def
statement:
cv_word_lt w1 w2 msb1 msb2 =
    cv_if (cv_eq msb1 msb2)
          (cv_lt w1 w2)
          (cv_if msb1 (Num 1) (cv_sub (Num 1) msb2))

name: cv_word_or_loop_def
statement:
cv_word_or_loop x y =
    if c2b (cv_lt (Num 0) x) then
      cv_add (cv_mul (Num 2) (cv_word_or_loop (cv_div x (Num 2)) (cv_div y (Num 2))))
             (cv_max (cv_mod x (Num 2)) (cv_mod y (Num 2)))
    else y

name: cv_word_or_def
statement:
cv_word_or x y =
    cv_if (cv_lt x y)
      (cv_word_or_loop x y)
      (cv_word_or_loop y x)

name: cv_word_and_loop_def
statement:
cv_word_and_loop x y =
    if c2b (cv_lt (Num 0) x) then
      cv_add (cv_mul (Num 2) (cv_word_and_loop (cv_div x (Num 2)) (cv_div y (Num 2))))
             (cv_div (cv_add (cv_mod x (Num 2)) (cv_mod y (Num 2))) (Num 2))
    else (Num 0)

name: cv_word_and_def
statement:
cv_word_and x y =
    cv_if (cv_lt x y)
      (cv_word_and_loop x y)
      (cv_word_and_loop y x)

name: cv_word_xor_loop_def
statement:
cv_word_xor_loop x y =
    if c2b (cv_lt (Num 0) x) then
      cv_add (cv_mul (Num 2) (cv_word_xor_loop (cv_div x (Num 2)) (cv_div y (Num 2))))
             (cv_mod (cv_add (cv_mod x (Num 2)) (cv_mod y (Num 2))) (Num 2))
    else y

name: cv_word_xor_def
statement:
cv_word_xor x y =
    cv_if (cv_lt x y)
      (cv_word_xor_loop x y)
      (cv_word_xor_loop y x)

name: cv_rep_trivial

name: cv_rep_move
statement: (b ==> cv_rep p x y z) = cv_rep (b /\ p) x y z

name: cv_rep_eval

cv_rep p y f (x:'a) ==>

name: cv_rep_assum

cv_rep p (cv (g a)) (f:'a -> cv) x ==>

    cv_rep (p_a /\ p) (cv cv_a) f x

name: if_eq_zero
statement: (if n = 0 then x else y) = (if 0 < (n:num) then y else x:'a)

name: cv_eval
statement:
c2n (Num n) = n /\
  c2n (Pair x y) = 0 /\
  c2b (Num n) = (n <> 0) /\
  c2b (Pair x y) = F

name: UNCURRY_pair_case
statement: !f. UNCURRY f = \x. case x of (x,y) => f x y

name: cv_proj_less_eq
statement: !v xs. cv_size (cv_proj xs v) <= cv_size v

name: to_cv_proj
statement:
cv_fst = cv_proj [T] /\
  cv_snd = cv_proj [F] /\
  cv_proj xs (cv_proj ys b) = cv_proj (xs ++ ys) b

name: cv_termination_simp
statement:
(c2b (cv_ispair cv_v) = ?x1 x2. cv_v = Pair x1 x2) /\
  (c2b (cv_lt (Num 0) cv_v) = ?k. cv_v = Num (SUC k)) /\
  (c2b (cv_lt (Num (NUMERAL (BIT1 n))) (cv_fst cv_v)) <=>
   ?k z. cv_v = Pair (Num k) z /\ NUMERAL (BIT1 n) < k) /\
  (c2b (cv_lt (Num (NUMERAL (BIT2 n))) (cv_fst cv_v)) <=>
   ?k z. cv_v = Pair (Num k) z /\ NUMERAL (BIT2 n) < k) /\
  (cv_fst cv_v = Pair x y <=> ?z. cv_v = Pair (Pair x y) z) /\
  (cv_snd cv_v = Pair x y <=> ?z. cv_v = Pair z (Pair x y)) /\
  (cv_fst cv_v = Num (SUC k) <=> ?z. cv_v = Pair (Num (SUC k)) z) /\
  (cv_snd cv_v = Num (SUC k) <=> ?z. cv_v = Pair z (Num (SUC k)))

name: cv_postprocess
statement: cv_if c x x = x

name: cv_rep_def
statement:
cv_rep pre_cond (cv_tm:cv) (from_fun:'a -> cv) hol_tm <=>
    pre_cond ==>
    from_fun hol_tm = cv_tm

name: cv_proj_def
statement:
cv_proj [] v = v /\
  cv_proj (T::xs) v = cv_fst (cv_proj xs v) /\
  cv_proj (F::xs) v = cv_snd (cv_proj xs v)

name: implies_def
statement: implies x y <=> (x ==> y)

name: cv_FST
statement: f_a (FST v) = cv_fst ((from_pair f_a f_b) (v: 'a # 'b))

name: cv_SND
statement: f_b (SND v) = cv_snd ((from_pair f_a f_b) (v: 'a # 'b))

name: OUTR_pre
statement: OUTR_pre x <=> ISR x

name: cv_TL
statement: (from_list f_a) (TL v) = cv_snd ((from_list f_a) (v:'a list))

name: EL_pre

name: FRONT

name: FRONT_pre
statement: !xs. FRONT_pre xs <=> xs <> []

name: LAST

name: LAST_pre

name: cv_rep_MEM

from_to f_a t_a ==>

name: REPLICATE

name: UNZIP_eq
statement:
UNZIP ts =
    case ts of
    | [] => ([],[])
    | (x::xs) => let (t1,t2) = UNZIP xs in (FST x :: t1, SND x :: t2)

name: MAPi_eq_list_mapi

name: combine_rle_isEmpty_eq
statement:
combine_rle_isEmpty xs =
    case xs of
    | [] => []
    | [t] => [t]
    | ((i,x)::(j,y)::xs) =>
        if x = LN /\ y = LN then combine_rle_isEmpty ((i + j,x)::xs)
        else (i,x)::combine_rle_isEmpty ((j,y)::xs)

name: combine_rle_isEmpty_pre
statement: combine_rle_isEmpty_pre xs

name: every_empty_snd
statement: !ys. EVERY ((λt. isEmpty t) o SND) ys = every_empty_snd ys

name: map_spt_right_left

MAP (λ(i,t). (i,spt_right t)) ys = map_spt_right ys /\
  MAP (λ(i,t). (i,spt_left t)) ys = map_spt_left ys

name: from_to_fmap

from_to (f0:'a -> cv) t0 ==>
  from_to (from_fmap f0) (to_fmap t0)

name: cv_rep_FUPDATE
statement: from_fmap f (m |+ (k,v)) = cv_insert (Num k) (f v) (from_fmap f m)

name: list_mem_def
statement:
list_mem y [] = F /\
  list_mem y (x::xs) = if x = y then T else list_mem y xs

name: replicate_acc_def
statement:
replicate_acc n x acc =
    if n = 0:num then acc else replicate_acc (n-1) x (x::acc)

name: genlist_def
statement:
genlist i f 0 = [] /\
  genlist i f (SUC n) = f i :: genlist (i+1:num) f n

name: list_mapi_def
statement:
list_mapi i f [] = [] /\
  list_mapi i f (x::xs) = f i x :: list_mapi (i + 1n) f xs

name: cv_map_fst_def
statement:
cv_map_fst cv =
    cv_if (cv_ispair cv)
      (Pair (cv_fst (cv_fst cv)) (cv_map_fst (cv_snd cv)))
      (Num 0)

name: cv_map_snd_def
statement:
cv_map_snd cv =
    cv_if (cv_ispair cv)
      (Pair (cv_snd (cv_fst cv)) (cv_map_snd (cv_snd cv)))
      (Num 0)

name: toAList_foldi_def
statement: toAList_foldi = foldi ^lam

name: combine_rle_isEmpty_def
statement: combine_rle_isEmpty = combine_rle isEmpty

name: cv_right_depth_def

name: every_empty_snd_def

name: map_spt_right_def

name: map_spt_left_def
