      swapseq n p /\ ~(a = b) /\ ((swap(a,b) o p) a = a)
      ==> ~(n = 0) /\ swapseq (n - 1) (swap(a,b) o p)

name: SWAPSEQ_IDENTITY_EVEN
statement: !n. swapseq n (I:'a->'a) ==> EVEN n

name: SWAPSEQ_EVEN_EVEN
statement: !m n p:'a->'a. swapseq m p /\ swapseq n p ==> (EVEN m <=> EVEN n)

name: EVENPERM_UNIQUE
statement: !n p b. swapseq n p /\ (EVEN n = b) ==> (evenperm p = b)

name: EVENPERM_I
statement: evenperm I = T

name: EVENPERM_SWAP
statement: !a b:'a. evenperm (swap(a,b)) <=> (a = b)

name: EVENPERM_COMPOSE
statement:
!p q. permutation p /\ permutation q
         ==> (evenperm (p o q) = (evenperm p = evenperm q))

name: EVENPERM_INVERSE
statement: !p. permutation p ==> (evenperm (inverse p) = evenperm p)

name: PERMUTATION_BIJECTIVE
statement: !p. permutation p ==> !y. ?!x. p(x) = y

name: PERMUTATION_FINITE_SUPPORT
statement: !p. permutation p ==> FINITE {x:'a| ~(p x = x)}

name: PERMUTATION_LEMMA
statement:
!s p:'a->'a.
       FINITE s /\
       (!y. ?!x. p(x) = y) /\ (!x. ~(x IN s) ==> (p x = x))
       ==> permutation p

name: PERMUTATION
statement: !p. permutation p <=> (!y. ?!x. p(x) = y) /\ FINITE {x:'a| ~(p(x) = x)}

name: PERMUTATION_INVERSE_WORKS
statement: !p. permutation p ==> (inverse p o p = I) /\ (p o inverse p = I)

name: PERMUTATION_INVERSE_COMPOSE
statement:
!p q. permutation p /\ permutation q
         ==> (inverse (p o q) = inverse q o inverse p)

name: PERMUTATION_COMPOSE_EQ
statement:
(!p q:'a->'a. permutation(p) ==> (permutation(p o q) <=> permutation q)) /\
   (!p q:'a->'a. permutation(q) ==> (permutation(p o q) <=> permutation p))

name: PERMUTATION_COMPOSE_SWAP
statement:
(!p a b:'a. permutation(swap(a,b) o p) <=> permutation p) /\
   (!p a b:'a. permutation(p o swap(a,b)) <=> permutation p)

name: PERMUTATION_PERMUTES
statement: !p:'a->'a. permutation p <=> ?s. FINITE s /\ p permutes s

name: PERMUTES_INDUCT
statement:
!P s. FINITE s /\
         P I /\
         (!a b:'a p. a IN s /\ b IN s /\ P p /\ permutation p
                    ==> P (swap(a,b) o p))
         ==> (!p. p permutes s ==> P p)

name: PERMUTES_NUMSET_LE
statement: !p s:num->bool. p permutes s /\ (!i. i IN s ==> p(i) <= i) ==> (p = I)

name: PERMUTES_NUMSET_GE
statement: !p s:num->bool. p permutes s /\ (!i. i IN s ==> i <= p(i)) ==> (p = I)

name: IMAGE_INVERSE_PERMUTATIONS
statement: !s:'a->bool. {inverse p | p permutes s} = {p | p permutes s}

name: IMAGE_COMPOSE_PERMUTATIONS_L
statement: !s q:'a->'a. q permutes s ==> ({q o p | p permutes s} = {p | p permutes s})

name: IMAGE_COMPOSE_PERMUTATIONS_R
statement: !s q:'a->'a. q permutes s ==> ({p o q | p permutes s} = {p | p permutes s})

name: PERMUTES_IN_COUNT
statement: !p n i. p permutes count n /\ i IN count n ==> p(i) < n

name: permutes
statement: p permutes s <=> (!x. ~(x IN s) ==> (p(x) = x)) /\ (!y. ?!x. p x = y)

name: inverse
statement: inverse (f :'a->'b) = \y. @x. f x = y

name: swap_def
statement: swap (i,j) k = if k = i then j else if k = j then i else k

name: permutation
statement: permutation p = ?n. swapseq n p

name: evenperm
statement: evenperm p = EVEN(@n. swapseq n p)

name: swapseq_def
statement:
(swapseq 0 I) /\
   (!a b p n. swapseq n p /\ ~(a = b) ==> swapseq (SUC n) (swap(a,b) o p))

name: restr_applies
statement: x IN A ==> (restr f A x = f x)

name: IN_UNCURRY
statement: (a,b) IN UNCURRY R <=> R a b

name: Delta_INTER
statement: Delta (s INTER t) = Delta s RINTER Delta t

name: Gr_Id
statement: Gr (\x. x) A = Delta A

name: Gr_restr
statement: Gr (restr f A) A = Gr f A

name: kernel_graph
statement: kernel A f = inv (Gr f A) O Gr f A

name: RIMAGE_Gr
statement: RIMAGE f A R = Gr f A O R O inv (Gr f A)

name: Delta_IMAGE
statement: Delta (IMAGE f A) = RIMAGE f A (Delta A)

name: RINV_IMAGE_Gr
statement: RINV_IMAGE f A R = inv (Gr f A) O R O Gr f A

name: restr_restr_o
statement: restr (f o restr g A) A = restr (f o g) A

name: restr_cases
statement: restr f A x = g x <=> x IN A /\ f x = g x \/  x NOTIN A /\ g x = ARB

name: oID
statement: f o (\x.x) = f /\ (\x.x) o f = f

name: symmetric_SPOr
statement: symmetric (SPOr A f g)

name: transitive_SPOr
statement: transitive (SPOr A f g)

name: SPOr_lemma0
statement:
restr (j1 o f) A = restr (j2 o g) A ==>
  !s1 s2. SPOr A f g s1 s2 ==>
          (!b1 b2. s1 = INL b1 /\ s2 = INL b2 ==> j1 b1 = j1 b2) /\
          (!b c. s1 = INL b /\ s2 = INR c ==> j1 b = j2 c) /\
          (!b c. s1 = INR c /\ s2 = INL b ==> j1 b = j2 c) /\
          (!c1 c2. s1 = INR c1 /\ s2 = INR c2 ==> j2 c1 = j2 c2)

name: SPOr_REFL
statement: SPOr A f g x x

name: Spushout_quotient
statement:
shom f A B /\ shom g A C ==>
  Spushout (A:'a set) (B:'b set) (C:'c set) f g (SPO A B C f g) (:'d)

name: Spushout_transfer
statement:
Spushout A B C f g (P,i1,i2) (:'d) /\ INJ h univ(:'e) univ(:'d) ==>
  Spushout A B C f g (P,i1,i2) (:'e)

name: shoms_exist
statement: !(A:'a set) (B:'b set). B <> {} ==> ?h. shom h A B

name: unit_pushout
statement:
shom f A B /\ shom g A C /\ A <> {} ==>
  Spushout A B C f g ({()}, restr (K ()) B, restr (K ()) C) (:unit)

name: Spushout_sym
statement:
Spushout A B C f g (P,p1,p2) (:'d) ==>
  Spushout A C B g f (P,p2,p1) (:'d)

name: shom_into_EMPTY
statement: shom f A {} <=> A = {} /\ f = K ARB

name: shom_outof_EMPTY
statement: shom f {} A <=> f = K ARB

name: restr_EMPTY
statement: restr f {} = K ARB

name: cardgt0
statement: cardgt (:'a) 0

name: cardgt1_INJ_bool
statement: cardgt (:'a) 1 <=> ?bf. INJ bf {T;F} univ(:'a)

name: Spushouts_iso
statement:
Spushout (A:'a set) (B:'b set) (C:'c set) f g (P : 'd set,i1,i2) (:'e) /\
  Spushout A B C f g (Q : 'e set,j1,j2) (:'d) /\
  cardgt (:'d) 1 /\ cardgt (:'e) 1 ==>
  ?H. BIJ H P Q /\ restr (H o i1) B = j1 /\ restr (H o i2) C = j2

name: eps_partition
statement: a IN A ==> eps R A a IN partition R A

name: restr_def
statement: restr f s = \x. if x IN s then f x else ARB

name: Delta_def
statement: Delta V a b <=>  a = b /\ a IN V

name: Gr_def
statement: Gr h A a b <=> a IN A /\ b = h a

name: span_def
statement: span A f g b d <=> ?a. a IN A /\ b = f a /\ d = g a

name: kernel_def
statement: kernel A f x y <=> x IN A /\ y IN A /\ f x = f y

name: RIMAGE_def
statement:
RIMAGE f A R x y <=>
  ?x0 y0. x = f x0 /\ y = f y0 /\ R x0 y0 /\ x0 IN A /\ y0 IN A

name: RINV_IMAGE_def
statement: RINV_IMAGE f A R x y <=> x IN A /\ y IN A /\ R (f x) (f y)

name: shom_def
statement: shom f A B <=> (!a. a IN A ==> f a IN B) /\ !a. a NOTIN A ==> f a = ARB

name: Spushout_def
statement:
Spushout (A:'a set) (B:'b set) (C:'c set) f g (P:'p set,i1,i2) (:'d) <=>
  shom f A B /\ shom g A C /\ shom i1 B P /\ shom i2 C P /\
  restr (i1 o f) A = restr (i2 o g) A /\
  !(Q:'d set) j1 j2.
    shom j1 B Q /\ shom j2 C Q /\ restr (j1 o f) A = restr (j2 o g) A ==>
    ?!u. shom u P Q /\ restr (u o i1) B = j1 /\ restr (u o i2) C = j2

name: SPO_pimg_def
statement:
SPO_pimg A f g (INL x) = PREIMAGE f {x} INTER A /\
  SPO_pimg A f g (INR y) = PREIMAGE g {y} INTER A

name: SPOr_def
statement:
SPOr A f g = EQC (\x y. (?a. a IN A /\ x = INL (f a) /\ y = INR (g a)) \/
                          x = y)

name: SPO_def
statement:
SPO A B C f g =
    (partition (SPOr A f g) (B <+> C),
     restr (\b. { a | a IN B <+> C /\ SPOr A f g (INL b) a }) B,
     restr (\c. { a | a IN B <+> C /\ SPOr A f g (INR c) a }) C)

name: cardgt_def
statement: cardgt (:'a) n <=> FINITE univ(:'a) ==> n < CARD univ(:'a)

name: eps_def
statement: eps R A a = if a IN A then {b | R a b /\ b IN A} else ARB

name: FINITE_INDUCT_STRONG
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        P {} /\ (!x s. P s /\ ~(x IN s) /\ FINITE s ==> P(x INSERT s))
        ==> !s. FINITE s ==> P s

name: TOPOLOGY_EQ
statement: !top1 top2. (top1 = top2) <=> !s. (open_in top1) s <=> (open_in top2) s

name: OPEN_OWN_NEIGH
statement: !A top. !x:'a. open_in(top) A /\ A x ==> neigh(top)(A,x)

name: OPEN_UNOPEN
statement:
!S' top. open_in(top) S' <=>
             (BIGUNION {P | open_in(top) P /\ P SUBSET S'} = S')

name: OPEN_NEIGH
statement:
!A top.
    open_in(top) A <=> !x:'a. A x ==> ?N. neigh(top)(N,x) /\ N SUBSET A

name: CLOSED_IN_EMPTY
statement: !top. closed_in top {}

name: CLOSED_IN_TOPSPACE
statement: !top. closed_in top (topspace top)

name: CLOSED_IN_UNION
statement: !top s t. closed_in top s /\ closed_in top t ==> closed_in top (s UNION t)

name: CLOSED_IN_BIGINTER
statement:
!top k:('a->bool)->bool.
   k <> {} /\ (!s. s IN k ==> closed_in top s) ==> closed_in top (BIGINTER k)

name: CLOSED_IN_INTER
statement: !top s t. closed_in top s /\ closed_in top t ==> closed_in top (s INTER t)

name: OPEN_IN_CLOSED_IN_EQ
statement:
!top s. open_in top s <=>
         s SUBSET topspace top /\ closed_in top (topspace top DIFF s)

name: limpt_thm
statement:
limpt t x A <=>
  x IN topspace t /\
  !U. open_in t U /\ x IN U ==> ?y. y IN U /\ y IN A /\ y <> x

name: CLOSED_LIMPT
statement:
!top. closed top ==>
        !S'. closed_in(top) S' = (!x:'a. limpt(top) x S' ==> S' x)

name: HULL_IMAGE_GALOIS
statement:
!P f g s. (!s. P(P hull s)) /\
            (!s. P s ==> P(IMAGE f s)) /\ (!s. P s ==> P(IMAGE g s)) /\
            (!s t. s SUBSET IMAGE g t <=> IMAGE f s SUBSET t) ==>
            P hull (IMAGE f s) = IMAGE f (P hull s)

name: HULL_IMAGE
statement:
!P f s. (!s. P(P hull s)) /\ (!s. P(IMAGE f s) <=> P s) /\
          (!x y:'a. (f x = f y) ==> (x = y)) /\ (!y. ?x. f x = y) ==>
          P hull (IMAGE f s) = IMAGE f (P hull s)

name: ISTOPOLOGY_SUBTOPOLOGY
statement: !top u:'a->bool. istopology {s INTER u | open_in top s}

name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
statement:
!top u s. open_in (subtopology top u) s <=>
            ?t. open_in top t /\ (s = t INTER u)

name: TOPSPACE_SUBTOPOLOGY
statement: !top u. topspace(subtopology top u) = topspace top INTER u

name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
statement:
!top u s. closed_in (subtopology top u) s <=>
              ?t:'a->bool. closed_in top t /\ (s = t INTER u)

name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_EMPTY
statement: !top s. open_in (subtopology top {}) s <=> (s = {})

name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_EMPTY
statement: !top s. closed_in (subtopology top {}) s <=> (s = {})

name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_REFL
statement: !top u:'a->bool. open_in (subtopology top u) u <=> u SUBSET topspace top

name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_REFL
statement: !top u:'a->bool. closed_in (subtopology top u) u <=> u SUBSET topspace top

name: SUBTOPOLOGY_SUPERSET
statement: !top s:'a->bool. topspace top SUBSET s ==> (subtopology top s = top)

name: SUBTOPOLOGY_TOPSPACE
statement: !top. subtopology top (topspace top) = top

name: SUBTOPOLOGY_UNIV
statement: !top. subtopology top UNIV = top

name: OPEN_IN_IMP_SUBSET
statement: !top s t. open_in (subtopology top s) t ==> t SUBSET s

name: CLOSED_IN_IMP_SUBSET
statement: !top s t. closed_in (subtopology top s) t ==> t SUBSET s

name: OPEN_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_UNION
statement:
!top s t u:'a->bool.
        open_in (subtopology top t) s /\ open_in (subtopology top u) s
        ==> open_in (subtopology top (t UNION u)) s

name: CLOSED_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY_UNION
statement:
!top s t u:'a->bool.
        closed_in (subtopology top t) s /\ closed_in (subtopology top u) s
        ==> closed_in (subtopology top (t UNION u)) s

name: SUBTOPOLOGY_SUBTOPOLOGY
statement:
!top s t:'a->bool.
        subtopology (subtopology top s) t = subtopology top (s INTER t)

name: EXT_SKOLEM_THM
statement: !P Q. (!x. x IN P ==> ?y. Q x y) <=> ?f. !x. x IN P ==> Q x (f x)

name: UNIV_GSPEC
statement: {x | T} = UNIV

name: IN_GSPEC
statement: !s. {x | x IN s} = s

name: SUBSET_RESTRICT
statement: !s P. {x | x IN s /\ P x} SUBSET s

name: UNIONS_IMAGE
statement: !f s. UNIONS (IMAGE f s) = {y | ?x. x IN s /\ y IN f x}

name: INTERS_IMAGE
statement: !f s. INTERS (IMAGE f s) = {y | !x. x IN s ==> y IN f x}

name: DIFF_INTERS
statement: !u s. u DIFF INTERS s = UNIONS {u DIFF t | t IN s}

name: INTERS_GSPEC
statement:
(!P f. INTERS {f x | P x} = {a | !x. P x ==> a IN (f x)}) /\
   (!P f. INTERS {f x y | P x y} = {a | !x y. P x y ==> a IN (f x y)}) /\
   (!P f. INTERS {f x y z | P x y z} =
                {a | !x y z. P x y z ==> a IN (f x y z)})

name: UNIONS_GSPEC
statement:
(!P f. UNIONS {f x | P x} = {a | ?x. P x /\ a IN (f x)}) /\
   (!P f. UNIONS {f x y | P x y} = {a | ?x y. P x y /\ a IN (f x y)}) /\
   (!P f. UNIONS {f x y z | P x y z} =
            {a | ?x y z. P x y z /\ a IN (f x y z)})

name: INTER_INTERS
statement:
(!f s:'a->bool. s INTER INTERS f =
           if f = {} then s else INTERS {s INTER t | t IN f}) /\
   (!f s:'a->bool. INTERS f INTER s =
           if f = {} then s else INTERS {t INTER s | t IN f})

name: INTERS_UNIONS
statement: !s. INTERS s = UNIV DIFF (UNIONS {UNIV DIFF t | t IN s})

name: UNIONS_INTERS
statement: !s. UNIONS s = UNIV DIFF (INTERS {UNIV DIFF t | t IN s})

name: INTERS_SUBSET
statement:
!u s:'a->bool.
    ~(u = {}) /\ (!t. t IN u ==> t SUBSET s) ==> INTERS u SUBSET s

name: INTERS_SUBSET_STRONG
statement: !u s:'a->bool. (?t. t IN u /\ t SUBSET s) ==> INTERS u SUBSET s

name: DIFF_UNIONS
statement: !u s. u DIFF UNIONS s = u INTER INTERS {u DIFF t | t IN s}

name: DIFF_UNIONS_NONEMPTY
statement: !u s. ~(s = {}) ==> u DIFF UNIONS s = INTERS {u DIFF t | t IN s}

name: pairwiseD_alt_pairwiseN
statement: !R. pairwiseD R = pairwiseN (RC R)

name: PAIRWISE_EMPTY
statement: !r. pairwise r {} <=> T

name: PAIRWISE_SING
statement: !r x. pairwise r {x} <=> T

name: PAIRWISE_IMP
statement:
!P Q s.
        pairwise P s /\
        (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ P x y /\ ~(x = y) ==> Q x y)
        ==> pairwise Q s

name: PAIRWISE_MONO
statement: !r s t. pairwise r s /\ t SUBSET s ==> pairwise r t

name: PAIRWISE_AND
statement:
!R R' s. pairwise R s /\ pairwise R' s <=>
            pairwise (\x y. R x y /\ R' x y) s

name: PAIRWISE_INSERT
statement:
!r x s.
        pairwise r (x INSERT s) <=>
        (!y. y IN s /\ ~(y = x) ==> r x y /\ r y x) /\
        pairwise r s

name: PAIRWISE_IMAGE
statement:
!r f. pairwise r (IMAGE f s) <=>
         pairwise (\x y. ~(f x = f y) ==> r (f x) (f y)) s

name: PAIRWISE_UNION
statement:
!R s t. pairwise R (s UNION t) <=>
           pairwise R s /\ pairwise R t /\
           (!x y. x IN s DIFF t /\ y IN t DIFF s ==> R x y /\ R y x)

name: UNION_OF_INC
statement: !P Q s:'a->bool. P {s} /\ Q s ==> (P UNION_OF Q) s

name: INTERSECTION_OF_INC
statement: !P Q s:'a->bool. P {s} /\ Q s ==> (P INTERSECTION_OF Q) s

name: UNION_OF_MONO
statement:
!P Q Q' s:'a->bool.
        (P UNION_OF Q) s /\ (!x. Q x ==> Q' x) ==> (P UNION_OF Q') s

name: INTERSECTION_OF_MONO
statement:
!P Q Q' s:'a->bool.
        (P INTERSECTION_OF Q) s /\ (!x. Q x ==> Q' x)
        ==> (P INTERSECTION_OF Q') s

name: FORALL_UNION_OF
statement:
(!s. (P UNION_OF Q) s ==> R s) <=>
   (!t. P t /\ (!c. c IN t ==> Q c) ==> R(UNIONS t))

name: FORALL_INTERSECTION_OF
statement:
(!s. (P INTERSECTION_OF Q) s ==> R s) <=>
   (!t. P t /\ (!c. c IN t ==> Q c) ==> R(INTERS t))

name: UNION_OF_EMPTY
statement: !P Q:('a->bool)->bool. P {} ==> (P UNION_OF Q) {}

name: INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
statement: !P Q:('a->bool)->bool. P {} ==> (P INTERSECTION_OF Q) UNIV

name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_ALT
statement:
!B s:'a->bool.
        (ARBITRARY UNION_OF B) s <=>
        !x. x IN s ==>  ?u. u IN B /\ x IN u /\ u SUBSET s

name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_EMPTY
statement: !P:('a->bool)->bool. (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) {}

name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
statement: !P:('a->bool)->bool. (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) UNIV

name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_INC
statement: !P s:'a->bool. P s ==> (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) s

name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_INC
statement: !P s:'a->bool. P s ==> (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) s

name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_COMPLEMENT
statement:
!P s. (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) s <=>
         (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF (\s. P(univ(:'a) DIFF s))) (univ(:'a) DIFF s)

name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_COMPLEMENT
statement:
!P s. (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) s <=>
         (ARBITRARY UNION_OF (\s. P(univ(:'a) DIFF s))) (univ(:'a) DIFF s)

name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_IDEMPOT
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        ARBITRARY UNION_OF ARBITRARY UNION_OF P = ARBITRARY UNION_OF P

name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_IDEMPOT
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P =
        ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P

name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_UNIONS
statement:
!P u:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s. s IN u ==> (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) s)
        ==> (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) (UNIONS u)

name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_UNION
statement:
!P s t. (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) s /\ (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) t
           ==> (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) (s UNION t)

name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_INTERS
statement:
!P u:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s. s IN u ==> (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) s)
        ==> (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) (INTERS u)

name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_INTER
statement:
!P s t. (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) s /\ (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) t
           ==> (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) (s INTER t)

name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_INTER_EQ
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) s /\ (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) t
               ==> (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) (s INTER t)) <=>
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) (s INTER t))

name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_INTER
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> P(s INTER t))
        ==> (!s t. (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) s /\ (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) t
                   ==> (ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) (s INTER t))

name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION_EQ
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) s /\
               (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) t
               ==> (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) (s UNION t)) <=>
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) (s UNION t))

name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> P(s UNION t))
        ==> (!s t. (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) s /\
                   (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) t
                   ==> (ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) (s UNION t))

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_EMPTY
statement: !P:('a->bool)->bool. (FINITE UNION_OF P) {}

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
statement: !P:('a->bool)->bool. (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) UNIV

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INC
statement: !P s:'a->bool. P s ==> (FINITE UNION_OF P) s

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_INC
statement: !P s:'a->bool. P s ==> (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) s

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_COMPLEMENT
statement:
!P s. (FINITE UNION_OF P) s <=>
         (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF (\s. P(univ(:'a) DIFF s))) (univ(:'a) DIFF s)

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_COMPLEMENT
statement:
!P s. (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) s <=>
         (FINITE UNION_OF (\s. P(univ(:'a) DIFF s))) (univ(:'a) DIFF s)

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_IDEMPOT
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        FINITE UNION_OF FINITE UNION_OF P = FINITE UNION_OF P

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_IDEMPOT
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        FINITE INTERSECTION_OF FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P =
        FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_UNIONS
statement:
!P u:('a->bool)->bool.
        FINITE u /\ (!s. s IN u ==> (FINITE UNION_OF P) s)
        ==> (FINITE UNION_OF P) (UNIONS u)

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_UNION
statement:
!P s t. (FINITE UNION_OF P) s /\ (FINITE UNION_OF P) t
           ==> (FINITE UNION_OF P) (s UNION t)

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTERS
statement:
!P u:('a->bool)->bool.
        FINITE u /\ (!s. s IN u ==> (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) s)
        ==> (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) (INTERS u)

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTER
statement:
!P s t. (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) s /\ (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) t
           ==> (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) (s INTER t)

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INTER_EQ
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. (FINITE UNION_OF P) s /\ (FINITE UNION_OF P) t
                   ==> (FINITE UNION_OF P) (s INTER t)) <=>
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> (FINITE UNION_OF P) (s INTER t))

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_INTER
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> P(s INTER t))
        ==> (!s t. (FINITE UNION_OF P) s /\ (FINITE UNION_OF P) t
                   ==> (FINITE UNION_OF P) (s INTER t))

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION_EQ
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) s /\
               (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) t
               ==> (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) (s UNION t)) <=>
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) (s UNION t))

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> P(s UNION t))
        ==> (!s t. (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) s /\
                   (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) t
                   ==> (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) (s UNION t))

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_EMPTY
statement: !P:('a->bool)->bool. (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) {}

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_EMPTY
statement: !P:('a->bool)->bool. (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) UNIV

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INC
statement: !P s:'a->bool. P s ==> (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_INC
statement: !P s:'a->bool. P s ==> (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) s

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_COMPLEMENT
statement:
!P s. (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s <=>
         (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF (\s. P(univ(:'a) DIFF s))) (univ(:'a) DIFF s)

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_COMPLEMENT
statement:
!P s. (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) s <=>
         (COUNTABLE UNION_OF (\s. P(univ(:'a) DIFF s))) (univ(:'a) DIFF s)

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_EXPLICIT
statement:
!P s:'a->bool.
        P {}
        ==> ((COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s <=>
             ?t. (!n. P(t n)) /\ UNIONS {t n | n IN univ(:num)} = s)

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_ASCENDING
statement:
!P s:'a->bool.
        P {} /\ (!t u. P t /\ P u ==> P(t UNION u))
        ==> ((COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s <=>
             ?t. (!n. P(t n)) /\
                 (!n. t n SUBSET t(SUC n)) /\
                 UNIONS {t n | n IN univ(:num)} = s)

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_IDEMPOT
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        COUNTABLE UNION_OF COUNTABLE UNION_OF P = COUNTABLE UNION_OF P

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_IDEMPOT
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P =
        COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_UNIONS
statement:
!P u:('a->bool)->bool.
        COUNTABLE u /\ (!s. s IN u ==> (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s)
        ==> (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) (UNIONS u)

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_UNION
statement:
!P s t. (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s /\ (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) t
           ==> (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) (s UNION t)

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTERS
statement:
!P u:('a->bool)->bool.
        COUNTABLE u /\ (!s. s IN u ==> (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) s)
        ==> (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) (INTERS u)

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_INTER
statement:
!P s t. (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) s /\ (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) t
           ==> (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) (s INTER t)

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTER_EQ
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s /\ (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) t
                   ==> (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) (s INTER t)) <=>
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) (s INTER t))

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTER
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> P(s INTER t))
        ==> (!s t. (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s /\ (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) t
                   ==> (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) (s INTER t))

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION_EQ
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) s /\
               (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) t
               ==> (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) (s UNION t)) <=>
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) (s UNION t))

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNION
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> P(s UNION t))
        ==> (!s t. (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) s /\
                   (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) t
                   ==> (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) (s UNION t))

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNIONS_NONEMPTY
statement:
!P u:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> P (s UNION t)) /\
        FINITE u /\ ~(u = {}) /\
        (!s. s IN u ==> (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) s)
        ==> (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) (UNIONS u)

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_UNIONS
statement:
!P u:('a->bool)->bool.
        (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) {} /\
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> P (s UNION t)) /\
        FINITE u /\
        (!s. s IN u ==> (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) s)
        ==> (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) (UNIONS u)

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTERS_NONEMPTY
statement:
!P u:('a->bool)->bool.
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> P (s INTER t)) /\
        FINITE u /\ ~(u = {}) /\
        (!s. s IN u ==> (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s)
        ==> (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) (INTERS u)

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_INTERS
statement:
!P u:('a->bool)->bool.
        (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) univ(:'a) /\
        (!s t. P s /\ P t ==> P (s INTER t)) /\
        FINITE u /\
        (!s. s IN u ==> (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) s)
        ==> (COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) (INTERS u)

name: COUNTABLE_DISJOINT_UNION_OF_IDEMPOT
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool.
        ((COUNTABLE INTER pairwise DISJOINT) UNION_OF
         (COUNTABLE INTER pairwise DISJOINT) UNION_OF P) =
        (COUNTABLE INTER pairwise DISJOINT) UNION_OF P

name: RELATIVE_TO_UNIV
statement: !P s. (P relative_to univ(:'a)) s <=> P s

name: RELATIVE_TO_IMP_SUBSET
statement: !P s t. (P relative_to s) t ==> t SUBSET s

name: FORALL_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
(!s. (P relative_to u) s ==> Q s) <=>
   (!s. P s ==> Q(u INTER s))

name: RELATIVE_TO_INC
statement: !P u s. P s ==> (P relative_to u) (u INTER s)

name: RELATIVE_TO
statement: (P relative_to u) = {u INTER s | P s}

name: RELATIVE_TO_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
!P:('a->bool)->bool s t.
        P relative_to s relative_to t = P relative_to (s INTER t)

name: RELATIVE_TO_COMPL
statement:
!P u s:'a->bool.
        s SUBSET u
        ==> ((P relative_to u) (u DIFF s) <=>
             ((\c. P(UNIV DIFF c)) relative_to u) s)

name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET
statement: !P s t:'a->bool. s SUBSET t /\ P s ==> (P relative_to t) s

name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET_TRANS
statement:
!P u s t:'a->bool.
      (P relative_to u) s /\ s SUBSET t /\ t SUBSET u ==> (P relative_to t) s

name: RELATIVE_TO_MONO
statement:
!P Q.
     (!s. P s ==> Q s) ==> !u. (P relative_to u) s ==> (Q relative_to u) s

name: RELATIVE_TO_SUBSET_INC
statement:
!P u s:'a->bool.
        s SUBSET u /\ P s ==> (P relative_to u) s

name: RELATIVE_TO_INTER
statement:
!P s. (!c d:'a->bool. P c /\ P d ==> P(c INTER d))
         ==> !c d. (P relative_to s) c /\ (P relative_to s) d
                   ==> (P relative_to s) (c INTER d)

name: RELATIVE_TO_UNION
statement:
!P s. (!c d:'a->bool. P c /\ P d ==> P(c UNION d))
         ==> !c d. (P relative_to s) c /\ (P relative_to s) d
                   ==> (P relative_to s) (c UNION d)

name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
!P u:'a->bool.
        ((ARBITRARY UNION_OF P) relative_to u) =
        (ARBITRARY UNION_OF (P relative_to u))

name: FINITE_UNION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
!P u:'a->bool.
        ((FINITE UNION_OF P) relative_to u) =
        (FINITE UNION_OF (P relative_to u))

name: COUNTABLE_UNION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
!P u:'a->bool.
        ((COUNTABLE UNION_OF P) relative_to u) =
        (COUNTABLE UNION_OF (P relative_to u))

name: ARBITRARY_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
!P u:'a->bool.
        ((ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF P) relative_to u) =
        ((ARBITRARY INTERSECTION_OF (P relative_to u)) relative_to u)

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
!P u:'a->bool.
        ((FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) relative_to u) =
        ((FINITE INTERSECTION_OF (P relative_to u)) relative_to u)

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
!P u:'a->bool.
        ((COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) relative_to u) =
        ((COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF (P relative_to u)) relative_to u)

name: FINITE_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO_ALT
statement:
!P u s:'a->bool.
        P u ==> ((FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P relative_to u) s <=>
                 (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF P) s /\ s SUBSET u)

name: COUNTABLE_INTERSECTION_OF_RELATIVE_TO_ALT
statement:
!P u s:'a->bool.
        P u ==> ((COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P relative_to u) s <=>
                 (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF P) s /\ s SUBSET u)

name: ARBITRARY_UNION_OF_NONEMPTY_FINITE_INTERSECTION
statement:
!u:('a->bool)->bool.
        ARBITRARY UNION_OF ((\s. FINITE s /\ ~(s = {})) INTERSECTION_OF u) =
        ARBITRARY UNION_OF (FINITE INTERSECTION_OF u relative_to UNIONS u)

name: OPEN_IN_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
!top s:'a->bool.
        (open_in top relative_to s) = open_in (subtopology top s)

name: CLOSED_IN_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
!top s:'a->bool.
        (closed_in top relative_to s) = closed_in (subtopology top s)

name: istopology
statement:
istopology L =
      ({} IN L /\
       (!s t. s IN L /\ t IN L ==> (s INTER t) IN L) /\
       (!k. k SUBSET L ==> (BIGUNION k) IN L))

name: neigh
statement:
neigh(top)(N,(x:'a)) = ?P. (open_in top) P /\ P SUBSET N /\ P x /\
                             N SUBSET topspace top

name: closed_in
statement:
closed_in top s <=>
        s SUBSET (topspace top) /\ open_in top (topspace top DIFF s)

name: closed_DEF
statement: closed (s :'a topology) = (closed_in s) UNIV

name: limpt
statement:
limpt(top) x S' <=>
  x IN topspace top /\
  !N:'a->bool. neigh(top)(N,x) ==> ?y. ~(x = y) /\ S' y /\ N y

name: subtopology
statement: subtopology top u = topology {s INTER u | open_in top s}

name: UNION_OF
statement: P UNION_OF Q = \s. ?u. P u /\ (!c. c IN u ==> Q c) /\ UNIONS u = s

name: INTERSECTION_OF
statement: P INTERSECTION_OF Q = \s. ?u. P u /\ (!c. c IN u ==> Q c) /\ INTERS u = s

name: ARBITRARY
statement: ARBITRARY (s:('a->bool)->bool) <=> T

name: relative_to
statement: (P relative_to s) t = ?u. P u /\ s INTER u = t

name: reln_to_rel
statement: reln_to_rel = CURRY

name: StrongWellOrderExists
statement: ?R:'a -> 'a -> bool. StrongLinearOrder R /\ WF R

name: WF_REC_INVARIANT
statement:
WF(<<) ==>
 !H S. (!f g x. (!z. z << x ==> f z = g z /\ S z (f z)) ==>
                H f x = H g x /\ S x (H f x)) ==>
       ?f:'a->'b. !x. f x = H f x

name: TARSKI_SET
statement: !f. (!s t. s SUBSET t ==> f(s) SUBSET f(t)) ==> ?s:'a->bool. f(s) = s

name: EXTENSION
statement: !s t. (s=t) <=> (!x:'a. x IN s <=> x IN t)

name: NOT_EQUAL_SETS
statement: !s:'a set. !t. s <> t <=> ?x. x IN t <=> x NOTIN s

name: SET_MINIMUM
statement:
!s:'a -> bool. !M.
     (?x. x IN s) <=> ?x. x IN s /\ !y. y IN s ==> M x <= M y

name: SUBSET_TRANS
statement: !(s:'a set) t u. s SUBSET t /\ t SUBSET u ==> s SUBSET u

name: SUBSET_transitive
statement: transitive (SUBSET)

name: SUBSET_REFL
statement: !(s:'a set). s SUBSET s

name: SUBSET_reflexive
statement: reflexive (SUBSET)

name: RC_SUBSET_THM
statement: RC(SUBSET) = (SUBSET)

name: TC_SUBSET_THM
statement: TC(SUBSET) = (SUBSET)

name: RTC_SUBSET_THM
statement: RTC (SUBSET) = (SUBSET)

name: SUBSET_ANTISYM
statement: !(s:'a set) t. (s SUBSET t) /\ (t SUBSET s) ==> (s = t)

name: EMPTY_SUBSET
statement: !s:'a set. EMPTY SUBSET s

name: SUBSET_EMPTY
statement: !s:'a set. s SUBSET EMPTY <=> (s = EMPTY)

name: UNIV_SUBSET
statement: !s:'a set. UNIV SUBSET s <=> (s = UNIV)

name: SUBSET_ANTISYM_EQ
statement: !(s:'a set) t. (s SUBSET t) /\ (t SUBSET s) <=> (s = t)

name: PSUBSET_TRANS
statement: !s:'a set. !t u. (s PSUBSET t /\ t PSUBSET u) ==> (s PSUBSET u)

name: transitive_PSUBSET
statement: transitive (PSUBSET)

name: PSUBSET_IRREFL
statement: !s:'a set. ~(s PSUBSET s)

name: RC_PSUBSET
statement: RC (PSUBSET) = (SUBSET)

name: TC_PSUBSET
statement: TC (PSUBSET) = (PSUBSET)

name: RTC_PSUBSET
statement: RTC (PSUBSET) = (SUBSET)

name: NOT_PSUBSET_EMPTY
statement: !s:'a set. ~(s PSUBSET EMPTY)

name: NOT_UNIV_PSUBSET
statement: !s:'a set. ~(UNIV PSUBSET s)

name: IN_UNION
statement: !s t (x:'a). x IN (s UNION t) <=> x IN s \/ x IN t

name: UNION_SUBSET
statement: !s t u. (s UNION t) SUBSET u <=> s SUBSET u /\ t SUBSET u

name: SUBSET_UNION_ABSORPTION
statement: !s:'a set. !t. s SUBSET t <=> (s UNION t = t)

name: IN_INTER
statement: !s t (x:'a). x IN (s INTER t) <=> x IN s /\ x IN t

name: SUBSET_INTER
statement: !s t u. s SUBSET (t INTER u) <=> s SUBSET t /\ s SUBSET u

name: SUBSET_INTER_ABSORPTION
statement: !s:'a set. !t. s SUBSET t <=> (s INTER t = s)

name: DISJOINT_ALT'
statement: !s t. DISJOINT s t <=> !x. x IN t ==> x NOTIN s

name: DISJOINT_UNION
statement: !(s:'a set) t u. DISJOINT (s UNION t) u <=> DISJOINT s u /\ DISJOINT t u

name: DISJOINT_UNION'
statement: !s t u. DISJOINT u (s UNION t) <=> DISJOINT u s /\ DISJOINT u t

name: DISJOINT_UNION_BOTH
statement:
!s t u:'a set.
        (DISJOINT (s UNION t) u <=> DISJOINT s u /\ DISJOINT t u) /\
        (DISJOINT u (s UNION t) <=> DISJOINT s u /\ DISJOINT t u)

name: DISJOINT_SUBSET
statement: !s t u. DISJOINT s t /\ u SUBSET t ==> DISJOINT s u

name: SUBSET_DISJOINT
statement: !s t u v. DISJOINT s t /\ u SUBSET s /\ v SUBSET t ==> DISJOINT u v

name: DISJOINT_SUBSET'
statement: !s t u. DISJOINT s t /\ u SUBSET s ==> DISJOINT u t

name: IN_DIFF
statement: !(s:'a set) t x. x IN (s DIFF t) <=> x IN s /\ x NOTIN t

name: UNION_DIFF_EQ
statement:
(!s t. ((s:'a -> bool) UNION (t DIFF s)) = (s UNION t))
  /\ !s t. ((t DIFF s) UNION (s:'a -> bool)) = (t UNION s)

name: IN_INSERT
statement: !x:'a. !y s. x IN (y INSERT s) <=> x=y \/ x IN s

name: COMPONENT
statement: !x:'a. !s. x IN (x INSERT s)

name: DECOMPOSITION
statement: !s:'a set. !x. x IN s <=> ?t. s = x INSERT t /\ x NOTIN t

name: ABSORPTION
statement: !x:'a. !s. (x IN s) <=> (x INSERT s = s)

name: DISJOINT_INSERT
statement: !(x:'a) s t. DISJOINT (x INSERT s) t <=> DISJOINT s t /\ x NOTIN t

name: INSERT_SUBSET
statement: !x:'a. !s t. (x INSERT s) SUBSET t <=> x IN t /\ s SUBSET t

name: SUBSET_INSERT
statement: !x:'a. !s. x NOTIN s ==> !t. s SUBSET (x INSERT t) <=> s SUBSET t

name: SUBSET_SING
statement: x SUBSET {a} <=> x = {} \/ x = {a}

name: IN_DELETE
statement: !s. !x:'a. !y. x IN (s DELETE y) <=> x IN s /\ x <> y

name: DELETE_NON_ELEMENT
statement: !x:'a. !s. x NOTIN s <=> (s DELETE x = s)

name: IN_DELETE_EQ
statement:
!s x. !x':'a.
      (x IN s <=> x' IN s) <=> (x IN (s DELETE x') <=> x' IN (s DELETE x))

name: SUBSET_DELETE
statement: !x:'a. !s t. s SUBSET (t DELETE x) <=> x NOTIN s /\ s SUBSET t

name: SUBSET_INSERT_DELETE
statement: !x:'a. !s t. s SUBSET (x INSERT t) <=> ((s DELETE x) SUBSET t)

name: PSUBSET_INSERT_SUBSET
statement: !s t. s PSUBSET t <=> ?x:'a. x NOTIN s /\ (x INSERT s) SUBSET t

name: PSUBSET_MEMBER
statement: !s:'a set. !t. s PSUBSET t <=> s SUBSET t /\ ?y. y IN t /\ y NOTIN s

name: CHOICE_INTRO
statement: (?x. x IN s) /\ (!x. x IN s ==> P x) ==> P (CHOICE s)

name: SING_INSERT
statement: SING (x INSERT s) <=> (s = {}) \/ (s = {x})

name: SING_UNION
statement:
SING (s UNION t) <=> SING s /\ (t = {}) \/ SING t /\ (s = {}) \/
                       SING s /\ SING t /\ (s = t)

name: IN_SING
statement: !x y. x IN {y:'a} <=> (x = y)

name: SING_IFF_EMPTY_REST
statement: !s:'a set. SING s <=> s <> EMPTY /\ REST s = EMPTY

name: IN_IMAGE
statement: !y:'b. !s f. y IN (IMAGE f s) <=> ?x:'a. y = f x /\ x IN s

name: IMAGE_CONG
statement:
!f s f' s'. (s = s') /\ (!x. x IN s' ==> (f x = f' x)) ==>
              IMAGE f s = IMAGE f' s'

name: SUBSET_IMAGE
statement: !f:'a->'b s t. s SUBSET (IMAGE f t) <=> ?u. u SUBSET t /\ (s = IMAGE f u)

name: INJ_INSERT
statement:
!f x s t. INJ f (x INSERT s) t <=>
              INJ f s t /\ (f x) IN t /\
              (!y. y IN s /\ (f x = f y) ==> (x = y))

name: IN_FUNSET
statement: !(f :'a -> 'b) P Q. f IN (FUNSET P Q) <=> !x. x IN P ==> f x IN Q

name: IN_DFUNSET
statement:
!(f :'a -> 'b) (P :'a -> bool) Q.
     f IN (DFUNSET P Q) <=> !x. x IN P ==> f x IN Q x

name: FUNSET_EMPTY
statement: !s (f :'a -> 'b). f IN (FUNSET s {}) <=> (s = {})

name: SCHROEDER_CLOSE
statement: !f s. x IN (schroeder_close f s) <=> (?n. x IN FUNPOW (IMAGE f) n s)

name: BIJ_ALT
statement:
!f s t. BIJ f s t <=>
            f IN (FUNSET s t) /\ (!y. y IN t ==> ?!x. x IN s /\ (y = f x))

name: INJ_LINV_OPT
statement:
INJ f s t ==> !x:'a. !y:'b.
    (LINV_OPT f s y = SOME x) <=> (y = f x) /\ x IN s /\ y IN t

name: BIJ_IFF_INV
statement:
!f s t. BIJ f s t <=>
           (!x. x IN s ==> f x IN t) /\
           ?g. (!x. x IN t ==> g x IN s) /\
               (!x. x IN s ==> (g (f x) = x)) /\
               (!x. x IN t ==> (f (g x) = x))

name: BIJ_support
statement:
!f s' s.
      BIJ f s' s' /\ s' SUBSET s /\ (!x. x NOTIN s' ==> (f x = x)) ==>
      BIJ f s s

name: SIMPLE_FINITE_INDUCT
statement:
!P. P EMPTY /\ (!s. P s ==> (!e:'a. P(e INSERT s)))
      ==>
      !s. FINITE s ==> P s

name: FINITE_INDUCT
statement:
!P. P {} /\ (!s. FINITE s /\ P s ==> (!e. ~(e IN s) ==> P(e INSERT s))) ==>
      !s:'a set. FINITE s ==> P s

name: FINITE_DELETE
statement: !x:'a. !s. FINITE(s DELETE x) <=> FINITE s

name: FINITE_UNION
statement: !s:'a set. !t. FINITE(s UNION t) <=> FINITE s /\ FINITE t

name: FINITE_DIFF_down
statement: !P Q. FINITE (P DIFF Q) /\ FINITE Q ==> FINITE P

name: FINITELY_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_FINITE
statement: !f. (!x. FINITE { y | x = f y }) ==> !s. FINITE (IMAGE f s) = FINITE s

name: SING_IFF_CARD1
statement: !s:'a set. SING s <=> CARD s = 1 /\ FINITE s

name: CARD_DIFF_EQN
statement: !t s. FINITE s ==> (CARD (s DIFF t) = CARD s - CARD (s INTER t))

name: BIJ_FINITE
statement: !f s t. BIJ f s t /\ FINITE s ==> FINITE t

name: BIJ_FINITE_SUBSET
statement:
!(f : num -> 'a) s t.
       BIJ f UNIV s /\ FINITE t /\ t SUBSET s ==>
       ?N. !n. N <= n ==> ~(f n IN t)

name: FINITE_BIJ
statement: !f s t. FINITE s /\ BIJ f s t ==> FINITE t /\ (CARD s = CARD t)

name: CARD_INJ_IMAGE
statement:
!f s. (!x y. (f x = f y) <=> (x = y)) /\ FINITE s ==>
        (CARD (IMAGE f s) = CARD s)

name: FINITE_COMPLETE_INDUCTION
statement:
!P. (!x. (!y. y PSUBSET x ==> P y) ==> FINITE x ==> P x)
      ==>
      !x. FINITE x ==> P x

name: FINITE_LEAST_MEASURE_INDUCTION
statement:
!f P.
    P {} /\
    (!a s. a NOTIN s /\ (!b. b IN s ==> f a <= f b) /\ P s ==>
           P (a INSERT s)) ==>
    !s. FINITE s ==> P s

name: HAS_SIZE_CARD
statement: !s n. s HAS_SIZE n ==> (CARD s = n)

name: HAS_SIZE_0
statement: !(s:'a->bool). s HAS_SIZE 0:num <=> (s = {})

name: HAS_SIZE_SUC
statement:
!(s:'a->bool) n. s HAS_SIZE (SUC n) <=>
                     s <> {} /\ !a. a IN s ==> (s DELETE a) HAS_SIZE n

name: FINITE_HAS_SIZE
statement: !s. FINITE s <=> s HAS_SIZE CARD s

name: CARD_IMAGE_INJ
statement:
!(f:'a->'b) s. (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ (f(x) = f(y)) ==> (x = y)) /\
                  FINITE s ==> (CARD (IMAGE f s) = CARD s)

name: HAS_SIZE_IMAGE_INJ
statement:
!(f:'a->'b) s n.
        (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f(x) = f(y) ==> x = y) /\ (s HAS_SIZE n)
        ==> ((IMAGE f s) HAS_SIZE n)

name: HAS_SIZE_INDEX
statement:
!s n.
      (s HAS_SIZE n) ==>
      ?f:num->'a. (!m. m < n ==> f(m) IN s) /\
                  (!x. x IN s ==> ?!m. m < n /\ (f m = x))

name: IN_COUNT
statement: !m n. m IN count n <=> m < n

name: COUNT_ZERO
statement: count 0 = {}

name: COUNT_SUC
statement: !n. count (SUC n) = n INSERT count n

name: COUNT_ONE
statement: count 1 = {0}

name: FINITE_BIJ_COUNT_EQ
statement: !s. FINITE s = ?c n. BIJ c (count n) s

name: FINITE_WEAK_ENUMERATE
statement: !s. FINITE s = ?f b. !e. e IN s <=> ?n. n < b /\ (e = f n)

name: IN_BIGUNION
statement: !x sos. x IN BIGUNION sos <=> ?s. x IN s /\ s IN sos

name: BIGUNION_IMAGE
statement: !f s. BIGUNION (IMAGE f s) = {y | ?x. x IN s /\ y IN f x}

name: BIGUNION_SUBSET
statement: !X P. BIGUNION P SUBSET X <=> (!Y. Y IN P ==> Y SUBSET X)

name: FINITE_BIGUNION
statement: !P. FINITE P /\ (!s. s IN P ==> FINITE s) ==> FINITE (BIGUNION P)

name: FINITE_BIGUNION_EQ
statement: !P. FINITE (BIGUNION P) <=> FINITE P /\ (!s. s IN P ==> FINITE s)

name: SUBSET_BIGUNION_SUBSET_I
statement: B SUBSET A /\ A IN As ==> B SUBSET BIGUNION As

name: FORALL_IN_BIGUNION
statement: !P s. (!x. x IN BIGUNION s ==> P x) <=> !t x. t IN s /\ x IN t ==> P x

name: INTER_BIGUNION
statement:
(!s t. BIGUNION s INTER t = BIGUNION {x INTER t | x IN s}) /\
    (!s t. t INTER BIGUNION s = BIGUNION {t INTER x | x IN s})

name: SUBSET_BIGUNION
statement: !f g. f SUBSET g ==> BIGUNION f SUBSET BIGUNION g

name: IN_BIGINTER
statement: x IN BIGINTER B <=> !P. P IN B ==> x IN P

name: IN_BIGINTER_IMAGE
statement: !x f s. (x IN BIGINTER (IMAGE f s)) = (!y. y IN s ==> x IN f y)

name: BIGINTER_IMAGE
statement: !f s. BIGINTER (IMAGE f s) = {y | !x. x IN s ==> y IN f x}

name: BIGINTER_INTER
statement: !P Q. BIGINTER {P; Q} = P INTER Q

name: SUBSET_BIGINTER
statement: !X P. X SUBSET BIGINTER P <=> !Y. Y IN P ==> X SUBSET Y

name: BIGINTER_UNION
statement: !s1 s2. BIGINTER (s1 UNION s2) = BIGINTER s1 INTER BIGINTER s2

name: BIGINTER_SUBSET
statement: !sp s t. t IN s /\ t SUBSET sp ==> (BIGINTER s) SUBSET sp

name: DIFF_BIGINTER
statement:
!sp s. (!t. t IN s ==> t SUBSET sp) /\ s <> {} ==>
         (BIGINTER s = sp DIFF (BIGUNION (IMAGE (\u. sp DIFF u) s)))

name: IN_CROSS
statement: !P Q x. x IN (P CROSS Q) <=> FST x IN P /\ SND x IN Q

name: CROSS_SUBSET
statement:
!P Q P0 Q0. (P0 CROSS Q0) SUBSET (P CROSS Q) <=>
                (P0 = {}) \/ (Q0 = {}) \/ P0 SUBSET P /\ Q0 SUBSET Q

name: FINITE_CROSS_EQ
statement:
!P Q. FINITE (P CROSS Q)
             <=>
        (P = {}) \/ (Q = {}) \/ FINITE P /\ FINITE Q

name: INFINITE_PAIR_UNIV
statement: FINITE univ(:'a # 'b) <=> FINITE univ(:'a) /\ FINITE univ(:'b)

name: INTER_CROSS
statement: !A B C D. (A CROSS B) INTER (C CROSS D) = (A INTER C) CROSS (B INTER D)

name: BIGUNION_CROSS
statement: !f s t. (BIGUNION (IMAGE f s)) CROSS t = BIGUNION (IMAGE (\n. f n CROSS t) s)

name: CROSS_BIGUNION
statement: !f s t. s CROSS (BIGUNION (IMAGE f t)) = BIGUNION (IMAGE (\n. s CROSS f n) t)

name: SUBSET_CROSS
statement: !a b c d. a SUBSET b /\ c SUBSET d ==> (a CROSS c) SUBSET (b CROSS d)

name: disjUNION_UNIV
statement: univ(:'a + 'b) = UNIV <+> UNIV

name: IN_disjUNION
statement: (INL a IN A <+> B <=> a IN A) /\ (INR b IN A <+> B <=> b IN B)

name: CARD_disjUNION
statement:
FINITE (s:'a set) /\ FINITE (t:'b set) ==>
  CARD (s <+> t) = CARD s + CARD t

name: IN_COMPL
statement: !(x:'a) s. x IN COMPL s <=> x NOTIN s

name: ITSET_SING
statement: !f x a. ITSET f {x} a = f x a

name: SUM_IMAGE_CONG
statement: s1 = s2 /\ (!x. x IN s2 ==> (f1 x = f2 x)) ==> SIGMA f1 s1 = SIGMA f2 s2

name: SUM_IMAGE_ZERO
statement: !s. FINITE s ==> ((SIGMA f s = 0) <=> (!x. x IN s ==> (f x = 0)))

name: ABS_DIFF_SUM_IMAGE
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==>
      (ABS_DIFF (SIGMA f s) (SIGMA g s) <= SIGMA (\x. ABS_DIFF (f x) (g x)) s)

name: SUM_IMAGE_MONO_LESS_EQ
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==>
      (!x. x IN s ==> f x <= g x) ==> SUM_IMAGE f s <= SUM_IMAGE g s

name: SUM_IMAGE_MONO_LESS
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==> (?x. x IN s /\ f x < g x) /\ (!x. x IN s ==> f x <= g x) ==>
      SUM_IMAGE f s < SUM_IMAGE g s

name: SUM_IMAGE_ADD
statement: !s. FINITE s ==> SIGMA (\x. f x + g x) s = SIGMA f s + SIGMA g s

name: SUM_SET_SING
statement: !n. SUM_SET {n} = n

name: SUM_SET_count_2
statement: !n. 2 * SUM_SET (count n) = n * (n - 1)

name: SUM_SET_count
statement: SUM_SET (count n) = n * (n - 1) DIV 2

name: PROD_IMAGE_EQ_0
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==>
  (PROD_IMAGE f s = 0 <=> ?x. x IN s /\ f x = 0)

name: PROD_IMAGE_EQ_1
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==>
  (PROD_IMAGE f s = 1 <=> IMAGE f s SUBSET {1})

name: prime_PROD_IMAGE
statement:
!f s. FINITE s ==>
  (prime (PROD_IMAGE f s) <=>
     ?p. IMAGE f s SUBSET {1; p} /\ prime p /\
         ?!x. x IN s /\ f x = p)

name: in_max_set
statement: !s. FINITE s ==> !x. x IN s ==> x <= MAX_SET s

name: MIN_SET_THM'
statement:
(!e. MIN_SET {e} = e) /\
    (!e s. s <> {} ==> MIN_SET (e INSERT s) = MIN e (MIN_SET s))

name: SUBSET_count_MAX_SET
statement: FINITE s ==> s SUBSET count (MAX_SET s + 1)

name: CARD_LE_MAX_SET
statement: FINITE s ==> CARD s <= MAX_SET s + 1

name: IN_POW
statement: !set e. e IN POW set <=> e SUBSET set

name: FINITE_POW_EQN
statement: FINITE (POW s) <=> FINITE s

name: inv_image_equiv_on
statement:
!R Y f. R equiv_on Y ==>
  inv_image R f equiv_on { x | f x IN Y }

name: equiv_on_subset
statement: !R s t. R equiv_on s /\ t SUBSET s ==> R equiv_on t

name: equiv_class_eq
statement:
!R s x y. R equiv_on s /\ x IN s /\ y IN s ==>
             ((equiv_class R s x = equiv_class R s y) <=> R x y)

name: partition_rel_eq
statement:
!R1 R2 Y.
    R1 equiv_on Y /\ R2 equiv_on Y /\
    partition R1 Y = partition R2 Y ==>
    (!x y. x IN Y /\ y IN Y ==> R1 x y = R2 x y)

name: partitions_thm
statement:
!X Y. X partitions Y <=>
  ((!x. x IN X ==> x <> {} /\ x SUBSET Y) /\
   (!y. y IN Y ==> ?!x. x IN X /\ y IN x))

name: partitions_FINITE
statement:
!X Y. X partitions Y /\ FINITE Y ==>
  FINITE X /\ (!s. s IN X ==> FINITE s)

name: partitions_DISJOINT
statement:
!v w s1 s2.
    v partitions w /\ s1 IN v /\ s2 IN v /\ s1 <> s2 ==>
    DISJOINT s1 s2

name: partitions_empty
statement: !v. v partitions {} <=> v = {}

name: empty_partitions
statement: !s. {} partitions s <=> s = {}

name: partitions_inj
statement: !x w1 w2. x partitions w1 /\ x partitions w2 ==> w1 = w2

name: partitions_covers
statement: !x y. x partitions y ==> BIGUNION x = y

name: partitions_PAIR_DISJOINT
statement:
!x y. x partitions y <=>
        {} NOTIN x /\
        (!s t. s IN x /\ t IN x /\ ~(s = t) ==> DISJOINT s t) /\
        BIGUNION x = y

name: partitions_SING
statement:
!v x. SING x ==>
        (v partitions x <=> v = {{CHOICE x}})

name: SING_partitions
statement: !x w. {x} partitions w <=> x = w /\ w <> {}

name: INJ_IMAGE_equiv_class
statement:
!f s t x. INJ f s t /\ x IN s ==>
  IMAGE f (equiv_class R s x) =
  equiv_class (inv_image R (LINV f s)) (IMAGE f s) (f x)

name: IMAGE_IMAGE_partition
statement:
!R f s t. INJ f s t ==>
  IMAGE (IMAGE f) (partition R s) =
  partition (inv_image R (LINV f s)) (IMAGE f s)

name: BIJ_IMAGE_partitions
statement:
!f x y v. BIJ f x y /\ v partitions x ==>
  IMAGE (IMAGE f) v partitions y

name: partitions_INSERT
statement:
!x w v. x NOTIN w ==>
  (v partitions (x INSERT w) <=>
   (?u s. u partitions w /\ v = (x INSERT s) INSERT (u DELETE s) /\
    (s <> {} ==> s IN u)))

name: FINITE_partitions
statement:
!x. FINITE x ==>
      FINITE { v | v partitions x }

name: part_in_partition
statement:
!w v x. v partitions w /\ x IN w ==>
  part v x IN v

name: part_partition
statement:
!R w y. y IN w /\ R equiv_on w ==>
  part (partition R w) y = { x | x IN w /\ R x y }

name: part_unique
statement:
!w v x s. v partitions w /\ x IN w /\ x IN s /\ s IN v ==>
  s = part v x

name: in_part
statement:
!w v x. v partitions w /\ x IN w ==>
  x IN part v x

name: part_SING
statement: !x w. x IN w ==> part {w} x = w

name: equivalence_same_part
statement: equivalence (\x y. part v x = part v y)

name: empty_refines
statement: !v. {} refines v

name: refines_grows_parts
statement:
!w v1 v2. v1 partitions w /\ v2 partitions w ==>
  (v1 refines v2 <=>
    (!x y. x IN w /\ y IN w /\ part v1 x = part v1 y ==>
                               part v2 x = part v2 y))

name: refines_refl
statement: !v. v refines v

name: refines_transitive
statement: !v1 v2 v3. v1 refines v2 /\ v2 refines v3 ==> v1 refines v3

name: refines_antisym
statement:
!w v1 v2. v1 partitions w /\ v2 partitions w /\
  v1 refines v2 /\ v2 refines v1 ==> v1 = v2

name: pairwise_EMPTY
statement: !r. pairwise r {}

name: disjoint_def
statement: !A. disjoint A = !a b. a IN A /\ b IN A /\ (a <> b) ==> DISJOINT a b

name: disjointI
statement: !A. (!a b . a IN A ==> b IN A ==> (a <> b) ==> DISJOINT a b) ==> disjoint A

name: disjointD
statement: !A a b. disjoint A ==> a IN A ==> b IN A ==> (a <> b) ==> DISJOINT a b

name: disjoint_empty
statement: disjoint {}

name: disjoint_sing
statement: !a. disjoint {a}

name: disjoint_same
statement: !s t. (s = t) ==> disjoint {s; t}

name: disjoint_two
statement: !s t. s <> t /\ DISJOINT s t ==> disjoint {s; t}

name: disjoint_union
statement:
!A B. disjoint A /\ disjoint B /\ (BIGUNION A INTER BIGUNION B = {}) ==>
          disjoint (A UNION B)

name: disjoint_image
statement: !f. (!i j. i <> j ==> DISJOINT (f i) (f j)) ==> disjoint (IMAGE f UNIV)

name: disjoint_insert_imp
statement: !e c. disjoint (e INSERT c) ==> disjoint c

name: disjoint_insert_notin
statement: !e c. disjoint (e INSERT c) /\ e NOTIN c ==> !s. s IN c ==> DISJOINT e s

name: disjoint_insert
statement: !e c. disjoint c /\ (!x. x IN c ==> DISJOINT x e) ==> disjoint (e INSERT c)

name: disjoint_restrict
statement: !e c. disjoint c ==> disjoint (IMAGE ($INTER e) c)

name: PSUBSET_EQN
statement: !s1 s2. s1 PSUBSET s2 <=> s1 SUBSET s2 /\ ~(s2 SUBSET s1)

name: UNIQUE_MEMBER_SING
statement: !x s. x IN s /\ (!y. y IN s ==> (x = y)) <=> (s = {x})

name: countable_surj
statement: !s. countable s <=> (s = {}) \/ ?f. SURJ f (UNIV:num set) s

name: COUNTABLE_COUNT
statement: !n. countable (count n)

name: COUNTABLE_NUM
statement: !s :num -> bool. countable s

name: COUNTABLE_IMAGE_NUM
statement: !f :num -> 'a. !s. countable (IMAGE f s)

name: pair_to_num_inv'
statement:
(!x. pair_to_num (num_to_pair x) = x) /\
    (!x. num_to_pair (pair_to_num x) = x)

name: COUNTABLE_ALT_BIJ
statement: !s. countable s <=> FINITE s \/ BIJ (enumerate s) UNIV s

name: COUNTABLE_ENUM
statement: !c. countable c <=> c = {} \/ ?f :num -> 'a. c = IMAGE f UNIV

name: PSUBSET_SING
statement: !s x. x PSUBSET {s} <=> (x = EMPTY)

name: DELETE_SUBSET_INSERT
statement: !s e s2. s DELETE e SUBSET s2 <=> s SUBSET e INSERT s2

name: PREIMAGE_ALT
statement: !f s. PREIMAGE f s = s o f

name: PREIMAGE_o
statement: !f g s. PREIMAGE (f o g) s = PREIMAGE g (s o f)

name: IN_PREIMAGE
statement: !f s x. x IN PREIMAGE f s <=> f x IN s

name: PREIMAGE_EMPTY
statement: !f. PREIMAGE f {} = {}

name: PREIMAGE_UNIV
statement: !f. PREIMAGE f UNIV = UNIV

name: PREIMAGE_COMPL
statement: !f s. PREIMAGE f (COMPL s) = COMPL (PREIMAGE f s)

name: PREIMAGE_UNION
statement: !f s t. PREIMAGE f (s UNION t) = PREIMAGE f s UNION PREIMAGE f t

name: PREIMAGE_INTER
statement: !f s t. PREIMAGE f (s INTER t) = PREIMAGE f s INTER PREIMAGE f t

name: PREIMAGE_I
statement: PREIMAGE I = I /\ PREIMAGE (λx. x) = (λx. x)

name: FINITE_PREIMAGE
statement: (!x y. f x = f y <=> x = y) /\ FINITE s ==> FINITE (PREIMAGE f s)

name: BIJ_NUM_TO_PAIR
statement: BIJ num_to_pair UNIV (UNIV CROSS UNIV)

name: BIJ_PAIR_TO_NUM
statement: BIJ pair_to_num (UNIV CROSS UNIV) UNIV

name: BIJ_SWAP
statement: BIJ SWAP (UNIV CROSS UNIV) (UNIV CROSS UNIV)

name: NUM_2D_BIJ_BIG_SQUARE
statement:
!(f : num -> num # num) N.
       BIJ f UNIV (UNIV CROSS UNIV) ==>
       ?k. IMAGE f (count N) SUBSET count k CROSS count k

name: NUM_2D_BIJ_SMALL_SQUARE
statement:
!(f : num -> num # num) k.
       BIJ f UNIV (UNIV CROSS UNIV) ==>
       ?N. count k CROSS count k SUBSET IMAGE f (count N)

name: NUM_2D_BIJ
statement:
?f. BIJ f ((UNIV : num -> bool) CROSS (UNIV : num -> bool))
              (UNIV : num -> bool)

name: NUM_2D_BIJ_INV
statement:
?f. BIJ f (UNIV : num -> bool)
              ((UNIV : num -> bool) CROSS (UNIV : num -> bool))

name: NUM_2D_BIJ_NZ
statement:
?f. BIJ f ((UNIV : num -> bool) CROSS ((UNIV : num -> bool) DIFF {0}))
              (UNIV : num -> bool)

name: NUM_2D_BIJ_NZ_INV
statement:
?f. BIJ f (UNIV : num -> bool)
              ((UNIV : num -> bool) CROSS ((UNIV : num -> bool) DIFF {0}))

name: NUM_2D_BIJ_NZ_ALT
statement:
?f. BIJ f ((UNIV : num -> bool) CROSS (UNIV : num -> bool))
              ((UNIV : num -> bool) DIFF {0})

name: NUM_2D_BIJ_NZ_ALT_INV
statement:
?f. BIJ f ((UNIV : num -> bool) DIFF {0})
              ((UNIV : num -> bool) CROSS (UNIV : num -> bool))

name: NUM_2D_BIJ_NZ_ALT2
statement:
?f. BIJ f (((UNIV : num -> bool) DIFF {0}) CROSS ((UNIV : num -> bool) DIFF {0}))
              (UNIV : num -> bool)

name: NUM_2D_BIJ_NZ_ALT2_INV
statement:
?f. BIJ f (UNIV : num -> bool)
              (((UNIV : num -> bool) DIFF {0}) CROSS ((UNIV : num -> bool) DIFF {0}))

name: EXTENSIONAL
statement: !s. EXTENSIONAL s = {f :'a->'b | !x. x NOTIN s ==> f x = ARB}

name: EXTENSIONAL_EMPTY
statement: EXTENSIONAL {} = {\x:'a. ARB:'b}

name: EXTENSIONAL_UNIV
statement: !f. EXTENSIONAL univ(:'a) f

name: EXTENSIONAL_EQ
statement:
!s f (g :'a->'b).
     f IN EXTENSIONAL s /\ g IN EXTENSIONAL s /\ (!x. x IN s ==> f x = g x)
     ==> f = g

name: RESTRICTION_IN_EXTENSIONAL
statement: !s (f :'a->'b). RESTRICTION s f IN EXTENSIONAL s

name: RESTRICTION_EXTENSION
statement:
!s f (g :'a->'b). RESTRICTION s f = RESTRICTION s g <=>
                (!x. x IN s ==> f x = g x)

name: RESTRICTION_FIXPOINT
statement: !s (f :'a->'b). RESTRICTION s f = f <=> f IN EXTENSIONAL s

name: RESTRICTION_RESTRICTION
statement:
!s t (f :'a->'b).
        s SUBSET t ==> RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION t f) = RESTRICTION s f

name: RESTRICTION_IDEMP
statement: !s (f :'a->'b). RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION s f) = RESTRICTION s f

name: IMAGE_RESTRICTION
statement: !(f :'a->'b) s t. s SUBSET t ==> IMAGE (RESTRICTION t f) s = IMAGE f s

name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE_RIGHT
statement:
!(f :'a->'b) (g :'b->'c) s.
        RESTRICTION s (g o RESTRICTION s f) =
        RESTRICTION s (g o f)

name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE_LEFT
statement:
!(f :'a->'b) (g :'b->'c) s t.
        IMAGE f s SUBSET t
        ==> RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION t g o f) =
            RESTRICTION s (g o f)

name: RESTRICTION_COMPOSE
statement:
!(f :'a->'b) (g :'b->'c) s t.
        IMAGE f s SUBSET t
        ==> RESTRICTION s (RESTRICTION t g o RESTRICTION s f) =
            RESTRICTION s (g o f)

name: RESTRICTION_UNIQUE
statement:
!s (f :'a->'b) g.
        RESTRICTION s f = g <=> EXTENSIONAL s g /\ !x. x IN s ==> f x = g x

name: RESTRICTION_UNIQUE_ALT
statement:
!s (f :'a->'b) g.
        f = RESTRICTION s g <=> EXTENSIONAL s f /\ !x. x IN s ==> f x = g x

name: ITSET_def
statement:
ITSET (s:'a->bool) (b:'b) =
       if FINITE s then
          if s={} then b
          else ITSET (REST s) (f (CHOICE s) b)
       else ARB

name: disjoint
statement: disjoint = pairwise (RC DISJOINT)

name: PREIMAGE_def
statement: PREIMAGE f s = {x | f x IN s}

name: rextension
statement: !s t. (s = t) <=> !x y. (x, y) IN s <=> (x, y) IN t

name: in_domain
statement: !x r. x IN domain r <=> ?y. (x, y) IN r

name: in_range
statement: !y r. y IN range r <=> ?x. (x, y) IN r

name: in_dom_rg
statement: (x, y) IN r ==> x IN domain r /\ y IN range r

name: domain_mono
statement: r SUBSET r' ==> domain r SUBSET domain r'

name: range_mono
statement: r SUBSET r' ==> range r SUBSET range r'

name: in_rrestrict
statement: !x y r s. (x, y) IN rrestrict r s <=> (x, y) IN r /\ x IN s /\ y IN s

name: in_rrestrict_alt
statement: x IN rrestrict r s <=> x IN r /\ FST x IN s /\ SND x IN s

name: rrestrict_SUBSET
statement: rrestrict r s SUBSET r

name: rrestrict_union
statement: !r1 r2 s. rrestrict (r1 UNION r2) s = (rrestrict r1 s) UNION (rrestrict r2 s)

name: rrestrict_rrestrict
statement: !r x y. rrestrict (rrestrict r x) y = rrestrict r (x INTER y)

name: domain_rrestrict_SUBSET
statement: domain (rrestrict r s) SUBSET s

name: range_rrestrict_SUBSET
statement: range (rrestrict r s) SUBSET s

name: strict_rrestrict
statement: !r s. strict (rrestrict r s) = rrestrict (strict r) s

name: finite_prefixes_subset_s
statement: !r s s'. finite_prefixes r s /\ s' SUBSET s ==> finite_prefixes r s'

name: finite_prefixes_subset_r
statement: !r r' s. finite_prefixes r s /\ r' SUBSET r ==> finite_prefixes r' s

name: finite_prefixes_subset_rs
statement:
!r s r' s'.
   finite_prefixes r s ==> r' SUBSET r ==> s' SUBSET s ==> finite_prefixes r' s'

name: finite_prefixes_subset
statement:
!r s s'.
    finite_prefixes r s /\ s' SUBSET s ==>
    finite_prefixes r s' /\ finite_prefixes (rrestrict r s') s'

name: finite_prefixes_union
statement:
!r1 r2 s1 s2.
    finite_prefixes r1 s1 /\ finite_prefixes r2 s2 ==>
    finite_prefixes (r1 UNION r2) (s1 INTER s2)

name: finite_prefixes_comp
statement:
!r1 r2 s1 s2.
    finite_prefixes r1 s1 /\ finite_prefixes r2 s2 /\
    { x | ?y. y IN s2 /\ (x, y) IN r2 } SUBSET s1 ==>
    finite_prefixes (rcomp r1 r2) s2

name: finite_prefixes_inj_image
statement:
!f r s.
    (!x y. (f x = f y) ==> (x = y)) /\ finite_prefixes r s ==>
    finite_prefixes { (f x, f y) | (x, y) IN r } (IMAGE f s)

name: finite_prefixes_range
statement:
!r s t.
    finite_prefixes r s /\ DISJOINT t (range r) ==>
    finite_prefixes r (s UNION t)

name: tc_rules
statement:
!r.
    (!x y. (x ,y) IN r ==> (x, y) IN tc r) /\
    (!x y. (?z. (x, z) IN tc r /\ (z, y) IN tc r) ==> (x, y) IN tc r)

name: tc_cases
statement: !r x y. (x, y) IN tc r <=> (x, y) IN r \/ ?z. (x, z) IN tc r /\ (z, y) IN tc r

name: tc_ind
statement:
!r tc'.
    (!x y. (x, y) IN r ==> tc' x y) /\
    (!x y. (?z. tc' x z /\ tc' z y) ==> tc' x y) ==>
    !x y. (x, y) IN tc r ==> tc' x y

name: tc_closure
statement: r SUBSET tc s ==> tc r SUBSET tc s

name: subset_tc
statement: r SUBSET tc r

name: tc_idemp
statement: tc (tc r) = tc r

name: tc_mono
statement: r SUBSET s ==> tc r SUBSET tc s

name: tc_strongind
statement:
!r tc'.
    (!x y. (x, y) IN r ==> tc' x y) /\
    (!x y. (?z. (x, z) IN tc r /\ tc' x z /\ (z, y) IN tc r /\ tc' z y) ==>
           tc' x y) ==>
    !x y. (x, y) IN tc r ==> tc' x y

name: tc_cases_right
statement: !r x y. (x, y) IN tc r <=> (x, y) IN r \/ ?z. (x, z) IN tc r /\ (z, y) IN r

name: tc_cases_left
statement: !r x y. (x, y) IN tc r <=> (x, y) IN r \/ ?z. (x, z) IN r /\ (z, y) IN tc r

name: tc_ind_left
statement:
!r tc'.
    (!x y. (x, y) IN r ==> tc' x y) /\
    (!x y. (?z. (x, z) IN r /\ tc' z y) ==> tc' x y) ==>
    (!x y. (x, y) IN tc r ==> tc' x y)

name: tc_strongind_left
statement:
!r tc'.
    (!x y. (x, y) IN r ==> tc' x y) /\
    (!x y. (?z. (x, z) IN r /\ (z, y) IN tc r /\ tc' z y) ==> tc' x y) ==>
    (!x y. (x, y) IN tc r ==> tc' x y)

name: tc_ind_right
statement:
!r tc'.
    (!x y. (x, y) IN r ==> tc' x y) /\
    (!x y. (?z. tc' x z /\ (z, y) IN r) ==> tc' x y) ==>
    (!x y. (x, y) IN tc r ==> tc' x y)

name: rtc_ind_right
statement:
!r tc'.
    (!x. x IN domain r \/ x IN range r ==> tc' x x) /\
    (!x y. (?z. tc' x z /\ (z, y) IN r) ==> tc' x y) ==>
    (!x y. (x, y) IN tc r ==> tc' x y)

name: tc_strongind_right
statement:
!r tc'.
    (!x y. (x, y) IN r ==> tc' x y) /\
    (!x y. (?z. (x, z) IN tc r /\ tc' x z /\ (z, y) IN r) ==> tc' x y) ==>
    (!x y. (x, y) IN tc r ==> tc' x y)

name: tc_union
statement: !x y. (x, y) IN tc r1 ==> !r2. (x, y) IN tc (r1 UNION r2)

name: tc_implication
statement:
!r1 r2. (!x y. (x, y) IN r1 ==> (x, y) IN r2) ==>
          (!x y. (x, y) IN tc r1 ==> (x, y) IN tc r2)

name: tc_domain_range
statement: !x y. (x, y) IN tc r ==> x IN domain r /\ y IN range r

name: rrestrict_tc
statement: !e e'. (e, e') IN tc (rrestrict r x) ==> (e, e') IN tc r

name: tc_SWAP
statement: tc (IMAGE SWAP r) = IMAGE SWAP (tc r)

name: acyclic_subset
statement: !r1 r2. acyclic r1 /\ r2 SUBSET r1 ==> acyclic r2

name: acyclic_union_E
statement: !r1 r2. acyclic (r1 UNION r2) ==> acyclic r1 /\ acyclic r2

name: acyclic_rrestrict
statement: !r s. acyclic r ==> acyclic (rrestrict r s)

name: acyclic_irreflexive
statement: !r x. acyclic r ==> (x, x) NOTIN r

name: acyclic_SWAP
statement: acyclic (IMAGE SWAP r) = acyclic r

name: acyclic_bigunion
statement:
!rs.
    (!r r'.
      r IN rs /\ r' IN rs /\ r <> r' ==>
      DISJOINT (domain r UNION range r) (domain r' UNION range r')) /\
    (!r. r IN rs ==> acyclic r) ==>
    acyclic (BIGUNION rs)

name: acyclic_union_I
statement:
!r r'.
    DISJOINT (domain r UNION range r) (domain r' UNION range r') /\
    acyclic r /\
    acyclic r' ==>
    acyclic (r UNION r')

name: transitive_tc
statement: !r. transitive r ==> (tc r = r)

name: tc_transitive
statement: !r. transitive (tc r)

name: antisym_subset
statement: antisym t ==> s SUBSET t ==> antisym s

name: partial_order_dom_rng
statement: !r s x y. (x, y) IN r /\ partial_order r s ==> x IN s /\ y IN s

name: partial_order_subset
statement:
!r s s'.
    partial_order r s /\ s' SUBSET s ==> partial_order (rrestrict r s') s'

name: strict_partial_order
statement:
!r s.
    partial_order r s ==>
    domain (strict r) SUBSET s /\ range (strict r) SUBSET s /\
    transitive (strict r) /\ antisym (strict r)

name: strict_partial_order_acyclic
statement: !r s. partial_order r s ==> acyclic (strict r)

name: linear_order_subset
statement:
!r s s'.
    linear_order r s /\ s' SUBSET s ==> linear_order (rrestrict r s') s'

name: partial_order_linear_order
statement: !r s. linear_order r s ==> partial_order r s

name: strict_linear_order_dom_rng
statement: !r s x y. (x, y) IN r /\ strict_linear_order r s ==> x IN s /\ y IN s

name: linear_order_dom_rng
statement: !r s x y. (x, y) IN r /\ linear_order r s ==> x IN s /\ y IN s

name: RREFL_EXP_RSUBSET
statement: R RSUBSET (RREFL_EXP R s)

name: RREFL_EXP_UNIV
statement: RREFL_EXP R UNIV = R

name: REL_RESTRICT_UNIV
statement: REL_RESTRICT R UNIV = R

name: in_rel_to_reln
statement: xy IN (rel_to_reln R) <=> R (FST xy) (SND xy)

name: reln_to_rel_app
statement: (reln_to_rel r) x y <=> (x, y) IN r

name: rel_to_reln_IS_UNCURRY
statement: rel_to_reln = UNCURRY

name: reln_to_rel_IS_CURRY
statement: reln_to_rel = CURRY

name: rel_to_reln_inv
statement: reln_to_rel (rel_to_reln R) = R

name: reln_to_rel_inv
statement: rel_to_reln (reln_to_rel r) = r

name: reln_to_rel_11
statement: (reln_to_rel r1 = reln_to_rel r2) <=> (r1 = r2)

name: rel_to_reln_11
statement: (rel_to_reln R1 = rel_to_reln R2) <=> (R1 = R2)

name: rel_to_reln_swap
statement: (r = rel_to_reln R) <=> (reln_to_rel r = R)

name: domain_to_rel_conv
statement: domain r = RDOM (reln_to_rel r)

name: range_to_rel_conv
statement: range r = RRANGE (reln_to_rel r)

name: strict_to_rel_conv
statement: strict r = rel_to_reln (STRORD (reln_to_rel r))

name: rrestrict_to_rel_conv
statement: rrestrict r s = rel_to_reln (REL_RESTRICT (reln_to_rel r) s)

name: rcomp_to_rel_conv
statement: r1 OO r2 = rel_to_reln ((reln_to_rel r2) O (reln_to_rel r1))

name: univ_reln_to_rel_conv
statement: univ_reln s = rel_to_reln (RRUNIV s)

name: tc_to_rel_conv
statement: tc r = rel_to_reln ((reln_to_rel r)^+)

name: acyclic_reln_to_rel_conv
statement: acyclic r = irreflexive ((reln_to_rel r)^+)

name: irreflexive_reln_to_rel_conv
statement:
(set_relation$irreflexive) r s =
  (relation$irreflexive) (REL_RESTRICT (reln_to_rel r) s)

name: irreflexive_reln_to_rel_conv_UNIV
statement: (set_relation$irreflexive) r UNIV = (relation$irreflexive) (reln_to_rel r)

name: reflexive_reln_to_rel_conv
statement:
(set_relation$reflexive) r s =
  (relation$reflexive) (RREFL_EXP (reln_to_rel r) s)

name: reflexive_reln_to_rel_conv_UNIV
statement: (set_relation$reflexive) r UNIV = (relation$reflexive) (reln_to_rel r)

name: transitive_reln_to_rel_conv
statement: (set_relation$transitive) r = (relation$transitive) (reln_to_rel r)

name: antisym_reln_to_rel_conv
statement: (set_relation$antisym) r = (relation$antisymmetric) (reln_to_rel r)

name: partial_order_reln_to_rel_conv
statement:
partial_order r s <=> reln_to_rel r RSUBSET RRUNIV s /\
                        WeakOrder (RREFL_EXP (reln_to_rel r) s)

name: partial_order_reln_to_rel_conv_UNIV
statement: partial_order r UNIV = WeakOrder (reln_to_rel r)

name: linear_order_reln_to_rel_conv_UNIV
statement: linear_order r UNIV = WeakLinearOrder (reln_to_rel r)

name: strict_linear_order_reln_to_rel_conv_UNIV
statement: strict_linear_order r UNIV = StrongLinearOrder (reln_to_rel r)

name: acyclic_WF
statement:
FINITE s /\ acyclic r /\ domain r SUBSET s /\ range r SUBSET s ==>
  WF (reln_to_rel r)

name: minimal_elements_subset
statement: minimal_elements s lo SUBSET s

name: minimal_elements_SWAP
statement: minimal_elements xs (IMAGE SWAP r) = maximal_elements xs r

name: maximal_union
statement:
!e s r1 r2.
    e IN maximal_elements s (r1 UNION r2) ==>
    e IN maximal_elements s r1 /\
    e IN maximal_elements s r2

name: minimal_union
statement:
!e s r1 r2.
    e IN minimal_elements s (r1 UNION r2) ==>
    e IN minimal_elements s r1 /\
    e IN minimal_elements s r2

name: minimal_elements_mono
statement: r SUBSET r' ==> minimal_elements xs r' SUBSET minimal_elements xs r

name: minimal_elements_rrestrict
statement: minimal_elements xs (rrestrict r xs) = minimal_elements xs r

name: WF_has_minimal_path
statement:
WF (reln_to_rel r) ==> x IN s ==>
  ?y. y IN minimal_elements s r /\ ((y, x) IN tc r \/ (y = x))

name: finite_acyclic_has_maximal
statement: !s. FINITE s ==> s <> {} ==> !r. acyclic r ==> ?x. x IN maximal_elements s r

name: finite_acyclic_has_minimal
statement: !s. FINITE s ==> s <> {} ==> !r. acyclic r ==> ?x. x IN minimal_elements s r

name: maximal_TC
statement:
!s r.
    domain r SUBSET s /\ range r SUBSET s ==>
    (maximal_elements s (tc r) = maximal_elements s r)

name: minimal_TC
statement:
!s r.
    domain r SUBSET s /\ range r SUBSET s ==>
    (minimal_elements s (tc r) = minimal_elements s r)

name: finite_acyclic_has_minimal_path
statement:
!s r x.
    FINITE s /\
    acyclic r /\
    x IN s /\
    x NOTIN minimal_elements s r ==>
    ?y. y IN minimal_elements s r /\ (y, x) IN tc r

name: finite_acyclic_has_maximal_path
statement:
!s r x.
    FINITE s /\
    acyclic r /\
    x IN s /\
    x NOTIN maximal_elements s r ==>
    ?y. y IN maximal_elements s r /\ (x, y) IN tc r

name: finite_prefix_po_has_minimal_path
statement:
!r s x s'.
    partial_order r s /\
    finite_prefixes r s /\
    x NOTIN minimal_elements s' r /\
    x IN s' /\
    s' SUBSET s ==>
    ?x'. x' IN minimal_elements s' r /\ (x', x) IN r

name: empty_strict_linear_order
statement: !r. strict_linear_order r {} = (r = {})

name: empty_linear_order
statement: !r. linear_order r {} = (r = {})

name: linear_order_restrict
statement: !s r s'. linear_order r s ==> linear_order (rrestrict r s') (s INTER s')

name: strict_linear_order_restrict
statement:
!s r s'.
    strict_linear_order r s ==>
    strict_linear_order (rrestrict r s') (s INTER s')

name: linear_order_dom_rg
statement: linear_order lo X ==> (domain lo UNION range lo = X)

name: linear_order_refl
statement: linear_order lo X ==> x IN X ==> (x, x) IN lo

name: linear_order_in_set
statement: linear_order lo X ==> (x, y) IN lo ==> x IN X /\ y IN X

name: IN_MIN_LO
statement: x IN X ==> linear_order lo X ==> y IN minimal_elements X lo ==> (y, x) IN lo

name: extend_linear_order
statement:
!r s x.
    x NOTIN s /\ linear_order r s ==>
    linear_order (r UNION {(y, x) | y | y IN (s UNION {x})}) (s UNION {x})

name: strict_linear_order_acyclic
statement: !r s. strict_linear_order r s ==> acyclic r

name: strict_linear_order_union_acyclic
statement:
!r1 r2 s.
    strict_linear_order r1 s /\ (domain r2 UNION range r2) SUBSET s ==>
    (acyclic (r1 UNION r2) <=> r2 SUBSET r1)

name: strict_linear_order
statement: !r s. linear_order r s ==> strict_linear_order (strict r) s

name: linear_order
statement: !r s. strict_linear_order r s ==> linear_order (r UNION {(x, x) | x IN s}) s

name: finite_strict_linear_order_has_maximal
statement:
!s r.
    FINITE s /\ strict_linear_order r s /\ s <> {} ==>
    ?x. x IN maximal_elements s r

name: finite_strict_linear_order_has_minimal
statement:
!s r.
    FINITE s /\ strict_linear_order r s /\ s <> {} ==>
    ?x. x IN minimal_elements s r

name: finite_linear_order_has_maximal
statement:
!s r.
    FINITE s /\ linear_order r s /\ s <> {} ==> ?x. x IN maximal_elements s r

name: finite_linear_order_has_minimal
statement:
!s r.
    FINITE s /\ linear_order r s /\ s <> {} ==> ?x. x IN minimal_elements s r

name: maximal_linear_order
statement:
!s r x y.
    y IN s /\ linear_order r s /\ x IN maximal_elements s r ==> (y, x) IN r

name: minimal_linear_order
statement:
!s r x y.
    y IN s /\ linear_order r s /\ x IN minimal_elements s r ==> (x, y) IN r

name: minimal_linear_order_unique
statement:
!r s s' x y.
    linear_order r s /\
    x IN minimal_elements s' r /\
    y IN minimal_elements s' r /\
    s' SUBSET s ==>
    (x = y)

name: finite_prefix_linear_order_has_unique_minimal
statement:
!r s s'.
    linear_order r s /\
    finite_prefixes r s /\
    x IN s' /\
    s' SUBSET s ==>
    SING (minimal_elements s' r)

name: nat_order_iso_thm
statement:
!(f: num -> 'a option) (s : 'a set).
    (!n m. (f m = f n) /\ f m <> NONE ==> (m = n)) /\
    (!x. x IN s ==> ?m. (f m = SOME x)) /\
    (!m x. (f m = SOME x) ==> x IN s) ==>
    linear_order
      {(x, y) | ?m n. m <= n /\ (f m = SOME x) /\ (f n = SOME y)} s /\
    finite_prefixes
      {(x, y) | ?m n. m <= n /\ (f m = SOME x) /\ (f n = SOME y)} s

name: upper_bounds_lem
statement:
!r s x1 x2.
    transitive r /\ x1 IN upper_bounds s r /\ (x1, x2) IN r ==>
    x2 IN upper_bounds s r

name: zorns_lemma
statement:
!r s.
    (s <> {}) /\ partial_order r s /\
    (!t. chain t r ==> upper_bounds t r <> {}) ==>
    (?x. x IN maximal_elements s r)

name: link_lemma
statement:
!x y. (x,y) IN tc ((a,b) INSERT R) ==>
        transitive R ==>
        (x = a /\ (y = b \/ (b,y) IN R)) \/
        (y = b /\ (x,a) IN R) \/
        (x,a) IN R /\ (b,y) IN R \/
        (x,y) IN R

name: StrongOrder_extends_to_StrongLinearOrder
statement:
!R1: 'a -> 'a -> bool.
    StrongOrder R1 ==> ?R2. R1 RSUBSET R2 /\ StrongLinearOrder R2

name: per_delete
per_restrict_per
statement: !r s s'. per s r ==> per s' (per_restrict r s')

name: countable_per
statement: !xs xss. countable xs /\ per xs xss ==> countable xss

name: all_choices_thm
statement: !x s y. x IN all_choices s /\ y IN x ==> ?z. z IN s /\ y IN z

name: linear_order_num_order
statement: !f s t. INJ f s t ==> linear_order (num_order f s) s

name: num_order_finite_prefix
statement: !f s t. INJ f s t ==> finite_prefixes (num_order f s) s

name: linear_order_of_countable_po
statement:
!r s.
    countable s /\ partial_order r s /\ finite_prefixes r s ==>
    ?r'. linear_order r' s /\ finite_prefixes r' s /\ r SUBSET r'

name: domain_def
statement: domain r = {x | ?y. (x, y) IN r}

name: range_def
statement: range r = {y | ?x. (x, y) IN r}

name: rrestrict_def
statement: rrestrict r s = {(x, y) | (x, y) IN r /\ x IN s /\ y IN s}

name: rcomp_def
statement: rcomp r1 r2 = { (x, y) | ?z. (x, z) IN r1 /\ (z, y) IN r2}

name: strict_def
statement: strict r = {(x, y) | (x, y) IN r /\ x <> y}

name: univ_reln_def
statement: univ_reln xs = {(x1, x2) | x1 IN xs /\ x2 IN xs}

name: finite_prefixes_def
statement: finite_prefixes r s = !e. e IN s ==> FINITE {e' | (e', e) IN r}

name: acyclic_def
statement: acyclic r = !x. (x, x) NOTIN tc r

name: reflexive_def
statement: reflexive r s = !x. x IN s ==> (x, x) IN r

name: irreflexive_def
statement: irreflexive r s = !x. x IN s ==> (x, x) NOTIN r

name: transitive_def
statement: transitive r = !x y z.  (x, y) IN r /\ (y, z) IN r ==> (x, z) IN r

name: antisym_def
statement: antisym r = !x y. (x, y) IN r /\ (y, x) IN r ==> (x = y)

name: partial_order_def
statement:
partial_order r s <=>
    domain r SUBSET s /\ range r SUBSET s /\
    transitive r /\ reflexive r s /\ antisym r

name: linear_order_def
statement:
linear_order r s <=>
    domain r SUBSET s /\ range r SUBSET s /\
    transitive r /\ antisym r /\
    (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s ==> (x, y) IN r \/ (y, x) IN r)

name: strict_linear_order_def
statement:
strict_linear_order r s <=>
    domain r SUBSET s /\ range r SUBSET s /\
    transitive r /\
    (!x. (x, x) NOTIN r) /\
    (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ x <> y ==> (x, y) IN r \/ (y, x) IN r)

name: reln_to_rel_def
statement: reln_to_rel r = (\x y. (x, y) IN r)

name: rel_to_reln_def
statement: rel_to_reln R = {(x, y) | x, y | R x y}

name: RRUNIV_def
statement: RRUNIV s = (\x y. x IN s /\ y IN s)

name: RREFL_EXP_def
statement: RREFL_EXP R s = (R RUNION (\x y. (x = y) /\ ~(x IN s)))

name: maximal_elements_def
statement:
maximal_elements xs r =
    {x | x IN xs /\ !x'. x' IN xs /\ (x, x') IN r ==> (x = x')}

name: minimal_elements_def
statement:
minimal_elements xs r =
    {x | x IN xs /\ !x'. x' IN xs /\ (x', x) IN r ==> (x = x')}

name: chain_def
statement: chain s r = !x y. x IN s /\ y IN s ==> (x, y) IN r \/ (y, x) IN r

name: upper_bounds_def
statement: upper_bounds s r = {x | x IN range r /\ !y. y IN s ==> (y, x) IN r}

name: fchains_def
statement:
fchains r =
    { k | chain k r /\ k <> {} /\
          !C. chain C r /\ C SUBSET k /\
              (upper_bounds C r DIFF C) INTER k <> {} ==>
              (CHOICE (upper_bounds C r DIFF C) IN
               minimal_elements ((upper_bounds C r DIFF C) INTER k) r) }

name: per_def
statement:
per xs xss <=>
    (BIGUNION xss) SUBSET xs /\ {} NOTIN xss /\
    !xs1 xs2. xs1 IN xss /\ xs2 IN xss /\ xs1 <> xs2 ==> DISJOINT xs1 xs2

name: per_restrict_def
statement: per_restrict xss xs = {xs' INTER xs | xs' IN xss} DELETE {}

name: all_choices_def
statement:
all_choices xss =
    {IMAGE choice xss | choice | !xs. xs IN xss ==> choice xs IN xs}

name: num_order_def
statement: num_order (f:'a -> num) s = {(x, y) | x IN s /\ y IN s /\ f x <= f y}

name: get_min_def
statement:
get_min r' (s, r) =
    let mins = minimal_elements (minimal_elements s r) r' in
      if SING mins then
        SOME (CHOICE mins)
      else
        NONE

name: nth_min_def
statement:
(nth_min r' (s, r) 0 = get_min r' (s, r)) /\
  (nth_min r' (s, r) (SUC n) =
    let min = get_min r' (s, r) in
      if min = NONE then
        NONE
      else
