name: FORALL_IMP_AE
statement: !m P. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> P x) ==> AE x::m. P x

name: AE_I
statement:
!N M P. null_set M N ==> {x | x IN m_space M /\ ~P x} SUBSET N ==>
            AE x::M. P x

name: AE_iff_null
statement:
!M P. measure_space M /\
          {x | x IN m_space M /\ ~P x} IN measurable_sets M ==>
          ((AE x::M. P x) <=> (null_set M {x | x IN m_space M /\ ~P x}))

name: AE_iff_null_sets
statement:
!N M. measure_space M /\ N IN measurable_sets M ==>
         (null_set M N <=> AE x::M. ~N x)

name: AE_NOT_IN
statement: !N M. null_set M N ==> AE x::M. x NOTIN N

name: AE_iff_measurable
statement:
!N M P. measure_space M /\ N IN measurable_sets M /\
            ({x | x IN m_space M /\ ~P x} = N) ==>
            ((AE x::M. P x) <=> (measure M N = 0))

name: RIGHT_IMP_AE_THM
statement: !m P Q. measure_space m ==> ((P ==> AE x::m. Q x) <=> (AE x::m. P ==> Q x))

name: RIGHT_IMP_AE_THM'
statement:
!m P Q. measure_space m ==>
           ((!i. P i ==> AE x::m. Q i x) <=> (!i. AE x::m. P i ==> Q i x))

name: AE_FORALL_SWAP_THM
statement:
!m P. measure_space m /\ countable univ(:'index) ==>
         ((AE x::m. !i. P i x) <=> !(i:'index). AE x::m. P i x)

name: AE_IMP_MEASURABLE_SETS
statement:
!m P. complete_measure_space m /\ (AE x::m. P x) ==>
          {x | x IN m_space m /\ P x} IN measurable_sets m

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_AE_EQ
statement:
!m f g. complete_measure_space m /\ (AE x::m. f x = g x) /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
            g IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_ADD'
statement:
!a f g h. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a Borel /\ g IN measurable a Borel /\
              (!x. x IN space a ==> (h x = f x + g x)) ==> h IN measurable a Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_SUB'
statement:
!a f g h. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a Borel /\ g IN measurable a Borel /\
              (!x. x IN space a ==> (h x = f x - g x)) ==> h IN measurable a Borel

name: SPACE_BOREL_2D
statement: space (Borel CROSS Borel) = UNIV

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_BOREL_2D
statement: sigma_algebra (Borel CROSS Borel)

name: CROSS_UNION_R
statement: !a b c. a CROSS (b UNION c) = (a CROSS b) UNION (a CROSS c)

name: CROSS_UNION_L
statement: !a b c. (a UNION b) CROSS c = (a CROSS c) UNION (b CROSS c)

name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_SETS_NORMAL
statement: !b. b IN subsets borel ==> IMAGE Normal b IN subsets Borel

name: BOREL_MEASURABLE_SETS_EMPTY
statement: {} IN subsets Borel

name: UNION_LEFT_CONG
statement: !A B C. B = C ==> A UNION B = A UNION C

name: IN_CROSS_SING
statement: !x A B. x IN {A} CROSS {B} <=> x = (A,B)

name: BOREL_2D_lemma1
statement: ^borel_2d_tm1 = ^borel_2d_tm2

name: BOREL_2D_lemma2
statement: sigma_algebra ^borel_2d_tm1

name: BOREL_2D_lemma4
statement:
!A B. A IN subsets borel /\ B IN subsets borel ==>
          A CROSS B IN subsets (borel CROSS borel)

name: BOREL_2D_lemma5
statement:
!A B. A IN subsets Borel /\ B IN subsets Borel ==>
          A CROSS B IN subsets (Borel CROSS Borel)

name: BOREL_2D
statement: Borel CROSS Borel = ^borel_2d_tm2

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_I
statement: (\x. x) IN measurable Borel Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_ABS
statement: abs IN measurable Borel Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_2D_VECTOR
statement:
!a X Y. sigma_algebra a /\
            X IN measurable a Borel /\ Y IN measurable a Borel ==>
            (\x. (X x,Y x)) IN measurable a (Borel CROSS Borel)

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_2D_FUNCTION
statement:
!a X Y f. sigma_algebra a /\
              X IN measurable a Borel /\ Y IN measurable a Borel /\
              f IN measurable (Borel CROSS Borel) Borel ==>
              (\x. f (X x,Y x)) IN measurable a Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_2D_MUL
statement: (\(x,y). x * y) IN measurable (Borel CROSS Borel) Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_TIMES'
statement:
!a f g h. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a Borel /\ g IN measurable a Borel /\
             (!x. x IN space a ==> h x = f x * g x) ==> h IN measurable a Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_TIMES
statement:
!m f g h.
     measure_space m /\
     f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
     g IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
     (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (h x = f x * g x)) ==>
     h IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_CONST
statement: !c. (\x. c) IN measurable Borel Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_AINV
statement: extreal_ainv IN measurable Borel Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_MAX
statement: !c. (\x. max x c) IN measurable Borel Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_MIN
statement: !c. (\x. min x c) IN measurable Borel Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_POW
statement: !n. (\x. x pow n) IN measurable Borel Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_POW
statement: !n a f. f IN measurable a Borel ==> (\x. (f x) pow n) IN measurable a Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_MONO_INCREASING
statement: !f. (!x y. x <= y ==> f x <= f y) ==> f IN measurable Borel Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_MONO_DECREASING
statement: !f. (!x y. x <= y ==> f y <= f x) ==> f IN measurable Borel Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_BOREL_ABS_POWR
statement: !p. 0 <= p /\ p <> PosInf ==> (\x. (abs x) powr p) IN measurable Borel Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_ABS_POWR
statement:
!a p f. f IN measurable a Borel /\ 0 <= p /\ p <> PosInf ==>
           (\x. (abs (f x)) powr p) IN measurable a Borel

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_CONG'
statement:
!a f g. (!x. x IN space a ==> f x = g x) ==>
            (f IN Borel_measurable a <=> g IN Borel_measurable a)

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_COMP
statement:
!a b f g h. f IN Borel_measurable b /\ g IN measurable a b /\
        (!x. x IN space a ==> h x = f (g x)) ==> h IN Borel_measurable a

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_COMP_BOREL
statement:
!a f g h. f IN Borel_measurable Borel /\ g IN Borel_measurable a /\
        (!x. x IN space a ==> h x = f (g x)) ==> h IN Borel_measurable a

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_SUM'
statement:
!a f g s. FINITE s /\ sigma_algebra a /\ (!i. i IN s ==> f i IN Borel_measurable a) /\
        (!x. x IN space a ==> g x = EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE (λi. f i x) s) ==> g IN Borel_measurable a

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_PROD
statement:
!a f g s. FINITE s /\ sigma_algebra a /\ (!i. i IN s ==> f i IN Borel_measurable a) /\
        (!i x. i IN s /\ x IN space a ==> f i x <> NegInf /\ f i x <> PosInf) /\
        (!x. x IN space a ==> g x = EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE (λi. f i x) s) ==>
        g IN Borel_measurable a

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_PROD'
statement:
!a f g s. FINITE s /\ sigma_algebra a /\ (!i. i IN s ==> f i IN Borel_measurable a) /\
        (!x. x IN space a ==> g x = EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE (λi. f i x) s) ==> g IN Borel_measurable a

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_INV
statement:
!a f g. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN Borel_measurable a /\
        (!x. x IN space a ==> g x = extreal_inv (f x) * indicator_fn {y | f y <> 0} x) ==>
        g IN Borel_measurable a

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_MUL_INV
statement:
!a f g h. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN Borel_measurable a /\ g IN Borel_measurable a /\
        (!x. x IN space a /\ g x = 0 ==> f x = 0) /\
        (!x. x IN space a ==> h x = f x * extreal_inv (g x)) ==>
        h IN Borel_measurable a

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_EXP
statement:
!a f g. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN Borel_measurable a /\ (!x. x IN space a ==> g x = exp (f x)) ==>
        g IN Borel_measurable a

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_POW'
statement:
!n a f g. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN Borel_measurable a /\ (!x. x IN space a ==> g x = f x pow n) ==>
        g IN Borel_measurable a

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_POW_EXP
statement:
!a f g h. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN Borel_measurable a /\
        (!n. {x | g x = n} INTER space a IN subsets a) /\
        (!x. x IN space a ==> h x = (f x) pow (g x)) ==> h IN Borel_measurable a

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_NORMAL_REAL
statement: !a f. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN Borel_measurable a ==> Normal o real o f IN Borel_measurable a

name: AE_subset
statement: !m P Q. (AE x::m. P x) /\ (!x. x IN m_space m /\ P x ==> Q x) ==> (AE x::m. Q x)

name: AE_cong
statement: !m P Q. (!x. x IN m_space m ==> P x = Q x) ==> ((AE x::m. P x) <=> (AE x::m. Q x))

name: AE_T
statement: !m. measure_space m ==> AE x::m. T

name: AE_UNION
statement: !m P Q. measure_space m /\ ((AE x::m. P x) \/ (AE x::m. Q x)) ==> (AE x::m. P x \/ Q x)

name: AE_BIGUNION
statement: !m P s. measure_space m /\ (?n. n IN s /\ AE x::m. P n x) ==> (AE x::m. ?n. n IN s /\ P n x)

name: AE_INTER
statement: !m P Q. measure_space m /\ (AE x::m. P x) /\ (AE x::m. Q x) ==> (AE x::m. P x /\ Q x)

name: AE_BIGINTER
statement: !m P s. measure_space m /\ countable s /\ (!n. n IN s ==> AE x::m. P n x) ==> (AE x::m. !n. n IN s ==> P n x)

name: AE_eq_add
statement:
!m f fae g gae. measure_space m /\ (AE x::m. f x = fae x) /\ (AE x::m. g x = gae x) ==>
        AE x::m. f x + g x = fae x + gae x

name: AE_eq_sum
statement:
!m f fae s. FINITE s /\ measure_space m /\ (!n. n IN s ==> AE x::m. (f n x):extreal = fae n x) ==>
        AE x::m. SIGMA (C f x) s = SIGMA (C fae x) s

name: Borel
statement:
Borel = (univ(:extreal),
             {B' | ?B S. B' = (IMAGE Normal B) UNION S /\ B IN subsets borel /\
                         S IN {EMPTY; {NegInf}; {PosInf}; {NegInf; PosInf}}})

name: ext_lborel_def
statement: ext_lborel = (space Borel, subsets Borel, lambda o real_set)

name: AE_def
statement: $AE = \P. almost_everywhere lborel P

name: ln_not_neginf
statement: !x. 0 < x ==> ln x <> NegInf

name: ln_mul
statement: !x y. 0 < x /\ 0 < y ==> ln (x * y) = ln x + ln y

name: ln_1
statement: ln (1 :extreal) = 0

name: ln_inv
statement: !x. 0 < x ==> ln (inv x) = ~(ln x)

name: exp_pos
statement: !x :extreal. 0 <= exp x

name: exp_pos_lt
statement: !x. x <> NegInf ==> 0 < exp x

name: normal_exp
statement: !r. exp (Normal r) = Normal (exp r)

name: exp_0
statement: exp 0 = (1 :extreal)

name: exp_add_lemma
statement: !x y. x <> NegInf /\ y <> NegInf ==> exp (x + y) = exp x * exp y

name: exp_add_lemma'
statement: !x y. x <> PosInf /\ y <> PosInf ==> exp (x + y) = exp x * exp y

name: exp_add
statement:
!x y. (x <> NegInf /\ y <> NegInf) \/ (x <> PosInf /\ y <> PosInf) ==>
          exp (x + y) = exp x * exp y

name: exp_neg
statement: !x. x <> NegInf ==> exp (~x) = inv (exp(x))

name: exp_le_x
statement: !x :extreal. &1 + x <= exp x

name: exp_le_x'
statement: !x :extreal. &1 - x <= exp (-x)

name: powr_pos
statement: !x a :extreal. 0 <= x powr a

name: powr_pos_lt
statement: !x a. 0 < x /\ 0 <= a /\ a <> PosInf ==> 0 < x powr a

name: infty_powr
statement: !a. 0 < a ==> PosInf powr a = PosInf

name: normal_powr
statement: !r a. 0 < r /\ 0 < a ==> (Normal r) powr (Normal a) = Normal (r powr a)

name: powr_0
statement: !x. x powr 0 = (1 :extreal)

name: zero_rpow
statement: !x :extreal. 0 < x ==> 0 powr x = 0

name: powr_eq_0
statement: !x a. 0 <= x /\ 0 < a /\ a <> PosInf ==> (x powr a = 0 <=> x = 0)

name: powr_1
statement: !x. 0 <= x ==> x powr 1 = x

name: powr_infty
statement:
!x. (1 < x ==> x powr PosInf = PosInf) /\
        (x = 1 ==> x powr PosInf = 1) /\
        (0 <= x /\ x < 1 ==> x powr PosInf = 0)

name: powr_mono_eq
statement: !a b c. 0 <= a /\ 0 <= c /\ 0 < b /\ b <> PosInf ==> (a powr b <= c powr b <=> a <= c)

name: powr_le_eq
statement:
!a b c. 1 < a /\ a <> PosInf /\ 0 <= b /\ 0 <= c ==>
           (a powr b <= a powr c <=> b <= c)

name: powr_powr
statement:
!a b c. 0 <= a /\ 0 < b /\ 0 < c /\ b <> PosInf /\ c <> PosInf ==>
           (a powr b) powr c = a powr (b * c)

name: mul_powr
statement:
!x y a. 0 <= x /\ 0 <= y /\ 0 < a /\ a <> PosInf ==>
           (x * y) powr a = x powr a * y powr a

name: powr_add
statement:
!a b c. 0 <= a /\ 0 <= b /\ b <> PosInf /\ 0 <= c /\ c <> PosInf ==>
            a powr (b + c) = a powr b * a powr c

name: sqrt_powr
statement: !x. 0 <= x ==> sqrt x = x powr (inv 2)

name: inv_powr
statement: !x p. 0 < x /\ 0 < p /\ p <> PosInf ==> (inv x) powr p = inv (x powr p)

name: gen_powr
statement: !a n. 0 <= a ==> (a pow n = a powr (&n :extreal))

name: young_inequality
statement:
!a b p q. 0 <= a /\ 0 <= b /\ 0 < p /\ 0 < q /\ p <> PosInf /\ q <> PosInf /\
              inv(p) + inv(q) = 1
          ==> a * b <= a powr p / p + b powr q / q

name: EXTREAL_ARCH_POW2
statement: !x. x <> PosInf ==> ?n. x < 2 pow n

name: EXTREAL_ARCH_POW2_INV
statement: !e. 0 < e ==> ?n. Normal ((1 / 2) pow n) < e

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_EMPTY
statement: !f. EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f {} = 0

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_SING
statement: !f e. EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f {e} = f e

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_FINITE_SAME
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==> !f p. p IN s /\ (!q. q IN s ==> (f p = f q)) ==>
                          (EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f s = (&(CARD s)) * f p)

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_FINITE_CONST
statement:
!P. FINITE P ==>
        !f x. (!y. y IN P ==> (f y = x)) ==> (EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f P = (&(CARD P)) * x)

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_CMUL
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==>
        !f c. (!x. x IN s ==> f x <> NegInf) \/ (!x. x IN s ==> f x <> PosInf) ==>
              (EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE (\x. Normal c * f x) s = Normal c * (EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f s))

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_IMAGE
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==>
        !f'. INJ f' s (IMAGE f' s) ==>
             !f. (!x. x IN (IMAGE f' s) ==> f x <> NegInf) \/
                 (!x. x IN (IMAGE f' s) ==> f x <> PosInf)
             ==> (EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f (IMAGE f' s) = EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE (f o f') s)

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_PERMUTES
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==> !g. g PERMUTES s ==>
        !f. (!x. x IN (IMAGE g s) ==> f x <> NegInf) \/
            (!x. x IN (IMAGE g s) ==> f x <> PosInf) ==>
            (EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE (f o g) s = EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f s)

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_DISJOINT_UNION
statement:
!s s'. FINITE s /\ FINITE s' /\ DISJOINT s s' ==>
           !f. (!x. x IN s UNION s' ==> f x <> NegInf) \/
               (!x. x IN s UNION s' ==> f x <> PosInf) ==>
               (EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f (s UNION s') =
                EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f s + EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f s')

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_EQ_CARD
statement:
!s. FINITE s ==>
       (EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE (\x. if x IN s then 1 else 0) s = &(CARD s))

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_OFFSET
statement:
!f m n. m <= n /\ (!n. 0 <= f n) ==>
            EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f (count n) =
            EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f (count m) +
            EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE (\i. f (i + m)) (count (n - m))

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_EQ_SHIFT
statement:
!f g N. (!n. n < N ==> g n = 0) /\ (!n. 0 <= f n /\ f n = g (n + N)) ==>
            !n. EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f (count n) = EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE g (count (n + N))

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_CROSS_SYM
statement:
!f s1 s2. FINITE s1 /\ FINITE s2 /\
             ((!s. s IN (s1 CROSS s2) ==> f s <> NegInf) \/
              (!s. s IN (s1 CROSS s2) ==> f s <> PosInf)) ==>
             (EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE (\(x,y). f (x,y)) (s1 CROSS s2) =
              EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE (\(y,x). f (x,y)) (s2 CROSS s1))

name: le_sup_imp
statement: !p x. p x ==> x <= sup p

name: sup_le
statement: !p x. sup p <= x <=> (!y. p y ==> y <= x)

name: sup_le'
statement: !p x. sup p <= x <=> (!y. y IN p ==> y <= x)

name: sup_sing
statement: !a:extreal. sup {a} = a

name: sup_mono_ext
statement:
!f g A B. (!n. n IN A ==> ?m. m IN B /\ f n <= g m) ==>
              sup {f n | n IN A} <= sup {g n | n IN B}

name: sup_seq
statement:
!f l. mono_increasing f ==>
         ((f --> l) <=> (sup (IMAGE (\n. Normal (f n)) UNIV) = Normal l))

name: sup_cmult
statement:
!f c. 0 <= c /\ (!n. 0 <= f n) ==>
         (sup (IMAGE (\n. c * f n) UNIV) = c * sup (IMAGE f UNIV))

name: lt_sup
statement: !a s. a < sup s <=> ?x. x IN s /\ a < x

name: sup_lt_epsilon'
statement:
!P e. 0 < e /\ (?x. x IN P /\ x <> NegInf) /\ (sup P <> PosInf) ==>
          ?x. x IN P /\ sup P < x + e

name: le_inf'
statement: !p x. x <= inf p <=> (!y. y IN p ==> x <= y)

name: inf_le'
statement:
!p x. (extreal_inf p <= x) <=>
          (!y. (!z. z IN p ==> y <= z) ==> y <= x)

name: inf_mono
statement: !p q. (!n:num. p n <= q n) ==> inf (IMAGE p UNIV) <= inf (IMAGE q UNIV)

name: inf_eq'
statement:
!p x. (extreal_inf p = x) <=>
          (!y. y IN p ==> x <= y) /\
          (!y. (!z. z IN p ==> y <= z) ==> y <= x)

name: inf_sing
statement: !a:extreal. inf {a} = a

name: inf_seq
statement:
!f l. mono_decreasing f ==>
         ((f --> l) <=> (inf (IMAGE (\n. Normal (f n)) UNIV) = Normal l))

name: inf_lt'
statement: !P y. (?x. x IN P /\ x < y) <=> extreal_inf P < y

name: lt_inf_epsilon'
statement:
!P e. 0 < e /\ (?x. x IN P /\ x <> PosInf) /\ (inf P <> NegInf) ==>
          ?x. x IN P /\ x < inf P + e

name: inf_num
statement: inf (\x. ?n :num. x = -&n) = NegInf

name: inf_cmul
statement: !P r. 0 < r ==> inf {x * Normal r | 0 < x /\ P x} = Normal r * inf {x | 0 < x /\ P x}

name: sup_comm
statement:
!f. sup {sup {f i j | j IN univ(:num)} | i IN univ(:num)} =
        sup {sup {f i j | i IN univ(:num)} | j IN univ(:num)}

name: sup_close
statement:
!e s. 0 < e /\ (abs (sup s) <> PosInf) /\ (s <> {}) ==>
          ?x. x IN s /\ sup s - e < x

name: sup_countable_seq
statement:
!A. A <> {} ==> ?f:num->extreal. IMAGE f UNIV SUBSET A /\
                      (sup A = sup {f n | n IN UNIV})

name: sup_seq_countable_seq
statement:
!A g. A <> {} ==>
          ?f:num->extreal. IMAGE f UNIV SUBSET IMAGE g A /\
                    (sup {g n | n IN A} = sup {f n | n IN UNIV})

name: ext_limsup_pos
statement: !a. (!n. 0 <= a n) ==> 0 <= limsup a

name: ext_liminf_pos
statement: !a. (!n. 0 <= a n) ==> 0 <= liminf a

name: ext_liminf_le_limsup
statement: !a. liminf a <= limsup a

name: ext_liminf_alt_limsup
statement: !a. liminf a = -limsup (numeric_negate o a)

name: ext_limsup_alt_liminf
statement: !a. limsup a = -liminf (numeric_negate o a)

name: ext_suminf_alt
statement:
!f. (!n. 0 <= f n) ==>
        (ext_suminf (\x. f x) = sup {SIGMA (\i. f i) (count n) | n IN UNIV})

name: ext_suminf_alt'
statement:
!f. (!n. 0 <= f n) ==>
        (ext_suminf (\x. f x) = sup {SIGMA f (count n) | n | T})

name: ext_suminf_add
statement:
!f g. (!n. 0 <= f n /\ 0 <= g n) ==>
          (ext_suminf (\n. f n + g n) = ext_suminf f + ext_suminf g)

name: ext_suminf_add'
statement:
!f g h. (!n. 0 <= f n) /\ (!n. 0 <= g n) /\ (!n. h n = f n + g n) ==>
            (ext_suminf h = ext_suminf f + ext_suminf g)

name: ext_suminf_cmul
statement:
!f c. 0 <= c /\ (!n. 0 <= f n) ==>
          (ext_suminf (\n. c * f n) = c * ext_suminf f)

name: ext_suminf_cmul_alt
statement:
!f c. 0 <= c /\ (!n. 0 <= f n) /\ (!n. f n < PosInf) ==>
         (ext_suminf (\n. (Normal c) * f n) = (Normal c) * ext_suminf f)

name: ext_suminf_lt_infty
statement: !f. (!n. 0 <= f n) /\ ext_suminf f < PosInf ==> !n. f n < PosInf

name: ext_suminf_suminf
statement:
!r. (!n. 0 <= r n) /\ ext_suminf (\n. Normal (r n)) <> PosInf ==>
        (ext_suminf (\n. Normal (r n)) = Normal (suminf r))

name: ext_suminf_mono
statement: !f g. (!n. 0 <= g n) /\ (!n. g n <= f n) ==> (ext_suminf g <= ext_suminf f)

name: ext_suminf_eq
statement: !f g. (!n. f n = g n) ==> (ext_suminf f = ext_suminf g)

name: ext_suminf_eq_shift
statement:
!f g N. (!n. n < N ==> g n = 0) /\ (!n. 0 <= f n /\ f n = g (n + N)) ==>
            (ext_suminf f = ext_suminf g)

name: ext_suminf_sub
statement:
!f g. (!n. 0 <= g n /\ g n <= f n) /\ ext_suminf f <> PosInf ==>
          (ext_suminf (\i. f i - g i) = ext_suminf f - ext_suminf g)

name: ext_suminf_sum
statement:
!f n. (!n. 0 <= f n) /\ (!m. n <= m ==> (f m = 0)) ==>
          (ext_suminf f = SIGMA f (count n))

name: ext_suminf_pos
statement: !f. (!n. 0 <= f n) ==> (0 <= ext_suminf f)

name: ext_suminf_sigma
statement:
!f n. (!i x. i < n ==> 0 <= f i x) ==>
          (SIGMA (ext_suminf o f) (count n) = ext_suminf (\x. SIGMA (\i. f i x) (count n)))

name: ext_suminf_sup_eq
statement:
!(f:num->num->extreal).
     (!i m n. m <= n ==> f m i <= f n i) /\
     (!n i. 0 <= f n i) ==>
     (suminf (\i. sup {f n i | n IN UNIV}) = sup {suminf (\i. f n i) | n IN UNIV})

name: pos_summable
statement:
!f. (!n. 0 <= f n) /\ (?r. !n. SIGMA f (count n) <= Normal r) ==>
        suminf f < PosInf

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_le_suminf
statement: !f n. (!n. 0 <= f n) ==> SIGMA f (count n) <= ext_suminf f

name: ext_suminf_summable
statement: !g. (!n. 0 <= g n) /\ suminf g < PosInf ==> summable (real o g)

name: ext_suminf_2d
statement:
!(f :num -> num -> extreal) (g :num -> extreal) (h :num -> num # num).
      (!m n. 0 <= f m n) /\
      (!n. ext_suminf (f n) = g n) /\  
      (ext_suminf g < PosInf) /\       
      BIJ h UNIV (UNIV CROSS UNIV)
     ==>
      (ext_suminf (UNCURRY f o h) = ext_suminf g)

name: ext_suminf_eq_infty_imp
statement:
!f. (!n. 0 <= f n) /\ (ext_suminf f = PosInf) ==>
        !e. e < PosInf ==> ?n. e <= SIGMA f (count n)

name: ext_suminf_eq_infty
statement:
!f. (!n. 0 <= f n) /\ (!e. e < PosInf ==> ?n. e <= SIGMA f (count n)) ==>
        (ext_suminf f = PosInf)

name: ext_suminf_2d_full
statement:
!(f :num -> num -> extreal) (g :num -> extreal) (h :num -> num # num).
       (!m n. 0 <= f m n) /\ (!n. ext_suminf (f n) = g n) /\
        BIJ h UNIV (UNIV CROSS UNIV) ==>
       (ext_suminf (UNCURRY f o h) = ext_suminf g)

name: harmonic_series_pow_2
statement: ext_suminf (\n. inv (&(SUC n) pow 2)) < PosInf

name: geometric_series_pow
statement: !x. 0 < x /\ x < 1 ==> ext_suminf (\n. x pow n) = inv (1 - x)

name: pow_half_ser'
statement: ext_suminf (\n. (1 / 2) pow (SUC n)) = 1

name: pow_half_ser_by_e
statement: !e. 0 < e /\ e <> PosInf ==> (e = ext_suminf (\n. e * ((1 / 2) pow (n + 1))))

name: ext_suminf_offset
statement:
!f m. (!n. 0 <= f n) ==>
           suminf f = SIGMA f (count m) + suminf (\i. f (i + m))

name: sup_maximal
statement: !p. FINITE p /\ p <> {} ==> extreal_sup p IN p

name: inf_minimal
statement: !p. FINITE p /\ p <> {} ==> extreal_inf p IN p

name: CEILING_LBOUND
statement: !x. Normal x <= &(ceiling (Normal x))

name: CEILING_UBOUND
statement: !x. (0 <= x) ==> &(ceiling (Normal x)) < (Normal x) + 1

name: normal_real_set
statement: !(s :extreal set). s INTER (IMAGE Normal UNIV) = IMAGE Normal (real_set s)

name: Q_set_def
statement:
Q_set = {x | ?a b. (x =  (&a / &b)) /\ ((0 :extreal) < &b)} UNION
            {x | ?a b. (x = -(&a / &b)) /\ ((0 :extreal) < &b)}

name: Q_not_infty
statement: !x. x IN Q_set ==> ?y. x = Normal y

name: Q_COUNTABLE
statement: countable Q_set

name: NUM_IN_Q
statement: !n:num. (&n IN Q_set) /\ (-&n IN Q_set)

name: Q_INFINITE
statement: INFINITE Q_set

name: OPP_IN_Q
statement: !x. x IN Q_set ==> -x IN Q_set

name: INV_IN_Q
statement: !x. (x IN Q_set) /\ (x <> 0) ==> 1 / x IN Q_set

name: ADD_IN_Q
statement: !x y. (x IN Q_set) /\ (y IN Q_set) ==> (x + y IN Q_set)

name: SUB_IN_Q
statement: !x y. (x IN Q_set) /\ (y IN Q_set) ==> (x - y IN Q_set)

name: MUL_IN_Q
statement: !x y. (x IN Q_set) /\ (y IN Q_set) ==> (x * y IN Q_set)

name: DIV_IN_Q
statement: !x y. (x IN Q_set) /\ (y IN Q_set) /\ (y <> 0) ==> (x / y IN Q_set)

name: CMUL_IN_Q
statement: !z:num x. x IN Q_set ==> (&z * x IN Q_set) /\ (-&z * x IN Q_set)

name: rat_not_infty
statement: !r. r IN Q_set ==> r <> NegInf /\ r <> PosInf

name: Q_DENSE_IN_R_LEMMA
statement: !x y. 0 <= x /\ x < y ==> ?r. r IN Q_set /\ x < r /\ r < y

name: Q_DENSE_IN_R
statement: !x y. (x < y) ==> ?r. (r IN Q_set) /\ (x < r) /\ (r < y)

name: COUNTABLE_ENUM_Q
statement: !c. countable c <=> (c = {}) \/ (?f:extreal->'a. c = IMAGE f Q_set)

name: CROSS_COUNTABLE_UNIV
statement: countable (univ(:num) CROSS univ(:num))

name: COUNTABLE_RATIONAL_INTERVALS
statement: countable rational_intervals

name: neutral_mul
statement: neutral(( * ):extreal->extreal->extreal) = &1

name: monoidal_mul
statement: monoidal(( * ):extreal->extreal->extreal)

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_THM
statement:
!f. (EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f {} = 1) /\
        !e s. FINITE s ==>
             (EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f (e INSERT s) = f e * EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f (s DELETE e))

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_EQ
statement:
!s f f'. (!x. x IN s ==> (f x = f' x)) ==>
             (EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f s = EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f' s)

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_DISJOINT_UNION
statement:
!s s'. FINITE s /\ FINITE s' /\ DISJOINT s s' ==>
           !f. (EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f (s UNION s') =
                EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f s * EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f s')

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_IMAGE
statement:
!s f'. INJ f' s (IMAGE f' s) ==>
           !f. EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f (IMAGE f' s) = EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE (f o f') s

name: max_fn_seq_0
statement: !g. max_fn_seq g 0 = g 0

name: max_fn_seq_cong
statement: !f g x. (!n. f n x = g n x) ==> !n. max_fn_seq f n x = max_fn_seq g n x

name: sup_insert
statement: !x s. sup (x INSERT s) = if s = {} then x else max x (sup s)

name: max_fn_seq_alt_sup
statement: !f x n. max_fn_seq f n x = sup (IMAGE (\i. f i x) (count (SUC n)))

name: max_fn_seq_le
statement: !f x y n. max_fn_seq f n x <= y <=> !i. i <= n ==> f i x <= y

name: lt_max_fn_seq
statement: !f x y n. x < max_fn_seq f n y <=> ?i. i <= n /\ x < f i y

name: max_fn_seq_mono
statement: !g n x. max_fn_seq g n x <= max_fn_seq g (SUC n) x

name: FN_PLUS_ALT
statement: !f. fn_plus f = (\x. max (f x) 0)

name: fn_plus
statement: !f x. fn_plus f x = max 0 (f x)

name: FN_MINUS_ALT
statement: !f. fn_minus f = (\x. -min (f x) 0)

name: fn_minus
statement: !f x. fn_minus f x = -min 0 (f x)

name: FN_ABS
statement: !f x. (abs o f) x = fn_plus f x + fn_minus f x

name: FN_ABS'
statement: !f. (abs o f) = (\x. fn_plus f x + fn_minus f x)

name: FN_PLUS_POS
statement: !g x. 0 <= (fn_plus g) x

name: FN_MINUS_POS
statement: !g x. 0 <= (fn_minus g) x

name: FN_PLUS_POS_ID
statement: !g. (!x. 0 <= g x) ==> ((fn_plus g) = g)

name: FN_PLUS_REDUCE
statement: !f x. 0 <= f x ==> (fn_plus f x = f x)

name: FN_PLUS_REDUCE'
statement: !f x. f x <= 0 ==> (fn_plus f x = 0)

name: FN_MINUS_REDUCE
statement: !f x. 0 <= f x ==> (fn_minus f x = 0)

name: FN_PLUS_ABS_SELF
statement: !f. fn_plus (abs o f) = abs o f

name: FN_MINUS_ABS_ZERO
statement: !f. fn_minus (abs o f) = \x. 0

name: FN_PLUS_ZERO
statement: fn_plus (\x. 0) = (\x. 0)

name: FN_MINUS_ZERO
statement: fn_minus (\x. 0) = (\x. 0)

name: FN_MINUS_TO_PLUS
statement: !f. fn_minus (\x. -(f x)) = fn_plus f

name: FN_PLUS_TO_MINUS
statement: !f. fn_plus (\x. -(f x)) = fn_minus f

name: FN_PLUS_NOT_INFTY
statement: !f x. f x <> PosInf ==> fn_plus f x <> PosInf

name: FN_MINUS_NOT_INFTY
statement: !f x. f x <> NegInf ==> fn_minus f x <> PosInf

name: FN_PLUS_LE_ABS
statement: !f x. fn_plus f x <= abs (f x)

name: FN_MINUS_LE_ABS
statement: !f x. fn_minus f x <= abs (f x)

name: FN_PLUS_INFTY_IMP
statement: !f x. (fn_plus f x = PosInf) ==> (fn_minus f x = 0)

name: FN_MINUS_INFTY_IMP
statement: !f x. (fn_minus f x = PosInf) ==> (fn_plus f x = 0)

name: indicator_fn_def
statement: !s. indicator_fn s = \x. if x IN s then (1 :extreal) else (0 :extreal)

name: DROP_INDICATOR_FN
statement: !s x. indicator_fn s x = if x IN s then 1 else 0

name: INDICATOR_FN_POS
statement: !s x. 0 <= indicator_fn s x

name: INDICATOR_FN_LE_1
statement: !s x. indicator_fn s x <= 1

name: indicator_fn_normal
statement: !s x. ?r. (indicator_fn s x = Normal r) /\ 0 <= r /\ r <= 1

name: INDICATOR_FN_EMPTY
statement: !x. indicator_fn {} x = 0

name: INDICATOR_FN_MONO
statement: !s t x. s SUBSET t ==> indicator_fn s x <= indicator_fn t x

name: INDICATOR_FN_CROSS
statement:
!s t x y. indicator_fn (s CROSS t) (x,y) = indicator_fn s x *
                                               indicator_fn t y

name: indicator_fn_split
statement:
!(r:num->bool) s (b:num->('a->bool)).
       FINITE r /\ (BIGUNION (IMAGE b r) = s) /\
       (!i j. i IN r /\ j IN r /\ i <> j ==> DISJOINT (b i) (b j)) ==>
       !a. a SUBSET s ==>
          (indicator_fn a = (\x. SIGMA (\i. indicator_fn (a INTER (b i)) x) r))

name: indicator_fn_suminf
statement:
!a x. (!m n. m <> n ==> DISJOINT (a m) (a n)) ==>
          (suminf (\i. indicator_fn (a i) x) = indicator_fn (BIGUNION (IMAGE a univ(:num))) x)

name: INDICATOR_FN_ABS
statement: !s. abs o (indicator_fn s) = indicator_fn s

name: INDICATOR_FN_ABS_MUL
statement: !f s. abs o (\x. f x * indicator_fn s x) = (\x. (abs o f) x * indicator_fn s x)

name: fn_plus_mul_indicator
statement:
!f s. fn_plus (\x. f x * indicator_fn s x) =
          (\x. fn_plus f x * indicator_fn s x)

name: fn_minus_mul_indicator
statement:
!f s. fn_minus (\x. f x * indicator_fn s x) =
          (\x. fn_minus f x * indicator_fn s x)

name: extreal_dist_ismet
statement: ismet (UNCURRY extreal_dist)

name: extreal_mr1_thm
statement: dist extreal_mr1 = UNCURRY extreal_dist

name: extreal_dist_normal
statement: !x y. extreal_dist (Normal x) (Normal y) = abs (x - y) / (1 + abs (x - y))

name: extreal_mr1_normal
statement: !x y. dist extreal_mr1 (Normal x,Normal y) = abs (x - y) / (1 + abs (x - y))

name: extreal_mr1_le_1
statement: !x y. dist extreal_mr1 (x,y) <= 1

name: EXTREAL_LIM
statement:
!(f :'a -> extreal) l net.
       (f --> l) net <=>
        trivial_limit net \/
        !e. &0 < e ==> ?y. (?x. netord(net) x y) /\
                           !x. netord(net) x y ==> dist extreal_mr1(f(x),l) < e

name: EXTREAL_LIM_SEQUENTIALLY
statement:
!(f :num -> extreal) l. (f --> l) sequentially <=>
          !e. &0 < e ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> dist extreal_mr1 (f n,l) < e

name: EXTREAL_LIM_EVENTUALLY
statement: !net (f :'a -> extreal) l. eventually (\x. f x = l) net ==> (f --> l) net

name: lim_sequentially_imp_extreal_lim
statement: !f l. (f --> l) sequentially ==> (Normal o f --> Normal l) sequentially

name: extreal_lim_sequentially_imp_real_lim
statement:
!f l. (?N. !n. N <= n ==> f n <> PosInf /\ f n <> NegInf) /\
          l <> PosInf /\ l <> NegInf /\ (f --> l) sequentially ==>
          (real o f --> real l) sequentially

name: extreal_lim_sequentially_eq
statement:
!f l. (?N. !n. N <= n ==> f n <> PosInf /\ f n <> NegInf) /\
          l <> PosInf /\ l <> NegInf ==>
         ((f --> l) sequentially <=> (real o f --> real l) sequentially)

name: extreal_lim_sequentially_eq'
statement:
!f r. (?N. !n. N <= n ==> f n <> PosInf /\ f n <> NegInf) ==>
         ((f --> Normal r) sequentially <=> (real o f --> r) sequentially)

name: normal_0
statement: Normal 0 = 0

name: normal_1
statement: Normal 1 = 1

name: normal_minus1
statement: Normal (-1) = -1

name: extreal_le_simps
statement:
(!x y. Normal x <= Normal y <=> x <= y) /\ (!x. NegInf <= x <=> T) /\ (!x. x <= PosInf <=> T) /\
    (!x. Normal x <= NegInf <=> F) /\ (!x. PosInf <= Normal x <=> F) /\ (PosInf <= NegInf <=> F)

name: extreal_lt_simps
statement:
(!x y. Normal x < Normal y <=> x < y) /\ (!x. x < NegInf <=> F) /\ (!x. PosInf < x <=> F) /\
    (!x. Normal x < PosInf <=> T) /\ (!x. NegInf < Normal x <=> T) /\ (NegInf < PosInf <=> T)

name: extreal_0_simps
statement:
(0 <= PosInf <=> T) /\ (0 < PosInf <=> T) /\
    (PosInf <= 0 <=> F) /\ (PosInf < 0 <=> F) /\
    (0 = PosInf <=> F) /\ (PosInf = 0 <=> F) /\
    (0 <= NegInf <=> F) /\ (0 < NegInf <=> F) /\
    (NegInf <= 0 <=> T) /\ (NegInf < 0 <=> T) /\
    (0 = NegInf <=> F) /\ (NegInf = 0 <=> F) /\
    (!r. 0 <= Normal r <=> 0 <= r) /\ (!r. 0 < Normal r <=> 0 < r) /\ (!r. 0 = Normal r <=> r = 0) /\
    (!r. Normal r <= 0 <=> r <= 0) /\ (!r. Normal r < 0 <=> r < 0) /\ (!r. Normal r = 0 <=> r = 0)

name: extreal_1_simps
statement:
(1 <= PosInf <=> T) /\ (1 < PosInf <=> T) /\ (PosInf <= 1 <=> F) /\
    (PosInf < 1 <=> F) /\ (1 = PosInf <=> F) /\ (PosInf = 1 <=> F) /\
    (1 <= NegInf <=> F) /\ (1 < NegInf <=> F) /\ (NegInf <= 1 <=> T) /\
    (NegInf < 1 <=> T) /\ (1 = NegInf <=> F) /\ (NegInf = 1 <=> F) /\
    (!r. 1 <= Normal r <=> 1 <= r) /\ (!r. 1 < Normal r <=> 1 < r) /\ (!r. 1 = Normal r <=> r = 1) /\
    (!r. Normal r <= 1 <=> r <= 1) /\ (!r. Normal r < 1 <=> r < 1) /\ (!r. Normal r = 1 <=> r = 1)

name: ineq_imp
statement:
(!x:extreal y. x < y ==> ~(y < x)) /\ (!x:extreal y. x < y ==> x <> y) /\
    (!x:extreal y. x < y ==> ~(y <= x)) /\ (!x:extreal y. x < y ==> x <= y) /\
    (!x:extreal y. x <= y ==> ~(y < x))

name: fn_plus_alt
statement: !f. fn_plus f = (λx. if 0 <= f x then f x else (0: extreal))

name: extreal_pow_alt
statement:
(!x:extreal. x pow 0 = 1) /\
    (!n x:extreal. x pow (SUC n) = x pow n * x)

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_ALT_FOLDR
statement:
!f s. FINITE s ==>
          EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f s = FOLDR (λe acc. f e + acc) 0x (REVERSE (SET_TO_LIST s))

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_EQ'
statement: !f g s. FINITE s /\ (!x. x IN s ==> f x = g x) ==> EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f s = EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE g s: extreal

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_MONO'
statement: !f g s. FINITE s /\ (!x. x IN s ==> f x <= g x) ==> EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f s <= EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE g s: extreal

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_COUNT_ZERO
statement: !f. EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f (count 0) = 0:extreal

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_COUNT_ONE
statement: !f. EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f (count 1) = f 0:extreal

name: EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE_COUNT_SUC
statement:
!f n. (!m. m <= n ==> f m <> NegInf) \/ (!m. m <= n ==> f m <> PosInf) ==>
        EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f (count (SUC n)) = (EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE f (count n)) + f n:extreal

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_NOT_INFTY
statement:
!f s. FINITE s /\ (!x. x IN s ==> f x <> NegInf /\ f x <> PosInf) ==>
        EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f s <> NegInf /\ EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f s <> PosInf

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_NORMAL
statement: !f s. FINITE s ==> EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE (λx. Normal (f x)) s = Normal (REAL_PROD_IMAGE f s)

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_0
statement: !f s. FINITE s /\ (?x. x IN s /\ f x = 0) ==> EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f s = 0

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_1
statement: !f s. FINITE s /\ (!x. x IN s ==> f x = 1) ==> EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f s = 1

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_ONE
statement: !s. FINITE s ==> EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE (λx. 1) s = 1x

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_POS
statement: !f s. FINITE s /\ (!x. x IN s ==> 0 <= f x) ==> 0 <= EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f s

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_MONO
statement:
!f g s. FINITE s /\ (!x. x IN s ==> 0 <= f x /\ f x <= g x) ==>
        EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f s <= EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE g s

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_COUNT_ZERO
statement: !f. EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f (count 0) = 1x

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_COUNT_ONE
statement: !f. EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f (count 1) = f 0: extreal

name: EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE_COUNT_SUC
statement: !f n. EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f (count (SUC n)) = EXTREAL_PROD_IMAGE f (count n) * f n: extreal

name: ext_suminf_sing_general
statement: !m r. 0 <= r ==> suminf (λn. if n = m then r else 0) = r

name: ext_suminf_nested
statement: !f. (!m n. 0 <= f m n) ==> suminf (λn. suminf (λm. f m n)) = suminf (λm. suminf (λn. f m n))

name: exp_mono_le
statement: !x:extreal y. exp x <= exp y <=> x <= y

name: pow_even_le
statement: !n. EVEN n ==> !x. 0 <= x pow n

name: pow_ainv_odd
statement: !n. ODD n ==> !x. -x pow n = -(x pow n)

name: pow_ainv_even
statement: !n. EVEN n ==> !x. -x pow n = x pow n

name: sub_le_sub_imp
statement: !w x y z. w <= x /\ z <= y ==> w - y <= x - z

name: leeq_trans
statement: !x:extreal y z. x <= y /\ y = z ==> x <= z

name: eqle_trans
statement: !x:extreal y z. x = y /\ y <= z ==> x <= z

name: extreal_exp_def
statement:
(extreal_exp (Normal x) = Normal (exp x)) /\
   (extreal_exp PosInf = PosInf) /\
   (extreal_exp NegInf = Normal 0)

name: extreal_powr_def
statement: extreal_powr x a = extreal_exp (extreal_mul a (extreal_ln x))

name: extreal_logr_def
statement:
(extreal_logr b (Normal x) = Normal (logr b x)) /\
   (extreal_logr b PosInf = PosInf)

name: extreal_lg_def
statement: extreal_lg x = extreal_logr 2 x

name: ext_mono_increasing_def
statement: ext_mono_increasing f = (!m n:num. m <= n ==> f m <= f n)

name: ext_mono_decreasing_def
statement: ext_mono_decreasing f = (!m n:num. m <= n ==> f n <= f m)

name: ceiling_def
statement: ceiling (Normal x) = LEAST (n:num). x <= &n

name: real_set_def
statement: real_set s = {real x | x <> PosInf /\ x <> NegInf /\ x IN s}

name: Q_set
statement: Q_set = IMAGE Normal q_set

name: open_interval_def
statement: open_interval (a :extreal) b = {x | a < x /\ x < b}

name: open_intervals_def
statement: open_intervals = {open_interval a b | T}

name: rational_intervals_def
statement: rational_intervals = {open_interval a b | a IN Q_set /\ b IN Q_set}

name: ext_product_def
statement: ext_product = iterate (( * ):extreal->extreal->extreal)

name: max_fn_seq_def
statement:
(max_fn_seq g 0       x = g 0 x) /\
   (max_fn_seq g (SUC n) x = max (max_fn_seq g n x) (g (SUC n) x))

name: indicator_fn
statement: indicator_fn s = Normal o indicator s

name: extreal_dist_def
statement:
extreal_dist (Normal x) (Normal y) = dist (bounded_metric mr1) (x,y) /\
    extreal_dist  PosInf     PosInf    = 0 /\
    extreal_dist  NegInf     NegInf    = 0 /\
    extreal_dist  _          _         = 1

name: extreal_mr1_def
statement: extreal_mr1 = metric (UNCURRY extreal_dist)

name: ext_tendsto_def
statement:
ext_tendsto f l net =
      !e. &0 < e ==> eventually (\x. dist extreal_mr1 (f(x),l) < e) net

name: extreal_lim_def
statement: extreal_lim net f = @l. ext_tendsto f l net

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_POS_SIMPLE_FN
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ (?s a x. pos_simple_fn m f s a x) ==>
          f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel

name: pos_simple_fn_integral_present
statement:
!m f (s :num->bool) a x
       g (s':num->bool) b y.
       measure_space m /\ pos_simple_fn m f s a x /\ pos_simple_fn m g s' b y ==>
       ?z z' c (k:num->bool).
          (!t. t IN m_space m ==> (f t = SIGMA (\i. Normal (z  i) * (indicator_fn (c i) t)) k)) /\
          (!t. t IN m_space m ==> (g t = SIGMA (\i. Normal (z' i) * (indicator_fn (c i) t)) k)) /\
          (pos_simple_fn_integral m s  a x = pos_simple_fn_integral m k c z) /\
          (pos_simple_fn_integral m s' b y = pos_simple_fn_integral m k c z') /\
           FINITE k /\ (!i. i IN k ==> 0 <= z i) /\ (!i. i IN k ==> 0 <= z' i) /\
          (!i j. i IN k /\ j IN k /\ i <> j ==> DISJOINT (c i) (c j)) /\
          (!i. i IN k ==> c i IN measurable_sets m) /\
          (BIGUNION (IMAGE c k) = m_space m)

name: psfis_present
statement:
!m f g a b.
       measure_space m /\
       a IN psfis m f /\ b IN psfis m g ==>
       ?z z' c (k:num->bool).
          (!t. t IN m_space m ==> (f t = SIGMA (\i. Normal (z  i) * (indicator_fn (c i) t)) k)) /\
          (!t. t IN m_space m ==> (g t = SIGMA (\i. Normal (z' i) * (indicator_fn (c i) t)) k)) /\
          (a = pos_simple_fn_integral m k c z) /\
          (b = pos_simple_fn_integral m k c z') /\
          FINITE k /\ (!i. i IN k ==> 0 <= z i) /\ (!i. i IN k ==> 0 <= z' i) /\
          (!i j. i IN k /\ j IN k /\ i <> j ==> DISJOINT (c i) (c j)) /\
          (!i. i IN k ==> c i IN measurable_sets m) /\
          (BIGUNION (IMAGE c k) = m_space m)

name: pos_simple_fn_le
statement:
!m f g s a x x' i. measure_space m /\
                       pos_simple_fn m f s a x /\ pos_simple_fn m g s a x' /\
                       (!x. x IN m_space m ==> g x <= f x) /\
                       i IN s /\ ~(a i = {}) ==> (Normal (x' i) <= Normal (x i))

name: pos_simple_fn_cmul
statement:
!m f z s a x. measure_space m /\ pos_simple_fn m f s a x /\ 0 <= z ==>
                  ?s' a' x'. pos_simple_fn m (\t. Normal z * f t) s' a' x'

name: pos_simple_fn_add
statement:
!m f g s a x s' a' x'.
       measure_space m /\ pos_simple_fn m f s a x /\ pos_simple_fn m g s' a' x' ==>
       ?s'' a'' x''. pos_simple_fn m (\t. f t + g t) s'' a'' x''

name: pos_simple_fn_integral_add
statement:
!m f (s :num -> bool) a x
       g (s':num -> bool) b y. measure_space m /\
                               pos_simple_fn m f s a x /\
                               pos_simple_fn m g s' b y ==>
       ?s'' c z. pos_simple_fn m (\x. f x + g x) s'' c z /\
                (pos_simple_fn_integral m s a x +
                 pos_simple_fn_integral m s' b y =
                 pos_simple_fn_integral m s'' c z)

name: pos_simple_fn_integral_add_alt
statement:
!m f s a x g y. measure_space m /\
           pos_simple_fn m f s a x /\ pos_simple_fn m g s a y ==>
          (pos_simple_fn_integral m s a x +
           pos_simple_fn_integral m s a y =
           pos_simple_fn_integral m s a (\i. x i + y i))

name: psfis_add
statement:
!m f g a b. measure_space m /\ a IN psfis m f /\ b IN psfis m g ==>
                (a + b) IN psfis m (\x. f x + g x)

name: pos_simple_fn_integral_mono
statement:
!m f (s :num->bool) a x
       g (s':num->bool) b y.
       measure_space m /\ pos_simple_fn m f s a x /\ pos_simple_fn m g s' b y /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> f x <= g x) ==>
       pos_simple_fn_integral m s a x <= pos_simple_fn_integral m s' b y

name: pos_simple_fn_integral_sub
statement:
!m f s a x g s' b y.
       measure_space m /\ (measure m (m_space m) <> PosInf) /\
       (!x. x IN m_space m ==> g x <= f x) /\
       (!x. x IN m_space m ==> g x <> PosInf) /\
       pos_simple_fn m f s  a x /\
       pos_simple_fn m g s' b y ==>
       ?s'' c z. pos_simple_fn m (\x. f x - g x) s'' c z /\
                (pos_simple_fn_integral m s   a x -
                 pos_simple_fn_integral m s'  b y =
                 pos_simple_fn_integral m s'' c z)

name: psfis_sub
statement:
!m f g a b. measure_space m /\ measure m (m_space m) <> PosInf /\
               (!x. x IN m_space m ==> g x <= f x) /\
               (!x. x IN m_space m ==> g x <> PosInf) /\
                a IN psfis m f /\ b IN psfis m g ==> (a - b) IN psfis m (\x. f x - g x)

name: pos_fn_integral_pos_simple_fn
statement:
!m f s a x. measure_space m /\ pos_simple_fn m f s a x ==>
               (pos_fn_integral m f = pos_simple_fn_integral m s a x)

name: pos_fn_integral_mspace
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) ==>
         (pos_fn_integral m f = pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn (m_space m) x))

name: pos_fn_integral_zero
statement: !m. measure_space m ==> (pos_fn_integral m (\x. 0) = 0)

name: pos_fn_integral_mono
statement:
!m f g. (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
            (!x. x IN m_space m ==> f x <= g x) ==>
            pos_fn_integral m f <= pos_fn_integral m g

name: pos_fn_integral_pos
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) ==>
          0 <= pos_fn_integral m f

name: pos_fn_integral_cmul
statement:
!m f c. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\ 0 <= c ==>
           (pos_fn_integral m (\x. Normal c * f x) = Normal c * pos_fn_integral m f)

name: pos_fn_integral_indicator
statement:
!m s. measure_space m /\ s IN measurable_sets m ==>
         (pos_fn_integral m (indicator_fn s) = measure m s)

name: pos_fn_integral_cmul_indicator
statement:
!m s c. measure_space m /\ s IN measurable_sets m /\ 0 <= c ==>
           (pos_fn_integral m (\x. Normal c * indicator_fn s x) = Normal c * measure m s)

name: pos_fn_integral_const
statement:
!m c. measure_space m /\ measure m (m_space m) < PosInf /\ 0 <= c ==>
         (pos_fn_integral m (\x. Normal c) = Normal c * measure m (m_space m))

name: pos_fn_integral_sum_cmul_indicator
statement:
!m s a x. measure_space m /\ FINITE s /\ (!i:num. i IN s ==> 0 <= x i) /\
             (!i:num. i IN s ==> a i IN measurable_sets m) ==>
             (pos_fn_integral m (\t. SIGMA (\i:num. Normal (x i) * indicator_fn (a i) t) s) =
              SIGMA (\i. Normal (x i) * measure m (a i)) s)

name: lebesgue_monotone_convergence_lemma
statement:
!m f fi g r'.
        measure_space m /\
        (!i. fi i IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel) /\
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> mono_increasing (\i. fi i x)) /\
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (sup (IMAGE (\i. fi i x) UNIV) = f x)) /\
        (r' IN psfis m g) /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> g x <= f x) /\
        (!i x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= fi i x) ==>
         r' <= sup (IMAGE (\i. pos_fn_integral m (fi i)) UNIV)

name: lebesgue_monotone_convergence
statement:
!m f fi. measure_space m /\
        (!i. fi i IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel) /\
        (!i x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= fi i x) /\
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> mono_increasing (\i. fi i x)) /\
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (sup (IMAGE (\i. fi i x) UNIV) = f x)) ==>
        (pos_fn_integral m f = sup (IMAGE (\i. pos_fn_integral m (fi i)) UNIV))

name: lebesgue_monotone_convergence_subset
statement:
!m f fi A. measure_space m /\
        (!i. fi i IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel) /\
        (!i x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= fi i x) /\
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (sup (IMAGE (\i. fi i x) UNIV) = f x)) /\
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> mono_increasing (\i. fi i x)) /\
         A IN measurable_sets m ==>
        (pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn A x) =
         sup (IMAGE (\i. pos_fn_integral m (\x. fi i x * indicator_fn A x)) UNIV))

name: lemma_fn_seq_positive
statement: !m f n x. 0 <= f x ==> (0 <= fn_seq m f n x)

name: lemma_fn_seq_mono_increasing
statement: !m f x. 0 <= f x ==> mono_increasing (\n. fn_seq m f n x)

name: lemma_fn_seq_upper_bounded
statement: !m f n x. 0 <= f x ==> (fn_seq m f n x <= f x)

name: lemma_fn_seq_sup
statement:
!m f x. x IN m_space m /\ 0 <= f x ==>
            (sup (IMAGE (\n. fn_seq m f n x) UNIV) = f x)

name: lemma_fn_seq_measurable
statement:
!m f n. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
            fn_seq m f n IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel

name: lemma_fn_seq_in_psfis
statement:
!m f n. (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\ measure_space m /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
            (fn_seq_integral m f n IN psfis m (fn_seq m f n))

name: BOREL_INDUCT
statement:
!f m P.
     measure_space m /\
     f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\ (!x. 0 <= f x) /\
     (!f g. f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            g IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (f x = g x)) /\ P f ==> P g) /\
     (!A. A IN measurable_sets m ==> P (indicator_fn A)) /\
     (!f c. f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            0 <= c /\ (!x. 0 <= f x) /\ P f ==> P (\x. c * f x)) /\
     (!f g. f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            g IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            (!x. 0 <= f x) /\ P f /\ (!x. 0 <= g x) /\ P g ==>
            P (\x. f x + g x)) /\
     (!u. (!i:num. (u i) IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel) /\
          (!i x. 0 <= u i x) /\ (!x. mono_increasing (\i. u i x)) /\
          (!i. P (u i)) ==> P (\x. sup (IMAGE (\i. u i x) UNIV))) ==> P f

name: integral_sequence
statement:
!m f.  (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\ measure_space m /\
           f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel
       ==> (pos_fn_integral m f = sup (IMAGE (\i. pos_fn_integral m (fn_seq m f i)) UNIV))

name: measurable_sequence
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
         (?fi ri. (!x. mono_increasing (\i. fi i x)) /\
                  (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (sup (IMAGE (\i. fi i x) UNIV) = fn_plus f x)) /\
                  (!i. ri i IN psfis m (fi i)) /\
                  (!i x. fi i x <= fn_plus f x) /\
                  (!i x. 0 <= fi i x) /\
                  (pos_fn_integral m (fn_plus f) =
                   sup (IMAGE (\i. pos_fn_integral m (fi i)) UNIV))) /\
         (?gi vi. (!x. mono_increasing (\i. gi i x)) /\
                  (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (sup (IMAGE (\i. gi i x) UNIV) = fn_minus f x)) /\
                  (!i. vi i IN psfis m (gi i)) /\
                  (!i x. (gi i) x <= fn_minus f x) /\
                  (!i x. 0 <= gi i x) /\
                  (pos_fn_integral m (fn_minus f) =
                   sup (IMAGE (\i. pos_fn_integral m (gi i)) UNIV)))

name: pos_fn_integral_mono_AE
statement:
!m u v. measure_space m /\
            (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= u x) /\
            (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= v x) /\
            (AE x::m. u x <= v x) ==>
            pos_fn_integral m u <= pos_fn_integral m v

name: pos_fn_integral_cong_AE
statement:
!m u v. measure_space m /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= u x) /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= v x) /\
           (AE x::m. u x = v x) ==>
           (pos_fn_integral m u = pos_fn_integral m v)

name: pos_fn_integral_cong
statement:
!m u v. measure_space m /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= u x) /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= v x) /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (u x = v x)) ==>
           (pos_fn_integral m u = pos_fn_integral m v)

name: pos_fn_integral_add
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= g x) /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            g IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
           (pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x + g x) = pos_fn_integral m f + pos_fn_integral m g)

name: pos_fn_integral_add3
statement:
!m f g h. measure_space m /\
             (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
             (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= g x) /\
             (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= h x) /\
              f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
              g IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
              h IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel
          ==> pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x + g x + h x) =
              pos_fn_integral m f + pos_fn_integral m g + pos_fn_integral m h

name: pos_fn_integral_sub
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            g IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= g x) /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> g x <= f x) /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> g x <> PosInf) /\
            pos_fn_integral m g <> PosInf ==>
           (pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x - g x) = pos_fn_integral m f - pos_fn_integral m g)

name: lebesgue_monotone_convergence_decreasing
statement:
!m f fi. measure_space m /\
        (!i. fi i IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel) /\
        (!i x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= fi i x /\ fi i x < PosInf) /\
        (!i. pos_fn_integral m (fi i) <> PosInf) /\
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> mono_decreasing (\i. fi i x)) /\
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (inf (IMAGE (\i. fi i x) UNIV) = f x)) ==>
        (pos_fn_integral m f = inf (IMAGE (\i. pos_fn_integral m (fi i)) UNIV))

name: lebesgue_monotone_convergence_decreasing'
statement:
!m f fi A. measure_space m /\
        (!i. fi i IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel) /\
        (!i x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= fi i x /\ fi i x < PosInf) /\
        (!i. pos_fn_integral m (fi i) <> PosInf) /\
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> mono_decreasing (\i. fi i x)) /\
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> inf (IMAGE (\i. fi i x) UNIV) = f x) /\
         A IN measurable_sets m ==>
        (pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn A x) =
         inf (IMAGE (\i. pos_fn_integral m (\x. fi i x * indicator_fn A x)) UNIV))

name: pos_fn_integral_sum
statement:
!m f s. FINITE s /\ measure_space m /\
           (!i. i IN s ==> !x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f i x) /\
           (!i. i IN s ==> f i IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel) ==>
           (pos_fn_integral m (\x. SIGMA (\i. (f i) x) s) =
            SIGMA (\i. pos_fn_integral m (f i)) s)

name: pos_fn_integral_disjoint_sets
statement:
!m f s t. measure_space m /\
              DISJOINT s t /\ s IN measurable_sets m /\ t IN measurable_sets m /\
              f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
             (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) ==>
             (pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn (s UNION t) x) =
              pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn s x) +
              pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn t x))

name: pos_fn_integral_disjoint_sets_sum
statement:
!m f s a. FINITE s /\ measure_space m /\
             (!i. i IN s ==> a i IN measurable_sets m) /\
             (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
             (!i j. i IN s /\ j IN s /\ i <> j ==> DISJOINT (a i) (a j)) /\
              f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
             (pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn (BIGUNION (IMAGE a s)) x) =
              SIGMA (\i. pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn (a i) x)) s)

name: pos_fn_integral_split
statement:
!m f s. measure_space m /\ s IN measurable_sets m /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
           (pos_fn_integral m f = pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn s x) +
                                  pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn (m_space m DIFF s) x))

name: pos_fn_integral_cmul_infty
statement:
!m s. measure_space m /\ s IN measurable_sets m ==>
          pos_fn_integral m (\x. PosInf * indicator_fn s x) = PosInf * measure m s

name: pos_fn_integral_suminf
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\
         (!i x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f i x) /\
         (!i. f i IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel) ==>
         (pos_fn_integral m (\x. suminf (\i. f i x)) =
          suminf (\i. pos_fn_integral m (f i)))

name: pos_fn_integral_null_set
statement:
!m f N. measure_space m /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\ N IN null_set m ==>
           (pos_fn_integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn N x) = 0)

name: lebesgue_monotone_convergence_AE
statement:
!m f fi. measure_space m /\
        (!i. fi i IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel) /\
        (AE x::m. !i. fi i x <= fi (SUC i) x /\ 0 <= fi i x) /\
        (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (sup (IMAGE (\i. fi i x) univ(:num)) = f x)) ==>
        (pos_fn_integral m (fn_plus f) =
         sup (IMAGE (\i. pos_fn_integral m (fn_plus (fi i))) univ(:num)))

name: integral_pos_fn
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) ==>
          (integral m f = pos_fn_integral m f)

name: integral_pos
statement: !m f. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) ==> 0 <= integral m f

name: integral_neg
statement: !m f. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> f x <= 0) ==> integral m f <= 0

name: integral_abs_pos_fn
statement: !m f. measure_space m ==> (integral m (abs o f) = pos_fn_integral m (abs o f))

name: integral_split
statement:
!m f s. measure_space m /\ s IN measurable_sets m /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
           (integral m f = integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn s x) +
                           integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn (m_space m DIFF s) x))

name: integral_split'
statement:
!m f s. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ s IN measurable_sets m ==>
           (integral m f = integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn s x) +
                           integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn (m_space m DIFF s) x))

name: integrable_eq
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\
            (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (f x = g x)) ==> integrable m g

name: integrable_cong
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (f x = g x)) ==>
           (integrable m f <=> integrable m g)

name: integrable_pos
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) ==>
         (integrable m f <=> f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
                             pos_fn_integral m f <> PosInf)

name: integrable_infty_null
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==>
          null_set m {x | x IN m_space m /\ (f x = PosInf)}

name: pos_fn_integral_infty_null
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
          f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
          pos_fn_integral m f <> PosInf ==>
          null_set m {x | x IN m_space m /\ (f x = PosInf)}

name: integrable_eq_AE
statement:
!m f g. complete_measure_space m /\
            integrable m f /\ (AE x::m. f x = g x) ==> integrable m g

name: integrable_bounded
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\
            g IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (abs (g x) <= f x))
        ==> integrable m g

name: integrable_fn_plus
statement: !m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==> integrable m (fn_plus f)

name: integrable_fn_minus
statement: !m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==> integrable m (fn_minus f)

name: integrable_plus_minus
statement:
!m f. measure_space m ==>
         (integrable m f <=> f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
                             integrable m (fn_plus f) /\ integrable m (fn_minus f))

name: integrable_add_pos
statement:

           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= g x) ==> integrable m (\x. f x + g x)

name: integrable_abs_alt
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ f IN Borel_measurable (measurable_space m) ==>
         (integrable m (abs o f) <=> pos_fn_integral m (abs o f) <> PosInf)

name: integrable_abs
statement: !m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==> integrable m (abs o f)

name: integrable_abs_bound_exists
statement:
!m u. measure_space m /\ integrable m (abs o u) ==>
          ?w. integrable m w /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= w x) /\
              !x. x IN m_space m ==> abs (u x) <= w x

name: integrable_bound_exists
statement:
!m u. measure_space m /\ integrable m u ==>
          ?w. integrable m w /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= w x) /\
              !x. x IN m_space m ==> abs (u x) <= w x

name: integrable_from_bound_exists
statement:
!m u. measure_space m /\
          u IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
          (?w. integrable m w /\
               (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= w x) /\
               (!x. x IN m_space m ==> abs (u x) <= w x)) ==> integrable m u

name: integrable_from_abs
statement:
!m u. measure_space m /\ u IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
          integrable m (abs o u) ==> integrable m u

name: integral_abs_imp_integrable
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
         (integral m (abs o f) = 0) ==> integrable m f

name: integrable_add
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ integrable m g /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (f x <> NegInf /\ g x <> NegInf) \/
                                   (f x <> PosInf /\ g x <> PosInf))
        ==> integrable m (\x. f x + g x)

name: integrable_cmul
statement: !m f c. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==> integrable m (\x. Normal c * f x)

name: integrable_ainv
statement: !m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==> integrable m (\x. -f x)

name: integrable_sub
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ integrable m g /\
            (!x. x IN m_space m ==> f x <> NegInf /\ g x <> PosInf)
        ==> integrable m (\x. f x - g x)

name: integrable_mul_indicator
statement:
!m s f. measure_space m /\ s IN measurable_sets m /\
            integrable m f ==> integrable m (\x. f x * indicator_fn s x)

name: integrable_not_infty_lemma
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\
         (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) ==>
          ?g. integrable m g /\
             (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= g x) /\
             (!x. x IN m_space m ==> g x <> PosInf) /\
             (integral m f = integral m g)

name: integral_cong
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (f x = g x)) ==>
           (integral m f = integral m g)

name: integral_cong_AE
statement: !m f g. measure_space m /\ (AE x::m. f x = g x) ==> (integral m f = integral m g)

name: integrable_not_infty
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\
         (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) ==>
          ?g. integrable m g /\ (!x. 0 <= g x) /\ (!x. g x <> PosInf) /\
             (integral m f = integral m g)

name: integrable_not_infty_alt
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\
         (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) ==>
          integrable m (\x. if f x = PosInf then 0 else f x) /\
         (integral m f = integral m (\x. if f x = PosInf then 0 else f x))

name: integrable_not_infty_alt2
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\
         (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) ==>
          integrable m (\x. if f x = PosInf then 0 else f x) /\
         (pos_fn_integral m f = pos_fn_integral m (\x. if f x = PosInf then 0 else f x))

name: integrable_not_infty_alt3
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==>
          integrable m (\x. if ((f x = NegInf) \/ (f x = PosInf)) then 0 else f x) /\
         (integral m f =
          integral m (\x. if ((f x = NegInf) \/ (f x = PosInf)) then 0 else f x))

name: integral_add_lemma
statement:
!m f f1 f2.
       measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\
       integrable m f1 /\ integrable m f2 /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (f x = f1 x - f2 x)) /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f1 x) /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f2 x) /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> f1 x <> PosInf \/ f2 x <> PosInf) ==>
      (integral m f = pos_fn_integral m f1 - pos_fn_integral m f2)

name: integral_add_lemma'
statement:
!m f f1 f2.
       measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\
       integrable m f1 /\ integrable m f2 /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (f x = f1 x - f2 x)) /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f1 x) /\
      (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f2 x) ==>
      (integral m f = pos_fn_integral m f1 - pos_fn_integral m f2)

name: integral_add
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ integrable m g /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (f x <> NegInf /\ g x <> NegInf) \/
                                   (f x <> PosInf /\ g x <> PosInf)) ==>
           (integral m (\x. f x + g x) = integral m f + integral m g)

name: integral_cmul
statement:
!m f c. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==>
           (integral m (\x. Normal c * f x) = Normal c * integral m f)

name: integrable_finite_integral
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==>
          integral m f <> PosInf /\ integral m f <> NegInf

name: integral_sub
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ integrable m g /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> (f x <> NegInf /\ g x <> PosInf) \/
                                   (f x <> PosInf /\ g x <> NegInf)) ==>
           (integral m (\x. f x - g x) = integral m f - integral m g)

name: integral_cmul_infty'
statement:
!m s. measure_space m /\ s IN measurable_sets m ==>
         (integral m (\x. NegInf * indicator_fn s x) = NegInf * (measure m s))

name: integral_neginf
statement: !m. measure_space m /\ 0 < measure m (m_space m) ==> (integral m (\x. NegInf) = NegInf)

name: integral_mono
statement:
!m f1 f2. measure_space m /\ integrable m f1 /\ integrable m f2 /\
             (!x. x IN m_space m ==> f1 x <= f2 x) ==>
              integral m f1 <= integral m f2

name: integrable_sum
statement:
!m f s. FINITE s /\ measure_space m /\ (!i. i IN s ==> integrable m (f i)) /\
            (!i x. i IN s /\ x IN m_space m ==>
                   f i x <> PosInf /\ f i x <> NegInf) ==>
            integrable m (\x. SIGMA (\i. f i x) s)

name: integral_sum
statement:
!m f s. FINITE s /\ measure_space m /\ (!i. i IN s ==> integrable m (f i)) /\
            (!x i. i IN s /\ x IN m_space m ==>
                   f i x <> PosInf /\ f i x <> NegInf) ==>
            (integral m (\x. SIGMA (\i. (f i) x) s) = SIGMA (\i. integral m (f i)) s)

name: finite_support_integral_reduce
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
         (!x. x IN m_space m ==> f x <> NegInf /\ f x <> PosInf) /\
          FINITE (IMAGE f (m_space m)) /\
          integrable m f /\ measure m (m_space m) < PosInf ==>
         (integral m f = finite_space_integral m f)

name: finite_space_integral_reduce
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
          (!x. x IN m_space m ==> f x <> NegInf /\ f x <> PosInf) /\
          FINITE (m_space m) /\ measure m (m_space m) < PosInf /\
          integrable m f
      ==> (integral m f = finite_space_integral m f)

name: finite_space_POW_integral_reduce
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ (POW (m_space m) = measurable_sets m) /\ FINITE (m_space m) /\
         (!x. x IN m_space m ==> f x <> NegInf /\ f x <> PosInf) /\
          measure m (m_space m) < PosInf ==>
         (integral m f = SIGMA (\x. f x * (measure m {x})) (m_space m))

name: measure_space_density
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
         (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) ==> measure_space (density m f)

name: measure_space_density'
statement:
!M f. measure_space M /\ f IN measurable (m_space M,measurable_sets M) Borel
      ==> measure_space (density M (fn_plus f))

name: measure_space_distr
statement:
!M B f. measure_space M /\ sigma_algebra B /\
            f IN measurable (m_space M,measurable_sets M) B ==>
            measure_space (space B, subsets B, distr M f)

name: markov_inequality
statement:
!m f a c. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ a IN measurable_sets m /\ 0 < c ==>
              measure m ({x | c <= abs (f x)} INTER a) <=
                inv c * integral m (\x. abs (f x) * indicator_fn a x)

name: markov_ineq
statement:
!m f c. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ 0 < c ==>
            measure m ({x | c <= abs (f x)} INTER m_space m) <= inv c * integral m (abs o f)

name: integral_triangle_ineq
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==>
          abs (integral m f) <= integral m (abs o f)

name: integral_triangle_ineq'
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==>
          abs (integral m f) <= pos_fn_integral m (abs o f)

name: integral_null_set
statement:
!m f N. measure_space m /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            N IN null_set m ==> integrable m (\x. f x * indicator_fn N x) /\
                                 (integral m (\x. f x * indicator_fn N x) = 0)

name: integral_abs_eq_0
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\
          f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
        ((integral m (abs o f) = 0) <=> AE x::m. (abs o f) x = 0) /\
        ((AE x::m. (abs o f) x = 0) <=> (measure m {x | x IN m_space m /\ f x <> 0} = 0))

name: pos_fn_integral_eq_0
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
          f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
        ((pos_fn_integral m f = 0) <=> (measure m {x | x IN m_space m /\ f x <> 0} = 0))

name: integral_eq_0
statement:
!m f. f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
          measure_space m /\ (AE x::m. 0 <= f x) ==>
        ((integral m f = 0) <=> (measure m {x | x IN m_space m /\ f x <> 0} = 0))

name: pos_fn_integral_cmult'
statement:
!f c m. measure_space m /\ 0 <= c /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
           (pos_fn_integral m (\x. max 0 (c * f x)) =
            c * pos_fn_integral m (\x. max 0 (f x)))

name: pos_fn_integral_cmult
statement:
!f c m. measure_space m /\ 0 <= c /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
           (pos_fn_integral m (\x. c * fn_plus f x) = c * pos_fn_integral m (fn_plus f))

name: density_fn_plus
statement:
!M f. density M (fn_plus f) =
           (m_space M, measurable_sets M,
            (\A. pos_fn_integral M (\x. max 0 (f x * indicator_fn A x))))

name: pos_fn_integral_density'
statement:
!f g M. measure_space M /\
            f IN measurable (m_space M, measurable_sets M) Borel /\
            g IN measurable (m_space M, measurable_sets M) Borel /\
           (AE x::M. 0 <= f x) /\ (!x. 0 <= g x) ==>
      ((pos_fn_integral (m_space M, measurable_sets M,
                         (\A. pos_fn_integral M (\x. max 0 (f x * indicator_fn A x))))
                        (\x. max 0 (g x)) =
        pos_fn_integral M (\x. max 0 (f x * g x))))

name: pos_fn_integral_density
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            g IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
           (AE x::m. 0 <= f x) /\ (!x. 0 <= g x)
       ==> (pos_fn_integral (density m (fn_plus f)) g =
            pos_fn_integral m (\x. (fn_plus f) x * g x))

name: EXTREAL_SUP_SEQ
statement:
!P. (?x. P x) /\ (?z. z <> PosInf /\ !x. P x ==> x <= z) ==>
        ?x. (!n. x n IN P) /\ (!n. x n <= x (SUC n)) /\ (sup (IMAGE x UNIV) = sup P)

name: EXTREAL_SUP_FUN_SEQ_IMAGE
statement:
!(P:extreal->bool) (P':('a->extreal)->bool) f.
       (?x. P x) /\ (?z. z <> PosInf /\ !x. P x ==> x <= z) /\ (P = IMAGE f P')
           ==> ?g. (!n:num. g n IN P') /\
                   (sup (IMAGE (\n. f (g n)) UNIV) = sup P)

name: EXTREAL_SUP_FUN_SEQ_MONO_IMAGE
statement:
!f (P :extreal->bool) (P' :('a->extreal)->bool).
       (?x. P x) /\ (?z. z <> PosInf /\ !x. P x ==> x <= z) /\ (P = IMAGE f P') /\
       (!g1 g2. (g1 IN P' /\ g2 IN P' /\ (!x. g1 x <= g2 x))  ==> f g1 <= f g2) /\
       (!g1 g2. g1 IN P' /\ g2 IN P' ==> (\x. max (g1 x) (g2 x)) IN P')
      ==>
       ?g. (!n. g n IN P') /\ (!x n. g n x <= g (SUC n) x) /\
           (sup (IMAGE (\n. f (g n)) UNIV) = sup P)

name: lemma_radon_max_in_F
statement:
!f g m v. measure_space m /\ measure_space v /\
              (m_space v = m_space m) /\ (measurable_sets v = measurable_sets m) /\
              f IN RADON_F m v /\ g IN RADON_F m v
          ==> (\x. max (f x) (g x)) IN RADON_F m v

name: Radon_Nikodym_finite
statement:
!M N. measure_space M /\ measure_space N /\
         (m_space M = m_space N) /\ (measurable_sets M = measurable_sets N) /\
          measure M (m_space M) <> PosInf /\
          measure N (m_space N) <> PosInf /\
          measure_absolutely_continuous (measure N) M ==>
      ?f. f IN measurable (m_space M,measurable_sets M) Borel /\
          (!x. 0 <= f x) /\
          !A. A IN measurable_sets M ==>
             (pos_fn_integral M (\x. f x * indicator_fn A x) = measure N A)

name: measure_restricted
statement:
!m s t. measure_space m /\
            s IN measurable_sets m /\ t IN measurable_sets m ==>
         (measure (m_space m, measurable_sets m,
           (\A. pos_fn_integral m (\x. indicator_fn s x * indicator_fn A x))) t =
          measure m (s INTER t))

name: measure_subadditive_finite
statement:
!J A M. measure_space M /\ FINITE J /\
           IMAGE A J SUBSET measurable_sets M ==>
           measure M (BIGUNION {A i | (i:num) IN J}) <=
           SIGMA (\i. measure M (A i)) J

name: split_space_into_finite_sets_and_rest
statement:
!M N. measure_space M /\ measure_space N /\
         (m_space M = m_space N) /\ (measurable_sets M = measurable_sets N) /\
          measure M (m_space M) <> PosInf /\
          measure_absolutely_continuous (measure N) M ==>
       ?A0 B. A0 IN measurable_sets M /\ disjoint_family B /\
              IMAGE B univ(:num) SUBSET measurable_sets M /\
             (A0 = m_space M DIFF BIGUNION {B i | i IN UNIV}) /\
             (!A. A IN measurable_sets M /\ A SUBSET A0 ==>
                  (((measure M A = 0) /\ (measure N A = 0)) \/
                   (0 < measure M A /\ (measure N A = PosInf)))) /\
             (!i. measure N (B i) <> PosInf)

name: Radon_Nikodym_finite_arbitrary
statement:
!M N. measure_space M /\ measure_space N /\
         (m_space M = m_space N) /\ (measurable_sets M = measurable_sets N) /\
         (measure M (m_space M) <> PosInf) /\
          measure_absolutely_continuous (measure N) M ==>
      ?f. f IN measurable (m_space M,measurable_sets M) Borel /\ (!x. 0 <= f x) /\
          !A. A IN measurable_sets M ==>
             (pos_fn_integral M (\x. f x * indicator_fn A x) = measure N A)

name: ext_suminf_cmult_indicator
statement:
!A f x i. disjoint_family A /\ x IN A i /\ (!i. 0 <= f i) ==>
              (suminf (\n. f n * indicator_fn (A n) x) = f i)

name: finite_integrable_function_exists
statement:
!m. measure_space m /\ sigma_finite m ==>
        ?h. h IN measurable (m_space m, measurable_sets m) Borel /\
           (pos_fn_integral m h <> PosInf) /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 < h x /\ h x < PosInf) /\
           (!x. 0 <= h x)

name: Radon_Nikodym_sigma_finite
statement:
!M N. measure_space M /\ measure_space N /\
         (m_space M = m_space N) /\ (measurable_sets M = measurable_sets N) /\
          sigma_finite M /\
          measure_absolutely_continuous (measure N) M ==>
      ?f. f IN measurable (m_space M,measurable_sets M) Borel /\ (!x. 0 <= f x) /\
          !A. A IN measurable_sets M ==>
             (pos_fn_integral M (\x. f x * indicator_fn A x) = measure N A)

name: Radon_Nikodym
statement:
!m v. measure_space m /\ sigma_finite m /\
          measure_space (m_space m,measurable_sets m,v) /\
          measure_absolutely_continuous v m ==>
      ?f. f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\ (!x. 0 <= f x) /\
          !s. s IN (measurable_sets m) ==> ((f * m) s = v s)

name: Radon_Nikodym'
statement:
!m v. measure_space m /\ sigma_finite m /\
          measure_space (m_space m,measurable_sets m,v) /\
          measure_absolutely_continuous v m ==>
      ?f. f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
         (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
          !s. s IN (measurable_sets m) ==> ((f * m) s = v s)

name: RN_deriv_thm
statement:
!m v. measure_space m /\
          (?f. f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
              (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
              (!s. s IN measurable_sets m ==> (f * m) s = v s)) ==>
          !s. s IN measurable_sets m ==> (v / m * m) s = v s

name: RN_deriv_thm'
statement:
!f m v. measure_space m /\
            f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
           (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
           (!s. s IN measurable_sets m ==> (f * m) s = v s) ==>
            measure_space_eq (density m (v / m))
                             (m_space m,measurable_sets m,v)

name: integrable_measurable
statement: !m f. integrable m f ==> f IN Borel_measurable (measurable_space m)

name: pos_fn_integrable_AE_finite
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
        f IN Borel_measurable (measurable_space m) /\ pos_fn_integral m f <> PosInf ==>
        AE x::m. f x = (Normal o real o f) x

name: integrable_AE_finite
statement: !m f. measure_space m /\ integrable m f ==> AE x::m. f x = (Normal o real o f) x

name: integrable_eq_AE_alt
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ (AE x::m. f x = g x) /\
        g IN Borel_measurable (measurable_space m) ==> integrable m g

name: integrable_cong_AE
statement:
!m f g. complete_measure_space m /\ (AE x::m. f x = g x) ==>
        (integrable m f <=> integrable m g)

name: integrable_cong_AE_alt
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ (AE x::m. f x = g x) /\
        f IN Borel_measurable (measurable_space m) /\ g IN Borel_measurable (measurable_space m)==>
        (integrable m f <=> integrable m g)

name: integral_mono_AE
statement: !m f g. measure_space m /\ (AE x::m. f x <= g x) ==> integral m f <= integral m g

name: integral_add'
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ integrable m g ==>
        integral m (λx. f x + g x) = integral m f + integral m g

name: integrable_add'
statement: !m f g. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ integrable m g ==> integrable m (λx. f x + g x)

name: integral_sum'
statement:
!m f s. FINITE s /\ measure_space m /\ (!i. i IN s ==> integrable m (f i)) ==>
            integral m (λx. SIGMA (λi. f i x) s) = SIGMA (λi. integral m (f i)) s

name: integrable_sum'
statement:
!m f s. FINITE s /\ measure_space m /\ (!i. i IN s ==> integrable m (f i)) ==>
        integrable m (λx. SIGMA (λi. f i x) s)

name: integral_sub'
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ integrable m g ==>
        integral m (λx. f x - g x) = integral m f - integral m g

name: integrable_sub'
statement:
!m f g. measure_space m /\ integrable m f /\ integrable m g ==>
        integrable m (λx. f x - g x)

name: integral_add3
statement:
!m f g h. measure_space m /\
              integrable m f /\ integrable m g /\ integrable m h
          ==> integral m (\x. f x + g x + h x) =
              integral m f + integral m g + integral m h

name: pos_simple_fn_def
statement:
pos_simple_fn m f (s :num set) (a :num -> 'a set) (x :num -> real) =
       ((!t. t IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f t) /\ 
        (!t. t IN m_space m ==>
            (f t = SIGMA (\i. Normal (x i) * indicator_fn (a i) t) s)) /\
        (!i. i IN s ==> a i IN measurable_sets m) /\
        FINITE s /\ (!i. i IN s ==> 0 <= x i) /\
        (!i j. i IN s /\ j IN s /\ (i <> j) ==> DISJOINT (a i) (a j)) /\
        (BIGUNION (IMAGE a s) = m_space m))

name: pos_simple_fn_integral_def
statement:
pos_simple_fn_integral (m :'a m_space)
                           (s :num set) (a :num -> 'a set) (x :num -> real) =
        SIGMA (\i:num. Normal (x i) * (measure m (a i))) s

name: psfs_def
statement: psfs m f = {(s,a,x) | pos_simple_fn m f s a x}

name: integral_def
statement: integral m f = pos_fn_integral m (fn_plus f) - pos_fn_integral m (fn_minus f)

name: integrable_def
statement:
integrable m f =
       (f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
        pos_fn_integral m (fn_plus f) <> PosInf /\
        pos_fn_integral m (fn_minus f) <> PosInf)

name: finite_space_integral_def
statement:
finite_space_integral m f =
      SIGMA (\r. r * measure m (PREIMAGE f {r} INTER m_space m)) (IMAGE f (m_space m))

name: seq_sup_def
statement:
(seq_sup P 0       = @r. r IN P /\ sup P < r + 1) /\
   (seq_sup P (SUC n) = @r. r IN P /\ sup P < r + Normal ((1 / 2) pow (SUC n)) /\
                           (seq_sup P n) < r /\ r < sup P)

name: RN_deriv_def
statement:
RN_deriv v m =
      @f. f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
          (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f x) /\
          !s. s IN measurable_sets m ==> ((f * m) s = v s)

name: fatou_lemma
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ (!x n. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f n x) /\
         (!n. f n IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel) ==>
          pos_fn_integral m (\x. liminf (\n. f n x)) <=
          liminf (\n. pos_fn_integral m (f n))

name: fatou_lemma'
statement:
!m f w. measure_space m /\ pos_fn_integral m w < PosInf /\
           (!x n. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= f n x /\ f n x <= w x /\ w x < PosInf) /\
           (!n. f n IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel) ==>
            limsup (\n. pos_fn_integral m (f n)) <=
            pos_fn_integral m (\x. limsup (\n. f n x))

name: LIM_SEQUENTIALLY_real_normal
statement:
!a l. (!n. a n <> PosInf /\ a n <> NegInf) ==>
          ((real o a --> l) sequentially <=>
           !e. 0 < e ==> ?N. !n. N <= n ==> abs (a n - Normal l) < Normal e)

name: LIM_SEQUENTIALLY_CESARO
statement:
!(f :num->real) l. ((\n. f n) --> l) sequentially ==>
          ((\n. SIGMA f (count (SUC n)) / &SUC n) --> l) sequentially

name: ext_liminf_le_subseq
statement:
!a f l. (!n. a n <> PosInf /\ a n <> NegInf) /\
            (!m n. m < n ==> f m < f n) /\
            ((real o a o f) --> l) sequentially ==> liminf a <= Normal l

name: ext_limsup_le_subseq
statement:
!a f l. (!n. a n <> PosInf /\ a n <> NegInf) /\
            (!m n. m < n ==> f m < f n) /\
            ((real o a o f) --> l) sequentially ==> Normal l <= limsup a

name: ext_liminf_imp_subseq
statement:
!a. (!n. a n <> PosInf /\ a n <> NegInf) /\
        liminf a <> PosInf /\ liminf a <> NegInf ==>
        ?f. (!m n. m < n ==> f m < f n) /\
            ((real o a o f) --> real (liminf a)) sequentially

name: ext_limsup_imp_subseq
statement:
!a. (!n. a n <> PosInf /\ a n <> NegInf) /\
        limsup a <> PosInf /\ limsup a <> NegInf ==>
        ?f. (!m n. m < n ==> f m < f n) /\
            ((real o a o f) --> real (limsup a)) sequentially

name: ext_limsup_thm
