statement:
!a l. (!n. a n <> PosInf /\ a n <> NegInf) ==>
          ((real o a --> l) sequentially <=>
           limsup a = Normal l /\ liminf a = Normal l)

name: ext_limsup_thm'
statement:
!a. (!n. 0 <= a n /\ a n <> PosInf) ==>
        (((\n. real (a n)) --> 0) sequentially <=> limsup a = 0 /\ liminf a = 0)

name: lebesgue_dominated_convergence
statement:
!m f fi. measure_space m /\ (!i. integrable m (fi i)) /\ integrable m f /\
            (!i x. x IN m_space m ==> fi i x <> PosInf /\ fi i x <> NegInf) /\
            (!x. x IN m_space m ==> f x <> PosInf /\ f x <> NegInf) /\
            (!x. x IN m_space m ==>
                ((\i. real (fi i x)) --> real (f x)) sequentially) /\
            (?w. integrable m w /\
                (!x. x IN m_space m ==> 0 <= w x /\ w x <> PosInf) /\
                 !i x. x IN m_space m ==> abs (fi i x) <= w x)
        ==> ((\i. real (integral m (fi i))) --> real (integral m f)) sequentially

name: pos_fn_integral_distr
statement:
!M B f u. measure_space M /\ sigma_algebra B /\
              f IN measurable (m_space M, measurable_sets M) B /\
              u IN measurable B Borel /\
             (!x. x IN space B ==> 0 <= u x) ==>
             (pos_fn_integral (space B,subsets B,distr M f) u = pos_fn_integral M (u o f))

name: integral_distr
statement:
!M B f u. measure_space M /\ sigma_algebra B /\
              f IN measurable (m_space M, measurable_sets M) B /\
              u IN measurable B Borel ==>
             (integral (space B,subsets B,distr M f) u = integral M (u o f)) /\
             (integrable (space B,subsets B,distr M f) u = integrable M (u o f))

name: pos_fn_integral_cong_measure
statement:
!sp sts u v f.
        measure_space (sp,sts,u) /\ measure_space (sp,sts,v) /\
        (!s. s IN sts ==> (u s = v s)) /\ (!x. x IN sp ==> 0 <= f x) ==>
        (pos_fn_integral (sp,sts,u) f = pos_fn_integral (sp,sts,v) f)

name: pos_fn_integral_cong_measure'
statement:
!m1 m2 f. measure_space m1 /\ measure_space m2 /\ measure_space_eq m1 m2 /\
             (!x. x IN m_space m1 ==> 0 <= f x) ==>
             (pos_fn_integral m1 f = pos_fn_integral m2 f)

name: integral_cong_measure_base
statement:
!sp sts u v f.
        measure_space (sp,sts,u) /\ measure_space (sp,sts,v) /\
       (!s. s IN sts ==> (u s = v s)) ==>
       (integral (sp,sts,u) f = integral (sp,sts,v) f) /\
       (integrable (sp,sts,u) f <=> integrable (sp,sts,v) f)

name: integral_cong_measure
statement:
!sp sts u v f.
        measure_space (sp,sts,u) /\ measure_space (sp,sts,v) /\
       (!s. s IN sts ==> (u s = v s)) ==>
       (integral (sp,sts,u) f = integral (sp,sts,v) f)

name: integral_cong_measure'
statement:
!m1 m2 f. measure_space m1 /\ measure_space m2 /\ measure_space_eq m1 m2 ==>
             (integral m1 f = integral m2 f)

name: integrable_cong_measure
statement:
!sp sts u v f.
        measure_space (sp,sts,u) /\ measure_space (sp,sts,v) /\
       (!s. s IN sts ==> (u s = v s)) ==>
       (integrable (sp,sts,u) f <=> integrable (sp,sts,v) f)

name: integrable_cong_measure'
statement:
!m1 m2 f. measure_space m1 /\ measure_space m2 /\ measure_space_eq m1 m2 ==>
             (integrable m1 f <=> integrable m2 f)

name: IN_FCP_CROSS
statement: !s a b. s IN fcp_cross a b <=> ?t u. (s = FCP_CONCAT t u) /\ t IN a /\ u IN b

name: fcp_cross_UNIV
statement:
FINITE univ(:'b) /\ FINITE univ(:'c) ==>
    fcp_cross univ(:'a['b]) univ(:'a['c]) = univ(:'a['b + 'c])

name: IN_FCP_PROD
statement: !s A B. s IN fcp_prod A B <=> ?a b. (s = fcp_cross a b) /\ a IN A /\ b IN B

name: FCP_BIGUNION_CROSS
statement: !f s t. fcp_cross (BIGUNION (IMAGE f s)) t = BIGUNION (IMAGE (\n. fcp_cross (f n) t) s)

name: FCP_CROSS_BIGUNION
statement: !f s t. fcp_cross t (BIGUNION (IMAGE f s)) = BIGUNION (IMAGE (\n. fcp_cross t (f n)) s)

name: FCP_CROSS_DIFF
statement:
!(X :'a['b] set) s (t :'a['c] set).
        FINITE univ(:'b) /\ FINITE univ(:'c) ==>
        fcp_cross (X DIFF s) t = (fcp_cross X t) DIFF (fcp_cross s t)

name: FCP_CROSS_DIFF'
statement:
!(s :'a['b] set) (X :'a['c] set) t.
        FINITE univ(:'b) /\ FINITE univ(:'c) ==>
        fcp_cross s (X DIFF t) = (fcp_cross s X) DIFF (fcp_cross s t)

name: FCP_SUBSET_CROSS
statement:
!(a :'a['b] set) b (c :'a['c] set) d.
        a SUBSET b /\ c SUBSET d ==> (fcp_cross a c) SUBSET (fcp_cross b d)

name: FCP_INTER_CROSS
statement:
!(a :'a['b] set) (b :'a['c] set) c d.
        FINITE univ(:'b) /\ FINITE univ(:'c) ==>
       (fcp_cross a b) INTER (fcp_cross c d) = fcp_cross (a INTER c) (b INTER d)

name: pair_operation_pair
statement:
pair_operation (pair$, :'a -> 'b -> 'a # 'b)
                   (FST :'a # 'b -> 'a) (SND :'a # 'b -> 'b)

name: pair_operation_FCP_CONCAT
statement:
FINITE univ(:'b) /\ FINITE univ(:'c) ==>
    pair_operation (FCP_CONCAT :'a['b] -> 'a['c] -> 'a['b + 'c])
                   (FCP_FST :'a['b + 'c] -> 'a['b])
                   (FCP_SND :'a['b + 'c] -> 'a['c])

name: IN_general_cross
statement:
!cons s A B. s IN (general_cross cons A B) <=>
                 ?a b. s = cons a b /\ a IN A /\ b IN B

name: CROSS_ALT
statement: !A B. A CROSS B = general_cross pair$, A B

name: fcp_cross_alt
statement: !A B. fcp_cross A B = general_cross FCP_CONCAT A B

name: IN_general_prod
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) s A B.
        s IN general_prod cons A B <=> ?a b. (s = general_cross cons a b) /\ a IN A /\ b IN B

name: prod_sets_alt
statement: !A B. prod_sets A B = general_prod pair$, A B

name: fcp_prod_alt
statement: !A B. fcp_prod A B = general_prod FCP_CONCAT A B

name: general_BIGUNION_CROSS
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) f (s :'index set) t.
       (general_cross cons (BIGUNION (IMAGE f s)) t =
        BIGUNION (IMAGE (\n. general_cross cons (f n) t) s))

name: general_CROSS_BIGUNION
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) f (s :'index set) t.
       (general_cross cons t (BIGUNION (IMAGE f s)) =
        BIGUNION (IMAGE (\n. general_cross cons t (f n)) s))

name: general_CROSS_DIFF
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) car cdr (X :'a set) s (t :'b set).
        pair_operation cons car cdr ==>
       (general_cross cons (X DIFF s) t =
        (general_cross cons X t) DIFF (general_cross cons s t))

name: general_CROSS_DIFF'
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) car cdr (s :'a set) (X :'b set) t.
        pair_operation cons car cdr ==>
       (general_cross cons s (X DIFF t) =
        (general_cross cons s X) DIFF (general_cross cons s t))

name: general_SUBSET_CROSS
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) (a :'a set) b (c :'b set) d.
        a SUBSET b /\ c SUBSET d ==>
        (general_cross cons a c) SUBSET (general_cross cons b d)

name: general_INTER_CROSS
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) car cdr (a :'a set) (b :'b set) c d.
        pair_operation cons car cdr ==>
       ((general_cross cons a b) INTER (general_cross cons c d) =
        general_cross cons (a INTER c) (b INTER d))

name: INDICATOR_FN_FCP_CROSS
statement:
!(s :'a['b] set) (t :'a['c] set) x y.
        FINITE univ(:'b) /\ FINITE univ(:'c) ==>
       (indicator_fn (fcp_cross s t) (FCP_CONCAT x y) =
        indicator_fn s x * indicator_fn t y)

name: indicator_fn_general_cross
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) car cdr (s :'a set) (t :'b set) x y.
        pair_operation cons car cdr ==>
       (indicator_fn (general_cross cons s t) (cons x y) =
        indicator_fn s x * indicator_fn t y)

name: sigma_algebra_prod_sigma
statement:
!a b. subset_class (space a) (subsets a) /\
          subset_class (space b) (subsets b) ==> sigma_algebra (fcp_sigma a b)

name: prod_sigma_alt
statement: !A B. prod_sigma A B = general_sigma pair$, A B

name: fcp_sigma_alt
statement: !A B. fcp_sigma A B = general_sigma FCP_CONCAT A B

name: sigma_algebra_general_sigma
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) A B.
        subset_class (space A) (subsets A) /\
        subset_class (space B) (subsets B) ==> sigma_algebra (general_sigma cons A B)

name: exhausting_sequence_general_cross
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) X Y A B f g.
       exhausting_sequence (X,A) f /\ exhausting_sequence (Y,B) g ==>
       exhausting_sequence (general_cross cons X Y,general_prod cons A B)
                           (\n. general_cross cons (f n) (g n))

name: exhausting_sequence_CROSS
statement:
!X Y A B f g.
       exhausting_sequence (X,A) f /\ exhausting_sequence (Y,B) g ==>
       exhausting_sequence (X CROSS Y,prod_sets A B) (\n. f n CROSS g n)

name: exhausting_sequence_cross
statement:
!X Y A B f g.
       exhausting_sequence (X,A) f /\ exhausting_sequence (Y,B) g ==>
       exhausting_sequence (fcp_cross X Y,fcp_prod A B) (\n. fcp_cross (f n) (g n))

name: general_sigma_of_generator
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) (car :'c -> 'a) (cdr :'c -> 'b) (X :'a set) (Y :'b set) E G.
        pair_operation cons car cdr /\
        subset_class X E /\ subset_class Y G /\
        has_exhausting_sequence (X,E) /\ has_exhausting_sequence (Y,G) ==>
       (general_sigma cons (X,E) (Y,G) = general_sigma cons (sigma X E) (sigma Y G))

name: PROD_SIGMA_OF_GENERATOR
statement:
!X Y E G. subset_class X E /\ subset_class Y G /\
              has_exhausting_sequence (X,E) /\
              has_exhausting_sequence (Y,G) ==>
             ((X,E) CROSS (Y,G) = (sigma X E) CROSS (sigma Y G))

name: prod_sigma_of_generator
statement:
!(X :'a['b] set) (Y :'a['c] set) E G.
        FINITE univ(:'b) /\ FINITE univ(:'c) /\
        subset_class X E /\ subset_class Y G /\
        has_exhausting_sequence (X,E) /\
        has_exhausting_sequence (Y,G) ==>
       (fcp_sigma (X,E) (Y,G) = fcp_sigma (sigma X E) (sigma Y G))

name: uniqueness_of_prod_measure_general
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) (car :'c -> 'a) (cdr :'c -> 'b)
     (X :'a set) (Y :'b set) E G A B u v m m'.
      pair_operation cons car cdr /\
      subset_class X E /\ subset_class Y G /\
      sigma_finite (X,E,u) /\ sigma_finite (Y,G,v) /\
     (!s t. s IN E /\ t IN E ==> s INTER t IN E) /\
     (!s t. s IN G /\ t IN G ==> s INTER t IN G) /\
     (A = sigma X E) /\ (B = sigma Y G) /\
      measure_space (X,subsets A,u) /\
      measure_space (Y,subsets B,v) /\
      measure_space (general_cross cons X Y,subsets (general_sigma cons A B),m) /\
      measure_space (general_cross cons X Y,subsets (general_sigma cons A B),m') /\
     (!s t. s IN E /\ t IN G ==> (m  (general_cross cons s t) = u s * v t)) /\
     (!s t. s IN E /\ t IN G ==> (m' (general_cross cons s t) = u s * v t)) ==>
      !x. x IN subsets (general_sigma cons A B) ==> (m x = m' x)

name: UNIQUENESS_OF_PROD_MEASURE
statement:
!(X :'a set) (Y :'b set) E G A B u v m m'.
      subset_class X E /\ subset_class Y G /\
      sigma_finite (X,E,u) /\ sigma_finite (Y,G,v) /\
     (!s t. s IN E /\ t IN E ==> s INTER t IN E) /\
     (!s t. s IN G /\ t IN G ==> s INTER t IN G) /\
     (A = sigma X E) /\ (B = sigma Y G) /\
      measure_space (X,subsets A,u) /\
      measure_space (Y,subsets B,v) /\
      measure_space (X CROSS Y,subsets (A CROSS B),m) /\
      measure_space (X CROSS Y,subsets (A CROSS B),m') /\
     (!s t. s IN E /\ t IN G ==> (m  (s CROSS t) = u s * v t)) /\
     (!s t. s IN E /\ t IN G ==> (m' (s CROSS t) = u s * v t)) ==>
      !x. x IN subsets (A CROSS B) ==> (m x = m' x)

name: uniqueness_of_prod_measure
statement:
!(X :'a['b] set) (Y :'a['c] set) E G A B u v m m'.
      FINITE univ(:'b) /\ FINITE univ(:'c) /\
      subset_class X E /\ subset_class Y G /\
      sigma_finite (X,E,u) /\ sigma_finite (Y,G,v) /\
     (!s t. s IN E /\ t IN E ==> s INTER t IN E) /\
     (!s t. s IN G /\ t IN G ==> s INTER t IN G) /\
     (A = sigma X E) /\ (B = sigma Y G) /\
      measure_space (X,subsets A,u) /\
      measure_space (Y,subsets B,v) /\
      measure_space (fcp_cross X Y,subsets (fcp_sigma A B),m) /\
      measure_space (fcp_cross X Y,subsets (fcp_sigma A B),m') /\
     (!s t. s IN E /\ t IN G ==> (m  (fcp_cross s t) = u s * v t)) /\
     (!s t. s IN E /\ t IN G ==> (m' (fcp_cross s t) = u s * v t)) ==>
      !x. x IN subsets (fcp_sigma A B) ==> (m x = m' x)

name: uniqueness_of_prod_measure_general'
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) (car :'c -> 'a) (cdr :'c -> 'b)
     (X :'a set) (Y :'b set) A B u v m m'.
      pair_operation cons car cdr /\
      sigma_finite_measure_space (X,A,u) /\
      sigma_finite_measure_space (Y,B,v) /\
      measure_space (general_cross cons X Y,subsets (general_sigma cons (X,A) (Y,B)),m) /\
      measure_space (general_cross cons X Y,subsets (general_sigma cons (X,A) (Y,B)),m') /\
     (!s t. s IN A /\ t IN B ==> (m  (general_cross cons s t) = u s * v t)) /\
     (!s t. s IN A /\ t IN B ==> (m' (general_cross cons s t) = u s * v t)) ==>
      !x. x IN subsets (general_sigma cons (X,A) (Y,B)) ==> (m x = m' x)

name: UNIQUENESS_OF_PROD_MEASURE'
statement:
!(X :'a set) (Y :'b set) A B u v m m'.
      sigma_finite_measure_space (X,A,u) /\
      sigma_finite_measure_space (Y,B,v) /\
      measure_space (X CROSS Y,subsets ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)),m) /\
      measure_space (X CROSS Y,subsets ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)),m') /\
     (!s t. s IN A /\ t IN B ==> (m  (s CROSS t) = u s * v t)) /\
     (!s t. s IN A /\ t IN B ==> (m' (s CROSS t) = u s * v t)) ==>
      !x. x IN subsets ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)) ==> (m x = m' x)

name: uniqueness_of_prod_measure'
statement:
!(X :'a['b] set) (Y :'a['c] set) A B u v m m'.
      FINITE univ(:'b) /\ FINITE univ(:'c) /\
      sigma_finite_measure_space (X,A,u) /\
      sigma_finite_measure_space (Y,B,v) /\
      measure_space (fcp_cross X Y,subsets (fcp_sigma (X,A) (Y,B)),m) /\
      measure_space (fcp_cross X Y,subsets (fcp_sigma (X,A) (Y,B)),m') /\
     (!s t. s IN A /\ t IN B ==> (m  (fcp_cross s t) = u s * v t)) /\
     (!s t. s IN A /\ t IN B ==> (m' (fcp_cross s t) = u s * v t)) ==>
      !x. x IN subsets (fcp_sigma (X,A) (Y,B)) ==> (m x = m' x)

name: existence_of_prod_measure_general
statement:
!(cons :'a -> 'b -> 'c) car cdr (X :'a set) (Y :'b set) A B u v m0.
       pair_operation cons car cdr /\
       sigma_finite_measure_space (X,A,u) /\
       sigma_finite_measure_space (Y,B,v) /\
       (!s t. s IN A /\ t IN B ==> (m0 (general_cross cons s t) = u s * v t)) ==>
       (!s. s IN subsets (general_sigma cons (X,A) (Y,B)) ==>
           (!x. x IN X ==> (\y. indicator_fn s (cons x y)) IN measurable (Y,B) Borel) /\
           (!y. y IN Y ==> (\x. indicator_fn s (cons x y)) IN measurable (X,A) Borel) /\
           (\y. pos_fn_integral (X,A,u)
                  (\x. indicator_fn s (cons x y))) IN measurable (Y,B) Borel /\
           (\x. pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v)
                  (\y. indicator_fn s (cons x y))) IN measurable (X,A) Borel) /\
       ?m. sigma_finite_measure_space (general_cross cons X Y,
                                       subsets (general_sigma cons (X,A) (Y,B)),m) /\
           (!s. s IN (general_prod cons A B) ==> (m s = m0 s)) /\
           (!s. s IN subsets (general_sigma cons (X,A) (Y,B)) ==>
               (m s = pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v)
                        (\y. pos_fn_integral (X,A,u) (\x. indicator_fn s (cons x y)))) /\
               (m s = pos_fn_integral (X,A,u)
                        (\x. pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v) (\y. indicator_fn s (cons x y)))))

name: EXISTENCE_OF_PROD_MEASURE
statement:
!(X :'a set) (Y :'b set) A B u v m0.
       sigma_finite_measure_space (X,A,u) /\
       sigma_finite_measure_space (Y,B,v) /\
       (!s t. s IN A /\ t IN B ==> (m0 (s CROSS t) = u s * v t)) ==>
       (!s. s IN subsets ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)) ==>
           (!x. x IN X ==> (\y. indicator_fn s (x,y)) IN measurable (Y,B) Borel) /\
           (!y. y IN Y ==> (\x. indicator_fn s (x,y)) IN measurable (X,A) Borel) /\
           (\y. pos_fn_integral (X,A,u) (\x. indicator_fn s (x,y))) IN measurable (Y,B) Borel /\
           (\x. pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v) (\y. indicator_fn s (x,y))) IN measurable (X,A) Borel) /\
       ?m. sigma_finite_measure_space (X CROSS Y,subsets ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)),m) /\
           (!s. s IN (prod_sets A B) ==> (m s = m0 s)) /\
           (!s. s IN subsets ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)) ==>
               (m s = pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v)
                        (\y. pos_fn_integral (X,A,u) (\x. indicator_fn s (x,y)))) /\
               (m s = pos_fn_integral (X,A,u)
                        (\x. pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v) (\y. indicator_fn s (x,y)))))

name: EXISTENCE_OF_PROD_MEASURE'
statement:
!(X :'a set) (Y :'b set) A B u v m0.
       sigma_finite_measure_space (X,A,u) /\
       sigma_finite_measure_space (Y,B,v) /\
       (!s t. s IN A /\ t IN B ==> (m0 (s CROSS t) = u s * v t)) ==>
       (!s. s IN subsets ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)) ==>
           (!x. x IN X ==> (\y. indicator_fn s (x,y)) IN measurable (Y,B) Borel) /\
           (!y. y IN Y ==> (\x. indicator_fn s (x,y)) IN measurable (X,A) Borel) /\
           (\y. integral (X,A,u) (\x. indicator_fn s (x,y))) IN measurable (Y,B) Borel /\
           (\x. integral (Y,B,v) (\y. indicator_fn s (x,y))) IN measurable (X,A) Borel) /\
       ?m. sigma_finite_measure_space (X CROSS Y,subsets ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)),m) /\
           (!s. s IN (prod_sets A B) ==> (m s = m0 s)) /\
           (!s. s IN subsets ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)) ==>
               (m s = integral (Y,B,v) (\y. integral (X,A,u) (\x. indicator_fn s (x,y)))) /\
               (m s = integral (X,A,u) (\x. integral (Y,B,v) (\y. indicator_fn s (x,y)))))

name: existence_of_prod_measure
statement:
!(X :'a['b] set) (Y :'a['c] set) A B u v m0.
       FINITE univ(:'b) /\ FINITE univ(:'c) /\
       sigma_finite_measure_space (X,A,u) /\
       sigma_finite_measure_space (Y,B,v) /\
       (!s t. s IN A /\ t IN B ==> (m0 (fcp_cross s t) = u s * v t)) ==>
       (!s. s IN subsets (fcp_sigma (X,A) (Y,B)) ==>
           (!x. x IN X ==> (\y. indicator_fn s (FCP_CONCAT x y)) IN measurable (Y,B) Borel) /\
           (!y. y IN Y ==> (\x. indicator_fn s (FCP_CONCAT x y)) IN measurable (X,A) Borel) /\
           (\y. pos_fn_integral (X,A,u)
                  (\x. indicator_fn s (FCP_CONCAT x y))) IN measurable (Y,B) Borel /\
           (\x. pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v)
                  (\y. indicator_fn s (FCP_CONCAT x y))) IN measurable (X,A) Borel) /\
       ?m. sigma_finite_measure_space (fcp_cross X Y,subsets (fcp_sigma (X,A) (Y,B)),m) /\
           (!s. s IN (fcp_prod A B) ==> (m s = m0 s)) /\
           (!s. s IN subsets (fcp_sigma (X,A) (Y,B)) ==>
               (m s = pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v)
                        (\y. pos_fn_integral (X,A,u) (\x. indicator_fn s (FCP_CONCAT x y)))) /\
               (m s = pos_fn_integral (X,A,u)
                        (\x. pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v) (\y. indicator_fn s (FCP_CONCAT x y)))))

name: measure_space_prod_measure
statement:
!m1 m2. sigma_finite_measure_space m1 /\
            sigma_finite_measure_space m2 ==> measure_space (m1 CROSS m2)

name: lborel_2d_prod_measure
statement:
!s. s IN measurable_sets lborel_2d ==>
        measure lborel_2d s = measure (lborel CROSS lborel) s

name: TONELLI
statement:
!(X :'a set) (Y :'b set) A B u v f.
        sigma_finite_measure_space (X,A,u) /\
        sigma_finite_measure_space (Y,B,v) /\
        f IN measurable ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)) Borel /\
        (!s. s IN X CROSS Y ==> 0 <= f s)
       ==>
        (!y. y IN Y ==> (\x. f (x,y)) IN measurable (X,A) Borel) /\
        (!x. x IN X ==> (\y. f (x,y)) IN measurable (Y,B) Borel) /\
        (\x. pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v) (\y. f (x,y))) IN measurable (X,A) Borel /\
        (\y. pos_fn_integral (X,A,u) (\x. f (x,y))) IN measurable (Y,B) Borel /\
        (pos_fn_integral ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) f =
         pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v) (\y. pos_fn_integral (X,A,u) (\x. f (x,y)))) /\
        (pos_fn_integral ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) f =
         pos_fn_integral (X,A,u) (\x. pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v) (\y. f (x,y))))

name: FUBINI
statement:
!(X :'a set) (Y :'b set) A B u v f.
        sigma_finite_measure_space (X,A,u) /\
        sigma_finite_measure_space (Y,B,v) /\
        f IN measurable ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)) Borel /\
     
       (pos_fn_integral ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) (abs o f) <> PosInf \/
        pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v)
          (\y. pos_fn_integral (X,A,u) (\x. (abs o f) (x,y))) <> PosInf \/
        pos_fn_integral (X,A,u)
          (\x. pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v) (\y. (abs o f) (x,y))) <> PosInf)
       ==>
     
        pos_fn_integral ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) (abs o f) <> PosInf /\
        pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v)
          (\y. pos_fn_integral (X,A,u) (\x. (abs o f) (x,y))) <> PosInf /\
        pos_fn_integral (X,A,u)
          (\x. pos_fn_integral (Y,B,v) (\y. (abs o f) (x,y))) <> PosInf /\
        integrable ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) f /\
       (AE y::(Y,B,v). integrable (X,A,u) (\x. f (x,y))) /\
       (AE x::(X,A,u). integrable (Y,B,v) (\y. f (x,y))) /\
        integrable (X,A,u) (\x. integral (Y,B,v) (\y. f (x,y))) /\
        integrable (Y,B,v) (\y. integral (X,A,u) (\x. f (x,y))) /\
       (integral ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) f =
        integral (Y,B,v) (\y. integral (X,A,u) (\x. f (x,y)))) /\
       (integral ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) f =
        integral (X,A,u) (\x. integral (Y,B,v) (\y. f (x,y))))

name: FUBINI'
statement:
!(X :'a set) (Y :'b set) A B u v f.
        sigma_finite_measure_space (X,A,u) /\
        sigma_finite_measure_space (Y,B,v) /\
        f IN measurable ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)) Borel /\
     
       (integral ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) (abs o f) <> PosInf \/
        integral (Y,B,v) (\y. integral (X,A,u) (\x. (abs o f) (x,y))) <> PosInf \/
        integral (X,A,u) (\x. integral (Y,B,v) (\y. (abs o f) (x,y))) <> PosInf)
       ==>
     
        integral ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) (abs o f) <> PosInf /\
        integral (Y,B,v) (\y. integral (X,A,u) (\x. (abs o f) (x,y))) <> PosInf /\
        integral (X,A,u) (\x. integral (Y,B,v) (\y. (abs o f) (x,y))) <> PosInf /\
        integrable ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) f /\
       (AE y::(Y,B,v). integrable (X,A,u) (\x. f (x,y))) /\
       (AE x::(X,A,u). integrable (Y,B,v) (\y. f (x,y))) /\
        integrable (X,A,u) (\x. integral (Y,B,v) (\y. f (x,y))) /\
        integrable (Y,B,v) (\y. integral (X,A,u) (\x. f (x,y))) /\
       (integral ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) f =
        integral (Y,B,v) (\y. integral (X,A,u) (\x. f (x,y)))) /\
       (integral ((X,A,u) CROSS (Y,B,v)) f =
        integral (X,A,u) (\x. integral (Y,B,v) (\y. f (x,y))))

name: IN_MEASURABLE_BOREL_FROM_PROD_SIGMA
statement:
!X Y A B f. sigma_algebra (X,A) /\ sigma_algebra (Y,B) /\
                f IN measurable ((X,A) CROSS (Y,B)) Borel ==>
               (!y. y IN Y ==> (\x. f (x,y)) IN measurable (X,A) Borel) /\
               (!x. x IN X ==> (\y. f (x,y)) IN measurable (Y,B) Borel)

name: SIGMA_FINITE_FILTERED_MEASURE_SPACE
statement:
!m a. sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a ==>
          !n. sigma_finite (m_space m,subsets (a n),measure m)

name: sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space_alt_all
statement:
!m a. sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a <=>
          measure_space m /\ filtration (m_space m,measurable_sets m) a /\
          !n. sigma_finite (m_space m,subsets (a n),measure m)

name: filtration_from_measurable_functions
statement:
!m X A. measure_space m /\
           (!n. X n IN Borel_measurable (measurable_space m)) /\
           (!n. A n = sigma (m_space m) (\n. Borel) X (count1 n)) ==>
            filtration (measurable_space m) A

name: MARTINGALE_EQ_SUB_SUPER
statement: !m a u. martingale m a u <=> sub_martingale m a u /\ super_martingale m a u

name: martingale_alt
statement:
!m a u.
      martingale m a u <=>
      sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a /\ (!n. integrable m (u n)) /\
      !i j s. i <= j /\ s IN subsets (a i) ==>
             (integral m (\x. u i x * indicator_fn s x) =
              integral m (\x. u j x * indicator_fn s x))

name: super_martingale_alt
statement:
!m a u.
      super_martingale m a u <=>
      sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a /\ (!n. integrable m (u n)) /\
      !i j s. i <= j /\ s IN subsets (a i) ==>
             (integral m (\x. u j x * indicator_fn s x) <=
              integral m (\x. u i x * indicator_fn s x))

name: sub_martingale_alt
statement:
!m a u.
      sub_martingale m a u <=>
      sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a /\ (!n. integrable m (u n)) /\
      !i j s. i <= j /\ s IN subsets (a i) ==>
             (integral m (\x. u i x * indicator_fn s x) <=
              integral m (\x. u j x * indicator_fn s x))

name: martingale_alt_generator
statement:
!m a u g. (!n. a n = sigma (m_space m) (g n)) /\
             (!n. has_exhausting_sequence (m_space m,g n)) /\
             (!n s. s IN (g n) ==> measure m s < PosInf) /\
             (!n s t. s IN (g n) /\ t IN (g n) ==> s INTER t IN (g n)) ==>
     (martingale m a u <=>
      filtered_measure_space m a /\ (!n. integrable m (u n)) /\
      !i j s. i <= j /\ s IN (g i) ==>
             (integral m (\x. u i x * indicator_fn s x) =
              integral m (\x. u j x * indicator_fn s x)))

name: sub_martingale_alt_generator
statement:
!m a u g. (!n. a n = sigma (m_space m) (g n)) /\
             (!n. has_exhausting_sequence (m_space m,g n)) /\
             (!n s. s IN (g n) ==> measure m s < PosInf) /\
             (!n. semiring (m_space m,g n)) ==>
     (sub_martingale m a u <=>
      filtered_measure_space m a /\ (!n. integrable m (u n)) /\
      !i j s. i <= j /\ s IN (g i) ==>
             (integral m (\x. u i x * indicator_fn s x) <=
              integral m (\x. u j x * indicator_fn s x)))

name: super_martingale_alt_generator
statement:
!m a u g. (!n. a n = sigma (m_space m) (g n)) /\
             (!n. has_exhausting_sequence (m_space m,g n)) /\
             (!n s. s IN (g n) ==> measure m s < PosInf) /\
             (!n. semiring (m_space m,g n)) ==>
     (super_martingale m a u <=>
      filtered_measure_space m a /\ (!n. integrable m (u n)) /\
      !i j s. i <= j /\ s IN (g i) ==>
             (integral m (\x. u j x * indicator_fn s x) <=
              integral m (\x. u i x * indicator_fn s x)))

name: lp_space_alt_finite
statement:
!p m f. 0 < p /\ p <> PosInf ==>
           (f IN lp_space p m <=>
            f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            pos_fn_integral m (\x. (abs (f x)) powr p) <> PosInf)

name: lp_space_alt_finite'
statement:
!p m f. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ p <> PosInf ==>
           (f IN lp_space p m <=>
            f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
            integral m (\x. (abs (f x)) powr p) <> PosInf)

name: lp_space_alt_infinite
statement:
!m f. measure_space m ==>
         (f IN lp_space PosInf m <=>
          f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
          ?c. 0 < c /\ c <> PosInf /\ AE x::m. abs (f x) < c)

name: L1_space_alt_integrable
statement: !m f. measure_space m ==> (f IN L1_space m <=> integrable m f)

name: L2_space_alt_integrable_square
statement:
!m f. measure_space m ==>
         (f IN L2_space m <=>
          f IN Borel_measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) /\
          integrable m (\x. (f x) pow 2))

name: seminorm_normal
statement:
!p m f. 0 < p /\ p <> PosInf ==>
            seminorm p m f = (pos_fn_integral m (\x. (abs (f x)) powr p)) powr (inv p)

name: seminorm_infty
statement:
!m f. seminorm PosInf m f =
          inf {c | 0 < c /\ measure m {x | x IN m_space m /\ c <= abs (f x)} = 0}

name: seminorm_infty_alt
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel ==>
          seminorm PosInf m f = inf {c | 0 < c /\ AE x::m. abs (f x) < c}

name: seminorm_pos
statement: !p m f. 0 < p ==> 0 <= seminorm p m f

name: seminorm_one
statement: !m f. measure_space m ==> seminorm 1 m f = pos_fn_integral m (abs o f)

name: seminorm_two
statement:
!m f. measure_space m ==>
          seminorm 2 m f = sqrt (pos_fn_integral m (\x. (f x) pow 2))

name: seminorm_not_infty
statement:
!p m f. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ f IN lp_space p m ==>
            seminorm p m f <> PosInf /\ seminorm p m f <> NegInf

name: seminorm_infty_AE_bound
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ f IN Borel_measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m)
      ==> (AE x::m. abs (f x) <= seminorm PosInf m f)

name: seminorm_powr
statement:
!p m f. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ p <> PosInf ==>
           (seminorm p m f) powr p = pos_fn_integral m (\x. (abs (f x)) powr p)

name: seminorm_eq_0
statement:
!p m f. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ f IN Borel_measurable (measurable_space m) ==>
           (seminorm p m f = 0 <=> AE x::m. f x = 0)

name: lp_space_alt_seminorm
statement:
!p m f. measure_space m /\ 0 < p ==>
           (f IN lp_space p m <=>
            f IN Borel_measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) /\
            seminorm p m f < PosInf)

name: Hoelder_inequality_lemma
statement:
!m u v. measure_space m /\ u IN lp_space PosInf m /\ v IN L1_space m ==>
            integrable m (\x. u x * v x) /\
            integral m (\x. abs (u x * v x)) <= seminorm PosInf m u * seminorm 1 m v

name: Hoelder_inequality
statement:
!m u v p q. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ 0 < q /\ inv(p) + inv(q) = 1 /\
                u IN lp_space p m /\ v IN lp_space q m
            ==> integrable m (\x. u x * v x) /\
                integral m (\x. abs (u x * v x)) <= seminorm p m u * seminorm q m v

name: Hoelder_inequality'
statement:
!m u v p q. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ 0 < q /\ inv(p) + inv(q) = 1 /\
                u IN lp_space p m /\ v IN lp_space q m
            ==> pos_fn_integral m (\x. abs (u x * v x)) <= seminorm p m u * seminorm q m v

name: Cauchy_Schwarz_inequality
statement:
!m u v. measure_space m /\ u IN L2_space m /\ v IN L2_space m ==>
            integrable m (\x. u x * v x) /\
            integral m (\x. abs (u x * v x)) <= seminorm 2 m u * seminorm 2 m v

name: Cauchy_Schwarz_inequality'
statement:
!m u v. measure_space m /\ u IN L2_space m /\ v IN L2_space m
        ==> pos_fn_integral m (\x. abs (u x * v x)) <=
            sqrt (pos_fn_integral m (\x. (u x) pow 2) *
                  pos_fn_integral m (\x. (v x) pow 2))

name: lp_space_add
statement:
!p m u v. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ u IN lp_space p m /\ v IN lp_space p m
          ==> (\x. u x + v x) IN lp_space p m

name: Minkowski_inequality
statement:
!p m u v. measure_space m /\ 1 <= p /\ u IN lp_space p m /\ v IN lp_space p m
          ==> (\x. u x + v x) IN lp_space p m /\
              seminorm p m (\x. u x + v x) <= seminorm p m u + seminorm p m v

name: Minkowski_inequality'
statement:
!p m u v. measure_space m /\ 1 <= p /\ u IN lp_space p m /\ v IN lp_space p m
          ==> seminorm p m (\x. u x + v x) <= seminorm p m u + seminorm p m v

name: seminorm_cong_AE
statement:
!m u v p. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\
              u IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
              v IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
             (AE x::m. u x = v x) ==> seminorm p m u = seminorm p m v

name: seminorm_cong
statement:
!m u v p. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\
             (u IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel \/
              v IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel) /\
             (!x. x IN m_space m ==> u x = v x) ==> seminorm p m u = seminorm p m v

name: lp_space_cong
statement:
!p m u v. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ (!x. x IN m_space m ==> u x = v x) ==>
             (u IN lp_space p m <=> v IN lp_space p m)

name: lp_space_cong_AE
statement:
!p m u v. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\
              u IN Borel_measurable (measurable_space m) /\
              v IN Borel_measurable (measurable_space m) /\
             (AE x::m. u x = v x) ==> (u IN lp_space p m <=> v IN lp_space p m)

name: seminorm_zero
statement: !p m. measure_space m /\ 0 < p ==> seminorm p m (\x. 0) = 0

name: seminorm_cmul
statement:
!p m u r. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\
              u IN measurable (measurable_space m) Borel ==>
              seminorm p m (\x. Normal r * u x) = Normal (abs r) * seminorm p m u

name: lp_space_cmul
statement:
!p m u r. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ u IN lp_space p m ==>
              (\x. Normal r * u x) IN lp_space p m

name: lp_space_add_cmul
statement:
!p m u v a b. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ u IN lp_space p m /\ v IN lp_space p m
              ==> (\x. Normal a * u x + Normal b * v x) IN lp_space p m

name: lp_space_AE_normal
statement:
!p m f. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ f IN lp_space p m ==>
            AE x::m. f x <> PosInf /\ f x <> NegInf

name: lp_space_sub
statement:
!p m u v. measure_space m /\ 0 < p /\ u IN lp_space p m /\ v IN lp_space p m
          ==> (\x. u x - v x) IN lp_space p m

name: sub_sigma_algebra_def
statement:
sub_sigma_algebra a b =
      (sigma_algebra a /\ sigma_algebra b /\ (space a = space b) /\
       (subsets a) SUBSET (subsets b))

name: filtration_def
statement:
filtration A (a :num -> 'a algebra) =
     ((!n. sub_sigma_algebra (a n) A) /\
      (!i j. i <= j ==> subsets (a i) SUBSET subsets (a j)))

name: filtered_measure_space_def
statement:
filtered_measure_space m a =
      (measure_space m /\ filtration (m_space m,measurable_sets m) a)

name: sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space_def
statement:
sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a =
      (filtered_measure_space m a /\ sigma_finite (m_space m,subsets (a 0),measure m))

name: martingale_def
statement:
martingale m a u =
     (sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a /\ (!n. integrable m (u n)) /\
      !n s. s IN (subsets (a n)) ==>
           (integral m (\x. u (SUC n) x * indicator_fn s x) =
            integral m (\x. u n x * indicator_fn s x)))

name: super_martingale_def
statement:
super_martingale m a u =
     (sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a /\ (!n. integrable m (u n)) /\
      !n s. s IN (subsets (a n)) ==>
           (integral m (\x. u (SUC n) x * indicator_fn s x) <=
            integral m (\x. u n x * indicator_fn s x)))

name: sub_martingale_def
statement:
sub_martingale m a u =
     (sigma_finite_filtered_measure_space m a /\ (!n. integrable m (u n)) /\
      !n s. s IN (subsets (a n)) ==>
           (integral m (\x. u n x * indicator_fn s x) <=
            integral m (\x. u (SUC n) x * indicator_fn s x)))

name: prod_measure_def
statement:
prod_measure m1 m2 =
      \s. pos_fn_integral m2 (\y. pos_fn_integral m1 (\x. indicator_fn s (x,y)))

name: prod_measure_space_def
statement:
prod_measure_space m1 m2 =
      (m_space m1 CROSS m_space m2,
       subsets (prod_sigma (m_space m1,measurable_sets m1)
                           (m_space m2,measurable_sets m2)),
       prod_measure m1 m2)

name: lp_space_def
statement:
lp_space p m =
      {f | f IN measurable (m_space m,measurable_sets m) Borel /\
           if p = PosInf then
             ?c. 0 < c /\ c <> PosInf /\
                 measure m {x | x IN m_space m /\ c <= abs (f x)} = 0
           else
             pos_fn_integral m (\x. (abs (f x)) powr p) <> PosInf}

name: seminorm_def
statement:
seminorm p m f =
    if p = PosInf then
       inf {c | 0 < c /\ measure m {x | x IN m_space m /\ c <= abs (f x)} = 0}
    else
      (pos_fn_integral m (\x. (abs (f x)) powr p)) powr (inv p)

name: COUNTABLY_SUBADDITIVE_SUBADDITIVE
statement:
!m. {} IN measurable_sets m /\ positive m /\ countably_subadditive m ==>
        subadditive m

name: COUNTABLY_ADDITIVE_FINITE_ADDITIVE
statement:
!m. {} IN measurable_sets m /\ positive m /\ countably_additive m ==>
        finite_additive m

name: COUNTABLY_SUBADDITIVE_FINITE_SUBADDITIVE
statement:
!m. {} IN measurable_sets m /\ positive m /\ countably_subadditive m ==>
        finite_subadditive m

name: MEASURE_INCREASING
statement:
!m s t. measure_space m /\ s SUBSET t /\
            s IN measurable_sets m /\ t IN measurable_sets m ==>
            measure m s <= measure m t

name: MEASURE_POSITIVE
statement: !m s. measure_space m /\ s IN measurable_sets m ==> 0 <= measure m s

name: measure_space_eq
statement:
!m1 m2. measure_space m1 /\
           (m_space m2 = m_space m1) /\
           (measurable_sets m2 = measurable_sets m1) /\
           (!s. s IN measurable_sets m2 ==> (measure m2 s = measure m1 s)) ==>
            measure_space m2

name: measure_space_eq'
statement: !m1 m2. measure_space m1 /\ measure_space_eq m1 m2 ==> measure_space m2

name: measure_space_eq_comm
statement: !m1 m2. measure_space_eq m1 m2 ==> measure_space_eq m2 m1

name: measure_space_eq_trans
statement:
!m1 m2 m3. measure_space_eq m1 m2 /\ measure_space_eq m2 m3 ==>
               measure_space_eq m1 m3

name: MEASURE_SPACE_MSPACE_MEASURABLE
statement: !m. measure_space m ==> (m_space m) IN measurable_sets m

name: MEASURE_SPACE_COMPL
statement:
!m s. measure_space m /\ s IN measurable_sets m ==>
          (m_space m) DIFF s IN measurable_sets m

name: MEASURE_SPACE_SUBSET_MSPACE
statement: !m s. measure_space m /\ s IN measurable_sets m ==> s SUBSET m_space m

name: MEASURE_SPACE_IN_MSPACE
statement: !m s. measure_space m /\ s IN measurable_sets m ==> (!x. x IN s ==> x IN m_space m)

name: MEASURE_COUNTABLE_INCREASING
statement:
!m s f.
       measure_space m /\ f IN (UNIV -> measurable_sets m) /\
       (f 0 = {}) /\ (!n. f n SUBSET f (SUC n)) /\
       (s = BIGUNION (IMAGE f UNIV)) ==>
       (sup (IMAGE (measure m o f) UNIV) = measure m s)

name: MEASURE_SPACE_REDUCE
statement: !m. (m_space m, measurable_sets m, measure m) = m

name: MEASURE_PRESERVING_LIFT
statement:
!m1 m2 a f.
       measure_space m1 /\ measure_space m2 /\
       measure_space (m_space m2,a,measure m2) /\
       measure m1 (m_space m1) <> PosInf /\
       measure m2 (m_space m2) <> PosInf /\
      (measurable_sets m2 = subsets (sigma (m_space m2) a)) /\
       f IN measure_preserving m1 (m_space m2,a,measure m2) ==>
       f IN measure_preserving m1 m2

name: MEASURE_PRESERVING_UP_SIGMA
statement:
!m1 m2 a. subset_class (m_space m1) a /\
       (measurable_sets m1 = subsets (sigma (m_space m1) a)) ==>
       measure_preserving (m_space m1, a, measure m1) m2 SUBSET measure_preserving m1 m2

name: finite_additivity_sufficient_for_finite_spaces
statement:
!s m. sigma_algebra s /\ FINITE (space s) /\
          positive (space s, subsets s, m) /\
          additive (space s, subsets s, m) ==>
          measure_space (space s, subsets s, m)

name: exhausting_sequence_alt
statement:
!a f. exhausting_sequence a f <=>
         f IN (univ(:num) -> subsets a) /\ (!m n. m <= n ==> f m SUBSET f n) /\
         BIGUNION (IMAGE f univ(:num)) = space a

name: sigma_finite_def
statement:
!m. sigma_finite m <=>
        ?f :num -> 'a set.
           f IN (UNIV -> measurable_sets m) /\
           (!n. f n SUBSET f (SUC n)) /\
           (BIGUNION (IMAGE f UNIV) = m_space m) /\
           (!n. measure m (f n) < PosInf)

name: sigma_finite_has_exhausting_sequence
statement: !sp sts u. sigma_finite (sp,sts,u) ==> has_exhausting_sequence (sp,sts)

name: sigma_finite_alt_exhausting_sequence
statement:
!m. sigma_finite m <=>
        ?f. exhausting_sequence (m_space m,measurable_sets m) f /\
            !n. measure m (f n) < PosInf

name: countable_covers_def
statement:
!sts. countable_covers (sts :'a set set) =
          \a. {f | f IN (univ(:num) -> sts) /\ a SUBSET (BIGUNION (IMAGE f UNIV))}

name: SEMIRING_PREMEASURE_INCREASING
statement: !m. semiring (m_space m, measurable_sets m) /\ premeasure m ==> increasing m

name: RING_ADDITIVE_STRONG_ADDITIVE
statement:
!m s t. ring (m_space m, measurable_sets m) /\ additive m /\ positive m /\
            s IN measurable_sets m /\ t IN measurable_sets m ==>
           (measure m (s UNION t) + measure m (s INTER t) = measure m s + measure m t)

name: RING_PREMEASURE_COUNTABLE_INCREASING
statement:
!m s f.
       ring (m_space m, measurable_sets m) /\ premeasure m /\
       f IN (UNIV -> measurable_sets m) /\
       (f 0 = {}) /\ (!n. f n SUBSET f (SUC n)) /\
       (s = BIGUNION (IMAGE f UNIV)) /\ s IN measurable_sets m ==>
       (sup (IMAGE (measure m o f) UNIV) = measure m s)

name: RING_ADDITIVE_SUBADDITIVE
statement:
!m. ring (m_space m, measurable_sets m) /\ positive m /\ additive m ==>
        subadditive m

name: RING_ADDITIVE_FINITE_ADDITIVE
statement:
!m. ring (m_space m, measurable_sets m) /\ positive m /\ additive m ==>
        finite_additive m

name: RING_SUBADDITIVE_FINITE_SUBADDITIVE
statement:
!m. ring (m_space m, measurable_sets m) /\ positive m /\
        subadditive m ==> finite_subadditive m

name: RING_PREMEASURE_COUNTABLY_SUBADDITIVE
statement:
!m. ring (m_space m, measurable_sets m) /\ premeasure m ==>
        countably_subadditive m

name: RING_ADDITIVE_INCREASING
statement:
!m. ring (m_space m, measurable_sets m) /\ positive m /\ additive m ==>
        increasing m

name: RING_ADDITIVE_EVERYTHING
statement:
!m. ring (m_space m, measurable_sets m) /\ positive m /\ additive m ==>
        finite_additive m /\ increasing m /\
        subadditive m /\ finite_subadditive m

name: MEASURE_SPACE_RESTRICTION
statement:
!sp sts m sub. measure_space (sp,sts,m) /\ sub SUBSET sts /\ sigma_algebra (sp,sub) ==>
                   measure_space (sp,sub,m)

name: MEASURE_SPACE_RESTRICTION'
statement:
!m sts. measure_space m /\ sts SUBSET (measurable_sets m) /\
           sigma_algebra (m_space m,sts) ==>
           measure_space (m_space m,sts,measure m)

name: OUTER_MEASURE_CONSTRUCTION
statement:
!sp sts m u. subset_class sp sts /\ {} IN sts /\ positive (sp,sts,m) /\
                 (u = outer_measure m (countable_covers sts)) ==>
         outer_measure_space (sp,POW sp,u) /\ (!x. x IN sts ==> u x <= m x) /\
         measure_space (sp,caratheodory_sets sp u,u) /\
         !v. outer_measure_space (sp,POW sp,v) /\ (!x. x IN sts ==> v x <= m x) ==>
             !x. x SUBSET sp ==> v x <= u x

name: SEMIRING_FINITE_ADDITIVE_EXTENSION
statement:
!m0. semiring (m_space m0, measurable_sets m0) /\
         positive m0 /\ finite_additive m0 ==>
         ?m. ((m_space m, measurable_sets m) =
               smallest_ring (m_space m0) (measurable_sets m0)) /\
             (!s. s IN measurable_sets m0 ==> (measure m s = measure m0 s)) /\
             positive m /\ additive m

name: SEMIRING_PREMEASURE_EXTENSION
statement:
!m0. semiring (m_space m0, measurable_sets m0) /\ premeasure m0 ==>
         ?m. ((m_space m, measurable_sets m) =
              smallest_ring (m_space m0) (measurable_sets m0)) /\
             (!s. s IN measurable_sets m0 ==> (measure m s = measure m0 s)) /\
             premeasure m

name: CARATHEODORY_SEMIRING
statement:
!m0. semiring (m_space m0, measurable_sets m0) /\ premeasure m0 ==>
         ?m. (!s. s IN measurable_sets m0 ==> (measure m s = measure m0 s)) /\
             ((m_space m, measurable_sets m) =
              sigma (m_space m0) (measurable_sets m0)) /\ measure_space m

name: CARATHEODORY_RING
statement:
!m0. ring (m_space m0, measurable_sets m0) /\
         positive m0 /\ countably_additive m0 ==>
         ?m. (!s. s IN measurable_sets m0 ==> (measure m s = measure m0 s)) /\
             ((m_space m, measurable_sets m) =
              sigma (m_space m0) (measurable_sets m0)) /\ measure_space m

name: CARATHEODORY
statement:
!m0. algebra (m_space m0, measurable_sets m0) /\
         positive m0 /\ countably_additive m0 ==>
         ?m. (!s. s IN measurable_sets m0 ==> (measure m s = measure m0 s)) /\
             ((m_space m, measurable_sets m) =
              sigma (m_space m0) (measurable_sets m0)) /\ measure_space m

name: measure_space_add
statement:
!sp sts u v. measure_space (sp,sts,u) /\ measure_space (sp,sts,v) ==>
                 measure_space (sp,sts,\s. u s + v s)

name: SEMIRING_SIGMA_MONOTONE
statement:
!sp sts u v. semiring (sp,sts) /\ has_exhausting_sequence (sp,sts) /\
                 measure_space (sp,subsets (sigma sp sts),u) /\
                 measure_space (sp,subsets (sigma sp sts),v) /\
                (!s. s IN sts ==> u s <= v s /\ v s < PosInf) ==>
                (!s. s IN subsets (sigma sp sts) ==> (u s <= v s))

name: null_sets
statement: null_set M = {N | N IN measurable_sets M /\ (measure M N = 0)}

name: NULL_SET_UNION
statement:
!m N1 N2. measure_space m /\ N1 IN null_set m /\ N2 IN null_set m ==>
        (N1 UNION N2) IN null_set m

name: NULL_SET_INTER
statement:
!m N1 N2. measure_space m /\ N1 IN null_set m /\ N2 IN null_set m ==>
        (N1 INTER N2) IN null_set m

name: NULL_SET_BIGUNION
statement:
!m f. measure_space m /\ (!n. f n IN null_set m) ==>
          BIGUNION (IMAGE f univ(:num)) IN null_set m

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_COMPLETION
statement: !m. measure_space m ==> sigma_algebra (completion m)

name: COMPLETION_SUBSET_SUBSETS
statement: !m. measure_space m ==> measurable_sets m SUBSET subsets (completion m)

name: COMPLETION_STABLE
statement:
!m. complete_measure_space m ==> space (completion m) = m_space m /\
                                   subsets (completion m) = measurable_sets m

name: COMPLETION_STABLE'
statement: !m. complete_measure_space m ==> completion m = measurable_space m

name: FINITE_IMP_SIGMA_FINITE
statement: !m. measure_space m /\ measure m (m_space m) <> PosInf ==> sigma_finite m

name: SIGMA_FINITE_ALT2
statement:
!m. measure_space m ==>
       (sigma_finite m <=> ?A. countable A /\ A SUBSET measurable_sets m /\
                              (BIGUNION A = m_space m) /\
                              (!a. a IN A ==> measure m a <> PosInf))

name: sigma_finite_thm
statement:
!m. measure_space m /\ sigma_finite m ==>
        ?A. IMAGE A UNIV SUBSET measurable_sets m /\
            (BIGUNION {A i | i IN UNIV} = m_space m) /\
            (!i:num. measure m (A i) <> PosInf)

name: sigma_finite_disjoint
statement:
!m. measure_space m /\ sigma_finite m ==>
        ?A. IMAGE A UNIV SUBSET measurable_sets m /\
           (BIGUNION {A i | i IN UNIV} = m_space m) /\
           (!i:num. measure m (A i) <> PosInf) /\ disjoint_family A

name: MEASURABLE_IF
statement:
!f g M N P. f IN measurable (m_space M, measurable_sets M)
                                (m_space N, measurable_sets N) /\
                g IN measurable (m_space M, measurable_sets M)
                                (m_space N, measurable_sets N) /\
             {x | x IN m_space M /\ P x} IN measurable_sets M /\
              measure_space M /\
              sigma_algebra (m_space N, measurable_sets N)
       ==> (\x. if P x then f x else g x) IN
            measurable (m_space M, measurable_sets M)
                       (m_space N, measurable_sets N)

name: MEASURABLE_IF_SET
statement:
!f g M N A. f IN measurable (m_space M, measurable_sets M)
                                (m_space N, measurable_sets N) /\
                g IN measurable (m_space M, measurable_sets M)
                                (m_space N, measurable_sets N) /\
                A INTER m_space M IN measurable_sets M /\
                measure_space M /\
                sigma_algebra (m_space N, measurable_sets N)
       ==> (\x. if x IN A then f x else g x) IN
           measurable (m_space M, measurable_sets M)
                      (m_space N, measurable_sets N)

name: countably_additive_alt_eq
statement:
!sp M u. countably_additive (sp,M,u) <=>
             !A. IMAGE A UNIV SUBSET M ==> disjoint_family A ==>
                 BIGUNION {A i | i IN UNIV} IN M ==>
                (u (BIGUNION {A i | i IN univ(:num)}) = suminf (u o A))

name: measure_space_trivial
statement: !a. sigma_algebra a ==> sigma_finite_measure_space (space a,subsets a,(\s. 0))

name: limsup_suminf_indicator_space
statement:
!a A. sigma_algebra a /\ (!n. A n IN subsets a) ==>
         (limsup A = {x | x IN space a /\ (suminf (\n. indicator_fn (A n) x) = PosInf)})

name: measure_space_measure_eq
statement:
!sp sts u v. measure_space (sp,sts,u) /\ (!s. s IN sts ==> u s = v s) ==>
                 measure_space (sp,sts,v)

name: measure_space_cong
statement:
!sp sts u v. (!s. s IN sts ==> u s = v s) ==>
                 (measure_space (sp,sts,u) <=> measure_space (sp,sts,v))

name: measure_space_add'
statement:
!a mu nu p. measure_space (space a,subsets a,mu) /\
                measure_space (space a,subsets a,nu) /\
               (!s. s IN subsets a ==> p s = mu s + nu s) ==>
                measure_space (space a,subsets a,p)

name: measure_space_sum
statement:
!a f m s. FINITE s /\ sigma_algebra a /\
        (!i. i IN s ==> measure_space (space a,subsets a,f i)) /\
        (!t. t IN subsets a ==> m t = EXTREAL_SUM_IMAGE (C f t) s) ==>
        measure_space (space a,subsets a,m)

name: measure_space_suminf
statement:
!a g m. (!n. measure_space (space a,subsets a,g n)) /\
        (!s. s IN subsets a ==> m s = suminf (C g s)) ==>
        measure_space (space a,subsets a,m)

name: measure_space_cmul
statement:
!a u v c. measure_space (space a,subsets a,u) /\ 0 <= c /\
        (!s. s IN subsets a ==> v s = c * u s) ==>
        measure_space (space a,subsets a,v)

name: measure_space_dirac_measure
statement: !a x. sigma_algebra a ==> measure_space (space a,subsets a,C indicator_fn x)

name: MEASURE_SPACE_SIGMA_ALGEBRA
statement: !m. measure_space m ==> sigma_algebra (measurable_space m)

name: measure_space_eq_def
statement:
measure_space_eq m1 m2 =
      (m_space m1 = m_space m2 /\
       measurable_sets m1 = measurable_sets m2 /\
       (!s. s IN measurable_sets m1 ==> (measure m1 s = measure m2 s)))

name: exhausting_sequence_def
statement:
exhausting_sequence (a :'a algebra) (f :num -> 'a -> bool) =
      (f IN (UNIV -> subsets a) /\ (!n. f n SUBSET f (SUC n)) /\
       BIGUNION (IMAGE f UNIV) = space a)

name: has_exhausting_sequence
statement: has_exhausting_sequence a = ?f. exhausting_sequence a f

name: sigma_finite
statement:
sigma_finite m = ?f. exhausting_sequence (m_space m,measurable_sets m) f /\
                         !n. measure m (f n) < PosInf

name: sigma_finite_measure_space_def
statement: sigma_finite_measure_space m = (measure_space m /\ sigma_finite m)

name: metric_countable_covers_def
completion_def
statement:
completion (m :'a m_space) =
      (m_space m, {s UNION n | s IN measurable_sets m /\
                               ?t. n SUBSET t /\ null_set m t})

name: PROB_SPACE_NOT_EMPTY
statement: !p. prob_space p ==> p_space p <> {}

name: PROB_SPACE_IN_PSPACE
statement: !p E. prob_space p /\ E IN events p ==> !x. x IN E ==> x IN p_space p

name: PROB_SPACE_SIGMA_FINITE
statement: !p. prob_space p ==> sigma_finite p

name: EVENTS_BIGUNION
statement:
!p f n. prob_space p /\ (f IN ((count n) -> events p)) ==>
            BIGUNION (IMAGE f (count n)) IN events p

name: PROB_INTER_ZERO
statement:
!p A B. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\ (prob p B = 0) ==>
           (prob p (A INTER B) = 0)

name: PROB_ZERO_INTER
statement:
!p A B. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\ (prob p A = 0) ==>
           (prob p (A INTER B) = 0)

name: PROB_EQ_BIGUNION_IMAGE
statement:
!p f g. prob_space p /\ f IN (UNIV -> events p) /\ g IN (UNIV -> events p) /\
           (!m n. m <> n ==> DISJOINT (f m) (f n)) /\
           (!m n. m <> n ==> DISJOINT (g m) (g n)) /\
           (!n :num. prob p (f n) = prob p (g n)) ==>
       (prob p (BIGUNION (IMAGE f UNIV)) = prob p (BIGUNION (IMAGE g UNIV)))

name: PROB_COUNTABLY_SUBADDITIVE
statement:
!p f. prob_space p /\ (IMAGE f UNIV) SUBSET events p ==>
          prob p (BIGUNION (IMAGE f UNIV)) <= suminf (prob p o f)

name: PROB_COUNTABLY_ZERO
statement:
!p c. prob_space p /\ countable c /\ c SUBSET events p /\
          (!x. x IN c ==> (prob p x = 0)) ==> (prob p (BIGUNION c) = 0)

name: PROB_FINITE_ADDITIVE
statement:
!p s f t. prob_space p /\ FINITE s /\ (!x. x IN s ==> f x IN events p) /\
             (!a b. (a :'b) IN s /\ b IN s /\ a <> b ==> DISJOINT (f a) (f b)) /\
             (t = BIGUNION (IMAGE f s)) ==> (prob p t = SIGMA (prob p o f) s)

name: prob_normal
statement:
!p. prob_space p ==>
  !x. x IN events p ==> ?r. prob p x = Normal r /\ 0 <= r /\ r <= 1

name: prob_on_finite_set
statement:
!p. FINITE (m_space p) /\ measurable_sets p = POW (m_space p) ==>
  (prob_space p <=>
   positive p /\ prob p (p_space p) = 1 /\ additive p)

name: distribution_distr
statement: distribution = distr

name: distribution_function
statement: !p X t. distribution_function p X t = distribution p X {x | x <= t}

name: joint_distribution_alt
statement: !p X Y. joint_distribution p X Y = distribution p (\x. (X x,Y x))

name: joint_distribution3_alt
statement: !p X Y Z. joint_distribution3 p X Y Z = distribution p (\x. (X x,Y x,Z x))

name: marginal_joint_zero
statement:
!p X Y s t. prob_space p /\ (events p = POW (p_space p)) /\
                ((distribution p X s = 0) \/ (distribution p Y t = 0))
            ==> (joint_distribution p X Y (s CROSS t) = 0)

name: marginal_joint_zero3
statement:
!p X Y Z s t u. prob_space p /\ (events p = POW (p_space p)) /\
                   ((distribution p X s = 0) \/
                    (distribution p Y t = 0) \/
                    (distribution p Z u = 0))
               ==> (joint_distribution3 p X Y Z (s CROSS (t CROSS u)) = 0)

name: distribution_prob_space
statement:
!p X s. prob_space p /\ sigma_algebra s /\ random_variable X p s ==>
            prob_space (space s, subsets s, distribution p X)

name: uniform_distribution_prob_space
statement:
!X p s. prob_space p /\ FINITE (p_space p) /\
            FINITE (space s) /\ sigma_algebra s /\ random_variable X p s ==>
            prob_space (space s, subsets s, uniform_distribution s)

name: distribution_partition
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!x. x IN p_space p ==> {x} IN events p) /\
          FINITE (p_space p) /\ random_variable X p Borel ==>
         (SIGMA (\x. distribution p X {x}) (IMAGE X (p_space p)) = 1)

name: distribution_space_eq_1
statement: !p X. prob_space p ==> (distribution p X (IMAGE X (p_space p)) = 1)

name: distribution_lebesgue_thm1
statement:
!X p s A. prob_space p /\ sigma_algebra s /\
             random_variable X p s /\ A IN subsets s ==>
      (distribution p X A = integral p (indicator_fn (PREIMAGE X A INTER p_space p)))

name: distribution_lebesgue_thm2
statement:
!X p s A. prob_space p /\ sigma_algebra s /\
              random_variable X p s /\ A IN subsets s ==>
      (distribution p X A = integral (space s, subsets s, distribution p X) (indicator_fn A))

name: real_random_variable_zero
statement: !p. prob_space p ==> real_random_variable (\x. 0) p

name: real_random_variable_const
statement:
!p m. prob_space p /\ m <> PosInf /\ m <> NegInf ==>
          real_random_variable (\x. m) p

name: real_random_variable_add
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\
            real_random_variable Y p ==> real_random_variable (\x. X x + Y x) p

name: real_random_variable_sub
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\
            real_random_variable Y p ==> real_random_variable (\x. X x - Y x) p

name: real_random_variable_ainv
statement: !p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==> real_random_variable (\x. -X x) p

name: real_random_variable_cmul
statement:
!p X r. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
            real_random_variable (\x. Normal r * X x) p

name: real_random_variable_cdiv
statement:
!p X c. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ c <> 0 ==>
            real_random_variable (\x. X x / Normal c) p

name: real_random_variable_sum
statement:
!p X (J :'index set). prob_space p /\ FINITE J /\
         (!i. i IN J ==> real_random_variable (X i) p) ==>
          real_random_variable (\x. SIGMA (\n. X n x) J) p

name: real_random_variable_fn_plus
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
          real_random_variable (fn_plus X) p

name: real_random_variable_fn_minus
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
          real_random_variable (fn_minus X) p

name: real_random_variable_mul_indicator
statement:
!p E X. prob_space p /\ E IN events p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
            real_random_variable (\x. X x * indicator_fn E x) p

name: random_variable_cong
statement:
!p X Y A. (!x. x IN p_space p ==> X x = Y x) ==>
              (random_variable X p A <=> random_variable Y p A)

name: real_random_variable_cong
statement:
!p X Y. (!x. x IN p_space p ==> X x = Y x) ==>
            (real_random_variable X p <=> real_random_variable Y p)

name: finite_marginal_product_space_POW3
statement:
!p s1 s2 s3 X Y Z.
       prob_space p /\ FINITE (p_space p) /\ (POW (p_space p) = events p) /\
       random_variable X p (s1, POW s1) /\
       random_variable Y p (s2, POW s2) /\
       random_variable Z p (s3, POW s3) /\
       FINITE s1 /\ FINITE s2 /\ FINITE s3 ==>
       measure_space (s1 CROSS (s2 CROSS s3), POW (s1 CROSS (s2 CROSS s3)),
                      joint_distribution3 p X Y Z)

name: distribution_x_eq_1_imp_distribution_y_eq_0
statement:
!X p x. prob_space p /\
            random_variable X p (IMAGE X (p_space p),POW (IMAGE X (p_space p))) /\
           (distribution p X {x} = 1)
        ==> !y. y <> x ==> (distribution p X {y} = 0)

name: joint_distribution_not_infty
statement:
!p X Y a. prob_space p /\ (events p = POW (p_space p)) ==>
              joint_distribution p X Y a <> NegInf /\
              joint_distribution p X Y a <> PosInf

name: distribution_not_infty
statement:
!p X a. prob_space p /\ (events p = POW (p_space p)) ==>
            distribution p X a <> NegInf /\
            distribution p X a <> PosInf

name: joint_conditional
statement:
!p X Y a b. prob_space p /\ (events p = POW (p_space p)) ==>
               (joint_distribution p X Y (a CROSS b) =
                conditional_distribution p Y X b a * distribution p X a)

name: conditional_distribution_pos
statement:
!p X Y a b. prob_space p /\ (events p = POW (p_space p)) /\
                distribution p Y b <> 0 ==>
                0 <= conditional_distribution p X Y a b

name: conditional_distribution_le_1
statement:
!p X Y a b. prob_space p /\ (events p = POW (p_space p)) /\
                distribution p Y b <> 0 ==>
                conditional_distribution p X Y a b <= 1

name: marginal_distribution1
statement:
!p X Y a. prob_space p /\ FINITE (p_space p) /\ (events p = POW (p_space p)) ==>
             (distribution p X a =
              SIGMA (\x. joint_distribution p X Y (a CROSS {x})) (IMAGE Y (p_space p)))

name: marginal_distribution2
statement:
!p X Y b. prob_space p /\ FINITE (p_space p) /\ (events p = POW (p_space p)) ==>
             (distribution p Y b =
              SIGMA (\x. joint_distribution p X Y ({x} CROSS b)) (IMAGE X (p_space p)))

name: joint_distribution_sums_1
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ FINITE (p_space p) /\ (events p = POW (p_space p)) ==>
         (SIGMA (\(x,y). joint_distribution p X Y {(x,y)})
                ((IMAGE X (p_space p)) CROSS (IMAGE Y (p_space p))) = 1)

name: joint_distribution_sum_mul1
statement:
!p X Y f. prob_space p /\ FINITE (p_space p) /\
              (events p = POW (p_space p)) /\
              (!x. f x <> PosInf /\ f x <> NegInf) ==>
        (SIGMA (\(x,y). joint_distribution p X Y {(x,y)} * (f x))
               (IMAGE X (p_space p) CROSS IMAGE Y (p_space p)) =
         SIGMA (\x. distribution p X {x} * (f x)) (IMAGE X (p_space p)))

name: integrable_absolute_moments
statement:
!p X n. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\
            integrable p (\x. (abs (X x)) pow n) ==>
            !m. m <= n ==> integrable p (\x. (abs (X x)) pow m)

name: variance_pos
statement: !p X. prob_space p ==> 0 <= variance p X

name: second_moment_pos
statement: !p X a. prob_space p ==> 0 <= second_moment p X a

name: variance_eq
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\
          integrable p (\x. X x pow 2) ==>
          variance p X = expectation p (\x. X x pow 2) - (expectation p X) pow 2

name: variance_le
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ integrable p (\x. X x pow 2) ==>
          variance p X <= expectation p (\x. X x pow 2)

name: expectation_cmul
statement:
!p X c. prob_space p /\ integrable p X ==>
            expectation p (\x. Normal c * X x) = Normal c * expectation p X

name: expectation_cdiv
statement:
!p X c. prob_space p /\ integrable p X /\ c <> 0 ==>
            expectation p (\x. X x / Normal c) = expectation p X / Normal c

name: expectation_pos
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!x. x IN p_space p ==> 0 <= X x) ==>
          0 <= expectation p X

name: expectation_posinf
statement: !p. prob_space p ==> expectation p (\x. PosInf) = PosInf

name: expectation_neginf
statement: !p. prob_space p ==> expectation p (\x. NegInf) = NegInf

name: expectation_const
statement: !p c. prob_space p ==> expectation p (\x. c) = c

name: variance_const
statement: !p c. prob_space p ==> variance p (\x. Normal c) = 0

name: expectation_sum
statement:
!p X J.
        FINITE J /\ prob_space p /\ (!i. i IN J ==> integrable p (X i)) /\
       (!i. i IN J ==> real_random_variable (X i) p) ==>
        expectation p (\x. SIGMA (\i. X i x) J) = SIGMA (\i. expectation p (X i)) J

name: expectation_cong
statement:
!p f g. prob_space p /\ (!x. x IN p_space p ==> f x = g x) ==>
            expectation p f = expectation p g

name: variance_cong
statement:
!p f g. prob_space p /\ (!x. x IN p_space p ==> f x = g x) ==>
            variance p f = variance p g

name: finite_second_moments_all
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
         (finite_second_moments p X <=> !r. second_moment p X (Normal r) < PosInf)

name: finite_second_moments_eq_finite_variance
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
         (finite_second_moments p X <=> variance p X < PosInf)

name: finite_second_moments_lemma
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
         (variance p X < PosInf <=> second_moment p X 0 < PosInf)

name: finite_second_moments_alt
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
         (finite_second_moments p X <=> second_moment p X 0 < PosInf)

name: finite_second_moments_eq_integrable_square
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
         (finite_second_moments p X <=> integrable p (\x. X x pow 2))

name: finite_second_moments_eq_integrable_squares
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
         (finite_second_moments p X <=> !c. integrable p (\x. (X x - Normal c) pow 2))

name: bounded_imp_finite_second_moments
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ random_variable X p Borel /\
         (?r. !x. x IN p_space p ==> abs (X x) <= Normal r) ==> finite_second_moments p X

name: bounded_imp_finite_second_moments'
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ random_variable X p Borel /\ integrable p X /\
         (?r. !x. x IN p_space p ==> abs (X x - expectation p X) <= Normal r) ==>
          finite_second_moments p X

name: finite_second_moments_imp_integrable
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ finite_second_moments p X ==>
          integrable p X

name: bounded_imp_integrable
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ random_variable X p Borel /\
         (?r. !x. x IN p_space p ==> abs (X x) <= Normal r) ==> integrable p X

name: finite_second_moments_imp_finite_expectation
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ finite_second_moments p X ==>
          expectation p X <> PosInf /\ expectation p X <> NegInf

name: finite_second_moments_cmul
statement:
!p X c. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ finite_second_moments p X ==>
            finite_second_moments p (\x. Normal c * X x)

name: finite_second_moments_ainv
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ finite_second_moments p X ==>
          finite_second_moments p (\x. -X x)

name: finite_second_moments_cdiv
statement:
!p X c. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\
            finite_second_moments p X /\ c <> 0 ==>
            finite_second_moments p (\x. X x / Normal c)

name: finite_second_moments_cong
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ (!x. x IN p_space p ==> X x = Y x) ==>
           (finite_second_moments p X <=> finite_second_moments p Y)

name: finite_second_moments_add
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\
            real_random_variable X p /\ real_random_variable Y p /\
            finite_second_moments p X /\ finite_second_moments p Y ==>
            finite_second_moments p (\x. X x + Y x)

name: finite_second_moments_sum
statement:
!p X (J :'index set). prob_space p /\ FINITE J /\
         (!i. i IN J ==> real_random_variable (X i) p) /\
         (!i. i IN J ==> finite_second_moments p (X i)) ==>
          finite_second_moments p (\x. SIGMA (\n. X n x) J)

name: finite_second_moments_sub
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\
            real_random_variable X p /\ real_random_variable Y p /\
            finite_second_moments p X /\ finite_second_moments p Y ==>
            finite_second_moments p (\x. X x - Y x)

name: finite_second_moments_imp_integrable_mul
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\
            real_random_variable X p /\ real_random_variable Y p /\
            finite_second_moments p X /\ finite_second_moments p Y ==>
            integrable p (\x. X x * Y x)

name: expectation_real_affine
statement:
!p X c. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ integrable p X /\
            c <> PosInf /\ c <> NegInf ==>
           (expectation p (\x. X x + c) = expectation p X + c)

name: expectation_normal
statement: !p X. prob_space p /\ integrable p X ==> ?r. expectation p X = Normal r

name: variance_real_affine
statement:
!p X c. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ integrable p X /\
            c <> PosInf /\ c <> NegInf ==> (variance p (\x. X x + c) = variance p X)

name: variance_real_affine'
statement:
!p X c. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ integrable p X /\
            c <> PosInf /\ c <> NegInf ==> (variance p (\x. X x - c) = variance p X)

name: variance_cmul
statement:
!p X c. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\
            finite_second_moments p X ==>
           (variance p (\x. Normal c * X x) = Normal (c pow 2) * variance p X)

name: variance_cdiv
statement:
!p X c. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\
            finite_second_moments p X /\ c <> 0 ==>
           (variance p (\x. X x / Normal c) = variance p X / Normal (c pow 2))

name: prob_markov_inequality
statement:
!p X a c. prob_space p /\ integrable p X /\ 0 < c /\ a IN events p ==>
              prob p ({x | c <= abs (X x)} INTER a) <=
                inv c * (expectation p (\x. abs (X x) * indicator_fn a x))

name: prob_markov_ineq
statement:
!p X c. prob_space p /\ integrable p X /\ 0 < c ==>
            prob p ({x | c <= abs (X x)} INTER p_space p) <= inv c * expectation p (abs o X)

name: chebyshev_inequality
statement:
!p X a t c. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\
                finite_second_moments p X /\ 0 < t /\ a IN events p ==>
       prob p ({x | t <= abs (X x - Normal c)} INTER a) <=
         inv (t pow 2) * (expectation p (\x. (X x - Normal c) pow 2 * indicator_fn a x))

name: chebyshev_ineq
statement:
!p X t c. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\
              finite_second_moments p X /\ 0 < t ==>
         prob p ({x | t <= abs (X x - Normal c)} INTER p_space p) <=
           inv (t pow 2) * (expectation p (\x. (X x - Normal c) pow 2))

name: chebyshev_ineq_variance
statement:
!p X t. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\
            finite_second_moments p X /\ 0 < t ==>
         prob p ({x | t <= abs (X x - expectation p X)} INTER p_space p) <=
           inv (t pow 2) * variance p X

name: chebyshev_ineq_variance'
statement:
!p X t. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\
            finite_second_moments p X /\ 0 < t ==>
         prob p ({x | t < abs (X x - expectation p X)} INTER p_space p) <=
           inv (t pow 2) * variance p X

name: pairwise_indep_events_def
statement:
!p E (J :'index set).
       pairwise_indep_events p E J <=>
       !i j. i IN J /\ j IN J /\ i <> j ==> indep p (E i) (E j)

name: pairwise_indep_sets_def
statement:
!p A (J :'index set).
       pairwise_indep_sets p A J <=>
       !i j. i IN J /\ j IN J /\ i <> j ==> indep_families p (A i) (A j)

name: pairwise_indep_vars_def
statement:
!p X A (J :'index set).
       pairwise_indep_vars p X A J <=>
       !i j. i IN J /\ j IN J /\ i <> j ==> indep_rv p (X i) (X j) (A i) (A j)

name: pairwise_indep_vars_subset
statement:
!p X A (s :'index set) (t :'index set).
       pairwise_indep_vars p X A t /\ s SUBSET t ==>
       pairwise_indep_vars p X A s

name: indep_vars_subset
statement:
!p X A (s :'index set) (t :'index set).
       indep_vars p X A t /\ s SUBSET t ==> indep_vars p X A s

name: indep_vars_alt_indep_events
statement:
!p X A (J :'index set).
       (!n. n IN J ==> sigma_algebra (A n)) ==>
       (indep_vars p X A (J :'index set) <=>
        !E. E IN (J --> (subsets o A)) ==>
            indep_events p (\n. (PREIMAGE (X n) (E n)) INTER p_space p) J)

name: indep_vars_alt_univ
statement:
!p X A. prob_space p /\ (!n. sigma_algebra (A n)) /\
           (!n. random_variable (X n) p (A n)) ==>
       (indep_vars p X A univ(:num) <=>
        !E n. E IN (count1 n --> subsets o A) ==>
              prob p (BIGINTER (IMAGE (\n. PREIMAGE (X n) (E n) INTER p_space p) (count1 n))) =
              PI (prob p o (\n. PREIMAGE (X n) (E n) INTER p_space p)) (count1 n))

name: INDEP
statement:
!p a b. a IN events p /\ b IN events p /\
          prob p (a INTER b) = prob p a * prob p b ==> indep p a b

name: total_imp_pairwise_indep_events
statement:
!p E (J :'index set).
           (!n. n IN J ==> (E n) IN events p) /\ indep_events p E J ==>
            pairwise_indep_events p E J

name: total_imp_pairwise_indep_sets
statement:
!p A (J :'index set).
      (!n. n IN J ==> (A n) SUBSET events p) /\ indep_sets p A J ==>
       pairwise_indep_sets p A J

name: total_imp_pairwise_indep_vars
statement:
!p X A (J :'index set). prob_space p /\
        (!i. i IN J ==> random_variable (X i) p (A i)) /\
        (!i. i IN J ==> sigma_algebra (A i)) /\
        indep_vars p X A J ==> pairwise_indep_vars p X A J

name: indep_rv_alt_indep_vars
statement:
!p X Y A B. random_variable (X :'a -> 'b) p A /\
                random_variable (Y :'a -> 'b) p B ==>
               (indep_rv p X Y A B <=> indep_vars p (binary X Y) (binary A B) {0; 1})

name: SIGMA_SUBSET_EVENTS
statement:
!a p. prob_space p /\ a SUBSET events p ==>
          subsets (sigma (p_space p) a) SUBSET events p

name: INDEP_FAMILIES_SIGMA_lemma
statement:
!p B n (J :'index set).
              prob_space p /\ (IMAGE B (n INSERT J)) SUBSET events p /\
              indep_events p B (n INSERT J) /\ n NOTIN J
          ==> indep_families p {B n} (subsets (sigma (p_space p) (IMAGE B J)))

name: INDEP_FAMILIES_SIGMA_lemma1
statement:
!p A m (N :'index set) S2.
         prob_space p /\ IMAGE A (m INSERT N) SUBSET events p /\
         indep_events p A (m INSERT N) /\ m NOTIN N /\
         S2 IN subsets (sigma (p_space p) (IMAGE A N)) ==> indep p (A m) S2

name: INDEP_FAMILIES_SIGMA_lemma2
statement:
!p A (M :'index set) N m S1.
       prob_space p /\ (IMAGE A (M UNION N)) SUBSET events p /\
       indep_events p A (M UNION N) /\ DISJOINT M N /\ m IN M /\ N <> {} /\
       S1 IN (subsets (sigma (p_space p) (IMAGE A M))) ==>
       indep_events p (\x. if x IN N then A x else S1) (m INSERT N)

name: INDEP_FAMILIES_SIGMA
statement:
!p A (M :'index set) N.
       prob_space p /\ (IMAGE A (M UNION N)) SUBSET events p /\
       indep_events p A (M UNION N) /\ DISJOINT M N /\ M <> {} /\ N <> {} ==>
       indep_families p (subsets (sigma (p_space p) (IMAGE A M)))
                        (subsets (sigma (p_space p) (IMAGE A N)))

name: Kolmogorov_0_1_Law
statement:
!p E. prob_space p /\ (!n. E n IN events p) /\ indep_events p E UNIV ==>
          !e. e IN subsets (tail_algebra p E) ==> (prob p e = 0) \/ (prob p e = 1)

name: covariance_self
statement: !p X. covariance p X X = variance p X

name: uncorrelated_thm
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ real_random_variable Y p /\
            uncorrelated p X Y ==>
           (expectation p (\s. (X s - expectation p X) * (Y s - expectation p Y)) = 0)

name: uncorrelated_covariance
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ real_random_variable Y p /\
            uncorrelated p X Y ==> (covariance p X Y = 0)

name: uncorrelated_orthogonal
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ real_random_variable Y p /\
            (expectation p X = 0) /\ (expectation p Y = 0) ==>
            (uncorrelated p X Y <=> orthogonal p X Y)

name: variance_sum
statement:
!p X (J :'index set).
            prob_space p /\ FINITE J /\ (!i. i IN J ==> real_random_variable (X i) p) /\
            uncorrelated_vars p X J ==>
           (variance p (\x. SIGMA (\n. X n x) J) = SIGMA (\n. variance p (X n)) J)

name: Borel_Cantelli_Lemma1
statement:
!p E. prob_space p /\ (!n. E n IN events p) /\
          suminf (prob p o E) < PosInf ==> (prob p (limsup E) = 0)

name: variance_eq_indicator_fn
statement:
!p s. prob_space p /\ s IN events p ==>
         (variance p (indicator_fn s) =
          expectation p (indicator_fn s) - (expectation p (indicator_fn s)) pow 2)

name: variance_le_indicator_fn
statement:
!p s. prob_space p /\ s IN events p ==>
          variance p (indicator_fn s) <= expectation p (indicator_fn s)

name: variance_sum_indicator_fn
statement:
!p E J. prob_space p /\ (!n. n IN J ==> (E n) IN events p) /\
            pairwise_indep_events p E J /\ FINITE J ==>
           (variance p (\x. SIGMA (\n. (indicator_fn o E) n x) J) =
            SIGMA (\n. variance p ((indicator_fn o E) n)) J)

name: Borel_Cantelli_Lemma2p
statement:
!p E. prob_space p /\ (!n. (E n) IN events p) /\
          pairwise_indep_events p E univ(:num) /\
         (suminf (prob p o E) = PosInf) ==> (prob p (limsup E) = 1)

name: Borel_Cantelli_Lemma2
statement:
!p E. prob_space p /\ (!n. (E n) IN events p) /\
          indep_events p E univ(:num) /\
         (suminf (prob p o E) = PosInf) ==> (prob p (limsup E) = 1)

name: Borel_0_1_Law
statement:
!p E. prob_space p /\ (!n. (E n) IN events p) /\
          pairwise_indep_events p E univ(:num) ==>
         (prob p (limsup E) = 0) \/ (prob p (limsup E) = 1)

name: converge_AE
statement:
!p X Y. (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\ real_random_variable Y p ==>
       ((X --> Y) (almost_everywhere p) <=>
        AE x::p. ((\n. X n x) --> (Y x)) sequentially)

name: converge_PR
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\
           (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\ real_random_variable Y p ==>
           ((X --> Y) (in_probability p) <=>
            !e. 0 < e /\ e <> PosInf ==>
               ((\n. prob p {x | x IN p_space p /\ e < abs (X n x - Y x)}) --> 0)
                sequentially)

name: converge_LP
statement:
!p X Y r. prob_space p /\
             (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\ real_random_variable Y p /\
              0 < r /\ r <> PosInf ==>
       ((X --> Y) (in_lebesgue r p) <=>
        (!n. X n IN lp_space r p) /\ Y IN lp_space r p /\
        ((\n. expectation p (\x. abs (X n x - Y x) powr r)) --> 0) sequentially)

name: converge_LP_alt_absolute_moment
statement:
!p X Y k. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
             real_random_variable Y p ==>
       ((X --> Y) (in_lebesgue (&k :extreal) p) <=>
        0 < k /\
        (!n. expectation p (\x. (abs (X n x)) pow k) <> PosInf) /\
        (expectation p (\x. (abs (Y x)) pow k) <> PosInf) /\
        ((\n. real (absolute_moment p (\x. X n x - Y x) 0 k)) --> 0) sequentially)

name: converge_AE_alt_sup
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            real_random_variable Y p ==>
       ((X --> Y) (almost_everywhere p) <=>
        !e. 0 < e /\ e <> PosInf ==>
            (sup (IMAGE (\m. prob p {x | x IN p_space p /\
                                         !n. m <= n ==> abs (X n x - Y x) <= e})
                        univ(:num)) = 1))

name: converge_AE_alt_inf
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            real_random_variable Y p ==>
       ((X --> Y) (almost_everywhere p) <=>
        !e. 0 < e /\ e <> PosInf ==>
            (inf (IMAGE (\m. prob p {x | x IN p_space p /\
                                         ?n. m <= n /\ e < abs (X n x - Y x)})
                        univ(:num)) = 0))

name: converge_AE_imp_PR
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            real_random_variable Y p /\
           (X --> Y) (almost_everywhere p) ==> (X --> Y) (in_probability p)

name: converge_AE_alt_liminf
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            real_random_variable Y p ==>
       ((X --> Y) (almost_everywhere p) <=>
        !e. 0 < e /\ e <> PosInf ==>
            prob p (liminf (\n. {x | x IN p_space p /\ abs (X n x - Y x) <= e})) = 1)

name: converge_AE_alt_limsup
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            real_random_variable Y p ==>
       ((X --> Y) (almost_everywhere p) <=>
        !e. 0 < e /\ e <> PosInf ==>
            prob p (limsup (\n. {x | x IN p_space p /\ e < abs (X n x - Y x)})) = 0)

name: converge_AE_alt_limsup'
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) ==>
         ((X --> (\x. 0)) (almost_everywhere p) <=>
          !e. 0 < e /\ e <> PosInf ==>
              prob p (limsup (\n. {x | x IN p_space p /\ e < abs (X n x)})) = 0)

name: converge_AE_to_zero
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            real_random_variable Y p ==>
       ((X --> Y) (almost_everywhere p) <=>
        ((\n x. X n x - Y x) --> (\x. 0)) (almost_everywhere p))

name: converge_PR_to_zero
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            real_random_variable Y p ==>
       ((X --> Y) (in_probability p) <=>
        ((\n x. X n x - Y x) --> (\x. 0)) (in_probability p))

name: converge_AE_imp_PR'
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
         (X --> (\x. 0)) (almost_everywhere p) ==>
         (X --> (\x. 0)) (in_probability p)

name: converge_LP_imp_PR'
statement:
!p X k. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            (X --> (\x. 0)) (in_lebesgue (&k :extreal) p) ==>
            (X --> (\x. 0)) (in_probability p)

name: converge_AE_cong_full
statement:
!p X Y A B m. (!n x. m <= n /\ x IN p_space p ==> X n x = Y n x) /\
                  (!x. x IN p_space p ==> A x = B x) ==>
                  ((X --> A) (almost_everywhere p) <=> (Y --> B) (almost_everywhere p))

name: converge_AE_cong
statement:
!p X Y Z m. (!n x. m <= n /\ x IN p_space p ==> X n x = Y n x) ==>
                ((X --> Z) (almost_everywhere p) <=> (Y --> Z) (almost_everywhere p))

name: converge_PR_cong_full
statement:
!p X Y A B m. (!n x. m <= n /\ x IN p_space p ==> X n x = Y n x) /\
                  (!x. x IN p_space p ==> A x = B x) ==>
                  ((X --> A) (in_probability p) <=> (Y --> B) (in_probability p))

name: converge_PR_cong
statement:
!p X Y Z m. (!n x. m <= n /\ x IN p_space p ==> X n x = Y n x) ==>
                ((X --> Z) (in_probability p) <=> (Y --> Z) (in_probability p))

name: converge_LP_cong
statement:
!p X Y Z k. prob_space p /\
               (!n x. x IN p_space p ==> X n x = Y n x) ==>
               ((X --> Z) (in_lebesgue k p) <=> (Y --> Z) (in_lebesgue k p))

name: converge_AE_to_zero'
statement:
!p X Y Z. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
              real_random_variable Y p /\
             (!n x. x IN p_space p ==> Z n x = X n x - Y x) ==>
             ((X --> Y) (almost_everywhere p) <=> (Z --> (\x. 0)) (almost_everywhere p))

name: converge_PR_to_zero'
statement:
!p X Y Z. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
              real_random_variable Y p /\
             (!n x. x IN p_space p ==> Z n x = X n x - Y x) ==>
             ((X --> Y) (in_probability p) <=> (Z --> (\x. 0)) (in_probability p))

name: converge_AE_alt_shift
statement:
!D p X Y. (X               --> Y) (almost_everywhere p) <=>
              ((\n. X (n + D)) --> Y) (almost_everywhere p)

name: converge_PR_alt_shift
statement:
!D p X Y. (X               --> Y) (in_probability p) <=>
              ((\n. X (n + D)) --> Y) (in_probability p)

name: converge_PR_add_to_zero
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\
