           (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
           (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
           (X --> (\x. 0)) (in_probability p) /\
           (Y --> (\x. 0)) (in_probability p) ==>
       ((\n x. X n x + Y n x) --> (\x. 0)) (in_probability p)

name: converge_PR_add
statement:
!p X Y A B. prob_space p /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
                real_random_variable A p /\ (X --> A) (in_probability p) /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
                real_random_variable B p /\ (Y --> B) (in_probability p) ==>
       ((\n x. X n x + Y n x) --> (\x. A x + B x)) (in_probability p)

name: converge_PR_ainv_to_zero
statement:
!p X. (X --> (\x. 0)) (in_probability p) ==>
          ((\n x. -X n x) --> (\x. 0)) (in_probability p)

name: converge_PR_ainv
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            real_random_variable Y p /\
            (X --> Y) (in_probability p) ==>
         ((\n x. -X n x) --> (\x. -Y x)) (in_probability p)

name: converge_PR_sub
statement:
!p X Y A B. prob_space p /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
                real_random_variable A p /\ (X --> A) (in_probability p) /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
                real_random_variable B p /\ (Y --> B) (in_probability p) ==>
       ((\n x. X n x - Y n x) --> (\x. A x - B x)) (in_probability p)

name: converge_PR_to_limit
statement:
!p X M m. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
              (M --> m) sequentially /\
              ((\n x. X n x - Normal (M n)) --> (\x. 0)) (in_probability p) ==>
              (X --> (\x. Normal m)) (in_probability p)

name: converge_PR_to_limit'
statement:
!p X M m. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
              (!n. M n <> PosInf /\ M n <> NegInf) /\ m <> PosInf /\ m <> NegInf /\
              ((real o M) --> real m) sequentially /\
              ((\n x. X n x - M n) --> (\x. 0)) (in_probability p) ==>
              (X --> (\x. m)) (in_probability p)

name: converge_AE_add_to_zero
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\
           (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
           (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
           (X --> (\x. 0)) (almost_everywhere p) /\
           (Y --> (\x. 0)) (almost_everywhere p) ==>
       ((\n x. X n x + Y n x) --> (\x. 0)) (almost_everywhere p)

name: converge_AE_add
statement:
!p X Y A B. prob_space p /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
                real_random_variable A p /\ (X --> A) (almost_everywhere p) /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
                real_random_variable B p /\ (Y --> B) (almost_everywhere p) ==>
       ((\n x. X n x + Y n x) --> (\x. A x + B x)) (almost_everywhere p)

name: converge_AE_ainv_to_zero
statement:
!p X. (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
          (X --> (\x. 0)) (almost_everywhere p) ==>
          ((\n x. -X n x) --> (\x. 0)) (almost_everywhere p)

name: converge_AE_ainv
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
            real_random_variable Y p /\
            (X --> Y) (almost_everywhere p) ==>
         ((\n x. -X n x) --> (\x. -Y x)) (almost_everywhere p)

name: converge_AE_sub
statement:
!p X Y A B. prob_space p /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
                real_random_variable A p /\ (X --> A) (almost_everywhere p) /\
               (!n. real_random_variable (Y n) p) /\
                real_random_variable B p /\ (Y --> B) (almost_everywhere p) ==>
       ((\n x. X n x - Y n x) --> (\x. A x - B x)) (almost_everywhere p)

name: converge_AE_to_limit
statement:
!p X M m. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
              (M --> m) sequentially /\
              ((\n x. X n x - Normal (M n)) --> (\x. 0)) (almost_everywhere p) ==>
              (X --> (\x. Normal m)) (almost_everywhere p)

name: converge_AE_to_limit'
statement:
!p X M m. prob_space p /\ (!n. real_random_variable (X n) p) /\
              (!n. M n <> PosInf /\ M n <> NegInf) /\ m <> PosInf /\ m <> NegInf /\
              ((real o M) --> real m) sequentially /\
              ((\n x. X n x - M n) --> (\x. 0)) (almost_everywhere p) ==>
              (X --> (\x. m)) (almost_everywhere p)

name: PROB_ZERO_AE
statement: !p E. prob_space p /\ E IN events p /\ (prob p E = 0) ==> AE x::p. x NOTIN E

name: PROB_ZERO_AE_EQ
statement: !p E. prob_space p /\ E IN events p ==> (prob p E = 0 <=> AE x::p. x NOTIN E)

name: PROB_ONE_AE
statement: !p E. prob_space p /\ E IN events p /\ (prob p E = 1) ==> AE x::p. x IN E

name: PROB_ONE_AE_EQ
statement: !p E. prob_space p /\ E IN events p ==> (prob p E = 1 <=> AE x::p. x IN E)

name: expectation_bounds
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
          suminf (\n. prob p {x | x IN p_space p /\ &SUC n <= abs (X x)}) <=
          expectation p (abs o X) /\ expectation p (abs o X) <= 1 +
          suminf (\n. prob p {x | x IN p_space p /\ &SUC n <= abs (X x)})

name: expectation_converge
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
         (expectation p (abs o X) < PosInf <=>
          suminf (\n. prob p {x | x IN p_space p /\ &SUC n <= abs (X x)}) < PosInf)

name: expectation_converge'
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p ==>
         (expectation p (abs o X) = PosInf <=>
          suminf (\n. prob p {x | x IN p_space p /\ &SUC n <= abs (X x)}) = PosInf)

name: expectation_distribution
statement:
!p X f. prob_space p /\ random_variable X p Borel /\ f IN measurable Borel Borel ==>
           (expectation p (f o X) =
            integral (space Borel,subsets Borel,distribution p X) f) /\
           (integrable p (f o X) <=>
            integrable (space Borel,subsets Borel,distribution p X) f)

name: identical_distribution_alt_prob
statement:
!p X E J i j s. identical_distribution p X E J /\
                    s IN subsets E /\ i IN J /\ j IN J ==>
        (prob p {x | x IN p_space p /\ X i x IN s} =
         prob p {x | x IN p_space p /\ X j x IN s})

name: identical_distribution_alt
statement:
!p X (J :'index set). prob_space p /\
         (!n. n IN J ==> random_variable (X n) p Borel) ==>
         (identical_distribution p X Borel J <=>
          (!f. f IN measurable Borel Borel ==>
               ?c. !n. n IN J ==> expectation p (f o (X n)) = c))

name: identical_distribution_alt'
statement:
!p (X :num -> 'a -> extreal).
          prob_space p /\ (!n. random_variable (X n) p Borel) ==>
         (identical_distribution p X Borel univ(:num) <=>
          (!f n. f IN measurable Borel Borel ==>
                 expectation p (f o (X n)) = expectation p (f o (X 0))))

name: random_variable_comp
statement:
!p X A f. random_variable X p A /\ f IN measurable A A ==>
              random_variable (f o X) p A

name: identical_distribution_cong
statement:
!p X f. prob_space p /\ (!n. random_variable (X n) p Borel) /\
            identical_distribution p X Borel univ(:num) /\
            f IN measurable Borel Borel ==>
            identical_distribution p (\n. f o X n) Borel univ(:num)

name: identical_distribution_integrable_general
statement:
!p X (J :'index set). prob_space p /\
         (!n. n IN J ==> random_variable (X n) p Borel) /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel J /\
         (?i. i IN J /\ integrable p (X i)) ==> !n. n IN J ==> integrable p (X n)

name: identical_distribution_integrable
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. random_variable (X n) p Borel) /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV /\ integrable p (X 0) ==>
          !(n :num). integrable p (X n)

name: identical_distribution_expectation_general
statement:
!p X (J :'index set). prob_space p /\
         (!n. n IN J ==> random_variable (X n) p Borel) /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel J ==>
          ?e. !n. n IN J ==> expectation p (X n) = e

name: identical_distribution_expectation
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ (!n. random_variable (X n) p Borel) /\
          identical_distribution p X Borel UNIV ==>
          !(n :num). expectation p (X n) = expectation p (X 0)

name: fundamental_theorem_of_random_vectors
statement:
!p X Y f. prob_space p /\ random_variable X p Borel /\ random_variable Y p Borel /\
              f IN measurable (Borel CROSS Borel) Borel ==>
              random_variable (\x. f (X x,Y x)) p Borel

name: indep_vars_comm
statement: !p X Y s t. indep_rv p X Y s t ==> indep_rv p Y X t s

name: indep_vars_cong
statement:
!p X B (J :'index set) f.
         indep_vars p (X :'index -> 'a -> 'b) B (J :'index set) /\
        (!n. n IN J ==> random_variable (X n) p (B n)) /\
        (!n. n IN J ==> f n IN measurable (B n) (B n)) ==>
         indep_vars p (\n. (f n) o (X n)) B (J :'index set)

name: indep_rv_cong
statement:
!p X Y A B f g. indep_rv p X Y A B /\
                    random_variable X p A /\ random_variable Y p B /\
                    f IN measurable A A /\ g IN measurable B B ==>
                    indep_vars p (f o X) (g o Y) A B

name: pairwise_indep_vars_cong
statement:
!p X B (J :'index set) f.
         pairwise_indep_vars p (X :'index -> 'a -> 'b) B (J :'index set) /\
        (!n. n IN J ==> random_variable (X n) p (B n)) /\
        (!n. n IN J ==> f n IN measurable (B n) (B n)) ==>
         pairwise_indep_vars p (\n. (f n) o (X n)) B (J :'index set)

name: indep_vars_expectation
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ real_random_variable Y p /\
            indep_rv p X Y Borel Borel /\ integrable p X /\ integrable p Y ==>
            expectation p (\x. X x * Y x) = expectation p X * expectation p Y

name: indep_vars_imp_uncorrelated
statement:
!p X Y. prob_space p /\ real_random_variable X p /\ real_random_variable Y p /\
            finite_second_moments p X /\ finite_second_moments p Y /\
            indep_rv p X Y Borel Borel ==> uncorrelated p X Y

name: pairwise_indep_vars_imp_uncorrelated
statement:
!p X A (J :'index set). prob_space p /\
           (!i. i IN J ==> real_random_variable (X i) p) /\
           (!i. i IN J ==> finite_second_moments p (X i)) /\
            pairwise_indep_vars p X (\n. Borel) J ==>
            uncorrelated_vars p X J

name: variance_sum'
statement:
!p X (J :'index set).
          prob_space p /\ FINITE J /\ pairwise_indep_vars p X (\n. Borel) J /\
         (!i. i IN J ==> real_random_variable (X i) p) /\
         (!i. i IN J ==> finite_second_moments p (X i)) ==>
         (variance p (\x. SIGMA (\n. X n x) J) = SIGMA (\n. variance p (X n)) J)

name: COND_PROB_ZERO
statement:
!p A B. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\
           (prob p A = 0) /\ prob p B <> 0 ==> (cond_prob p A B = 0)

name: COND_PROB_ZERO_INTER
statement:
!p A B. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\
           (prob p (A INTER B) = 0) /\ prob p B <> 0 ==> (cond_prob p A B = 0)

name: COND_PROB_INCREASING
statement:
!p A B C. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\ C IN events p /\
              prob p C <> 0 ==> cond_prob p (A INTER B) C <= cond_prob p A C

name: COND_PROB_POS_IMP_PROB_NZ
statement:
!A B p. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\
            0 < cond_prob p A B /\ prob p B <> 0 ==> prob p (A INTER B) <> 0

name: COND_PROB_BOUNDS
statement:
!p A B. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\
            prob p B <> 0 ==> 0 <= cond_prob p A B /\ cond_prob p A B <= 1

name: COND_PROB_FINITE
statement:
!p A B. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\
            prob p B <> 0 ==> cond_prob p A B <> PosInf /\ cond_prob p A B <> NegInf

name: COND_PROB_ITSELF
statement: !p B. prob_space p /\ B IN events p /\ prob p B <> 0 ==> (cond_prob p B B = 1)

name: COND_PROB_COMPL
statement:
!p A B. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ COMPL A IN events p /\
            B IN events p /\ prob p B <> 0 ==>
           (cond_prob p (COMPL A) B = 1 - cond_prob p A B)

name: COND_PROB_DIFF
statement:
!p A1 A2 B. prob_space p /\ A1 IN events p /\ A2 IN events p /\
                B IN events p /\ prob p B <> 0 ==>
               (cond_prob p (A1 DIFF A2) B =
                cond_prob p A1 B - cond_prob p (A1 INTER A2) B)

name: COND_PROB_MUL_RULE
statement:
!p A B. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\ prob p B <> 0 ==>
           (prob p (A INTER B) = (prob p B) * (cond_prob p A B))

name: COND_PROB_MUL_EQ
statement:
!p A B. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\
            prob p A <> 0 /\ prob p B <> 0 ==>
           (cond_prob p A B * prob p B = cond_prob p B A * prob p A)

name: COND_PROB_UNION
statement:
!p A1 A2 B.
       prob_space p /\ A1 IN events p /\ A2 IN events p /\ B IN events p /\
       prob p B <> 0 ==>
      (cond_prob p (A1 UNION A2) B =
       (cond_prob p A1 B) + (cond_prob p A2 B) - (cond_prob p (A1 INTER A2) B))

name: COND_PROB_FINITE_ADDITIVE
statement:
!p A B n s. prob_space p /\ B IN events p /\ A IN ((count n) -> events p) /\
                (s = BIGUNION (IMAGE A (count n))) /\ prob p B <> 0 /\
                (!a b. a <> b ==> DISJOINT (A a) (A b)) ==>
                (cond_prob p s B = SIGMA (\i. cond_prob p (A i) B) (count n))

name: BAYES_RULE
statement:
!p A B. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\
            prob p A <> 0 /\ prob p B <> 0 ==>
           (cond_prob p B A = (cond_prob p A B) * (prob p B) / (prob p A))

name: TOTAL_PROB_SIGMA
statement:
!p A B s. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ FINITE s /\
             (!x. x IN s ==> B x IN events p /\ prob p (B x) <> 0) /\
             (!a b. a IN s /\ b IN s /\ ~(a = b) ==> DISJOINT (B a) (B b)) /\
             (BIGUNION (IMAGE B s) = p_space p) ==>
             (prob p A = SIGMA (\i. (prob p (B i)) * (cond_prob p A (B i))) s)

name: BAYES_RULE_GENERAL_SIGMA
statement:
!p A B s k. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ prob p A <> 0 /\ FINITE s /\
        (!x . x IN s ==> B x IN events p /\ prob p (B x) <> 0) /\
         k IN s /\ (!a b. a IN s /\ b IN s /\ ~(a = b) ==> DISJOINT (B a) (B b)) /\
        (BIGUNION (IMAGE B s) = p_space p) ==>
        (cond_prob p (B k) A = ((cond_prob p A (B k)) * prob p (B k)) /
                                (SIGMA (\i. (prob p (B i)) * (cond_prob p A (B i)))) s)

name: COND_PROB_ADDITIVE
statement:
!p A B s. prob_space p /\ FINITE s /\ B IN events p /\
             (!x. x IN s ==> A x IN events p) /\ prob p B <> 0 /\
             (!x y. x IN s /\ y IN s /\ x <> y ==> DISJOINT (A x) (A y)) /\
             (BIGUNION (IMAGE A s) = p_space p) ==>
             (SIGMA (\i. cond_prob p (A i) B) s = 1)

name: COND_PROB_SWAP
statement:
!p A B C.
       prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\ C IN events p /\
       prob p (B INTER C) <> 0 /\ prob p (A INTER C) <> 0 ==>
      (cond_prob p A (B INTER C) * cond_prob p B C =
       cond_prob p B (A INTER C) * cond_prob p A C)

name: PROB_INTER_SPLIT
statement:
!p A B C.
       prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\ C IN events p /\
       prob p (B INTER C) <> 0 ==>
      (prob p (A INTER B INTER C) =
       cond_prob p A (B INTER C) * cond_prob p B C * prob p C)

name: COND_PROB_INTER_SPLIT
statement:
!p A B C.
        prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\ C IN events p /\
        prob p (B INTER C) <> 0 ==>
        (cond_prob p (A INTER B) C = cond_prob p A (B INTER C) * cond_prob p B C)

name: indep_alt_cond_prob
statement:
!p A B. prob_space p /\ A IN events p /\ B IN events p /\ prob p B <> 0 ==>
           (indep p A B <=> cond_prob p A B = prob p A)

name: pdf_le_pos
statement:
!p X x. prob_space p /\ random_variable X p Borel /\
            distribution p X << ext_lborel ==> 0 <= pdf p X x

name: expectation_pdf_1
statement:
!p X. prob_space p /\ random_variable X p Borel /\
          distribution p X << ext_lborel ==>
          expectation ext_lborel (pdf p X) = 1

name: random_variable_def
statement: random_variable X p s <=> X IN measurable (p_space p, events p) s

name: real_random_variable_def
statement:
real_random_variable X p <=>
         random_variable X p Borel /\
         !x. x IN p_space p ==> X x <> NegInf /\ X x <> PosInf

name: identical_distribution_def
statement:
identical_distribution p X E (J :'index set) =
      !i j s. s IN subsets E /\ i IN J /\ j IN J ==>
             (distribution p (X i) s = distribution p (X j) s)

name: joint_distribution_def
statement:
joint_distribution (p :'a p_space) X Y =
      (\a. prob p (PREIMAGE (\x. (X x,Y x)) a INTER p_space p))

name: joint_distribution3_def
statement:
joint_distribution3 (p :'a p_space) X Y Z =
      (\a. prob p (PREIMAGE (\x. (X x,Y x,Z x)) a INTER p_space p))

name: expectation_def
statement: expectation = lebesgue$integral

name: indep_def
statement:
indep p a b = (a IN events p /\ b IN events p /\
                   (prob p (a INTER b) = prob p a * prob p b))

name: pairwise_indep_events
statement:
pairwise_indep_events p E (J :'index set) =
      pairwise (\i j. indep p (E i) (E j)) J

name: indep_events_def
statement:
indep_events p E (J :'index set) =
      !N. N SUBSET J /\ N <> {} /\ FINITE N ==>
         (prob p (BIGINTER (IMAGE E N)) = PI (prob p o E) N)

name: indep_families_def
statement: indep_families p q r = !s t. s IN q /\ t IN r ==> indep p s t

name: pairwise_indep_sets
statement:
pairwise_indep_sets p A (J :'index set) =
      pairwise (\i j. indep_families p (A i) (A j)) J

name: indep_sets_def
statement:
indep_sets p A (J :'index set) =
      !N. N SUBSET J /\ N <> {} /\ FINITE N ==>
         !E. E IN (N --> A) ==> (prob p (BIGINTER (IMAGE E N)) = PI (prob p o E) N)

name: indep_rv_def
statement:
indep_rv (p :'a p_space) (X :'a -> 'b) (Y :'a -> 'b) s t =
      !a b. (a IN subsets s) /\ (b IN subsets t) ==>
            indep p ((PREIMAGE X a) INTER p_space p)
                    ((PREIMAGE Y b) INTER p_space p)

name: pairwise_indep_vars
statement:
pairwise_indep_vars p X A (J :'index set) =
      pairwise (\i j. indep_rv p (X i) (X j) (A i) (A j)) J

name: indep_vars_def
statement:
indep_vars p X A (J :'index set) =
      !E N. N SUBSET J /\ N <> {} /\ FINITE N /\
            E IN (N --> subsets o A) ==>
            prob p (BIGINTER (IMAGE (\n. PREIMAGE (X n) (E n) INTER p_space p) N)) =
            PI (prob p o (\n. PREIMAGE (X n) (E n) INTER p_space p)) N

name: converge_def
statement:
(converge (X :num->'a->extreal) (Y :'a->extreal) (almost_everywhere p) =
     AE x::p. ((\n. real (X n x)) --> real (Y x)) sequentially) /\

   
   (converge (X :num->'a->extreal) (Y :'a->extreal) (in_probability p) =
     !e. 0 < e /\ e <> PosInf ==>
         ((\n. real (prob p {x | x IN p_space p /\ e < abs (X n x - Y x)})) --> 0)
           sequentially) /\

   
   (converge (X :num->'a->extreal) (Y :'a->extreal) (in_lebesgue r p) <=>
     0 < r /\ r <> PosInf /\
     (!n. expectation p (\x. (abs (X n x)) powr r) <> PosInf) /\
     (expectation p (\x. (abs (Y x)) powr r) <> PosInf) /\
     ((\n. real (expectation p (\x. (abs (X n x - Y x)) powr r))) --> 0)
       sequentially)

name: prob_density_function_def
statement: prob_density_function p X = RN_deriv (distribution p X) ext_lborel

name: in_borel_measurable_open
statement:
!f M. f IN borel_measurable M <=>
          (!s. s IN subsets (sigma UNIV {s | open s}) ==>
           (PREIMAGE f s) INTER (space M) IN subsets M)

name: box_alt
statement: !a b. box a b = OPEN_interval (a,b)

name: open_UNION_rational_box
statement:
!M. open M ==> (M = BIGUNION {box a b | a IN q_set /\ b IN q_set /\
                                            box a b SUBSET M})

name: borel_eq_box
statement: borel = sigma UNIV (IMAGE (\(a,b). box a b) UNIV)

name: borel_eq_gr_less
statement: borel = sigma UNIV (IMAGE (\(a,b). {x | a < x /\ x < b}) UNIV)

name: borel_eq_less
statement: borel = sigma UNIV (IMAGE (\a. {x | x < a}) UNIV)

name: borel_eq_le
statement: borel = sigma UNIV (IMAGE (\a. {x | x <= a}) UNIV)

name: borel_eq_gr
statement: borel = sigma UNIV (IMAGE (\a. {x | a < x}) UNIV)

name: borel_eq_ge_le
statement: borel = sigma UNIV (IMAGE (\(a,b). {x | a <= x /\ x <= b}) UNIV)

name: borel_eq_gr_le
statement: borel = sigma UNIV (IMAGE (\(a,b). {x | a < x /\ x <= b}) UNIV)

name: in_borel_measurable_le
statement:
!f m. sigma_algebra m ==>
         (f IN borel_measurable m <=>
          f IN (space m -> UNIV) /\
          !a. {w | w IN space m /\ f w <= a} IN subsets m)

name: in_borel_measurable_gr
statement:
!f m. sigma_algebra m  ==>
         (f IN borel_measurable m <=>
          f IN (space m -> UNIV) /\
          !a. {w | w IN space m /\ a < f w} IN subsets m)

name: in_borel_measurable_less
statement:
!f m. sigma_algebra m ==>
         (f IN borel_measurable m <=>
          f IN (space m -> UNIV) /\
          !a. {w | w IN space m /\ f w < a} IN subsets m)

name: in_borel_measurable_ge
statement:
!f m. sigma_algebra m ==>
         (f IN borel_measurable m <=>
          f IN (space m -> UNIV) /\
          !a. {w | w IN space m /\ a <= f w} IN subsets m)

name: borel_measurable_sets_le
statement: !a. {x | x <= a} IN subsets borel

name: borel_measurable_sets_less
statement: !a. {x | x < a} IN subsets borel

name: borel_measurable_sets_ge
statement: !a. {x | a <= x} IN subsets borel

name: borel_measurable_sets_gr
statement: !a. {x | a < x} IN subsets borel

name: borel_measurable_sets_gr_less
statement: !a b. {x | a < x /\ x < b} IN subsets borel

name: borel_measurable_sets_gr_le
statement: !a b. {x | a < x /\ x <= b} IN subsets borel

name: borel_measurable_sets_ge_less
statement: !a b. {x | a <= x /\ x < b} IN subsets borel

name: borel_measurable_sets_ge_le
statement: !a b. {x | a <= x /\ x <= b} IN subsets borel

name: REAL_SING_BIGINTER
statement:
!(c :real). {c} = BIGINTER (IMAGE (\n. {x | c - ((1/2) pow n) <= x /\
                                                x < c + ((1/2) pow n)}) UNIV)

name: borel_measurable_sets_sing
statement: !c. {c} IN subsets borel

name: borel_measurable_sets_not_sing
statement: !c. {x | x <> c} IN subsets borel

name: borel_measurable_sets
statement:
(!a. {x | x < a} IN subsets borel) /\
   (!a. {x | x <= a} IN subsets borel) /\
   (!a. {x | a < x} IN subsets borel) /\
   (!a. {x | a <= x} IN subsets borel) /\
   (!a b. {x | a < x /\ x < b} IN subsets borel) /\
   (!a b. {x | a < x /\ x <= b} IN subsets borel) /\
   (!a b. {x | a <= x /\ x < b} IN subsets borel) /\
   (!a b. {x | a <= x /\ x <= b} IN subsets borel) /\
   (!c. {c} IN subsets borel) /\
   (!c. {x | x <> c} IN subsets borel)

name: in_borel_measurable_add
statement:
!a f g h. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a borel /\ g IN measurable a borel /\
             (!x. x IN space a ==> (h x = f x + g x)) ==> h IN measurable a borel

name: in_borel_measurable_const
statement: !a k f. sigma_algebra a /\ (!x. x IN space a ==> (f x = k)) ==> f IN measurable a borel

name: in_borel_measurable_cmul
statement:
!a f g z. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a borel /\
             (!x. x IN space a ==> (g x = z * f x)) ==> g IN measurable a borel

name: in_borel_measurable_sub
statement:
!a f g h. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a borel /\ g IN measurable a borel /\
             (!x. x IN space a ==> (h x = f x - g x)) ==> h IN measurable a borel

name: in_borel_measurable_pow2
statement:
!a f g. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a borel /\
            (!x. x IN space a ==> (g x = (f x) pow 2)) ==> g IN measurable a borel

name: in_borel_measurable_mul
statement:
!a f g h. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a borel /\ g IN measurable a borel /\
             (!x. x IN space a ==> (h x = f x * g x)) ==> h IN measurable a borel

name: in_borel_measurable_max
statement:
!a f g. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a borel /\ g IN measurable a borel
        ==> (\x. max (f x) (g x)) IN measurable a borel

name: in_borel_measurable_min
statement:
!a f g. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a borel /\ g IN measurable a borel
        ==> (\x. min (f x) (g x)) IN measurable a borel

name: in_borel_measurable_lt2
statement:
!a f g. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a borel /\ g IN measurable a borel ==>
            {x | x IN space a /\ f x < g x} IN subsets a

name: in_borel_measurable_le2
statement:
!a f g. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a borel /\ g IN measurable a borel ==>
            {x | x IN space a /\ f x <= g x} IN subsets a

name: in_borel_measurable_mul_indicator
statement:
!a f s. sigma_algebra a /\ f IN measurable a borel /\ s IN subsets a ==>
            (\x. f x * indicator_fn s x) IN measurable a borel

name: in_measurable_sigma_pow'
statement:
!a sp N f. sigma_algebra a /\

name: in_right_open_interval

name: right_open_interval_interior
statement: !a b. a < b ==> a IN (right_open_interval a b)

name: in_right_open_intervals

name: right_open_interval_in_intervals

name: right_open_interval_empty

name: in_right_open_intervals_nonempty

name: right_open_interval_empty_eq

name: right_open_interval_DISJOINT

!a b c d. a <= b /\ b <= c /\ c <= d ==>

name: right_open_interval_disjoint

name: right_open_interval_inter

!a b c d. a < b /\ c < d /\

name: right_open_interval_union
statement:
!a b c d. a < b /\ c < d /\ a <= d /\ c <= b ==>
             (right_open_interval a b UNION right_open_interval c d =
              right_open_interval (min a c) (max b d))

name: right_open_interval_DISJOINT_imp
statement:
!a b c d. a < b /\ c < d /\

name: right_open_intervals_semiring

name: right_open_interval_upperbound
statement: !a b. a < b ==> interval_upperbound (right_open_interval a b) = b

name: right_open_interval_lowerbound
statement: !a b. a < b ==> interval_lowerbound (right_open_interval a b) = a

name: right_open_interval_two_bounds
statement:

name: right_open_interval_between_bounds

name: LINE_MONO

name: IMAGE_SND_CROSS_INTERVAL

name: line

name: SPACE

name: ALGEBRA_FINITE_UNION
statement:
!a c. algebra a /\ FINITE c /\ c SUBSET (subsets a) ==>

name: ALGEBRA_FINITE_INTER

name: ALGEBRA_FINITE_INTER'

!a c. algebra a /\ FINITE c /\ c SUBSET (subsets a) /\ c <> {} ==>

name: ALGEBRA_INTER_SPACE

!a s. algebra a /\ s IN subsets a ==>
          ((space a INTER s = s) /\ (s INTER space a = s))

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_EMPTY
statement: !a. sigma_algebra a ==> {} IN (subsets a)

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_SPACE
statement: !a. sigma_algebra a ==> (space a) IN (subsets a)

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_COMPL
statement: !a s. sigma_algebra a /\ s IN (subsets a) ==> (space a DIFF s) IN (subsets a)

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_UNION

!a s t. sigma_algebra a /\ s IN (subsets a) /\ t IN (subsets a) ==>

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_INTER
statement:
!a s t. sigma_algebra a /\ s IN (subsets a) /\ t IN (subsets a) ==>

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_DIFF
statement:
!a s t. sigma_algebra a /\ s IN (subsets a) /\ t IN (subsets a) ==>

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_FINITE_UNION
statement:
!a c. sigma_algebra a /\ FINITE c /\ c SUBSET (subsets a) ==>

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_FINITE_INTER
statement:
!a f n. sigma_algebra a /\ 0 < n /\ (!i. i < n ==> f i IN (subsets a)) ==>

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_FINITE_INTER'
statement:
!a c. sigma_algebra a /\ FINITE c /\ c SUBSET (subsets a) /\ c <> {} ==>

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_ALT_SPACE

!a. sigma_algebra a <=>

name: SIGMA_SMALLEST

name: PREIMAGE_SIGMA_ALGEBRA

             sigma_algebra (sp,IMAGE (\s. PREIMAGE f s INTER sp) (subsets A))

name: SIGMA_CONG

name: SEMIRING_FINITE_INTER

!r f n. semiring r /\ 0 < n /\ (!i. i < n ==> f i IN (subsets r)) ==>

name: SEMIRING_FINITE_INTER'

name: RING_FINITE_INTER

name: RING_FINITE_INTER'

name: INTER_SPACE_REDUCE
statement: !sp sts. subset_class sp sts ==> !x. x IN sts ==> (x INTER sp = x)

name: RING_FINITE_BIGUNION1
statement: !X sp sts. ring (sp, sts) /\ FINITE X ==> X SUBSET sts ==> BIGUNION X IN sts

name: RING_FINITE_BIGUNION2

!A N sp sts. ring (sp, sts) /\ FINITE N /\ (!i. i IN N ==> A i IN sts) ==>

name: RING_DIFF_ALT

name: ring_alt_pow_imp

!sp sts. sts SUBSET POW sp /\ {} IN sts /\

            (!a b. a IN sts /\ b IN sts ==> a DIFF b IN sts) ==> ring (sp, sts)

name: ring_alt_pow

!sp sts. ring (sp, sts) <=>

             (!s t. s IN sts /\ t IN sts ==> s DIFF t IN sts)

name: RING_BIGUNION

name: ring_disjointed_sets

name: RING_INSERT
statement: !x A sp sts. ring (sp,sts) /\ {x} IN sts /\ A IN sts ==> x INSERT A IN sts

name: RING_SETS_COLLECT_FINITE

!sp sts s P. ring (sp, sts) /\

statement: !sp sts. algebra (sp, sts) <=> ring (sp, sts) /\ sp IN sts

name: ALGEBRA_COMPL_SETS
statement: !sp sts a. algebra (sp,sts) /\ a IN sts ==> sp DIFF a IN sts

!sp sts. algebra (sp,sts) <=>

             (!a b. a IN sts /\ b IN sts ==> a UNION b IN sts)

name: algebra_alt_inter

!sp sts. algebra (sp,sts) <=> sts SUBSET POW sp /\ {} IN sts /\
             (!a. a IN sts ==> sp DIFF a IN sts) /\
             (!a b. a IN sts /\  b IN sts ==> a INTER b IN sts)

name: ALGEBRA_SETS_COLLECT_NEG
statement:
!sp sts P. algebra (sp,sts) /\ {x | x IN sp /\ P x} IN sts ==>

name: ALGEBRA_SETS_COLLECT_IMP

!sp sts P Q. algebra (sp,sts) /\ {x | x IN sp /\ P x} IN sts ==>

                 {x | x IN sp /\ (Q x ==> P x)} IN sts

name: ALGEBRA_SETS_COLLECT_CONST
statement: !sp sts P. algebra (sp,sts) ==> {x | x IN sp /\ P} IN sts

name: ALGEBRA_SINGLE_SET

name: ALGEBRA_RESTRICT'

name: ALGEBRA_RESTRICT

!sp sts a. algebra (sp,sts) /\ a IN sts ==>

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_RESTRICT'

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_RESTRICT
statement:
!sp sts a. sigma_algebra (sp,sts) /\ a IN sts ==>

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_RESTRICT_SUBSET
statement:
!sp sts a. sigma_algebra (sp,sts) /\ a IN sts ==>

name: sigma_algebra_alt
statement:
!sp sts. sigma_algebra (sp,sts) <=>
             algebra (sp,sts) /\
             !A. IMAGE A UNIV SUBSET sts ==> BIGUNION {A i | i IN univ(:num)} IN sts

name: sigma_algebra_alt_pow
statement:
!sp sts. sigma_algebra (sp,sts) <=>
             sts SUBSET POW sp /\ {} IN sts /\
            (!s. s IN sts ==> sp DIFF s IN sts) /\
            (!A. IMAGE A UNIV SUBSET sts ==>

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_COUNTABLE_UN
statement:
!sp sts A X. sigma_algebra (sp,sts) /\ IMAGE (A:num->'a->bool) X SUBSET sts ==>
                 BIGUNION {A x | x IN X} IN sts

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_COUNTABLE_UN'
statement:
!sp sts A X. sigma_algebra (sp,sts) /\ IMAGE A X SUBSET sts /\

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_COUNTABLE_INT
statement:
!sp sts A X. sigma_algebra (sp,sts) /\ IMAGE (A:num->'a->bool) X SUBSET sts /\

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_COUNTABLE_INT'
statement:
!sp sts A X. sigma_algebra (sp,sts) /\ countable X /\ (X <> {}) /\
                 IMAGE (A:num->'a->bool) X SUBSET sts ==>
                 BIGINTER {(A:num->'a->bool) x | x IN X} IN sts

name: sigma_sets_BIGUNION
statement:
!sp st A. (!i. (A:num->'a->bool) i IN sigma_sets sp st) ==>
              BIGUNION {A i | i IN UNIV} IN sigma_sets sp st

name: sigma_algebra_sigma_sets
statement: !sp st. st SUBSET POW sp ==> sigma_algebra (sp, sigma_sets sp st)

name: sigma_sets_least_sigma_algebra
statement:
!sp A. A SUBSET POW sp ==>
          (sigma_sets sp A =
           BIGINTER {B | A SUBSET B /\ sigma_algebra (sp,B)})

name: sigma_sets_union
statement:
!sp st a b. a IN sigma_sets sp st /\ b IN sigma_sets sp st ==>
                a UNION b IN sigma_sets sp st

name: sigma_sets_BIGINTER
statement:
!sp st A. st SUBSET POW sp ==>
             (!i. (A :num->'a->bool) i IN sigma_sets sp st) ==>
              BIGINTER {A i | i IN UNIV} IN sigma_sets sp st

name: sigma_sets_BIGINTER2
statement:
!sp st A N. st SUBSET POW sp /\  (!i:num. i IN N ==> A i IN sigma_sets sp st) /\
               (N <> {}) ==> BIGINTER {A i | i IN N} IN sigma_sets sp st

name: sigma_sets_fixpoint
statement: !sp sts. sigma_algebra (sp,sts) ==> (sigma_sets sp sts = sts)

name: sigma_sets_superset_generator
statement: !X A. A SUBSET sigma_sets X A

name: IN_MEASURABLE
statement:
!a b f. f IN measurable a b <=>
            f IN (space a -> space b) /\
            (!s. s IN subsets b ==> ((PREIMAGE f s)INTER(space a)) IN subsets a)

name: MEASURABLE_LEMMA
statement:
!f a b sp sts.
       sigma_algebra a /\ subset_class sp sts /\
       f IN (space a -> sp) /\ b = (sigma sp sts)
     ==>
      ((!s. s IN subsets b ==> ((PREIMAGE f s) INTER (space a)) IN subsets a)
       <=>
       (!s. s IN sts       ==> ((PREIMAGE f s) INTER (space a)) IN subsets a))

name: MEASURABLE_SUBSET
statement:
!a b. sigma_algebra a /\ subset_class (space b) (subsets b) ==>
          measurable a b SUBSET measurable a (sigma (space b) (subsets b))

name: MEASURABLE_LIFT
statement:
!f a b. sigma_algebra a /\ subset_class (space b) (subsets b) /\
            f IN measurable a b ==> f IN measurable a (sigma (space b) (subsets b))

name: MEASURABLE_UP_SIGMA
statement:
!a b. subset_class (space a) (subsets a) /\ sigma_algebra b ==>
          measurable a b SUBSET measurable (sigma (space a) (subsets a)) b

name: MEASURABLE_PROD_SIGMA'
statement:
!a a1 a2 f. sigma_algebra a /\
                subset_class (space a1) (subsets a1) /\
                subset_class (space a2) (subsets a2) /\
               (FST o f) IN measurable a a1 /\
               (SND o f) IN measurable a a2 ==> f IN measurable a (a1 CROSS a2)

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_PROD_SIGMA
statement:
!a b. subset_class (space a) (subsets a) /\
          subset_class (space b) (subsets b) ==> sigma_algebra (prod_sigma a b)

name: SPACE_PROD_SIGMA
statement: !a b. space (prod_sigma a b) = space a CROSS space b

name: space_sigma_function
statement: !sp A f. space (sigma_function sp A f) = sp

name: sigma_algebra_sigma_function
statement:
!sp A f. sigma_algebra A /\ f IN (sp -> space A) ==>

name: sigma_function_subset
statement:
!A B f. sigma_algebra A /\ f IN measurable A B ==>

name: SIGMA_MEASURABLE
statement:
!sp A f. sigma_algebra A /\ f IN (sp -> space A) ==>

name: space_sigma_functions
statement: !sp A f (J :'index set). space (sigma_functions sp A f J) = sp

name: sigma_algebra_sigma_functions

            sigma_algebra (sigma_functions sp A f J)

name: sigma_functions_subset

            (!i. i IN J ==> sigma_algebra (B i)) /\
            (!i. i IN J ==> f i IN measurable A (B i)) ==>
            subsets (sigma (space A) B f J) SUBSET subsets A

name: sigma_functions_1
statement:
!sp A f. sigma_algebra A /\ f 0 IN (sp -> space A) ==>
             sigma sp (\n. A) f (count 1) = sigma sp A (f 0)

name: sigma_function_alt_sigma_functions
statement:
!sp A X. sigma_algebra A /\ X IN (sp -> space A) ==>
             sigma sp A X = sigma sp (\n. A) (\n x. X x) (count 1)

name: SIGMA_SIMULTANEOUSLY_MEASURABLE
statement:
!sp A f (J :'index set).
            (!i. i IN J ==> sigma_algebra (A i)) /\
            (!i. f i IN (sp -> space (A i))) ==>
             !i. i IN J ==> f i IN measurable (sigma sp A f J) (A i)

name: prod_sigma_alt_sigma_functions'
statement:
!A B. algebra A /\ algebra B ==>
          prod_sigma A B =
          sigma_functions (space A CROSS space B)
                          (binary A B) (binary FST SND) {0; 1 :num}

name: prod_sigma_alt_sigma_functions
statement:
!A B. sigma_algebra A /\ sigma_algebra B ==>
          prod_sigma A B =
          sigma_functions (space A CROSS space B)
                          (binary A B) (binary FST SND) {0; 1 :num}

name: PREIMAGE_SIGMA_SUBSET
statement:
!Z sp sts f. subset_class sp sts /\ f IN (Z -> sp) ==>
                 IMAGE (\s. PREIMAGE f s INTER Z) (subsets (sigma sp sts)) SUBSET
                 subsets (sigma Z (IMAGE (\s. PREIMAGE f s INTER Z) sts))

name: PREIMAGE_SIGMA
statement:
!Z sp sts f. subset_class sp sts /\ f IN (Z -> sp) ==>
                 IMAGE (\s. PREIMAGE f s INTER Z) (subsets (sigma sp sts)) =
                 subsets (sigma Z (IMAGE (\s. PREIMAGE f s INTER Z) sts))

name: SIGMA_RESTRICT
statement:
!sp sts B. subset_class sp sts /\ B SUBSET sp ==>
               sigma_algebra (B,IMAGE (\s. s INTER B) (subsets (sigma sp sts))) /\
               subsets (sigma B (IMAGE (\s. s INTER B) sts)) =
               IMAGE (\s. s INTER B) (subsets (sigma sp sts))

name: TRACE_SIGMA_ALGEBRA
statement:
!a E. sigma_algebra a /\ E SUBSET (space a) ==>
          sigma_algebra (E,{A INTER E | A IN subsets a})

name: SEMIRING_PROD_SETS

!a b. semiring a /\ semiring b ==>
          semiring ((space a CROSS space b),prod_sets (subsets a) (subsets b))

name: SEMIRING_PROD_SETS'

          semiring ((space a CROSS space b),prod_sets (subsets a) (subsets b))

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_SUBSET_SPACE
statement: !a s. sigma_algebra a /\ s IN subsets a ==> s SUBSET space a

name: SIGMA_ALGEBRA_PROD_SIGMA_WEAK
statement: !a b. sigma_algebra a /\ sigma_algebra b ==> sigma_algebra (a CROSS b)

name: IN_SPACE_PROD_SIGMA
statement: !a b z. z IN space (a CROSS b) <=> FST z IN space a /\ SND z IN space b

name: MEASURABLE_FST
statement: !a b. sigma_algebra a /\ sigma_algebra b ==> FST IN measurable (a CROSS b) a

name: MEASURABLE_SND
statement: !a b. sigma_algebra a /\ sigma_algebra b ==> SND IN measurable (a CROSS b) b

name: IN_MEASURABLE_EQ
statement: !a b f g. f IN measurable a b /\ (!x. x IN space a ==> g x = f x) ==> g IN measurable a b

name: IN_MEASURABLE_CONG
statement: !a b c d f g. a = c /\ b = d /\ (!x. x IN space c ==> f x = g x) ==> (f IN measurable a b <=> g IN measurable c d)

name: IN_MEASURABLE_COMP
statement:
!f g h a b c. f IN measurable a b /\ g IN measurable b c /\ (!x. x IN space a ==> h x = g (f x)) ==>
        h IN measurable a c

name: IN_MEASURABLE_PROD_SIGMA
statement:
!a bx by fx fy f.
        sigma_algebra a /\
        subset_class (space bx) (subsets bx) /\
        subset_class (space by) (subsets by) /\
        fx IN measurable a bx /\ fy IN measurable a by /\
        (!z. z IN space a ==> f z = (fx z,fy z)) ==> f IN measurable a (bx CROSS by)

name: algebra_finite_subsets_imp_sigma_algebra
statement: !a. algebra a /\ FINITE (subsets a) ==> sigma_algebra a

name: algebra_finite_space_imp_sigma_algebra
statement: !a. algebra a /\ FINITE (space a) ==> sigma_algebra a

name: algebra_def
statement:
algebra a =
    (subset_class (space a) (subsets a) /\
     {} IN subsets a /\
     (!s. s IN subsets a ==> space a DIFF s IN subsets a) /\
     (!s t. s IN subsets a /\ t IN subsets a ==> s UNION t IN subsets a))

name: sigma_algebra_def
statement:
sigma_algebra a =
    (algebra a /\
     !c. countable c /\ c SUBSET (subsets a) ==> BIGUNION c IN (subsets a))

name: semiring_def
statement:
semiring r =
    (subset_class (space r) (subsets r) /\
     {} IN (subsets r) /\
     (!s t. s IN (subsets r) /\ t IN (subsets r) ==> s INTER t IN (subsets r)) /\
     (!s t. s IN (subsets r) /\ t IN (subsets r) ==>
            ?c. c SUBSET (subsets r) /\ FINITE c /\ disjoint c /\
               (s DIFF t = BIGUNION c)))

name: ring_def
statement:
ring r =
    (subset_class (space r) (subsets r) /\
     {} IN (subsets r) /\
     (!s t. s IN (subsets r) /\ t IN (subsets r) ==> s UNION t IN (subsets r)) /\
     (!s t. s IN (subsets r) /\ t IN (subsets r) ==> s DIFF t IN (subsets r)))

name: dynkin_system_def
statement:
dynkin_system d =
    (subset_class (space d) (subsets d) /\
     (space d) IN (subsets d) /\
     (!s. s IN (subsets d) ==> (space d DIFF s) IN (subsets d)) /\
     (!f :num -> 'a set.
        f IN (UNIV -> (subsets d)) /\ (!i j. i <> j ==> DISJOINT (f i) (f j))
        ==> BIGUNION (IMAGE f UNIV) IN (subsets d)))

name: sigma_function_def
statement: sigma_function sp A f = (sp,IMAGE (\s. PREIMAGE f s INTER sp) (subsets A))

name: sigma_functions_def
statement:
sigma_functions sp A f (J :'index set) =
      sigma sp (BIGUNION (IMAGE (\i. IMAGE (\s. PREIMAGE (f i) s INTER sp)
                                           (subsets (A i))) J))

name: sigma_sets_def
statement:
(sigma_sets sp st {}) /\
    (!a. st a ==> sigma_sets sp st a) /\
    (!a. sigma_sets sp st a ==> sigma_sets sp st (sp DIFF a)) /\
    (!A. (!i. sigma_sets sp st ((A :num->'a->bool) i)) ==>
              sigma_sets sp st (BIGUNION {A i | i IN UNIV}))

name: IN_PROD_SETS
statement: !s a b. s IN prod_sets a b <=> ?t u. (s = t CROSS u) /\ t IN a /\ u IN b

name: finite_enumeration_of_sets_has_max_non_empty
statement:
!f s. FINITE s /\ (!x. f x IN s) /\
            (!m n. ~(m = n) ==> DISJOINT (f m) (f n)) ==>
            ?N. !n:num. n >= N ==> (f n = {})

name: DISJOINT_RESTRICT_L
statement: !s t c. DISJOINT s t ==> DISJOINT (s INTER c) (t INTER c)

name: DISJOINT_RESTRICT_R
statement: !s t c. DISJOINT s t ==> DISJOINT (c INTER s) (c INTER t)

name: DISJOINT_CROSS_L
statement: !s t c. DISJOINT s t ==> DISJOINT (s CROSS c) (t CROSS c)

name: DISJOINT_CROSS_R
statement: !s t c. DISJOINT s t ==> DISJOINT (c CROSS s) (c CROSS t)

name: SUBSET_RESTRICT_L
statement: !r s t. s SUBSET t ==> (s INTER r) SUBSET (t INTER r)

name: SUBSET_RESTRICT_R
statement: !r s t. s SUBSET t ==> (r INTER s) SUBSET (r INTER t)

name: SUBSET_RESTRICT_DIFF
statement: !r s t. s SUBSET t ==> (r DIFF t) SUBSET (r DIFF s)

name: SUBSET_INTER_SUBSET_L
statement: !r s t. s SUBSET t ==> (s INTER r) SUBSET t

name: SUBSET_INTER_SUBSET_R
statement: !r s t. s SUBSET t ==> (r INTER s) SUBSET t

name: SUBSET_MONO_DIFF
statement: !r s t. s SUBSET t ==> (s DIFF r) SUBSET (t DIFF r)

name: SUBSET_DIFF_SUBSET
statement: !r s t. s SUBSET t ==> (s DIFF r) SUBSET t

name: SUBSET_DIFF_DISJOINT
statement: !s1 s2 s3. (s1 SUBSET (s2 DIFF s3)) ==> DISJOINT s1 s3

name: BINARY_RANGE
statement: !a b. IMAGE (binary a b) UNIV = {a;b}

name: UNION_BINARY
statement: !a b. a UNION b = BIGUNION {binary a b i | i IN UNIV}

name: INTER_BINARY
statement: !a b. a INTER b = BIGINTER {binary a b i | i IN UNIV}

name: FINITE_TWO
statement: !s t. FINITE {s; t}

name: SUBSET_TWO
statement: !N s t. N SUBSET {s; t} /\ N <> {} ==> N = {s} \/ N = {t} \/ N = {s; t}

name: BIGUNION_OVER_INTER_L
statement: !f s d. BIGUNION (IMAGE f s) INTER d = BIGUNION (IMAGE (\i. f i INTER d) s)

name: BIGUNION_OVER_DIFF
statement: !f s d. BIGUNION (IMAGE f s) DIFF d = BIGUNION (IMAGE (\i. f i DIFF d) s)

name: BIGINTER_OVER_INTER_L
statement:
!f s d. s <> {} ==> (BIGINTER (IMAGE f s) INTER d =
                         BIGINTER (IMAGE (\i. f i INTER d) s))

name: finite_decomposition
statement:
!c. FINITE c ==>
        ?f n. (!x. x < n ==> f x IN c) /\ (c = IMAGE f (count n)) /\
              (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ i <> j ==> f i <> f j)

name: finite_disjoint_decomposition
statement:
!c. FINITE c /\ disjoint c ==>
        ?f n. (!i. i < n ==> f i IN c) /\ (c = IMAGE f (count n)) /\
              (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ i <> j ==> f i <> f j) /\
              (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ i <> j ==> DISJOINT (f i) (f j))

name: finite_disjoint_decomposition'
statement:
!c. FINITE c /\ disjoint c ==>
        ?f n. (!i. i < n ==> f i IN c) /\ (!i. n <= i ==> (f i = {})) /\
              (c = IMAGE f (count n)) /\
              (BIGUNION c = BIGUNION (IMAGE f univ(:num))) /\
              (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ i <> j ==> f i <> f j) /\
              (!i j. i < n /\ j < n /\ i <> j ==> DISJOINT (f i) (f j))

name: disjoint_family_on_def
statement:
!A J. disjoint_family_on A (J :'index set) <=>
         (!i j. i IN J /\ j IN J /\ (i <> j) ==> DISJOINT (A i) (A j))

name: disjoint_family_def
statement:
!A. disjoint_family (A :'index -> 'a set) <=>
        !i j. i <> j ==> DISJOINT (A i) (A j)

name: disjoint_family_disjoint
statement: !A. disjoint_family (disjointed A)

name: BIGUNION_disjointed
statement: !A. BIGUNION {disjointed A i | i IN UNIV} = BIGUNION {A i | i IN UNIV}

name: infinitely_often_lemma
statement: !P. ~(?N. INFINITE N /\ !n:num. n IN N ==> P n) <=> ?m. !n. m <= n ==> ~(P n)

name: infinity_bound_lemma
statement: !N m. INFINITE N ==> ?n:num. m <= n /\ n IN N

name: LIMSUP_COMPL
statement: !(E :num -> 'a set). COMPL (liminf E) = limsup (COMPL o E)

name: LIMSUP_DIFF
statement: !sp E. (!n. E n SUBSET sp) ==> (sp DIFF (liminf E) = limsup (\n. sp DIFF (E n)))

name: IN_LIMSUP
statement: !A x. x IN limsup A <=> ?N. INFINITE N /\ !n. n IN N ==> x IN (A n)

name: IN_LIMINF
statement: !A x. x IN liminf A <=> ?m. !n. m <= n ==> x IN (A n)

name: LIMSUP_MONO_STRONGER
statement: !A B. (?d. !y n. y IN A n ==> ?m. n - d <= m /\ y IN B m) ==> limsup A SUBSET limsup B

name: LIMSUP_MONO_STRONG
statement: !A B. (!y n. y IN A n ==> ?m. n <= m /\ y IN B m) ==> limsup A SUBSET limsup B

name: LIMSUP_MONO_WEAK
statement: !A B. (!n. A n SUBSET B n) ==> limsup A SUBSET limsup B

name: count1_def
statement: !n. count1 n = {m | m <= n}

name: count1_numseg
statement: !n. count1 n = {0..n}

name: prod_sets_def
statement: prod_sets a b = {s CROSS t | s IN a /\ t IN b}

name: binary_def
statement: binary a b = (\x:num. if x = 0 then a else b)

name: disjoint_family_on
statement:
disjoint_family_on a s =
      (!m n. m IN s /\ n IN s /\ (m <> n) ==> (a m INTER a n = {}))

name: disjointed
statement: disjointed A n = A n DIFF BIGUNION {A i | i IN {x:num | 0 <= x /\ x < n}}

name: LENGTH_TO_EXISTS_CONS
statement:
(n < LENGTH xs <=> (?y ys. (xs = y :: ys) /\ n <= LENGTH ys))
  /\
  (LENGTH xs > n <=> (?y ys. (xs = y :: ys) /\ n <= LENGTH ys))
  /\
  (0 < n ==> ((LENGTH xs = n) <=> (?y ys. (xs = y :: ys) /\ (LENGTH ys = PRE n))))
  /\
  (0 < n ==> ((n = LENGTH xs) <=> (?y ys. (xs = y :: ys) /\ (LENGTH ys = PRE n))))
  /\
  (0 < n ==> (n <= LENGTH xs <=> (?y ys. (xs = y :: ys) /\ PRE n <= LENGTH ys)))
  /\
  (0 < n ==> (LENGTH xs >= n <=> (?y ys. (xs = y :: ys) /\ PRE n <= LENGTH ys)))
  /\
  (0 < x ==> (PRE (x + y) = PRE x + y))
  /\
  (0 < y ==> (PRE (x + y) = x + PRE y))

name: HD_TL_EQ_NIL_1
statement: !l. ([HD l] = l) <=> (LENGTH l = 1)

name: CONS_EQ_REWRITE
statement:
((x :: xs = ys) <=> 1 <= LENGTH ys /\ (x = HD ys) /\ (xs = TL ys))
  /\
  ((ys = x :: xs) <=> 1 <= LENGTH ys /\ (HD ys = x) /\ (TL ys = xs))
  /\
  (0 < n ==> (n <= LENGTH (TL ys) <=> n + 1 <= LENGTH ys))
  /\
  (n <= m ==> (n <= rhs /\ m <= rhs <=> m <= rhs))
  /\
  (([] = TL ys) <=> LENGTH ys <= 1)
  /\
  ((TL ys = []) <=> LENGTH ys <= 1)
  /\
  (LENGTH (TL ys) <= n <=> LENGTH ys <= n + 1)
  /\
  (m <= n /\ n <= m <=> (m = n))
  /\
  (m <= LENGTH ys /\ (n = LENGTH ys) <=> m <= n /\ (n = LENGTH ys))

name: QUOTIENT_REP
statement: !R (abs:'a->'b). QUOTIENT R abs ==> (!a. ?r. R r r /\ (abs r = a))

name: QUOTIENT_REL
statement:
!R (abs:'a->'b). QUOTIENT R abs ==>
                   (!r s. R r s <=> R r r /\ R s s /\ (abs r = abs s))

name: MEM_Delete1
statement: !A (a:'a) x. MEM x (A Delete1 a) <=> MEM x A /\ ~(x = a)

name: MEM_Inter1
statement: !A B (x:'a). MEM x (A Inter1 B) <=> MEM x A /\ MEM x B

name: list_EXTENSION
statement: !A B. A == B <=> (!a:'a. MEM a A = MEM a B)

name: MEM_Inter1
statement:
!A B (x:'a).
           MEM x (A Inter1 B) <=> MEM x A /\ MEM x B

name: ETA_R_equals
statement:
(!x t:^term. ETA_R (Var x) t = F) /\
   (!t u t':^term. ETA_R (App t u) t' = F) /\
   (!x u t:^term. ETA_R (Lam x u) t <=> ~(x IN FV t) /\ (u = App t (Var x)))

name: vsubst1
statement:
(!ys. [] // ys = []:^subs) /\
   (!xs. xs // [] = []:^subs) /\
   (!xs ys x y.
       (CONS x xs) // (CONS y ys) = CONS (x, Var1 y :'a term1) (xs // ys))

name: HEIGHT1_def
statement:
(HEIGHT1 (Con1 a)    = 0)                                       /\
    (HEIGHT1 (Var1 x)    = 0)                                       /\
    (HEIGHT1 (App1 t u)  = SUC (HEIGHT1 t MAX HEIGHT1 u)) /\
    (HEIGHT1 (Lam1 x u)  = SUC (HEIGHT1 u))

name: vsubst1_def
statement:
($// NIL ys = NIL) /\
  ($// (CONS (x:var) xs) ys =
   (if ys = [] then [] else
      CONS (x, (Var1 (HD ys) :'a term1))
           ($// xs (TL ys))))

name: SUB_term1_def
statement:
($SUB1t (Con1 (a:'a)) s = Con1 a)                                    /\
    ($SUB1t (Var1 x) s      = SUB1 s x)                                  /\
    ($SUB1t (App1 t u) s    = App1 ($SUB1t t s) ($SUB1t u s))            /\
    ($SUB1t (Lam1 x u) s    =
          let x' = variant x (FV_subst1 s (FV1 u DIFF {x}))  in
          Lam1 x' ($SUB1t u (CONS (x, Var1 x') s)))

name: VAR_EQ
statement: !x y. (x = y) <=> (Base x = Base y) /\ (Index x = Index y)

name: is_variant_SOME_mk_variant
statement: !x y. y is_variant x <=> (?k. y = mk_variant x k)

name: is_variant_NOT_EQ
statement: !x y. (y is_variant x) /\ ~(x = y) ==> (y is_variant mk_variant x 1)

name: LENGTH_FILTER_LESS_EQ
statement:
!l n.  LENGTH (FILTER (\y. n = y) l) + LENGTH (FILTER (\y. n < y) l) =
         LENGTH (FILTER (\y. n <= y) l)

name: NULL_APPEND
statement: !l1 l2:('a) list. NULL (APPEND l1 l2) <=> NULL l1 /\ NULL l2

name: HEIGHT_LESS_EQ_ZERO
statement:
(!o'. (HEIGHT_obj o' <= 0) = (?x. o' = OVAR x)) /\
  (!d. (HEIGHT_dict d <= 0) = (d = NIL)) /\
  (!e. (HEIGHT_entry e <= 0) = F) /\
  (!m. (HEIGHT_method m <= 0) = F)

name: HEIGHT1_def
statement:
(HEIGHT_obj1 (OVAR1 x)       = 0)                                        /\
    (HEIGHT_obj1 (OBJ1 d)        = SUC (HEIGHT_dict1 d))                     /\
    (HEIGHT_obj1 (INVOKE1 a l)   = SUC (HEIGHT_obj1 a))                      /\
    (HEIGHT_obj1 (UPDATE1 a l m) = SUC (HEIGHT_obj1 a MAX HEIGHT_method1 m))
     /\
    (HEIGHT_dict1 (CONS e d)     = SUC (HEIGHT_entry1 e MAX HEIGHT_dict1 d)) /\
    (HEIGHT_dict1 (NIL)          = 0)
     /\
    (HEIGHT_entry1 (l, m)        = SUC (HEIGHT_method1 m))
     /\
    (HEIGHT_method1 (SIGMA1 x a) = SUC (HEIGHT_obj1 a))

name: FV_object1_def
statement:
(FV_obj1 (OVAR1 x)        = {x})                                /\
    (FV_obj1 (OBJ1 d)         = FV_dict1 d)                         /\
    (FV_obj1 (INVOKE1 a l)    = FV_obj1 a)                          /\
    (FV_obj1 (UPDATE1 a l m)  = FV_obj1 a UNION FV_method1 m)
     /\
    (FV_dict1 (CONS e es)     = FV_entry1 e UNION FV_dict1 es)      /\
    (FV_dict1 (NIL)           = {})
     /\
    (FV_entry1 (l, m)         = FV_method1 m)
     /\
    (FV_method1 (SIGMA1 y b)  = FV_obj1 b DIFF {y})

name: vsubst1_def
statement:
($// NIL ys = NIL) /\
        ($// (CONS (x:var) xs) ys = (if ys = [] then [] else
                                                CONS (x, OVAR1 (HD ys))
                                                     ($// xs (TL ys))))

name: NSUB_object1_def
statement:
($NSUB1o (OVAR1 x) s        = SUB1 s x)                                /\
    ($NSUB1o (OBJ1 d) s         = OBJ1 ($NSUB1d d s))                      /\
    ($NSUB1o (INVOKE1 a l) s    = INVOKE1 ($NSUB1o a s) l)                 /\
    ($NSUB1o (UPDATE1 a l m) s  = UPDATE1 ($NSUB1o a s) l ($NSUB1m m s))
     /\
    ($NSUB1d (CONS e es) s      = CONS ($NSUB1e e s) ($NSUB1d es s))       /\
    ($NSUB1d (NIL) s            = NIL)
     /\
    ($NSUB1e (l, m) s           = (l, ($NSUB1m m s)))
     /\
    ($NSUB1m (SIGMA1 x a) s     = SIGMA1 x ($NSUB1o a s))

name: SUB_object1_def
statement:
($SUB1o (OVAR1 x) s        = SUB1 s x)                               /\
    ($SUB1o (OBJ1 d) s         = OBJ1 ($SUB1d d s))                      /\
    ($SUB1o (INVOKE1 a l) s    = INVOKE1 ($SUB1o a s) l)                 /\
    ($SUB1o (UPDATE1 a l m) s  = UPDATE1 ($SUB1o a s) l ($SUB1m m s))
     /\
    ($SUB1d (CONS e es) s      = CONS ($SUB1e e s) ($SUB1d es s))        /\
    ($SUB1d (NIL) s            = NIL)
     /\
    ($SUB1e (l, m) s           = (l, ($SUB1m m s)))
     /\
    ($SUB1m (SIGMA1 y b) s     =
          let y' = variant y (FV_subst1 s (FV_obj1 b DIFF {y}))  in
          SIGMA1 y' ($SUB1o b (CONS (y, OVAR1 y') s)))

name: FV_invoke_method
statement: !m o'. FV_obj (invoke_method m o') SUBSET (FV_method m UNION FV_obj o')

name: is_variant_NOT_EQ
statement: !x y. (y is_variant x) /\ ~(x = y) ==> (y is_variant mk_variant x 1)

name: EQUIV_IMP_PARTIAL_EQUIV
statement: !R :'a -> 'a -> bool. EQUIV R ==> PARTIAL_EQUIV R

name: QUOTIENT_REL
statement:
!R (abs:'a->'b) rep. QUOTIENT R abs rep ==>
                       (!r s. R r s <=> R r r /\ R s s /\ (abs r = abs s))

name: EQUIV_REFL_SYM_TRANS
statement:
!R.
         (!x y:'a. R x y = (R x = R y))
           <=>
         (!x. R x x) /\
         (!x y. R x y ==> R y x) /\
         (!x y z. R x y /\ R y z ==> R x z)

name: IN_FUN
statement:
!(f:'a -> 'b) (g:bool -> bool) s x.
        x IN ((f --> g) s) <=> g ((f x) IN s)

name: IN_RESPECTS
statement: !(R:'a->'a->bool) x. x IN respects R <=> R x x

name: RES_EXISTS_EQUIV
statement:
!R m.
         RES_EXISTS_EQUIV R m <=>
           (?(x : 'a) :: respects R. m x) /\
           (!x y :: respects R. m x /\ m y ==> (R x y))

name: FUN_REL_IMP
statement:
!(R1:'a->'a->bool) (R2:'b->'b->bool) f g x y.
    (R1 ===> R2) f g /\ (R1 x y) ==> (R2 (f x) (g y))

name: QT_FUN_REL_IMP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1.
    QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
    !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2.
      QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
      !f g. respects(R1 ===> R2) f /\ respects(R1 ===> R2) g /\
            ((rep1 --> abs2) f = (rep1 --> abs2) g) ==>
            !x y. R1 x y ==> R2 (f x) (g y)

name: ABSTRACT_PRS
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1.
    QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
    !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2.
      QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
      !f. f = (rep1 --> abs2) (RES_ABSTRACT (respects R1) ((abs1 --> rep2) f))

name: RES_ABSTRACT_RSP
statement:
!R1 (abs1:'a -> 'c) rep1.
    QUOTIENT R1 abs1 rep1 ==>
    !R2 (abs2:'b -> 'd) rep2.
      QUOTIENT R2 abs2 rep2 ==>
      !f1 f2.
        (R1 ===> R2) f1 f2 ==>
        (R1 ===> R2) (RES_ABSTRACT (respects R1) f1)
                     (RES_ABSTRACT (respects R1) f2)

name: LEFT_RES_FORALL_REGULAR
statement:
!P R Q.
    (!x:'a. R x /\ (Q x ==> P x)) ==>
    (RES_FORALL R Q ==> $! P)

name: RIGHT_RES_FORALL_REGULAR
statement:
!P R Q. (!x:'a. R x ==> P x ==> Q x) ==>
          ($! P ==> RES_FORALL R Q)

name: INT_SGN_TOTAL
statement: !a. (SGN a = ~1) \/ (SGN a = 0) \/ (SGN a = 1)

name: ABS_EQ_MUL_SGN

name: MUL_ABS_SGN
statement: ABS x * SGN x = x

name: ABS_SGN
statement: ABS (SGN i) = if i = 0 then 0 else 1

name: SGN_MUL_Num

name: INT_MUL_POS_SIGN
statement: !a:int b:int. 0 < a ==> 0 < b ==> 0i < a * b

name: INT_SGN_MUL2
statement: !x y. SGN (x * y) = SGN x * SGN y

name: SGN_def
statement: SGN x = if x = 0i then 0i else if x < 0i then ~1 else 1i

statement: is_ring (ring 0q 1q rat_add rat_mul rat_ainv)

statement: !a:frac. rat_equiv a a

statement: !a b. rat_equiv a b <=> rat_equiv b a

statement: !a b. rat_equiv a b ==> ((frac_nmr a = 0) <=> (frac_nmr b = 0))

statement: !a b. rat_equiv a b ==> (frac_nmr a > 0 <=> frac_nmr b > 0)

statement: !a b. (frac_nmr a = 0) ==> (rat_equiv a b <=> (frac_nmr b = 0))

statement: !f1 f2. rat_equiv f1 f2 = (rat_equiv f1 = rat_equiv f2)

name: RAT_EQUIV_ALT
statement:
!a. rat_equiv a =

name: DIVISION_APPEND_LEMMA1
statement:

         (\n. if n < dsize D1 then D1(n) else D2(n - dsize D1)) (n)
            <
         (\n. if n < dsize D1 then D1(n) else D2(n - dsize D1)) (SUC n)) /\
    (!n. n >= dsize D1 + dsize D2 ==>
         (\n. if n<dsize D1 then D1(n) else D2(n - dsize D1)) (n)
            =
         (\n. if n<dsize D1 then D1(n) else D2(n - dsize D1)) (dsize D1 + dsize D2))

        tdiv(b,c) (d2,p2) /\

        ==> tdiv(a,c)
              ((\n. if n < dsize d1 then  d1(n) else d2(n - (dsize d1))),
               (\n. if n < dsize d1
                    then p1(n) else p2(n - (dsize d1)))) /\
            fine g ((\n. if n < dsize d1 then  d1(n) else d2(n - (dsize d1))),
               (\n. if n < dsize d1
                    then p1(n) else p2(n - (dsize d1)))) /\
            !f. rsum((\n. if n < dsize d1 then  d1(n) else d2(n - (dsize d1))),
                     (\n. if n < dsize d1
                          then p1(n) else p2(n - (dsize d1)))) f =
                rsum(d1,p1) f + rsum(d2,p2) f

name: fine
statement:
fine(g:real->real) (D,p) =
     !n. n < dsize D ==> D(SUC n) - D(n) < g(p(n))

name: rsum
statement:
rsum (D,(p:num->real)) f =
        sum(0,dsize(D))(\n. f(p n) * (D(SUC n) - D(n)))

name: Dint
statement:
Dint(a,b) f k <=>
       !e. &0 < e ==>
           ?g. gauge(\x. a <= x /\ x <= b) g /\
               !D p. tdiv(a,b) (D,p) /\ fine(g)(D,p) ==>
                   abs(rsum(D,p) f - k) < e

name: integrable
statement: integrable(a,b) f = ?i. Dint(a,b) f i

name: integral
statement: integral(a,b) f = @i. Dint(a,b) f i

name: GAUGE_BIGINTER
statement:
!f s. FINITE s /\ (!d. d IN s ==> gauge (f d)) ==>
          gauge (\x. BIGINTER {f d x | d IN s})

name: GAUGE_EXISTENCE_LEMMA
statement:
!p q. (!x:real. ?d:real. p x ==> &0 < d /\ q d x) <=>
          (!x:real. ?d:real. &0 < d /\ (p x ==> q d x))

name: DIVISION_OF
statement:
!s i. s division_of i <=>
        FINITE s /\
        (!k. k IN s ==> ~(k = {}) /\ ?a b. k = interval[a,b]) /\
        (!k1 k2. k1 IN s /\ k2 IN s /\ ~(k1 = k2)
                 ==> (interior(k1) INTER interior(k2) = {})) /\
        (BIGUNION s = i)

name: DIVISION_1_SORT
statement:
!d s:real->bool. d division_of s /\
     (!k. k IN d ==> ~(interior k = {}))
      ==> ?n t. (IMAGE t { 1n..n} = d) /\
      !i j. i IN { 1n..n} /\ j IN { 1n..n} /\ i < j
      ==> ~(t i = t j) /\
     !x y. x IN t i /\ y IN t j ==> x <= y

name: TAGGED_DIVISION_OF
statement:
!s i. s tagged_division_of i <=>
        FINITE s /\
        (!x k. (x,k) IN s
               ==> x IN k /\ k SUBSET i /\ ?a b. k = interval[a,b]) /\
        (!x1 k1 x2 k2. (x1,k1) IN s /\ (x2,k2) IN s /\ ~((x1,k1) = (x2,k2))
                       ==> (interior(k1) INTER interior(k2) = {})) /\
        (BIGUNION {k | ?x. (x,k) IN s} = i)

name: has_integral
statement:
!f y a b.
     (f has_integral y) (interval[a,b]) <=>
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?d. gauge d /\
                    !p. p tagged_division_of interval[a,b] /\ d FINE p
                        ==> abs(sum p (\(x,k). content(k) * f(x)) - y) < e

name: has_integral_alt
statement:
!f i y.
     (f has_integral y) i <=>
        if ?a b. i = interval[a,b] then (f has_integral y) i
        else !e. &0 < e
                 ==> ?B. &0 < B /\
                         !a b. ball(0,B) SUBSET interval[a,b]
                               ==> ?z. ((\x. if x IN i then f(x) else 0)
                                        has_integral z) (interval[a,b]) /\
                                       abs(z - y) < e

name: CONTENT_SPLIT
statement:
!a b:real k. content(interval[a,b]) =
                 content(interval[a,b] INTER {x | x <= c}) +
                 content(interval[a,b] INTER {x | x >= c})

name: OPERATIVE_DIVISION
statement:
!op d a b f:(real->bool)->'a.
        monoidal op /\ operative op f /\ d division_of interval[a,b]
    ==> (iterate(op) d f = f(interval[a,b]))

name: INTERVAL_DOUBLESPLIT
statement:
!e a b c. interval[a,b] INTER {x:real | abs(x - c) <= e} =
              interval[(max (a) (c - e)), (min (b) (c + e))]

name: CONTENT_DOUBLESPLIT
statement:
!a b:real c e.
        &0 < e ==> ?d. &0 < d /\
                content(interval[a,b] INTER {x | abs(x - c) <= d}) < e

name: CONTENT_IMAGE_STRETCH_INTERVAL
statement:
!a b:real m.
        content(IMAGE (\x. m 1 * x) (interval[a,b]):real->bool) =
        abs(product{ 1n.. 1n} m) * content(interval[a,b])

name: HAS_INTEGRAL_STRETCH
statement:
!f:real->real i m a b.
        (f has_integral i) (interval[a,b]) /\
        ~(m  1n = &0)
        ==> ((\x:real. f(m  1n * x)) has_integral
             (inv(abs(product{ 1n.. 1n} m)) * i))
            (IMAGE (\x. inv(m 1) * x) (interval[a,b]))

name: DIVISION_COMMON_POINT_BOUND
statement:
!d s:real->bool x.
        d division_of s
        ==> CARD {k | k IN d /\ ~(content k = &0) /\ x IN k}
            <= 2 EXP  1n

name: INTEGRAL_SPLIT
statement:
!f:real->real a b t.
        f integrable_on interval[a,b]
        ==> (integral (interval[a,b]) f =
                integral(interval [a,(@f. f = min (b) t)]) f +
                integral(interval [(@f. f = max (a) t),b]) f)

name: INTEGRAL_SPLIT_SIGNED
statement:
!f:real->real a b t.
        a <= t /\ a <= b /\
        f integrable_on interval[a,(@f. f = max (b) t)]
        ==> (integral (interval[a,b]) f =
                integral(interval
                 [a,(@f. f = t)]) f +
                (if b < t then -&1 else &1) *
                integral(interval [(@f. f = min (b) t), (@f. f = max (b) t)]) f)

name: INTEGRABLE_STRADDLE
statement:
!f:real->real s.
        (!e. &0 < e
             ==> ?g h i j. (g has_integral i) s /\
                           (h has_integral j) s /\
                           abs(i - j) < e /\
                           !x. x IN s
                               ==> (g x) <= (f x) /\
                                   (f x) <= (h x))
        ==> f integrable_on s

name: ABS_LE_L1
statement: !x:real. abs x <= sum{ 1n.. 1n} (\i. abs(x))

name: MONOTONE_CONVERGENCE_INCREASING
statement:
!f:num->real->real g s.
        (!k. (f k) integrable_on s) /\
        (!k x. x IN s ==> (f k x) <= (f (SUC k) x)) /\
        (!x. x IN s ==> ((\k. f k x) --> g x) sequentially) /\
        bounded {integral s (f k) | k IN univ(:num)}
        ==> g integrable_on s /\
            ((\k. integral s (f k)) --> integral s g) sequentially

name: HAS_INTEGRAL_LIM_AT_POSINFINITY
statement:
!f l:real.
        (f has_integral l) {t | &0 <= t} <=>
        (!a. f integrable_on interval[0,a]) /\
        ((\a. integral (interval[0,a]) f) --> l) at_posinfinity

name: HAS_INTEGRAL_LIM_SEQUENTIALLY
statement:
!f:real->real l.
           (f --> 0) at_posinfinity /\
           (!n. f integrable_on interval[0,&n]) /\
           ((\n:num. (integral (interval[0,&n]) f)) --> l) sequentially
           ==> (f has_integral l) {t | &0 <= t}

name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ON_ABS
statement:
!f:(real->bool)->real s.
    (\x. (abs(f x))) has_bounded_setvariation_on s <=>
    f has_bounded_setvariation_on s

name: HAS_BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ON_IMP_BOUNDED_ON_SUBINTERVALS
BOUNDED_SETVARIATION_ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_INTERVAL
statement:
!f:real->real a b.
        f integrable_on interval[a,b] /\
        (\k. integral k f) has_bounded_setvariation_on interval[a,b]
        ==> f absolutely_integrable_on interval[a,b]

name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_MAX
statement:
!f:real->real g:real->real s.
        f absolutely_integrable_on s /\ g absolutely_integrable_on s
        ==> (\x. (max (f(x)) (g(x))):real)
            absolutely_integrable_on s

name: ABSOLUTELY_INTEGRABLE_MIN
statement:
!f:real->real g:real->real s.
        f absolutely_integrable_on s /\ g absolutely_integrable_on s
        ==> (\x. (min (f(x)) (g(x))):real)
            absolutely_integrable_on s

name: INTEGRABLE_MIN_CONST
statement:
!f s t.
        &0 <= t /\ (!x. x IN s ==> &0 <= f x) /\
        (\x:real. (f x)) integrable_on s
        ==> (\x. (min (f x) t)) integrable_on s

name: BEPPO_LEVI_INCREASING
statement:
!f:num->real->real s.
        (!k. (f k) integrable_on s) /\
        (!k x. x IN s ==> (f k x) <= (f (SUC k) x)) /\
        bounded {integral s (f k) | k IN univ(:num)}
        ==> ?g k. negligible k /\
                  !x. x IN (s DIFF k) ==> ((\k. f k x) --> g x) sequentially

name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_REFLECT
statement:
!(fs :(real->real)->bool) a b.
        fs equiintegrable_on interval[a,b]
        ==> {(\x. f(-x)) | f IN fs} equiintegrable_on interval[-b,-a]

name: SUM_CONTENT_AREA_OVER_THIN_DIVISION
statement:
!d a b:real s c.
        d division_of s /\ s SUBSET interval[a,b] /\
                 a <= c /\ c <= b /\
        (!k. k IN d ==> ~(k INTER {x | x = c} = {}))
        ==> (b - a) *
            sum d (\k. content k /
                       (interval_upperbound k - interval_lowerbound k))
            <= &2 * content(interval[a,b])

name: BOUNDED_EQUIINTEGRAL_OVER_THIN_TAGGED_PARTIAL_DIVISION
statement:
!fs f:real->real a b e.
    fs equiintegrable_on interval[a,b] /\ f IN fs /\
    (!h x. h IN fs /\ x IN interval[a,b] ==> abs(h x) <= abs(f x)) /\
    &0 < e
    ==> ?d. gauge d /\
            !c p h. c IN interval[a,b] /\
                      p tagged_partial_division_of interval[a,b] /\
                      d FINE p /\
                      h IN fs /\
                      (!x k. (x,k) IN p ==> ~(k INTER {x | x = c} = {}))
                      ==> sum p(\(x,k). abs(integral k h)) < e

name: EQUIINTEGRABLE_HALFSPACE_RESTRICTIONS_LE
statement:
!fs f:real->real a b.
        fs equiintegrable_on interval[a,b] /\ f IN fs /\
        (!h x. h IN fs /\ x IN interval[a,b] ==> abs(h x) <= abs(f x))
        ==> { (\x. if x <= c then h x else 0) | c IN univ(:real) /\ h IN fs }
            equiintegrable_on interval[a,b]

name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_MAX
statement:
!f g s. f has_bounded_variation_on s /\ g has_bounded_variation_on s
           ==> (\x. (max ((f x)) ((g x))))
               has_bounded_variation_on s

name: HAS_BOUNDED_VARIATION_ON_MIN
statement:
!f g s. f has_bounded_variation_on s /\ g has_bounded_variation_on s
           ==> (\x. (min ((f x)) ((g x)))) has_bounded_variation_on s

name: OPERATIVE_FUNCTION_ENDPOINT_DIFF
statement:
!f:real->real.
      operative (+) (\k. f (interval_upperbound k) - f (interval_lowerbound k))

name: VECTOR_VARIATION_COMBINE
statement:
!f:real->real a b c.
        a <= c /\ c <= b /\
        f has_bounded_variation_on interval[a,b]
        ==> (vector_variation (interval[a,c]) f +
             vector_variation (interval[c,b]) f =
             vector_variation (interval[a,b]) f)

name: INCREASING_BOUNDED_VARIATION
statement:
!f a b.
        (!x y. x IN interval[a,b] /\ y IN interval[a,b] /\ x <= y
               ==> (f x) <= (f y))
        ==> f has_bounded_variation_on interval[a,b]

name: gauge_def
statement: Gauge d <=> !x. x IN d(x) /\ open(d(x))

name: has_integral_compact_interval
statement:
(f has_integral_compact_interval y) i <=>
        !e. &0 < e
            ==> ?d. gauge d /\
                    !p. p tagged_division_of i /\ d FINE p
                        ==> abs(sum p (\(x,k). content(k) * f(x)) - y) < e

name: has_integral_def
statement:
(f has_integral y) i <=>
        if ?a b. i = interval[a,b] then (f has_integral_compact_interval y) i
        else !e. &0 < e
                 ==> ?B. &0 < B /\
                         !a b. ball(0,B) SUBSET interval[a,b]
                               ==> ?z. ((\x. if x IN i then f(x) else 0)
                                        has_integral_compact_interval z)
                                        (interval[a,b]) /\ abs(z - y) < e

name: integrable_on
statement: f integrable_on i <=> ?y. (f has_integral y) i

name: integral_def
statement: integral i f = @y. (f has_integral y) i

name: LIM_AT_LIM
statement: !f l a. (real_topology$--> f l) (at a) <=> (f -> l)(a)

name: diffl_has_vector_derivative
statement: !f l x. ($diffl f l)(x) <=> (f has_vector_derivative l) (at x)

name: diffl_has_derivative'
statement: !f l x. (f diffl l) x <=> (f has_derivative ($* l)) (at x)

name: contl_eq_continuous_at
statement: !f x. f contl x <=> f continuous (at x)

name: differentiable_has_vector_derivative
statement: !f x. f differentiable x <=> ?l. (f has_vector_derivative l) (at x)

name: differentiable_alt
statement: !f x. f differentiable x <=> derivative$differentiable f (at x)

name: DIFF_CONT
statement: !f l x. ($diffl f l)(x) ==> $contl f x

name: CONTL_LIM
statement: !f x. f contl x = (f -> f(x))(x)

name: DIFF_XM1
statement: !x. x <> 0 ==> ((\x. inv(x)) diffl (-(inv(x) pow 2)))(x)

name: INTERVAL_LEMMA_LT
statement:
!a b x. a < x /\ x < b ==>
        ?d. &0 < d /\ !y. abs(x - y) < d ==> a < y /\ y < b

name: ROLLE
statement:
!f a b. a < b /\
           (f(a) = f(b)) /\
           (!x. a <= x /\ x <= b ==> f contl x) /\
           (!x. a < x /\ x < b ==> f differentiable x)
        ==> ?z. a < z /\ z < b /\ (f diffl &0)(z)

name: MVT
statement:
!f a b. a < b /\
           (!x. a <= x /\ x <= b ==> f contl x) /\
           (!x. a < x /\ x < b ==> f differentiable x)
        ==> ?l z. a < z /\ z < b /\ (f diffl l)(z) /\
            (f(b) - f(a) = (b - a) * l)

name: dist
statement: !x y. Dist(x:real,y:real) = abs(x - y)

name: linear_repr
statement: !f. linear f <=> ?l. f = \x. l * x

name: linear_alt_cmul
statement: !f. linear f <=> !c x. f(c * x) = c * f(x)

name: MIDPOINT_REFL
statement: !x. midpoint(x,x) = x

name: MIDPOINT_COLLINEAR
statement:
!a b c:real.
     a <> c ==>
     ((b = midpoint(a,c)) <=> collinear{a;b;c} /\ (dist(a,b) = dist(b,c)))

name: INDEPENDENT_INJECTIVE_IMAGE_GEN
statement:
!(f:real->real) s. independent s /\ linear f /\
     (!x y. x IN span s /\ y IN span s /\ (f(x) = f(y)) ==> (x = y))
    ==> independent (IMAGE f s)

name: SPAN_LINEAR_IMAGE
statement: !f:real->real s. linear f ==> (span(IMAGE f s) = IMAGE f (span s))

name: open_def
statement: !s. Open s <=> !x. x IN s ==> ?e. &0 < e /\ !x'. dist(x',x) < e ==> x' IN s

name: euclidean
statement: euclidean = topology open

name: OPEN_BIGUNION
statement: !f. (!s. s IN f ==> open s) ==> open (BIGUNION f)

name: OPEN_IN
statement: !s. open s <=> open_in euclidean s

name: closed_def
statement: !s. Closed s <=> open (UNIV DIFF s)

name: CLOSED_IN
statement: !s. closed s <=> closed_in euclidean s

name: OPEN_SUB_OPEN
statement: !s. open s <=> !x. x IN s ==> ?t. open t /\ x IN t /\ t SUBSET s

name: ball
statement: !x e. ball(x,e) = { y | dist(x,y) < e}

name: CONNECTED_IFF_CONNECTABLE_POINTS
statement:
!(s:real->bool).
        connected s <=>
        !a b. a IN s /\ b IN s
              ==> ?t. connected t /\ t SUBSET s /\ a IN t /\ b IN t

name: CONNECTED_SEGMENT
statement:
(!a b:real. connected(segment[a,b])) /\
   (!a b:real. connected(segment(a,b)))

name: limit_point_of
statement:
!x s. x limit_point_of s <=>
          !t. x IN t /\ Open t ==> ?y. ~(y = x) /\ y IN s /\ y IN t

name: net_tybij
statement:
(!a. mk_net (netord a) = a) /\
  (!r. (!x y. (!z. r z x ==> r z y) \/ (!z. r z y ==> r z x)) <=>
       (netord (mk_net r) = r))

name: DORDER_NET
statement: !n. dorder (netord n)

name: at
statement: !a. at a = mk_net(\x y. &0 < dist(x,a) /\ dist(x,a) <= dist(y,a))

name: LIM_DEF
statement:
!f l net. (f --> l) net <=>
        trivial_limit net \/
        !e. &0 < e ==> ?y. (?x. netord(net) x y) /\
                           !x. netord(net) x y ==> dist(f(x),l) < e

name: INTER_BALLS_EQ_EMPTY
statement:
(!a b:real r s. (ball(a,r) INTER ball(b,s) = {}) <=>
                     r <= &0 \/ s <= &0 \/ r + s <= dist(a,b)) /\
   (!a b:real r s. (ball(a,r) INTER cball(b,s) = {}) <=>
                     r <= &0 \/ s < &0 \/ r + s <= dist(a,b)) /\
   (!a b:real r s. (cball(a,r) INTER ball(b,s) = {}) <=>
                     r < &0 \/ s <= &0 \/ r + s <= dist(a,b)) /\
   (!a b:real r s. (cball(a,r) INTER cball(b,s) = {}) <=>
                     r < &0 \/ s < &0 \/ r + s < dist(a,b))

name: LIM_SUBSEQUENCE_WEAK
statement:
!s r l. (!m n. m <= n ==> r(m) <= r(n)) /\ (!n. ?m. n <= r(m)) /\
            (s --> l) sequentially ==> (s o r --> l) sequentially

name: UNIFORMLY_CONVERGENT_EQ_CAUCHY_ALT
statement:
!P s:num->'a->real.
      (?l. !e. &0 < e ==> ?N. !n x. N <= n /\ P x ==> dist(s n x,l x) < e) <=>
      (!e. &0 < e ==>
           ?N. !m n x. N <= m /\ N <= n /\ m < n /\ P x ==>
                       dist(s m x,s n x) < e)

name: CONNECTED_MONOTONE_QUOTIENT_PREIMAGE
statement:
!f:real->real s t.
    f continuous_on s /\ (IMAGE f s = t) /\
   (!u. u SUBSET t
   ==> (open_in (subtopology euclidean s) {x | x IN s /\ f x IN u} <=>
        open_in (subtopology euclidean t) u)) /\
       (!y. y IN t ==> connected {x | x IN s /\ (f x = y)}) /\
        connected t ==> connected s

name: diameter
SEPARATE_COMPACT_CLOSED
statement:
!s t:real->bool.
        compact s /\ closed t /\ (s INTER t = {})
        ==> ?d. &0 < d /\ !x y. x IN s /\ y IN t ==> d <= dist(x,y)

name: IS_INTERVAL_COMPACT
statement: !s:real->bool. is_interval s /\ compact s <=> ?a b. s = interval[a,b]

name: IS_INTERVAL_SUMS
CONTINUOUS_ON_IVT
statement:
!f a b y. a <= b /\ f(a) <= y /\ y <= f(b) /\
              f continuous_on (interval [a,b])
          ==> ?x. x IN interval [a,b] /\ (f(x) = y)

name: CARD_EQ_REAL
statement: univ(:real) =_c univ(:num->bool)

name: DIM_SUBSTANDARD
statement: dim {x:real | x = &0} = 0

name: setdist
HAUSDIST_EQ
statement:
!s t:real->bool s' t':real->bool.
        (!b. (!x. x IN s ==> setdist({x},t) <= b) /\
             (!y. y IN t ==> setdist({y},s) <= b) <=>
             (!x. x IN s' ==> setdist({x},t') <= b) /\
             (!y. y IN t' ==> setdist({y},s') <= b))
        ==> (hausdist(s,t) = hausdist(s',t'))

name: HAUSDIST_BALLS
statement:
(!a b:real r s.
        hausdist(ball(a,r),ball(b,s)) =
        if r <= &0 \/ s <= &0 then &0 else dist(a,b) + abs(r - s)) /\
   (!a b:real r s.
        hausdist(ball(a,r),cball(b,s)) =
        if r <= &0 \/ s < &0 then &0 else dist(a,b) + abs(r - s)) /\
   (!a b:real r s.
        hausdist(cball(a,r),ball(b,s)) =
        if r < &0 \/ s <= &0 then &0 else dist(a,b) + abs(r - s)) /\
   (!a b:real r s.
        hausdist(cball(a,r),cball(b,s)) =
        if r < &0 \/ s < &0 then &0 else dist(a,b) + abs(r - s))

name: gdelta
statement:
!s. gdelta (s:real->bool) <=>
        ?g. COUNTABLE g /\ (!u. u IN g ==> open u) /\ (BIGINTER g = s)

name: fsigma
statement:
!s. fsigma (s:real->bool) <=>
        ?g. COUNTABLE g /\ (!c. c IN g ==> closed c) /\ (BIGUNION g = s)

name: GDELTA_COMPLEMENT
statement: !s. gdelta(univ(:real) DIFF s) <=> fsigma s

name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_EUCLIDEAN
statement: metrizable_space euclidean

name: CLOSED_AS_GDELTA
statement: !s:real->bool. closed s ==> gdelta s

name: INTERVAL_UPPERBOUND
statement: !a b:real. a <= b ==> (interval_upperbound(interval[a,b]) = b)

name: OPEN_INTERVAL_UPPERBOUND
statement: !a b:real. a < b ==> interval_upperbound(interval(a,b)) = b

name: INTERVAL_LOWERBOUND
statement: !a b:real. a <= b ==> (interval_lowerbound(interval[a,b]) = a)

name: OPEN_INTERVAL_LOWERBOUND
statement: !a b:real. a < b ==> interval_lowerbound(interval(a,b)) = a

name: INTERVAL_LOWERBOUND_NONEMPTY
statement:
!a b:real. ~(interval[a,b] = {}) ==>
               (interval_lowerbound(interval[a,b]) = a)

name: INTERVAL_UPPERBOUND_NONEMPTY
statement:
!a b:real. ~(interval[a,b] = {}) ==>
               (interval_upperbound(interval[a,b]) = b)

name: INTERVAL_BOUNDS_EMPTY
statement:
(interval_upperbound {} = 0) /\
    (interval_lowerbound {} = 0)

name: INTERVAL_BOUNDS_NULL
statement:
!a b:real. (content(interval[a,b]) = &0)
        ==> (interval_upperbound(interval[a,b]) =
             interval_lowerbound(interval[a,b]))

name: dist_def
statement: Dist = dist mr1

name: euclidean_def
statement: euclidean = mtop mr1

name: euclidean_open_def
statement: Open = open_in euclidean

name: euclidean_closed_def
statement: Closed = closed_in euclidean

name: ball_def
statement: ball = metric$B(mr1)

name: limit_point_of_def
statement: x limit_point_of s <=> limpt(euclidean) x s

name: at_def
statement: at z = mk_net (nets$tendsto (mr1,z))

name: reallim
statement: reallim net f = @l. (f --> l) net

name: bounded_def
statement: Bounded s <=> ?a. !x:real. x IN s ==> abs(x) <= a

name: cauchy_def
statement:
cauchy (s:num->real) <=>
     !e. &0 < e ==> ?N. !m n. m >= N /\ n >= N ==> dist(s m,s n) < e

name: set_diameter_def
OPEN_interval

name: DIFF_COMPOSITE
statement:
((f diffl l)(x) /\ ~(f(x) = &0) ==>
        ((\x. inv(f x)) diffl ~(l / (f(x) pow 2)))(x)) /\
   ((f diffl l)(x) /\ (g diffl m)(x) /\ ~(g(x) = &0) ==>
    ((\x. f(x) / g(x)) diffl (((l * g(x)) - (m * f(x)))
                               / (g(x) pow 2)))(x)) /\
   ((f diffl l)(x) /\ (g diffl m)(x) ==>
                   ((\x. f(x) + g(x)) diffl (l + m))(x)) /\
   ((f diffl l)(x) /\ (g diffl m)(x) ==>
                   ((\x. f(x) * g(x)) diffl ((l * g(x)) + (m * f(x))))(x)) /\
   ((f diffl l)(x) /\ (g diffl m)(x) ==>
                   ((\x. f(x) - g(x)) diffl (l - m))(x)) /\
   ((f diffl l)(x) ==> ((\x. ~(f x)) diffl ~l)(x)) /\
   ((g diffl m)(x) ==>
         ((\x. (g x) pow n) diffl ((&n * (g x) pow (n - 1)) * m))(x)) /\
   ((g diffl m)(x) ==> ((\x. exp(g x)) diffl (exp(g x) * m))(x)) /\
   ((g diffl m)(x) ==> ((\x. sin(g x)) diffl (cos(g x) * m))(x)) /\
   ((g diffl m)(x) ==> ((\x. cos(g x)) diffl (~(sin(g x)) * m))(x))

name: MCLAURIN
statement:
!f diff h n.
    &0 < h /\ 0 < n /\ (diff(0) = f) /\
    (!m t. m < n /\ &0 <= t /\ t <= h ==>
           (diff(m) diffl diff(SUC m)(t))(t)) ==>
    (?t. &0 < t /\ t < h /\
        (f(h) = sum(0,n)(\m. (diff(m)(&0) / &(FACT m)) * (h pow m))
                +
                ((diff(n)(t) / &(FACT n)) * (h pow n))))

name: MCLAURIN_NEG
statement:
!f diff h n.
    h < &0 /\ 0 < n /\ (diff(0) = f) /\
    (!m t. m < n /\ h <= t /\ t <= &0 ==>
           (diff(m) diffl diff(SUC m)(t))(t)) ==>
    (?t. h < t /\ t < &0 /\
         (f(h) = sum(0,n)(\m. (diff(m)(&0) / &(FACT m)) * (h pow m))
                 + ((diff(n)(t) / &(FACT n)) * (h pow n))))

name: MCLAURIN_ALL_LT
statement:
!f diff.
      (diff 0 = f) /\
      (!m x. ((diff m) diffl (diff(SUC m) x)) x)
      ==> !x n. ~(x = &0) /\ 0 < n
            ==> ?t. &0 < abs(t) /\ abs(t) < abs(x) /\
                    (f(x) = sum(0,n)
                                (\m. (diff m (&0) / &(FACT m)) * x pow m)
                            +
                            (diff n t / &(FACT n)) * x pow n)

name: MCLAURIN_ZERO

name: karatsuba_num
statement:
! d x y.
    0 < d ==>
    x * y =
      let x1 = x DIV d in
      let x0 = x MOD d in
      let y1 = y DIV d in
      let y0 = y MOD d in
      let z0 = x0 * y0 in
      let z2 = x1 * y1 in
      let z1a = x1 + x0 in
      let z1b = y1 + y0 in
      let z1 = z1a * z1b in
      let z1 = z1 - z2 - z0 in
        (z2 * d + z1) * d + z0

name: karatsuba_bit
statement:
! x y.
    bleval (mul x y) = bleval (
    let d = (fromBL
            (divpow2
             (add (divpow2 (tobl (LENGTH x) F) 1)
              (divpow2 (tobl (LENGTH y) F) 1)) 1)) + 1 in
      let x1 = divpow2 x d in
      let x0 = modpow2 x d in
      let y1 = divpow2 y d in
      let y0 = modpow2 y d in
      let z0 = mul x0 y0 in
      let z2 = mul x1 y1 in
      let z1a = add x1 x0 in
      let z1b = add y1 y0 in
      let z1Mul = mul z1a z1b in
      let z1 = sub (sub z1Mul z2) z0 in
        add (mulpow2 (add (mulpow2 z2 d) z1) d) z0)
