name: bleval_def
statement:
bleval [] = 0 /\
  bleval (T::rest) = 2 * bleval rest + 1 /\
  bleval (F::rest) = 2 * bleval rest

name: frombl_def
statement:
frombl addedp [] = 0 /\
  frombl T [T] = ZERO /\
  frombl F [T] = BIT1 ZERO /\
  frombl T (F::rest) = BIT1 (frombl T rest) /\
  frombl F (F::rest) = BIT2 (frombl T rest) /\
  frombl T (T::rest) = BIT2 (frombl T rest) /\
  frombl F (T::rest) = BIT1 (frombl F rest)

name: fromBL_def
statement:
fromBL bs =
  if bs = [] then 0
  else
    let bs1 = REV bs []
    in
      case HD bs1 of
        T => NUMERAL (frombl F bs)
      | F =>
          let
            bs2 = dropWhile ((=) F) bs1 ;
            bs3 = REV bs2 [] ;
          in
            if bs3 = [] then 0 else NUMERAL (frombl F bs3)

name: add_aux_def
statement:
add_aux [] bs F = bs /\
  add_aux [] [] T = [T] /\
  add_aux [] (F :: bs) T = T :: bs /\
  add_aux [] (T :: bs) T = F :: (add_aux [] bs T) /\
  add_aux bs [] F = bs /\
  add_aux (F :: bs) [] T = T :: bs /\
  add_aux (T :: bs) [] T = F :: (add_aux [] bs T) /\
  add_aux (F :: bs1) (F :: bs2) T = T ::(add_aux bs1 bs2 F) /\
  add_aux (F :: bs1) (F :: bs2) F = F :: (add_aux bs1 bs2 F) /\
  add_aux (T :: bs1) (F :: bs2) F = T ::(add_aux bs1 bs2 F) /\
  add_aux (T :: bs1) (F :: bs2) T = F :: (add_aux bs1 bs2 T) /\
  add_aux (F :: bs1) (T :: bs2) T = F :: (add_aux bs1 bs2 T) /\
  add_aux (F :: bs1) (T :: bs2) F = T ::(add_aux bs1 bs2 F) /\
  add_aux (T :: bs1) (T :: bs2) T = T ::(add_aux bs1 bs2 T) /\
  add_aux (T :: bs1) (T :: bs2) F = F :: (add_aux bs1 bs2 T)

name: add_def
statement: add bs1 bs2 = add_aux bs1 bs2 F

name: divpow2_def
statement:
divpow2 ([]:bool list) k = [] /\
  divpow2 bs 0 = bs /\
  divpow2 (b::bs) (SUC k) = divpow2 bs k

name: modpow2_def
statement:
modpow2 ([]:bool list) k = [] /\
  modpow2 bs 0 = [] /\
  modpow2 (b::bs) (SUC k) = b :: (modpow2 bs k)

name: mul_def
statement:
mul [] _ = [] /\
  mul (T::bs) bs2 = add bs2 (mul bs (F::bs2)) /\
  mul (F::bs) bs2 = mul bs (F::bs2)

name: mulpow2_def
statement:
mulpow2 [] _ = [] /\
  mulpow2 bs 0 = bs /\
  mulpow2 bs (SUC k) = F::(mulpow2 bs k)

name: lte_aux_def
statement:
lte_aux [] [] = T /\
  lte_aux (F::bs1) (T::bs2) = T /\
  lte_aux (T::bs1) (F::bs2) = F /\
  lte_aux (T::bs1) (T::bs2) = lte_aux bs1 bs2 /\
  lte_aux (F::bs1) (F::bs2) = lte_aux bs1 bs2 /\
  lte_aux _ _ = F

name: zeroPad_def
statement:
zeroPad [] [] = ([], []) /\
  zeroPad (b::bs1) [] =
    (let (bs1pad, bs2pad) = zeroPad bs1 [] in
      (b::bs1pad, F::bs2pad)) /\
  zeroPad [] (b::bs2) =
    (let (bs1pad, bs2pad) = zeroPad [] bs2 in
       (F::bs1pad, b::bs2pad)) /\
  zeroPad (b1::bs1) (b2::bs2) =
    (let (bs1pad, bs2pad) = zeroPad bs1 bs2 in
       (b1::bs1pad, b2::bs2pad))

name: lte_def
statement:
lte bs1 bs2 =
  let (bs1pad, bs2pad) = zeroPad bs1 bs2 in
    lte_aux (REV bs1pad []) (REV bs2pad [])

name: sub_aux_def
statement:
sub_aux [] _ _ = [] /\
  sub_aux (F :: bs1) [] T = T :: (sub_aux bs1 [] T) /\
  sub_aux (T :: bs1) [] T = F :: bs1 /\
  sub_aux (F :: bs1) [] F = F :: bs1 /\
  sub_aux (T :: bs1) [] F = T :: bs1 /\
  sub_aux (F :: bs1) (F :: bs2) T = T :: (sub_aux bs1 bs2 T) /\
  sub_aux (F :: bs1) (F :: bs2) F = F :: (sub_aux bs1 bs2 F) /\
  sub_aux (F :: bs1) (T :: bs2) T = F :: (sub_aux bs1 bs2 T) /\

name: extreal_add_def
statement:
(extreal_add (Normal x) (Normal y) = Normal (x + y)) /\
   (extreal_add (Normal _) a = a) /\
   (extreal_add b (Normal _) = b) /\
   (extreal_add NegInf NegInf = NegInf) /\
   (extreal_add PosInf PosInf = PosInf)

name: extreal_ainv_def

   (extreal_ainv PosInf = NegInf) /\

name: extreal_sub

name: extreal_le_def
statement:
(extreal_le (Normal x) (Normal y) = (x <= y)) /\
   (extreal_le NegInf _ = T) /\
   (extreal_le _ PosInf = T) /\
   (extreal_le _ NegInf = F) /\
   (extreal_le PosInf _ = F)

name: extreal_lt_def
statement: extreal_lt x y = ~extreal_le y x

name: extreal_mul_def
statement:
(extreal_mul NegInf NegInf = PosInf) /\
   (extreal_mul NegInf PosInf = NegInf) /\
   (extreal_mul PosInf NegInf = NegInf) /\
   (extreal_mul PosInf PosInf = PosInf) /\
   (extreal_mul (Normal x) NegInf =
       (if x = 0 then (Normal 0) else (if 0 < x then NegInf else PosInf))) /\
   (extreal_mul NegInf (Normal y) =
       (if y = 0 then (Normal 0) else (if 0 < y then NegInf else PosInf))) /\
   (extreal_mul (Normal x) PosInf =
       (if x = 0 then (Normal 0) else (if 0 < x then PosInf else NegInf))) /\
   (extreal_mul PosInf (Normal y) =
       (if y = 0 then (Normal 0) else (if 0 < y then PosInf else NegInf))) /\
   (extreal_mul (Normal x) (Normal y) = Normal (x * y))

name: extreal_abs_def

(extreal_abs (Normal x) = Normal (abs x)) /\
   (extreal_abs _ = PosInf)

name: extreal_pow_def
statement:
(extreal_pow (Normal a) n = Normal (a pow n)) /\
   (extreal_pow PosInf n = (if n = 0 then Normal 1 else PosInf)) /\
   (extreal_pow NegInf n =
       (if n = 0 then Normal 1 else (if (EVEN n) then PosInf else NegInf)))

name: extreal_sqrt_def

(extreal_sqrt (Normal x) = Normal (sqrt x)) /\
   (extreal_sqrt PosInf = PosInf)

name: ITSET_alt

         (@g. (g {} = b) /\
              !x s. FINITE s ==>
                    (g (x INSERT s) = if x IN s then g s else f x (g s))) s

name: FINITE_RECURSION

        ==> (ITSET f {} b = b) /\
            !x s. FINITE s
                  ==> (ITSET f (x INSERT s) b =
                       if x IN s then ITSET f s b
                                 else f x (ITSET f s b))

name: TOPOLOGICAL_SORT'
statement:
!R s n. transitive R /\ antisymmetric R /\ s HAS_SIZE n ==>
            ?f. s = IMAGE f (count n) /\
                !j k. j < n /\ k < n /\ j < k ==> ~(R (f k) (f j))

name: ITERATE_PERMUTES
statement:
!op. monoidal op
         ==> !(f:'a->'b) p s. p PERMUTES s
                ==> (iterate op s f = iterate op s (f o p))

name: SUM_DIFF'
statement: !f s t. FINITE s /\ t SUBSET s ==> (sum (s DIFF t) f = sum s f - sum t f)

name: SUM_ADD'
statement: !f g s. FINITE s ==> (sum s (\x. f(x) + g(x)) = sum s f + sum s g)

name: SUM_ADD_COUNT
statement: !f g n. sum (count n) (\x. f(x) + g(x)) = sum (count n) f + sum (count n) g

name: SUM_0'
statement: !s:'a->bool. sum s (\n. &0) = &0

name: SUM_NEG'
statement: !f s. sum s (\x. -(f(x))) = -(sum s f)

name: SUM_SUB'
statement: !f g s. FINITE s ==> (sum s (\x. f(x) - g(x)) = sum s f - sum s g)

name: SUM_LE'
statement: !f g s. FINITE(s) /\ (!x. x IN s ==> f(x) <= g(x)) ==> sum s f <= sum s g

name: SUM_LT'
statement:
!f g s:'a->bool.
        FINITE(s) /\ (!x. x IN s ==> f(x) <= g(x)) /\
        (?x. x IN s /\ f(x) < g(x))
         ==> sum s f < sum s g

name: SUM_EQ'
statement: !f g s. (!x. x IN s ==> (f x = g x)) ==> (sum s f = sum s g)

name: SUM_EQ_COUNT
statement: !f g n. (!i. i < n ==> (f i = g i)) ==> (sum (count n) f = sum (count n) g)

name: SUM_ABS'
statement: !f s. FINITE(s) ==> abs(sum s f) <= sum s (\x. abs(f x))

name: SUM_ABS_LE'
statement:
!f:'a->real g s.
        FINITE s /\ (!x. x IN s ==> abs(f x) <= g x)
        ==> abs(sum s f) <= sum s g

name: SUM_SWAP_COUNT
statement:
!(f:num->num->real) m n.
      sum (count m) (\i. sum (count n) (f i)) = sum (count n) (\j. sum (count m) (\i. f i j))

name: SUM_BOUND'
statement:
!s f b. FINITE s /\ (!x:'a. x IN s ==> f(x) <= b)
           ==> sum s f <= &(CARD s) * b

name: SUM_GROUP'
statement:
!f:'a->'b g s t.
        FINITE s /\ (IMAGE f s) SUBSET t
        ==> (sum t (\y. sum {x | x IN s /\ (f(x) = y)} g) = sum s g)

name: SUM_OFFSET'
statement: !p f m n. sum{m+p..n+p} f = sum{m..n} (\i. f(i + p))

name: sum_real
statement: !f n. sum{0..n} f = real$sum(0,SUC n) f

name: SUM_DIFFS'
statement:
!m n. sum{m..n} (\k. f(k) - f(k + 1)) =
          if m <= n then f(m) - f(n + 1) else (0:real)

name: REAL_MUL_SUM
statement:
!s t f g.
        FINITE s /\ FINITE t
        ==> sum s f * sum t g = sum s (\i. sum t (\j. f(i) * g(j)))

name: REAL_MUL_SUM_NUMSEG
statement:
!f g m n p q. sum{m..n} f * sum{p..q} g =
                sum{m..n} (\i. sum{p..q} (\j. f(i) * g(j)))

name: NPRODUCT_CONG
statement:
(!f g s.   (!x. x IN s ==> (f(x) = g(x)))
           ==> (nproduct s (\i. f(i)) = nproduct s g)) /\
    (!f g a b. (!i. a <= i /\ i <= b ==> (f(i) = g(i)))
           ==> (nproduct{a..b} (\i. f(i)) = nproduct{a..b} g)) /\
    (!f g p.   (!x. p x ==> (f x = g x))
           ==> (nproduct {y | p y} (\i. f(i)) = nproduct {y | p y} g))

name: PRODUCT_EQ_COUNT
statement:
!f g n. (!i. i < n ==> (f i = g i)) ==>
             product (count n) f = product (count n) g

name: PRODUCT_EQ_0_COUNT
statement: !f n. product (count n) f = &0 <=> ?i. i < n /\ (f(i) = &0)

name: PRODUCT_EQ_1_COUNT
statement: !f n. (!i. i < n ==> f i = &1) ==> product (count n) f = &1

name: PRODUCT_MUL_COUNT
statement:
!f g n. product (count n) (\x. f x * g x) =
            product (count n) f * product (count n) g

name: PRODUCT_CONG
statement:
(!f g s.   (!x. x IN s ==> (f(x) = g(x)))
           ==> (product s (\i. f(i)) = product s g)) /\
    (!f g a b. (!i. a <= i /\ i <= b ==> (f(i) = g(i)))
           ==> (product{a..b} (\i. f(i)) = product{a..b} g)) /\
    (!f g p.   (!x. p x ==> (f x = g x))
           ==> (product {y | p y} (\i. f(i)) = product {y | p y} g))

name: DROP_INDICATOR
statement: !s x. (indicator s x) = if x IN s then &1 else &0

name: DROP_INDICATOR_POS_LE
statement: !s x. &0 <= (indicator s x)

name: DROP_INDICATOR_LE_1
statement: !s x. (indicator s x) <= &1

name: DROP_INDICATOR_ABS_LE_1
statement: !s x. abs(indicator s x) <= &1

name: INDICATOR_EMPTY
statement: indicator {} = (\x. 0)

name: INDICATOR_COMPLEMENT
statement: !s. indicator (UNIV DIFF s) = \x. 1 - indicator s x

name: REAL_MAX_REDUCE
statement: !x y :real. x <= y \/ x < y ==> (max x y = y) /\ (max y x = y)

name: REAL_MIN_REDUCE
statement: !x y :real. x <= y \/ x < y ==> (min x y = x) /\ (min y x = x)

name: REAL_LT_MAX_BETWEEN
statement: !x b d :real. x < max b d /\ b <= x ==> x < d

name: REAL_MIN_LE_BETWEEN
statement: !x a c :real. min a c <= x /\ x < a ==> c <= x

name: REAL_ARCH_INV_SUC
statement: !x:real. 0 < x ==> ?n. inv &(SUC n) < x

name: REAL_ARCH_INV'
statement: !x:real. 0 < x ==> ?n. inv (&n) < x

name: ABS_LE_HALF_POW2
statement: !x y :real. abs (x * y) <= 1/2 * (x pow 2 + y pow 2)

name: ITERATE_PERMUTE
statement:
!op. monoidal op ==>
       !(f:'a -> 'b) p s. p permutes s ==>
                          (iterate op s f = iterate op s (f o p))

name: NSUM_PERMUTE
statement: !f p s. p permutes s ==> (nsum s f = nsum s (f o p))

name: NSUM_PERMUTE_COUNT
statement: !f p n. p permutes (count n) ==> (nsum (count n) f = nsum (count n) (f o p))

name: NSUM_PERMUTE_NUMSEG
statement:
!f p m n.
  p permutes (count n DIFF count m) ==>
   (nsum (count n DIFF count m) f = nsum (count n DIFF count m) (f o p))

name: SUM_PERMUTE
statement: !f p s. p permutes s ==> (sum s f = sum s (f o p))

name: SUM_PERMUTE_COUNT
statement: !f p n. p permutes (count n) ==> (sum (count n) f = sum (count n) (f o p))

name: SUM_PERMUTE_NUMSEG
statement:
!f p m n.
  p permutes (count n DIFF count m) ==>
   (sum (count n DIFF count m) f = sum (count n DIFF count m) (f o p))

name: PRODUCT_PERMUTE
statement: !f p s. p permutes s ==> (product s f = product s (f o p))

name: PRODUCT_PERMUTE_COUNT
statement:
!f p n.
    p permutes (count n) ==> (product (count n) f = product (count n) (f o p))

name: PRODUCT_PERMUTE_NUMSEG
statement:
!f p m n.
    p permutes (count n DIFF count m) ==>
    (product (count n DIFF count m) f = product (count n DIFF count m) (f o p))

name: PERMUTES_IN_NUMSEG
statement: !p n i. p permutes {1 .. n} /\ i IN {1 .. n} ==> 1 <= p(i) /\ p(i) <= n

name: SUM_PERMUTATIONS_INVERSE
statement:
!f n. sum {p | p permutes count n } f =
         sum {p | p permutes count n } (\p. f(inverse p))

name: SUM_PERMUTATIONS_COMPOSE_L
statement:
!f s q. q permutes s ==>
           sum {p | p permutes s} f =
           sum {p | p permutes s} (\p. f(q o p))

name: SUM_PERMUTATIONS_COMPOSE_L_COUNT
statement:
!f n q. q permutes count n ==>
           sum {p | p permutes count n} f =
           sum {p | p permutes count n} (\p. f(q o p))

name: SUM_PERMUTATIONS_COMPOSE_L_NUMSEG
statement:
!f m n q.
        q permutes (count n DIFF count m)
        ==> sum {p | p permutes (count n DIFF count m)} f =
            sum {p | p permutes (count n DIFF count m)} (\p. f(q o p))

name: SUM_PERMUTATIONS_COMPOSE_R
statement:
!f s q.
        q permutes s
        ==> sum {p | p permutes s} f =
            sum {p | p permutes s} (\p. f(p o q))

name: SUM_PERMUTATIONS_COMPOSE_R_COUNT
statement:
!f n q.
        q permutes count n
        ==> sum {p | p permutes count n} f =
            sum {p | p permutes count n} (\p. f(p o q))

name: SUM_PERMUTATIONS_COMPOSE_R_NUMSEG
statement:
!f m n q.
        q permutes (count n DIFF count m)
        ==> sum {p | p permutes (count n DIFF count m)} f =
            sum {p | p permutes (count n DIFF count m)} (\p. f(p o q))

name: numseg
statement: numseg m n = {x:num | m <= x /\ x <= n}

name: nsum
statement: (nsum :('a->bool)->('a->num)->num) = iterate (+)

name: nproduct
statement: nproduct = iterate(( * ):num->num->num)

name: indicator
statement: indicator (s :'a -> bool) :'a -> real = \x. if x IN s then 1 else 0

name: lifted
statement:
(lifted op NONE _ = NONE) /\
   (lifted op _ NONE = NONE) /\
   (lifted op (SOME x) (SOME y) = SOME(op x y))

name: bounded_metric_alt
statement: !m x y. ^bmetric_tm = 1 - inv (1 + dist m (x,y))

name: bounded_metric_ismet
statement: !m. ismet (\(x,y). ^bmetric_tm)

name: bounded_metric_thm
statement: !m x y. dist (bounded_metric m) (x,y) = ^bmetric_tm

name: bounded_metric_lt_1
statement: !(m :'a metric) x y. dist (bounded_metric m) (x,y) < 1

name: mtop_istopology
statement:
!m:('a)metric.
      istopology (\S'. !x. S' x ==>
                           ?e. &0 < e /\
                               (!y. (dist m)(x,y) < e ==> S' y))

name: BALL_OPEN
statement: !m:('a)metric. !x e. &0 < e ==> open_in(mtop(m))(B(m)(x,e))

name: TOPSPACE_MTOP
statement: topspace (mtop m) = UNIV

name: MDIST_REFL
statement: !m x:'a. x IN mspace m ==> mdist m (x,x) = &0

name: mtopology
mball
statement:
!m x r. mball m (x:'a,r) =
          {y | x IN mspace m /\ y IN mspace m /\ mdist m (x,y) < r}

name: IS_TOPOLOGY_METRIC_TOPOLOGY
statement:
!m. istopology {u | u SUBSET mspace m /\
                        !x:'a. x IN u ==> ?r. &0 < r /\ mball m (x,r) SUBSET u}

name: OPEN_IN_MTOPOLOGY
statement:
!(m:'a metric) u.
     open_in (mtopology m) u <=>
     u SUBSET mspace m /\
     (!x. x IN u ==> ?r. &0 < r /\ mball m (x,r) SUBSET u)

name: IN_MBALL
statement:
!m x y:'a r.
     y IN mball m (x,r) <=>
     x IN mspace m /\ y IN mspace m /\ mdist m (x,y) < r

name: MTOP_LIMPT
statement:
!m:('a)metric x S'.
    limpt(mtop m) x S' <=>
    !e. &0 < e ==> ?y. ~(x = y) /\ S' y /\ (dist m)(x,y) < e

name: MR1_LIMPT
statement: !x. limpt(mtop mr1) x univ(:real)

name: FSIGMA_IN_ASCENDING
statement:
!top s:'a->bool.
        fsigma_in top s <=>
        ?c. (!n. closed_in top (c n)) /\
            (!n. c n SUBSET c(n + 1)) /\
            UNIONS {c n | n IN univ(:num)} = s

name: GDELTA_IN_ALT
statement:
!top s:'a->bool.
        gdelta_in top s <=>
        s SUBSET topspace top /\ (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF open_in top) s

name: FSIGMA_IN_SUBSET
statement: !top s:'a->bool. fsigma_in top s ==> s SUBSET topspace top

name: GDELTA_IN_SUBSET
statement: !top s:'a->bool. gdelta_in top s ==> s SUBSET topspace top

name: CLOSED_IMP_FSIGMA_IN
statement: !top s:'a->bool. closed_in top s ==> fsigma_in top s

name: OPEN_IMP_GDELTA_IN
statement: !top s:'a->bool. open_in top s ==> gdelta_in top s

name: FSIGMA_IN_EMPTY
statement: !top:'a topology. fsigma_in top {}

name: GDELTA_IN_EMPTY
statement: !top:'a topology. gdelta_in top {}

name: FSIGMA_IN_TOPSPACE
statement: !top:'a topology. fsigma_in top (topspace top)

name: GDELTA_IN_TOPSPACE
statement: !top:'a topology. gdelta_in top (topspace top)

name: FSIGMA_IN_UNIONS
statement:
!top t:('a->bool)->bool.
        COUNTABLE t /\ (!s. s IN t ==> fsigma_in top s)
        ==> fsigma_in top (UNIONS t)

name: FSIGMA_IN_UNION
statement:
!top s t:'a->bool.
        fsigma_in top s /\ fsigma_in top t ==> fsigma_in top (s UNION t)

name: FSIGMA_IN_INTER
statement:
!top s t:'a->bool.
        fsigma_in top s /\ fsigma_in top t ==> fsigma_in top (s INTER t)

name: GDELTA_IN_INTERS
statement:
!top t:('a->bool)->bool.
        COUNTABLE t /\ ~(t = {}) /\ (!s. s IN t ==> gdelta_in top s)
        ==> gdelta_in top (INTERS t)

name: GDELTA_IN_INTER
statement:
!top s t:'a->bool.
        gdelta_in top s /\ gdelta_in top t ==> gdelta_in top (s INTER t)

name: GDELTA_IN_UNION
statement:
!top s t:'a->bool.
        gdelta_in top s /\ gdelta_in top t ==> gdelta_in top (s UNION t)

name: FSIGMA_IN_DIFF
statement:
!top s t:'a->bool.
        fsigma_in top s /\ gdelta_in top t ==> fsigma_in top (s DIFF t)

name: GDELTA_IN_DIFF
statement:
!top s t:'a->bool.
        gdelta_in top s /\ fsigma_in top t ==> gdelta_in top (s DIFF t)

name: GDELTA_IN_FSIGMA_IN
statement:
!top s:'a->bool.
       gdelta_in top s <=>
       s SUBSET topspace top /\ fsigma_in top (topspace top DIFF s)

name: FSIGMA_IN_GDELTA_IN
statement:
!top s:'a->bool.
        fsigma_in top s <=>
        s SUBSET topspace top /\ gdelta_in top (topspace top DIFF s)

name: GDELTA_IN_DESCENDING
statement:
!top s:'a->bool.
        gdelta_in top s <=>
        ?c. (!n. open_in top (c n)) /\
            (!n. c(n + 1) SUBSET c n) /\
            INTERS {c n | n IN univ(:num)} = s

name: FSIGMA_IN_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
!top s:'a->bool.
        (fsigma_in top relative_to s) = fsigma_in (subtopology top s)

name: FSIGMA_IN_RELATIVE_TO_TOPSPACE
statement: !top:'a topology. fsigma_in top relative_to (topspace top) = fsigma_in top

name: FSIGMA_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
statement:
!top u s:'a->bool.
         fsigma_in (subtopology top u) s <=>
         ?t. fsigma_in top t /\ s = t INTER u

name: GDELTA_IN_RELATIVE_TO
statement:
!top s:'a->bool.
        (gdelta_in top relative_to s) = gdelta_in (subtopology top s)

name: GDELTA_IN_SUBTOPOLOGY
statement:
!top u s:'a->bool.
         gdelta_in (subtopology top u) s <=>
         ?t. gdelta_in top t /\ s = t INTER u

name: FSIGMA_IN_FSIGMA_SUBTOPOLOGY
statement:
!top s t:'a->bool.
        fsigma_in top s
        ==> (fsigma_in (subtopology top s) t <=>
             fsigma_in top t /\ t SUBSET s)

name: GDELTA_IN_GDELTA_SUBTOPOLOGY
statement:
!top s t:'a->bool.
        gdelta_in top s
        ==> (gdelta_in (subtopology top s) t <=>
             gdelta_in top t /\ t SUBSET s)

name: METRIZABLE_SPACE_MTOPOLOGY
statement: !m. metrizable_space (mtopology m)

name: FORALL_METRIC_TOPOLOGY
statement:
!P. (!m:'a metric. P (mtopology m) (mspace m)) <=>
       !top. metrizable_space top ==> P top (topspace top)

name: FORALL_METRIZABLE_SPACE
statement:
!P. (!top. metrizable_space top ==> P top (topspace top)) <=>
       (!m:'a metric. P (mtopology m) (mspace m))

name: EXISTS_METRIZABLE_SPACE
statement:
!P. (?top. metrizable_space top /\ P top (topspace top)) <=>
       (?m:'a metric. P (mtopology m) (mspace m))

name: CLOSED_IMP_GDELTA_IN
statement:
!top s:'a->bool.
        metrizable_space top /\ closed_in top s ==> gdelta_in top s

name: OPEN_IMP_FSIGMA_IN
statement:
!top s:'a->bool.
        metrizable_space top /\ open_in top s ==> fsigma_in top s

name: ISMET_R2
statement: ismet ^mr2_tm

name: MR2_DEF
statement:
!x1 x2 y1 y2. (dist mr2) ((x1,x2),(y1,y2)) =
                  sqrt ((x1 - y1) pow 2 + (x2 - y2) pow 2)

name: bounded_metric_def
statement: bounded_metric (m :'a metric) = metric (\(x,y). ^bmetric_tm)

name: mtop
statement:
mtop (m :'a metric) =
    topology (\S'. !x. S' x ==> ?e. &0 < e /\ !y. (dist m)(x,y) < e ==> S' y)

name: mspace
statement: mspace m = topspace (mtop m)

name: ball
statement: B(m)(x,e) = \y. (dist m)(x,y) < e

name: mr1
statement: mr1 = metric(\(x,y). abs(y - x))

name: gdelta_in
statement:
gdelta_in (top:'a topology) =
        (COUNTABLE INTERSECTION_OF open_in top) relative_to topspace top

name: fsigma_in
statement: fsigma_in (top:'a topology) = COUNTABLE UNION_OF closed_in top

name: metrizable_space
statement: metrizable_space top = ?m. top = mtopology m

name: mr2
statement: mr2 = metric ^mr2_tm

name: MTOP_TENDS
statement:
!d g. !x:'b->'a. !x0. (x tends x0)(mtop(d),g) <=>
     !e. &0 < e ==> ?n. g n n /\ !m. g m n ==> dist(d)(x(m),x0) < e

name: tendsto
statement:
tendsto(m:('a)metric,x) y z =
      (&0 < (dist m)(x,y) /\ (dist m)(x,y) <= (dist m)(x,z))

name: inv0_def
statement: inv0 x = if x = 0r then 0r else prove_real_assums$inv x

name: real_div_def
statement: real_div x y = if y = 0r then 0r else prove_real_assums$/ x y

name: REAL_LE_LCANCEL_IMP
statement: !x y z. 0 < x /\ x * y <= x * z ==> y <= z

name: REAL_LE_RCANCEL_IMP
statement: !x y z. 0 < z /\ x * z <= y * z ==> x <= y

name: REAL_NEG_INV'
statement: -inv x = inv (-x)

name: REAL_LT_INV_EQ
statement: !x. 0 < inv x <=> 0 < x

name: REAL_LT_ADDL
statement: !x y. y < x + y <=> 0 < x

name: REAL_LT_NEG
statement: !x y. ~x < ~y <=> y < x

name: REAL_INV_MUL'
statement: !x y. inv(x * y) = inv(x) * inv(y)

name: REAL_INV_DIV
statement: !x y. x <> 0 /\ y <> 0 ==> (inv (x / y) = y * inv x)

name: REAL_INV_DIV'
statement: !x y. inv (x / y) = y * inv x

name: REAL_DIV_PROD
statement: !a b c (d :real). a / b * (c / d) = (a * c) / (b * d)

name: REAL_DIV_LT
statement: !a b c (d :real). 0 < b * d ==> (a / b < c / d <=> a * d < c * b)

name: ABS_POS
statement: !x. 0 <= abs(x)

name: ABS_ABS
statement: !x. abs(abs(x)) = abs(x)

name: REAL_ABS_DIV
statement: !x y. abs (x / y) = abs x / abs y

name: ABS_BOUNDS_LT
statement: !(x :real) k. abs(x) < k <=> -k < x /\ x < k

name: REAL_POW
statement: !m n. &m pow n = &(m EXP n)

name: POW_1
statement: !x. x pow 1 = x

name: POW_ONE
statement: !n. &1 pow n = &1

name: POW_M1
statement: !n. abs(~1 pow n) = 1

name: ABS_POW2
statement: !x. abs(x pow 2) = x pow 2

name: REAL_POW2_ABS
statement: !x. abs(x) pow 2 = x pow 2

name: NEGATED_POW
statement:
((-x) pow NUMERAL (BIT1 n) = -(x pow NUMERAL (BIT1 n))) /\
  ((-x) pow NUMERAL (BIT2 n) = x pow NUMERAL (BIT2 n))

name: REAL_POW_LE_1
statement: !(n:num) (x:real). (&1:real) <= x ==> (&1:real) <= x pow n

name: REAL_POW_INV
statement: !x n. (inv x) pow n = inv(x pow n)

name: REAL_POW_DIV
statement: !x y n. (x / y) pow n = (x pow n) / (y pow n)

name: REAL_POW_ADD
statement: !x m n. x pow (m + n) = x pow m * x pow n

name: REAL_POW_MONO
statement: !m n x. &1 <= x /\ m <= n ==> x pow m <= x pow n

name: REAL_POW_MONO_LT
statement: !m n x. &1 < x /\ m < n ==> x pow m < x pow n

name: REAL_POW_POW
statement: !x m n. (x pow m) pow n = x pow (m * n)

name: SIMP_REAL_ARCH
statement: !x:real. ?n. x <= &n

name: REAL_BIGNUM
statement: !r : real. ?n : num. r < &n

name: REAL_ARCH_INV
statement: !e. &0 < e <=> ?n. ~(n = 0) /\ &0:real < inv(&n) /\ inv(&n) < e:real

name: SUM_LT
statement:
!f g m n.
       (!r. m <= r /\ r < n + m ==> f r < g r) /\ 0 < n ==>
       sum (m,n) f < sum (m,n) g

name: SUM_PICK
statement: !n k x. sum (0, n) (\m. if m = k then x else 0) = if k < n then x else 0

name: SUM_SPLIT
statement: !f m n p. sum(m,n) f + sum(m + n,p) f = sum(m,n + p) f

name: SUM_DIFFS
statement: !d m n. sum(m,n) (\i. d(SUC i) - d(i)) = d(m + n) - d m

name: REAL_INV_INJ
statement: !x y : real. (inv x = inv y) <=> (x = y)

name: REAL_DIV_SUB
statement: !x y z :real. y / x - z / x = (y - z) / x

name: REAL_MIN_LE_MAX
statement: !x:real y. min x y <= max x y

name: REAL_MAX_SUB_MIN
statement: !x:real y. max x y - min x y = abs (y - x)

name: REAL_SUM_IMAGE_EMPTY

statement:
!f. (REAL_SUM_IMAGE f {} = 0) /\
        (!e s. FINITE s ==>
               (REAL_SUM_IMAGE f (e INSERT s) =
                f e + REAL_SUM_IMAGE f (s DELETE e)))

name: REAL_SUM_IMAGE_SING

        !f. (!x. x IN P ==> 0 <= f x) /\ (?x. x IN P /\ ~(f x = 0)) ==>
            ((~(REAL_SUM_IMAGE f P = 0)) <=> (~(P = {})))

name: REAL_SUM_IMAGE_NEG

name: REAL_SUM_IMAGE_IMAGE
statement:
!P. FINITE P ==>
        !f'. INJ f' P (IMAGE f' P) ==>
             !f. REAL_SUM_IMAGE f (IMAGE f' P) = REAL_SUM_IMAGE (f o f') P

name: REAL_SUM_IMAGE_DISJOINT_UNION

!P P'. FINITE P /\ FINITE P' /\ DISJOINT P P' ==>
                (!f. REAL_SUM_IMAGE f (P UNION P') =
                     REAL_SUM_IMAGE f P +
                     REAL_SUM_IMAGE f P')

   (!x y. x + y = y + x) /\
   (!x. 0r + x = x) /\
   (!x y z. x * (y * z) = (x * y) * z) /\

   (!x. 1r * x = x) /\
   (!x. 0r * x = 0r) /\

name: BISIM_REL_def
statement:
!p q. (!l.
            (!p'. ts p l p' ==> ?q'. ts q l q' /\ (BISIM_REL ts) p' q') /\
            (!q'. ts q l q' ==> ?p'. ts p l p' /\ (BISIM_REL ts) p' q'))

name: WBISIM_REL_def
statement:
!p q.
    (!l. l <> tau ==>
      (!p'. ts p l p' ==> ?q'. WTS ts tau q l q' /\ WBISIM_REL ts tau p' q') /\
      (!q'. ts q l q' ==> ?p'. WTS ts tau p l p' /\ WBISIM_REL ts tau p' q')) /\
    (!p'. ts p tau p' ==> ?q'. ETS ts tau q   q' /\ WBISIM_REL ts tau p' q') /\
    (!q'. ts q tau q' ==> ?p'. ETS ts tau p   p' /\ WBISIM_REL ts tau p' q')
   ==>
    WBISIM_REL ts tau p q

name: BFT_def0
statement:
BFT G f seen fringe acc =
    if FINITE (Parents G)
      then case fringe
           of [] => acc
           | h::t =>
              if MEM h seen
                then BFT G f seen t acc
                else BFT G f (h::seen)
                             (t ++ G h)
                             (f h acc)
      else ARB

name: DFT_REACH_THM

name: def
statement:
DFT G f seen to_visit acc =
    if FINITE (Parents G)
      then case to_visit
           of [] => acc
           | visit_now :: visit_later =>
              if MEM visit_now seen
                then DFT G f seen visit_later acc
                else DFT G f (visit_now :: seen)
                             (G visit_now ++ visit_later)
                             (f visit_now acc)
      else ARB

name: merge_def
statement:
(merge R [] [] = []) /\
  (merge R l [] = l) /\
  (merge R [] l = l) /\
  (merge R (x::l1) (y::l2) =
    if R x y then
      x::merge R l1 (y::l2)
    else
      y::merge R (x::l1) l2)

name: mergesortN_def
statement:
(mergesortN R 0 l = []) /\
  (mergesortN R 1 (x::l) = [x]) /\
  (mergesortN R 1 [] = []) /\
  (mergesortN R 2 (x::y::l) = sort2 R x y) /\
  (mergesortN R 2 [x] = [x]) /\
  (mergesortN R 2 [] = []) /\
  (mergesortN R 3 (x::y::z::l) = sort3 R x y z) /\
  (mergesortN R 3 [x;y] = sort2 R x y) /\
  (mergesortN R 3 [x] = [x]) /\
  (mergesortN R 3 [] = []) /\
  (mergesortN R n l =
    let len1 = DIV2 n in
      merge R
            (mergesortN R (DIV2 n) l)
            (mergesortN R (n - len1) (DROP len1 l)))

name: merge_tail_def
statement:
(merge_tail (negate:bool) R [] [] acc = acc) /\
  (merge_tail negate R l [] acc = REV l acc) /\
  (merge_tail negate R [] l acc = REV l acc) /\
  (merge_tail negate R (x::l1) (y::l2) acc =
    if R x y <> negate then
      merge_tail negate R l1 (y::l2) (x::acc)
    else
      merge_tail negate R (x::l1) l2 (y::acc))

name: mergesortN_tail_def
statement:
(mergesortN_tail (negate :bool) R 0 l = []) /\
  (mergesortN_tail negate R 1 (x::l) = [x]) /\
  (mergesortN_tail negate R 1 [] = []) /\
  (mergesortN_tail negate R 2 (x::y::l) = sort2_tail negate R x y) /\
  (mergesortN_tail negate R 2 [x] = [x]) /\
  (mergesortN_tail negate R 2 [] = []) /\
  (mergesortN_tail negate R 3 (x::y::z::l) = sort3_tail negate R x y z) /\
  (mergesortN_tail negate R 3 [x;y] = sort2_tail negate R x y) /\
  (mergesortN_tail negate R 3 [x] = [x]) /\
  (mergesortN_tail negate R 3 [] = []) /\
  (mergesortN_tail negate R n l =
    let len1 = DIV2 n in
    let neg = ~negate in
      merge_tail neg R (mergesortN_tail neg R (DIV2 n) l)
                       (mergesortN_tail neg R (n - len1) (DROP len1 l))
                       [])

name: char_encode_def
statement:
char_encode delopt c =
  if ~ isPrint c then
    if c = #"\n" then "\\n"
    else if c = #"\t" then "\\t"
    else if ORD c < 10 then
      "\\00" ++ num_to_dec_string (ORD c)
    else if ORD c < 100 then
      "\\0" ++ num_to_dec_string (ORD c)
    else "\\" ++ num_to_dec_string (ORD c)
  else if c = #"\\" then "\\\\"
  else case delopt of
         NONE => [c]
       | SOME d => if c = del_to_char d then
                     "\\" ++ [c]
                   else [c]

name: char_decode_def
statement:
char_decode delopt [] = NONE /\
  char_decode delopt (c::s) =
  if c = #"\\" then
    case s of
      [] => NONE
    | c2 :: stl =>
        if c2 = #"n" then SOME (#"\n", stl)
        else if c2 = #"t" then SOME (#"\t", stl)
        else if c2 = #"\\" then SOME (#"\\", stl)
        else if isDigit c2 then
          let d23 = TAKE 2 stl
          in
            if LENGTH d23 = 2 /\ EVERY isDigit d23 then
              let n = num_from_dec_string (c2::d23)
              in
                if n < 256 then SOME (CHR n, DROP 2 stl)
                else NONE
            else NONE
        else
          case delopt of
            NONE => NONE
          | SOME d => if del_to_char d = c2 then SOME (c2, stl)
                      else NONE
  else
    if isPrint c then
      case delopt of
        NONE => SOME (c, s)
      | SOME d => if del_to_char d = c then NONE
                  else SOME (c, s)
    else NONE

name: strencode_def
statement: strencode delopt s = FLAT (MAP (char_encode delopt) s)

name: strdecode_def
statement:
strdecode delopt s =
    case char_decode delopt s of
      NONE => (case (s,delopt) of
                 ([], _) => SOME("", [])
               | (_, NONE) => NONE
               | (c::tl, SOME d) => if c = del_to_char d then SOME("", c::tl)
                                    else NONE)
    | SOME(c, rest) => OPTION_MAP (CONS c ## I) (strdecode delopt rest)

          else let r0 = n MOD 256 in
               let r = if r0 = 0 then 256 else r0 in
               let s0 = n2s ((n - r) DIV 256)
               in
                 STRING (CHR (r - 1)) s0

name: SAT_def
statement:
(STATESAT ((M:('s,'a)STRUCTURE), s:'s) (TRUE:'a state_formula) = T)
 /\ (STATESAT (M,s) FALSE      = F)
 /\ (STATESAT (M,s) (REG a)    = ?PI. (PI STATE_NO 0 = s) /\
                                      (PI IS_FAIR_PATH_IN M) /\
                                      (a IN (M.valids s)))
 /\ (STATESAT (M,s)  ~f        = ~STATESAT (M,s) f)
 /\ (STATESAT (M,s) (f1 \/ f2) = STATESAT (M,s) f1 \/ STATESAT (M,s) f2)
 /\ (STATESAT (M,s) (f1 /\ f2) = STATESAT (M,s) f1 /\ STATESAT (M,s) f2)
 /\ (STATESAT (M,s) (E g1)     = ?PI. (PI IS_FAIR_PATH_IN M) /\
                                      (PI STATE_NO 0 = s) /\ PATHSAT(M,PI) g1)
 /\ (STATESAT (M,s) (A g1)     = !PI. (PI IS_FAIR_PATH_IN M) /\
                                      (PI STATE_NO 0 = s) ==> PATHSAT(M,PI) g1)

 /\ (PATHSAT (M,PI) (STATE f1) = STATESAT (M, PI STATE_NO 0) f1)
 /\ (PATHSAT (M,PI) (g1 FAILS) = ~PATHSAT (M,PI) g1)
 /\ (PATHSAT (M,PI) (g1 \/ g2) = PATHSAT (M,PI) g1 \/ PATHSAT (M,PI) g2)
 /\ (PATHSAT (M,PI) (g1 /\ g2) = PATHSAT (M,PI) g1 /\ PATHSAT (M,PI) g2)
 /\ (PATHSAT (M,PI) (X g1)     = PATHSAT (M, PI FROM 1) g1)
 /\ (PATHSAT (M,PI) (FU g1)    = ?k. k >= 0 /\ PATHSAT (M,(PI FROM k)) g1)
 /\ (PATHSAT (M,PI) (G g1)     = !i. i>=0 ==> PATHSAT (M,PI FROM i) g1)
 /\ (PATHSAT (M,PI) (g1 U g2)  = ?k. k>=0 /\ PATHSAT (M,PI FROM k) g2 /\
                                     !j. 0<=j/\j<k ==> PATHSAT(M,PI FROM j) g1)
 /\ (PATHSAT (M,PI) (g1 R g2)  = !j. j>=0
                                     ==> (!i. i<j ==> ~PATHSAT(M,PI FROM i) g1)
                                     ==> PATHSAT(M,PI FROM j) g2)

name: FUNPOW_OPT_next_n_NONE
statement:
!step_fun n n' s.
   (FUNPOW_OPT step_fun n s = NONE) ==>
   (FUNPOW_OPT step_fun (n + n') s = NONE)

name: FUNPOW_OPT_prev_EXISTS
statement:
!step_fun n n' s s'.
   n > 0 ==>
   (FUNPOW_OPT step_fun n s = SOME s') ==>
   n' < n ==>
   ?s''.
   (FUNPOW_OPT step_fun n' s = SOME s'')

name: FUNPOW_ASSOC
statement:
!f m n x.
 FUNPOW f m (FUNPOW f n x) = FUNPOW f n (FUNPOW f m x)

name: FUNPOW_OPT_step
statement:
!f n x x' x''.
 FUNPOW_OPT f (SUC n) x = SOME x'' ==>
 f x = SOME x' ==>
 FUNPOW_OPT f n x' = SOME x''

name: FUNPOW_OPT_PRE
statement:
!f n x x' x''.
 n > 0 ==>
 FUNPOW_OPT f n x = SOME x' ==>
 f x = SOME x'' ==>
 FUNPOW_OPT f (PRE n) x'' = SOME x'

name: FUNPOW_OPT_ADD_NONE
statement:
!f n n' ms ms'.
 FUNPOW_OPT f n ms = SOME ms' ==>
 FUNPOW_OPT f n' ms' = NONE ==> 
 FUNPOW_OPT f (n'+n) ms = NONE

name: FUNPOW_OPT_INTER
statement:
!f n n' ms ms' ms''.
 FUNPOW_OPT f n ms = SOME ms' ==>
 FUNPOW_OPT f (n'+n) ms = SOME ms'' ==>
 FUNPOW_OPT f n' ms' = SOME ms''

name: FUNPOW_SUB
statement:
!f m n x.
 m > n ==>
 FUNPOW f (m - n) (FUNPOW f n x) = FUNPOW f m x

name: FUNPOW_OPT_split
statement:
!f n' n s s'' s'.
n > n' ==>
FUNPOW_OPT f n s = SOME s' ==>
FUNPOW_OPT f (n - n') s = SOME s'' ==>
FUNPOW_OPT f n' s'' = SOME s'

name: FUNPOW_OPT_split2
statement:
!f n' n s s'' s'.
n > n' ==>
FUNPOW_OPT f n s = SOME s' ==>
FUNPOW_OPT f n' s = SOME s'' ==>
FUNPOW_OPT f (n - n') s'' = SOME s'

name: FUNPOW_OPT_cycle
statement:
!f s s' n n'.
 (OLEAST n. n > 0 /\ FUNPOW_OPT f n s = SOME s) = SOME n ==>
 s <> s' ==>
 (OLEAST n'. FUNPOW_OPT f n' s = SOME s') = SOME n' ==>
 n' < n

name: LGENLIST_UNFOLD_NONE
statement: !f. LGENLIST f NONE = (f 0) ::: (LGENLIST (f o SUC) NONE)

name: LGENLIST_UNFOLD_NEQ_SOME0
statement: !no f. (no <> SOME 0) ==> (LGENLIST f no = (f 0) ::: (LGENLIST (f o SUC) (OPT_NUM_PRE no)))

name: OPT_LCONS_REWRS
statement:
(!ll. OPT_LCONS NONE ll = ll) /\
    (!e ll. OPT_LCONS (SOME e) ll = e:::ll)

name: OPT_CONS_fromList
statement: !eo l. fromList (OPT_CONS eo l) = OPT_LCONS eo (fromList l)

name: LMAP_EQ_LNIL
statement: !f ll. (LMAP f ll = LNIL) <=> (ll = LNIL)

name: w2w_n2w
statement: !n. (w2w ((n2w n):'a word)):'b word = (n2w (n MOD dimword (:'a)))

name: align_n2w
statement:
!n m. align n ((n2w m):'a word) =
        n2w ((m MOD dimword (:'a)) DIV 2 ** n * 2 ** n)

name: w2n_MOD_2EXP_ID
statement: !(w:'a word). (MOD_2EXP (dimindex (:'a)) (w2n w)) = w2n w

name: word_extract_bits_w2w
statement: !h l a. ((h >< l) (a:'a word)) = w2w ((h -- l) a)

name: sw2sw_w2w_downcast
statement:
!w.
  (dimindex (:'b) <= dimindex (:'a)) ==> ((sw2sw (w : 'a word) : 'b word) = w2w w)

name: fixwidth_fixwidth_le
statement: !v n m. n <= m ==> (fixwidth n (fixwidth m v) = fixwidth n v)

name: w2v_word_join
statement:
FINITE univ(:'a) /\ FINITE univ(:'b) ==>
  !w1:'a word w2:'b word. w2v (word_join w1 w2) = (w2v w1 ++ w2v w2)

name: w2v_word_concat
statement:
FINITE univ(:'a) /\ FINITE univ(:'b) /\ (dimindex (:'c) = dimindex (:'a) + dimindex (:'b)) ==>
  !w1:'a word w2:'b word. w2v ((w1 @@ w2):'c word) = (w2v w1 ++ w2v w2)

name: word1_distinct
statement: (1w:word1) <> 0w

name: BIT_ADD_WORD_CARRY
statement:
!w0:'a word (w1:'a word).
  BIT (dimindex (:'a)) (w2n w0 + w2n (w1)) <=>
  ~(w2n w0 + w2n w1 < dimword (:'a))

name: word_sub_n2w
statement:
!n m. (n2w n - n2w m):'a word = n2w (if m <= n then (n - m) else
            dimword (:'a) - (m - n) MOD dimword (:'a))

name: aligned_neg
statement: !p (a:'a word). aligned p (-a) <=> aligned p a

name: align_aligned_add
statement:
!p (a:'a word) b. aligned p b ==>
                    ((align p (a + b) = ((align p a) + b)))

name: align_aligned_sub
statement:
!p (a:'a word) b. aligned p b ==>
                    ((align p (a - b) = ((align p a) - b)))

name: testbit_el_iff
statement: !v i. testbit i v = ((i < LENGTH v) /\ EL (LENGTH v - 1 - i) v)

name: w2w_32_64
statement: !(b1:word32). w2w ((w2w b1):word64) = b1

name: n2w_w2n_w2w_32_64
statement: !(b1:word32). n2w ((w2n b1)) = (w2w:word32 -> word64) b1

name: w2w_n2w_w2n_64_32
statement: !(b1:word64). (w2w:word64 -> word32) b1 = n2w ((w2n b1))

name: if_bool_1w
statement: !b. ((if b then 1w else 0w) = 1w) = b

name: FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK_11
statement: !pre n1 n2. (FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK pre n1 = FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK pre n2) <=> (n1 = n2)

name: FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_AUX_PROPS
statement:
!s pre n i.
  FINITE s ==>
  let i = FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_AUX pre n s in
  (n <= i) /\ ~(FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK pre i IN s) /\
  (!i'. (n <= i' /\ i' < i) ==> ((FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK pre i') IN s))

name: FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_NOT_IN
statement: !s pre n. FINITE s ==> ~(FRESH_INDEXED_STRING pre n s IN s)

name: FRESH_INDEXED_STRINGS_PROPS_INDICES
statement:
!s pre l n. FINITE s ==> (
       ?nl. (FRESH_INDEXED_STRINGS pre n s l = MAP (FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK pre) nl) /\
            (LENGTH nl = l) /\
            (ALL_DISTINCT nl) /\
            (EVERY ($<= n) nl) /\
            (EVERY (\n. ~((FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK pre n) IN s)) nl))

name: FRESH_INDEXED_STRINGS_PROPS
statement:
!s pre l n. FINITE s ==> (
      (LENGTH (FRESH_INDEXED_STRINGS pre n s l) = l) /\
      ALL_DISTINCT (FRESH_INDEXED_STRINGS pre n s l) /\
      (EVERY (\n. ~(n IN s)) (FRESH_INDEXED_STRINGS pre n s l)))

name: SPLIT_ELs_GEN_thm
statement:
!i h x t.
  SPLIT_ELs t x i =
  SPLIT_ELs (h::t) x (i + 1)

name: SPLIT_ELs_0_thm
statement: !l. SPLIT_ELs l l 0

name: flat_setlist_def
statement:
flat_setlist l <=>
  FOLDL (\acc x. x UNION acc) EMPTY l

name: OPT_NUM_MIN_def
statement:
(OPT_NUM_MIN NONE no2 = no2) /\
   (OPT_NUM_MIN no1 NONE = no1) /\
   (OPT_NUM_MIN (SOME n1) (SOME n2) = SOME (MIN n1 n2))

name: OPT_NUM_PRE_def
statement: OPT_NUM_PRE = OPTION_MAP PRE

name: OPT_NUM_SUC_def
statement: OPT_NUM_SUC = OPTION_MAP SUC

name: OPT_CONS_def
statement: OPT_CONS eo l = option_CASE eo l (\e. CONS e l)

name: FUNPOW_OPT_def
statement:
FUNPOW_OPT (r : 'a -> 'a option) n x =
  FUNPOW (\x. option_CASE x NONE r) n (SOME x)

name: OPT_LCONS_def
statement: OPT_LCONS eo l = option_CASE eo l (\e. LCONS e l)

name: FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK_def
statement:
FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK pre n =
  (pre ++ (num_to_dec_string n))

name: FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_AUX_def
statement: FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_AUX pre n s = (LEAST x. (n <= x) /\ ~((FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK pre x) IN s))

name: FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_def
statement: FRESH_INDEXED_STRING pre n s = (FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK pre (FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_AUX pre n s))

name: FRESH_INDEXED_STRINGS_def
statement:
(FRESH_INDEXED_STRINGS pre n s 0 = []) /\
  (FRESH_INDEXED_STRINGS pre n s (SUC m) =
   let ns = (FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_AUX pre n s) in
   let ss = FRESH_INDEXED_STRING_MK pre ns in
   (ss::FRESH_INDEXED_STRINGS pre (SUC ns) s m))

name: SPLIT_ELs_def
statement:
(SPLIT_ELs _ []      _ = T) /\
  (SPLIT_ELs l (h::t)  i = ((EL i l = h) /\ (SPLIT_ELs l t (i + 1))))

name: apply_to_select_REWR
statement: !array index. (FAPPLY array index) = (select array index)

name: update_to_store_REWR
statement: !array index value. (FUPDATE array (index, value)) = (store array index value)

name: const_map_to_const_array_REWR
statement: !value. (FUN_FMAP (K (value)) (UNIV)) = (const_array value)

name: bir_var_eq_EXPAND
statement:
!v1 (v2:bir_var_t). (v1 = v2) <=>
                        (bir_var_name v1 = bir_var_name v2) /\
                        (bir_var_type v1 = bir_var_type v2)

name: bir_env_lookup_UPDATE
statement:
bir_env_lookup vn (BEnv ((vn' =+ vo) env)) =
   (if (vn' = vn) then vo else bir_env_lookup vn (BEnv env))

name: bir_env_read_UPDATE
statement:
bir_env_read var (BEnv ((vn =+ vo) env)) =
   (if (bir_var_name var = vn) then
      (if (OPTION_MAP type_of_bir_val vo) = SOME (bir_var_type var) then
         vo
       else
         NONE)
    else bir_env_read var (BEnv env))

name: bir_env_read_NEQ_NONE
statement:
!var env v.
(v <> NONE) ==>
((bir_env_read var env = v) <=> (?va. (v = SOME va) /\
                                      (bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name var) env = v) /\
                                      (bir_var_type var = type_of_bir_val va)))

name: bir_env_write_different_type
statement:
!v va env. (type_of_bir_val va <> bir_var_type v) ==>
               (bir_env_write v va env = NONE)

name: bir_env_write_types
statement:
!env env' v va.
    (bir_env_write v va env = SOME env') ==>
    (bir_env_lookup_type (bir_var_name v) env = bir_env_lookup_type (bir_var_name v) env')

name: bir_env_read_types
statement:
!env v ty r. (bir_env_read v env = r) ==>
                 (r <> NONE) ==>
                 (?va. (r = SOME va) /\ (type_of_bir_val va = bir_var_type v))

name: bir_env_read_EQ_lookup_IMPL
statement:
!env1 env2 v.
   (bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name v) env1 = bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name v) env2) ==>
   (bir_env_read v env1 = bir_env_read v env2)

name: bir_env_satisfies_envty_of_env
statement: !env. bir_env_satisfies_envty env (bir_envty_of_env env)

name: bir_env_default_satisfies_envty
statement: !envty. bir_env_satisfies_envty (bir_env_default envty) envty

name: bir_v_in_envty_env_IMP
statement:
!envty env v. (bir_envty_includes_v envty v) ==>
             (bir_env_satisfies_envty env envty) ==>
             (?va. (bir_env_read v env = SOME va) /\ (type_of_bir_val va = bir_var_type v))

name: bir_v_in_envty_env_IMP2
statement:
!envty env v. (bir_envty_includes_v envty v) ==>
             (bir_env_satisfies_envty (BEnv env) envty) ==>
             (?va. (env (bir_var_name v) = SOME va) /\ (type_of_bir_val va = bir_var_type v))

name: bir_vs_in_envty_env_IMP
statement:
!envty env vs. (bir_envty_includes_vs envty vs) ==>
             (bir_env_satisfies_envty env envty) ==>
             !v. (v IN vs) ==>
                 (?va. (bir_env_read v env = SOME va) /\ (type_of_bir_val va = bir_var_type v))

name: bir_vs_in_envty_env_IMP2
statement:
!envty env vs. (bir_envty_includes_vs envty vs) ==>
             (bir_env_satisfies_envty (BEnv env) envty) ==>
             !v. (v IN vs) ==>
                 (?va. (env (bir_var_name v) = SOME va) /\ (type_of_bir_val va = bir_var_type v))

name: bir_envty_includes_vs_IMP_vs_consistent
statement:
!envty vs. (bir_envty_includes_vs envty vs) ==>
             (bir_vs_consistent vs)

name: bir_vs_consistent_IMP_includes_envty_of_vs
statement:
!envty vs. (bir_vs_consistent vs) ==>
             (bir_envty_includes_vs (bir_envty_of_vs vs) vs)

name: bir_envty_includes_vs_EMPTY
statement: !envty. (bir_envty_includes_vs envty EMPTY)

name: bir_envty_includes_vs_INSERT
statement:
!envty v vs. (bir_envty_includes_vs envty (v INSERT vs)) <=>
               ((bir_envty_includes_v envty v) /\ (bir_envty_includes_vs envty vs))

name: bir_envty_includes_vs_UNION
statement:
!envty vs1 vs2. (bir_envty_includes_vs envty (vs1 UNION vs2)) <=>
                  ((bir_envty_includes_vs envty vs1) /\ (bir_envty_includes_vs envty vs2))

name: bir_envty_includes_vs_SUBSET
statement:
!envty vs1 vs2. (bir_envty_includes_vs envty vs1) ==>
                  (vs2 SUBSET vs1) ==>
                  (bir_envty_includes_vs envty vs2)

name: bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS_EQUIV_EQ
statement:
!vs env1 env2. (bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env1 env2) <=>
                   (bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env1 = bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env2)

name: bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS_EQUIV
statement:
(!vs env. bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env env) /\
   (!vs env1 env2. (bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env1 env2 <=> (bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env2 env1))) /\
   (!vs env1 env2 env3. bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env1 env2 ==>
                        bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env2 env3 ==>
                        bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env1 env3)

name: bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS_EMPTY
statement: !env1 env2. bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS EMPTY env1 env2

name: bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS_UNIV
statement: !env1 env2. bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS UNIV env1 env2 <=> (env1 = env2)

name: bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS_SUBSET
statement: !vs1 vs2 env1 env2. vs2 SUBSET vs1 ==> bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs1 env1 env2 ==> bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs2 env1 env2

name: bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS_read_IMPL
statement:
!vs env1 env2. bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env1 env2 ==>
  (!v. v IN vs ==> (bir_env_read v env1 = bir_env_read v env2))

name: bir_var_name_def
statement: bir_var_name (BVar n _) = n

name: bir_var_type_def
statement: bir_var_type (BVar _ ty) = ty

name: bir_env_map_empty_def
statement: bir_env_map_empty = (\(s:string). (NONE:bir_val_t option))

name: bir_env_empty_def
statement: bir_env_empty = BEnv (bir_env_map_empty)

name: bir_env_lookup_def
statement: (bir_env_lookup varname (BEnv env) = env varname)

name: bir_env_update_def
statement:
bir_env_update varname v ty (BEnv env) =
      if (ty = (type_of_bir_val v)) /\ (env varname <> NONE) then
        SOME (BEnv ((varname =+ SOME v) env))
      else
        NONE

name: bir_env_lookup_type_def
statement: bir_env_lookup_type var_name env = OPTION_MAP type_of_bir_val (bir_env_lookup var_name env)

name: bir_env_check_type_def
statement:
bir_env_check_type var env =
    (bir_env_lookup_type (bir_var_name var) env = SOME (bir_var_type var))

name: bir_env_read_def
statement:
bir_env_read var env =
  if (bir_env_check_type var env) then
    (bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name var) env)
  else
    NONE

name: bir_env_write_def
statement:
bir_env_write var va env =
	 if (bir_env_check_type var env) then
	   bir_env_update (bir_var_name var) va (bir_var_type var) env
	 else
	   NONE

name: bir_envty_of_env_def
statement:
bir_envty_of_env (BEnv env) =
  BEnvTy ((OPTION_MAP type_of_bir_val) o env)

name: bir_env_default_def
statement:
bir_env_default (BEnvTy envty) =
           BEnv ((OPTION_MAP bir_default_value_of_type) o envty)

name: bir_env_satisfies_envty_def
statement:
bir_env_satisfies_envty (BEnv env) (BEnvTy envty) =
  !vn t. (envty vn = SOME t) ==> (?v. (env vn = SOME v) /\ (type_of_bir_val v = t))

name: bir_envty_includes_v_def
statement:
bir_envty_includes_v (BEnvTy envty) v =
  (envty (bir_var_name v) = SOME (bir_var_type v))

name: bir_envty_includes_vs_def
statement:
bir_envty_includes_vs envty vs =
  (!v. (v IN vs) ==> (bir_envty_includes_v envty v))

name: bir_envty_of_vs_def
statement:
bir_envty_of_vs (vs:bir_var_t -> bool) =
  BEnvTy (\vn. if vn IN (IMAGE bir_var_name vs) then
                 SOME (bir_var_type (CHOICE (vs DIFF { BVar vn' vt' | ?vt. (vt = vt') /\ (vn <> vn')})))
               else
                 NONE)

name: bir_vs_consistent_def
statement:
bir_vs_consistent vs =
  !v1 v2. (v1 IN vs) ==> (v2 IN vs) ==> ((bir_var_name v1) = (bir_var_name v2)) ==> (v1 = v2)

name: bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS_def
statement:
bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env1 env2 <=>
  (!v. v IN vs ==> (bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name v) env1 = bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name v) env2))

name: bir_env_varname_is_bound_ALT_DEF
statement: !var env. bir_env_varname_is_bound env var <=> IS_SOME (bir_env_lookup_type var env)

name: bir_env_varname_is_bound_ALT2_DEF
statement: !var env. bir_env_varname_is_bound env var <=> IS_SOME (bir_env_lookup var env)

name: bir_is_well_typed_env_THM
statement: !env. bir_is_well_typed_env env

name: bir_env_var_is_initialised_EQ_envty
statement: !env var. bir_env_var_is_initialised env var <=> bir_envty_includes_v (bir_envty_of_env env) var

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_EQ_envty
statement: !env vs. bir_env_vars_are_initialised env vs <=> bir_envty_includes_vs (bir_envty_of_env env) vs

name: bir_env_restrict_vars_IN_THM
statement:
!vs env v.
    v IN vs ==>
    bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name v) (bir_env_restrict_vars vs env) = bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name v) env

name: bir_env_restrict_vars_NOTIN_IMAGE_THM
statement:
!vs env bvn.
    bvn NOTIN (IMAGE bir_var_name vs) ==>
    bir_env_lookup bvn (bir_env_restrict_vars vs env) = NONE

name: bir_env_restrict_vars_IMP_var_is_initialised_THM
statement:
!v vs env.
    (v IN vs) ==>
    (bir_env_var_is_initialised env v) ==>
    (bir_env_var_is_initialised (bir_env_restrict_vars vs env) v)

name: bir_env_restrict_vars_IMP_vars_are_initialised_THM
statement:
!vs env.
    (bir_env_vars_are_initialised env vs) ==>
    (bir_env_vars_are_initialised (bir_env_restrict_vars vs env) vs)

name: bir_env_var_is_initialised_weaken
statement: !v env. bir_env_var_is_initialised env v ==> bir_env_var_is_declared env v

name: bir_env_var_is_declared_weaken
statement: !v env. bir_env_var_is_declared env v ==> bir_env_varname_is_bound env (bir_var_name v)

name: bir_env_order_REFL
statement: !env. bir_env_order env env

name: bir_env_order_TRANS
statement:
!env1 env2 env3.
       bir_env_order env1 env2 ==> bir_env_order env2 env3 ==>
       bir_env_order env1 env3

name: bir_env_varname_is_bound_ORDER
statement:
!env1 env2 v. bir_env_order env1 env2 ==>
                  bir_env_varname_is_bound env1 v ==>
                  bir_env_varname_is_bound env2 v

name: bir_env_var_is_declared_ORDER
statement:
!env1 env2 v. bir_env_order env1 env2 ==>
                  bir_env_var_is_declared env1 v ==>
                  bir_env_var_is_declared env2 v

name: bir_env_var_is_initialised_ORDER
statement:
!env1 env2 v. bir_env_order env1 env2 ==>
                  bir_env_var_is_initialised env1 v ==>
                  bir_env_var_is_initialised env2 v

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_EMPTY
statement: !env. bir_env_vars_are_initialised env {}

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_INSERT
statement:
!env v vs. bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (v INSERT vs) <=>
               (bir_env_var_is_initialised env v /\ bir_env_vars_are_initialised env vs)

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_UNION
statement:
!env vs1 vs2. bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (vs1 UNION vs2) <=>
                  (bir_env_vars_are_initialised env vs1 /\
                   bir_env_vars_are_initialised env vs2)

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_SUBSET
statement:
!env vs1 vs2. bir_env_vars_are_initialised env vs1 ==>
                  (vs2 SUBSET vs1) ==>
                   bir_env_vars_are_initialised env vs2

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_ORDER
statement:
!env1 env2 vs. bir_env_order env1 env2 ==>
                   bir_env_vars_are_initialised env1 vs ==>
                   bir_env_vars_are_initialised env2 vs

name: bir_env_order_update
statement:
!env env' vn va ty.
    ~(bir_env_varname_is_bound env vn) /\
    (bir_env_update vn va ty env = SOME env') ==>
    bir_env_order env env'

name: bir_env_order_write
statement:
!env env' v va.
    (bir_env_write v va env = SOME env') ==>
    bir_env_order env env'

name: bir_env_order_well_typed
statement:
!env env'. bir_is_well_typed_env env ==>
             bir_env_order env env' ==>
             bir_is_well_typed_env env'

name: bir_var_set_is_well_typed_EQ_bir_vs_consistent
statement: !vs.  bir_var_set_is_well_typed vs = bir_vs_consistent vs

name: bir_var_set_is_well_typed_INJ_DEF
statement: bir_var_set_is_well_typed vs <=> INJ bir_var_name vs UNIV

name: bir_var_set_is_well_typed_EMPTY
statement: bir_var_set_is_well_typed {}

name: bir_var_set_is_well_typed_INSERT
statement:
!v vs. bir_var_set_is_well_typed (v INSERT vs) <=>
           bir_var_set_is_well_typed vs /\
           (!v'. v' IN vs ==>
                 (bir_var_name v = bir_var_name v') ==>
                 (bir_var_type v = bir_var_type v'))

name: bir_var_set_is_well_typed_UNION
statement:
!vs1 vs2. bir_var_set_is_well_typed (vs1 UNION vs2) <=>
            bir_var_set_is_well_typed vs1 /\
            bir_var_set_is_well_typed vs2 /\
            (!v1 v2. v1 IN vs1 ==> v2 IN vs2 ==>
                 (bir_var_name v1 = bir_var_name v2) ==>
                 (bir_var_type v1 = bir_var_type v2))

name: bir_var_set_is_well_typed_SUBSET
statement: !vs1 vs2. vs1 SUBSET vs2 ==> bir_var_set_is_well_typed vs2 ==> bir_var_set_is_well_typed vs1

name: bir_var_set_is_well_typed_REWRS
statement:
(bir_var_set_is_well_typed (set [])) /\
    (!v vs. bir_var_set_is_well_typed (set (v::vs)) =
       (EVERY (\v'. (bir_var_name v = bir_var_name v') ==>
		   (bir_var_type v = bir_var_type v')
	     ) vs /\
       bir_var_set_is_well_typed (set vs))
    )

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_WELL_TYPED
statement: !vs env. bir_env_vars_are_initialised env vs ==> bir_var_set_is_well_typed vs

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_ENV_EXISTS_EXTENSION
statement:
!vs1 vs2 env1.
      (vs1 SUBSET vs2 /\ bir_var_set_is_well_typed vs2) ==>
      bir_env_vars_are_initialised env1 vs1 ==>
      (?env2. bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs1 env1 env2 /\
              bir_env_vars_are_initialised env2 vs2)

name: bir_env_varname_is_bound_def
statement: (bir_env_varname_is_bound (BEnv env) vn = ?v. (env vn = SOME v))

name: bir_env_var_is_declared_def
statement:
(bir_env_var_is_declared env v <=>
  (bir_env_lookup_type (bir_var_name v) env = SOME (bir_var_type v)))

name: bir_is_well_typed_env_def
statement:
(bir_is_well_typed_env env <=> 
     bir_env_satisfies_envty env (bir_envty_of_env env))

name: bir_env_var_is_initialised_def
statement:
(bir_env_var_is_initialised env var <=>
  (?v. (bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name var) env = SOME v) /\
       (type_of_bir_val v = bir_var_type var)))

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_def
statement:
bir_env_vars_are_initialised env vs <=>
  (!v. v IN vs ==> bir_env_var_is_initialised env v)

name: bir_env_restrict_vars_def
statement:
bir_env_restrict_vars vs (BEnv f) =
  (BEnv (\x. if x IN (IMAGE bir_var_name vs) then f x else NONE))

name: bir_env_order_def
statement:
(bir_env_order env1 env2) <=> !vn. (
     
     ((bir_env_lookup vn env1 = NONE) ==>
      (bir_env_lookup vn env2 = NONE)) /\

     
     (!va1. (bir_env_lookup vn env1 = SOME va1) ==>
            (?va2. (bir_env_lookup vn env2 = SOME va2) /\
                   (type_of_bir_val va1 = type_of_bir_val va2)))
   )

name: bir_var_set_is_well_typed_def
statement:
bir_var_set_is_well_typed vs <=>
  (!v1 v2. (v1 IN vs /\ v2 IN vs /\ (bir_var_name v1 = bir_var_name v2)) ==>
           (bir_var_type v1 = bir_var_type v2))

name: bir_eval_cast_REWRS
statement:
(!ct bi ty. (bir_eval_cast ct (SOME (BVal_Imm bi)) ty = SOME (BVal_Imm (bir_gencast ct bi ty)))) /\
  (!ct ty. bir_eval_cast ct NONE ty = NONE) /\
  (!ct at vt mmap ty. bir_eval_cast ct (SOME (BVal_Mem at vt mmap)) ty = NONE)

name: bir_eval_unary_exp_REWRS
statement:
(!et bi. (bir_eval_unary_exp et (SOME (BVal_Imm bi)) = SOME (BVal_Imm (bir_unary_exp et bi)))) /\
   (!et. bir_eval_unary_exp et NONE = NONE) /\
   (!et at vt mmap. bir_eval_unary_exp et (SOME (BVal_Mem at vt mmap)) = NONE)

name: bir_eval_bin_exp_REWRS
statement:
(!et bi1 bi2. bir_eval_bin_exp et (SOME (BVal_Imm bi1)) (SOME (BVal_Imm bi2)) =
     if (type_of_bir_imm bi1 <> type_of_bir_imm bi2) then NONE else
     SOME (BVal_Imm (bir_bin_exp et bi1 bi2))) /\
  (!et v. bir_eval_bin_exp et NONE v = NONE) /\
  (!et v. bir_eval_bin_exp et v NONE = NONE) /\
  (!et at vt mmap v. bir_eval_bin_exp et (SOME (BVal_Mem at vt mmap)) v = NONE) /\
  (!et at vt mmap v. bir_eval_bin_exp et v (SOME (BVal_Mem at vt mmap)) = NONE)

name: bir_eval_bin_pred_REWRS
statement:
(!et bi1 bi2. bir_eval_bin_pred et (SOME (BVal_Imm bi1)) (SOME (BVal_Imm bi2)) =
     if (type_of_bir_imm bi1 <> type_of_bir_imm bi2) then NONE else
     SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (bir_bin_pred et bi1 bi2)))) /\
  (!et v. bir_eval_bin_pred et NONE v = NONE) /\
  (!et v. bir_eval_bin_pred et v NONE = NONE) /\
  (!et at vt mmap v. bir_eval_bin_pred et (SOME (BVal_Mem at vt mmap)) v = NONE) /\
  (!et at vt mmap v. bir_eval_bin_pred et v (SOME (BVal_Mem at vt mmap)) = NONE)

name: bir_eval_memeq_REWRS
statement:
(!at1 vt1 mmap1 at2 vt2 mmap2. (bir_eval_memeq (SOME (BVal_Mem at1 vt1 mmap1)) (SOME (BVal_Mem at2 vt2 mmap2)) =
     if ((at1 <> at2) \/ (vt1 <> vt2)) then NONE else
     SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (bir_memeq at1 vt1 mmap1 mmap2))))) /\
   (!v. bir_eval_memeq NONE v = NONE) /\
   (!v. bir_eval_memeq v NONE = NONE) /\
   (!bi v. bir_eval_memeq (SOME (BVal_Imm bi)) v = NONE) /\
   (!bi v. bir_eval_memeq v (SOME (BVal_Imm bi)) = NONE)

name: bir_eval_ifthenelse_REWRS
bir_eval_ifthenelse_REWRS_NONE
statement:
(!vc v1 v2.
     (type_of_bir_val vc <> BType_Imm Bit1) ==>
     (bir_eval_ifthenelse (SOME vc) v1 v2 = NONE)) /\
  (!vc v1 v2.
     ~(bir_val_is_Bool vc) ==>
     (bir_eval_ifthenelse (SOME vc) v1 v2 = NONE)) /\
  (!vc v1 v2.
     (type_of_bir_val v1 <> type_of_bir_val v2) ==>
     (bir_eval_ifthenelse vc (SOME v1) (SOME v2) = NONE))

name: bir_eval_ifthenelse_TF_EQ
statement:
!c v.
     bir_eval_ifthenelse (SOME c) v v =
     if (bir_val_is_Bool c) then v else NONE

name: bir_eval_load_NONE_REWRS1
statement:
(!mem en t. bir_eval_load mem NONE en t = NONE) /\
    (!mem en t aty vty mmap. bir_eval_load mem (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) en t = NONE)

name: bir_eval_load_NONE_REWRS2
statement:
(!a en t. bir_eval_load NONE a en t = NONE) /\
    (!a en t i. bir_eval_load (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) a en t = NONE)

name: bir_eval_load_NONE_REWRS3
statement:
!a en t i aty vty mmap.
      (type_of_bir_imm i <> aty) ==>
      (bir_eval_load (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) en t = NONE)

name: bir_eval_load_NONE_REWRS4
statement:
!a en t i aty vty mmap.
      (t <> vty) ==>
      (bir_eval_load (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) BEnd_NoEndian t = NONE)

name: bir_eval_load_NONE_REWRS5
statement:
!a en t i aty vty mmap en.
      (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty t aty = NONE) ==>
      (bir_eval_load (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) en t = NONE)

name: bir_eval_load_SINGLE_REWR
statement:
!a en t i aty vty mmap en.
      (bir_eval_load (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) en vty) =
      ((if (type_of_bir_imm i = aty) then (SOME (BVal_Imm (n2bs (bir_load_mmap mmap (b2n i)) vty)))
       else NONE))

name: bir_eval_load_BASIC_REWR
statement:
!a en t i aty vty ty mmap en.
      (bir_eval_load (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) en ty) =
      (if type_of_bir_imm i = aty then
        case bir_load_from_mem vty ty aty mmap en (b2n i) of
          NONE => NONE
        | SOME i => SOME (BVal_Imm i)
       else NONE)

name: thm_prune0
statement:
(!ta a.
      (type_of_bir_imm a <> ta) ==>
      (bir_eval_load (SOME (BVal_Mem ta tv mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm a)) en tr = NONE)) /\
      (!tr tv.
      (tr <> tv) ==> (bir_number_of_mem_splits tv tr ta <> NONE) ==>
      (bir_eval_load (SOME (BVal_Mem ta tv mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) BEnd_NoEndian tr = NONE)) /\
      (!tr tv.
      (bir_number_of_mem_splits tv tr ta = NONE) ==>
      (bir_eval_load (SOME (BVal_Mem ta tv mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) en tr = NONE))

name: bir_eval_store_NONE_REWRS1
statement:
(!mem en v. bir_eval_store mem NONE en v = NONE) /\
    (!mem en v aty vty mmap. bir_eval_store mem (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) en v = NONE)

name: bir_eval_store_NONE_REWRS2
statement:
(!a en v. bir_eval_store NONE a en v = NONE) /\
    (!a en v i. bir_eval_store (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) a en v = NONE)

name: bir_eval_store_NONE_REWRS3
statement:
(!a en mem. bir_eval_store mem a en NONE = NONE) /\
    (!a en mem ta tv mmap. bir_eval_store mem a en (SOME (BVal_Mem ta tv mmap)) = NONE)

name: bir_eval_store_NONE_REWRS4
statement:
!en v i aty vty mmap.
      (type_of_bir_imm i <> aty) ==>
      (bir_eval_store (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) en v = NONE)

name: bir_eval_store_NONE_REWRS5
statement:
!a en v aty vty mmap.
      (type_of_bir_imm v <> vty) ==>
      (bir_eval_store (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) a BEnd_NoEndian (SOME (BVal_Imm v)) = NONE)

name: bir_eval_store_NONE_REWRS6
statement:
!a en v aty vty mmap en.
      (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty (type_of_bir_imm v) aty = NONE) ==>
      (bir_eval_store (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) a en (SOME (BVal_Imm v)) = NONE)

name: bir_eval_store_SINGLE_REWR
statement:
!a en t i aty v vty mmap en.
      ((type_of_bir_imm i = aty) /\ (type_of_bir_imm v = vty)) ==>
      (bir_eval_store (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) en (SOME (BVal_Imm v)) =
      SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty (FUPDATE mmap (b2n i, b2n v))))

name: bir_eval_store_BASIC_REWR
statement:
!a en t i aty v vty mmap en.
      (bir_eval_store (SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) en (SOME (BVal_Imm v)) =
      (if type_of_bir_imm i = aty then
         case bir_store_in_mem vty aty v mmap en (b2n i) of
           NONE => NONE
         | SOME mmap' => SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap')
       else NONE))

name: thm_prune0
statement:
(!ta a.
      (type_of_bir_imm a <> ta) ==>
      (bir_eval_store (SOME (BVal_Mem ta tv mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm a)) en v = NONE)) /\
      (!i tv.
      (type_of_bir_imm i <> tv) ==> (bir_number_of_mem_splits tv (type_of_bir_imm i) ta <> NONE) ==>
      (bir_eval_store (SOME (BVal_Mem ta tv mmap)) a BEnd_NoEndian (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) = NONE)) /\
      (!i tv.
      (bir_number_of_mem_splits tv (type_of_bir_imm i) ta = NONE) ==>
      (bir_eval_store (SOME (BVal_Mem ta tv mmap)) a en (SOME (BVal_Imm i)) = NONE))

name: bir_eval_cast_def
statement:
(bir_eval_cast ct (SOME (BVal_Imm bi)) ty = SOME (BVal_Imm (bir_gencast ct bi ty))) /\
  (bir_eval_cast _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_eval_unary_exp_def
statement:
(bir_eval_unary_exp et (SOME (BVal_Imm bi)) = SOME (BVal_Imm (bir_unary_exp et bi))) /\
  (bir_eval_unary_exp _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_eval_bin_exp_def
statement:
(bir_eval_bin_exp et (SOME (BVal_Imm bi1)) (SOME (BVal_Imm bi2)) =
     if (type_of_bir_imm bi1 <> type_of_bir_imm bi2) then NONE else
     SOME (BVal_Imm (bir_bin_exp et bi1 bi2))) /\
  (bir_eval_bin_exp _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_eval_bin_pred_def
statement:
(bir_eval_bin_pred pt (SOME (BVal_Imm bi1)) (SOME (BVal_Imm bi2)) =
     if (type_of_bir_imm bi1 <> type_of_bir_imm bi2) then NONE else
     SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (bir_bin_pred pt bi1 bi2)))) /\
  (bir_eval_bin_pred _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_eval_memeq_def
statement:
(bir_eval_memeq (SOME (BVal_Mem at1 vt1 mmap1)) (SOME (BVal_Mem at2 vt2 mmap2)) =
     if ((at1 <> at2) \/ (vt1 <> vt2)) then NONE else
     SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (bir_memeq at1 vt1 mmap1 mmap2)))) /\
  (bir_eval_memeq _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_eval_ifthenelse_def
statement:
(bir_eval_ifthenelse (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 cw))) (SOME v1) (SOME v2) =
     if (type_of_bir_val v1 <> type_of_bir_val v2) then NONE else
       if (cw = 1w) then SOME v1 else SOME v2) /\
  (bir_eval_ifthenelse _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_eval_load_def
statement:
(bir_eval_load (SOME (BVal_Mem ta tv mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm a)) en t =
     if ((type_of_bir_imm a) = ta) then
        (case (bir_load_from_mem tv t ta mmap en (b2n a)) of
           NONE => NONE
         | SOME i => SOME (BVal_Imm i))
     else NONE) /\
  (bir_eval_load _ _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_eval_store_def
statement:
(bir_eval_store (SOME (BVal_Mem ta tv mmap)) (SOME (BVal_Imm a)) en (SOME (BVal_Imm v)) =
     if ((type_of_bir_imm a) = ta) then
        (case (bir_store_in_mem tv ta v mmap en (b2n a)) of
           NONE => NONE
         | SOME mmap' => SOME (BVal_Mem ta tv mmap'))
     else NONE) /\
  (bir_eval_store _ _ _ _ = NONE)

name: bir_eval_exp_def
statement:
(bir_eval_exp (BExp_Const n) env = SOME (BVal_Imm n)) /\

  (bir_eval_exp (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) env = SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) /\

  (bir_eval_exp (BExp_Den v) env = bir_env_read v env) /\

  (bir_eval_exp (BExp_Cast ct e ty) env = (
     bir_eval_cast ct (bir_eval_exp e env) ty)) /\

  (bir_eval_exp (BExp_UnaryExp et e) env = (
     bir_eval_unary_exp et (bir_eval_exp e env))) /\

  (bir_eval_exp (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) env = (
     bir_eval_bin_exp et (bir_eval_exp e1 env) (bir_eval_exp e2 env))) /\

  (bir_eval_exp (BExp_BinPred pt e1 e2) env = (
     bir_eval_bin_pred pt (bir_eval_exp e1 env) (bir_eval_exp e2 env))) /\

  (bir_eval_exp (BExp_MemEq e1 e2) env = (
     bir_eval_memeq (bir_eval_exp e1 env) (bir_eval_exp e2 env))) /\


  (bir_eval_exp (BExp_IfThenElse c et ef) env =
     bir_eval_ifthenelse (bir_eval_exp c env) (bir_eval_exp et env) (bir_eval_exp ef env)
  ) /\

  (bir_eval_exp (BExp_Load mem_e a_e en ty) env =
     bir_eval_load (bir_eval_exp mem_e env) (bir_eval_exp a_e env) en ty) /\

  (bir_eval_exp (BExp_Store mem_e a_e en v_e) env =
     bir_eval_store (bir_eval_exp mem_e env) (bir_eval_exp a_e env) en (bir_eval_exp v_e env))

name: bir_unary_exp_REWRS
statement:
!uo.
  (!w. (bir_unary_exp uo (Imm1 w)   = Imm1   (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w))) /\
  (!w. (bir_unary_exp uo (Imm8 w)   = Imm8   (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w))) /\
  (!w. (bir_unary_exp uo (Imm16 w)  = Imm16  (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w))) /\
  (!w. (bir_unary_exp uo (Imm32 w)  = Imm32  (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w))) /\
  (!w. (bir_unary_exp uo (Imm64 w)  = Imm64  (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w))) /\
  (!w. (bir_unary_exp uo (Imm128 w) = Imm128 (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w)))

name: type_of_bir_unary_exp
statement: !uo r. type_of_bir_imm (bir_unary_exp uo r) = type_of_bir_imm r

name: bir_bin_exp_REWRS
statement:
!uo.
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_exp uo (Imm128 w1) (Imm128 w2) = Imm128 (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_exp uo (Imm64  w1) (Imm64  w2) = Imm64  (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_exp uo (Imm32  w1) (Imm32  w2) = Imm32  (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_exp uo (Imm16  w1) (Imm16  w2) = Imm16  (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_exp uo (Imm8   w1) (Imm8   w2) = Imm8   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_exp uo (Imm1   w1) (Imm1   w2) = Imm1   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!r1 r2. (type_of_bir_imm r1 <> type_of_bir_imm r2) ==>
           (bir_bin_exp uo r1 r2 = ARB))

name: type_of_bir_bin_exp
statement:
!oper_r r1 r2. (type_of_bir_imm r1 = type_of_bir_imm r2) ==>
    (type_of_bir_imm (bir_bin_exp oper_r r1 r2) = type_of_bir_imm r1)

name: bir_bin_pred_REWRS
statement:
!uo.
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_pred uo (Imm128 w1) (Imm128 w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_pred uo (Imm64  w1) (Imm64  w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_pred uo (Imm32  w1) (Imm32  w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_pred uo (Imm16  w1) (Imm16  w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_pred uo (Imm8   w1) (Imm8   w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!w1 w2. (bir_bin_pred uo (Imm1   w1) (Imm1   w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2))) /\
  (!r1 r2. (type_of_bir_imm r1 <> type_of_bir_imm r2) ==>
     (bir_bin_pred uo r1 r2 = F))

name: bir_bin_pred_Equal_REWR
statement: !b1 b2. (bir_bin_pred BIExp_Equal b1 b2) <=> (b1 = b2)

name: bir_bin_pred_NotEqual_REWR
statement:
!b1 b2. (bir_bin_pred BIExp_NotEqual b1 b2) <=>
          ((type_of_bir_imm b1 = type_of_bir_imm b2) /\ (b1 <> b2))

name: bir_cast_REWRS0_aux
statement:
!s1 s (w:'a word).
  (size_of_bir_immtype s1 = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
  (bir_cast (w2bs w s1) s = w2bs w s)

name: w2wh_id
statement: !w. w2wh (w : 'a word) = w

name: w2wh_w2w
statement:
!w.
  (dimindex (:'a) <= dimindex (:'b)) ==> ((w2wh (w : 'a word) : 'b word) = w2w w)

name: w2n_w2wh
statement:
!w:'a word.
    w2n ((w2wh w):'b word) =
    (DIV_2EXP (dimindex (:'a) - dimindex (:'b)) (w2n w))

name: bir_hcast_REWRS_aux
statement:
!s1 s2 (w:'a word).
  (size_of_bir_immtype s1 = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
  (size_of_bir_immtype s2 = dimindex (:'b)) ==>
  (bir_hcast (w2bs w s1) s2 = w2bs ((w2wh w):'b word) s2)

name: bir_scast_REWRS_aux
statement:
!s1 s2 (w:'a word).
  (size_of_bir_immtype s1 = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
  (size_of_bir_immtype s2 = dimindex (:'b)) ==>
  (bir_scast (w2bs w s1) s2 = w2bs (if (s1 = Bit1) then (w2w w) else (sw2sw w):'b word) s2)

name: type_of_bir_gencast
statement: !ct b s. type_of_bir_imm (bir_gencast ct b s) = s

name: bir_gencast_ID
statement: !ct b s. (type_of_bir_imm b = s) ==> ((bir_gencast ct b s) = b)

name: bir_casts_Bit1
statement:
!ct b c. (type_of_bir_imm b = Bit1) ==>
             (bir_gencast ct b c = bir_cast b c)

name: bir_HighestSetBit_def
statement: bir_HighestSetBit (w:'a word) = if w = 0w then -1 else w2i (word_log2 w)

name: bir_CountLeadingZeroBits_def
statement: bir_CountLeadingZeroBits (w:'a word) = Num (((&(word_len (0w:'a word))) - 1) - (bir_HighestSetBit w))

name: bir_CountLeadingSignBits_def
statement: bir_CountLeadingSignBits (w:'a word) = bir_CountLeadingZeroBits (word_xor (w >>> 1) (w && (word_1comp(word_ror (1w:'a word) 1)))) -1

name: bir_word_countleadingzeros_def
statement: bir_word_countleadingzeros (w:'a word) = (n2w (bir_CountLeadingZeroBits w) :'a word)

name: bir_word_countleadingsigns_def
statement: bir_word_countleadingsigns (w:'a word) = (n2w (bir_CountLeadingSignBits w) :'a word)

name: bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER_def
statement:
(bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_Not = word_1comp) /\
   (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_ChangeSign = word_2comp) /\
   (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_CLZ = bir_word_countleadingzeros) /\
   (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_CLS = bir_word_countleadingsigns)

name: bir_unary_exp_def
statement:
(bir_unary_exp uo (Imm128 w) = Imm128 (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w)) /\
  (bir_unary_exp uo (Imm64 w)  = Imm64 (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w)) /\
  (bir_unary_exp uo (Imm32 w)  = Imm32 (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w)) /\
  (bir_unary_exp uo (Imm16 w)  = Imm16 (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w)) /\
  (bir_unary_exp uo (Imm8 w)   = Imm8  (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w)) /\
  (bir_unary_exp uo (Imm1 w)   = Imm1  (bir_unary_exp_GET_OPER uo w))

name: bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER_def
statement:
(bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_And = word_and) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_Or = word_or) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_Xor = word_xor) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_Plus = $+) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_Minus = $-) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_Mult = $*) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_Div = $//) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_SignedDiv = $/) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_Mod =  word_mod) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_SignedMod = word_smod) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_LeftShift = word_lsl_bv) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_RightShift = word_lsr_bv) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER BIExp_SignedRightShift = word_asr_bv) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER _ = ARB)

name: bir_bin_exp_def
statement:
(bir_bin_exp uo (Imm128 w1) (Imm128 w2) = Imm128 (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_exp uo (Imm64  w1) (Imm64  w2) = Imm64  (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_exp uo (Imm32  w1) (Imm32  w2) = Imm32  (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_exp uo (Imm16  w1) (Imm16  w2) = Imm16  (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_exp uo (Imm8   w1) (Imm8   w2) = Imm8   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_exp uo (Imm1   w1) (Imm1   w2) = Imm1   (bir_bin_exp_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_exp uo _ _ = ARB)

name: bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER_def
statement:
(bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER BIExp_Equal = $=) /\
   (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER BIExp_NotEqual = $<>) /\
   (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER BIExp_LessThan = word_lo) /\
   (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER BIExp_SignedLessThan = word_lt) /\
   (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER BIExp_LessOrEqual = word_ls) /\
   (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER BIExp_SignedLessOrEqual = word_le)

name: bir_bin_pred_def
statement:
(bir_bin_pred uo (Imm128 w1) (Imm128 w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_pred uo (Imm64  w1) (Imm64  w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_pred uo (Imm32  w1) (Imm32  w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_pred uo (Imm16  w1) (Imm16  w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_pred uo (Imm8   w1) (Imm8   w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_pred uo (Imm1   w1) (Imm1   w2) = (bir_bin_pred_GET_OPER uo w1 w2)) /\
  (bir_bin_pred uo _ _ = F)

name: bir_cast_def
statement: bir_cast r s = n2bs (b2n r) s

name: bir_lcast_def
statement: bir_lcast = bir_cast

name: bir_hcast_def
statement:
bir_hcast r s =
  n2bs (DIV_2EXP ((size_of_bir_immtype (type_of_bir_imm r) - (size_of_bir_immtype s))) (b2n r)) s

name: w2wh_def
statement: w2wh (w : 'a word) = (word_extract (dimindex (:'a) - 1) (dimindex (:'a) - dimindex (:'b)) w) :'b word

name: bir_scast_def
statement:
bir_scast r s =
  n2bs (if (type_of_bir_imm r = Bit1) then (b2n r) else
     (SIGN_EXTEND (size_of_bir_immtype (type_of_bir_imm r))
                  (size_of_bir_immtype s) (b2n r))) s

name: bir_gencast_def
statement:
(bir_gencast BIExp_UnsignedCast = bir_cast) /\
  (bir_gencast BIExp_SignedCast = bir_scast) /\
  (bir_gencast BIExp_HighCast = bir_hcast) /\
  (bir_gencast BIExp_LowCast = bir_lcast)

name: bir_load_mmap_FUPDATE_THM
statement: !mmap a b x. bir_load_mmap (FUPDATE mmap (a,b)) x = if x = a then b else bir_load_mmap mmap x

name: fold_bir_endian_THM
statement: !P. (P BEnd_BigEndian /\ P BEnd_LittleEndian /\ P BEnd_NoEndian) <=> (!en. P en)

name: bir_number_of_mem_splits_NEQ_SOME0
statement: !vt rt at. bir_number_of_mem_splits vt rt at <> SOME 0

name: bir_number_of_mem_splits_EQ_SOME1
statement: !vt rt at. (bir_number_of_mem_splits vt rt at = SOME 1) <=> (vt = rt)

name: bir_number_of_mem_splits_ID
statement: !rt at. bir_number_of_mem_splits rt rt at = SOME 1

name: type_of_bir_mem_concat
statement: !vl ty. type_of_bir_imm (bir_mem_concat vl ty) = ty

name: bir_load_bitstring_from_mmap_w2v
statement:
!value_ty mmap a. (size_of_bir_immtype value_ty = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
      (bir_load_bitstring_from_mmap value_ty mmap a =
       (w2v ((n2w (bir_load_mmap mmap a)):'a word)))

name: bir_mem_addr_id
statement: !s a. a < 2 ** size_of_bir_immtype s ==> (bir_mem_addr s a = a)

name: bir_mem_addr_w2n
statement:
!s. (size_of_bir_immtype s = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
      !c. (bir_mem_addr s (w2n (c:'a word)) = w2n c)

name: bir_mem_addr_w2n_add
statement:
!s. (size_of_bir_immtype s = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
      !c n. (bir_mem_addr s (w2n (c:'a word) + n) = w2n (c + n2w n))

name: bir_load_from_mem_SINGLE
statement:
!en a vty aty mmap. bir_load_from_mem vty vty aty mmap en a =
    SOME (n2bs (bir_load_mmap mmap (bir_mem_addr aty a)) vty)

name: bir_load_from_mem_NO_ENDIAN
statement:
!a vty rty aty mmap. bir_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap BEnd_NoEndian a =
    (if vty = rty then
      SOME (n2bs (bir_load_mmap mmap (bir_mem_addr aty a)) vty)
     else NONE)

name: bir_load_from_mem_EQ_NONE
statement:
!a en vty rty aty mmap. (bir_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap en a = NONE) <=>
      ((bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty = NONE) \/
      ((vty <> rty) /\ (en = BEnd_NoEndian)))

name: bir_load_from_mem_EQ_NONE_IMP
statement:
!a en vty rty aty mmap.
      ((bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty = NONE) \/
      ((vty <> rty) /\ (en = BEnd_NoEndian))) ==>
      (bir_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap en a = NONE)

name: bir_load_from_mem_EQ_SOME
statement:
!a en vty rty aty mmap res. (bir_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap en a = SOME res) <=>
      (?n vs vs'. (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty = SOME n) /\
                  (vs = MAP (\n. bir_load_bitstring_from_mmap vty mmap (bir_mem_addr aty (a+n))) (COUNT_LIST n)) /\
                  ((en = BEnd_BigEndian) /\ (vs' = vs) \/
                   (en = BEnd_LittleEndian) /\ (vs' = REVERSE vs) \/
                   (en = BEnd_NoEndian) /\ (n = 1) /\ (vs' = vs)) /\
                   (res = bir_mem_concat vs' rty))

name: type_of_bir_load_from_mem
statement:
!a en vty rty aty mmap res. (bir_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap en a = SOME res) ==>
      (type_of_bir_imm res = rty)

name: bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs_THM
statement:
!vt rt at mmap mmap' en a.
      (!addr. addr IN (bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs vt rt at en a) ==>
              (bir_load_mmap mmap addr = bir_load_mmap mmap' addr)) ==>
      (bir_load_from_mem vt rt at mmap en a =
       bir_load_from_mem vt rt at mmap' en a)

name: bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs_FINITE
statement:
!tv tr ta en a.
      FINITE (bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs tv tr ta en a)

name: bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs_EMPTY
statement:
!mmap tv tr ta en a.
      (bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs tv tr ta en a = {}) <=>
      (bir_load_from_mem tv tr ta mmap en a = NONE)

name: bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs_NoEndian
statement:
!tv tr ta a.
      (bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs tv tr ta BEnd_NoEndian a = {}) \/
      (bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs tv tr ta BEnd_NoEndian a = {bir_mem_addr ta a})

name: bitstring_split_aux_REWR2
statement:
!n acc x xs.
  (bitstring_split_aux (SUC n) acc (x::xs) =
  (bitstring_split_aux (SUC n) ((TAKE (SUC n) (x::xs))::acc) (DROP (SUC n) (x::xs))))

name: bitstring_split_REWRS
statement:
(!n. n <> 0 ==> (bitstring_split n [] = [])) /\
    (!n bs. n <> 0 /\ bs <> [] ==> (bitstring_split n bs = (TAKE n bs) :: (bitstring_split n (DROP n bs))))

name: bitstring_split_REWRS_LENGTH
statement:
(!n bs. n <> 0 /\ (LENGTH bs = 0) ==> (bitstring_split n bs = [])) /\
    (!n bs. n <> 0 /\ 0 < LENGTH bs ==> (bitstring_split n bs = (TAKE n bs) :: (bitstring_split n (DROP n bs))))

name: bitstring_split_FLAT
statement: !n. n <> 0 ==> !bs. (FLAT (bitstring_split n bs) = bs)

name: bitstring_split_LENGTHS
statement:
!n m bs. n <> 0 /\ (LENGTH bs = m*n) ==> (
      (EVERY (\l. LENGTH l = n) (bitstring_split n bs)) /\
      (LENGTH (bitstring_split n bs) = m))

name: bitstring_split_LENGTHS_MODDIV
statement:
!n bs. n <> 0 /\ (LENGTH bs MOD n = 0) ==> (
      (EVERY (\l. LENGTH l = n) (bitstring_split n bs)) /\
      (LENGTH (bitstring_split n bs) = LENGTH bs DIV n))

name: bitstring_split_LENGTHS_b2v
statement:
!n v vty aty. (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty (type_of_bir_imm v) aty = SOME n) ==>
      (EVERY (\l. LENGTH l = (size_of_bir_immtype vty)) (bitstring_split (size_of_bir_immtype vty) (b2v v)) /\
      (LENGTH (bitstring_split (size_of_bir_immtype vty) (b2v v)) = n))

name: bitstring_split_SINGLE
statement:
!n bs. n <> 0 ==>
      (LENGTH bs = n) ==>
      (bitstring_split n bs = [bs])

name: bir_mem_concat_bitstring_split
statement:
!v n rty.
      (n <> 0) ==>
      (bir_mem_concat (bitstring_split n (b2v v)) rty = n2bs (b2n v) rty)

name: bir_update_mmap_UNCHANGED
statement:
!aty mmap a vs a'.
      (!n. n < LENGTH vs ==> (a' <> bir_mem_addr aty (a+n))) ==>
      (bir_load_mmap (bir_update_mmap aty mmap a vs) a' = bir_load_mmap mmap a')

name: bir_store_in_mem_SINGLE
statement:
!en a vty aty mmap v.
     (type_of_bir_imm v = vty) ==>
     (bir_store_in_mem vty aty v mmap en a = SOME (FUPDATE mmap ((bir_mem_addr aty a), b2n v)))

name: bir_store_in_mem_NO_ENDIAN
statement:
!a vty aty v mmap. bir_store_in_mem vty aty v mmap BEnd_NoEndian a =
    (if vty = (type_of_bir_imm v) then
      SOME (FUPDATE mmap ((bir_mem_addr aty a), b2n v))
     else NONE)

name: bir_store_in_mem_EQ_NONE
statement:
!a en vty aty v mmap. (bir_store_in_mem vty aty v mmap en a = NONE) <=>
      ((bir_number_of_mem_splits vty (type_of_bir_imm v) aty = NONE) \/
      ((vty <> (type_of_bir_imm v)) /\ (en = BEnd_NoEndian)))

name: bir_store_in_mem_EQ_NONE_IMP
statement:
!a en vty aty v mmap.
      ((bir_number_of_mem_splits vty (type_of_bir_imm v) aty = NONE) \/
       ((vty <> (type_of_bir_imm v)) /\ (en = BEnd_NoEndian))) ==>
      (bir_store_in_mem vty aty v mmap en a = NONE)

name: bir_store_in_mem_EQ_SOME
statement:
!a en vty aty v mmap res. (bir_store_in_mem vty aty v mmap en a = SOME res) <=>
      (?n vs vs'. (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty (type_of_bir_imm v) aty = SOME n) /\
                  (vs = (bitstring_split (size_of_bir_immtype vty) (b2v v))) /\
                  ((en = BEnd_BigEndian) /\ (vs' = vs) \/
                   (en = BEnd_LittleEndian) /\ (vs' = REVERSE vs) \/
                   (en = BEnd_NoEndian) /\ (n = 1) /\ (vs' = vs)) /\
                   (res = bir_update_mmap aty mmap a vs'))

name: bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs_THM
statement:
!a en vty aty v mmap mmap'.
       (bir_store_in_mem vty aty v mmap en a = SOME mmap') ==>
       (!addr. ~(addr IN bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs vty v aty en a) ==>
               (bir_load_mmap mmap' addr = bir_load_mmap mmap addr))

name: bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs_FINITE
statement:
!tv v ta en a.
      FINITE (bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs tv v ta en a)

name: bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs_EMPTY
statement:
!mmap tv v ta en a.
      (bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs tv v ta en a = {}) <=>
      (bir_store_in_mem tv ta v mmap en a = NONE)

name: bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs_NoEndian
statement:
!tv v ta a.
      (bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs tv v ta BEnd_NoEndian a = {}) \/
      (bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs tv v ta BEnd_NoEndian a = {bir_mem_addr ta a})

name: bir_load_bitstring_from_updated_mmap
statement:
!aty vty vs n mmap a. (
      (LENGTH vs = n) /\
      (!v. MEM v vs ==> (LENGTH v = (size_of_bir_immtype vty))) /\
      (n <= 2 ** (size_of_bir_immtype aty))) ==>
   (MAP (\n.
    bir_load_bitstring_from_mmap vty
             (bir_update_mmap aty mmap a vs)
             (bir_mem_addr aty (a + n))) (COUNT_LIST n) = vs)
