name: bir_store_load_mem_THM
statement:
!a en vty aty v mmap mmap'.
       (bir_store_in_mem vty aty v mmap en a = SOME mmap') ==>
       (bir_load_from_mem vty (type_of_bir_imm v) aty mmap' en a = SOME v)

name: bir_store_load_mem_disjoint_THM
statement:
!a en vty aty v mmap mmap' a' en' vty' aty' rty'.
       (DISJOINT (bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs vty v aty en a)
                 (bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs vty' aty' rty' en' a')) ==>
       (bir_store_in_mem vty aty v mmap en a = SOME mmap') ==>
       (bir_load_from_mem vty' aty' rty' mmap' en' a' =
        bir_load_from_mem vty' aty' rty' mmap en' a')

name: bir_load_mmap_def
statement:
bir_load_mmap (mmap: num |-> num) a =
      case FLOOKUP mmap a of
        | NONE => 0
        | SOME v => v

name: bir_number_of_mem_splits_def
statement:
bir_number_of_mem_splits
   (value_ty : bir_immtype_t) (result_ty : bir_immtype_t) (a_ty : bir_immtype_t) =
   if ((size_of_bir_immtype result_ty) MOD (size_of_bir_immtype value_ty) = 0) then
      (if ((size_of_bir_immtype result_ty) DIV (size_of_bir_immtype value_ty) <=
           2 ** (size_of_bir_immtype a_ty)) then
        SOME ((size_of_bir_immtype result_ty) DIV (size_of_bir_immtype value_ty))
       else NONE)
   else NONE

name: bir_mem_concat_def
statement: bir_mem_concat vl rty = v2bs (FLAT vl) rty

name: bir_load_bitstring_from_mmap_def
statement:
bir_load_bitstring_from_mmap value_ty mmap (a:num) =
    fixwidth (size_of_bir_immtype value_ty) (n2v (bir_load_mmap mmap a))

name: bir_mem_addr_def
statement: bir_mem_addr aty a = MOD_2EXP (size_of_bir_immtype aty) a

name: bir_load_from_mem_def
statement:
bir_load_from_mem
  (value_ty : bir_immtype_t) (result_ty : bir_immtype_t) (a_ty : bir_immtype_t) (mmap : num |-> num) (en: bir_endian_t) (a:num) =

   case (bir_number_of_mem_splits value_ty result_ty a_ty) of
    | NONE => NONE
    | SOME (n:num) => (
        let vs = MAP (\n. bir_load_bitstring_from_mmap value_ty mmap (bir_mem_addr a_ty (a+n))) (COUNT_LIST n) in
        let vs' = (case en of BEnd_LittleEndian => SOME (REVERSE vs)
                          |  BEnd_BigEndian => SOME vs
                          |  BEnd_NoEndian => if (n = 1) then SOME vs else NONE) in
        case vs' of NONE => NONE
                 |  SOME vs'' => SOME (bir_mem_concat vs'' result_ty)
   )

name: bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs_def
statement:
bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs tv tr ta en a =
   case (bir_number_of_mem_splits tv tr ta) of
    | NONE => {}
    | SOME (n:num) => (if (n <> 1) /\ (en = BEnd_NoEndian) then {} else
        set (MAP (\n. (bir_mem_addr ta (a + n))) (COUNT_LIST n)))

name: bitstring_split_def
statement: bitstring_split n bs = bitstring_split_aux n [] bs

name: bir_update_mmap_def
statement:
(bir_update_mmap aty mmap a [] = mmap) /\
  (bir_update_mmap aty mmap a (v::vs) =
                        bir_update_mmap aty (FUPDATE mmap ((bir_mem_addr aty a), v2n v)) (SUC a) vs)

name: bir_store_in_mem_def
statement:
bir_store_in_mem
  (value_ty : bir_immtype_t) (a_ty : bir_immtype_t) (result : bir_imm_t) (mmap : num |-> num) (en: bir_endian_t) (a:num) =

   let result_ty = type_of_bir_imm result in
   case (bir_number_of_mem_splits value_ty result_ty a_ty) of
    | NONE => NONE
    | SOME (n:num) => (
        let vs = bitstring_split (size_of_bir_immtype value_ty) (b2v result) in
        let vs' = (case en of BEnd_LittleEndian => SOME (REVERSE vs)
                          |  BEnd_BigEndian => SOME vs
                          |  BEnd_NoEndian => if (n = 1) then SOME vs else NONE) in

        case vs' of NONE => NONE
                 |  SOME vs'' => SOME (bir_update_mmap a_ty mmap a vs'')
   )

name: bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs_def
statement:
bir_store_in_mem_used_addrs vty v aty en a =
  bir_load_from_mem_used_addrs vty (type_of_bir_imm v) aty en a

name: bir_memeq_def
statement:
(bir_memeq aty vty mmap1 mmap2 = !a. (n2bs (bir_load_mmap mmap1 (bir_mem_addr aty a)) vty) =
                                       (n2bs (bir_load_mmap mmap2 (bir_mem_addr aty a)) vty))

name: fold_bir_immtype_THM
statement: !P. ((P Bit1 /\ P Bit8 /\ P Bit16 /\ P Bit32 /\ P Bit64 /\ P Bit128) <=> (!ty. P ty))

name: size_of_bir_immtype_INJ
statement: !b1 b2. (size_of_bir_immtype b1 = size_of_bir_immtype b2) <=> (b1 = b2)

name: size_of_bir_immtype_NEQ_0
statement: !b. size_of_bir_immtype b <> 0

name: size_of_bir_immtype_EQ_REWRS0
statement:
!ty n. is_valid_bir_immtype_size n ==>
           ((size_of_bir_immtype ty = n) <=> (ty = THE (bir_immtype_of_size n)))

name: is_valid_bir_immtype_size_IS_SOME
statement: !n. is_valid_bir_immtype_size n <=> IS_SOME (bir_immtype_of_size n)

name: bir_immtype_of_num_inv
statement:
(!brt. bir_immtype_of_size (size_of_bir_immtype brt) = SOME brt) /\
    (!n brt. (bir_immtype_of_size n = SOME brt) ==>
             (size_of_bir_immtype brt = n))

name: thm_none_aux
statement: !n. ~(is_valid_bir_immtype_size n) ==> (bir_immtype_of_size n = NONE)

name: b2n_n2bs
statement: !bt n. b2n (n2bs n bt) = MOD_2EXP (size_of_bir_immtype bt) n

name: b2n_n2b_fixed
statement:
(!n. b2n (n2b_1 n)  = n MOD 2) /\
    (!n. b2n (n2b_8 n)  = n MOD 2**8) /\
    (!n. b2n (n2b_16 n) = n MOD 2**16) /\
    (!n. b2n (n2b_32 n) = n MOD 2**32) /\
    (!n. b2n (n2b_64 n) = n MOD 2**64) /\
    (!n. b2n (n2b_128 n) = n MOD 2**128) /\
    (!n bt. b2n (n2bs n bt) = n MOD 2**(size_of_bir_immtype bt))

name: n2bs_b2n
statement: !b s. (s = type_of_bir_imm b) ==> (n2bs (b2n b) s = b)

name: w2n_lt_trans
statement: !w:'a word. dimword (:'a) <= m ==> (w2n w < m)

name: b2n_lt
statement: !b. b2n b < 2 ** (size_of_bir_immtype (type_of_bir_imm b))

name: b2n_MOD_2EXP
statement:
!i n. ((size_of_bir_immtype (type_of_bir_imm i)) = n) ==>
          (MOD_2EXP n (b2n i) = b2n i)

name: type_of_n2bs
statement: !s n. type_of_bir_imm (n2bs n s) = s

name: type_of_bir_imm_n2bs_INTRO
statement: !s b. (type_of_bir_imm b = s) <=> (?n. b = n2bs n s)

name: n2bs_MOD_size_of_bir_immtype
statement: !s n. n2bs (MOD_2EXP (size_of_bir_immtype s) n) s = n2bs n s

name: n2bs_CASE
statement:
!b. (?n. (n < 2 ** (size_of_bir_immtype (type_of_bir_imm b))) /\
             (b = n2bs n (type_of_bir_imm b)))

name: bir_immtype_t_LIST_THM
statement: !s. MEM s bir_immtype_t_LIST

name: bir_immtype_t_UNIV_SPEC
statement: (UNIV:bir_immtype_t set) = set bir_immtype_t_LIST

name: bir_immtype_t_FINITE_UNIV
statement: FINITE (UNIV : (bir_immtype_t set))

name: bir_imm_t_LIST_THM
statement: !i. MEM i bir_imm_t_LIST

name: bir_imm_t_UNIV_SPEC
statement: (UNIV:bir_imm_t set) = set bir_imm_t_LIST

name: bir_imm_t_FINITE_UNIV
statement: FINITE (UNIV : (bir_imm_t set))

name: b2w_REWRS
statement:
(!w. (b2w ( Imm1  w )  = w2w w)) /\
  (!w. (b2w ( Imm8  w )  = w2w w)) /\
  (!w. (b2w ( Imm16 w )  = w2w w)) /\
  (!w. (b2w ( Imm32 w )  = w2w w)) /\
  (!w. (b2w ( Imm64 w )  = w2w w)) /\
  (!w. (b2w ( Imm128 w ) = w2w w))

name: w2bs_REWRS
statement:
(!w. (w2bs w Bit1   = Imm1   (w2w w))) /\
  (!w. (w2bs w Bit8   = Imm8   (w2w w))) /\
  (!w. (w2bs w Bit16  = Imm16  (w2w w))) /\
  (!w. (w2bs w Bit32  = Imm32  (w2w w))) /\
  (!w. (w2bs w Bit64  = Imm64  (w2w w))) /\
  (!w. (w2bs w Bit128 = Imm128 (w2w w)))

name: w2bs_b2w
statement:
!b s. ((s = type_of_bir_imm b) /\ size_of_bir_immtype (type_of_bir_imm b) <= dimindex (:'a)) ==>
          (w2bs ((b2w b):'a word) s = b)

name: type_of_w2bs
statement: !s w. type_of_bir_imm (w2bs w s) = s

name: bool2b_inv
statement:
(!b. (b2bool (bool2b b) = b)) /\
    (!w. ((bool2b (b2bool (Imm1 w))) = Imm1 w))

name: type_of_bool2b
statement: !b. type_of_bir_imm (bool2b b) = Bit1

name: bool2w_11
statement: !b1 b2. (bool2w b1 = bool2w b2) <=> (b1 = b2)

name: bool2b_EQ_IMM1_ELIMS
statement:
(!b. (bool2b b = Imm1 1w) <=> b) /\
    (!b. (bool2b b = Imm1 0w) <=> ~b) /\
    (!b. (Imm1 1w = bool2b b) <=> b) /\
    (!b. (Imm1 0w = bool2b b) <=> ~b)

name: bool2b_NEQ_IMM_ELIMS_AUX
statement: (!i b. (type_of_bir_imm i <> Bit1) ==> (bool2b b <> i))

name: bool2b_11
statement: !b1 b2. (bool2b b1 = bool2b b2) <=> (b1 = b2)

name: b2v_LENGTH
statement:
!r. LENGTH (b2v r) = size_of_bir_immtype (
        type_of_bir_imm r)

name: v2n_w2v
statement: !w:'a word. (v2n (w2v w) = w2n w)

name: v2n_b2v
statement: !r. v2n (b2v r) = b2n r

name: type_of_v2bs
statement: !s v. type_of_bir_imm (v2bs v s) = s

name: v2w_fixwidth_imp
statement:
!v w. ((dimindex (:'a)) <= w) ==>
          ((v2w (fixwidth w v) = ((v2w v):'a word)))

name: v2bs_fixwidth
statement:
!v vty w. (size_of_bir_immtype vty <= w) ==>
            (v2bs (fixwidth w v) vty = v2bs v vty)

name: v2bs_n2v
statement: !n. v2bs (n2v n) = n2bs n

name: n2v_v2n
statement: !v n. (LENGTH v = n) ==> (fixwidth n (n2v (v2n v)) = v)

name: type_of_bir_imm_def
statement:
(type_of_bir_imm (Imm1  _)  = Bit1) /\
  (type_of_bir_imm (Imm8  _)  = Bit8) /\
  (type_of_bir_imm (Imm16 _)  = Bit16) /\
  (type_of_bir_imm (Imm32 _)  = Bit32) /\
  (type_of_bir_imm (Imm64 _)  = Bit64) /\
  (type_of_bir_imm (Imm128 _) = Bit128)

name: size_of_bir_immtype_def
statement:
(size_of_bir_immtype Bit1   = 1) /\
  (size_of_bir_immtype Bit8   = 8) /\
  (size_of_bir_immtype Bit16  = 16) /\
  (size_of_bir_immtype Bit32  = 32) /\
  (size_of_bir_immtype Bit64  = 64) /\
  (size_of_bir_immtype Bit128 = 128)

name: bir_immtype_of_size_def
statement:
bir_immtype_of_size n = (
         if n = 1   then SOME Bit1
    else if n = 8   then SOME Bit8
    else if n = 16  then SOME Bit16
    else if n = 32  then SOME Bit32
    else if n = 64  then SOME Bit64
    else if n = 128 then SOME Bit128
    else NONE)

name: is_valid_bir_immtype_size_def
statement: is_valid_bir_immtype_size n = ?b. n = size_of_bir_immtype b

name: b2n_def
statement:
(b2n ( Imm1   w ) = w2n w) /\
  (b2n ( Imm8   w ) = w2n w) /\
  (b2n ( Imm16  w ) = w2n w) /\
  (b2n ( Imm32  w ) = w2n w) /\
  (b2n ( Imm64  w ) = w2n w) /\
  (b2n ( Imm128 w ) = w2n w)

name: n2bs_def
statement:
(n2bs n Bit1   = Imm1   (n2w n)) /\
  (n2bs n Bit8   = Imm8   (n2w n)) /\
  (n2bs n Bit16  = Imm16  (n2w n)) /\
  (n2bs n Bit32  = Imm32  (n2w n)) /\
  (n2bs n Bit64  = Imm64  (n2w n)) /\
  (n2bs n Bit128 = Imm128 (n2w n))

name: n2b_1_def
statement: n2b_1  n  = n2bs n Bit1

name: n2b_8_def
statement: n2b_8  n  = n2bs n Bit8

name: n2b_16_def
statement: n2b_16 n  = n2bs n Bit16

name: n2b_32_def
statement: n2b_32 n  = n2bs n Bit32

name: n2b_64_def
statement: n2b_64 n  = n2bs n Bit64

name: n2b_128_def
statement: n2b_128 n = n2bs n Bit128

name: bir_immtype_t_LIST_def
statement: bir_immtype_t_LIST = ^(listSyntax.mk_list (TypeBase.constructors_of ``:bir_immtype_t``, ``:bir_immtype_t``))

name: bir_imm_t_LIST_def
statement:
bir_imm_t_LIST =
     FLAT (MAP (\s. MAP (\n. n2bs n s) (COUNT_LIST (2 ** size_of_bir_immtype s))) bir_immtype_t_LIST)

name: b2w_def
statement: b2w bi = n2w (b2n bi)

name: w2bs_def
statement: w2bs w s = n2bs (w2n w) s

name: b2bool_def
statement: b2bool bi = (b2n bi <> 0)

name: bool2w_def
statement: bool2w b = (if b then 1w else 0w):word1

name: bool2b_def
statement: bool2b b = Imm1 (bool2w b)

name: v2bs_def
statement: v2bs v s = n2bs (v2n v) s

name: b2v_def
statement:
(b2v ( Imm1   w ) = w2v w) /\
  (b2v ( Imm8   w ) = w2v w) /\
  (b2v ( Imm16  w ) = w2v w) /\
  (b2v ( Imm32  w ) = w2v w) /\
  (b2v ( Imm64  w ) = w2v w) /\
  (b2v ( Imm128 w ) = w2v w)

name: bir_state_restrict_vars_ALT_THM
statement:
!vs st.
    (bir_state_restrict_vars vs st).bst_environ = bir_env_restrict_vars vs st.bst_environ /\
    (bir_state_restrict_vars vs st).bst_pc = st.bst_pc /\
    (bir_state_restrict_vars vs st).bst_status = st.bst_status

name: bir_get_program_block_info_by_label_THM
statement:
(!p l. ((bir_get_program_block_info_by_label (BirProgram p) l = NONE) <=> (!bl. MEM bl p ==> (bl.bb_label <> l)))) /\

    (!p l i bl.
          (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label (BirProgram p) l = SOME (i, bl)) <=>
          ((((i:num) < LENGTH p) /\ (EL i p = bl) /\ (bl.bb_label = l) /\
             (!j'. j' < i ==> (EL j' p).bb_label <> l))))

name: bir_get_program_block_info_by_label_MEM
statement:
!p l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) <=>
          (?i bl. bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p l = SOME (i, bl))

name: bir_get_blocks_INV_thm
statement: !p. BirProgram (bir_get_blocks p) = p

name: bir_get_blocks_labels_length_thm
statement: !p. LENGTH (bir_labels_of_program p) = LENGTH (bir_get_blocks p)

name: bir_get_blocks_labels_EL_thm
statement:
!p i.
  (i < LENGTH (bir_get_blocks p)) ==>
  EL i (bir_labels_of_program p) = (EL i (bir_get_blocks p)).bb_label

name: bir_block_pc_11
statement: (bir_block_pc l1 = bir_block_pc l2) <=> (l1 = l2)

name: bir_state_is_terminated_IMP
statement:
(!st. (st.bst_status = BST_Running) ==> ~(bir_state_is_terminated st)) /\
    (!st. (st.bst_status <> BST_Running) ==> (bir_state_is_terminated st))

name: bir_exec_stmt_observe_state_THM
statement: !oid ec el obf st. SND (bir_exec_stmt_observe oid ec el obf st) = bir_exec_stmt_observe_state ec el st

name: bir_exec_stmtB_exists
statement:
!h st.
      ?obs' st'.
        bir_exec_stmtB h st = (obs', st')

name: bir_exec_stmtB_state_REWRS
statement:
(!ex st. (bir_exec_stmtB_state (BStmt_Assert ex) st = (bir_exec_stmt_assert ex st))) /\
  (!ex st. (bir_exec_stmtB_state (BStmt_Assume ex) st = (bir_exec_stmt_assume ex st))) /\
  (!v ex st. (bir_exec_stmtB_state (BStmt_Assign v ex) st = (bir_exec_stmt_assign v ex st))) /\
  (!oid ec el obf st. (bir_exec_stmtB_state (BStmt_Observe oid ec el obf) st = bir_exec_stmt_observe_state ec el st))

name: bir_exec_stmt_state_REWRS
statement:
(!p bst st. (bir_exec_stmt_state p (BStmtB bst) st =
     let st' = bir_exec_stmtB_state bst st in
     if (bir_state_is_terminated st') then st' else (st' with bst_pc updated_by bir_pc_next))) /\
  (!p est st. (bir_exec_stmt_state p (BStmtE est) st = bir_exec_stmtE p est st))

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_REWRS
statement:
(!p st. (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st 0 = st)) /\
  (!p st n. (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st (SUC n) =
     (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p (bir_exec_step_state p st) n)))

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_0
statement: !p st. bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (SOME 0) = [||]

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_NEQ_SOME0
statement:
!p st no. (no <> SOME 0) ==> (
        bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st no =
            (let (fe, st') = bir_exec_step p st in
             let ll' = bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st' (OPT_NUM_PRE no) in
             (OPT_LCONS fe ll')))

name: IS_BER_Ended_EXISTS
statement:
!ber. IS_BER_Ended ber <=> (?ol step_count pc_count final_st.
        ber = BER_Ended ol step_count pc_count final_st)

name: bir_state_restrict_vars_def
statement:
bir_state_restrict_vars vs st =
  st with bst_environ updated_by (bir_env_restrict_vars vs)

name: bir_labels_of_program_def
statement:
bir_labels_of_program (BirProgram p) =
  MAP (\bl. bl.bb_label) p

name: bir_get_program_block_info_by_label_def
statement:
bir_get_program_block_info_by_label
  (BirProgram p) l = INDEX_FIND 0 (\(x:'a bir_block_t). x.bb_label = l) p

name: bir_get_blocks_def
statement: bir_get_blocks (BirProgram p) = p

name: bir_get_current_statement_def
statement:
bir_get_current_statement p pc =
  option_CASE (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p pc.bpc_label) NONE
     (\ (_, bl). if (pc.bpc_index < LENGTH bl.bb_statements) then SOME (BStmtB (EL (pc.bpc_index) bl.bb_statements)) else (if pc.bpc_index = LENGTH bl.bb_statements then SOME (BStmtE bl.bb_last_statement) else NONE))

name: bir_pc_next_def
statement: bir_pc_next pc = pc with bpc_index updated_by SUC

name: bir_block_pc_def
statement: bir_block_pc l = <| bpc_label := l; bpc_index := 0 |>

name: bir_pc_first_def
statement: bir_pc_first (BirProgram p) = bir_block_pc (HD p).bb_label

name: bir_state_is_terminated_def
statement:
bir_state_is_terminated st =
  (st.bst_status <> BST_Running)

name: bir_state_set_typeerror_def
statement:
bir_state_set_typeerror st =
  (st with bst_status := BST_TypeError)

name: bir_state_set_failed_def
statement:
bir_state_set_failed st =
  (st with bst_status := BST_Failed)

name: bir_state_init_def
statement:
bir_state_init p = <|
    bst_pc       := bir_pc_first p
  ; bst_environ  := bir_env_default (bir_envty_of_vs {}) 
  ; bst_status := BST_Running
|>

name: bir_exec_stmt_assign_def
statement:
bir_exec_stmt_assign v ex (st : bir_state_t) =
   case bir_eval_exp ex st.bst_environ of
     | SOME va => (case bir_env_write v va st.bst_environ of
                     | SOME env => (st with bst_environ := env)
                     | NONE => bir_state_set_typeerror st
                  )
     | NONE => bir_state_set_typeerror st

name: bir_exec_stmt_assert_def
statement:
bir_exec_stmt_assert ex (st : bir_state_t) =
  case (option_CASE (bir_eval_exp ex st.bst_environ) NONE bir_dest_bool_val) of
    | SOME T => st
    | SOME F => (st with bst_status := BST_AssertionViolated)
    | NONE => bir_state_set_typeerror st

name: bir_exec_stmt_assume_def
statement:
bir_exec_stmt_assume ex (st : bir_state_t) =
  case (option_CASE (bir_eval_exp ex st.bst_environ) NONE bir_dest_bool_val) of
    | SOME T => st
    | SOME F => (st with bst_status := BST_AssumptionViolated)
    | NONE => bir_state_set_typeerror st

name: bir_exec_stmt_observe_def
statement:
bir_exec_stmt_observe oid ec el obf (st : bir_state_t) =
  let
    vol = MAP (\e. bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ) el;
    vobc = option_CASE (bir_eval_exp ec st.bst_environ) NONE bir_dest_bool_val
  in
  case vobc of
    | SOME T =>   if EXISTS IS_NONE vol then
                    (NONE, bir_state_set_typeerror st)
                  else
                    (SOME (oid, obf (MAP THE vol)), st)
    | SOME F =>   if EXISTS IS_NONE vol then
                    (NONE, bir_state_set_typeerror st)
                  else
                    (NONE, st)
    | NONE => (NONE, bir_state_set_typeerror st)

name: bir_exec_stmt_observe_state_def
statement:
bir_exec_stmt_observe_state ec el (st : bir_state_t) =
  let
    vol = MAP (\e. bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ) el;
    vobc = option_CASE (bir_eval_exp ec st.bst_environ) NONE bir_dest_bool_val
  in
  case vobc of
    | SOME _ =>   if EXISTS IS_NONE vol then
                    bir_state_set_typeerror st
                  else
                    st
    | NONE => bir_state_set_typeerror st

name: bir_exec_stmtB_def
statement:
(bir_exec_stmtB (BStmt_Assert ex) st = (NONE, bir_exec_stmt_assert ex st)) /\
  (bir_exec_stmtB (BStmt_Assume ex) st = (NONE, bir_exec_stmt_assume ex st)) /\
  (bir_exec_stmtB (BStmt_Assign v ex) st = (NONE, bir_exec_stmt_assign v ex st)) /\
  (bir_exec_stmtB (BStmt_Observe oid ec el obf) st = bir_exec_stmt_observe oid ec el obf st)

name: bir_exec_stmtB_state_def
statement:
bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st =
  SND (bir_exec_stmtB stmt st)

name: bir_exec_stmt_halt_def
statement:
bir_exec_stmt_halt ex (st : bir_state_t) =
  case bir_eval_exp ex st.bst_environ of
    | NONE => bir_state_set_typeerror st
    | SOME v => st with bst_status := BST_Halted v

name: bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label_def
statement:
bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p
   (l : bir_label_t) (st : bir_state_t) =
    if (MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p)) then
      st with bst_pc := bir_block_pc l
    else (st with bst_status := (BST_JumpOutside l))

name: bir_eval_label_exp_def
statement:
(bir_eval_label_exp (BLE_Label l) env = SOME l) /\
   (bir_eval_label_exp (BLE_Exp e) env = case bir_eval_exp e env of
      | SOME (BVal_Imm i) => SOME (BL_Address i)
      | _ => NONE
   )

name: bir_exec_stmt_jmp_def
statement:
bir_exec_stmt_jmp p le (st : bir_state_t) =
    case bir_eval_label_exp le st.bst_environ of
      | NONE => bir_state_set_typeerror st
      | SOME l => bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p l st

name: bir_exec_stmt_cjmp_def
statement:
bir_exec_stmt_cjmp p ec l1 l2 (st : bir_state_t) =
  let
    vobc = option_CASE (bir_eval_exp ec st.bst_environ) NONE bir_dest_bool_val
  in
  case vobc of
    | SOME T => bir_exec_stmt_jmp p l1 st
    | SOME F => bir_exec_stmt_jmp p l2 st
    | NONE => bir_state_set_typeerror st

name: bir_exec_stmtE_def
statement:
(bir_exec_stmtE p (BStmt_Jmp l) st = bir_exec_stmt_jmp p l st) /\
  (bir_exec_stmtE p (BStmt_CJmp e l1 l2) st = bir_exec_stmt_cjmp p e l1 l2 st) /\
  (bir_exec_stmtE p (BStmt_Halt ex) st = bir_exec_stmt_halt ex st)

name: bir_exec_stmt_def
statement:
(bir_exec_stmt (p:'a bir_program_t) (BStmtB (bst:'a bir_stmt_basic_t)) st =
     let (oo, st') = bir_exec_stmtB bst st in
     if (bir_state_is_terminated st') then (oo, st') else (oo, st' with bst_pc updated_by bir_pc_next)) /\
  (bir_exec_stmt p (BStmtE bst) st = (NONE, bir_exec_stmtE p bst st))

name: bir_exec_stmt_state_def
statement: bir_exec_stmt_state p stmt state = SND (bir_exec_stmt p stmt state)

name: bir_exec_step_def
statement:
bir_exec_step p state =
  if (bir_state_is_terminated state) then (NONE, state) else
  case (bir_get_current_statement p state.bst_pc) of
    | NONE => (NONE, bir_state_set_failed state)
    | SOME stm => (bir_exec_stmt p stm state)

name: bir_exec_step_state_def
statement: bir_exec_step_state p state = SND (bir_exec_step p state)

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_def
statement: (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n = FUNPOW (bir_exec_step_state p) n st)

name: bir_state_COUNT_PC_def
statement:
bir_state_COUNT_PC (count_failing:bool, pc_cond) st =
  case st.bst_status of
    | BST_JumpOutside l => pc_cond (bir_block_pc l)
    | BST_Running => pc_cond st.bst_pc
    | _ => count_failing

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_def
statement:
(bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st 0 = 0) /\
   (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st (SUC n) =
    let r = bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p
               (bir_exec_step_state p st) n in
    if (bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond (bir_exec_step_state p st)) then SUC r else r)

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS_def
statement:
bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond max_steps_opt p st = (OLEAST i.
     bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st i) \/
     (max_steps_opt = SOME (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st i))
)

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_def
statement:
bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st step_no = (
     LMAP THE (LFILTER IS_SOME (LGENLIST
        (\i. FST (bir_exec_step p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st i))) step_no)))

name: IS_BER_Ended_def
statement:
(IS_BER_Ended (BER_Ended _ _ _ _) = T) /\
   (IS_BER_Ended (BER_Looping _) = F)

name: valOf_BER_Ended_def
statement:
valOf_BER_Ended (BER_Ended ol step_count pc_count final_st) =
  (ol, step_count, pc_count, final_st)

name: valOf_BER_Ended_steps_def
statement:
valOf_BER_Ended_steps (BER_Ended ol step_count pc_count final_st) =
  (ol, step_count, final_st)

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_def
statement:
bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p state max_steps_opt =
  let step_no = bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond max_steps_opt p state in
  let ll = bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p state step_no in
  (case step_no of
    | NONE => BER_Looping ll
    | SOME i => BER_Ended (THE (toList ll)) i
                (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i)
                (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state i))

name: bir_exec_steps_def
statement: (bir_exec_steps p state = bir_exec_steps_GEN (T, (\_. T)) p state NONE)

name: bir_exec_step_n_def
statement:
bir_exec_step_n p state n =
  valOf_BER_Ended_steps (bir_exec_steps_GEN (T, (\_. T)) p state (SOME n))

name: bir_exec_block_n_def
statement:
bir_exec_block_n p state n =
  valOf_BER_Ended (bir_exec_steps_GEN (F, (\pc. pc.bpc_index = 0)) p state (SOME n))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_def
statement:
bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p state n =
  bir_exec_steps_GEN (F, \pc. (pc.bpc_index = 0) /\ (pc.bpc_label IN ls)) p state (SOME n)

name: bir_exec_to_labels_def
statement: bir_exec_to_labels ls p state = bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p state 1

name: type_of_bir_exp_THM
statement:
!env e ty. (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty) ==>
              ((bir_eval_exp e env = NONE) \/ (?v. (bir_eval_exp e env = SOME v) /\ (type_of_bir_val v = ty)))

name: type_of_bir_exp_EQ_SOME_REWRS
statement:
(!i ty. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Const i) = SOME ty) <=> (ty = BType_Imm (type_of_bir_imm i))) /\

  (!aty vty mmap ty. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) = SOME ty) <=> (ty = BType_Mem aty vty)) /\

  (!v ty. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Den v) = SOME ty) <=> (ty = bir_var_type v)) /\

  (!ct e ty ty'. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Cast ct e ty') = SOME ty) <=> (
     (ty = BType_Imm ty') /\ (?it. (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm it))))) /\

  (!et e ty. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_UnaryExp et e) = SOME ty) <=> (
     (bir_type_is_Imm ty) /\ (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty))) /\

  (!et e1 e2 ty. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) = SOME ty) <=> (
     (bir_type_is_Imm ty) /\ (type_of_bir_exp e1 = SOME ty) /\ (type_of_bir_exp e2 = SOME ty))) /\

  (!pt e1 e2 ty. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_BinPred pt e1 e2) = SOME ty) <=> (
     (ty = BType_Bool) /\ (?it. (type_of_bir_exp e1 = SOME (BType_Imm it)) /\
                              (type_of_bir_exp e2 = SOME (BType_Imm it))))) /\

  (!me1 me2 ty. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_MemEq me1 me2) = SOME ty) <=> (
     ?at vt. (ty = BType_Bool) /\ (type_of_bir_exp me1 = SOME (BType_Mem at vt)) /\ (type_of_bir_exp me2 = type_of_bir_exp me1))) /\

  (!ce e1 e2 ty. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_IfThenElse ce e1 e2) = SOME ty) <=> (
     (type_of_bir_exp ce = SOME BType_Bool) /\
     (type_of_bir_exp e1 = SOME ty) /\
     (type_of_bir_exp e2 = SOME ty))) /\

  (!rty ty ae en me. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Load me ae en rty) = SOME ty) <=> (
     (ty = BType_Imm rty) /\ (?at vt. (type_of_bir_exp me = SOME (BType_Mem at vt)) /\
                            (type_of_bir_exp ae = SOME (BType_Imm at)) /\
                            (if en = BEnd_NoEndian then (vt = rty) else
                                  (bir_number_of_mem_splits vt rty at <> NONE))))) /\

  (!ty ae en me v. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Store me ae en v) = SOME ty) <=> (
     ?at vt rty. (ty = BType_Mem at vt) /\
             (type_of_bir_exp me = SOME (BType_Mem at vt)) /\
             (type_of_bir_exp ae = SOME (BType_Imm at)) /\
             (type_of_bir_exp v = SOME (BType_Imm rty)) /\
             (if en = BEnd_NoEndian then (vt = rty) else
                                  (bir_number_of_mem_splits vt rty at <> NONE))))

name: bir_eval_exp_IS_SOME_IMPLIES_TYPE
statement:
!env e va ty.
    (bir_eval_exp e env = SOME va) ==>
    (type_of_bir_val va = ty) ==>
    (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty)

name: type_of_bir_exp_EQ_NONE_REWRS
statement:
(!i. ~(type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Const i) = NONE)) /\

  (!aty vty mmap. ~(type_of_bir_exp (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) = NONE)) /\

  (!v. ~(type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Den v) = NONE)) /\

  (!ct e ty ty'. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Cast ct e ty') = NONE) <=> (
     (!ity. (type_of_bir_exp e <> SOME (BType_Imm ity))))) /\

  (!et e. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_UnaryExp et e) = NONE) <=> (
     (!ity. type_of_bir_exp e <> SOME (BType_Imm ity)))) /\

  (!et e1 e2. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) = NONE) <=> !ity.
     (type_of_bir_exp e1 <> SOME (BType_Imm ity)) \/
     (type_of_bir_exp e2 <> SOME (BType_Imm ity))) /\

  (!pt e1 e2. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_BinPred pt e1 e2) = NONE) <=> !ity.
     (type_of_bir_exp e1 <> SOME (BType_Imm ity)) \/
     (type_of_bir_exp e2 <> SOME (BType_Imm ity))) /\

  (!me1 me2. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_MemEq me1 me2) = NONE) <=> !at vt.
     (type_of_bir_exp me1 <> SOME (BType_Mem at vt)) \/
     (type_of_bir_exp me2 <> SOME (BType_Mem at vt))) /\

  (!ce e1 e2 ty. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_IfThenElse ce e1 e2) = NONE) <=> (
     (type_of_bir_exp ce <> SOME BType_Bool) \/
     (type_of_bir_exp e1 = NONE) \/
     (type_of_bir_exp e2 <> type_of_bir_exp e1))) /\

  (!rty ty ae en me. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Load me ae en rty) = NONE) <=> (
     (!at vt. (type_of_bir_exp me = SOME (BType_Mem at vt)) /\
              (type_of_bir_exp ae = SOME (BType_Imm at)) ==>
              (if en = BEnd_NoEndian then (vt <> rty) else
                   (bir_number_of_mem_splits vt rty at = NONE))))) /\

  (!ty ae en me v. (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Store me ae en v) = NONE) <=> (
     !at vt rty.
             (type_of_bir_exp me = SOME (BType_Mem at vt)) /\
             (type_of_bir_exp ae = SOME (BType_Imm at)) /\
             (type_of_bir_exp v = SOME (BType_Imm rty)) ==>
             (if en = BEnd_NoEndian then (vt <> rty) else
                                  (bir_number_of_mem_splits vt rty at = NONE))))

name: type_of_bir_exp_NOT_SOME_Imm
statement:
!ex env. 
    (!ity. type_of_bir_exp ex <> SOME (BType_Imm ity)) ==>
    (?aty vty. (type_of_bir_exp ex = SOME (BType_Mem aty vty)) \/
     (type_of_bir_exp ex = NONE)
    )

name: type_of_2bir_exp_NOT_SOME_Imm
statement:
!ex ex'. 
    (!ity.
     type_of_bir_exp ex <> SOME (BType_Imm ity) \/
     type_of_bir_exp ex' <> SOME (BType_Imm ity)) ==>
    ((?aty vty. type_of_bir_exp ex = SOME (BType_Mem aty vty)) \/
     (type_of_bir_exp ex = NONE) \/
     (?aty vty. type_of_bir_exp ex' = SOME (BType_Mem aty vty)) \/
     (type_of_bir_exp ex' = NONE) \/
     (?ity' ity''.
      (type_of_bir_exp ex = SOME (BType_Imm ity')) /\
      (type_of_bir_exp ex' = SOME (BType_Imm ity'')) /\
      (ity' <> ity'')
     )
    )

name: bir_type_of_bir_exp_NONE
statement:
!ex env.
    (type_of_bir_exp ex = NONE) ==>
    (bir_eval_exp ex env = NONE)

name: bir_vars_of_exp_THM
statement:
!env1 env2 e. (!v. v IN (bir_vars_of_exp e) ==>
                     (bir_env_read v env1 = bir_env_read v env2)) ==>
                (bir_eval_exp e env1 = bir_eval_exp e env2)

name: bir_vars_of_exp_THM_EQ_FOR_VARS
statement:
!env1 env2 e. (bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS (bir_vars_of_exp e) env1 env2) ==>
                (bir_eval_exp e env1 = bir_eval_exp e env2)

name: bir_vars_of_exp_FINITE
statement: !e. FINITE (bir_vars_of_exp e)

name: type_of_bir_exp_THM_with_envty
statement:
!env envty e ty. (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty) ==>
                     (bir_envty_includes_vs envty (bir_vars_of_exp e)) ==>
                     (bir_env_satisfies_envty env envty) ==>
                     (?v. ((bir_eval_exp e env) = SOME v) /\ (type_of_bir_val v = ty))

name: type_of_bir_exp_THM_with_init_vars
statement:
!env e ty. (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty) ==>
               (bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e)) ==>
               (?va. (bir_eval_exp e env = SOME va) /\ (type_of_bir_val va = ty))

name: bir_eval_exp_IS_SOME_IMPLIES_INIT
statement:
!env e va.
    (bir_eval_exp e env = SOME va) ==>
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e)

name: type_of_bir_exp_def
statement:
(type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Const i) = SOME (BType_Imm (type_of_bir_imm i))) /\

  (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) = SOME (BType_Mem aty vty)) /\

  (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Den v) = SOME (bir_var_type v)) /\

  (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Cast ct e rty) = (case (type_of_bir_exp e) of
      NONE => NONE
    | SOME ty => (if (bir_type_is_Imm ty) then SOME (BType_Imm rty) else NONE))) /\

  (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_UnaryExp et e) = (case (type_of_bir_exp e) of
      NONE => NONE
    | SOME ty => (if (bir_type_is_Imm ty) then
        SOME ty else NONE))) /\

  (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) = (case (type_of_bir_exp e1,
       type_of_bir_exp e2) of
       (SOME ty1, SOME ty2) => (if ((bir_type_is_Imm ty1) /\ (ty2 = ty1)) then SOME ty1 else NONE)
       | _, _ => NONE)) /\

  (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_BinPred pt e1 e2) = (case (type_of_bir_exp e1,
       type_of_bir_exp e2) of
       (SOME ty1, SOME ty2) => (if ((bir_type_is_Imm ty1) /\ (ty2 = ty1)) then SOME BType_Bool else NONE)
       | _, _ => NONE)) /\

  (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_MemEq e1 e2) = (case (type_of_bir_exp e1,
       type_of_bir_exp e2) of
       (SOME (BType_Mem aty1 vty1), SOME (BType_Mem aty2 vty2)) => (if ((aty2 = aty1) /\ (vty2 = vty1)) then SOME BType_Bool else NONE)
       | _, _ => NONE)) /\


  (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_IfThenElse ec e1 e2) = (case (type_of_bir_exp ec, type_of_bir_exp e1,
       type_of_bir_exp e2) of
       (SOME ect, SOME ty1, SOME ty2) => (if ((ect = BType_Bool) /\ (ty2 = ty1)) then SOME ty1 else NONE)
       | _, _, _ => NONE)) /\

  (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Load me ae en rty) = (case (type_of_bir_exp me, type_of_bir_exp ae) of
       (SOME (BType_Mem aty vty), SOME (BType_Imm aty')) => (if (
            (aty = aty') /\ (if en = BEnd_NoEndian then (vty = rty) else (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty <> NONE))
           ) then SOME (BType_Imm rty) else NONE)
       | _, _ => NONE)) /\

  (type_of_bir_exp (BExp_Store me ae en v) = (case (type_of_bir_exp me, type_of_bir_exp ae, type_of_bir_exp v) of
       (SOME (BType_Mem aty vty), SOME (BType_Imm aty'), SOME (BType_Imm rty)) => (if (
            (aty = aty') /\ (if en = BEnd_NoEndian then (vty = rty) else (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty <> NONE))
           ) then SOME (BType_Mem aty vty) else NONE)
       | _, _, _ => NONE))

name: bir_vars_of_exp_def
statement:
(bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_Const _) = {}) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_MemConst _ _ _) = {}) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_Den v) = {v}) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_Cast _ e _) = bir_vars_of_exp e) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_UnaryExp _ e) = bir_vars_of_exp e) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_BinExp _ e1 e2) = (bir_vars_of_exp e1 UNION bir_vars_of_exp e2)) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_BinPred _ e1 e2) = (bir_vars_of_exp e1 UNION bir_vars_of_exp e2)) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_MemEq e1 e2) = (bir_vars_of_exp e1 UNION bir_vars_of_exp e2)) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_IfThenElse ec e1 e2) = (bir_vars_of_exp ec UNION bir_vars_of_exp e1 UNION bir_vars_of_exp e2)) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_Load me ae _ _) = (bir_vars_of_exp me UNION bir_vars_of_exp ae)) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_Store me ae _ ve) = (bir_vars_of_exp me UNION bir_vars_of_exp ae UNION bir_vars_of_exp ve))

name: bir_exp_is_well_typed_def
statement:
bir_exp_is_well_typed e <=>
  (IS_SOME (type_of_bir_exp e) /\
   bir_vs_consistent (bir_vars_of_exp e))

name: bir_get_current_statement_stmts_of_prog
statement:
!p pc stmt. (bir_get_current_statement p pc = SOME stmt) ==>
                stmt IN (bir_stmts_of_prog p)

name: bir_is_well_typed_block_ALT_DEF
statement:
!bl. bir_is_well_typed_block bl <=>
    (!stmt. stmt IN bir_stmts_of_block bl ==> bir_is_well_typed_stmt stmt)

name: bir_is_well_typed_program_ALT_DEF
statement:
!p. bir_is_well_typed_program p <=>
    (!stmt. stmt IN bir_stmts_of_prog p ==> bir_is_well_typed_stmt stmt)

name: bir_get_current_statement_well_typed
statement:
!p pc stmt. (bir_is_well_typed_program p /\
                (bir_get_current_statement p pc = SOME stmt)) ==>
                bir_is_well_typed_stmt stmt

name: bir_vars_of_block_ALT_DEF
statement: !bl. bir_vars_of_block bl = BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_stmt (bir_stmts_of_block bl))

name: bir_vars_of_program_ALT_DEF
statement:
!p. bir_vars_of_program p =
        BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_stmt (bir_stmts_of_prog p))

name: bir_vars_of_block_ALT_thm
statement:
!bl.
  (bir_vars_of_block bl = flat_setlist (bir_vars_of_block_as_setlist bl))

name: bir_vars_of_block_ALT_IMAGE_set_thm
statement:
!l.
  (IMAGE bir_vars_of_block (set l) = IMAGE (flat_setlist o bir_vars_of_block_as_setlist) (set l))

name: bir_vars_of_program_ALT_thm
statement:
!p.
  (bir_vars_of_program p = bir_vars_of_program_as_setlist p)

name: bir_get_current_statement_vars_of
statement:
!p pc stmt. (bir_get_current_statement p pc = SOME stmt) ==>
                bir_vars_of_stmt stmt SUBSET bir_vars_of_program p

name: bir_vars_of_label_exp_THM_EQ_FOR_VARS
statement:
!env1 env2 e. (bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS (bir_vars_of_label_exp e) env1 env2) ==>
                (bir_eval_label_exp e env1 = bir_eval_label_exp e env2)

name: bir_changed_vars_of_stmtB_SUBST_all_vars
statement: !stmt. bir_changed_vars_of_stmtB stmt SUBSET bir_vars_of_stmtB stmt

name: bir_changed_vars_of_stmt_SUBST_all_vars
statement: !stmt. bir_changed_vars_of_stmt stmt SUBSET bir_vars_of_stmt stmt

name: bir_changed_vars_of_block_SUBST_all_vars
statement: !bl. bir_changed_vars_of_block bl SUBSET bir_vars_of_block bl

name: bir_changed_vars_of_program_SUBST_all_vars
statement: !p. bir_changed_vars_of_program p SUBSET bir_vars_of_program p

name: bir_changed_vars_of_block_ALT_DEF
statement: !bl. bir_changed_vars_of_block bl = BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_changed_vars_of_stmt (bir_stmts_of_block bl))

name: bir_changed_vars_of_program_ALT_DEF
statement:
!p. bir_changed_vars_of_program p =
        BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_changed_vars_of_stmt (bir_stmts_of_prog p))

name: bir_get_current_statement_changed_vars_of
statement:
!p pc stmt. (bir_get_current_statement p pc = SOME stmt) ==>
                bir_changed_vars_of_stmt stmt SUBSET bir_changed_vars_of_program p

name: bir_exps_of_block_ALT_DEF
statement: !bl. bir_exps_of_block bl = BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_exps_of_stmt (bir_stmts_of_block bl))

name: bir_exps_of_program_ALT_DEF
statement:
!p. bir_exps_of_program p =
        BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_exps_of_stmt (bir_stmts_of_prog p))

name: bir_get_current_statement_exps_of
statement:
!p pc stmt. (bir_get_current_statement p pc = SOME stmt) ==>
                bir_exps_of_stmt stmt SUBSET bir_exps_of_program p

name: bir_exp_vars_of_stmtB
statement:
!stmt. BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_exp (bir_exps_of_stmtB stmt)) SUBSET
         bir_vars_of_stmtB stmt

name: bir_exp_vars_of_label_exp
statement:
!le. bir_vars_of_label_exp le =
       BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_exp (bir_exps_of_label_exp le))

name: bir_exp_vars_of_stmtE
statement:
!stmt. bir_vars_of_stmtE stmt =
         BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_exp (bir_exps_of_stmtE stmt))

name: bir_exp_vars_of_stmt
statement:
!stmt. BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_exp (bir_exps_of_stmt stmt)) SUBSET
         bir_vars_of_stmt stmt

name: bir_exp_vars_of_block
statement:
!bl. BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_exp (bir_exps_of_block bl)) SUBSET
       bir_vars_of_block bl

name: bir_exp_vars_of_program
statement:
!p. BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_exp (bir_exps_of_program p)) SUBSET
       bir_vars_of_program p

name: bir_stmts_of_block_def
statement:
bir_stmts_of_block bl =
  (BStmtE (bl.bb_last_statement) INSERT (IMAGE BStmtB (set bl.bb_statements)))

name: bir_stmts_of_prog_def
statement:
bir_stmts_of_prog (BirProgram p) =
  BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_stmts_of_block (set p))

name: bir_is_well_typed_label_exp_def
statement:
(bir_is_well_typed_label_exp (BLE_Label _) = T) /\
  (bir_is_well_typed_label_exp (BLE_Exp e) = (case (type_of_bir_exp e) of
      NONE => F
    | SOME ty => (bir_type_is_Imm ty)))

name: bir_is_well_typed_stmtE_def
statement:
(bir_is_well_typed_stmtE (BStmt_Jmp le) = bir_is_well_typed_label_exp le) /\
  (bir_is_well_typed_stmtE (BStmt_CJmp c le1 le2) =
       ((type_of_bir_exp c = SOME BType_Bool) /\
       (bir_is_well_typed_label_exp le1) /\
       (bir_is_well_typed_label_exp le2))) /\
  (bir_is_well_typed_stmtE (BStmt_Halt e) = (type_of_bir_exp e <> NONE))

name: bir_is_well_typed_stmtB_def
statement:
(bir_is_well_typed_stmtB (BStmt_Assign v e) = (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (bir_var_type v))) /\
  (bir_is_well_typed_stmtB (BStmt_Assert e) = (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME BType_Bool)) /\
  (bir_is_well_typed_stmtB (BStmt_Assume e) = (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME BType_Bool)) /\
  (bir_is_well_typed_stmtB (BStmt_Observe _ e el _) = ((type_of_bir_exp e = SOME BType_Bool) /\
                                                     (EVERY (IS_SOME o type_of_bir_exp) el)))

name: bir_is_well_typed_stmt_def
statement:
(bir_is_well_typed_stmt (BStmtE s) = bir_is_well_typed_stmtE s) /\
  (bir_is_well_typed_stmt (BStmtB s) = bir_is_well_typed_stmtB s)

name: bir_is_well_typed_block_def
statement:
bir_is_well_typed_block bl <=>
  ((EVERY bir_is_well_typed_stmtB bl.bb_statements) /\
   (bir_is_well_typed_stmtE bl.bb_last_statement))

name: bir_is_well_typed_program_def

name: bir_is_bool_exp_REWRS
statement:
(bir_is_bool_exp bir_exp_false) /\
  (bir_is_bool_exp bir_exp_true) /\

  (!c. (bir_is_bool_exp (BExp_Const c) <=> (type_of_bir_imm c = Bit1))) /\

  (!v. (bir_is_bool_exp (BExp_Den v) <=> (BType_Imm Bit1 = bir_var_type v))) /\

  (!uo e. (bir_is_bool_exp (BExp_UnaryExp uo e) <=> bir_is_bool_exp e)) /\

  (!bo e1 e2. (bir_is_bool_exp (BExp_BinExp bo e1 e2) <=>
     (bir_is_bool_exp e1 /\ bir_is_bool_exp e2))) /\

  (!bo e1 e2. (bir_is_bool_exp (BExp_BinPred bo e1 e2) <=>
     ?it. (type_of_bir_exp e1 = SOME (BType_Imm it)) /\
          (type_of_bir_exp e2 = SOME (BType_Imm it)))) /\

  (!bo e1 e2. (bir_is_bool_exp (BExp_MemEq e1 e2) <=>
     ?at vt. (type_of_bir_exp e1 = SOME (BType_Mem at vt)) /\
             (type_of_bir_exp e2 = SOME (BType_Mem at vt)))) /\

  (!ec e1 e2. (bir_is_bool_exp (BExp_IfThenElse ec e1 e2) <=>
     bir_is_bool_exp ec /\ bir_is_bool_exp e1 /\ bir_is_bool_exp e2)) /\

  (!ct e s. (bir_is_bool_exp (BExp_Cast ct e s) <=>
     ((s = Bit1) /\ (?it. (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm it)))))) /\

  (!ae me en s. (bir_is_bool_exp (BExp_Load ae me en s) <=>
     ((s = Bit1) /\ (?at.
     (type_of_bir_exp ae = SOME (BType_Mem at Bit1)) /\
     (type_of_bir_exp me = SOME (BType_Imm at)))))) /\

  (!ae me ve en. (bir_is_bool_exp (BExp_Store ae me en ve) <=>  F))

name: bir_is_bool_exp_env_REWRS
statement:
(bir_is_bool_exp_env env bir_exp_false) /\
  (bir_is_bool_exp_env env bir_exp_true) /\

  (!c. (bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_Const c) <=> ((type_of_bir_imm c = Bit1)))) /\

  (!v. (bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_Den v) <=> (
     bir_env_var_is_initialised env v /\
     (BType_Imm Bit1 = bir_var_type v)))) /\

  (!uo e. (bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_UnaryExp uo e) <=> bir_is_bool_exp_env env e)) /\

  (!bo e1 e2. (bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_BinExp bo e1 e2) <=>
     (bir_is_bool_exp_env env e1 /\ bir_is_bool_exp_env env e2))) /\

  (!bo e1 e2. (bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_BinPred bo e1 e2) <=> (
     bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e1) /\
     bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e2) /\
     ?it. (type_of_bir_exp e1 = SOME (BType_Imm it)) /\
          (type_of_bir_exp e2 = SOME (BType_Imm it))))) /\

  (!ec e1 e2. (bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_IfThenElse ec e1 e2) <=>
     bir_is_bool_exp_env env ec /\ bir_is_bool_exp_env env e1 /\ bir_is_bool_exp_env env e2)) /\

  (!ct e s. (bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_Cast ct e s) <=>
     ((s = Bit1) /\
     bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e) /\
     (?it. (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm it)))))) /\

  (!ae me en s. (bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_Load ae me en s) <=>
     ((s = Bit1) /\
      bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp me) /\
      bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp ae) /\
     (?at.
     (type_of_bir_exp ae = SOME (BType_Mem at Bit1)) /\
     (type_of_bir_exp me = SOME (BType_Imm at)))))) /\

  (!ae me ve en. (bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_Store ae me en ve) <=>  F))

name: bir_eval_bool_exp_TF

(!env. (bir_eval_bool_exp bir_exp_true env) = T) /\

name: bir_eval_bool_exp_BExp_BinExp

!de uo bop env e1 e2.

       bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_BinExp uo e1 e2) ==> (

name: bir_bin_pred_GET_BOOL_OPER_THM

name: bir_eval_bool_exp_BExp_BinPred

!de uo bop env e1 e2.
       (bir_bin_pred_GET_BOOL_OPER uo = SOME (de, bop)) ==>
       bir_is_bool_exp_env env e1 ==>
       bir_is_bool_exp_env env e2 ==> (
       (bir_eval_bool_exp (BExp_BinPred uo e1 e2) env) <=>
        bop (bir_eval_bool_exp e1 env) (bir_eval_bool_exp e2 env))

name: bir_unary_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER_THM
statement:
!de uo b bop. (bir_unary_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER uo = SOME (de, bop)) ==>
                  (bir_unary_exp uo (bool2b b) = (bool2b (bop b)))

name: bir_eval_bool_exp_BExp_UnaryExp
statement:
!de uo bop env e.
       (bir_unary_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER uo = SOME (de, bop)) ==>
       bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_UnaryExp uo e) ==> (
       (bir_eval_bool_exp (BExp_UnaryExp uo e) env) <=>
        bop (bir_eval_bool_exp e env))

name: bir_eval_bool_exp_BExp_IfThenElse
statement:
!env e ec e1 e2.
       bir_is_bool_exp_env env (BExp_IfThenElse ec e1 e2) ==> (
       (bir_eval_bool_exp (BExp_IfThenElse ec e1 e2) env) <=>
        if (bir_eval_bool_exp ec env) then (bir_eval_bool_exp e1 env) else (bir_eval_bool_exp e2 env))

name: bir_eval_bool_exp_EQ
statement:
!exp env.
      bir_is_bool_exp_env env exp
      ==>
      ((bir_eval_bool_exp exp env) <=> (bir_eval_exp exp env = SOME bir_val_true))

name: bir_val_true_def
statement: bir_val_true  = BVal_Imm   (Imm1 1w)

name: bir_val_false_def
statement: bir_val_false = BVal_Imm   (Imm1 0w)

name: bir_mk_bool_val_def
statement: bir_mk_bool_val b = BVal_Imm (bool2b b)

name: bir_exp_true_def
statement: bir_exp_true  = BExp_Const (Imm1 1w)

name: bir_exp_false_def
statement: bir_exp_false = BExp_Const (Imm1 0w)

name: bir_is_bool_exp_def
statement:
bir_is_bool_exp e <=>
  (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm Bit1))

name: bir_exp_or_def
statement: bir_exp_or  e1 e2 = BExp_BinExp   BIExp_Or  e1 e2

name: bir_exp_and_def
statement: bir_exp_and e1 e2 = BExp_BinExp   BIExp_And e1 e2

name: bir_exp_not_def
statement: bir_exp_not e     = BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not e

name: bir_exp_imp_def
statement: bir_exp_imp e1 e2 = bir_exp_or (bir_exp_not e1) e2

name: bir_is_bool_exp_env_def
statement:
bir_is_bool_exp_env env e <=>
  (bir_is_bool_exp e /\
   (bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e)))

name: bir_eval_bool_exp_def
statement:
bir_eval_bool_exp env e =
  THE (bir_dest_bool_val (THE (bir_eval_exp env e)))

name: bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER_def
statement:
(bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_And = SOME (T, $/\)) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_Or = SOME (T, $\/)) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_Xor = SOME (F, (\b1 b2. ~(b1 = b2)))) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_Plus = SOME (F, (\b1 b2. ~(b1 = b2)))) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_Minus = SOME (F, (\b1 b2. ~(b1 = b2)))) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_Mult = SOME (F, $/\ )) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_Div = NONE) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_SignedDiv = NONE) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_Mod =  NONE) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_SignedMod = NONE) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_LeftShift = SOME (F, \b1 b2. b1 /\ ~b2)) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_RightShift = SOME (F, \b1 b2. b1 /\ ~b2)) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_SignedRightShift = SOME (F, \b1 b2. b1)) /\
   (bir_bin_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER _ = NONE)

name: bir_bin_pred_GET_BOOL_OPER_def
statement:
(bir_bin_pred_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_Equal = SOME (T, $=)) /\
   (bir_bin_pred_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_NotEqual = SOME (T, $<>)) /\
   (bir_bin_pred_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_LessThan = SOME (F, (\b1 b2. ~b1 /\ b2))) /\
   (bir_bin_pred_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_SignedLessThan = SOME (F, (\b1 b2. b1 /\ ~b2))) /\
   (bir_bin_pred_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_LessOrEqual = SOME (T, $==>)) /\
   (bir_bin_pred_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_SignedLessOrEqual = SOME (F, \b1 b2. b2 ==> b1))

name: bir_unary_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER_def
statement:
(bir_unary_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_Not        = SOME (T, $~)) /\
   (bir_unary_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_ChangeSign = SOME (F, (\b. b))) /\
   (bir_unary_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_CLZ        = SOME (F, $~)) /\
   (bir_unary_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER BIExp_CLS        = SOME (F, (\b. F))) /\
   (bir_unary_exp_GET_BOOL_OPER _                = NONE)

name: bir_eval_exp_EQUIV_IS_EQUIV
statement:
(!e. bir_eval_exp_EQUIV e e) /\
    (!e1 e2. bir_eval_exp_EQUIV e1 e2 <=> bir_eval_exp_EQUIV e2 e1) /\
    (!e1 e2 e3. bir_eval_exp_EQUIV e1 e2 ==> bir_eval_exp_EQUIV e2 e3 ==>
                bir_eval_exp_EQUIV e1 e3)

name: bir_eval_exp_EQUIV_IS_CONG_SUBST
statement:
!v ve ve' e. bir_eval_exp_EQUIV ve ve' ==>
               bir_eval_exp_EQUIV (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) (bir_exp_subst1 v ve' e)

name: bir_exp_CONG_REFL
statement: !e. bir_exp_CONG e e

name: bir_exp_CONG_TRANS
statement: !e1 e2 e3. bir_exp_CONG e1 e2 ==> bir_exp_CONG e2 e3 ==> bir_exp_CONG e1 e3

name: bir_exp_CONG_SYM
statement: !e1 e2. bir_exp_CONG e1 e2 <=> bir_exp_CONG e2 e1

name: bir_exp_CONG_EQUIV_THM
statement: !e1 e2. bir_exp_CONG e1 e2 <=> (bir_exp_CONG e1 = bir_exp_CONG e2)

name: bir_exp_CONG_IS_CONG_SUBST
statement:
!v ve ve' e. bir_exp_CONG ve ve' ==>
               bir_exp_CONG (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) (bir_exp_subst1 v ve' e)

name: bir_exp_CONG_BASIC_CONG_RULES
statement:
(!e e' ty ct.
      bir_exp_CONG e e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG (BExp_Cast ct e ty) (BExp_Cast ct e' ty))

/\

(!e e' et.
      bir_exp_CONG e e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG (BExp_UnaryExp et e) (BExp_UnaryExp et e'))

/\

(!e1 e1' e2 e2' et.
      bir_exp_CONG e1 e1' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG e2 e2' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) (BExp_BinExp et e1' e2'))

/\

(!e1 e1' e2 e2' et.
      bir_exp_CONG e1 e1' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG e2 e2' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG (BExp_BinPred et e1 e2) (BExp_BinPred et e1' e2'))

/\

(!c c' et et' ef ef'.
      bir_exp_CONG c c' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG et et' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG ef ef' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG (BExp_IfThenElse c et ef) (BExp_IfThenElse c' et' ef'))

/\


(!mem_e mem_e' a_e a_e' en ty.
      bir_exp_CONG mem_e mem_e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG a_e a_e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG (BExp_Load mem_e a_e en ty) (BExp_Load mem_e' a_e' en ty))

/\

(!mem_e mem_e' a_e a_e' v_e v_e' en.
      bir_exp_CONG mem_e mem_e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG a_e a_e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG v_e v_e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG (BExp_Store mem_e a_e en v_e) (BExp_Store mem_e' a_e' en v_e'))

name: bir_exp_CONG_simp_IDEMPOTENT_AND
statement:
!e.
     (?ty. bir_type_is_Imm ty /\ (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty)) ==>
     bir_exp_CONG (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And e e) e

name: bir_exp_CONG_simp_IDEMPOTENT_OR
statement:
!e.
     (?ty. bir_type_is_Imm ty /\ (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty)) ==>
     bir_exp_CONG (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or e e) e

name: bir_exp_CONG_WEAK_IS_WEAK
statement: !e1 e2. bir_exp_CONG e1 e2 ==> bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e1 e2

name: bir_exp_CONG_WEAK_REFL
statement: !e. bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e e

name: bir_exp_CONG_WEAK_TRANS
statement: !e1 e2 e3. bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e1 e2 ==> bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e2 e3 ==> bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e1 e3

name: bir_exp_CONG_WEAK_IS_CONG_SUBST
statement:
!v ve ve' e. bir_exp_CONG_WEAK ve ve' ==>
               bir_exp_CONG_WEAK (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) (bir_exp_subst1 v ve' e)

name: bir_exp_CONG_WEAK_BASIC_CONG_RULES
statement:
(!e e' ty ct.
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK (BExp_Cast ct e ty) (BExp_Cast ct e' ty))

/\

(!e e' et.
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK (BExp_UnaryExp et e) (BExp_UnaryExp et e'))

/\

(!e1 e1' e2 e2' et.
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e1 e1' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e2 e2' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) (BExp_BinExp et e1' e2'))

/\

(!e1 e1' e2 e2' et.
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e1 e1' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e2 e2' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK (BExp_BinPred et e1 e2) (BExp_BinPred et e1' e2'))

/\

(!c c' et et' ef ef'.
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK c c' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK et et' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK ef ef' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK (BExp_IfThenElse c et ef) (BExp_IfThenElse c' et' ef'))

/\


(!mem_e mem_e' a_e a_e' en ty.
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK mem_e mem_e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK a_e a_e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK (BExp_Load mem_e a_e en ty) (BExp_Load mem_e' a_e' en ty))

/\

(!mem_e mem_e' a_e a_e' v_e v_e' en.
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK mem_e mem_e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK a_e a_e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK v_e v_e' ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK (BExp_Store mem_e a_e en v_e) (BExp_Store mem_e' a_e' en v_e'))

name: bir_exp_CONG_WEAK_simp_IDEMPOTENT_AND
statement:
!e. (?ty. bir_type_is_Imm ty /\ (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty)) ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And e e) e

name: bir_exp_CONG_WEAK_simp_IDEMPOTENT_OR
statement:
!e. (?ty. bir_type_is_Imm ty /\ (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty)) ==>
      bir_exp_CONG_WEAK (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or e e) e

name: bir_exp_CONG_WEAK_simp_IF_THEN_ELSE_TF_EQ
statement:
!c e. (type_of_bir_exp c = SOME BType_Bool) ==>
        bir_exp_CONG_WEAK (BExp_IfThenElse c e e) e

name: bir_eval_exp_EQUIV_def
statement:
bir_eval_exp_EQUIV e1 e2 <=> (!env.
    (bir_eval_exp e1 env = bir_eval_exp e2 env))

name: bir_exp_CONG_def
statement:
bir_exp_CONG e1 e2 <=> (
    (type_of_bir_exp e1 = type_of_bir_exp e2) /\
    (bir_vars_of_exp e2 = bir_vars_of_exp e1) /\
    (!env ty.  bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e1) ==>
               (type_of_bir_exp e1 = SOME ty) ==>
               (bir_eval_exp e1 env = bir_eval_exp e2 env)))

name: bir_exp_CONG_WEAK_def
statement:
bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e1 e2 <=> (
    (type_of_bir_exp e1 = type_of_bir_exp e2) /\
    (bir_vars_of_exp e2 SUBSET bir_vars_of_exp e1) /\
    (!env ty.  bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e1) ==>
               (type_of_bir_exp e1 = SOME ty) ==>
               (bir_eval_exp e1 env = bir_eval_exp e2 env)))

name: bir_eval_imm_types_EXISTS
statement:
!env ex ty.
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp ex) ==>
    (type_of_bir_exp ex = SOME (BType_Imm ty)) ==>
    ?i. (bir_eval_exp ex env = SOME (BVal_Imm i)) /\
        (type_of_bir_imm i = ty)

name: bir_exp_and_true
statement:
!b b'.
      (type_of_bir_imm b = type_of_bir_imm b') ==>
      (bir_bin_exp BIExp_And b' b = Imm1 1w) ==>
      ((b' = Imm1 1w) /\ (b = Imm1 1w))

name: bir_and_equiv
statement:
!env ex1 ex2.
      (bir_eval_exp ex1 env = SOME bir_val_true) /\
        (bir_eval_exp ex2 env = SOME bir_val_true) <=>
      (bir_eval_exp (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And ex1 ex2) env =
         SOME bir_val_true
      )

name: bir_and_op1
statement:
!ex env.
     (bir_eval_exp (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And bir_exp_true ex) env =
       SOME bir_val_true) <=>
     (bir_eval_exp ex env = SOME bir_val_true)

name: bir_and_op2
statement:
!ex env.
     (bir_eval_exp (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And ex bir_exp_true) env =
       SOME bir_val_true) <=>
     (bir_eval_exp ex env = SOME bir_val_true)

name: bir_disj1_false
statement:
!ex env.
      (bir_eval_bin_exp BIExp_Or (SOME bir_val_false) (bir_eval_exp ex env)
        = SOME bir_val_true) ==>
      (bir_eval_exp ex env = SOME bir_val_true)

name: bir_or_equiv
bir_or_impl
statement:
!env ex1 ex2.
      ((bir_eval_exp (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or ex1 ex2) env =
        SOME bir_val_true) ==>
      ((bir_eval_exp ex1 env = SOME bir_val_true) \/
       (bir_eval_exp ex2 env = SOME bir_val_true))
      )

name: bir_not_equiv
statement:
!env ex.
      bir_is_bool_exp_env env ex ==>
      (~(bir_eval_exp ex env = SOME bir_val_true) <=>
        (bir_eval_exp (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not ex) env =
          SOME bir_val_true)
      )

name: bir_not_equiv_alt
statement:
!ex env.
  bir_is_bool_exp_env env ex ==>
  ((bir_eval_unary_exp BIExp_Not (bir_eval_exp ex env)
     = SOME bir_val_true) <=>
  ((bir_eval_exp ex env) = SOME bir_val_false))

name: bir_not_val_true
statement:
!env ex.
      (bir_eval_exp (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not ex) env =
        SOME bir_val_true) <=>
      (bir_eval_exp ex env = SOME bir_val_false)

name: bir_vars_init_not
statement:
!ex. (bir_vars_of_exp ex) =
         (bir_vars_of_exp (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not ex))

name: bir_is_bool_exp_not
statement:
!ex. (bir_is_bool_exp ex) =
         (bir_is_bool_exp (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not ex))

name: bir_impl_equiv
bir_equal_equiv
statement:
!ex1 ex2 env.
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp ex1) ==>
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp ex2) ==>
    bir_is_imm_exp ex1 ==>
    bir_is_imm_exp ex2 ==>
    (type_of_bir_exp ex1 = type_of_bir_exp ex2) ==>
    ((bir_eval_exp 
       (BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal ex1 ex2) env = SOME bir_val_true
     ) <=> (
      (bir_eval_exp ex1 env) =
        (bir_eval_exp ex2 env)
     )
    )

name: bir_lessthan_equiv
statement:
!ex1 ex2 env it.
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp ex1) ==>
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp ex2) ==>
    (type_of_bir_exp ex1 = SOME (BType_Imm it)) ==>
    (type_of_bir_exp ex2 = SOME (BType_Imm it)) ==>
    ((bir_eval_exp
       (BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessThan ex1 ex2) env = SOME bir_val_true
    ) <=> (bir_imm_word_lo (bir_eval_exp ex1 env) (bir_eval_exp ex2 env)))

name: bir_slessthan_equiv
statement:
!ex1 ex2 env it.
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp ex1) ==>
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp ex2) ==>
    (type_of_bir_exp ex1 = SOME (BType_Imm it)) ==>
    (type_of_bir_exp ex2 = SOME (BType_Imm it)) ==>
    ((bir_eval_exp
       (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan ex1 ex2) env = SOME bir_val_true
    ) <=> (bir_imm_word_lt (bir_eval_exp ex1 env) (bir_eval_exp ex2 env)))

name: bir_eval_bin_pred_64_mem_eq
statement:
!mm w_ref w_deref.
 (bir_eval_bin_pred BIExp_Equal
  (bir_eval_load (SOME (BVal_Mem Bit64 Bit8 mm))
    (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w_ref))) BEnd_LittleEndian Bit64)
  (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w_deref))) = SOME bir_val_true) <=>
 (bir_load_from_mem Bit8 Bit64 Bit64 mm BEnd_LittleEndian (w2n w_ref) = SOME (Imm64 w_deref))

name: bir_eval_bin_pred_exists_64_eq
statement:
!f w reg.
 (bir_eval_bin_pred BIExp_Equal
  (if (?z. f reg = SOME z /\ BType_Imm Bit64 = type_of_bir_val z)
  then f reg else NONE) (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w))) = SOME bir_val_true)
 <=>
 (f reg = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w)))

name: bir_eval_bin_pred_exists_64_mem_eq
statement:
!f mm w_ref w_deref.
 (bir_eval_bin_pred BIExp_Equal
  (bir_eval_load
   (if (?z. f mm = SOME z /\ BType_Mem Bit64 Bit8 = type_of_bir_val z)
    then f mm else NONE) (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w_ref))) BEnd_LittleEndian Bit64)
 (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w_deref))) = SOME bir_val_true) 
   <=>
 (?map. f mm = SOME (BVal_Mem Bit64 Bit8 map) /\
  bir_load_from_mem Bit8 Bit64 Bit64 map BEnd_LittleEndian (w2n w_ref) = SOME (Imm64 w_deref))

name: bir_eval_bin_pred_exists_64_lowcast_32_eq
statement:
!f w reg.
(bir_eval_bin_pred BIExp_Equal
 (bir_eval_cast BIExp_LowCast
   (if (?z. f reg = SOME z /\ BType_Imm Bit64 = type_of_bir_val z)
    then f reg else NONE) Bit32) (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm32 w))) =
 SOME bir_val_true) 
 <=>
 (?(z:word64). f reg = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 z)) /\ n2w (w2n z) = w)

name: bir_is_imm_exp_def
statement:
bir_is_imm_exp e =
  (?it. type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm it))

name: bir_imm_word_lo_def
statement:
(bir_imm_word_lo (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 w1)))   (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 w2))) = (w1 <+ w2)) /\
  (bir_imm_word_lo (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm8 w1)))   (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm8 w2))) = (w1 <+ w2)) /\
  (bir_imm_word_lo (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm16 w1)))  (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm16 w2))) = (w1 <+ w2)) /\
  (bir_imm_word_lo (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm32 w1)))  (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm32 w2))) = (w1 <+ w2)) /\
  (bir_imm_word_lo (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w1)))  (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w2))) = (w1 <+ w2)) /\
  (bir_imm_word_lo (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm128 w1))) (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm128 w2))) = (w1 <+ w2))

name: bir_imm_word_lt_def
statement:
(bir_imm_word_lt (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 w1)))   (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 w2))) = (w1 < w2)) /\
  (bir_imm_word_lt (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm8 w1)))   (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm8 w2))) = (w1 < w2)) /\
  (bir_imm_word_lt (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm16 w1)))  (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm16 w2))) = (w1 < w2)) /\
  (bir_imm_word_lt (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm32 w1)))  (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm32 w2))) = (w1 < w2)) /\
  (bir_imm_word_lt (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w1)))  (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 w2))) = (w1 < w2)) /\
  (bir_imm_word_lt (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm128 w1))) (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm128 w2))) = (w1 < w2))

name: bir_exp_subst_var_REWRS
statement:
(!v. bir_exp_subst_var FEMPTY v = BExp_Den v) /\
    (!s v ve v'. bir_exp_subst_var (s |+ (v, ve)) v' = (if v = v' then ve else bir_exp_subst_var s v'))

name: bir_exp_subst_EMPTY
statement: !e. bir_exp_subst FEMPTY e = e

name: bir_exp_subst_TYPE_EQ_GEN
statement:
!s1 s2 e.
  (!v. (type_of_bir_exp (bir_exp_subst_var s1 v) =
        type_of_bir_exp (bir_exp_subst_var s2 v))) ==>
  (type_of_bir_exp (bir_exp_subst s1 e) = type_of_bir_exp (bir_exp_subst s2 e))

name: bir_exp_subst_TYPE_EQ
statement:
!s. FEVERY (\ (v, e). (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (bir_var_type v))) s ==>
        (!e. (type_of_bir_exp (bir_exp_subst s e) = type_of_bir_exp e))

name: bir_exp_subst_NO_TYPE
statement:
!s e v ve. (
    (v IN bir_vars_of_exp e) /\
    (FLOOKUP s v = SOME ve) /\
    (type_of_bir_exp ve = NONE)) ==>
    (type_of_bir_exp (bir_exp_subst s e) = NONE)

name: bir_exp_subst_EVAL_EQ_GEN
statement:
!env s1 s2 e.
  (!v. (bir_eval_exp (bir_exp_subst_var s1 v) env =
        bir_eval_exp (bir_exp_subst_var s2 v) env)) ==>
  (bir_eval_exp (bir_exp_subst s1 e) env = bir_eval_exp (bir_exp_subst s2 e) env)

name: bir_exp_subst_EVAL_EQ
statement:
!env s e.
  FEVERY (\ (v, e). (bir_eval_exp e env = bir_env_read v env)) s ==>
  (bir_eval_exp (bir_exp_subst s e) env = bir_eval_exp e env)

name: bir_exp_subst_USED_VARS
statement:
!s e. bir_vars_of_exp (bir_exp_subst s e) =
        ((bir_vars_of_exp e) DIFF (FDOM s)) UNION
        (BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_exp
           {e' | ?v. ((v IN (bir_vars_of_exp e)) /\ (FLOOKUP s v = SOME e'))}))

name: bir_exp_subst_UNUSED_VARS_OVERAPPROX
statement:
!s vs e. bir_vars_of_exp e SUBSET vs ==>
           (bir_exp_subst (DRESTRICT s vs) e = bir_exp_subst s e)

name: bir_exp_subst_UNUSED_VARS
statement: !s e. (bir_exp_subst (DRESTRICT s (bir_vars_of_exp e)) e = bir_exp_subst s e)

name: bir_exp_subst1_REWRS
statement:
(!v ve n. bir_exp_subst1 v ve (BExp_Const n) = (BExp_Const n)) /\
   (!v ve aty vty mmap. bir_exp_subst1 v ve (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) = (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap)) /\
   (!v ve v'. bir_exp_subst1 v ve (BExp_Den v') = (if v = v' then ve else (BExp_Den v'))) /\
   (!v ve ct e ty.
      bir_exp_subst1 v ve (BExp_Cast ct e ty) =
      BExp_Cast ct (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) ty) /\
   (!v ve et e.
      bir_exp_subst1 v ve (BExp_UnaryExp et e) =
      BExp_UnaryExp et (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e)) /\
   (!v ve et e1 e2.
      bir_exp_subst1 v ve (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) =
      BExp_BinExp et (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e1)
        (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e2)) /\
   (!v ve pt e1 e2.
      bir_exp_subst1 v ve (BExp_BinPred pt e1 e2) =
      BExp_BinPred pt (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e1)
        (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e2)) /\
   (!v ve me1 me2.
      bir_exp_subst1 v ve (BExp_MemEq me1 me2) =
      BExp_MemEq (bir_exp_subst1 v ve me1)
        (bir_exp_subst1 v ve me2)) /\
   (!v ve c et ef.
      bir_exp_subst1 v ve (BExp_IfThenElse c et ef) =
      BExp_IfThenElse (bir_exp_subst1 v ve c) (bir_exp_subst1 v ve et)
        (bir_exp_subst1 v ve ef)) /\
   (!v ve mem_e a_e en ty.
      bir_exp_subst1 v ve (BExp_Load mem_e a_e en ty) =
      BExp_Load (bir_exp_subst1 v ve mem_e) (bir_exp_subst1 v ve a_e) en
        ty) /\
   (!v ve mem_e a_e en v_e.
     bir_exp_subst1 v ve (BExp_Store mem_e a_e en v_e) =
     BExp_Store (bir_exp_subst1 v ve mem_e) (bir_exp_subst1 v ve a_e) en
       (bir_exp_subst1 v ve v_e))

name: bir_exp_subst1_TYPE_EQ_GEN
statement:
!v ve ve' e. (type_of_bir_exp ve = type_of_bir_exp ve') ==>
                 (type_of_bir_exp (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) = type_of_bir_exp (bir_exp_subst1 v ve' e))

name: bir_exp_subst1_TYPE_EQ
statement:
!v ve e. (type_of_bir_exp ve = SOME (bir_var_type v)) ==>
             (type_of_bir_exp (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) = type_of_bir_exp e)

name: bir_exp_subst1_NO_TYPE
statement:
!e v ve. (
    (v IN bir_vars_of_exp e) /\
    (type_of_bir_exp ve = NONE)) ==>
    (type_of_bir_exp (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) = NONE)

name: bir_exp_subst1_NO_TYPE_SOME
statement:
!e v ve ty. (
    (v IN bir_vars_of_exp e) ==>
    (type_of_bir_exp (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) = SOME ty) ==>
    (?ty. type_of_bir_exp ve = SOME ty))

name: bir_exp_subst1_EVAL_EQ_GEN
statement:
!env v ve ve' e.
  (bir_eval_exp ve env = bir_eval_exp ve' env) ==>
  (bir_eval_exp (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) env = bir_eval_exp (bir_exp_subst1 v ve' e) env)

name: bir_exp_subst1_EVAL_EQ
statement:
!env v ve e.
  (bir_eval_exp ve env = bir_env_read v env) ==>
  (bir_eval_exp (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) env = bir_eval_exp e env)

name: bir_exp_subst1_USED_VARS
statement:
!v ve e. bir_vars_of_exp (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) =
        ((bir_vars_of_exp e) DIFF {v}) UNION
        (if v IN bir_vars_of_exp e then bir_vars_of_exp ve else {})

name: bir_exp_subst1_UNUSED_VAR
statement:
!v ve e. ~(v IN bir_vars_of_exp e) ==>
           (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e = e)

name: bir_eval_exp_subst1_env
statement:
!ex env varn ty e1 e1_va.
    (bir_env_lookup_type varn (BEnv env) = SOME ty) ==>
    (bir_eval_exp e1 (BEnv env) = SOME e1_va) ==>
    (type_of_bir_val e1_va = ty) ==>
    (bir_eval_exp ex
      (BEnv ((varn =+ SOME e1_va) env)) =
        bir_eval_exp (bir_exp_subst1 (BVar varn ty) e1 ex)
                     (BEnv env)
    )

name: bir_exp_subst_var_def
statement: bir_exp_subst_var s v = case FLOOKUP s v of NONE => BExp_Den v | SOME e => e

name: bir_exp_subst_def
statement:
(bir_exp_subst s (BExp_Const n) = (BExp_Const n)) /\
   (bir_exp_subst s (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) = (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap)) /\
   (bir_exp_subst s (BExp_Den v) = bir_exp_subst_var s v) /\
   (bir_exp_subst s (BExp_Cast ct e ty) =
      BExp_Cast ct (bir_exp_subst s e) ty) /\
   (bir_exp_subst s (BExp_UnaryExp et e) =
      BExp_UnaryExp et (bir_exp_subst s e)) /\
   (bir_exp_subst s (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) =
      BExp_BinExp et (bir_exp_subst s e1)
        (bir_exp_subst s e2)) /\
   (bir_exp_subst s (BExp_BinPred pt e1 e2) =
      BExp_BinPred pt (bir_exp_subst s e1)
        (bir_exp_subst s e2)) /\
   (bir_exp_subst s (BExp_MemEq me1 me2) =
      BExp_MemEq (bir_exp_subst s me1)
        (bir_exp_subst s me2)) /\
   (bir_exp_subst s (BExp_IfThenElse c et ef) =
      BExp_IfThenElse (bir_exp_subst s c) (bir_exp_subst s et)
        (bir_exp_subst s ef)) /\
   (bir_exp_subst s (BExp_Load mem_e a_e en ty) =
      BExp_Load (bir_exp_subst s mem_e) (bir_exp_subst s a_e) en
        ty) /\
   (bir_exp_subst s (BExp_Store mem_e a_e en v_e) =
     BExp_Store (bir_exp_subst s mem_e) (bir_exp_subst s a_e) en
       (bir_exp_subst s v_e))

name: bir_exp_subst1_def
statement: bir_exp_subst1 v ve = (bir_exp_subst (FEMPTY |+ (v, ve)))

name: bir_exp_satisfiable_taut_NEGATION
statement:
!e. bir_is_bool_exp e /\ (bir_var_set_is_well_typed (bir_vars_of_exp e)) ==>
      (bir_exp_is_satisfiable e <=> ~(bir_exp_is_taut (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not e)))

name: bir_exp_is_taut_WEAK_CONG_IMPL
statement: !e1 e2. bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e1 e2 ==> (bir_exp_is_taut e1 ==> bir_exp_is_taut e2)

name: bir_exp_is_taut_WEAK_CONG_IFF
statement:
!e1 e2. bir_exp_CONG e1 e2 ==>
        (bir_exp_is_taut e1 <=> bir_exp_is_taut e2)

name: bir_exp_is_satisfiable_WEAK_CONG_IMPL
statement: !e1 e2. bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e1 e2 ==> (bir_exp_is_satisfiable e1 ==> bir_exp_is_satisfiable e2)

name: bir_exp_is_satisfiable_WEAK_CONG_IFF
statement:
!e1 e2. bir_exp_CONG_WEAK e1 e2 ==> bir_var_set_is_well_typed (bir_vars_of_exp e1) ==>
        (bir_exp_is_satisfiable e1 <=> bir_exp_is_satisfiable e2)

name: bir_exp_is_satisfiable_CONG_IFF
statement:
!e1 e2. bir_exp_CONG e1 e2 ==>
        (bir_exp_is_satisfiable e1 <=> bir_exp_is_satisfiable e2)

name: bir_exp_is_taut_INTRODUCE_FRESH_VAR_AS_ABBREV
statement:
!v ve e ty. (bir_type_is_Imm ty /\
              (bir_var_type v = ty) /\
              (type_of_bir_exp ve = SOME ty) /\
              (bir_var_set_is_well_typed (v INSERT bir_vars_of_exp (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e))) /\
              (v IN (bir_vars_of_exp e)) /\
              ~(v IN (bir_vars_of_exp ve))) ==>

(bir_exp_is_taut (bir_exp_subst1 v ve e) <=>
bir_exp_is_taut (BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessOrEqual
                 (BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal (BExp_Den v) ve)
                 e))

name: bir_exp_is_taut_same_vars_both_bool
statement:
!ex ex' st.
    (bir_exp_is_taut (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not ex') ex)) ==>
    (bir_vars_of_exp ex' = bir_vars_of_exp ex) ==>
    ((bir_is_bool_exp_env st.bst_environ ex') =
       (bir_is_bool_exp_env st.bst_environ ex))

name: bir_exp_is_taut_def
statement:
bir_exp_is_taut e <=> (
  bir_is_bool_exp e /\ (bir_var_set_is_well_typed (bir_vars_of_exp e)) /\
  (!env. (bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e)) ==>
         (bir_eval_exp e env = SOME bir_val_true)))

name: bir_exp_is_satisfiable_def
statement:
bir_exp_is_satisfiable e <=> (
  bir_is_bool_exp e /\ (bir_var_set_is_well_typed (bir_vars_of_exp e)) /\
  (?env. (bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e) /\
         (bir_eval_exp e env = SOME bir_val_true))))

name: BExp_Align_type_of

           if (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm sz)) then
               SOME (BType_Imm sz) else NONE

name: BExp_Align_eval
statement:
!sz p e env. bir_eval_exp (BExp_Align sz p e) env =
     case (sz, bir_eval_exp e env) of
         (Bit1,   SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1   w))) => SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1   (align p w)))
       | (Bit8,   SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm8   w))) => SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm8   (align p w)))
       | (Bit16,  SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm16  w))) => SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm16  (align p w)))
       | (Bit32,  SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm32  w))) => SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm32  (align p w)))
       | (Bit64,  SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64  w))) => SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64  (align p w)))
       | (Bit128, SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm128 w))) => SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm128 (align p w)))
       | (_, _) => NONE

name: thm0
statement:
!w:'a word p.
     (MEM p (COUNT_LIST (dimindex (:'a)))) ==> (0 < p) ==>
     (((w && n2w (dimword (:'a) - 2 ** p) = align p w)) /\
      (((n2w (dimword (:'a) - 2 ** p) && w) = align p w)))

       | (Bit8,   SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm8   w))) => SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (aligned p w)))
       | (Bit16,  SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm16  w))) => SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (aligned p w)))
       | (Bit32,  SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm32  w))) => SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (aligned p w)))
       | (Bit64,  SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64  w))) => SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (aligned p w)))

name: word_extract_byte_index
statement:
!w:'a word m n. m < dimindex (:'a) ==>
  ((word_extract_byte w n) ' m =
  ((w ' m) /\ (n <= m) /\ (m < n + 8)))

name: word_reverse_8_16_ALT_DEF
statement: !w:word16. word_reverse_8_16 w = (w >>> 8) || (w << 8)

name: word_reverse_8_32_ALT_DEF_aux
statement:
!w:word32. word_reverse_8_32 w = (w >>> 24) || (word_extract_byte (w >>> 8) 8) ||
                                  (word_extract_byte (w << 8) 16) || (w << 24)

name: word_reverse_8_64_ALT_DEF_aux
statement:
!w:word64. word_reverse_8_64 w = (w >>> 56) || (word_extract_byte (w >>> 40) 8) ||
                                  (word_extract_byte (w >>> 24) 16) ||
                                  (word_extract_byte (w >>> 8) 24) ||
                                  (word_extract_byte (w << 8) 32) ||
                                  (word_extract_byte (w << 24) 40) ||
                                  (word_extract_byte (w << 40) 48) ||
                                  (w << 56)

name: word_reverse_8_128_ALT_DEF_aux
statement:
!w:word128. word_reverse_8_128 w = (w >>> 120) || (word_extract_byte (w >>> 104) 8) ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w >>> 88) 16)  ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w >>> 72) 24)  ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w >>> 56) 32)  ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w >>> 40) 40)  ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w >>> 24) 48)  ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w >>>  8) 56)  ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w <<   8) 64)  ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w <<  24) 72)  ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w <<  40) 80)  ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w <<  56) 88)  ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w <<  72) 96)  ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w <<  88) 104) ||
                                    (word_extract_byte (w << 104) 112) ||
                                    (w << 120)

name: bir_eval_exp_BExp_IntervalPred_thm

    bir_eval_exp (BExp_IntervalPred e (e_l, e_h)) env = (
      bir_eval_bin_exp BIExp_And
        (bir_eval_bin_pred BIExp_LessOrEqual
          (bir_eval_exp e_l env)
          (bir_eval_exp e env))
        (bir_eval_bin_pred BIExp_LessOrEqual

        (SOME (BType_Imm ty), SOME (BType_Imm lty), SOME (BType_Imm hty)) =>

name: WI_MEM_implies_wf
statement: !w i. WI_MEM w i ==> WI_wf i

name: WI_wf_size
statement: !b sz. (WI_wf (WI_size (b:'a word) sz) <=> ~(nzcv_BIR_ADD_C b sz))

name: WI_wf_size_compute
statement: !b sz. (WI_wf (WI_size (b:'a word) sz) <=> (b <=+ ~sz))

name: WI_wf_size_SUM_LT
statement:
!(b:'a word) sz.
    WI_wf (WI_size b sz) <=>
    w2n b + w2n sz < dimword (:'a)

name: WI_size_INTRO
statement: !s e. ((WI_end s e) = (WI_size s (e - s)))

name: WI_MEM_WI_size
statement:
!sz b (w:'a word).
    WI_wf (WI_size b sz) ==> (
     (WI_MEM w (WI_size b sz)) <=>
      MEM w (WI_ELEM_LIST b (w2n sz)))

name: WI_MEM_WI_end
statement:
!b e (w:'a word).
    WI_wf (WI_end b e) ==> (
     (WI_MEM w (WI_end b e)) <=>
      MEM w (WI_ELEM_LIST b (w2n (e - b))))

name: WI_ELEM_LIST_ADD
statement:
!b:'a word n1 n2. WI_ELEM_LIST b (n1 + n2) =
                   (WI_ELEM_LIST b n1) ++ (WI_ELEM_LIST (b + n2w n1) n2)

name: WI_not_wf_empty
statement: !i. ~(WI_wf i) ==> WI_is_empty i

name: WI_wfe_NOT_EMPTY
statement: !i. WI_wfe i <=> ~(WI_is_empty i)

name: WI_is_empty_NOT_WFE
statement: !i. (WI_is_empty i) <=> ~(WI_wfe i)

name: WI_wf_is_empty_End
statement: !b e. WI_wf (WI_end b e) ==> (WI_is_empty (WI_end b e) <=> (b = e))

name: WI_wfe_End
statement: !b e. WI_wfe (WI_end b e) <=> (b <+ e)

name: WI_is_empty_End
statement: !b e. WI_is_empty (WI_end b e) <=> (e <=+ b)

name: WI_wf_is_empty_Size
statement: !b sz. WI_wf (WI_size b sz) ==> (WI_is_empty (WI_size b sz) <=> (sz = 0w))

name: WI_wfe_Size
statement: !b sz. WI_wfe (WI_size b sz) <=> (b <=+ ~sz /\ sz <> 0w)

name: WI_empty_interval_End_Props
statement:
(!b. WI_wf (WI_end b b)) /\
    (!b. WI_is_empty (WI_end b b)) /\
    (!b w. ~(WI_MEM w (WI_end b b)))

name: WI_empty_interval_Size_Props
statement:
(!b. WI_wf (WI_size b 0w)) /\
    (!b. WI_is_empty (WI_size b 0w))

name: WI_sing_interval_Size_Props
statement:
!b:'a word.
       (1 < dimword (:'a)) ==>
       b <=+ ~1w ==> (

       (WI_wf (WI_size b 1w)) /\
       (~(WI_is_empty (WI_size b 1w))) /\
       (!w. (WI_MEM w (WI_size b 1w) <=> (w = b))))

name: WI_NOT_EMPTY_BEGIN_IN
statement: !b e. WI_is_empty (WI_end b e) <=> ~ (WI_MEM b (WI_end b e))

name: WI_NOT_EMPTY_BEGIN_IN_size
statement: !b sz. WI_is_empty (WI_size b sz) <=> ~ (WI_MEM b (WI_size b sz))

name: WI_MEM_characterisation
statement:
!i1 i2. WI_wf i1 ==> WI_wf i2 ==> ~(WI_is_empty i1 /\ WI_is_empty i2) ==> (

    (i1 = i2) <=> (!w. WI_MEM w i1 <=> WI_MEM w i2))

name: WI_wf_size_LOWER_EQ
statement:
!b sz1 sz2. (sz2 <=+ sz1) ==>
              (WI_wf (WI_size (b:'a word) sz1)) ==>
              (WI_wf (WI_size b sz2))

name: WI_is_sub_ANTISYM
statement: !i1 i2. WI_wf i1 /\ WI_wf i2 ==> WI_is_sub i1 i2 ==> WI_is_sub i2 i1 ==> ((i1 = i2) \/ (WI_is_empty i1 /\ WI_is_empty i2))

name: WI_is_sub_EMPTY
statement:
(!i1 i2. WI_is_empty i1 ==> (WI_is_sub i1 i2)) /\
  (!i1 i2. WI_is_empty i2 ==> (WI_is_sub i1 i2 <=> (WI_is_empty i1)))

statement:
!b1 e1 b2 e2.

     WI_wf (WI_end b2 e2) ==> (
     WI_is_sub (WI_end b1 e1) (WI_end b2 e2) <=>
     (b1 = e1) \/ ((b2 <=+ b1) /\ (e1 <=+ e2)))

statement:

     (b2 <=+ b1) /\ (e1 <=+ e2))

name: WI_overlap_SYM
statement: !i1 i2. WI_overlap i1 i2 <=> WI_overlap i2 i1

name: WI_overlap_EMPTY
statement:
(!i1 i2. WI_is_empty i1 ==> ~(WI_overlap i1 i2)) /\
  (!i1 i2. WI_is_empty i2 ==> ~(WI_overlap i1 i2))

name: WI_overlap_compute
statement:
!b1 e1 b2 e2.
     WI_wf (WI_end b1 e1) ==>
     WI_wf (WI_end b2 e2) ==> (
     WI_overlap (WI_end b1 e1) (WI_end b2 e2) <=>
     (b1 <+ e1) /\ (b2 <+ e2) /\ (((b2 <=+ b1 /\ b1 <+ e2) \/ (b1 <=+ b2 /\ b2 <+ e1))))

name: WI_overlap_compute_NOT_EMPTY
statement:
!b1 e1 b2 e2.
     WI_wfe (WI_end b1 e1) ==>
     WI_wfe (WI_end b2 e2) ==> (
     WI_overlap (WI_end b1 e1) (WI_end b2 e2) <=>
     (((b2 <=+ b1 /\ b1 <+ e2) \/ (b1 <=+ b2 /\ b2 <+ e1))))

name: WI_distinct_ALT_DEF
statement: !(i1:'a word_interval_t) i2. WI_distinct i1 i2 <=> !w. ~(WI_MEM w i1) \/ ~(WI_MEM w i2)

name: WI_distinct_SYM
statement: !i1 i2. WI_distinct i1 i2 <=> WI_distinct i2 i1

name: WI_distinct_EMPTY
statement:
(!i1 i2. WI_is_empty i1 ==> (WI_distinct i1 i2)) /\
  (!i1 i2. WI_is_empty i2 ==> (WI_distinct i1 i2))

name: WI_distinct_WI_MEM_L
statement: !i1 i2. WI_distinct i1 i2 <=> (!w. WI_MEM w i1 ==> ~(WI_MEM w i2))

name: WI_distinct_WI_MEM_R
statement: !i1 i2. WI_distinct i1 i2 <=> (!w. WI_MEM w i2 ==> ~(WI_MEM w i1))

name: WI_distinct_compute
statement:
!b1 e1 b2 e2.
     WI_wf (WI_end b1 e1) ==>
     WI_wf (WI_end b2 e2) ==> (
     WI_distinct (WI_end b1 e1) (WI_end b2 e2) <=>
     ((e1 <=+ b1) \/ (e2 <=+ b2) \/ (((b1 <+ b2 \/ e2 <=+ b1) /\ (b2 <+ b1 \/ e1 <=+ b2)))))

name: WI_distinct_compute_NOT_EMPTY
statement:
!b1 e1 b2 e2.
     WI_wfe (WI_end b1 e1) ==>
     WI_wfe (WI_end b2 e2) ==> (
     WI_distinct (WI_end b1 e1) (WI_end b2 e2) <=>
     (((b1 <+ b2 \/ e2 <=+ b1) /\ (b2 <+ b1 \/ e1 <=+ b2))))

name: WI_distinct_compute_MEM_UNCHANGED
statement:
!(mb:'a word) me.
     WI_wfe (WI_end (mb:'a word) me) ==>

    !(wb:'a word) sz. (sz < dimword (:'a)) /\ (sz <> 0) ==>
    (WI_distinct_MEM_UNCHANGED_COMPUTE mb me wb sz <=>
     (WI_wfe (WI_size wb (n2w sz))) /\ (WI_distinct (WI_end mb me) (WI_size wb (n2w sz))))

name: WI_distinct_compute_MEM_UNCHANGED_COND_REWRITE
statement:
!(wb:'a word) mb me sz.
    (mb MOD dimword (:'a) < me MOD dimword (:'a) /\ sz < dimword (:'a) /\ sz <> 0) ==>
    (WI_distinct_MEM_UNCHANGED_COMPUTE (n2w mb) (n2w me) wb sz <=>
     (WI_wfe (WI_size wb (n2w sz))) /\
     WI_wfe (WI_end ((n2w mb):'a word) (n2w me)) /\
     (WI_distinct (WI_end ((n2w mb):'a word) (n2w me)) (WI_size wb (n2w sz))))

name: BExp_unchanged_mem_interval_distinct_eval
statement:
!sz mb_n me_n wb_e isz env.
  (bir_eval_exp (BExp_unchanged_mem_interval_distinct sz mb_n me_n wb_e isz) env =
     case (sz, bir_eval_exp wb_e env) of
         (Bit1, SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 wb))) =>
            SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (WI_distinct_MEM_UNCHANGED_COMPUTE (n2w mb_n) (n2w me_n) wb isz)))
       | (Bit8, SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm8 wb))) =>
            SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (WI_distinct_MEM_UNCHANGED_COMPUTE (n2w mb_n) (n2w me_n) wb isz)))
       | (Bit16, SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm16 wb))) =>
            SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (WI_distinct_MEM_UNCHANGED_COMPUTE (n2w mb_n) (n2w me_n) wb isz)))
       | (Bit32, SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm32 wb))) =>
            SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (WI_distinct_MEM_UNCHANGED_COMPUTE (n2w mb_n) (n2w me_n) wb isz)))
       | (Bit64, SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 wb))) =>
            SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (WI_distinct_MEM_UNCHANGED_COMPUTE (n2w mb_n) (n2w me_n) wb isz)))
       | (Bit128, SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm128 wb))) =>
            SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b (WI_distinct_MEM_UNCHANGED_COMPUTE (n2w mb_n) (n2w me_n) wb isz)))
       | _ => NONE)
