name: WI_size_def
statement: WI_size s sz = WI_end s (sz + s)

name: WI_wf_def
statement: WI_wf (WI_end b e) <=> (b <=+ e)

name: WI_MEM_def
statement: WI_MEM w (WI_end b e) <=> (b <=+ w) /\ (w <+ e)

name: WI_ELEM_LIST_def
statement:
(WI_ELEM_LIST b 0 = []) /\
  (WI_ELEM_LIST b (SUC n) = b::(WI_ELEM_LIST (b+1w) n))

name: WI_is_empty_def
statement: WI_is_empty i <=> !w. ~(WI_MEM w i)

name: WI_wfe_def
statement: WI_wfe i <=> (WI_wf i /\ ~(WI_is_empty i))

name: WI_is_sub_def
statement: WI_is_sub i1 i2 <=> (!w. WI_MEM w i1 ==> WI_MEM w i2)

name: WI_overlap_def
statement: WI_overlap i1 i2 <=> (?w. WI_MEM w i1 /\ WI_MEM w i2)

name: WI_distinct_def
statement: WI_distinct i1 i2 <=> ~(WI_overlap i1 i2)

name: WI_distinct_MEM_UNCHANGED_COMPUTE_def
statement:
WI_distinct_MEM_UNCHANGED_COMPUTE (mb : 'a word) (me : 'a word) (wb : 'a word) sz =
    (wb <=+ n2w ((dimword (:'a) - 1) - sz) /\
    ((mb <+ wb \/ (n2w sz + wb <=+ mb)) /\
    ((wb <+ mb \/ me <=+ wb))))

name: BExp_unchanged_mem_interval_distinct_def
statement:
BExp_unchanged_mem_interval_distinct sz mb_n me_n wb_e isz =
     (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And
        (BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessOrEqual wb_e
           (BExp_Const (n2bs ((2 ** (size_of_bir_immtype sz) − 1 − isz)) sz)))
        (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And
           (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or
              (BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessThan (BExp_Const (n2bs mb_n sz))
                 wb_e)
              (BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessOrEqual
                 (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus (BExp_Const (n2bs isz sz))
                    wb_e) (BExp_Const (n2bs mb_n sz))))
           (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or
              (BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessThan wb_e
                 (BExp_Const (n2bs mb_n sz)))
              (BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessOrEqual
                 (BExp_Const (n2bs me_n sz)) wb_e))))

name: FUNS_EQ_OUTSIDE_WI_size_def
statement:
FUNS_EQ_OUTSIDE_WI_size (b:'a word) (sz : num) (f1 : 'a word -> 'b) (f2 : 'a word -> 'b) <=>
  ((WI_wf (WI_size b (n2w sz))) ==>
  (!a. ~(WI_MEM a (WI_size b (n2w sz))) ==>
       (f1 a = f2 a)))

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_DEF

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_N_CARRY_DEF
statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w1 w2 = awc_BIR_N w1 (~w2) T

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z_CARRY_DEF
statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w1 w2 = awc_BIR_Z w1 (~w2) T

statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_ADD_N w1 w2 = awc_BIR_N w1 w2 F

name: nzcv_BIR_ADD_Z_CARRY_DEF
statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_ADD_Z w1 w2 = awc_BIR_Z w1 w2 F

name: nzcv_BIR_ADD_C_CARRY_DEF
statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_ADD_C w1 w2 = awc_BIR_C w1 w2 F

statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_ADD_V w1 w2 = awc_BIR_V w1 w2 F

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_N_raw
statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w1 w2 = (w1 - w2 < 0w)

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z_raw
statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w1 w2 = (w1 - w2 = 0w)

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_C_raw
statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_SUB_C w1 w2 = (w1 >=+ w2)

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_V_raw
statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2 = ((w1 - w2 < 0w) <=> (w1 >= w2))

name: nzcv_BIR_ADD_C_raw
statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_ADD_C w1 w2 = ((w1 >=+ -w2) /\ (w2 <> 0w))

name: awc_BIR_C_raw
statement: !w1 w2 c. awc_BIR_C w1 w2 c = (if c then w1 >=+ ~w2 else (w1 >+ ~w2))

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_V_raw
statement: !w1 w2. nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2 = ((w1 - w2 < 0w) <=> (w1 >= w2))

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_NZCV_REWRS
statement:
(!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w1 w2 <=> w1 - w2 < 0w) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w1 w2 <=> (w1 = w2)) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_SUB_C w1 w2 <=> w2 <=+ w1) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2 <=> (w1 - w2 < 0w <=> w2 <= w1))

name: nzcv_BIR_ADD_NZCV_REWRS
statement:
(!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_ADD_N w1 w2 <=> w1 + w2 < 0w) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_ADD_Z w1 w2 <=> (w1 = -w2)) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_ADD_C w1 w2 <=> ~w2 <+ w1) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_ADD_V w1 w2 <=> ((w1 < 0w <=> w2 < 0w) /\ (w1 + w2 < 0w <=/=> w1 < 0w)))

name: awc_BIR_NZCV_REWRS
statement:
(!w1 (w2:'a word) c. awc_BIR_N w1 w2 c <=> w1 + w2 + (if c then 1w else 0w) < 0w) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word) c. awc_BIR_Z w1 w2 c <=> (w1 + w2 + (if c then 1w else 0w) = 0w)) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word) c. awc_BIR_C w1 w2 c <=> (if c then ~w2 <=+ w1 else (~w2 <+ w1))) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word) c. awc_BIR_V w1 w2 c <=> ((w1 < 0w <=> w2 < 0w) /\ (w1 + w2 + (if c then 1w else 0w) < 0w <=/=> w1 < 0w)))

name: nzcv_BIR_ADD_SYM
statement:
(!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_ADD_N w1 w2 <=> nzcv_BIR_ADD_N w2 w1) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_ADD_Z w1 w2 <=> nzcv_BIR_ADD_Z w2 w1) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_ADD_C w1 w2 <=> nzcv_BIR_ADD_C w2 w1) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word). nzcv_BIR_ADD_V w1 w2 <=> nzcv_BIR_ADD_V w2 w1)

name: awc_BIR_NZCV_SYM
statement:
(!w1 (w2:'a word) c. awc_BIR_N w1 w2 c <=> awc_BIR_N w2 w1 c) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word) c. awc_BIR_Z w1 w2 c <=> awc_BIR_Z w2 w1 c) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word) c. awc_BIR_C w1 w2 c <=> awc_BIR_C w2 w1 c) /\
  (!w1 (w2:'a word) c. awc_BIR_V w1 w2 c <=> awc_BIR_V w2 w1 c)

name: awc_BIR_NZVC_ELIMS_SYM

statement:
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_EQ    w1 w2 <=> (w1 = w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_NE    w1 w2 <=> ~(w1 = w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_CS_HS w1 w2 <=> (w2 <=+ w1))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_CC_LO w1 w2 <=> (w1 <+ w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_MI    w1 w2 <=> (w1 - w2 < 0w))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_PL    w1 w2 <=> (0w <= w1 - w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_VS    w1 w2 <=> (nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_VC    w1 w2 <=> ~(nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_HI    w1 w2 <=> (w1 >+ w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_LS    w1 w2 <=> (w1 <=+ w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_GE    w1 w2 <=> (w1 >= w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_LT    w1 w2 <=> (w1 < w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_GT    w1 w2 <=> (w1 > w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_LE    w1 w2 <=> (w1 <= w2))) /\
(!(w1:'a word) (w2:'a word). (nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_AL    w1 w2 <=> T))

name: awc_BIR_C_def
statement: awc_BIR_C w1 w2 c = FST (SND (add_with_carry (w1, w2, c)))

name: awc_BIR_V_def
statement: awc_BIR_V w1 w2 c = SND (SND (add_with_carry (w1, w2, c)))

name: awc_BIR_N_def
statement: awc_BIR_N w1 w2 c = (w1 + w2 + (if c then 1w else 0w) < 0w)

name: awc_BIR_Z_def
statement: awc_BIR_Z w1 w2 c = (w1 + w2 + (if c then 1w else 0w) = 0w)

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_N_def
statement: nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w1 w2 = (let (n, z, c, v) = nzcv w1 w2 in n)

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z_def
statement: nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w1 w2 = (let (n, z, c, v) = nzcv w1 w2 in z)

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_C_def
statement: nzcv_BIR_SUB_C w1 w2 = (let (n, z, c, v) = nzcv w1 w2 in c)

name: nzcv_BIR_SUB_V_def
statement: nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2 = (let (n, z, c, v) = nzcv w1 w2 in v)

name: nzcv_BIR_ADD_V_def
statement:
nzcv_BIR_ADD_V (w1 : 'a word) (w2 : 'a word) <=>
   ((word_msb w1 <=> word_msb w2) /\
    (word_msb (w1 + w2) <=/=> word_msb w1))

name: nzcv_BIR_ADD_C_def
statement:
nzcv_BIR_ADD_C (w1 : 'a word) (w2 : 'a word) <=>
   BIT (dimindex (:'a)) (w2n w1 + w2n w2)

name: nzcv_BIR_ADD_Z_def
statement:
nzcv_BIR_ADD_Z (w1 : 'a word) (w2 : 'a word) <=>
   nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w1 (-w2)

name: nzcv_BIR_ADD_N_def
statement:
nzcv_BIR_ADD_N (w1 : 'a word) (w2 : 'a word) <=>
   nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w1 (-w2)

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_EQ_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_EQ    w1 w2 <=> nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w1 w2

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_NE_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_NE    w1 w2 <=> ~(nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w1 w2)

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_CS_HS_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_CS_HS w1 w2 <=> nzcv_BIR_SUB_C w1 w2

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_CC_LO_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_CC_LO w1 w2 <=> ~(nzcv_BIR_SUB_C w1 w2)

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_MI_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_MI    w1 w2 <=> (nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w1 w2)

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_PL_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_PL    w1 w2 <=> ~(nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w1 w2)

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_VS_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_VS    w1 w2 <=> (nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2)

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_VC_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_VC    w1 w2 <=> ~(nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2)

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_HI_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_HI    w1 w2 <=> (nzcv_BIR_SUB_C w1 w2) /\ ~(nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w1 w2)

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_LS_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_LS    w1 w2 <=> ~(nzcv_BIR_SUB_C w1 w2) \/ (nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w1 w2)

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_GE_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_GE    w1 w2 <=> (nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w1 w2 <=> nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2)

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_LT_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_LT    w1 w2 <=> ~(nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w1 w2 <=> nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2)

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_GT_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_GT    w1 w2 <=> (((nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w1 w2 <=> nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2)) /\ ~(nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w1 w2))

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_LE_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_LE    w1 w2 <=> (~((nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w1 w2 <=> nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w1 w2)) \/ (nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w1 w2))

name: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_AL_def
statement: nzcv_SUB_COND_CODE_AL    (w1 : 'a word) (w2:'a word) <=> T

name: BExp_nzcv_SUB_N_def
statement:
BExp_nzcv_SUB_N sz e1 e2 =
   BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Minus e1 e2)
        (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz))

name: BExp_nzcv_SUB_Z_def
statement:
BExp_nzcv_SUB_Z e1 e2 =
   BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal e1 e2

name: BExp_nzcv_SUB_C_def
statement:
BExp_nzcv_SUB_C e1 e2 =
   BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessOrEqual e2 e1

name: BExp_nzcv_SUB_V_def
statement:
BExp_nzcv_SUB_V sz e1 e2 =
(BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal
        (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan
           (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Minus e1 e2) (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz)))
        (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessOrEqual e2 e1))

name: BExp_nzcv_ADD_N_def
statement:
BExp_nzcv_ADD_N sz e1 e2 =
   BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus e1 e2)
        (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz))

name: BExp_nzcv_ADD_Z_def
statement:
BExp_nzcv_ADD_Z e1 e2 =
   BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal e1 (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_ChangeSign e2)

name: BExp_nzcv_ADD_C_def
statement:
BExp_nzcv_ADD_C e1 e2 =
   BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessThan (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not e2) e1

name: BExp_nzcv_ADD_V_def
statement:
BExp_nzcv_ADD_V sz e1 e2 =
     (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And
        (BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal
           (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan e1
              (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz)))
           (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan e2
              (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz))))
        (
           (BExp_BinPred BIExp_NotEqual
              (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan
                 (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus e1 e2) (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz)))
              (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan e1
                 (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz))))))

name: BExp_ADD_WITH_CARRY_N_def
statement:
BExp_ADD_WITH_CARRY_N sz e1 e2 ec =
   BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus e1
        (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus e2 (BExp_IfThenElse ec (BExp_Const (n2bs 1 sz)) (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz)))))
        (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz))

name: BExp_ADD_WITH_CARRY_Z_def
statement:
BExp_ADD_WITH_CARRY_Z sz e1 e2 ec =
   BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus e1
        (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus e2 (BExp_IfThenElse ec (BExp_Const (n2bs 1 sz)) (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz)))))
        (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz))

name: BExp_ADD_WITH_CARRY_C_def
statement:
BExp_ADD_WITH_CARRY_C e1 e2 ec =
   BExp_IfThenElse ec
     (BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessOrEqual (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not e2) e1)
     (BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessThan (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not e2) e1)

name: BExp_ADD_WITH_CARRY_V_def
statement:
BExp_ADD_WITH_CARRY_V sz e1 e2 ec =
     (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And
        (BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal
           (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan e1
              (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz)))
           (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan e2
              (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz))))
        (BExp_BinPred BIExp_NotEqual
              (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan
                 (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus e1
                    (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Plus e2 (BExp_IfThenElse ec (BExp_Const (n2bs 1 sz)) (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz)))))
                  (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz)))
              (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan e1
                 (BExp_Const (n2bs 0 sz)))))

name: bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC_IS_EQUIV
statement:
(!st. bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st st) /\
    (!st1 st2. bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2 <=> (bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st2 st1)) /\
    (!st1 st2 st3. bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2 ==>
                   bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st2 st3 ==>
                   bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st3)

name: bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC_terminated
statement:
!st1 st2. bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2 ==>
     (bir_state_is_terminated st1 = bir_state_is_terminated st2)

name: bir_observation_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC_IS_EQUIV
statement:
(!ost. bir_observation_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC ost ost) /\
    (!ost1 ost2. bir_observation_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC ost1 ost2 <=>
                 bir_observation_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC ost2 ost1) /\
    (!ost1 ost2 ost3. bir_observation_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC ost1 ost2 ==>
                      bir_observation_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC ost2 ost3 ==>
                      bir_observation_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC ost1 ost3)

name: bir_exec_stmtB_pc_unimportant
statement:
!st1 st2 stmt.
     bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2 ==>
     bir_observation_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC (bir_exec_stmtB stmt st1) (bir_exec_stmtB stmt st2)

name: bir_exec_stmtE_pc_unimportant
statement:
!p st1 st2 stmt.
     bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2 ==>
     bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st1) (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st2)

name: bir_exec_stmtE_pc_unimportant_strong
statement:
!p st1 st2 stmt.
     bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2 /\ ~(bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st1)) ==>
     (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st1 = bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st2)

name: bir_exec_stmt_pc_unimportant
statement:
!p st1 st2 stmt.
     bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2 ==>
     bir_observation_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC (bir_exec_stmt p stmt st1) (bir_exec_stmt p stmt st2)

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_exists
statement:
!stmtsB l c st.
      ?l' c' st'.
        bir_exec_stmtsB stmtsB (l,c,st) = (l', c', st')

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_REWRS
statement:
(!l c st. bir_exec_stmtsB [] (l, c, st) = (REVERSE l, c, st)) /\
    (!stmts l c st. bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
       (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, c, st) = (REVERSE l, c, st))) /\
    (!stmts stmt l c st. ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
       (bir_exec_stmtsB (stmt::stmts) (l, c, st) =
        let (fe, st') = bir_exec_stmtB stmt st in
        bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (OPT_CONS fe l, SUC c, st')))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_REWRS_COND
statement:
(!l c st. (bir_exec_stmtsB [] (l, c, st) = (REVERSE l, c, st))) /\
    (!stmt stmts l c st. (bir_exec_stmtsB (stmt::stmts) (l, c, st) =
       if (bir_state_is_terminated st) then (REVERSE l, c, st) else
       let (fe, st') = bir_exec_stmtB stmt st in
       bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (OPT_CONS fe l, SUC c, st')))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_APPEND
statement:
!stmts1 stmts2 l c st. (bir_exec_stmtsB (stmts1 ++ stmts2) (l, c, st) =
       let (l', c', st') = bir_exec_stmtsB stmts1 (l, c, st) in
       bir_exec_stmtsB stmts2 (REVERSE l', c', st'))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_RESET_ACCUMULATOR_COUNTER
statement:
!l c stmts st. (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, c, st) =
                   (let (l', c', st') = bir_exec_stmtsB stmts ([], 0, st) in
                   ((REVERSE l) ++ l', c+c', st')))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_RESET_ACCUMULATOR
statement:
!l c stmts st. (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, c, st) =
                   (let (l', c', st') = bir_exec_stmtsB stmts ([], c, st) in
                   ((REVERSE l) ++ l', c', st')))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_RESET_COUNTER
statement:
!l c stmts st. (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, c, st) =
                   (let (l', c', st') = bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, 0, st) in
                   (l', c+c', st')))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_REWR_NO_STEP
statement:
!l c st l' st' stmts. (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, c, st) = (l', c, st')) <=>
       ((l' = REVERSE l) /\ (st' = st) /\
       ((bir_state_is_terminated st) \/ (stmts = [])))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_pc_unchanged
statement:
!stmts st1 st2 m c l l'.
     (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, m, st1) = (l', c, st2)) ==>
     (st2.bst_pc = st1.bst_pc)

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_pc_unimportant
statement:
!stmts l st1 st2 st1' st2' m c1 c2 l1 l2.
     bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2 /\
     (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, m, st1) = (l1, c1, st1')) /\
     (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, m, st2) = (l2, c2, st2')) ==>

     ((l1 = l2) /\ (c1 = c2) /\ (bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1' st2'))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_pc_unimportant_EVAL
statement:
!stmts st1 st2 st1' m c l l'.
     bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2 /\
     (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, m, st1) = (l', c, st1')) ==>

     (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, m, st2) = (l', c, (st1' with bst_pc := st2.bst_pc)))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_COUNTER
statement:
!stmts st l l' c c' st'. (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, c, st) = (l', c', st')) ==>
                             (c <= c')

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_COUNTER_EQ
statement:
!stmts st l l' c st'. (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, c, st) = (l', c, st')) ==>
                             ((st' = st) /\ (l' = REVERSE l))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_not_terminated_COUNTER
statement:
!stmts m st c st' l l'.
  (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, m, st) = (l', c, st')) /\
  (~(bir_state_is_terminated st')) ==>
  (c = (m + LENGTH stmts))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_SEMANTICS
statement:
!p i bl c st m l0.
    (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p (st.bst_pc.bpc_label) = SOME (i, bl)) /\
    (c + st.bst_pc.bpc_index <= LENGTH bl.bb_statements) ==> !n1 st1 n2 st2 l1 l2.

    (bir_exec_stmtsB (SEG c st.bst_pc.bpc_index bl.bb_statements) (l0, m, st) = (l1, n1, st1)) /\
    (bir_exec_step_n p st c = (l2, n2, st2)) ==>

    ((n2 = n1 - m) /\
     (l1 = REVERSE l0 ++ l2) /\
    (bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2) /\
    (st1.bst_pc = st.bst_pc) /\
    (st2.bst_pc = st.bst_pc with bpc_index := (st.bst_pc.bpc_index +
       (if bir_state_is_terminated st2 then PRE n2 else n2))))

name: bir_get_current_block_SOME
statement:
!p pc bl. (bir_get_current_block p pc = SOME bl) <=>
              (?i. (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p pc.bpc_label = SOME (i, bl)) /\
                  (pc.bpc_index = 0))

name: bir_get_current_block_block_pc_IS_SOME
statement:
!p l. IS_SOME (bir_get_current_block p (bir_block_pc l)) <=>
          MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p)

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_SEMANTICS_WHOLE_BLOCK
statement:
!p bl st n1 st1 l1 n2 st2 l2.
    (bir_get_current_block p st.bst_pc = SOME bl) /\

    (bir_exec_stmtsB bl.bb_statements ([], 0, st) = (l1, n1, st1)) /\
    (bir_exec_step_n p st (LENGTH bl.bb_statements) = (l2, n2, st2)) ==>

    ((n2 = n1) /\ (l2 = l1) /\
    (bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2) /\
    (st1.bst_pc = st.bst_pc) /\
    (st2.bst_pc = st.bst_pc with bpc_index := (st.bst_pc.bpc_index +
       (if bir_state_is_terminated st2 then PRE n2 else n2))))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_not_jumped
statement:
!stmts l c st ll l' c' st'.
st.bst_status <> BST_JumpOutside ll ==>
(bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l,c,st) = (l',c',st')) ==>
st'.bst_status <> BST_JumpOutside ll

name: bir_exec_block_exists
statement:
!prog bl st.
      ?l' c' st'.
        bir_exec_block prog bl st = (l', c', st')

name: bir_exec_block_REWR_TERMINATED
statement:
!p bl st. bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
             (bir_exec_block p bl st = ([], 0, st))

name: bir_exec_block_REWR_NO_STEP
statement:
!p bl st. (bir_exec_block p bl st = (ol, 0, st')) <=>
             (ol = []) /\ (bir_state_is_terminated st) /\ (st' = st)

name: bir_exec_block_n_1_TO_step_n
statement:
!p bl st.
    (bir_get_current_block p st.bst_pc = SOME bl) ==>

    (bir_exec_block_n p st 1 = (
       let (ol, c, st') = bir_exec_step_n p st (bir_block_size bl) in
       (ol, c, (if (0 < c) /\ (bir_state_COUNT_PC (F, \pc. pc.bpc_index = 0) st') then 1 else 0), st')))

name: bir_exec_block_SEMANTICS_step_n
statement:
!p bl st.
    (bir_get_current_block p st.bst_pc = SOME bl) ==>

    (bir_exec_block p bl st = bir_exec_step_n p st (bir_block_size bl))

name: bir_exec_block_SEMANTICS
statement:
!p bl st.
    (bir_get_current_block p st.bst_pc = SOME bl) ==>

    (bir_exec_block_n p st 1 = (
       let (ol, st_c, st') = bir_exec_block p bl st in
       (ol, st_c, (if (0 < st_c /\ bir_state_COUNT_PC (F, \pc. pc.bpc_index = 0) st') then 1 else 0), st')))

name: bir_exec_stmtE_new_block_pc
statement:
!st p stmt. let st' = bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st in
                ~(bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
                IS_SOME (bir_get_current_block p st'.bst_pc)

name: bir_get_current_statement_NONE_stmt
statement:
!prog pc.
      (bir_get_current_statement prog pc = NONE) ==>
      (bir_get_current_block prog pc = NONE)

name: bir_exec_block_new_block_pc
statement:
!p bl st st' c l.
    (bir_get_current_block p st.bst_pc = SOME bl) /\
    (bir_exec_block p bl st = (l, c, st')) /\
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
    (IS_SOME (bir_get_current_block p st'.bst_pc))

name: bir_exec_step_n_block
statement:
!p st bl n.
       (bir_get_current_block p st.bst_pc = SOME bl) /\
       (bir_block_size bl <= n) ==>

    (bir_exec_step_n p st n =
      let (l1, c1, st1) = bir_exec_block p bl st in
      let (l2, c2, st2) = bir_exec_step_n p st1 (n - bir_block_size bl) in
      (l1 ++ l2, c1+c2, st2))

name: bir_exec_block_n_block
statement:
!p st bl n.
       (bir_get_current_block p st.bst_pc = SOME bl) ==>

    (bir_exec_block_n p st (SUC n) =
      let (l1, c1, st1) = bir_exec_block p bl st in
      let (l2, c2, c_bl2, st2) = bir_exec_block_n p st1 n in
      (l1 ++ l2, c1+c2, if (0 < c1 /\ bir_state_COUNT_PC (F, \pc. pc.bpc_index = 0) st1) then
          SUC c_bl2 else c_bl2, st2))

name: bir_exec_steps_block
statement:
!p st bl.
       (bir_get_current_block p st.bst_pc = SOME bl) ==>

    (bir_exec_steps p st =
      let (l1, c1, st1) = bir_exec_block p bl st in
      case bir_exec_steps p st1 of
        BER_Looping ll2 => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2)
      | BER_Ended l2 c2 c2' st2 =>
        BER_Ended (l1++l2) (c1 + c2) (c1 + c2') st2)

name: bir_exec_steps_block_GUARD
statement:
!p st bl.
       (bir_get_current_block p st.bst_pc = SOME bl) ==>

    (bir_exec_steps p st =
      let (l1, c1, st1) = bir_exec_block p bl st in
      if c1 < bir_block_size bl then BER_Ended l1 c1 c1 st1
      else (
        case bir_exec_steps p st1 of
          BER_Looping ll2 => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2)
        | BER_Ended l2 c2 c2' st2 =>
          BER_Ended (l1++l2) (c1 + c2) (c1 + c2') st2))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_block
statement:
!ls p st n bl.
       (bir_get_current_block p st.bst_pc = SOME bl) ==>

    (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st (SUC n) =
      let (l1, c1, st1) = bir_exec_block p bl st in
      let c1' = if (0 < c1) /\ (bir_state_COUNT_PC (F,
         \pc. (pc.bpc_index = 0) /\ (pc.bpc_label IN ls)) st1) then 1 else 0 in
      case bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st1 (SUC n-c1') of
        BER_Looping ll2 => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2)
      | BER_Ended l2 c2 c2' st2 =>
        BER_Ended (l1++l2) (c1 + c2) (c1' + c2') st2)

name: bir_exec_to_labels_block
statement:
!ls p st bl.
       (bir_get_current_block p st.bst_pc = SOME bl) ==>

    (bir_exec_to_labels ls p st =
      let (l1, c1, st1) = bir_exec_block p bl st in
      if (0 < c1) /\ (bir_state_COUNT_PC (F,
         \pc. (pc.bpc_index = 0) /\ (pc.bpc_label IN ls)) st1) then
         BER_Ended l1 c1 1 st1
      else
      case bir_exec_to_labels ls p st1 of
        BER_Looping ll2 => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2)
      | BER_Ended l2 c2 c2' st2 =>
        BER_Ended (l1++l2) (c1 + c2) c2' st2)

name: bir_changed_vars_of_exec_stmtsB_THM
statement:
!stmts st ol n.
   bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS (bir_varset_COMPL (BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_changed_vars_of_stmtB (set stmts))))
        (let (ol', n', st') = (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (ol, n, st)) in
         st'.bst_environ) (st.bst_environ)

name: bir_changed_vars_of_block_THM
statement:
!(p:'a bir_program_t) (bl:'a bir_block_t) st.
   (bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS (bir_varset_COMPL (bir_changed_vars_of_block bl))
        (let (ol, n, st') = (bir_exec_block p bl st) in
         st'.bst_environ) (st.bst_environ))

name: bir_vars_of_exec_stmtsB_THM
statement:
!vs (stmts :'a bir_stmt_basic_t list) st1 st2 l n.
    (BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_stmtB (set stmts)) SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (let (ol1, n1, st1') = bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, n, st1) in
     let (ol2, n2, st2') = bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, n, st2) in
     ((ol1 = ol2) /\ (n1 = n2) /\ (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2')))

name: bir_vars_of_block_THM
statement:
!(p : 'a bir_program_t) vs (bl :'a bir_block_t) st1 st2.
    (bir_vars_of_block bl SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (let (ol1, n1, st1') = bir_exec_block p bl st1 in
     let (ol2, n2, st2') = bir_exec_block p bl st2 in
     ((ol1 = ol2) /\ (n1 = n2) /\ (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2')))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_ENV_ORDER
statement:
!stmts l n st.
  bir_env_order st.bst_environ
    (SND (SND (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, n, st)))).bst_environ

name: bir_exec_block_ENV_ORDER
statement:
!p st bl.
  bir_env_order st.bst_environ
    (SND (SND (bir_exec_block p bl st))).bst_environ

name: bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC_def
statement:
bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC st1 st2 <=>
  ((st1 with bst_pc := ARB) = (st2 with bst_pc := ARB))

name: bir_observation_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC_def
statement:
bir_observation_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC ost1 ost2 = (
    (FST ost1 = FST ost2) /\ (bir_states_EQ_EXCEPT_PC (SND ost1) (SND ost2)))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_def
statement:
(bir_exec_stmtsB [] (l, c, st) = (REVERSE l, c, st)) /\
  (bir_exec_stmtsB (stmt::stmts) (l, c, st) =
     if (bir_state_is_terminated st) then (REVERSE l, c, st) else
     let (fe, st') = bir_exec_stmtB stmt st in
     bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (OPT_CONS fe l, SUC c, st'))

name: bir_get_current_block_def
statement:
bir_get_current_block p pc = if pc.bpc_index <> 0 then NONE else
     (option_CASE (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p pc.bpc_label) NONE (\ibl. SOME (SND ibl)))

name: bir_block_size_def
statement: bir_block_size bl = SUC (LENGTH bl.bb_statements)

name: bir_exec_block_def
statement:
bir_exec_block (p:'a bir_program_t) (bl:'a bir_block_t) st =
  let (l, c, st') = bir_exec_stmtsB bl.bb_statements ([], 0, st) in
  (if (bir_state_is_terminated st') then
    (l, c, st' with bst_pc := (st.bst_pc with bpc_index := st.bst_pc.bpc_index + PRE c))
  else
    (l, SUC c,
        let st'' = bir_exec_stmtE p bl.bb_last_statement st' in
        if (bir_state_is_terminated st'') then
          (st'' with bst_pc := (st.bst_pc with bpc_index := st.bst_pc.bpc_index + c))
        else st''))

name: bir_state_set_failed_SAME_ENV
statement: !st. (bir_state_set_failed st).bst_environ = st.bst_environ

name: bir_state_set_typeerror_SAME_ENV
statement: !st. (bir_state_set_typeerror st).bst_environ = st.bst_environ

name: bir_exec_stmt_assume_SAME_ENV
statement: !e st. (bir_exec_stmt_assume e st).bst_environ = st.bst_environ

name: bir_exec_stmt_assert_SAME_ENV
statement: !e st. (bir_exec_stmt_assert e st).bst_environ = st.bst_environ

name: bir_exec_stmt_observe_SAME_ENV
statement: !oid ec el obf st. (SND (bir_exec_stmt_observe oid ec el obf st)).bst_environ = st.bst_environ

name: bir_exec_stmt_assign_ENV
statement:
!v e st.
      (bir_exec_stmt_assign v e st).bst_environ =
      case (bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ) of
        | NONE => st.bst_environ
	| SOME va => 
      (case bir_env_write v va st.bst_environ of
         | SOME env => env
         | NONE => st.bst_environ)

name: bir_exec_stmtB_ENV_ORDER
statement: !st stmt. bir_env_order st.bst_environ (bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st).bst_environ

name: bir_exec_stmt_ENV_ORDER
statement: !p st stmt. bir_env_order st.bst_environ (bir_exec_stmt_state p stmt st).bst_environ

name: bir_exec_step_ENV_ORDER
statement: !p st. bir_env_order st.bst_environ (bir_exec_step_state p st).bst_environ

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_ENV_ORDER
statement: !p n st. bir_env_order st.bst_environ (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n).bst_environ

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_ENV_ORDER
statement:
!pc_cond p st mo c_st c_pc st' ol. (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st mo = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
  bir_env_order st.bst_environ st'.bst_environ

name: bir_exec_steps_ENV_ORDER
statement:
!p st c_st c_pc st' ol. (bir_exec_steps p st = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
  bir_env_order st.bst_environ st'.bst_environ

name: bir_exec_step_n_ENV_ORDER
statement:
!l p c n st st'. (bir_exec_step_n p st n = (l, c, st')) ==>
  bir_env_order st.bst_environ st'.bst_environ

name: bir_exec_block_n_ENV_ORDER
statement:
!p st n st' c c' l. (bir_exec_block_n p st n = (l, c, c', st')) ==>
  bir_env_order st.bst_environ st'.bst_environ

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_ENV_ORDER
statement:
!ls p st n c_st c_pc st' ol. (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st n = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
  bir_env_order st.bst_environ st'.bst_environ

name: LENGTH_num_to_hex_string
statement: LENGTH (num_to_hex_string n) = (if n = 0 then 1 else SUC (LOG 16 n))

name: LENGTH_num_to_hex_string_fixwidth
statement:
!w n. (0 < w /\ n < 16 ** w) ==>
        (LENGTH (num_to_hex_string_fix_width w n) = w+2)

name: MEM_REPLICATE_EQ
statement: !x y n. MEM x (REPLICATE n y) <=> ((0 < n) /\ (x = y))

name: num_from_hex_string_fix_width
statement: !w n. num_from_hex_string (DROP 2 (num_to_hex_string_fix_width w n)) = n

name: num_to_hex_string_PREFIX
statement: !w n. TAKE 2 (num_to_hex_string_fix_width w n) = "0x"

name: LENGTH_b2s
statement:
!i. LENGTH (b2s i) = case type_of_bir_imm i of
     Bit1   => 3
   | Bit8   => 4
   | Bit16  => 6
   | Bit32  => 10
   | Bit64  => 18
   | Bit128 => 34

name: s2b_b2s
statement: !b. s2b (b2s b) = SOME b

name: INDEX_OF_b2s_STRCAT
statement: !b s. INDEX_OF #"_" (STRCAT (b2s b) (STRING #"_" s)) = SOME (LENGTH (b2s b))

name: BL_Label_of_addr_SPLIT
statement:
!b s s'. (BL_Label_of_addr b s' = BL_Label s) <=>
           (?i. (INDEX_OF #"_" s = SOME i) /\
                (TAKE i s = b2s b) /\
                (DROP (SUC i) s = s'))

name: bir_immediate_of_label_string_THM
statement:
!b s' s. (BL_Label_of_addr b s' = BL_Label s) ==>
           (bir_immediate_of_label_string s = SOME b)

name: BL_Label_of_addr_11
statement: !b1 b2 s1 s2. (BL_Label_of_addr b1 s1 = BL_Label_of_addr b2 s2) <=> ((b1 = b2) /\ (s1 = s2))

name: IS_BL_Address_NOT
statement: !l. ~(IS_BL_Address l) <=> IS_BL_Label l

name: IS_BL_Label_NOT
statement: !l. ~(IS_BL_Label l) <=> IS_BL_Address l

name: IS_BL_Address_EXISTS
statement: !l. IS_BL_Address l <=> ?i. (l = BL_Address i)

name: IS_BL_Label_EXISTS
statement: !l. IS_BL_Label l <=> ?s. (l = BL_Label s)

name: BL_recognisers
statement:
(!l. (IS_BL_Label (BL_Label l))) /\
  (!l. ~(IS_BL_Label (BL_Address l))) /\
  (!b s. (IS_BL_Label (BL_Label_of_addr b s))) /\
  (!l s. ~(IS_BL_Label (BL_Address_HC l s))) /\
  (!l. ~(IS_BL_Address (BL_Label l))) /\
  (!l. (IS_BL_Address (BL_Address l))) /\
  (!b s. ~(IS_BL_Address (BL_Label_of_addr b s))) /\
  (!l s. IS_BL_Address (BL_Address_HC l s))

name: BL_destructors
statement:
(!l. dest_BL_Label (BL_Label l) = l) /\
  (!b s. dest_BL_Label (BL_Label_of_addr b s) = (b2s b ++ #"_"::s)) /\
  (!b. dest_BL_Address (BL_Address b) = b) /\
  (!b s. dest_BL_Address (BL_Address_HC b s) = b)

name: bir_labels_of_program_REWRS
statement:
(bir_labels_of_program (BirProgram []) = []) /\
  (!bl bls. bir_labels_of_program (BirProgram (bl::bls)) =
            (bl.bb_label :: bir_labels_of_program (BirProgram bls)))

name: bir_label_addresses_of_program_REWRS
statement:
(bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels [] = []) /\
    (!l ls. (bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels ((BL_Label l)::ls) =
             bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels ls)) /\
    (!l i ls. (bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels ((BL_Label_of_addr i l)::ls) =
               bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels ls)) /\
    (!i ls. (bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels ((BL_Address i)::ls) =
               (b2n i)::(bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels ls))) /\
    (!i s ls. (bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels ((BL_Address_HC i s)::ls) =
               (b2n i)::(bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels ls)))

name: num_to_hex_string_fix_width_def
statement:
num_to_hex_string_fix_width w n =
  let s = num_to_hex_string n in
  "0x" ++ (if LENGTH s < w then APPEND (REPLICATE (w - LENGTH s) #"0") s else s)

name: b2s_def
statement:
(b2s ( Imm1   w ) = num_to_hex_string_fix_width 1  (w2n w)) /\
  (b2s ( Imm8   w ) = num_to_hex_string_fix_width 2  (w2n w)) /\
  (b2s ( Imm16  w ) = num_to_hex_string_fix_width 4  (w2n w)) /\
  (b2s ( Imm32  w ) = num_to_hex_string_fix_width 8  (w2n w)) /\
  (b2s ( Imm64  w ) = num_to_hex_string_fix_width 16 (w2n w)) /\
  (b2s ( Imm128 w ) = num_to_hex_string_fix_width 32 (w2n w))

name: s2b_def
statement:
s2b s =
  if (TAKE 2 s <> "0x") then NONE else
  (let n = num_from_hex_string (DROP 2 s) in
  (case (LENGTH s) of
      3 => SOME (n2bs n Bit1)
    | 4 => SOME (n2bs n Bit8)
    | 6 => SOME (n2bs n Bit16)
    | 10 => SOME (n2bs n Bit32)
    | 18 => SOME (n2bs n Bit64)
    | 34 => SOME (n2bs n Bit128)
    | _ => NONE))

name: BL_Label_of_addr_def
statement:
BL_Label_of_addr (i:bir_imm_t) s =
  BL_Label (STRCAT (b2s i) (#"_"::s))

name: bir_immediate_of_label_string_def
statement:
bir_immediate_of_label_string s =
   case INDEX_OF #"_" s of
      NONE => NONE
    | SOME i => s2b (TAKE i s)

name: BL_Address_HC_def
statement:
BL_Address_HC b (hc:string) =
  BL_Address b

name: IS_BL_Label_def
statement:
(IS_BL_Label (BL_Label _) = T) /\
  (IS_BL_Label _ = F)

name: IS_BL_Address_def
statement:
(IS_BL_Address (BL_Address _) = T) /\
  (IS_BL_Address _ = F)

name: dest_BL_Label_def
statement: dest_BL_Label (BL_Label l) = l

name: dest_BL_Address_def
statement: dest_BL_Address (BL_Address b) = b

name: bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels_def
statement:
bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels l =
   (MAP (b2n o dest_BL_Address) (FILTER IS_BL_Address l))

name: bir_label_addresses_of_program_def
statement:
bir_label_addresses_of_program p =
  bir_label_addresses_of_program_labels (bir_labels_of_program p)

name: bir_program_addr_labels_sorted_def
statement:
bir_program_addr_labels_sorted p <=>
  SORTED $< (bir_label_addresses_of_program p)

name: bir_program_string_labels_guarded_def
statement:
bir_program_string_labels_guarded p <=>
    EVERY (\l. IS_BL_Label l ==> ?i s. (BL_Label_of_addr i s = l) /\
                                       (MEM (BL_Address i) (bir_labels_of_program p)))
      (bir_labels_of_program p)

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_REWRS2
statement:
(!p st. (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st 0 = st)) /\
  (!p st n. (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st (SUC n) =
     bir_exec_step_state p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n)))

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_ADD
statement:
!p st n1 n2. (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n1) n2) =
                 bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st (n1 + n2)

name: bir_exec_step_REWR_TERMINATED
statement:
!p st.
   bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
   (bir_exec_step p st = (NONE, st))

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_TERMINATED_0
statement:
!p st. bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
           (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st = K st)

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_TERMINATED
statement:
!p st n1. bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n1) ==>
                 (!n2. (n1 <= n2) ==> (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n2 =
                                       bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n1))

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_valid_pc
statement:
!p st n. bir_is_valid_pc p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n).bst_pc <=>
           bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_END_DEF
statement:
(!pc_cond p st.
      bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st 0 = 0) /\
   (!pc_cond p st n.
     bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st (SUC n) =
     (let r =
            bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p
              st n
      in
        if bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st (SUC n)) then SUC r
        else r))

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_ADD
statement:
!pc_cond p st n1 n2.
      bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st (n1 + n2) =
      (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st n1 +
       bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n1) n2)

name: IN_bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET
statement:
!i pc_cond p st. i IN (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET pc_cond p st) <=>
   (i <> 0) /\ (bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st i))

name: INTER_INSERT_aux
statement:
(s1 INTER (e INSERT s2)) =
  if (e IN s1) then e INSERT (s1 INTER s2) else (s1 INTER s2)

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_ALT_DEF
statement:
!pc_cond p i state. bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i =
  CARD ((bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET pc_cond p state) INTER
        (count (SUC i)))

name: bir_state_COUNT_PC_MONO
statement:
!pc_cond pc_cond'.
   (bir_pc_cond_impl pc_cond pc_cond') ==>
   (!st. bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st ==> bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond' st)

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_MONO_PC_COND
statement:
!pc_cond pc_cond' p state i.
   (bir_pc_cond_impl pc_cond pc_cond') ==>
   bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i <=
   bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond' p state i

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_LESS_EQ
statement:
!pc_cond p state i.
   bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i <= i

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_EQ
statement:
!pc_cond p state i.
   (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i = i) <=> (
   !j. j < i ==> bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state (SUC j)))

name: bir_state_COUNT_PC_ALL_STEPS
statement: !st. bir_state_COUNT_PC (T, \_. T) st

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_EQ_COUNT_ALL_STEPS
statement:
!p state i.
   (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs (T, \_. T) p state i = i)

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_MONO
statement:
!pc_cond p state i j.
   i <= j ==>
   bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i <=
   bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state j

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_COMPLETE
statement:
!pc_cond p state i c_j.
   (c_j < bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i) ==>
   (?j. j < i /\ (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state j = c_j))

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_COMPLETE_LESS_EQ
statement:
!pc_cond p state i c_j.
   (c_j <= bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i) ==>
   (?j. j <= i /\ (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state j = c_j))

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_COMPLETE_FORALL_NEQ
statement:
(!i. (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st i <> n)) <=>
  (!i. (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st i < n))

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_EQ_0
statement:
!pc_cond p state i.

   (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i = 0) <=> (
   !j. j < i ==> ~(bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state (SUC j))))

name: FINITE_bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET
statement:
!pc_cond p st c.
  (FINITE (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET pc_cond p st) /\
   CARD (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET pc_cond p st) < c) <=>
  (!i. bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st i < c)

name: INFINITE_bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET
statement:
!pc_cond p st.
  INFINITE (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET pc_cond p st) <=>
  (!c_i. ?i. bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st i = c_i)

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_block_starts_at_front
statement:
!p st n st_n i.
     (st_n = bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n) ==>
     ((bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n).bst_pc.bpc_index = i) ==>
     ~(bir_state_is_terminated st_n) ==>
     (i <= n) ==>

     ((bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st (n-i)).bst_pc =
      (st_n.bst_pc with bpc_index := 0))

name: bir_is_valid_pc_FINITE
statement: !p. FINITE {pc | bir_is_valid_pc p pc}

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_LOOPING_BLOCK_EXISTS
statement:
!p st.
   (!n. ~(bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n))) ==>
   ?l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) /\
       INFINITE {i | (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st i).bst_pc = bir_block_pc l}

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET_BLOCK_PC
statement:
!p pc_cond st.
   (!pc. (pc.bpc_index = 0) ==> (SND pc_cond) pc) ==>
   (!n. ~(bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n))) ==>
   INFINITE (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET pc_cond p st)

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS_UNFOLD
statement:
!pc_cond max_steps_opt p st.
    (bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond max_steps_opt p st =
     if (bir_state_is_terminated st \/ (max_steps_opt = SOME 0)) then SOME 0 else
     (let st' = bir_exec_step_state p st in
      let max_steps_opt' = if (bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st') then OPT_NUM_PRE max_steps_opt else max_steps_opt in
      OPT_NUM_SUC (bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond max_steps_opt' p st')))

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS_TERMINATED_REWR
statement:
!pc_cond max_steps p st.
    bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
    (bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond max_steps p st = SOME 0)

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS_NO_STEPS_REWR
statement:
!pc_cond p st.
    (bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond (SOME 0) p st = SOME 0)

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS_STEP_REWR
statement:
!pc_cond p st max_steps.
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) /\ ~(max_steps = SOME 0) ==>

    (bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond max_steps p st =
    (let st' = bir_exec_step_state p st in
    let max_steps_opt' =
          if bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st' then OPT_NUM_PRE max_steps
          else max_steps
    in
      OPT_NUM_SUC
        (bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond max_steps_opt' p
           st')))

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS_EQ_SOME
statement:
(bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond max_steps_opt p state = SOME i) <=>
    ((!n. n < i ==> ~(bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n)) /\
                    (max_steps_opt <> SOME
           (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state n))) /\
    ((bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state i)) \/
    (max_steps_opt = SOME (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i))))

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS_EQ_NONE
statement:
(bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond max_steps_opt p state = NONE) <=>
    (!n. ~(bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n))) /\
    (case max_steps_opt of NONE => T | SOME max_steps =>
       (!i. bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i < max_steps))

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_SUC
statement:
!p st n. bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (SOME (SUC n)) =
            (let (fe, st') = bir_exec_step p st in
             let ll' = bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st' (SOME n) in
             (OPT_LCONS fe ll'))

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_NONE
statement:
!p st. bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st NONE =
            (let (fe, st') = bir_exec_step p st in
             let ll' = bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st' NONE in
             (OPT_LCONS fe ll'))

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_OPT_NUM_SUC
statement:
!p st no.
        bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (OPT_NUM_SUC no) =
            (let (fe, st') = bir_exec_step p st in
             let ll' = bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st' no in
             (OPT_LCONS fe ll'))

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_REWR_TERMINATED
statement:
!p st no.
   bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
   (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st no = [||])

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_list_REWRS
statement:
(!p st. bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st 0 = []) /\
   (!p st n. bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st (SUC n) =
      let (fe, st') = bir_exec_step p st in
      let l' = bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st' n in
      OPT_CONS fe l')

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_list_ADD
statement:
!p st n1 n2.
      bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st (n1 + n2) =
      (bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st n1 ++
       bir_exec_steps_observe_list p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n1) n2)

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_list_fromList
statement:
!p st step_no. (fromList (bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st step_no)) =
                   bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (SOME step_no)

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_toList_SOME
statement:
!p st step_no. toList (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (SOME step_no)) =
                   SOME (bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st step_no)

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_list_to_llist_THE
statement:
!p st step_no. (bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st step_no) =
                   THE (toList (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (SOME step_no)))

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_list_REWR_TERMINATED
statement:
!p st n.
   bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
   (bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st n = [])

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_NONE_ADD
statement:
!p st n. LAPPEND (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (SOME n))
             (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n) NONE) =
           bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st NONE

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_SOME_ADD
statement:
!p st n1 n2. LAPPEND (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (SOME n1))
             (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n1) (SOME n2)) =
           bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (SOME (n1 + n2))

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_ADD
statement:
!p st n no. LAPPEND (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (SOME n))
             (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n) no) =
           bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (OPTION_MAP ($+ n) no)

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_MIN_NUMBER
statement:
!p st no n. bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n) ==>
       (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st no =
        bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st (OPT_NUM_MIN no (SOME n)))

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_list_MIN_NUMBER
statement:
!p st n1 n2. bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st n1) ==>
       (bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st n2 =
        bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st (MIN n2 n1))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_REWR_TERMINATED
statement:
!p st pc_cond max_steps.
    bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st max_steps = BER_Ended [] 0 0 st)

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_REWR_no_steps
statement:
!pc_cond p st.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME 0) = BER_Ended [] 0 0 st)

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_REWR_STEP
statement:
!pc_cond p st max_steps.
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st max_steps =
      (if (max_steps = SOME 0) then BER_Ended [] 0 0 st else (
      (let (fe, st') = bir_exec_step p st in
       let max_steps' = if (bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st') then (OPT_NUM_PRE max_steps) else max_steps in
       (case (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st' max_steps') of
             BER_Ended ol step_count pc_count st_final =>
             BER_Ended (OPT_CONS fe ol) (SUC step_count)
                       (if (bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st') then SUC pc_count else pc_count) st_final
           | BER_Looping oll => BER_Looping (OPT_LCONS fe oll))))))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_EQ_Looping
statement:
((bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p state mo) = BER_Looping ll) <=>
    ((ll = bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p state NONE) /\
     (bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond mo p state = NONE))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_1_EQ_Looping
statement:
((bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p state (SOME 1)) = BER_Looping ll) <=>
    ((ll = bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p state NONE) /\
     (!n. ~bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n)) /\
     (!n. 0 < n ==> ~(bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n))))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_SOME_EQ_Looping
statement:
((bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p state (SOME step_no)) = BER_Looping ll) <=>
    ((ll = bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p state NONE) /\
     (!n. ~bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n)) /\
     (!i. bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state i < step_no))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_NOT_Looping_max_steps_blocks
statement:
!pc_cond p state m.
  (!pc. (pc.bpc_index = 0) ==> (SND pc_cond) pc) ==>
  IS_BER_Ended (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p state (SOME m))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_EQ_Ended
statement:
!p state mo ol step_c pc_c state' pc_cond.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p state mo = BER_Ended ol step_c pc_c state') <=>
    ((ol = bir_exec_steps_observe_list p state step_c) /\
     (pc_c = bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state step_c) /\
     (case mo of NONE => (bir_state_is_terminated state')
               | SOME m => ((pc_c <= m) /\ ((pc_c < m) ==> (bir_state_is_terminated state')) /\
                            (((pc_c = m) /\ (0 < m)) ==> (
                               bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond state')))) /\
     (state' = bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state step_c) /\
     (!n. n < step_c ==> (~(bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n)) /\
                          mo <> SOME (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state n))))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_EQ_Ended_0
statement:
(!pc_cond p st max_steps ol c_pc st'.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st max_steps = BER_Ended ol 0 c_pc st') <=> (
       (ol = []) /\ (c_pc = 0) /\ (st' = st) /\
       (bir_state_is_terminated st \/ (max_steps = SOME 0))))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_EQ_Ended_SUC
statement:
(!pc_cond p st max_steps c_st ol c_pc st'.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st max_steps = BER_Ended ol (SUC c_st) c_pc st') <=> (
       ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) /\ (max_steps <> SOME 0) /\

       let (fe, st1) = bir_exec_step p st in
       let max_steps' = if bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st1 then OPT_NUM_PRE max_steps else max_steps in
       ?ol' c_pc'. (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st1 max_steps' = BER_Ended ol' c_st c_pc' st') /\
                   (ol = OPT_CONS fe ol') /\
                   (c_pc = if (bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st1) then SUC c_pc' else c_pc')))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_SOME_EQ_Ended
statement:
!pc_cond p m state mo ol step_c pc_c state'.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p state (SOME m) = BER_Ended ol step_c pc_c state') <=>
    ((ol = bir_exec_steps_observe_list p state step_c) /\
     (pc_c =
      bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state step_c) /\
     (pc_c <= m /\ (pc_c < m ==> bir_state_is_terminated state') /\
      ((pc_c = m) /\ 0 < m ==> bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond state')) /\
     (state' = bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state step_c) /\
     (!n.
       n < step_c ==>
       ~bir_state_is_terminated
          (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n)) /\
     (!n. n < step_c ==>
       bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p state n < m))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_SOME_EQ_Ended_pc_counts
statement:
!pc_cond p st n ol c_st c_pc st'.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n) = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
    (~bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
    (n = c_pc)

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_SOME_EQ_Ended_Running_steps
statement:
!pc_cond p st n ol c_st c_pc st'.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n) =
      BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
    (~bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
    (n > 0) ==>
    (c_st > 0)

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_1_EQ_Ended
statement:
!p state ol step_c pc_c state' pc_cond.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p state (SOME 1) = BER_Ended ol step_c pc_c state') <=>
    ((ol = bir_exec_steps_observe_list p state step_c) /\
     (if (0 < step_c /\ (bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond state')) then
        (pc_c = 1) else (pc_c = 0)) /\
     ((pc_c = 0) ==> (bir_state_is_terminated state')) /\
     (state' = bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state step_c) /\
     (!n. n < step_c ==> (~(bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n)))) /\
     (!n. (0 < n /\ n < step_c) ==>
       ~(bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n))))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_SOME_ADD_Ended
statement:
!n1 mo pc_count p state0 state1 state2 l1 l2 c_st1 c_st2 c_pc1 c_pc2.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_count p state0 (SOME n1) = BER_Ended l1 c_pc1 c_st1 state1) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_count p state1 mo = BER_Ended l2 c_pc2 c_st2 state2) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_count p state0 (OPTION_MAP (\n2. n1+n2) mo) = BER_Ended (l1++l2)
         (c_pc1+c_pc2) (c_st1 + c_st2) state2)

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_SOME_ADD_Looping
statement:
!n1 mo pc_count p state0 state1 l1 ll2 c_st1 c_pc1.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_count p state0 (SOME n1) = BER_Ended l1 c_pc1 c_st1 state1) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_count p state1 mo = BER_Looping ll2) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_count p state0 (OPTION_MAP (\n2. n1+n2) mo) = BER_Looping
         (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_combine
statement:
!pc_cond p st mo n.

    (!m. (mo = SOME m) ==> n <= m) ==>

    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st mo =
      case (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n)) of
        BER_Looping ll1 => BER_Looping ll1
      | BER_Ended l1 c1 c1' st1 =>
         (case bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st1 (OPTION_MAP (\m. m - n) mo) of
           BER_Looping ll2 => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2)
         | BER_Ended l2 c2 c2' st2 =>
           BER_Ended (l1++l2) (c1 + c2) (c1' + c2') st2))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_REWR_BIG_STEP
statement:
!pc_cond p st mo.

    (mo <> SOME 0) ==>

    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st mo =
      case (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME 1)) of
        BER_Looping ll1 => BER_Looping ll1
      | BER_Ended l1 c1 c1' st1 =>
         (case bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st1 (OPT_NUM_PRE mo) of
           BER_Looping ll2 => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2)
         | BER_Ended l2 c2 c2' st2 =>
           BER_Ended (l1++l2) (c1 + c2) (c1' + c2') st2))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_1_step_weaker_cond_1
statement:
!pc_cond pc_cond' p st.
    bir_pc_cond_impl pc_cond pc_cond' ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME 1) =
      case (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond' p st (SOME 1)) of
        BER_Looping ll1 => BER_Looping ll1
      | BER_Ended l1 c1 c1' st1 =>
         if (0 < c1) /\ (bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st1) then
           BER_Ended l1 c1 1 st1
         else
         (case bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st1 (SOME 1) of
           BER_Looping ll2 => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2)
         | BER_Ended l2 c2 c2' st2 =>
           BER_Ended (l1++l2) (c1 + c2) c2' st2))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_1_step_weaker_cond
statement:
!pc_cond pc_cond' p st n.
    bir_pc_cond_impl pc_cond pc_cond' ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n) =
      if (n = 0) then BER_Ended [] 0 0 st else
      case (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond' p st (SOME 1)) of
        BER_Looping ll1 => BER_Looping ll1
      | BER_Ended l1 c1 _ st1 =>
         let c1' = if (0 < c1) /\ (bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st1) then 1 else 0 in
         (case bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st1 (SOME (n - c1')) of
           BER_Looping ll2 => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2)
         | BER_Ended l2 c2 c2' st2 =>
           BER_Ended (l1++l2) (c1 + c2) (c1' + c2') st2))

name: bir_exec_step_n_TO_steps_GEN
statement:
((bir_exec_step_n p state n = (l, c, state'))) <=>
     (bir_exec_steps_GEN (T, \_. T) p state (SOME n) =
     (BER_Ended l c c state'))

name: bir_exec_step_n_EQ_THM
statement:
((bir_exec_step_n p state n = (l, c, state'))) <=>
    ((l = bir_exec_steps_observe_list p state c) /\
     (c <= n) /\ (c < n ==> bir_state_is_terminated state') /\
     (state' = bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state c) /\
     (!n.
        n < c ==>
        ~bir_state_is_terminated
           (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n)))

name: bir_exec_step_n_combine
statement:
!p state0 state1 state2 n1 n2 l1 l2 c1 c2.
    (bir_exec_step_n p state0 n1 = (l1, c1, state1)) ==>
    (bir_exec_step_n p state1 n2 = (l2, c2, state2)) ==>
    (bir_exec_step_n p state0 (n1 + n2) = (l1++l2, c1+c2, state2))

name: bir_exec_step_n_add
statement:
!p state0 n1 n2.
    (bir_exec_step_n p state0 (n1 + n2) =
      let (l1, c1, state1) = bir_exec_step_n p state0 n1 in
      let (l2, c2, state2) = bir_exec_step_n p state1 n2 in
      (l1++l2, c1+c2, state2))

name: bir_exec_step_n_REWR_0
statement: !p state. bir_exec_step_n p state 0 = ([], 0, state)

name: bir_exec_step_n_REWR_TERMINATED
statement: !p state n. bir_state_is_terminated state ==> (bir_exec_step_n p state n = ([], 0, state))

name: bir_exec_step_n_REWR_1
statement:
!p state. bir_exec_step_n p state 1 =
         (if (bir_state_is_terminated state) then ([], 0, state) else
         (let (fe, st') = bir_exec_step p state in
         ((OPT_CONS fe []), 1, st')))

name: bir_exec_step_n_SUC
statement:
!p st n.
   bir_exec_step_n p st (SUC n) =
   if bir_state_is_terminated st then ([],0,st) else
   let (fe,st') = bir_exec_step p st in
   let (l,c,st'') = bir_exec_step_n p st' n in
   (OPT_CONS fe l, SUC c, st'')

name: bir_exec_step_n_SUC_END
statement:
!p st n.
   bir_exec_step_n p st (SUC n) =
   let (l,c,st') = bir_exec_step_n p st n in
   if bir_state_is_terminated st' then (l,c,st') else
   let (fe,st'') = bir_exec_step p st' in
   (l ++ OPT_CONS fe [], SUC c, st'')

name: bir_exec_step_n_REWR_NOT_TERMINATED
statement:
!p st n. ~bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
       (bir_exec_step_n p st (SUC n) =
         (let (fe, st') = bir_exec_step p st in
          let (l, n', st'') = bir_exec_step_n p st' n in
          (OPT_CONS fe l, SUC n', st'')))

name: bir_exec_step_n_COUNT_0
statement:
!p l state state' c. (bir_exec_step_n p state c = (l, 0, state')) <=>
      ((l = []) /\ (state' = state) /\ (0 < c ==> bir_state_is_terminated state))

name: bir_exec_block_n_TO_steps_GEN
statement:
((bir_exec_block_n p state n = (l, c_bl, c_st, state'))) <=>
     (bir_exec_steps_GEN (F, \pc. pc.bpc_index = 0) p state (SOME n) =
     (BER_Ended l c_bl c_st state'))

name: bir_exec_block_n_EQ_THM
statement:
((bir_exec_block_n p state n = (l, c_st, c_bl, state'))) <=>

    ((l = bir_exec_steps_observe_list p state c_st) /\
     (c_bl = bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs (F, \pc. pc.bpc_index = 0) p state c_st) /\
     (c_bl <= n) /\ (c_bl < n ==> bir_state_is_terminated state') /\
     (state' = bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state c_st) /\
     ((bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs (F, \pc. pc.bpc_index = 0) p state c_st = n) /\
       0 < n ==>
       (bir_state_COUNT_PC (F, \pc. pc.bpc_index = 0) (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state c_st))) /\
       (!n'. n' < c_st ==>
          ~bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n') /\
          bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs (F, \pc. pc.bpc_index = 0) p state n' < n))

name: bir_exec_block_n_combine

!p state0 state1 state2 n1 n2 l1 l2 c_bl1 c_bl2 c_st1 c_st2.
    (bir_exec_block_n p state0 n1 = (l1, c_bl1, c_st1, state1)) ==>
    (bir_exec_block_n p state1 n2 = (l2, c_bl2, c_st2, state2)) ==>

name: bir_exec_block_n_REWR_TERMINATED

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_UNIV_REWR

    bir_exec_to_labels_n UNIV p st m =
    let (ol, c_st, c_pc, st') = bir_exec_block_n p st m in

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_REWR_0

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_REWR_TERMINATED

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_REWR_SUC
statement:
!ls p st n.
    (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st (SUC n) =
      case (bir_exec_to_labels ls p st) of
        BER_Looping ll1 => BER_Looping ll1
      | BER_Ended l1 c1 c1' st1 =>
         (case bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st1 n of
           BER_Looping ll2 => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2)
         | BER_Ended l2 c2 c2' st2 =>
           BER_Ended (l1++l2) (c1 + c2) (c1' + c2') st2))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_block_1
statement:
!ls p st n.
    (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st (SUC n) =
      let (l1, c1, _, st1) = bir_exec_block_n p st 1 in
      let c1' = if (0 < c1) /\ (bir_state_COUNT_PC (F,
         \pc. (pc.bpc_index = 0) /\ (pc.bpc_label IN ls)) st1) then 1 else 0 in
      case bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st1 (SUC n-c1') of
        BER_Looping ll2 => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2)
      | BER_Ended l2 c2 c2' st2 =>
        BER_Ended (l1++l2) (c1 + c2) (c1' + c2') st2)

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_ended_running
statement:
!ls prog st l n m c_l' st'.
    (n > 0) ==>
    (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls prog st n = BER_Ended l m c_l' st') ==>
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
    ((st'.bst_pc.bpc_index = 0) /\ st'.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls)

name: bir_exec_to_labels_ended_running
statement:
!ls prog st l n c_l' st'.
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st = BER_Ended l n c_l' st') ==>
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
    ((st'.bst_pc.bpc_index = 0) /\ st'.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls)

name: bir_exec_steps_EQ_Looping
statement:
(bir_exec_steps p state = BER_Looping ll) <=>
    ((ll = bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p state NONE) /\
     (!n. ~bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n)))

name: bir_exec_steps_EQ_Ended
statement:
((bir_exec_steps p state = BER_Ended l c1 c2 state') <=>
    ((l = bir_exec_steps_observe_list p state c1) /\
     (c1 = c2) /\
     bir_state_is_terminated state' /\
     (state' = bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state c1) /\
     (!n. n < c1 ==> ~(bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state n)))))

name: bir_exec_steps_REWR_TERMINATED
statement:
bir_state_is_terminated state ==>
    (bir_exec_steps p state = BER_Ended [] 0 0 state)

name: bir_exec_steps_REWR_NOT_TERMINATED
statement:
~bir_state_is_terminated state ==>
    (bir_exec_steps p state =
       let (fe, state') = bir_exec_step p state in
       case bir_exec_steps p state' of
         BER_Ended ol step_count pc_count st_final =>
           BER_Ended (OPT_CONS fe ol) (SUC step_count) (SUC pc_count)
             st_final
         | BER_Looping oll => BER_Looping (OPT_LCONS fe oll))

name: bir_exec_steps_combine
statement:
!p state0 n1 state1 c1 l1.
    (bir_exec_step_n p state0 n1 = (l1, c1, state1)) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps p state0 =
       case bir_exec_steps p state1 of
         BER_Ended ol step_count pc_count st_final =>
           BER_Ended (l1 ++ ol) (c1 + step_count) (c1 + pc_count)
             st_final
         | BER_Looping oll => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) oll))

name: bir_exec_steps_combine_GUARD
statement:
!p state0 n1 state1 c1 l1.
    (bir_exec_step_n p state0 n1 = (l1, c1, state1)) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps p state0 =
       (if c1 < n1 then BER_Ended l1 c1 c1 state1 else (
       case bir_exec_steps p state1 of
         BER_Ended ol step_count pc_count st_final =>
           BER_Ended (l1 ++ ol) (c1 + step_count) (c1 + pc_count)
             st_final
         | BER_Looping oll => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) oll))))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_increase_max_steps_looping_SOME
statement:
!pc_cond p st ll n1 n2.
    (n1 <= n2) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n1) = BER_Looping ll) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n2) = BER_Looping ll)

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_increase_max_steps_looping_NONE
statement:
!pc_cond p st ll n.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n) = BER_Looping ll) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st NONE = BER_Looping ll)

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_EQ_Ended_FIX_STEPS
statement:
!pc_cond p st ol c_pc c_st st' mo.
    ((bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st mo = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st')) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME
       (if (bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st' \/ (mo = SOME 0)) then c_pc else SUC c_pc)) = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st')

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_increase_max_steps_Ended_NONE
statement:
!pc_cond p st ol c_pc c_st st' n.
    (bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n) = BER_Ended ol c_pc c_st st') ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st NONE = BER_Ended ol c_pc c_st st')

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_increase_max_steps_Ended_SOME
statement:
!pc_cond p st ol c_pc c_st st' n1 n2.
    (n1 <= n2) ==>
    (bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n1) = BER_Ended ol c_pc c_st st') ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n2) = BER_Ended ol c_pc c_st st')

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_decrease_max_steps_Ended_SOME
statement:
!pc_cond p st n1 n2 ol c_st c_pc st'.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n1) = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
    (n2 < n1) ==>
    (?ol' c_st' c_pc' st''.
      bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n2) = BER_Ended ol' c_st' c_pc' st'')

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_decrease_max_steps_Ended_terminated
statement:
!pc_cond p st n1 n2 ol ol' c_st c_st' c_pc c_pc' st' st''.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n1) = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
    (~bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
    (n2 < n1) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n2) = BER_Ended ol' c_st' c_pc' st'') ==>
    (~bir_state_is_terminated st'')

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_decrease_max_steps_Ended_steps_taken
statement:
!pc_cond p st n1 n2 ol ol' c_st c_st' c_pc c_pc' st' st''.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n1) = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
    (~bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
    (n2 < n1) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n2) = BER_Ended ol' c_st' c_pc' st'') ==>
    (c_st' < c_st)

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_change_cond_Looping_NONE
statement:
!pc_cond pc_cond' mo p st ll.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st mo = BER_Looping ll) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond' p st NONE = BER_Looping ll)

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_change_cond_Looping_SOME
statement:
!pc_cond pc_cond' p st ll n1.
    (bir_pc_cond_impl pc_cond' pc_cond) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n1) = BER_Looping ll) ==>
    (?n2. (n2 <= n1) /\ ((bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond' p st (SOME n2) = BER_Looping ll)))

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_change_cond_Ended_terminated
statement:
!pc_cond pc_cond' p st ol c_pc c_st mo st'.
    bir_state_is_terminated st' ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st mo = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
    (?c_pc'. bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond' p st NONE = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc' st')

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_change_cond_Ended_NONE
statement:
!pc_cond pc_cond' p st ol c_pc c_st st'.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st NONE = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
    (?c_pc'. bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond' p st NONE = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc' st')

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_change_cond_Ended_SOME
statement:
!pc_cond pc_cond' p st n1 ol c_pc c_st st'.
    (bir_pc_cond_impl pc_cond pc_cond') ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st (SOME n1) = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
    ?n2 c_pc'. (n1 <= n2) /\ (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond' p st (SOME n2) = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc' st')

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_TO_bir_exec_step_n
statement:
!p st st' mo c_st c_pc ol pc_cond.
    (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st mo = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') ==>
    (bir_exec_step_n p st c_st = (ol, c_st, st'))

name: bir_exec_steps_TO_bir_exec_step_n
statement:
!p st st' ol c_st c_pc.
    (bir_exec_steps p st = BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st') <=>
    ((bir_exec_step_n p st c_st = (ol, c_st, st')) /\ (c_pc = c_st) /\
      (bir_state_is_terminated st'))

name: bir_exec_block_n_TO_bir_exec_step_n
statement:
!p st st' ol c_st c_pc m.
    (bir_exec_block_n p st m = (ol, c_st, c_pc, st')) ==>
    (bir_exec_step_n p st c_st = (ol, c_st, st'))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_change_labels
statement:
!ls p st n ls' st' ol c_st c_l.
    (ls SUBSET ls') ==>
    (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st n = BER_Ended ol c_st c_l st') ==>
    (?n' c_l'. (n <= n') /\
               (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls' p st n' = BER_Ended ol c_st c_l' st'))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_TO_bir_exec_block_n
statement:
!ls p st n st' ol c_st c_l .
    (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st n = BER_Ended ol c_st c_l st') ==>
    (?m c_l'. (n <= m) /\ (bir_exec_block_n p st m = (ol, c_st, c_l', st')))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_TO_bir_exec_step_n
statement:
!ls p st n st' ol c_st c_l .
    (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st n = BER_Ended ol c_st c_l st') ==>
    (bir_exec_step_n p st c_st = (ol, c_st, st'))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_TO_bir_exec_steps
statement:
!ls p st n ll .
    (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st n = BER_Looping ll) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps p st = BER_Looping ll)

name: bir_exec_step_n_LIMIT_STEP_NO
statement:
!p st n l st' c.
    (bir_exec_step_n p st n = (l, c, st')) ==>
    (bir_exec_step_n p st c = (l, c, st'))

name: bir_exec_step_n_acc_REWR_0
statement:
!(p:'a bir_program_t) aol an s.
           bir_exec_step_n_acc p 0 (aol, an, s) = (REVERSE aol, an, s)

name: bir_exec_step_n_acc_REWR_TERMINATED
statement:
!(p:'a bir_program_t) n aol an s.
           bir_state_is_terminated s ==>
           (bir_exec_step_n_acc p n (aol, an, s) = (REVERSE aol, an, s))

name: bir_exec_step_n_acc_REWR_NOT_TERMINATED
statement:
!(p:'a bir_program_t) n aol an s.
           ((~bir_state_is_terminated s) /\ (~(n = 0))) ==>
           (bir_exec_step_n_acc p n (aol, an, s) =
            (let
               (fe, s') = bir_exec_step p s
             in
               bir_exec_step_n_acc p (n-1) (OPT_CONS fe aol, an + 1, s')
            )
           )

name: bir_exec_step_n_plus_acc_thm
statement:
!p s n aol an. (bir_exec_step_n_acc (p:'a bir_program_t) n (aol, an, s)) =
                 (\(ol, sn, s'). (APPEND (REVERSE aol) ol, sn + an, s')) (bir_exec_step_n p s n)

name: bir_exec_step_n_acc_eq_thm
statement:
!p s n. bir_exec_step_n_acc (p:'a bir_program_t) n ([], 0, s) =
          bir_exec_step_n     p s n

name: bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET_def
statement:
bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_PC_COND_SET pc_cond p state =
   {i | i <> 0 /\ bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p state i)}

name: bir_pc_cond_impl_def
statement:
bir_pc_cond_impl (cf1, pc_cond1) (cf2, pc_cond2) <=> (
    (cf1 ==> cf2) /\
    (!pc. pc_cond1 pc ==> pc_cond2 pc))

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_list_def
statement:
bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st step_no = (
     MAP THE (FILTER IS_SOME (GENLIST
        (\i. FST (bir_exec_step p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st i))) step_no)))

name: bir_exec_step_n_acc_def
statement:
bir_exec_step_n_acc (p:'a bir_program_t) (n:num) (aol:(num # 'a) list, an:num, s:bir_state_t) =
            if (n = 0) \/ (bir_state_is_terminated s) then
              (REVERSE aol, an, s)
            else
              let
                (fe, s') = bir_exec_step p s
              in
                bir_exec_step_n_acc p (n-1) (OPT_CONS fe aol, an + 1, s')

name: bir_stmtB_not_assume_never_assumviol
statement:
!stmtb st obs st'.
    bir_stmtB_is_not_assume stmtb ==>
    (st.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated) ==>
    (bir_exec_stmtB stmtb st = (obs, st')) ==>
    (st'.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated)

name: bir_stmtsB_not_assume_never_assumviol
statement:
!stmtsB l c st l' c' st'.
    bir_stmtsB_has_no_assumes stmtsB ==>
    (st.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated) ==>
    (bir_exec_stmtsB stmtsB (l, c, st) = (l', c', st')) ==>
    (st'.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated)

name: bir_exec_stmtE_not_assumviol
statement:
!prog stmtE st.
      (st.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated) ==>
      ((bir_exec_stmtE prog stmtE st).bst_status <>
         BST_AssumptionViolated)

name: bir_block_not_assume_never_assumviol
statement:
!prog bl st l' c' st'.
    bir_block_has_no_assumes bl ==>
    (st.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated) ==>
    (bir_exec_block prog bl st = (l', c', st')) ==>
    (st'.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated)

name: bir_prog_to_block_no_assumes
statement:
!prog st bl.
    (bir_get_current_block prog st.bst_pc = SOME bl) ==>
    bir_prog_has_no_assumes prog ==>
    bir_block_has_no_assumes bl

name: bir_prog_not_assume_never_assumviol_exec_block_n
statement:
!prog st n bl ol nstep npc st'.
    (bir_get_current_block prog st.bst_pc = SOME bl) ==>
    bir_prog_has_no_assumes prog ==>
    (st.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated) ==>
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st n = (ol, nstep, npc, st')) ==>
    (st'.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated)

name: bir_prog_not_assume_never_assumviol_exec_to_labels
statement:
!ls prog st bl ol c_st c_l st'.
    (bir_get_current_block prog st.bst_pc = SOME bl) ==>
    bir_prog_has_no_assumes prog ==>
    (st.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated) ==>
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st =
       BER_Ended ol c_st c_l st'
    ) ==>
    (st'.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated)

name: bir_stmtB_is_not_assume_def
statement:
(bir_stmtB_is_not_assume (BStmt_Assume ex) = F) /\
  (bir_stmtB_is_not_assume _ = T)

name: bir_stmtsB_has_no_assumes_def
statement:
(bir_stmtsB_has_no_assumes [] = T) /\
  (bir_stmtsB_has_no_assumes (h::t) =
    ((bir_stmtB_is_not_assume h) /\ (bir_stmtsB_has_no_assumes t))
  )

name: bir_block_has_no_assumes_def
statement:
bir_block_has_no_assumes block =
    bir_stmtsB_has_no_assumes block.bb_statements

name: bir_prog_has_no_assumes_def
statement:
(bir_prog_has_no_assumes (BirProgram []) = T) /\
  (bir_prog_has_no_assumes (BirProgram (h::t)) =
    ((bir_block_has_no_assumes h) /\
    (bir_prog_has_no_assumes (BirProgram t)))
  )

name: bir_stmtB_is_observe_ALT_DEF
statement: bir_stmtB_is_observe stmt <=> (?oid ec el obf. stmt = BStmt_Observe oid ec el obf)

name: bir_exec_stmtB_only_observe_produces_observation
statement: !stmt st. IS_SOME (FST (bir_exec_stmtB stmt st)) ==> bir_stmtB_is_observe stmt

name: bir_exec_stmt_only_observe_produces_observation
statement: !stmt p st. IS_SOME (FST (bir_exec_stmt p stmt st)) ==> bir_stmt_is_observe stmt

name: bir_exec_stmtB_NO_OBSERVE
statement:
!stmt st. ~(bir_stmtB_is_observe stmt) ==>
    (bir_exec_stmtB stmt st = (NONE, bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st))

name: bir_exec_stmt_NO_OBSERVE
statement:
!stmt p st. ~(bir_stmt_is_observe stmt) ==>
    (bir_exec_stmt p stmt st = (NONE, bir_exec_stmt_state p stmt st))

name: bir_exec_step_NO_OBSERVE_current
statement:
!p st. (!stmt. (bir_get_current_statement p st.bst_pc = SOME stmt) ==>
                 ~(bir_stmt_is_observe stmt)) ==>
    (bir_exec_step p st = (NONE, bir_exec_step_state p st))

name: bir_exec_step_NO_OBSERVE
statement:
!p st. (~(bir_program_contains_observe p)) ==>
    (bir_exec_step p st = (NONE, bir_exec_step_state p st))

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_llist_NO_OBSERVE
statement:
!p st step_no. (~(bir_program_contains_observe p)) ==>
     (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st step_no = [||])

name: bir_exec_steps_observe_list_NO_OBSERVE
statement:
!p st step_no. (~(bir_program_contains_observe p)) ==>
     (bir_exec_steps_observe_list p st step_no = [])

name: bir_exec_steps_GEN_NO_OBSERVE
statement:
!pc_cond p st step_no.
     (~(bir_program_contains_observe p)) ==>
     case (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st step_no) of
       | BER_Looping ll => (ll = [||])
       | BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st' => (ol = [])

name: bir_exec_steps_NO_OBSERVE
statement:
!p st. (~(bir_program_contains_observe p)) ==>
         case (bir_exec_steps p st) of
           | BER_Looping ll => (ll = [||])
           | BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st' => (ol = [])

name: bir_exec_to_labels_n_NO_OBSERVE
statement:
!ls step_no p st. (~(bir_program_contains_observe p)) ==>
         case (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st step_no) of
           | BER_Looping ll => (ll = [||])
           | BER_Ended ol c_st c_pc st' => (ol = [])

name: bir_exec_step_n_NO_OBSERVE
statement:
!p st step_no. (~(bir_program_contains_observe p)) ==>
                 (FST (bir_exec_step_n p st step_no) = [])

name: bir_exec_block_n_NO_OBSERVE
statement:
!p st step_no. (~(bir_program_contains_observe p)) ==>
                 (FST (bir_exec_block_n p st step_no) = [])

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_state_THM
statement:
!stmts l c st. SND (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, c, st)) =
                   bir_exec_stmtsB_state stmts (c, st)

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_state_REWRS
statement:
(!c st. bir_exec_stmtsB_state [] (c, st) = (c, st)) /\
    (!stmts c st. bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
       (bir_exec_stmtsB_state stmts (c, st) = (c, st))) /\
    (!stmts (stmt:'a bir_stmt_basic_t) c st. ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
       (bir_exec_stmtsB_state (stmt::stmts) (c, st) =
        bir_exec_stmtsB_state stmts (SUC c, bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st)))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_state_REWRS_COND
statement:
(!c st. (bir_exec_stmtsB_state [] (c, st) = (c, st))) /\
    (!stmt stmts c st. (bir_exec_stmtsB_state (stmt::stmts) (c, st) =
       if (bir_state_is_terminated st) then (c, st) else
       bir_exec_stmtsB_state stmts (SUC c, bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st)))

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_NO_OBSERVE_THM
statement:
!stmts l c st. ~(EXISTS bir_stmtB_is_observe stmts) ==>
         (FST (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts (l, c, st)) = REVERSE l)

name: bir_exec_block_state_ALT_DEF
statement:
!p bl st. bir_exec_block_state p bl st =
  let (c, st') = bir_exec_stmtsB_state bl.bb_statements (0, st) in
  (if (bir_state_is_terminated st') then
    (c, st' with bst_pc := (st.bst_pc with bpc_index := st.bst_pc.bpc_index + PRE c))
  else
    (SUC c,
        let st'' = bir_exec_stmtE p bl.bb_last_statement st' in
        if (bir_state_is_terminated st'') then
          (st'' with bst_pc := (st.bst_pc with bpc_index := st.bst_pc.bpc_index + c))
        else st''))

name: bir_exec_block_NO_OBSERVE_THM
statement:
!p bl st. ~(bir_block_contains_observe bl) ==>
         (FST (bir_exec_block p bl st) = [])

name: bir_exec_block_DEF_NO_OBSERVE
statement:
!p bl st. ~(bir_block_contains_observe bl) ==>
         (bir_exec_block p bl st = ([], bir_exec_block_state p bl st))

name: bir_stmtB_is_observe_def
statement:
(bir_stmtB_is_observe (BStmt_Observe _ _ _ _) = T) /\
  (bir_stmtB_is_observe _ = F)

name: bir_stmt_is_observe_def
statement:
(bir_stmt_is_observe (BStmtB stmt) = bir_stmtB_is_observe stmt) /\
  (bir_stmt_is_observe _ = F)

name: bir_block_contains_observe_def
statement:
bir_block_contains_observe bl <=>
  EXISTS bir_stmtB_is_observe bl.bb_statements

name: bir_program_contains_observe_def
statement:
bir_program_contains_observe (BirProgram p) <=>
  EXISTS bir_block_contains_observe p

name: bir_exec_stmtsB_state_def
statement:
bir_exec_stmtsB_state stmts (c, st) =
  SND (bir_exec_stmtsB stmts ([], c, st))

name: bir_exec_block_state_def

bir_exec_block_state p bl st =
  SND (bir_exec_block p bl st)

name: bir_exec_stmtB_terminates_no_change
statement:
!st stmt fe st'.
     ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
     (bir_exec_stmtB stmt st = (fe, st')) ==>
     (bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
     (((st' with bst_status := BST_Running) = st) /\ (fe = NONE))

statement:
!st stmt. ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
              (bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st)) ==>
              (((bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st) with bst_status := BST_Running) = st)

              (bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st)) ==>
              (((bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st) with bst_status := BST_Running) = st)

name: bir_exec_stmt_terminates_no_change
statement:
!p st (stmt:'a bir_stmt_t) fe st'. ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
              (bir_exec_stmt p stmt st = (fe, st')) ==>
              (bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
              (((st' with bst_status := BST_Running) = st) /\ (fe = NONE))

name: bir_exec_stmt_terminates_no_change_state
statement:
!p st (stmt:'a bir_stmt_t). ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
              (bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_stmt_state p stmt st)) ==>
