name: bir_exec_step_terminates_no_change
statement:
!p st fe st'. ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
              (bir_exec_step p st = (fe, st')) ==>
              (bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
              (((st' with bst_status := BST_Running) = st) /\ (fe = NONE))

name: bir_exec_step_terminates_no_change_state
statement:
!p st. ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
         (bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_step_state p st)) ==>
         (((bir_exec_step_state p st) with bst_status := BST_Running) = st)

name: bir_exec_step_n_last_step_terminates
statement:
!p st n st' l i.
     (bir_exec_step_n p st n = (l, SUC i, st')) ==>
     (bir_state_is_terminated st') ==> (
     ?st''. (bir_exec_step_n p st i = (l, i, st'')) /\
            (st'' = st' with bst_status := BST_Running) /\
            (bir_exec_step p st'' = (NONE, st')))

name: bir_exec_stmtB_status_not_halted
statement: !st stmt v. (st.bst_status <> BST_Halted v) ==> (((bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st).bst_status <> BST_Halted v))

name: bir_exec_stmtE_status_halted
statement: !st p stmt v. (st.bst_status <> BST_Halted v) ==> (((bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st).bst_status = BST_Halted v)) ==> (?e. (stmt = BStmt_Halt e) /\ (SOME v = bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ))

name: bir_exec_stmt_status_halted
statement: !st p stmt v. (st.bst_status <> BST_Halted v) ==> (((bir_exec_stmt_state p stmt st).bst_status = BST_Halted v)) ==> (?e. (stmt = BStmtE (BStmt_Halt e)) /\ (SOME v = bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ))

name: bir_exec_step_status_halted
statement: !st p v. (st.bst_status <> BST_Halted v) ==> (((bir_exec_step_state p st).bst_status = BST_Halted v)) ==> (?e. ((bir_get_current_statement p st.bst_pc = SOME (BStmtE (BStmt_Halt e)))) /\ (SOME v = bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ))

name: bir_exec_stmtB_status_not_jumped
statement: !st stmt l. (st.bst_status <> BST_JumpOutside l) ==> (((bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st).bst_status <> BST_JumpOutside l))

name: bir_stmtE_is_jmp_to_label_REWRS
statement:
(!le env l. (bir_stmtE_is_jmp_to_label env l (BStmt_Jmp le) <=>
       (bir_eval_label_exp le env = SOME l))) /\
    (!ce le1 le2 env l. (bir_stmtE_is_jmp_to_label env l (BStmt_CJmp ce le1 le2) <=>
       case (bir_eval_exp ce env) of
	 | NONE => F
	 | SOME va => (
	      case (bir_dest_bool_val va) of
		| NONE => F
		| SOME T => (bir_eval_label_exp le1 env = SOME l)
		| SOME F => (bir_eval_label_exp le2 env = SOME l)
           )
    )) /\
    (!l env e. (bir_stmtE_is_jmp_to_label env l (BStmt_Halt e) <=> F))

name: bir_stmtE_is_jmp_to_label_SEM
statement:
!p stmt st l. (bir_stmtE_is_jmp_to_label st.bst_environ l stmt) ==>
                  (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st = bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p l st)

name: bir_exec_stmtE_status_jumped
statement:
!st p stmt l. (st.bst_status <> BST_JumpOutside l) ==>
                (((bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st).bst_status = BST_JumpOutside l)) ==>
                ((~(MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p))) /\
                 (bir_stmtE_is_jmp_to_label st.bst_environ l stmt))

name: bir_stmt_is_jmp_to_label_SEM
statement:
!p stmt st l. (bir_stmt_is_jmp_to_label st.bst_environ l stmt) ==>
                  (bir_exec_stmt p stmt st = (NONE, bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p l st))

name: bir_exec_stmt_status_jumped
statement:
!st p stmt l. (st.bst_status <> BST_JumpOutside l) ==>
                (((bir_exec_stmt_state p stmt st).bst_status = BST_JumpOutside l)) ==>
                (~(MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p)) /\
                (bir_stmt_is_jmp_to_label st.bst_environ l stmt))

name: bir_exec_step_status_jumped
statement:
!st p l. (st.bst_status <> BST_JumpOutside l) ==>
           (((bir_exec_step_state p st).bst_status = BST_JumpOutside l)) ==>

                (~(MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p)) /\
                ((?stmt. (bir_get_current_statement p st.bst_pc = SOME stmt) /\
                         (bir_stmt_is_jmp_to_label st.bst_environ l stmt))))

name: bir_exec_step_n_status_jumped
statement:
!st p n l ol n' st'.
           (bir_exec_step_n p st n = (ol, SUC n', st')) ==>
           (st'.bst_status = BST_JumpOutside l) ==>
           ((~(MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p))) /\

           (?stmt. (bir_get_current_statement p st'.bst_pc = SOME stmt) /\
                   (bir_stmt_is_jmp_to_label st'.bst_environ l stmt)) /\
           (?st''. (bir_exec_step_n p st n' = (ol, n', st'')) /\
             (st'' = st' with bst_status := BST_Running) /\
             (bir_exec_step p st'' = (NONE, st'))))

name: bir_exec_stmtB_status_typeerror_Assign
bir_exec_stmtB_status_typeerror_cond_exp_aux
statement:
!v. (type_of_bir_val v = BType_Bool) <=>
       (case bir_dest_bool_val v of
         | NONE => F
         | SOME _ => T)

name: bir_exec_stmtB_status_typeerror_Assert
statement:
!st stmt e.
  (st.bst_status <> BST_TypeError) ==>
  (((bir_exec_stmtB_state (BStmt_Assert e) st).bst_status = BST_TypeError) <=>
    ((bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ = NONE) \/
     (?va.
      (bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ = SOME va) /\
      (type_of_bir_val va <> BType_Bool))
    )
  )

name: bir_exec_stmtB_status_typeerror_Assume
bir_exec_stmtB_status_typeerror_Observe
bir_exec_stmtE_status_typeerror_jmp_to_label
statement:
!st stmt p l. (st.bst_status <> BST_TypeError) ==>
                ((bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p l st).bst_status <> BST_TypeError)

name: bir_eval_label_exp_EQ_NONE
statement:
!le env. (bir_eval_label_exp le env = NONE) <=>
           (?e. (le = BLE_Exp e) /\
                ~(?va. (bir_eval_exp e env = SOME va) /\ (bir_val_is_Imm va)))

name: bir_exec_stmtE_status_typeerror_Jmp
statement:
!st stmt p le. (st.bst_status <> BST_TypeError) ==>
                 (((bir_exec_stmtE p (BStmt_Jmp le) st).bst_status = BST_TypeError) <=>
                 (bir_eval_label_exp le st.bst_environ = NONE))

name: bir_exec_stmtE_status_typeerror_CJmp
statement:
!st stmt p ce le1 le2.
     (st.bst_status <> BST_TypeError) ==>
     (((bir_exec_stmtE p (BStmt_CJmp ce le1 le2) st).bst_status = BST_TypeError) <=>
      case bir_eval_exp ce st.bst_environ of
	| NONE => T
	| SOME va => (
		case bir_dest_bool_val va of
		   NONE => T
		 | SOME T => (bir_eval_label_exp le1 st.bst_environ = NONE)
		 | SOME F => (bir_eval_label_exp le2 st.bst_environ = NONE)
           ))

name: bir_exec_stmtE_status_typeerror_Halt
statement:
!st stmt p e.
  (st.bst_status <> BST_TypeError) ==>
  (((bir_exec_stmtE p (BStmt_Halt e) st).bst_status = BST_TypeError) <=>
    (bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ = NONE)
  )

            (?e. (stmt = BStmt_Assume e) /\ (bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 0w))))

statement:

name: bir_exec_stmt_status_assumption
statement:

              (?e. (stmt = BStmtB (BStmt_Assume e)) /\ (bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 0w))))

name: bir_exec_step_status_assumption
statement:
!st p. (st.bst_status <> BST_AssumptionViolated) ==>
         ((bir_exec_step_state p st).bst_status = BST_AssumptionViolated) ==>
         (?e. (bir_get_current_statement p st.bst_pc = SOME (BStmtB (BStmt_Assume e))) /\
              (bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 0w))))

name: bir_exec_stmtB_status_assertion

name: bir_exec_stmtE_status_not_assertion
statement:
!st p stmt. (st.bst_status <> BST_AssertionViolated) ==>

name: bir_exec_stmt_status_assertion
statement:
!st p stmt. (st.bst_status <> BST_AssertionViolated) ==>

              (?e. (stmt = BStmtB (BStmt_Assert e)) /\ (bir_eval_exp e st.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 0w))))

name: bir_exec_step_status_assertion
statement:
!st p. (st.bst_status <> BST_AssertionViolated) ==>

name: bir_exec_to_labels_TO_bir_exec_block_n_SUC_term
statement:
!ls prog st l' n' n0 st'.
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st = BER_Ended l' n' n0 st') ==>
    bir_state_is_terminated st' ==>
    ?m.
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st (SUC m) = (l',n',m,st'))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_TO_bir_exec_block_n_SUC_both_term
statement:
!ls prog st l' n' n0 st' b.
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st = BER_Ended l' n' n0 st') ==>
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
    (st'.bst_status = BST_JumpOutside b) ==>
    ((bir_block_pc b).bpc_index = 0) ==>
    ?m.
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st (SUC m) = (l',n',SUC m,st'))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_bir_exec_block_n_term
statement:
!ls prog st l' n' c_l' st'.
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st =
       BER_Ended l' n' c_l' st') ==>
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
    bir_state_is_terminated st' ==>
    ?m m'.
    ?l''' n'''  st'''.
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st (SUC m) = (l', n', m', st')) /\
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st m = (l''', n''', m, st''')) /\
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated st''')

name: bir_exec_to_labels_block_n_notin_ls
statement:
!ls prog st l l' n n' n0 c_l' c_l'' m m' st' st''.
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st = BER_Ended l n n0 st') ==>
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st m' = (l',n',c_l'',st'')) ==>
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st m = (l,n,c_l',st')) ==>
    (m' < m) ==>
    (0 < m') ==>
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated st'') ==>
    st''.bst_pc.bpc_label NOTIN ls

name: bir_exec_to_labels_reached_ls
statement:
!prog ls st m m' l l' n n' n0 c_l' c_l'' st' st''.
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st = BER_Ended l n n0 st'') ==>
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st m' = (l',n',c_l'',st')) ==>
    st'.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated st'' ==>
    m' > 0 ==>
    ~(n' < n)

name: bir_exec_to_labels_not_reached_ls
statement:
!prog ls st m m' l' l'' l''' n' n'' n''' n0 c_l' c_l'' c_l'''
     st' st'' st'''.
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st = BER_Ended l' n' n0 st') ==>
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st m' = (l'',n'',c_l'',st'')) ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
    st''.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls ==>
    m' > 0 ==>
    ~(n'' < n')

name: bir_exec_to_labels_nz_blocks
statement:
!ls prog st l m l' n c_l' st'.
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st = BER_Looping l) ==>
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st m = (l',n,c_l',st')) ==>
    m > 0 ==>
    n > 0

name: bir_exec_to_labels_looping_not_reached_ls
statement:
!ls prog st l m l' n c_l' st'.
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st = BER_Looping l) ==>
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st m = (l',n,c_l',st')) ==>
    0 < m ==>
    st'.bst_pc.bpc_label NOTIN ls

name: bir_exec_to_labels_term_ls
statement:
!prog st ls m m' l' l'' l''' n' n'' n''' n0 c_l' c_l'' c_l'''
     st' st'' st'''.
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st = BER_Ended l' n' n0 st') ==>
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st m = (l''',n''',c_l''',st''')) ==>
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st m' = (l'',n'',c_l'',st'')) ==>
    (bir_exec_block_n prog st (SUC m) = (l',n',c_l',st')) ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated st''' ==>
    m' > 0 ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated st'' ==>
    st''.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls ==>
    bir_state_is_terminated st' ==>
    ~(m' < (SUC m))

name: bir_stmtE_is_jmp_to_label_def
statement:
bir_stmtE_is_jmp_to_label env l stmt <=>
                ((?le. (stmt = BStmt_Jmp le) /\ (bir_eval_label_exp le env = SOME l)) \/
                 (?le1 le2 ce c. (stmt = BStmt_CJmp ce le1 le2) /\
                                 (bir_eval_exp ce env = SOME (BVal_Imm (bool2b c))) /\
                                 (bir_eval_label_exp (if c then le1 else le2) env = SOME l)))

name: bir_stmt_is_jmp_to_label_def
statement:
(bir_stmt_is_jmp_to_label env l (BStmtB _) <=> F) /\
  (bir_stmt_is_jmp_to_label env l (BStmtE stmt) = bir_stmtE_is_jmp_to_label env l stmt)

name: bir_is_valid_labels_blocks_EQ_EL
statement:
!p n1 n2. (bir_is_valid_labels (BirProgram p) /\ n1 < LENGTH p /\ n2 < LENGTH p /\
                ((EL n1 p).bb_label = (EL n2 p).bb_label)) ==> (n1 = n2)

name: bir_is_valid_labels_blocks_EQ
statement:
!p bl1 bl2. (bir_is_valid_labels (BirProgram p) /\ MEM bl1 p /\ MEM bl2 p /\
                (bl1.bb_label = bl2.bb_label)) ==> (bl1 = bl2)

name: bir_get_program_block_info_by_label_valid_THM
statement:
(!p l. ((bir_get_program_block_info_by_label (BirProgram p) l = NONE) <=> (!bl. MEM bl p ==> (bl.bb_label <> l)))) /\

    (!p l i bl. bir_is_valid_labels (BirProgram p) ==>
          ((bir_get_program_block_info_by_label (BirProgram p) l = SOME (i, bl)) <=>
           ((i:num) < LENGTH p) /\ (EL i p = bl) /\ (bl.bb_label = l)))

name: bir_is_valid_pc_of_valid_blocks
statement:
!p pc. bir_is_valid_labels (BirProgram p) ==>
           (bir_is_valid_pc (BirProgram p) pc <=> (?bl. MEM bl p /\ (pc.bpc_label = bl.bb_label) /\
             (pc.bpc_index <= LENGTH bl.bb_statements)))

name: bir_get_program_block_info_by_label_valid_pc
statement: !p pc. bir_is_valid_pc p pc ==> IS_SOME (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p pc.bpc_label)

name: bir_get_current_statement_IS_SOME
statement: !p pc. IS_SOME (bir_get_current_statement p pc) <=> bir_is_valid_pc p pc

name: bir_get_current_statement_SOME_B
statement:
!p pc stmt. (bir_get_current_statement p pc = SOME (BStmtB stmt)) <=>
                (?i bl. (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p pc.bpc_label = SOME (i, bl)) /\
                   (pc.bpc_index < LENGTH bl.bb_statements) /\
                   (stmt = EL pc.bpc_index bl.bb_statements))

name: bir_get_current_statement_SOME_E
statement:
!p pc stmt. (bir_get_current_statement p pc = SOME (BStmtE stmt)) <=>
                (?i bl. (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p pc.bpc_label = SOME (i, bl)) /\
                   (pc.bpc_index = LENGTH bl.bb_statements) /\
                   (stmt = bl.bb_last_statement))

name: bir_pc_next_valid
statement:
!p pc. (bir_is_valid_pc p (bir_pc_next pc)) <=>
         (?stmt. bir_get_current_statement p pc = SOME (BStmtB stmt))

name: bir_is_valid_pc_block_pc
statement:
!l p. bir_is_valid_pc p (bir_block_pc l) <=>
        MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p)

name: bir_pc_first_valid
statement: !p. bir_is_valid_program p ==> bir_is_valid_pc p (bir_pc_first p)

name: bir_is_valid_pc_label_OK
statement: !p pc. bir_is_valid_pc p pc ==> MEM pc.bpc_label (bir_labels_of_program p)

name: bir_state_init_valid
statement: !p. bir_is_valid_program p ==> bir_is_valid_state p (bir_state_init p)

name: bir_exec_step_invalid_pc_THM
statement:
!p st. ~(bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc) ==>
          (bir_exec_step p st = (NONE, if (bir_state_is_terminated st) then st else bir_state_set_failed st))

name: bir_exec_step_valid_THM
statement:
!p st. bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc ==>
          (if bir_state_is_terminated st then
             (bir_exec_step p st = (NONE, st))
           else
             (?stmt. (bir_get_current_statement p st.bst_pc = SOME stmt) /\
                     (bir_exec_step p st = (bir_exec_stmt p stmt st))))

name: bir_exec_step_state_valid_THM
statement:
!p st. bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc ==>
          (if bir_state_is_terminated st then
             (bir_exec_step_state p st = st)
           else
             (?stmt. (bir_get_current_statement p st.bst_pc = SOME stmt) /\
                     (bir_exec_step_state p st = (bir_exec_stmt_state p stmt st))))

name: bir_exec_stmtB_well_typed_env_assign
statement:
!st v ex. bir_is_well_typed_env st.bst_environ ==>
              bir_is_well_typed_env (bir_exec_stmt_assign v ex st).bst_environ

name: bir_exec_stmtB_well_typed_env_assert
statement:
!st ex. bir_is_well_typed_env st.bst_environ ==>
            bir_is_well_typed_env (bir_exec_stmt_assert ex st).bst_environ

name: bir_exec_stmtB_well_typed_env_assume
statement:
!st ex. bir_is_well_typed_env st.bst_environ ==>
            bir_is_well_typed_env (bir_exec_stmt_assume ex st).bst_environ

name: bir_exec_stmtB_well_typed_env_observe
statement:
!st el ec.
      bir_is_well_typed_env st.bst_environ ==>
      bir_is_well_typed_env (bir_exec_stmt_observe_state ec el st).bst_environ

name: bir_exec_stmtB_well_typed_env
statement:
!st stmt. bir_is_well_typed_env st.bst_environ ==>
            bir_is_well_typed_env (bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st).bst_environ

name: bir_exec_stmtB_pc_unchanged
statement: !st stmt. (bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st).bst_pc = st.bst_pc

name: bir_exec_stmtB_valid_state_invar
statement:
!p st stmt. bir_is_valid_state p st ==>
              bir_is_valid_state p (bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st)

name: bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label_valid_pc
statement:
!p st l. bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc ==>
             bir_is_valid_pc p (bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p l st).bst_pc

name: bir_exec_stmt_jmp_valid_pc
statement:
!p st l. bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc ==>
             bir_is_valid_pc p (bir_exec_stmt_jmp p l st).bst_pc

name: bir_exec_stmtE_valid_pc_jmp
statement:
!p st l. bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc ==>
             bir_is_valid_pc p (bir_exec_stmtE p (BStmt_Jmp l) st).bst_pc

name: bir_exec_stmtE_valid_pc_cjmp
statement:
!p st ex l1 l2.
       bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc ==>
       bir_is_valid_pc p (bir_exec_stmtE p (BStmt_CJmp ex l1 l2) st).bst_pc

name: bir_exec_stmtE_valid_pc_halt
statement:
!p st ex.  bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc ==>
               bir_is_valid_pc p (bir_exec_stmtE p (BStmt_Halt ex) st).bst_pc

name: bir_exec_stmtE_valid_pc
statement:
!p st stmt. bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc ==>
              bir_is_valid_pc p (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st).bst_pc

name: bir_exec_stmtE_env_unchanged
statement: !p st stmt. (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st).bst_environ = st.bst_environ

name: bir_exec_stmtE_valid_state_invar
statement:
!p st stmt. bir_is_valid_state p st ==>
              bir_is_valid_state p (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st)

name: bir_exec_stmtE_block_pc
statement:
!p st stmt. ~(bir_state_is_terminated (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st)) ==>
              ((bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st).bst_pc.bpc_index = 0)

name: bir_exec_step_valid_pc
statement:
!p st. bir_is_valid_pc p (bir_exec_step_state p st).bst_pc <=>
         bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc

name: bir_exec_step_well_typed_env
statement:
!p st. bir_is_well_typed_env st.bst_environ ==>
         bir_is_well_typed_env (bir_exec_step_state p st).bst_environ

name: bir_exec_step_valid_state_invar
statement:
!p st. bir_is_valid_state p st ==>
         bir_is_valid_state p (bir_exec_step_state p st)

name: bir_is_valid_labels_def
statement:
bir_is_valid_labels p =
  ALL_DISTINCT (bir_labels_of_program p)

name: bir_program_is_empty_def
statement: bir_program_is_empty (BirProgram p) <=> NULL p

name: bir_is_valid_program_def
statement:
bir_is_valid_program p <=>
   (bir_is_valid_labels p) /\ ~(bir_program_is_empty p)

name: bir_is_valid_pc_def
statement:
bir_is_valid_pc p pc =
   (?i bl. (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p (pc.bpc_label) = SOME (i, bl)) /\
           (pc.bpc_index <= LENGTH bl.bb_statements))

name: bir_is_valid_state_def
statement:
bir_is_valid_state p st <=>
  ((bir_is_well_typed_env st.bst_environ) /\ bir_is_valid_pc p st.bst_pc)

name: IN_bir_varset_COMPL
statement: !v vs. v IN bir_varset_COMPL vs <=> (!v'. v' IN vs ==> (bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name v'))

name: bir_varset_COMPL_EMPTY
statement: bir_varset_COMPL EMPTY = UNIV

name: bir_varset_COMPL_UNIV
statement: bir_varset_COMPL UNIV = EMPTY

name: bir_varset_COMPL_SUBSET_COMPL
statement: !vs. bir_varset_COMPL vs SUBSET COMPL vs

name: bir_varset_COMPL_UNION
statement:
!vs1 vs2. bir_varset_COMPL (vs1 UNION vs2) =
             bir_varset_COMPL vs1 INTER bir_varset_COMPL vs2

name: bir_varset_COMPL_SING
statement: !v. bir_varset_COMPL {v} = {v' | bir_var_name v' <> bir_var_name v}

name: bir_varset_COMPL_INSERT
statement:
!v vs. bir_varset_COMPL (v INSERT vs) =
          (bir_varset_COMPL vs INTER {v' | bir_var_name v' <> bir_var_name v})

name: bir_varset_COMPL_SUBSET
statement: !vs1 vs2. vs2 SUBSET vs1 ==> (bir_varset_COMPL vs1 SUBSET bir_varset_COMPL vs2)

name: bir_varset_COMPL_IN_EVAL
statement:
(!v. v IN bir_varset_COMPL EMPTY) /\
  (!v. ~(v IN bir_varset_COMPL UNIV)) /\
  (!v vs1 vs2. (v IN bir_varset_COMPL (vs1 UNION vs2)) <=>
       (v IN bir_varset_COMPL vs1 /\
        v IN bir_varset_COMPL vs2)) /\
  (!v vs v'. (v IN bir_varset_COMPL (v' INSERT vs)) <=>
       (bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name v') /\
       (v IN bir_varset_COMPL vs))

name: bir_changed_vars_of_stmtB_THM
statement:
!st stmt.
   (bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS (bir_varset_COMPL (bir_changed_vars_of_stmtB stmt))
        (bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st).bst_environ (st.bst_environ))

name: bir_changed_vars_of_stmt_THM
statement:
!st p stmt.
   (bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS (bir_varset_COMPL (bir_changed_vars_of_stmt stmt))
        (bir_exec_stmt_state p stmt st).bst_environ (st.bst_environ))

name: bir_changed_vars_exec_step_THM
statement:
!(p:'a bir_program_t) st.
   (bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS (bir_varset_COMPL (bir_changed_vars_of_program p))
        ((bir_exec_step_state p st).bst_environ) (st.bst_environ))

name: bir_changed_vars_exec_step_n_THM
statement:
!(p:'a bir_program_t) n st.
   (bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS (bir_varset_COMPL (bir_changed_vars_of_program p))
        ((let (ol, n', st') = bir_exec_step_n p st n in st').bst_environ) (st.bst_environ))

name: bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS_ALT_DEF
statement:
!vs st1 st2.
  bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2 <=>
  (st1.bst_pc = st2.bst_pc) /\ (st1.bst_status = st2.bst_status) /\
  bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1.bst_environ st2.bst_environ

name: bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS_SYM_thm
statement:
!vs st1 st2.
  bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2 <=>
  bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st2 st1

name: bir_vars_EQ_state_restrict_vars_THM
statement:
!vs st.
    bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st (bir_state_restrict_vars vs st)

name: bir_vars_of_stmtB_THM
statement:
!st1 st2 vs stmt.
    (bir_vars_of_stmtB stmt SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (let (oo1, st1') = bir_exec_stmtB stmt st1 in
     let (oo2, st2') = bir_exec_stmtB stmt st2 in
     ((oo1 = oo2) /\ (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2')))

name: bir_vars_of_stmtB_state_THM
statement:
!st1 st2 vs stmt.
    (bir_vars_of_stmtB stmt SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>

    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs
      (bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st1)
      (bir_exec_stmtB_state stmt st2))

name: bir_vars_of_stmtE_THM
statement:
!st1 st2 vs p stmt.
    (bir_vars_of_stmtE stmt SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs
      (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st1)
      (bir_exec_stmtE p stmt st2))

name: bir_vars_of_stmt_THM
statement:
!st1 st2 vs p stmt.
    (bir_vars_of_stmt stmt SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (let (oo1, st1') = bir_exec_stmt p stmt st1 in
     let (oo2, st2') = bir_exec_stmt p stmt st2 in
     ((oo1 = oo2) /\ (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2')))

name: bir_vars_of_stmt_state_THM
statement:
!st1 st2 vs p stmt.
    (bir_vars_of_stmt stmt SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs
      (bir_exec_stmt_state p stmt st1)
      (bir_exec_stmt_state p stmt st2))

name: bir_vars_exec_step_THM
statement:
!p st1 st2 vs.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (let (oo1, st1') = bir_exec_step p st1 in
     let (oo2, st2') = bir_exec_step p st2 in
     ((oo1 = oo2) /\ (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2')))

name: bir_vars_exec_step_state_THM
statement:
!p st1 st2 vs.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs (bir_exec_step_state p st1) (bir_exec_step_state p st2))

name: bir_vars_exec_infinite_step_fun_THM
statement:
!p vs i st1 st2.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st1 i) (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st2 i))

name: bir_vars_exec_step_n_THM
statement:
!p vs n st1 st2.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (let (ol1, n1, st1') = bir_exec_step_n p st1 n in
     let (ol2, n2, st2') = bir_exec_step_n p st2 n in
     ((ol1 = ol2) /\ (n1 = n2) /\ (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2')))

name: bir_vars_exec_steps_THM_aux_SOME
statement:
!p vs st1 st2 st1' ol c c'.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps p st1 = BER_Ended ol c c' st1') ==>
    (?st2'. (bir_exec_steps p st2 = BER_Ended ol c c' st2') /\
            (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2'))

name: bir_vars_exec_steps_THM_aux_NONE
statement:
!p vs st1 st2 st1' ll1 ll2.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps p st1 = BER_Looping ll1) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps p st2 = BER_Looping ll2) ==>
    (ll1 = ll2)

name: bir_vars_exec_steps_THM
statement:
!p vs st1 st2.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (case (bir_exec_steps p st1, bir_exec_steps p st2) of
         | (BER_Looping ll1, BER_Looping ll2) => ll1 = ll2
         | (BER_Ended ol1 n1 n1' st1', BER_Ended ol2 n2 n2' st2') =>
              (ol1 = ol2) /\ (n1 = n2) /\ (n2' = n2) /\ (n1' = n2) /\
              (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2')
         | (_, _) => F)

name: bir_vars_state_COUNT_PC_THM
statement:
!vs st1 st2 pc_cond.
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st1 =
     bir_state_COUNT_PC pc_cond st2)

name: bir_vars_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs_THM
statement:
!vs st1 st2 pc_cond p i.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st1 i =
     bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun_COUNT_PCs pc_cond p st2 i)

name: bir_vars_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS_THM
statement:
!vs st1 st2 pc_cond p max_steps_opt.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond max_steps_opt p st1 =
     bir_exec_infinite_steps_COUNT_STEPS pc_cond max_steps_opt p st2)

name: bir_vars_exec_steps_observe_llist_aux_THM
statement:
!vs st1 st2 p i.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (FST (bir_exec_step p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st1 i)) =
     FST (bir_exec_step p (bir_exec_infinite_steps_fun p st2 i)))

name: bir_vars_exec_steps_observe_llist_THM
statement:
!vs st1 st2 p step_no.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st1 step_no =
     bir_exec_steps_observe_llist p st2 step_no)

name: bir_vars_exec_steps_GEN_THM
statement:
!vs st1 st2 pc_cond p max_steps_opt.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (case (bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st1 max_steps_opt, bir_exec_steps_GEN pc_cond p st2 max_steps_opt) of
         | (BER_Looping ll1, BER_Looping ll2) => ll1 = ll2
         | (BER_Ended ol1 n1 n1' st1', BER_Ended ol2 n2 n2' st2') =>
              (ol1 = ol2) /\ (n1 = n2) /\ (n1' = n2') /\
              (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2')
         | (_, _) => F)

name: bir_vars_exec_to_labels_n_THM
statement:
!vs st1 st2 p ls n.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (case (bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st1 n, bir_exec_to_labels_n ls p st2 n) of
         | (BER_Looping ll1, BER_Looping ll2) => ll1 = ll2
         | (BER_Ended ol1 n1 n1' st1', BER_Ended ol2 n2 n2' st2') =>
              (ol1 = ol2) /\ (n1 = n2) /\ (n1' = n2') /\
              (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2')
         | (_, _) => F)

name: bir_vars_exec_to_labels_THM
statement:
!ls p vs st1 st2.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (case (bir_exec_to_labels ls p st1, bir_exec_to_labels ls p st2) of
         | (BER_Looping ll1, BER_Looping ll2) => ll1 = ll2
         | (BER_Ended ol1 n1 n1' st1', BER_Ended ol2 n2 n2' st2') =>
              (ol1 = ol2) /\ (n1 = n2) /\ (n1' = n2') /\
              (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2')
         | (_, _) => F)

name: bir_vars_exec_to_labels_spec_THM
statement:
!ls p vs st1 st2 ol n n' st1'.
    (bir_vars_of_program p SUBSET vs) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls p st1 = BER_Ended ol n n' st1') ==>
    ?st2'. bir_exec_to_labels ls p st2 = BER_Ended ol n n' st2' /\
           bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2'

name: bir_vars_exec_to_labels_spec2_THM
statement:
!ls p vs st1 st2 ol n n' st1'.
    (vs = bir_vars_of_program p) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls p st1 = BER_Ended ol n n' st1') ==>
    ?st2'. bir_exec_to_labels ls p st2 = BER_Ended ol n n' st2' /\
           bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2'

name: bir_varset_COMPL_def
statement:
bir_varset_COMPL vs =
  {v | !v'. v' IN vs ==> (bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name v')}

name: bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS_def
statement:
bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2 <=> (
    ?env.
      (st2 = st1 with bst_environ := env) /\
      bir_env_EQ_FOR_VARS vs env (st1.bst_environ))

name: bir_is_subprogram_REFL
statement: !p. bir_is_subprogram p p

name: bir_is_subprogram_TRANS
statement: !p1 p2 p3. bir_is_subprogram p1 p2 ==> (bir_is_subprogram p2 p3) ==> bir_is_subprogram p1 p3

name: bir_program_eq_REFL
statement: !p. bir_program_eq p p

name: bir_program_eq_SYM
statement: !p1 p2. (bir_program_eq p1 p2) <=> (bir_program_eq p2 p1)

name: bir_program_eq_TRANS
statement: !p1 p2 p3. (bir_program_eq p1 p2) ==> (bir_program_eq p2 p3) ==> bir_program_eq p1 p3

name: bir_is_subprogram_ANTISYM
statement: !p1 p2. (bir_program_eq p1 p2) <=> ((bir_is_subprogram p1 p2) /\ (bir_is_subprogram p2 p1))

name: bir_subprogram_eq_cong
statement:
!p_sub p_sub' p p'.
   bir_program_eq p p' ==>
   bir_program_eq p_sub p_sub' ==>
   (bir_is_subprogram p_sub p <=> bir_is_subprogram p_sub' p')

name: bir_program_combine_SUBPROGRAMS
statement:
(!p1 p2. bir_is_subprogram p1 (bir_program_combine p1 p2)) /\
    (!p1 p2. bir_is_subprogram p2 (bir_program_combine p1 p2))

name: bir_program_combine_NEUTRAL
statement:
(!p. bir_program_combine p (BirProgram []) = p) /\
    (!p. bir_program_combine (BirProgram []) p = p)

name: bir_program_combine_COMM
statement: !p1 p2. bir_program_eq (bir_program_combine p1 p2) (bir_program_combine p2 p1)

name: bir_program_combine_ASSOC
statement:
!p1 p2 p3. (bir_program_combine p1 (bir_program_combine p2 p3)) =
               (bir_program_combine (bir_program_combine p1 p2) p3)

name: bir_is_subprogram_BLOCKS_SUBLIST
statement:
!p_sub p. bir_is_subprogram (BirProgram p_sub) (BirProgram p) ==>
              (!bl. MEM bl p_sub ==> MEM bl p)

name: bir_program_eq_BLOCKS_EQ
statement:
!p1 p2. bir_program_eq (BirProgram p1) (BirProgram p2) ==>
              (!bl. MEM bl p1 <=> MEM bl p2)

name: bir_labels_of_program_SUBPROGRAM
statement:
!p1 p2. bir_is_subprogram p1 p2 ==>
          (!l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p1) ==> MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p2))

name: bir_labels_of_program_PROGRAM_EQ
statement:
!p1 p2. bir_program_eq p1 p2 ==>
          (!l. MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p1) <=> MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p2))

name: bir_labels_of_program_PROGRAM_COMBINE
statement:
!p1 p2. bir_labels_of_program (bir_program_combine p1 p2) =
          (bir_labels_of_program p1) ++ (bir_labels_of_program p2)

name: bir_is_valid_labels_SUBPROGRAM
statement:
!p1 p2. bir_is_subprogram p1 p2 ==>
          bir_is_valid_labels p2 ==>
          bir_is_valid_labels p1

name: bir_is_valid_labels_PROGRAM_EQ
statement:
!p1 p2. bir_program_eq p1 p2 ==>
          (bir_is_valid_labels p1 <=> bir_is_valid_labels p2)

name: bir_is_valid_labels_PROGRAM_COMBINE
statement:
!p1 p2. bir_is_valid_labels (bir_program_combine p1 p2) <=>
          (bir_is_valid_labels p1 /\ bir_is_valid_labels p2 /\
           (!l. ~(MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p1)) \/ ~(MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p2))))

name: bir_program_is_empty_SUBPROGRAM
statement:
!p1 p2. bir_is_subprogram p1 p2 ==>
          bir_program_is_empty p2 ==>
          bir_program_is_empty p1

name: bir_program_is_empty_PROGRAM_EQ
statement:
!p1 p2. bir_program_eq p1 p2 ==>
          (bir_program_is_empty p1 <=> bir_program_is_empty p2)

name: bir_program_is_empty_PROGRAM_COMBINE
statement:
!p1 p2. bir_program_is_empty (bir_program_combine p1 p2) <=>
          (bir_program_is_empty p1 /\ bir_program_is_empty p2)

name: bir_get_program_block_info_by_label_SUBPROGRAM
statement:
!p1 p2 l n1 bl.
          bir_is_subprogram p1 p2 ==>
          bir_is_valid_labels p2 ==>
          (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p1 l = SOME (n1, bl)) ==>
          ?n2. (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p2 l = SOME (n2, bl))

name: bir_is_valid_pc_SUBPROGRAM
statement:
!p1 p2 pc.
          bir_is_subprogram p1 p2 ==>
          bir_is_valid_labels p2 ==>
          bir_is_valid_pc p1 pc ==>
          bir_is_valid_pc p2 pc

name: bir_is_valid_pc_PROGRAM_EQ
statement:
!p1 p2 pc.
          bir_program_eq p1 p2 ==>
          bir_is_valid_labels p2 ==>
          (bir_is_valid_pc p1 pc <=> bir_is_valid_pc p2 pc)

name: bir_get_current_statement_SUBPROGRAM
statement:
!p1 p2 pc stmt.
          bir_is_subprogram p1 p2 ==>
          bir_is_valid_labels p2 ==>
          (bir_get_current_statement p1 pc = SOME stmt) ==>
          (bir_get_current_statement p2 pc = SOME stmt)

name: bir_get_current_statement_PROGRAM_EQ
statement:
!p1 p2 pc.
          bir_program_eq p1 p2 ==>
          bir_is_valid_labels p2 ==>
          (bir_get_current_statement p1 pc = bir_get_current_statement p2 pc)

name: bir_vars_of_program_SUBPROGRAM
statement:
!env prog1 prog2.
    bir_is_subprogram prog1 prog2 ==>
    ((bir_vars_of_program prog1) SUBSET (bir_vars_of_program prog2))

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_SUBPROGRAM
statement:
!env prog1 prog2.
    bir_is_subprogram prog1 prog2 ==>
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_program prog2) ==>
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_program prog1)

name: bir_jumped_outside_termination_cond_NOT_PROGRAM_EQ
statement:
!p1 p2 st1 st2.
    bir_program_eq p1 p2 ==>

     bir_is_subprogram p1 p2 ==>
     bir_is_valid_labels p2 ==>
     bir_is_valid_pc p1 st.bst_pc ==>
     ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>

name: bir_is_subprogram_def
statement:
bir_is_subprogram (BirProgram p_sub) (BirProgram p) <=>
  (?l'. PERM (p_sub ++ l') p)

name: bir_program_eq_def
statement:
bir_program_eq (BirProgram p1) (BirProgram p2) <=>
  PERM p1 p2

name: bir_program_combine_def
statement:
bir_program_combine (BirProgram p1) (BirProgram p2) =

name: bir_jumped_outside_termination_cond_def
statement:
bir_jumped_outside_termination_cond (p1 : 'a bir_program_t) (p2 : 'a bir_program_t) st1 st2 <=>
  ?l. (st1.bst_status = BST_JumpOutside l) /\
      (MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p2)) /\
      ~(MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p1)) /\
      (st2 = (st1 with <| bst_status := BST_Running;
                          bst_pc := (bir_block_pc l) |>))

                   (bir_updateB_desc_value up)) /\
        (OPTION_MAP type_of_bir_val (bir_updateB_desc_value up) = SOME (bir_var_type (bir_updateB_desc_var up))) /\
               (bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_temp_var up)) st'.bst_environ =
                   (bir_updateB_desc_value up)) /\
        (OPTION_MAP type_of_bir_val (bir_updateB_desc_value up) = SOME (bir_var_type (bir_updateB_desc_temp_var up))))
    updates) /\
  (!var v. (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = SOME var) ==>
           (bir_updateE_desc_value eup = SOME v) ==>
           ((bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name var) st'.bst_environ =
            SOME (BVal_Imm v)) /\ (type_of_bir_val (BVal_Imm v) = bir_var_type var))) /\

  
  (!vn. (EVERY (\up. (vn <> bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_var up)) /\
                     (vn <> bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_temp_var up))) updates) ==>
        (!var. (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = SOME var) ==> (bir_var_name var <> vn)) ==>
        (bir_env_lookup vn st'.bst_environ = bir_env_lookup vn st.bst_environ)))

name: bir_assert_block_SEM
statement:
!st al l.
  EVERY (bir_assert_desc_OK st.bst_environ) al ==>
  ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>

  (!c.
  (bir_exec_stmtsB (bir_assert_block al) (l, c, st) =
  (case INDEX_FIND 0 (\a. ~(bir_assert_desc_value a)) al of
     | NONE        => (REVERSE l, c + LENGTH al, st)
     | SOME (n, _) => (REVERSE l, c + SUC n, (st with bst_status := BST_AssertionViolated)))))

name: bir_assert_block_SEM_NOT_FAIL
statement:
!st al (l:(num # 'a) list) c l' c' st'.
  EVERY (bir_assert_desc_OK st.bst_environ) al ==>
  ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
  (bir_exec_stmtsB (bir_assert_block al) (l, c, st) = (l', c', st')) ==>
  ~(st'.bst_status = BST_AssertionViolated) ==>

  ((l' = REVERSE l) /\
   (c' = c + LENGTH al) /\
   (st' = st) /\
   (EVERY (\a. bir_assert_desc_value a) al))

name: bir_assert_block_SEM_NOT_FAIL_BLOCK
statement:
!al bl (p : 'a bir_program_t) (l:(num # 'a) list) c st st'.
  EVERY (bir_assert_desc_OK st.bst_environ) al ==>
  ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
  (bir_exec_block p (bl with bb_statements := (bir_assert_block al) ++ bl.bb_statements) st = (l, c, st')) ==>
  ~(st'.bst_status = BST_AssertionViolated) ==>

  ((LENGTH al < c) /\
  (bir_exec_block p bl st = (l, c - LENGTH al,
     if (bir_state_is_terminated st') then
        (st' with bst_pc := (st'.bst_pc with bpc_index := st'.bst_pc.bpc_index - LENGTH al))
     else st')) /\
  (EVERY (\a. bir_assert_desc_value a) al))

            SOME (BVal_Imm v)) /\ (type_of_bir_val (BVal_Imm v) = bir_var_type var))) /\

  
  (!vn. (EVERY (\up. (vn <> bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_var up)) /\
                     (vn <> bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_temp_var up))) updates) ==>
        (!var. (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = SOME var) ==> (bir_var_name var <> vn)) ==>

name: bir_changed_vars_of_update_block
statement:
bir_changed_vars_of_block (bir_update_block l eup dl) =

  (case bir_updateE_desc_var eup of SOME v => {v} | _ => {}) UNION
  (set (MAP bir_updateB_desc_var dl)) UNION
  (set (MAP bir_updateB_desc_temp_var (FILTER bir_updateB_desc_use_temp dl)))

name: bir_changed_vars_of_update_assert_block_AUX
statement:
bir_changed_vars_of_block (((bir_update_assert_block l al eup dl)):'a bir_block_t) =
  bir_changed_vars_of_block ((bir_update_block l eup dl):'a bir_block_t)

name: bir_changed_vars_of_update_assert_block
statement:
bir_changed_vars_of_block (((bir_update_assert_block l al eup dl)):'a bir_block_t) =
  (case bir_updateE_desc_var eup of SOME v => {v} | _ => {}) UNION
  (set (MAP bir_updateB_desc_var dl)) UNION
  (set (MAP bir_updateB_desc_temp_var (FILTER bir_updateB_desc_use_temp dl)))

name: bir_updateB_desc_var_def
statement: bir_updateB_desc_var (BUpdateDescB var _ _ _) = var

name: bir_updateB_desc_temp_var_def
statement:
bir_updateB_desc_temp_var (BUpdateDescB var _ _ use_temp) =
          bir_temp_var use_temp var

name: bir_updateB_desc_exp_def
statement: bir_updateB_desc_exp (BUpdateDescB _ e _ _) = e

name: bir_updateB_desc_value_def
statement: bir_updateB_desc_value (BUpdateDescB _ _ v _) = v

name: bir_updateB_desc_use_temp_def
statement: bir_updateB_desc_use_temp (BUpdateDescB _ _ _ ut) = ut

name: bir_vars_of_updateB_desc_def
statement:
bir_vars_of_updateB_desc d =
  ((bir_updateB_desc_temp_var d) INSERT
   (bir_updateB_desc_var d) INSERT
   (bir_vars_of_exp (bir_updateB_desc_exp d)))

name: bir_updateB_desc_OK_def
statement:
bir_updateB_desc_OK env (BUpdateDescB var e v_opt use_temp) <=> (
     
     (?v. (v_opt = SOME v) /\
          (type_of_bir_val v = (bir_var_type var))
     ) /\

     
     (~(bir_is_temp_var_name (bir_var_name var))) /\

     
     bir_env_var_is_declared env var /\
     bir_env_var_is_declared env (bir_temp_var use_temp var) /\

     
     (bir_eval_exp e env = v_opt)
  )

name: bir_update_blockB_desc_OK_def
statement:
bir_update_blockB_desc_OK env updates <=> (

  
  EVERY (bir_updateB_desc_OK env) updates /\

  
  (ALL_DISTINCT (MAP (\up. bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_var up)) updates)) /\

  
  (!i j var. (i < LENGTH updates) /\ (j < i) /\
             var IN (bir_vars_of_exp (bir_updateB_desc_exp (EL i updates))) ==>
             (bir_var_name var <>
                 bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_temp_var (EL j updates)))))

name: bir_update_blockB_STEP1_def
statement:
bir_update_blockB_STEP1 (BUpdateDescB var e v use_temp) =
  BStmt_Assign (bir_temp_var use_temp var) e

name: bir_update_blockB_STEP2_def
statement:
(bir_update_blockB_STEP2 (BUpdateDescB var e v T) =
     (BStmt_Assign var (BExp_Den (bir_temp_var T var))))

name: bir_update_blockB_def
statement:
bir_update_blockB updates =
  (MAP bir_update_blockB_STEP1 updates) ++
  (MAP bir_update_blockB_STEP2 (FILTER bir_updateB_desc_use_temp updates))

name: bir_updateE_SEM_def
statement:
(bir_updateE_SEM (BUpdateDescE_Jmp l) = BUpdateValE_Jmp l) /\
   (bir_updateE_SEM (BUpdateDescE_CJmp _ _ b l1 l2) =
      BUpdateValE_Jmp (if b then l1 else l2)) /\
   (bir_updateE_SEM (BUpdateDescE_XJmp _ _ i) =
      BUpdateValE_Jmp (BL_Address i)) /\
   (bir_updateE_SEM (BUpdateDescE_Halt _ _ v) =
      BUpdateValE_Halt v)

name: bir_state_pc_is_at_label_def
statement:
bir_state_pc_is_at_label p l_new st =
    (if MEM l_new (bir_labels_of_program p) then
        ((st.bst_pc = bir_block_pc l_new) /\
         (st.bst_status = BST_Running))
     else
        (st.bst_status = BST_JumpOutside l_new))

name: BUpdateValE_SEM_def
statement:
(BUpdateValE_SEM st p (BUpdateValE_Halt v) =
     (st.bst_status = BST_Halted (BVal_Imm v))) /\
  (BUpdateValE_SEM st p (BUpdateValE_Jmp l_new) =
    (bir_state_pc_is_at_label p l_new st))

name: BUpdateValE_EXEC_def
statement:
(BUpdateValE_EXEC p (BUpdateValE_Halt v) =
    bir_exec_stmt_halt (BExp_Const v)) /\
  (BUpdateValE_EXEC p (BUpdateValE_Jmp l_new) =
    bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p l_new)

name: bir_updateE_desc_var_def
statement:
(bir_updateE_desc_var (BUpdateDescE_Jmp l) = NONE) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_var (BUpdateDescE_CJmp vo _ _ _ _) = vo) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_var (BUpdateDescE_XJmp vo _ _) = vo) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_var (BUpdateDescE_Halt vo _ _) = vo)

name: bir_updateE_desc_exp_def
statement:
(bir_updateE_desc_exp (BUpdateDescE_Jmp l) = NONE) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_exp (BUpdateDescE_CJmp _ c _ _ _) = SOME c) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_exp (BUpdateDescE_XJmp _ e _) = (SOME e)) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_exp (BUpdateDescE_Halt _ e _) = SOME e)

name: bir_updateE_desc_value_def
statement:
(bir_updateE_desc_value (BUpdateDescE_Jmp _) = NONE) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_value (BUpdateDescE_CJmp _ _ b _ _) = SOME (bool2b b)) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_value (BUpdateDescE_XJmp _ _ v) = (SOME v)) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_value (BUpdateDescE_Halt _ _ v) = SOME v)

name: bir_updateE_desc_final_exp_def
statement:
bir_updateE_desc_final_exp d =
    (case (bir_updateE_desc_var d) of
       SOME v => SOME (BExp_Den v)
     | NONE => (case (bir_updateE_desc_exp d) of
       | SOME e => SOME e
       | NONE => NONE))

name: bir_updateE_desc_final_exp_vars_def
statement:
bir_updateE_desc_final_exp_vars d =
  case bir_updateE_desc_final_exp d of
      SOME e => bir_vars_of_exp e
    | NONE => {}

name: bir_updateE_desc_remove_var_def
statement:
(bir_updateE_desc_remove_var (BUpdateDescE_Jmp l) = (BUpdateDescE_Jmp l)) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_remove_var (BUpdateDescE_CJmp vo e b l1 l2) =
     (BUpdateDescE_CJmp NONE e b l1 l2)) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_remove_var (BUpdateDescE_XJmp vo e i) = (BUpdateDescE_XJmp NONE e i)) /\
  (bir_updateE_desc_remove_var (BUpdateDescE_Halt vo e i) =
     (BUpdateDescE_Halt NONE e i))

name: bir_updateE_desc_OK_def
statement:
bir_updateE_desc_OK env d <=> (
     (!e v. ((bir_updateE_desc_exp d = SOME e) /\ (bir_updateE_desc_value d = SOME v)) ==>
            (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm (type_of_bir_imm v))) /\
            (bir_eval_exp e env = SOME (BVal_Imm v))) /\

     (!e var. ((bir_updateE_desc_var d = SOME var) /\ (bir_updateE_desc_exp d = SOME e)) ==>
              (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (bir_var_type var)) /\
              bir_env_var_is_declared env var)
  )

name: bir_update_block_desc_OK_def
statement:
bir_update_block_desc_OK env eup updates <=> (

  bir_update_blockB_desc_OK env updates /\
  bir_updateE_desc_OK env eup /\

  (!v up v'. (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = SOME v) ==>
             (MEM up updates) ==>
             (v' IN (bir_vars_of_updateB_desc up)) ==>
             ((bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name v'))) /\

  (!v e up v'. (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = NONE) ==>
               (bir_updateE_desc_exp eup = SOME e) ==>
               (v IN bir_vars_of_exp e) ==>
               MEM up updates ==>
               (v' IN {bir_updateB_desc_temp_var up; bir_updateB_desc_var up}) ==>
               ((bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name v'))))

name: bir_update_blockE_INIT_def
statement:
(bir_update_blockE_INIT d =
   case (bir_updateE_desc_var d, bir_updateE_desc_exp d) of
     | (SOME v, SOME e) => [BStmt_Assign v e]
     | (_, _) => [])

name: bir_update_blockE_FINAL_def
statement:
(bir_update_blockE_FINAL (BUpdateDescE_Jmp l) = BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Label l)) /\
  (bir_update_blockE_FINAL (BUpdateDescE_CJmp vo e _ l1 l2) = BStmt_CJmp
    (option_CASE vo e (\v. BExp_Den v)) (BLE_Label l1) (BLE_Label l2)) /\
  (bir_update_blockE_FINAL (BUpdateDescE_XJmp vo e i) = BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Exp
    (option_CASE vo e (\v. BExp_Den v)))) /\
  (bir_update_blockE_FINAL (BUpdateDescE_Halt vo e _) = BStmt_Halt (option_CASE vo e (\v. BExp_Den v)))

name: bir_assert_desc_value_def

m0_mod_step_thm
statement:
!s s' (d:word64) sm.
    (s = m0_mod_inv sm) ==>
    (NextStateM0 s = SOME s') ==>
    (s'.count = s.count + (w2n d)) ==>

    (sm.countw <=+ (n2w ((2 ** 64) - 1)) - d) ==>
    (NextStateM0_mod sm = SOME (<| base := s'; countw := sm.countw + d |>))

name: m0_mod_step_gen_thm
statement:
!s' (d:word64) sm.
    (NextStateM0 (m0_mod_inv sm) = SOME s') ==>
    (s'.count = (m0_mod_inv sm).count + (w2n d)) ==>

    (sm.countw <=+ (n2w ((2 ** 64) - 1)) - d) ==>
    (NextStateM0_mod sm = SOME (<| base := s'; countw := sm.countw + d |>))

name: m0_mod_step_gen_relaxed_thm
statement:
!s' (d:word64) (dmax:word64) sm.
    (NextStateM0 (m0_mod_inv sm) = SOME s') ==>
    (d <=+ dmax) ==>
    (s'.count = (m0_mod_inv sm).count + (w2n d)) ==>

    (sm.countw <=+ (n2w ((2 ** 64) - 1)) - dmax) ==>
    (NextStateM0_mod sm = SOME (<| base := s'; countw := sm.countw + d |>))

name: m0_mod_def
statement: m0_mod s = if s.count < (2 ** 64) then SOME (<| base := s; countw := n2w s.count |>) else NONE

name: m0_mod_inv_def
statement: m0_mod_inv sm = sm.base with <| count := w2n sm.countw |>

name: NextStateM0_mod_def
statement:
NextStateM0_mod sm = case NextStateM0 (m0_mod_inv sm) of
                       | NONE    => NONE
                       | SOME s' => m0_mod s'

name: t_jgmt_imp_partial_triple
statement:
!TS l ls pre post.
 first_enc TS ==>
 t_jgmt TS l ls pre post ==>
 p_jgmt TS l ls pre post

name: partial_case_rule_thm
statement:
!TS l ls pre post C1.
 p_jgmt TS l ls (\s. (pre s) /\ (C1 s)) post ==>
 p_jgmt TS l ls (\s. (pre s) /\ (~(C1 s))) post ==>
 p_jgmt TS l ls pre post

name: partial_weakening_rule_thm
statement:
!TS. 
 !l ls pre1 pre2 post1 post2.
 first_enc TS ==>
 (!s. TS.ctrl s = l ==> pre2 s ==> pre1 s) ==>
 (!s. TS.ctrl s IN ls ==> post1 s ==> post2 s) ==>
 p_jgmt TS l ls pre1 post1 ==>
 p_jgmt TS l ls pre2 post2

name: partial_subset_rule_thm
statement:
!TS. !l ls1 ls2 pre post.
 first_enc TS ==>
 (!s. post s ==> ~(TS.ctrl s IN ls2)) ==>
 p_jgmt TS l (ls1 UNION ls2) pre post ==>
 p_jgmt TS l ls1 pre post

name: partial_conj_rule_thm
statement:
!TS.
 first_enc TS ==>
 !l ls pre post1 post2.
 p_jgmt TS l ls pre post1 ==>
 p_jgmt TS l ls pre post2 ==>
 p_jgmt TS l ls pre (\s. post1 s /\ post2 s)

name: total_to_partial
statement:
!TS l ls pre post.
 first_enc TS ==>
 t_jgmt TS l ls pre post ==>
 p_jgmt TS l ls pre post

name: partial_seq_rule_thm
statement:
!TS l ls1 ls2 pre post.
 first_enc TS ==>
 p_jgmt TS l (ls1 UNION ls2) pre post ==>
 (!l1. l1 IN ls1 ==>
   p_jgmt TS l1 ls2 post post
 ) ==>
 p_jgmt TS l ls2 pre post

name: partial_loop_rule_thm
statement:
!TS.
 first_enc TS ==>
 !l le invariant C1 var post.
 partial_loop_contract TS l le invariant C1 ==>
 p_jgmt TS l le (\st. invariant st /\ ~(C1 st)) post ==>
 p_jgmt TS l le invariant post

name: p_jgmt_def
statement:
p_jgmt TS (l:'b) (ls:'b->bool) pre post =
 !s s'.
  TS.ctrl s = l ==>
  pre s ==>
  TS.weak ls s s' ==>
  post s'

name: partial_loop_contract_def
statement:
partial_loop_contract TS l le invariant C1 =
    (l NOTIN le /\
     p_jgmt TS l ({l} UNION le) (\s. invariant s /\ C1 s)
       (\s. TS.ctrl s = l /\ invariant s))

name: total_ext_emb_rule_thm
statement:
!TS TS' invariant l ls ls' pre post.
  first_enc TS ==>
  first_enc TS' ==>
  (!s ls s'. TS.weak s ls s' ==> TS'.weak s ls s') ==>
  (!s l. TS'.ctrl s = l  ==> TS.ctrl s = l) ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls ls' pre post ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS' invariant l ls ls' pre post

name: total_ext_el_subset_rule_thm
statement:
!TS.
  !invariant l ls ls' ls'' pre post.
  first_enc TS ==>
  ls'' SUBSET ls' ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls ls' pre post ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls ls'' pre post

name: total_ext_el_to_il_rule_thm
statement:
!TS invariant l l' ls ls' pre post.
  first_enc TS ==>
  l' IN ls' ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls ls' pre post ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l (l' INSERT ls) (ls' DELETE l') pre post

name: total_ext_il_to_el_rule_thm
statement:
!TS invariant l l' ls ls' pre post.
  first_enc TS ==>
  l' IN ls ==>
  ls DELETE l' <> {} ==>
  (!s. TS.ctrl s = l' ==> (post s = F)) ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls ls' pre post ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l (ls DELETE l') (l' INSERT ls') pre post

name: total_ext_il_to_el_set_rule_thm
statement:
!TS invariant l ls ls' ls'' pre post.
  first_enc TS ==>
  FINITE ls'' ==>
  ls'' PSUBSET ls ==>
  (!s l'.
   l' IN ls'' ==>
   TS.ctrl s = l' ==>
   (post s = F)
  ) ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls ls' pre post ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l (ls DIFF ls'') (ls' UNION ls'') pre post

name: total_ext_post_weak_rule_thm
statement:
!TS invariant l ls ls' pre post1 post2.
  first_enc TS ==>
  (!s. (TS.ctrl s) IN ls ==> (post1 s) ==> (post2 s)) ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls ls' pre post1 ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls ls' pre post2

name: total_ext_pre_str_rule_thm
statement:
!TS invariant l ls ls' pre1 pre2 post.
  first_enc TS ==>
  (!s. TS.ctrl s = l ==> pre2 s ==> pre1 s) ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls ls' pre1 post ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls ls' pre2 post

name: total_ext_seq_one_rule_thm
statement:
!TS invariant l il1 il2 el1 el2 pre post.
  first_enc TS ==>
  el1 INTER el2 = {} ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l (il1 UNION il2) (el1 UNION el2) pre post ==>
  (!l1.
   l1 IN il1 ==>
   t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l1 (il2 UNION el1) el2 post post
  ) ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l (il2 UNION el1) el2 pre post

name: total_ext_std_seq_rule_thm
statement:
!TS ls1 ls1' ls2 ls2' invariant l pre1 post1 post2.
  first_enc TS ==>
  ls1' SUBSET ls2 ==>
  ls1 INTER ls1' = EMPTY ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls1 ls2 pre1 post1 ==>
  (!l1. l1 IN ls1 ==> t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l1 ls1' ls2' post1 post2) ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ls1' (ls2 INTER ls2') pre1 post2

name: total_ext_loop_rule_thm
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !l il el invariant C1 wf_rel var post.
  WF wf_rel ==>
  l NOTIN il ==> 
  l NOTIN el ==>
  (!x. t_ext_jgmt TS invariant l ({l} UNION il) el
    (\s. C1 s /\ (var s = x))
    (\s. (TS.ctrl s = l) /\ wf_rel (var s) x)) ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS (\s. T) l il el (\s. ~(C1 s) /\ invariant s) post ==>
  t_ext_jgmt TS (\s. T) l il el invariant post

name: t_ext_jgmt_def
statement:
t_ext_jgmt m invariant (l:'a) (ls:'a->bool) (ls':'a->bool) pre post =
  (ls INTER ls' = EMPTY /\ ls <> EMPTY /\
   (t_jgmt m l (ls UNION ls')
               (\s. pre s /\ invariant s)
               (\s. if m.ctrl s IN ls'
                    then F
                    else post s /\ invariant s))
  )

name: total_emb_rule_thm
statement:
!TS TS'.
  first_enc TS ==>
  first_enc TS' ==>
  (!ls s s'. TS.weak ls s s' ==> TS'.weak ls s s') ==>
  (!s l. (TS'.ctrl s = l)  ==> (TS.ctrl s = l)) ==>
  !l ls pre post.
   t_jgmt TS l ls pre post ==>
   t_jgmt TS' l ls pre post

name: total_case_rule_thm
statement:
!m l ls pre post C1.
  t_jgmt m l ls (\ms. pre ms /\ C1 ms) post ==>
  t_jgmt m l ls (\ms. pre ms /\ ~(C1 ms)) post ==>
  t_jgmt m l ls pre post

name: total_conseq_rule_thm
statement:
!TS. 
  !l ls pre1 pre2 post1 post2.
  first_enc TS ==>
  (!s. TS.ctrl s = l ==> pre2 s ==> pre1 s) ==>
  (!s. TS.ctrl s IN ls ==> post1 s ==> post2 s) ==>
  t_jgmt TS l ls pre1 post1 ==>
  t_jgmt TS l ls pre2 post2

name: total_subset_rule_thm
statement:
!TS.
  !l ls1 ls2 pre post.
   first_enc TS ==>
   (!s. post s ==> ~(TS.ctrl s IN ls2)) ==>
   t_jgmt TS l (ls1 UNION ls2) pre post ==>
   t_jgmt TS l ls1 pre post

name: total_seq_rule_thm
statement:
!TS l ls1 ls2 pre post.
  first_enc TS ==>
  t_jgmt TS l (ls1 UNION ls2) pre post ==>
  (!l1.
   l1 IN ls1 ==>
   t_jgmt TS l1 ls2 post post
  ) ==>
  t_jgmt TS l ls2 pre post

name: total_conj_rule
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !l ls pre post1 post2.
  t_jgmt TS l ls pre post1 ==>
  t_jgmt TS l ls pre post2 ==>
  t_jgmt TS l ls pre (\s. post1 s /\ post2 s)

name: inductive_invariant
statement: ^inductive_invariant_goal

name: total_loop_rule_thm
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !l le invariant C1 wf_rel var post.
  WF wf_rel ==>
  total_loop_jgmt TS l le invariant C1 wf_rel var ==>
  t_jgmt TS l le (\s. invariant s /\ ~C1 s) post ==>
  t_jgmt TS l le invariant post

name: t_jgmt_def
statement:
t_jgmt TS (l:'b) (ls:'b->bool) pre post =
  !s.
   TS.ctrl s = l ==>
   pre s ==>
   ?s'. TS.weak ls s s' /\ post s'

name: loop_step_def
statement:
loop_step TS s wf_rel var l le invariant C1 =
    let x = var s in
      (\s'.  TS.weak ({l} UNION le) s s' /\
             (invariant s /\ C1 s) /\
             ((TS.ctrl s' = l) /\ invariant s' /\ (wf_rel (var s') x))
      )

name: total_loop_jgmt_def
statement:
total_loop_jgmt TS l le invariant C1 wf_rel var =
  (l NOTIN le /\ WF wf_rel /\
   !x. t_jgmt TS l ({l} UNION le) (\s. invariant s /\ C1 s /\ var s = x)
        (\s. TS.ctrl s = l /\ invariant s /\ wf_rel (var s) x))

name: weak_comp
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s s' s''.
   TS.weak (ls1 UNION ls2) s s' ==>
   TS.ctrl s' NOTIN ls2 ==>
   TS.weak ls2 s' s'' ==>
   TS.weak ls2 s s''

name: weak_unique
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls s s' s''.
   TS.weak ls s s' ==>
   TS.weak ls s s'' ==>
   s' = s''

name: weak_union
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s s'.
   TS.weak (ls1 UNION ls2) s s' ==>
   TS.ctrl s' NOTIN ls1 ==>
   TS.weak ls2 s s'

name: weak_union2
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s s'.
   TS.weak (ls1 UNION ls2) s s' ==>
   TS.ctrl s' IN ls2 ==>

name: weak_ctrl_in
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls s s'.

   TS.ctrl s' IN ls

name: weak_union_ctrl_not_in
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s s'.
   TS.weak (ls1 UNION ls2) s s' ==>
   TS.ctrl s' NOTIN ls2 ==>

name: weak_superset_thm
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s s'.
   TS.weak ls1 s s' ==>
   ?s''. TS.weak (ls1 UNION ls2) s s''

name: weak_nonempty
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !s ls. 
   TS.weak ls s <> {} <=> (?s'. TS.weak ls s s')

name: weak_inter
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !s s' s'' ls1 ls2.
   DISJOINT ls1 ls2 ==>
   TS.weak ls2 s s' ==>
   TS.weak (ls1 UNION ls2) s s'' ==>
   TS.ctrl s'' IN ls1 ==>
   TS.weak ls2 s'' s'

name: weak_least_trs
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !s ls s'.
   s <> s' ==>
   TS.weak ls s s' ==>
   ?n'. n' > 0 /\ (OLEAST n'. FUNPOW_OPT TS.trs n' s = SOME s') = SOME n'

name: weak_union_ctrl
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s s' s''.
   TS.weak ls2 s s' ==>
   TS.weak (ls1 UNION ls2) s s'' ==>
   s' <> s'' ==>
   TS.ctrl s'' IN ls1

name: weak_subset
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s s'.
   TS.weak (ls1 UNION ls2) s s' ==>
   ls1 SUBSET ls2 ==>
   TS.weak ls2 s s'

name: weak_exec_exists
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls s s'.
  TS.weak ls s s' <=> weak_exec TS ls s = SOME s'

name: weak_exec_to_n
statement:
!TS ls s s'. 
   weak_exec TS ls s = SOME s' <=>
   weak_exec_n TS s ls 1 = SOME s'

name: weak_exec_n_prev
statement:
!TS ls s s' n_l.
  weak_exec_n TS s ls (SUC n_l) = SOME s' ==>
  ?s''. weak_exec_n TS s ls n_l = SOME s'' /\ weak_exec_n TS s'' ls 1 = SOME s'

name: weak_exec_n_split2
statement:
!TS ls s s' s'' n n'.
   n >= n' ==>
   weak_exec_n TS s ls n' = SOME s'' ==>
   weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s' ==>
   weak_exec_n TS s'' ls (n - n') = SOME s'

name: weak_exec_n_cycle
statement:
!TS s s' ls n_l n_l'.
 n_l > 0 /\ weak_exec_n TS s ls n_l = SOME s ==>
 s <> s' ==>
 (OLEAST n_l'. weak_exec_n TS s ls n_l' = SOME s') = SOME n_l' ==>
 n_l' < n_l

name: weak_exec_incr_last
statement:
!TS.
 first_enc TS ==>
 !s ls s' n_l s''.
 (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s') = SOME n_l ==>
 TS.weak ls s' s'' ==>
 weak_exec_n TS s ls (SUC n_l) = SOME s''

name: weak_exec_incr_first
statement:
!TS.
 first_enc TS ==>
 !s ls s' n_l s''.
 TS.weak ls s s' ==>
 (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s' ls n = SOME s'') = SOME n_l ==>
 weak_exec_n TS s ls (SUC n_l) = SOME s''

name: weak_exec_n_add
statement:
!TS s s' s'' ls n n'.
 weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s' ==>
 weak_exec_n TS s' ls n' = SOME s'' ==>
 weak_exec_n TS s ls (n + n') = SOME s''

name: weak_exec_n_inter
statement:
!TS.
 first_enc TS ==>
 !s s' ls1 ls2 n_l n_l'.
 DISJOINT ls1 ls2 ==>
 weak_exec_n TS s ls2 1 = SOME s' ==>
 (OLEAST n_l. weak_exec_n TS s (ls1 UNION ls2) n_l = SOME s') = SOME n_l ==>
 n_l' < n_l ==>
 !s''.
 (OLEAST n_l. weak_exec_n TS s (ls1 UNION ls2) n_l = SOME s'') = SOME n_l' ==>
 weak_exec_n TS s'' ls2 1 = SOME s'

name: weak_inter_exec
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s n_l s' s''.
   TS.weak ls2 s s' ==>
   DISJOINT ls1 ls2 ==>
   (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s (ls1 UNION ls2) n = SOME s') = SOME n_l ==>
   SING (\n. n < n_l /\ weak_exec_n TS s (ls1 UNION ls2) n = SOME s'') ==>
   TS.weak ls2 s'' s'

name: weak_exec_n_OLEAST_equiv
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls s s'.
   (OLEAST n_l. n_l > 0 /\ weak_exec_n TS s ls n_l = SOME s') = SOME 1 ==>
   TS.weak ls s s'

name: weak_exec_n_OLEAST_inter
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !s s' s'' ls n' n'' n_l.
  (OLEAST n'. FUNPOW_OPT TS.trs n' s = SOME s') = SOME n' ==>
  (OLEAST n''. n'' > 0 /\ FUNPOW_OPT TS.trs n'' s = SOME s'') = SOME n'' ==>
  n' > n'' ==>
  (OLEAST n_l. n_l > 0 /\ weak_exec_n TS s ls n_l = SOME s'') = SOME 1 ==>
  (OLEAST n_l. weak_exec_n TS s'' ls n_l = SOME s') = SOME n_l ==>
  (OLEAST n_l. weak_exec_n TS s ls n_l = SOME s') = SOME (n_l + 1)

name: weak_exec_1_superset_lemma
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s'.
   !n n'. n' <= n ==>
          n' >= 1 ==>
          !s. TS.weak ls1 s s' /\ ((OLEAST n'. FUNPOW_OPT TS.trs n' s = SOME s') = SOME n') ==>
          s <> s' ==>
          ls1 SUBSET ls2 ==>
          ?n_l. n_l >= 1 /\ (OLEAST n_l. weak_exec_n TS s ls2 n_l = SOME s') = SOME n_l

name: weak_exec_1_superset
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s s'.
   weak_exec_n TS s ls1 1 = SOME s' ==>
   s <> s' ==>
   ls1 SUBSET ls2 ==>
   ?n. n >= 1 /\ (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s ls2 n = SOME s') = SOME n

name: weak_exec_exists_superset
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s s'. 
   TS.weak ls1 s s' ==>
   ?s''. weak_exec TS (ls1 UNION ls2) s = SOME s''

name: weak_exec_n_exists_superset
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !ls1 ls2 s s'. 
   TS.weak ls1 s s' ==>
   s <> s' ==>
   ?n. (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s (ls1 UNION ls2) n = SOME s') = SOME n

name: weak_exec_least_nonzero
statement:
!TS ls s s' n_l.
 (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s') = SOME n_l ==>
 s <> s' ==>
 n_l > 0

name: weak_exec_sing_least_less
statement:
!TS ls s s' n_l.
 SING (\n. n < n_l /\ weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s') ==>
 ?n_l'. (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s') = SOME n_l' /\ n_l' < n_l

name: weak_exec_incr_least
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
  !s ls s' s_e n_l n_l' s''.
   (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s_e) = SOME n_l ==>
   s'' <> s_e ==>
   (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s') = SOME n_l' ==>
   TS.weak ls s' s'' ==>
   SING (\n. n < n_l /\ weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s'') ==>
   n_l' < n_l ==>
   (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s'') = SOME (SUC n_l')

name: weak_exec_uniqueness
statement:
!TS.
 first_enc TS ==>
 !ls s s' s'' s''' n_l n_l'. 
 (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s') = SOME n_l ==>
 (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s'') = SOME n_l' ==>
 n_l' < n_l ==>
 TS.weak ls s'' s''' ==>
 s''' <> s' ==>
 SING (\n_l''. n_l'' < n_l /\ weak_exec_n TS s ls n_l'' = SOME s''')

name: weak_exec_unique_start
statement:
!TS.
 first_enc TS ==>
 !s ls s' n_l. 
 (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s ls n = SOME s') = SOME n_l ==>
 s <> s' ==>
 SING (\n_l'. n_l' < n_l /\ weak_exec_n TS s ls n_l' = SOME s)

name: weak_exec_less_incr_superset
statement:
!TS.
  first_enc TS ==>
   !ls1 ls2 s s' s'' s''' n_l n_l'.
   DISJOINT ls1 ls2 ==>
   (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s (ls1 UNION ls2) n = SOME s') = SOME n_l ==>
   TS.ctrl s' IN ls2 ==>
   (OLEAST n. weak_exec_n TS s (ls1 UNION ls2) n = SOME s'') = SOME n_l' ==>
   n_l' < n_l ==>
   TS.weak (ls1 UNION ls2) s'' s''' ==>
   TS.ctrl s''' NOTIN ls2 ==>
   SUC n_l' < n_l

name: first_enc_def
statement:
first_enc TS =
  !s ls s'. TS.weak ls s s' =
   ?n.
    (n > 0 /\
     FUNPOW_OPT TS.trs n s = SOME s' /\
     TS.ctrl s' IN ls
    ) /\
    !n'.
     n' < n /\ n' > 0 ==>
     ?s''.
      FUNPOW_OPT TS.trs n' s = SOME s'' /\
      TS.ctrl s'' NOTIN ls

name: ominus_def
statement:
(ominus NONE _ = NONE) /\
 (ominus _ NONE = NONE) /\
 (ominus (SOME (n:num)) (SOME n') = SOME (n - n'))

name: weak_exec_def
statement:
weak_exec TS ls s =
  let
   S' = TS.weak ls s
  in
   if S' = {}
   then NONE
   else SOME (CHOICE S')

name: weak_exec_n_def
statement: weak_exec_n TS s ls n = FUNPOW_OPT (weak_exec TS ls) n s

name: bload_64_to_arm8_load_64_thm
statement:
!bs ms. (bmr_rel arm8_bmr bs ms) ==>
    (!a.
    ((bir_eval_load
      (bir_env_read (BVar "MEM" (BType_Mem Bit64 Bit8)) bs.bst_environ)
      (SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 a))) BEnd_LittleEndian Bit64) =
        SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 (arm8_load_64 ms.MEM a))))
    )

name: default_arm8_bir_state_satisfies_rel_thm
statement:

    bmr_rel arm8_bmr (default_arm8_bir_state ms) ms

name: exist_bir_of_arm8_thm
statement:
!ms vars.
    arm8_wf_varset vars ==>
    arm8_bmr.bmr_extra ms ==>
    ?bs.
      (bmr_rel arm8_bmr bs ms /\ (bs.bst_status = BST_Running) /\
       bir_env_vars_are_initialised bs.bst_environ vars)

name: bir_arm8_block_pc
statement:
!bs ms ml.
    bmr_rel arm8_bmr bs ms ==>
    (arm_ts.ctrl ms = ml) ==>
    (bs.bst_status = BST_Running) ==>
    (bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address (Imm64 ml)))

name: bir_get_ht_conseq_from_m_ante
statement:
!bs p bpre bpost mpre ms ml mls.
    bir_cont p bir_exp_true (BL_Address (Imm64 ml))
      {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} {} bpre bpost ==>
    bir_pre_arm8_to_bir mpre bpre ==>
    mpre ms ==>
    bmr_rel arm8_bmr bs ms ==>
    (bs.bst_status = BST_Running) ==>
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised bs.bst_environ
      (bir_vars_of_program p UNION bir_vars_of_exp bpre) ==>
    (bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address (Imm64 ml))) ==>
    (?bs'.
     (bir_weak_trs {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} p bs =
       SOME bs') /\
     (bir_eval_exp (bpost bs'.bst_pc.bpc_label) bs'.bst_environ =
       SOME bir_val_true)
    )

name: bir_arm8_exec_in_end_label_set
statement:
!c_addr_labels ms' bs bs' mls p n n' lo li.
    
    (bir_exec_to_addr_label_n p bs n' = BER_Ended lo n c_addr_labels bs') ==>
    (n' > 0) ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated bs' ==>
    (bs'.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address li)) ==>
    ((bir_block_pc (BL_Address li)).bpc_label IN
         {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls}) ==>
    
    bmr_rel arm8_bmr bs' ms' ==>
    c_addr_labels > 0 /\
    ms'.PC IN mls

name: bir_arm8_inter_exec
statement:
!n' c_addr_labels n0 ms ml mls bs bs' p lo l c_st n mu mms.
    bir_is_lifted_prog arm8_bmr mu mms p ==>
    EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains arm8_bmr ms) mms ==>
    (arm_ts.ctrl ms = ml) ==>
    (MEM (BL_Address (Imm64 ml)) (bir_labels_of_program p)) ==>
    bmr_rel arm8_bmr bs ms ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated bs ==>
    (bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address (Imm64 ml))) ==>
    (bir_exec_to_labels {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} p bs = BER_Ended l c_st n0 bs') ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated bs' ==>
    (bir_exec_to_addr_label_n p bs n' = BER_Ended lo c_st c_addr_labels bs') ==>
    (!n''.
       n'' < c_addr_labels /\ n'' > 0 ==>
       ?ms''.
	 (FUNPOW_OPT arm8_bmr.bmr_step_fun n'' ms = SOME ms'') /\
	 ms''.PC NOTIN mls
    )

name: arm8_lift_contract_thm
statement:
!p mms ml mls mu mpre mpost bpre bpost.
    MEM (BL_Address (Imm64 ml)) (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
    bir_cont p bir_exp_true (BL_Address (Imm64 ml))
      {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} {} bpre bpost ==>
    bir_is_lifted_prog arm8_bmr mu mms p ==>
    arm8_wf_varset (bir_vars_of_program p UNION bir_vars_of_exp bpre) ==>
    bir_pre_arm8_to_bir mpre bpre ==>
    bir_post_bir_to_arm8 mpost bpost {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} ==>
    arm8_cont mms ml mls mpre mpost

name: arm_weak_trs_def
statement:
arm_weak_trs ls ms ms' = 
        ?n.
          ((n > 0) /\
           (FUNPOW_OPT arm8_bmr.bmr_step_fun n ms = SOME ms') /\
           (ms'.PC IN ls)
          ) /\
          !n'.
            (((n' < n) /\ (n' > 0)) ==>
            ?ms''.
              (FUNPOW_OPT arm8_bmr.bmr_step_fun n' ms = SOME ms'') /\
              (~(ms''.PC IN ls))
            )

name: arm_ts_def
arm8_cont_def
statement:
arm8_cont mms l ls pre post =
    t_jgmt arm_ts l ls
      (\ms. (arm8_bmr.bmr_extra ms)  /\
            (EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains arm8_bmr ms) mms) /\
            (pre ms))         
      (\ms. (arm8_bmr.bmr_extra ms)  /\
            (EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains arm8_bmr ms) mms) /\
            (post ms))

name: bir_pre_arm8_to_bir_def
statement:
bir_pre_arm8_to_bir pre pre_bir = (
    bir_is_bool_exp pre_bir /\
    !ms bs.
    bmr_rel arm8_bmr bs ms ==>
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised bs.bst_environ (bir_vars_of_exp pre_bir) ==>
    pre ms ==>
    (bir_eval_exp pre_bir bs.bst_environ = SOME bir_val_true))

name: bir_post_bir_to_arm8_def
statement:
bir_post_bir_to_arm8 post post_bir ls =
    !ms bs.
    bs.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls ==>
    bs.bst_status = BST_Running ==>
    bmr_rel arm8_bmr bs ms ==>
    (bir_eval_exp (post_bir bs.bst_pc.bpc_label) bs.bst_environ = SOME bir_val_true) ==>
    post ms

name: arm8_vars_def
arm8_wf_varset_def
statement: arm8_wf_varset vset = (vset SUBSET arm8_vars)

name: default_arm8_bir_state_def

 (("tmp_ProcState_V" =+ SOME(BVal_Imm (bool2b ms.PSTATE.V)))

 (("tmp_ProcState_Z" =+ SOME(BVal_Imm (bool2b ms.PSTATE.Z)))

 (("tmp_R1" =+ SOME(BVal_Imm (Imm64 (ms.REG 1w))))
 (("R2" =+ SOME(BVal_Imm (Imm64 (ms.REG 2w))))
 (("tmp_R2" =+ SOME(BVal_Imm (Imm64 (ms.REG 2w))))
 (("R3" =+ SOME(BVal_Imm (Imm64 (ms.REG 3w))))
 (("tmp_R3" =+ SOME(BVal_Imm (Imm64 (ms.REG 3w))))
 (("R4" =+ SOME(BVal_Imm (Imm64 (ms.REG 4w))))
 (("tmp_R4" =+ SOME(BVal_Imm (Imm64 (ms.REG 4w))))
 (("R5" =+ SOME(BVal_Imm (Imm64 (ms.REG 5w))))

name: set_of_address_in_all_address_labels_thm
bir_exec_to_labels_TO_exec_to_addr_label_n
statement:
!bs' ml' mls p bs l n n0.
    (bs'.bst_pc.bpc_label IN {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls}) ==>
    (bir_exec_to_labels {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} p bs =
         BER_Ended l n n0 bs') ==>
    ?n' lo c_st c_addr_labels.
         (n' > 0) /\
         (c_st = n) /\
         (bir_exec_to_addr_label_n p bs n' =
           BER_Ended lo c_st c_addr_labels bs')

name: bir_is_lifted_prog_MULTI_STEP_EXEC_compute
statement:
!mu bs bs' ms ml (p:'a bir_program_t) (r:(64, 8, 'b) bir_lifting_machine_rec_t)
      mms n' lo c_st c_addr_labels.
    bir_is_lifted_prog r mu mms p ==>
    bmr_rel r bs ms ==>
    MEM (BL_Address (Imm64 ml)) (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
    (bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address (Imm64 ml))) ==>
    EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms) mms ==>
    (bir_exec_to_addr_label_n p bs n' =
         BER_Ended lo c_st c_addr_labels bs') ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated bs ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated bs' ==>
    ?ms' li.
    (FUNPOW_OPT r.bmr_step_fun c_addr_labels ms = SOME ms') /\
    bmr_ms_mem_unchanged r ms ms' mu /\
    EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms') mms /\
    (bs'.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address li)) /\
    MEM (BL_Address li) (bir_labels_of_program p) /\
    bmr_rel r bs' ms'

name: bir_inter_exec_notin_end_label_set
statement:
!mls p bs l n0 n' n'' lo lo' c_st c_st' bs' bs''.
    (bir_exec_to_labels {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} p bs =
       BER_Ended l c_st n0 bs') ==>
    (bir_exec_to_addr_label_n p bs n'' = BER_Ended lo' c_st' n'' bs'') ==>
    c_st' < c_st ==>
    n'' > 0 ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated bs'' ==>
    bs''.bst_pc.bpc_label NOTIN
      {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls}

        SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm64 (riscv_mem_load_dword ms.MEM8 a)))))

name: exist_bir_of_riscv_thm
statement:
!ms vars.
    riscv_wf_varset vars ==>
    riscv_bmr.bmr_extra ms ==>
    ?bs.
      (bmr_rel riscv_bmr bs ms /\ (bs.bst_status = BST_Running) /\
       bir_env_vars_are_initialised bs.bst_environ vars)

name: bir_riscv_block_pc
statement:
!bs ms ml.
    bmr_rel riscv_bmr bs ms ==>
    (riscv_ts.ctrl ms = ml) ==>
    (bs.bst_status = BST_Running) ==>
    (bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address (Imm64 ml)))

name: riscv_bir_get_ht_conseq_from_m_ante
statement:
!bs p bpre bpost mpre ms ml mls.
    bir_cont p bir_exp_true (BL_Address (Imm64 ml))
      {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} {} bpre bpost ==>
    bir_pre_riscv_to_bir mpre bpre ==>
    mpre ms ==>
    bmr_rel riscv_bmr bs ms ==>
    (bs.bst_status = BST_Running) ==>
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised bs.bst_environ
      (bir_vars_of_program p UNION bir_vars_of_exp bpre) ==>
    (bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address (Imm64 ml))) ==>
    (?bs'.
     (bir_weak_trs {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} p bs =
       SOME bs') /\
     (bir_eval_exp (bpost bs'.bst_pc.bpc_label) bs'.bst_environ =
       SOME bir_val_true)
    )

name: bir_riscv_exec_in_end_label_set
statement:
!c_addr_labels ms' bs bs' mls p n n' lo li.
    
    (bir_exec_to_addr_label_n p bs n' = BER_Ended lo n c_addr_labels bs') ==>
    (n' > 0) ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated bs' ==>
    (bs'.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address li)) ==>
    ((bir_block_pc (BL_Address li)).bpc_label IN
         {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls}) ==>
    
    bmr_rel riscv_bmr bs' ms' ==>
    c_addr_labels > 0 /\
    (ms'.c_PC ms'.procID) IN mls

name: bir_riscv_inter_exec
statement:
!n' c_addr_labels n0 ms ml mls bs bs' p lo l c_st n mu mms.
    bir_is_lifted_prog riscv_bmr mu mms p ==>
    EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains riscv_bmr ms) mms ==>
    (riscv_ts.ctrl ms = ml) ==>
    (MEM (BL_Address (Imm64 ml)) (bir_labels_of_program p)) ==>
    bmr_rel riscv_bmr bs ms ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated bs ==>
    (bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address (Imm64 ml))) ==>
    (bir_exec_to_labels {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} p bs = BER_Ended l c_st n0 bs') ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated bs' ==>
    (bir_exec_to_addr_label_n p bs n' = BER_Ended lo c_st c_addr_labels bs') ==>
    (!n''.
       n'' < c_addr_labels /\ n'' > 0 ==>
       ?ms''.
	 (FUNPOW_OPT riscv_bmr.bmr_step_fun n'' ms = SOME ms'') /\
	 (ms''.c_PC ms''.procID) NOTIN mls)

name: riscv_lift_contract_thm
statement:
!p mms ml mls mu mpre mpost bpre bpost.
    MEM (BL_Address (Imm64 ml)) (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
    bir_cont p bir_exp_true (BL_Address (Imm64 ml))
	{BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} {} bpre bpost ==>
      bir_is_lifted_prog riscv_bmr mu mms p ==>
      riscv_wf_varset (bir_vars_of_program p UNION bir_vars_of_exp bpre) ==>
      bir_pre_riscv_to_bir mpre bpre ==>
      bir_post_bir_to_riscv mpost bpost {BL_Address (Imm64 ml') | ml' IN mls} ==>
      riscv_cont mms ml mls mpre mpost

name: riscv_weak_trs_def
statement:
riscv_weak_trs ls ms ms' = 
  ?n.
    ((n > 0) /\
     (FUNPOW_OPT riscv_bmr.bmr_step_fun n ms = SOME ms') /\
     ((ms'.c_PC ms'.procID) IN ls))
    /\
    !n'. (((n' < n) /\ (n' > 0)) ==>
          ?ms''.
            (FUNPOW_OPT riscv_bmr.bmr_step_fun n' ms = SOME ms'') /\
            (~((ms''.c_PC ms''.procID) IN ls)))

name: riscv_ts_def
riscv_cont_def
statement:
riscv_cont mms l ls pre post =
    t_jgmt riscv_ts l ls
      (\ms. (riscv_bmr.bmr_extra ms)  /\
            (EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains riscv_bmr ms) mms) /\
            (pre ms))
      (\ms. (riscv_bmr.bmr_extra ms)  /\
            (EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains riscv_bmr ms) mms) /\
            (post ms))

name: bir_pre_riscv_to_bir_def
statement:
bir_pre_riscv_to_bir pre pre_bir = (

    (bir_eval_exp (post_bir bs.bst_pc.bpc_label) bs.bst_environ = SOME bir_val_true) ==>
    post ms

name: bir_exec_block_n_to_FUNPOW_OPT_bir_trs
statement:
!prog st m l n c_l' st'.
      (bir_exec_block_n prog st m = (l,n,c_l',st')) ==>
      ~(bir_state_is_terminated st') ==>
      (FUNPOW_OPT (bir_trs prog) m st = SOME st')

name: FUNPOW_OPT_bir_trs_to_bir_exec_block_n
statement:
!prog st m st'.
      (FUNPOW_OPT (bir_trs prog) m st = SOME st') ==>
      ?l n c_l'.
      (bir_exec_block_n prog st m = (l,n,c_l',st'))

name: bir_trs_term
statement:
!prog st.
    bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
    (bir_trs prog st = NONE)

name: bir_trs_FUNPOW_term
statement:
!prog n st.
    bir_state_is_terminated st ==>
    n > 0 ==>
    (FUNPOW_OPT (bir_trs prog) n st = NONE)

name: FUNPOW_OPT_bir_trs_running_invar
statement:
!prog st m st'.
      (FUNPOW_OPT (bir_trs prog) m st = SOME st') ==>
      ~(bir_state_is_terminated st) ==>
      ~(bir_state_is_terminated st')

name: FUNPOW_OPT_bir_trs_running
statement:
!prog n st st'.
    (FUNPOW_OPT (bir_trs prog) n st = SOME st') ==>
    n > 0 ==>
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated st')

name: bir_weak_trs_EQ
statement:
!ls prog st st'.
    (bir_weak_trs ls prog st = SOME st') <=>
       (?l n n0.
       bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st =
         BER_Ended l n n0 st') /\
    ~bir_state_is_terminated st' /\
    (st'.bst_pc.bpc_index = 0) /\ st'.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls

name: bir_ts_first_enc
statement:
!(prog: 'a bir_program_t).
      first_enc (bir_ts prog)

name: bir_label_jgmt_impl_weak_jgmt
statement:
!prog l ls pre post.
    ls <> {} ==>
    bir_exec_to_labels_triple prog l ls pre post ==>
    bir_cont prog bir_exp_true l ls {} pre post

name: bir_il_to_el_rule_thm
statement:
!prog inv l ilist elist pre post elabel.
    bir_cont prog inv l ilist elist pre post ==>
    elabel IN ilist ==>
    ilist DELETE elabel <> {} ==>
    (post elabel = bir_exp_false) ==>
    bir_cont prog inv l (ilist DELETE elabel) (elabel INSERT elist) pre post

name: bir_il_to_el_set_rule_thm
statement:
!prog inv l ilist elist pre post elabels.
    bir_cont prog inv l ilist elist pre post ==>
    FINITE elabels ==>
    elabels PSUBSET ilist ==>
    (!elabel. elabel IN elabels ==> (post elabel = bir_exp_false)) ==>
    bir_cont prog inv l (ilist DIFF elabels) (elabels UNION elist) pre post

name: bir_post_weak_rule_thm
statement:
!prog invariant l ls ls' pre post1 post2.
    (!st.
     st.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls ==>
     (bir_eval_exp (post1 st.bst_pc.bpc_label) st.bst_environ = SOME bir_val_true) ==>
     (bir_eval_exp (post2 st.bst_pc.bpc_label) st.bst_environ = SOME bir_val_true)
    ) ==>
    bir_cont prog invariant l ls ls' pre post1 ==>
    bir_cont prog invariant l ls ls' pre post2

name: bir_taut_pre_str_rule_thm
statement:
!prog invariant l ls ls' pre1 pre2 post.
    ((bir_vars_of_exp pre2) SUBSET (bir_vars_of_program prog)) ==>
    ((bir_vars_of_exp pre1) SUBSET (bir_vars_of_program prog)) ==>
    bir_exp_is_taut
      (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not pre2) pre1) ==>
    bir_cont prog invariant l ls ls' pre1 post ==>
    bir_cont prog invariant l ls ls' pre2 post

name: bir_taut_post_weak_rule_thm
statement:
!prog invariant l ls l2 ls' pre post1 post2.
    ((bir_vars_of_exp (post1 l2)) SUBSET (bir_vars_of_program prog)) ==>
    ((bir_vars_of_exp (post2 l2)) SUBSET (bir_vars_of_program prog)) ==>
    (!l'. (l' <> l2) ==> (post1 l' = post2 l')) ==>
    bir_exp_is_taut
      (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not (post1 l2)) (post2 l2)) ==>
    bir_cont prog invariant l ls ls' pre post1 ==>
    bir_cont prog invariant l ls ls' pre post2

name: bir_std_seq_rule_thm
statement:
!prog ls1 ls1' ls2 ls2' invariant l pre1 post1 post2.
    ls1' SUBSET ls2 ==>
    (ls1 INTER ls1' = EMPTY) ==>
    bir_cont prog invariant l ls1 ls2 pre1 post1 ==>
    (!l1. (l1 IN ls1) ==> (bir_cont prog invariant l1 ls1' ls2' (post1 l1) post2)) ==>
    bir_cont prog invariant l ls1' (ls2 INTER ls2') pre1 post2

name: bir_signed_loop_rule_thm
statement:
!prog l il el invariant C1 variant post.
    
    
    (type_of_bir_exp variant = SOME (BType_Imm Bit64)) ==>
    bir_vars_of_exp variant SUBSET bir_vars_of_program prog ==>
    
    bir_is_bool_exp C1 ==>
    (bir_vars_of_exp C1) SUBSET (bir_vars_of_program prog) ==>
    
    l NOTIN il ==>
    l NOTIN el ==>
    (il INTER el = {}) ==>
    
    (!x.
     bir_cont prog invariant l ({l} UNION il) el
       (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And C1
	  (BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal variant (BExp_Const (Imm64 x)))
       )
       (\l'.
	    if l' = l then
	      (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And
		 (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessThan variant
		    (BExp_Const (Imm64 x)))
		 (BExp_BinPred BIExp_SignedLessOrEqual
		    (BExp_Const (Imm64 0w)) variant))
	    else bir_exp_false)
    ) ==>
    bir_cont prog bir_exp_true l il el
      (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And invariant (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not C1)) post ==>
    bir_cont prog bir_exp_true l il el
      invariant
      post

name: bir_unsigned_loop_rule_thm
statement:
!prog l il el invariant C1 variant post.
    
    
    (type_of_bir_exp variant = SOME (BType_Imm Bit64)) ==>
    bir_vars_of_exp variant SUBSET bir_vars_of_program prog ==>
    
    bir_is_bool_exp C1 ==>
    (bir_vars_of_exp C1) SUBSET (bir_vars_of_program prog) ==>
    
    l NOTIN il ==>
    l NOTIN el ==>
    (il INTER el = {}) ==>
    
    (!x.
     bir_cont prog invariant l ({l} UNION il) el
       (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And C1
	  (BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal variant (BExp_Const (Imm64 x)))
       )
       (\l'.
	    if l' = l then
	      (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And
		 (BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessThan variant
		    (BExp_Const (Imm64 x)))
		 (BExp_BinPred BIExp_LessOrEqual
		    (BExp_Const (Imm64 0w)) variant))
	    else bir_exp_false)
    ) ==>
    bir_cont prog bir_exp_true l il el
      (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And invariant (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not C1)) post ==>
    bir_cont prog bir_exp_true l il el
      invariant
      post

name: bir_il_subset_rule_thm
statement:
!prog l ls1 ls2 pre post.
    ls1 <> {} ==>
    (!st. (bir_eval_exp (post st.bst_pc.bpc_label) st.bst_environ = SOME bir_val_true) ==>
          (~(st.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls2))
    ) ==>
    bir_cont prog bir_exp_true l (ls1 UNION ls2) {} pre post ==>
    bir_cont prog bir_exp_true l ls1 {} pre post

name: bir_el_subset_rule_thm
statement:

name: bir_exec_to_labels_triple_precond_subprogram
statement:
!prog1 prog2 s pre.
    bir_is_subprogram prog1 prog2 ==>

    bir_exec_to_labels_triple_precond s pre prog1

name: bir_is_valid_pc_exec
statement:
!s pre prog ls l' n n0 s'.
    (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog s = BER_Ended l' n n0 s') ==>
    
    bir_exec_to_labels_triple_precond s pre prog ==>
    ~bir_state_is_terminated s' ==>
    bir_is_valid_pc prog s.bst_pc

name: bir_prog_comp_rule_thm
statement:
!prog1 prog2 invariant il el l pre post.
    bir_is_subprogram prog1 prog2 ==>

    bir_cont prog1 invariant l il el pre post ==>
