name: bir_trs_def
statement:
bir_trs (prog:'a bir_program_t) st =
  let
    (_, _, _, st') = bir_exec_block_n prog st 1
  in
   if ~(bir_state_is_terminated st')
   then SOME st'
   else NONE

name: bir_weak_trs_def
statement:
bir_weak_trs ls prog st =
    case (bir_exec_to_labels ls prog st) of
      BER_Ended _ _ _ st' =>
        if ~(bir_state_is_terminated st')
        then SOME st'
        else NONE
    | BER_Looping _ => NONE

name: bir_ts_def
bir_exec_to_labels_triple_precond_def
statement:
bir_exec_to_labels_triple_precond st pre prog =
    ((bir_eval_exp pre st.bst_environ = SOME bir_val_true) /\
    (bir_env_vars_are_initialised st.bst_environ
       (bir_vars_of_program prog)) /\
    (st.bst_pc.bpc_index = 0) /\
    (st.bst_status = BST_Running) /\
    (bir_is_bool_exp_env st.bst_environ pre))

name: bir_exec_to_labels_triple_postcond_def
statement:
bir_exec_to_labels_triple_postcond st post prog =
    ((bir_eval_exp (post st.bst_pc.bpc_label) st.bst_environ =
       SOME bir_val_true) /\
    (bir_env_vars_are_initialised st.bst_environ
       (bir_vars_of_program prog)) /\
    (st.bst_pc.bpc_index = 0) /\
    (st.bst_status = BST_Running) /\
    (bir_is_bool_exp_env st.bst_environ (post st.bst_pc.bpc_label)))

name: bir_cont_def
statement:
bir_cont prog invariant (l:bir_label_t) ls ls' pre post =
    t_ext_jgmt (bir_ts prog)
      (\s. bir_exec_to_labels_triple_precond s invariant prog)
      l ls ls'
      (\s. bir_exec_to_labels_triple_precond s pre prog)
      (\s'. bir_exec_to_labels_triple_postcond s' post prog)

   (FINITE univ(:'c)) ==>
   (dimindex (:'c) <= dimindex (:'a)) ==>
   (dimindex (:'b) = dimindex (:'a) - (dimindex (:'c))) ==>
   (dimindex (:('b + 'c)) = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
   (
    (((((dimindex (:'a) - 1) >< (dimindex (:'c))) w):'b word) @@ ((n2w n):'c word)):'a word =
     ((w && ~(n2w (2 ** (dimindex (:'c)) - 1))) || n2w (n MOD 2 ** (dimindex (:'c))))
   )

name: arm8_movk_16_fold_base_l

   (FINITE univ(:'b)) ==>
   (16 <= dimindex (:'a)) ==>
   (dimindex (:'b) = dimindex (:'a) - 16) ==>
   (dimindex (:('b + 16)) = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
   (dimindex (:(16 + 'b)) = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
   (
     ( ((n2w n):word16) @@ ((((dimindex (:'a) - 16 - 1) >< 0) w):'b word) ):'a word
     =
     ( ((n2w (n MOD 2 ** 16)) << (dimindex (:'a) - 16)) || (w && ~((n2w ((2 ** 16) - 1)) << (dimindex (:'a) - 16)) ) )
   )

name: arm8_movk_16_fold_base_m

!n (w:'a word).
   FINITE univ(:'b) ==>
   FINITE univ(:'c) ==>
   FINITE univ(:'d) ==>
   (16 <= dimindex (:'a)) ==>
   (dimindex (:'b) + dimindex (:'c) = dimindex (:'a) - 16) ==>
   (dimindex (:('b + 'c + 16)) = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
   (dimindex (:('b + 'd)) = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
   (dimindex (:'d) = 16 + dimindex (:'c)) ==>
   (dimindex (:(16 + 'c)) + dimindex (:'b) = dimindex (:'a)) ==>
   (
      ( ((((dimindex (:'a) - 1) >< (dimindex (:'d))) w):'b word) @@ (((n2w n):word16) @@ ((((dimindex (:'c) - 1) >< 0) w):'c word)):'d word ):'a word
      =
      ( (w && ((n2w (2 ** (dimindex (:'b)) - 1)) << (dimindex (:'d)))) || ((n2w (n MOD 2 ** 16)) << (dimindex (:'c))) || (w && (n2w (2 ** (dimindex (:'c)) - 1))) )

name: thm_def
statement:
!(value_ty :bir_immtype_t) (a_ty :bir_immtype_t) (result :bir_imm_t)
      (mmap :'a word -> 'v word) (en :bir_endian_t) (a :'a word).
     (size_of_bir_immtype value_ty = dimindex (:'v)) ==>
     (size_of_bir_immtype a_ty = dimindex (:'a)) ==> (
     bir_store_in_mem_words value_ty a_ty result mmap en a =
     (let (result_ty :bir_immtype_t) = type_of_bir_imm result
      in
        case bir_number_of_mem_splits value_ty result_ty a_ty of
          (NONE :num option) => (NONE :('a word -> 'v word) option)
        | SOME n =>
            (let (vs :bitstring list) =
                   bitstring_split (size_of_bir_immtype value_ty)
                     (b2v result)
             in
             let (vs' :bitstring list option) =
                   case en of
                     BEnd_BigEndian => SOME vs
                   | BEnd_LittleEndian => SOME (REVERSE vs)
                   | BEnd_NoEndian =>
                       if n = (1 :num) then SOME vs
                       else (NONE :bitstring list option)
             in
               case vs' of
                 (NONE :bitstring list option) =>
                   (NONE :('a word -> 'v word) option)
               | SOME vs'' => SOME (bir_update_mmap_words mmap a vs''))))

name: bir_mmap_w_w2n_def
statement:
(bir_mmap_w_w2n (mmap_w: 'a word |-> 'b word)): num |-> num =
      FUN_FMAP (\x. w2n (FAPPLY mmap_w (n2w x)))
               (IMAGE w2n (FDOM mmap_w))

name: bir_mmap_n2w_def

(bir_mmap_n2w (mmap: num |-> num)) : 'a word |-> 'b word =
      FUN_FMAP (\x. n2w (FAPPLY mmap (w2n x)))
               (IMAGE n2w ((FDOM mmap) INTER {n | n < dimword (:'a)}))

name: bir_is_lifted_mem_exp_def
statement:
bir_is_lifted_mem_exp
  (env:bir_var_environment_t) (e : bir_exp_t) (m : 'a word -> 'b word) <=>
  (?sa sb mem_n.
     (size_of_bir_immtype sa = (dimindex (:'a))) /\
     (size_of_bir_immtype sb = (dimindex (:'b))) /\
     (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Mem sa sb)) /\
     (bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e)) /\
     (bir_eval_exp e env = SOME (BVal_Mem sa sb mem_n)) /\
     (m = bir_load_mmap_w (bir_mmap_n2w mem_n)))

name: bir_is_lifted_imm_exp_def

  ((type_of_bir_exp e = SOME (BType_Imm (type_of_bir_imm i))) /\
  (bir_env_vars_are_initialised env (bir_vars_of_exp e)) /\
  (bir_eval_exp e env = SOME (BVal_Imm i)))

name: bir_is_lifted_exp_def
statement:
(bir_is_lifted_exp env e (BLV_Imm i) = bir_is_lifted_imm_exp env e i) /\
  (bir_is_lifted_exp env e (BLV_Mem m) = bir_is_lifted_mem_exp env e m)

name: bir_update_mmap_words_def
statement:
(bir_update_mmap_words mmap a [] = mmap) /\
  (bir_update_mmap_words mmap a (v::vs) =
    bir_update_mmap_words ((a =+ v2w v) mmap) (a + 1w) vs)

name: bir_store_in_mem_words_def
statement:
bir_store_in_mem_words
  (value_ty : bir_immtype_t) (a_ty : bir_immtype_t) (result : bir_imm_t) (mmap : 'a word -> 'v word) (en: bir_endian_t) (a : 'a word) =

   let result_ty = type_of_bir_imm result in
   case (bir_number_of_mem_splits value_ty result_ty a_ty) of
    | NONE => NONE
    | SOME (n:num) => (
        let vs = bitstring_split (size_of_bir_immtype value_ty) (b2v result) in
        let vs' = (case en of BEnd_LittleEndian => SOME (REVERSE vs)
                          |  BEnd_BigEndian => SOME vs
                          |  BEnd_NoEndian => if (n = 1) then SOME vs else NONE) in

        case vs' of NONE => NONE
                 |  SOME vs'' => SOME (bir_update_mmap_words mmap a vs'')
   )

(bir_exec_to_addr_label_n p st (SUC n) =
      case bir_exec_to_addr_label p st of
        BER_Ended l1 c1 c1' st1 =>
          (case bir_exec_to_addr_label_n p st1 n of
             BER_Ended l2 c2 c2' st2 =>
               BER_Ended (l1 ++ l2) (c1 + c2) (c1' + c2') st2
           | BER_Looping ll2 => BER_Looping (LAPPEND (fromList l1) ll2))

     bmr_rel r bs ms ==>  ms_case_cond ms ==> bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms mm ==> (BL_Address (bmr_pc_lf r ms) = l) ==> (

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL_INTRO_raw
statement:
!r bs mem_up imm_ups all_var_names updates_imm update_mem_opt eup eup_temp.

      (bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL_REL r bs mem_up imm_ups all_var_names updates_imm update_mem_opt /\

      (!v up v'.
        eup_temp ==>
        (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = SOME v) ==>
        ~(bir_var_name v IN all_var_names)) /\
     (!v e up v'.
        (~eup_temp \/ (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = NONE)) ==>
        (bir_updateE_desc_exp eup = SOME e) ==>
        v IN bir_vars_of_exp e ==>
        MEM up (updates_imm ++ (option_CASE update_mem_opt [] (\x. [x]))) ==>
        v' IN {bir_updateB_desc_temp_var up; bir_updateB_desc_var up} ==>
        bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name v')) ==>

bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL
  r bs mem_up imm_ups eup eup_temp (updates_imm ++ (option_CASE update_mem_opt [] (\x. [x])))

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL_INTRO
statement:
!r bs mem_up imm_ups all_var_names updates_imm update_mem_opt.

bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL_REL r bs mem_up imm_ups all_var_names updates_imm update_mem_opt ==> !eup eup_temp.

     ((!v up v'.
        eup_temp ==>
        (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = SOME v) ==>
        ~(bir_var_name v IN all_var_names)) /\
     (!vn e up v'.
        (~eup_temp \/ (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = NONE)) ==>
        (bir_updateE_desc_exp eup = SOME e) ==>
        DISJOINT (IMAGE bir_var_name (bir_vars_of_exp e))
           (bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_UPDATES_VARS
             (updates_imm ++ (option_CASE update_mem_opt [] (\x. [x])))))) ==>

bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL
  r bs mem_up imm_ups eup eup_temp (updates_imm ++ (option_CASE update_mem_opt [] (\x. [x])))

   (!e v vn ty ups. (bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_UPDATES_VARS
      ((BUpdateDescB (BVar vn ty) e v T)::ups) =
      ((bir_temp_var_name vn) INSERT vn INSERT
      (bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_UPDATES_VARS ups)))) /\

   (!e v vn ty ups. (bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_UPDATES_VARS
      ((BUpdateDescB (BVar vn ty) e v F)::ups) =
      (vn INSERT

   bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL_REL r bs mem_up imm_ups all_var_names updates_imm update_mem_opt ==>

   (dimindex (:'addr_ty) = size_of_bir_immtype sz) ==>

   bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_al_mem_COND_WITH_DESC_OK r (WI_end (n2w mu_b) (n2w mu_e)) bs ms ms' (MAP (\ (b, s, f1, f2, e). BAssertDesc (BExp_unchanged_mem_interval_distinct sz mu_b mu_e e s)
           (WI_distinct_MEM_UNCHANGED_COMPUTE (n2w mu_b) (n2w mu_e) b s)) il)

     bir_is_lifted_prog r mu mms1 p1 ==>
     bir_is_lifted_prog r mu mms2 p2 ==>
     (!i. MEM (BL_Address i) (bir_labels_of_program p1) ==> ~(MEM (BL_Address i) (bir_labels_of_program p2))) ==>
     bir_is_lifted_prog r mu (mms1++mms2) (bir_program_combine p1 p2)

     bir_is_lifted_prog r mu mms p ==>

name: bir_is_lifted_prog_MULTI_STEP_EXEC
statement:
!(r: ('a, 'b, 'ms) bir_lifting_machine_rec_t) mu mms (p : 'o bir_program_t).
     bir_is_lifted_prog r mu mms p ==>
     !n ms bs.
       (bmr_rel r bs ms ==>
        (?li. MEM (BL_Address li) (bir_labels_of_program p) /\
              (bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address li))) ==>
        EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms) mms ==>
       ~bir_state_is_terminated bs ==>

       ?lo c_st c_addr_labels bs'.
         (bir_exec_to_addr_label_n p bs n = BER_Ended lo c_st c_addr_labels bs') /\
         (bs'.bst_status <> BST_AssertionViolated ==>
          ?ms'.
            (FUNPOW_OPT r.bmr_step_fun c_addr_labels ms = SOME ms') /\
            bmr_ms_mem_unchanged r ms ms' mu /\
            EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms') mms /\
            (case bs'.bst_status of
              | BST_Running =>
                  (?li. MEM (BL_Address li) (bir_labels_of_program p) /\
                        (bs'.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address li)))
              | BST_JumpOutside ll =>
                  ~(MEM ll (bir_labels_of_program p)) /\
                  (IS_BL_Address ll)
              | _ => F) /\
            bmr_rel r bs' ms'))

name: bmr_mem_contains_APPEND
statement:
!r ms b l1 l2. bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms (b, (l1 ++ l2)) <=>
  bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms (b, l1) /\
  bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms (b + n2w (LENGTH l1), l2)

name: WI_MEM_bmr_ms_mem_contains_interval_APPEND
statement:
!b l1 (l2 : 'b word list) (w:'a word).
   ((w2n b + (LENGTH (l1 ++ l2))) < dimword (:'a)) ==>

  (WI_MEM w (bmr_ms_mem_contains_interval (b,l1 ++ l2)) <=>
  WI_MEM w (bmr_ms_mem_contains_interval (b, l1)) \/
  WI_MEM w (bmr_ms_mem_contains_interval (b + n2w (LENGTH l1), l2)))

name: bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_merge2
statement:
!r mu b1 l1 b2 l2.

    ((b1:'a word) + n2w (LENGTH l1) = b2) ==>
    (bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV r mu [(b1, l1); (b2, l2)] [(b1, l1++l2)])

name: bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE_THM_RAW
statement:
!r mu acc ci mms.
      (case ci of NONE => T | SOME (b, l, b') => (b' = b + n2w (LENGTH (FLAT l)))) ==>
      bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV r mu (case ci of NONE => ((REVERSE acc)++mms) | SOME (b, l, _) =>
         ((REVERSE acc)++(b, FLAT (REVERSE l))::mms))
        (bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc ci mms)

name: bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE_THM
statement:
!r mu mms.
      bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV r mu mms
        (bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE [] NONE mms)

name: bir_is_lifted_prog_MMS_EQUIV_COMPUTE
statement:
!(r : ('addr_ty, 'val_ty, 'ms) bir_lifting_machine_rec_t) mu (p : 'o bir_program_t) mms1.
       bir_is_lifted_prog r mu mms1 p ==>
       (!mms2. (bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE [] NONE mms1 = mms2) ==>
               bir_is_lifted_prog r mu mms2 p)

name: bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE_REWRS
statement:
(!acc.
      bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc NONE [] = REV acc []) /\
   (!l (b':'a word) b acc.
      bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc (SOME (b,l,b')) [] =
      REV ((b,FLAT (REV l []))::acc) []) /\
   (!mms l b acc.
      bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc NONE ((n2w b,l)::mms) =
      (let b' = n2w (b + LENGTH l) in
      bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc
        (SOME (n2w b,[l],b')) mms)) /\
   (!mms l2 l b2 b' b acc.
     bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc (SOME (b,l,n2w b'))
       ((n2w b2,l2)::mms) =
     let (b2':'a word) = n2w (b2 + LENGTH l2) in
     if b' = b2 then
       bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc
         (SOME (b,l2::l,b2')) mms
     else if b' MOD dimword (:'a) = b2 MOD dimword (:'a) then
       bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc
         (SOME (b,l2::l,b2')) mms
     else
       bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE ((b,FLAT (REV l []))::acc)
         (SOME (n2w b2,[l2],b2')) mms)

name: bmr_ms_mem_unchanged_def
statement:
bmr_ms_mem_unchanged r ms ms' i <=>
  (!a. WI_MEM a i ==> (bmr_mem_lf r ms' a = bmr_mem_lf r ms a))

name: bir_exec_to_addr_label_n_def
statement:
bir_exec_to_addr_label_n =
  bir_exec_to_labels_n {l | IS_BL_Address l}

name: bir_exec_to_addr_label_def
statement:
bir_exec_to_addr_label =
  bir_exec_to_labels {l | (IS_BL_Address l)}

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_def
statement:
bir_is_lifted_inst_block
    
    (r: ('a, 'b, 'ms) bir_lifting_machine_rec_t)


    




    (ms_case_cond : 'ms -> bool)

    



    l

    

    mu

    

    mm

    
    (bl :'o bir_block_t)

    <=>

  
  (WI_wfe mu /\ WF_bmr_ms_mem_contains mm /\ WI_is_sub (bmr_ms_mem_contains_interval mm) mu) /\

  (!ms bs (p : 'o bir_program_t) c lo bs'.

    
    ms_case_cond ms ==>

    
    (bmr_rel r bs ms) ==>

    
    (bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc l) ==>

    
    bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms mm ==>

    
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated bs) ==>

    
    (bir_exec_block p bl bs = (lo, c, bs')) ==>

    
    ~(bs'.bst_status = BST_AssertionViolated) ==>


    


    (?ms'. (r.bmr_step_fun ms = SOME ms') /\
           (bmr_ms_mem_unchanged r ms ms' mu) /\
           (bmr_rel r bs' ms')))

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_ms'_COND_def
statement:
bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_ms'_COND r ms al_step ms' <=>
     
     ((EVERY (\a. bir_assert_desc_value a) al_step) ==>
      (r.bmr_step_fun ms = SOME ms')) /\

     
     ((EVERY (\a. bir_assert_desc_value a) al_step) ==>
      r.bmr_extra ms')

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_imm_ups_COND_def
statement:
bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_imm_ups_COND r ms ms' imm_ups updates <=>

     
     (MAP FST imm_ups = r.bmr_imms) /\
     (!v lf. (MEM (BMLI v lf, NONE) imm_ups) ==>
             (lf ms' = lf ms) /\ (!up. MEM up updates ==>
             (bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_var up)) /\
             (bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_temp_var up)))) /\

     (!v lf res. (MEM (BMLI v lf, SOME res) imm_ups) ==>
                 (lf ms' = res) /\ (?up. MEM up updates /\ (bir_updateB_desc_var up = v) /\
                                   (bir_updateB_desc_value up = SOME (BVal_Imm res))))

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_al_mem_COND_def

bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_al_mem_COND r mu ms ms' al_mem <=>

     

     (EVERY (\a. bir_assert_desc_value a) al_mem ==>
     ?mem_chs.
     (!a. ~(MEM a mem_chs) ==> (bmr_mem_lf r ms' a = bmr_mem_lf r ms a)) /\
     (!a. (MEM a mem_chs) ==> ~(WI_MEM a mu)))

bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_mem_COND r bs ms ms' mem_up updates <=>
     
     (case (mem_up, r.bmr_mem) of
       | (NONE, BMLM v lf) => (
             (lf ms' = lf ms) /\ (!up. MEM up updates ==>
             (bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_var up)) /\
             (bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_temp_var up))))
       | (SOME res, BMLM v lf) =>
              (lf ms' = res) /\ (?up.

              MEM up updates /\ (bir_updateB_desc_var up = v) /\
              (bir_is_lifted_exp bs.bst_environ (bir_updateB_desc_exp up) (BLV_Mem res))))

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_eup_COND_def

bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_eup_COND r eup ms'  <=>
     
     (!var. (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = SOME var) ==>
            ((!v lf. (MEM (BMLI v lf) r.bmr_imms ==>
                    (bir_var_name var) <> (bir_var_name v))) /\
            (case r.bmr_mem of
               | (BMLM v lf) => (bir_var_name var) <> (bir_var_name v)))) /\
     (bir_updateE_SEM eup = BUpdateValE_Jmp (BL_Address (bmr_pc_lf r ms')))

     bir_updateE_desc_OK bs.bst_environ eup /\

     (case (bir_updateE_desc_var eup) of NONE => T
       | SOME var => case r.bmr_pc of BMLPC v_pc v_pc_cond _ =>
         ((var = v_pc) \/ (var = v_pc_cond))) /\

     (bir_updateE_SEM eup = BUpdateValE_Jmp (BL_Address (bmr_pc_lf r ms')))

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL_def
statement:
bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL
      (r: ('a, 'b, 'c) bir_lifting_machine_rec_t) bs
      (mem_up : ('a word -> 'b word) option)
      (imm_ups :('c bir_machine_lifted_imm_t # bir_imm_t option) list)
      (eup :bir_updateE_desc_t) (eup_temp :bool) updates =

     ?updates_imm updates_mem.

     
     ((MAP (\up. (bir_updateB_desc_var up, bir_updateB_desc_value up)) updates_imm) =
      (MAP (\x. (case x of | (BMLI v _, SOME r) => (v, SOME (BVal_Imm r))))
        (FILTER (\x. IS_SOME (SND x)) imm_ups))) /\

     
     (case mem_up of NONE => (updates_mem = []) | SOME res =>
       (?upd_mem. (updates_mem = [upd_mem]) /\
           (bir_updateB_desc_var upd_mem = bmr_mem_var r) /\
           ((bir_updateB_desc_value upd_mem) =
             (bir_eval_exp (bir_updateB_desc_exp upd_mem) bs.bst_environ)) /\
           (bir_is_lifted_exp bs.bst_environ (bir_updateB_desc_exp upd_mem)
             (BLV_Mem res)))) /\

     
     (PERM updates (updates_imm ++ updates_mem)) /\

     
     (!var e v use_temp.
            MEM (BUpdateDescB var e (SOME (BVal_Imm v)) use_temp) updates_imm ==>
            bir_is_lifted_imm_exp bs.bst_environ e v) /\

     
     (!i j var.
        i < LENGTH updates /\ j < i /\
        var IN bir_vars_of_exp (bir_updateB_desc_exp (EL i updates)) ==>
        bir_var_name var <>
        bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_temp_var (EL j updates))) /\

     (!v up v'.
        eup_temp ==>
        (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = SOME v) ==>
        MEM up (updates_imm ++ updates_mem) ==>
        v' IN  bir_vars_of_exp (bir_updateB_desc_exp up) ==>
        bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name v') /\

     (!v e up v'.
        (~eup_temp \/ (bir_updateE_desc_var eup = NONE)) ==>
        (bir_updateE_desc_exp eup = SOME e) ==>
        v IN bir_vars_of_exp e ==>
        MEM up (updates_imm ++ updates_mem) ==>
        v' IN {bir_updateB_desc_temp_var up; bir_updateB_desc_var up} ==>
        bir_var_name v <> bir_var_name v')

bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_block l' al_mem al_step eup_temp eup updates =

                 (if eup_temp then eup
                  else bir_updateE_desc_remove_var eup) updates

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_precond_def
statement:
bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_precond r bs ms l mu mm bl l' ms_case_cond ms'
     al_step imm_ups mem_up al_mem eup eup_temp updates <=> (

     bmr_rel r bs ms ==>
     ms_case_cond ms ==>
     bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms mm ==>
     (BL_Address (bmr_pc_lf r ms) = l) ==> (
     bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_ms'_COND_WITH_DESC_OK r bs ms al_step ms' /\
     bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_imm_ups_COND_NO_UPDATES r ms ms' imm_ups /\
     bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_mem_COND_NO_UPDATES r ms ms' mem_up /\
     bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_al_mem_COND_WITH_DESC_OK r mu bs ms ms' al_mem /\
     bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_eup_COND_FIXED_VARS r bs eup ms' /\
     bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL r bs mem_up imm_ups eup eup_temp updates /\
     (bl = bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_block l' al_mem al_step eup_temp eup updates)))

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_imm_ups_COND_NO_UPDATES_CHECK_def
statement:
(bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_imm_ups_COND_NO_UPDATES_CHECK ms ms' [] [] <=> T) /\
  (bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_imm_ups_COND_NO_UPDATES_CHECK ms ms'
     ((BMLI v lf, NONE)::imm_ups) ((BMLI v' lf')::imms) <=>
       (v' = v) /\ (lf' = lf) /\
       (lf ms' = lf ms) /\
       bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_imm_ups_COND_NO_UPDATES_CHECK ms ms' imm_ups imms
     ) /\
  (bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_imm_ups_COND_NO_UPDATES_CHECK ms ms'
     ((BMLI v lf, SOME res)::imm_ups) ((BMLI v' lf')::imms) <=>
       (v' = v) /\ (lf' = lf) /\
       (lf ms' = res) /\
       bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_imm_ups_COND_NO_UPDATES_CHECK ms ms' imm_ups imms
     ) /\
  (bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_imm_ups_COND_NO_UPDATES_CHECK ms ms'
     _ _ <=> F)

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL_REL_def
statement:
bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_FULL_REL
      (r: ('a, 'b, 'c) bir_lifting_machine_rec_t) bs
      (mem_up : ('a word -> 'b word) option)
      (imm_ups :('c bir_machine_lifted_imm_t # bir_imm_t option) list)
      all_var_names updates_imm update_mem_opt <=>

     
     ((MAP (\up. (bir_updateB_desc_var up, bir_updateB_desc_value up)) updates_imm) =
      (MAP (\x. (case x of | (BMLI v _, SOME r) => (v, SOME (BVal_Imm r))))
        (FILTER (\x. IS_SOME (SND x)) imm_ups))) /\

     
     (case mem_up of NONE => (update_mem_opt = NONE) | SOME res =>
       (?upd_mem. (update_mem_opt = SOME upd_mem) /\
           (bir_updateB_desc_var upd_mem = bmr_mem_var r) /\
           ((bir_updateB_desc_value upd_mem) =
             (bir_eval_exp (bir_updateB_desc_exp upd_mem) bs.bst_environ)) /\
           (bir_is_lifted_exp bs.bst_environ (bir_updateB_desc_exp upd_mem)
             (BLV_Mem res)))) /\

     
     (!var e v use_temp.
            MEM (BUpdateDescB var e (SOME (BVal_Imm v)) use_temp) updates_imm ==>
            bir_is_lifted_imm_exp bs.bst_environ e v) /\

     
     let updates = updates_imm ++ (option_CASE update_mem_opt [] (\x. [x])) in (

     (!i j var.
        i < LENGTH updates /\ j < i /\
        var IN bir_vars_of_exp (bir_updateB_desc_exp (EL i updates)) ==>
        bir_var_name var <>
        bir_var_name (bir_updateB_desc_temp_var (EL j updates)))) /\

     (!up var. MEM up updates ==>
               var IN bir_vars_of_exp (bir_updateB_desc_exp up) ==>
               (bir_var_name var IN all_var_names))

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_updates_UPDATES_VARS_def
statement:

bir_is_lifted_inst_block_COMPUTE_al_mem_INTERVALS sz bs il <=>

     (s < dimword (:'a) /\ s <> 0) /\
     (FUNS_EQ_OUTSIDE_WI_size b s f1 f2) /\
     (bir_is_lifted_imm_exp bs.bst_environ e (w2bs b sz))) il)

name: bir_is_lifted_inst_prog_def
statement:
bir_is_lifted_inst_prog
    
    (r: ('a, 'b, 'ms) bir_lifting_machine_rec_t)

    


    l

    

    mu

    

    mm

    
    (p :'o bir_program_t)

    <=>

  
  (WI_wfe mu /\ WF_bmr_ms_mem_contains mm /\ WI_is_sub (bmr_ms_mem_contains_interval mm) mu /\
   bir_is_valid_labels p /\ (!l'. MEM (BL_Address l') (bir_labels_of_program p) <=> (l' = l)) /\
   bir_program_string_labels_guarded p) /\

  (!ms bs.

    
    (bmr_rel r bs ms) ==>

    
    (bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address l)) ==>

    
    bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms mm ==>

    
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated bs) ==>

    


    ?lo c c' bs'.
      (bir_exec_to_addr_label p bs = BER_Ended lo c c' bs') /\

      (~(bs'.bst_status = BST_AssertionViolated) ==>
      (?ms'. (r.bmr_step_fun ms = SOME ms') /\
             (bmr_ms_mem_unchanged r ms ms' mu) /\
             (bmr_rel r bs' ms'))))

name: bir_is_lifted_prog_def
statement:
bir_is_lifted_prog
    
    (r: ('a, 'b, 'ms) bir_lifting_machine_rec_t)

    

    (mu : 'a word_interval_t)

    


    (mms : ('a word # 'b word list) list)

    
    (p :'o bir_program_t)

    <=>

  
  (WI_wfe mu /\ EVERY (\mm. WF_bmr_ms_mem_contains mm /\
   WI_is_sub (bmr_ms_mem_contains_interval mm) mu) mms /\ (bir_is_valid_labels p) /\
   bir_program_string_labels_guarded p) /\

  (!ms bs li.

    
    (bmr_rel r bs ms) ==>

    
    MEM (BL_Address li) (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
    (bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address li)) ==>


    
    EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms) mms ==>

    
    ~(bir_state_is_terminated bs) ==>

    


    ?lo c_st c_addr_labels bs'.
      (bir_exec_to_addr_label p bs = BER_Ended lo c_st c_addr_labels bs') /\

      (~(bs'.bst_status = BST_AssertionViolated) ==>
      (?ms'. (r.bmr_step_fun ms = SOME ms') /\
             (bmr_ms_mem_unchanged r ms ms' mu) /\
             (bmr_rel r bs' ms'))))

name: bir_is_lifted_prog_LABELS_DISTINCT_def
statement:
bir_is_lifted_prog_LABELS_DISTINCT r mu mms ps <=>
   (ALL_DISTINCT (FILTER IS_BL_Address (bir_labels_of_program (BirProgram (FLAT ps)))) ==>
    bir_is_lifted_prog r mu (FLAT mms) (BirProgram (FLAT ps)))

name: bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_def
statement:
bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV r mu mms1 mms2 <=>
  (EVERY (\mm. WF_bmr_ms_mem_contains mm /\
               WI_is_sub (bmr_ms_mem_contains_interval mm) mu) mms1 =
   EVERY (\mm. WF_bmr_ms_mem_contains mm /\
               WI_is_sub (bmr_ms_mem_contains_interval mm) mu) mms2) /\
  (!ms. EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms) mms1 =
        EVERY (bmr_ms_mem_contains r ms) mms2)

name: bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE_def
statement:
(bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc NONE [] = REVERSE acc) /\
   (bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc (SOME (b, l, b')) [] = REVERSE ((b, FLAT (REVERSE l))::acc)) /\

   (bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc NONE ((b, l)::mms) =
    bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc (SOME (b, [l], b + n2w (LENGTH l))) mms) /\

   (bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc (SOME (b, l, b')) ((b2, l2)::mms) =
      if (b' = b2) then
        bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE acc (SOME (b, l2::l, (b2+n2w (LENGTH l2)))) mms
      else
        bmr_mem_contains_regions_EQUIV_MERGE ((b,FLAT (REVERSE l))::acc) (SOME (b2, [l2], (b2+n2w (LENGTH l2)))) mms)

name: PROTECTED_COND_ID
statement: !c t. PROTECTED_COND c t t = t

name: PROTECTED_COND_RAND
statement: !f b x y. f (PROTECTED_COND b x y) = PROTECTED_COND b (f x) (f y)

name: PROTECTED_COND_RATOR
statement: !b f g x. (PROTECTED_COND b f g) x = PROTECTED_COND b (f x) (g x)

name: PROTECTED_COND_NEG_COND
statement: !b x y. (PROTECTED_COND (~b) x y) = PROTECTED_COND b y x

name: PROTECTED_COND_NEG_COND_CONJ
statement: !b1 b2 x y. (PROTECTED_COND (~b1 \/ ~b2) x y) = PROTECTED_COND (b1 /\ b2) y x

name: COMBINE_TWO_STEP_THMS_SIMPLE
statement:
!next cond1 cond2 ms ms1 ms2.
     (cond1 ==> (next ms = SOME ms1)) ==>
     (cond2 ==> (next ms = SOME ms2)) ==>
     (cond1 <=> ~cond2) ==>
     (next ms = SOME (PROTECTED_COND cond1 ms1 ms2))

name: COMBINE_TWO_STEP_THMS_SIMPLE_2
statement:
!next cond1 cond2 cond3 ms ms1 ms2.
     (cond3 ==> cond1 ==> (next ms = SOME ms1)) ==>
     (cond3 ==> cond2 ==> (next ms = SOME ms2)) ==>
     (cond1 <=> ~cond2) ==>
     (cond3) ==> 
     (next ms = SOME (PROTECTED_COND cond1 ms1 ms2))

name: w2w_REMOVE_1
statement:
!w : 'a word.
           dimindex (:'a) < dimindex (:'b) ==>
           dimindex (:'b) <> dimindex (:'c) ==>
           (((w2w ((w2w w):'b word)):'c word) =
                  w2w w)

name: w2w_REMOVE_2
statement:
!w : 'a word.
           ~(dimindex (:'a) <= dimindex (:'b)) ==>
           dimindex (:'c) < dimindex (:'b) ==>

           (((w2w ((w2w w):'b word)):'c word) =
                  w2w w)

name: MEM_bmr_vars
statement:
!r v. MEM v (bmr_vars r) <=> (?mf. r.bmr_mem = (BMLM v mf)) \/
                               (?lf. MEM (BMLI v lf) r.bmr_imms)

name: MEM_bmr_temp_vars
statement:
!r v. MEM v (bmr_temp_vars r) <=>

      (?v'. MEM v' (bmr_vars r) /\
            (v = bir_temp_var T v')) \/
      (?v_pc v_pc_cond lf. (r.bmr_pc = BMLPC v_pc v_pc_cond lf) /\
                           ((v = v_pc) \/ (v = v_pc_cond)))

name: bmr_vars_NO_TEMP_VAR
statement:
!r. bmr_ok r ==>
    EVERY (\v. ~(bir_is_temp_var_name (bir_var_name v))) (bmr_vars r)

name: bmr_temp_vars_TEMP_VAR
statement:
!r. bmr_ok r ==>
    EVERY (\v. (bir_is_temp_var_name (bir_var_name v))) (bmr_temp_vars r)

name: bmr_vars_IN_TEMP
statement: !r v. MEM v (bmr_vars r) ==> MEM (bir_temp_var T v) (bmr_temp_vars r)

name: bmr_vars_INITIALISED
statement:
!r bs ms. bmr_ok r ==> bmr_rel r bs ms ==>
   EVERY (bir_env_var_is_initialised bs.bst_environ) (bmr_vars r)

name: bmr_vars_DECLARED
statement:
!r bs ms. bmr_rel r bs ms ==>
   EVERY (bir_env_var_is_declared bs.bst_environ) (bmr_vars r)

name: bmr_temp_vars_DECLARED
statement:
!r bs ms. bmr_rel r bs ms ==>
   EVERY (bir_env_var_is_declared bs.bst_environ) (bmr_temp_vars r)

name: bmr_lifted
statement:
!r.
   bmr_ok r ==>
   !bs ms. bmr_rel r bs ms ==>

     (EVERY (\i. case i of BMLI v lf =>
        (bir_is_lifted_exp bs.bst_environ (BExp_Den v) (BLV_Imm (lf ms)))) r.bmr_imms /\
     (case r.bmr_mem of BMLM v lf =>
        (bir_is_lifted_exp bs.bst_environ (BExp_Den v) (BLV_Mem (lf ms)))))

name: bmr_rel_IMPL_IS_BL_Block_Address
statement:
!r bs ms. bmr_rel r bs ms ==>
    bir_state_COUNT_PC
       (F,(\pc. (pc.bpc_index = 0) /\ pc.bpc_label IN {l | IS_BL_Address l})) bs

name: bmr_rel_RECOVER_FROM_JUMP_OUTSIDE
statement:
!r bs ms l.
      bmr_rel r bs ms ==>
      (bs.bst_status = BST_JumpOutside l) ==>
      (bmr_rel r (bs with <| bst_status := BST_Running; bst_pc := bir_block_pc l|>) ms)

statement:

   (w2n b + LENGTH wl < dimword (:'a))

name: bir_machine_lifted_imm_OK_def
statement:
bir_machine_lifted_imm_OK (BMLI v (lf : 'ms -> bir_imm_t)) <=>
(~(bir_is_temp_var_name (bir_var_name v))) /\
(!ms. BType_Imm (type_of_bir_imm (lf ms)) = (bir_var_type v))

name: bir_machine_lifted_imm_def
statement:
bir_machine_lifted_imm (BMLI v lf) bs ms <=>

(bir_env_read v bs.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm (lf ms))) /\
(bir_env_var_is_declared bs.bst_environ (bir_temp_var T v))

name: bir_machine_lifted_imms_def
statement:
bir_machine_lifted_imms vl bs ms =
EVERY (\vlf. bir_machine_lifted_imm vlf bs ms) vl

name: bir_machine_lifted_mem_OK_def
statement:
bir_machine_lifted_mem_OK (BMLM v (lf : 'ms -> 'a word -> 'b word)) <=>
  (?sa sb.
     (bir_var_type v = BType_Mem sa sb) /\
     (size_of_bir_immtype sa = (dimindex (:'a))) /\
     (size_of_bir_immtype sb = (dimindex (:'b))) /\
     (~(bir_is_temp_var_name (bir_var_name v))))

name: bir_machine_lifted_mem_def
statement:
bir_machine_lifted_mem (BMLM v lf) bs ms <=>

?sa sb mem_n. (bir_var_type v = BType_Mem sa sb) /\
(bir_env_read v bs.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Mem sa sb mem_n)) /\
(lf ms = (\a. n2w (bir_load_mmap mem_n (w2n a)))) /\
(bir_env_var_is_declared bs.bst_environ (bir_temp_var T v))

name: bir_machine_lifted_pc_OK_def
statement:
bir_machine_lifted_pc_OK (BMLPC v_pc v_pc_cond (lf : 'ms -> bir_imm_t)) <=>
  (bir_is_temp_var_name (bir_var_name v_pc)) /\
  (bir_is_temp_var_name (bir_var_name v_pc_cond)) /\
  (!ms. BType_Imm (type_of_bir_imm (lf ms)) = (bir_var_type v_pc)) /\
  (bir_var_type v_pc_cond = BType_Bool)

name: bir_machine_lifted_pc_def
statement:
bir_machine_lifted_pc (BMLPC v_pc v_pc_cond lf) bs ms <=>

(bir_env_var_is_declared bs.bst_environ v_pc) /\
(bir_env_var_is_declared bs.bst_environ v_pc_cond) /\
(((bs.bst_pc = bir_block_pc (BL_Address (lf ms))) /\ (bs.bst_status = BST_Running)) \/
(bs.bst_status = BST_JumpOutside (BL_Address (lf ms))))

name: bmr_mem_val_sz_def

name: bmr_vars_def
statement:
bmr_vars r =
  (case r.bmr_mem of (BMLM v _) => v)::
  (MAP (\i. case i of (BMLI v _) => v) r.bmr_imms)

name: bmr_temp_vars_def
statement:
bmr_temp_vars r =
  (case r.bmr_pc of BMLPC v1 v2 _ => [v1;v2]) ++
  (MAP (bir_temp_var T) (bmr_vars r))

name: bmr_varnames_distinct_def
statement:
bmr_varnames_distinct r <=>
  ALL_DISTINCT (MAP bir_var_name (bmr_vars r ++ bmr_temp_vars r))

name: bmr_ok_def
statement:
bmr_ok r <=>
(EVERY bir_machine_lifted_imm_OK r.bmr_imms) /\
(bir_machine_lifted_mem_OK r.bmr_mem) /\
(bir_machine_lifted_pc_OK r.bmr_pc) /\
(bmr_varnames_distinct r)

name: bmr_rel_def
statement:
bmr_rel r bs ms <=>
(EVERY (\i. bir_machine_lifted_imm i bs ms) r.bmr_imms) /\
(bir_machine_lifted_mem r.bmr_mem bs ms) /\
(bir_machine_lifted_pc r.bmr_pc bs ms) /\
(r.bmr_extra ms)

name: bmr_ms_mem_contains_def

name: WF_bmr_ms_mem_contains_def

name: aligned_1_m0_mem_word
statement:
(!addr ms. aligned 1 (m0_mem_word_LE ms.MEM addr) = aligned 1 (ms.MEM addr)) /\
  (!addr ms. aligned 1 (m0_mem_half_LE ms.MEM addr) = aligned 1 (ms.MEM addr)) /\
  (!addr ms. aligned 1 (m0_mem_word_BE ms.MEM addr) = aligned 1 (ms.MEM (addr + 3w))) /\
  (!addr ms. aligned 1 (m0_mem_half_BE ms.MEM addr) = aligned 1 (ms.MEM (addr + 1w)))

name: aligned_2_m0_mem_word
statement:
(!addr ms. aligned 2 (m0_mem_word_LE ms.MEM addr) = aligned 2 (ms.MEM addr)) /\
  (!addr ms. aligned 2 (m0_mem_half_LE ms.MEM addr) = aligned 2 (ms.MEM addr)) /\
  (!addr ms. aligned 2 (m0_mem_word_BE ms.MEM addr) = aligned 2 (ms.MEM (addr + 3w))) /\
  (!addr ms. aligned 2 (m0_mem_half_BE ms.MEM addr) = aligned 2 (ms.MEM (addr + 1w)))

name: m0_mem_store_half_BE_32
statement:
!(a :word32) (w :word32) (mmap :word32 -> word8).
     (a + (1w :word32) =+ (((7 :num) >< (0 :num)) w :word8))
       ((a =+ (((15 :num) >< (8 :num)) w :word8)) mmap) =
     m0_mem_store_half_BE a (w2w w) mmap

name: m0_mem_store_half_LE_32
statement:
!(a :word32) (w :word32) (mmap :word32 -> word8).
     (a + (1w :word32) =+ (((15 :num) >< (8 :num)) w :word8))
       ((a =+ (((7 :num) >< (0 :num)) w :word8)) mmap) =
     m0_mem_store_half_LE a (w2w w) mmap

name: m0_LIFT_STORE_WORD_LE
statement:
!env em ea va ev vv ms mem_f.
     bir_is_lifted_mem_exp env em mem_f ==>
     bir_is_lifted_imm_exp env ea (Imm32 va) ==>
     bir_is_lifted_imm_exp env ev (Imm32 vv) ==>
     bir_is_lifted_mem_exp env (BExp_Store em ea BEnd_LittleEndian ev)

name: nzcv_SUB_V_fold_ARM8

!w1 w0:'a word.

  (word_msb w0 <=/=> BIT  (dimindex (:'a) - 1) (w2n w0 + w2n (~w1) + 1))) =
  nzcv_BIR_SUB_V w0 w1

name: nzcv_SUB_C_fold_ARM8
statement:
!w1 w0.
  ((if w2n w0 + w2n (~(w1:'a word)) + 1 < dimword (:'a) then w2n w0 + w2n (~w1) + 1
   else (w2n w0 + w2n (~w1) + 1) MOD (dimword (:'a))) <>
  w2n w0 + w2n (~w1) + 1) = nzcv_BIR_SUB_C w0 w1

name: nzcv_SUB_Z_fold_ARM8
statement: !w1 w0. ((w0:'a word - w1) = 0w) = nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w0 w1

name: nzcv_SUB_N_fold_ARM8

name: nzcv_ADD_V_fold_ARM8

!w1:'a word w0:'a word.
  ((word_msb w0 <=> word_msb w1) /\
  (word_msb w0 <=/=> BIT (dimindex (:'a) - 1) (w2n w0 + w2n w1))) = nzcv_BIR_ADD_V w0 w1

name: nzcv_ADD_V_fold_ARM8_ID
statement:
!w:'a word.

name: nzcv_ADD_C_fold_ARM8

!w1 w0.

   else (w2n w0 + w2n w1) MOD (dimword (:'a))) <>
  w2n w0 + w2n w1) = nzcv_BIR_ADD_C w0 w1

name: nzcv_ADD_Z_fold_ARM8

name: nzcv_ADD_N_fold_ARM8

name: awc_BIR_V_fold_ARM8
statement:
!w1:'a word w0:'a word c.
  ((word_msb w0 <=> word_msb w1) /\
  (word_msb w0 <=/=> BIT (dimindex (:'a) - 1) (w2n w0 + w2n w1 + (if c then 1 else 0)))) = awc_BIR_V w0 w1 c

name: awc_BIR_V_fold_ARM8_ID
statement:
!w:'a word c.
  (word_msb w <=/=> BIT (dimindex (:'a) - 1) (w2n w + w2n w + (if c then 1 else 0))) = awc_BIR_V w w c

name: awc_BIR_V_fold_ARM8_ngcs
statement:

   awc_BIR_V 0w (~w) c

name: awc_BIR_C_fold_ARM8
statement:
!w0 w1 c.
  ((if w2n w0 + ((w2n (w1:'a word)) + if c then 1 else (0:num)) < dimword (:'a) then
       w2n w0 + (w2n w1 + if c then 1 else 0)
  else (w2n w0 + (w2n w1 + if c then 1 else 0)) MOD (dimword (:'a))) <>
  w2n w0 + (w2n w1 + if c then 1 else 0)) = awc_BIR_C w0 w1 c

name: awc_BIR_C_fold_ARM8_ngcs
statement:
!w1 c.
  ((if ((w2n (~(w1:'a word))) + if c then 1 else (0:num)) < dimword (:'a) then
       (w2n (~w1) + if c then 1 else 0)
  else ((w2n (~w1) + if c then 1 else 0)) MOD (dimword (:'a))) <>
  (w2n (~w1) + if c then 1 else 0)) = awc_BIR_C 0w (~w1) c

name: awc_BIR_Z_fold_ARM8
statement:
!w1 (w0 : 'a word) c.
     ((n2w (w2n w0 + ((w2n w1 + if c then 1 else 0)))) = (0w:'a word)) <=>
     awc_BIR_Z w0 w1 c

name: awc_BIR_Z_fold_ARM8_ngcs
statement:
!(w1 : 'a word) c.
     ((n2w ((w2n (~w1) + if c then 1 else 0))) = (0w:'a word)) <=>
     awc_BIR_Z 0w (~w1) c

name: awc_BIR_N_fold_ARM8
statement:
!w1 w0 c. BIT (dimindex (:'a) - 1) ((w2n w0 + ((w2n w1 + if c then 1 else 0)))) =

name: awc_BIR_N_fold_ARM8_ngcs
statement:

name: awc_BIR_RES_fold_ARM8
statement:

name: awc_BIR_RES_fold_ARM8_ngcs

name: awc_BIR_RES_fold_ARM8_BITS

!(w0:'a word) w1 c.
            (dimindex (:'a) < dimindex (:'b)) ==>
            ((n2w (BITS (dimindex (:'a) -1) 0 (w2n w0 + ((w2n w1 + if c then 1 else 0))))):'b word =
             w2w (w0 + w1 + (if c then 1w else 0w)))

name: awc_BIR_RES_fold_ARM8_ngcs_BITS
statement:
!(w1:'a word) c.
            (dimindex (:'a) < dimindex (:'b)) ==>

name: awc_BIR_Z_nzcv_BIR_ADD_Z_fold

name: awc_BIR_Z_nzcv_BIR_SUB_N_fold

!(w0:'a word) w1 c. nzcv_BIR_SUB_N (w0 - w1) (if c then 0w else 1w) =

name: awc_BIR_Z_nzcv_BIR_ADD_N_fold

!(w0:'a word) w1 c. nzcv_BIR_ADD_N (w0 + w1) (if c then 1w else 0w) =

name: awc_BIR_Z_nzcv_BIR_ADD_N_fold_ngcs
statement:
!(w1:'a word) c. nzcv_BIR_ADD_N (~w1) (if c then 1w else 0w) =

name: nzcv_SUB_V_fold_ARM8_CONST
statement:
!w0 n. n < dimword (:'a) ==> INT_MIN (:'a) <= n ==>
   (((word_msb w0) /\
    (word_msb w0 <=/=> BIT  (dimindex (:'a) - 1) (w2n w0 + n + 1))) =

   (nzcv_BIR_SUB_V (w0:'a word) (n2w (dimword (:'a) - SUC n))))

name: nzcv_ADD_V_fold_ARM8_CONST
statement:
!(w0 : 'a word) n. n < dimword (:'a) ==> (n < INT_MIN (:'a)) ==>
   ((~(word_msb w0) /\
    (word_msb w0 <=/=> BIT  (dimindex (:'a) - 1) (w2n w0 + n))) =
   nzcv_BIR_ADD_V w0 (n2w n))

name: nzcv_SUB_C_fold_ARM8_CONST
statement:
!w0 n. n < dimword (:'a) ==>
 ( ((if w2n w0 + n + 1 < dimword (:'a) then w2n w0 + n + 1
   else (w2n w0 + n + 1) MOD (dimword (:'a))) <>
  w2n w0 + n + 1) = (nzcv_BIR_SUB_C (w0:'a word) (n2w (dimword (:'a) - SUC n))))

name: nzcv_ADD_C_fold_ARM8_CONST
statement:
!w0 n. n < dimword (:'a) ==>
 ( ((if w2n w0 + n < dimword (:'a) then w2n w0 + n
   else (w2n w0 + n) MOD (dimword (:'a))) <>
  w2n w0 + n) = (nzcv_BIR_ADD_C (w0:'a word) (n2w n)))

name: nzcv_ADD_Z_to_SUB

!(w0:'a word) n.
         (n < dimword (:'a)) /\ (dimword (:'a) - n < n) ==>
         (nzcv_BIR_ADD_Z w0 (n2w n) <=>
          nzcv_BIR_SUB_Z w0 (n2w (dimword (:'a) - n)))

name: nzcv_ADD_N_to_SUB
statement:
!(w0:'a word) n.
         (n < dimword (:'a)) /\ (dimword (:'a) - n < n) ==>
         (nzcv_BIR_ADD_N w0 (n2w n) <=>
          nzcv_BIR_SUB_N w0 (n2w (dimword (:'a) - n)))

     word_bit ((MIN 32 (w2n w1)) - 1) w2) =

name: riscv_is_lifted_mem_exp_STORE0_8LSB

    bir_is_lifted_mem_exp env em (mem_f : word64 -> word8) ==>
    bir_is_lifted_imm_exp env ea (Imm64 va) ==>
    bir_is_lifted_imm_exp env er (Imm64 vr) ==>
    (!r.
    (bir_store_in_mem_words Bit8 Bit64 (Imm8 (w2w vr)) mem_f BEnd_LittleEndian va = SOME r) ==>
    (bir_is_lifted_mem_exp env (BExp_Store em ea BEnd_LittleEndian (BExp_Cast BIExp_LowCast er Bit8)) r))

name: riscv_is_lifted_mem_exp_STORE0_16LSB
statement:
!env em ea (va :word64) er (vr : word64) mem_f.
    bir_is_lifted_mem_exp env em (mem_f : word64 -> word8) ==>
    bir_is_lifted_imm_exp env ea (Imm64 va) ==>

name: riscv_mem_load_half_def

riscv_mem_load_half (m : (word64 -> word8)) (a:word64) =
  ((m (a + 1w) @@ m a):word16)

name: riscv_mem_load_word_def

    (m (a + 3w) @@ m (a + 2w) @@ m (a + 1w) @@ m a) : word32

name: riscv_mem_load_dword_def

  (m (a + 7w) @@ m (a + 6w) @@ m (a + 5w) @@ m (a + 4w) @@
      m (a + 3w) @@ m (a + 2w) @@ m (a + 1w) @@ m a) : word64

name: riscv_mem_store_half_def

   (a + 1w =+ (15 >< 8)  w)
  ((a + 0w =+ (7  >< 0)  w) mmap)

name: bir_vars_bir_ts_thm
statement:
!ls p vs st1 st2 st1'.
    (vs = bir_vars_of_program p) ==>
    (bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1 st2) ==>
    ((bir_ts p).weak ls st1 st1') ==>
    ?st2'. (bir_ts p).weak ls st2 st2' /\
           bir_state_EQ_FOR_VARS vs st1' st2'

name: bir_Pi_overapprox_Q_thm
statement:
!p P sys Pi Q.
  (Pi_overapprox_Q (bir_symb_rec_sbir p) P (birs_symb_to_symbst sys) (IMAGE birs_symb_to_symbst Pi) Q)
  <=>
  (!sys2 bs bs' H.
     sys2 IN Pi ==>
     birs_symb_matchstate sys H bs ==>
     (\bs. P (birs_symb_to_concst bs)) bs ==>
     (?H'. symb_interpr_ext H' H /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys2 H' bs') ==>
     (\bs bs'. Q (birs_symb_to_concst bs) (birs_symb_to_concst bs')) bs bs')

!e senv.
  birs_senv_typecheck e senv <=> bir_envty_includes_vs (birs_envty_of_senv senv) (bir_vars_of_exp e)

name: bir_envty_includes_v_senv_gen_env_thm
statement:
!v l.
  bir_envty_includes_v (birs_envty_of_senv (birs_gen_env l)) v =
    (OPTION_BIND (birs_gen_env l (bir_var_name v)) type_of_bir_exp = SOME (bir_var_type v))

name: bir_envty_includes_vs_EMPTY
statement:
!envty.
  bir_envty_includes_vs envty EMPTY

name: birs_senv_typecheck_IMP_birs_eval_exp_subst_type_thm
statement:
!e senv.
  (birs_senv_typecheck e senv) ==>
  (type_of_bir_exp (birs_eval_exp_subst e senv) = type_of_bir_exp e)

name: birs_eval_exp_ALT2_typeok_thm
statement:
!e senv ty sv.
  (bir_envty_includes_vs (birs_envty_of_senv senv) (bir_vars_of_exp e)) ==>
  (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 e senv = SOME sv) ==>
  (type_of_bir_exp sv = SOME ty)

name: birs_eval_exp_ALT2_typeerr_thm
statement:
!e senv.
  ((~(bir_envty_includes_vs (birs_envty_of_senv senv) (bir_vars_of_exp e))) \/
   (type_of_bir_exp e = NONE)) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 e senv = NONE)

name: birs_eval_exp_ALT2_thm
statement:
!e senv.
  (bir_envty_includes_vs (birs_envty_of_senv senv) (bir_vars_of_exp e)) ==>
  (IS_SOME (type_of_bir_exp e)) ==>
  (SOME (birs_eval_exp_subst e senv) = birs_eval_exp_ALT2 e senv)

name: birs_eval_exp_ALT_thm
statement:
!e senv.
  birs_eval_exp e senv = birs_eval_exp_ALT e senv

name: birs_eval_exp_NONE_EQ_bir_exp_env_type_thm
statement:
!senv e.
  ((type_of_bir_exp e = NONE) \/
   (~bir_envty_includes_vs (birs_envty_of_senv senv) (bir_vars_of_exp e)))
  <=>
  (birs_eval_exp e senv = NONE)

name: birs_eval_exp_SOME_EQ_bir_exp_env_type_thm
statement:
!senv e ty.
  (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty) /\
  (bir_envty_includes_vs (birs_envty_of_senv senv) (bir_vars_of_exp e))
  <=>
  (?sv. birs_eval_exp e senv = SOME (sv, ty))

name: birs_eval_exp_IMP_type_thm
statement:
!e senv sv ty.
  (birs_eval_exp e senv = SOME (sv, ty)) ==>
  (type_of_bir_exp sv = SOME ty)

name: bir_vars_of_exp_IMP_symbs_SUBSET_senv_thm
statement:
!e senv sv ty.
  (birs_eval_exp e senv = SOME (sv,ty)) ==>
  (bir_vars_of_exp sv SUBSET (BIGUNION {bir_vars_of_exp e | (?vn. senv vn = SOME e)}))

name: birs_interpret_get_var_thm
statement:
!H bv.
  birs_interpret_get_var
    (SymbInterpret H)
    (bv)
  =
  H (bv)

name: birs_interpret_fun_thm
statement:
!i e.
  birs_interpret_fun i e = birs_interpret_fun_ALT i e

name: birs_symb_from_to_symbst_thm
statement: !s. birs_symb_to_symbst (birs_symb_from_symbst s) = s

name: birs_symb_to_from_symbst_thm
statement: !s. birs_symb_from_symbst (birs_symb_to_symbst s) = s

name: birs_symb_to_symbst_EXISTS_thm
statement: !s. ?st. birs_symb_to_symbst st = s

name: birs_symb_to_symbst_SET_EXISTS_thm
statement: !Pi. ?Pi_t. IMAGE birs_symb_to_symbst Pi_t = Pi

name: birs_symb_from_symbst_EXISTS_thm
statement: !s. ?st. birs_symb_from_symbst st = s

name: birs_symb_to_symbst_BIJ_thm
statement:
!s1 s2.
  (birs_symb_to_symbst s1 = birs_symb_to_symbst s2) ==>
  (s1 = s2)

name: birs_symb_to_symbst_EQ_thm
statement:
!s1 s2.
  (birs_symb_to_symbst s1 = birs_symb_to_symbst s2) <=>
  (s1 = s2)

name: birs_symb_to_concst_def
statement:
birs_symb_to_concst s =
      (SymbConcSt
        s.bst_pc
        (\bvn. bir_env_lookup bvn s.bst_environ)
        s.bst_status)

name: birs_symb_from_concst_def
birs_eval_exp_subst_var_def
statement:
birs_eval_exp_subst_var x senv =
      option_CASE (senv (bir_var_name x)) (BExp_Den x) (I)

name: birs_eval_exp_subst_def
statement:
(birs_eval_exp_subst (BExp_Const n) senv = (BExp_Const n)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_subst (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) senv = (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_subst (BExp_Den v) senv = birs_eval_exp_subst_var v senv) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_subst (BExp_Cast ct e ty) senv =
      BExp_Cast ct
        (birs_eval_exp_subst e senv) ty) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_subst (BExp_UnaryExp et e) senv =
      BExp_UnaryExp et
        (birs_eval_exp_subst e senv)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_subst (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) senv =
      BExp_BinExp et
        (birs_eval_exp_subst e1 senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_subst e2 senv)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_subst (BExp_BinPred pt e1 e2) senv =
      BExp_BinPred pt
        (birs_eval_exp_subst e1 senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_subst e2 senv)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_subst (BExp_MemEq me1 me2) senv =
      BExp_MemEq
        (birs_eval_exp_subst me1 senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_subst me2 senv)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_subst (BExp_IfThenElse c et ef) senv =
      BExp_IfThenElse
        (birs_eval_exp_subst c senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_subst et senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_subst ef senv)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_subst (BExp_Load mem_e a_e en ty) senv =
      BExp_Load
        (birs_eval_exp_subst mem_e senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_subst a_e senv)
        en
        ty) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_subst (BExp_Store mem_e a_e en v_e) senv =
      BExp_Store
        (birs_eval_exp_subst mem_e senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_subst a_e senv)
        en
        (birs_eval_exp_subst v_e senv))

name: birs_eval_exp_subst_ALT_def
statement:
birs_eval_exp_subst_ALT e senv =
      bir_exp_subst
        (FUN_FMAP
          (\x. birs_eval_exp_subst_var x senv)
          (bir_vars_of_exp e))
        e

name: APPEND_distinct_def
statement:
APPEND_distinct l1 l2 =
      FOLDR (\x l. if MEM x l then l else x::l) l2 l1

name: bir_vars_of_exp_LIST_def
statement:
(bir_vars_of_exp_LIST (BExp_Const _) =
     []) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST (BExp_MemConst _ _ _) =
     []) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST (BExp_Den v) =
     [v]) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST (BExp_Cast _ e _) =
     bir_vars_of_exp_LIST e) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST (BExp_UnaryExp _ e) =
     bir_vars_of_exp_LIST e) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST (BExp_BinExp _ e1 e2) =
     (APPEND_distinct
       (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST e1)
       (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST e2))) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST (BExp_BinPred _ e1 e2) =
     (APPEND_distinct
       (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST e1)
       (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST e2))) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST (BExp_MemEq e1 e2) =
     (APPEND_distinct
       (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST e1)
       (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST e2))) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST (BExp_IfThenElse ec e1 e2) =
     (APPEND_distinct
       (APPEND_distinct
         (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST ec)
         (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST e1))
       (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST e2))) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST (BExp_Load me ae _ _) =
     (APPEND_distinct
       (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST me)
       (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST ae))) /\
  (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST (BExp_Store me ae _ ve) =
     (APPEND_distinct
       (APPEND_distinct
         (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST me)
         (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST ae))
       (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST ve)))

name: birs_envty_of_senv_def
statement:
birs_envty_of_senv senv =
  BEnvTy ((\x. OPTION_BIND x type_of_bir_exp) o senv)

name: birs_senv_typecheck_def
statement:
birs_senv_typecheck e senv =
      EVERY (\v. ((\x. OPTION_BIND x type_of_bir_exp) o senv) (bir_var_name v) = SOME (bir_var_type v)) (bir_vars_of_exp_LIST e)

name: birs_eval_exp_def
statement:
birs_eval_exp e senv =
      let e_ty_o = type_of_bir_exp e; in
      if
        birs_senv_typecheck e senv /\
        IS_SOME e_ty_o
      then
        let e' = birs_eval_exp_subst e senv; in
        SOME (e', THE e_ty_o)
      else
        NONE

name: birs_eval_exp_subst_var_ALT_def
statement:
birs_eval_exp_subst_var_ALT x senv =
      OPTION_BIND
        (senv (bir_var_name x))
        (\x_ex. if type_of_bir_exp (x_ex) = SOME (bir_var_type x) then
                  SOME x_ex
                else NONE)

name: birs_eval_cast_def
statement:
(birs_eval_cast ct (SOME e) ty =
     if ~(option_CASE (type_of_bir_exp e) F bir_type_is_Imm) then NONE else
     SOME (BExp_Cast ct e ty)) /\
  (birs_eval_cast _ _ _ = NONE)

name: birs_eval_unary_exp_def
statement:
(birs_eval_unary_exp et (SOME e) =
     if ~(option_CASE (type_of_bir_exp e) F bir_type_is_Imm) then NONE else
     SOME (BExp_UnaryExp et e)) /\
  (birs_eval_unary_exp _ _ = NONE)

name: birs_eval_bin_exp_def
statement:
(birs_eval_bin_exp et (SOME e1) (SOME e2) =
     if ~(option_CASE (type_of_bir_exp e1) F bir_type_is_Imm) \/ (type_of_bir_exp e1 <> type_of_bir_exp e2) then NONE else
     SOME (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2)) /\
  (birs_eval_bin_exp _ _ _ = NONE)

name: birs_eval_bin_pred_def
statement:
(birs_eval_bin_pred pt (SOME e1) (SOME e2) =
     if ~(option_CASE (type_of_bir_exp e1) F bir_type_is_Imm) \/ (type_of_bir_exp e1 <> type_of_bir_exp e2) then NONE else
     SOME (BExp_BinPred pt e1 e2)) /\
  (birs_eval_bin_pred _ _ _ = NONE)

name: birs_eval_memeq_def
statement:
(birs_eval_memeq (SOME e1) (SOME e2) =
     if ~(option_CASE (type_of_bir_exp e1) F bir_type_is_Mem) \/ (type_of_bir_exp e1 <> type_of_bir_exp e2) then NONE else
     SOME (BExp_MemEq e1 e2)) /\
  (birs_eval_memeq _ _ = NONE)

name: birs_eval_ifthenelse_def
statement:
(birs_eval_ifthenelse (SOME ec) (SOME et) (SOME ef) =
     if ~(option_CASE (type_of_bir_exp ec) F (bir_type_is_Imm_s Bit1)) \/ IS_NONE (type_of_bir_exp et) \/ (type_of_bir_exp et <> type_of_bir_exp ef) then NONE else
       SOME (BExp_IfThenElse ec et ef)) /\
  (birs_eval_ifthenelse _ _ _ = NONE)

name: birs_eval_load_def
statement:
(birs_eval_load (SOME em) (SOME ea) en sz =
     case type_of_bir_exp em of
      | SOME (BType_Mem aty vty) =>
         (case type_of_bir_exp ea of
          | SOME (BType_Imm avty) =>
             if aty <> avty \/ (en = BEnd_NoEndian /\ vty <> sz) \/ (en <> BEnd_NoEndian /\ IS_NONE (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty sz aty)) then NONE else
             SOME (BExp_Load em ea en sz)
          | _ => NONE)
      | _ => NONE) /\
  (birs_eval_load _ _ _ _ = NONE)

name: birs_eval_store_def
statement:
(birs_eval_store (SOME em) (SOME ea) en (SOME ev) =
     case type_of_bir_exp em of
      | SOME (BType_Mem aty vty) =>
         (case type_of_bir_exp ea of
          | SOME (BType_Imm avty) =>
             (case type_of_bir_exp ev of
              | SOME (BType_Imm sz) =>
                 if aty <> avty \/ (en = BEnd_NoEndian /\ vty <> sz) \/ (en <> BEnd_NoEndian /\ IS_NONE (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty sz aty)) then NONE else
                 SOME (BExp_Store em ea en ev)
              | _ => NONE)
          | _ => NONE)
      | _ => NONE) /\
  (birs_eval_store _ _ _ _ = NONE)

name: birs_eval_exp_ALT2_def
statement:
(birs_eval_exp_ALT2 (BExp_Const n) senv = SOME (BExp_Const n)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) senv = SOME (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 (BExp_Den v) senv = birs_eval_exp_subst_var_ALT v senv) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 (BExp_Cast ct e ty) senv =
      birs_eval_cast ct
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 e senv) ty) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 (BExp_UnaryExp et e) senv =
      birs_eval_unary_exp et
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 e senv)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) senv =
      birs_eval_bin_exp et
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 e1 senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 e2 senv)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 (BExp_BinPred pt e1 e2) senv =
      birs_eval_bin_pred pt
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 e1 senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 e2 senv)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 (BExp_MemEq me1 me2) senv =
      birs_eval_memeq
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 me1 senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 me2 senv)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 (BExp_IfThenElse c et ef) senv =
      birs_eval_ifthenelse
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 c senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 et senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 ef senv)) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 (BExp_Load mem_e a_e en ty) senv =
      birs_eval_load
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 mem_e senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 a_e senv)
        en
        ty) /\
   (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 (BExp_Store mem_e a_e en v_e) senv =
      birs_eval_store
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 mem_e senv)
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 a_e senv)
        en
        (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 v_e senv))

name: birs_eval_exp_ALT_def
statement:
birs_eval_exp_ALT e senv =
      OPTION_MAP (\se. (se, THE (type_of_bir_exp se))) (birs_eval_exp_ALT2 e senv)

name: bir_val_to_constexp_def
statement:
(bir_val_to_constexp (BVal_Imm i) = BExp_Const i) /\
   (bir_val_to_constexp (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap) = BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap)

name: birs_interpret_subst_fmap_get_def
statement:
birs_interpret_subst_fmap_get i x =
      if x IN symb_interpr_dom i then
        bir_val_to_constexp (THE (symb_interpr_get i x))
      else
        BExp_Den x

name: birs_interpret_subst_fmap_def
statement:
birs_interpret_subst_fmap i e =
      FUN_FMAP (birs_interpret_subst_fmap_get i) (bir_vars_of_exp e)

name: birs_interpret_subst_def
statement:
birs_interpret_subst i e =
      bir_exp_subst
        (birs_interpret_subst_fmap i e)
        e

name: birs_interpret_fun_def
statement:
birs_interpret_fun i e =
      bir_eval_exp
       (birs_interpret_subst i e)
       bir_env_empty

name: birs_interpret_get_var_def
statement:
birs_interpret_get_var i x =
      if x IN symb_interpr_dom i then
        symb_interpr_get i x
      else
        NONE

name: birs_interpret_fun_ALT_def
statement:
(birs_interpret_fun_ALT i (BExp_Const n) = SOME (BVal_Imm n)) /\
   (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i (BExp_MemConst aty vty mmap) = SOME (BVal_Mem aty vty mmap)) /\
   (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i (BExp_Den v) = birs_interpret_get_var i v) /\
   (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i (BExp_Cast ct e ty) =
      bir_eval_cast ct (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i e) ty) /\
   (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i (BExp_UnaryExp et e) =
      bir_eval_unary_exp et (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i e)) /\
   (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i (BExp_BinExp et e1 e2) =
      bir_eval_bin_exp et
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i e1)
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i e2)) /\
   (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i (BExp_BinPred pt e1 e2) =
      bir_eval_bin_pred pt
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i e1)
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i e2)) /\
   (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i (BExp_MemEq me1 me2) =
      bir_eval_memeq
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i me1)
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i me2)) /\
   (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i (BExp_IfThenElse c et ef) =
      bir_eval_ifthenelse
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i c)
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i et)
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i ef)) /\
   (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i (BExp_Load mem_e a_e en ty) =
      bir_eval_load
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i mem_e)
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i a_e)
        en
        ty) /\
   (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i (BExp_Store mem_e a_e en v_e) =
      bir_eval_store
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i mem_e)
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i a_e)
        en
        (birs_interpret_fun_ALT i v_e))

name: birs_symb_to_symbst_def
statement:
birs_symb_to_symbst s =
      (SymbSymbSt
        s.bsst_pc
        s.bsst_environ
        s.bsst_pcond
        s.bsst_status)

name: birs_symb_from_symbst_def
birs_state_is_terminated_def
statement:
birs_state_is_terminated st =
      (st.bsst_status <> BST_Running)

name: birs_state_set_typeerror_def
statement:
birs_state_set_typeerror st =
      (st with bsst_status := BST_TypeError)

name: birs_state_set_failed_def
statement:
birs_state_set_failed st =
      (st with bsst_status := BST_Failed)

name: birs_update_env_def
statement: birs_update_env (n, v) env = (n =+ (SOME v)) env

name: birs_exec_stmt_assign_def
birs_exec_stmt_assert_def
birs_exec_stmt_assume_def
birs_exec_stmt_observe_def
statement:
birs_exec_stmt_observe oid ec el obf st =
  let
    svol = MAP (\e. birs_eval_exp e st.bsst_environ) el;
  in
   if EXISTS IS_NONE svol then
     ({birs_state_set_typeerror st})
   else
  case birs_eval_exp ec st.bsst_environ of
    | SOME (svob, BType_Imm Bit1) => {st}
    | _ => ({birs_state_set_typeerror st})

name: birs_exec_stmtB_def
statement:
(birs_exec_stmtB (BStmt_Assert ex) st =
     (birs_exec_stmt_assert ex st)) /\
   (birs_exec_stmtB (BStmt_Assume ex) st =
     (birs_exec_stmt_assume ex st)) /\
   (birs_exec_stmtB (BStmt_Assign v ex) st =
     (birs_exec_stmt_assign v ex st)) /\
   (birs_exec_stmtB (BStmt_Observe oid ec el obf) st =
     birs_exec_stmt_observe oid ec el obf st)

name: birs_exec_stmt_halt_def
statement:
birs_exec_stmt_halt ex (st : birs_state_t) =
      {st with bsst_status := BST_Halted (BVal_Imm (Imm1 0w))}

name: birs_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label_def
statement:
birs_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p (st : birs_state_t) (l : bir_label_t) =
    if MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) then
      st with bsst_pc := bir_block_pc l
    else st with bsst_status := (BST_JumpOutside l)

name: birs_symbval_concretizations_def
statement: birs_symbval_concretizations pcond vaex = {BL_Address iv | ?i. birs_interpret_fun i pcond = SOME bir_val_true /\ birs_interpret_fun i vaex = SOME (BVal_Imm iv)}

name: birs_eval_label_exp_def
statement:
(birs_eval_label_exp (BLE_Label l) senv pcond = SOME {l}) /\
   (birs_eval_label_exp (BLE_Exp e)   senv pcond =
     case birs_eval_exp e senv of
      | SOME (vaex, BType_Imm _) => SOME (birs_symbval_concretizations pcond vaex)
      | _ => NONE
   )

name: birs_exec_stmt_jmp_def
statement:
birs_exec_stmt_jmp p le (st : birs_state_t) =
    case birs_eval_label_exp le st.bsst_environ st.bsst_pcond of
      | NONE => {birs_state_set_typeerror st}
      | SOME ls => IMAGE (birs_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p st) ls

name: birs_exec_stmt_cjmp_def
statement:
birs_exec_stmt_cjmp p ec l1 l2 (st : birs_state_t) =
      case birs_eval_exp ec st.bsst_environ of
     | SOME (vaex, BType_Imm Bit1) =>
        (birs_exec_stmt_jmp p l1 (st with bsst_pcond := BExp_BinExp BIExp_And st.bsst_pcond vaex)) UNION
        (birs_exec_stmt_jmp p l2 (st with bsst_pcond := BExp_BinExp BIExp_And st.bsst_pcond (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not vaex)))
     | NONE => {birs_state_set_typeerror st}
     | _ => {birs_state_set_typeerror st}

name: birs_exec_stmtE_def

     birs_exec_stmt_jmp p l st) /\
   (birs_exec_stmtE p (BStmt_CJmp e l1 l2) st =
     birs_exec_stmt_cjmp p e l1 l2 st) /\
   (birs_exec_stmtE p (BStmt_Halt ex) st =
     birs_exec_stmt_halt ex st)

name: birs_exec_stmt_def
statement:
(birs_exec_stmt (p:'a bir_program_t) (BStmtB (bst:'a bir_stmt_basic_t)) st =
     let (sts') = birs_exec_stmtB bst st in
     IMAGE (\st'.
     if (birs_state_is_terminated st') then
       (st')
     else
       (st' with bsst_pc updated_by bir_pc_next)) sts') /\
   (birs_exec_stmt p (BStmtE bst) st =
     (birs_exec_stmtE p bst st))

name: birs_exec_step_def
statement:
birs_exec_step p state =
  if (birs_state_is_terminated state) then {state} else
  case (bir_get_current_statement p state.bsst_pc) of
    | NONE => {birs_state_set_failed state}
    | SOME stm => (birs_exec_stmt p stm state)

name: birs_val_eq_def

   (birs_val_eq (BVal_Mem at1 vt1 mmap1) (BVal_Mem at2 vt2 mmap2) =
      (bir_eval_memeq (SOME (BVal_Mem at1 vt1 mmap1)) (SOME (BVal_Mem at2 vt2 mmap2)) = SOME bir_val_true)) /\
   (birs_val_eq _ _ = F)

name: birs_symb_subst_f_sound_NOTIN_thm
statement:
!prog.
  symb_subst_f_sound_NOTIN (bir_symb_rec_sbir prog)

name: birs_symb_matchstate_IMP_birs_state_set_failed_thm
statement:
!sys H s.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate (birs_state_set_failed sys) H (bir_state_set_failed s))

name: birs_symb_matchstate_IMP_same_pc_update_thm
statement:
!sys H s pc_upd.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate
     (sys with bsst_pc updated_by pc_upd)
     H
     (s with bst_pc updated_by pc_upd))

name: birs_symb_matchstate_interpr_ext_IMP_matchstate_thm
statement:
!sys1 sys2 H1 H2 s1 s2.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys1 H1 s1) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys2 H2 s2) ==>
  (symb_interpr_ext H2 H1) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys1 H2 s1)

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_IMP_UPDATE_ENV_thm
statement:
!sys H vn sv.
  (bir_vars_of_exp sv SUBSET birs_symb_symbols sys) ==>
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs (birs_symb_symbols sys) H) ==>
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs (birs_symb_symbols (sys with bsst_environ := (vn =+ (SOME sv)) sys.bsst_environ)) H)

name: birs_interpret_fun_IMP_birs_matchenv_thm
statement:
!H senv env vn sv v.
  (birs_interpret_fun H sv = SOME v) ==>
  (birs_matchenv H senv (BEnv (env))) ==>
  (birs_matchenv H ((vn =+ (SOME sv)) senv) (BEnv ((vn =+ (SOME v)) env)))

name: birs_eval_exp_IMP_varset_thm
statement:
!ex senv sv ty.
  (birs_eval_exp ex senv = SOME (sv,ty)) ==>
  (bir_vars_of_exp sv SUBSET (BIGUNION {bir_vars_of_exp e | (?vn. senv vn = SOME e)}))

name: birs_exec_stmt_assign_sound_thm
statement:
!v ex s s' sys Pi H.
  (bir_exec_stmt_assign v ex s = s') ==>
  (birs_exec_stmt_assign v ex sys = Pi) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_state_set_typeerror_SING_symb_matchstate_thm
statement:
!s sys s' Pi H.
  (bir_state_set_typeerror s = s') ==>
  ({birs_state_set_typeerror sys} = Pi) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_symb_matchstate_IMP_bir_symb_eval_exp_thm
statement:
!s sys H e.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  ((birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = NONE /\
    bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ = NONE)
   \/
   (?sv ty v.
         birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv,ty) /\
         bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ = SOME v /\
         birs_interpret_fun H sv = SOME v /\
         type_of_bir_val v = ty))

name: birs_symb_matchstate_IMP_bir_symb_eval_exp_SOME_thm
statement:
!s sys H e sv ty.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv,ty)) ==>
  (?v. (bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ = SOME v) /\
       (birs_interpret_fun H sv = SOME v) /\
       (type_of_bir_val v = ty))

name: birs_symb_matchstate_IMP_bir_symb_eval_exp_NONE_thm
statement:
!s sys H e.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = NONE) ==>
  (bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ = NONE)

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_COND_thm
statement:
!sys sys' H e sv ty.
  (birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv, ty)) ==>
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs (birs_symb_symbols sys) H) ==>
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs (birs_symb_symbols sys') H) ==>
  ((symb_interpr_for_symbs
          (birs_symb_symbols
             (sys' with bsst_pcond := BExp_BinExp BIExp_And sys.bsst_pcond sv))
          H)
   /\
   (symb_interpr_for_symbs
          (birs_symb_symbols
             (sys' with
                bsst_pcond :=
                  BExp_BinExp BIExp_And sys.bsst_pcond
                    (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not sv))) H))

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_UPD_status_thm
statement:
!sys H status.
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs (birs_symb_symbols sys) H) ==>
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs (birs_symb_symbols
            (sys with bsst_status := status)) H)

name: birs_symb_matchstate_COND_UNION_thm
statement:
!s sys H e sv bv stfun sffun systfun sysffun s' Pi.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv,BType_Imm Bit1)) ==>
  (bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 (bool2w bv)))) ==>
  (birs_interpret_fun H sv = bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ) ==>

  (if bv then
     birs_symb_matchonestate (systfun (birs_branch T sv sys)) H (stfun s)
   else
     birs_symb_matchonestate (sysffun (birs_branch F sv sys)) H (sffun s)) ==>

  ((if bv then stfun s else sffun s) = s') ==>
  ((systfun (birs_branch T sv sys)) UNION
   (sysffun (birs_branch F sv sys))
   = Pi) ==>

  (birs_symb_matchonestate Pi H s')

name: birs_symb_matchstate_COND_thm
statement:
!s sys H e sv bv st sf syst sysf s' Pi.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv,BType_Imm Bit1)) ==>
  (bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 (bool2w bv)))) ==>
  (birs_interpret_fun H sv = bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate syst H st) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sysf H sf) ==>
  ((if bv then st else sf) = s') ==>
  ({syst with bsst_pcond := BExp_BinExp BIExp_And sys.bsst_pcond sv;
         sysf with
           bsst_pcond :=
             BExp_BinExp BIExp_And sys.bsst_pcond
               (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not sv)} = Pi) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_symb_matchstate_UPD_status_thm
statement:
!status s sys H s' Pi.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  ((s with bst_status := status) = s') ==>
  ({sys with bsst_status := status} = Pi) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: bir_eval_exp_BOOL_NONE_sound_thm
statement:
!s sys H e.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (option_CASE (bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ) NONE bir_dest_bool_val = NONE) ==>
  ((birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = NONE) \/
   (?sv. birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv, BType_Imm Bit8)) \/
   (?sv. birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv, BType_Imm Bit16)) \/
   (?sv. birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv, BType_Imm Bit32)) \/
   (?sv. birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv, BType_Imm Bit64)) \/
   (?sv. birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv, BType_Imm Bit128)) \/
   (?sv aty vty. birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv, BType_Mem aty vty)))

name: bir_eval_exp_BOOL_SOME_sound_thm
statement:
!s sys H e bv.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (option_CASE (bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ) NONE bir_dest_bool_val = SOME bv) ==>
  (?sv. (birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv, BType_Imm Bit1)) /\
        (bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 (bool2w bv)))) /\
        (birs_interpret_fun H sv = bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ))

name: bir_eval_exp_EXISTS_IS_NONE_sound_thm
statement:
!s sys H el.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (EXISTS IS_NONE (MAP (\e. bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ) el)
   =
   EXISTS IS_NONE (MAP (\e. birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ) el))

name: birs_exec_stmt_assert_sound_thm
statement:
!ex s s' sys Pi H.
  (bir_exec_stmt_assert ex s = s') ==>
  (birs_exec_stmt_assert ex sys = Pi) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_exec_stmt_assume_sound_thm
statement:
!ex s s' sys Pi H.
  (bir_exec_stmt_assume ex s = s') ==>
  (birs_exec_stmt_assume ex sys = Pi) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_exec_stmt_observe_sound_thm
statement:
!oid ec el obf s s' sys Pi H.
  (SND (bir_exec_stmt_observe oid ec el obf s) = s') ==>
  (birs_exec_stmt_observe oid ec el obf sys = Pi) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_exec_stmtB_sound_thm
statement:
!stmt s s' sys Pi H.
  (SND (bir_exec_stmtB stmt s) = s') ==>
  (birs_exec_stmtB stmt sys = Pi) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_eval_label_exp_SOME_sound_thm
statement:
!sys s H le ls l.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (birs_eval_label_exp le sys.bsst_environ sys.bsst_pcond = SOME ls) ==>
  (?l. l IN ls /\ bir_eval_label_exp le s.bst_environ = SOME l)

name: birs_eval_label_exp_NONE_sound_thm
statement:
!sys s H le.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (birs_eval_label_exp le sys.bsst_environ sys.bsst_pcond = NONE) ==>
  (bir_eval_label_exp le s.bst_environ = NONE)

name: birs_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label_sound_thm
statement:
!sys s H p l sys' s'.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (birs_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p sys l = sys') ==>
  (bir_exec_stmt_jmp_to_label p l s = s') ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_exec_stmt_jmp_sound_thm
statement:
!p le s s' sys Pi H.
  (bir_exec_stmt_jmp p le s = s') ==>
  (birs_exec_stmt_jmp p le sys = Pi) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_symb_matchstate_BRANCH_thm
statement:
!sys H s e sv bv.
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp e sys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv,BType_Imm Bit1)) ==>
  (bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ = SOME (BVal_Imm (Imm1 (bool2w bv)))) ==>
  (birs_interpret_fun H sv = bir_eval_exp e s.bst_environ) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate (birs_branch bv sv sys) H s)

name: birs_exec_stmt_cjmp_sound_thm
statement:
!p ex le1 le2 s s' sys Pi H.
  (bir_exec_stmt_cjmp p ex le1 le2 s = s') ==>
  (birs_exec_stmt_cjmp p ex le1 le2 sys = Pi) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: bir_prog_has_no_halt_block_thm
statement:
!blocks block.
  (bir_prog_has_no_halt (BirProgram blocks)) ==>
  (MEM block blocks) ==>
  (bir_block_has_no_halt block)

name: INDEX_FIND_IMP_MEM_thm
statement:
!i P l j x.
  (INDEX_FIND i P l = SOME (j, x)) ==>
  (MEM x l)

name: bir_prog_has_no_halt_thm
statement:
!prog l stmt.
  (bir_prog_has_no_halt prog) ==>
  (bir_get_current_statement prog l = SOME stmt) ==>
  (!estmt. stmt = BStmtE estmt ==> bir_stmtE_is_not_halt estmt)

name: birs_exec_stmtE_sound_thm
statement:
!p estmt s s' sys Pi H.
  (bir_stmtE_is_not_halt estmt) ==>
  (bir_exec_stmtE p estmt s = s') ==>
  (birs_exec_stmtE p estmt sys = Pi) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_exec_stmt_sound_thm
statement:
!p stmt s s' sys Pi H.
  (!estmt. stmt = BStmtE estmt ==> bir_stmtE_is_not_halt estmt) ==>
  (SND (bir_exec_stmt p stmt s) = s') ==>
  (birs_exec_stmt p stmt sys = Pi) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_exec_step_sound_thm
statement:
!prog s s' sys Pi H.
  (bir_prog_has_no_halt prog) ==>
  ((SND o bir_exec_step prog) s = s') ==>
  (birs_exec_step prog sys = Pi) ==>
  (birs_symb_matchstate sys H s) ==>
  (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys' H s')

name: birs_symb_step_sound_thm
statement:
!prog.
  (bir_prog_has_no_halt prog) ==>
  (symb_step_sound (bir_symb_rec_sbir prog))

name: birs_symb_expr_conj_eq_def
statement:
birs_symb_expr_conj_eq e1 e2 conj1 =
      BExp_BinExp BIExp_And
        (if option_CASE (type_of_bir_exp e1) F bir_type_is_Mem then BExp_MemEq e1 e2 else BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal e1 e2)
        conj1

name: birs_symb_env_subst_def
statement:
birs_symb_env_subst s env =
    OPTION_MAP (bir_exp_subst s) o env

name: birs_symb_subst_def
statement:
birs_symb_subst s bs =
    (bs
      with bsst_pcond := bir_exp_subst s bs.bsst_pcond)
      with bsst_environ := birs_symb_env_subst s bs.bsst_environ

name: birs_symb_env_subst1_def
statement:
birs_symb_env_subst1 v e env =
    OPTION_MAP (bir_exp_subst1 v e) o env

name: birs_symb_subst1_def
statement:
birs_symb_subst1 (v,e) bs =
    (bs
      with bsst_pcond := bir_exp_subst1 v e bs.bsst_pcond)
    with bsst_environ := birs_symb_env_subst1 v e bs.bsst_environ

name: birs_branch_def
statement:
(birs_branch T sv sys =
      sys with bsst_pcond := BExp_BinExp BIExp_And sys.bsst_pcond sv) /\
   (birs_branch F sv sys =
      sys with bsst_pcond := BExp_BinExp BIExp_And sys.bsst_pcond (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not sv))

name: bir_stmtE_is_not_halt_def
statement:
(bir_stmtE_is_not_halt (BStmt_Halt ex) = F) /\
   (bir_stmtE_is_not_halt _ = T)

name: bir_block_has_no_halt_def
statement:
bir_block_has_no_halt block =
    bir_stmtE_is_not_halt block.bb_last_statement

name: bir_prog_has_no_halt_def
statement:
(bir_prog_has_no_halt (BirProgram []) = T) /\
   (bir_prog_has_no_halt (BirProgram (h::t)) =
    ((bir_block_has_no_halt h) /\
    (bir_prog_has_no_halt (BirProgram t)))
  )

name: birs_symb_symbols_EQ_thm
statement: !prog sys. symb_symbols (bir_symb_rec_sbir prog) (birs_symb_to_symbst sys) = birs_symb_symbols sys

name: birs_interpr_welltyped_EQ_thm
statement:
!prog H.
symb_interpr_welltyped (bir_symb_rec_sbir prog) H = birs_interpr_welltyped H

name: birs_interpret_fun_EQ_thm
statement:
!prog H e vo.
((bir_symb_rec_sbir prog).sr_interpret_f H e = vo)
<=>
(birs_interpret_fun H e = vo)

name: birs_matchenv_EQ_thm
statement:
!prog H f s.
symb_interpr_symbstore (bir_symb_rec_sbir prog) H f
       (symb_concst_store (birs_symb_to_concst s)) =
  birs_matchenv H f s.bst_environ

name: birs_symb_matchstate_EQ_thm
statement:
!prog sys H s.
symb_matchstate (bir_symb_rec_sbir prog) (birs_symb_to_symbst sys) H (birs_symb_to_concst s) =
  birs_symb_matchstate sys H s

name: birs_interpret_subst_PRESERVES_type_thm
statement:
!sv H.
  (birs_interpr_welltyped H) ==>
  (type_of_bir_exp (birs_interpret_subst H sv) = type_of_bir_exp sv)

name: birs_interpret_fun_PRESERVES_type_thm
statement:
!sv H v.
  (birs_interpr_welltyped H) ==>
  (birs_interpret_fun H sv = SOME v) ==>
  (type_of_bir_exp sv = SOME (type_of_bir_val v))

name: birs_matchenv_IMP_EQ_bir_envty_includes_vs_thm
statement:
!H senv env vs.
  (birs_interpr_welltyped H) ==>
  (birs_matchenv H senv env) ==>
  (bir_envty_includes_vs (birs_envty_of_senv senv) vs
   <=>
   bir_envty_includes_vs (bir_envty_of_env env) vs)

name: birs_interpret_fun_sound_NONE_thm
statement:
!H senv env e.
  (birs_interpr_welltyped H) ==>
  (birs_matchenv H senv env) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp e senv = NONE) ==>
  (bir_eval_exp e env = NONE)

name: birs_interpret_fun_sound_thm
statement:
!H senv env e sv ty v.
  (birs_interpr_welltyped H) ==>
  (birs_matchenv H senv env) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp e senv = SOME (sv, ty)) ==>
  (?v. birs_interpret_fun H sv = SOME v /\ bir_eval_exp e env = SOME v)

name: birs_eval_exp_sound_thm
statement:
!H senv env e.
  (birs_interpr_welltyped H) ==>
  (birs_matchenv H senv env) ==>
  ((birs_eval_exp e senv = NONE /\ bir_eval_exp e env = NONE) \/
   (?sv ty v.
      birs_eval_exp e senv = SOME (sv, ty) /\ bir_eval_exp e env = SOME v /\
      birs_interpret_fun H sv = SOME v))

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_EQ_set_typeerror_thm
statement:
!sys H.
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs (birs_symb_symbols (birs_state_set_typeerror sys)) H) =
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs (birs_symb_symbols sys) H)

name: birs_symb_symbols_def
statement:
birs_symb_symbols sys =
      (BIGUNION {bir_vars_of_exp e | ?vn. sys.bsst_environ vn = SOME e}) UNION (bir_vars_of_exp sys.bsst_pcond)

name: birs_interpr_welltyped_def
statement:
birs_interpr_welltyped H =
      !sy. sy IN (symb_interpr_dom H) ==> type_of_bir_val (THE (symb_interpr_get H sy)) = bir_var_type sy

name: birs_matchenv_def
statement:
birs_matchenv H senv env =
      (!var. (bir_env_lookup var env <> NONE \/ senv var <> NONE) ==>
         ?e v.
            senv   var = SOME e /\
            bir_env_lookup var env = SOME v /\
            birs_interpret_fun H e = SOME v)

name: birs_symb_matchstate_def
statement:
birs_symb_matchstate sys H s = (
      (symb_interpr_for_symbs (birs_symb_symbols sys) H) /\
      (birs_interpr_welltyped H) /\
      (sys.bsst_pc = s.bst_pc) /\
      (birs_matchenv H sys.bsst_environ s.bst_environ) /\
      (birs_interpret_fun H sys.bsst_pcond = SOME bir_val_true) /\
      (sys.bsst_status = s.bst_status))

name: birs_symb_matchonestate_def
statement:
birs_symb_matchonestate Pi H s =
      ?sys. sys IN Pi /\ birs_symb_matchstate sys H s

name: bir_eval_exp_NONE_IMP_bir_type_of_bir_exp_thm
statement:
!env envty e.
(bir_envty_of_env env = envty) ==>
(
  (bir_eval_exp e env = NONE)
  ==>
  ((type_of_bir_exp e = NONE) \/
   (~bir_envty_includes_vs envty (bir_vars_of_exp e)))
)

name: NOT_bir_v_in_envty_env_IMP
statement:
!envty env bv vo.
  (~bir_envty_includes_v envty bv) ==>
  (bir_envty_of_env env = envty) ==>
  (bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name bv) env = vo) ==>
  (OPTION_ALL (\v. ~(type_of_bir_val v = bir_var_type bv)) vo)

name: bir_eval_exp_with_var_not_in_env_thm
statement:
!bv env vo e.
  (bv IN (bir_vars_of_exp e)) ==>
  (bir_env_lookup (bir_var_name bv) env = vo) ==>
  (OPTION_ALL (\v. ~(type_of_bir_val v = bir_var_type bv)) vo) ==>
  (bir_eval_exp e env = NONE)

name: NOT_bir_envty_includes_vs_IMP_bir_eval_exp_thm
statement:
!env envty e.
(bir_envty_of_env env = envty) ==>
(
  (~bir_envty_includes_vs envty (bir_vars_of_exp e))
  ==>
  (bir_eval_exp e env = NONE)
)

name: bir_eval_exp_NONE_EQ_bir_exp_env_type_thm
statement:
!env envty e.
(bir_envty_of_env env = envty) ==>
(
  ((type_of_bir_exp e = NONE) \/
   (~bir_envty_includes_vs envty (bir_vars_of_exp e)))
  <=>
  (bir_eval_exp e env = NONE)
)

name: bir_number_of_mem_splits_1_IMP_types_thm
statement:
!vty rty aty.
  (bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty = SOME 1) ==>
  (vty = rty)

name: bir_load_from_mem_BEnd_NoEndian_IMP_types_thm
statement:
!vty rty aty mmap en a v.
  (bir_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap en a = SOME v) ==>
  (en = BEnd_NoEndian) ==>
  (vty = rty)

name: bir_load_from_mem_NOT_BEnd_NoEndian_IMP_mem_splits_thm
statement:
!vty rty aty mmap en a v.
  (bir_load_from_mem vty rty aty mmap en a = SOME v) ==>
  (~(en = BEnd_NoEndian)) ==>
  (~(bir_number_of_mem_splits vty rty aty = NONE))

name: bir_store_in_mem_BEnd_NoEndian_IMP_types_thm
statement:
!vty aty res mmap en a v.
  (bir_store_in_mem vty aty res mmap en a = SOME v) ==>
  (en = BEnd_NoEndian) ==>
  (type_of_bir_imm res = vty)

name: bir_store_in_mem_NOT_BEnd_NoEndian_IMP_mem_splits_thm
statement:
!vty aty res mmap en a v.
  (bir_store_in_mem vty aty res mmap en a = SOME v) ==>
  (~(en = BEnd_NoEndian)) ==>
  (~(bir_number_of_mem_splits vty (type_of_bir_imm res) aty = NONE))

name: bir_eval_exp_SOME_IMP_type_of_bir_exp_thm
statement:
!env e v ty.
  ((bir_eval_exp e env) = SOME v) ==>
  (type_of_bir_val v = ty) ==>
  (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty)

name: bir_eval_exp_SOME_IMP_type_of_bir_exp_envty_incl_thm
statement:
!env envty e ty.
(bir_envty_of_env env = envty) ==>
(
  (?v. ((bir_eval_exp e env) = SOME v) /\ (type_of_bir_val v = ty))
  ==>
  ((type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty) /\
  (bir_envty_includes_vs envty (bir_vars_of_exp e)))
)

name: bir_eval_exp_SOME_EQ_bir_exp_env_type_thm
statement:
!env envty e ty.
(bir_envty_of_env env = envty) ==>
(
  (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty) /\
  (bir_envty_includes_vs envty (bir_vars_of_exp e))
  <=>
  (?v. ((bir_eval_exp e env) = SOME v) /\ (type_of_bir_val v = ty))
)

name: bir_eval_exp_SOME_EQ_bir_exp_env_type_EMPTY_thm
statement:
!env e ty.
(bir_vars_of_exp e = EMPTY) ==>
(
  (type_of_bir_exp e = SOME ty)
  <=>
  (?v. ((bir_eval_exp e env) = SOME v) /\ (type_of_bir_val v = ty))
)

name: bir_exp_subst_FUN_FMAP_bir_vars_of_exp_UNION_thm
statement:
!vs f e.
  (FINITE vs) ==>
  (bir_exp_subst (FUN_FMAP f (vs UNION bir_vars_of_exp e)) e) =
  (bir_exp_subst (FUN_FMAP f (bir_vars_of_exp e)) e)

name: bir_load_from_mem_IS_SOME_thm
statement:
!vty sz aty mmap en anum.
  (if en = BEnd_NoEndian then vty = sz
        else bir_number_of_mem_splits vty sz aty <> NONE) ==>
  (?v. bir_load_from_mem vty sz aty mmap en anum = SOME v /\ type_of_bir_imm v = sz)

name: bir_load_from_mem_IS_SOME_thm1
statement:
!vty sz aty mmap en anum.
  (if en = BEnd_NoEndian then vty = sz
        else bir_number_of_mem_splits vty sz aty <> NONE) ==>
  (?v. bir_load_from_mem vty sz aty mmap en anum = SOME v)

name: bir_store_in_mem_IS_SOME_thm
statement:
!sz vty aty v mmap en anum.
  (type_of_bir_imm v = sz) ==>
  (if en = BEnd_NoEndian then vty = sz
        else bir_number_of_mem_splits vty sz aty <> NONE) ==>
