  (?vm. bir_store_in_mem vty aty v mmap en anum = SOME vm)

name: bir_pc_set_lbls_IN_thm
statement:
!pc lbls.
    (pc IN (bir_pc_set_lbls lbls)) = (pc.bpc_label IN lbls)

name: bir_pc_set_lbls_EMPTY_thm
statement:
!pc lbls.
    bir_pc_set_lbls EMPTY = EMPTY

name: bir_pc_set_lbls_ADD_thm
statement:
!pc lbls.
    pc INSERT (bir_pc_set_lbls lbls) SUBSET
    bir_pc_set_lbls (pc.bpc_label INSERT lbls)

name: bir_pc_set_lbls_UNION_thm
statement:
!lbls1 lbls2.
    (bir_pc_set_lbls lbls1) UNION (bir_pc_set_lbls lbls2) =
    bir_pc_set_lbls (lbls1 UNION lbls2)

name: birs_symb_symbst_pc_thm
statement:
!s.
  symb_symbst_pc (birs_symb_to_symbst s) = s.bsst_pc

name: birs_symb_concst_pc_thm
statement:
!s.
  symb_concst_pc (birs_symb_to_concst s) = s.bst_pc

name: symb_symbols_set_ALT_thm
statement:
!sr Pi.
  symb_symbols_set sr Pi = (BIGUNION (IMAGE (symb_symbols sr) Pi))

name: birs_symb_symbols_set_EQ_thm
statement:
!prog Pi.
  symb_symbols_set (bir_symb_rec_sbir prog) (IMAGE birs_symb_to_symbst Pi) = BIGUNION (IMAGE birs_symb_symbols Pi)

name: birs_exps_of_senv_thm
statement:
!senv.
  birs_exps_of_senv senv
  =
  birs_exps_of_senv_COMP EMPTY senv

name: birs_exps_of_senv_COMP_thm
statement:
!sr Pi.
  (!excset. birs_exps_of_senv_COMP excset (K NONE) = EMPTY) /\
  (!excset senv vn sv. birs_exps_of_senv_COMP excset ((vn =+ (SOME sv)) senv) =
    if vn IN excset then
      birs_exps_of_senv_COMP (vn INSERT excset) senv
    else
      sv INSERT (birs_exps_of_senv_COMP (vn INSERT excset) senv)) /\
  (!excset senv vn. birs_exps_of_senv_COMP excset ((vn =+ NONE) senv) = (birs_exps_of_senv_COMP (vn INSERT excset) senv))

name: birs_symb_symbols_thm
statement:
!sys.
  birs_symb_symbols sys = (BIGUNION (IMAGE bir_vars_of_exp (birs_exps_of_senv sys.bsst_environ))) UNION (bir_vars_of_exp sys.bsst_pcond)

name: PairToBVar_BVarToPair_I_thm
statement: PairToBVar ∘ BVarToPair = I

name: bir_senv_GEN_bvar_EQ_thm
statement:
!x y.
  bir_senv_GEN_bvar x = bir_senv_GEN_bvar y <=> x = y

name: MEM_FST_IMP_MEM_thm
statement:
!vn l.
  (MEM vn (MAP FST l)) ==>
  (?ty. MEM (vn,ty) l)

name: NOT_MEM_FST_IMP_thm
statement:
!vn l.
  (~(MEM vn (MAP FST l))) ==>
  (!e. ~(MEM e l) \/ ~((\(vni,ty). vni = vn) e))

name: bir_senv_GEN_list_NOT_MEM_thm
statement:
!vn l.
  (~(MEM vn (MAP FST l))) ==>
  (bir_senv_GEN_list l vn = NONE)

name: bir_senv_GEN_list_APPLY_thm
statement:
!vn ty l.
  (MEM (vn,ty) l) ==>
  (ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST l)) ==>
  (bir_senv_GEN_list l vn = SOME (BExp_Den (bir_senv_GEN_bvar (vn,ty))))

name: bir_senv_GEN_list_vars_thm
statement:
!l.
  (ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST l)) ==>
  (BIGUNION {bir_vars_of_exp e | (?vn. (bir_senv_GEN_list l) vn = SOME e)} = set (MAP bir_senv_GEN_bvar l))

name: bir_interpr_GEN_list_NOT_MEM_thm
statement:
!vn ty l f.
  (~(MEM vn (MAP FST l))) ==>
  (bir_interpr_GEN_list l f (bir_senv_GEN_bvar (vn,ty)) = NONE)

name: bir_interpr_GEN_list_APPLY_thm
statement:
!vn ty l f.
  (MEM (vn,ty) l) ==>
  (ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST l)) ==>
  (bir_interpr_GEN_list l f (bir_senv_GEN_bvar (vn,ty)) = f vn)

name: bir_interpr_GEN_list_APPLY2_thm
statement:
!vn l f.
  (MEM vn (MAP FST l)) ==>
  (?ty. bir_interpr_GEN_list l f (bir_senv_GEN_bvar (vn,ty)) = f vn)

name: bir_interpr_GEN_list_IS_SOME_IMP_EXISTS_thm
statement:
!l f bv.
  (IS_SOME (bir_interpr_GEN_list l f bv)) ==>
  (?vn ty. bv = bir_senv_GEN_bvar (vn, ty) /\ (MEM (vn,ty) l))

name: bir_envty_list_inclusive_thm
statement:
!l env.
    bir_envty_list_inclusive l env = EVERY (bir_env_var_is_initialised (BEnv env) o PairToBVar) l

name: bir_envty_list_inclusive_thm2
statement:
!l env.
    bir_envty_list_inclusive l env = EVERY (bir_env_var_is_initialised (BEnv env)) (MAP PairToBVar l)

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_IMP_envty_list_inclusive_thm
statement:
!l f.
    (bir_env_vars_are_initialised (BEnv f) (set l)) ==>
    (bir_envty_list_inclusive (MAP BVarToPair l) f)

name: bir_env_vars_are_initialised_IMP_envty_list_inclusive_thm2
statement:
!l f.
    (bir_env_vars_are_initialised (BEnv f) (set (MAP PairToBVar l))) ==>
    (bir_envty_list_inclusive l f)

name: bir_envty_list_MEM_IMP_thm
statement:
!vn ty l f.
  (MEM (vn,ty) l) ==>
  (bir_envty_list l f) ==>
  (?v. f vn = SOME v /\ type_of_bir_val v = ty)

name: bir_envty_list_NOT_MEM_IMP_thm
statement:
!vn l f.
  (~(MEM vn (MAP FST l))) ==>
  (bir_envty_list l f) ==>
  (f vn = NONE)

name: bir_envty_list_b_thm
statement:
!l env.
  bir_envty_list_b l env = bir_envty_list l (\bvn. bir_env_lookup bvn env)

name: bir_state_restrict_vars_envty_list_b_thm
statement:
!l vs st st'.
    (ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST l)) ==>
    (set (MAP PairToBVar l) = vs) ==>
    (st' = bir_state_restrict_vars vs st) ==>
    (bir_env_vars_are_initialised st.bst_environ vs) ==>
    (bir_envty_list_b l st'.bst_environ)

name: birs_matchenv_bir_senv_GEN_thm
statement:
!l f.
  (bir_envty_list l f) ==>
  (birs_matchenv (SymbInterpret (bir_interpr_GEN_list l f))
          (bir_senv_GEN_list l) (BEnv f))

name: symb_interpr_dom_bir_interpr_GEN_list_thm
statement:
!l f.
  (bir_envty_list l f) ==>
  (symb_interpr_dom (SymbInterpret (bir_interpr_GEN_list l f))
   =
   set (MAP bir_senv_GEN_bvar l))

name: birs_interpr_welltyped_bir_interpr_GEN_list_thm
statement:
!l f.
  (bir_envty_list l f) ==>
  (birs_interpr_welltyped (SymbInterpret (bir_interpr_GEN_list l f)))

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_bir_interpr_GEN_list_thm
statement:
!l f lbl status bpre_sv.
  (bir_envty_list l f) ==>
  (bir_vars_of_exp bpre_sv SUBSET (set (MAP bir_senv_GEN_bvar l))) ==>
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs
          (birs_symb_symbols
             <|bsst_pc := lbl; bsst_environ := bir_senv_GEN_list l;
               bsst_status := status; bsst_pcond := bpre_sv|>)
          (SymbInterpret (bir_interpr_GEN_list l f)))

name: bir_envty_list_IMP_birs_eval_exp_vars_thm
statement:
!l bpre bpre_sv ty.
  (ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST l)) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp bpre (bir_senv_GEN_list l) = SOME (bpre_sv,ty)) ==>
  (bir_vars_of_exp bpre_sv SUBSET set (MAP bir_senv_GEN_bvar l))

name: bir_envty_list_IMP_birs_eval_exp_interpret_thm
statement:
!l f e v sv ty.
  (bir_envty_list l f) ==>
  (bir_eval_exp e (BEnv f) = SOME v ) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp e (bir_senv_GEN_list l) = SOME (sv,ty)) ==>
  (birs_interpret_fun (SymbInterpret (bir_interpr_GEN_list l f)) sv = SOME v )

name: bprog_P_entails_gen_thm
statement:
!lbl status l f bpre bpre_sv ty.
  (bir_envty_list l f) ==>
  (bir_eval_exp bpre (BEnv f) = SOME bir_val_true) ==>
  (birs_eval_exp bpre (bir_senv_GEN_list l) = SOME (bpre_sv,ty)) ==>
  (?H. birs_symb_matchstate
              <|bsst_pc := lbl;
                bsst_environ := bir_senv_GEN_list l;
                bsst_status := status;
                bsst_pcond := bpre_sv |>
              H
              (bir_state_t
                 lbl
                 (BEnv f)
                 status)
  )

name: bir_BEnv_lookup_EQ_thm
statement:
!env.
  BEnv (λbvn. bir_env_lookup bvn env) = env

name: birs_gen_env_NULL_thm
statement:
!n sv l.
    birs_gen_env ([]) = (K NONE)

name: birs_gen_env_thm
statement:
!n sv l.
    birs_gen_env ((n, sv)::l) = (n =+ (SOME sv)) (birs_gen_env l)

name: birs_gen_env_FILTER_EQ_thm
statement:
!vn l.
    birs_gen_env (FILTER (\x. FST x <> vn) l) vn = NONE

name: birs_gen_env_FILTER_NEQ_thm
statement:
!vn vn' l.
    (vn <> vn') ==>
    (birs_gen_env (FILTER (\x. FST x <> vn') l) vn = birs_gen_env l vn)

name: birs_update_env_thm
statement:
!n sv l.
    birs_update_env (n, sv) (birs_gen_env l) = birs_gen_env((n, sv)::(FILTER (\x. (FST x) <> n) l))

name: birs_gen_env_GET_NULL_thm
statement:
!m.
    birs_gen_env [] m = NONE

name: birs_gen_env_GET_thm
statement:
!n sv l m.
    birs_gen_env ((n, sv)::l) m = if n = m then SOME sv else birs_gen_env l m

name: birs_env_vars_are_initialised_SUBSET_thm
statement:
!senv symbs vs.
    birs_env_vars_are_initialised senv symbs vs <=>
    (vs SUBSET (birs_env_var_is_initialised senv symbs))

name: birs_env_vars_are_initialised_EMPTY_thm
statement:
!senv symbs.
    (birs_env_vars_are_initialised senv symbs EMPTY)

name: birs_env_vars_are_initialised_INSERT_thm
statement:
!v vs senv symbs.
   birs_env_vars_are_initialised senv symbs (v INSERT vs) <=>
     birs_env_var_is_initialised senv symbs v /\
     birs_env_vars_are_initialised senv symbs vs

name: birs_env_var_is_initialised_gen_env_EMPTY_thm
statement:
!symbs.
    birs_env_var_is_initialised (birs_gen_env ([])) symbs = EMPTY

name: birs_env_var_is_initialised_gen_env_INSERT_thm0
statement:
!l symbs var.
    birs_env_var_is_initialised (birs_gen_env (l)) symbs var =
    if l = [] then F else
    if FST (HD l) = bir_var_name var then
      IS_SOME (type_of_bir_exp (SND (HD l))) /\
      (type_of_bir_exp (SND (HD l)) = SOME (bir_var_type var)) /\
      bir_vars_of_exp (SND (HD l)) SUBSET symbs
    else
      (birs_env_var_is_initialised (birs_gen_env  (TL l)) symbs var)

name: birs_env_var_is_initialised_gen_env_INSERT_thm
statement:
!vn se l symbs.
    birs_env_var_is_initialised (birs_gen_env ((vn,se)::l)) symbs =
    (option_CASE (type_of_bir_exp se)
       EMPTY
       (\ty. (if bir_vars_of_exp se SUBSET symbs then
             {BVar vn ty} else {}))) UNION
     (birs_env_var_is_initialised (birs_gen_env (FILTER (\x. (FST x) <> vn) l)) symbs)

name: birs_symb_env_subst1_gen_env_thm
statement:
!v e l.
    birs_symb_env_subst1 v e (birs_gen_env l) =
      birs_gen_env (MAP (\x. (FST x, bir_exp_subst1 v e (SND x))) l)

name: bir_pc_set_lbls_def
statement:
bir_pc_set_lbls lbls pc = 
    (pc.bpc_label IN lbls)

name: birs_exps_of_senv_def
statement:
birs_exps_of_senv senv =
      {e | (?vn. senv vn = SOME e)}

name: birs_exps_of_senv_COMP_def
statement:
birs_exps_of_senv_COMP excset senv =
      {e | (?vn. (~(vn IN excset)) /\ senv vn = SOME e)}

name: BVarToPair_def
statement: BVarToPair (BVar bvn bty) = (bvn, bty)

name: PairToBVar_def
statement: PairToBVar (bvn, bty) = (BVar bvn bty)

name: bir_senv_GEN_bvar_def
statement: bir_senv_GEN_bvar (vn,ty) = BVar (CONCAT["sy_";vn]) ty

name: bir_senv_GEN_list_def
statement: bir_senv_GEN_list l = FOLDR (\(vn,ty). \f. (vn =+ SOME (BExp_Den (bir_senv_GEN_bvar (vn,ty)))) f) (K NONE) l

name: bir_interpr_GEN_list_def
statement: bir_interpr_GEN_list l envf = FOLDR (\(vn,ty). \f. ((bir_senv_GEN_bvar (vn,ty)) =+ envf vn) f) (K NONE) l

name: bir_envty_list_inclusive_def
statement: bir_envty_list_inclusive l env = EVERY (\(vn,ty). ?v. env vn = SOME v /\ type_of_bir_val v = ty) l

name: bir_envty_list_exclusive_def
statement: bir_envty_list_exclusive l env = (!vn. (~(EXISTS (\(vni,ty). vni = vn) l)) ==> (env vn = NONE))

name: bir_envty_list_def
statement: bir_envty_list l env = (ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST l) /\ bir_envty_list_inclusive l env /\ bir_envty_list_exclusive l env)

name: bir_envty_list_b_def
statement: bir_envty_list_b l (BEnv env) = bir_envty_list l env

name: birs_gen_env_fun_def
statement: birs_gen_env_fun (n, sv) env = (n =+ (SOME sv)) env

name: birs_gen_env_def
statement: birs_gen_env l = FOLDR birs_gen_env_fun (K NONE) l

name: birs_env_var_is_initialised_def
statement:
birs_env_var_is_initialised senv symbs var <=>
  (?se. (senv (bir_var_name var) = SOME se) /\
       (type_of_bir_exp se = SOME (bir_var_type var)) /\
       (bir_vars_of_exp se SUBSET symbs))

name: birs_env_vars_are_initialised_def
statement:
birs_env_vars_are_initialised senv symbs vs <=>
  (!v. v IN vs ==> birs_env_var_is_initialised senv symbs v)

name: INSERT_SING_DIFF_ALT_thm
statement:
!A B C.
     ((A INSERT C) DIFF {A}) UNION {B} = B INSERT (C DELETE A)

name: birs_pcondinf_thm
statement:
!bprog pcond.
  birs_pcondinf pcond ==>
  symb_pcondinf (bir_symb_rec_sbir bprog) pcond

name: birs_pcondwiden_thm
statement:
!bprog pcond pcond'.
  symb_pcondwiden (bir_symb_rec_sbir bprog) pcond pcond' <=>
  birs_pcondwiden pcond pcond'

name: birs_symb_exec_SUBSET_Pi_thm
statement:
!p bs L Pi Pi'.
    (birs_symb_exec p (bs, L, Pi)) ==>
    (Pi SUBSET Pi') ==>
    (birs_symb_exec p (bs, L, Pi'))

name: birs_symb_exec_SUBSET_L_thm
statement:
!p bs L Pi L'.
    (birs_symb_exec p (bs, L, Pi)) ==>
    (L SUBSET L') ==>
    (birs_symb_exec p (bs, L', Pi))

name: birs_symb_exec_INSERT_DELETE_thm
statement:
!prog bs L A B C.
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, A INSERT (B DELETE C)) ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, A INSERT B)

name: birs_symb_symbols_set_EQ_thm2
statement: !prog Pi. symb_symbols_set (bir_symb_rec_sbir prog) (IMAGE birs_symb_to_symbst Pi) = birs_symb_symbols_set Pi

name: birs_freesymbs_thm
statement:
birs_freesymbs bs sbs =
      ((BIGUNION (IMAGE birs_symb_symbols sbs)) DIFF (birs_symb_symbols bs))

name: birs_freesymbs_EQ_thm
statement:
!prog L bs sbs.
  birs_freesymbs bs sbs = symb_freesymbs (bir_symb_rec_sbir prog) (birs_symb_to_symbst bs, L, IMAGE birs_symb_to_symbst sbs)

name: bir_conj_true
statement:
!A B.
      (bir_eval_bin_exp BIExp_And (A) (B) = SOME bir_val_true) ==>
      (A = SOME bir_val_true /\
       B = SOME bir_val_true)

name: birs_pcondwiden_AND_thm
statement:
!pre cond.
  birs_pcondwiden (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And pre cond) pre

name: assert_spec_thm
branch_prune1_spec_thm
branch_prune2_spec_thm
birs_symb_pcondwiden_sys_thm
statement:
!prog bs bs'.
    symb_pcondwiden_sys (bir_symb_rec_sbir prog) (birs_symb_to_symbst bs) (birs_symb_to_symbst bs') =
    birs_symb_pcondwiden_sys bs bs'

name: birs_rule_WIDEN_thm
statement:
!prog L bs bs2 bs2' Pi.
    birs_symb_pcondwiden_sys bs2 bs2' ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, bs2 INSERT Pi) ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, bs2' INSERT Pi)

name: birs_rule_WIDEN_spec_thm
birs_rule_NARROW_thm
statement:
!prog L bs1 bs1' Pi.
    birs_symb_pcondwiden_sys bs1 bs1' ==>
    birs_symb_symbols bs1 INTER birs_freesymbs bs1' Pi = EMPTY ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs1', L, Pi) ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs1, L, Pi)

name: birs_rule_NARROW_spec_thm
birs_rule_RENAME1_thm
statement:
!prog L bs Pi alpha alpha'.
    bir_var_type alpha = bir_var_type alpha' ==>
    alpha' NOTIN (birs_symb_symbols bs UNION birs_symb_symbols_set Pi) ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, Pi) ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (birs_symb_subst1 (alpha, BExp_Den alpha') bs, L, IMAGE (birs_symb_subst1 (alpha, BExp_Den alpha')) Pi)

name: birs_rule_RENAME1_spec_thm
statement:
!prog L bs Pi alpha alpha'.
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, Pi) ==>
    bir_var_type alpha = bir_var_type alpha' ==>
    alpha' NOTIN birs_symb_symbols bs ==>
    alpha' NOTIN birs_symb_symbols_set Pi ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (birs_symb_subst1 (alpha, BExp_Den alpha') bs, L, IMAGE (birs_symb_subst1 (alpha, BExp_Den alpha')) Pi)

name: birs_rule_RENAME1_FREE_thm
statement:
!prog L bs bs2 Pi alpha alpha'.
    bir_var_type alpha = bir_var_type alpha' ==>
    alpha NOTIN (birs_symb_symbols bs) ==>
    alpha' NOTIN (birs_symb_symbols bs2) ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, bs2 INSERT Pi) ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, (birs_symb_subst1 (alpha, BExp_Den alpha') bs2) INSERT Pi)

name: birs_rule_RENAME1_FREE_spec_thm
statement:
!prog L bs bs2 Pi alpha alpha'.
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, bs2 INSERT Pi) ==>
    bir_var_type alpha = bir_var_type alpha' ==>
    alpha NOTIN birs_symb_symbols bs ==>
    alpha' NOTIN birs_symb_symbols bs2 ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, (birs_symb_subst1 (alpha, BExp_Den alpha') bs2) INSERT Pi)

name: birs_rule_INST1_thm
statement:
!prog L bs Pi alpha bexp.
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, Pi) ==>
    type_of_bir_exp bexp = SOME (bir_var_type alpha) ==>
    alpha IN birs_symb_symbols bs ==>
    bir_vars_of_exp bexp INTER birs_freesymbs bs Pi = EMPTY ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (birs_symb_subst1 (alpha, bexp) bs, L, IMAGE (birs_symb_subst1 (alpha, bexp)) Pi)

name: birs_rule_FREESYMB_INTRO_thm
statement:
!prog L bs bs2 bs2' Pi alpha bexp vn symbexp symbexp' pcond'.
    bir_type_is_Imm (bir_var_type alpha) ==>
    bs2.bsst_environ vn = SOME symbexp ==>
    (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And (BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal (BExp_Den alpha) bexp)) bs2.bsst_pcond = pcond' ==>
    alpha NOTIN birs_symb_symbols bs ==>
    alpha NOTIN birs_symb_symbols bs2 ==>
    bir_vars_of_exp bexp SUBSET birs_symb_symbols bs2 ==>
    type_of_bir_exp bexp = SOME (bir_var_type alpha) ==>
    birs_simplification pcond' symbexp symbexp' ==>
    ((bs2 with bsst_pcond := pcond') with bsst_environ := birs_update_env (vn,symbexp') bs2.bsst_environ) = bs2' ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, bs2 INSERT Pi) ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, bs2' INSERT Pi)

name: birs_rule_FREESYMB_INTRO_thm2
statement:
!prog bs L bs2 Pi bs2' alpha bexp vn symbexp symbexp' pcond'.
    pcond' = (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And (BExp_BinPred BIExp_Equal (BExp_Den alpha) bexp)) bs2.bsst_pcond ==>
    (bs2' =
     <|bsst_pc := bs2.bsst_pc;
       bsst_environ := birs_update_env (vn,symbexp') bs2.bsst_environ;
       bsst_status := bs2.bsst_status;
       bsst_pcond := pcond'|>) ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, bs2 INSERT Pi) ==>
    type_of_bir_exp bexp = SOME (bir_var_type alpha) ==>
    bir_type_is_Imm (bir_var_type alpha) ==>
    bs2.bsst_environ vn = SOME symbexp ==>
    alpha NOTIN birs_symb_symbols bs ==>
    alpha NOTIN birs_symb_symbols bs2 ==>
    bir_vars_of_exp bexp SUBSET birs_symb_symbols bs2 ==>
    birs_simplification pcond' symbexp symbexp' ==>
    birs_symb_exec prog (bs, L, bs2' INSERT Pi)

name: symb_rule_SUBST_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys L sys2 var symbexp symbexp' Pi.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>
  (symb_ARB_val_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L, sys2 INSERT Pi)) ==>
  ((symb_symbst_store sys2) var = SOME symbexp) ==>

  (symb_simplification sr (symb_symbst_pcond sys2) symbexp symbexp') ==>

  (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L, (symb_symbst_store_update var symbexp' sys2) INSERT (Pi DELETE sys2)))

name: symb_rule_SUBST_SING_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys L sys2 var symbexp symbexp'.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>
  (symb_ARB_val_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L, {sys2})) ==>
  ((symb_symbst_store sys2) var = SOME symbexp) ==>

  (symb_simplification sr (symb_symbst_pcond sys2) symbexp symbexp') ==>

  (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L, {symb_symbst_store_update var symbexp' sys2}))

name: birs_symb_to_symbst_IMAGE_DELETE_thm
statement:
!x s.
  IMAGE birs_symb_to_symbst s DELETE birs_symb_to_symbst x =
  IMAGE birs_symb_to_symbst (s DELETE x)

name: birs_rule_SUBST_thm1
birs_rule_SUBST_thm
birs_rule_SUBST_spec_thm
birs_rule_STEP_gen1_thm
statement:
!prog sys.
  (bir_prog_has_no_halt prog) ==>

  (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound (bir_symb_rec_sbir prog)
    (sys,
     {symb_symbst_pc sys},
     IMAGE birs_symb_to_symbst
       (birs_exec_step prog (birs_symb_from_symbst sys))))

name: birs_rule_STEP_gen2_thm
statement:
!prog bsys.
  (bir_prog_has_no_halt prog) ==>

  (birs_symb_exec prog
    (bsys,
     {bsys.bsst_pc},
     (birs_exec_step prog bsys)))

name: birs_rule_STEP_gen3_thm
statement:
!prog bsys.
  (bir_prog_has_no_halt prog) ==>

  (birs_symb_exec prog
    (bsys,
     bir_pc_set_lbls {bsys.bsst_pc.bpc_label},
     (birs_exec_step prog bsys)))

name: birs_rule_SEQ_gen_thm
statement:
!prog bsys_A L_A bPi_A bsys_B L_B bPi_B.
  (birs_symb_exec prog (bsys_A, L_A, bPi_A)) ==>
  (birs_symb_exec prog (bsys_B, L_B, bPi_B)) ==>

  ((birs_symb_symbols bsys_A) INTER (birs_freesymbs bsys_B bPi_B) = EMPTY) ==>

  (birs_symb_exec prog (bsys_A, L_A UNION L_B, (bPi_A DIFF {bsys_B}) UNION bPi_B))

name: birs_rule_SEQ_gen2_thm
statement:
!prog bsys_A L_A bPi_A bsys_B L_B bPi_B.
  (birs_symb_exec prog (bsys_A, L_A, bsys_B INSERT bPi_A)) ==>
  (birs_symb_exec prog (bsys_B, L_B, bPi_B)) ==>

  ((birs_symb_symbols bsys_A) INTER (birs_freesymbs bsys_B bPi_B) = EMPTY) ==>

  (birs_symb_exec prog (bsys_A, L_A UNION L_B, bPi_A UNION bPi_B))

name: birs_freesymbs_SING_EMPTY_SUFFICIENT_thm
statement:
!bs1 bs2.
  (bs1.bsst_environ = bs2.bsst_environ /\
   bs1.bsst_pcond   = bs2.bsst_pcond) ==>
  (birs_freesymbs_SING_EMPTY bs1 bs2)

name: birs_freesymbs_SING_EMPTY_SUFFICIENT2_thm
statement:
!bs1 bs2 bs2'.
  (birs_freesymbs_SING_EMPTY bs1 bs2 /\
   bs2.bsst_environ = bs2'.bsst_environ /\
   bs2.bsst_pcond   = bs2'.bsst_pcond) ==>
  (birs_freesymbs_SING_EMPTY bs1 bs2')

name: SUBSET_of_DIFF_2_thm
statement:
!s t v.
    s SUBSET t ==>
    ((v DIFF t) SUBSET (v DIFF s))

name: birs_freesymbs_SING_EMPTY_SUFFICIENT3_thm
statement:
!bs1 bs1' bs2.
  (birs_freesymbs_SING_EMPTY bs1 bs2 /\
   (birs_symb_symbols bs1) SUBSET (birs_symb_symbols bs1')) ==>
  (birs_freesymbs_SING_EMPTY bs1' bs2)

name: BIGUNION_IMAGE_DIFF_EQ_thm
statement:
!f s1 s2s.
  ((BIGUNION (IMAGE f s2s)) DIFF s1 = BIGUNION (IMAGE (\s2. (f s2) DIFF s1) s2s))

name: birs_freesymbs_thm2
statement:
!bs sbs.
  (birs_freesymbs bs sbs = BIGUNION (IMAGE (\bs2. birs_freesymbs_SING bs bs2) sbs))

name: birs_freesymbs_EMPTY_thm
statement:
!bs sbs.
  (birs_freesymbs_EMPTY bs sbs =
   !bs2. bs2 IN sbs ==> (birs_freesymbs_SING_EMPTY bs bs2))

name: birs_eval_exp_IMP_symb_symbols_EQ_pcond_thm
statement:
!bsys be sv ty pcond'.
  (birs_eval_exp be bsys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv,ty) /\
   bir_vars_of_exp pcond' = bir_vars_of_exp bsys.bsst_pcond UNION bir_vars_of_exp sv) ==>
  (birs_symb_symbols bsys =
   birs_symb_symbols (bsys with bsst_pcond := pcond'))

name: birs_eval_exp_IMP_symb_symbols_EQ_pcond_status_thm
statement:
!bsys be sv ty pcond' status'.
  (birs_eval_exp be bsys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv,ty) /\
   bir_vars_of_exp pcond' = bir_vars_of_exp bsys.bsst_pcond UNION bir_vars_of_exp sv) ==>
  (birs_symb_symbols bsys =
   birs_symb_symbols (bsys with <|bsst_status := status'; bsst_pcond := pcond'|>))

name: birs_eval_exp_IMP_symbs_SUBSET_senv_thm
statement:
!e senv sv ty.
       birs_eval_exp e senv = SOME (sv,ty) ==>
       bir_vars_of_exp sv SUBSET birs_vars_of_env senv

name: birs_eval_exp_IMP_vars_of_env_SUBSET_thm
statement:
!env be sv ty vn.
  (birs_eval_exp be env = SOME (sv,ty)) ==>
  (birs_vars_of_env (birs_update_env (vn,sv) env) SUBSET (birs_vars_of_env env))

name: birs_eval_exp_IMP_symb_symbols_SUBSET_environ_thm
statement:
!bsys be sv ty vn.
  (birs_eval_exp be bsys.bsst_environ = SOME (sv,ty)) ==>
  (birs_symb_symbols (bsys with bsst_environ := birs_update_env (vn,sv) bsys.bsst_environ) SUBSET
   birs_symb_symbols bsys)

name: birs_exec_stmt_jmp_NO_FRESH_SYMBS
statement:
!prog bsys l.
  birs_freesymbs_EMPTY bsys (birs_exec_stmt_jmp prog l bsys)

name: birs_exec_stmt_cjmp_NO_FRESH_SYMBS
statement:
!prog bsys e l1 l2.
  birs_freesymbs_EMPTY bsys (birs_exec_stmt_cjmp prog e l1 l2 bsys)

name: birs_exec_stmtE_NO_FRESH_SYMBS
statement:
!prog bsys estmt.
  birs_freesymbs_EMPTY bsys (birs_exec_stmtE prog estmt bsys)

name: birs_exec_stmt_assign_NO_FRESH_SYMBS
statement:
!bsys var be.
  birs_freesymbs_EMPTY bsys (birs_exec_stmt_assign var be bsys)

name: birs_exec_stmt_assert_assume_NO_FRESH_SYMBS
statement:
!bsys be.
  birs_freesymbs_EMPTY bsys (birs_exec_stmt_assert be bsys) /\
  birs_freesymbs_EMPTY bsys (birs_exec_stmt_assume be bsys)

name: birs_exec_stmtB_NO_FRESH_SYMBS
statement:
!bsys stmt.
  birs_freesymbs_EMPTY bsys (birs_exec_stmtB stmt bsys)

name: birs_exec_step_NO_FRESH_SYMBS
statement:
!prog bsys.




  birs_freesymbs_EMPTY bsys (birs_exec_step prog bsys)

name: birs_rule_STEP_SEQ_gen_thm
statement:
!prog bs1 L bs2.
  (bir_prog_has_no_halt prog) ==>

  (birs_symb_exec prog
    (bs1,
     L,
     {bs2}
  )) ==>

  (birs_symb_exec prog
    (bs1,
     (bs2.bsst_pc) INSERT L,
     (birs_exec_step prog bs2)
  ))

name: birs_rule_STEP_SEQ_gen2_thm
statement:
!prog bs1 L bs2.
  (bir_prog_has_no_halt prog) ==>

  (birs_symb_exec prog
    (bs1,
     bir_pc_set_lbls L,
     {bs2}
  )) ==>

  (birs_symb_exec prog
    (bs1,
     bir_pc_set_lbls ((bs2.bsst_pc.bpc_label) INSERT L),
     (birs_exec_step prog bs2)
  ))

name: birs_jumptarget_singletonconst_thm
statement:
!pcond vaex iv.
  (!i. birs_interpret_fun i vaex = SOME (BVal_Imm iv)) ==>
  (?i. birs_interpret_fun i pcond = SOME bir_val_true) ==>
  (birs_symbval_concretizations pcond vaex = {BL_Address iv})

name: birs_jumptarget_empty_thm
statement:
!pcond vaex iv.
  (!i. birs_interpret_fun i pcond = SOME bir_val_false) ==>
  (birs_symbval_concretizations pcond vaex = EMPTY)

name: birs_pcondinf_def
statement:
birs_pcondinf pcond =
  (!H.
    (birs_interpr_welltyped H) ==>
    (symb_interpr_for_symbs (bir_vars_of_exp pcond) H) ==>
    (birs_interpret_fun H pcond = SOME bir_val_false)
  )

name: birs_pcondwiden_def
statement:
birs_pcondwiden pcond pcond' =
    (!H.
      (birs_interpr_welltyped H) ==>
      (symb_interpr_for_symbs ((bir_vars_of_exp pcond) UNION (bir_vars_of_exp pcond')) H) ==>
      (birs_interpret_fun H pcond = SOME bir_val_true) ==>
      (birs_interpret_fun H pcond' = SOME bir_val_true))

name: birs_symb_exec_def
statement:
birs_symb_exec p (bs, L, bP) =
      (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound (bir_symb_rec_sbir p) (birs_symb_to_symbst bs, L, IMAGE birs_symb_to_symbst bP))

name: birs_symb_symbols_set_def
statement:
birs_symb_symbols_set Pi =
      BIGUNION (IMAGE birs_symb_symbols Pi)

name: birs_freesymbs_def
statement:
birs_freesymbs bs sbs =
      ((birs_symb_symbols_set sbs) DIFF (birs_symb_symbols bs))

name: birs_symb_pcondwiden_sys_def
statement:
birs_symb_pcondwiden_sys bs bs' =
    (
      bs.bsst_status = bs'.bsst_status /\
      bs.bsst_pc = bs'.bsst_pc /\
      bs.bsst_environ = bs'.bsst_environ /\
      birs_exp_imp bs.bsst_pcond bs'.bsst_pcond
    )

name: birs_freesymbs_SING_def
statement:
birs_freesymbs_SING bs1 bs2 =
      ((birs_symb_symbols bs2) DIFF (birs_symb_symbols bs1))

name: birs_freesymbs_EMPTY_def
statement:
birs_freesymbs_EMPTY bs sbs =
      (birs_freesymbs bs sbs = EMPTY)

name: birs_freesymbs_SING_EMPTY_def
statement:
birs_freesymbs_SING_EMPTY bs1 bs2 =
      (birs_freesymbs_SING bs1 bs2 = EMPTY)

name: birs_vars_of_env_def
statement:
birs_vars_of_env senv =
      BIGUNION {bir_vars_of_exp e | (?vn. senv vn = SOME e)}

name: SUBSET_of_DIFF_thm
statement:
!s t v.
    s SUBSET t ==>
    ((s DIFF v) SUBSET (t DIFF v))

name: FUNPOW_OPT_SOME_thm
statement:
!f g.
   (!y. f y = SOME (g y)) ==>
   (!n x.
      (FUNPOW_OPT f n x = SOME (FUNPOW g n x)))

name: symb_interpr_get_CASES_thm
statement:
!H symb.
  (?v. symb_interpr_get H symb = SOME v) \/
  (symb_interpr_get H symb = NONE)

name: symb_interpr_get_update_id_thm
statement: !H symb vo. symb_interpr_get (symb_interpr_update H (symb, vo)) symb = vo

name: symb_interpr_get_update_thm
statement:
!H symb symb' vo. symb_interpr_get (symb_interpr_update H (symb', vo)) symb =
if symb = symb' then vo else symb_interpr_get H symb

name: symb_interpr_dom_IMP_get_CASES_thm
statement:
!H symb.
  (symb IN symb_interpr_dom H ==> ?v. symb_interpr_get H symb = SOME v) /\
  ((~(symb IN symb_interpr_dom H)) ==> symb_interpr_get H symb = NONE)

name: symb_interpr_dom_thm
statement:
!H symb.
  (symb IN symb_interpr_dom H) = (symb_interpr_get H symb <> NONE)

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_EQ_thm
statement:
!H1 H2.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 (UNIV)) <=>
  (H1 = H2)

name: symb_interpr_EQ_thm
statement:
!H1 H2.
  (H1 = H2) <=>
  (!symb. symb_interpr_get H1 symb = symb_interpr_get H2 symb)

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_ID_thm
statement:
!H symbs.
  symb_interprs_eq_for H H symbs

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_COMM_thm
statement:
!H1 H2 symbs.
  symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 symbs =
  symb_interprs_eq_for H2 H1 symbs

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_SUBSET_thm
statement:
!H1 H2 symbs symbs_sub.
  (symbs_sub SUBSET symbs) ==>
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 symbs) ==>
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 symbs_sub)

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_UNION_thm
statement:
!H1 H2 symbs1 symbs2.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 (symbs1 UNION symbs2)) <=>
  ((symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 symbs1) /\
   (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 symbs2))

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER_symbs_thm
statement:
!H1 H2 H3 symbs1 symbs3.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H2 H1 symbs1) ==>
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H2 H3 symbs3) ==>
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H3 (symbs1 INTER symbs3))

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER_symbs_thm2
statement:
!H1 H2 symbs1 symbs2.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 symbs1) ==>
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 (symbs1 INTER symbs2))

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_TRANS_thm
statement:
!H1 H2 H3 symbs.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 symbs) ==>
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H2 H3 symbs) ==>
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H3 symbs)

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_IMP_dom_thm
statement:
!H1 H2 symbs.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 symbs) ==>
  (symbs SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H1) ==>
  (symbs SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H2)

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_UPDATE_dom_thm
statement:
!H symb vo.
  symb_interprs_eq_for (symb_interpr_update H (symb, vo)) H ((symb_interpr_dom H) DELETE symb)

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_update_thm
statement:
!H1 H2 symb vo symbs.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for (symb_interpr_update H1 (symb, vo)) H2 (symbs DELETE symb)) =
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 (symbs DELETE symb))

name: symb_interpr_ext_thm
statement:
!H1 H2.
  symb_interpr_ext H1 H2 =
    (!symb. (symb_interpr_get H2 symb <> NONE) ==> (symb_interpr_get H1 symb = symb_interpr_get H2 symb))

name: symb_interpr_ext_IMP_dom_thm
statement:
!H1 H2.
  (symb_interpr_ext H1 H2) ==>
  ((symb_interpr_dom H2) SUBSET (symb_interpr_dom H1))

name: symb_interpr_ext_id_thm
statement: !H. symb_interpr_ext H H

name: symb_interpr_ext_TRANS_thm
statement:
!H H' H''.
  (symb_interpr_ext H  H' ) ==>
  (symb_interpr_ext H' H'') ==>
  (symb_interpr_ext H  H'' )

name: symb_interpr_ext_UPDATE_thm
statement:
!H symb vo.
  (~(symb IN symb_interpr_dom H)) ==>
  (symb_interpr_ext (symb_interpr_update H (symb, vo)) H)

name: symb_interpr_ext_symb_NONE_thm
statement:
!H symb.
  symb_interpr_ext H (symb_interpr_update H (symb, NONE))

name: symb_interpr_dom_UPDATE_NONE_thm
statement:
!H symb.
  symb_interpr_dom (symb_interpr_update H (symb, NONE))
  = (symb_interpr_dom H) DELETE symb

name: symb_interpr_dom_UPDATE_SOME_thm
statement:
!H symb vo.
  symb_interpr_dom (symb_interpr_update H (symb, SOME vo))
  = symb INSERT (symb_interpr_dom H)

name: symb_interpr_ext_IMP_eq_for_thm
statement:
!H1 H2 symbs.
  (symb_interpr_ext H2 H1) ==>
  (symbs SUBSET (symb_interpr_dom H1)) ==>
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 symbs)

name: symb_interpr_ext_IMP_eq_for_SING_thm
statement:
!H1 H2 symb.
  (symb_interpr_ext H2 H1) ==>
  (symb IN (symb_interpr_dom H1)) ==>
  (symb_interpr_get H1 symb = symb_interpr_get H2 symb)

name: symb_interpr_ext_IMP_eq_for_SING_thm2
statement:
!H1 H2 symb v.
  (symb_interpr_ext H2 H1) ==>
  (symb_interpr_get H1 symb = SOME v) ==>
  (symb_interpr_get H1 symb = symb_interpr_get H2 symb)

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_thm
statement:
!symbs H.
    symb_interpr_for_symbs symbs H =
    (!symb. (symb IN symbs) ==> (symb_interpr_get H symb <> NONE))

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_min_thm0
statement:
!symbs H.
    symb_interpr_for_symbs_min symbs H =
    ((symb_interpr_for_symbs symbs H) /\
     (!symb. (symb_interpr_get H symb <> NONE) ==> (symb IN symbs)))

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_min_thm
statement:
!symbs H.
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs_min symbs H) =
  (!symb. (symb IN symbs) = (symb_interpr_get H symb <> NONE))

name: symb_interpr_restr_IS_eq_for_thm
statement:
!H symbs.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H (symb_interpr_restr symbs H) symbs)

name: symb_interpr_restr_dom_thm
statement:
!H symbs.
  (symb_interpr_dom (symb_interpr_restr symbs H) = symb_interpr_dom H INTER symbs)

name: symb_interpr_restr_ext_thm
statement:
!H symbs.
  (symb_interpr_ext H (symb_interpr_restr symbs H))

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_IMP_restr_thm
statement:
!H symbs.
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs symbs H) ==>
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs symbs (symb_interpr_restr symbs H))

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_TO_min_thm
statement:
!H H' symbs.
  (H' = symb_interpr_restr symbs H) ==>

  (symb_interpr_for_symbs symbs H) ==>

  ((symb_interpr_for_symbs_min symbs H') /\
   (symb_interpr_ext H H'))

name: symb_interpr_restr_thm
statement:
!H H' symbs symbs'.
  (H' = symb_interpr_restr  symbs' H) ==>
  (symbs SUBSET symbs') ==>

  (!symb. (symb IN symbs) ==> (symb_interpr_get H symb = symb_interpr_get H' symb))

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_min_REMOVE_NOT_min_thm
statement:
!H H' symb symbs s.
  (symb IN (symb_interpr_dom H)) ==>
  (H' = symb_interpr_update H (symb, NONE)) ==>

  (symb_interpr_for_symbs_min symbs H) ==>
  (~(symb_interpr_for_symbs_min symbs H'))

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER_COMM_thm
statement:
!H1 H2.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER H1 H2) =
  (symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER H2 H1)

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER_TRANS_thm
statement:
!H1 H2 H3.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER H1 H2) ==>
  (symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER H2 H3) ==>
  ((symb_interpr_dom H1) INTER ((symb_interpr_dom H3) DIFF (symb_interpr_dom H2)) = EMPTY) ==>
  (symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER H1 H3)

name: symb_interpr_ext_IMP_interprs_eq_for_INTER_thm
statement:
!H1 H2 H3.
  (symb_interpr_ext H2 H1) ==>
  (symb_interpr_ext H2 H3) ==>
  (symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER H1 H3)

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER_doms_thm
statement:
!H1 H12 H2 H23 H3.
  ((symb_interpr_dom H1) INTER ((symb_interpr_dom H3) DIFF (symb_interpr_dom H2)) = EMPTY) ==>

  (symb_interpr_ext H12 H1) ==>
  (symb_interpr_ext H12 H2) ==>

  (symb_interpr_ext H23 H2) ==>
  (symb_interpr_ext H23 H3) ==>

  (symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER H1 H3)

name: symb_interpr_get_extend_thm
statement:
!H_extra H_base symb v.
  (symb_interpr_get H_base symb = SOME v) ==>
  (symb_interpr_get (symb_interpr_extend H_extra H_base) symb = SOME v)

name: symb_interpr_get_extend_dom_thm
statement:
!H_extra H_base symb.
  (symb IN symb_interpr_dom H_base) ==>
  (symb_interpr_get (symb_interpr_extend H_extra H_base) symb = symb_interpr_get H_base symb)

name: symb_interpr_get_extend_dom_thm2
statement:
!H_extra H_base symb.
  (symb_interpr_get (symb_interpr_extend H_extra H_base) symb =
   if symb IN symb_interpr_dom H_base then
     symb_interpr_get H_base symb
   else
     symb_interpr_get H_extra symb)

name: symb_interpr_dom_extend_thm
statement:
!H_extra H_base.
  (symb_interpr_dom (symb_interpr_extend H_extra H_base)) =
  ((symb_interpr_dom H_extra) UNION (symb_interpr_dom H_base))

name: symb_interpr_extend_IMP_ext_thm
statement:
!H_extra H_base.
  (symb_interpr_ext (symb_interpr_extend H_extra H_base) H_base)

name: symb_interpr_extend_IMP_ext_thm2
statement:
!H_extra H_base.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER H_extra H_base) ==>
  (symb_interpr_ext (symb_interpr_extend H_extra H_base) H_extra)

name: symb_interpr_extend_symbs_IMP_ext_thm
statement:
!valfun symbs H.
  (symb_interpr_ext (symb_interpr_extend_symbs valfun symbs H) H)

name: symb_interpr_extend_symbs_IMP_for_symbs_thm
statement:
!valfun symbs H.
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs ((symb_interpr_dom H) UNION symbs) (symb_interpr_extend_symbs valfun symbs H))

name: symb_interpr_extend_symbs_IMP_dom_thm
statement:
!valfun symbs H.
  (symb_interpr_dom (symb_interpr_extend_symbs valfun symbs H) = ((symb_interpr_dom H) UNION symbs))

name: symb_interpr_extend_symbs_IMP_eq_for_thm
statement:
!valfun symbs H.
  (symb_interprs_eq_for H (symb_interpr_extend_symbs valfun symbs H) (symb_interpr_dom H))

name: symb_interpr_extend_symbs_IMP_get_thm
statement:
!valfun symbs H symb.
  (?v. symb_interpr_get H symb = SOME v) ==>
  (symb_interpr_get (symb_interpr_extend_symbs valfun symbs H) symb = symb_interpr_get H symb)

name: symb_interpr_get_def
statement: symb_interpr_get (SymbInterpret h) symb = h symb

name: symb_interpr_update_def
statement: symb_interpr_update (SymbInterpret h) (symb, vo) = SymbInterpret ((symb =+ vo) h)

name: symb_interpr_dom_def
statement: symb_interpr_dom (SymbInterpret h) = {symb | h symb <> NONE}

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_def
statement:
symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 symbs =
      (!symb. (symb IN symbs) ==> (symb_interpr_get H1 symb = symb_interpr_get H2 symb))

name: symb_interpr_ext_def
statement: symb_interpr_ext H1 H2 = symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 (symb_interpr_dom H2)

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_def
statement:
symb_interpr_for_symbs symbs H =
      (symbs SUBSET (symb_interpr_dom H))

name: symb_interpr_for_symbs_min_def
statement:
symb_interpr_for_symbs_min symbs H =
      (symbs = (symb_interpr_dom H))

name: symb_interpr_restr_def
statement:
symb_interpr_restr symbs H =
    (SymbInterpret (\symb. if symb IN symbs then symb_interpr_get H symb else NONE))

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER_def
statement:
symb_interprs_eq_for_INTER H1 H2 =
      (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 ((symb_interpr_dom H1) INTER (symb_interpr_dom H2)))

name: symb_interpr_extend_def
statement:
symb_interpr_extend H_extra H_base =
    (SymbInterpret (\symb.
      if symb IN (symb_interpr_dom H_base) then
        symb_interpr_get H_base symb
      else
        symb_interpr_get H_extra symb))

name: symb_interpr_extend_symbs_def
statement:
symb_interpr_extend_symbs valfun symbs H =
    (SymbInterpret (\symb.
      if symb IN (symb_interpr_dom H) then
        symb_interpr_get H symb
      else if symb IN symbs then
        SOME (valfun symb)
      else
        NONE))

name: symb_prop_transfer_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys L Pi P Q.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>
  (P_entails_an_interpret sr P sys) ==>
  (Pi_overapprox_Q sr P sys Pi Q) ==>
  (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L, Pi)) ==>
  (prop_holds sr (symb_symbst_pc sys) L P Q)

name: prop_holds_sty_thm
statement:
!sr l L sty P Q.
  (!s. P s ==> symb_concst_store_ty_sat sr sty s) ==>
  ((prop_holds_sty sr l L sty P Q) =
   (prop_holds sr l L P Q))

name: prop_holds_sty_thm2
statement:
!sr l L sty P Q.
  ((prop_holds_sty sr l L sty P Q) =
   (prop_holds sr l L (\s. symb_concst_store_ty_sat sr sty s /\ P s) Q))

name: symb_prop_transfer_sty_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys L Pi P Q.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>
  (P_entails_an_interpret sr (\s. symb_concst_store_ty_sat sr (symb_symbst_store_ty sr sys) s /\ P s) sys) ==>
  (Pi_overapprox_Q sr (\s. symb_concst_store_ty_sat sr (symb_symbst_store_ty sr sys) s /\ P s) sys Pi Q) ==>
  (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L, Pi)) ==>
  (prop_holds_sty sr (symb_symbst_pc sys) L (symb_symbst_store_ty sr sys) P Q)

name: symb_prop_transfer_binHoare_thm
statement:
!sr.
!Q' l L P Q.
  (Q' = \s. \s'. Q s' /\ (~((symb_concst_pc s') IN (COMPL L)))) ==>
  (prop_holds sr l (COMPL L) P Q') ==>
  (t_jgmt (symb_hl_etl_wm sr) l L P Q)

name: symb_hl_trs_thm
statement: !sr. !x. (symb_hl_trs sr x) = SOME (sr.sr_step_conc x)

name: FUNPOW_OPT_SOME_symb_hl_trs_thm
statement:
!sr. !n x.
      (FUNPOW_OPT (symb_hl_trs sr) n x = SOME (FUNPOW sr.sr_step_conc n x))

name: symb_hl_is_weak
statement:
!sr.
      first_enc (symb_hl_etl_wm sr)

name: P_entails_an_interpret_def
statement:
P_entails_an_interpret sr P sys =
    (!s.
     (symb_concst_pc s = symb_symbst_pc sys) ==>
     (P s) ==>
     (?H. symb_matchstate sr sys H s))

name: Pi_overapprox_Q_def
statement:
Pi_overapprox_Q sr P sys Pi Q =
    (!sys' s s' H.
     (sys' IN Pi) ==>
     (P s) ==>
     (symb_matchstate sr sys H s) ==>
     (symb_matchstate_ext sr sys' H s') ==>
     (Q s s'))

name: prop_holds_def
statement:
prop_holds sr l L P Q =
    (!s.
     (symb_concst_pc s = l) ==>
     (P s) ==>
     (?n s'.
       conc_step_n_in_L sr s n L s' /\
       Q s s'))

name: symb_concst_store_ty_sat_def
statement:
symb_concst_store_ty_sat sr sty s =
    (!vn.
       ((IS_SOME (sty vn)) \/ (IS_SOME ((symb_concst_store s) vn))) ==>
       (?ty v.
          (sty vn = SOME ty) /\
          ((symb_concst_store s) vn = SOME v) /\
          (sr.sr_typeof_val v = ty)))

name: symb_symbst_store_ty_def
statement:
symb_symbst_store_ty sr sys =
    (\vn. OPTION_BIND ((symb_symbst_store sys) vn) (sr.sr_typeof_exp))

name: prop_holds_sty_def
statement:
prop_holds_sty sr l L sty P Q =
    (!s.
     (symb_concst_pc s = l) ==>
     (symb_concst_store_ty_sat sr sty s) ==>
     (P s) ==>
     (?n s'.
       conc_step_n_in_L sr s n L s' /\
       Q s s'))

name: symb_symbst_store_notyerr_def
statement:
symb_symbst_store_notyerr sr sys =
    (!vn sv.
       ((symb_symbst_store sys) vn = SOME sv) ==>
       (IS_SOME (sr.sr_typeof_exp sv)))

name: symb_symbst_is_GEN_def
statement:
symb_symbst_is_GEN sr sys =
    (?vn2sy vnS syS.
      (BIJ vn2sy vnS syS) /\
      (!vn. (~(vn IN vnS)) ==> ((symb_symbst_store sys) vn = NONE)) /\
      (!vn. vn IN vnS ==> ((symb_symbst_store sys) vn = SOME (sr.sr_mk_exp_symb_f(vn2sy vn))))
    )

name: P_GEN_def
statement:
P_GEN sr sys P s =
      (symb_concst_store_ty_sat sr (symb_symbst_store_ty sr sys) s /\
       symb_concst_extra s = symb_symbst_extra sys /\
       P s)

name: symb_hl_trs_def
statement: symb_hl_trs sr st = SOME (sr.sr_step_conc st)

name: symb_hl_weak_def
statement:
symb_hl_weak sr ls st st' =
    (?n. (conc_step_n_in_L_relaxed sr st n (COMPL ls) st' /\ (~((symb_concst_pc st') IN (COMPL ls)))))

name: symb_hl_etl_wm_def
symb_symbst_store_update_READ_thm
symb_symbst_store_update_UNCHANGED_thm
statement:
!var symbexp sys.
  (symb_symbst_pc (symb_symbst_store_update var symbexp sys) = symb_symbst_pc sys) /\
  (symb_symbst_pcond (symb_symbst_store_update var symbexp sys) = symb_symbst_pcond sys) /\
  (symb_symbst_extra (symb_symbst_store_update var symbexp sys) = symb_symbst_extra sys)

name: symb_symbst_pcond_update_READ_thm
statement:
!pcond_f sys.
  (symb_symbst_pcond (symb_symbst_pcond_update pcond_f sys) =
   pcond_f (symb_symbst_pcond sys))

name: symb_symbst_pcond_update_UNCHANGED_thm
statement:
!pcond_f sys.
  (symb_symbst_pc (symb_symbst_pcond_update pcond_f sys) = symb_symbst_pc sys) /\
  (symb_symbst_store (symb_symbst_pcond_update pcond_f sys) = symb_symbst_store sys) /\
  (symb_symbst_extra (symb_symbst_pcond_update pcond_f sys) = symb_symbst_extra sys)

name: symb_symbols_SUBSET_pcond_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys.
  (sr.sr_symbols_f (symb_symbst_pcond sys))
  SUBSET
  (symb_symbols sr sys)

name: symb_symbols_SUBSET_store_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys.
  (symb_symbols_store sr (symb_symbst_store sys))
  SUBSET
  (symb_symbols sr sys)

name: symb_symbols_SUBSET_store_exps_thm
statement:
!sr.
!store var symbexp.
  ((store var) = SOME symbexp) ==>
  ((sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp)
   SUBSET
   (symb_symbols_store sr store))

name: symb_symbols_SUBSET_store_exps_thm2
statement:
!sr.
!sys var symbexp.
  (((symb_symbst_store sys) var) = SOME symbexp) ==>
  ((sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp)
   SUBSET
   (symb_symbols sr sys))

name: symb_symbols_set_SUBSET_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys Pi.
  (sys IN Pi) ==>
  ((symb_symbols sr sys) SUBSET (symb_symbols_set sr Pi))

name: symb_symbols_of_symb_symbst_store_update_SUBSET_store_exps_thm2
statement:
!sr.
!var symbexp sys.
  (sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp) SUBSET (symb_symbols sr (symb_symbst_store_update var symbexp sys))

name: symb_symbols_of_symb_symbst_store_update_SUBSET1_thm
statement:
!sr.
!var symbexp sys.
  ((symb_symbols sr (symb_symbst_store_update var symbexp sys)) SUBSET
   ((symb_symbols sr sys) UNION (sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp)))

name: symb_symbols_of_symb_symbst_store_update_SUBSET2_thm
statement:
!sr.
!var symbexp symbexp' sys.
  ((symb_symbst_store sys) var = SOME symbexp') ==>
  ((symb_symbols sr sys) SUBSET
   ((symb_symbols sr (symb_symbst_store_update var symbexp sys)) UNION
    (sr.sr_symbols_f (symbexp')))
  )

name: symb_symbols_of_symb_symbst_pcond_update_SUBSET1_thm
statement:
!sr.
!pcond_f sys.
  ((symb_symbols sr (symb_symbst_pcond_update pcond_f sys)) SUBSET
   ((symb_symbols sr sys) UNION (sr.sr_symbols_f (pcond_f (symb_symbst_pcond sys)))))

name: symb_symbols_of_symb_symbst_pcond_update_SUBSET2_thm
statement:
!sr.
!pcond_f sys.
  ((symb_symbols sr sys) SUBSET
   ((symb_symbols sr (symb_symbst_pcond_update pcond_f sys)) UNION
    (sr.sr_symbols_f (symb_symbst_pcond sys)))
  )

name: symb_interpr_welltyped_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H.
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) =
  (!symb v.
    (symb_interpr_get H symb = SOME v) ==>
    (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb = sr.sr_typeof_val v))

name: symb_interpr_ext_welltyped_IMP_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H1 H2.
  (symb_interpr_ext H2 H1) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H2) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H1)

name: symb_interpr_extend_welltyped_IMP_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H_base H_extra.
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H_base) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H_extra) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr (symb_interpr_extend H_extra H_base))

name: symb_interpr_update_NONE_IMP_welltyped_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H symb.
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr (symb_interpr_update H (symb,NONE)))

name: symb_interpr_update_SOME_IMP_welltyped_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H symb v.
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
  (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb = sr.sr_typeof_val v) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr (symb_interpr_update H (symb, SOME v)))

name: symb_interpr_update_SOME_IMP_welltyped_thm2
statement:
!sr.
!H symb vo v.
  (symb_interpr_get H symb = SOME v) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr (symb_interpr_update H (symb, vo))) ==>
  (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb = sr.sr_typeof_val v) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H)

name: symb_interpr_update_SOME_IMP_welltyped_thm3
statement:
!sr.
!H symb vo v.
  (symb_interpr_get H symb = NONE) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr (symb_interpr_update H (symb, vo))) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H)

name: symb_symbst_store_update_IMP_EQ_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H sys1 sys2 var symbexp symbexp' cstore.
  ((symb_symbst_store sys1) var = SOME symbexp) ==>
  (sys2 = symb_symbst_store_update var symbexp' sys1) ==>

  (sr.sr_interpret_f H symbexp =
   sr.sr_interpret_f H symbexp') ==>

  ((symb_interpr_symbstore sr H (symb_symbst_store sys1) cstore) =
   (symb_interpr_symbstore sr H (symb_symbst_store sys2) cstore))

name: symb_symbst_pcond_IMP_EQ_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H sys1 sys2 s.
  (symb_symbst_pcond sys1 = symb_symbst_pcond sys2) ==>
  ((symb_interpr_symbpcond sr H sys1) =
   (symb_interpr_symbpcond sr H sys2))

name: symb_symbst_pcond_update_IMP_EQ_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H sys1 sys2 pcond pcond_f.
  (symb_symbst_pcond sys1 = pcond) ==>
  (sys2 = symb_symbst_pcond_update pcond_f sys1) ==>

  (sr.sr_interpret_f H pcond =
   sr.sr_interpret_f H (pcond_f pcond)) ==>

  ((symb_interpr_symbpcond sr H sys1) =
   (symb_interpr_symbpcond sr H sys2))

name: symb_suitable_interpretation_SUBSET_dom_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys H.
  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr sys H) =
  ((symb_symbols sr sys) SUBSET (symb_interpr_dom H))

name: symb_suitable_interpretation_UPDATE_SOME_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys H symb v.
  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr sys H) ==>
  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr sys (symb_interpr_update H (symb,SOME v)))

name: symb_suitable_interpretation_UPDATE_SOME_thm2
statement:
!sr.
!sys H symb v.
  (symb IN symb_interpr_dom H) ==>
  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr sys (symb_interpr_update H (symb,SOME v))) ==>
  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr sys H)

name: symb_minimal_interpretation_EQ_dom_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys H.
  (symb_minimal_interpretation sr sys H) =
  (symb_symbols sr sys = symb_interpr_dom H)

name: matchstate_IMP_symbols_SUBSET_interpr_dom_thm
statement:
!sr sys H s.
  (symb_matchstate sr sys H s) ==>
  ((symb_symbols sr sys) SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H)

name: symb_symbst_store_update_IMP_matchstate_EQ_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H sys1 sys2 var symbexp symbexp' s.
  ((symb_symbst_store sys1) var = SOME symbexp) ==>
  (sys2 = symb_symbst_store_update var symbexp' sys1) ==>

  (((sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp) UNION
    (sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp')) SUBSET (symb_interpr_dom H)) ==>

  (sr.sr_interpret_f H symbexp =
   sr.sr_interpret_f H symbexp') ==>

  ((symb_matchstate sr sys1 H s) =
   (symb_matchstate sr sys2 H s))

name: symb_symbst_pcond_update_IMP_matchstate_EQ_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H sys1 sys2 pcond pcond_f s.
  (symb_symbst_pcond sys1 = pcond) ==>
  (sys2 = symb_symbst_pcond_update pcond_f sys1) ==>

  (((sr.sr_symbols_f pcond) UNION
    (sr.sr_symbols_f (pcond_f pcond))) SUBSET (symb_interpr_dom H)) ==>

  (sr.sr_interpret_f H pcond =
   sr.sr_interpret_f H (pcond_f pcond)) ==>

  ((symb_matchstate sr sys1 H s) =
   (symb_matchstate sr sys2 H s))

name: symb_matchstate_UNIQUE_store_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys H s s'.
  (symb_matchstate sr sys H s) ==>
  (symb_matchstate sr sys H s') ==>

  (symb_concst_store s = symb_concst_store s')

name: symb_matchstate_UNIQUE_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys H s s'.
  (symb_matchstate sr sys H s) ==>
  (symb_matchstate sr sys H s') ==>

  (s = s')

name: symb_matchstate_IMP_interpret_exp_SOME_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys var symbexp H s.
  (symb_symbst_store sys var = SOME symbexp) ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys H s) ==>

  (?v. sr.sr_interpret_f H symbexp = SOME v)

name: symb_matchstate_ext_IMP_SAME_interpret_exp_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys var symbexp H H' s v.
  (symb_symbst_store sys var = SOME symbexp) ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys H  s) ==>
  (symb_matchstate sr sys H' s) ==>

  (sr.sr_interpret_f H  symbexp =
   sr.sr_interpret_f H' symbexp)

name: symb_matchstate_ext_w_ext_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H H' sys s.
  (symb_interpr_ext H' H) ==>

  (symb_matchstate_ext sr sys H' s) ==>
  (symb_matchstate_ext sr sys H  s)

name: step_n_deterministic_thm
statement:
!stepf.
!s n s' s''.
(step_n stepf s n s') ==>
(step_n stepf s n s'') ==>
(s' = s'')

name: step_n_total_thm
statement:
!stepf.
!s n.
?s'.
step_n stepf s n s'

name: step_n_in_L_onlyL_thm
statement:
!pcf stepf.
!s n L s'.
(step_n_in_L pcf stepf s n L s') ==>
(
  
  (!n' s''. n' < n ==> step_n stepf s n' s'' ==> pcf(s'') IN L)
)

name: step_n_in_L_IMP_SUPER_thm
statement:
!pcf stepf.
!s n L L' s'.
  (L SUBSET L') ==>
  (step_n_in_L pcf stepf s n L  s') ==>
  (step_n_in_L pcf stepf s n L' s')

name: step_n_in_L_SEQ_thm
statement:
!pcf stepf.
!s n_A L_A s' n_B L_B s''.
  (step_n_in_L pcf stepf s  n_A L_A s') ==>
  (step_n_in_L pcf stepf s' n_B L_B s'') ==>
  (step_n_in_L pcf stepf s (n_A + n_B) (L_A UNION L_B) s'')

name: FUNPOW_ABS_thm
statement:
!f g.
  (!x. g (f x) = x) ==>
  !stepf.
  !s n s'.
    FUNPOW (f o stepf o g) n (f s)
    =
    f (FUNPOW stepf n s)

name: step_n_ABS_thm
statement:
!f g.
  (!x y. (f x = f y) <=> (x = y)) ==>
  (!x. g (f x) = x) ==>
  !stepf.
  !s n s'.
    step_n (f o stepf o g) (f s) n (f s')
    =
    step_n stepf s n s'

name: step_n_in_L_ABS_thm
statement:
!f g.
  (!x y. (f x = f y) <=> (x = y)) ==>
  (!x. g (f x) = x) ==>
  (!x. ?y. (f y) = x) ==>
  !pcf stepf.
  !s n L s'.
    step_n_in_L pcf (f o stepf o g) (f s) n L (f s')
    =
    step_n_in_L (pcf o f) stepf s n L s'

name: conc_step_n_in_L_IMP_relaxed_thm
statement:
!sr.
!s n L s'.
(conc_step_n_in_L sr s n L s') ==>
(conc_step_n_in_L_relaxed sr s n L s')

name: symb_hl_step_in_L_sound_SUBSET_Pi_thm
statement:
!sr sys L Pi Pi'.
    (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L, Pi)) ==>
    (Pi SUBSET Pi') ==>
    (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L, Pi'))

name: symb_hl_step_in_L_sound_SUBSET_L_thm
statement:
!sr sys L Pi L'.
    (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L, Pi)) ==>
    (L SUBSET L') ==>
    (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L', Pi))

name: symb_subst_store_thm
statement:
!sr.
!subst store var.
  ((store var = NONE) ==> ((symb_subst_store sr subst store) var = NONE)) /\
  (!e. (store var = SOME e) ==> ((symb_subst_store sr subst store) var = SOME (sr.sr_subst_f subst e)))

name: symb_concst_pc_def
statement: symb_concst_pc (SymbConcSt lbl _ _) = lbl

name: symb_concst_store_def
statement: symb_concst_store (SymbConcSt _ store _) = store

name: symb_concst_extra_def
statement: symb_concst_extra (SymbConcSt _ _ extra) = extra

name: symb_symbst_pc_def
statement: symb_symbst_pc (SymbSymbSt lbl _ _ _) = lbl

name: symb_symbst_store_def
statement: symb_symbst_store (SymbSymbSt _ store _ _) = store

name: symb_symbst_store_update_def
statement:
symb_symbst_store_update var symbexpr (SymbSymbSt lbl store pcond extra) =
    SymbSymbSt lbl ((var =+ (SOME symbexpr)) store) pcond extra

name: symb_symbst_pcond_def
statement: symb_symbst_pcond (SymbSymbSt _ _ pcond _) = pcond

name: symb_symbst_pcond_update_def
statement:
symb_symbst_pcond_update pcond_f (SymbSymbSt lbl store pcond extra) =
    SymbSymbSt lbl store (pcond_f pcond) extra

name: symb_symbst_extra_def
statement: symb_symbst_extra (SymbSymbSt _ _ _ extra) = extra

name: symb_symbols_store_def
statement:
symb_symbols_store sr store =
      BIGUNION ({sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp | ?var. store var = SOME symbexp})

name: symb_symbols_def
statement:
symb_symbols sr sys =
      (symb_symbols_store sr (symb_symbst_store sys) UNION
       sr.sr_symbols_f (symb_symbst_pcond sys))

name: symb_symbols_set_def
statement:
symb_symbols_set sr Pi =
      BIGUNION ({symb_symbols sr sys | sys IN Pi})

name: symb_freesymbs_def
statement:
symb_freesymbs sr (sys, L, Pi) =
    (symb_symbols_set sr Pi) DIFF (symb_symbols sr sys)

name: symb_interpr_welltyped_def
statement:
symb_interpr_welltyped sr H =
      (!symb.
         (symb IN symb_interpr_dom H) ==>
         (?v. symb_interpr_get H symb = SOME v /\
              sr.sr_typeof_symb symb = sr.sr_typeof_val v))

name: symb_interpr_symbstore_def
statement:
symb_interpr_symbstore sr H store cstore =
    (!var. (store var <> NONE \/ cstore var <> NONE) ==>
         ?symbexp v.
            store  var = SOME symbexp /\
            cstore var = SOME v /\
            sr.sr_interpret_f H symbexp = SOME v)

name: symb_interpr_symbpcond_def
statement:
symb_interpr_symbpcond sr H sys =
    (sr.sr_interpret_f H (symb_symbst_pcond sys) = SOME sr.sr_val_true)

name: symb_suitable_interpretation_def
statement:
symb_suitable_interpretation sr sys H =
      symb_interpr_for_symbs (symb_symbols sr sys) H

name: symb_minimal_interpretation_def
statement:
symb_minimal_interpretation sr sys H =
      symb_interpr_for_symbs_min (symb_symbols sr sys) H

name: symb_matchstate_def
statement:
symb_matchstate ^(mk_var("sr", symb_rec_t_tm))
                      sys
                      H
                      ^(mk_var("s", symb_concst_t_tm)) =
    (symb_suitable_interpretation sr sys H /\
     symb_interpr_welltyped sr H /\
     symb_symbst_pc sys = symb_concst_pc s /\
     symb_interpr_symbstore sr H (symb_symbst_store sys) (symb_concst_store s) /\
     symb_interpr_symbpcond sr H sys /\
     symb_symbst_extra sys = symb_concst_extra s)

name: symb_matchstate_ext_def
statement:
symb_matchstate_ext sr sys H s =
    (?H'. symb_interpr_ext H' H /\
          symb_matchstate sr sys H' s)

name: step_n_def
statement: (step_n stepf s n s' = (FUNPOW stepf n s = s'))

name: step_n_in_L_relaxed_def
statement:
step_n_in_L_relaxed pcf stepf s n L s' =
    (step_n stepf s n s' /\
     (n > 0) /\
     (!n'. 0 < n' ==> n' < n ==>
        ?s''. step_n stepf s n' s'' /\ pcf(s'') IN L))

name: step_n_in_L_def
statement:
step_n_in_L pcf stepf s n L s' =
    ((pcf s) IN L /\
     (step_n_in_L_relaxed pcf stepf s n L s'))

name: conc_step_n_in_L_relaxed_def
statement: conc_step_n_in_L_relaxed sr = step_n_in_L_relaxed symb_concst_pc sr.sr_step_conc

name: conc_step_n_in_L_def
statement: conc_step_n_in_L sr = step_n_in_L symb_concst_pc sr.sr_step_conc

name: symb_hl_step_in_L_sound_def
statement:
symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L, Pi) =
    !s H.
    (symb_minimal_interpretation sr sys H) ==>
    (symb_matchstate sr sys H s) ==>
    (?n s'.
      (conc_step_n_in_L sr s n L s') /\
      (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ symb_matchstate_ext sr sys' H s')
    )

name: symb_subst_store_def
statement:
symb_subst_store sr subst store =
      (\var. OPTION_MAP (sr.sr_subst_f subst) (store var))

name: symb_subst_def
statement:
symb_subst sr subst sys =
      (SymbSymbSt
        (symb_symbst_pc sys)
        (symb_subst_store sr subst (symb_symbst_store sys))
        (sr.sr_subst_f subst (symb_symbst_pcond sys))
        (symb_symbst_extra sys))

name: symb_subst_set_def
statement:
symb_subst_set sr subst Pi =
      (IMAGE (symb_subst sr subst) Pi)

name: symb_symbols_f_sound_thm
statement:
!sr.
    symb_symbols_f_sound sr =
    (!symbexp H H'.
       (!symb. (symb IN (sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp)) ==> (symb_interpr_get H symb = symb_interpr_get H' symb)) ==>
       (sr.sr_interpret_f H  symbexp =
        sr.sr_interpret_f H' symbexp))

name: symb_interpr_restr_interpret_EQ_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H symbs symbexp.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  ((sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp) SUBSET symbs) ==>

  (sr.sr_interpret_f H symbexp = sr.sr_interpret_f (symb_interpr_restr symbs H) symbexp)

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_store_IMP_EQ_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H1 H2 store cstore.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 (symb_symbols_store sr store)) ==>
  ((symb_interpr_symbstore sr H1 store cstore) =
   (symb_interpr_symbstore sr H2 store cstore))

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_pcond_IMP_EQ_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H1 H2 sys.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 (sr.sr_symbols_f (symb_symbst_pcond sys))) ==>
  ((symb_interpr_symbpcond sr H1 sys) =
   (symb_interpr_symbpcond sr H2 sys))

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_matchstate_IMP_matchstate_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys H1 H2 s.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H1) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H2) ==>

  (symb_interprs_eq_for H1 H2 (symb_symbols sr sys)) ==>
  ((symb_matchstate sr sys H1 s) =
   (symb_matchstate sr sys H2 s))

name: symb_matchstate_TO_min_RESTR_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H sys s.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys H  s) ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys (symb_interpr_restr (symb_symbols sr sys) H) s)

name: symb_matchstate_TO_min_RESTR_UNION_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H sys s symbs H'.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys H  s) ==>

  (symb_interpr_restr (symb_symbols sr sys UNION symbs) H = H') ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys H' s)

name: symb_matchstate_TO_minimal_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys H s.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys H s) ==>

  (?H'. (symb_interpr_ext H H')/\
        (symb_minimal_interpretation sr sys H') /\
        (symb_matchstate sr sys H' s)
  )

name: symb_interpr_ext_matchstate_IMP_matchstate_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys H1 H2 s.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_interpr_ext H2 H1) ==>
  (symb_matchstate sr sys H1 s) ==>

  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H2) ==>
  (symb_matchstate sr sys H2 s)

name: symb_interpr_extend_IMP_symb_matchstate_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys H_extra H_base s.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H_extra) ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys H_base s) ==>
  (symb_matchstate sr sys (symb_interpr_extend H_extra H_base) s)

name: symb_matchstate_interpr_ext_EXISTS_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H1 H12 H2 H23 H3 sys s.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H1) ==>

  ((symb_interpr_dom H1) INTER ((symb_interpr_dom H3) DIFF (symb_interpr_dom H2)) = EMPTY) ==>

  (symb_interpr_ext H12 H1) ==>
  (symb_interpr_ext H12 H2) ==>

  (symb_interpr_ext H23 H2) ==>
  (symb_interpr_ext H23 H3) ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys H3 s) ==>

  (symb_matchstate_ext sr sys H1 s)

name: symb_matchstate_ext_WITHOUT_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys H s symb.
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  (~(symb IN symb_interpr_dom H)) ==>
  (~(symb IN symb_symbols sr sys)) ==>

  (symb_matchstate_ext sr sys H s) ==>

  (?H'. (symb_interpr_ext H' H) /\
        (symb_matchstate sr sys H' s) /\
        (~(symb IN symb_interpr_dom H')))

name: symb_interpr_extend_symbs_sr_IMP_welltyped_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H symbs.
  (symb_ARB_val_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr (symb_interpr_extend_symbs_sr sr symbs H))

name: symb_interpr_extend_symbs_sr_IS_interpr_ext_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H symbs.
  (symb_interpr_ext (symb_interpr_extend_symbs_sr sr symbs H) H)

name: symb_interpr_extend_symbs_sr_IS_interpr_for_symbs_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H symbs.
  (symb_interpr_for_symbs symbs (symb_interpr_extend_symbs_sr sr symbs H))

name: symb_interpr_extend_symbs_sr_IMP_matchstate_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H symbs sys s.
  (symb_ARB_val_sound sr) ==>
  (symb_symbols_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys H s) ==>
  (symb_matchstate sr sys (symb_interpr_extend_symbs_sr sr symbs H) s)

name: symb_interpr_update_interpret_f_IMP_welltyped_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H symb e.
  (symb_typeof_exp_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
  (sr.sr_symbols_f e SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H) ==>
  (sr.sr_typeof_exp e = SOME (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb)) ==>

  (symb_interpr_welltyped sr (symb_interpr_update H (symb, sr.sr_interpret_f H e)))

name: symb_expr_conj_eq_thm
statement:
!sr.
  (symb_mk_exp_eq_f_sound sr) ==>
  (symb_mk_exp_conj_f_sound sr) ==>
    ((!e1 e2 conj1 H.
       (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
       (sr.sr_interpret_f H (symb_expr_conj_eq sr e1 e2 conj1) = SOME sr.sr_val_true) =
       ((sr.sr_interpret_f H conj1 = SOME sr.sr_val_true) /\
        (sr.sr_interpret_f H e1 <> NONE) /\
        (OPTREL sr.sr_val_eq (sr.sr_interpret_f H e1) (sr.sr_interpret_f H e2)))) /\
     (!e1 e2 conj1.sr.sr_symbols_f (symb_expr_conj_eq sr e1 e2 conj1) =
         sr.sr_symbols_f e1 UNION
         sr.sr_symbols_f e2 UNION
         sr.sr_symbols_f conj1))

name: symb_subst_store_sound_NOTIN_thm
statement:
!sr.
!symb symb_inst store.
  (symb_subst_f_sound_NOTIN sr) ==>

  (sr.sr_typeof_exp symb_inst = SOME (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb)) ==>
  (symb NOTIN symb_symbols_store sr store) ==>
  (symb_subst_store sr (symb, symb_inst) store = store)

name: symb_subst_sound_NOTIN_thm
statement:
!sr.
!symb symb_inst sys.
  (symb_subst_f_sound_NOTIN sr) ==>

  (sr.sr_typeof_exp symb_inst = SOME (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb)) ==>
  (symb NOTIN symb_symbols sr sys) ==>
  (symb_subst sr (symb,symb_inst) sys = sys)

name: symb_subst_store_sound_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H H' symb symb_inst store store_r cstore v.
  (symb_subst_f_sound sr) ==>

  (sr.sr_typeof_exp symb_inst = SOME (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb)) ==>
  (symb_subst_store sr (symb, symb_inst) store = store_r) ==>

  (sr.sr_interpret_f H symb_inst = SOME v) ==>
  ((symb_interpr_update H (symb, SOME v)) = H') ==>

  (symb_interpr_symbstore sr H  store_r cstore =
   symb_interpr_symbstore sr H' store   cstore)

name: symb_subst_store_symbols_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H symb symb_inst store.
  (symb_subst_f_sound sr) ==>

  (sr.sr_symbols_f symb_inst SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H) ==>
  (symb_symbols_store sr store SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H) ==>
  (symb_symbols_store sr (symb_subst_store sr (symb,symb_inst) store) SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H)

name: symb_subst_store_symbols_thm2
statement:
!sr.
!H symb symb_inst store.
  (symb_subst_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb IN symb_interpr_dom H) ==>
  (symb_symbols_store sr (symb_subst_store sr (symb,symb_inst) store) SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H) ==>
  (symb_symbols_store sr store SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H)

name: symb_subst_store_symbols_thm3
statement:
!sr.
!H symb symb_inst store.
  (symb_subst_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_symbols_store sr (symb_subst_store sr (symb,symb_inst) store) =
   (symb_symbols_store sr store DIFF {symb}) UNION (if symb IN symb_symbols_store sr store then sr.sr_symbols_f symb_inst else EMPTY))

name: symb_subst_symbols_thm
statement:
!sr.
!H symb symb_inst sys.
  (symb_subst_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_symbols sr (symb_subst sr (symb, symb_inst) sys) =
   (symb_symbols sr sys DIFF {symb}) UNION (if symb IN symb_symbols sr sys then sr.sr_symbols_f symb_inst else EMPTY))

name: symb_subst_suitable_interpretation_thm
statement:
!sr.
!sys H symb symb_inst.
  (symb_subst_f_sound sr) ==>

  (sr.sr_symbols_f symb_inst SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H) ==>
  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr sys H) ==>
  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr (symb_subst sr (symb,symb_inst) sys) H)

name: symb_subst_suitable_interpretation_thm2
statement:
!sr.
!sys H symb symb_inst.
  (symb_subst_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb IN symb_interpr_dom H) ==>
  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr (symb_subst sr (symb,symb_inst) sys) H) ==>
  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr sys H)

name: symb_subst_suitable_interpretation_thm3
statement:
!sr.
!sys H symb symb_inst vo.
  (symb_subst_f_sound sr) ==>

  (sr.sr_symbols_f symb_inst SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H) ==>

  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr sys  (symb_interpr_update H (symb, vo))) ==>
  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr (symb_subst sr (symb, symb_inst) sys) H)

name: symb_subst_suitable_interpretation_thm4
statement:
!sr.
!sys H symb symb_inst vo.
  (symb_subst_f_sound sr) ==>

  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr (symb_subst sr (symb, symb_inst) sys) H) ==>
  (symb_suitable_interpretation sr sys  (symb_interpr_update H (symb, SOME v)))

name: symb_subst_sound_thm1
statement:
!sr.
!H H' symb symb_inst sys sys_r s v.
  (symb_typeof_exp_sound sr) ==>
  (symb_subst_f_sound sr) ==>

  
  (sr.sr_symbols_f symb_inst SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H) ==>
  


  (sr.sr_typeof_exp symb_inst = SOME (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb)) ==>
  (symb_subst sr (symb, symb_inst) sys = sys_r) ==>

  (sr.sr_interpret_f H symb_inst = SOME v) ==>
  ((symb_interpr_update H (symb, SOME v)) = H') ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys_r H  s) ==>
  (symb_matchstate sr sys   H' s)

name: symb_subst_sound_thm2
statement:
!sr.
!H H' symb symb_inst sys sys_r s v.
  (symb_typeof_exp_sound sr) ==>
  (symb_subst_f_sound sr) ==>

  (sr.sr_symbols_f symb_inst SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H) ==> 
  

  (!v'. symb_interpr_get H symb = SOME v' ==> sr.sr_typeof_symb symb = sr.sr_typeof_val v') ==> 

  (sr.sr_typeof_exp symb_inst = SOME (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb)) ==>
  (symb_subst sr (symb, symb_inst) sys = sys_r) ==>

  (sr.sr_interpret_f H symb_inst = SOME v) ==>
  ((symb_interpr_update H (symb, SOME v)) = H') ==>

  (symb_matchstate sr sys   H' s) ==>
  (symb_matchstate sr sys_r H  s)

name: symb_symbols_f_sound_def
statement:
symb_symbols_f_sound sr =
    (!symbexp H H'.
       (symb_interprs_eq_for H H' (sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp)) ==>
       (sr.sr_interpret_f H  symbexp =
        sr.sr_interpret_f H' symbexp))

name: symb_ARB_val_sound_def
statement:
symb_ARB_val_sound sr =
      (!t. sr.sr_typeof_val (sr.sr_ARB_val t) = t)

name: symb_interpr_extend_symbs_sr_def
statement:
symb_interpr_extend_symbs_sr sr =
      symb_interpr_extend_symbs (\s. sr.sr_ARB_val (sr.sr_typeof_symb s))

name: symb_typeof_exp_sound_def
statement:
symb_typeof_exp_sound sr =
      (!e t.
       (!H.
          (sr.sr_typeof_exp e = SOME t) ==>

          (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
          (sr.sr_symbols_f e SUBSET symb_interpr_dom H) ==>

          (?v. (sr.sr_interpret_f H e = SOME v) /\
               (sr.sr_typeof_val v = t))
       ))

name: symb_val_eq_sound_def
symb_mk_exp_eq_f_sound_def
statement:
symb_mk_exp_eq_f_sound sr =
      ((!e1 e2 H.
         (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
         (sr.sr_interpret_f H (sr.sr_mk_exp_eq_f e1 e2) = SOME sr.sr_val_true) =
         ((sr.sr_interpret_f H e1 <> NONE) /\
          (OPTREL sr.sr_val_eq (sr.sr_interpret_f H e1) (sr.sr_interpret_f H e2)))) /\
       (!e1 e2. sr.sr_symbols_f (sr.sr_mk_exp_eq_f e1 e2) =
         sr.sr_symbols_f e1 UNION sr.sr_symbols_f e2))

name: symb_mk_exp_conj_f_sound_def
statement:
symb_mk_exp_conj_f_sound sr =
      ((!e1 e2 H.
         (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
         (sr.sr_interpret_f H (sr.sr_mk_exp_conj_f e1 e2) = SOME sr.sr_val_true) =
         ((sr.sr_interpret_f H e1 = SOME sr.sr_val_true) /\
          (sr.sr_interpret_f H e2 = SOME sr.sr_val_true))) /\
       (!e1 e2. sr.sr_symbols_f (sr.sr_mk_exp_conj_f e1 e2) =
         sr.sr_symbols_f e1 UNION sr.sr_symbols_f e2))

name: symb_expr_conj_eq_def
statement:
symb_expr_conj_eq sr e1 e2 conj1 =

name: symb_mk_exp_symb_f_sound_def
statement:
symb_mk_exp_symb_f_sound sr =
      ((!H symb v.
         (symb_interpr_get H symb = SOME v) ==>
         (sr.sr_interpret_f H (sr.sr_mk_exp_symb_f symb) = SOME v)) /\
       (!symb. sr.sr_symbols_f (sr.sr_mk_exp_symb_f symb) = {symb}))

name: symb_mk_exp_symb_f_sound_typeof_def
statement:
symb_mk_exp_symb_f_sound_typeof sr =
      (!symb.
         sr.sr_typeof_exp (sr.sr_mk_exp_symb_f symb) = SOME (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb))

name: symb_mk_exp_neg_f_sound_def
statement:
symb_mk_exp_neg_f_sound sr =
       (!symbexp. sr.sr_symbols_f (sr.sr_mk_exp_neg_f symbexp) = sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp)

name: symb_subst_f_sound_def
statement:
symb_subst_f_sound sr =
      (!symb symb_inst symbexp symbexp_r.
       (!H H' v.
          (sr.sr_typeof_exp symb_inst = SOME (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb)) ==>
          (sr.sr_subst_f (symb, symb_inst) symbexp = symbexp_r) ==>
          

          (sr.sr_interpret_f H symb_inst = SOME v) ==>
          ((symb_interpr_update H (symb, SOME v)) = H') ==>

          (sr.sr_interpret_f H  symbexp_r =
           sr.sr_interpret_f H' symbexp)) /\
       ((sr.sr_subst_f (symb, symb_inst) symbexp = symbexp_r) ==>
        (sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp_r = ((sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp) DIFF {symb}) UNION
           (if symb IN (sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp) then sr.sr_symbols_f symb_inst else EMPTY)))
      )

name: symb_subst_f_sound_NOTIN_def
statement:
symb_subst_f_sound_NOTIN sr =
      (!symb symb_inst symbexp.
          (sr.sr_typeof_exp symb_inst = SOME (sr.sr_typeof_symb symb)) ==>
          (symb NOTIN sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp) ==>
          (sr.sr_subst_f (symb, symb_inst) symbexp = symbexp)
      )

name: symb_step_sound_def
statement:
symb_step_sound sr =
    (!sys Pi.
     (sr.sr_step_symb sys = Pi) ==>
     (!s H s'.
       (symb_matchstate sr sys H s) ==>
       (sr.sr_step_conc s = s') ==>
       (?sys'. sys' IN Pi /\ symb_matchstate sr sys' H s')
     )
    )

name: symb_rule_TRANSF_GEN_thm
statement:

  (!H s s'.
     (symb_minimal_interpretation sr sys H) ==>
     (symb_matchstate sr sys H s) ==>




     (symb_matchstate_ext sr sys2 H s') ==>
     (symb_matchstate_ext sr sys2' H s')
  ) ==>

  (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys, L, (Pi DIFF {sys2}) UNION {sys2'}))

name: symb_fresh_simplification_matchstate_IMP_matchstate_thm
statement:

  (symb_symbst_pcond_update
     (symb_expr_conj_eq sr (sr.sr_mk_exp_symb_f symb) symb_exp)
     (symb_symbst_store_update var symbexp' sys)
   = sys'
  ) ==>

  (symb_simplification sr (symb_symbst_pcond sys') symbexp symbexp') ==>


  (symb_matchstate sr sys H s) ==>

  ((symb_interpr_extend_symbs_sr sr (symb_symbols sr sys') (symb_interpr_update H (symb, sr.sr_interpret_f H symb_exp))) = H') ==>

name: symb_FRESH_simplification_TRANSF_matchstate_ext_thm

name: symb_rule_FRESH_thm

)

name: symb_interprs_eq_for_INST_thm
statement:

  (symb_interpr_dom H_4 = sys1mbs UNION sys2mbs UNION {symb}) ==>

  ((symbs DELETE symb) INTER (sys2mbs DIFF sys1mbs) = EMPTY) ==>

statement:

  (symb_pcondwiden sr (symb_symbst_pcond sys1) pcond) ==>
  ((sr.sr_symbols_f pcond) SUBSET (sr.sr_symbols_f (symb_symbst_pcond sys1))) ==> 
  

  (symb_symbst_pcond_update
     (sr.sr_mk_exp_conj_f pcond)
     (sys2)
   = sys2'
  ) ==>

  (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys1, L, Pi)) ==>
  (symb_hl_step_in_L_sound sr (sys1, L, (Pi DIFF {sys2}) UNION {sys2'}))

name: symb_pcondinf_def
statement:
symb_pcondinf sr pcond =
  (!H.
    (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
    (symb_interpr_for_symbs (sr.sr_symbols_f pcond) H) ==>
    (sr.sr_interpret_f H pcond <> SOME sr.sr_val_true)
  )

name: symb_pcondwiden_def
statement:
symb_pcondwiden sr pcond pcond' =
    (!H.
      (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
      (symb_interpr_for_symbs ((sr.sr_symbols_f pcond) UNION (sr.sr_symbols_f pcond')) H) ==>
      (sr.sr_interpret_f H pcond = SOME sr.sr_val_true) ==>
      (sr.sr_interpret_f H pcond' = SOME sr.sr_val_true))

name: symb_pcondwiden_sys_def
statement:
symb_pcondwiden_sys sr sys sys' = (
    (symb_symbst_extra sys =
     symb_symbst_extra sys') /\
    (symb_symbst_pc sys =
     symb_symbst_pc sys') /\
    (symb_symbst_store sys =
     symb_symbst_store sys') /\
    (symb_pcondwiden sr (symb_symbst_pcond sys) (symb_symbst_pcond sys'))
  )

name: symb_simplification_def
statement:
symb_simplification sr pcond symbexp symbexp' =
    (!H.
       (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
       (symb_interpr_for_symbs
            ((sr.sr_symbols_f pcond) UNION
             (sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp) UNION
             (sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp')) H) ==>

       (sr.sr_interpret_f H pcond = SOME sr.sr_val_true) ==>
       (sr.sr_interpret_f H symbexp = sr.sr_interpret_f H symbexp')
    )

name: symb_weak_bool_def
statement:
symb_weak_bool sr symbexp =
    (!H.
       (symb_interpr_welltyped sr H) ==>
       (symb_interpr_for_symbs (sr.sr_symbols_f symbexp) H) ==>

       (sr.sr_interpret_f H symbexp = SOME sr.sr_val_true
        \/
        sr.sr_interpret_f H (sr.sr_mk_exp_neg_f symbexp) = SOME sr.sr_val_true)
    )

name: bir_never_assumviol_ht
statement:
!prog l ls pre post.
    bir_prog_has_no_assumes prog ==>
    bir_exec_to_labels_or_assumviol_triple prog l ls pre post ==>
    bir_exec_to_labels_triple prog l ls pre post

name: bir_exec_to_labels_triple_def
statement:
bir_exec_to_labels_triple p l ls pre post =
  !s r.
    bir_env_vars_are_initialised s.bst_environ
                                 (bir_vars_of_program p) ==>
    ((s.bst_pc.bpc_index = 0) /\ (s.bst_pc.bpc_label = l)) ==>
    (s.bst_status = BST_Running) ==>
    bir_is_bool_exp_env s.bst_environ pre ==>
    (bir_eval_exp pre (s.bst_environ) = SOME bir_val_true) ==>
    ((bir_exec_to_labels ls p s) = r) ==>
    (?l1 c1 c2 s'.
      (r = BER_Ended l1 c1 c2 s') /\
      (s'.bst_status = BST_Running) /\
      bir_is_bool_exp_env s'.bst_environ (post s'.bst_pc.bpc_label) /\
      (bir_eval_exp (post s'.bst_pc.bpc_label) s'.bst_environ = SOME bir_val_true) /\
      ((s'.bst_pc.bpc_index = 0) /\ (s'.bst_pc.bpc_label IN ls))
    )

                                            (BLE_Label l2)
                              )
      ) ==>
      bir_is_bool_exp post1 ==>
      bir_is_bool_exp post2 ==>
      MEM l1 (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
      MEM l2 (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
      (bir_exec_block_cjmp_triple p bl 
        (bir_wp_exec_stmtsB bl.bb_statements
            (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And
              (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or
                (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not e)
                post1
              ) (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or e post2)
            )

name: bir_exec_to_labels_or_assumviol_triple_jmp
statement:
!p l bl l1 ls post post'.
      bir_wp_post_map_contains_bool_exp post ==>
      bir_is_well_typed_program p ==>
      bir_is_valid_program p ==>
      MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
      MEM l1 (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
      (SND(THE(bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p l)) = bl) ==>
      (bl.bb_last_statement = (BStmt_Jmp (BLE_Label l1))) ==>
      (((l1 IN ls) ==> (post' = (post l1))) /\
       ((~(l1 IN ls)) ==>
        (bir_exec_to_labels_or_assumviol_triple p l1 ls post' post) /\
        (bir_is_bool_exp post')
       )
      ) ==>
      (bir_exec_to_labels_or_assumviol_triple p l ls
        (bir_wp_exec_stmtsB bl.bb_statements post') post
      )

name: bir_exec_to_labels_or_assumviol_triple_cjmp
statement:
!p l bl e l1 l2 ls post post1' post2'.
      bir_wp_post_map_contains_bool_exp post ==>
      bir_is_well_typed_program p ==>
      bir_is_valid_program p ==>
      MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
      MEM l1 (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
      MEM l2 (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
      (SND (THE (bir_get_program_block_info_by_label p l)) = bl) ==>
      (bl.bb_last_statement = (BStmt_CJmp e (BLE_Label l1)
                                            (BLE_Label l2))
      ) ==>
      (((l1 IN ls) ==> (post1' = (post l1))) /\
       ((~(l1 IN ls)) ==>
         bir_exec_to_labels_or_assumviol_triple p l1 ls post1' post /\
         bir_is_bool_exp post1'
       )
      ) ==>
      (((l2 IN ls) ==> (post2' = (post l2))) /\
       ((~(l2 IN ls)) ==>
         bir_exec_to_labels_or_assumviol_triple p l2 ls post2' post /\
         bir_is_bool_exp post2'
       )
      ) ==>
      (bir_exec_to_labels_or_assumviol_triple p l ls
        (bir_wp_exec_stmtsB bl.bb_statements 
        (
          (BExp_BinExp BIExp_And 
            (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or (BExp_UnaryExp BIExp_Not e)
                                  post1'
            )
            (BExp_BinExp BIExp_Or e post2')
          )
        )
      ) post)

      bir_is_well_typed_program p ==>
      bir_is_valid_program p ==>

      FEVERY (\(l1, wp1). bir_is_bool_exp wp1) wps ==>
      ((bir_wp_exec_of_block p l ls wps post) = SOME wps') ==>
      (FEVERY (\(l1, wp1). bir_is_bool_exp wp1) wps')

name: bir_wp_exec_of_block_sound_thm
statement:
!p l ls post wps wps'.
      bir_wp_post_map_contains_bool_exp post ==>
      bir_is_well_typed_program p ==>
      bir_is_valid_program p ==>
      MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
      bir_edges_blocks_in_prog p l ==>
      FEVERY (\(l1, wp1). bir_is_bool_exp wp1) wps ==>
      FEVERY (\(l1, wp1).
               (bir_exec_to_labels_or_assumviol_triple p l1 ls wp1 post)) wps ==>
      ((bir_wp_exec_of_block p l ls wps post) = SOME wps') ==>
      (FEVERY (\(l1, wp1).
                (bir_exec_to_labels_or_assumviol_triple p l1 ls wp1 post)) wps')

name: bir_wp_exec_of_block_bool_exec_thm

      bir_is_well_typed_program p ==>

      ((bir_wp_exec_of_block p l ls wps post) = SOME wps') ==>

name: bir_wp_exec_of_block_sound_exec_thm
statement:
!p l ls post wps wps'.
    bir_wp_post_map_contains_bool_exp post ==>
    bir_is_well_typed_program p ==>
    bir_is_valid_program p ==>
    MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
    bir_edges_blocks_in_prog_exec p l ==>
    bir_bool_wps_map wps ==>
    bir_sound_wps_map p ls post wps ==>
    ((bir_wp_exec_of_block p l ls wps post) = SOME wps') ==>

name: bir_wp_exec_of_block_reusable_thm
statement:
!p l ls post wps wps'.
      bir_wp_post_map_contains_bool_exp post ==>
      bir_is_well_typed_program p ==>
      bir_is_valid_program p ==>
      MEM l (bir_labels_of_program p) ==>
      bir_edges_blocks_in_prog_exec p l ==>
      ((bir_bool_wps_map wps) /\
       (bir_sound_wps_map p ls post wps)
      ) ==>
      ((bir_wp_exec_of_block p l ls wps post) = SOME wps') ==>
